details.title: OutGraft
details.short_description: A high speed runner action game where you're always being chased. Vent your heat to knock enemies back, and survive with the power of parasites.

details.title: BitLoaf
details.short_description: Little 3D Loafs live on your Windows desktop. They wander, react to you, hang out with each other, and find their own fun while you work. Even secret characters! With more to come with updates.

details.title: The Shadow Cosmos
details.short_description: A 3D metroidvania with retro aesthetic. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious, dream-like world with non-linear exploration and progression, stylish and challenging fights with a powerful halberd, tricky parkour and puzzles. Collect shadows, unleash darkness.

details.title: Rec Room: A New Semester
details.short_description: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

details.title: FC Tycoon 2027
details.short_description: A data-driven football management simulation where you take control of your club's journey — from tactics, scouting and transfers to finances and facilities. Build your philosophy, shape your destiny, and lead your team to greatness.

details.title: The drawing of the Exodus
details.short_description: This is a summary of the Book of Exodus from the Bible, told using images generated by artificial intelligence and accompanied by brief captions.

details.title: Starwinder
details.short_description: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

details.title: Jester's Dungeon
details.short_description: An Obscure Dungeon Crawler where you a wizard, Dives into a dungeon to reclaim your stolen Relic from a wicked Jester. Sacrifice your blood to the Black Eye and use it's powers to survive, slay monsters and master the dungeon.

details.title: TCG Town
details.short_description: Make a living collecting cards or doing jobs in TCG Town. Create your character, play solo or join friends, and take your collection with you. Trade for that missing card, give a friend their favorite, or keep every last one for yourself.

details.title: Hypothesis Sudoku
details.short_description: A classic 9×9 Sudoku game built around logical deduction and branching hypotheses. Mark assumptions separately from deductions, manage candidates, backtrack through multiple branches, and progress through ten chapters containing 100,000 puzzles.

details.title: Matryoshka
details.short_description: Cursed entities that devour humans have gotten into the Matryoshka dolls. Inspect them with extreme caution. If you encounter a cursed doll, you must immediately burn and seal it away. A single mistake will be fatal.

details.title: Chess Lords
details.short_description: A cinematic medieval chess saga! Take on 12 rivals in the Campaign, play Free Battle, solve 24 checkmate puzzles and watch every capture become a brutal, piece-specific execution.

details.title: Swift Cultivation
details.short_description: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle cultivation game. Set your action queue and let time do the rest: breakthroughs happen on their own, food gets eaten for you, and every death makes you stronger. Fight, craft — and ascend.

details.title: Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者
details.short_description: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》 is a shooting game with a post-apocalyptic theme. Players will face the threats of zombies and rebels. They need to defend against zombie attacks, go out to explore, collect supplies and avoid the attacks of zombies and rebels.

details.title: Shanhai Phantasm
details.short_description: 《山海幻境：无限篇》是一款像素风卡牌RPG游戏，融合了三消特色玩法，放置挂机收益稳定，主打一个白嫖很舒服，微氪会更爽！上班摸鱼很爽，下班放空也很爽！登录直接百抽，每周8张自选英雄保底，所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，一起来沉浸体验探索山海神话的快感吧！

details.title: SquareFrontlineTD
details.short_description: Embark on a strategic journey in SquareFrontlineTD, a refreshing 3D low-poly tower defense game! Build unique towers on a floating block island, master three distinct game modes, and use gold to upgrade your defenses against endless waves of incoming blocky monsters.

details.title: HelloLove2:Binary
details.short_description: 2030: AI companions reshape romance. As an emotion engineer with missing memories, you awaken in a tangled love affair. A commanding boss, an awakened AI, an anti-AI rebel, and a mysterious system enter your life. Each choice rewrites fate. Is algorithmic love still love?

details.title: CHASA : Twilight Reaper
details.short_description: Become a Grim Reaper in this isometric horde-survival action game. Choose your weapon, combine and ascend your skills, and challenge powerful Guardians. Shape your build with gear and the Spirit Vein passive skill tree.

details.title: Chalk Thrower Simulator
details.short_description: Keep a sleepy class awake by throwing chalk then a duster to finish. Draft perks between periods, climb twelve Standards, outlast Detention, race the Daily or crack 32 chalk puzzles. Solo, online co-op or versus.

details.title: Incremental Pachinko Heaven
details.short_description: Launch balls! Upgrade the board! Earn mountains of medals—and keep paying off your debt! A short pachinko incremental with a skill tree that keeps giving you new ways to earn!

details.title: GOD OF DEFIANCE
details.short_description: A Journey to the West deckbuilder with shadow-puppet art and mahjong-powered combat. Choose your fighter, build card and relic combinations, read enemy intentions and take branching routes through a ten-chapter single-player expedition.

name: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness

details.title: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
details.short_description: Murmurs of Fear is a psychological horror about those left alone with the unexplainable. It is a self-contained story about fear, isolation, and the struggle to stay sane as reality itself begins to fracture.

details.title: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
details.short_description: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is an SNES-era inspired top-down action-adventure game where you explore magical dungeons, collect tools, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. What grade will you get? This game is proudly human-made.

details.title: Junk Tower Together
details.short_description: What are friends for if not to build a tower out of junk together... In Junk Tower Together, take turns stacking the most ridiculous objects, balance on the brink of disaster, and build a crazy tower with a group of up to 8 players.

details.title: Forge the Fates
details.short_description: Take deckbuilding to the next level. Transform your hand of cards into a tactical grid of runes. Plan, shift, and strike to unleash powerful combos and chain match-3 bonuses. Choose your hero, master their deck, and fight through deadly dungeons to face a mysterious dark overlord.

details.title: Meet the Rome
details.short_description: “All roads lead to Rome, but the tolls are strictly non-refundable.” Wrapped in the parchment of ancient bureaucracy, Meet the Rome is a satirical, choice-driven narrative game.

details.title: Necro Rising
details.short_description: Defeat the horde. Raise the fallen into a skeleton legion and lead it with your spells. Reclaim the Seal of Return, bring the dead home, and rebuild a workshop and a camp where people await your return. Eastern dark fantasy action. Play the free demo.

details.title: Slimy Dude
details.short_description: Slimy Dude is a semi-linear 3D gravity-puzzle platformer. Master running your way through gravity-bending puzzles, explore vibrant planetary zones, hunt for starship components to unlock new galaxies and track down a missing person to fulfil your promise!

details.title: Potato Factory
details.short_description: Stranded on Mars with a storm closing in, you need money for a rocket. Grow potatoes, sell your first batch of chips, and put your earnings into a bigger production line. Then the mutant potatoes arrive, right on schedule. What could you sell them for?

details.title: Slime Alchemy
details.short_description: Slime Alchemy is a relaxing puzzle game where you must place pieces in specific locations on a hexagonal grid.

details.title: Sengoku Fields of Empire
details.short_description: SENGOKU combines samurai action, economic management and grand strategy in feudal Japan. Lead the Tokugawa clan, build farms and trade networks, recruit warriors, forge alliances, conquer castles and rise through the Imperial Court to become Shogun.

name: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot

details.title: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
details.short_description: An incremental loot game where you drop your heroes onto hordes of slimes. They do the fighting, you grab the loot and fill your treasure chest. When time runs out, it bursts and rains it all back down. Upgrade your army in a huge skill tree and go again for a bigger haul.

details.title: SheepTag: Dragons
details.short_description: SheepTag returns with dragons. Build your lair, unleash magical abilities, and outwit wizard hunters—or grab a staff and chase the dragons down. Dive into a frantic, round-based multiplayer hunt packed with cunning escapes and close calls. SHEEPTAG IS BAAACK!

details.title: Arctic Drive
details.short_description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

details.title: Sunstone of Time
details.short_description: Step into the role of a brilliant scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secrets, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs.

details.title: Deadshift
details.short_description: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player & multiplayer, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave-30 boss, then keep fighting in endless mode.

details.title: Alone at  School:Christmas
details.short_description: Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric horror walking simulator. Arriving at school before everyone else on Christmas morning, you soon realize that someone, or something, is already waiting for you in the empty halls.

details.title: Meme Paint
details.short_description: Meme Paint is a unique take on the well-known Paint

details.title: Sort On The Ball
details.short_description: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

details.title: Incremental Pain Profit
details.short_description: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

details.title: Me and You
details.short_description: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

details.title: Canvas Attack!
details.short_description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

details.title: Snackrifice
details.short_description: Feed your hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. You decide which chaotic curses afflict your run as you overcome the many levels of Purgatory.

name: Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave

details.title: Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game where you play as a rat with a nose for cheese. Sniff out, stack, and shelve over 300 types of cheese and milk. Complete sets to earn wedges, unlock cheesy powers like the Cheese’nado, and turn delicious chaos into satisfying order.

details.title: Coma Dreams
details.short_description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

details.title: Hellstorm Gunners
details.short_description: Crew a B-17 Flying Fortress with up to nine friends. Fly her from take-off to landing, man the guns, fight the fires and bomb real targets. Play the solo campaign under your own name or eleven more modes, from factory raids to Zombie Rain. Bots man the empty guns.

details.title: Tidy Up: Gacha Collection
details.short_description: A cozy co-op gacha shop sim. Scoop capsules from the ball pool, crack them open and tidy 3,376 cute toys onto their shelves. Every toy earns yen each second: buy gacha machines and upgrades, complete 16 collections, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Stay Lit
details.short_description: You're the last ember. He's the jerk who blew out the rest. Roll through 130 trap-packed levels in 26 worlds while Snuff, a shadow imp, rigs each level right in front of you and takes notes on how you play, so the level changes after you die.

details.title: Tea ceremony simulator
details.short_description: A quiet tearoom, but chaos in your hands! A first-person tea ceremony simulator where you brew matcha yourself—holding, tilting, and spilling. Nothing is automated, so mistakes get served as is. Score 80+ three times in a row to face a special guest. Can you score a perfect 100?

details.title: ShotMachine
details.short_description: A turn-based western roguelite where your revolver is a slot machine. Load it round by round, fuse bullets into jackpot rounds, let your winnings ride at THE COUNT and take the rails all the way to The House, the casino at the end of the line.

details.title: NecroSmash
details.short_description: A first-person survivors-like for solo or co-op play. Dash, slide, and smash through hundreds of enemies across multi-level arenas, level up mid-run, and face a boss at the end of every level. Clear a run to unlock new classes and new areas to test them in.

details.title: A Sector Darkly
details.short_description: Command a ship and crew stranded far from home in this open-world space sandbox RPG. Explore, trade, fight, and craft to survive among the strange alien factions. One by one entire sectors are going dark and no one knows why. Solve the mystery of the dark sectors and get your crew home.

details.title: TCG Shop Life
details.short_description: Run your dream TCG shop! Stock shelves, open card packs, customize your store, and hire staff. Collect cards, build powerful decks, and even compete in tournaments all the way to the World Championship!

details.title: Son of Beach
details.short_description: Turn a filthy, rubbish-choked beach into a bustling seaside destination! Recycle litter, unlock powerful tools and vehicles, and clear rubbish mountains. Build facilities, run stalls and welcome visitors. Reinvest your earnings to bring the beach to life.

details.title: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
details.short_description: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

details.title: Clip Out: Backrooms
details.short_description: Play solo or in 2-player online co-op in this PSX style extraction roguelite based on the Backrooms. Explore procedural levels, scavenge for loot, and extract alive to upgrade your gear.

details.title: Cubetoria Pentomino Challenge
details.short_description: Twelve pieces. One perfect fit. Build all twelve pentominoes from real 3D cubes and fill the build plate, matching every lettered anchor. 220 computer-checked challenges on five plates, a Daily Challenge, Free Build and the Cubetoria crew to cheer you on.

details.title: Athelan Battlegrounds
details.short_description: Made by 2 people, Athelan Battlegrounds is an old school PvP turn-based tactics where player skill matters most. Build your team and engage in a meaningful battle of wits against other players in this "Chess meets LoL" indie game!

details.title: Dark Hours: Anomalies
details.short_description: Dark Hours: Anomalies is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. The Trickster has trapped your crew of thieves in an endless loop. Memorize every room and spot the anomalies to break the curse. Miss one and you start over. Can you beat it, or will you be trapped forever?

details.title: Sound Bounded
details.short_description: Sound is everything. Explore a dark, misty world, activate mysterious crystals and survive a relentless hunter who sees through sound. Scream to run faster, stay quiet to hide, and use the environment to your advantage. Every noise has consequences.

details.title: Limited-time Game Bundle Challenge
details.short_description: A bunch of Normal Retro Classic games, but what if, you need to change to another game when the Count Down ends. How many Score can you get?

details.title: Hop 'n' Karty
details.short_description: Hop and Marty are back in an all new Kart Racing game from Evilkookey games. Play as all your favourite characters from the Hop 'n' Marty and battle it out as you blast through the courses on your way to first place. Play alone or with friends and try to beat your best times.

details.title: Strato Alto
details.short_description: Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory! Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

name: Take This Thing Out Of Me

details.title: Take This Thing Out Of Me
details.short_description: It's a short game. But it can be a long one. It all depends on whether you were born under a lucky star... or whether you have the skill in your hands. Just... take the thing out!

details.title: Runecast
details.short_description: A pixel-art autobattler: cast runes, set your company across three lanes and watch your strategy decide the fight. Merge heroes, pick promotions, gear up your troop and march through four acts, from the Palisade to the Basalt Hall, against bosses that demand preparation.

details.title: Fleshborn
details.short_description: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.

details.title: Shelfish
details.short_description: Undo anything. Nothing locks. A cozy organizing puzzle where every drag snaps into place, a ghost shows exactly where each thing will land, and any mistake is one press from fixed. Tidy 40 levels across five rooms with Shelly the hermit crab, plus a fresh drawer every day.

details.title: Backmare: Return of the nightmare
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in Backmare, a psychological survival horror experience designed to twist your reality and test your sanity. Here, survival is not merely about running away—it is about piecing together a fractured truth forgotten by time.

details.title: Blaze Of Empires
details.short_description: Real-time strategy with armies and arcane magic. Choose Legionaries, Skelestians, or Antarions, gather food, wood and gold, build a base, and command a hero. An 11-mission campaign and Gods Challenge 9 stages and bosses with special attacks. Solo or co-op.

details.title: The Sixth Sin
details.short_description: The Sixth Sin is a horror game set in a suspense-filled atmosphere where you battle demons, supernatural beings, and puzzles, surviving through your own ingenuity. The voice guiding you is one of them. Manage your inventory, complete rituals, and never let go of the light or your magical items.

details.title: Beryl
details.short_description: Team up with up to three friends in a free-to-play action RPG. Build your hero from 720 skills, find rare gear, socket gems into your gear, and fight through 840 kinds of monsters and 14 colossal bosses on ever-harder world difficulties.

name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators

details.title: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
details.short_description: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

details.title: Spirestorm
details.short_description: Dive into enemies and rebound skyward in this arcade action roguelite. Climb a 25,400-metre tower, forge upgrades, and decide when to bank your haul.

details.title: Cucumber
details.short_description: One cucumber. One space bar. Suddenly, a collection. Make your cucumber jump, collect designs through activity in the game, combine cucumbers through crafting and display your favourites. A free meme game with optional cosmetic shop items.

name: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss

details.title: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
details.short_description: Run your very own cat cafe! Lead your cats on adventures into a magical city, gather ingredients to cook scrumptious dishes, customize your dream cafe, and bring bliss to your loyal customers in this cozy management lifesim. 🐱

details.title: Pocket Dynasty
details.short_description: Coach an American football team in modern-retro pixel art. Call every play, hand the headset to your coordinators, or take the snap yourself. Draft rookies, bring legends back as coaches, chase a title, and challenge a friend on one PC or online.

details.title: Decrypting Life
details.short_description: Decrypting Life is a short, nostalgic incremental game where you restore corrupted files to uncover a story from the 2000s

details.title: Coins in Place
details.short_description: Coins in Place is an incremental game where you work as a coin picker in a messy tavern. Pick up every coin before the day ends! Earn gems, buy upgrades, and recruit cats to help you. On Day 7, a mountain of coins awaits. Miss even one and you're stuck working another week.

details.title: Toe-tal War
details.short_description: TOE-TAL WAR is an action-puzzle platformer where you kill people with your foot smell. Run and jump to make your feet smelly, change your shoes and socks to control the smell — then get close to enemies and stink them to death. Some levels may require a little practice and hard thinking.

details.title: Warrior Quest
details.short_description: What would you say to a goblin if you could speak to it in your own words? Bribe it, lie to it, threaten it... or just chop its head off. Warrior Quest is an old-school dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where you can fight, sneak, bluff, or bargain your way through. Whatever you do, roll well!

details.title: Dopamine rogue
details.short_description: Manage your dopamine, earn money, build decks, and navigate life's challenges in this psychological life-simulation roguelike. Every choice shapes your story as you struggle to survive your own mind. A solo-developed project crafted over two years.

details.title: Before it Falls
details.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

details.title: Monsters Can Cook
details.short_description: You were a bad person in your past life, and now you'll have to work as a junior chef even after death. Buy questionable ingredients, cook for guests, and improve your skills until your restaurant gets five stars.

name: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit

details.title: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
details.short_description: S.O.S is a roguelike deck-building game built on blackjack. Collect cards, build your deck, and turn the odds of blackjack in your favor.

details.title: Valliberum Memory Challenges
details.short_description: Three tabletop memory games on one virtual table. Remember species and colour, plan a nature expedition, or match pairs across a mischievous 8x8 map. Play solo for a high score, locally against a friend, or against the CPU.

details.title: FRAGILE!
details.short_description: Online co-op moving company for 1–4 players. Carry sofas, pianos and chandeliers with both hands through 10 places and 40 contracts... and break nothing. A new Daily Contract every day, Steam leaderboards and Twitch chat chaos votes.

details.title: VICIOUS CIRCLE
details.short_description: Spiral into madness.

name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon

details.title: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a business empire with a workforce that's already dead. Recruit and train ghosts, run supernatural attractions, and balance profit, reputation and suspicion in this darkly humorous estate-management sim. The guests think it's all special effects. You know better.

details.title: BroCode
details.short_description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

details.title: Clocks Sleep at Zero
details.short_description: A puzzle game where every clock must count down to zero together!

details.title: Traymon World: Taskbar Monster RPG
details.short_description: The world’s smallest idle monster-collecting RPG. Hatch special monsters from eggs and trade with players around the world. Battles play out automatically, so don’t stop until you’ve built the strongest squad!

details.title: Stealing Them Softly
details.short_description: A popular Japanese visual novel by Dark One! — a touching story of two people torn by inner conflict and sorrow as they face separation from the one they love. What kind of ending awaits them…?

details.title: MYTHHUNT
details.short_description: Hunt cryptids in a hostile open forest, alone or with up to four players in co-op. Scavenge supplies, hunt wildlife, craft gear and customize firearms. Survive each encounter, reach extraction and bring your hard-earned loot back to the lodge.

details.title: Wildermeld
details.short_description: Hunt four dragons in a side-scrolling dark fantasy RPG. Explore a world generated anew each game, build your hero, brave dangerous dungeons, craft equipment and survive hunger, fatigue and the wilds. Earn four kingdoms' trust, with optional permadeath.

details.title: Prism Factory
details.short_description: Wire rainbows in a factory of light. A prism splits white light into red, green and blue. Bend the beams, mix them, and deliver the colour each order asks for: red and green make yellow. Orders keep coming, until your single white beam becomes rainbow wiring across the whole board.

details.title: HYPER BUTTERFLY
details.short_description: Fly, butterfly, fly!!! 15 original tracks. Custom mp3/ogg file support. Absolute madness and a breath of fresh air in the rhythm game genre! Have a nice day!!!

details.title: Zombie Apocalypse Together
details.short_description: Fight zombies, scavenge cities, explore the wild, hunt, craft and build a base in a world that is new every game. Start with nothing and survive with up to 3 friends. Every seventh night, the Blood Moon brings the horde to your walls.

details.title: NGL Biathlon 2027
details.short_description: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon simulator. Race as your favourite athlete, develop them in a career from junior to the Big Crystal Globe, build your own tournaments and take on real players online. Every discipline, relays included, and 15 tracks

details.title: 装甲奇兵
details.short_description: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. Start with Eileen / Ghost, unlock two more crews, fight nine stages, and push each battlefield from Easy to Nightmare.

details.title: 碧海遗城
details.short_description: Azure Ruins is a hex-board merge roguelike where shape, count, and rank drive your strategy. Pair Trait Runestones, Relic rules, and special mechanics to stack chains and multipliers. Spend limited Stamina to crack an island city's mechanisms, storm the Royal Vault, and climb global leaderboards.

details.title: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
details.short_description: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

details.title: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition
details.short_description: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

details.title: Salem 1692
details.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Join on your phone, accuse your neighbors, and root out the witches hiding in Salem before they turn the whole town against itself. One host screen, no downloads for players, pure social chaos.

details.title: Put It Away Please
details.short_description: It's summer vacation, and you put the groceries away exactly as your mother's notes say. A short puzzle-horror game in a PS1-style kitchen. Don't forget to turn around.[Estimated completion time: 30 minutes]

details.title: Oh Baby Blocks
details.short_description: A cozy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

details.title: Mischka Cars
details.short_description: Top-down combat racing with rockets, mines and oil, a career across five leagues, rollercoaster stunts on stilted tracks and car football with ramps and bumpers. Tune your car in the garage, build your own tracks and earn 75 achievements.

details.title: Kitsune Kart
details.short_description: Race as kemonomimi yokai girls through 24 courses of Japanese folklore, from fox shrines to Raijin's thunderclouds. Drift, boost and hurl yokai mischief at your rivals to take the lead.

details.title: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
details.short_description: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

details.title: Grave Mistakes
details.short_description: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

details.title: Coding War
details.short_description: Program a combat robot and send it to battle against other robots.

details.title: Big Climb
details.short_description: BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied by a real physical rope. Climb the mountain together before the colossal spider gets the one lagging behind.

details.title: Carnival: Tidy Up!
details.short_description: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!

details.title: Chronocracy
details.short_description: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

details.title: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow
details.short_description: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

details.title: Steal & Sell Simulator
details.short_description: Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.

details.title: No Road Home
details.short_description: Our goal is to let you build and defend your own base, recruit survivors, deploy automated defenses like combat drones and artillery, reclaim settlements from bandits and mutants, and upgrade your car in a hostile post-apocalyptic open world.

details.title: No Body No Problem!
details.short_description: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.

details.title: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist
details.short_description: A desktop alchemy game. Type and move your mouse to gather resources; control the heat, forge items, find rare affixes and fill your collection. Exchange supplies with other players. Eligible items can enter Steam Inventory and the Community Market. Internet required.

details.title: 7 Shifts in Subway
details.short_description: 7 Shifts in Subway is a first-person psychological horror game in which you play as a night-train operator. Keep an eye on passengers through cameras, follow strange subway rules, and try to survive seven shifts where every mistake could be your last.

details.title: Depthline
details.short_description: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.

details.title: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
details.short_description: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

details.title: Mirrorbane
details.short_description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy world with atmospheric pixel art. Recruit unique heroes, combine their cards into a single deck, and develop your team in town between expeditions.

details.title: Appulse
details.short_description: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!

details.title: Fool's Trigger
details.short_description: Welcome to the table where life is the stake. Fool’s Trigger is a tense mix of Russian roulette and a card game for 6. Load your revolver, manipulate the cards, put lives on the line, and dare to find out who will be the unluckiest today.

details.title: Hunter Road
details.short_description: Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters? Buy rifles at the shop? Defeated allies vanish forever? Welcome to the new standard of permadeath monster RPGs. Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

details.title: Stompworks
details.short_description: They fired you, then repossessed your whole town. They missed the mech under the tarp. Build a war machine from 59 parts, put a different gun on each arm, and stomp through 10 levels of wave combat and boss fights to take it all back. One mech. One run. No continues.

details.title: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together is a cozy first-person sorting game. Put 2,304 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes. Play alone or with up to three friends, learn useful abilities, assemble paintings and bring the theatre back to life.

details.title: Unknown Depths
details.short_description: Climb down a deep, dark shaft with up to three friends. A blind worm grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it follows your trail. Light holds it back, but not for long. Hook, swing and rappel deeper, while your friends' voices echo down the shaft.

details.title: Auto Mechanic Tidy Up
details.short_description: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

details.title: Midnight Yakiniku | 深夜焼肉
details.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a yakiniku restaurant in Japan. As the owner, you open the restaurant and welcome customers as usual. But that night, orders begin arriving from Table 7—a table that shouldn't exist...

name: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel

details.title: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel
details.short_description: There's something exciting about staying at a business hotel. A room you've never seen, a night all to yourself. What will you do? Please relax and enjoy your stay with us.

details.title: Attack of the Astrals
details.short_description: Heroes and villains fight the cosmos in this tactical roguelike! Every move unleashes an attack in quick battles that reward creative strategies. Combine necromancy, explosives, mimicry and more to thwart the evolving Astral threat!

details.title: Sombie
details.short_description: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

details.title: Kick The Piñata!
details.short_description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

details.title: Night Concierge
details.short_description: November 2003. Night shift at the front desk of a post-Soviet apartment block. Something is wearing your neighbors' faces. Check the resident log, question visitors over the intercom and call their apartment: if they answer from home, who's at the door? PS1-style first-person horror.

details.title: Vox Populi II: 2026-2029
details.short_description: Create or choose a character with a fully customizable ideology, campaign in elections across numerous countries, then take control of Parliament and the government to lead your nation as you see fit! Your own objectives will determine your victory conditions!

details.title: Street Food Restaurant Owner
details.short_description: Build your own street food business! Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, manage ingredients, unlock new recipes, and protect your reputation as you transform a small local food stall into a legendary destination.

details.title: Shark Mart
details.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

details.title: Voidrush
details.short_description: Pilot your rocket through an endless 3D tunnel, from the planet's surface into space. Dodge rotating obstacles, risk a boost for extra points and beat your personal best. Play solo or challenge up to three computer opponents. German-language interface.

details.title: RUN Gor I
details.short_description: Are you capable of mastering your own body? Do you know what you need to eat? Move and build the protein your body needs before you run out of time. Face your dreams and obtain the necessary nutrients, avoid the monsters, and run. You are not alone.

details.title: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
details.short_description: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

details.title: Idle Demon Slayer
details.short_description: Build a party of up to five heroes in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG. Auto-battle for gear with random affixes and collect offline rewards. Combine formations, combat styles, and cultivation manuals to take on secret-realm bosses and climb the Endless Tower.

details.title: Kill Loot Heal Repeat
details.short_description: Descend into an endless dungeon in this turn-based roguelike RPG! Fight monsters, collect loot, and master skills through use. Gather resources, craft weapons, brew potions, and cook food to survive. Manage hunger, overcome deadly encounters, and grow stronger. How deep can you descend?

details.title: TrapRush
details.short_description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

details.title: Planet Chess
details.short_description: Six boards. Two players. One ultimate showdown. Planet Chess transforms classic chess into an intense multiplayer battle where you fight across six independent boards at once. Outsmart your opponent, master every move, and claim victory!

name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price

details.title: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
details.short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

details.title: Loop Minesweeper
details.short_description: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.

details.title: Gravity Switch
details.short_description: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

details.title: Farmer's Diary
details.short_description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.

details.title: Train Station Staff Simulator
details.short_description: First-person sim: work at a small, new one-line station in Japan. Open up at dawn, sort out trouble at the gates, announce delays, hit the emergency stop if someone falls onto the tracks: over 60 kinds of real station work. Even with a subway line, you're one person sharing the work with your crew.

details.title: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

details.title: Reshine
details.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

details.title: Eyelord Returns
details.short_description: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

details.title: 4th Supplementary
details.short_description: You are trapped in an endless, haunted school loop. Evade the lingering spirit, seal the anomalies, and find a way out before it's too late.

details.title: The Pogo Witch
details.short_description: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

details.title: A Cold Comfort
details.short_description: A tragic yuri visual novel about wolfgirls, selfish cruelty, and the grim inevitability of death. Lost deep in the frostbitten frozen tundra, a group of intrepid explorers on a doomed expedition die one by one as the cold slowly creeps in.

details.title: Ship Miner
details.short_description: Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

details.title: TaskBound Saga
details.short_description: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 12 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, equip the gear and upgrade your party.

details.title: Put Out The Sun
details.short_description: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Land on the Sun as a crew of four-armed aliens, spit and spray it dark, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the last flicker. For 1-6 players.

details.title: TOP STEED
details.short_description: Enter the world of high-speed horse racing! Saddle up and drift across over-the-top tracks in this multiplayer racing game with realistic riding controls. Claim victory with your TOP STEED!

details.title: Reflections at Frostkorn
details.short_description: On the early morning he comes of age, Yu begins the sacred journey to the foothill of Mountain Frostkorn.

details.title: No Mercy
details.short_description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

details.title: Watch My Step!
details.short_description: Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!

details.title: Shiver Slopes
details.short_description: A fast-paced action game where you ski through dangerous slopes, dodge obstacles, and shoot enemies (in bullet time) while navigating procedurally generated mountains. Race for high scores or beat your best times.

details.title: QuizForge
details.short_description: Create quizzes with images, audio and videos. Play solo, together on one PC or online via Steam. Connect smartphones over your local network, and discover or share quiz packs on Steam Workshop.

details.title: Shole Soccer
details.short_description: Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

details.title: Slop Squad
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Vacuum up valuable scrap from procedurally generated maps and get it back to the scrap crusher before the things lurking inside get you.

details.title: Galactic Arms
details.short_description: Command a mighty fleet of battleships. Upgrade and customise your ships with powerful modules, and traverse the cosmos to outmanoeuvre and defeat your opponents in this strategic single-player card game.

details.title: Slots Up!
details.short_description: A short, incremental game about rigging a slot machine to become a millionaire.

details.title: SwitcHead
details.short_description: SwitcHead is a chaotic online co-op game for 2 where you control your friend's head... and they control yours. Shout directions, search the factory, crack the safes and build each brick toy before the conveyor belt carries it away!

details.title: Near The Sun
details.short_description: Near The Sun is a 2D action-adventure game where you slice through enemy lines with sharp dashes and race across a collapsing underworld. Experience a story that changes depending on the order you explore, and discover a way to save a girl from a long-lost "previous world."

details.title: A Real Life Party
details.short_description: hey ill be there soon. u should go in tho my roommates are super chill.

details.title: Split Brain Samsara
details.short_description: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

details.title: Charmosaic
details.short_description: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.

details.title: RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign
details.short_description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by Dan Fournie and originally published in C3i magazine. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

details.title: Tilt Siege
details.short_description: A pinball roguelite about holding a castle. An army marches down the table toward your keep: smash it with the ball, tilt the whole table to dump soldiers into the spikes, and build towers and bumpers between waves.

details.title: Slice of Fortune
details.short_description: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Upgrade your blade to make it bigger and sharper than ever, slice every fruit in existence, and sell their juice through the Pachinko shop to grow richer and unlock powerful upgrades through the Skill Tree.

details.title: Ghost Girl Requiem
details.short_description: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices you make in each chapter shape the story's final ending.

details.title: The Caffeine Chronicles
details.short_description: A philosophical interactive visual novel about everyday interactions

details.title: Jingle Janitor
details.short_description: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

details.title: ArkSeed Terraformery
details.short_description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time. Arkseed Terraformery is a 2D factory and colony building and automation game with physics.

details.title: Flak Simulator
details.short_description: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

name: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero

details.title: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
details.short_description: Age of Failon is a turn-based dark fantasy strategy RPG where exploration and battle drive your progression. Build your army through adventure instead of weekly creature spawns, develop your stronghold, unlock spells and lead your hero through a massive 30-chapter campaign with 6 playable realms.

details.title: Via Libera: Italian Train Driver
details.short_description: Drive a regional electric train from the cab on the real Florence–Empoli–Pisa line. Wake it from cold, read Italian signals, take the dispatcher's radio orders and keep 92 timetable services on time through rain, fog and night. Early Access.

details.title: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
details.short_description: A 2D painterly fishing game for people who just want to fish. Read the water, pick your lure and fight bass that fight back. No crops, no mines, no energy meter. Chill on the water. Hard on the hook.

details.title: Automotive Tycoon
details.short_description: Found a carmaker in 1890 and keep it alive until 2040. Design cars part by part, grow your works from a shed to an assembly line, sell across a world shaped by wars, oil shocks and laws — and spend political capital to bend that history.

name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix

details.title: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
details.short_description: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.

details.title: GUNBOAT-8
details.short_description: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.

details.title: Another Map Simulator
details.short_description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

details.title: SoulRoad
details.short_description: Rhythm racing meets vehicular combat. Drive, drift, jump and smash to the beat across rollercoaster skies, sunset canyons and trinary star rings. Master 19 distinct rides, survive pack battles, and race your friends over LAN multiplayer.

details.title: NinMaki
details.short_description: What do you know as a ninja? An expert in stealth? Or a powerful killing machine? NinMaki is a side-scrolling action puzzle game where you experience a ninja mission.

details.title: Paid Parking Simulator
details.short_description: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.

details.title: Mars Colony Simulator
details.short_description: Stranded alone on Mars. Mine iron and ice with a tactile beam, rebuild a broken colony, and survive the freezing night on stored sunlight and rationed oxygen — while a sandworm's dust plume crawls the horizon. An austere low-poly survival builder about earning your way home.

details.title: Blank Slate
details.short_description: Blank Slate is a first-person crime sandbox — craft graded fake IDs, run shady storefronts, launder dirty cash, hire a crew — ID makers, a dealer and a store manager — train them up, pay their wages, and let them lift the work, and outrun the heat in a city that looks the other way.

details.title: Build Bigger Heroes
details.short_description: Recruit, equip, fuse, and evolve your own fantasy heroes. Build an army of up to eight in this pixel art roguelite autobattler, discover powerful combinations, and test them across three acts. Choose your encounters, rescue magical Wonders, and forge heroes worth remembering.

details.title: The Funeral of Kay
details.short_description: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.

details.title: Joe Silva: Solo Trip
details.short_description: N2O Joe Silva Solo Trip is a puzzle game where the goal is to help Joe overcome obstacles, collect oranges, and rescue magic flowers to reach the final cube before the path disappears. The game features 45 unlocked levels, a minimalist visual style, and no microtransactions.

details.title: Goshiwon | 고시원
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a cramped Korean goshiwon. You and your friend make fake ghost videos for views. But something that looks exactly like his costume gets one step closer every day.

details.title: Vibe Train
details.short_description: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

details.title: Digging In The Desert
details.short_description: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

details.title: DUST & DEBT
details.short_description: Framed for a debt of one billion in a ruined world. Explore 10 km × 10 km of Ashfall and shape your build with over 2,500 gear designs and branching skills. Find a loyal canine companion, uncover the truth behind the debt, and confront the man who took your freedom.

details.title: 少女三国志
details.short_description: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。

details.title: Survivor Town
details.short_description: Survivor Town blends colony management, autonomous survivor simulation, and tower defense in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit unique survivors, build production chains, research technology, craft equipment, explore dangerous lands, and defend your settlement against daily raids and powerful Bosses.

details.title: 1000 Milliarden Dollar - Kohle und Stahl
details.short_description: Essen, 1807: Grow your family business into an industrial conglomerate. Trade, manufacture, and invest in new technology. In this turn-based business and family simulation, you’ll guide your dynasty through wars and crises until 1933—and decide who will carry on your life’s work.

details.title: Point Zero: Victoria
details.short_description: One cold case, four deathbed flashbacks. Every shift in perspective overturns the "truth" you believed. Story-driven, with exploration, deduction, puzzles, and combat. Ready for a mind-bending thrill ride with twists at every turn?

details.title: Iron Dawn
details.short_description: Pilot devastating war machines as a mercenary in an tactical mech shooter. Choose your contract, customize your loadout, deploy into fully destructible battlefields, and extract with your earnings. Get paid, upgrade your arsenal, and take on increasingly dangerous missions.

details.title: 暴走拆城 (Rampage Demolition)
details.short_description: Pilot an auto-firing weapons platform through swarms of machines in this top-down action roguelite. Level up and evolve weapons, trigger chain collapses, and cut the power to industrial districts across nine maps.

details.title: The False Alice -Retold Tale-
details.short_description: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.

details.title: Just a Villager MMORPG
details.short_description: You don't need to be a hero to protect someone's tomorrow. Set out as just a villager in this 8-bit MMORPG. Cross paths with other players, help each other, and uncover the world's secrets to the end. Play with strangers, friends, or solo. Then the Trial Tower awaits. Buy once, no subscription.

details.title: Dice Tiny Town
details.short_description: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

details.title: Pest Protocol
details.short_description: Pest Protocol is a short incremental game about a very tired exterminator, a cursor, and infested sites that refuse to stay clean. Squash some pests, buy yourself better tools, and eventually let the whole operation run itself while you make a cup of tea.

details.title: Mole & Ore
details.short_description: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

details.title: Infinite Loop: Incremental
details.short_description: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

details.title: GhostomVillage
details.short_description: Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive. Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

details.title: Return to college
details.short_description: How do you define university? Beyond classes, will you shop, date, exercise, or work part-time? How will you treat roommates, classmates, and everyone you meet: friendly, warm, or cold? After graduation, study abroad, find a course-related job, or freelance? Return to university; find your answer.

details.title: Bust 10
details.short_description: Bust 10 is a chaotic, family-friendly party card game blending pot betting with sabotage. Bet, bluff, and use items to outsmart rivals. When someone busts, the winner smashes them with punishment props! Single-player now; online multiplayer in development.

details.title: Arcana Rift: Tactics
details.short_description: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

details.title: Touhou Auto Chess
details.short_description: Touhou Auto Chess is a single-player roguelite auto battler based on the Touhou Project. Recruit companions from Gensokyo and build diverse team compositions by combining equipment, treasures, and synergies. Discover fresh combos with your favorite characters!

details.title: Antiutopia
details.short_description: Antiutopia is a fast-paced, skill-based multiplayer FPS set in a fractured sci-fi world. Built from the ground up in a custom engine by a solo developer, it delivers classic arena gun-play, tight matches, and pure competitive action. No progression grind, no gimmicks, just skill.

details.title: Metal Wayfarer
details.short_description: Build your mech. Break their war machines. Metal Wayfarer is a single-player action shooter where you swap weapons, torsos and legs, boost through firefights, and bring down towering bosses. Reclaim an occupied island and turn Iron Legion salvage into your next upgrade.

details.title: Just Weeding
details.short_description: Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim. Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!

details.title: Defend The Wall
details.short_description: Choose your hero. Kill demons. Collect gold. Build your army. Upgrade Skills. Defend the wall. In this army building incremental game, you must amass the strongest army you can to survive waves of demons and defeat the Demon Lord.

details.title: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
details.short_description: Refluff is a first-person ASMR sim about running your own rug-washing workshop. Scrape, soak, foam, scrub and squeegee filthy carpets clean on a real fluid simulation. Get paid for every percent, upgrade your tools, take on bigger, dirtier rugs.

details.title: Linlang's Ledger
details.short_description: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

details.title: Desktop Island: Idle Together!
details.short_description: Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.

details.title: Hide & Chisel
details.short_description: Carve your body out of marble, and stand as still as a statue! Hide & Chisel is a hide-and-seek game where you carve a block of stone into any shape you can think of. Hide from the Curator and his hammer!

details.title: Desktop Divinity
details.short_description: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.

details.title: BPM Boy
details.short_description: BPM Boy is a physics-based platformer, featuring hidden secrets, leaderboards for speed-runners and a funky original soundtrack.

details.title: 2D Hates 3D
details.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as Commander, leading a squad of flat 2D shapes against an invasion of 3D ones. Clear timed waves, collect scrap. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from squad damage to time-bending perks. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

details.title: Monster Showdown
details.short_description: Survive escalating waves of monsters in a fast-paced first-person horde shooter. Earn cash, build your arsenal, upgrade your weapons, grab powerful Perk Donuts, repair defenses, defeat bosses, and unlock wild modifiers that change the way you play.

details.title: Tanks & Trebuchets
details.short_description: A WW2 tank in a medieval world, fighting armies of several hundred soldiers at a time and knocking down their castles. There is an open-world campaign, a Gauntlet roguelike mode, and online co-op and PvP with friends for up to four players.

details.title: The Film Archive
details.short_description: Restore order to a film archive in this cozy first-person sorting game. Inspect films, reunite numbered reels, and shelve 400 films across three floors. Unlock useful upgrades and turn towering piles of film cans into a satisfying, organized collection.

details.title: Meow Star Archives
details.short_description: Restore the cats' damaged memory archives in this hand-drawn puzzle game. And you'll also discover the stories of these lovely cats before they returned to the stars! No timers, just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place. Come and enjoy some cozy moments with these lovely cats!

details.title: KINETET
details.short_description: A falling-block puzzle driven by physics. Adjust your angle and power to launch blocks that roll, tumble, and stack. Connect same-colored blocks from wall to wall to clear them, and compete with players worldwide for the high score on the online leaderboards!

details.title: MeowFactory
details.short_description: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

details.title: Lumanto
details.short_description: A free fantasy RPG of hooded heroes and 350+ magical creatures. Play on your own whenever you want, or join a live stream's caravan from Steam or the Twitch chat. Build your heroes, tame creatures, forge gear and trade in a player market powered by Lúmen.

details.title: Box Them Cats
details.short_description: Box Them Cats is a cozy drag-and-drop puzzle game. Grab wandering cats, sort them into the right-sized boxes, recycle the sneaky trash bags, and take on clients’ challenges to earn goddess blessings.

details.title: Paragra: Paragliding Adventure
details.short_description: Paragra is a 2D arcade paragliding game. Climb in thermals, become an XC league hero and win competitions. Read the sky and don't land in a field too early.

details.title: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME
details.short_description: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

details.title: Newborn
details.short_description: Newborn is a 3D online fantasy RPG for Windows where every journey begwins at the very start of a life. Create a character, step into the medieval town of Rokento, and set out across a living continent of desert dunes, frozen glaciers, misty marshlands, open seas and far-off islands.

details.title: CRT TD
details.short_description: Use your retro gadget weapons to defend against the mutated tech bros. On your turn, position your gadget weapons, prepare your defensive gadgets and grow your economy. Test your strategy and your build against encounters in procedurally generated levels.

details.title: The Endless Harvest
details.short_description: The Endless Harvest is an idle village-builder crossed with a tower defense. Build a farm that earns money on its own, invest it in towers and upgrades, and survive waves of raiders that grow stronger every round. Production continues while the game is closed — how far will you get?

details.title: Unearther
details.short_description: Explore a handcrafted-procedural world where discoveries and challenging adventures await. Gather resources, craft equipment, build your home, survive dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden within.

details.title: Blubbis Abenteuer
details.short_description: German-language interactive children’s book with full German voice narration – no English version available

details.title: webFPV
details.short_description: Learn FPV from your first hover to a pro licence. Race five inch and whoop tracks, freestyle a whole town (even upside down in 3D mode), build your own maps, then play six mini games. A manga styled drone sim that runs fully offline.

details.title: Infinite Crosswalk
details.short_description: Infinite Crosswalk is a psychedelic walking simulator and horror game in retro 3D style. You get hit on a zebra crossing and trapped in limbo. Uncover the victims' tragic stories to escape — or pay with parts of your own body.

details.title: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

details.title: Cargo Lines
details.short_description: Build a bustling railway network and juggle cargo transport in real time. New stations appear, the flow of goods shifts constantly, deadlines loom, and trains collide if you don't keep your eyes on them. Keep your cool and master the chaos as orders pile up, and every second counts.

details.title: Carry On Together
details.short_description: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

details.title: Island Sort
details.short_description: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

details.title: Empire Water Works
details.short_description: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

details.title: 狂猎世界
details.short_description: As a tactician, the player will take on the role of a demon hunter squad commander. Lead your team into the dungeon to collect resources and develop the team, confront the combat challenge known as "Flood," and ultimately succeed in passing the final trial.

details.title: Dog Soup
details.short_description: Your significant other is coming home in a few minutes. The pot is empty. And a hungry beast is running around the house eating your vegetables. Grab them, carry them, throw them in the soup, and try not to get hit with a rolling pin!

details.title: MOI
details.short_description: After an embarrassing video, Mimp tries a makeover that promises a perfect face and effortless confidence. It also makes caring feel unnecessary. A short psychological horror visual novel about shame, appearance, and deciding what you can afford to lose.

details.title: Dear Gardener
details.short_description: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals. Mow the lawns, trim the hedges, water the flowers and send the harvest to market. Everyone who hires you is lovely. Everyone who hires you is hiding something.

details.title: Patch Zero
details.short_description: You are a tiny security agent inside a hacked corporate network. Blast through server rooms infested with worms, botnets, trojans and ransomware, pick upgrades, and reach the Core Server in this fast top-down roguelite.

details.title: 多元幸存者 Diverse survivors
details.short_description: Diverse survivors is a 2D top-down solo ARPG horde survival game. Fight monster swarms, enchant single skills, loot random affix gear and unlock set bonuses with full armor sets. Make unique builds, explore multiverse dungeons alone and grow strong with gear enchantment systems.

details.title: Our Life: Now & Forever
details.short_description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

details.title: Studio Sim
details.short_description: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.

details.title: PAYDIRT: Gold Mining Tycoon
details.short_description: Start with a tent, a shovel and an empty wallet. Pan your first gold, hire a crew and earn your way to heavy machinery in a clay-styled mining management sim. Choose your prospector, explore with Pepper and build a mine that pays.

name: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop

details.title: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a wrecked magic wand shop. Find a home for 2,400 wands, tidy up the elemental halls and unlock handy upgrades. Play at your own pace, with no timers and no fail state.

details.title: Mammalarium
details.short_description: Relax and collect over 500 unique mammals in this cozy idle game. Watch babies grow into magnificent adults in real-time, customize warm woodland habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from tiny shrews to great whales.

details.title: Sime Returns
details.short_description: Sime Returns is a quirky, darkly comedic action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and the island that decided it no longer likes him. Rescue your cats from furious villagers, and unravel the mysteries lurking beneath the sunny shores of the Adriatic.

details.title: Creator Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a creator company with your own studio and production team. Combine production cards, design workflows, and furnish your workspace with equipment and housing items in this management sim. Develop your staff, grow channels, and expand through sponsorships and creator contracts.

details.title: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
details.short_description: Turn robot pursuit into a collision trap. Outsmart malfunctioning machines in turn-based grid strategy with tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport. Take on 50 campaign levels, endless Survival, ASCII Classic, and a Weekly Challenge with replay-verified online rankings.

details.title: Taskbar Fishing & Aquarium
details.short_description: An idle fishing and aquarium game for the corner of your desktop. While you work, a small window quietly fishes for you. Collect 35 species across 10 rarity tiers, then decorate your tank with castles, rocks and coral to build the aquarium you want.

details.title: Tinsel Tumble
details.short_description: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

details.title: How Smart Are You
details.short_description: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

details.title: Lifeguard Simulator
details.short_description: Guard the beach, react fast, and save lives using quads, jet skis and drones. Patrol the bay, help those in need and uncover a hidden criminal intrigue beneath the waves.

details.title: Tidy Mall Together
details.short_description: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 7000 runaway things back onto the shelves of 18 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

details.title: Bio Inc. Total Defense
