details.title: Harmony Of Tea
details.short_description: Small relaxing puzzle game where you need to find the right place for tea on a shelf. Travel from Yunnan Province to Shanghai as a tea courier, explore charming provinces and discover unique tea flavors.

details.title: Frogball
details.short_description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Super cute retro fantasy pinball, packed to the gills with old-school fun.

details.title: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story
details.short_description: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.

details.title: Citystate Metropolis
details.short_description: The creative, pragmatic, limitless city builder. Engineer a masterpiece of urban design, a small sustainable town or a futuristic metropolis. With procedurally generated buildings, grid-less zoning and powerful editor tools, everything is customizable: the city is yours.

details.title: UPG Cubed
details.short_description: A fast-paced minimalist platformer where precision is everything. Master jumping, wall-jumping and dashing, collect diamonds, beat challenging levels and push your skills to the limit. And create your own levels in UPG Cubed

details.title: Trivia Arena: The Grand Stage
details.short_description: A party trivia game show on a grand velvet stage. Up to 8 friends join with their phones as controllers: no app, just scan the QR code. Answer wrong and your plush drops through a trapdoor. Three game modes, thousands of questions, seasonal events and online play with friends.

details.title: MazeParty
details.short_description: Ruin your friends' plans and turn the tables in MazeParty, a 4-player online board party game. Roll dice together, navigate a maze in first person, and get in each other's way with items. Earn gold in 20 minigames and collect keys to chase the final victory.

details.title: Night of the Living Toys
details.short_description: A cozy co-op toy sorting game. Play with three friends or solo. Two modes to choose from: dig through a huge pile of toys or open boxes and complete sets. Fill every shelf before the store opens and keep its secret!

details.title: Cave Crawler
details.short_description: Embark on an adventure inspired by Gameboy era games. Explore, fight bosses, and earn resources! Travel across islands and towns to engage in subtle, lore rich story.

details.title: Outcity
details.short_description: Tired of big city life, you move to Outcity to start fresh in the countryside. Build your farm your way in a cozy sandbox where imagination has no limits and friendly villagers help your homestead grow into a thriving village. Gather your determination, your creativity, and get to work!

details.title: Jumplife
details.short_description: Jumplife is a minimalistic platformer with lots of wall jumping and wall sliding.

details.title: Royal Bomb Squad POP!
details.short_description: Blast colorful jawbreakers in this cartoon bubble shooter! Eight delightful weirdos with eight different playstyles, across Story, Score Attack, Time Attack, and head-to-head VS modes - on the couch or online with Remote Play Together! The Dream Kingdom is counting on you!

details.title: Dorifto!
details.short_description: Push your car to the limit of grip and chase perfect lap times on winding back roads where drifting isn't just a technique, it's the only way to drive! Settle rivalries and prove your skill in online multiplayer and local split-screen.

details.title: DataCenter Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your own Data Center, from a single rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest Hardware. Wire power, cooling and network by hand, keep the machines running, vibe code Products and launch your own AI platform to finance the whole thing. Solo or in online co-op with up to three friends.

details.title: An Eggcellent Sorting Game
details.short_description: Sort thousands of colorful eggs by matching their patterns in this relaxing organizing game. Turn a giant mess into satisfying order, level up 8 skills, meet quirky characters, and complete quests. No rush, no pressure. Just you and an eggnormous pile of eggs!

details.title: That Mountain Needs to Fall
details.short_description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

details.title: Tiny Fortress
details.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

details.title: STAGE TOUR
details.short_description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

details.title: PRESIDENT
details.short_description: Become President… or end up the Asshole! PRESIDENT brings the famous card game to life with 11 modes, five AI difficulty levels and multiplayer. Challenge your friends or compete in tournaments with up to 16 participants to claim the crown!

details.title: Calibration Sequence
details.short_description: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

details.title: Slaysurge
details.short_description: The world shattered and its shards rose into the sky. You are the last Warden. Leadyour company across eight floating realms, march through the Firmament and ride asteam citadel into the Gorges in a fast, never-stalling idle RPG.

details.title: Sortman
details.short_description: A Swiss sorting hall buried under a million letters and parcels. Sort by hand, weigh, throw, load the vans, answer furious customers, then build a chain of belts and machines that fills the vans by itself. Solo or up to four players, no timer.

details.title: Dustronauts
details.short_description: Clean up dusty alien worlds alone or with up to 16 players in this relaxing space cleaning simulator! Vacuum endless dust, upgrade your equipment, automate your operations, and build your own space cleaning empire with friends.

details.title: Cry( ) Still
details.short_description: In Cry ( ) Still you explore frozen ruins where heat is a limited resource. You must find heat sources, avoid enemies that detect sound and suck the heat out of you, solve puzzles to unlock your path forwards. All in order to find your way out of the ancient temple.

details.title: Neural Defense
details.short_description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

details.title: Ardent Arcana
details.short_description: Solo or with up to three friends online, take on the beasts of French folklore in this co-op dungeon roguelite. Wield 14 weapons, master the 22 Major Arcana and fight your way down five procedural dungeons to the boss waiting at the bottom.

details.title: Outlanders VR
details.short_description: Outlanders is a town-building strategy game, populated by hard-working, charming folk in search of a simpler life. Some just want to survive off the land, others want to create amazing things.

details.title: We Made Gods
details.short_description: 2040. A rogue AI has seized the world's war factories. Lead human veterans, machine-fused soldiers or the AI itself in a real-time strategy game of three asymmetric factions, a story campaign, skirmish against the AI and online multiplayer.

details.title: The Crooked Table
details.short_description: Four players. Three secret sides. One table full of liars. Play every card face down, claim whatever you like, and bet your chips that someone else is lying. Help your team, sabotage the table, or play everyone for yourself. Just don’t get caught.

details.title: Grindhouse Theater Simulator
details.short_description: September 1983. Eighty seats, one projector, your choice of double bill. Run the Rialto in a first-person theater sim: book genre films, sell tickets and popcorn, hire the Grindhouse Gang and keep the show running when the print snaps and the crowd loses patience.

details.title: Galaxization
details.short_description: A galaxy and civilization simulator on your Windows wallpaper. While you work, civilizations sprout, rise, trade, fight and fall among 200,000 stars. Pick the view: the whole galaxy, the black hole, a star system, or the sky from a planet's surface. Built in Rust: light on CPU and battery.

details.title: Home Before Dusk
details.short_description: Farm, cook and fall in love in a fenced town at the end of the world. Once a week, a helicopter flies you out to abandoned towns for fuel, medicine and parts. Search fast and get back on board before dusk: the pilots don't wait for anyone.

details.title: Vault Traitors
details.short_description: Social deduction with MOBA-style abilities, 25+ roles, 50+ unique items, an arsenal of weapons and air that's running out. 16 players are sealed in an underground vault with traitors among them. Lock your door - and survive the night.

details.title: PinDOS
details.short_description: Play your own copies of Epic Pinball, Silver Ball, Silver Ball 2 Plus and Extreme Pinball in a new front end: the whole table on one tall screen with no scrolling, 2-4 players online or on your home network, and a full virtual pinball cabinet mode. The games are not included.

details.title: GreeDrill
details.short_description: You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore. A push-your-luck mining roguelike: drill deeper for a bigger payout, surface before the hull cracks, outrun the Bailiff and face the five Guardians of the deep.

details.title: Bonkaboo
details.short_description: Bonk your friends off the table in this online physics party game for 1-8. Get knocked off and you come back as a ghost, dropping fans, bumpers and boulders on whoever’s still standing.

details.title: Broken Contract
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game built around mechanics of contracts and betrayal. Before each shift, every player signs a contract known only to them, while the company’s objectives remain the same for everyone. You and your friends decide for yourselves what rules to play by.

details.title: DIEATHLON
details.short_description: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

details.title: Dragon's Brew
details.short_description: Run the board game cafe of your dreams! Craft food and drink, deliver orders to the townsfolk, collect board games, and customise your space, your way!

details.title: Grass and Cash
details.short_description: Bad news: you're in debt. Good news: there's cash buried in the grass. Worse news: you're starting with nail scissors. Start mowing.

details.title: Geareo
details.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with precision machines and intricate clockwork contraptions.

details.title: Zombie Crawlers
details.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

details.title: 10 Million Pixels
details.short_description: Mine millions of pixels in search of the one Golden Pixel by shooting bouncing balls.

details.title: Red Rising
details.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

details.title: Spray to Grail
details.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

details.title: Undying Knights
details.short_description: Undying Knights is a couch and online party game that fuses strategy and reflexes. Enjoy quick rounds with flexible team fights, unique weapons and deadly traps, all with a handicap option that keeps every battle fair.

details.title: Petri Party
details.short_description: Petri Party is a frantic, physics-driven party platformer where disposable slimes battle it out across a playful laboratory micro-world. Grab a friend (or seventeen), pick your weapon, and dive into fast, high-skill rounds full of grappling, wall-walking and gloriously accidental victories.

details.title: Down to Floor Zero
details.short_description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor… intact.

details.title: Saucer Rumble Showdown
details.short_description: Take control of your own flying saucer in this chaotic, physics-based arena party game! Ram opponents, dodge environmental hazards, and fight to be the last UFO flying. Battle in local multiplayer with CPU opponents or challenge players online!

details.title: Cult Of Echoes
details.short_description: Use echolocation to hunt your friends down in an asymmetrical horror game where sound is everything!

details.title: MineMergeMatic
details.short_description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

details.title: Army Factory
details.short_description: Build your settlement into a war machine. Gather resources, raise massive armies, prepare your regiments, and watch your battle plan unfold as thousands of soldiers clash.

name: This is not Chess, It's War!

details.title: This is not Chess, It's War!
details.short_description: Use your voice to command your army and lead them to victory in an intense game of chess!

details.title: Sketch to Arrest
details.short_description: A witness, a sketch artist, and a killer who might be sitting right next to you. Draw suspects from shaky testimony, question everything you're told, and decide who to arrest before another night ends in another body.

details.title: Ruff Day
details.short_description: Customers drop off their pups with a list of demands and wishes with some oddly specific notes. You'll be feeding, cleaning, and playing with them to keep them happy. A happy dog = $$$!

details.title: Capybara Clash
details.short_description: These Capybaras are armed to the teeth and eager to unleash destruction on both their enemies and the environment, with a huge arsenal of fun but deadly weapons. Blow it all up online, alone or in local multiplayer.

details.title: Project Angels 2 - Visual Novel
details.short_description: The visual novel sequel to Project Angels. Steel Waters and Apollyon—two factions of the ANGELS have tormented the Indicus Ocean for years. Their maker, a Puppetmaster turned Savior, now aims to balance the two beliefs of liberty and stability, all while reuniting what was whole under a new home.

details.title: Boy Escape from School
details.short_description: Help the Kid escape from school by solving puzzles and riddles in the latest installment of this thrilling adventure series! You’ll need wit, attention to detail, and ingenuity to break out of the locked school.

details.title: Hell Control
details.short_description: Customize your demon hunter and fight solo or with up to 3 friends in this third-person roguelite shooter. Choose upgrades as you level up, build your firepower, and destroy the Demon Cores fueling the invasion. Hell won't clear itself.

details.title: Staircase55: A SCP-087 Story
details.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror game that has you exploring a dark deep and paradoxical stairwell. Equipped only with a flashlight, navigate through the this strange staircase and uncover the secrets of the seemingly infinite stairwell, SCP-087.

details.title: Bad Things Might Happen
details.short_description: Play as an AI Researcher whose wife left him because of his AI Psychosis, build an indoor data center and build the most complex AI model that has ever existed. Social Commentary meets classic incremental mechanics. Begin progressing by hand, and then automate your way through AI development.

details.title: Fire Crew Simulator
details.short_description: A co-op firefighting sim for up to 4 players. Fly helicopters with water buckets and drive the fire engine against a forest fire that spreads tree by tree, all on the same map. Or run the lookout tower campaign on your own.

details.title: One Bow Army
details.short_description: One archer against an undead army. Choose where every arrow lands, build your power through a skill tree, and hold the wall against the horde.

details.title: CORN!
details.short_description: Shuck corn to buy tools, buy tools to shuck corn. It couldn’t be more simple! Fend off wasps, children, bears, and Mean Gary! Stay inside the garage, you never know what’s waiting outside for you. Uncover all the secrets that this corn holds.

details.title: Ecos de Valdrenne
details.short_description: A dark, turn-based JRPG where the Resonator reads traces, changes enemy intentions and steals techniques. Explore a top-down 2D world of secrets, solve puzzles with eight divine powers, and decide what to preserve when memory itself fractures.

details.title: Keg & Crypt
details.short_description: Turn an inherited tavern into the busiest room in town. Brew ale and cider, cook meals, and win over regulars. Then venture into the Drowned Abbey for combat and loot. Play solo or run the tavern with up to three friends online.

details.title: Fragment Collapse
details.short_description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

details.title: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid
details.short_description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

details.title: It's All Ogre
details.short_description: A VR Co-op puzzle game where each player inhabits one half of a two headed ogre. Each player is responsible for an arm and a leg. Coordinate together to bring the ogre to life to complete action puzzles and to feed the ogre!

details.title: Alphadia F
details.short_description: Embark on an epic fantasy JRPG in Alphadia F, the remake of Alphadia IV. Explore Valhalard, uncover the mystery of six fallen crystals, and save four kingdoms in strategic turn-based battles. Master the energi system, character progression, cooking, and classic anime-style RPG adventure.

name: Ahwa: Heart of the Azure Dragon

details.title: Ahwa: Heart of the Azure Dragon
details.short_description: An otome visual novel set among four guardian clans. After losing her mother, Ahwa inherits leadership of the Azure Dragon clan, and with it an old law: a leader must stand alone. Will she carry every burden herself, or share it? Your choices shape six bonds and the fate of the four clans.

details.title: Christmas Night: Brothers
details.short_description: Survive a terrifying Christmas night inside a massive luxury mansion. Play solo or together in local split-screen co-op while collecting gifts and avoiding deadly creatures.

details.title: My Little Secret
details.short_description: It seems your classmate Tia wasn't expecting company and has a secret she's keen on keeping! Collect evidence and confront Tia to reveal what she's been hiding.

details.title: rock[et]
details.short_description: Destroy thousands of asteroids and repair your destroyed rock[et] in this cute incremental that's secretly 3 games in 1! Unlock game-changing skills, invent run-breaking synergies, employ a drone army, discover new planets, and much, much more.

details.title: StalSide
details.short_description: Trapped inside a broken computer simulation of a post‑nuclear world, you must survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the zone. Play solo or with up to 8 friends in this chilling mix of survival and digital mystery.

details.title: Witches' Grove
details.short_description: Pick a fighter, train them up and send them into the Grand Rumpus! Buy techniques and potions between rounds, weather a witch's wild spells and race through the Grove Games. Twelve quirky fighters, countless builds, one Champion's Wish. How far can you take them?

details.title: Crimson Sanity
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a dark alternate 1950s America in this story-driven VR shooter! Become Detective Jonathan Kramer and destroy a stockpile of a mysterious drug that turns people into deranged mutants. Fight, explore, and relive nightmarish childhood memories to uncover the mystery of Dr. Phobos.

details.title: Karesansui
details.short_description: Karesansui is a zen garden meditative sandbox. Rake and decorate your desktop garden as you listen to the calming sounds of nature. Experiment with different patterns, lighting, and materials, and share the perfect photos with your friends.

details.title: Onions are Life
details.short_description: The greatest onion game you'll ever play! Plant onions, grow onions, harvest onions, love onions, become onions, in this incremental onion-farming sim!

details.title: OctaRace
details.short_description: OctaRace is an explosive racing game. It pays tribute to the good old top-down multiplayer titles, offering fun and intense races.

details.title: Ember Express
details.short_description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

details.title: Dice Mice
details.short_description: Dice Mice is an fast paced arcade puzzle game inspired by classic 90s gameplay. Score massive combos or better yet, steal them from your opponents. Choose a mouse and roll some dice.

details.title: Frozen Feathers
details.short_description: Throw snowballs, slide across the ice and shove your friends into the sea in short, chaotic penguin battles. Play online with up to 4 players, split-screen on one PC, or tap PLAY and fight bots in seconds.

details.title: Sort The Pandas
details.short_description: Thousands of pandas, two amazing worlds and one mission – put everything perfectly in place! Over 5,000 pandas are waiting for you in a shop full of shelves and a lush bamboo grove. Every panda you place brings you closer to perfect order. Level up your skills and see how many pandas you can sort!

details.title: Jurassic Paradise: No Escape
details.short_description: Survive a dinosaur park with 3–8 players in an online game of cooperation and social deduction. Repair facilities, share supplies, and vote out suspects—or sabotage your friends as a hidden cultist. Transform into a dinosaur and turn suspicion into a chase.

details.title: The Princess's Reongemt
details.short_description: In a world ruled by alien gods, the last kingdom "White Crown" secretly creates an artificial human with foreign memories. As their only weapon against the divine oppressors who control all resources, this being may hold the key to humanity's rebellion———

details.title: Trivia no Sekai
details.short_description: Competitive anime and video game trivia where knowing the answer isn't enough. Play 92 wildcards to attack rivals, counter their tricks and flip the score at the last second. Over 4,000 questions in English and Spanish, online matches for 1-4 players, free-for-all or 2v2.

details.title: Golf Orbit
details.short_description: Hit the perfect shot and launch your golf ball into orbit! Time your swings, smash through obstacles, earn coins, and upgrade your abilities to reach incredible distances. Break your records, explore new worlds, and see just how far your ball can go!

details.title: Tilelings!
details.short_description: A chaotic battle of wits with friends!? A fresh new competitive party game combining puzzles and action! Online multiplayer for up to 4 players! Have a blast with your friends in a variety of game modes that test both your puzzle-solving and action skills!!

name: Rest in Order: Cozy Tomb Tidy Up

details.title: Rest in Order: Cozy Tomb Tidy Up
details.short_description: A cozy 3D tidying game inside a Pharaoh's burial chamber. Restore the sarcophagi, line up the canopic jars and put every sacred treasure back in its place. Prefer chills? Switch on Spooky Mode and feel the dead watching.

details.title: Unbox Super Card
details.short_description: Buy CardBoxes, reveal valuable cards, build your automated opening factory, and Prestige to grow your fortune even faster. Complete every collection and become the ultimate card collector.

details.title: Beyond the Curtains
details.short_description: "Beyond the Curtains" is a cozy idle game. Watch a town, train journey, or graveyard through a window. Click to interact, press "nap" to move time, or simply observe. No tutorials, no goals—witness changes across three themes and piece together their stories.

details.title: DeCube
details.short_description: A nostalgic incremental game where you mine whole planets down to their core. Dig, upgrade and hire workers to uncover the secrets that lie beneath...

details.title: Matchday: Player Career
details.short_description: Live a footballer's career on and off the pitch. Earn your place, take charge of key moments in matches, build relationships at the club, and see your performances and choices shape the seasons ahead.

details.title: WordSearch Kingdom
details.short_description: Find hidden words and unwind at your own pace. Explore 10 puzzle languages with 960 levels each, trace words in changing directions, and use a hint when you need one. No time limit, with your progress saved automatically.

details.title: Code Fragment
details.short_description: Trapped inside the game you were creating, explore a corrupted digital world in this 2D puzzle-platformer. Collect Nodes, use consoles to change your surroundings, and defeat bosses to unlock new abilities and find your way out.

details.title: The Lords Next Door
details.short_description: When 10 retired lords share a valley, nobody raids at 3 AM—everyone just wants the quiet life. Build a storybook town and hire heroes of 18 races—orcs, undead, dragons—to help you farm, fish, and cook. Visit 9 real-player neighbors to trade gifts, and stand together when monsters attack!

details.title: Pawn Shop Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a pixel-art pawn shop, from a tiny corner store to a city emporium. Haggle with every customer, learn what things are really worth, spot fakes and stolen goods, gamble on storage units and drive your rival out of business.

details.title: StoneSpace
details.short_description: Crashed on an alien planet, your only hope of seeing home again is building a new ship from scratch. Explore, gather resources, expand your base, level up your skills, and craft hundreds of items – from flint tools to nuclear reactors.

details.title: BlackHole Defence
details.short_description: You are the black hole. Pull in matter, gain mass and grow while your attacks keep the battlefield moving. Turn a small singularity into the centre of a cosmic battle.

details.title: Tiny Bomber
details.short_description: Survive the countdown in a fast-paced vertical bullet-hell roguelite. Collect coins to extend your run, graze bullets for aircraft-specific boosts, build wild upgrade combos, turn defeated bosses into companion drones, tweak map spawns, and team up in 2-player co-op to push toward the final boss!

details.title: Zumba - The Dragon's Marble Trial
details.short_description: The dragon’s marbles are rolling—only you can stop them! In Zumba – The Dragon’s Marble Trial, shoot, match, and explode marbles before they reach the end. Unleash draconic power-ups, and blaze through mythical worlds. Grab your fire-breath and let the marble-matching magic begin!

details.title: Flightless
details.short_description: Emerge from an egg as a baby penguin, learning to waddle, slide, and live life as a penguin should in a dreamy post-apocalyptic Antarctica. Find your way in a wordless story of meetings and separations.

details.title: FD's Industry Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.

details.title: Talk Of The Tavern
details.short_description: A co-op autobattler roguelike where rival guilds journey toward the King’s castle, stopping at taverns to outbid each other for mercenaries and shape their builds with powerful scrolls. Survive the road and conquer the King’s Tournament.

details.title: Dagesh
details.short_description: Four players. Sixteen cards. One Boss. Bluff your friends, bargain for a bigger cut, or call "Dagesh!" and force a showdown. In this multiplayer card game, a good deal can beat a great hand.

details.title: Ukraine Under Fire
details.short_description: Command Ukrainian or Russian forces in a 3D turn-based strategy game. Capture cities, defend river crossings, dig trenches and coordinate land, air and naval units on a hex map of Ukraine. Each turn brings new decisions—and another day of war.

details.title: Carpet Daddy
details.short_description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

details.title: Crinchure Collector
details.short_description: A Gacha-Inspired Collectathon Game - FREE PULLS FOR LIFE!! Hundreds of cute Crinchures, sweet Swords, incredible Ingredients and more to collect, with a short novels's worth of flavor text, events, and lore! Experience the joy of ripping packs, without those pesky microtransactions!

details.title: Once Upon a Shelf
details.short_description: Tidy up after the curse in various rooms of your new cottage! Every night around the witching hour, everything on your cellar shelves gets flung off in a jumbled heap. Somewhere underneath it all lies one of your boggart-stolen belongings. Take back what is rightfully yours!

details.title: Sincognito
details.short_description: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

details.title: Grandpa Loves Trains
details.short_description: Grandpa has retired and now spends his days playing with his toy trains. With the station needing a new conductor, the responsibility falls to his grandson, Abraham. Board passengers, unlock powerful abilities through a skill tree, and expand your railway empire in this cozy incremental roguelite.

details.title: Market Manager Simulator
details.short_description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

details.title: Sun is Lava
details.short_description: Suit up and cool the Sun in a first-person sci-fi co-op. Spray paths across molten lava, salvage asteroids, build water-powered machines, and explore a dangerous solar world alone or with friends.

details.title: 日本一周漢字の旅
details.short_description: Everyday Japan, in a quiz! Interested in Japan? Don’t miss this! Join Hina-chan for fun Kanji challenges!

name: Just Place It: Tidy Up the Cozy House

details.title: Just Place It: Tidy Up the Cozy House
details.short_description: Just Place It: Tidy Up the Cozy House is a cozy, first-person home organizing simulator. Pick up and place 3,000+ scattered items, unlock abilities, and style your space with custom shelf layouts. Organize over 999+ unique objects in a stress-free journey with no pressure.

details.title: Nanjing Massacre: John Rabe's Diary
details.short_description: This text game is based on John Rabe's diaries. Play as Rabe in the desperate Nanking Safety Zone. Your choices shape blood-stained diary entries. Decide refugees' survival under extreme resource scarcity. Help the younger generation re-examine this heavy history through immersive narrative.

details.title: Carrot Planet
details.short_description: Cozy co-op incremental automation game for 1-16 players. Harvest an entire planet of carrots to feed the Bunny Mothership. Pick carrots, drive vehicles, automate everything, and befriend the locals. Build a massive carrot empire together!

details.title: Six Kingdoms: Eternal War
details.short_description: Six Kingdoms: Eternal War is a fantasy card battler about six races at war: humans, undead, elves, dwarves, demons and elementals. Build your deck and lead your hero through a campaign of battles and bosses, or fight real players in the ranked online Arena and its tournaments.

details.title: Pet Ferris Wheel Arena
details.short_description: Raise a tiny kitten into an extraordinary arena companion. Hatch, care, train, and evolve your cats, discover surprising forms, and watch your choices come alive in real-time AI battles. Build a collection and take on an offline ranked challenge.

details.title: Crafty Marbles
details.short_description: Build whatever you want for your marbles! Crazy machines, incredible races, spectacular chain reactions, frantic battles or anything else! Turn any idea into organized chaos!

details.title: Wee Boats
details.short_description: The chill multiplayer boaty honk game! Explore with your friends as miniature boats in this lil nautical adventure!

details.title: WORLD EATER
details.short_description: Eat the entire world. All 100 billion voxels of it. Start with a shovel and a backpack, work your way up to bombs, giant machines, robots and factories, and don't stop until nothing is left. First-person co-op for up to 8 players.

details.title: Minigolf Brake!
details.short_description: Play minigolf and BRAKE! whenever you want - going down, up, in a mud, a stream, or even on a water surface!

details.title: Contested Space: Core Defender
details.short_description: The first pack-opening defense game you can play with friends! Rip booster packs to build your fleet, aim your own cannon, and fight through a 40-stage campaign that keeps getting bigger. 1-4 player online co-op, a roguelike mode, and hundreds of permanent unlocks.

details.title: Factory Time
details.short_description: A factory automation incremental game at the end of the universe. Start crafting by hand, automate production, and build the Chronoforge to escape.

details.title: Mourning Tide
details.short_description: A guilt-ridden fisherman sails into forbidden waters. With every catch, the echoes of his life rise to the surface. Unravel the past, seek redemption’s light, or be consumed by the Mourning Tide. A fishing horror game.

details.title: MMOS: MMO Simulator
details.short_description: Build, run and play your own fantasy MMO in a single-player management sim. Design the world, classes, loot and raids, then watch simulated adventurers play, form guilds and chase rare drops. Keep them subscribed, log in as a character yourself, and share your MMO on the Steam Workshop.

details.title: Ember & Tide
details.short_description: Ember is fire, Tide is water. Team up in a fire-and-water puzzle platformer for couch co-op or solo play: fuse into steam, outsmart lava and ice, and solve 30 handcrafted levels. Then build your own in the Level Editor!

details.title: Tech Legends Simulator
details.short_description: Open a tiny PC shop and grow it into a tech empire. Stock shelves from Amazoom deliveries, ring up customers at a real cash register, build gaming PCs by hand, hire staff, run a LAN café, mine crypto and expand your HQ all the way to the second floor.

details.title: PAWSHOT
details.short_description: PAWSHOT - a deadly roulette for true predators. Count your shells, put your paws, fangs, and shotgun to use. Your life is on the line. Good luck.

details.title: UNDIVIDED
details.short_description: UNDIVIDED is a dark fantasy romance visual novel where your choices matter. As a corrupt sickness spreads across the land, your own life takes on new meaning. Travel with three powerful allies, decide who deserves your trust or your heart, and choose what you will risk to save a dying world.

details.title: Nildigo
details.short_description: Spicy-zen puzzle roguelite with dangerous money grids, hundreds of Perks and Powers, and a high degree of exponential breakability.

details.title: Foosball Champs
details.short_description: Experience the most authentic foosball simulation in VR. Bring the table directly into your room and face off against friends in lag-free and cross-platform multiplayer.

details.title: Let's Build Together
details.short_description: Build up to 859,436 pieces in a single map, solo or with up to 8 friends. Unlock powerful upgrades, automate construction with helpers, and turn empty plots into finished buildings in this cozy first-person building game.

details.title: Ratscension
details.short_description: A top-down roguelite action dungeon crawler. Ascend the tower and fight the evil rat wizard. Avoid dangerous enemies. Find valuable loot. Build your character and explore the tower. Play solo or online co-op with friends!

details.title: Psycho Santa
details.short_description: Pilot Santa’s weaponized sleigh, smash through houses, and deliver presents with the police on your tail. When Krampus knocks you out of the sky, fight on foot, hijack tanks, and decide who gets a second chance in this darkly comic Christmas action game.

details.title: Planetary Wars
details.short_description: Planetary Wars begins when humanity discovers quantum ports to a new Earth-sized exoplanet. Take your one-way ticket and conquer it by land, sea, air and space with thousands of players. Play solo or with friends, chat via text-to-speech and fight as a jetpack super-soldier with keyboard or gamepad.

details.title: Breakpoint
details.short_description: BREAKPOINT is a tactical card battler with a twist on classic playing cards. Outplay your opponent with Singles, Pairs, Straights, and Bombs. Build Rage when you pass, unleash BREAK to turn the tables, and explore new strategies with each character's unique abilities.

details.title: HITLER BACKROOMS
details.short_description: HITLER BACKROOMS is a co-op game for 1-6 players, where you must make your way through the Backrooms while avoiding the Hitler entity. Explore the Backrooms alone, or with friends! Progress through the levels and try to survive. Will you find the way out? Or will another hidden world await?

details.title: Organize my Shop 3: Christmas Store
details.short_description: Your favorite cozy organizing returns in a festive new format! Dive into a winter wonderland, brew some hot cocoa, and place fairy lights, nutcrackers, blankets, and mugs neatly on the shelves at your own pace while enjoying your favorite holiday movie ☕✨

details.title: Kiosco Simulator
details.short_description: Kiosco Simulator is a management sim where you run a 24-hour kiosco in Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina. Serve customers, manage stock, survive the night, and build your reputation as you earn money to upgrade your shop and expand your business.

details.title: The Landlords
details.short_description: A story-driven property-trading board game built on The Landlord's Game, Lizzie Magie's 1904 original. Buy land, charge rent and strike deals with characterful rivals or friends online, under her ruthless Monopolist rules or her Prosperity rules, where everyone can win.

details.title: Tribes
details.short_description: In a Stone Age–like war, stranded on a lush, isolated island, it’s up to you to command your tribe and conquer and colonize the island by any means necessary! Tribes offers Skirmish, Multiplayer, and a full Campaign mode for you to experience with friends or play alone!

details.title: Simora Town: Broke to Boss
details.short_description: Build your empire in a living open world where every NPC has a real home and routine! Manage supermarkets, fast-food spots, and furniture stores, buy any property, decorate your dream house, and make friends with every citizen. Can you turn this town into your personal business empire?

details.title: Wail of Despair
details.short_description: A lonely girl left unaccompanied is followed into the colorful tunnels of her local fast food play place.

details.title: Task Bar Deads
details.short_description: A tiny zombie survival game that lives on your Windows taskbar. Your pixel survivor fights the undead, gathers loot and grows stronger while you work. Forge better gear, build your skills and take on giant bosses.

details.title: A Place for Hue
details.short_description: A relaxing single-player sorting game where you restore 30 hand-crafted color gradients by finding the perfect spot for each piece! Pick up, sort and place over 6,000 mosaic pieces of all shapes and colors, earn money, unlock helpful upgrades, and watch your messy gallery slowly come to life!

details.title: Innkeeping
details.short_description: A cozy medieval inn-management sim. Build your inn, brew your ale, set your prices, and take care of your guests. Grow your reputation and business while balancing happy patrons and rising costs to turn a quiet roadside stop into a legendary landmark.

details.title: Cat Shelter Simulator
details.short_description: Build a cozy cat shelter, rescue abandoned kittens, and give every feline a loving home! Feed, groom, heal and play with your cats, build friendships, and discover the joy of finding them their forever families.

details.title: Gofoot
details.short_description: Gofoot is a fast, lightweight, and nostalgic football management game. Create your manager, build squads, compete in championships, and customize leagues, clubs, and players in a simple, addictive sandbox experience built for the community.

details.title: The Divided
details.short_description: Co-op extraction action-RPG for 1–4 players. Take missions from the hideout, drop into hostile zones, and fight or sneak past the infected. Loot what you can carry and extract — or die and leave it all behind. Melee is the smart play. Guns invite the horde. Craft, trade, gear up. Bring friends.

details.title: Drums & Steel
details.short_description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and campaigns. May the best army win.

details.title: Deliverance Protocol: Ironrot
details.short_description: Atmospheric first-person retro horror. You are a courier — a disposable tool of the System. Sort, deliver, collect archives. Obey… or uncover what lies inside.

details.title: Necro-Matcher
details.short_description: A match-3 rogue-lite! Traverse through multiple floors battling baddies and discovering secrets in every unique run.

details.title: Noël macabre
details.short_description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

details.title: Santa Sack Attack
details.short_description: Santa Sack Attack is a Christmas-themed third-person platform action game where the player must navigate environmental obstacles and techno-adversaries, smashing blocks, drones, and robots to reach their goal. Gameplay is family friendly fun and is appropriate for all ages.

details.title: Deadlines
details.short_description: A multiplayer melee combat game where you and your coworkers are trapped in a sprawling office building with an impossible deadline. Work together to survive, form alliances to improve your odds, or turn on your coworkers before they turn on you.

details.title: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
details.short_description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

details.title: General Jeon
details.short_description: From a peasant boy in peninsula, to the most powerful man in the nation — and finally, to a criminal facing the judgment of history —— Sixty years of turbulence. One road from a thatched hut to the Blue House. How far will you go?

name: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction

details.title: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction
details.short_description: Run a mad science shop by day, pilot a giant robot by night. In this 1-4 player co-op comedy sim you stock shelves, brew unstable potions and expose undercover agents - then split the robot's controls with your friends to flatten 5 cities and beat 5 superheroes.

name: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era

details.title: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era
details.short_description: This is a game about the painstaking and gradual process of building a fully functional, resource-harvesting, and self-defending base in the desert from scratch. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the unknown deserts!

details.title: Sweetheart, We're Infested
details.short_description: Vacuum alien bugs, board enemy ships and deliver a baby star in a jam jar before the galaxy goes dark. Keep your battered pest-control ship flying in this space roguelike romcom, where your partner’s ex remembers every failed run and gets pettier each loop.

details.title: Fall Off Reach
details.short_description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

details.title: Grand Bonk: Co-op Horde Survival
details.short_description: Your crew vs. every cop in town. Grand Bonk is a 4-player co-op horde survival roguelite: hold your block against an entire police department, level up a build that's all yours, stack it until it breaks, and bonk every wave that dares show up.

details.title: EVA Awakening
details.short_description: A cinematic VR psychological sci-fi experience aboard the mysterious Aeon Express. Solve immersive puzzles, shape the narrative, and question the nature of consciousness.

details.title: The Hardest Game Ever
details.short_description: The Hardest Game Ever is a brutally difficult 2d platformer game, featuring constant death, a variety of different challenging puzzles, and unique, obstacles with each stage, ranging from simple jumps turned into something very different to obstacles that even platformer veterans would struggle with

details.title: Los Cuentos de Frox
details.short_description: Explore the vast universe of Tora in this classic 2D turn-based RPG. Delve into a deep fantasy world filled with mysteries, traverse interconnected rooms and dungeons packed with secrets, and manage your inventory in a narrative-driven adventure.

details.title: Mystic Cleaver
details.short_description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive.The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action.Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

details.title: Fih🥀🥀
details.short_description: Your monitor is the aquarium. Type and click as you always do: your input becomes food, fish grow on your desktop, and gold piles up while you work. Collect 29 crayon-drawn species, roll for rare ones, chase off sharks, paint your own fish. Clicks pass through, and keystrokes are never recorded.

details.title: The Ludic Wound
details.short_description: Beneath the wallpaper, a cursor blinks in a language older than sleep. The apartment remembers you. The machine dreams of the one dreaming it. Somewhere between the pixel and the void, a wound is opened.

details.title: Sort The Lot
details.short_description: A cozy relaxing game about sorting 298 vehicles in an impound lot! Earn parking points, upgrade your abilities, unlock new areas, and park every vehicle!

details.title: Chicken Must Fry
details.short_description: Chicken Must Fry is a survivor-like game where you play as a raw chicken refusing to be fried, wiping out monsters from the ruthless Frying Empire. Combine various skills and items, upgrade your characters, and survive the endless waves of enemies!

details.title: Rolling Toolman 3: Darkness
details.short_description: Toolman is back in this 3prd person adventure game. Roll and try to reach goal as soon as you can and avoid falling from map and beware obstacles and traps

details.title: Save the North Pole
details.short_description: Oh no! A snowstorm has buried Santa’s village at the North Pole! The wind blew the ornaments off the giant tree and hid them in the snow, and Christmas is tomorrow! Become an elf and team up with friends to clear the paths, dig up the ornaments and hang them on the tree. Save Christmas!

details.title: Pine Creek: Prologue
details.short_description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the Grays, and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror prologue set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986. Play the Pine Creek prologue.

details.title: Boat Trip
details.short_description: Pilot your boat through swarming schools of fish in this naval action roguelite. Combine weapons, upgrade your ship and face colossal bosses, solo or in 1~4 online co-op.

details.title: Astrocraft: Prologue
details.short_description: Build a space station on a barren asteroid, in first person and for free. Mine ore, run machines, open a shop for the ships that land, and hand the work to a crew of robots until the station runs on its own, solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Tribes of the Ridge
details.short_description: Lead your tribe in this side-scrolling colony sim! Grow a humble settlement into a thriving civilization. Survive harsh winters, manage resources, build efficient production chains, unlock new professions, and raise glorious monuments!

details.title: Dog Escape: Extraction Shooter
details.short_description: **Dog Escape: Extraction Shooter** A cute meme‑themed top‑down shooter‑survival game. Step into the paws of a brave pup, scavenge for supplies amid hostile forces and colossal bosses. Hunt for rare loot, upgrade your gear, craft high‑tier weapons, and grow from a nobody into a formidable fighter.

details.title: Snap & Print
details.short_description: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! 📸 Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

details.title: Fire Up the Stadium
details.short_description: Fire Up the Stadium is an incremental restoration game where you bring a massive stadium back to its former glory. Restore faded seats, earn money, unlock powerful tools and upgrades, and build automated restoration machines. The more seats you restore, the faster and more powerful you become!

details.title: Demidoff Corp Pico
details.short_description: Demidoff Corp Pico is a free retro prologue to the Ural-based metroidvania Demidoff Corp, created in the Pico-8 game format. Find out what happened to the fluffy agent before the events of the main game: explore the mines, gather malachite, and battle a variety of enemies.

details.title: Waywardens
details.short_description: Lead three heroes with one shared deck in a dark fantasy tactical roguelite. Play each card as an action or a chess-inspired move. Read enemy attacks, break their formation and turn a desperate hand into a winning plan. Build your company. Brave the road.

name: Dose of Order: Pharmacy Tidy Up

details.title: Dose of Order: Pharmacy Tidy Up
details.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying sim. After a stormy night, over 6,000 products cover your pharmacy floor. Pick up, sort and shelve every one in its place, unlock talents that sweep up and auto-place for you, and restore the whole shop from chaos to spotless.

details.title: Kingdom of Embers
details.short_description: Real-time strategy meets action RPG. Build a kingdom and raise an army, then take the field as its ruler: lead your troops into battle in person, and delve into deadly dungeons for legendary weapons and world-ending spells.

details.title: BIGGER BEASTS!
details.short_description: Hatch eggs, raise tiny creatures into giants and build your team to face bosses. A pixel art creature-collecting idle RPG with automatic battles, equipment to forge and a village that helps your companions grow.

name: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory

details.title: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
details.short_description: Run a Christmas gift factory with unruly gnomes in this short management game! Wrap gifts yourself, set up production equipment, manage your gnomes, and assign tasks. Turn a chaotic workshop into a smoothly running factory before Christmas.

details.title: Millennium Classics
details.short_description: Millennium Classics brings back the simple, satisfying elegance of classic puzzle games, free from ads, invasive tracking, or distracting progress bars. Just pure relaxation and mental exercise, just like in the good old days.

name: Maybe... I'll go to the beach

details.title: Maybe... I'll go to the beach
details.short_description: It's a perzine-like spatial programming puzzle game about my experience of being an artist in the present landscape.

details.title: The Tram
details.short_description: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

details.title: Grey Havok's Crystal War
details.short_description: Defend crystals from monster waves in a chaotic arcade FPS. Play solo, in local split-screen or 1P vs 2P, or online via Steam. Earn in-game currency, progress through unlockable levels, chase high scores, and uncover a secret Light Gun Mode.

details.title: Polish Pierogi
details.short_description: Run your own pierogi restaurant! Prepare delicious Polish dumplings step by step, serve hungry customers, upgrade your kitchen and master the art of keeping everyone fed, happy and coming back for more.

details.title: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet
details.short_description: Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite. Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them. Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score. Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

details.title: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
details.short_description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

details.title: MOTHERSHIP: The Last Stand
details.short_description: Take command of Mothership Keystone, the last fortress-station of the Compact: aim its Prime Battery, build defenses under fire and break flagship after flagship across a war of 24 systems. Every run makes your Admiralty stronger.

details.title: Sword Finger R
details.short_description: A typing RPG for everyone, from beginners to experts!!This is NOT a typing practice program!!Every keystroke leads to attacks, defense, and rewards!!(No manual needed. Playtime: Approximately 1 hour.)Supported keyboard layouts: Japanese (JIS) and English (US) only.[F11] Full Screen

details.title: For Good Measure
details.short_description: Two measuring tapes stuck together... Why? No time to explain, you have puzzles to solve! Don't let the simple two-button movement controls fool you into thinking it'll be easy. Tackle the puzzles alone or team up with a friend in online or local co-op.

details.title: ナツノカナタ ―PROLOGUE－
details.short_description: The prologue of the novel Natsuno Kanata is now a visual novel! When Shiori boots up her late grandmother's old PC, she unexpectedly connects to a desolate alternate world ravaged by a mysterious pandemic. A post-apocalyptic adventure.

details.title: One More Voyage
details.short_description: ONE MORE VOYAGE is a minimalist 4X game all about exploring strange planets. On each voyage you are on the hunt for vital resources to make your next jump. The further you get, the more points you can invest in permanent upgrades. Can you find the star cipher to chart the way to a new galaxy?

details.title: NorefSoccer
details.short_description: NoRef Soccer is a fast-paced 3D street football action game. With no referees or fouls, unleash intense physical tackles, stylish dribbling, and superpower shots! Control unique players across asphalt, beach, and snow courts to dominate the streets and build your dynasty.

details.title: Billard Masters Legacy
details.short_description: Precision cue sports powered by deterministic 1,000 Hz physics! Play 8-Ball, 9-Ball, Snooker, 3-Cushion & Carom in the Online Club or vs PC. Conquer 30 Master Challenges, build custom layouts, and collect 84 cues with live match chronicles across 15 atmospheric 3D venues.

details.title: Grand Opening: The Apothecary
details.short_description: Tidy up your cozy apothecary by organizing every potion, herb, and alchemy accessory after a rival store owner sabotaged your store. Explore the shop, put away over 3,000 items, and solve puzzles to unlock more areas and items.

details.title: Gutter Scrap
details.short_description: Bolt a war machine together from trash in this mech shooter. Then take your city back from the scrap dealer who crowned himself General. Nine districts, nine bosses, 41 parts to mix and match, and a mech that can dance.

details.title: Trucker: Master Drivers
details.short_description: Experience the realistic truck driving experience in Türkiye, and start your journey to becoming MASTER DRIVERS through realistic vehicle breakdowns and road experiences.

details.title: Mahalle Kıraathanesi
details.short_description: Welcome to the neighbourhood coffeehouse! Play Okey, 101 Okey, Backgammon, Kız Tavlası, Pişti and Yekta with your friends or with regulars who remember you, tease you and hold grudges. Buy a round of tea, put your chips on the table and become the boss of the coffeehouse.

details.title: Night At The Mall
details.short_description: A psychological horror job sim. Complete security maintenance in a sprawling, desolate mall while surviving creeping, unpredictable threats. Manage electrical systems, monitor CCTV cameras, and survive a night shift where you never know what is lurking in the dark.

details.title: Twenty Till Him
details.short_description: Kidnapped by a serial killer. Twenty seconds per room. Four ways out, and only one lets you live. Read the dust, the draft, the blood and the silence, then choose before the masked old man comes back. One mistake and you wake up tied in the first room again. 100 rooms. One house. No happy ending.

details.title: Rogue Curling
details.short_description: Balatro-like roguelike curling where physics-based skill matters no less than a solid build. Combine synergies and precision, or just break the rules!

details.title: Tidy Garage
details.short_description: Tidy Garage is a relaxing game about organizing a garage. Sort tools, parts, and all sorts of odds and ends, admire their details, and turn a cluttered garage into a pleasant, tidy space at your own pace.

details.title: Kugle
details.short_description: Raise your Kugle, explore open worlds and take on your friends in mini-games where gravity knows no bounds. Free-to-play, cross-platform on PC and mobile.

details.title: Still Awake
details.short_description: Still Awake is a psychological horror game that puts you inside the terrifying experience of sleep paralysis, where you're trapped between sleep and reality.

details.title: Minato
details.short_description: Minato combines classic minesweeper with roguelike elements. Progress through increasingly challenging stages, discover unique items, and face guardians that add unexpected twists before proceeding to the next floor.

details.title: Growing Knight
details.short_description: Growing Knight is an incremental game of timing and positioning where you fight monsters, upgrade your skills and go for another run until you become unstoppable. Learn skills, spells and hire retinue to fight with you.

details.title: Pumpkin Reaper
details.short_description: Pumpkin Reaper is an action roguelike where skill placement shapes your build. Arrange spells, summons, and upgrades in a five-slot Ritual Circle to trigger synergies and awaken powerful Arcana. Fight endless waves, test wild combinations, and push each run further. No permanent power upgrades.

details.title: Click Clock
details.short_description: Unravel the mysterious fabric of time in this incremental game. Blood is the currency time demands. The clock is ticking. What are you waiting for?

details.title: Math Star
details.short_description: Solve the problem and hit the answer on the beat. A rhythm game where math is your instrument: 20 songs, 4 levels, a 20-show tour and a practice mode that learns from your mistakes. Can you keep the show going?

details.title: Big Pig Dig
details.short_description: A tower defense where thousands of pigs pour out of their dens. Place your turrets, then dig, drill and blast to break the stampede. Every tool reshapes the ground and redirects the herd. Each pig you stop is gold for a bigger arsenal.

details.title: Steal Deal
details.short_description: Embark on a journey across a dying world in a 2D top-down action roguelike—solo or in 2–4 player co-op! Traverse randomly generated levels, upgrade your arsenal, and collect Divine Deals that can grant you immense power or lead to your downfall.

details.title: Purrmission Denied
details.short_description: Truly, how hard could moderating be? This short, narrative moderation simulator tests your memory and reading skills to keep THEMOUSER's chat peaceful. Just make sure to hit the daily quota!

details.title: Gridiron Dynasty
details.short_description: Every league. One universe. Pro, college, Canadian, and arena football evolve together from 1960 and beyond, with historical rule changes, expansions, and mergers. Recruit, draft, trade, and sign players. Take control as GM, head coach, or both. Call the plays and watch every snap unfold.

details.title: Evilos
details.short_description: Evilos is an action tower defense game where you play as an ancient evil sorcerer battling endless waves of do-gooders. Tear down the kingdom with a vast arsenal of evolvable magic weapons and spells, and bolster your defenses with elite minions across 10 acts. This time, you are the final boss!

details.title: Block Party Apocalypse
details.short_description: A blocky third-person zombie shooter for 1–4 players. Fight 30 waves across three days of the outbreak, stack upgrade cards, grab miniguns and flamethrowers from supply drops, and reach the last evacuation helicopter out of Port Haven.

details.title: Taubenchaos
details.short_description: Be the pigeon the city deserves! Peck healthy grain, splat unsuspecting tourists, dodge the janitor and take on 32 wild bosses - alone, on one couch or online with a friend via Steam. 96 levels, Boss Rush, Endless mode and a music box with 101 tracks.

details.title: Standard Procedures
details.short_description: A casual team vs. team FPS about gunfights and negotiation. Your character is completely physically simulated and can interact with the world and be injured dynamically.

details.title: Mingle
details.short_description: Mingle is a hidden object puzzle game where you move through a crowd to find your identical twin. Each match transforms you into someone new, with hundreds of chatty little characters and surprising level twists.

details.title: Just Fly
details.short_description: A cozy-adrenaline wingsuit game with no forced goals. Explore procedural sky islands with forests, canyons, tunnels and dangerous caves. Weave between trees, hot air balloons and wind turbine blades, and score points with high-speed proximity flying. No timers, no goals, epic crashes. Just fly.

details.title: Survive the Squallies
details.short_description: Settle into a new home, go fishing, and meet the neighbors in this retro first-person horror game. Something is watching from the woods. Explore, run, and hide as Bill discovers that getting home alive is harder than fitting in.

details.title: NextBot PANIC!
details.short_description: Turn your friend's face into a monster. Invite 7 people. See who survives. NextBot PANIC! is a chaotic 1-8 player co-op survival horror where YOU create custom Nextbots. Navigate procedural mazes, unlock loot, and experience pure meme panic!

details.title: FIRMWARE
details.short_description: FIRMWARE is an assembly programming puzzle game. Challenge yourself with hundreds of puzzles and different game types: Multi-core systems with shared buses and I/O pins, programming microcontrollers driving circuits, shuffling instructions to fix programs, and large programs for encoding messages.

details.title: Candy Factory
details.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

details.title: Astral Industrial Complex
details.short_description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

details.title: ORION
details.short_description: ORION is a real-time sci-fi 4X grand strategy game where you explore a procedurally generated galaxy, build an interstellar empire, shape its society, design powerful fleets, and conquer, unite, or outlast your rivals.

details.title: Desk Top Soccer
details.short_description: Manage your football club from a corner of your desktop or in fullscreen. Pick the line-up, train, build up the club and take your team from the bottom division to the top at your own pace. In multiplayer, compete in leagues against managers worldwide and trade players on the Steam Market.

details.title: Apple Picker
details.short_description: Start with an apple tree, end with a multiverse turned to pulp in this creepy idle incremental game. Pick apples. Produce more apples. Cause the apple-fication of reality. Uncover the source of this all-consuming apple obsession. But whatever you do, (don't) shoot the unicorn.

details.title: Act Normal
details.short_description: Everyone looks like an NPC. Some of them are players. Blend in, spot the others, and outsmart your opponents across chaotic multiplayer game modes. Just remember one thing: Act Normal.

details.title: GRIDDLE 66
details.short_description: GRIDDLE 66 is a hands-on fast-food job simulator. Grill burgers, prepare fries and drinks, serve customers, and clean up after each shift. Work solo or in 2-player online co-op, sharpen your skills, and rise from part-timer to the Hall of Fame.

details.title: 纤维
details.short_description: Connections are like fiber threads—tugged and tangled. Some tighten; others fray. Grades, the future, and family expectations steal her breath. Between closeness and distance, hope and avoidance, she tries to understand—and be understood.

name: This is why, you shouln´t build hackbots Karl

details.title: This is why, you shouln´t build hackbots Karl
details.short_description: Karl just wanted free games on Vaporizor. Now his rogue hackbot is devouring digital worlds pixel by pixel! Thrown into the chaos by the Cheat Buster Authority, Karl must hack, fight, and fix his mess to save the gaming multiverse!

details.title: TUNE
details.short_description: You lost everything in the war, except the memory of a faint prayer of a being who stayed beside you. Years later, you return to trace its prayer across a ruined Earth. Search through static, uncover the truth, and remember what others have forgotten.

name: All the Promised Burn - An Yssaia Game

details.title: All the Promised Burn - An Yssaia Game
details.short_description: ALL THE PROMISED BURN is a hand-drawn, Knowledge-based narrative RPG about what an assassin does after the War ends. Can you learn new ways to be, when the past is still burned into you?

details.title: Bosky
details.short_description: Escape your school, avoid being seen by the teachers, and retrieve your backpacks and other things before getting outta here.

details.title: Path of Damned
details.short_description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

name: Dakota Keys and the Secret of the Ancients

details.title: Dakota Keys and the Secret of the Ancients
details.short_description: A classic point-and-click adventure inspired by the golden age of 1990s adventure games. Explore ancient Egypt, solve challenging puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and follow Dakota Keys on a journey into one of history's greatest mysteries.

details.title: LIMINAL: Within
details.short_description: Boot up Black & White Limbo! Become the Prince of Might and reclaim your ruined homeland in a pixel-art RPG. Beyond the screen, Shuuichi Hirata’s life takes a sinister turn. A murder. A game to blame? Explore, battle, and shape the story in this cinematic mystery adventure. What will you choose?

details.title: Deforest a Planet
details.short_description: A cosy idle game about clearing an entire planet, one tree at a time. Hire woodcutters, raise lumbermills and watch your crew spread across a tiny spinning world, until the last tree falls and a bigger planet waits.

details.title: Feral Prince
details.short_description: Rip Soul Orbs from weakened enemies, forge them into black-jade Soul Tiles, and lock five into a poker hand that reshapes your next fight. Dokkaebi Masks cheat the rules, while escaped Husks return as Wraiths carrying the power you stole. A 2D action roguelite.

details.title: MOMENT: A Clockwork Melody
details.short_description: Solve puzzles as you compose melodies. Place clockwork launchers, tune their timing and guide balls through colour-changing routes. Each collision plays a note, turning your solution into music. Explore 40 levels, experiment in Free Mode and share your own puzzles.

details.title: Undersea Post Office Sim
details.short_description: Run the last post office on the seabed. Weigh every parcel, price it to the exact stamp, catch the forgeries, and pack the day's mail into a fish-shaped cargo hold that has to hang level. Four weeks. Four rent days. One desk between you and eviction.

details.title: Nexus Survivors
details.short_description: In Nexus Survivors, you don't get a pre-made fireball handed to you. You build it yourself — from cards that determine how it moves, what it does, and what happens when it hits. Every spell in your arsenal is your own creation.

details.title: Proximity
details.short_description: Proximity- game about exploring randomly generated galaxy, combining RTS and FPS mechanics. Build factories, manage colonists and their needs. Design any vehicles with polygonal modelling and fly seamlessly from the surface into space. Adjust design to handle realistic physics. Have fun with friends

details.title: Cozy Plates
details.short_description: Decorate your own elegant plates using a variety of delicious ingredients, from sushi to sweet desserts. Arrange every detail with easy controls, set the cozy atmosphere, and create the perfect presentation. Relax, learn at your own pace, and get into the flow.

details.title: HYPER TITAN
details.short_description: Sci-fi fleet combat: pilot your mothership, build modules, recruit hero captains, and wage formation war across the galaxy.

details.title: Rush Your Band
details.short_description: Start as an unknown artist. Record your own songs using your real voice, release them online, grow your fanbase and build your music career.

details.title: World Trails: Hiking Simulator
details.short_description: Walk 30 real hiking trails across six continents, from the Dolomites to Everest Base Camp. Scramble up steep slopes, camp in huts and tents, survive snow, fog and thin air, and photograph the world's great peaks. A third-person hiking simulator.

details.title: Cat-Eye: Nail Salon Simulator
details.short_description: Soak off old polish, file and shape real 3D nails, then pull a glowing cat-eye band to life with a magnet. A cozy nail salon sim with fair scoring, regulars with stories, disaster rescues and influencer ready one-click vertical clips to share every set.

details.title: Faunaville
details.short_description: Care for animals, build lasting bonds, and learn new abilities from your companions in Faunaville, a cozy farming RPG. Grow crops, cook meals, fish, help the townsfolk, and explore alongside an animal buddy in turn-based battles. All at your own pace. No stamina bar, no day clock, do what you want.

details.title: One Twisted Boxing Day
details.short_description: Build a manic gift-making factory as you buy upgrades, race the clock, chase quotas, fight off inspectors, and gently... unalive your employees in this comedic Christmas-themed real-time automation game. For the good of the company!

details.title: Pave The Universe
details.short_description: Your home planet sent you and your alien crew with one job: pave the whole planet, every last square metre. Dig, level, cut pavers to size, build factories and robots, and take over a wild little planet. Solo or with up to 8 friends.

details.title: The House Doesn't End
details.short_description: A first-person puzzle game inside a house that refuses to make sense. Step through impossible doorways, walk on walls, and work alongside a replay of your own movements. Carry objects between rooms, connect the clues, and find your way out.

details.title: Multi Purpose Wheel Incremental
details.short_description: Rotate everything in this new spin on the Incremental genre! Rotate satisfying contraptions to earn interconnected currencies. Upgrade the contraptions to earn more, earn faster, and earn whackier. Unlock new contraptions to expand your rotating horizons.

details.title: BLOOD KESTREL
details.short_description: BLOOD KESTREL is a story-driven tactical stealth and action FPS. After a staged "gas accident" claims your wife's life and turns you into Subject K-7 of an illegal military gene program, break out of the Helix underground lab, customize looted weapons in real time, and hunt down the syndicate.

details.title: Meander
details.short_description: Draw with crochet stitches, draw new brushes to fit any aesthetic, draw little animation paths to bring your art to life! There are no goals or timers. Just a lot of options to let you relax and be creative. Fill your scrapbook with your doodles and decorate them with stickers and text! (No AI)

details.title: Pawprint Trails
details.short_description: Solve cozy animal logic puzzles and help little friendships bloom. Find every friend's place across 128 puzzles, create ten shared sanctuary projects, and collect memories of picnics, stargazing, baking, and more.

details.title: Main Street Operator
details.short_description: Buy a tired neighborhood laundromat and turn it around. Walk the floor, clean and repair machines, manage prices and cash flow, modernize the store, win back customers, pay down the seller note, and decide when the business is finally worth keeping—or selling.

details.title: Whispers from Below
details.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

details.title: Relocate Motorhomes Simulator
details.short_description: Drive 60 motorhomes across 12 handcrafted worlds and more than 300 km of road. Deliver RVs, start your own rental company, furnish your home on wheels, cook, adopt a pet and road-trip in cross-platform convoy with voice chat.

details.title: Nexus: Eternal Ruin
details.short_description: Chosen by the gods, fight to save the universe in this survivor-like bullet heaven. Complete objectives, slay endless hordes, collect their souls and unlock new abilities on your way to each world's final boss. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

details.title: ALL GAS
details.short_description: ALL GAS is an endless traffic-weaving roguelike experience on a highway that crumbles behind you as you drive. Upgrade your vehicle and modify your environment in real-time as you weave through traffic. Find your line, stay in the flow, and earn your spot on the global leaderboards.

details.title: Mini Chess
details.short_description: Turn your Steam Deck or Steam Machine into a simple hand drawn lightweight Mini Chess board for two.

details.title: Quitter's Quest
details.short_description: Quit your job in Quitters Quest! Escape your soul-crushing office job by solving puzzles, outsmarting annoying coworkers, and talking to everything in this classic-style point and click adventure. Take what's left of your dignity and get the hell out.

details.title: Pro & College Football Coach
