details.short_description: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

details.title: Smash Simulator
details.short_description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

details.title: Aftershock
details.short_description: An earthquake has just struck the building you’re in — and caught off guard, you’ll have only moments to react. Every step could mean the difference between life and death.

details.title: Chest & Blade
details.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where the fighting happens on its own. The deciding doesn't: open chests, compare gear, salvage the rest, then spend it on skills, runes and three-card augments until the wall you were stuck on breaks. Offline progress keeps it moving.

details.title: The Friendliest Skunk
details.short_description: Skunk is the friendliest critter in the forest — but his natural scent makes making friends a bit… tricky. Help Skunk traverse a musical forest, in this charming rhythm-based platformer! Meet adorable forest friends, outwit hungry predators, and prove that kindness (+ good timing) conquers all!

details.title: HOTLIME
details.short_description: Chaotic PvP party game for 2–4 players. Citrus fighters battle to the death in a hellish skyscraper — one hit decides everything. Escape, if the bartender lets you!

details.title: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
details.short_description: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

details.title: Terrafarmer
details.short_description: A roguelite farming strategy game where every tile matters. Choose from randomly offered polyomino crop tiles, arrange them for powerful synergies, and terraform a dead planet before your debt catches up.

details.title: Chibi Engine
details.short_description: Make your desktop a lively place with cute chibi characters. Pet them, talk to them, give them gifts, and decorate your workspace with image or GIF stickers. Join our community on Steam Workshop to share your own characters and discover what others create

details.title: 问仙程
details.short_description: 《问仙程》是一款追寻鲜活修仙体验的开放世界角色扮演游戏。你将踏上一段修仙之旅，体验不同寻常的修仙境界、凝练法相真身。与百态角色互动，触发丰富事件——结交仙友、争夺奇遇秘境。你的抉择将深刻改变众生命运，这片开放天地中，是救世之道还是灭世之途？全凭你一念之间！

details.title: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover
details.short_description: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover is an intense 2D beat em' up set in a world dominated by corporations led by monsters! The only way out is up! Begin your freelance kaiju career in campaign mode, or play with friends in the traditional, challenging arcade mode!

details.title: Ta-Miu
details.short_description: Play as a cat chosen by the goddess Bastet. Solve ancient puzzles, unlock magical powers, and uncover the secrets of Egypt filled with myths, temples, and tombs. Embark on a mystical adventure and stop an ancient evil!

name: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -

details.title: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -
details.short_description: 古代中国から伝わる呪術「蟲毒」に着想を得た、「蟲毒×魔獣錬成×落ちものパズル」それが、「シェオルの森-黄昏の魔獣使い-」です。魔獣を使い魔にし、魔獣と戦わせ、使い魔同士を融合し巨大な魔獣を錬成しましょう！

details.title: Shrouded Siege
details.short_description: Design dastardly mazes in this co-op roguelike tower defense set in Irish mythology. Combine divine boons to make unstoppable towers and sculpt the terrain to make the ultimate death traps for your enemies.

details.title: Car-Nudge
details.short_description: Car-Nudge is a party game with cars. Play locally or online with up to 8 players, through different minigames and levels. Demolish your friends (or enemies) to win and unlock new customizations and cars to play with.

details.title: Chicken Jump, Puppy Jump
details.short_description: An online multiplayer party game for 4–8 players. Build your crew of robo-animal thieves, roam across insane locations to snatch treasures, or simply STEAL goodies from rival players — all to become the MOST WANTED crew on the Bounty Board!

details.title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
details.short_description: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

details.title: Sweets'Devil
details.short_description: 《Sweets' Devil》is a Top-View action adventure game that emphasizes one shot kill and roaming. Engage in level battles and boss challenges in a humorous and entertaining fairy tale style , ‌fight against various sweets legions that treat human as the devil in their legend .

details.title: Oakley the Leafbug
details.short_description: Your best friend is going to make a horrible mistake that brings on the end of the world. Race across the Earth in this 2.5D platformer to find her, before it's too late!

details.title: Vibes TCG
details.short_description: A quirky Penguin-filled Trading Card Game.

details.title: ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom
details.short_description: Detective novelist MEL Gideon, whose career is facing difficulties, receives a strange letter claiming someone is in trouble and needs her help. Intrigued, she decides to investigate. As she digs deeper, she starts to realize that her past is far more complicated than she ever imagined...

details.title: Awen
details.short_description: Awen is a large Open world fantasy VR RPG. When creating Awen we aimed to make every aspect of the gameplay uncompromised, from movement to combat. Combat is visceral and satisfying. Exploration and progress is open-ended. Come explore the world of Awen.

details.title: Paddle Cats
details.short_description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

details.title: B-Type: Space Builder
details.short_description: A base builder shoot'em up in Deep Space. Explore the galaxy aboard your B-Type Star Ship. Shoot down your foes to expand your territory. Build planetary facilities, collect resources and raise an Intergalactic Defense Force. Can you save the world from a robotic alien invasion across dimensions?

details.title: Outer Express
details.short_description: 500 years after Earth's destruction, humanity scours desolate planets for resources. As a Star Scavenger, lead your team on dangerous expeditions to collect valuable scrap within a limited time. Race against the clock, outwit deadly aliens, and work together to survive and complete the mission.

details.title: Pinbleton Park
details.short_description: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

details.title: Sever's Zone
details.short_description: "Sever's Zone" is a 3D first-person shooter about survival in the Anomalous Zone, full of artifacts, anomalies and dangerous inhabitants of the Zone - living and not so. The plot of the game is based on a series of books in the genre of science fiction.

details.title: Eionis
details.short_description: Enter the world of Eionis in a dynamic, free-to-play 2D MMORPG. Choose one of 9 unique character classes - from a samurai to a destroyer, and many other diverse playstyles. Explore an open world, fight monsters, collect items, and develop your character through both PvE and PvP battles.

details.title: Consortium's Fall: Echoes of Xo'lara
details.short_description: Consortium’s Fall is a sci-fi roguelite twin-stick shooter about a people’s budding rebellion against a ruthless oppressor. Infiltrate enemy territory, defeat those who stand in your way and uncover secrets necessary to free your people once and for all.

details.title: Hoops Ahead: Basketball Manager
details.short_description: A new basketball league has been founded! Manage, trade, and sign players to help lead your team to a championship.

details.title: CapyBash
details.short_description: Jump, stomp, laugh and dominate. Think you can beat your friends in the ultimate capybara showdown? Prove it!

details.title: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure across a nuclear-torn America! Play as Pedro and Sofia and set out on a quest in this open-world, 3D/2D role-playing game!

details.title: One More Wipe : Raid Night
details.short_description: One More Wipe : Raid Night — Lead a 25-player raid. Alone. Nobody's late, nobody's AFK, and you will still wipe. Recruit from 10 classes, draft a new build every run and call the shots through 8 dungeons and 16 bosses. Or hand the raid to your AI agent.

details.title: TOCOViX
details.short_description: Place Crosses on the game board and complete "Shapes". Earn "Stops" to block your opponents and make your way to victory! Play with your friends on the same device or challenge other players Online.

details.title: KEEPERS 1477
details.short_description: A story-driven action RPG set in medieval Ottoman Istanbul, featuring authentic Ottoman and Turkish miniature art. Explore the city, complete quests, master brutal melee combat, cast powerful spells, discover hidden secrets, and battle hordes of undead and demons to protect the capital.

details.title: Card Buster
details.short_description: Get ready to bust through enemies with powerful card combos in this action-packed roguelike! Build your deck, master crazy synergies, and take on the evil mage Psychic to free Dusty Creek in this fast-paced, post-apocalyptic adventure!

details.title: Kaiju Catastrophe
details.short_description: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart!

details.title: Fabled Frontier
details.short_description: An open world survival action rpg set in a procedurally generated world inspired by fairy tales. Build your hero as well as a home!

details.title: The One Who Stands Behind
details.short_description: You are a God of Destruction. Realize your strength through powerfull card combos and burn your enemies from existence in the unique deckbuilder combined with hex-grid tactics.

details.title: Kanun 1919
details.short_description: An action-adventure game set in a dieselpunk world. You are an imperial courier tasked with investigating the disappearance of a special cargo in the sealed-off city of Turov. Uncover its dark secrets and face the unknown. The fate of the city—and perhaps the entire world—rests on your shoulders!

details.title: Indie Game Farmer
details.short_description: Grow crops. Fund your game-making dream. Tend your pixel farm, sell the harvest, and upgrade your tools while dividing each day between farming, part-time work, and game development. Turn your first potato into your first release, and build a living from crops and games.

details.title: VOIDRUSH
details.short_description: An action roguelite, solo or co-op with up to 10 players. Face endless hordes, combine 52 weapons and 161 items into devastating evolutions, unions and synergies, and hold on until the end as the Void awakens beyond the map.

details.title: Bullet Maidens
details.short_description: Protect a school from demon soldiers. Battle followers of the occult. Discover a chilling revelation that just might lead to doom...or salvation? A turn-based tactical shooter that doesn't rely on luck about Taiwanese schoolgirls saving their refuge in a world at war.

details.title: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
details.short_description: Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Renew an old farm. Give new life to the farmland. Take care of the animals. Convince Old Bill that together you can do more. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer.

details.title: Adventures of Steve the Cat
details.short_description: You are a cute cat Steve, who has to go through a lot of beautiful, exciting and dangerous locations. On the way you will meet a lot of enemies created by a crazy professor.

details.title: DreamVision Studio
details.short_description: "DreamVision Studio" is a Studio/World maker for content creators in real time that uses the webcam to generate an avatar that can interact with the customizable world. Its the definitive content creation playground that can be used as a tool.

details.title: Tank Arena
details.short_description: Tank Arena is a chaotic top-down multiplayer tank shooter built for fast, explosive battles with friends. Jump into the arena, blast each other with shells, and see who survives the longest.

details.title: Subway Nomads
details.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic metro system. Explore dark tunnels, battle zombies, and build your mobile base. Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer co-op. Will you escape to the surface or thrive in the underground?

details.title: Evie: The Echo Condition
details.short_description: Explore a dangerous, forgotten world to find the cure to save your best friend’s life, in Evie, an HD-2D action-adventure game that weaves a wordless fantasy tale out of the real-life battle against childhood leukemia.

details.title: Followers of Krow
details.short_description: Medieval Fantasy RPG Autobattler in a 3D Pixel Art style, where you buy and upgrade abilities to fight monsters and explore to uncover secrets about the world.

details.title: CUBOID
details.short_description: CUBOID is a challenging spatial puzzle game with minimalist design, where you progress through a labyrinth of levels using a unique mechanic of merging with world blocks.

details.title: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
details.short_description: An incompetent wizard is tasked with stopping a recently awakened evil entity that just so happens to be trapped inside a (deeply suspiciously heavy) spoon. What follows is a sprawling, absurd 1990s-style point-and-click comedy adventure across bizarre fantasy realms and also North Derbyshire.

details.title: ICE on the EDGE
details.short_description: Become a coach in ICE on the EDGE, a figure skating simulation game. Train your athlete, master skills, and craft the perfect routine to win. Face fierce rivals and experience a dramatic story carved on the ice. Can your guidance lead them to the highest stage?

details.title: Orbit Fall
details.short_description: Master thrust and momentum against gravity. Dodge hazards, land on distant planets, and complete missions using your ship’s systems. Move objects and clear paths. Manage fuel and damage, upgrade your craft, then launch back to orbit in this 2D pixel-art arcade adventure.

details.title: Rally Dynasty
details.short_description: A rally manager from 1973 to today. Run one family team: hire the drivers, buy the cars, choose the tyres and pay every bill in period money. When a driver retires or dies, an heir takes over the team. Unofficial and unlicensed.

details.title: Marco!
details.short_description: Marco Polo, except your friends can hear you panic. One player hunts blindfolded, seeing only the sounds you make. Hide, whisper, sabotage your friends, and try not to laugh in this microphone-powered multiplayer game of hide-and-seek.

details.title: RogueForge
details.short_description: Draw your own weapons and build a place to call home. RogueForge is a 3D open-world survival crafting game with gathering, farming, cooking, building and combat. Trade with local communities, engrave runes into your gear, and explore dungeons and challenge bosses.

details.title: Down to Business
details.short_description: Turn every dig into a bigger operation. Mine for valuable ore, take on contracts, upgrade your vehicle, and build your bases to reach as deep into the planet as possible.

details.title: HOLD THE COOP!
details.short_description: HOLD THE COOP! is an incremental auto-battler where you protect your coop from waves of coyotes. Earn gold, buy upgrades, unlock stronger chicken units, and survive tougher rounds. Lose, upgrade, and come back stronger!

name: Mixed Waste Tidy Up the Landfill

details.title: Mixed Waste Tidy Up the Landfill
details.short_description: One million pieces of trash. Five hungry mouths. One enormous cleanup.

details.title: Please Fix!
details.short_description: You're the entire IT department. Dash between desks, untangle cables, rescue printers and tackle increasingly ridiculous tickets in this funny single-player time-management game. Keep the office happy, upgrade your toolkit, and bring an emotional support duck. No IT knowledge required.

details.title: Mind Forge
details.short_description: A calm, data-driven cognitive trainer. 14 science-based drills sharpen attention, memory, logic, space and reaction: Stroop inhibition, n-back, paper folding, stop-signal tasks. Transparent stats, adaptive difficulty, auto review scheduling. No account; all data stays on your device.

details.title: Sweep Together
details.short_description: The world’s famous monuments are closed. The reason? Mountains of trash! Join the Sweeper Crew, upgrade your tools, and get these iconic sights ready to reopen. Clean solo, team up in online co-op, or work for rival companies in PvP. Race to finish your cleanup first and claim the prize!

details.title: MotoBox
details.short_description: Motobox is a Sandbox game where you freely ride your motorcycle and weave through traffic at high speed. Experiment with a collection of Motorcycles , Maps & Sandboxes to Ride in , and freely experience how it feels to drive at high speeds through crowded city traffics.

details.title: WHERE MEMORY FAILS
details.short_description: Where Memory Fails is a dark fantasy memory-and-deduction roguelite. Read the dungeon's clues, reveal a path through the grid, collect gold, survive its dangers, and find the exit before your health and steps run out.

details.title: Rollamon
details.short_description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

details.title: Mechanical Salvage Works
details.short_description: A light, bite-sized incremental game where you zap runaway machines, salvage parts, fulfill orders, and customize your machines!
developers: 为什么不问问神奇海螺呢
publishers: 为什么不问问神奇海螺呢

details.title: May the Best Craft Win
details.short_description: Send four adventurers into a dungeon while you are away. Come back to a haul of sealed loot and rare ore, then gamble it all at the forge: refine, socket, enchant, and sell the surplus on a living market. An idle party RPG where the dungeon is the input and the crafting is the game.

details.title: BountySisters
details.short_description: Three bounty-hunting sisters take on a wild cast of villains in this fully voiced vertical shoot ’em up! Choose from three unique aircraft, master a variety of weapons, tackle gimmick-packed stages, and face powerful bosses in a colorful world with character designs by Shuzilow.HA.

details.title: Micro Generals
details.short_description: Micro Generals is a 2D SideScrolling Tug Of War RTS featuring 6 distinct factions with 100+ distinct units with their own strenghts and weaknesses , upgrades system , deep tactical play , 56 levels and faction superpowers

details.title: Starets
details.short_description: Starets is a narrative walking sim set in the historical context of 14th-century Rus, in the lands of the Principality of Tver. Nikodim, a former princely scribe, is on his way to a monastery.

details.title: Goldgrave
details.short_description: An incremental auto-battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero to slay hordes and loot gear. Pick a class with its own attack style and learn its skills. Gear up, sweep the gold and descend against floors of enemies, bosses and legendary drops.

details.title: Kintsugi Master
details.short_description: Find beauty in the broken. Restore treasured objects through the art of Kintsugi, fulfill commissions, and upgrade your materials as you grow into a master artisan. A cozy, relaxing experience with soothing ASMR sounds and increasingly intricate creations.

details.title: Dig to Escape
details.short_description: Dig to Escape is a co-op digging game where you search a mysterious island for buried objects. Turn your discoveries into scrap, upgrade your tools and uncover the missing boat motor parts you need to escape. Play alone or dig irresponsibly with your friends.

details.title: Toothpick Museum
details.short_description: You are the curator of the Toothpick Museum. The day before opening, your exhibits shattered! Carefully pick up the scattered toothpicks, avoid getting pricked, and rebuild the museum's masterpiece before the doors open!

details.title: Bonfire Room
details.short_description: A cozy, low-key multiplayer hangout for 2-4 players around a quiet campfire. Feed the fire, sit back and watch the flames, and share six wordless emotes to connect. No goals, no competition, no pressure to talk — just being there together is the point. Works solo too, as ambient background company.

details.title: Prosecutor Absolution
details.short_description: You have been appointed Deputy Chief Prosecutor of Davelia. Your goal is to pay off your mortgage. Your tool is other people's prison sentences. Your conscience is your problem. The State of Davelia will not forget about you.

details.title: Forever
details.short_description: Forever is a free-to-play, old-school 2D fantasy MMORPG. Create your character, level up, master your class, fight in open PvP duels and tournaments, found a clan and trade in a persistent world shared with players on PC and other devices.

details.title: Weirdoku: The Files
details.short_description: Weirdoku: the Files is a horror puzzle game. You play as a new recruit at the Anomaly Bureau, reconstructing the scene from the clues and identifying the Anomaly hidden among the people.

details.title: Goblin Apocalypse: Open World Survival
details.short_description: The human king is dead, and the fragile peace of Turtek died with him. Survive as a goblin in an open world, solo or in co-op: sneak past raiders, fight with stamina-based combat, rescue goblins and peaceful humans, and build a colony that keeps working while you explore.

details.title: Battleterm
details.short_description: Battleterm is a drone combat simulator, a fusion of a simulator and a strategy game. It aims to simulate a real drone battlefield. Your task is to defeat the enemy by spawning different drones and coordinating their strategies. And the game economy matters too.

details.title: Tetrilaunch
details.short_description: An arcade physics puzzle where you aim and fire tetromino shipments into a compacting bay, build full rows, and survive escalating ten-bay runs.

details.title: Station 12
details.short_description: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players, with larger lobbies up to 12. Find keycards and race to escape a doomed station while a friend hunts you as the Monster. Land the shot that saves your crew, or give away your hiding spot over proximity chat.

details.title: Yes, Your Majesty!
details.short_description: Outrageous! A century on the throne—peace and prosperity across the realm—yet my flag covers but a speck on the map? I keep an elite army, and all they do is parade for me! Guards! A grand campaign begins! — Yes! Your Majesty!

details.title: Infinite Fireball
details.short_description: Shout your incantations to cast spells in this chaotic co-op party game for up to 20 players! Play Colossus Guard, brawl in free-for-all or team deathmatches, and customize your magic words and character look. Embrace the chaos and show your unique style!

details.title: Revengeful dwell
details.short_description: This is a first-person horror adventure game. From horror game developer Akumu Yuko comes the third installment, “Revengeful dwell.”

details.title: A Mirror Apart
details.short_description: Explore a world inspired by Infinity Mirror Rooms. Guide Kagami through peaceful, handcrafted isometric puzzles, where every move echoes through imperfect mirrored spaces and each reflection becomes part of the solution.

details.title: Merchants Demise
details.short_description: A dark roguelike trading RPG where you lead a caravan through a dangerous kingdom, buy low, sell high, recruit a crew, survive brutal encounters, and gamble everything on one more, profitable journey.

details.title: Machine Madness
details.short_description: Build your machine, connect moving parts, set goals, and watch physics take over. Professor Otto Correct has a workshop, a cat, and many parts that were never meant to go together.

details.title: Epsilon Aurigae
details.short_description: Stranded in a nebula with a broken hyperdrive. Interact with peculiar creatures that call this corner of the galaxy their home in order to trade for items and ultimately get the parts that you need to fix your ship.

details.title: ARUFA - The Blade of Fate
details.short_description: An anime-inspired 3D hack-and-slash game where you chain attacks, dodge enemy strikes, unleash powerful abilities, and challenge yourself to defeat a dangerous boss.

details.title: 国gal笑笑传
details.short_description: 当国产galgame占领了整个世界。吃饭、睡觉、打工、购买，这个世界的一切都围绕国产galgame发生。你将在这里体验到超过50款“有趣”的galgame游戏。努力打工然后购买更多galgame吧！

details.title: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors
details.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

details.title: Border Pastoral Tale
details.short_description: A relaxing, wholesome cartoon-style herding simulation game. Become a sheepdog and guide scattered flocks back to their pens across vast grasslands while fending off wolf attacks. Supports local 2-player co-op with simple controls. Experience pure fun through agile movement and precise herding!

name: AI 位面旅者：无限世界

details.title: AI 位面旅者：无限世界
details.short_description: 《AI 位面旅者：无限世界》是一款由 AI 实时驱动的团队冒险 RPG。你带着队伍在位面之间穿梭：探索区域、完成任务、打怪、升级、招募同伴；也可以在信标塔手填世界观、区域、角色与部队，造一个完全属于自己的位面。剧情、敌人、事件全部由 AI 现场生成，没有两次冒险是一样的。每个角色都有自己的记忆与打算，会按自己的目标行动；你不在的时候，区域里的角色仍在自行流动。角色、装备、技能、血统分 D 到 SSS 品级，敌人与友军部队是成建制的单位；回合制战斗可手动指挥每一次出手。买断制，需自备 AI 服务商 API Key 驱动剧情。

details.title: Driver Survivor
details.short_description: A driving survivors-like where your car is the weapon. Drift through zombie hordes, stack automatic weapons and upgrades, smash through a destructible city, and rescue survivors in a branching story—or push your build to its limit in endless mode.

details.title: PUYON
details.short_description: A fresh take on mouse action! PUYON is a level-based, top-down 2D action game where you use your mouse to reach the goal without bumping into walls or objects.

details.title: Mightmancer
details.short_description: An old-school first-person action RPG set across a vast open world. Explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies, master four mixable classes, recruit companions. Relive the iconic blend of 2D and 3D art unique to late-90s RPGs.

details.title: Schooligans
details.short_description: A chaotic school party game for 1 to 8 players. Pull off the dumbest stunts, film everything on your phone, outsmart teachers who can hear your voice, sneak out at night and betray your friends to become the most popular kid at Coolischool. A stunt nobody filmed never happened.

details.title: Nectar Spines
details.short_description: You encounter your handsome model neighbor in the story, but he harbors dark intentions toward you… A stormy night approaches. Evade his pursuit and struggle desperately. Yet the second you launch the game, escape is impossible.

details.title: Ɐ L∞P
details.short_description: A first-person observation horror game set in an apartment trapped in a ten-day loop. Find and correct every anomaly, survive the monster, and reach the door on Day 10. Miss one detail—or get caught—and you return to Day 0.

details.title: Circuit Manager
details.short_description: Manage your own racing circuit. Upgrade its facilities, increase its prestige, attract bigger and better racing series, and deal with everything that can go wrong during a race weekend

details.title: Montic
details.short_description: Assemble an army of time monkeys to defeat time-eating termites! Plan your moves around your enemies' known movements in this turn-based strategy game.

details.title: Fallen Valkyries: Prologue
details.short_description: An Anime Wave-based Arena Shooter, Kill Goblin > Collect Bounty > Buy Upgrade > Survive

details.title: Lumber Plumber
details.short_description: Lumber Plumber is a game about tree felling, water plumbing, ore mining, rock crushing, metal bending, resource exploring, and wonder assembling. Transport lumber across long distances using steam locomotives and conveyor belts.

details.title: Check My Papers
details.short_description: 2027. One year since the superpowers’ standoff came to a head. The nuclear winter has lifted, but people still hide in bunkers, afraid of the radiation. Who gets a new home—and who is cast out into the wastes? Lives are in your hands, Captain.

details.title: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
details.short_description: "Paradise Beyond the Nightmare" is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

details.title: 和平东京
details.short_description: This is an anti-war themed destruction game. Our goal is world peace! To achieve this great mission, we must first establish peace in Tokyo!

details.title: Isometric House Builder
details.short_description: A cozy 2D isometric building game with pixel art style. Follow blueprints to place blocks and construct houses step by step. Balance accuracy and creativity as you complete foundations, walls, and roofs, turning simple plans into charming pixel-art homes.

details.title: Shogi: AI’s Forbidden Move
details.short_description: A groundbreaking shogi game created entirely without a game engine. From rule design to thinking algorithms, everything has been conceived and built by AI. Experience a unique worldview and gameplay that sets it apart from any shogi game before.

details.title: TomaDO!
details.short_description: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

details.title: What a Wonderful Venom World
details.short_description: "What a Wonderful Venom World" is a difficult survival sim. All food is poisoned, and you must find an antidote through endless trial and error. Face countless deaths and share info with other players to speed up your research. This game is for players who enjoy a serious challenge.

details.title: Demondemon Demon Tamer
details.short_description: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

details.title: Devoid
details.short_description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

details.title: A Baby CEO?!
details.short_description: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

details.title: Moonlight Cradle
details.short_description: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

details.title: Nitrania
details.short_description: Race. Boost. Unlock. A blazing-fast 90s-inspired arcade grip racer with 4-player split-screen. Master nitro to overtake 19 rivals, collect points, and unlock cars, upgrades, and vibrant track regions. Featuring an original soundtrack by the legendary retro racing composer BARRY LEITCH.

details.title: Emoji Guess Party
details.short_description: Think you can guess the answer from a few emojis? Emoji Guess Party is a lighthearted emoji puzzle game filled with idioms, wordplay, internet slang, and brain-teasing riddles. Play solo or guess together with friends.

details.title: Carte Blanche
details.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

details.title: Deep Claims
details.short_description: Deep Claims is a space exploration game where you upgrade your ship and equipment in order to mine increasingly valuable and hazardous asteroids. Can you make it to the core?

details.title: Investment Fund Game
details.short_description: Investment Fund Game is a singleplayer sandbox simulation where you become the manager of an investment fund. Buy stocks, bonds, commodities. Test different investment strategies, track your performance, and compete with AI-driven funds using their own approaches.

details.title: Bar Master
details.short_description: Bar Master is a management game where you play as a bar owner and must develop your business. Start by serving beers in a simple bar, hire waiters, unlock new drinks, expand your bar, and buy new bars in the city!

details.title: 模拟修仙录
details.short_description: 《模拟修仙录》是一款修仙题材的策略构筑游戏。穿越获得无限模拟金手指的你，将利用系统随机提供的天材地宝、流派秘法及修仙百艺，一步步积累真元、修炼突破，构筑独属于自己的修炼法门，最终证道长生！

details.title: Midnight Dies Y2K
details.short_description: It’s December 31st, 1999. As the Devil’s daughter, you’ve been dared to stop your dad’s plan to take over the world before midnight. Solve wacky problems, collect bizarre items, and choose carefully—your decisions shape the ending!

details.title: Tasmon's Little Island ~ Cursed Mascot
details.short_description: Raise a mysterious creature "Tasmon" on your desktop!! No need to pay attention constantly, enjoy interacting with them in your free time. Once it has grown enough, you can challenge simple auto battles. The Tasmon's appearance upon birth will depend on what you do on your PC

details.title: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
details.short_description: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

details.title: Songs of the Shore
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover in this point-and-click 3D collectathon. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.

details.title: Knightmared
details.short_description: Auto-attack roguelike where you forge a knight into an unstoppable demon slayer. Survive 15 minutes, build devastating synergies, master your weapons.

details.title: Idle Bones Magic
details.short_description: Raise hordes of zombies and other un-dead beings to automate your dreams of conquest in this idle incremental game. Make your armies grow and snowball and then sit back and watch them take over the world.

details.title: Marble Run Maker
details.short_description: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions.

details.title: Barely Correct
details.short_description: Barely Correct blends arithmetic duels with romance. Numbers aren't just brain teasers—they're weapons for control. Win 1v1 calculation battles to strip away your opponent’s defenses layer by layer. Reach the tipping point to reveal the truth hidden beneath their surface.

details.title: Bunny Jump Jump
details.short_description: Journey up through the sewers, across lakes and up the tallest tree to catch the fleeting blue butterfly. Hop through challenging platforming challenges as a cute bunny and see beautifully handmade and cozy world!

details.title: ODDLI: A satisfying game
details.short_description: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

details.title: Ultakia
details.short_description: Ultakia is a turn-based space 4X strategy game with distinctive resource management. Explore exotic systems and acquire powerful technologies. Exploit your planets, trade with other races and destroy those who stand in your way.

details.title: Cyber Arena
details.short_description: You are being attacked by the virus. SURVIVE AS LONG AS POSSIBLE !!

details.title: Kowloon 666
details.short_description: Sequel to "School 666". Welcome to Kowloon Walled City!!! A co-op horror game about Kowloon, made by Lokin who still living in Kowloon.

details.title: My Slimadatchi
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion idle game where you care for your adorable slime as it plays, enjoys treats, and partake in activities with you. Earn slime points to unlock new toys, customize your Slimadatchi shell, and dress up your slime to create a companion that's truly your own!

details.title: Grotto Escape
details.short_description: You play as a SF character facing Heroic Fantasy creatures in this Dungeon Crawler with Platformer gameplay.

details.title: SWT: Survivor With Towers
details.short_description: Fusion of Vampire Survivors Like and Tower Defense! Survive with Towers against waves of enemies. Build towers by day, survive endless enemy waves by night. Expand your territory, gain experience, and grow stronger with each battle. How long can you survive?

details.title: Hellwire
details.short_description: A dueling deckbuilder game against other players. Learn the rules of the bizarre match unfolding before you, turn the tide with clever (and not so clever) abilities, don’t get tangled in the wires, and pray for the mercy of the Biomechanical Goat.

details.title: Trauma Record
details.short_description: 夜を歩く、血だまりの上を走る、永遠を断ち切る。 復讐のための翼は折れない。

details.title: RitualRX
details.short_description: RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-filled shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.

details.title: Wizard Hand
details.short_description: Wizard Hand is a magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. You play solitaire by using your magical cards to uncover dazzling combos and accumulate magical points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

details.title: Con Clicker
details.short_description: Con Clicker is an incremental game about building your evil TV infomercial empire. Scam your way to fortune by running outrageous ads, selling ridiculous products, and automating your operation for exponential growth. It's satire, scams, and endless clicking fun!

details.title: Project Roy
details.short_description: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

details.title: Potion in Motion
details.short_description: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

details.title: CLIMB IT!
details.short_description: Take on the challenge and conquer the mountain! Test your coordination and resilience as you scale sheer cliffs and navigate through mountain caves - where every misstep can come at a high cost. Join this thrilling adventure and prove your skill!

details.title: Looters Inc.
details.short_description: Looters Inc is a physics-based co-op heist game. Break into houses, clinics and banks with your friends. And steal the most valuable items you can find. But be careful, the residents are violent, maybe even more violent than you.

details.title: Ember of Origins
details.short_description: Ember of Origins is a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling pixel action shooter. Explore the ruins of a world consumed by infernal flames, scavenge resources, upgrade powerful weapons, and battle demonic hordes as you embark on a dangerous journey to rescue your missing companion.

details.title: SEALAND 2124
details.short_description: Sealand 2124 is a story-driven adventure puzzle game that takes you to a utopian city on the ocean. Join Anja and her clever albino magpie, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the secrets of a world that blends hope and danger.

details.title: Uagi-Saba 2
details.short_description: Uagi-Saba 2 is a creature care/breeder sim. Raise cute creatures called Faelings all with their own brain, genes and unique body parts. Guide them through beautiful hand drawn environments using speech and positive/negative reinforcement. Breed your favorites and create the perfect creature!

details.title: Shadow Dwellers – Deliverance
details.short_description: Deliver, or take it back. An observation-based horror game where you process packages while watching for subtle irregularities in the same apartment building. No correct answers are given. What remains are your decisions—and the recorded “variations.”

details.title: Mr. Cloak
details.short_description: Be the first to explore the uncharted labyrinth beneath the city of Dravaneth as Mr. Cloak. Use stealth and wit to uncover its secrets, evade deadly traps, and chart your own escape route. Every level has multiple exits, unlocking new paths, areas, and dangers in your journey to survive.

details.title: GTL Schedule
details.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

details.title: COLDNIGHTS
details.short_description: Learn how to survive, craft and build the essentials, find source of food and construct necessary shelter before the snow starts falling. And may be someday, after building a bridge, you will find your way back home. Keep building bridges.

details.title: Vironics
details.short_description: Control a Nanite body from a space station to gather Nanite resources on Earth, seized by a rogue AI. Build and fortify your dropbase with turrets and defenses, fight waves of robotic enemies, and collect Nanites for extraction, balancing fast FPS combat with strategic tower placement.

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own car rental lot in this detailed simulator. Manage reservations, clean and service vehicles, and keep customers happy. With time-based tasks, strategy elements, and high replayability, every day brings a new challenge.

details.title: Children's Garden
details.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

details.title: 后室迷失之境Backrooms：The Lost
details.short_description: A [Puzzle game] + [escape room] backrooms game;You are FBI agent Tommy.Unfortunately, he fell into the back room during a disappearance case.Random mazes, physical dangers, and the pressure of liminal spaces,Can you escape safely?

details.title: Magengaard
details.short_description: Magengaard is a 3D PvP arena game where spells are cast by drawing glyphs. Explore the fantasy world of the Academy, meet its inhabitants, uncover its mysteries, and master your skills in the arena.

details.title: Nuclear Sub: Prologue
details.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

details.title: Split Decision
details.short_description: In a dying town where boxing is the last stand of entertainment, you hold the judge’s pen. Bribes, threats, and loyalties will decide whether you live to judge another day… Or get knocked out cold. Split Decision is a tense narrative game where every point makes a difference.

details.title: ForgeCraft
details.short_description: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

details.title: FESTERED
details.short_description: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

details.title: Match Tree
details.short_description: Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game). Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep. Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

details.title: Ariadne's Tale
details.short_description: Ariadne's Tale is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth to rescue Theseus. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

details.title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
details.short_description: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

details.title: Eversiege
details.short_description: Eversiege is a roguelike, tower defense in which you'll defend a castle in procedurally generated terrain. Establish a production, build defending buildings and survive waves of enemies coming from everywhere! After defeat, buy new buildings, unlock new leaders and prepare to fight again.

details.title: Rotten Sails
details.short_description: A co-op horror about looting cursed islands for a cartel that won't go ashore itself. 1–4 players, in-game proximity chat, no weapons.

details.title: Panic In Store !
details.short_description: You play a supermarket employee who must (in each level and within a given time) put the right boxes in the right departments. But be careful! Customers will come after you to waste your time!

details.title: Byte Survivor
details.short_description: Bank balance: ¥0. Shut-in gamer El, lured by her pet robot Puruya, picks up a shady part-time job inside a video game. A tinker-heavy survivors-like: runs of about 10 minutes, simple controls, screen-melting hordes. Earn, build, and uncover more of the story with every run.

details.title: Retro Rail: Japan!
details.short_description: Drive nostalgic Japanese‑style trains through busy city lines and iconic routes. Follow timetables, signals, and station rules to become a master conductor. Choose between relaxed journeys or strict professional challenges in this retro 1990s console‑aesthetic simulator.

details.title: Uphill
details.short_description: A precision platformer that allows you to alter the environment.

details.title: Mercenarian
details.short_description: In a world inhabited by monsters, seek out stronger weapons and skillstones to snatch your enemies’ abilities. Spit poison like a spider, slash through relentless foes, and level up to face stronger creatures. Sharpen your weapons, choose how you fight, and live the life of a Mercenary.

details.title: Star Child
details.short_description: Star Child is an explosive new action-adventure set on a sinister alien planet. Fight numerous aliens and formidable bosses, wield powerful explosives and destructive laser weapons, find secrets and unlock new abilities as you progress. Can you survive your dangerous mission?

details.title: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
details.short_description: A pleasant breeze of ease and casual fun ... or a satisfying challenge and strategy - you decide how you want to play the game ! Also, a lot of cute animals !

details.title: Rules of War
details.short_description: Take command in this 4X-lite strategy game with fast-paced tactical combat and missile warfare. Build your economy, deploy land, sea, and air units, expand borders, advance technology, and navigate deceitful diplomacy. In a world of collapsing nuclear powers, can you lead your nation to victory?

details.title: Sleepy Cat
details.short_description: Who says cats are just for show? Cute can be deadly! A Roguelite ARPG featuring Day/Night cycles, Elemental counters, Skill learning, and Magic evolution—all in a fresh, vibrant art style! Become Laila the "Sleepy Cat" and uncover the vast, mysterious lore behind the Seven Valleys.

details.title: Skylark 64
details.short_description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

details.title: Shop Crush
details.short_description: Shop Crush is a shop-owner simulator and visual novel set in the early 2000s. Stock a wide variety of goods, haggle with shoppers, and manage your reputation. Get to know your regulars and peel back the illusions tied to each persona as you slowly uncover the horrifying truth.

details.title: Galactic Tavern
details.short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey as you build and manage your space tavern! Craft unique cocktails, and create a bustling atmosphere with live music performances. Explore the depths of space and become the ultimate entrepreneur in this management simulation adventure!

details.title: 万剑之残破修仙界
details.short_description: "The Broken Cultivation World of Ten Thousand Swords" is a portrait‑mode wuxia single‑player game from an indie developer. Featuring gorgeous combat visuals, its idle‑style gameplay focuses on item gathering. Every idle grind prepares for thrilling high‑damage bursts in turn‑based xianxia battles.

name: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D

details.title: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D
details.short_description: This HD-2D role-playing game pays tribute to the beloved Three Kingdoms RPGs of the classic console era. Follow the journey of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang as you recruit legendary heroes, travel across ancient China, and experience a grand tale of war, loyalty, and ambition.

details.title: Sakagura Life
details.short_description: In a quiet town nestled among rice paddies, you’ve bought an old sake brewery for a bargain. Craft premium sake, build friendships with locals and friendly Yokai, and battle hostile spirits while solving puzzles in this unique blend of life sim, adventure, and brewing.

details.title: Nova Dawn: Overload
details.short_description: Take up arms and take care of robot buddies in this co-op action roguelite. Hunt giant hostile robots that have stolen the sun to harvest their mechanical parts, upgrade the machinery you can build and strengthen the bond between you and your Nova robot buddies!

details.title: Dark & Quispy
details.short_description: A Fantasy Rogue-Like game with Paper thin graphics. Cut through waves of enemies and collect their souls to increase your power! Encounter a variety of enemies and events as you make your way through the DARK.

details.title: Echo of Prypiat
details.short_description: "Echo of Prypiat" is an exciting walking simulator that immerses the player in the atmosphere of the Chernobyl exclusion zone, conveying all the horrors and fears of people left in this forgotten land. The game is created to allow the player to feel the soul of this mysterious place.

details.title: Venusville
details.short_description: Guide pioneering settlers among Venusian clouds in this space colonisation city builder. Grow food, collect energy, mine resources, balance buoyancy and weight to stay afloat in the treacherous Venusian atmosphere, and build a self-sufficient colony while navigating storms and acidic clouds.

details.title: CPA:Reports Bousy
details.short_description: Experience the constant fear and loneliness surrounded by the decrepit old walls of an abandoned house with a tragic story, while feeling the true horror of being hunted by a creature created from a strong friendship. Try to survive and escape the house!

details.title: ULTRA MUSHROOM
details.short_description: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and ultra mushrooms that bring joy!

details.title: 约会普拉斯 Date Plus
details.short_description: A game born from memes, featuring the “World’s Richest Person” sending you $50, a chaotic skewer vendor, and a quirky dog-shaped backpack. Dive into a whimsical yet heartfelt dating adventure full of unexpected twists and pure hilarity!

details.title: INSTALLATION 19
details.short_description: Alex Carter, part of The Abducted UFO group, acts on a tip about nighttime sightings. Unknowingly, he wanders into a top-secret military base, triggering a suspenseful journey.

details.title: Library of Meialia
details.short_description: To uncover the secrets of Aethium Magic in the Library of Meialia, you’ve set out to prove your worth. Faced with doubts, pursuing forces, and sealed monsters, this journey is fraught with danger... Collect books, gather weapons, and explore the grand library alongside a diverse array of companions.

details.title: Spaceborne Fighters
details.short_description: Spaceborne Fighters is a dynamic action platformer featuring arena battles against hordes of enemies. Explore 10 diverse maps, develop your character through skill trees, and craft items to face challenges in the most spectacular way.

details.title: Transit World
details.short_description: Lead your transport company to success: manage people, vehicles, and finances, take on jobs or drive yourself – Transit World combines management depth with freedom.

details.title: Roman Legacy: Speed Trials
details.short_description: Explore a reimagined ancient Rome in the industrial revolution in this fast-paced precision platformer. Master abilities like jetpacks and dashing, interact with the environment through wall running, and navigate interesting levels. Compete on leaderboards in 'Roman Legacy: Speed Trials'.

details.title: 孤行
details.short_description: 边地一座废村，金军扎着哨。 一个断了手的人走回来。刀出鞘，旧事也一层层被拽出来。 《孤行》用「今日」与「昔日」双线讲张四的故事。 人还在同一条回村路上往深处走，记忆却把他送回水缸、集市、军营，以及更远的地方。 战斗嵌在剧情里。你读他的失去，也替他点出这一刀该落在谁身上。

details.title: Space Cleaners
details.short_description: You and your friends are building a space cleaning business. Navigate filthy and hostile space stations, clean everything up and work hard for your reputation.

details.title: Bloodsmith
details.short_description: A fierce, action-packed narrative RPG; Play as Quentin Ashborne, the archaeologist whose duty has brought him to fight tooth and nail against the damned souls. If you are to survive, you must learn to manage & manipulate blood. Ride the downward spiral.

details.title: The Barkeeper
details.short_description: Swap the espresso machine for a cocktail shaker! Mix, shake and serve drinks against the clock, master new recipes in bars across the city and keep your customers happy - solo or with a friend in 2-player co-op. One wrong ingredient and it's straight in the trash!

details.title: Broken & Loved
details.short_description: Broken & Loved is an interactive visual novel which tells the story of Evangeline and Rei, two university students entangling their lives in a love story fill with reflection, drama, sweetness and happiness.

details.title: Terrestrial planet
details.short_description: On a planet with a biome climate similar to Earth, manage your residents from basic construction and planting, develop and research various cutting-edge technologies, recruit soldiers to form troops, resist foreign enemies or actively conquer other countries, and unify this distant planet.

details.title: Tank Core
details.short_description: "Tank Core" is a 2D top-down shooter game infused with Roguelike elements. Players will collect various random tank components in levels, including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores, to assemble unique tanks that will protect base and defeat all enemies encountered.

details.title: Cryptage
details.short_description: A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters and buying new staffs and skins to improve yourself! The game has endless mode.

details.title: Raiders Rise
details.short_description: Explore hostile planets, face endless hordes of devourers, collect crystals, and upgrade your equipment. Choose the hero that best suits your playstyle, cooperate with your allies to survive… or betray the other team at the perfect moment and claim victory.

details.title: Wildlife Sports : Untamed
details.short_description: Join your friends in a silly sports Showdown! Choose your totem animal and compete in wacky games. With simple yet entertaining gameplay, enjoy quick matches or all-night sessions of endless fun and laughter. Who will reign supreme?

details.title: Rico's Theater
details.short_description: Rico's Theater is an extremely intense first-person online multiplayer horror game. Choose multiple classes that vary in weapons & abilities & work together with friends in fighting dangerous entities.

details.title: Planet Party Time
details.short_description: "Planet Party Time" combines social sim & party games. As an alien, team with robot PADI to restore a planet via unique recruits. Become a Cube Galaxy Hero Candidate: explore space, play minigames for rewards. Build custom minigames via intuitive editor & host parties!

details.title: Chill Chess
details.short_description: Relax, strategize, and master chess in a sleek 3D sci-fi world. Play against friends or other players online, or challenge smart AI.

details.title: My Fairy Princess
details.short_description: In My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals. Your choices shape not only the life she leads, but the one she comes to love.

name: 異星間恋愛ガイド ‐Interplanetary love guide‐

details.title: 異星間恋愛ガイド ‐Interplanetary love guide‐
details.short_description: A romance simulation set in a future where interstellar travel is common. Explore the island, meet alien characters, and deepen your bonds through daily choices. A world woven from danger, secrets, and quiet moments of connection. Your choices shape each relationship and lead to multiple endings.

details.title: SHOCK
details.short_description: With only a wheelchair for mobility, Jack, a disabled war veteran, must use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape a cybernetic creature. Explore a psychological survival horror experience in third person and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

details.title: Kayotica
details.short_description: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

details.title: Ashen Vow
details.short_description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

details.title: Rentcthulhu
details.short_description: A dark fairytale deckbuilder where you serve Ancient Gods. Reconstruct shattered stories using card suits and racial synergies. Stack high scores to complete Oracle challenges in this twisted roguelike adventure. Can you mend the fragments before the darkness wins?

details.title: Echo Protocol
details.short_description: A sci-fi survivors-style shooter. Hold the line across boarded stations, neon extraction runs, convoy escorts and frozen outposts. Level up mid-fight and stack elemental rounds, drones and auras into a run-ending build — or gamble on pacts that cut as deep as they hit. Every run feeds your Echoes.

details.title: Wade: Fly Fishing
details.short_description: Step into a Quebec river and fly fish in VR. Hand-crafted rod and line physics, living currents, and fish fights that demand real focus, hook it, fight it, and try not to lose it.

details.title: 白噪
details.short_description: What?! Mr. Boring is trying to invade the universe? No way! Grab your shotgun, power gauntlets, rocket launcher, and the 24/7 rock ‘n’ roll bass cannon! Unleash a storm of bullets to the beat of the sickest rhythm and save the world the only way a true superhero can, White Noise!

details.title: Dystopia RPG
details.short_description: Dystopia RPG is an 8 bit style fantasy RPG where You lost a duel to a government's shaman and ended up trapped and sealed in a Cell Phone application. Explore the Dungeons, Combat monsters, Collect and Trade Items, Glitch the game & break free.

details.title: HexBrandPre
details.short_description: Story of VoltSpark. Choose the most suitable set of equipments for you, then dodge the bullets and crash the enemies. A bullet-hell game, which is quite difficult. Instant reactions, level understanding, strategies are requird to beat this game. As agile as leopard, ruin everything like thunder.

details.title: Cube Party
details.short_description: Cube Party is a 2-8 player co-op puzzle and adventure game! Team up with friends, stack your box characters into walls, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and find the key to clear 40+ unique levels!

details.title: FLINT
details.short_description: Multiplayer survival in an open world. Build your base, farm, hunt different creatures, survive in a harsh world, fight or team up with other players and evolve through the ages.

details.title: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm
details.short_description: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm is a BL visual novel set in an epic fantasy world — told through 8 POV characters, 30+ fully illustrated cast members, accompanied with 40+ soundtracks and 50+ event CG's. The story branches based on your decisions, shaping relationships, loyalties, and personal fates.

details.title: The Sword Wizard - Part 1
details.short_description: A 2D action-adventure game through a fun and silly story. Use magic to launch swords at enemies. Explore maps to find more swords of various types and questionable designs. Magically combine swords into new powers to unleash even more swords at enemies.

details.title: Chronia: The Rotcore
details.short_description: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

details.title: Aboxcalipse
details.short_description: Grab supplies, stack boxes, and toss them into the truck while smashing zombies with crates along the way. In Aboxcalypse, you're warehouse workers in a zombie apocalypse, using your own inventory as a weapon to survive.

details.title: Zavix Tower 2
details.short_description: Zavix Tower 2 is a challenging Party based roguelike with turn-based RPG about Dungeon Crawling through a tower. Recruit Heroes, Upgrade your Town and try to help your mysterious host unravel the mysteries within Zavix Tower!

details.title: The Waiting
details.short_description: Please make your way to the top floor. Bob is waiting for you.

details.title: Spaceships and Cellular Automata
details.short_description: Spaceships and Cellular Automata is a tower defense game set in space! Place different towers to defend your ship against the waves of aliens. The enemies are simulated based on Conway's Game of Life. Even just one of your bullets is enough to cause a destabilizing chain reaction to destroy them!

details.title: Re:Curse
details.short_description: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

details.title: Shapes N Music
details.short_description: A brutal bullet-hell rhythm game where every death is your fault. Dodge hazards, dash and die to a varied soundtrack synced to intense levels. Master 4 more game modes built to steal your evenings. Can you beat each level without taking a hit?

name: Oops! I Got Hit by Cupid's Arrow

details.title: Oops! I Got Hit by Cupid's Arrow
details.short_description: Live-action interactive romance game. Play as an archery coach meeting three heroines. Your choices shape the story, unlock different romantic routes and multiple endings. Movie-grade production with immersive experience.

details.title: Hunter: Into the Abyss
details.short_description: Fight through ever-changing dungeons in this fast-paced action rogue-like, mastering brutal combat, powerful upgrades, and epic boss battles. Hunt the Elders of the Abyss and stop them from rising

details.title: Chemical-Burn
details.short_description: Chemical-Burn is a first person shooter action-adventure set in Hazard City—one of the last few cities on Earth, where the remaining human populations have been placed. Engage in thrilling first person combat as Cindy using a variety of weapons & your dog Buddy. Plan. Execute. Survive. Repeat.

details.title: Rot Forever
details.short_description: Rot Forever is a surreal FPS horror game, set in a decaying megastructure.

details.title: Hammam Simulator
details.short_description: Hammam Simulator lets you experience the authentic rituals of a traditional bathhouse. Scrub, foam, and cleanse as you manage the daily operations of a bustling hammam. Feel the warmth of marble, hear the soothing sound of water, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and tradition.

details.title: A.V.E.N.A.
details.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

details.title: Blitzpoint
details.short_description: A minimalist modern military strategy tower defense game where you build and defend a forward operating base. Strategically place defenses, manage resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies. Build by day, defend by night, and command your forces in fast-paced, action-packed gameplay.

details.title: Blood Vow: Survive the Night
details.short_description: Defend the people of Sodermark from the hordes of darkness. Fight as an army of one, or online with up to four-player PvE multiplayer in this wave-based, action-survival game.

details.title: GridController
details.short_description: An online power company tycoon. Start with an exercise bike wired to a car battery and a street full of dark houses, and grow it into a utility that lights whole regions with solar, wind, gas, hydro and nuclear, on a grid you wire yourself.

details.title: Hathor's Peak
details.short_description: Hathor's Peak is a roguelike solitaire, reach the needed score before being out of cards. Progress through the levels, some of which will be boss battles that impose special rules and require you to use your action cards wisely.

details.title: Afterground: The Children
details.short_description: The world ended. The road home didn't. Fight through ever-changing ruins, build your power one card at a time, and rescue survivors on a journey from grasslands through desert to frozen wastes. A post-apocalyptic action roguelite where every night could be the last.

details.title: Click Click Chicken
details.short_description: A short incremental game about catching chickens, pigs, cows and sheep.

details.title: Wire Throne
details.short_description: Upgrade your ride and unleash devastating firepower to take down Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

details.title: Meteorder
details.short_description: Meteors are falling from the sky. Hurry up, your objective is to eliminate them by aligning same-colored blocks and launching them upward. Meteorder is an exciting tile-matching puzzle game where you can compete against opponents, explore various planets, and enjoy the beats.

name: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!

details.title: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!
details.short_description: A magical candy shop is a sticky mess! Play as an adorable marshmallow in this cozy first-person cleaning and organizing sim. Vacuum up gummies, scrape away syrup, and sort colorful candies to perfection. No timers, no stress, just pure satisfaction!

details.title: Ecliptic
details.short_description: Ecliptic is a 3D Puzzle Adventure Game set in the Stars! Inspired by the mythological figures of the horoscope, embark on the hero's journey with the mysterious protagonist on a journey of identity and discovery.

details.title: Hyper Hadron Racing
details.short_description: Hyper Hadron Racing is a futuristic racing game set in space. Choose your spacecraft and battle your way to first place across a multitude of tracks and environments rich with power-ups, features and hazards! Or create your own unique tracks to share and compete online.

details.title: THE MOST GIGACHAD SURVIVORS
details.short_description: Dive into a giga-action roguelike about GigaChad who have spent his entire lives in the gym and are stepping outside for the first time! Explore the unfamiliar world, fight the city's inhabitants, and complete wild quests. Help the GigaChad discover this complex world and understand himself!

details.title: Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic single-player simulator where you sell resources to survivors to withstand internal and external threats. Work with scavengers to gather supplies, keep your shelter secure, and uncover the secrets of the bunker.

details.title: STRIKER!
details.short_description: STRIKER! is a retro-inspired football-golf game set across 40+ levels. Control your team of Strikers and shoot your ball over a wide range of different courses and mechanics.

details.title: Tarvos Desolation
details.short_description: Survive on a hostile moon full of nightmares! Face hordes of monsters, explore mysterious locations, and uncover secrets that may save your life. Will you find a way to escape, or will you be consumed by the darkness of Tarvos?

details.title: You Died!
details.short_description: How will you cope with the loss of yourself? Each episode of You Died! will give you an opportunity to experience a stage of grief for yourself. Make choices, deal with the consequences, and interact with your environment to express the emotions of the main character.

details.title: Order of Renewal
details.short_description: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

details.title: 地球勇者 Earth Fighter
details.short_description: “Knights of Earth Realm” is a 2D platform shooter action light rogue game. Synthesize various homemade or advanced weapon equipment, lead your pet, and fight against human looters, out-of-control mech, evil insectoids, and other threats on the post-disaster wasteland.

details.title: Newma Holiday
details.short_description: On a rare holiday, Newty's plans were disrupted by an urgent deadline. His computer was infected with a virus, and his desktop pet Ema, now self-aware, asked for help to fix it. Newty and Ema teamed up to solve puzzles and remove the virus.

details.title: Bomber Hero
details.short_description: BomberHero is a thrilling multiplayer game inspired by Bomberman. Up to 4 players can join online battles or play against bots. Customize your hero, collect power-ups, and dominate diverse arenas. Are you ready for explosive fun? Join the action on Steam!

details.title: Coming Home, Little Oak
details.short_description: As a little oak, your life was turned upside down when you were kidnapped from your village and family by giant robots. Survive, overcome the challenges, and find your way back home!

details.title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
details.short_description: EARTH is mutated and destroyed. You are a R.E.A.P.E.R, one of the lucky humans tasked with preparing earth for the return of humanity! Collect valuable loot and S.C.I.E.N.C.E! Travel from the REAPER space station to the infested, ancient ruins of EARTH with your fellow REAPERS.

details.title: Adventure Paws
details.short_description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!

name: Orson, P.I.: Midnight at the Grand Hotel

details.title: Orson, P.I.: Midnight at the Grand Hotel
details.short_description: Twelve guests at a Chicago hotel plot to steal millions in jewels. Stop them before midnight strikes.

details.title: HackOS
details.short_description: HackOS: The ultimate hacking MMO. Dive into a shared, ever-evolving world of espionage, dilemmas, competition & collaboration — all via your terminal. Inspired by classic hacking games and refined for modern players, HackOS combines the depth of simulation with the excitement of arcade gameplay.

details.title: Chronicles of Humanity
details.short_description: Chronicles of Humanity is an expanding anthology of historical visual novels. Enter different eras, weigh conflicting testimony under political and personal pressure, and shape who is protected, what is recorded, and how each life is remembered. Complete stories are released as separate DLC.

name: 杀剧回环：衔尾之蛇 Killing Tragedy Samsara: Ouroboros Reincarnation

details.title: 杀剧回环：衔尾之蛇 Killing Tragedy Samsara: Ouroboros Reincarnation
details.short_description: A.D.2046 Spring, Hecate, the great novelist, was invited to La Stella Domani Detective Competition, and unexpectedly forced to play a murder game among gifted and criminal teens. With the power of time loop, could she crack those perfect crimes?

details.title: Magic Wands Workshop
details.short_description: A unique wand workshop simulator where you can create amazing combinations of wand elements and test their power! Immerse yourself in the world of magic and match wands to your demanding clients.

details.title: 十品芝麻官
details.short_description: Strange History Mystery is a HD2D ancient style pixel role-playing + reasoning and decryption game. Players will play the role of the newly appointed county magistrate Bao Cheng, and seek the truth in the treacherous officialdom and confusing cases, and find their own "way to be an official".

details.title: Little Woody
details.short_description: Little Woody is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you guide a small wooden soul through a mysterious world of shifting environments. Meet unusual companions along the way, solve handcrafted logic puzzles, explore atmospheric locations and uncover a forgotten past.

details.title: Hallow Maze
details.short_description: Hallow maze is a soulslike metroidvania set in a gothic world in 2D. Use transformations into different creatures to open your way, as well as incredible tools of energy. Discover the origin of the scourge that is infecting the lands of the Evernight Valley and venture into The Hallow Maze...

details.title: PSYCHExFUSE
details.short_description: CONQUER YOUR SELF and escape the nostalgia-fueled nightmare in PSYCHExFUSE, a brand new RPG horror filled with mystery, challenges and terror. Unite your past selves and save a troubled world in an interdimensional adventure into the deepest depths of your mind!

details.title: Among Shadows
details.short_description: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and social deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. As the Blood Moon rises, can you uncover the traitors and escape before it’s too late?

name: Partons à Cheval Trouver les Licornes !

details.title: Partons à Cheval Trouver les Licornes !
details.short_description: Embark on this Point and Click Visual Novel about horse riding in search of unicorns, while taking care of your equine friend.

name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2

details.title: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
details.short_description: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

details.title: Endless Tactics
details.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelite about defending a planetary mining expedition, upgrading your starship, and extracting before alien hordes overrun you.

name: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots

details.title: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots
details.short_description: Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR! There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

details.title: Pico Garden
details.short_description: On a cozy corner of your desktop, build a miniature world that is uniquely yours. Watch diverse creatures arrive and thrive, with the gentle rhythm of nature keeping you company as you study, work, and relax.

details.title: KAI
details.short_description: KAI is a game of Exploration and Adventure between the sidereal space and underwater depths.
