Skillfully lure and guide groups of fish to solve puzzles, access new areas and uncover the truth behind the mission entrusted to you, Akira, and the other crew members aboard the ship.

details.title: Dungeons and Diners
details.short_description: Dungeon and Diners: A Culinary Adventure Awaits! Dive into dungeons with your friends, hunting for exotic ingredients to bring back to your bustling diner. Choose to team up with up to 4 players or enlist the help of adventurers for both dungeon delving and diner duties.

details.title: Star of Games
details.short_description: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

details.title: VTumbler
details.short_description: Dive into the vibrant world of VTubers in an unparalleled free-to-play arcade puzzle fighting spectacle in VTumbler!

details.title: L.OD
details.short_description: 2D exploratory adventure

details.title: Feeling Death
details.short_description: A Game Where You're Killed for Becoming a Couple.

details.title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
details.short_description: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen who desires a girlfriend by year's end. Is there hope in his future or endless despair?

details.title: Anseion - Fantasy MMORPG
details.short_description: Get ready for a journey to the world of Anseion, an immersive 2D MMORPG. Choose your faction: good or evil. Fight against players and monsters, explore the fascinating world, collect items and create your own. Make a unique character. Participate in events and faction battles, increase your rank.

details.title: EXODUS: Sunflower on the Horizon
details.short_description: An original sci-fi RPG like you've never experienced before...

details.title: Enfilade
details.short_description: Enfilade is a fast paced low poly multiplayer fps game with 30 levels and 18 weapons If there are not enough players there is bot support. Level up and unlock new weapons

details.title: STREAM STRATOS
details.short_description: "StreamStratos" is a 3D action game.

details.title: Candela: Colorless Dreams
details.short_description: Manipulate colours and solve challenging puzzles in this mysterious 2D platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the overworld, uncover hidden secrets, and bring light to this dark, desolate land

details.title: Tunnel Baby
details.short_description: On one rainy morning, Steve found a baby in a utility tunnel. He is not alone. Navigate eerie locales, solve puzzles, and face bizarre creatures to uncover a cosmic mystery in Tunnel Baby.

name: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered

details.title: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world and battle the nightmares born from your own fears in this puzzle-driven turn-based RPG.

details.title: Kinetic Response
details.short_description: In the far future you will die on a distant world, piloting a heap of iron held together by hopes and dreams of a bygone time, for there is no salvation in this godless hegelian nightmare at the end of history.

details.title: Don't Peek Out
details.short_description: An asymmetrical survival game where strategy, and trust collide. Players navigate a mazed house, gather objects and seal ancient runes before dawn breaks. Something hunts them in the dark and it won’t stop until every player is caught. Will you outsmart the monster, or embrace the shadows as one?

details.title: Lost Call
details.short_description: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.

details.title: Peerless Destiny 绝世天命
details.short_description: A 3D ARPG.Millennia later, you wake in a dying shell. Darkness rules, demons reign. The path of cultivation is now myth.You smile, eyes cold.A mechanical voice echoes:[Invincible Cultivation System rebooted][Energy 1%… Identity: Ancient Human Immortal][Privilege unlocked: Reignite cultivation]

details.title: 魔法少女パラノイド
details.short_description: 引きこもり気味の高校2年生、主人公の『夢宮める』はある日魔法使いである『ミュリィ』に助けられ、魔法少女になることに。 人々の心を悪に変える『バグ』と戦う魔法少女となっためるはこの世界の『悪』と対峙する事になる。 『バグ』と呼ばれる怪物と戦う、かわいくて不穏な魔法少女RPG。

details.title: CYBRID: Survivor
details.short_description: CYBRID: Survivor - is a single-player shooter with survival elements. Use your entire arsenal, fight hordes of robots, mine resources and unlock powerful upgrades as you clean up the streets at night. You are alone, against everyone!

details.title: The Mirror Dimension
details.short_description: The Mirror Dimension is a co-op psychological thriller and horror game for 1 to 4 players. Players investigate paranormal activities, solve mysteries across dimensions, and eliminate spiritual entities to find problems. Are you ready to explore different dimensions?

name: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.

details.title: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.
details.short_description: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character via thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the dev, had growing up.

details.title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
details.short_description: On a small, snowy skerry somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, where he is or why he is there. A point-and-click mystery where atmosphere and unusual puzzles are at the heart of the game.

details.title: About LAST Chanks: Prologue
details.short_description: A free puzzle-platformer for solo players and online co-op. Two damaged robots struggle to survive as their energy slowly runs out. Explore forgotten ruins, overcome dangerous obstacles, and begin the search for the legendary Chank.

details.title: The Heirloom
details.short_description: Uncover the secrets of your family and your grandfather's old lighthouse as you seek the truth behind the unusual happenings in The Heirloom, a mysterious thriller adventure inspired by the atmosphere of the Hebrides and Scottish folklore!

details.title: Underground Nomads
details.short_description: You command a drilling train, leading a dwarf clan through the underground depths toward the planetary core. Manage the crew, complete expeditions, gather resources, upgrade gear, and make tough choices to reach the abandoned city and bring your people back home.

details.title: Code5erpent
details.short_description: The game where numbers are a weapon. On a simulated Earth, add, multiply, or combine the numbers which comprise the matrix's code, and take advantage of a rich equipment system of weapons and scrolls in order to come up with devastating combos to annihilate your enemies.

details.title: I Chew, Therefore I Am
details.short_description: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

details.title: Mataha
details.short_description: You are in an ever-shifting maze, with countless enemies who are tasked with keeping you imprisoned. Can you unlock the secrets of Mataha and find your way out? And Remember you lose everything on death, except what you have learned about the maze, it's guards and yourself.

details.title: In Game Leader
details.short_description: Become your teams In-Game Leader and lead your team of 5 agents to victory.

details.title: Alchemist Chronicles
details.short_description: Brew remedies, heal the sick, and face impossible choices. You are the only healer in a small village — but sometimes you must choose who lives and who doesn't.

details.title: Hip to be Squared
details.short_description: Hip to be Squared is a fast paced, bullet hell dungeon crawler where you create insane builds to clear an ever changing dungeon filled with abstract enemies. All enemies in Hip to be Squared attack in sync with the music. The only path to success is to choose your upgrades wisely.

details.title: Sunder
details.short_description: Sunder is an orbital-artillery RTS in a living star system. Every world is a gun platform on a moving orbit: bend shots around the sun, shove planets off their rails, and crack rival worlds to the core. Draft your arsenal as you fight — solo skirmishes or online war with up to 8 players.

details.title: Orbit Crisis
details.short_description: Master orbital navigation to protect Earth in this atmospheric space simulation, where careful timing, experimentation, and patience matter more than quick reactions.

details.title: Aptacris : Dipolos Anomalia
details.short_description: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds. Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles. Play as Ai'Lynn, searching for a fragment within her own mind.

details.title: Green Space
details.short_description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

details.title: Squeak
details.short_description: Squeak is a cooperative tactical game for 2 players about the symbiosis of Spirit and Human. Choose your role, unlocking unique ways to interact with the world. Combine your abilities and act as one to overcome the trials.

details.title: runz
details.short_description: RUNZ is a top-down roguelite arena shooter where every bullet in your magazine matters. Draft bullets like an auto-battler, combine three of a kind, stack synergies and upgrade your gun to survive 20 waves.

details.title: The Veiled Moon: Tengu
details.short_description: Harness elemental physics to restore the Star-Stone in a mystical Zen world.

details.title: Junebug
details.short_description: Junebug is a cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, make them your own, then experience what you’ve built through your cat. Explore, play, relax, and enjoy the little moments you create together.

details.title: Making the Cut
details.short_description: A deep golf career simulation. Build a player from unknown rookie to world #1 across a 20-year career. Manage your form, your team, your reputation, and your schedule as you climb the world rankings. Inspired by Football Manager and Out of the Park Baseball.

details.title: Furniture Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own furniture and home decor store. Place sofas, style showrooms, set prices, and watch customers react to how you decorate. A beautiful display isn't just pretty — it sells.

details.title: Robot&Gun&Magic
details.short_description: Guns and magic intertwine — carve your way through the apocalypse. Play as an awakened robot warrior, wielding firearms and magic power to scavenge, fight, and survive in a world stripped bare of resources. Ammo is scarce, mana is precious, and every battle is a fight for survival.

details.title: Follow like a shadow
details.short_description: Two characters, one player! 'Follow like a shadow' is a minimalist two-character puzzle game. The player controls both the black and white shadows simultaneously — move one, and the other automatically mirrors the movement.

details.title: Keyboard Curse
details.short_description: Keyboard Curse is a 2D rage-platformer where every key you press spawns a physical keycap into the level. Jump, run, panic, and try not to trap yourself — because every press makes it worse.

details.title: Appetite for Destruction
details.short_description: Co-op in a fully destructible world. Meet the quota faster than your friends - or stop them from doing it. Use physics and tools to survive the escalating chaos, or switch to Sandbox mode with no limits.

details.title: Leach
details.short_description: A top-down pixel-art survival game set in a dead, dark town. Scavenge gear, strike from the shadows, and stay alive — alone or in co-op. What you carry is who you are

details.title: Gods vs Steam
details.short_description: Turn enemies into weapons in a challenging, physics-driven horde-survival roguelite. Shape your build through deep skill trees and overcome brutal bosses on your path to divine power.

details.title: Cozy Against Humanity
details.short_description: Cozy Against Humanity is a roguelike tower defense game where the coziest things imaginable turn against you. Adapt, resist, and survive the soft apocalypse.

details.title: Till & Toast
details.short_description: In this cozy organizing and management simulator, sort 3,600 freshly baked breads and pastries onto the correct shelves, open your bakery for business, earn coins, upgrade convenience abilities, and unlock adorable food-themed assistants and decorations to build your own bakery.

details.title: Hatchling Scramble
details.short_description: A cute, wholesome action game where you help baby sea turtles reach the ocean. But you can't control them, only protect them. Turn off bright lights, scare away aggressive crabs, and clear the beach so every hatchling makes it to the sea! 20% of net proceeds support the Sea Turtle Conservancy.

details.title: fibbtry
details.short_description: A Poolcore atmospheric exploration game. Wander freely, drift in thought, until you're ready to wake and carry this rain back into the real world.

details.title: Unregret
details.short_description: An angry office worker named Butch snaps and sets off on a brutal journey toward his dream of becoming a Hollywood actor. Fight through hordes of enemies in a fast-paced 2D beat ‘em up, using combo-based combat and any weapons you can find - from bare fists to automatic rifles.

details.title: Seasonal Lockdown
details.short_description: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

details.title: Pack and Ship: Warehouse Simulator
details.short_description: Build your logistics empire from the ground up. Choose the most profitable contracts, optimize your warehouse layout for maximum efficiency, and upgrade your equipment. Balance risk and reward as you adapt your strategy to a shifting market. Every lift, every pallet, and every decision counts.

name: The Last Wizard - A Goblin Detective Mystery

details.title: The Last Wizard - A Goblin Detective Mystery
details.short_description: Investigate a murder as the first goblin detective in a comedic fantasy world without magic...where a wizard is the prime suspect!

details.title: Gustav Mlha: Záhada Krkonoš
details.short_description: The Giant Mountains hide a mystery! Krakonoš's elite squadron has vanished, and private detective Gustav Mlha is on the case. Explore more than 30 locations in a pixel-art point-and-click adventure packed with oddball locals, quirky puzzles, Czech voice acting, and offbeat humor.

details.title: Agaric
details.short_description: Agaric is a 2D Action-RPG game, about a sole mushroom set on an quest to resolve an imminent problem, only to find themselves in the midst of more conflict

details.title: Merchanteer
details.short_description: Set sail in the Southern Isles where every action shapes the world. Trade cargo, build ships, fight pirates, liberate ports and explore hand-crafted islands - alone or together with friends.

details.title: Power Of The Sun
details.short_description: Empower the sun and drive forward the engine of creation of the universe. Collect cosmic resources, generate energy, and evolve through a galaxy of upgrades. Burn brighter and radiate light into the universe!

details.title: Function SUE
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of “maSUEmatics”! Draw equations, shape the world, and roll Sue to the goal in this free-form physics puzzle.

name: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon

details.title: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon
details.short_description: Help a mighty dragon restore its power in this relaxing incremental game. Gather resources, summon workers, construct buildings, and unlock powerful upgrades as you progress.

details.title: ALIGNMENT : An Engineering Odyssey
details.short_description: Route a road through real mountain terrain, build it with curves, earthworks, bridges and tunnels, then drive it to test the design.

details.title: KuLaLa Catcher
details.short_description: Multiplayer "claw machine" party game! Use that unreliable claw to battle in various game modes. It's party time! Party like KuLaLa~! Catch 'em like KuLaLa~!!

name: College Crisis: The Tuition Survival Game

details.title: College Crisis: The Tuition Survival Game
details.short_description: College Crisis is a darkly comedic, turn based survival sim about surviving college inside a broken system. Progress week by week managing money, energy, sanity, dormmates, and scholarships that vanish without warning as subtle cosmic anomalies creep into campus life.

name: 我喜欢的白毛美少女不可能是凶手

details.title: 我喜欢的白毛美少女不可能是凶手
details.short_description: “为什么我什么都做不到!这样的现实，由我亲手撕烂!这一次我不会再让任何人伤害你!” —— 本游戏为单女主剧情作 属于悬疑恋爱类文字冒险游戏，主角将通过一个个选项来了解一场凶杀案背后的真相，其中有很多线索和不一样的结局来提供游戏趣味性。 『没有人能拒绝白毛异瞳的杀伤力!』 这是如梦幻般的故事。 无法忘怀，也不能忘怀的爱与回忆!!!

details.title: Cozy Pixel Painter
details.short_description: A cozy pixel painting game where you relax, color cute pixel art, and unwind at your own pace

details.title: The Last Lighthouse
details.short_description: Tend a Magical Lighthouse at the edge of the cosmos. Gather and refine resources, maintain and upgrade the Lighthouse Engine, and aid incoming ships while an unsettling fog closes in.

details.title: 绯想觅剑录 TenshiSwordQuest
details.short_description: This is a 2D horizontal board platform puzzle game about finding one's own Sword Of Scarlet Perception by the Hinanawi Tenshi. She use her ability to manipulate stones to overcome numerous obstacles and find the unclaimed Sword Of Scarlet Perception.

details.title: 耶耶耶一周
details.short_description: A dog-raising simulation game where you can make dog food, play with dogs, go out and meet friendly dogs, experiencing the joys and troubles of lively puppies.

details.title: Trapped on the FlipSide
details.short_description: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

details.title: Whispers of Appalachia
details.short_description: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

details.title: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory
details.short_description: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory is a story rich, investigative mystery game where your only tools are your contacts and the people you can find and get to talk to you. Read through old internet archives, pick out what is important, and solve the mystery of the 10 year old cold case.

details.title: Pocket Chef: Asia
details.short_description: Pocket Chef: Asia is a cozy, hand-drawn ramen shop game. Start at a little Japanese street cart, make every bowl with your own hands, crack riddle orders, count out the change and keep your quirky customers happy. In the full game, the journey continues across Asia.

details.title: Eclipstation
details.short_description: Explore the station rooms, gather resources, hide from dangerous creatures, and combine the items you find. Crafting can help you survive… or create a new threat.

details.title: The Wicked Isles
details.short_description: A Puzzle Roguelike of Risk and Deduction. Combine powers of artifacts, unlock new characters and find your way out of the cursed archipelago.

details.title: Serenade of the Soul
details.short_description: 7 days granted at life's end. "The night air is pleasant, isn't it?" A story as calm as the evening breeze, shared with a fairy found in despair. A classic romance brought to life through full Korean voice acting and lyrical New Age music.

details.title: 奥卡米亚的骑士
details.short_description: A fantasy RPG themed around chemistry and alchemy. You trigger effective attacks by choosing the correct answers to chemistry questions .Explore mazes, collect materials, and craft quest items using chemical equations. Upgrade your skills, and finally complete the protagonist’s legendary story.

details.title: Redast
details.short_description: Secure the area, detect the anomalies, solve the ritual, and reach the extraction point at all costs. A multiplayer operation combining tactical FPS dynamics with supernatural hunting.

details.title: Static Shift
details.short_description: A Lovecraftian, psychological co-op horror where the powers from above are tormenting you and your co-workers, warping reality with anomalies and using any means necessary to stop you from leaving or finding out the truth: Can you do it? (co-op not included in demo version)

details.title: Recycle Quest
details.short_description: Recycle Quest is a Sokoban puzzle game where you control Jake to help cleaning the city

details.title: Bunkum
details.short_description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

details.title: Winds of Bounty
details.short_description: Winds of Bounty is a casual, fast-paced single and network multi player, competitive sailing exploration and treasure hunting game, featuring multiple game modes, including Treasure Hunt, Monster Hunt, Orb Hunt, Race, Arena, and Treasure Gallery!

details.title: Desktop Dice Ranch
details.short_description: Dice Ranch is a desktop idle game built around dice. Roll for coins, collect dice in all kinds of styles, breed their offspring on your ranch, unlock combos and talent skills, and go on expeditions to defeat powerful foes. Build the ultimate dice ranch of your own.

details.title: SUPERUSER
details.short_description: An ASCII bullet-heaven roguelite where you stack weapon modifiers, evolve your arsenal, and fight towering bosses. Turn bullets, blades, and fireballs into cascading destruction. Experiment with powerful combinations as enemies flood the arena.

name: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-

details.title: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-
details.short_description: "Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

name: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里

details.title: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里
details.short_description: 在一个本该平凡的周五，您与念白请假从西安前往广州参加婚礼，在前往高铁站的地铁上，似乎因为早上吃了不怎么干净的食物，导致有些腹泻，恰好站站有厕所，于是你们开启了“飞翔五十二里”的旅程。念白看似状态良好，但她似乎在隐瞒什么？当“从韦曲南8到北客站”真实上演，您能否掌控全局，带领念白平安抵达北客站呢？

details.title: WHIPLASH
details.short_description: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

details.title: Beats & Brains
details.short_description: Beats & Brains is a co-op rhythm beat 'em up game. Fight zombies to the beat as Mona and Lu to rescue your bandmate in the apocalyptic Toronto subways. Play co-op, stay in sync, and jam against the living dead. Compatible with classic guitar and drum controllers!

details.title: Anomaly Sweepers
details.short_description: Join a starship cleanup crew and take on bizarre jobs across space. Memorize each site before anomalies appear, then spot what changed and hold to remove it before time runs out. From a salon where hair regrows as fast as you cut it to a tango hall that won't stop dancing, 20 strange sites await.

details.title: Gridiron Football GM
details.short_description: Take over a fictional pro football team as its head coach and turn it into a dynasty. Set the game plan, call the plays, manage the cap, make trades, sign free agents and draft from a 130-program college league simulated alongside the pros.

details.title: Just A Watermelon
details.short_description: Put aside all the responsibilities, bills, and stress that come with being human. You’re just a watermelon.

details.title: X Calibur
details.short_description: X Calibur is a top-down hack-and-slash roguelike! Every run starts with building your own dungeon-crawler path. Collect sword parts, forge powerful builds, and become unstoppable! No checkpoints to save you from the robots. Do you have what it takes to reach the end?

details.title: Kinbound
details.short_description: Kinbound is a survival roguelike where you combine familiars, trigger synergies, and build completely absurd teams to survive hordes of enemies and bosses. Collect XP, choose your upgrades, strengthen your build, and survive as long as you can.

details.title: Scraw's Blooms
details.short_description: Design sunflower fields, control cross-pollination, and scale your harvest with careful or chaotic management. As the field's scarecrow, Scraw awaits perfect blooms while scaring off those pesky crows. What new varieties will you grow?

details.title: Hostile Process
details.short_description: A fast-paced top-down shooter where aiming is controlled by rotating the camera. Use your character’s enhanced abilities to carve the fastest route through each level. Chase faster times, earn ranks, and unlock new challenges.

details.title: Long Carnage
details.short_description: Long Carnage is a first-person cooperative horror game for up to 4 players. Explore an isolated house, find resources, restore power, and survive unique killers with their own mechanics in dynamic and unpredictable matches.

details.title: Quilt
details.short_description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

details.title: Neural Drift
details.short_description: Play as an emerging AI inside a motherboard grid. Buy, place, and combine programs to make money, build powerful synergies, and decide whether the AI becomes ethical or ruthless.

details.title: MSO FreeCell Arena
details.short_description: Real-time multiplayer FreeCell. Same deal, real rivals: everyone gets the same shuffle and races to solve it, every race timed to the millisecond. Race the nightly Arena Hour, take the worldwide Daily Challenge, and try to beat the dev. Free to download and play. No microtransactions.

details.title: Arcane Colosseum
details.short_description: Arcane Colosseum is a first-person PvP action game where you draw runes and cast spells with your voice to battle other wizards. Master a variety of spells, choose powerful augments, and forge your own strategy to become the last wizard standing!

details.title: Tavern & Tombs
details.short_description: Tavern & Tombs is an action roguelite looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore procedural dungeons, blast hordes of monsters with powerful magic, and collect epic loot. Return to your tavern to brew potions and spend essence on permanent upgrades before your next run into the crypts!

details.title: BROKEN：Survivors  破界：幸存者
details.short_description: This is a fast-paced roguelike hack-and-slash game where weapons, characters, and skills can all be developed independently and freely combined to create your very own build!

name: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff

details.title: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff
details.short_description: Find 850+ mischievous guinea pigs across a cozy hand-drawn hidden-object adventure set in a Peruvian-inspired finca. Collect snackos, unlock secret rooms, solve tiny puzzles, and follow the crumbs toward the legendary Golden Corn.

details.title: A Moon Full of Money
details.short_description: Blast rocks, upgrade your base, and earn lots of money in this compact incremental game. Expand and automate your operation with powerful abilities like mining robots, drones, mines, supply drops, an orbital laser, and more.

details.title: Fairy Forge
details.short_description: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

details.title: Pepo Sort Master
details.short_description: In Pepo Sort Master, take on high-speed sorting puzzles in a whimsical factory. Among the mysterious creatures called "Pepo" streaming down the line, "Pepo Imposters" are hiding in the mix. Master the art of Pepo inspection and earn your title as a certified Master Pepo!

details.title: BOOSTDRIVE
details.short_description: BOOSTDRIVE is a free-to-play arcade racing game set in stylized cyber-city environments inspired by Central Asia, featuring fast driving, neon tracks, and multiplayer competition.

name: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter

details.title: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter
details.short_description: You are not a scavenger on endless walks. You are a Soldier in a Tactical Shooter with a Helmet Cam perspective. Action from second zero, dodging artillery, drones, and the most tactical AI on the market in an intense field that wants you dead. Extract weapons, upgrades, currency, and killstreaks.

details.title: Acid Clashers
details.short_description: Acid Clashers is a single-player turn-based Autobattler game with a strong focus on incrementing stats.

details.title: 觀淵決:Abyss run
details.short_description: This is a Roguelike strategy game centered around "Dice-Building" and "Distance Control." 🔹 Customizable Dice: Ditching traditional deckbuilding, you can engrave skills directly onto your dice faces to create unique tactical builds.

details.title: Flagship Down
details.short_description: Tactical roguelike auto-battler. Assemble your fleet and equip your flagship with modules and weapons. Recruit and assign crew members to your ships. Start the round and watch your strategy unfold in fully automated battles.

details.title: Pirates Dig Deeper
details.short_description: Dig with your crew. Defend with your cannons. Pirates Dig Deeper is a co-op blend of digging and tower defense. Descend into the island, fight off rival pirates, and unseal the ancient temple to steal the elixir of immortality.

details.title: Leadville
details.short_description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outmaneuver their rivals.

details.title: Ragnarok Mining Co.
details.short_description: Ragnarok Mining Co. is a satisfying planet demolition interval clicker set in a dystopian future where you are just a number in the corporate world. Scan for hotspots, fire your probes, and destroy worlds.

details.title: Defend Your Fish
details.short_description: An Arcade style strategy game where you must protect your bucket of fish from crabs, seagulls, and other such enemies. The goal is to survive as long as possible to build up your score, earn coins to unlock cosmetics and upgrades to help your future runs!

details.title: DECASTLE
details.short_description: A turn-based medieval fantasy deck-building game where every card shapes how you break enemy castles. Build your deck, plan your strategy, and unleash powerful actions to collapse fortifications in stylized, physics-driven battles.

details.title: Reefdeck
details.short_description: What if your deck was made of fish? Reefdeck is a cartoon underwater auto-battler roguelike where you collect, deploy, and battle absurd sea creatures. Crack open coral packs, build your roster, and survive bullet hell chaos beneath the waves.

details.title: MEMORY DEALER
details.short_description: You are a memory trafficker. Harvest stolen memories from captive minds and sell them to BRN CORP. Buy neural implants with your credits, but don't get addicted to your own supply, or you'll lose those memories forever. A shady cyberpunk idle game on your desktop.

details.title: Chrongrid
details.short_description: Chrongrid is an AI-driven narrative experience. Inside an author's story blueprint, you make your own choices and the world responds in its own way — every choice echoes, no two journeys alike. Built-in blueprints are the start; play others' stories or write your own, in any language.

details.title: PAWTENTIAL DISASTER
details.short_description: A chaotic physics co-op game where a pack of dogs must get one very unlucky baby back home and a avoid Pawtential Disaster.

details.title: DIG! DIG! DIG!
details.short_description: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

details.title: JERONIMO
details.short_description: JERONIMO is a roguelite shooter where you play as the Eraser against your eternal enemy: the Drawer, a frantic pencil who summons waves from his rolling lab. Wield up to 6 unique weapons, stack broken builds, and crush the hordes. Every enemy is a drawing from my 6-year-old nephew's notebook.

details.title: Chonkstars
details.short_description: Chonkstars is the ultimate multiplayer showdown where food is your weapon and being hefty is your greatest strength! In this arena, you'll be tossing pizzas, slinging fish, throwing eggs, and serving up absolute chaos. Gear up, because the fight to become the heavyweight champion has just begun!

details.title: Arena 2006
details.short_description: A sci-fi shooter inspired by the golden '06 era: a story campaign, arena modes with bots or online play, drivable cars and rocket jumps. No waiting queues, no microtransactions, no 60 GB patches. We're here to frag.

details.title: Memoware
details.short_description: MEMOWARE! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle game where you must record the history of civilizations that vanished without a trace in a mountain with no name. Collect all the MEMORIES and organize them in each book of each civilization in chronological order.

details.title: Unlander
details.short_description: Unlander is a survival video game where you explore the never-ending world of the banished. From hunger to monsters, everything is set to kill you. Uniquely, every action must be played with dices. As you progress, you will find upgrades and you’ll craft stronger items to defeat the nightmares.

details.title: ZArmory
details.short_description: You won't pull the trigger. You'll make sure it never jams. Arm the last remnants of humanity against endless zombie hordes. From the "safety" of your workshop.

details.title: Shelf Shock
details.short_description: Shelf Shock is a first-person puzzle game taking place in a wacky warehouse. Follow clues, place items, make trickshots, and dodge lasers as you stock the shelves within the time limit.

details.title: Still Waters
details.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen - the kind you can reach into. Grab fish, toss them, collect them, and let a little ocean keep you company while you work, study or chill.

details.title: Sleighers
details.short_description: A festive anthro-themed hero shooter set in the atmospheric and whimsical Arctic Circle. Choose your class, and help your team decorate and dominate in this more festive twist on the Domination game mode, but watch out for Old Man Winter and his periodic blizzards!

details.title: Hello Mayor
details.short_description: You are not merely building a city—you are governing it. Plan districts, balance the budget, investigate local problems, chair government meetings, appoint officials, negotiate with investors, and watch every decision travel from public concern to policy, implementation, and consequence.

details.title: Evergrind
details.short_description: Evergrind is an idle adventure like you've never experienced before! Discover unknown regions, face dangerous creatures, and create the ultimate loot loop. Master skills, process rare resources, and forge powerful gear on your journey to absolute perfection!

details.title: President Noir
details.short_description: The ultimate "President" card game app! Packed with tons of unique house rules and features cross-platform online multiplayer.

details.title: Pararecords
details.short_description: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

details.title: Deaded
details.short_description: Build your defences, scavenge for loots and survive the zombie infested city saturated with a mysterious fog. Survivors will ask for help but its up to you to save them, or leave them for dead. How long will you survive before you become... Deaded...

details.title: Dawn of the Zombies: Survivors
details.short_description: Face the horde in a world of shifting light and rainy nights. Choose from 4 heroes and 3 weapons to survive 2 deadly maps. Customize your run with 100+ nodes. Play solo or split-screen across 3 difficulties. Start at 6 AM. When the colors fade to gray, the real fight begins.

details.title: Blood Peace
details.short_description: Blood Peace is a fast-paced rogue-lite dungeon crawler where you embody a cybernetic warrior with extraordinary abilities. Engage in epic battles against a diverse bestiary across 7 unique biomes. Each playthrough generates a procedurally created world, ensuring infinite replayability.

details.title: Meritaton
details.short_description: The story of a pharaoh's daughter who decides to challenge her destiny. The mysterious and fragile world of Ancient Egypt hides more than meets the eye.

details.title: Past Visiting Hours
details.short_description: Past Visiting Hours is a 1v3 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Diagnose cursed patients, survive the hospital's monstrous inhabitants, or take control as The Board and turn the hospital into a living nightmare. Your shift is about to get a whole lot worse.

details.title: DESPA
details.short_description: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

details.title: Road Warriors
details.short_description: Survive on the road in this post apocalyptic world! Road Warriors is a casual game with rogue-lite elements where your goal is to create the strongest build in one run!

details.title: Snake Fusion
details.short_description: Snake meets roguelike. Eat everything in your path, fuse matching pieces into stronger forms, choose powerful upgrades, and build an absurdly powerful snake as you fight to survive increasingly dangerous waves.

details.title: Still Hope
details.short_description: An investigation becomes a nightmare when Sam searches for missing Jess. Explore a private research facility and confront his story-rich, emotional journey into psychological horror.

details.title: 卡恩特村
details.short_description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

details.title: Please, Spin
details.short_description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

details.title: Dittomatic
details.short_description: A turn-based photocopier roguelike about copying the copy of a copy. Box up stamps, copy them and press them back onto the page. Copies grow stronger, matches fuse and mismatches misprint. Build a page worth printing, then watch the score cascade past quota.

details.title: Woe Reigns Unending
details.short_description: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

details.title: Safety Check YOSHI!
details.short_description: This is a game where you earn points by identifying hazards (near-miss incidents). If you successfully point them out, say, "Safety check, YOSHI!"

details.title: CAT-A-STROPHIC
details.short_description: CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

details.title: Kanji Grinder
details.short_description: Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary, your daily reviews will be a breeze. Plus, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their skills, plenty of challenges await!

details.title: Ping Profit - Internet Tycoon
details.short_description: Run the internet your way. Build infrastructure, control traffic, stop outages, and grow a basement hosting startup into a global powerhouse.

details.title: Ghost Merc: Frontlines
details.short_description: A fast-paced, team-based FPS. Engage in intense firefights, coordinate with your clan, and adapt your strategy to dominate the battlefield. Featuring a competitive clan system, objective-based modes, and deep customization, every match is a test of skill and teamwork.

details.title: Potat
details.short_description: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

details.title: Monster Pod Quest
details.short_description: Monster Pod Quest is an experimental creature collector with infinitely many procedurally generated monsters. Create completely unique creatures, build your party and battle through a huge variety of worlds to vanquish the bosses of the land.

details.title: JohnJohnson: Remnant
details.short_description: They were made to entertain. But now they want to smash and kill.

details.title: Temple of Glyphs
details.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only glyphs and puzzles. Decipher the true meaning behind every enigmatic symbol, connect tiles to reshape the world, and uncover the secrets of the ancient temple.

details.title: Hexora
details.short_description: Hexora is a unique and innovative strategy puzzle game that combines the classic mine-sweeping gameplay with a godly perspective and city-building elements. Embark on an exciting adventure to unveil the unknown and guide your people to prosperity.

details.title: 02:17 AM
details.short_description: A remote forest lookout fell silent at 02:17 AM. Follow the missing keeper’s trail, restore the radio and piece together the clues in an atmospheric first-person mystery. No combat or jump scares.

details.title: Touhou Dream Duel
details.short_description: Battle your way through a beautifully drawn Gensokyo in this unique fighting game inspired by the classics from the Touhou Project franchise.

details.title: Anne & Mary's Hunt for Booty
details.short_description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.

details.title: Apogee
details.short_description: You wake up in a failing aircraft at 75,000 feet. No memory. No flight log. No rescue coming. Keep systems running and sweep for data to stay airborne. Explore a forgotten network of high-altitude stations and follow a signal that's been waiting forty-one years for someone to listen.

details.title: Type & Magic
details.short_description: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard’s castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle’s dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don’t.

details.title: Slopeside Kings
details.short_description: Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racer for up to four players, where you shred the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost. Pickup and use chaotic items along the slopes to battle your way to the finish line!

details.title: Cave Trek
details.short_description: Dig passages, build footholds, and find your way past monsters and traps in CaveTrek, a single-player roguelike platformer. Explore randomized pixel caves, gather treasure, and spend it on supplies. Every shovel use counts. How much will you risk on the way to the exit?

details.title: COTS
details.short_description: Step into a chicken-themed tower-defense roguelike where you build and upgrade your coop, think up strategies during the day, and hope to survive when night falls. Wild predators lurk in the dark, ready to tear down your defenses! COTS is action, strategy, collectible cards…and of course, CHICKENS!

details.title: One Summer Holiday
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic summer vacation of rural comfort. A timeless place of natural beauty, rich conversations, quiet occurrences and indulgent detail and delight awaits you in One Summer Holiday.

details.title: Honeycomb Coins
details.short_description: Honeycomb Coins is a free-to-play, coin-fighting, 1vs1 turn-based strategy board game. Online support. Win the game to get coins and collect coins of various designs!

details.title: Snatchems
details.short_description: Dive into the pixel-packed universe of 'Snatchems️,' a roguelike first-person shooter where you infiltrate the early internet as a "Snatchems️" megafan, bent on capturing as many goofy characters as possible.

details.title: The Last Waltz
details.short_description: The Last Waltz is a full-scale visual novel about an incredible niche sport; the first visual novel to be based on Dancesport. Featuring Over 30 stunning CGs, a soundtrack of more than 35 pieces of authentic Dancesport music, and integrating real footage of professional dancers and competitions.

name: レビィのスライムファクトリー

details.title: レビィのスライムファクトリー
details.short_description: なぜかスライムになってしまったししょーを元に戻すため、みならい錬金術師レビィが日夜奮闘！スライムと錬金術の不思議な世界で繰り広げるカラフルで魅力的なパズルゲーム。

details.title: better.game
details.short_description: A game without lag or ping advantage. Client-side customizable. Players can see and hear different things. Moving spherical zone. Build, fight, or just go to zone. Jetpack, glide, grapple, ascend, teleport or drive across the map. Lose, view an instant replay, then reboot and get back in the fight.

details.title: Martian Elevator
details.short_description: Travel the world as a cute ufo and ruin everybody's day! Unlock new methods of mischief in over 30 levels, each with unique setting and objectives. This is an cartoonish UFO simulator!

details.title: Herbalist Roman
details.short_description: Step into the role of a medieval herbalist. Study your herbal book, craft macerations, and help your clients by easing their ailments. Christianity is reaching the Slavic village of Drebor, and your choices will determine whether these changes unfold in peace.

details.title: The Julian
details.short_description: Work at a supermarket, pack groceries into your inventory, and spend your wages on shopping and cooking to survive. Manage satiety and sanity while building friendships that set the story in motion. Your choices lead to multiple endings. A survival simulation fusing puzzle, daily life, and narrative

details.title: Project Leo
details.short_description: Advanced physics based rally racing game. Set in Englands' picturesque countryside, rally through highly detailed beautiful english rally stages and test your mettle on dirt, gravel and asphalt surfaces.

details.title: Bharat Police
details.short_description: > Lead a police department in India where officers grow and react to how you use them. Develop their skills, shape your squad through perks, and manage the buffs and setbacks they pick up on duty. Choose your team, plan each response, and keep your officers ready for the next call.

details.title: TOWER KING
details.short_description: Building Management Simulation x Rogue-lite!You are a rookie hired CEO.Endure unreasonable demands from your boss and achieve your goals!However, the orders keep escalating…!?Overcome countless hardships and aim to become a tycoon!!

details.title: Misty Garden
details.short_description: Build the garden, fulfilling requests from the cute visitors, and even recruit them to create items! Decorate your misty garden to welcome cute little creatures, provide a place to help them relax!

details.title: CatLands
details.short_description: CatLands is a relaxing, cozy puzzle game. Move blocks to bring landscapes back together. Collect cats, build a village or just have fun with friends in online co-op.

details.title: GoopUpClassic
details.short_description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule! Fight your companions after the trial is done!

details.title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
details.short_description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

details.title: ROCKABILLYHOSTEL
details.short_description: ROCKABILLY HOSTEL is a simple walking simulator based on pixel art. It is just a game to walking around and look around the beautiful abandoned buildings and the scenery. There is nothing more about this game but it is OK as long as the girls and the graphics are pretty.

details.title: SANGRA
details.short_description: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

details.title: Cursed Bloodline
details.short_description: A narrative psychological horror where past and present slowly blur inside a remote house. The line between memory and reality is gone.

details.title: 終末メイドロイド
details.short_description: A choice-type adventure novel game in which the ending is determined by the percentage of parts recovered from the “receive,” “don't receive,” and “take” options.

details.title: Prism Warriors DX
details.short_description: The Prism Warriors return for another helping of retro-styled bullet hell action. Face off against the sinister Twilight Four, and fight to save more than just your friends...

details.title: BENBOWARS
details.short_description: FIGHT or KILL your way thru a world under attack by THE EVIL SKELETON ARMY—Episodic 2D+ Super Action Platforminger Adventurevania—The Most Indie Game Ever Made—

details.title: Shoot for the Moon
details.short_description: Shoot your spear at flying creatures, feed them to the monster beneath your feet, and grow big enough to escape the forest in this fully-voiced arcade action platformer!

details.title: GraviTech
details.short_description: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.

details.title: Death of a Dungslinger
details.short_description: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

details.title: Stuck In The Backrooms
details.short_description: Stuck In The Backrooms is a horror multiplayer (1-4) exploration game where players find themselves trapped in a different reality. Solve puzzles and investigate levels while avoiding (OR NOT...) entities. Some things were never meant to be found…

details.title: Creature Containment
details.short_description: Creature Containment is a hardcore base-building Action RPG. As a fresh Militia Commander, you've been tasked with infiltrating and wiping out an underground goblin infestation. Manage your base, equip your Operators, and fight hordes of creatures in the depths below...

details.title: Rebels of the Realm
details.short_description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

details.title: Blood Curse Legions
details.short_description: This is a RTS game where you primarily control cavalry units in battle. Utilize the vampire's abilities to command in battle, develop unique vampire heroes based on the game's evolving situation, and form a powerful Blood Curse Legion to dominate the world and establish a vampire nation.

details.title: Die Meeple
details.short_description: Die Meeple is a roguelite dice deckbuilder where classic board games have risen in revolt. Reclaim forgotten boards, battle their rebellious pieces, and unlock new dice, upgrades, and artifacts.

details.title: Leaforia
details.short_description: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

details.title: Sweets & Dragons
details.short_description: Sweets & Dragons is a simulation game of maid cafe management in another world. The player becomes the owner of a maid cafe, and while managing the shop and training beautiful maid androids, collects money and grows the shop.

details.title: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds
details.short_description: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds is an MMO of true rarity. Unique quests, permanent NPC deaths, unpredictable bosses, evolving worlds, and legendary items only one player can claim. Knowledge, not grind, shapes the world.

details.title: Stealer
details.short_description: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

details.title: Memories Of Zattera
details.short_description: Memories of Zattera is a visual novel that merges fantasy and science fiction. Explore moral and political dilemmas from multiple viewpoints as tradition, progress and freedom collide. Will you see the world the same once all truths are revealed?

details.title: Kiki's Nightmare
details.short_description: An adventure RPG where you step in the shoes of a fearless hero. Navigate through unhospitable terrain, fierce enemies and save Kiki from her own terrifying dream!

details.title: Turbowheels
details.short_description: Turbowheels is a dynamic car party game where you compete against your friends in a series of crazy game modes. Get behind the wheel, step on the gas, and prove your skills in a variety of challenges, ranging from frantic racing to total demolition chaos.

details.title: Kronopunk GP
details.short_description: Kronopunk GP is a VR motorcycle racing experience with a cyberpunk aesthetic, inspired by sim racing. Riding focuses on precision and flow rather than arcade-style handling. You control the bike using both head movement and hand positioning, while the heads up display provides information.

details.title: On the Green: Endless Golf
details.short_description: The golf roguelike. On the Green is a deckbuilder for the back nine. Your bag is the deck. Every swing rolls a die. Stack the deck, work the course, bury your rivals in the sand. One shot, one roll, one trophy at a time. Tee it up!

details.title: Finish Your Meatballs!
details.short_description: Finish Your Meatballs! is a galactic double stick shooter inspired in old classic arcade games. ¡Defeat multiple enemies and surpass your friends and THE WORLD with your best scores in various game modes!

details.title: Black Hole Idle
details.short_description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

details.title: Panda Gambler
details.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic survival challenge, your goal is to earn money on a slot machine to stay alive and rescue more refugees. Every winning streak lets you save one extra refugee. While scavenging for supplies, beware of the mutant zombies lurking in the city.

details.title: Cheesy Michael Ball
details.short_description: You won't rest until you've ruined Cheesy Michael’s life. All you need is an egg. Tilt your way through chaotic 3D levels, reach the door handle and earn stars along the way.

details.title: Dungeon Descent
details.short_description: Dungeon Descent is an incremental dungeon crawler where you fight enemies, acquire loot, and descend into increasingly more difficult floors of the dungeon.

details.title: Deadwood Contingency
details.short_description: Command a covert military unit tasked with containing and researching a mysterious threat lurking deep within the forest. Face unnatural creatures, uncover the source of the outbreak, and prevent the calamity from spreading to the world.

details.title: Ad Aquilonem - 100 Days with Seto -
details.short_description: A character-raising simulation game where you spend 100 days with Seto, a young beastfolk found collapsed near your home. Train, rest, and bond with him as you prepare for the decisive battle that awaits in 100 days.

details.title: Banshee Protocol
details.short_description: Simulator of a spacecraft missile defense operator. Keep an eye on the radar, adjust and launch missiles, repelling continuous attacks until the warp jump is completed. Break through the guarded sectors and find out the source of the mysterious signal.

details.title: The Moth and the Moon
details.short_description: The Moth and the Moon is a rhythm platformer where each precise jump advances Clair de Lune. Guide a tiny moth across a forest lake, combining platforming skill with musical timing to complete the performance. You may even make new a friend along the way...

details.title: Rogue Space Convoy
details.short_description: Rogue Space Convoy is a roguelite space action shooter where you pilot a fighter, build a convoy, and choose branching encounters across five hostile passages. Disable enemy cruisers, salvage upgrades, and keep the Ark alive long enough to reach the gate.

details.title: Grumpy Dungeon
details.short_description: The dungeon is dying. It would rather die than say thank you. Fight through its halls with wisps living in your weapons and fighting at your side. Rescue every last spirit, grow them, evolve them, regrow its garden. It remembers everything. Collect all the wisps.

details.title: 从前有座山
details.short_description: 一座小小的浮空仙山，您可以种田，种花，养殖，钓鱼，养鱼，捉虫，养蜂，酿蜜，修行，可以全屏游玩，也可以位于屏幕底部的休闲种田挂机模拟游戏，不会影响您的正常工作。

details.title: Muscle Kingdom
details.short_description: Grow it. Train it. Show it off. Raise mysterious creatures called "Macho" and dominate posing battles in this fresh bodybuilding brawler. Your battle cry decides the winner. Become the ultimate trainer!

details.title: Otherworldly Business
details.short_description: An action RPG set in an anime-styled otherworld. Play an adventurer who crossed over from the real world and take contracts to hunt goblins. World travel unlocks mid-to-late game, opening the West, the post-apocalypse, elven territory and more.

details.title: 四季餐厅
details.short_description: Four Seasons Restaurant "is a restaurant management game that combines classic simulation management with a warm and healing art style. Whether you're reliving the classic joys of the past or experiencing the refreshing gameplay of the four seasons, this place will be your culinary sanctuary.

details.title: Pedal Pedal Pedal
details.short_description: A chaotic physics racer where two tiny riders share one oversized BMX. Each pumps, steers and brakes, and the bike only goes where you both agree. Race a friend on one keyboard or online, or ride solo and control both riders yourself.

details.title: waga-mom
details.short_description: ――My curfew is 8 PM. Having a helicopter mom is annoying, but it's not a big deal.

details.title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a quiet patch of land into a cozy farm. Grow and sell crops, raise animals, evolve helpful pets, upgrade your equipment, and expand at your own pace in a relaxing first-person farming experience.

details.title: Tavern Game Night
details.short_description: Gather 2–8 players for seven online party games in a cozy fantasy tavern. Compete in word games, trivia, dice, drawing and deduction, then put those skills to use in Tavern Race, where challenges can move several players toward victory.

details.title: Genuine Article
details.short_description: Vienna, 1901. A bureau that authenticates antiques: without your certificate the piece is worth nothing. Silver, paintings, watches, papers — each carries a truth and a lie about its history. A predecessor’s debt makes bribes tempting. And you won’t get this right every time — mistakes cost.

details.title: T-Shirt Kingdom
details.short_description: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

details.title: Digsum
details.short_description: A relaxed incremental mining game about digging deeper, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering ancient artifacts.

details.title: Beneath Europa
details.short_description: Dive into the eerie depths of Europa to find extraterrestrial life. Are you ready to take the next step?

details.title: Swarmkeeper
details.short_description: Exploit an abomination of bees to destroy your adversaries. Swarmkeeper is a 2D linear Zelda-like, with a twist of Cult of the Lamb, that follows a tale as old as time: Your former business partners have dropped your services and you must seek revenge. You’ll never forget your first sting.

details.title: TohKago
details.short_description: Throw it, aim it. Watermelon?—BOOM! A fresh take on a staple of Japanese school sports days. The rules are simple: Pick up fruits and throw them into your team's basket. In a chaotic free-for-all, a single watermelon can make all your steadily collected fruits go BOOM. Who will have the last laugh?

details.title: Unstrung
details.short_description: In Unstrung, a 2.5D narrative puzzle game, you take center stage in a visionary puppeteer’s masterpiece—a dark retelling of Hansel and Gretel. But disobedience is strictly off-script…

details.title: Touhou Sky Cruiser
details.short_description: Run a sky cruiser built by Tenshi. Expand it room by room with new floors and terraces, offer dining and entertainment, and carry guests from port to port as you grow your business above the clouds.

details.title: Click & Loot
details.short_description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

details.title: Meat Wall
details.short_description: IF IT MOVES, SHOOT IT. IF IT STOPS, BUILD WITH IT. MEAT WALL is a darkly comedic tower defense where the horde becomes the map. Pile ’em high, build with ’em, burn ’em, grind ’em, or blast a path through ’em. Shape the battlefield. Change your strategy. EVERY WALL CHANGES THE WAR.

details.title: Syncope
details.short_description: Delve into the depths of your subconscious in this psychological isometric action game, and face your greatest fears made manifest. Fight, trade, and venture deeper into the madness of the mindscape. Can you confront the dangers and move forward towards a better future? The real battle is within.

details.title: TDG: Tower Defense
details.short_description: TDG is a single-player military tower defense game. Hold a 30-wave campaign or an endless run on procedural maps, place and upgrade six tower types, meet Siege Carrier bosses, and adapt when new paths open. Sell or repair between fights. Early Access: full runs now, more content and polish ahead.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Story
details.short_description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

details.title: Five to Fire
details.short_description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

details.title: Hearth Fable
details.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

details.title: Bullet Reign
details.short_description: Bullet Reign is a roguelike action shooter in a wasteland. Fight endless mutant waves as an armed survivor, choosing classes, weapons, and items to craft unique builds. Every run offers new progression choices—blast through the swarm and be the last one standing.

details.title: Africa Survival
details.short_description: As an explorer, you travel to Africa, hunt in the savanna, Avoid attacks from various ferocious beasts, gather resources, build shelter, and survive.

details.title: 9号台球馆：心动搭档
details.short_description: No. 9 Pool Hall blends playable eight-ball, character stories, roguelike builds, and Steam friend matches. Practice aiming and position play, meet distinctive partners, and survive nine strange nights. AI assisted art, audio, writing, code, and testing; no AI runs during play or sends player data.

details.title: Mapborn
details.short_description: Your map is the world. Mapborn is a real-time grand strategy sandbox played directly on your original artwork. Add cities and nations, choose one to rule, and shape its history through war, diplomacy, politics, and rebellion.

details.title: Mining Mike
details.short_description: Mikey Minerals owes the Shimigu Mining Corporation TRILLIONS in college debt. His sentence: the remote planet Dirt. Strap into a mech-themed roguelike mining tower defense survivor. Battle hordes, build a base, MINE and make money for the COMPANY.

details.title: Siege of Incrementalia
details.short_description: Command an undead army and lay siege to a continent in this incremental strategy game. Build war machines, sacrifice minions and automate hellish magic in your quest to unite the lands of Incrementalia by force.

details.title: Solarise
details.short_description: A short and sweet game that aims to be a love letter to solar panel production and the crisis of the modern century for Europe as it grapples with reindustrialisation. Manage your factory, power needs, politics, and just ordinary people, in order to lower costs and outcompete your global rivals.

details.title: The City Knows
details.short_description: A story-driven deduction game set in Okayama, Japan, where everyone has an answer—but you need evidence. Examine evidence and records, cross-reference witness accounts, reconstruct timelines, and separate plausible theories from provable facts across six murder investigations.

details.title: 罐头成长计划
details.short_description: 一款养成游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演妈妈，收养一只来自孤儿院的小罐头生物，前往罐头小镇抚养它，通过各种方式的培养来引导小罐成长为不同性格和职业，形成不同的人际关系 9名有感情线路的角色，游戏内包含钓鱼，换装，喂食，打工，战斗，抽卡机，五子棋，阵营选择，npc小任务等游玩方式 ·养成游戏 ·自由选择多结局

details.title: Flightline: Airline Sim
details.short_description: Flightline is an airline management sim about building an airline that has to make sense. Set routes, choose aircraft, price seats, and shape a network where passengers route themselves through real markets. Expansion succeeds only when the entire operation holds together.

details.title: Fungus Co.
details.short_description: Grow and spread mycelium from spores across a dark substrate in this relaxing incremental.

details.title: First-Person Jigsaw
details.short_description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

details.title: Angry Tanks
details.short_description: Angry Tanks is an arcade tank shooter. Move forward, performing front flips and destroying enemy tanks.

details.title: Beach Manager Simulator
details.short_description: Clean, rent, build, and play! Run your own beach in this first-person management sim. Earn money from gear rentals, expand your facilities, hire staff, and tow banana boats full of guests. Go fishing, dig up treasure, and make the beach your own.

details.title: PlatAttack
details.short_description: PlatAttack is a precision 3D platformer: clay worlds, tight jumps, medals, and a clock that never lies. Race your ghost, climb the boards, and build your own maps.

details.title: Afterwork Apocalypse
details.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite set in an office tower after hours. You fight with the stapler and the office coffee while keeping your colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and the elevator takes you up through four buildings, floor by floor.

details.title: Between the notes
details.short_description: A mystical psychological thriller set in the quiet village of Klavishne. Talk to the locals, learn stories, enjoy the atmosphere, pick up the pieces. But find out: who is the woman in the portrait and what happened to her?

details.title: BEACON 09
details.short_description: You're a prisoner sentenced to work at a crumbling lighthouse. Every night, you race against the clock, repairing whatever fails before your explosive collar decides your time is up. Repair, explore, survive in this terrifying first-person horror game.

details.title: Which Sea Is This?
details.short_description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

details.title: Shelter Prepare
details.short_description: Shelter Prepare is a post-apocalyptic placement game where you arrange various resources to create your ideal safe house. It's a low-pressure, purely placement-based, and cozy game. No combat, no death; focus on resource placement, space management, and cleaning. Gradually expand your space.

details.title: Dwarven Mining Company
details.short_description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

details.title: Lost Dude
details.short_description: Lost Dude is an atmospheric 2D platform-adventure game that follows a character who sets out on a journey to find their lost friend, experiences various events along the way, and embarks on new adventures together after reuniting.

details.title: Type The Rhythm
details.short_description: A rhythm typing trainer where you type real words to a variety of musical styles. Augmented proprioception lets you move the grooves between your brain and fingers for faster, cleaner typing. From hunt-and-peck to 150 WPM blindfolded, Type The Rhythm moves you forward.

details.title: Gunfort
details.short_description: Gunfort is a tower defense game where your army is competent and well-funded. The city is surrounded, and horrors are coming down every road. Build turrets, call in commanders, and hold the line. Watch your brilliant strategy unfold or discover exactly how much government money you can waste.

details.title: DepotDash
details.short_description: Fast-paced top-down construction yard simulator where you manage deliveries, move materials with heavy machines, and keep suppliers happy before your depot overflows.

details.title: NightMeer
details.short_description: NightMeer is a 2D exploration adventure about the nights you can't sleep. Wrapped in the pressure of having to fall asleep now, Noah drifts through her darkened room. Guide her with a click, and slowly let the tension leave her body and mind. How she gets through this night is up to you.

details.title: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
details.short_description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

details.title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
details.short_description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

details.title: ComboCraft Legendary
details.short_description: An Idle incremental clicker focused on crafting symbols, merging combinations, and building automated production. Reset your run to unlock permanent upgrades and grow stronger each cycle.

details.title: Clash of Worlds
details.short_description: Clash of Worlds is a turn-based strategic card game. Similar gameplay mechanics to Yu-Gi-Oh!. Featuring multiple supported formats and a developer who cares about fun. All gameplay is manual, as if playing "in real life". Join the Stoat server for help or questions. Stoat: https://stt.gg/K8jk6Dxd

details.title: Orbital Upgrade
details.short_description: As the AI of a space station, you control programmable bots and solve automation puzzles. Plan precise processes, optimize your strategies, and watch your solutions execute autonomously.

details.title: Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator
details.short_description: Run the town’s coziest cat caretaking home! Renovate and upgrade your house, manage inventory and order supplies online. Fulfill specific feline requests with specialized furniture and engaging toys. Play with cats, keep them happy, and optimize your layout to create the perfect daily workflow.

details.title: World without Time
details.short_description: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

details.title: Veldrak: Dark Revenant
details.short_description: A multiplayer action RPG of dark survival. Customize your warrior, infuse magic through alchemy, tame wild beasts, and lead autonomous NPCs to build and defend your settlement against rank 1 to 5 demons.

details.title: Twilight Gallery
details.short_description: A point-and-click game inspired by early internet flash games. A mysterious company has induced you into a year-long coma and is curating your dreams. Free the trapped souls of artists from their exhibits to escape.

details.title: Chicago 4th of July
details.short_description: Chicago 4th of July is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in a near-future Chicago — a glamorous yet oppressive megacity wrapped in a mysterious Veil. Uncover the truth behind the Veil, navigate a world ruled by power and rise against a system built to keep you blind.

name: Dragon’s Breath : Chronicles of the Red Dragon (レッドドラゴン戦記)

details.title: Dragon’s Breath : Chronicles of the Red Dragon (レッドドラゴン戦記)
details.short_description: The Red Dragon returns. Venture into the dungeons of Mount Firebreath. This 2D adventure RPG is brought to life with stunning retro pixel art. Classic bump-combat evolves with timing-based action for tense battles. Upgrade your gear, master key items, and defeat the Dragon.

details.title: Cauldron Chaos: Co-op Potion Shop
details.short_description: Run a potion shop with up to 3 friends as wooden witch dolls. brew potions, levitate everything, fling each other across the room, and try not to blow up the cauldron. You will.

details.title: DISPEL
details.short_description: In DISPEL, play as the sole survivor of an unknown magical calamity. Explore the ruins of a corrupted wizard academy, avoid the shades of your former friends, solve puzzles to discover new areas of the school, and uncover what happened in Feylight Academy.

details.title: Unchest
details.short_description: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

details.title: Orbital Command
details.short_description: Orbital Command is about controlling planet based weapon systems to defend your planets from large asteroids and hostile invaders. Will you be able to complete the Dyson Sphere, or will your planets end up barren husks?

details.title: Make Burgers: GRILL UP
details.short_description: Embark on a burger-filled adventure with chef Bobby Grill and his bright yellow food truck! Get ready to serve unique burgers not only to regular customers, but also to sweet tooths, robots, zombies, and even aliens!

details.title: The lost trail
details.short_description: Play as a raccoon on a heartfelt and dangerous journey to find the boy who once saved you from poachers. Explore the wild, avoid traps, uncover secrets, and experience a story of friendship, survival, and hope.

details.title: Loginnnnnn
