details.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op to breach 10 ultra-realistic login screens with Physics-Driven Cursors! To unlock the final mini game, you must use fectly log into 10 fictional online services without a single mistake. Do you ready to get stuck at the login page???

details.title: Coffin Hunter
details.short_description: You owe the Helix a very specific soul. Hunt for coffins, harvest rare souls, and build the ultimate killing machine in this fast-paced roguelite. Survive faction wars, hunt bounty hunters, and find a way to reach the Kingpin in the lawless Marupto Rift.

details.title: Cube Sweeper
details.short_description: Cube Sweeper is a casual relaxing puzzle game. All you have to do is work out which cubes are red and which cubes are empty. Numbers show how many adjacent cubes are red and from that information you can solve all the levels in the game without guessing.

name: Privacy Not Included - A Motel Simulator

details.title: Privacy Not Included - A Motel Simulator
details.short_description: You're a night clerk at a roadside motel in 1997, working off a court sentence. Check guests in, clean up after them, and once you get a hidden camera, decide what to do with whatever it catches on tape.

details.title: Pun Chan Pop
details.short_description: Think fast, match faster! Chain 5 pieces in any direction to win, or use the Square-Merge to turn 2x2 clusters into massive, high-scoring blocks before clearing them. Battle cute animals to a pulsing Bitpop soundtrack in this frantic puzzle showdown!

name: Find Bunny : A Little Hidden Journey

details.title: Find Bunny : A Little Hidden Journey
details.short_description: Find Bunny is a cozy hidden-object game where you peel stickers to find and collect hidden pictures. Join Coco and Matcha on a journey to uncover the secret of the misbehaving crops. Cross the sea, ride the train, fill your album with stickers, and help new friends bring peace back to the farm!

details.title: Sushi Sewers
details.short_description: A fast-paced cyberpunk bullet-heaven where neon chaos, dark power, and endless enemy swarms collide. Survive the waves, create the strongest builds, and become unstoppable.

details.title: Glamour Photographer
details.short_description: Fulfill your dream of becoming a glamour photographer, meet beautiful women from different cultures and backgrounds, and maybe even marry one of them!

details.title: 洛希极限 Roche Limit
details.short_description: ​Roche Limit​ is a 2D pixel sci-fi action roguelite, blending high-speed aerial combat with ARPG builds. Choose a mecha-girl, build her skills on the battle, and face the cosmic legion. Between runs, bond with the girls for more skill possibles and stories. Prevent cataclysm before the moon falls.

details.title: Reinvaders
details.short_description: Reinvaders is a short retro sci-fi shooter. Fight through four levels, dash past alien fire, and take down bosses in a tight arcade-style campaign.

details.title: Dreamsink
details.short_description: Awakening in a frigid room with an empty pill bottle, she’s forgotten something vital. Trapped between a monochrome bedroom and distorted dreams, she must face anxiety and depression... Break mental shackles and find the light in this psychological puzzle adventure！

details.title: City of Promotion
details.short_description: City of Promotion est un jeu qui combine les échecs et la construction de colonies, où les joueurs utilisent les règles de déplacement des pièces d'échecs pour collecter des ressources, développer des colonies et résister aux attaques de monstres en essaim.

details.title: Ravelle - Last Draw
details.short_description: What starts as casual matches in a humble café becomes a shared effort to protect a place that matters. Ravelle is a free-to-play turn-based strategy card game with visual novel elements, blending tactical card battles and personal character stories.

details.title: Gun Repair Shop
details.short_description: Become a master gunsmith. Repair, restore, customize, and test firearms in a detailed workshop simulator: buy parts, craft components, renovate classic weapons, and take them to the shooting range to prove your work

details.title: SECONDED
details.short_description: Seconded is a strategy-driven tavern management game about assigning the right companion to the right problem under pressure and uncertainty. Each request hides its true requirements, forcing you to read situations carefully rather than rely on explicit instructions.

details.title: Goldfish Gunner
details.short_description: Become the most wanted outlaw by taking on the role of Goldfish, a gunner robbing every bank in the Wild West. Escape across challenging, obstacle-filled landscapes where your only way to move is by firing your weapon and riding the recoil.

details.title: Doomsday Defense Line
details.short_description: This is an innovative game that combines strategy, action and character development. David to the frontlines of the plant-animal alliance. Engage in fierce defensive battles against the powerful zombie horde, and uncover the fascinating stories behind every precious character in this world.
developers: 上海齐格飞网络科技有限公司
publishers: 辰炎翎网络科技（上海）有限公司

details.title: Smoke Easy: Hookah Lounge Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own hookah lounge! Seat guests, pack the bowl, keep the coals burning, put out fires (literally) and grow your business from a tiny spot to a place worth staying for.

details.title: DOOMFRONT
details.short_description: Ever wonder what happens when you mix high-octane progression and a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler? Well I did, and you're about to find out. Travel from room to room at extreme speeds fighting and looting any foe who dares to stop you in your tracks.

details.title: What The Dog Doing?
details.short_description: A relaxing idle digging game that sits at the corner of your screen. Work (or don't) while your best friend digs for items, collects treasures and unlocks new biomes and outfits.

details.title: HellFactory Inc.
details.short_description: Run a factory in Hell. Automate production lines, hit monthly revenue targets, bribe the board of Seven Deadly Sins, and skim slush funds to seize control — before they terminate you. A roguelike fusion of factory automation and boardroom politics.

details.title: Project ACCIPITER
details.short_description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But UOOHHH~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad ACCIPITER in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

details.title: Backrooms: Echo
details.short_description: The next level of Backrooms games. Co-op for 1–4 players. Procedurally generated levels, terrifying entities, and a realistic atmosphere. Every playthrough is a unique experience. Try to find the way out, but don’t trust everything you hear and see.

details.title: PAWSTRONAUTS
details.short_description: A co-op pixel art platformer about 10 animal astronauts crash-landed on a hostile alien planet. Every character is a life. Stomp, grab, and throw enemies through 6 worlds and epic boss fights. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

name: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim

details.title: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim
details.short_description: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

details.title: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator
details.short_description: Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

details.title: PLA-TOON 2
details.short_description: A chaotic, stylized, light-hearted, whimsical, cartoon party-style shooter.

details.title: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
details.short_description: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

details.title: Cardbound Heroes
details.short_description: Cardbound Heroes is a Draw & Strike Roguelite where you combine cards to match numbers, cross out fields, fight enemies and unlock powerful combos. Build your deck, discover hidden combo cards, and master a campaign that changes every run.

details.title: The Rat Eater
details.short_description: Collect strange loot in this absurd world. Choose your simple rat and turn him into complex killing machine. Explore unique skill trees, craft items and eat rats. What more would one want?

details.title: Otaku Love Story
details.short_description: Behind the keyboard, you're a struggling web novelist. In reality, a socially anxious shut-in. Your life is a simple loop of writing, gaming, and binge-watching, until four very different girls crash into your world—right through the internet.

details.title: Grim Fate: Cloverleaf Bay
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a polished VHS style psychological horror experience, with an atmospheric first person view, branching dialogues, environmental clues, a mystery to uncover and some things that aren't quite right that will keep you questioning what's real and what's not.

details.title: Starship Dice
details.short_description: Fill your fleet with different weapons and equipment, and return to base with loot. The fleet will engage in automatic battles in three-dimensional space, and you will plan the star map route and action mode, but it is best to pray for permission from the God of Dice.

details.title: Birdoo
details.short_description: Birdoo: Feathered Fury is an indie action game were you assume the role of a bird embarking on a quest for revenge against the humans who wronged him. No longer will you tolerate being called a "flying rat" or being shooed away. It's time to exact your revenge!

details.title: Red & Blue
details.short_description: Play as two housecats causing chaos while their owners are gone! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, and help each other solve color-coded puzzles.

details.title: Agent Panda
details.short_description: You are Agent Panda - a fearless detective trying to solve the mystery of Puzzle Islands. You must solve many puzzles and interview many quirky witnesses in order to find the mastermind! Who has been setting up all the puzzles? A light-hearted detective puzzle game with character.

details.title: Mindbound
details.short_description: Mindbound is a short single-player horror game that revolves around uncovering what has happened. After a business trip, Marty returns home eagerly anticipating seeing his wife and daughter. But, things turn out differently than expected. The game emphasizes a deep atmosphere.

details.title: 悪夢祓いのアリス
details.short_description: Defeat enemies in a real-time card battle using magical energy that builds over time. Unlike turn-based games, enjoy the dynamic thrill of real-time strategy. Adapt to a constantly changing deck and discover your own optimal solutions.

details.title: Wanted 3D: Dead or Alive
details.short_description: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a UZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

details.title: The Legend of Simurgh
details.short_description: You are a small bird traveling through 7 valleys to find the Simurgh and bring life back to your village.

details.title: Ponchorado
details.short_description: Ponchorado is a satirical Wild West survival-action game with roguelite elements in a 1930s cartoon style, set in the ruins of a never-finished western movie. Play as Poncho, a forgotten stuntman battling through chaos, clichés, and caricatures.

details.title: KAL
details.short_description: KAL is a first-person psychological horror game. Trapped in an old, abandoned Creole house, immerse yourself in a time loop and relive the story of a slave who became a true legend.

details.title: Buff Climbers
details.short_description: Physics-driven rogue-like platformer for you and your friends. Each run brings new hazards, fresh loot, and betrayal. Buff Climbers is in early development. Please excuse the lack of polish.

details.title: Var Game Simulator
details.short_description: Var Game Simulator allows you to manage critical moments of football like a VAR referee. Carefully examine offside, penalty and card decisions and make the right decision. Experience the excitement of football through the eyes of a referee with realistic scenarios!

details.title: Industronaut
details.short_description: A survival engineering game where you build life support habitats, mine resources, and automate production chains on a radiation heavy planet. No rescue. No support. Just engineering.

details.title: Defiled West
details.short_description: A top-down Western Action RPG set in a desolate & mutated frontier. Discover and overpower furiously unstable foes that waver the rules of life and death. Collect and upgrade powerful weapons and wield a variety of otherworldly gadgets. Reclaim what was lost, one building at a time.

details.title: Bore Bore
details.short_description: Descend to the center of the Earth and survive beneath toxic skies. Watch out for the creatures. Manage your air, water, and food. Build vehicles to dig deeper. Grow potatoes, gather resources, and design robots to defend and automate your world — the control is in your hands.

details.title: イミテーション
details.short_description: ――It seems that in this world, immortal humans are called “Players.” Eve, a girl living in a world where immortality is commonplace. Become her, gather information through conversation and exploration, and unravel the mysteries of this world.

details.title: retrospect
details.short_description: "retrospect" is a linear, full-length visual novel. Trace the memories of the ghosts and learn about them. That is the only mourning you can do.

details.title: Project Damascus
details.short_description: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

details.title: Bring Me Home
details.short_description: A small point and click game about helping a dog to get back home.

details.title: BONEMARROW
details.short_description: BoneMarrow is a short action survival horror in which you play a mutant creature created in a lab, destined to be used as a test subject. When the facility you were created in falls into disarray due to the meddling of a dark cult, you finally have your opportunity to escape.

details.title: ENTRY_13
details.short_description: ENTRY_13 is a psychological horror experience inspired by Backrooms lore. Explore its meta, multi-layered narrative, and its procedural, ever-changing maps. Track your way in, find your way out. Survive the encounters.

details.title: Spooky Lord
details.short_description: Become the Lord of Fear! Command a team of spooky spirits, each with unique powers, to haunt or outwit humans in this tactical ghost game. Choose your approach, master your minions, and control the world of the living!

details.title: Paccarat
details.short_description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

details.title: This Is Not A Dungeon
details.short_description: TINAD is a unique tower defense game where you defend your retirement home from overeager heroes. Play as the dungeon itself. Deploy traps, summon minions, and prove you’re just trying to enjoy your golden years in peace against heroes who can’t read the sign and assume every dungeon is evil.

details.title: Crime & Anomaly
details.short_description: Fight to keep your mind in the shadow of crime and the unknown. Crime & Anomaly is an indie psychological horror that drags you through the dark corridors of 1860s Saint Petersburg. Inspired by Dostoevsky’s Crime and Punishment, every creaking floorboard and flicker of light can shatter your sanity.

details.title: Warrior Is Just Going
details.short_description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

details.title: Multitales: Hood, Gun & Contraband
details.short_description: Red Riding Hood takes up a shotgun and explosive pies to find her missing father. Beneath the bright fairytale lies a dark story of fear, betrayal, and choices made when there’s nothing left to lose.

details.title: Pledged to a Princess
details.short_description: A cute and wholesome yuri visual about a young princess, Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva, who (finally!) gets to meet her online friend and fellow anime fan, Audrey McMahon. Is the power of cute girls enough to bring a princess and a pauper together?

details.title: SiegeBorn
details.short_description: SiegeBorn is a top-down action RTS. Lead your troops, command powerful siege engines, and defeat the enemies!

details.title: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum
details.short_description: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum is a fast-paced Rogue-Like First Person Arena fighter. Battle through hordes of enemies. In this cruel coliseum, it's a free-for-all. You choose where to fight and who to fight at the right moment, with the aid of Magic Crystals that give single use weapons and tools.

details.title: B-Ricky High School
details.short_description: Meet Ricky in this exciting arcade game mixing flipper, brick smashing and fight. Get ready for the challenges of Arcade or Story mode and for the tough ones, settle the score in the double 2-player mode.

details.title: Do Crimes!
details.short_description: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

details.title: World In The Abyss
details.short_description: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

details.title: 残阳 1645/1937
details.short_description: As a Ming officer in 1645’s Yangzhou & Jiangyin massacres, shield a girl from shouma fate while obeying orders. In 1937’s Battle of Yangzhou, protect a war journalist returned from Japan. Your choices decide their survival and shape their fates across 300 years.

details.title: Chinese Black Dragon Legend
details.short_description: " Chinese Black Dragon Legend" is a daily comedy Cantonese-style visual novel (galgame). The story follows Sino-French footballer Zhong Guolong's romantic journey with four heroines: Bai Xiaotong, Aisha, Frolana, and Kim Sung-ae.

details.title: Fantasy Sino-Japanese War：Rebirth
details.short_description: ​​Dragons roar, history bends. As Admiral Ding Ruchang, you command magical sea beasts, not ships, in this thrilling SRPG. After a crushing defeat, lead the Beiyang Fleet's last hope against Japan's monsters. Rewrite the Sino-Japanese War.

details.title: SCRATCH CO.
details.short_description: Build a deck of scratch tickets, chase rising quotas, permanently upgrade your gas station, and pay off your debt! Scratch the itch of gambling in SCRATCH CO.

details.title: Peg Together
details.short_description: Peg Together is a multiplayer puzzle game that puts you against a friend to see who can achieve the highest score by hitting the most pegs with the furthest shots! Explore through different levels and worlds and master them all to win against your friend!

details.title: 100 Lucky Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Native Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Raft Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Chess Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Vicelock - Tactical Roguelite RPG
details.short_description: Build a team, loot gear in turn-based tactical combat, then extract or push deeper and risk losing it all. Forge, craft and trade your haul on a real player-driven market. A tactical roguelite where your loot actually has value.

details.title: HER VOICE BEHIND
details.short_description: A magician wakes with no memory of the woman he loved... or how she died. Explore a circus that rearranges itself behind you, evade the witness in the rafters, and uncover what really happened during "The Final Show." An atmospheric first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: Atout
details.short_description: Classic Card Games & more: 23 card games in one, from Tarot to Hanafuda, plus Rummy, Belote, Poker and Solitaire. Three AI difficulty levels, local and online multiplayer, 24 variants, six languages. A warm pixel-art take on the classics — play solo or with friends.

name: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients

details.title: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
details.short_description: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

details.title: Glitch Gears
details.short_description: In Glitch Gears, dodge, boost, and outmaneuver in a driving experience inspired by old-school arcade games, with fresh mechanics from auto shooters. Stay ahead of relentless pursuers and master endless, traffic-filled roads in this high-speed battle for freedom.

details.title: Elderwood Online
details.short_description: Dive back into the golden age of MMORPGs. Leveling is the journey, not a sprint: every level is earned, builds take real thought, and the world grows wider, never taller. No auto-play, no shortcuts to endgame, no pay-to-win. Made by a solo indie developer for those who love the long climb.

details.title: Mystical Tactics
details.short_description: Mystical Tactics is a turn-based tactical-RPG roguelike in which you control a squad of adventurers in a mystical world. Train your heroes in fast-paced tactical battles, equip them with powerful items and lead them to repel the Dark Lord and his legions.

details.title: BUS: Bro u Survived
details.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! Fight zombies, gather resources, help other survivors, and solve puzzles. Can you uncover the truth about the beginning of the epidemic and decide the fate of the island?

details.title: The Walls
details.short_description: A story of escape filled with nightmares, trapped within a simulation universe that is reality itself. Markus, dragged into a deep psychological pit by the pain of losing his family, finds himself confronting his nightmares in this simulation universe.

details.title: 遥岸灯海
details.short_description: 出身术士名门却没有天赋的人类少女，在机缘巧合之下得到了和城内最强大的猫妖签订契约的机会。直到某个期限——灯海节——到来前，她都为了成为出色的术士而不断努力。尽管她身边的猫妖，似乎并不理解她的心愿。

details.title: Ocean in the Cold Sky
details.short_description: You can manually parry attacks, fly a little with your meagre wings, and die instantly.

details.title: Rise of the Bugs
details.short_description: RISE OF THE BUGS is a 2D pixel art adventure game about annoying bugs. Lead a colony in search of new food, discover the secrets of mutation and escape from the angry men on the kitchen. Will you be able to steal the mysterious sauce or you die crushed under a slipper?

details.title: DuckTape Inc.
details.short_description: Night shift for the notoriously stingy DuckTape Inc. In 1-5 player co-op, keep an offshore oil rig and a polar research station running: tape pipes, hunt hacked drones, drill ice and reach the helicopter before the thing in the dark finds you. The pilot waits for no one.

details.title: FPS Pro Team Manager
details.short_description: Recruit and manage the team of FPS players of your dreams, create your own strategies and rise to the top of the world's elite.

details.title: Space Fighter
details.short_description: Experience the unique mix of modern fast-paced multiplayer action with intuitive twin-stick controls and a retro pixelart look. Battle against other pilots in quick PvP sessions of classic versus and space racing - or team up with friends in Co-op to defend against aliens and hunt difficult bosses.

details.title: Hyakki Yagyō: Endless Nights
details.short_description: A roguelike dungeon defense game inspired by Dungeon Maker. Recruit mercenaries, set traps, and fortify against nightly yokai hordes. Romance your allies, unleash cinematic ultimate skills, and survive as long as you can — or fall to the Hyakki Yagyo.

details.title: TAILS GEAR HD
details.short_description: A revamped version of "Tales Gear," originally released in 2007, featuring high-resolution support, new systems, and rearranged background music. A full-fledged 2.5D vertical-scrolling shooter characterized by the Tail Pod, an optional weapon that combines offense and defense.

details.title: Always Summer Out Here
details.short_description: Always Summer Out Here is a visual novel about life in a small post-soviet town with management elements. Atmospheric locations, soulful dialogues, non-linear questlines, and tough decisions that shape the game world await you. Welcome to the Province!

name: Five Nights at Bowl City High School

details.title: Five Nights at Bowl City High School
details.short_description: You've just been hired at Bowl City High School, but its not what it seems... Use your flashlight to light up the office and look for lurking teachers, locate hiding spots to survive, and block off vents to stop them from getting into your office. Most importantly, however, you must stop Mr. Gut...

details.title: The Encroaching
details.short_description: The Encroaching is a digital board game for 1–4 players where you build a map one tile at a time then confront the threats that follow those choices. Hidden roles, secret objectives and a corruption creeping through the city means every placement counts, and not everyone may be who they claim to be.

details.title: Trapper
details.short_description: An animal-catching game made both for and against the hardcore collectors.

details.title: The Floral Princes
details.short_description: A dark fantasy otome RPG where cursed Floral Princes fight against the corruption consuming their kingdom. Build romantic bonds, make meaningful choices, collect powerful cards, and battle through a cinematic story-rich adventure.

details.title: 門 GATE
details.short_description: A Japanese psychological horror game set in 1980s Japan. Travel to the past after a nuclear war and prepare for the coming battle against AI machines using cursed powers, strange devices, and experimental technology.

details.title: Two Ants
details.short_description: Two slacker ants, one mysterious ball, and a brutally unforgiving climb. Coordinate your movement, master precise jumps, and drag this thing to the top before your friendship implodes.

details.title: AQUA FALL
details.short_description: Slide, fly, and crash in! Aqua Fall is a chaotic party race where up to 8 players tear down a water slide. Shortcuts off the course are the key to victory. Dive into the pool at the finish and compete for first place! Public matches and bot battles are easy to jump into.

details.title: Echo of Memory -AI Profiler-
details.short_description: Echoe of Memory: AI Profiler is a mystery adventure where you reopen cold cases with your AI partner, ECHO. As investigator Makoto Kuroiwa, search crime scene photos, social media, and police DBs, expose contradictions, and uncover the truth behind the official record’s lies!

name: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby

details.title: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby
details.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

details.title: Midnight Scour
details.short_description: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

details.title: Izaav:Darkness from Beyond
details.short_description: A 2D platform shooter ,where you fight against monsters and nature itself — everything standing between you and what you hold dear. A young boy, armed with weapons and determination, faces growing darkness. The deeper he goes, the harsher it becomes — but not impossible.

details.title: Feline Fury 3D
details.short_description: Hunt down the mouse invasion as a chunky cat with claws, bombs, and lightning. Feline Fury is a fast roguelite where every run reshapes the woods, the desert, the tundra, and the volcano around you. Build a deck of abilities, chase community milestones, climb the Furmament.

details.title: Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends
details.short_description: Take the wheel in Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends, a single-player open-wheel racing game. Master 18 track configurations, compete against AI rivals, and upgrade your car through a 22-event career. Chase faster laps, earn medals, and race your way to the top.

name: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil

details.title: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil
details.short_description: On a dreary night, a lighthouse keeper must sweep their beam to guide lost souls ashore, and burn back the dark creeping from within.

details.title: Farm Bang
details.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

details.title: NowLoading Forever
details.short_description: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

details.title: AIRSKIPPER
details.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

details.title: A Sweet Treat for Nona
details.short_description: Your Nona lost all the rolling pins, go find them! Explore levels full of crazy sweets, where each introduces into a new unexpected mechanic. Mix ingredients, discover abilities, and face challenges in this pixel-art puzzle platformer.

details.title: Penance
details.short_description: A top-down action game about a crusader spending his final hours paying for the sins that ravaged everything he cherished. Fight through waves of powerful, high ranking imperial soldiers, with a Flame Meter that drains constantly and never refills.

details.title: Simulacre
details.short_description: Simulacre is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror where familiar voices may not belong to your friends. Explore unsettling locations with unique objectives and threats, survive together, and never be certain who—or what—you can trust.

details.title: Plucked
details.short_description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

details.title: SEO or Die
details.short_description: Start with a single website and build a sprawling online empire. Grow traffic, manage clients, expand your team, and survive fifteen years of internet evolution in a life sim and business management RPG where every decision can lead to fortune or failure.

details.title: Celestial Oath
details.short_description: Easy to Learn. Instantly Accessible. Simple Mechanics. Endless Possibilities. Epic Dungeons. Diverse Character Builds. Enter a world of ancient myths, legendary heroes, and timeless traditions. Join players from around the globe and discover the epic legends of the East.

details.title: Hustle On High
details.short_description: A fast paced game where you play as Kaz and you enter human labs and defeat loads of strange creatures and creations, will you make it to the end only time will tell

details.title: Autobus - The Card Game
details.short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

details.title: DANJIRI RAMPAGE
details.short_description: Ride the danjiri and carve every corner in this full-throttle Japanese festival action game. Master your balance atop traditional festival floats, nail razor-sharp drifts on steep slopes, and chase high scores with your festival spirit. All set to high-energy enka music.

details.title: PuzzlePlants
details.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic gardening puzzle game players travel from island to island to help the inhabitants put food on the table. While placing plants, they have to consider their needs and avoid bad matches. Players face increasingly difficult puzzles due to sunlight, wind, rain or soil quality.

details.title: Cold Contours: Intake
details.short_description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

details.title: CHAINSPIRE
details.short_description: CHAINSPIRE is a soul-like platformer for 1–4 players connected by a real physical chain. Your friend will become your enemy the very moment they stop listening to you.

details.title: Pokermancer
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands are scored on a grid, not played from a hand. Link neighboring cards across a 4x4 grid into pairs, straights and flushes, then slide, swap and delete cards to bypass hazards that block the paths you need.

details.title: Hellevator
details.short_description: Hellevator is a darkly comedic action roguelite where YOU are a hungry elevator in a failing hotel in Hell. Bite intruders in half, keep demanding guests alive and happy, and transform your cabin for management's bizarre assignments as you climb floor by floor.

details.title: Honest Work
details.short_description: Play as the frontier's least qualified cattle outfit. The herd spooks at everything, the wilderness wants you dead, and your posse's lassos are a bigger threat than the wolves. Drive the cattle, rope your friends, get paid. It ain't much, but it's honest work.

details.title: VEKARRA
details.short_description: A dark-fantasy party roguelite with turn-based tactical combat on a shared timeline. Lead four heroes into the Abyss, watch most enemy attacks charge, and interrupt the killing blow. Draft skills instead of grinding levels. Lose all four and the run ends. Free demo: solo or two-player local co-op.

details.title: Gloomhallow
details.short_description: Gloomhallow is a macabre and unforgiving turn & tile based tactical PvP game. 3 Phases, 1 turn. Predict your enemies' movements and pre-decided all 3 phases before committing and letting yours, and your opponents decisions, dictate the outcome of battle. Every decision counts.

name: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done?

details.title: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done?
details.short_description: Pinball, wands and chain scoring in one roguelike. Break balls with your cue ball and wand spells, link same-attribute balls into long chains on the 16-slot ball rail, and hit the target score before time's up. Seven attributes and over a hundred relics, wand parts and decorations to build around.

details.title: Buckaroo
details.short_description: A creature-breeding sim where you catch wild critters in an open world and breed them into absurd creations, with over 60 million combinations. Then take your critter down to the rodeo or the racetrack and climb the ranked circuit.

name: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-

details.title: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-
details.short_description: 懐かしくて温かくてちょっぴり切ない…… 少年少女たちによる、ひと夏のジュブナイルRPG！

details.title: Next Level: Tower Defense
details.short_description: Race-based tower defense. Build your army, defend your king, and send waves at your rivals. Up to 8-player FFA, 2v2 & 4v4 teams, and singleplayer. Crossplay on Windows, Linux, macOS & Steam Deck.

details.title: Groundwork
details.short_description: The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

details.title: Absolute Sumo: Chonk Arena
details.short_description: A silly online party game where you play a chubby meme animal in a tiny sumo belt and shove everyone else out of the ring. Win rounds to grow from a cute little wobbler into a giant slab of muscle, dodge shifting arenas, and fight over who gets to push who.

details.title: Shrimp Method
details.short_description: Shrimp Method is a deliciously addictive shrimp-themed incremental game, where you can watch your shrimp slosh around into full grown crustaceans, vacuumed up by Shrimp Co.'s industrial vacuum network and turned into sweet sweet money!

details.title: Konbini Shift
details.short_description: A shop-sim puzzle game about running a Japanese convenience store. Drag runs of matching goods off the shelves to fill orders, then cook what you sell in the kitchen out back. VIPs and the panic clock force you to spend powerups wisely and clock out with the day banked and your manager's ask filled.

details.title: Kingdom's Destiny: Warlords
details.short_description: Defend the realms from tyrannical warlords, then recruit them! Command epic turn-based battles to defend the land from oppression. When pirates invade the small kingdom of Forestgrove they awaken military leaders who rise against cruelty and subjugation.

details.title: SALT SWEEPER
details.short_description: SALT SWEEPER is a roguelite twist on minesweeper. Sweep corrupted desert mines, fight enemies in turn-based combat, and grow more powerful with weapons and spells you find along the way.

details.title: Precinct 2099
details.short_description: NeoTokyo, 2099. The man who sold immortality is dead in a penthouse sealed from the inside. You are detective Kade Katano: scan the scene, read people, roll the dice and decide which truth closes the file. A noir visual novel — one complete case, three endings.

details.title: ODYSSEY: Wine-Dark Sea
details.short_description: Troy has fallen. Home is an angry sea away. Lead a crew of named men through the myths of the Odyssey — ration food, bargain with gods, decide who lives. In the myth he came home alone. Can you do better? A story-rich roguelite where every voyage ends in an epic Song about your choices.

details.title: 飞鸟的日记
details.short_description: "theDIARY" is a post-apocalyptic supernatural AVG with multiple endings. Play as Raven, navigate choices and stats, and uncover the dark truth behind humanity's angels to find the source of the tragedy.

details.title: May, Be Dead
details.short_description: May, Be Dead is a first-person surrealist adventure game about walking through endless hexagonal rooms of memory and repeatedly killing May, a mysterious figure you shared an intimate yet ambiguous relationship with.

details.title: Sound & Shoal
details.short_description: A surreal first-person narrative adventure about memory, loss, and the stories we tell ourselves. Explore an ever-changing world where reality and fantasy blur in search of meaning.

details.title: Apocalypse Train
details.short_description: Command a heavily armed, constantly moving train through a hostile post-apocalyptic wasteland. Manage your crew's hunger, mine for resources, upgrade your mobile base, and defend relentless monster attacks.

details.title: No More Turtles
details.short_description: No More Turtles is a plastic-producing incremental game. Start cranking grandpa's machine, loot abandoned warehouses, and pollute your way to saving a world overrun by turtles!

details.title: Operation: Doomed Peter
details.short_description: OPERATION : Doomed Peter is a dungeon crawler heavily inspired by the 80's and 90's games like rogue. Weapons include guns, voodoo magic, melee, and even thrown weapons! Fight through hordes of monsters consisting of over 35 uniqe encounters and 3 bosses!

details.title: Review Responder
details.short_description: As a review responder for an e-commerce store, you face various customer complaints and must make critical decisions. Will you sincerely apologize, firmly refute, or skillfully defuse the situation? Every choice impacts your store's performance and determines the course of your career.

details.title: DEGEN DROOLS
details.short_description: An autobattler where degenerate marshmallows fight automatically. Stick them with darts, roast them together, stack them on top of one another for more power, and gamble everything. THE ONLY THING TO BEWARE IS YOURSELF!

details.title: Lean Into The Swarm
details.short_description: Direct a growing swarm of harvesters as it consumes procedurally generated worlds tile by tile. Upgrade your operation, steer the frontier, use Scorch, and carry permanent Salvage perks into each larger world.

details.title: CampSight
details.short_description: CampSight is a co-op horror photography roguelike where you explore a haunted campground, photograph strange wildlife, and earn enough to meet your quota. Search abandoned camps, caves, cabins, and dark trails but beware: some creatures run, some stalk you, and some should never be watched too long

details.title: Aquaculture Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own fish farm in first person. Keep the water alive, raise trout, eels, sturgeon and koi, breed 25 koi varieties, and sell through customer orders, an online market, your farm shop and a show hall where you haggle face to face.

details.title: Shadows of Christmas Eve
details.short_description: Explore a house that gradually transforms as the nightmares become increasingly disturbing, while presences seem to watch you from the darkness. Discover the secrets hidden within its walls before it’s too late...

details.title: Break the Bank
details.short_description: Break the Bank is an incremental clicker game where you watch balls bounce through boards and break buildings for money. Upgrade, automate, unlock new zones, and defeat strange bosses.

details.title: HeroNet
details.short_description: Hire unique heroes, fight fearsome battles, and solve the inane problems of your clients in HeroNet!

details.title: Whisker Cat Shelter
details.short_description: Welcome to Whisker Village! Run a cozy cat shelter, welcome cats brought in by villagers, care for new arrivals, and help them find loving forever homes, solo or with a friend.

details.title: Cindocu: The Omens
details.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of Persia Kelborn - heir to the oldest dynasty on the continent of Ferrum. Uncover the dark secrets hidden within his family for centuries, and witness events that began long before he was born...

details.title: Bumper Buddies
details.short_description: Join your friends online for the hilarious, addictive party racer where you race, shove, and betray your buddies. Team up 1v1 to 3v3 across physics-fueled minigames. Paint your car however you like.

details.title: Priest Amore
details.short_description: Priest Amore is a cartoon-style, casual puzzle game. Players will take on the role of Amor, a priest working in the fictional institution "Palace of Love," experiencing her day in the life while encountering a mundane yet meaningful adventure about love and understanding.

details.title: Triox
details.short_description: A short indie horror blending Sokoban puzzles with tense resource management. Deep inside a hostile mining facility, you remotely pilot a pushing machine. The world's oxygen is depleting, but a volatile new form of cyclic ozone has been discovered. Excavate it. It's humanity's only hope.

details.title: New Trivia Unlocked!
details.short_description: A knowledge Q&A party game with Steam Workshop support! Featuring hundreds of quirky, mind-bending, and bizarre questions—from everyday facts to counterintuitive trivia and pure luck challenges. Play online with your friends to find out who the true "know-it-all" is!

details.title: Until somewhere
details.short_description: WARNING! This game is harder than it looks – you’ll need to be a real go-getter. The aim is to build your shuttle and upgrade it so you can venture into the unknown depths of interstellar space. With only Lina, your faithful companion, by your side, will you have enough patience?

details.title: Empirestead
details.short_description: A cozy medieval farming life sim on Grey Croft. Keep animals, trade in Ashford, and live through the seasons.

details.title: Voidlights
details.short_description: Voidlights is a Neon-lit 2D top-down roguelight shooter. Auto-fire through escalating void swarms, stack modules and systems, survive storms and bosses. Play solo with save/continue, or dive into Steam co-op with up to 6 players.

details.title: SoulPurge
details.short_description: SoulPurge is a psychological horror mystery. Explore an old abandoned mansion. Find clues to solve the mystery. Discover how and why its former inhabitants lost their lives. Evade the horrors that wander the mansion halls. Free their tortured souls in an attempt to redeem yours.

details.title: Crashborn
details.short_description: Lost and with no memories, cross a solar system to get back home. Tear through each planet's hordes to recharge your ship's energy and take off before the world turns lethal. Combine weapons, implants and anomalies until nothing can stop you. Every death rewrites your reality and your memory.

details.title: Still Pines: watchtower
details.short_description: Still Pines: Watchtower is a first-person psychological horror mystery where you play as Claire, a college student trapped at an isolated winter watchtower. Explore a semi-open snowy forest, uncover clues about a missing ranger, survive the thing watching from the trees, and follow story objectives.

details.title: Backrooms With Friends!
details.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op horror game where you and your friends noclip into an endless maze also known as the Backrooms. Explore procedurally generated levels and avoid the Entities that stalk the halls. Get separated and you might not make it back. Get caught and you won't make it out at all...

details.title: Deck of Empires
details.short_description: A multiplayer RTS game where you are dealt cards every 60 seconds, and you use strategy to place cards, and command your units to create and grow a powerful empire to defeat your foes!

details.title: I’m A Food Delivery Guy
details.short_description: 送外卖，攒彩礼，目标 18 万 8！“想娶我女儿，彩礼必须 18 万 8，一分都不能少！”，丈母娘的一句话，让你决定离开电子厂，开始全职送外卖，努力奋斗，只为攒够彩礼，迎娶你的心上人。

details.title: Whale Simulator
details.short_description: A livestream management sim. Lead your streamers all the way up — numbers climbing — until they stand on the national-champion stage. You're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot.

details.title: Backrooms: Emergency Exit
details.short_description: Backrooms: Emergency Exit is an Online-Coop Horror experience for 1–4 players. Survive in the face of horrifying entities and dangerous hazards. Uncover the mysteries and secrets hidden deep within the Backrooms to find the exit. And most importantly: Stay alive.

details.title: DDD: Deep Dungeon Descent
details.short_description: A top-down precision platformer in 1-bit pixel art. Your jump is your everything — weapon, escape, and only tool. Descend 100 floors of spikes, crumbling ground and enemies. Die, restart the floor instantly, race the clock.

details.title: Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions
details.short_description: The immortal path begins in Qi Refinement. In this desktop idle RPG, up to three cultivators battle on their own. Choose their techniques, forge equipment, and open the chests won along the way. Gather cultivation and prepare for the next breakthrough.

details.title: Hemolysis
details.short_description: 《Hemolysis》 is an idle game with a distinctive flair. As you awaken, a strange plague has already ravaged this crumbling land—and continues to gnaw at it still. Driven by hunger and hopelessness, you must venture again into this world, at once known and alien, to find any means of staying alive.

details.title: Aegis Vanguard
details.short_description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

details.title: ViRtual Mass Human
details.short_description: ViRtual Mass Human is a VR sandbox where you can interact with AI-powered characters that respond naturally and build your own worlds. Experience the feeling of characters truly being there. Freely place objects and create your own unique VR experiences.

details.title: Isle of Cards
details.short_description: Isle of Cards is a strategy deckbuilder where you build up your island by playing cards. Draw cards and place tiles to level up your island before time runs out. Create unique decks by unlocking new cards and completing challenges.

details.title: Stack & Spell
details.short_description: A cozy magical tidy-up game about collecting, identifying, and organizing enchanted cards. Learn their secrets, master the archive's classification system, and turn magical chaos into perfect order.

details.title: Offering Accepted
details.short_description: You signed her contract. Now you press the button, forever. Every press fills the bar, every full bar drops chests, every chest spills cursed relics, and every relic makes the next press worth more. Fair trade?

details.title: Golden Trivia Show
details.short_description: Enter a quiz show solo or with friends. Divide your gold bars among the possible answers; those placed on a wrong answer will fall into a piranha pool. Will you make it to the end?

details.title: Wyrdtide
details.short_description: Sail your longship into the horde. A viking survival roguelite for 1–4 players: hold the helm while your crew fights on its own, raid island villages for new hands, carve runes as you level, and fell the warden that guards each sea's gate.

details.title: SCREW IT!
details.short_description: SCREW IT! is a 4–8 player voice party game set inside a chaotic retro TV show. Outbid your friends, call their bluffs, prove your claims on the mic, survive ridiculous penalties, and compete in arcade challenges to become the night's champion.

details.title: Rox Solid Pro Football
details.short_description: Choose your role (Owner, General Manager, Head Coach, Off/Def/ST Coordinator, or Position Coach), choose what you want to control (24 different settings across Scouting, Coaching, Front Office, and Game Management groupings), and play as many seasons as you want.

details.title: EverPet
details.short_description: Get up to mischief with your finite friend. Care or consequence? It's your choice!

details.title: Beefarunna
details.short_description: The alien invasion has subsided, and Ash has to get off the couch to buy some groceries. Unfortunately, the El Camino broke down on the way to the MeggaMart. Run, jump, and slide your way to a complete cowbell collection in Beefrunna (or: Super Beefarena).

details.title: Board Dynasty
details.short_description: Buy properties and collect rent. Choose a mode before each match. In Weather, send asteroids at a rival’s hotel. In Flip Side, turn the board over to swap property values. Play solo, share one PC with up to four players, or play online in supported modes.

name: The Otherworld Book of Destiny: Chaos Era

details.title: The Otherworld Book of Destiny: Chaos Era
details.short_description: An open-world life-simulation RPG set in the “Age of Turmoil.” Start as a nobody and roam the Five Realms—trading, taming pets, hunting treasure, and stealing. Master nearly 10,000 martial arts, choose one of seven paths, and forge your legend among historical and mythical heroes.

details.title: SpellSimmer
details.short_description: SpellSimmer is a cozy fantasy cooking game where customers hide what they want behind clues. Decode their requests, combine ingredient properties, cook the right dishes, shape a light or dark reputation, and build your kitchen through talents, helpers, and upgrades.

details.title: CUT AND DICE
details.short_description: CUT AND DICE is a grim indie game with dark humor, where a single dice roll costs you a finger. You and your opponent sit at the table. Roll the dice. Whoever gets the lower number loses a finger. Perks help, but they can't buy luck. Enemies get tougher. Lose — start over. Feeling lucky?

details.title: Sweet Saviour
details.short_description: A single player turn-based RPG that focuses on candy hero's that fight their way through the worlds growing corruption. The game includes mechanics such as permanent character loss and card collecting where you will fight enemies through linear levels.

details.title: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder
details.short_description: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder is a martial arts roguelite deckbuilder with Chinese-style cosmic horror. Choose from five schools, battle through unfolding events, and build with 300+ cards and 57 traits. Face the final enemy shaped by your choices, and uncover the truth of reincarnation.

details.title: Voodoo You Chasing?
details.short_description: Voodoo You Chasing? is a freeze tag game but someone brought magic and bad decision-making. Play as a Wizard: collect glyphs to complete the ritual. Or be the Voodoo Hunter: capture them all to protect your mojo.

details.title: One duck too many
details.short_description: A tiny bathtub sits on top of your taskbar with one duck in it. Its bubbles hatch more ducks, those ducks hatch more, and soon they spill over the rim and wander across your desktop. A desktop companion with 30 ducks to discover, born from the water's temperature, the night and each other.

details.title: Mana League
details.short_description: Fast 7v7 fantasy football with dwarves, orcs, goblins and a lot more. Curl it, chip it or fire a Zigzag Bolt past the keeper. Cast Team Spells, dodge mine carts and play with up to 4 friends on couch co-op or online.

details.title: Brackets & Banners
details.short_description: Build your college basketball legacy. Recruit players, shape your roster, and chase tournament runs in a fictional coaching career sim. Make the calls yourself or delegate to your staff as each season adds new players, stories, and banners to your program's history.

details.title: 人生档案：千禧
details.short_description: Return to 2000 with your memories of the future. In this business-life sandbox spanning 2000–2025, act on your knowledge of the era: invest, start a company or negotiate a stake in someone else’s. Then decide what that money is for. A bigger business? A different life?

details.title: BombCase
details.short_description: Two agents. One table. A row of briefcases - and one of them is a bomb. Listen, scan, bluff and sabotage your way through a 24-mission Cold War campaign of turn-based deduction, then take the seat against a real opponent online. Open the wrong case and it's over.

details.title: Coral Pastoral
details.short_description: This is a desktop companion game set in the ocean, featuring small fish and sea deities from various civilizations. It combines idle gameplay with light card and incremental mechanics. Use coral skills to create your own beautiful underwater world. By the way, the ocean deities will protect you!

details.title: Tactical Terry
details.short_description: Terry has a crime problem. Six ridiculous crews have taken over town, and Terry P.D. has a rookie, a coffee machine and a budget the council keeps cutting. Breach, clear and cuff your way through a 1–4 player co-op tactical shooter that takes the shooting seriously and nothing else.

details.title: Jane Doe: Cold Case Division
details.short_description: An asymmetric co-op deduction game where you solve cold cases through communication. One player investigates, while the other plays the forensic artist reconstructing the victim's face. Features lite roguelite progression.

details.title: Next, Million Worlds
details.short_description: Expand your civilization to an empire of a million worlds. Balance production and logistics, experiment with economy mods, but don't sweat it. This is the age of expansion; growth is inevitable. This is a relaxed incremental experience where you can optimize and experiment, but you can't lose.

details.title: Diviper
details.short_description: A snake game where your tail is a math puzzle. Scoop up numbers, line them up, and watch matching ones merge — 2, 4, 8, 16, boom. Stuck? Just divide your way out. (Your mermaid buddy will help ;P )

details.title: Wuxing Realm
details.short_description: A five-element strategic idle game. Build teams from Warriors, Equipment, and Spells — kick back with auto-battles or take command and cast spells mid-fight. The right combo unleashes power beyond the numbers. What's your strongest lineup?

details.title: Upstart Tycoon
details.short_description: An incremental tycoon about getting rich in a crooked city. Play as a thief, a dirty cop, a 9–5 worker or a suburban teen, and climb from nobody to the person Port Vesper can't function without. Every run, the city you left behind has changed.

details.title: Seconds to Midnight: Definitive Edition
details.short_description: Infiltrate guarded facilities in a retro espionage stealth game with classic Resident Evil style fixed camera angles. Avoid cameras, outsmart patrols, hack restricted systems, and complete your mission without being seen. You have no weapons. One mistake ends it all. Will you do it?

details.title: SCRUBBED
details.short_description: Grab your sponge and sink into an endless pile of dirty dishes. Scrub, foam and rinse at your own pace, earn tips, upgrade your gear and find your zen, one plate at a time.

details.title: RepCell
details.short_description: What if attention became the most valuable thing in society? And everyone who lost it was sent to a container suspended above the ocean until they became visible again?

details.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 4
details.short_description: Slide, paint, and outsmart every level in this new installment of a vibrant ninja-themed puzzle-platformer!

details.title: Final Kastle
details.short_description: Orc hordes march on your castle wave after wave. Man the cannons, call down lightning, freeze the field and fight on the walls, alone or with up to 16 players online, in a third-person castle defense shooter with a living castle to explore.

details.title: Alchemist's Codex
details.short_description: Run a small alchemy shop and discover recipes by experiment. Grind, boil, distill and brew real ingredient properties, not fixed recipes. Take commissions, buy from the merchant, gather in your yard, and fill your Codex on the way to becoming a master alchemist.

details.title: Arcana Clash
details.short_description: A 2–6 player tarot card battler. Each of the 78 cards has two faces — upright and reversed — and you choose which one to unleash every time you play. Strike, curse, or turn the whole table upside down, and outlast your rivals before the Clock of Fate swallows everyone.

details.title: SARUR
details.short_description: SARUR is a single-player action adventure in a royal steampunk city above the clouds. Find out what happened.

details.title: 万仙
details.short_description: 开局即挂机，招募弟子、炼丹炼器、闯秘境占世界——一款桌面修仙放置网游。

details.title: Pinball Bonanza Live
details.short_description: Run a live stream from your garage and build a seven-floor pinball machine with your viewers’ donations. Flip, nudge and chase multiball while chat cheers you on — then automate it all in a hands-on incremental pinball game.

details.title: Grain Master
details.short_description: Enjoy a relaxing ASMR sorting experience in Grain Master! Sort grains one by one using chopsticks, upgrade your tools, improve your speed, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and enjoyment.

name: サッカークラブ運営をやろう！

details.title: サッカークラブ運営をやろう！
details.short_description: 監督になって草サッカーリーグからワールドリーグの頂点を目指すサッカークラブ運営シミュレーション。練習を選び、メンバーと作戦を決めたら、あとは選手たちを信じて見守ろう！

details.title: Paint The Wall
details.short_description: 400 meters of bare concrete. Out you go! Paint the Wall is a satisfying painting sim where the higher you climb, the more you earn. Upgrade to paint cannons and hot air balloons, hire robots and drones, and paint it all, solo or with friends. That wall won't paint itself!

details.title: The Garden of Forgotten Blooms
details.short_description: A watercolor gothic idle RPG. Build a party of 42 flower-named companions, enjoy automatic battles and offline rewards, and explore a 15-chapter story. Japanese and Chinese character voices. No microtransactions.

details.title: Neon Turf
details.short_description: A cyberpunk auto-battler where you buy buildings, not units. Build noodle bars, clubs and clinics. They earn cash each round, and some send fighters to battle rival gangs. Buying the same building multiple times levels it up. Clubs draw police attention, which results in police raids on your base.

details.title: SEA CATCH
details.short_description: Look, think, catch! SEA CATCH is a cute, fast-paced ocean puzzle game where shapes and colors hold the key. Make quick choices, build combos in the 60-second challenge, beat your best score, and unlock 10 adorable Sea Friends!

details.title: Carry Crew
details.short_description: “We can fit one more!” Pick your cargo, stack it high, and grab opposite ends of the board in this physics-based co-op delivery game for two. Take tight turns together and count down to each jump. The finish line is in sight, and the top box just started to slide.

details.title: Maiden Taskbar
details.short_description: A little adventure begins at the bottom of your screen. Keep this idle RPG running above your taskbar and build a squad of maidens from 100+ cards across five races.

details.title: Catnip Wars : Labyrinth
details.short_description: Drop into a Necronazi labyrinth with up to three friends, or a squad of Catbot companions. Your weapons fire on their own: you steer, dodge and pick upgrades. Fight to the stairs at the centre of every floor, twenty floors down, before the Oberst comes for you. Then keep going.

details.title: I, TANK
details.short_description: The machines have taken over the world. Blast them all with WW2-era tanks and take back our cities, with heavy metal playing in the Background. A stylized survivors-like with interesting mechanics. Play with historic tanks such as the T-34 or the Tiger 1, or make your own tank in the workshop.

details.title: Jungle Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the wild jungle in this pixel-art action survival adventure! Battle deadly creatures, unlock powerful abilities, command animal companions and defeat colossal bosses across five unique chapters. Gather the cure and save your village!

details.title: Bubble Tea Simulator
details.short_description: Run a cozy little bubble tea café with up to six friends. Cook the pearls, shake the drinks and keep the queue smiling, then close up, pile into bed and wake up ready to open your next branch. Play solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Bottom Feeders: Crab Crew
details.short_description: Haul up crab pots with 1–6 friends in this silly co-op crabbing game. Throw pots off the pier, pull up 37 kinds of ridiculous crabs, sell them, and trade your leaky rowboat for a solid gold yacht. Or just shove your crew into the sea.

details.title: 武侠奶瓦的青春冒险
details.short_description: One milk frog. Five roommates. One cyber-wuxia city. A short comedy visual novel about rent, assassination attempts, and the most chaotic shared apartment in Jiangcheng. 12 endings. Chinese & English.

details.title: Grandma's Button Shop
details.short_description: Grandma's button shop has gotten out of hand. Pick up the buttons scattered across her cozy old house and sort each one into its own labelled drawer, tray, tin or card. Unlock skills that light up, gather and auto-place buttons, and try your luck at the plinko board.

details.title: GLIMWARD
details.short_description: A day-and-night tower defense. By day, build inside your light; by night, thousands of shadow creatures surge toward the sun core from every side. Shape your tower layout, alternate red, green and blue light to trigger spectral reactions, and hold the last light.

details.title: Drug Shop: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Talwer and Pesse finally went legit, but their shop is a disaster. A first-person sorting game for 1 to 4 players: put thousands of products on the right shelves, cook in the lab and stock the store, alone or in online co-op.

details.title: 迷途远征队
details.short_description: Choose from six classes in a co-op action roguelite. Play solo with AI companions or team up with a friend on the same screen. Pick routes, build your character, and face bosses across three regions. Automatic attacks give you room to dodge, use skills, and rescue allies.

details.title: Hero Sling
details.short_description: Pull back the slingshot and launch your mounted hero into the sky! Slash monsters mid-flight, slam down for combos and smash giant bosses. Collect 60 mounts, master 6 classes and fly farther every run.

details.title: Sink My Heart
details.short_description: She matched with you on a dating app and brought you back to a roadside motel. Now she wants to play a game. On the board, the pieces are your organs, and every part she hits is an ability you lose. "It's just a game," she says. A one-night horror board game.

details.title: Night of the Yokai
details.short_description: Leap through barrages of yokai attacks in a single-player 2D action roguelite inspired by Japanese woodblock prints. Choose one of four fighters, combine skills and equipment, and take on waves of spirits and towering bosses.

details.title: Steal de Janeiro
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game about petty theft in a made-up corner of early-2000s Rio de Janeiro. Pick pockets, strip parked cars at night, shake off the guards and flip the loot online at Tico's lan house. Every heist pays for the next upgrade.

details.title: Infinite Bookshelf
details.short_description: Sort colorful books and watch flowers bloom in this cozy 3D puzzle game. Drag books into matching shelf compartments, use your tray to plan each move, and bring order to a tropical library with procedurally generated layouts.

details.title: Snowman Left Behind
details.short_description: A cozy team snowball fight for up to eight friends. Build a snow fort, pelt the other team until they're snowmen, then hurry over to rescue your frozen friends. Twelve wintry maps, each with its own trick: sleds, toy trains, catapults, sheep and Grandma's cookies.

details.title: BLACKSITE SHIFT
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game for solo play or online co-op with up to four players. Memorize the rooms of an underground facility, spot changes, and report anomalies. Survive seven night shifts—some anomalies can kill you.

name: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon

details.title: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a delivery empire in a single-player open-world simulation. Deliver parcels, negotiate with residents, expand your fleet, build a home and manage your own cargo branch. Buy properties, collect rent and defend your business from the Patron’s men.

details.title: Santa's Sweatshop
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game set in Santa's warehouse. Wrap gifts, load the conveyor belt and meet a daily quota that grows every day. Earn cookies to buy upgrades, expand the warehouse and hire elves to help you.

details.title: Dead Or Drawn
details.short_description: A Wild West party game of drawing, describing and bluffing for 3–6 players. The narrator secretly sees a suspect and describes it out loud while everyone sketches it on a WANTED poster. The posters go up on the board, anonymous. Can you spot the narrator's drawing?

details.title: Break Reality
details.short_description: Break Reality is a small-scale multiplayer first-person shooter made by a solo developer. The maps are built tight, so contact is constant. No vehicles. No sliding, just boots, ground and gunfire.

details.title: Lords, Land & Levy
details.short_description: Build a living medieval village, defend its walls in real time, then march out to lead the assault yourself. Marry, scheme and make war across a realm of rival lords, rise from village lord to king, and hold the west against the Great Khan.

details.title: Accordspire
details.short_description: Rebuild a ruined fortress and defend its Core against the Horde. By day, gather, build and forge alliances with Humans, Dwarves and Elves. At sunset the bell tolls and the siege begins. Play solo or in co-op for up to 3 players.

details.title: Parts Survivor
details.short_description: A top-down survival shooter roguelike built from scrap. Dodge the swarm, let your guns fire themselves, and craft gears, pipes and springs into new weapons between waves. Open crates, stack modifiers, survive 20 waves and the final boss.

details.title: Kill the Kings
details.short_description: The ultimate chess roguelike is here! Kill the Kings combines deck building roguelike games with the tactics of chess. Deploy pieces from your hand, chain banners, tomes, contracts and fiefs into wild synergies, and take down the Kings of 12 comics, each with its own rules.

details.title: 검 강화하기
details.short_description: Hammer a rusty dagger into a legendary blade. Every press of the forge can succeed, fail or shatter your sword. Evolve 119 swords across elemental lines, sell high and reinvest, then take your blade into real-time 1v1 duels and race tournaments against other players.

details.title: ODD EXIT
details.short_description: Snow outside, a TV hissing in the living room, and the same hallway waiting beyond the exit door. ODD EXIT is a first-person horror game set in an apartment from the ’90s. If everything looks normal, head for the exit. If you spot an anomaly, turn back to the entrance.

details.title: Tidy Up the Cars Together
details.short_description: Rebuild 15 classic cars in a cozy first-person workshop, solo or in online co-op. Hammer rusty frames back into shape, hunt down 1,830 scattered parts and carry each one to the car it belongs to. Take your time. That last missing door is in here somewhere.

details.title: Carpet Forge
details.short_description: Build your deck, deploy wooden toy vehicles, and bolt on a variety of weapons and utility modules in this roguelike top-down turn-based tactics and deckbuilding game. Draft units, weapons or effects and outsmart the creepy, broken plastic nightmare toys!

details.title: Realm Lords
details.short_description: A spiritual successor to classic medieval strategy games, combining turn-based kingdom management with real-time tactical battles. Work the land, trade resources, build castles, and lead armies to unite a divided realm.

details.title: Firebase Zero
details.short_description: The Breaches are open. The Hive is coming through, flying the war machines of the last race it found. Make your sniper, pick their squad and their perks, and fight sector by sector until you reach the Hive Heart. An action-idle game you can play your way.

details.title: Geargrave Rigrunners
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder on wheels. Lead a convoy down three faction-owned roads. Every vehicle in your column brings its own cards, every wreck takes them away, and any enemy you cripple can be boarded and driven home. Build your deck, build your fleet, deliver the cargo.

details.title: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Together!
details.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game for 1-4 elves. The party wrecked Santa's workshop on Christmas Eve: sort thousands of toys, baubles and presents back onto the right shelves, solo or in online co-op. No timer, no way to lose, and when a room is spotless, every Christmas light comes on.

details.title: Tiny Winter Market
details.short_description: Build and decorate your own cozy Christmas market in a charming pixel-art winter village! Welcome visitors, manage festive stalls, help Santa deliver presents, discover hidden surprises, and enjoy the magic of Christmas in Tiny Winter Market.

details.title: Industry Keeper
details.short_description: Tower defense + Factory simulator. The rift has opened and its horde marches on your wall. Build towers to hold the line, and a factory settlement behind it to feed them: mine, haul and craft on conveyors, raise your Palace, cast spells and face the guardians of the rift.

details.title: Puzzle Programmer
details.short_description: Solve logic puzzles by hand, then build routines to solve them for you. Nineteen puzzle types, a daily puzzle, par scores to beat, and a Workshop for inventing puzzle types of your own.

details.title: TORCH & TRIGGER
details.short_description: A sci-fi military novel set in "Plantation." Soldier Jin is ordered to play the role of a temporary family with a girl and a child. He recalls human warmth, but dark secrets stir——.

details.title: Neural Goblins
details.short_description: Explore a one-of-a-kind fantasy 3D brain world built with Gaussian Splatting—messy, noisy and lost in fog. Pick a goal, pilot a Brain Bubble Jellyfish through 11 mind caves, find five Neural Goblins, tackle bizarre minigames and build your own nest. What the hell are they up to?

details.title: Island Raiders
details.short_description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

details.title: Lost Land
details.short_description: Survival on a mysterious island, Hunting, fishing, farming, enjoying a free life

details.title: Dig to the Core
details.short_description: A pixel-art incremental mining game where you dig through one planet after another. Every planet has its own mining style, skill-tree upgrades, and collectibles. Buy the game once to explore multiple planets—and mine on three planets at the same time.

details.title: Slay Sean, Save The World!
details.short_description: A comic-book auto-battler where the Greek gods brawl. Draft your pantheon, fuse skills into game-breaking combos, and crush real players' ghost armies to climb from Mortal to Olympian. Rebuild your board every round. Then slay Sean and save the world.

name: End of the Sea, Last Summer:Monochrome Iris

details.title: End of the Sea, Last Summer:Monochrome Iris
details.short_description: A one-summer story about a young painter and a genius biologist girl. As the world loses its colors, he sets out to paint his final masterpiece.A fully voiced short visual novel.

details.title: Stray Light
details.short_description: What the eye sees is a prison.” Lost in a cursed forest, ancient streetlights are your only escape. Shift seamlessly between a grim reality and beautiful memories to eliminate obstacles and solve dual-world puzzles. Remember: what blocks you here might not exist on the other side.

details.title: Galvanize Simulator
details.short_description: Manage a hot-dip galvanizing plant. Bid steel contracts, staff the pickle line and kettle, and run overhead cranes—auto or by hand. Upgrade plant equipment, optimize racks, expand your line, and ship coated loads on time without burning zinc or customers.

details.title: JOVA
details.short_description: A cozy, bright cascade puzzler. Line up three or more Jovials to clear them, chain the cascades, then bank the meter to trigger HYPER for ultra combos! Play cozy solo across two modes and a 50-level ladder, or go head-to-head in local or online versus against a friend or one of your 10 AI rivals.

details.title: White Hound
details.short_description: Run WHITE HOUND from a living guild office in the Free City of Azalea. Hire heroes, choose quests from the board, watch parties march a miniature quest map, pay salaries, fight Guild Wars, and chase fame in the Gazette... without leaving your desk of course!!!

details.title: Death to Demons
details.short_description: You are a Necromancer, use your powers to raise the dead in this dark fantasy roguelite auto-battler. Build an undead army, evolve minions, choose powerful upgrades, and fight through waves of demons to break the gates of Hell and free the lands of Vaelthorron.

details.title: Duck Duck Gone
details.short_description: Hide a rubber duck in plain sight, then hunt down everyone else’s in this chaotic online party game for up to 8 players. Paint it, resize it, fool your friends and pray the reveal camera is kind.

details.title: Cursor Survivors
details.short_description: Your friend's "harmless" prank virus mutated and hijacked your PC! Luckily, your AI assistant is ready. Command an evolving fleet of cursors in this bullet-heaven roguelite. Purge swarms of mutating malware, stack game-breaking upgrades, and reclaim your system!

details.title: Vanguard Monsters
