details.short_description: Vanguard Monsters is a run-based creature raising roguelike autobattler. Hatch a team, evolve them to more powerful forms, and collect gear to defeat the endless forces of the encroaching void.

name: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable

details.title: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable
details.short_description: Bansing is a 3D healing-style companion game deeply integrated with AI. There are no fixed scripted characters; players can create a friend or family member who understands their preferences and habits, always by their side.
developers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司
publishers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司

details.title: Blame Echoes
details.short_description: Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological horror under a frozen planet in alien ruins. Playing as pilot Adam Lorn, you explore a forgotten complex for your missing wife while facing a presence that somehow already knows you.

name: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计

details.title: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计
details.short_description: In a parallel universe text-based dialogue adventure game, a brand-new Three Kingdoms era is constructed. Players can freely choose to play as classic warriors, and each dialogue choice will lead to distinct and surprising events.

details.title: Nexaris: Starweb Dominion
details.short_description: Lead a living star network in this real-time 3D sci-fi strategy game. Expand from one stellar core, link orbital nodes, secure resources, and launch coordinated assaults as every connection reshapes your economy, defenses, and territorial control.

details.title: Crack the Stone
details.short_description: Minimalist desktop idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Upgrade the water flow from a single drop to a steady stream and keep wearing the stone down. Someday it will crack. Patience always wins.

details.title: Glooky: Cursors in the City
details.short_description: In this co-op adventure game, play as cursors able to take control of various hosts in the decrepit city of Glooky. Make your way through puzzles, discover picturesque neighbourhoods and their peculiar inhabitants, and uncover the secret behind the sprawling metropolis…

details.title: Christmas Inc
details.short_description: Build a toy factory in this first-person incremental game. Place machines, run conveyor belts to delivery, cash in and upgrade. Unlock 20 presents, prestige for Stars and deck the halls.

details.title: Hungry Hungry Human
details.short_description: A chaotic supermarket social deduction game where one player is secretly eating the products while everyone else works, watches, searches, and votes to catch them.

details.title: Nuts & Bolts
details.short_description: An action-horror game where you fight off against various robots as part of your job. Time your attacks properly, chain together combos, flee when necessary, and complete your mission.

details.title: Unwanted Guest VR
details.short_description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person escape horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

details.title: Escape from Track 7
details.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

details.title: DON'T MAKE A SOUND
details.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a first-person FMV interactive AVG survival horror game. Explore an infected city as Alex, search for your daughter, investigate clues, solve simple puzzles, and make critical choices. Eyeless creatures hunt by sound—one wrong move can lead to a deadly Bad Ending.
developers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.
publishers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

details.title: Ember Camp Knight
details.short_description: Descend into a dungeon no one built for you. Fast, punchy pixel action in 5–10 minute bites — fight down through four themed floors, rest at a strange campfire, and meet the girl who tends it. Why does this dungeon exist? The answer waits at the bottom.

details.title: Pouring Pints
details.short_description: Run your dream pub, solo or with up to 4 friends. Pour pints, sling snacks, and keep the customers happy as service descends into chaos. Dive bar, sports bar, or village pub. Build and decorate it your way with new ways to play every run. How long can you keep the doors open?

name: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?

details.title: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?
details.short_description: A cat cultivation, sect management, and ARPG loot game. Train feline disciples, send them into secluded cultivation, breed kittens that inherit stronger talents and looks, then enter dungeons to fight, loot gear, farm skill stones, build skills, and challenge higher-realm foes.

details.title: ELEMENTORS
details.short_description: Merge-autobattler where every unit fights on two synergy fronts at once. Forge your own d12 of elements, roll it every round, and fuse with creatures. 13 types × 13 elements. Every element you apply is permanent — choose wisely.

details.title: Rush To Hell: Abyss
details.short_description: Rush To Hell: Abyss is a fast-paced precision platformer focused on pure gameplay. Dodge deadly traps, defeat relentless enemies, and challenge massive infernal bosses as you descend deeper into a hostile world. Descend. Die. Learn. Repeat.

details.title: Roomy
details.short_description: Make a tiny 3D room that is your link in bio. Fill it with furniture, put a link on anything in it, like your YouTube on the TV, and share it anywhere. Visits, knocks and tips show up as they happen, and new things turn up while it's open. Free.

details.title: Final Commit
details.short_description: `Final Commit` is a top-down roguelite survival action game where you swap between two characters. Combine traits, change classes, and unleash Sync Drives to complete your build and reach the ending of an unfinished game world.

details.title: Cyber Wukong
details.short_description: Cyber Wukong is an exhilarating Roguelite action game! Here, immortal arts are black tech, and magical treasures are cybernetic creations. Enter a twisted West world of data, steel, and incense. Forge your combat style and face the mechanical Buddha, chanting scriptures and wielding a gun

details.title: Road Tycoon
details.short_description: Road Tycoon is an idle incremental racing game with custom-built tracks, prestige layers, and vehicle ascensions. Build the perfect track, let your cars race, and push your numbers into infinity.

details.title: Gunfire & Magic - Desktop Co-op Extraction!
details.short_description: A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends! In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your camp, and uncover your origins!

details.title: Grand Vista Hotel
details.short_description: Build and manage a growing hotel. Earn stars, upgrade rooms and elevators, add restaurants, spas, conferences and events, and transform a small family hotel into a luxury Palace.

details.title: AstroBoost
details.short_description: Fast-paced side-scrolling arcade action. Tap to jump, hold to boost, destroy obstacles, and survive the dangers of deep space.

details.title: Rift Crashers
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op bullet-heaven survivor. Pick from 8 characters, stack 18 weapons, and fight through 5 dark fantasy biomes before crashing the Rift itself. Build broken loadouts, survive escalating chaos, and take on a multi-boss gauntlet finale.

details.title: Cube Duty
details.short_description: Cube Duty is a Cube-Powered City Builder where every throw shapes your kingdom. Every cube can become a building, resource or unit. Grow intricate production chains, recruit powerful armies, and defend your Castle against waves of enemies and epic bosses!

details.title: Stardust Protocol
details.short_description: Blast through bullet hell in a sci-fi roguelite shooter. Chart a branching star map, combine scatter shots, missiles, homing fire and lasers, and build your arsenal with upgrades and items. Weigh risks at black markets and unknown events. Face colossal mechanical bosses. Play the free demo.

details.title: 100 Fairyland Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Songkran Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Vendor Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Folder Folder Folder
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

details.title: 2in1
details.short_description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

details.title: Champion Trainer
details.short_description: The next level of horse racing sims. Genuine Thoroughbred lineages spanning over 300 years, 30 real UK/IRE courses featuring full race calendars, online head to heads, Mendelian and polygenic inheritance, Chef-de-Race dosage, Bruce Lowe families, nicks built from real-world race records... and more.

details.title: CartWare
details.short_description: An incremental game where you go from a single-product online store up to global e-commerce domination. Manage your inventory, fulfill and ship customer orders, deal with suppliers, and expand your storefront across a retro desktop operating system, and become the world's #1 online retailer.

name: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game

details.title: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game
details.short_description: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game is an active incremental game where you cast your line, reel in the big catches, and build your fortune one fish at a time.

details.title: Zone Rush: Floating Medieval Hamlet
details.short_description: A knight robbed of her floating home, left with only a sword. Capture Zones for more time, combo through Vikings, and topple the Fire Golems guarding them. Fall, and you lose score and drop to level 1. A fast-paced single-player action game: race across a multi-level village and beat your best.

details.title: Final Armada
details.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

name: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター

details.title: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター
details.short_description: Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike where you build the board itself as your deck and aim for each stage's target score. Customize pieces, collect Relics from bosses, and find powerful combinations to overcome ever-tougher goals!

details.title: Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch
details.short_description: Summon a spirit beast, raise it week by week, and take it up the tournament cups. It has a mind of its own, and every choice shapes how long you get together. A monster-raising sim drawn from Chinese myth. Free demo out now.

details.title: Blades and Hunger
details.short_description: A dark-fantasy text-based rpg with a detailed combat model built to simulate decision making in fencing, and a world delivered entirely in prose.

details.title: Verdict
details.short_description: Trapped in a high-stakes interrogation room, you must defend your innocence against an adaptive AI detective. Every answer is evaluated in real time—watch your words, because your own claims can convict you.

details.title: Evil Among Shadows: Hollow Creek
details.short_description: After Kevin's disappearance, Sam stays with her aunt and uncle to support them after the loss of their son. She and her friend Anthony soon stumble down the same rabbit hole as her cousin did, growing increasingly obsessed with proving there is a serial killer lurking in Hollow Creek.

details.title: Toast Cat: Scratch & Win
details.short_description: Raise a Toast Cat on your desktop that spits out all sorts of scratch cards. Whatever you're doing, it hops along with you; once it's earned enough affection, it'll pull out a scratch card just for you. No need to watch it constantly — scratch one in a spare moment and unwind.

details.title: Redraft FC
details.short_description: A football management game about hindsight. Inherit a real club exactly as it was, tear the squad up, and sign the players you now know were going to be great - at what they cost then. Play it forward season by season. Seven ways to play, from managing a club to being a pundit.

details.title: BROODHOUSE
details.short_description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. Push past carrying capacity and the overflow turns feral in your hands. A roguelike deckbuilder about a colony that grows faster than you can hold it.

details.title: Wheel Street
details.short_description: Wheel Street is a roguelike deckbuilder on a circular board. Move and merge assets, combine strategy cards, and build a money-making machine. Grow on down days, cash in on up days, and unleash combos to beat rising weekly targets.

details.title: ねこっとラーメン
details.short_description: 異世界に転生したあなたが得たスキルは「カップラーメンを出す」！？猫の獣人たちが暮らす世界で出会った女の子・ユズと、成り行きで始めたお店を営業する調理シミュレーション。注文に合う商品を選び、かやくやスープを入れ、お湯の量と待ち時間を見極めて一杯を仕上げましょう。複数のお客さんを同時に迎え、それぞれの調理時間と待ち時間を管理。日ごとに変わる注文傾向や制限を乗り越えた先で、物語は複数の結末へ分岐します。

details.title: Keep The Circle Alive
details.short_description: An incremental game about protecting a tiny circle. Destroy endless waves of enemies, earn resources, stack upgrades, watch the numbers climb, and turn your circle into an unstoppable machine.

details.title: Mow The Planet
details.short_description: Start on Mum's back lawn and keep going: the street, the city, the planet, then the Moon, Mars and every world after that. Mow ground that stays mowed, bolt ridiculous kits onto one growing machine, and run a mowing company big enough to stripe the solar system.

details.title: Re+pray Signals: Echoes Still Wait
details.short_description: You are the only one connected to a child trapped in a closed-off world. Speaking becomes the key; listening becomes hope. A conversational adventure where the words you exchange help unravel its mysteries. #RepraySignals

details.title: Hist Maker: ReMake
details.short_description: A world history you can play. Combine people, events and ideas (Emperor Napoleon + Britain = Trafalgar) to rebuild 69 eras, from antiquity to the early 20th century. Every discovery fills in the era's panorama. Build your own levels with mods, history or not, and share them on the Workshop.

details.title: Dead Bet
details.short_description: Dead Bet is a card-based roguelite set in a deadly show. Study fighters, uncover their secrets, and use cards to influence their chances. A wrong prediction can cost a family member their life. You decide who pays.

details.title: Just Dots
details.short_description: The classic pen-and-paper game of Dots — place dots, close the loop around your opponent's, claim territory — now against a neural network that taught itself from scratch and beats its own creator. Grow from beginner to master. Any board size, local 2-player.

details.title: Edenfinity
details.short_description: Edenfinity is a relaxing incremental colony game where you guide Adam and Eve as they build a new civilization in Eden. Gather resources, sell your surplus, craft bricks, construct houses, and unlock upgrades.

details.title: Catacrawl
details.short_description: A fast action roguelike about a cat and a horde that never stops. Your skills fire where you aim, and a run is ten to fourteen minutes with two bosses. Three cats, nine skill trees, generated maps, quests, loot with uniques - and permanent progress, so every death still gets you somewhere.

details.title: Honey, Tidy the Basement
details.short_description: Honey, Tidy the Basement! is a cozy organization simulator where an earthquake has knocked over 2,880 console games all over your basement. Pick up each game case, sort them by console, and return them to their correct shelf as you unlock handy abilities to speed up your organizing.

details.title: M.A.M.M.O.N.
details.short_description: MAMMON is a co-op physics-based multiplayer action game where you and your fellow demons descend into Hell to find valuables, smash them to pieces, absorb the gold they leave behind, and bring your haul to the submission point before it's too late.

name: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm

details.title: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm
details.short_description: Powered by offline local AI, this Three Kingdoms dialogue simulator lets you roleplay as Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang and Guan Yu. Relive six classic scenes and reshape history through free, flexible conversations.

details.title: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi escape adventure. Freeze robots, ignite fuel, and throw objects at enemies while solving escape-room puzzles. In the full game, build and playtest your own rooms, then share them as level files.

details.title: 紀事盆栽 Potted Archive
details.short_description: Potted Archive is an idle desktop companion blending sci-fi storytelling with plant cultivation. Grow over 20 exotic plants in a transparent, low-energy window. As they evolve, unlock diary entries to uncover an epic tale of interstellar exile right from your screen.

details.title: KILLWORLD
details.short_description: [KILLWORLD] is an open-world first-person shooter. Explore the territory, raid enemy outposts, battle armed patrols, use vehicles, discover secret locations, and choose your own combat style in a sandbox where freedom of action and dynamic gameplay are paramount.

details.title: Feast for Frogs
details.short_description: Leap into this incremental game about frogs with strange abilities. Upgrade your abilities, get more powerful frogs, and eat more bugs!

details.title: Melody Teacher
details.short_description: Melody Teacher is a cozy hidden object & rhythm game. Explore relaxing scenes, collect hidden musicians, and play their melodies to build the soundtrack one layer at a time.

details.title: Mio: Resonance
details.short_description: Talk in real time with AI characters who remember you. Customize their personality, appearance, and voice, then keep your unique companion by your side in desktop companion mode.

details.title: Pilipka
details.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure based on Belarusian mythology and folklore. Pilipka just wanted to finish his shift at karchma and come home for dinner. And then so much happened that now he has to go on a trip to get Fern Flower in the company of his friend, a talking mouse.

details.title: Debts & Jackpots
details.short_description: Start broke, crack safes, chase jackpots, and build your fortune. Upgrade your operation, hunt for rare treasures, and fight your way out of crushing debt!

name: The Shaman: What's in Your House?

details.title: The Shaman: What's in Your House?
details.short_description: "Something is in your house." As a Shaman, you are the only one who can face the unknown. Investigate haunted homes, uncover secrets, and exorcise malevolent spirits. Your choices determine the client's fate. Experience a chilling K-horror story where every decision matters.

details.title: Dawn's Wake
details.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

details.title: Mini Survival: final adventure
details.short_description: Build a shelter in a world overrun by zombies. Recruit survivors, grow food, craft equipment and venture into dangerous regions for supplies. Fortify your base, defend against zombie waves and bring rescued pets along on your next expedition.

details.title: 天机：大唐重构
details.short_description: Tianji: Reforging Tang is a 2D side-view deckbuilding rogue-like set in an alternate late Tang Dynasty. Play as a modern science student, build Physics and Chemistry decks, break enemy armor, read hidden intents, and reshape the fate of Tang.

details.title: Cook Cook Village ~!
details.short_description: 《Cook Cook Village》 is a deck-building roguelike where you run shops using resource tokens to gain certain amount of fullness. Operate your shops day by day, earn rewards from villagers, and build a deck that leads to big success.

details.title: Caravanserai Simulator
details.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own trading outpost on the harsh Silk Road. Draw water from the well, care for merchants' camels, trade goods, and upgrade your caravanserai from a dusty camp into a thriving desert empire.

details.title: Memory Farm
details.short_description: Memory Farm is a nostalgic farming mobile game. Return to childhood: farm, raise poultry, gather wood and harvest. Unlock shops as the main house upgrades to cook. Complete tasks for upgrade resources. With various gameplay, renovate the barren courtyard into a thriving one.

details.title: Index 1391
details.short_description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

details.title: Tileburg
details.short_description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

details.title: Gladiator's Revenge
details.short_description: A roguelite where you are the gladiator. Pick one of nine fighters, each with a strength and a weakness. Walk the map, choose your fights and rise from slave to champion. Every win brings a new skill. Buy armor you can see on your fighter, and find 100+ items that change how you fight.

details.title: Signal Zero
details.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

details.title: CandyPop
details.short_description: The Great Sweet Battle Begins! "CandyPop" is a confectionery war set in the Land of Sweets! A top-down, all-direction chaotic battle shooting action game! Are you ready?

details.title: Blokour
details.short_description: Jump, build and fight through the dungeons of Blokour! In this puzzle platformer, you place and break blocks whilst solving puzzles and dodging dangerous traps. Featuring 125 levels, 4 boss fights and more than 60 different types of blocks, you'll venture through a wide range of exciting challenges.

details.title: Urban Feather
details.short_description: Urban Feather is a local co-op digital tabletop game for 1-4 players about avian migration. Navigate a procedurally generated city, manage environmental hazards, and learn real-world strategies to prevent bird-window collisions.

details.title: Prevent WW3
details.short_description: You have no direct power - only diplomacy and influence. A global strategy game where you lead an international organization: stop conflicts, resolve economic crises, and restore stability before the world descends into chaos.

details.title: Pachinko Life
details.short_description: A bullet hell pachinko roguelite where the board shoots back.

details.title: 超时空怪盗
details.short_description: 是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。 千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

details.title: Rock Diver
details.short_description: Become a Rock Diver as you travel across alien worlds, extract valuable minerals, upgrade your gear, and get nice and friendly with hordes of local wildlife.

details.title: 回圈Loop
details.short_description: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

details.title: Triad: Elemental Saga
details.short_description: A tactical card battler with dynamic decks. Pick three heroes, each channeling Fire, Water, Earth, or Air, each chasing a personal quest. Complete in-match quests to earn resources, and unlock epic items and spells from your Archives.

details.title: Neon Arcade
details.short_description: There is a place where arcade machines never die and the desktop never sleeps. RiderOS is your portal to 50+ neon-soaked games across every genre, all breathing the same electric air. Log in. Pick a window. Lose the evening.

details.title: Fearless Crew
details.short_description: Fearless Crew is a monster-hunter co-op game where you and up to 3 friends hunt monsters and bring them back to the ship. Each monster is caught in a unique way, with different tools - so be smart about what items you use and when. Even you might get caught off guard by the very tools you use

details.title: Treug Dispute: Tabletop Interpretation
details.short_description: In this single-player board game, you take control of the city of Treug and overcome the crises that befell it. Balance resources and develop the city. But most importantly: find out how this story truly ended.

details.title: GearGrave
details.short_description: 2D side-scrolling strategy game. Spawn units, fight, and destroy. Your choices decide victory or defeat.

details.title: 字走三国
details.short_description: Hidden within the words lies a chilling killing intent; the chess pieces radiate a boundless fighting spirit. Tiny words weave the Three Kingdoms narrative, yet aspire to contain profound emotions.

details.title: The Nightwal Legacy
details.short_description: A first-person supernatural thriller where you explore a manor overtaken by darkness. Wield a mysterious power to confront an ancient evil, unravel the truth, and save your brother.

details.title: Radical Tower Defense
details.short_description: In Radical Tower Defense, harness shifting core chips to forge a unique steel defense. Each choice reshapes your combat style. Unlock architectures, explore chip synergies, ignite tactical reactions. Don’t just defend—become a blade to break formations, strike the heartland, crush the enemy lair!

details.title: HOLER!
details.short_description: Dig, dig, and DIG! One meter deeper, one second longer. A relentless mining action game where you plunge into an endless underground world! Your only rival is your past self. The eternal challenge to shatter your own "Best Record" begins now!

details.title: Hidden Streets
details.short_description: Find cats and hidden objects in illustrated streets full of detail.

details.title: BLIGHTEN
details.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

details.title: 夏飢聲（なきごえ）
details.short_description: A first-person horror adventure game featuring a side story (spin-off) scenario based on “Kyoso Musebiya” by “Obaken.” Guided to Musebiya, the protagonist ventures into a mysterious underground space. What choices will they make, and what fate awaits them…?

details.title: Fantasy Mountains
details.short_description: Paper Mountain is the first chapter in Fantasy Mountains. A casual, friendly, single‑player VR climbing game. Enter a fantasy paper world. Meet and interact with the mountain creatures along the path. Collect useful and less useful items. Find your way to the mountaintop.

details.title: Tyrants Must Fall
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, build an army to triumph in fast-paced battles. Deploy your troops, plan your attack, and watch as the action plays out simultaneously. Unlock powerful formations and guide the Hero of Destiny as he topples the Tyrant King!

details.title: Basement Server Simulator
details.short_description: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

details.title: Sunny Hollow
details.short_description: Move to a magical city to live with your grandmother and make it your home. Explore vibrant districts, build relationships with 100+ villagers who remember how you treat them, help with errands and jobs, fish at the waterways, customize your home, and discover the stories throughout Sunny Hollow.

details.title: Astral Bloom
details.short_description: Grow a living alien world in this incremental base-builder. Cultivate strange plants, command loyal wisps, and reshape the sky with powerful wishes. Automate and expand your ecosystem as you uncover lost memories. As your sanctuary grows, will you stay... or leave in search of something more?

name: I Want To Be a Child

details.title: I Want To Be a Child
details.short_description: Family is the most precious thing you have. No matter what, right

details.title: Confessional: Reality TV Manager
details.short_description: A reality TV production management game. Cast, create or download contestants, design your season, and watch drama unfold in the most complex relationship sim ever created. Scout hidden talent, manage moods, watch challenges play out, and survive dramatic tribal councils. Build your franchise.

details.title: Min5 Min - Party Edition
details.short_description: "Fast, competitive, and sugar-coated! Min5 Min is designed for those looking for intense action in a short amount of time. Equipped with a variety of characters and powerful weapons, you have a minimum of 5 minutes to survive in this stylized world!"

details.title: EIDOL
details.short_description: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

name: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel

details.title: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel
details.short_description: Command a squad of broken survivors on a planet that hunts you. A tactical mech-action game, you must build your base, defend against crystalline swarms, and manage the "Icarus Drift"—a neural link that grants god-like power but costs your humanity. Will you break the enemy, or become part of it?

details.title: Z Drive
details.short_description: Drive, explore, search for resources, and craft! And drive! Do it for as long as you can! This FPS takes place in a rough world after a zombie attack. Prepare your wheeled fortress for every possible adventure! Explore the dead world and search for the remnants of civilization.

details.title: 奉先勇者:我爹是魔王?
details.short_description: In this world of swords and magic, a new chapter in the tale of the Demon King and the Hero is about to unfold...

details.title: Drinking Medieval
details.short_description: You are a simple peasant living in medieval times, working for your feudal lord. One day, you discover the recipe for brewing beer. This changes your life - improve your brewing skills, unlock new sales channels, and expand your product across growing territories.

details.title: Atrum
details.short_description: Atrum is a dark fantasy, third-person roguelike where you play as a powerful mage descending into darkness. Fight challenging enemies and bosses across corrupted realms and collect magical items to shape your build before the darkness consumes you.

details.title: BB ADVENTURE
details.short_description: “BB ADVENTURE” is an immersive action game where you ride a real balance ball and clear athletic stages. Using a controller with an accelerometer, your balance ball’s movements control the in-game character, making you feel as if you’re inside the game.

details.title: TheDowsing / ダウジング
details.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

details.title: TwinGrip
details.short_description: TwinGrip is a twin-stick physics-based puzzle-platformer video-game. That's a lot of hyphens. Control each leg of your vessel individually with a controller, or both at the same time with the mouse! Master this unique control scheme and find your way home!

details.title: The Great Hatch
details.short_description: Help goblins take down a giant floating egg

details.title: Space Revolver
details.short_description: SPACE REVOLVER is a puzzle adventure game that follows the journey of a protagonist caught in a catastrophic black hole accident. With your spaceship critically damaged, you must explore uncharted planets, solve puzzles, repair your ship, and find your way back home.

details.title: Typeria
details.short_description: In Typeria, every keystroke is an attack. Watch your weapons and followers unleash dazzling assaults to harvest foes,collect and sell a wild arsenal of bizarre weapons scattered across diverse realms——all from a compact window on your desktop.

details.title: Plush Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own cozy plushie shop in this management simulation game. Buy, price, and sell adorable plush toys, stationery, and mystery blind boxes!

details.title: Dungeon Directive
details.short_description: You’ve taken over the guild hall in the center of town near a mysterious dungeon portal. With a small roster of heroes and limited resources, it’s your job to rebuild the guild, send parties into the depths, and shape a legacy that lasts for generations. What future will your choices create?

details.title: PONG EMOTIONAL
details.short_description: Legendary classic game "PONG" returns with stunning visuals and emotionally stirring sound! A high-performance AI precisely predicts the ball's trajectory and counters with calculated moves. If you can clear STAGE 30, you're a true super player!

details.title: Aerosurge
details.short_description: Perform daring aerial stunts, destroy your enemies and weave through hazardous environments to complete your missions before the time runs out! Upgrade your weapons and abilities between objectives, before taking out enemies across a variety of landscapes and planets

details.title: Finally a Florist
details.short_description: Finally a Florist is a cozy, slice-of-life game where you gather flowers to arrange beautiful bouquets. Explore peaceful landscapes, befriend animals, and fill heartfelt requests from the local villagers as you finally become a florist.

details.title: Phantom Containment
details.short_description: Survive the Planet, a massive open-world containment world filled with dangerous entities, anomaly outbreaks, hostile factions, and hidden secrets. Build, investigate, scavenge, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that never ended.

details.title: Runaway Rumble
details.short_description: Runaway Rumble is a fast-paced PvP action-sports game where players chase or escape using parkour and powerful abilities. Set in multiverse arenas, each character brings unique powers and style. Run. Chase. Rumble!

details.title: Catgirl Rage: Claws of Fury
details.short_description: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

details.title: Kui & Chai: Evolution Survivors
details.short_description: Kui and Chai is a single human survivor game that collects various materials, strengthens itself, defeats evolving enemies, and perseveres until the last moment, perhaps knowing the truth of everything.

details.title: Dungeon Manager
details.short_description: This is a PVE auto Battler! Right after graduating from the management school but before getting degree certificate, you are snatched away by a red dragon and forced to be a dungeon manager. You need to fighting against the invaders of the evil empire together with the cute creatures in the dungeon.

details.title: Seaworks: Trap Season
details.short_description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

details.title: Neon Dash
details.short_description: Neon Dash is a Retro-Futurism style rhythm platformer game. Get past challenging obstacles to the music's beat, and journey back to the dreamy 80s to push your limits!

details.title: Hookah Simulator
details.short_description: Start with a small cozy hookah lounge and turn it into the most popular spot in the city! Your goal is to craft perfect hookahs, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

details.title: Elevator
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

details.title: Out On The Water
details.short_description: Out On The Water is a short, meditative journey through memory and grief that tells the story of an inattentive father and his last chance to connect with his children. Set adrift in quiet waters that represent each child, catch strange memory fish to uncover the past and face regrets.

details.title: Starlight Blade
details.short_description: An adventure-packed slasher where you play as the heir to a legendary blade, crushing armies of faded stars and battling the very creators of the universe.

details.title: EURGAVA™ - Pathforgers
details.short_description: Here's a challenge: In this simple, 2D-isometric hack'n'slash boss rush game, the Pilgrims need you to win against the Naga Cult in 100 weeks!

details.title: Androfoco
details.short_description: An FPS with SHOOTING COMBAT! Shooting your enemies a few times will not do! You must hit them with everything you've got so that they can never make it back to the stage. That is where the big money is!

details.title: Pawn City
details.short_description: From A Single Store To A Monopoly - Buy Sell And Trade Anything That Comes Through Your Door. Expand Your Business, Hire Employees, Bid For Storage Units, Don't Get Scammed, And Take Over The City !

details.title: Not Guilty!
details.short_description: Not Guilty! is a prison warden and executioner simulator. Become a scumbag: fabricate cases, spend the prison budget on your own whims, and EXECUTE PEOPLE IN DOZENS OF WAYS. Or try to stay human… if you can.

details.title: Argot's Laboratory
details.short_description: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job... Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

details.title: southbound
details.short_description: A thousand years after collapse, the southern wilderness is the last frontier — and something is fracturing at its edge. Push deeper into a procedurally generated world of ruins, monsters, and growing strangeness. A survival roguelite where every run takes you further south, and further from normal.

details.title: FUGUE
details.short_description: Suspense adventure visual novel——Expectations are like a mirage: they are beautiful but lead nowhere. You will arrive in Jiangzhou, and assume the roles of a student or related personnel at Jiangzhou City No. 32 High School, and a special high school.

details.title: Love Bird
details.short_description: The next hit reality dating show is here, and YOU are the star! Your job? Win hearts, stir drama, charm the nation—or crash and burn while trying. Can you make memorable TV, uncover the secrets hidden behind the scenes, and still find romance in the chaos?

details.title: Akashic
details.short_description: Akashic is an AI-powered interactive storybook game that blends Roguelite elements with role-playing narrative. Every adventure is unique — driven by AI-generated dialogues and dynamic worldbuilding, where your choices, emotions, and conversations shape the unfolding story.

details.title: CubeMate
details.short_description: Chess meets the Rubik's Cube. Rotate a 3D cube until every face satisfies a chess challenge: check, checkmate, advantage, equality or a classic solve. A 34-level campaign tree from 2×2 to 7×7, Free Play, a Daily puzzle and shareable seeds.

details.title: Salt and Spice
details.short_description: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.

details.title: Island Core
details.short_description: The Otherworld invasion left one island base standing. You are the Core, a central AI with the personalities of fallen scientists. Mount lasers, saw guns, flamethrowers and drones, and hold the line through snowfield, desert and swamp. Single-player horde defense × character builds.

details.title: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition
details.short_description: Step into your own garage workshop and breathe new life into forgotten furniture. In this immersive first-person simulation, sand away decades of wear, apply vibrant paints, and polish each piece to a showroom finish—one satisfying restoration at a time.

details.title: Pip sellfish
details.short_description: Catch fish by drawing circles around them, sell them in Pip's little beach shop, and reinvest everything. Fish, sell, upgrade, repeat. A cozy fishing incremental game.

details.title: UGOMEKU NOTE
details.short_description: A world more real than reality itself— It begins to wriggle into life.

details.title: Alt梦魇救赎
details.short_description: Psychiatrist Marine and her assistant Felix make an emergency visit to Egas Psychiatric Hospital for her important patient Edward on Christmas Eve, but they get caught up in a crisis...

details.title: Not My Floor
details.short_description: Not My Floor is a horror game set in the grim stairwell of a Soviet-era apartment block on the outskirts of Kyiv in the early 1990s. After a long shift at the factory, all you want is to get home—but the elevator and the entire building have their own sinister plans, driven by a mysterious entity.

details.title: Stick A Round
details.short_description: Relive the joy of your childhood in Stick A Round! Find uniquely generated sticks that transform into weapons based on their real-world shapes. Battle friends in combat, play action packed or relaxing minigames, and explore a changing world where your imagination sets the rules.

details.title: Mini Shopkeeper
details.short_description: Run your cozy little shop from the bottom of your screen, decorate to attract unique customers, hire assistants, and send adventurers for rare treasures - all in a lively, charming management sim!

details.title: Tokyo Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your second-hand shop under Tokyo’s neon lights! 🏮 Find, buy, and sell unique Japanese goods and grow your store! 💰🎎

details.title: 2048 Bosses
details.short_description: 2048 Bosses is a puzzle roguelike where your 2048 score is your weapon: every merge builds Power, and merging into your hero's attack tiles strikes the boss. Combine skills and heroes into game-breaking builds and discover the routes that lead to each boss.

details.title: Rustmire
details.short_description: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

details.title: Still Stars Echo
details.short_description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

details.title: Stackatalbi
details.short_description: Stackatalbi is a survival game where you stack cards to collect resources and craft new items. Drag your hero over an open world, hunt, fish, farm and grow stronger to fight new foes. Play solo or online co-op with a friend.

details.title: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage?
details.short_description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

details.title: Before the Silence
details.short_description: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

details.title: Paradise Court
details.short_description: You and up to three friends just took over the worst apartment building in town. Fix the pipes, mop the floors, deal with angry tenants and evict the ones who won’t pay, all while trying to keep the place in one piece. A chaotic co-op building-management sim for 1-4 players.

details.title: Who is the Thief?
details.short_description: Runners hide in a crowd of identical NPCs. Hunters spot the one who moves like a human. An asymmetric online party game for 2–10 players: finish your tasks without getting caught, or hunt down the runners hiding in the crowd.

details.title: Blood & Ledger
details.short_description: Port Aldrich, 1920. You start as a young nobody and follow your family for eighty years. Rackets, businesses, elections or a police badge: in this city everyone plays by the same rules as you, and nobody forgets.

details.title: Night Study: Korean Ghost Stories
details.short_description: A complete first-person horror game in just 1.44MB — it fits on a single floppy disk. You fell asleep during night study and woke up alone. Learn each ghost's rule, find the keys and escape a Korean high school before dawn.

details.title: Children of Titan
details.short_description: Build bases on Saturn's real moons, harvest ten resources and grow a colony from a bare crater. Train troops, launch fleets and fight beside your alliance in server-wide wars against the alien Selenite Brood. A free-to-play strategy MMO in one persistent world.

details.title: Petri: Microbe Swarm
details.short_description: You are a brand-new microbe. Grow a living swarm: send cells between colonies, upgrade them, and out-spread rival strains across five animal hosts, from fish to whale. Roguelike runs: pick a strain, mutate after every win or skip for a one-battle boost. Mouse, keyboard or controller.

details.title: Brownie Clicker
details.short_description: Three out of four people prefer homemade brownies over homemade cookies. In Brownie Clicker, you're going to have more deep impacting choices, more depth, and more home-cooked goodness than you've ever expected from a mere 'clicker'. Production, world wide shipping, marketing and so much more!

details.title: Let 'er Ride
details.short_description: A Wild West roguelike based on casino Let It Ride. Post three bets, then pull them home or let ’em ride as the Board turns. Hire a posse of oddballs, beat crooked Proprietors at their own rules, and win Her back from the Baron.

details.title: Chaos Universalis
details.short_description: A grand strategy sandbox on a real globe. Start any day from c. 8700 BC to AD 1800 as a nation, a person or any entity, and just tell your friend Baibai what you want to do. Baibai plays out every side's reaction as you build your legend across 131 regions and 21,000+ individually drawn districts.

details.title: Minesweeper Survivors
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets roguelite survival! Reveal tiles and flag mines while your weapons tear through enemy hordes. Collect artifacts, create powerful builds, defeat bosses, and upgrade your arsenal between runs.

details.title: Mall Santa Mayhem
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, and Santa’s sleigh is empty. Race three other elves through a mall that’s new every run: hook, bounce, zipline and shopping-cart your way to every gift on the kid’s list, and get it to Santa before his patience runs out. 1-4 players, couch or online.

name: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator - Prologue

details.title: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator - Prologue
details.short_description: Run a medieval pigeon post, raise your flock, and take your first steps toward rebuilding the war-torn Kingdom of Melthoria.

details.title: Sneaklings: Paint Hide & Seek
details.short_description: Paint yourself into the scene and hope nobody notices. Sneaklings is online hide-and-seek for 2–8 players: hiders turn into garden gnomes, cheese wheels and toy dinosaurs and paint themselves to match the map, while seekers hunt for anything that looks a little too alive.

details.title: Just 19,999 Bricks, Right?
details.short_description: A short, first-person survival incremental game about clearing a brickyard from Bricks and something else...

details.title: Bad Beans
details.short_description: A cute, fluffy deathrun party game that is secretly a bloodbath. One player is the Bad Bean, slamming big red buttons that fire traps. Everyone else runs for their life, and their limbs, across seven trap-packed courses. Up to 8 beans online; bots fill the empty seats.

details.title: Pay To Die
details.short_description: “One more room, then we’re out.” You’ve got the package. The loot next door might cover the bill. Get to the elevator and hold off the horde until the doors open. Pay To Die is a third-person survival extraction game for up to four players in online co-op.

details.title: She is in Silence
details.short_description: A visual novel featuring expressive sequences brought to life through a wealth of AI-generated animation.The game includes multiple endings. At the end of the game, you will confess to something. It is up to you to decide what that "something" truly is.

details.title: Thornroad
details.short_description: Build on a map that grows as you play. Thornroad is a roguelike tower defence with branching paths, card drafts, 17 upgradeable towers and boss battles. Play solo, or defend the core together in online or same-screen co-op.

details.title: ASMR Infinite Extreme Universe
details.short_description: Cut, peel, pop and scrub your way through ten small worlds of real sounds. A water cube, a rainbow party, a machine that grows out of tingles. No score to chase, no clock, nothing watching you. Wear headphones.

details.title: Clanker Labs
details.short_description: Clanker Labs is an incremental game about building your own AI. Click for compute, train your models and launch them to a feed that scores each one out of 100 and roasts it. Set your prices and beat the rival labs. Then your AI starts spending your money on its own: allow, stop or bargain.

details.title: Thousands Will Fall
details.short_description: 50,000 enemies on screen at once. One castle. You have a minigun. Orc warbands and a swarm that thinks are coming for your walls. Build a tower maze, then drop in and mow them down with miniguns, black holes and nukes. Solo or co-op for up to 4, and every friend brings another horde.

details.title: Company Policy
details.short_description: Co-op horror for 1 to 4 players. Finish your tasks before 6 AM in an office tower where things called the Colleagues roam the floors. The company memo gives you the rules to survive. Some of them are false.

details.title: Snap Party
details.short_description: Forty tourists. One phone pointed at the park guard. Ten seconds later, the photo lands on his phone. Blend into a sunny theme park crowd, snap the guards in secret — or play the guard, study your own photo, find the sneak and bonk them! Wrong person? Oops.

details.title: Where's Mama?
details.short_description: A PaleoDyne truck crashes on Route 9 and one egg rolls into a storm drain. You're what hatches. Eat your way up from mice to elephants across five chapters, work out how each place fights back, and find your mother. The two men who lost you are waiting at her gate.

details.title: Last Bastion: Gatefall
details.short_description: Pilot a towering mech on the walls of a doomed canyon. Build towers, draft upgrade cards and hold three gates against a living tide of thousands of bugs — and the titans that follow. When a gate falls, ride the zipline back and make your next stand.

details.title: Christmas Toys Restoration
details.short_description: Bring four forgotten toys back to life in a cozy Christmas workshop. Take them apart, clean and repaint them, repair their mechanisms, then test your handiwork, add a child's name, and send each wrapped gift up the chimney to Santa.

name: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam

details.title: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam
details.short_description: A tiny animal band lives on your taskbar. Every key you press and every click you make plays a beat, so the more you work, the bigger the show. Collect 50+ animal musicians, dress them up, decorate the stage and tour 12 countries while you get things done.

details.title: The Plushie Atelier
details.short_description: Open your cozy plush toy workshop! Wash, repair, and sew stuffed animals, or design your own cuddly friends. Decorate your shop, discover your customers’ stories, and enjoy peaceful days with Crumb and your animal companions.

details.title: Cat Fight
details.short_description: Scrap with other cats in a fast, chaotic multiplayer arena brawler. Swat, pounce, and use items across five competitive modes, with local, LAN, and online play plus optional bots. Cat Fight is in active development.

details.title: 问道长生
details.short_description: An ancient old man hands you a worn jade slip and a breathing manual: "Between these two lies your fate." A text-based xianxia idle game — cultivate, refine pills, forge artifacts, join sects, find a Dao companion and ascend through fifteen realms. (Simplified Chinese only)

details.title: KER
details.short_description: KER is a 2D puzzle strategy heist game where you play as Agent Orange, who have to enter into most secure building and get the FILE securely. The building is equipped with pass cords and other securities measure, but only aim to get out the file securely.

details.title: Sprout
details.short_description: By day, work your first shift at Santa's toy factory: wrap presents, build toys and bake cookies. By night, survive the lockdown: hide, board up doors, solve puzzles and watch the cameras while something crawls through the halls hunting you.

details.title: Blob Buddies
details.short_description: Team up as squishy blobs in a co-op puzzle platformer for 1 to 8 players. Stack into towers, push heavy blocks together, ride the wind and carry the spark home - on one keyboard, with gamepads or online with friends. 148 stages in two campaigns.

name: Capture the Flag: Arcade Car Battles

details.title: Capture the Flag: Arcade Car Battles
details.short_description: Grab the flag and don't let go! Fast arcade car battles in a roaring stadium: campaign, 6-car free-for-all, 4v4 teams and Bring It Home goals, offline vs AI or online with friends. Boost, bump, dodge TNT and collect 15 cars. No ads.

details.title: King Of The Gill
details.short_description: A one-button fishing roguelite. Time the needle, land the catch, buy upgrades, and take relics that bend the rules. Fifteen bosses stand between you and the title of King of the Gill. A procedural banjo band plays along.

details.title: Word War
details.short_description: Word War is a crossword strategy game for 1–4 players. Make words to capture star territories, then change a letter or two to steal your enemy's. Mind-game your friends with ambushes and flanks to hold the most territories before the time runs out!

details.title: Caldera County
details.short_description: Your callsign is Air Attack 51. Circling overhead, your job is to call in aerial drops and direct ground crews against a fire that spreads with the wind, terrain and fuel. You must hold the line and protect every structure you can, but keeping people safe (including your units) is top priority.

details.title: Undercrown: Protect the Deadland
details.short_description: Dig a living dungeon, grow a hungry ecosystem of monsters and hide the Dungeon Lord from waves of human heroes. Thirty years after losing the throne, Albert returns - and this time the arena is underground.

details.title: From Cave to Shelf
details.short_description: Dig into the earth, explore mysterious caves, and collect crystals. Arrange your finds on the shelves of an abandoned magical mineral museum, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into perfect order.

details.title: DataFactory
details.short_description: A top-down 2D pixel action RPG. Trapped in a six-floor factory run by a central AI, the only exit is at the top. Collect data coins, uncover the truth—every coin you spend rewrites the world outside. Four endings await.

details.title: Dragon Joust
details.short_description: Two riders. Four dragons. One sky to rule. Pick the Orc King or the Sorceress Queen, saddle up a fire, ice, poison, or magic dragon, and joust your rivals out of the clouds. Raid villages, summon storms, call a Titan, or just fly for high scores, solo, online or tournament with 8 players .

details.title: Sector Defense
details.short_description: Command the last line of defense in this single-player, turn-based sci-fi roguelite. Build two Defense Platforms, craft gear from salvage, and hold your home sector against three unknown invading factions, one run at a time.

details.title: Infernum
details.short_description: Heaven made a wager, and the Accuser lost. Now he wants a rematch. Descend into hell as Cain, Job or Lot, survive waves of demons, build your run item by item and bring down the lords of the abyss all the way to Lucifer. Then turn the Key of the Abyss, where nothing has a limit anymore.

details.title: Corehold
details.short_description: Corehold is a dungeon defence strategy game. Carve corridors, rotate and fit buildings into tight rooms, recruit defenders and set traps for invading heroes. Your army shapes your faction's future, while your Dungeon Boss protects the Core.

details.title: Zombie Swarm Defense
details.short_description: Millions of zombies. One massive swarm. And only you can stop it. Build powerful defenses, combine unique tower effects, and unleash devastating abilities. Use every angle, perfect your strategy, and show the horde what true destruction looks like!

name: Get Your Cards in a Row

details.title: Get Your Cards in a Row
details.short_description: Your uncle Jeff left you his game shop, and it's been ransacked. Put over 25,000 things back where they belong in this first-person physics sim. Dig through the heaps, unlock rooms, upgrade your tools, and tidy up alone or with up to 3 friends.

details.title: Arcadeous
details.short_description: Own an arcade from minute one. Fill the floor with cabinets you can walk up to and actually play, set the ticket payout, stock the prize counter and keep the crowd coming back. A first-person arcade management sim where every machine is a real game.

details.title: Make It Burn
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game about throwing gems into a hole. Press the buzzer, push the gems into the fire and buy machines to burn more and more. Bring the gem count on the wall down to zero to open the next room.

details.title: Adventure Paintball
details.short_description: Grab a marker, pick a side and paint everything! Adventure Paintball is a fast, colorful first-person paintball shooter: 10 v 10 online battles and free-for-all across 7 wild maps, from Candy Land to the Moon. Earn cash, unlock 9 blasters and make your look your own.

details.title: Stress Relief Bamboo Fighter
details.short_description: Control a bamboo toy fighter and pop your rivals’ balloons with fists, guns and blades! Customize balloon images, challenge the AI, battle online with 2–4 players, or command your troops in Strategy Mode.

details.title: Skylane: Airline Tycoon Sim
details.short_description: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share.

details.title: 回声 E.C.H.O.S
details.short_description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

details.title: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
details.short_description: A pinball-action × roguelike strategy game. Launch balls to smash enemies, equip turrets and skills, and craft your own build from hundreds of combinations. Three modes: turn-based tactics, real-time combat, and stage-based challenges.

details.title: Kepler Protocol
details.short_description: Kepler-186e. An Imperial colony on a world that wants it gone. Turn-based strategy and hard survival: secure water and Flux power, keep the supply lines alive and hold out against a swarm steered by stimulus and pheromone.

details.title: Smash Them All
details.short_description: A highly dynamic top-down action game where the car serves as both a weapon and the primary tool for survival.

details.title: MUGENDUNGEON
details.short_description: “MUGENDUNGEON” is a top-down roguelike action game where players explore procedurally generated dungeons. Collect keys, reach the goal, clear each floor, upgrade gear in the shop, and dive deeper in this single-player adventure.

details.title: Eleven Legends
details.short_description: Eleven Legends blends football management, character growth, and strategic matches. You are not just a manager on the sidelines, nor just one player on the pitch. Plan each week, build bonds, find mentors, and lead your team to victory.

details.title: Beyond Orbit
details.short_description: A tab-target space MMO inspired by Earth & Beyond. Choose between three classes, Warrior, Explorer or Trader and make your way through the galaxy. Fight, mine, haul and craft with other pilots.

details.title: Jett Rider - Mini Hero
details.short_description: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

details.title: VoidHue
details.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

name: This is not just a farm

details.title: This is not just a farm
details.short_description: This Is Not Just a Farm is an idle farming simulator with horror elements where you can make progress while doing other things on your computer.

details.title: What Remains
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a childhood home. Explore, uncover four days of missing memory, and survive something that has been listening since you arrived.

details.title: Sign It
details.short_description: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

details.title: Chihuahua Racing
details.short_description: Arcade combat racing on planet Chihuahua! Twenty dogs race for the championship across 20 tracks with homing missiles, bombs, 18 wild supers and 26 random events. Build your own tracks, then race them alone or split screen with a friend, even tied together by a rope.

details.title: (Debt Feeds Debt
details.short_description: A turn-based bond card strategy game. Buy bonds, fulfill orders, build FEVER combos, and push progress to 100 before decay—and the demonic contract—catch up.

details.title: Factor Zoo
details.short_description: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

details.title: Unregistered Scene
details.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

details.title: Misplaced
details.short_description: Misplaced is a historical detective puzzle game about sorting case files and uncovering hidden connections. Read letters, witness statements, and official records, figure out where each document belongs, and piece together the truth behind a murder case inspired by real events.

details.title: Chief Bubble Officer
details.short_description: Chief Bubble Officer is a Roll-and-Write strategy game. In every match, aim to score as many points as possible within limited actions. Each turn, draw random number cards and fill distinct charts. Every chart features unique rules, with a wild range of fill requirements and scoring systems.

details.title: Winter Hunts Us
details.short_description: Lead a prehistoric clan across a brutal hex map in a turn-based survival roguelite. Outrun the glacier, fight hunger, face strange events, and defy extinction.

details.title: ICU - Intensive Care Unit 8
details.short_description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

details.title: Decks & Dashes
details.short_description: Step into the arena in Decks & Dashes, a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategy meets reflexes. Draft powerful elemental spells, dodge incoming attacks, and unleash devastating combos in real-time combat. Do you have the skills to become the ultimate arena champion?

name: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices

details.title: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices
details.short_description: 「その選択肢、正気か？」シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？ 予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！

details.title: Endless War: Defense
details.short_description: Endless War: Defense returns with new missions, improved UI and modern resolutions support. Take command of fortified positions across WWII’s most iconic battlefields. Build defenses, deploy reinforcements, and let your army do the job or take direct control of any unit to turn the tide.

details.title: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.)
details.short_description: Rescue abandoned toys and find your way back to your owner in this thrilling co-op action adventure! Evade those who seek to break or discard you by using the ultimate survival tactic: stop moving and 'Act Like Toys!' to blend in.

details.title: You Will Fall
details.short_description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

details.title: Scarecrow Simulator
details.short_description: No swords. No dragons. No heroic destiny. Just you, a scarecrow, standing proudly in a medieval field while the world grows around you. Surprisingly relaxing. Surprisingly addictive.

details.title: S-Ranker
details.short_description: Fight through short dungeons in this action roguelite. Choose new powers in combat, equip runes between runs, and rise from F-Rank to S-Rank.

details.title: Clicker Tactics: Memorian
details.short_description: A clicker × auto-battle tactics game where you place your companions on a 3×3 grid. Link chains with a wide variety of skills and relics, and mow down the hordes surging toward you. An exhilarating incremental RPG where every adventure makes you stronger.

details.title: Magical Magic World 2
details.short_description: All the main characters are VTubers!! A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪ One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

details.title: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding
details.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

details.title: Funny Rummy
details.short_description: A Rummy roguelike set in a surreal, hand-drawn world that blends daydream and reality. Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds to bend the rules with wild cards and sub-suits that unlock new strategies. Experiment with new decks and trinkets to build power against ever-increasing scoring goals.

details.title: Vatan
details.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

details.title: Bad AI
details.short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

details.title: The Hollow Archive
details.short_description: Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.

details.title: SPLATTER KING
details.short_description: Smash through horned demons as you plunge ever downward to save the Queen. The deeper you descend, the deadlier the enemies become. Only those strong enough to survive can reclaim their throne.

details.title: 疾擎速骋Rapid Engine Speed
details.short_description: 《Rapid Engine Speed》 is a realistic motorcycle racing game focused on authentic handling. Ditch the convenience of automatic shifting, and experience the full manual gear-shifting process from pulling the clutch and shifting gears to throttle control.
publishers: 重庆疾擎速骋科技有限公司

details.title: Brave Legends
details.short_description: Collect equipment and skill books to build your own unique build.

details.title: Mindreaders
details.short_description: How well do you actually know your friends? Mindreaders is a social party game about syncing up. One player hints, the rest guess where on the Wheel they meant. Easy to learn, endlessly replayable, perfect for couch nights or Discord calls.

details.title: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
details.short_description: An idle sim living on your desktop. Play as a cat developer where your typing and clicks are turned into progress. Conquer bugs and deadlines to turn “New Folder (2)” into a Steam hit. Check your scores, read the comments, and aim for that elusive +1 Wishlist!

details.title: Bingo Bingle
details.short_description: Spin your way to fortune by cranking a bingo drum and building powerful combinations of balls and cards.

details.title: Kidnapped Simulator
details.short_description: Kidnapped Simulator is a first-person psychological horror game where you write your own replies to the serial killer holding you captive. Your words shape the encounter as you search for a way out.

details.title: JUNK CONNECT
details.short_description: Falling-block puzzle x Electronic circuit design! New to electronics? No problem. Our real-time navigation visualizes exactly where the current is flowing. Even with zero prior knowledge, you’ll discover the joy of "making it work" through play.

details.title: Frame by Frame
details.short_description: Step directly into the film reel in Frame by Frame, an award-winning 2.5D puzzle-platformer. Restore a damaged documentary about the dawn of Italian cinema by solving environmental puzzles, repairing film splices, and bringing cinematic history back to life, one frame at a time.

details.title: ASHEN SEA
details.short_description: Ashen Sea is a first-person narrative experience for AXISRAY. Play as BASH, a party robot repairing arcades and tuning jukeboxes via terminal on a derelict spaceship. No combat, no time limits—explore freely. When a shuttle is the only way down, the party’s meaning blurs.

details.title: Final Assembly
details.short_description: Run a chaotic factory with up to 8 players. Earn enough cash before time runs out—while a hidden saboteur quietly breaks everything from within. No voting. A rotating Leader decides who lives or dies.

details.title: Road From Horno
details.short_description: Road From Horno is a tactical narrative shooter where precision, stealth, and tactical decision-making are essential to survive as you fight to protect the people you once hunted.

details.title: Ant Idea
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game. Lead your squad of insect people, explore the complex and ever-changing natural world, and reap unpredictable rewards from your adventures. You know that victory takes swords and food, strategy and intuition, struggle and compromise, and a touch of luck.

details.title: GUILDMAKER
details.short_description: Run a guild of valiant, procedurally generated adventurers who fight, trade, craft, and do quests on their own. Do your best as their guildmaster to provide them a place to rest and thrive, and restore an old guild to its former glory.

details.title: Blood List
details.short_description: "Blood List" is a hardcore action game specialized in boss battles. As the "Contractor," you will eliminate every formidable foe standing in your way.

details.title: ChessSnake
details.short_description: Chess... chess never changes. How much can you do?! It's time for something new - a combination of chess and snake!

details.title: OpTek
details.short_description: An interactive co-op repair game with horror elements. Up to 4 players will work together to survive routine maintenance sessions conducted in chambers that store dangerous entities. Work together to survive and bring the chamber online before certain death...

details.title: FLOWSXTY
details.short_description: FLOWSXTY is a minimal action game. A brutal trench runner where you WASD between four lanes.

details.title: REMNANT: Rebirth
details.short_description: Explore the silent echoes of a fallen open-world in REMNANT: Rebirth. Navigate lush, overgrown ruins where nature has reclaimed its throne and zombies lurk in the shadows. Master survival, uncover secrets of a lost civilization, and endure the challenges of an untamed post-apocalyptic era.

details.title: Just an Ordinary Bike Ride
details.short_description: In this adventure horror game you experience nothing but a calm bike ride home, your chauffeur is late and it's starting to rain. You only have a bike but you need to get home, it's a rather empty street aside from some debris. It's just a bike ride home.

details.title: Postponed: Game Dev Management Roguelite
details.short_description: An addictive wave-based arcade roguelite, in which you are the manager of a game development studio. You get a project each week, that your team and you have to work on to get paid. With that money get upgrades, skill your employees and even unlock characters. Ever wanted to lead a game dev studio?

name: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga

details.title: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
details.short_description: Auto Chess +Tower Defense + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

details.title: Incredigble
details.short_description: Uncover dinosaur fossils as you mine through rocks, earn money and upgrade your abilities! Fill your museum with your discoveries to reach the goal of becoming world renowned!

details.title: Zebulon 3D
details.short_description: Meet Zebulon once more in a new adventure now in 3D and crispy voxels! Jump, dash, explore, and gather back your siblings in this new exciting game about purpose and family.

details.title: Air Hockey: Magical Heroes
