details.short_description: A magical roguelite twist on air hockey! Battle forest animals, collect power-ups, and survive a series of intense air hockey matches.

details.title: The Oath of Runeveil
details.short_description: An online-enabled 3D action RPG set in a vast world to explore. Centered on real-time battles and character progression, it can be enjoyed both solo and in cooperative play.

details.title: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
details.short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

details.title: Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG
details.short_description: A short and straightforward turn-based RPG where every action matters. Explore, cast spells through quirky enchantments, help the townsfolk, and hunt for treasure, without endless grinding or overcomplicated stories.

details.title: Fyrardien
details.short_description: After a fateful discovery, our hero and their new companions embark on a challenging journey through unknown lands. Are they the last hope for their world? And could these new companions become more than just friends? The choice is yours, young Guardian...

details.title: WHERE IS MABEL?
details.short_description: Help Mabel find her sister! Explore the library, interact with characters and solve puzzles and collect the necessary notes to uncover the truth behind everything in this single player 2.5D adventure game.

details.title: Wong
details.short_description: A 2D speedrun platformer. Destroy targets to charge a shot that launches you and never lose your momentum. Learn the routes, find the shortcuts and fight for the best time against your friends and the rest of the world.

details.title: Hierosaga Overture
details.short_description: Enter the tomb of the Pharaess and tactically maneuver through a plethora of challenges and monster-filled gauntlets in this homage to strategy roguelikes of the 90s.

details.title: Castle Cats
details.short_description: Idle RPG and Cat-Collecting Adventure. Build a guild of heroic cats, train and evolve a wide cast of over 400 feline characters, take on quests at your own pace, customize your base, and dive into seasonal events and fun story updates in a cozy, ever-growing universe.

details.title: ProTax 98
details.short_description: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

details.title: 七不思議に至るまで
details.short_description: The protagonist, a member of a university occult club, obtains a mysterious notebook about a high school’s “Seven Mysteries” The story branches based on your choices — will you uncover the truth, or meet an ending best left hidden? A suspense-driven horror visual novel exploring the Seven Mysteries.

details.title: Inverted Dreams
details.short_description: This dream driven psychological exploration game guides you through shifting landscapes shaped by buried fears, fractured memories and unsettling truths. As the world bends, every shadow becomes a clue, and every step pulls you deeper into the subconscious you’ve tried to forget.

details.title: Jade Simulator
details.short_description: This is a hardcore jade processing simulator. Players inspect raw stones for color and cracks, then operate machinery to cut and polish them. Learn to distinguish natural jade from fakes while upgrading equipment. Experience the full journey from a rough rock to a translucent masterpiece.

details.title: Infinity Arena
details.short_description: Create and customize your hero in Infinity Arena. Combine skills, items, and upgrades to craft unique strategies and conquer the final arena. Get ready for the ultimate battle!

details.title: Pogo Froggo
details.short_description: Two frogs, one bar, zero coordination. Bounce up the mountain before your tank breaks... and before you blame each other.

details.title: Tower.defense(): Program The Fight
details.short_description: Program three distinct towers with readable visual logic, then solve handcrafted tower-defense puzzles where placement, line of sight and every code block matter. No programming experience required.

details.title: ULTRA
details.short_description: The Ascendancy inherited the Earth, and gave humanity the ULTRA. Humanity gave you in return: a Runner. Navigate the trails of the Evergrowth with quick feet, rhythm, grappling hooks, ice bombs, and forgotten tech. Race with friends or alone to save humanity.

details.title: The Rule of Adult
details.short_description: Unable to find work, you unwittingly join ruthless HarborTech. A strange contract traps your soul. Manage time and resources, meet KPIs and fight turn-based battles to reclaim your soul and quit within 10 weeks. Uncover its secrets in this workplace psychological horror RPG.

details.title: To The Deep
details.short_description: Dive into a surreal deep sea dream. Survive by devouring and evolving, and encounter a cast of strange, mysterious companions. Explore, upgrade, and uncover the "truth" hidden beneath the beautiful waves. This is more than an adventure—it is a dimension-breaking dive to the deep.

details.title: RK Roulette
details.short_description: RISK YOUR LIFE IN HORROR. Risk it however you want: Play Russian roulette with up to 4 players, customizable bullets and gamemodes, or else, survive hard enemy waves also fully customizable. Buy items on the black market and create unique matches with your own personal touch. YOUR life, YOUR rules.

name: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards

details.title: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards
details.short_description: A text-based RPG adventure. Uncover an epic story of decay and rebirth in a new world, 200 years after humanity's arrival. Guide multiple protagonists through an immersive narrative, diverse gameplay, and a dynamic art style. An unforgettable experience awaits!

details.title: Breath of Digital God
details.short_description: Become a digital god in a fast-paced meditative bullet hell. Freeze time, reverse reality, and survive waves of chaotic energy synced to music. Master your abilities and reach the highest level of reality.

details.title: NETRUN
details.short_description: With dual grappling hooks in hand, swing, thrust, and dash your way to victory in this fast, momentum-based precision platformer packed with traps, enemies, and physics-based challenges.

name: DARK・PLANETARIUM~ダーク・プラネタリウム〜

details.title: DARK・PLANETARIUM~ダーク・プラネタリウム〜
details.short_description: 『DARK・PLANETARIUM』PLANETARIUM×HORROR GAME.Girl &deformed head get lost in a dark planetarium an a dying planet and travel through space. 「Don't forget. This planet」It features antique pixel art with a space theme.

details.title: Undead Yet Again
details.short_description: You are patient zero. Punch humans. Spread the undead. Mutate your zombie horde into an unstoppable vessel of apocalypse. And then do it all over again.

details.title: NANOTINKER
details.short_description: Nanotinker is an isometric 3D plateformer. Use your tools and your mind to evolve in an abstract universe that blends known plateformer and puzzle features. Unriddle environmental puzzles, progress and outsmart traps to unravel a mysterious story.

details.title: ガッチャ！サバイバー
details.short_description: A roguelike action game where you absorb bullets to fight. Switch between Light and Dark, turn bullets into energy, and unleash powerful bursts! Build your skills and survive the overwhelming bullet storm.

details.title: Fieldwork
details.short_description: Your editor sent you to explore an abandoned ship graveyard. Photograph the evidence, stay quiet and get out alive.

details.title: Broken Masks
details.short_description: Enter an abandoned orphanage, solve unsettling puzzles, and uncover its terrible secrets. Living toys, dark presences, and haunted corridors will push your sanity to the limit. Can you survive the horror lurking within?

details.title: STORMY
details.short_description: Turn a sheet of paper into your controller using your webcam, or stick to standard controls. Journey across a vast planetary system to save your lost ally while piloting spaceships, exploring as a robot, fighting, trading, racing, mining, and cultivating life forms.

details.title: Ocean Homeward:Soul Summoner Survivors
details.short_description: Play as a Soul Summoner, sail the nether Ocean, survive monster hordes. Awaken spirits, collect soul fragments, craft gear sets and build unique combat styles. Upgrade spirits, forge affixes, unlock legendary captains and vessels. Purify the Ocean, lead spirits Homeward, uncover nether sea secrets.

details.title: CatDude & Karsh
details.short_description: A boss rush adventure with moderately challenging combat and cozy hub world activities, including fishing, hotel management, and market trading.

details.title: Whale Cleaner
details.short_description: Take charge of a deep-sea wash station for filthy marine giants! Upgrade bizarre bio-industrial tools to scrub whales, dolphins, sharks and other mysterious beasts. Get them spotless before Mr. Claw docks your pay in this relaxing, atmospheric, and satisfying cleaning simulator. Find hidden secrets!

details.title: Fixpert
details.short_description: Fixpert is a classic block-pusher style puzzle game. Help the titular Fixpert repair the factory and solve it's many head-scratching brain teasers! Using crates as bridges to cross bodies of water, buttons to open doors and power battery-chargers, managing fires and explosives, AND MORE!

details.title: Grow/Tend/Reap
details.short_description: Every seed you plant removes a card from your deck. Every harvest brings it back. Your farm IS your deck. Grow crops. Tend fields. Reap what you sow.

details.title: Don't Hang Up
details.short_description: A short visual novel where you play as a payphone that is going through its last night before being shut down. How this night will go is up to you.

details.title: BONKER LADS
details.short_description: BONKER LADS is a sandbox chaos battle simulator where you can build armies, set up battles, and watch fighters and military vehicles clash.

details.title: 失序的我与乐园
details.short_description: This is an adventure that takes place in an amusement park. Players will explore strange scenes, meet mysterious companions, and uncover the truth behind the 'Disorderly Park' program through turn-based battles and story choices.

details.title: 大收藏家
details.short_description: "The Collector" is a multiplayer auction game of sealed bids and hidden information. Face three players in five-round auctions for a container of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues, place secret bids, and compete for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more.

details.title: Cats Out
details.short_description: The cats are out. They are everywhere, being a mess, stealing everything. Call your friends or if you're brave enough, take them on alone. Get your brooms ready, aim your slippers and go to War with those hungry little thieves!

details.title: Geometrical
details.short_description: Geometrical is an addictive hybrid of a survivors-like and an incremental endless progression. Face waves of enemies, improve your stats after each round, and get ready to battle a final boss every 7 days. Will you be able to defeat the 5 great bosses?

details.title: Blast Off!
details.short_description: Blast Off is a cute space adventure game. You’ve crash-landed in a tiny, strange solar system with only your trusty magnet gun and a sarcastic robot drone at your side. Explore unique planets, solve magnetic puzzles, and collect the scattered parts of your ship so you can get home!

details.title: Sky Rush
details.short_description: Race as birds down colorful slopes, build speed by sliding smoothly, and compete for best times with friends across diverse worlds like Mushroom, Grass, and Ice. Fun, fast-paced, and all about improving your record.

details.title: The Man Who Walked
details.short_description: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

details.title: Atlas Proxima: Tether
details.short_description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

details.title: The Fridge
details.short_description: THE FRIDGE is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps. Find or purchase weapons in each run and face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Obtain magical catalysts to boost your weapons’ power and experiment with different combinations to adapt your combat style.

details.title: Isekai Guardians
details.short_description: Text-Based MMORPG in an isekai anime fantasy world.

details.title: On the Rocks
details.short_description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Scavenge the wasteland, brew with what you find, and serve whoever comes through your doors. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run together.

details.title: Five Shifts at Zlata’s
details.short_description: Five Shifts at Zlata's is an atmospheric horror night-shift simulator where you play as a security mechanic in a family restaurant hiding dark secrets. Monitor cameras, manage power, restart the generator, and keep the animatronics-mascots away. Survive five shifts… if you can.

details.title: Backrooms: Eternals
details.short_description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

details.title: Fever Tilt
details.short_description: Fever Tilt is a fast 1v1 zero-G arena where you mine gems, weaponize drifting debris, and sabotage your opponent with lasers, forcefields, and explosives. Procedural arenas and physics-driven chaos make every 3–7 minute match a ruthless fight to score first.

details.title: Ominous Gift
details.short_description: Escape this dungeon that's like a prison! Embark on an adventure through the remnants of an ancient kingdom, using unique weapons that define how you traverse the world, fight your way through hostile inhabitants as you find the path out of this dungeon that was once a great kingdom.

details.title: The Final Hold
details.short_description: You and your teammates must survive as long as possible against relentless robots and deadly creatures. Your aim matters, but so does your strategy. Every enemy type fights differently, so stay ready. Fortify your base with turrets, healing stations, traps and a variety of upgrades.

details.title: North Pole Defense
details.short_description: A blood-soaked horde shooter in a fully destructible voxel North Pole. Grab your guns, call in sleigh strikes and dig through the walls as you and up to three friends defend Christmas against endless waves of undead elves, Krampus, and worse.

name: ECHOES OF THE VALKYRIE THE SWORD OF AGES

details.title: ECHOES OF THE VALKYRIE THE SWORD OF AGES
details.short_description: A groundbreaking 3D dungeon RPG where you aim for the ultimate goal — the 999th floor. Live-action footage and 3D CG merge to create an overwhelming sense of immersion, where reality and fantasy intertwine. Explore hyper-realistic dungeons and face powerful monsters that will test her fate.

details.title: Pharmacy 24
details.short_description: Pharmacy 24 is a horror simulator game where you take on the role of a pharmacist, serving customers and taking care of the Pharmacy... Who knows, maybe one day it will accept you.

details.title: Hex-Caliber
details.short_description: Dive into the depths of Hell's Vestibule as a gunned Ritualist. Fight off roaming scores of monsters by empowering your firearms with spells and Rituals in a fast-paced dungeon crawler roguelike.

name: Rare Metal War: The sins of memory

details.title: Rare Metal War: The sins of memory
details.short_description: Iron beasts. Furry heroes. One last hope. In a world where humanity has fallen, unlikely saviors rise from the animal kingdom. Strap into your customized mech, unleash devastating firepower, and fight through endless waves of enemies in this action-packed survivor roguelike.

details.title: FireFly
details.short_description: A momentum-driven 2D platforming adventure where mastering movement unlocks exploration. Leap, slide, and swing through vibrant open maps as a grounded firefly searching for family and hidden secrets.

details.title: Phantom Lamb
details.short_description: Play a story-driven third-person psychological thriller set in a sinister early-20th-century asylum where reality bends under the weight of forgotten horrors. Phantom Lamb blends tense stealth gameplay with an immersive narrative of haunting secrets and psychological dread.

details.title: REALM ARCANA
details.short_description: REALM ARCANA is a 1v1 online strategy card game. Take turns deploying units, combine abilities and positioning, and adapt to randomized battlefields that change the rules of combat. Read the field, outplay your opponent, and find a new path to victory each match.

details.title: Serenity Sketch
details.short_description: Relax and paint with water in Serenity Sketch, a guided mindfulness sandbox. Create ephemeral art, follow gentle voice prompts in atmospheric landscapes, and find stillness in letting go. A self-care ritual where each evaporating brushstroke brings freedom and reflection.

details.title: SILKRUN
details.short_description: SILKRUN is an arcade racing game! Master silky smooth powerslides around insane tracks, even on a keyboard — race against time, computer opponents, and online in different weather conditions and time of day. Super Cars 2 meets Slicks 'N Slide, Outrun, Stunts & The Need for Speed in modern 3D racing!

details.title: Whenster
details.short_description: Who knows when what happened? Whenster is a timeline card game for friends: place movies, TV series, video games, inventions and historic events in the right order before the clock runs out. Host on Steam, and your friends join for free right in their browser.

name: Blue Men Group ULTIMATE VIDEO BLACKJACK

details.title: Blue Men Group ULTIMATE VIDEO BLACKJACK
details.short_description: The Blue Men Group are energetic, enigmatic, interacting, arousing, performing, embarrassing, feeling, alarming, inspiring, desperate, hateful, impressive and performative. Join us at computer playing our Ultimate Video BlackJack collection. Unlock video, gameplay, get blowmanjobs, you will enjoy

details.title: DiceVenture Dungeon
details.short_description: DiceVenture Dungeon is a roguelike dice-building dungeon crawler. Choose your path, roll and reroll to unleash class skills, and craft your build with dice, relics, and traits. Take on dice challenges for greater rewards—every run brings new choices and combinations.

details.title: STATO
details.short_description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

details.title: Grid Gear TD
details.short_description: Why settle for a tower that only does one job? Slow the front line with Cryo Round, yank the pack into a black hole with Gravity Well, and fry the pileup with Chain Arc. All on one tower—as long as you can fit them onto the grid.

details.title: Tower of Insolence
details.short_description: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

details.title: A Game About Popping Bubbles
details.short_description: A relaxing, cozy, classic screensaver-inspired game about popping bubbles with satisfying VFX and SFX. Upgrade your equipment for even better pops, unlock achievements, and uncover a mysterious secret.

details.title: The Castle of the West
details.short_description: A fast-paced, fantasy-themed boomer shooter inspired by the greats. Take down various creatures from Goblins to Skeletons with your rapid-fire crossbow through various hand crafted non-linear fps stages. What's not to love?

details.title: Towers to Be
details.short_description: Platform and zoom around a dream-like world to discover what happened to the mind of this patient.

details.title: Floodline Legion
details.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are a living army. Summon units onto a single lane in real time, manage your mana, and let a clean deterministic battle play out. Forge a Swarm, a blessed elite, or a spreading plague — then climb.

details.title: HANA: Neon Petals
details.short_description: This game is a Japanese card adventure game set in a cyberpunk world. Play “Hanafuda” to defeat enemies and help the girl bring the neon lights back to the city! *“Hanafuda” is a traditional Japanese card game similar to poker.

details.title: Silent Nightmare: Willow Lane
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a young woman whose ordinary evening slowly descends into a nightmare. Uncover the truth, make the right choices, and survive the night.

details.title: Manage Town Together
details.short_description: Build your business and help a small town thrive! Run your own market, deliver orders, drive with friends, maintain your vehicle, and grow the community together in this relaxing co-op life simulation.

details.title: Flemenco
details.short_description: A spy-heist traditional roguelike! Become a criminal and interfere in the nefarious dealings of the ubiquitous Flemenco Corporation. Break into data centers to expose illicit records, infiltrate office buildings, perform elaborate acrobatic feats, and much more!

details.title: Robin Hood: Death to Tyrants
details.short_description: In this First Person Shooter, you are Robin Hood. Steal from the evil, rescue the poor and become a Legend.

details.title: MiniCook
details.short_description: Play as a street food vendor at a night market, grilling and selling skewers. Earn enough to buy a fried rice cart and expand your business. Save more to open your own bubble tea shop. The game focuses on the experience of running a food business, with management as a secondary element.

details.title: cutichoria
details.short_description: This is a mystery puzzle game that blends traditional Chinese fairy tales with surrealism. Explore this unsettling yet dazzling world, spend a beautiful day here, and uncover the secrets buried deep within the Zhenyan Lake Sanatorium!

details.title: Unburied
details.short_description: Unburied is a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades and towers by day, then hold your keep by night as the dead pour in. Turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, shape your build, and survive until dawn turns them to ash.

details.title: SSN: Artemis
details.short_description: Command a nuclear-powered attack submarine in a modern warfare sim. Hunt enemy ships, evade hostile aircraft, stalk enemy vessels and strike from the shadows. Every contact is uncertain. Every choice carries risk. Every weapon fired may reveal your position.

details.title: OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery
details.short_description: Stack your cart to the absolute limit and conquer a massive high-rise apartment! OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery is a chaotic physics-based delivery simulator. Balance fragile packages like Tetris, beat the unforgiving clock, and avoid corporate fines. Survive the daily grind solo or in co-op!

details.title: Flowering Void
details.short_description: Alone and newly awakened, uncover the secrets of this dark and unusual world by fighting and defending against the cruel environment.

details.title: Master Thief
details.short_description: Become the ultimate burglar in this witty 1-4 player co-op heist game. Craft your character, hone your skills, and pull off daring thefts as you rise from small-time crook to Master Thief!

details.title: Bilingual Crosswords
details.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

details.title: FOREX GAMING FX
details.short_description: We offer a special program that allows you to improve your skills with just 10 minutes of training per day through high-speed training using currency charts. There are three courses to choose from: one for beginners, one for advanced traders, and one for AI automated trading.

details.title: Our Ephemeral Nights
details.short_description: As he enters his final semester of college, Kev continues to wonder if there’s something more to the future he’s carving out for himself. After a chance encounter with Vivi, an aspiring voice actor also in her final semester, he experiences the beautiful and fleeting days before his graduation.

details.title: SGS Vietnam War
details.short_description: The Vietnam War remains one of the most emblematic conflicts of the Cold War era. Relive, on each side, the epic fight for dominance in this key Southeast Asia conflict from US intervention in 1965 till the Fall of Saigon in 1975.

details.title: Magic Cards Duel
details.short_description: A wild party card game for 2-4 players. Jumpscare, stun, and blur your friends, but watch out: they can counter, reflect, or even steal your attacks. Chain epic combos and outplay everyone!

details.title: Unburden
details.short_description: UNBURDEN is a casual, adventure game in which you guide Mark on a journey to shed his heavy burden of precious possessions while helping others he meets along the way. All in an effort to restore the vibrancy and lightness life once held.

details.title: Send In The Vampires
details.short_description: Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up. Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

details.title: Roll For Damage!
details.short_description: A light dice-based dungeon crawl. Roll numerous dice and see fortunes expand across various distinct stages.

details.title: Paranormal Research Society
details.short_description: Build a career as a paranormal field researcher in an exciting horror comedy about finally getting a job and gunning down ghosts while performing menial labor for your infuriating boss.

details.title: Recovered Occurrence
details.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

details.title: On Sight
details.short_description: On Sight is a love letter to classic shooters that drops players into high energy gunfights in arenas across the galaxy. Play with friends, strangers, or solo with bot support on every map.

details.title: Escape from Ashville
details.short_description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

name: Reunions with you billions of times

details.title: Reunions with you billions of times
details.short_description: This is a short, romance-focused visual novel where you play as a student. As you fall in love with your classmate Qiu, you become trapped in a time loop and die again and again. Together with Qiu, you must search for a way to break the loop, with your choices leading to different endings.

details.title: ZHITEN
details.short_description: Some villages aren't just abandoned, they are cursed. Zhiten, a victim of clashing cults, awakens from its slumber with Nikolay's return. While Nikolay searches for traces of the past, he will be forced to meet the village's new owners.

details.title: Mad MOJO
details.short_description: Mad MOJO is a monster-catching deckbuilder with a deep, fourth-wall-breaking meta game hidden beneath the surface. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO with poker-inspired hands. Break the game by tackling puzzles in an in-game PC. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

details.title: 6RAVITY CUBE
details.short_description: “Novel 6-direction gravity puzzle‑action game!” Packed with diverse gimmicks — experience intuitive yet strategically deep puzzle‑solving!

details.title: Reaction
details.short_description: Fly your ship though a derelict space station in this action/puzzle 2D platformer as you avoid hazards, repair your ship back to working condition and uncover the mysteries within. What awaits inside and can you get out again?

details.title: Humanity's Fall
details.short_description: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

details.title: Crosstown
details.short_description: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

details.title: Subway Story
details.short_description: A narrative-driven exploration game set in the New York City subway, where you ride trains, interact with strangers, and make choices that shape how the city's underbelly responds.

details.title: For the Glory of Wilson
details.short_description: For the Glory of Wilson is an action roguelite where you recruit allies who fight alongside you and influence every battle.

details.title: BLACKMURK: Shuffling Man
details.short_description: Fear is real. Sometimes tragedy needs nothing more than that. 💀 A short visual novel based on the story of the same name — about the silence that lets something shuffling into your home. 👁️👁️

details.title: 离校 School's Out
details.short_description: A first-person 3D horror adventure. Trapped in a mysterious world modeled after an old school, an amnesiac hero teams up with enigmatic heroines to face looping spaces and terrifying monsters. As they seek escape and the truth, they begin to break free from the fate that binds them.

details.title: The Dark Curiosity
details.short_description: First-person psychological sci-fi horror set on an abandoned space station. Left alone, you explore and piece together what happened. Something is moving in the dark, and the closer you get to the truth, the closer it gets to you.

details.title: THE DAY THAT WASN'T
details.short_description: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

details.title: Impulse Vector: Fighter Ops
details.short_description: As an independent contractor aboard a corporate carrier, pilot your Space Superiority Fighter on missions for rival organisations. Protect miners, strike enemy stations, and patrol the void to earn your keep and build your company’s name across the frontier!

details.title: RatSpire
details.short_description: RatSpire is a top-down survivor roguelite focused on minion progression and auto-battling, choosing your own path. Recruit quirky classes, stack weapons, potions, and relics to craft absurd builds, and the higher you climb, the better it feels. Hands off — let your legion fight for you.

details.title: Infected Zone Survival
details.short_description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

details.title: Act! Autonomy: Cell-Tones
details.short_description: Act! Cellular Tuning—a rhythm game with fully innovative free-input gameplay—is set to launch in Winter 2026! Relax, immerse yourself fully, and tune your unique movement in the ocean of the subconscious!

details.title: Cup Or Die
details.short_description: Every cup is a gamble. Play deadly beer pong, take your chances, and find a way out.

name: To the Stars: Do Maid Robots Dream of Electric Grapefruit

details.title: To the Stars: Do Maid Robots Dream of Electric Grapefruit
details.short_description: This is a Visual Novel RPG where you role play as a maid robot in a post-apocalyptic world, where pollution made the ground surface no longer liveable; Your purpose is to help your USER build her spaceship "The Golden Star" and eventually witness her journey into the sapce.

details.title: Purrfect Ascent
details.short_description: A minimalist Foddian-style precision platformer with an unusual control scheme: the character automatically jumps when moving left or right, and jump height scales directly with horizontal speed up to a maximum. A brutal ascent to rescue your frightened kitty. Meow.

details.title: Harvestville: Song of the Ancestress
details.short_description: A farming/life-sim game with a folk horror twist. An enigmatic deity has convinced the residents of Harvestville to conduct an unorthodox ritual. Grow crops, connect with the townsfolk, and uncover the terrifying secrets waiting beneath the surface...

details.title: Kintsugi
details.short_description: Take a cinematic adventure through the world of Kintsugi as you use different movement abilities to traverse through its magical landscape and save wounded creatures from the Corruption.

details.title: XENOBLAST
details.short_description: XENOBLAST is a chaotic party game where you battle for glory throughout the unknown universe. Use lasers, missiles, phasers and many more weapons to devastate your opponents. With a heavy focus on movement, this game encourages the use of gravity fields and movement devices to dominate your foes.

details.title: Case File: Archived 3:12AM
details.short_description: At 3:12 AM, someone knocked. The door was locked from the inside. A story-rich psychological horror where you explore and investigate a Kolkata home as reality begins to repeat, change, and remember.

details.title: Alone After Dark: Head Practitioner
details.short_description: Attend to patients and fill out paperwork as 22-year-old Kimora Jackson on her first shift after graduating nursing school. Draw blood, administer medications, and try not to lose your head in the chilling hallways of Coldrock Medical Center.

details.title: City of Hunger
details.short_description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

details.title: Turbo Ziggurat
details.short_description: You are a tiny creature in a living human city. Talk to NPCs out loud to find clues, track down crystal balls, and steal them before the enemy team does. A chaotic team PvP game.

details.title: 蛊道The Reverend's Path
details.short_description: An innovative roguelite real-time combat game of one-handed, effortless spell programming. Wield arcane Gu, pick it up intuitively, and carve out your supreme Path of Gu across two layers: the Killer Move Board (build your skills) and the Condition Pool (set when they fire).

details.title: EVO Card
details.short_description: A biopunk roguelike deckbuilder where you evolve by stealing enemy organs. Devour rivals, mutate your entire body, fuse material cards, and build the ultimate chimera. Kill or be eaten—become the apex predator.

details.title: Snack Factory Together
details.short_description: Manage a snack factory together! Produce various treats for maximum profit. Upgrade machines, unlock new products, and deliver massive orders. Can you handle the demand?

details.title: Mage On The Move
details.short_description: Mage on the Move is a rouge like game with many upgrades and things to unlock to avoid dying from the robots that will chase you through your runs. Purchase stat upgrades with skill points and physical upgrades with the legendary currency of the Vietnamese dong (in game currency only).

details.title: Lane of the Eternal Night
details.short_description: An exploratory, self-chosen experience type of light roguelike turn-based pixel indie game, currently without much storyline. Although the combat is turn-based, it’s more like a rock-paper-scissors style game mode, and it also includes skills.

details.title: Fast Food Wars
details.short_description: Fast Food Wars is a bullet-hell shoot'em up rogue-lite game in a procedural generated restaurant with random power ups, weapons. You play as a burger fighting to claim back all the invaded burger restaurant from other fast foods

details.title: Sepium
details.short_description: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

details.title: Mars Base Alley
details.short_description: Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet—one alley at a time.

details.title: Wild Wordopia
details.short_description: Language x roguelike. The incarnations of an ancient language (Proto-Indo-European) that is said to have existed about 6,000 years ago are reborn as "Wild Words"!

details.title: Lushlands Adventure
details.short_description: Reach the finish without being seen in a cozy top-down stealth puzzle adventure. Sneak past guards, use distractions, push objects, and explore colorful pixel-art areas from farms and forests to caves and snowy villages.

details.title: ObeyE
details.short_description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a [Fake] New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!

details.title: FalseGods Gambit
details.short_description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

details.title: The New Year's School
details.short_description: The world's first cooperative survival quiz! Face challenging questions in this pixel-art horror JRPG and survive through 7 fields of knowledge with your friends!

details.title: The Book of the Alchemist
details.short_description: 1980s America. A dying doctor follows the call of an ancient book to a fog-shrouded town of disappearances, unsolved murders, and secrets. Dark alchemy offers a cure—at a horrific price. Will you die human, or kill your humanity to survive?

details.title: Stuck in a Trench
details.short_description: You are the High Command. Guide generals as they send soldiers through wartime trenches, make agonizing strategic choices, learn from campaign outcomes, and build a lasting legacy across many fronts.

details.title: One Last Push
details.short_description: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

details.title: Recalibration
details.short_description: Take down all your enemies using as few bullets as possible. Be both stylish and efficient – that’s what a true assassin is all about. Uncover the betrayal, track down the culprits, and bring them to justice in the name of global peace.

details.title: Jacaro: Looming Dread
details.short_description: A single session of Jacaro stands between you and a fate worse than death. Whilst something is lurking and waiting for a mistake.

details.title: SkyRen
details.short_description: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

details.title: Kōyō
details.short_description: Fast, satisfying top-down combat meets cozy progression. Slay yokai, grab loot, craft upgrades, and explore an Edo-inspired valley in a stylized 2.5D action RPG.

details.title: SHATTERSHAPE
details.short_description: SHATTERSHAPE is an arcade-style shooter in which you are a lone circle fighting hordes of enemies with evil vertices. SHATTER your enemies with numerous power-ups. ONLY THE ROUND SURVIVE.

details.title: TAKE OUT
details.short_description: "Take Out" is an emotion-driven visual novel and rhythm adventure about 30 days with Morning, an android delivered to your home. Your choices shape your bond, while each day's emotions unfold in webtoon-style cutscenes and rhythm gameplay as she grows from a household assistant into a band vocalist.

details.title: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
details.short_description: You are randomly assigned “Civic Disturbance Duty” and must complete tasks using the power of your butt. Explore a world filled with absurd gameplay, chaotic tasks, and mediocre visuals.

details.title: Boundless Evil: Awakening
details.short_description: A first-person horror experience set in a desolate highlands village. Track your missing archaeologist sister, unravel her clues through exploration and puzzles, scavange for loot and face the dark force she accidentally unleashed.

details.title: BOLD: Networked Newt Action
details.short_description: BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

details.title: Andromis
details.short_description: Mission-driven third-person action game with 50 explosive missions. Fight rogue machines, rescue civilians, and battle across a war-torn city and iconic locations. Drive cars, armed vehicles, and a tank while unleashing heavy weapons and large-scale urban destruction.

details.title: PonySide
details.short_description: PonySide is a 2D top-down fantasy RPG built for cooperative multiplayer adventure. Create your own unique character, team up with friends, and explore a world filled with danger, mystery, and opportunity.

details.title: Escape from Area 51
details.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi detective puzzle game where mind reading, shapeshifting, and social roles open different paths through the game. Explore Area 51, use dialogue, avoid enemies, and uncover a conspiracy inside a secret military base.

details.title: AGENCY
details.short_description: We made a weird game. You play as π.

details.title: Theobald's Adventure - Micro RPG
details.short_description: Monsters have invaded the kingdom, taking advantage of the knights' annual holiday! You are the last hope! Equip yourself with weapons and fight the monsters surrounding you in this turn-based game with your spinning attacks across a dozen fantasy worlds!

details.title: Follow Dalian
details.short_description: Hack, Slash, and Loot! A pixel-art Action Roguelike built on two pillars: the visceral thrill of mowing down hordes and the endless addiction of grinding for gear. Meticulously craft your build with weapons, armor, gadgets, and skills, evolve it inside the run, then unleash satisfying carnage!

details.title: The Last Wait
details.short_description: Trapped in a sterile hospital, clinging to life, you anticipate your daughter’s arrival as reality slowly begins to slip. Your only chance is to endure the long, suffocating wait. The Last Wait. Can you hold on long enough to see her once more?

details.title: VERDGE
details.short_description: VERDGE is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

details.title: FatSheep Crisis:RE
details.short_description: Baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa. Baa.

details.title: Frog Up!
details.short_description: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don’t fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

details.title: Rise to Power: Banana Republic
details.short_description: The dictator is dead and democracy is up for grabs. Rise from nobody to president of Isla Paraíso: win or rig elections, buy the press, capture the courts, survive coups. A deeply simulated political sandbox where every path to power is open. Even the worst ones.

details.title: HeroesSagaZero
details.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

details.title: Crosstalk
details.short_description: Juna Park's broken implant shuts down every device around her, and the city wants her gone. You play Cal Rowe, the PI keeping her alive. She can say stop. Whether you listen decides how much she trusts you, and every one of the ten endings costs something.

details.title: Unknown Call: Ohio
details.short_description: You wake up in an empty forest in Ohio. A voice calls you. Says you're friends. Says you need to get out. But the signal keeps breaking, and so does your memory. Your friend will guide you from a distance, but he can't save you. Escape the creatures in the dark and find your friend.

details.title: Carouspell
details.short_description: Carouspell is a dark fantasy roguelite bullet heaven where you wield revolving magic to slay hordes of monsters. Spin your Spell Chamber, collect ancient relics and assemble god-slaying combinations to survive the deepest pits of despair.

details.title: Combo Smith
details.short_description: Combo-Smith is a Strategy FPS game where you combine your current weapons to create better ones. Defeat the Opposing team by Creating Crazy Combo's that wipe them all out, The limit is your imagination.

name: 结界大阵：生灵庇护所 Warding Sanctum: Creature Refuge

details.title: 结界大阵：生灵庇护所 Warding Sanctum: Creature Refuge
details.short_description: A strategy game blending Xianxia (cultivation) elements with tower defense and settlement-building mechanics. Recruit and cultivate creatures, fuse them into formations, repel demon invasions from the outside world, and build your Creature Sanctuary.

details.title: We Die Below
details.short_description: 1–4 player co-op dungeon crawler. Choose your class and gear! Fight through procedural dungeons, complete objectives, and outrun the horrors you awaken. Deep combat. High stakes. Permadeath if your party falls.

details.title: Crimson Monarch
details.short_description: The old Monarch is dead. Long live the Monarch. Rule over five vampire factions, forge alliances, and decide who lives or dies. Protect the Veil of secrecy or let it burn. Every judgment creates friends or enemies in a high-stakes political visual novel

details.title: Defend The Nest
details.short_description: Help two super intelligent crows make silly weapons out of whatever junk they can find in a city park, and then watch them fight off a horde of critters. A relaxing and yet chaotic auto battling roguelike.

details.title: S4NCTU4RY
details.short_description: A cyberpunk bar that runs at the bottom of your screen. Build your menu around the synergies of 50 cocktails, and welcome 15 guests in Story Mode. Your job is to make one drink a sanctuary for the exhausted.

details.title: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own bakery in space as orders start stacking up. Keep the machines moving, prepare sweet treats, manage your robot helpers, and turn your little shop into the galaxy’s busiest bakery — solo or with friends.

name: Fuse Beads Simulator ~ Debt Payoff Story

details.title: Fuse Beads Simulator ~ Debt Payoff Story
details.short_description: Create and sell various pieces of art using fuse beads. Earn money to cover your daily expenses and pay off your debts. As your Store Level grows, you'll unlock useful tools and new types of beads

details.title: Cats and cats and coffees!
details.short_description: Your new coworkers have paws, tiny aprons, and ambitious nap schedules. Build a cozy idle cafe on your desktop: hire cats, brew coffee, open themed cafes, and fill your album with rare visitors while you work or unwind.

details.title: THREE KINGDOMS: STRATEGY SIMULATOR
details.short_description: Three Kingdoms Strategy Simulator is an AI-native historical strategy title. Every NPC possesses independent cognition and persistent long-term memory. None of the regional warlords are pre-scripted routines hardcoded into the game engine.

details.title: Grindbound
details.short_description: A single-player, top-down 3D auto-looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore dungeons, defeat enemies, collect randomized gear, and combine skills and equipment to create powerful builds. No complex controls or quick reflexes required.

details.title: Pawns into the Dark
details.short_description: Everything is visible but the Dark. Reveal tiles beside your pawns, step by step, in an 8×8 board-game-inspired tactical puzzler. Uncertain exploration meets deterministic combat. No misses, no critical hits: 3 ATK defeats a pawn with 3 HP. Read what's visible, use limited resources, and survive.

details.title: Slash And Dash
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a shape-shifting hero and dash through random realms in this pixel-art action runner rogue-lite! Can you defeat powerful bosses and save the world? Collect diamonds, upgrade your stats, and prepare for the ultimate showdown!!!

name: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory

details.title: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory
details.short_description: Play by yourself or with a friend in this action puzzler. With tons of power up combinations, zany sound effects and music you'll never get bored.

details.title: Lost Exit
details.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

details.title: Overserved: Food Fighters!
details.short_description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

name: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分

details.title: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分
details.short_description: "The world of deity : Part 1" is the free first part of a sci-fi romance ADV "The world of deity" published by Cloudside Games. By cooperating with "little sister" Yiran to uncover the truth behind the chemical plant explosion, players can gradually discover the hidden secrets behind this world.

details.title: ALTAR CORP
details.short_description: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

details.title: Star Seed Protocol
details.short_description: Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival shooter where you aim your own weapons, deploy turrets and drones, reshape your build with implants, research new technology, and fight through alien swarms across varied mission types.

details.title: 10000 BC
details.short_description: Build a civilization from the Stone Age to the distant future in this roguelike strategy game. Recruit unique residents, construct your settlement, survive enemy waves, and shape history through difficult choices.

details.title: Aiya Desire
details.short_description: Exploration × Rhythm Game × Horror Adventure?! After her mother dies and her father disappears, Aiya heads to Sentinel Radio Tower. Explore, solve puzzles, talk, flee a relentless pursuer, and survive 2-button rhythm boss fights. Did HC, the Harmony Chip, end the Infection Panic—or hide a secret?

details.title: Stellar Abyss
details.short_description: Stellar Abyss is an online space sandbox. Command and customize your ship as you explore, fight, mine, manufacture, and trade between star systems. Take on contracts alone or join a fleet for rescue and escort missions. Start with a small ship and find your next opportunity among the stars.

details.title: Creovia
details.short_description: A 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build worlds, craft gear, explore dangerous subworlds, trade with players, and grow your legacy in a persistent, player-driven universe.

details.title: Lang Ops: Corrupted Files
details.short_description: Malicious virus attacked your PC which contained all your files! During the recovering process, file code showed as letters in different languages. Therefore, you've created special forces of cursors to counter the corrupted files!

details.title: VCR83
details.short_description: VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

details.title: The Idle Captain
details.short_description: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.

details.title: Hypercube
details.short_description: An exhilarating FPS-style combat game featuring fully destructible arenas. The more you fight on, the less of the level you have left to fight in!

details.title: BOKOSUKA WARS II
details.short_description: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

details.title: One Last Draw
details.short_description: One Last Draw is a thrilling roguelike card game: HIT or STAND? Keep drawing to boost your score, earn money, and discover powerful Cards, Chips, and Items. But the more you draw, the greater the chance of hitting a Bomb Card and losing everything. Score enough to advance!

details.title: YOLKA: 90s New Year Simulator
details.short_description: Snow and chill outside, but warmth in your heart. In this nostalgic first-person simulator, dive back into childhood and get ready for New Year’s Eve. Decorate the tree, build a snowman, play, and fully immerse yourself in the cozy vibe of the 90s.

details.title: OrderlyWorld
details.short_description: Build a supply chain. Roll an elemental army. Survive the waves. Choose a finite hero pool, produce resources for hero draws, and build deeper chains for rarer heroes. Adapt your formation to every roll and enemy threat.

details.title: StarFrame
details.short_description: A single persistent galaxy shared by every player. Full loot. Rich skill system. Exploration, Industry, PvE/PvP Combat

details.title: Anomagram
details.short_description: Anomagram is a horror set on a night shift moderating a short-video feed. More slices of someone else's ordinary life arrive each night, and you approve or report each one. Some videos are not normal. The anomaly doesn't stay inside the video. It reaches the terminal, and you. Eight nights.

details.title: Buildcraft TD
details.short_description: Build powerful defenses, expand your village, and unlock new technologies in this strategic tower defense game. Gather resources, strengthen your economy, and survive increasingly challenging enemy waves.

details.title: Arms Race
details.short_description: The enemy that kills you robs your grave, takes your build, and comes back next run wearing it. A bullet hell roguelite with no chests, 100+ mutating items, and a different continent's mythology on every floor.

details.title: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture
details.short_description: One wrong delivery can start a war. Smuggle cargo in a Tetris-style hold. Dodge faction inspections. Betray whoever pays. A pixel-art space rogue-like where every run is one bad jump from total loss.

details.title: Rabbit On The Rails
details.short_description: A short 3D side-scrolling puzzle horror game set on a mysterious circus train. Explore eerie train cars, solve unsettling puzzles, and guide a young girl as she tries to escape a world that feels both warm and deeply disturbing.

details.title: Get Stoned
details.short_description: Get Stoned is an incremental tower defense game where players design their own bullet loadouts. Gather resources, unlock unique boulders, and discover game-breaking synergies while defending your castle. It's time for everything to get stoned!

details.title: The Real Guest
details.short_description: Warning: Do not go outside. Keep your doors tightly shut. Pull the curtains closed. Only allow humans to enter. Eliminate all "impostors".

details.title: Cult Inc.
details.short_description: Cult Inc. is an incremental clicker where you control and grow a cult. Attract curious outsiders and persuade them into joining the organization. Upgrade your cult, unlock new abilities, and dominate the world through sheer numbers, with a little sacrifice of course.

details.title: Defense Of Legends
details.short_description: A tower defense where your towers are heroes. Upgrade them, equip powerful items, create unique builds, and discover devastating combinations to stop endless enemy waves from reaching the portal.

details.title: Forgotten Possessions
details.short_description: Find and collect items that tell a dark story in an abandoned log cabin, but watch out for what lurks behind you. You sneak through dark rooms against a relentless, adaptive creature. Experience a dynamic world with randomized item locations and a reactive environment.

details.title: One Matter, One Hexagram
details.short_description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

details.title: Bookshelves
details.short_description: A cozy board game for you and your friends. Draft books from library carts, line them up by genre and fill your shelf for points. Up to 4 players online, with bots for the empty seats, plus a fresh Daily Curate puzzle every day.

name: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT

details.title: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT
details.short_description: Real or AI? A solo spot-the-fake game show against GEN, the robot host who made the fakes. Two exhibits, one real: zoom into pictures, walk around 3D dioramas, stake your call, slam READY. The reveal circles the tell. 3 campaigns, 7 contestant classes; win a campaign and you drop an anvil on GEN.

details.title: Ceti Break
details.short_description: Your cursor is you. Dodge and lunge as you attack and evade at the speed and accuracy of your mouse control. Fill out the skill tree for buffs and bonuses to help you survive the waves that grow in number and strength.

details.title: 101 Cats: Guangzhou
details.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Guangzhou landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

details.title: Rubblebound
details.short_description: Rubblebound is a minimalist idle game with roguelite elements. Unleash the balls, build skills, break bricks, upgrade, repeat. And see your power grow in this incremental game.

details.title: Dungeon Wizard
details.short_description: Hover, pop, upgrade, repeat! Pop!Corn is a pixel-art incremental game about turning a handful of kernels into a popcorn frenzy. Unlock five flavors, grow a branching skill tree, and build better cooking gear until every batch bursts with rewards.

details.title: Velikopolsky Chess
details.short_description: Classic chess game is re-envisioned with Ukrainian folklore and style. Chess pieces that talk with an attitude. Many chess board styles, chess pieces sets, online, LAN play, hotseat, challenge the computer, and learn. Good for all ages, all difficulty levels, and music to relax. Build the community.

details.title: GAEKGWI
details.short_description: A first-person horror game rooted in Korean folklore. Navigate a village whose paths change with each visit. Learn how its ghosts hunt, conserve your lantern oil, and use charms and ritual tools to escape danger—or fight back.

details.title: MODERN CAPITAL
details.short_description: Buy from suppliers or make it yourself? MODERN CAPITAL is a business simulation of production, retail, and investment. Run factories and stores, compete on price, quality, and brand, and expand through stocks, real estate, and company acquisitions.

details.title: SHAFT HAPPENS
details.short_description: Your shift goes down. Your quota goes up. Scavenge haunted workplaces, throw loot into the elevator and escape before the doors close. Co-op horror for 1–4 players, with upgrades, suspicious colleagues and a company that values its equipment more than you.

details.title: DAYSOWN
details.short_description: Learn a trade, earn your first wages, and save for a place of your own. DAYSOWN is a single-player life sim of hands-on jobs, village crafts, growing food, and making a living one day at a time.

details.title: Splicers
details.short_description: Splicers is a party shooter with silly game modes, tough challenges, and a huge roster of characters and weapons. Bring your friends, add some bots, change the rules, and build your own maps and missions to share with the world.

details.title: Grey Staithe
details.short_description: Grey Staithe is a retro point-and-click puzzle game with cult-themed flair. Explore the environments, use the items you find, uncover the secrets buried here, and complete the commissioned task.

details.title: Void Drive
details.short_description: Chain your cars together and drive across roads hanging over the void. If one falls, everyone falls. Jump, crash and laugh through 17 trap-filled worlds with up to 3 friends online, or go solo and chase your best time.

details.title: Until You’re Better
details.short_description: A first-person ASMR game in a wellness center in orbit. Every real day your nurse gives you a check-up: follow her light, guess sounds with your eyes closed, tell her which ear a sound was in. Progress your treatment to unlock new activities and more of the center. No ending, only unwinding.

details.title: Doodle Survivors
details.short_description: Fight through 10 stages in a survival roguelite full of stick figures, monster hordes and ridiculous weapons. Attacks fire automatically: you dodge, collect upgrades and discover powerful evolutions. Earn gold, recruit new characters and build up permanent upgrades.

details.title: The Last Duck
details.short_description: The Last Duck is a top-down roguelite shooter where you play as a rebellious duck battling hordes of farm animals. Wield up to 6 weapons, collect powerful items, create unique builds, and fight your way through the farm and into the wild!

details.title: Total Chemistry
details.short_description: A chemistry study app for the MCAT and General Chemistry, with over 6,800 practice items, a lesson for every topic, flashcards and mock exams. It also includes Life Support, a game where you keep an orbital station breathing with real chemistry.

details.title: AstroTec
details.short_description: Build a ship out of snap-together blocks & fly it on its own thrusters. Mine the rocks, fight the raiders, then pull the blocks off whatever you beat & bolt them onto your own ship. Bring friends, dock your ships together & fly them as one.

details.title: The Water Listens
details.short_description: Every splash gives you away. Something lurks in the water, listening for your next move. Stay quiet, stay together, and pray it finds someone else first. Water Listens is a co-op horror game where the water carries your sound and the monster follows.

details.title: Competition
details.short_description: Coach a college track & field and cross country program in a shared online world. Recruit athletes, plan their training, enter them in meets and watch them race live against other coaches' teams. Seasons follow the real calendar: one game day is one real day.

details.title: One More Potato
details.short_description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

details.title: Times and Ages
details.short_description: Lead one of 82 nations from antiquity to modern times: found cities, research 122 technologies, build world wonders and win through conquest, science, culture, religion or diplomacy – turn-based on living 3D maps with seasons and weather.

details.title: Tanks 2026
details.short_description: A tank battle in the spirit of old 8-bit games. Hold the base across 35 stages or in RANDOM mode, where enemies hunt you down. Clear stages clean to earn rewards you keep for good. Play solo or with a friend, in pixel art or HD.

details.title: Don't Sell the Cat
details.short_description: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.

details.title: Lights Out Pact
details.short_description: Lights Out Pact is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Everyone hides a random item in a freshly generated room, then searches for others'. You can't take your own. Miss an item and lose a body part. Last one standing wins. Modes: find everything, hunt your target, or last one to find loses.

details.title: The Dungeon
details.short_description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

details.title: MAGOS
details.short_description: Master your spells and stay one step ahead of your rivals in simultaneous turn-based wizard duels. Combine elements that react with each other and transform the environment, unleashing chaotic battles. Discover powerful combos that could wipe out your enemies... or backfire on you!

details.title: 纸牌矿工
details.short_description: Card Miner is a casual strategy game blending poker, resource gathering, and deck building. Play cards to earn points and rewards, collect wood, grass, and ore to buy upgrades, and use special cards and multipliers to maximize earnings within limited plays on your way to a million coins.

details.title: Multi Miner Madness
details.short_description: A mining party game for up to four players. Drill for ore, haul it up and sell it, then spend the money on bigger drills, bombs and rams. Play on one screen with friends on the couch, or online through Steam.

details.title: Lily's Little Golf Game
details.short_description: Party golf for up to four players, all on the same hole at once. Race to the cup on wild mini golf courses, sabotage your rivals on the open links, or turn your clubs into weapons in the battle arena. Play on one screen or play online. You can even build your own minigolf courses!

details.title: Lily's Little Dart Game
details.short_description: Couch party darts for up to four players. Race from 301 down to zero, cause mayhem in a three-minute Chaos match, or steer your dart in slow motion through an obstacle course in The Gauntlet. Play on one screen or online with friends.

details.title: Brilliancy!!
details.short_description: Solve real chess puzzles in a roguelike where chess skill drives the score. Seat Tutors and upgrades that reward forks, sacrifices and quiet moves, beat each Set’s Target, outlast Bosses and hunt for the hidden Brilliancy. No invented pieces, no bent rules: the best chess is always rewarded.

details.title: Mutoid 2
details.short_description: Fight east through mutant hordes in a top-down survival shooter where heads pop and limbs come off. Revive fallen allies to fight beside you until the infection turns them back. Find and unlock an arsenal of guns, gear and perks to power your next run.

details.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 2
details.short_description: This ninja master is back in action in the second installment of this fast-paced, vibrant puzzle-platformer - and this time, he’s brought a friend along.

details.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 3
details.short_description: New part of the puzzle platformer about ninja painters

details.title: Garden Cleaner: Cozy Grass Simulator
details.short_description: 200,000+ blades of grass. Two bare hands. Pull them one by one, sell the harvest, and work your way up to a riding mower in a calm, cozy first-person yard cleaning game.

details.title: Classic Shooter Arena
details.short_description: Build your own arenas and fight inside SERAPH's combat simulation. Classic Shooter Arena combines fast-paced first-person shooting with a map maker, letting you shape the battlefield while a cold, sarcastic AI judges every round.

details.title: CellMates
details.short_description: Twelve players. One prison. Prisoners craft, stash and lie their way to freedom while guards search cells, cuff suspects and count heads. Break out of Greybar by chopper or truck, or haul a homemade boat off Gull Rock past the sharks. Not everyone is on your side.

name: Kuze Tooru Case Files: The Liar Vanishes in the Rain

details.title: Kuze Tooru Case Files: The Liar Vanishes in the Rain
details.short_description: A small incident on a rainy night leads back to a lie told sixteen years ago. A classic whodunit with private detective Tooru Kuze and police detective Rei Narumi. Solve each chapter as a portrait ADV, unlock it as Showa-style manga, question suspects in your own words, and name the culprit.

details.title: Yoban
details.short_description: Your childhood friend Saichi was swept away by the river; this morning his body surfaced. By custom, the one who was with him keeps the vigil. Keep the lamp lit, stay by his side, keep your eyes shut, and drive off what comes by sound alone.

details.title: Plough
details.short_description: A cosy low-poly game about clearing an Alpine village's roads with a snowplough. Snow doesn't vanish, it moves, and the side of the road is where your neighbours live. Take jobs from the board, from the 6:30 bus to the Christmas market and a power cut. New jobs every week.

name: Where To Pee? - Urinal Etiquette Simulator

details.title: Where To Pee? - Urinal Etiquette Simulator
details.short_description: A first-person comedy simulator about men's room etiquette. Pick the most respectful urinal before your bladder gives up, dodge starers, talkers and manspreaders, and keep your dignity through 100 levels and an endless mode.

details.title: Ten Million Ducks
details.short_description: Clear ten million rubber ducks from a lake. Start by hand, then work your way up to nets, a vacuum, and a collection boat. Turn in your haul, earn money, and upgrade your equipment. Use pumps to gather the ducks and drones to pick up stragglers until the lake is clear.

details.title: SOVOK: Battle Royale
details.short_description: A Soviet-themed battle royale packed with Russian memes. Loot up, squad up, and fit your glove with cassettes to blind enemies, punch through thin walls, and heal teammates. Sweep away the competition in SOVOK!

details.title: 烈焰觉醒之战神传奇
details.short_description: 一款以南宋末年为舞台的 3D暗黑武侠MMORPG。它没有把“侠”字挂在嘴边当装饰，而是把你丢进一个金国“暗棋”死士、南疆五仙教与南宋武林多方绞杀的乱世里，让你用刀、枪、剑、镰四种兵器，从一场灭门血案开始，一路杀到盟主之位。没有花哨的转职树，没有温吞的成长曲线，你要做的只有一件事：用最趁手的兵器，在这个不讲道理的时代里活下来，然后让所有人记住你的名字。

details.title: Destination & Acceleration
details.short_description: This is a top-down platformer where your goal is to complete the levels. Destination & Acceleration is a truly hardcore, stylish, and fair game. What a shame you won't even make it past ten levels here.

details.title: Shell Yeah!
details.short_description: A tiny island that lives right on your desktop. Shelly harvests coconuts, runs her beach bar and splashes in the pool while you work. Upgrade the island, throw toys, meet new friends and collect 72 illustrated trading cards. Free to play, relaxing, always there.

details.title: Rabid
details.short_description: RABID is a dark fantasy tactical RPG where blackjack fuels every battle. Lead a team of mutated animals, customize your decks, collect powerful loot, and master turn-based combat as you uncover the dark secrets of a mysterious laboratory.

details.title: Neuroflux
details.short_description: Neuroflux is a modern take on Nerts, the frantic real-time solitaire race. Everyone plays at once: flip through your deck, build on the shared center card stacks, empty your Flux pile and hit FLUX before anyone else. Up to 4 players online on dedicated servers, or practice solo. Free to play.

details.title: One Million Dominoes
details.short_description: Topple a million dominoes, one push at a time. Pick where to push, watch the chain race across the table, and grow it into a wave of tens of thousands. A short, satisfying incremental game with achievements and timed loops.

details.title: Spot the Symbol
details.short_description: A calm, colorful collection of quick brain games about seeing what’s hidden. Race your friends to the answer, and sneak in a little sabotage when they pull ahead.

details.title: Sort My Money
details.short_description: Collect more than 46 currencies from around the world in this cozy organizing game! Sort 292 unique banknotes, arrange them by country and denomination, complete collections, and build your own museum of world money.

details.title: Dungeon Dealer
details.short_description: Heroes bleed. You profit. Send squads into deadly dungeons, crack open chests of glowing loot and sell every find at the perfect moment. Arm your best heroes, conquer it all, then retire rich and start a bigger era in this pixel-art incremental game.

details.title: Astral Wizards
details.short_description: Pick a wizard, walk into the swarm and let your spells fire on their own. A neon pixel-art bullet heaven with 30 worlds across 3 galaxies, laws that bend the rules, ENDLESS boss marathons and 13 wizards to master. Evolve 24 weapons into screen-filling light shows. No ads, no microtransactions.

details.title: Christmas '99
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 1999. A childhood home filled with glowing lights, familiar memories, and holiday cheer. But beneath the warmth of Christmas lies a disturbing secret.

details.title: 英雄之责：烬海
details.short_description: You are the last hope. In a world swallowed by ash, build a final refuge, explore perilous islands, and lead your army against formidable foes. Every expedition forces you to weigh time, resources, and lives—until the Shoreless King arrives at your gates.

details.title: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone
details.short_description: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone is a neon top-down shooter. Customize your ship's left and right cannons, fight through branching rooms, collect gear, and build powerful weapon combos. Face geometric enemies, elite threats, and multi-phase bosses.

details.title: Caritas Nocturna
details.short_description: A quiet puzzle adventure with no combat. On a winter night of plague, the bell wakes you, the porter of a Spanish monastery. Until dawn, walk its rooms and perform the fourteen works of mercy for those still waiting.

details.title: Modular Synth Simulator
details.short_description: Build your own modular synthesizer and find your sound. Patch modules together, turn knobs, explore unexpected combinations, and make music. Jump in with ready-made patches or learn the basics with step-by-step tutorials.

details.title: They Seemed Normal
details.short_description: They Seemed Normal is a chaotic mix of inspection and tower defense where every stage affects the next. Work as a passport inspector and interrogate visitors. Let the right ones in and eliminate the "uncannies". Buy and upgrade birds, then use them as turrets to defend your base at night.

name: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。

details.title: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。
details.short_description: A documentary game where you walk through real accidents as one of the people who were there: an airliner that lost its controls, an airship in flames, a liner struck in the fog, a march into a blizzard, and a spacecraft far from Earth. Then read what really happened.

details.title: Marble Hoarder
details.short_description: Sort thousands of glass marbles in a cozy, messy old marble shop. Pick them up, toss each one into the tray where it belongs, unlock skills like Spotlight, Gather and Auto-Place, and race your marbles on a wooden race machine. No timers, no pressure.

details.title: Tidy Up: Midnight Cleaner Simulator
details.short_description: Clean up spooky buildings at night as a caretaker. Sort the trash into the correct categories. Will you survive the nights?

name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler

details.title: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
details.short_description: Rip open packs, drop the tiles on your desktop and grow a tiny fantasy world one square at a time. Recruit knights, skeletons, orcs, vampires and dragonblood. They fight on their own while you work. Pull the rune slot for doubles, then hunt down three bosses.

details.title: Wooden Tower
details.short_description: Pull wooden blocks from a teetering tower in a physics-based game of balance. Try the Daily Challenge, practice in Sandbox, face an AI opponent, or invite friends through Steam or Discord for online rounds with up to five players.

details.title: Earthworks
details.short_description: Build your own earthmoving company! Buy trucks and excavators, compete for contracts, hire employees, manage your fleet, and grow your business. Overcome economic challenges, expand your operations, and build your construction empire in this 2D management simulation.

details.title: Turbidity
details.short_description: Turbidity is a surreal dungeon crawler where you are tasked with the collection of 3,000 fingernails by your God, the Striver of Atrocity.

details.title: Not So Crazy Water World
details.short_description: Yes — we used 100% AI + Unreal Engine 5 to turn those fake 'Crazy Water World' ads into a real open-world survival RPG! Freely lay deck planks across the sea and build 2-storey structures on your ship, fish up 20 legendary companions, run a Urine Recycler, steer into 35° naval ramming & boarding battles, and raid 28 grand dungeons!

details.title: FIT IT
details.short_description: A very challenging puzzle game. Unlike classic block puzzles, some levels add extra decoy blocks, and some even make you work out where parts of the board go first. 500 levels that keep getting harder, plus Daily Challenge, Endless and Relax modes.

details.title: Boots Down
