details.short_description: Lead an elite special operations team through intense, real-time tactical missions. Plan every move, coordinate your squad, and adapt when combat erupts. Explore detailed 3D environments where positioning, precision, and teamwork determine survival.

details.title: Oloid
details.short_description: "Daddy was in the wall," says your three-year-old son. A mystery visual novel about an old St Petersburg flat: oil-painted art, Russian voice acting, English text, choices that matter. Episode I — about 2 to 3 hours.

details.title: Crawlers
details.short_description: Crawlers is an action roguelike automation game set on a distant space colony. Build up your mech with a deadly factory while fighting off hordes of bugs, all to finally escape a doomed planet.

details.title: Real War: Not Fake
details.short_description: The fake-mobile incremental arcade game now made real! Shoot enemies, increase your army, gather coins, upgrade your gear, and defeat bosses to complete levels!

details.title: Midnight Brag: Before Poker
details.short_description: Before poker, there was Brag. Play Three Card Brag, the classic British card game of bluffing and nerve, in five late-night clubs run by bosses who never lose. Beat them in a voiced campaign, then sit down with real players at live tables with voice chat, in VR or on a flat screen.

name: Train Plus Pro 2027 | トレインプラスプロ2027

details.title: Train Plus Pro 2027 | トレインプラスプロ2027
details.short_description: A serious train-driving game rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 from "Train Plus West Japan". Drive Series 207, 221, 223, 227 and 321 on a fictional 55.5 km, 26-station four-track main line, with signals, ATS, gradients and cant. ＪＲ西日本商品化許諾済

details.title: 终端游戏：请审判我吧
details.short_description: 《终端游戏：请审判我吧》是一款带有meta元素的文字推理解密游戏。某一天，玩家在网络上下载到了游戏，在游戏内NPC的指引下，连接各个站点、探索并综合信息进行推理，拼凑时间线，了解整个故事，并最终对游戏内的NPC的选择进行审判……

details.title: Hyper Arcane Mage Battle
details.short_description: A mage platform battler for up to 8 players (Local multiplayer or Online). Earn spell cards and build between rounds until the winner is crowned at the match standings.

details.title: Historarium
details.short_description: Shape continents, civilizations, and see the rise and fall of empires. Follow individual characters as they rise to power. Or as mighty rulers fall to irrelevance. Create nations and see them evolve through the centuries. Or destroy it all and watch civilization react to your actions.

details.title: Sweep City
details.short_description: Keep your streets clean and discover hidden treasures in this relaxing street sweeper adventure. Drive through procedurally generated neighborhoods, uncover rare finds, and upgrade your sweeper with unique specializations. Cruise to your own tunes while keeping the city spotless.

details.title: Witchbound
details.short_description: Witchbound is a first-person reverse horror game where you play as Callisto Coven, a powerful witch defending her mansion from villagers and priests who seek to destroy the cursed relics binding her to it. Hunt them, terrify them, and become the horror they fear.

name: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

details.title: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?
details.short_description: The Hellspawn Trials is an endless top down shooter where you choose from a variety of dynamic weapons and Faustian upgrades with unique side effects so you can become powerful enough to discover the answer to the ultimate question: How many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

details.title: MICROVERSE
details.short_description: MICROVERSE is a sci-fi action/adventure game. It includes weapons such as laser pistols, melee weapons and a 'merchant center' where you use in-game credits to buy new weapons and upgrades.

details.title: Battle Air Hockey BREAK BEATS!
details.short_description: Super exhilarating battle air hockey! Hit the ball and score a BREAK!

details.title: Sokoku
details.short_description: A block-pushing game where you not only push blocks, you are one. Plan your movements so that the right number ends up on top, while you interact with other cubes and mechanics. Can you roll your way to the solution?

details.title: Super Terrestrial
details.short_description: A roguelite autoscroller, where you control a spaceship navigating procedurally generated levels. Use limited aerial jumps and hover abilities to dodge hazards, collect gems, and explore alternate biomes. Each run features upgrades, power-ups, dynamic enemies, and challenging bosses.

details.title: Peregrine Point
details.short_description: Peregrine Point is a single-player story driven game about life, death, and what comes next. Maintain the lighthouse, keep the lamp filled with oil and help guide recently departed cats get to where the need to be.

details.title: The Blue Cut Hook
details.short_description: The Blue Cut Hook blends cozy tavern management with subtle adventure. You're no hero, just a humble tavern keeper, but your food, gear, and advice quietly shape the adventurers who pass through. They make the choices, take the glory, and face the danger, but your influence might keeps them alive.

details.title: ZOPHARION
details.short_description: They react to your every move. Fight, run, or disappear. Every decision buys time. Every mistake gets you killed.

details.title: EggRoyale
details.short_description: Adorable birds are battling over eggs! Strategically guide your allies to fend off enemies in this simple yet deep 3D real-time strategy game. Enjoy easy controls, thrilling combat, and the heartwarming charm of hardworking birds. Dive into their delightful world and lead your team to victory!

details.title: Rich Flavors
details.short_description: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

details.title: UnderMire
details.short_description: Explore, fight, and SMUSH in this hand-drawn roguelite first person adventure! Descend a magical bunker filled with wild biomes, master magical tools, manage your fear gauge, overcome hazards, combat spooky enemies, and cause co-op chaos.

details.title: Slimy Timey
details.short_description: Slimy Timey is a simple 2D platformer where you play as a slime that can jump and attach to walls. Jump, slide, avoid all the dangerous traps, reach the end, and get all the stars!

details.title: BitBeasts
details.short_description: Can you survive humanity's deadliest drones? Build your ship, evolve alien Beasts, unlock powerful talents, and fight through an ultra-hard roguelite space shooter where every run is different.

details.title: Five Heads
details.short_description: Five prisoners each have a visible-to-others card on their forehead. Across three rounds, they logically deduce and rank their cards from lowest to highest. On the final round, each guesses their exact card, using every prior guess as a clue. A single mistake can doom them—can you solve it?

name: You Sure You Wanna Drink This?

details.title: You Sure You Wanna Drink This?
details.short_description: A charming picture-book style interactive story with light puzzles and turn-based combat. After the Pharmacist’s knowledge vanishes, experiment on your partner to learn! Analyze potion effects to deduce ingredient properties. Enjoy vibrant art and story. Reclaim your lost knowledge!

details.title: CHARK
details.short_description: Chess and deckbuilding collide in a compact 5×5 roguelike battlefield of risk and reward. Build momentum from a lone King: stack small advantages, gamble on bold moves, and watch the rules bend as your King snowballs to victory. Short, intense runs how far can you go?

details.title: Tangles 2 تشابك
details.short_description: On the remote island of Scirine, Majed, a young biology intern, arrives at Al-Bayan Research Center, expecting scientific breakthroughs. But his journey turns into a descent into mystery as he uncovers terrifying truths, where reality blends with illusions, revealing more secrets with every step.

details.title: Destiny Code
details.short_description: Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG! As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices. A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!

details.title: Sadko
details.short_description: Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.

details.title: The (mis)adventures of Magical Girl Luna
details.short_description: In another world, where magic and technology go hand in hand, lives Luna - a young but formidable magical girl. Raised by the powerful witch Solaire, Luna is about to embark on an incredible adventure, one that will put both her idealistic nature and her starry-eyed view of the world to the test.

details.title: Will O Wisp
details.short_description: This is a platform action game in which you control light in a world shrouded in complete darkness and rely on it to progress. Use the light to travel from place to place and illuminate the buried truth.

details.title: Don't Die, Dummy!
details.short_description: Who knew the secret to robot destruction was the perfect spin kick? Dance now, explain later!

details.title: Magic Cells
details.short_description: A life-or-death war between cells and germs! 20+ bosses lead 100+ minions to invade—cunning, multiplying, mutating, and parasitizing your turf! Summon 24+ magic cells, wield 100+ tech cards to fight back, and harness 9 divine powers to win!

details.title: Deliver Together
details.short_description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

details.title: Dark Dungeon Feminized
details.short_description: This FPS game has dark and beautiful art style. A tragic accident turns the strict laboratory into a dark dungeon. You are trying to escape from here with wisdom and strategy, and discover its unknown dark secrets.（Has Customizable female villain with costume damage）

details.title: LastRoll
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic tactical roguelike. Assemble a crew of 4, roll dice to fuel your skills and fight your way to the final boss. One lost battle means starting over. No cards. No mercy. Just dice.

details.title: Crabgrass
details.short_description: Crabgrass is a cozy narrative management game where players get the satisfying experience of yard maintenance with none of the real world consequences like sore muscles or a lawn that simply just won’t grow no matter what you do.

details.title: RoboCatPush
details.short_description: 《RoboCatPush》is a lighthearted puzzle game. Play as a cute cat robot and solve puzzles in beautiful levels. In this 3D box world, vertical stacking is key. Step by step, solve carefully crafted puzzles and push special boxes to the finish.

details.title: Fractaloid Attacks!
details.short_description: Aim better. Destroy smarter. Explore and use Technologies. Pinball × breakout × platformer = ricochets, combos, fun! Fractaloids have taken over the system — crystalline trees grown from living code. Knowledge comes through destruction.

details.title: Click Click Universe
details.short_description: Click Click Universe is a relaxing and delightful top-down 3D clicker game. Players are free to explore an open world made up of polyhedral shapes, where they can collect items, trigger interactions, and observe how everything changes with each click.

details.title: I Never Late for Work
details.short_description: This is a life-simulation roguelike card game. Harness item and skill cards to shorten your commute, continuously boost yourself through diverse events, forge connections with different friends to help each other out, and become the best employee who never arrives late.

details.title: Advena
details.short_description: A top-down open-world survival game, where you explore a hostile planet while trying to fix your spaceship and get back home. Fight, outwit and defeat the planet's wildlife to evolve and get stronger.

details.title: Poker Warrior
details.short_description: This is a roguelike deck-builder game around poker suits. Hearts fuel survival, Spades drive strength, Diamonds power wealth, and Clubs embrace chaos. Through deck construction and card fusion, you can twist the suits, break expectations, and uncover wildly different builds.

details.title: X Space
details.short_description: A sudden, devastating strike has reduced your interstellar voyage to ruins. As the sole survivor in X SPACE, you must rebuild your space base from scratch, assemble a versatile fleet, and pilot your massive mobile fortress into the depths of the universe.

details.title: Heartseers Grove
details.short_description: Gather, craft, build, and explore in Heartseers Grove, a cosy survival game set in a peaceful world of forests, hills, and caves.

details.title: Cults of the Endtimes
details.short_description: The world is in agony. The only salvation is faith. Forge a god from the fears and hopes of a dying humanity. Spread your ideas like a virus, mutate dogmas, and battle other egregores for the last souls on Earth. A strategy game about manipulating consciousness without direct control.

details.title: Tome Improvement
details.short_description: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

details.title: No Reason to Climb
details.short_description: A simple yet challenging 2D platformer where the only goal is to climb as high as possible for no reason at all. Jump, dodge, and face precision-based challenges across 5 increasingly difficult worlds, where one mistake can send you falling and cost all your progress.

details.title: SWAT God
details.short_description: SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

details.title: D3LIGHT
details.short_description: rhythm game abomination that mix keyboard and mouse inputs

details.title: Revil Bone
details.short_description: A spooky co-op survival game for up to 6 players. Explore shifting worlds, mix crystals for Statue demands, gather resources, and survive chaotic encounters where heavy hits trigger physics-based bone reactions.

details.title: Day 22
details.short_description: You're a cop checking an abandoned barn. Simple assignment. But the longer you're there, the less you can trust what you see — or yourself. A first-person psychological anomaly horror experience built around paranoia and perception.

details.title: Date the Difference
details.short_description: Date the Difference is a casual puzzle game where you spot differences between images while enjoying a light dating-themed atmosphere. Explore stylish scenes, find hidden details, earn rewards, and unlock charming characters through relaxing, attention-based gameplay.

details.title: Simple World Beta
details.short_description: Simple World is a relaxing, safe, open-world survival game where you explore, gather resources, and build at your own pace – alone or in co-op (at least during the day).

details.title: Liminal Backrooms
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore unsettling Backrooms-inspired levels, solve environmental puzzles, find exits, and survive entities with unique rules. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Death Projection
details.short_description: Explore every corner of the realms of death in this Metroidvania! Face enemies, platforming challenges, and gain more power as you try to bring balance to this world, as a reaper!

details.title: Sushi Neko Do
details.short_description: Welcome to a curious little sushi restaurant, where the sushi are all Sushi Neko. Use the order tickets as your clues to find the perfect one from the cutting board and place them on a plate — a relaxing hidden-object game with no timers.

details.title: Mine Climbers
details.short_description: Mine Climbers is a vertical platformer where you'll be dashing and jumping your way out of a collapsing mineshaft while avoiding the falling rubble. An unlikely mix of falling block puzzle gameplay and traditional platforming.

details.title: Slotlander
details.short_description: A short incremental game about a gambling addict whose trip to rehab goes wrong. After a plane crash, you wake up alone on a tropical island with a broken slot machine on the beach. One wish brings it to life. Spins are free. No penalties. No one telling you to stop.

details.title: KADI: Ottoman Judge
details.short_description: You are a kadı in 1300s Ottoman Empire. Judge cases rooted in real history across ten provinces, from Gemlik to Damascus. Grow wise through knowledge or fall to bribery the balance is yours. Marry, raise a child, and choose between conscience and a never-ending purse. Every ruling shapes your fate.

details.title: The Gauntlet
details.short_description: Fight a diverse cast of characters each harder than the last! A boss rush game where you face many bosses back to back until you beat them all. Will you survive The Gauntlet?

name: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive

details.title: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive
details.short_description: Experience the chilling solitude of a nighttime drive through the woods. You are not the only person—or thing—on the road tonight. Drive carefully and try to stay calm behind the wheel. Can you make it to the sunrise?

details.title: Bullet Time Agent
details.short_description: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Leap past laser obstacles with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death...again.

details.title: Flywheel
details.short_description: Flywheel is a 2D action game where you dash through the skies using jumps and flight. Each run challenges you with ever-changing terrain. With retro pixel art, nostalgic sound, and simple controls, the game is easy to pick up and enjoy.

details.title: SheepHoundra
details.short_description: A sorting action game where you expose goats disguised as sheep with a blower and use stolen ink to dye sheep for shipment. Create "Rare Sheep" in specified colors within the time limit and aim for maximum profit!

details.title: Crime Empire Idle
details.short_description: Build your criminal dynasty in a deep idle/incremental game. Run crimes, launder dirty cash, upgrade your empire, use the black market, craft weapons & gear to fight criminal opponents while you balance heat and notoriety.

details.title: Pale Cure
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where you explore a mutating house, evade a delusional family, and live through the nightmare.

details.title: What the House Remembers
details.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror game where a secluded house twists memory into reality. As your sanity deteriorates, uncover a buried truth hidden within its walls before the house reveals what you've tried to forget.

details.title: Rayborne
details.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

details.title: Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes
details.short_description: Fluendora is a multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle. Prove to your friends you know some words (or learn some if you don't). Players can either compete for the highest score (up to 6 players) or enjoying a peaceful solo session.

details.title: Can I Get a Job?
details.short_description: Operator, you have been appointed to the position of labor resource allocator. The System observes and analyzes every decision you make. Compliance with instructions is recommended. Begin work.

details.title: 9Clock OverPack
details.short_description: You have until nine. Ransack the room, decide what actually matters, and cram it into a suitcase that is always one slot too small. Everything you leave behind comes back - as a story about how your trip went.

details.title: Diamond Legacy Online
details.short_description: Set in an ancient world, this MMORPG lets you develop your character, strengthen your equipment, and challenge guilds. Progress solo or with a party, take risks, and earn the rewards of your effort. In this world, power is not given; it is earned.

details.title: Wrath of the Arcane Realms
details.short_description: Wrath of the Arcane Realms is a hexagon-based, turn-based roguelike strategy game. Assemble a party of 3 from 6 heroes, chart your path across the realms, and craft your own synergies by drafting unique skills. There is no "correct" way to save the Arcane Realms. Don't seek the solution—define it!

details.title: These Eyes
details.short_description: These Eyes is a no-text adventure game with elements of action, platforming, quests, and horror. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and interact with other characters.

details.title: CHEAT
details.short_description: CHEAT is an exam-themed card Roguelike game. You play as a student who must collect and use various bizarre cards and skills. Stay vigilant, dodge the teachers, improve your scores and rankings, and ultimately achieve victory in the exam!

details.title: Evolution: Code of 6 Desires
details.short_description: In this evolutionary simulation game, you play as a deity sowing the seeds of life. Each human you create possesses a unique genome, where the combination of desire genes determines their behavioral patterns and fate trajectory. A sandbox about life, choice, and destiny awaits your discovery.

name: Hell's Beasts: Yama Wanted Me Dead, I Left Him Half-Dead

details.title: Hell's Beasts: Yama Wanted Me Dead, I Left Him Half-Dead
details.short_description: In this live-action FMV Hell-office game, become an Underworld Judge deciding fates—watch quirky ghosts pull stunts and talent shows, sling sharp words and cards to shake up the workplace, and unlock your past life to rewrite your present!

details.title: Good luck, little Rocket !
details.short_description: A new experimental rocket prototype has been built: your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to test its reliability by landing on the various platforms below you. Once this mission is accomplished, restore hope to humanity with your exceptional skill.

details.title: Game Jam Watercooler Sim
details.short_description: A story-driven game featuring Chinese-style group chat simulation + Game Jam Survival Guide. You will join an online group and experience the full 21-day game development competition: teaming up, arguing, teammates ghosting, and more. It truly captures the laughter and struggles of indie developers.

details.title: SWOM
details.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

details.title: Feast of the Beast Unleashed
details.short_description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampiric clans as you advance toward the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that is consuming the world."

details.title: Real Life: Dorm Affairs
details.short_description: Mike’s new job at a women’s dorm leads him into unexpected bonds, rising danger, and tough choices as local gangs target vulnerable students. Protect the girls, navigate romance, and face the city’s hidden threats.

details.title: Scratch your Luck
details.short_description: Scratch tickets, upgrade your odds, and pay deadlines before you go broke.

details.title: 164: Fragile Ascent
details.short_description: 164 Floors. The ultimate test of mind and body. The ascent is simple, mechanical, yet unforgiving. Every step brings you closer to the summit… or your own annihilation. 164: Fragile Ascent is a first-person rhythm challenge where the certainty of the machine clashes with the fragility of the mind.

details.title: Twilight Haven
details.short_description: Twilight Haven is based in a wonderful, magical but also strange and dangerous place hidden far north of the country known as Hazeldawn. It is not a place you will find on any map, nor in any book, it is hidden from the eyes and minds of all those but the few souls that it chooses to bring home.

details.title: Path of Glory
details.short_description: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

details.title: FOTR
details.short_description: A quasi-documentary trip that leads to a phone booth in 2002, where feelings of nostalgia and pain from broken parental relationships intertwine.

details.title: Santa's Burnout
details.short_description: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

details.title: Road 88
details.short_description: Road 88 is a car anomaly game where you must spot the differences on an endless road loop and avoid deadly hazards.

details.title: Broken Race
details.short_description: Have you ever tried driving without sleeping? In Broken Race, being tired makes reality look strange and turns every race into a fight to stay sane. Get upgrades, survive the enemies, and reach the finish line before your brain decides that the laws of physics are just a suggestion.

details.title: Frontiers of the Realms
details.short_description: Build a realm and a deck to match. Grow villages into cities, shape production chains and play cards for supplies, expansion and tactical support. A turn-based strategy game where rivals act in the same round. Play against AI or challenge friends online.

details.title: Wheels Echo: The Winter Chronicle
details.short_description: Wheels Echo is a winter survival story where your thoughts shape the journey. As Fred Walker, explore a silent frozen world, write down clues in your notebook, uncover mysteries, survive the cold, and piece together what happened to everyone — and to you.

name: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture

details.title: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture
details.short_description: Create your personal oasis in the corner of your desktop.​ This is a laid-back idle simulation game where simple clicks allow you to grow plants and feed adorable animals. Watch them thrive and multiply, receive surprise letters and gifts, and let the serene ambiance of nature fill your screen.
developers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills
publishers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills

details.title: AENIGMA
details.short_description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

details.title: Lounge Café
details.short_description: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

details.title: UNFATED
details.short_description: A realistic first-person action shooter set in an open-world post-apocalyptic setting. Survive, resist, and conquer a world devastated by invaders. Team up, explore the terrain, and reclaim the fate of humanity.

details.title: ANGLE
details.short_description: A disturbing psychological horror experience that unfolds as only the echo of your footsteps accompanies you through the dark corridors, where you move along the fragile edges of your own perception.

details.title: That's Not My Cat!
details.short_description: Adopt a tiny cat that lives on top of your desktop. It hops across your windows, naps on your taskbar, and earns its hats one cuddle at a time. Name it. Love it. Never close it.

details.title: Hexagon Soup
details.short_description: A keyboard-first traditional roguelike on an isometric hex grid—turn-based, permadeath, and ruthless decision-making. Your class emerges from the skills you pick, not a menu. Manage scarce resources, out-position enemies, claim Hex Runes, then survive the climb back out.

details.title: 100 Anomaly Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 凉面爱情故事
details.short_description: This is a light-hearted and enjoyable short visual novel.You will guide the male protagonist to different endings through various choices. Xu Bu, who was originally a graduate student in history, became a teacher after giving up his studies. Then,the new stroy will begin.

details.title: Apu's frenlyquest
details.short_description: Play as Apu on his quest to save his friends from monsters! Apu's frenlyquest is a top down shooter RPG, with section based progression, dungeons filled with strange enemies and bosses, and the chance to explore and discover! Help Apu on his quest to save his world from a hidden meddling evil!

details.title: Taking Today Off
details.short_description: Taking Today Off is a light-hearted roguelike deck-builder about managing modern life states. Draw cards, place them on the board, add stickers and tools, and build playful combos. Easy to learn, with fresh choices and strategies every run.

details.title: Crow Hunts Worms
details.short_description: An Action Incremental/Roguelite Puzzle where you Aim, Shoot, and utilize Gun Skills to annihilate worms! Upgrade your guns and get temporary upgrades while playing and clear infested areas OR play endlessly!

details.title: Cozywood Creek
details.short_description: A gentle idle game with a living stream flowing quietly at the bottom of your screen. Terraform the land and watch as animals arrive to make Cozywood their home. Cultivate the surrounding area and bring this cozy ecosystem to life.

details.title: Break Protocol
details.short_description: The protocol has called… and it’s time to destroy everything! BREAK PROTOCOL reinvents the brick-breaker roguelike: build powerful combos, exploit card synergies, and face unique enemies and bosses across increasingly dangerous sectors.

details.title: A Game of Masks
details.short_description: A 2D point and click adventure where you get to interact with everyone from the street food vendor to the mob boss (and everyone in between) to carry out your assignment for your pompous but powerful politician.

details.title: Take Profit
details.short_description: Step into the role of elite Spec Ops agent Lucy “Talent” Lawson as she dismantles a global crime syndicate to rescue her kidnapped sister. Hunt down The Trust, eliminate its leaders, and seize their profits in this intense, story-driven third-person shooter.

details.title: Spruce Falls
details.short_description: You're locked in a diner! But for a good reason. Someone chopped down the Grand Spruce, and the collateral damage is Big News. Figure out which of the many suspicious characters murdered the town's journalist by essentially bugging everybody.

details.title: Lantern
details.short_description: A mysterious exploration adventure set on a transformed Mars. At the controls of LANTERN, a forgotten rover, explore, drift, jump, and photograph the strange. Every discovery updates its BIOS, revealing new objectives and new leads to follow.

details.title: Dopamine Fuel
details.short_description: Parkour through a procedurally generated city to avoid the rats, sentient trash, robot pigeons, and more! Pick abilities and items to make a build capable of fighting off the swarm! In style of course.

details.title: Black Resonance: Obelisk Siege
details.short_description: A dark 2.5D combat roguelite with arena-defense elements where a rock musician turns sound into a weapon, builds defenses around an ancient obelisk, and holds back waves of monstrous enemies in a gothic world of darkness and metal.

details.title: UFO Craft
details.short_description: You are a UFO. Your target: anything that moves and isn't properly secured. Pilot the UFO, sow chaos, and abduct everything! Equipped with a powerful gravity beam, destruction physics, and deep ship upgrades. Abduct cows, cars, and people in this insane cosmic abduction simulator. Earth isn't ready!

details.title: DT.O: Hanes
details.short_description: When a woodcutter is hired to map the ancient forest of Ethrna, a mysterious substance called ■■■■■ shatters his reality. Face a world of forgotten memories and a past that shouldn't exist...? Can Phabius find the truth within his mind?

name: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken

details.title: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken
details.short_description: A puzzle platformer that starts by teaching you the rules—then dares you to break them. Bend mechanics, exploit systems, and discover solutions the game never intended.

details.title: Stack the Spells
details.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

details.title: Table of Fates
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a medieval tavern. Build your deck through tactical card play. Create powerful combos, make risky deals, and know when to walk away. Karma remembers every choice!

details.title: DeskFarm: Idle Garden
details.short_description: A desktop-optimized idle farm that stays by your side. Use built-in pin and hide features to grow your pixel garden without interrupting your workflow. Strategically secure rare seeds from the rotating shop and upgrade your way to discover increasingly valuable crop tiers.

details.title: Pocket Paradise Restaurant
details.short_description: Run your restaurant on the paradise island of Isla Sabor ! Dive in the ocean to get food, design and expand your restaurant, buy supplies and cook meals for your clients !

details.title: The Defective One
details.short_description: This is a visual novel set against the backdrop of a high school student band. It is a fierce collision between gender identity, the concept of freedom, and traditional views. You will play as the band's bassist, choose your answers to these issues, and experience the story of this special band.

details.title: PIGGO
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party card game where players race to collect four matching cards, bluff their friends, and react at the perfect moment. Play with 2-4 players through fast unpredictable rounds. In PIGGO, it’s never just the cards.

details.title: Endless Harvest
details.short_description: Endless Harvest is relaxing yet strategic incremental farming game where every crop you place changes the efficiency of your growing plot of land. Grow crops, unlock upgrades, and optimize your farm as much as possible!

details.title: The Pyroxene Ages
details.short_description: This is a top-down, loot-based RogueLite game. You can build a town, craft weapons and socket them with various gems, then embark on adventures across maps you construct yourself.

details.title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run the game store you never wanted to leave, from the late ’90s to today. Buy, sell and repair games, haggle over trade-ins, and hunt for rare finds. Customize your shop and fill your shelves with parodies that make you laugh, cringe, or remember the games you grew up with.

details.title: Oath for Glory
details.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

details.title: Wanderfolk
details.short_description: A farming RPG where villagers remember everything. Grow crops, forage, and explore a procedurally generated world, then talk to AI-powered NPCs who form real opinions about you. Build friendships, pursue romance, fight monsters (or stay peaceful), and become part of a living village community.

details.title: Seal The Breach
details.short_description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

details.title: KeelOver
details.short_description: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

details.title: ELLA in da room
details.short_description: A seemingly cozy (but ultimately frustrating) 2D platformer, where a little girl’s imagination transforms her room into a magical world. Jump across pillows, race toy cars, and explore nostalgic adventures in which every object becomes part of a story, all while testing your patience to its limits.

details.title: Astral Echelons
details.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter!

details.title: Ember
details.short_description: Join up to 5 friends in a deadly game of hide and seek. Play as a survivor or the monster lurking in the shadows.

details.title: Chains of Vithra
details.short_description: "In a brutal, unforgiving RPG, descend into a shattered realm of massive seamless landscapes and shadowed city hubs. Forge a tormented hero through ruthless progression, engage in visceral tactical combat, and make harrowing choices that shape a grim, persistent multiplayer world."

details.title: Exipath
details.short_description: Uncover memories, decipher clues, and evade the darkness in Exipath, a survival horror game following the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she falls into the abyss of her greatest nightmares in search of a brighter future.

details.title: Block Machine
details.short_description: Block Machine is an elimination-style Roguelike game inspired by Tetris and slot machines. Pull down the lever. You will complete the elimination through random choices again and again, obtaining more items and achieving higher scores.

details.title: On Time In Full
details.short_description: Manage dev teams. Hit deadlines. Deliver quality. OTIF is a kanban board simulation where every hire, every card, and every decision has a cost — and the client is watching.

details.title: War for Ylinthia
details.short_description: Based on the “Ylinthian Chronicles” novel series by M.J. Macourek, this easy to play PVE combination of Real Time Strategy and tabletop games allows for infinite replayability.

details.title: CRIKEYMAS
details.short_description: CRIKEYMAS is a chaotic platformer SUPER HAMMER ACTION GAME where everything is possible with your trusty hammer. Help Mr. SANTER's errand boy reindeer to smash through delightfully devilish levels!

details.title: IN:DARK RECALL
details.short_description: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

details.title: Tax On Dice
details.short_description: Help Gibo to collect the King's taxes. Every season, roll dice to send Gibo in corresponding towns and collect their resources. In your downtime, buy dice and town upgrades to satisfy the ever-growing King's greed.

details.title: Synapse Idle
details.short_description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

details.title: Victoria Kopernik: Monastery
details.short_description: Occult influencer Victoria Kopernik explores a cursed monastery in this short survival horror experience.

details.title: Greebly Gambit
details.short_description: Greebly Gambit is a chaotic fantasy smash-and-grab-style game where you play as a goblin trying to steal everything not nailed down in order to help revive the god of hope.

details.title: Game Show But Evil
details.short_description: A quiz show...but different!

details.title: SOS! Love~Controlled
details.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

details.title: Rune Tavern
details.short_description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

details.title: Mobius
details.short_description: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

details.title: Grandpa Needs Fish
details.short_description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

details.title: The Sons of Earth
details.short_description: An asymmetric hex wargame about occupation and insurgency. Command the alien Verkhan Empire pacifying a human world — or the fractured Sons of Earth fighting to reclaim it.

details.title: Reach The Banana
details.short_description: A chaotic two-player climbing game where you control one monkey together, one arm each, and battle physics, panic, terrible coordination, mistimed grabs, desperate recoveries, and an endless chain of bad decisions on every climb.

details.title: AllWheelDrive
details.short_description: Drive a single vehicle together, literally. In this chaotic co-op experience, gather up to four friends and share the every control of a single RV or, drive in chaos. Coordinate, argue, and try to stay on the road as things quickly spiral out of control. Fullfill your grandpa's last wish.

details.title: sh2dow cat
details.short_description: A feline game of light and shadow! sh2dow cat is a puzzle platformer that combines two 2D perspectives. Switch between a physical white cat and a shadow cat, and use the light to find your way through the levels.

details.title: ZAIBALY
details.short_description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

details.title: The Plus-One Kingdom
details.short_description: In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

details.title: DarkCage
details.short_description: DarkCage is a mystery escape-room adventure where you must solve puzzles and gather clues alongside others trapped in an unfamiliar place. Only by uncovering the truth can you hope to escape.

details.title: INTERRED
details.short_description: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

details.title: Anomaly Planet
details.short_description: A Singleplayer Horror Game about navigating an Endless, Living Labyrinth buried in a Mysterious Planet, all whilst facing Dangerous Entities.

details.title: Tower of Genn
details.short_description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests and discover new interactions with special blocks, strategically placing your pieces, to build a lasting legacy for your people.

details.title: Break Point: Brace & Breach
details.short_description: [Hero-Building] + [Frontline Tower Defense]｜Hold against multi-lane assaults｜Adjust positions, facing, skill builds, and formations to create a unique defense｜Push the front, seize resources, and strengthen your heroes｜Let the enemy tide shatter against your masterpiece

details.title: PicoCat
details.short_description: This is a cozy, relaxing idle game that can float anywhere on your screen. A group of adorable stray cats live on this island. Care for them and give them forever homes, so you can enjoy heart‑warming cat‑petting moments amid your busy daily life.

details.title: Cat Guardians(캣 가디언즈)
details.short_description: A crisis arrives while the owner is away on a trip! A warning from mice trying to steal the premium cheese! Build defenses, jump in as one of 4 cats, and draft a card every wave to save the premium cheese. Solo or 4-player online co-op.

details.title: Rescue Incoming
details.short_description: Survive escalating zombie attacks while scavenging supplies and upgrading your gear. Hold out until rescue arrives... if you can.

details.title: Karnage: The Legend Grows
details.short_description: A challenging, heavy metal–infused rogue-lite where you battle hordes, build powerful weapon synergies, and rise to challenge the great wyrms across a dark fantasy world.

details.title: Loreth
details.short_description: A Roguelike strategy game set in the Loreth Academy, where you play as a student god researching civilizations, ecosystems, heroes, demons, and the laws of the world through powerful symbol-building simulations.

details.title: Pebble'z
details.short_description: Pebble'z is an online FPS arena shooter set in a medieval fantasy universe. You play as one of Great Wizard Geoffrus' golems. Now freed from his evil reign, you can finally fight your stone-headed brothers and see which golem is the best!

details.title: Ruin Blade
details.short_description: “Ruin Blade” is a top‑down melee‑focused action RPG. You descend into ancient ruins long forgotten by the world. Face waves of relentless creatures and carve your path by steel, instinct, and the will to survive.

details.title: 中国棋牌博物馆
details.short_description: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads.

details.title: F.A.G.E.N.
details.short_description: F.A.G.E.N. is a 2–4 player co-op comedy-horror game where every sound you make affects your nose. Run a bizarre restaurant by day, collect the F.A.G.E.N. resources demanded by your boss at night, and try to reach the goals they set before you get fired.

details.title: Degrowth
details.short_description: Unbuild various cities in order to convince citizens of the benefits of cloud based living! Perform demolition using our simple one-click interface, but be careful not to delete the homes of citizens who are still employed! Your work is complete when everyone's brain is uploaded to the cloud!

details.title: Long Rescue
details.short_description: Long Rescue is a Survival Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies across multiple worlds in pursuit of the villain who stole your dog. Build and customize your character with crazy ability combinations to grow into a powerful force capable of defeating your nemesis. Will you rescue your dog?

details.title: Paycheck to Paycheck
details.short_description: A life sim where you grind late-night jobs to pay off debt. Manage hunger and fatigue as you work. Want a shot at turning your life around? Scratch and pray!

name: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!

details.title: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!
details.short_description: After being cast out of your sect, you decide to grow stronger your own way. This idle cultivation game combines automatic combat, equipment progression, and combat skill builds. Train in twelve classes, refine it to higher tiers as you face hordes of monsters and powerful bosses.

details.title: The Last Summons
details.short_description: A co-op dungeon action game. A calamity has woken beneath a village, and the last summons brought you here. In parties of up to 10, descend into ever deadlier depths, slay the bosses below, and bring back stronger weapons and lost powers — if you survive.

details.title: Eau de Tycoon
details.short_description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

details.title: FishingMaster: Catch Giants Together
details.short_description: Fishing Master: Catch Giants Together is a first-person fishing simulation focused on realistic float fishing. Cast your line, watch the float, set the hook, and fight powerful fish. Control your rod angle, manage line tension, and enjoy peaceful lakeside scenery between thrilling catches.

details.title: Bubble Boom 2000
details.short_description: BUBBLE BOOM 2000 is a free-to-play Top Down Shooter inspired by popular 2000s and early 2010s aesthetics, packaged in an experience that makes you feel like you're back in a 90s arcade. Play as bright and bubbly characters across different maps and pop all of your foes.

details.title: Secret Daifugo
details.short_description: An online-compatible President where "secret effects" hidden in the cards decide victory or defeat. Each player chooses two effects and assigns them to a card number that only they know. Deduce the effects set by the other players and gain the advantage in the game.

details.title: Strange Plains
details.short_description: Roam as a buffalo through seven strange eras in this single-player action roguelite. Graze to survive, restore the prairie, and protect a growing herd. Face hunters, cryptids and visitors from above, then carry your surviving family home to the Wallow.

details.title: Turret Slayer
details.short_description: Build your own turrets, one wild part at a time. Find secret combos, fight off boarders, beat the bosses, then take your winning ships into the Galactic War.

details.title: The Invisible Ruins
details.short_description: You came for a lost treasure hidden beneath the ocean floor. You will have to decrypt an ancient language to find the way

details.title: Sector Scavengers: Signal & Salvage
details.short_description: Deck-building roguelike built on top of a basebuilding RPG. Wake into debt. Scavenge derelicts. Play risky cards. Die a lot. Every collapse unlocks new cards and perks. Can you pay off the Company, or will you be booted out the nearest airlock when the next bill comes due?

details.title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
details.short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Gods With Guns
details.short_description: In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok! Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.

details.title: DRONECOM
details.short_description: A real-time naval sensor-warfare game where EMCON is everything: every emission that finds the enemy helps the enemy find you. Design your own drones: subs, ships, aircraft, missiles, and launch them from carriers. Physically modelled radar, sonar, IR and ESM in a moddable CIC sandbox.

details.title: 危ノコ
details.short_description: Control a mushroom and climb toward the summit while avoiding dangerous “Abunoko.” Overcome various obstacles and carefully make your way upward. A single mistake can send you falling far back down. The higher you climb, the more dangers await, testing both your skill and patience.

details.title: Kircles
details.short_description: Kircles is a designer-driven tower defense game where players can combine 18 different turrets to create unique mechanics and prevent “bugs” from reaching the exit. 60+ levels in three campaigns. Every level can be solved with different approaches optimizing resource spending.

details.title: Cunning Stunt Racer
details.short_description: Inspired by the legendary Stunt Car Racer, Cunning Stunt Racer brings back the raw intensity of high-risk, high-reward racing — rebuilt with retro visuals with a modern twist, modern physics, and competitive gameplay.

details.title: LUBA
details.short_description: LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements. Explore a mysterious place and find your way using light and shadow.

details.title: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike
details.short_description: A Sci-fi Falling Block and Color Matching in Space with Slimes! Slimestronauts: Burst Strike demands you keep cool under pressure just like the good old days! Unlike the good old days; there Obstacles, Enemies, to overcome, help of Ability Enhancing PWUPS, and even Custom Game Mode!

details.title: VIGNETTE
details.short_description: A first-person point-and-click psychological horror game. Only the areas illuminated by your flashlight change in appearance. The game progresses through quiet unease and puzzle-solving, without relying on jump scares. A demo is now available (approx. 20 minutes).

details.title: Nappy Knight
details.short_description: You wake up in a strange land, you don't know who you are but you know what you must do - kill, loot, repeat.

details.title: 技能贪吃蛇 , Skill Snake
details.short_description: "Skill Snake" is an innovative casual game that adds skills and new mechanisms to the traditional Snake game and combines it with simulation management.

details.title: Clinical Memory
details.short_description: Clinical Memory is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ward 7B hospital. Experience distorted memory cycles, explore a changing environment, and make choices that may bring you closer to the truth or send you back to the beginning.

details.title: Evidentia
details.short_description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

details.title: CARDaCOMBS
details.short_description: A retro roguelike deckbuilder where cards cost more than just energy. Descend the CARDaCOMBS, defeat monsters, and upgrade your deck with cards that cost energy, discards, blood, and MORE!!!

details.title: STILL WATCHING: The Night Caregiver
details.short_description: Your real smartphone is your only weapon... Sync your phone with the game and pray it doesn't ring while you're hiding in the closet.

details.title: NoOneKnowsME.
details.short_description: You are not human—and no one can ever find out. NoOneKnowsME. is a psychological horror adventure set aboard a spaceship. Complete daily tasks, survive tense conversations, and hide your true identity for seven days as you make your way back to Earth.
developers: 箱詰めプロダクション

details.title: Is Gambling Bad For Business?
details.short_description: Grow a company from one tiny office into a billion dollar HQ tower, then bet it on a coin flip. Hire from CVs, survive crises, keep the board happy and don't go bankrupt. Build only with gambling winnings. Then go online: buy land from cities and conquer other players' plots at blackjack.

details.title: DRAWCERY
details.short_description: Draw your spells. Command the elements. DRAWCERY is an online PvP spell-summoning game with unique, draw-to-cast combat. Sketch elemental symbols in the heat of battle to unleash real-time magic and outplay your rivals like a true wizard.

details.title: Infiniterra
details.short_description: A voxel sandbox focused on atmosphere and contrast. Explore layered worlds, survive eerie nights, and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

details.title: Incrawler
details.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler where you slay enemies, collect loot, and build powerful hero synergies. Master skill trees, invest in unique traits, and prestige to push deeper and defeat challenging bosses.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Stratagem
details.short_description: A retro-inspired, narrative-driven turn-based tactics RPG. Enemies telegraph their attacks before executing them, and it's up to you to disrupt them. Lead your heroes to victory to restore the Han dynasty!

details.title: 幻想乡毋宁
details.short_description: Grow crops, build a home, and venture into Gensokyo in this 3D Touhou Project fan game. Explore the Human Village, get to know familiar characters, and combine everyday life with journeys and action combat beyond your fields.

details.title: Silentia
details.short_description: In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears. Hunt as Krav, a creature that grows stronger with every sound, or survive as one of the many, escaping in total silence. Make a sound, and it finds you.

name: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg

details.title: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg
details.short_description: Step into the boots of a guard in the dark megapolis of Haensburg. Master first-person combat and exploration in a striking 2D-in-3D stylized world. Caught between powerful factions, your decisions will shape the city's fate. Will you uphold the law or survive the shadows?

details.title: Quackoban
details.short_description: In Quackoban you will push blocks that fuse into shapes, teleport and move in groups. A new and challenging twist on the Sokoban block-pushing classic, bringing it to new dimensions where you have to think in shapes.

details.title: VeriData Inc.
details.short_description: Solve spreadsheet-based puzzles and handle crazy coworkers in a normal day's work at VeriData Inc.

details.title: Menhera Maiden
details.short_description: A ‘Landmine × Yuri’ Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

name: A Game About Launching A Ball

details.title: A Game About Launching A Ball
details.short_description: A challenging game about launching a ball to collect stars. Collect the stars as fast as you can, discover the secrets, upgrade your ball, and unlock the awards. Grab a friend to play online or split screen!

details.title: Jingle Balls
details.short_description: Santa is injured and the gift list is gone. Jingle Balls is a first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Search each house for clues, choose the right gift, and leave it without being seen. House layouts change between visits. Face different enemies and use a range of items.

details.title: Dungeon of Departure
details.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious cave system, four dungeon explorers struggle to find a way out before the light fades forever... Navigate a mysterious underground as you navigate through multiple story paths in this text-based, pixel-art, dark fantasy rpg, visual novel computer game

details.title: FingBlade
details.short_description: Fingblade is a physics-driven Rogue-lite action game. Swing your mouse to control the weapon's real inertia, slashing through endless waves of enemies. Unlock 4 unique weapons, master Chain Lightning and Necromancy builds, and collect gems for permanent upgrades. If the blade breaks, you die.

details.title: soupsoup
details.short_description: Explore diverse illustration magazines in soupsoup, a hidden object game filled with unique artistic visions. Experience over 200 creative stages featuring relaxing healing sounds. Collect stars to unlock new magazines and immerse yourself in beautiful worlds created by talented artists.

details.title: WING-IT
details.short_description: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

details.title: Childrens Story
details.short_description: Childrens Story is an Anthology Game that presents a growing collection of stories on VHS Tapes. Each tape contains a one-off story with unique plot and setting elements that evoke fear, wonder, and live entertainment. Tune-in Next Time!

details.title: Liar's Lift
details.short_description: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

details.title: Maum
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Collect potions and spells, use them wisely against enemies for protection or fun.

details.title: Midnight Cleaner YOKOHAMA Bay Beats
details.short_description: Dark Story Rhythm Game

details.title: Legend Of Asha
details.short_description: Enter the Kingdom of Ngoma in the Legend of Asha, a Top-Down adventure set in a unique and vibrant Afro-Fantasy setting. Explore unique and beautiful landscapes, use and upgrade powerful elemental abilities, fight off enemies and defeat Thonarka the Ravager to restore balance to the land.

details.title: 2P连接中
details.short_description: In the virtual world known as MoMoLand, bugs are no longer glitches but the tools you rely on for survival and breaking the rules. Your goal is to navigate through limited, sandbox-style maps, using various bugs to evade patrolling service robots and ultimately reach the exit.

details.title: Almamon
details.short_description: Bond with mons and uncover a clash of cosmic powers in this turn based RPG. Choose to battle with deep strategic moment to moment decisions or as a chill autobattler.

details.title: Terra: The Voracious
details.short_description: "Terra: The Voracious", also known as "TTV", is a Furry-Vore RPG, using simple turn-based combat to defeat and escape stomachs, pouches, and much more!

details.title: Skatebound
details.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

details.title: Tower Of Hope
details.short_description: 30 years ago, heroes sealed an Evil God within the Tower of Hope. Now the barrier is broken. You are an adventurer seeking glory, but the truth of what really happened waits inside.

details.title: Lost in Art
details.short_description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

details.title: TAMITOS: Tale of Understanding
details.short_description: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

details.title: HAE Stack
details.short_description: In the far future year of 2025, society is dominated by a handful of global megacorporations that surveil everyone, everywhere, at all times. They know where you go, who you know, what you like, and sell that information to anyone willing to pay. But you need a job, and one of them is hiring.

details.title: Flow - The Tidal Whispers
details.short_description: A challenging narrative platformer built for the NES, where kindness shapes the journey.

name: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3

details.title: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3
details.short_description: Slide, trick, and throw snowballs in this fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by Ninja Gaiden and Sonic. Play solo or local co‑op as you battle enemies, discover perks, and master icy challenges in Rise of the Penguins 3.

details.title: Dig n Fight
details.short_description: Dig for treasures, build powerful backpack synergies, and defeat all enemies.

details.title: Infinigama
details.short_description: Explore a universe of diverse worlds. Jump between adventures, trade, craft, and meet other players. Each world offers unique challenges, while a shared economy and evolving environments let your actions ripple across the entire connected universe.

details.title: RelicFairy
details.short_description: Abyss is a roguelike action RPG where players build powerful synergy blocks using equipment and skill items. Combine abilities, create unique builds, and fight your way deeper into a dangerous dungeon filled with unpredictable challenges.

details.title: Project OC
details.short_description: Project OC is a multiplayer online desktop idle game. Unlock 1000+ customization options through idle gameplay and freely mix appearances, outfits, expressions, and actions to create your unique OC. Invite friends to join and let their OCs live on your desktop!

details.title: Frost Muscle
details.short_description: Get good at sliding your muscle car on snow. Earth is freezing and only your driving save it.

details.title: You Are ¿Not? A Dentist
details.short_description: Brush their teeth. Accept their gifts. Pay your rent. Explore many towns in this first person brush-em-up adventure about an aspiring dentist pursuing their dreams. You can heal the world, and even support yourself, if you try!

details.title: Spatial Puzzle 3D
details.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game that combines spatial logic and brain-teasing challenges.The game features simple controls and a relaxed pace with a satisfying level of challenge. It is designed for players who enjoy Sudoku, Rubik’s Cube, and other spatial logic puzzles.

details.title: Zero Point
details.short_description: Mine ore, draw water from a spring, and harvest greens on an alien world. Craft gear, expand your outpost, and set up defenses for the night. Help three stranded friends find a way home in this single-player sci-fi survival crafting adventure.

details.title: Dark March
details.short_description: Dark March - is a casual, humorous, single-player pixel adventure game set in a fantasy setting. You are a lich! You must rid your lands of corruption, restore order, and bring peace to those in need! Summon helpers, use magic, explore the world, and defeat your enemies!

details.title: Jingle Blocks
details.short_description: Jingle blocks is a Christmas themed incremental in which you have to make enough toys for the whole world ! Collect ressources, craft unique hand made pixel-art toys, rebuild your village and prepare each year for the best Christmas

details.title: Overcommit: Class Inheritance
details.short_description: Manage chaos, people, and impossible expectations in a satirical corporate world. Turn stress into progress, survive absurd workflows, and keep your sanity intact. How much can you handle before everything falls apart?

details.title: Forge In Hand
details.short_description: Forge in Hand is a poker roguelike deckbuilder where you craft your own luck. Change ranks and suits with cheat cards, combine relics and enchantments, and chase powerful hands. Scoring consumes cards from your deck, so every big play comes at a cost. How far can your deck take you?

details.title: Seven Relics
details.short_description: This is a card adventure game where you can choose 4 characters to form a team, select different routes to defeat enemies, and earn gold and experience points. Enemies will attack, and you can level up characters, purchase equipment, upgrade, enhance, and forge your cards to defeat powerful foes.

details.title: Hecatomb
details.short_description: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

details.title: Tide Fall
details.short_description: Explore dangerous islands, build and defend your base, sail the seas, and raid rival crews in this open-world pirate survival game.

details.title: Spinbot
details.short_description: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

details.title: Between Worlds: challenging puzzles
details.short_description: "Between Worlds" is a 2D puzzle game where you reshape the boundary between two intertwined worlds to reach the goal. Turn characters into terrain to create paths, but every change affects both sides of the world. Use logic, shifting gravity, and creative thinking to solve complex puzzles.

details.title: Monsters Awaiting Parcels
details.short_description: Parcels arrive every day — along with those who want to claim them. Find the parcels, make decisions, and don’t make mistakes, because if something goes wrong, the consequences can be… unpleasant.

details.title: The Letter
details.short_description: The Letter is a narrative-driven psychological adventure set in a forgotten town. Explore abandoned streets, follow scattered notes and hidden messages, and uncover fragments of a story inspired by real events as you piece together a mystery buried in the past.

details.title: Paralegal
details.short_description: Jump into the stress of the working world, as [Law firm's name here]'s newest Paralegal with this 2d side-scroller! Do important and fulfilling tasks, such as bringing coffee, sorting decades old files and letting a client scream at you, all while the clock is ticking in the Background.

details.title: 澄心大学
details.short_description: 《澄心大学》是一款校园题材剧情向视觉小说。在鲜活而平静的大学日常中，走近四位拥有不同故事的女主角，并通过选择与分支推动人物关系，走向属于你的青春结局。

details.title: Aliens Go Home ReRun
details.short_description: Brick-breaking and SHMUP elements combine in this 2.5D remake of the 2017 title Aliens Go Home Run, with new stages, characters, and more! Play ball... Again!

details.title: Mass Edge - Gravity Ball
details.short_description: Mass Edge is a vibrant 3D puzzle-platformer that challenges your perception of movement, space, and timing. Built around a unique physics-based rolling mechanic, players must navigate intricate 3D environments by carefully controlling momentum, balance, and spatial awareness.

details.title: Thugs in Fantasy
details.short_description: You know nothing about magic. You don't know how to swing a sword. Fortunately, you know how to throw a punch.

details.title: HIGHEST STAKES
details.short_description: HIGHEST STAKES is a game of Heads-Up five-card poker against the dealer with roguelite elements. Use a variety of chaotic charms and items to cheat the game in your favour. You have a large debt to pay, and at her table, your life is the wager.

details.title: Astrovein
details.short_description: Ready to blast a path to riches in Astrovein? A full hold draws alien warships! Fight beside your captain or man the turret and defend your loot with raw firepower. Upgrade ship, weapons and modules; push into deadlier sectors for rarer ore. Busy? Your captain keeps fighting and mining.

details.title: HUSH
details.short_description: A co-op horror game where you and your friends break into monsters’ homes and wreck their stuff. Smash everything you can and escape the crime scene before they catch you — they hear every sound.

details.title: Veil of Despair - Episode 1
details.short_description: Veil of Despair is an episodic psychological horror series set in a fractured mirror world born from grief and suffering. Episode 1: Death's Reach is completely free and kicks off a descent into loss, trauma and raw emotional pain through suffocating atmosphere and intense psychological tension.

details.title: Hold & Advance
details.short_description: 2D action sandbox about exploring an underground world, crafting and tactically defending alien stations. Build turrets, combine modules and repel enemy waves to unlock powerful upgrades that radically change your playstyle.

details.title: KILL BREACH
details.short_description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

details.title: Bounty Gunman
details.short_description: Control the line of fire. Take the shot. A retro pixel-art 1v1 western shooter focused on positioning and mind games.

details.title: Finding Cats In Green Street
details.short_description: Find cute cats in Green Street. Can you find them? Meow Meow...Kittens are calling you！

details.title: Remaining Kingdom
details.short_description: Remaining Kingdom combines deckbuilding, roguelike progression, and real-time tower defense into one dark fantasy experience where each Lord changes the way you fight.

details.title: Psyai
details.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click detective adventure. Investigate a neon-soaked city, hack corporate networks, and diagnose broken AI minds. Inspired by Policenauts and Snatcher.

details.title: Stray Service
details.short_description: What's cheaper than cheap labor? Cats! Play as Tub and Bub - two very committed felines on the clock to bus tables, wash dishes, and mop up every mess before the restaurant goes under. Solo or with a friend, it's chaotic, it's frantic, and someone's definitely knocking over a stack of plates.

details.title: Last One Breathing
details.short_description: Scavenge ruined locations, manage a grid backpack, barter, craft, and keep your shelter standing through the night in a survival adventure where every item you carry can change the run.

details.title: NIGHTMARE OF THE FOREST
details.short_description: Join Johnny on a desperate search for his missing daughter in a mysterious forest. Confront the shadows and the presence of Marcus in this immersive horror experience.

details.title: Sonnet
details.short_description: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

details.title: Breakkaboom
details.short_description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks. Break stuff with them and just enjoy a fun playground! You can also explore mysterious simulation worlds, but when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

details.title: CARGO CRUSH ZERO
details.short_description: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. CARGO CRUSH ZERO is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

details.title: Exile of Arcadia
details.short_description: A high-octane platformer utilizing a teleporting dagger to traverse through a futuristic city!

name: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil

details.title: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil
details.short_description: A high-intensity, Touhou Project survivor-like action game set in Gensokyo, playable in just 5–10 minutes! Break through overwhelming enemy hordes and bullet hell attacks using your own unique builds and pure player skill.

name: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental

details.title: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental
details.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about flying through space, popping bubbles, and harvesting Bubble Matter. Build combos, land skillshots for massive multipliers, and spend your loot in a sprawling upgrade shop.

details.title: HEMA. Humetal Era Morphose Arms
details.short_description: 《HEMA》is a Character Action Game Mixing with 2D Metroidvania. Beating the AI-Robot army – Humetal with Stylish Combo Combat !! Explore the Humetal Base and Discover Hidden Sub-Gadget And equipment !! Beat the Boss to Upgrade your Character to perform more Flashy Combat Skill !!

name: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero

details.title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
details.short_description: The game centered around Ragnar Lothbrok, a legendary Viking hero. Players assume the role of Ragnar, who has been reborn by Odin’s order to fulfill a divine quest. Ragnar embarks on a journey filled with discoveries, battles, and encounters with mythical creatures.

details.title: Adrenaline Overdrive
details.short_description: In this retro-styled FPS, tear through an alternate 1980s Brooklyn as a vengeful detective enhanced by experimental drugs. Master supernatural movement abilities, and uncover the truth behind your brother's murder - before the power that drives you becomes your doom.

details.title: Goblin Lair: Shards of Magic
details.short_description: Goblin Lair its a fast-paced strategic clicker! Smash your mouse like a maniac to gather crystals! Manage your resources wisely, recruit goblins, build your base and strengthen your warriors. Expand your base, enhance your clicks or automate your miners as you fend off relentless enemy raids!

details.title: 双魂のデュアリスト
details.short_description: "Dual Souls Dualist" is a deckbuilding roguelike game where you combine two decks to create endless strategies. Charge up the cards you draw, unleash powerful attacks, and conquer the evil corporation's skyscraper stronghold while defeating enemies along the way.．

details.title: Spook'd
details.short_description: Deep dive into Spook'd, a social deduction party game. Blend into a crowd of ghost NPCs to survive, or hunt down the players hiding among them. Cooperate or betray your friends, and share the laughs!
