details.title: パラパラパズル
details.short_description: Your animations got scattered — piece them back together! The adorable pixel-art animations by asaha, a creator active mainly on Twitter and YouTube, have been scattered by someone's mischief!? Rearrange the frames and bring their cute movements back to life in this fresh animation puzzle game.

details.title: 木鱼敲敲有限公司
details.short_description: With just a tap of your fingers, you can raise small woodfish on your desktop Seven adorable and quirky little woodfish are at your beck and call. They'll become your work (slack-off) buddies, keeping you company through day and night. Happy or not, just give their little heads a knock!

details.title: Dinosaur Apocalypse
details.short_description: Dinosaurs took over the Earth, and humans were almost wiped out. How would you survive?

details.title: Nordic
details.short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player. Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends! Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

details.title: AstroPoly
details.short_description: A pixel-art space mining game. Dig into procedurally generated planets, chart your own route across the star map, collect rare ores, level up your gear, and grow your fortune by investing in the market.

details.title: Road to FIRE
details.short_description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

details.title: Nightveld
details.short_description: A bullet heaven (a reverse bullet hell) where your only weapon is the light you see with. Widen the beam to see the swarm coming, or focus it to burn what's close, and go blind everywhere else. Survive to dawn, pick a power, and face a longer, hungrier Night. How many can you last?

details.title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
details.short_description: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

details.title: OnlyCats
details.short_description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

name: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon

details.title: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your dream indie game studio from a tiny office into an industry legend. Hire developers, create games, research engines, survive reviews, fight bugs, decorate your office, and make one more release.

details.title: Tap Monster: Forest
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of monsters! Tap the screen, fight alongside your monsters, and conquer levels—easy to start, thrilling to master. Get stronger even while lying down!

details.title: Moonstone Resort
details.short_description: Find tranquility in a peaceful farming life while building a cozy hotel for guests. When you're ready for an adventure, explore the depths of the mines, encountering unique creatures and uncovering valuable resources.

details.title: Final Absolution
details.short_description: Final Absolution is an upcoming survival-horror first-person shooter with a focus on exploration, inspired by Super Metroid and Doom. A mysterious force has overtaken the N-Space rocket launch site and corrupted the artificial intelligence that manages the remote island spaceport.

details.title: Backframes: Escape Together
details.short_description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

details.title: Project Horizon
details.short_description: Project Horizon is a 1-4 player co-op first-person spaceship simulator where the entire crew needs to work together to carefully maintain the nuclear reactor, take up arms against enemy ships, and repair every leak and faulty electrical panel to survive.

details.title: RoMiMiMi
details.short_description: RoMiMiMi is a simple board game. Win the game and reach the last floor.

details.title: Kitty Convenience
details.short_description: Join the adorable kitty crew in Kitty Convenience, a chaotic co-op adventure! Manage a bustling store solo or with friends in modes from Kitten Mode (ages 3-6) to high-stakes challenges. Play locally or online with emote-only chat. Adapt, team up, and keep customers happy! 🐾🛒

details.title: BOTO LABO
details.short_description: Solve up to 100 Sokoban-Puzzle levels with the help of your robot friends! Arrange them. Move them. Watch 'em go and... reach the flag in your own style! We got cats, dogs and many more!

details.title: On Paper
details.short_description: Dig through mountains of shredded paper in this cute detective puzzle adventure. Sort scraps with Fedo Chan, snap documents together, uncover ridiculous evidence, and upgrade your tools to expose a shady cat businessman. Some secrets are only obvious On Paper.

details.title: My Nail Salon
details.short_description: Create cute manicures in a colourful nail-art salon. Paint and layer polish, blend ombré, shape magnetic shimmer, and add stickers, charms and rings. Experiment in Free Play or recreate your customers’ inspiration photos in Open Store.

details.title: ICE TO MEET YOU
details.short_description: Prepare your courtyard, build snow defenses, and survive a chaotic New Year's Eve snow war! Gather snow, craft snowballs, complete ridiculous errands, and fight off rival neighborhoods solo or with friends.

details.title: Towa Powa
details.short_description: Stack towers, make your own rules, and bring everyone into the same game — local and online. Take on a co-op campaign, create new modes, exploit unbalanced mechanics, share your creations through the Workshop, and relive your most epic matches.

details.title: Columbiad: To The Moon
details.short_description: Build a retro-industrial space program, manage your launch base, assemble and upgrade the Columbiad, then guide each mission from atmospheric ascent to Earth orbit and lunar transfer in a low-poly spaceflight management adventure.

details.title: Burrito Aftermath
details.short_description: Make burritos fast, beat the clock, and throw your creations into the hole before the bomb goes off. Burrito Aftermath is a chaotic first-person arcade cooking game about speed, high scores, unlocks, with questionable concerns for work place safety

details.title: Chaikov Party: Stickman Shooter
details.short_description: Take what you can, run if you must. Stuff everything into your backpack, make it to the edge of town alive, and sell it all to that dealer who buys anything. He might not pay top dollar, but it'll be enough to get you some new gear, a few painkillers, and turn you into the coolest guy on this street

details.title: 无法同意的用户协议
details.short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game set on your desktop. Uncover hidden rules in absurd user agreements, pop-ups, webpages, and minigames. Outsmart the traps, investigate Clause Inc., and uncover the truth behind the installation wizard.

details.title: UNDERKOVER
details.short_description: Hide-and-paint party game for 2–8 friends in a meme-Soviet apartment block. Paint yourself into carpets and wallpaper, freeze, and survive the NKVD officer, his dog in a hat, the blackout — and your own friends, who can snitch on you any second.

details.title: Blightwinter
details.short_description: Blightwinter combines push-your-luck deckbuilding with medieval town management. As leader of a fragile settlement, you must manage resources, assign townsfolk, and prepare for the relentless fall harvest before winter's chill and dark afflictions take hold.

details.title: Flameward
details.short_description: A tower defense on the move. Escort the last flame through a sunless world, command a mounted hero, and play cards to deploy troops and spells. Dodge deadly attacks, break ambushes, and upgrade your deck for the road ahead.

details.title: WHO'S LIVE?
details.short_description: Hide among NPCs and stream live! WHO'S LIVE? is an online stealth and deduction game for up to 4 players. Streamers earn donations while staying hidden, while Enforcers use livestream footage delayed by about 2 seconds to track them down. Play solo or with friends!

details.title: Qrack
details.short_description: Qruack turns your desktop into a relaxing duck pond. Work, meet, or space out while your new companions hang out at the bottom of your screen. over 60 ducks will keep you company either way.

details.title: Arithmeria
details.short_description: Arithmeria is a non-violent RPG for kids that replaces traditional combat with arithmetic questions and realm restoration. Enjoy a full adventure campaign followed by a robust endgame built for grinding and farming!

details.title: The Inconvenience Store
details.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

details.title: Move The Freak Out!
details.short_description: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

details.title: In Between
details.short_description: Three stories. An emotional game about the stories we live in between certain chapters of our lives and the chance to make new choices, reliving those moments.

details.title: Too Deep To Stop
details.short_description: Break dirt, drop treasure, and blow up whatever gets in the way. Too Deep To Stop is a physics-based incremental mining clicker where each haul pays for stronger hits, stranger tools, and a bigger mess on the next run.

details.title: Unreported Shift
details.short_description: Psychological indie-horror, simulation. In the 1990s, a small Balkan border town hides dangerous secrets. When Agent Bogomir is assigned to the checkpoint, he becomes an unwilling witness to the town’s darkest mysteries - and must uncover the monster behind the evil living within it.

details.title: Decksplorer
details.short_description: Decksplorer is a lite puzzle adventure where you explore dangerous decks, find unique items, manage limited energy, and complete contracts. Choose one of four classes and conquer tougher challenges.

details.title: TideBox
details.short_description: TideBox is a 2D physics sandbox where you can mess around with liquids and see what happens. Build stuff, dig tunnels, make rivers, flood entire areas, mix things together, or just dump a ton of liquid somewhere and watch the chaos unfold.

details.title: Mossu
details.short_description: Mossu is a botanical cubesat terrarium floating through the real solar system, with you and your friends as it's caretakers! Hands on plant growth, cubesat construction and exploration in your shared, persistent craft. Go from Earth orbit to the Martian surface!

details.title: Pencil Shavings Soup
details.short_description: Pencil Shavings Soup is an incremental about running an underground factory that makes soup from pencil shavings! Collect, sharpen and upgrade your way to becoming the richest critter ever!

details.title: Night Class
details.short_description: Escape Night Class by exploring the school and solving puzzles without getting caught by the horror of an evil presence.

details.title: Arclore
details.short_description: Steel and sorcery. Fists and inner energy. Arclore is a 2D pixel-art fantasy beat 'em up RPG built around aerial juggles and wall combos. Choose and upgrade two skills, then fight through branching stages solo or in local 2-player co-op.

details.title: The Turing Choice
details.short_description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? The Turing Choice is a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening, because nothing is what it seems.

details.title: D for Defender
details.short_description: A Tower Defense with no respite, no waves, no end. Facing monsters that learn from your placements and adapt in real time to every one of your weaknesses, build and upgrade your defenses freely to create the perfect trap.

details.title: Cleanup Wizard
details.short_description: You, a wizard with a mop, fight against computer viruses to save the world! An incremental about cleaning up and collecting viruses to upgrade your mystic abilities to purge the world of this virus once and for all.

name: 絶望ショッピング ZETSUBO SHOPPING

details.title: 絶望ショッピング ZETSUBO SHOPPING
details.short_description: You wake in a room with no windows and no doors. Your only link to the outside is a shopping site: ZETSUBO．com. A small allowance arrives each day. You buy water. You buy food. The contract runs thirty days. Today's listings: drinking water, cheap rations, a stick of incense, and...

details.title: UNDELIVERED
details.short_description: UNDELIVERED is an exploration-based puzzle platformer in where PAR/Cel, a small, solar-powered robot must traverse an island in search of the parts required to repair the ruined boat of the islands residents.

details.title: Warwake
details.short_description: Take the helm of a WWII battleship in this naval combat game as you steer, manage your speed, and lay your main guns by hand, fighting ship-to-ship duels where turning broadside triples your guns and doubles the target you present.

details.title: PixelPainter 95
details.short_description: Fill the canvas. Then fill a bigger one. An incremental paint game on a 1995 desktop, from a single page toward a billion tiles. Widen your brush, hire painters that work while you are away, and print each page into a stronger start.

details.title: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
details.short_description: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, Lovecraftian 2-player co-op / solo exploration and adventure game where one role charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

details.title: Deal Me In
details.short_description: Build wild upgrade combinations in a haunted casino. Fuse maxed cards into unstable bonuses, gamble across six games, and pay your growing debt while monsters hunt you. A first-person horror roguelike for solo play, 2–4 player online co-op or VS.

details.title: Curse Appraiser
details.short_description: Become the appraiser of a decaying old pawnshop. Uncover the true value of the items your customers bring in and the hidden curses they carry. Read through lies, negotiate the price, and follow the clues left behind by your father to unravel a dark secret in this dark fantasy simulation game.

details.title: Catomi: Suika Roguelike
details.short_description: Turn cute cat-fruit into huge combos! Collect powerful catalysts that twist the rules, boost your multipliers, and change how you play. Drop or slingshot fruit into place, trigger chain reactions, and build powerful combinations that send your score soaring in this Suika-style roguelike.

details.title: Dark Brew
details.short_description: The darkness surrounding the Odyssey Coffee House is undeniable, but what’s the connection behind these unusual occurrences? Who’s the culprit? Dark Brew is a mystery/thriller cafe simulator set amongst the stars. Play as Leon the racoon, and manage the coffee house while talking to patrons.

details.title: X SPACE: Meditation Pod
details.short_description: Work, study or unwind in a sunlit space cabin with a cozy companion by your side. Set a Pomodoro timer, mix lo-fi music with soft ship ambience, and watch Earth, a nebula or a black hole drift past your window. Every focused hour carries you somewhere new.

details.title: 李商隐：青袍玉珂传
details.short_description: 这是一款古风恋爱文字冒险游戏，在晚唐历史的基础上进行了戏剧化改编。你将扮演李商隐这位才华横溢却命运多舛的贫寒少年，在恶劣的世道挣扎求存，在寒门与豪门的斗争中进行艰难抉择，一路上也会有红颜知己相伴。本作对于角色的塑造复杂立体，而非分出绝对的正邪。

details.title: Devour The Kingdom
details.short_description: Sell ​​your soul to a dark deity and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Gather the troops and devour the kingdom. A mix of incremental and auto-battler.

name: 豚の背に明日への金貨を

details.title: 豚の背に明日への金貨を
details.short_description: Is it hope you carry, or a heavy burden? Tomorrow’s Coins, Pig’s Back is a roguelike action RPG. Brave randomly generated maps that grow larger and deadlier as you ascend. Exchange loot for coins, upgrade your stats, and enhance unique weapons. Your choices forge your path in the abyss.

details.title: Eyes Wide Open
details.short_description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

details.title: Flippin Broke
details.short_description: Evicted, broke, and all you've got is a stupid bottle. Flip it, raid Crusty Carl's bin for weirder bottles, and build a team where every bottle has its own chaotic trait. Kick the curb and flip it till you’re rich!

details.title: Glaring Flaw
details.short_description: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, reveal hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both natural disaster and an approaching new era.

details.title: Elsewhere
details.short_description: “When humans dream, they visit actual universes.” Elsewhere is an atmospheric puzzle and magical combat game where you embark on a journey across a breathtaking dream universe. Work with a dragon named Wonder to restore the passage between worlds and figure out why the universe is decaying.

details.title: Mym's Sword
details.short_description: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

details.title: Grim Dice
details.short_description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

details.title: Skillpoint Warrior
details.short_description: Slay, upgrade, conquer! In Skillpoint Warrior, every defeated enemy fuels your ascent to power. Harvest skill points to infinitely boost your stats, hunt for game-changing loot, and crush formidable bosses as you battle your way through diverse, unforgiving worlds.

details.title: Timberheim
details.short_description: Timberheim is a cozy Viking lumberjack game: swing your axe to chop down trees, carry the logs through the deep snow to feed the ever-burning fire, and watch the village rise one log at a time.

details.title: False Hope
details.short_description: One winter. Four survivors, and a wounded stranger who won't last the night without you. To the east lies a missile, the one chance left to end the war for good, if you can hold the camp together long enough to reach it. Every choice may costs someone.

details.title: SELF//FORK
details.short_description: A physics-driven cyberpunk incremental. Fork yourself into data packets, bounce through a hostile mainframe's defense matrix, and reunite the fragments to break free.

details.title: Severed Souls — Chapter I
details.short_description: Above, a floating golden city promises utopia. Below lies an abyss of poverty and despair. In this parallel narrative RPG, guide two brothers separated at birth: a royal heir and a slum orphan raised by a stray dog. Will you bridge their severed worlds, or doom them to a fatal collision?

details.title: Ashioto Kyōfu | Footsteps Terror
details.short_description: Touka Saeki, a former journalist and owner of the online video channel “Footsteps Terror”, travels to an abandoned mountain village where a school drama club mysteriously disappeared to cover that place in her next video. Her arrival awakens a long-buried curse...

details.title: Department 98
details.short_description: Your placement is confirmed. Report to District Intake, desk seven. The previous occupant's effects have been cleared. An idle game inside a fake 1990s office OS about paperwork, promotion, and a job going very well.

details.title: Can't Escape It
details.short_description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

details.title: Ravenian Conquerors
details.short_description: A real-time sandbox strategy game across the vast archipelago of Ravenia, with a new island every play. Lead a faction, raise armies, and seize cities as you evolve through four ages. Prepare for a cosmic crisis that could end everything. Stand against it, or become the crisis itself.

details.title: Crooked Derby
details.short_description: Bet on one horse. Tell everyone you backed another. Crooked Derby is a party game of secret bets and public lies: rig the race with face-up cards, call your rivals’ bluffs, and get away with it. Play with friends online or solo against lying bots

details.title: Sewer Crawler
details.short_description: Survive horrific creatures and collect treasure in underground mazes, talk to eccentric characters, and manage your resources in a first-person survival horror experience.

details.title: Counterweight
details.short_description: A social deduction tower-builder for 4–8 players. Stack blocks, raise the tower, and figure out which of your friends is placing them badly on purpose. Grab chaotic items, vote people out, and forge the Saboteur Detector before every block hits the ground.

details.title: Celestial Sentinel
details.short_description: This is Xhono overwatch space station. Enemy forces are attacking. All kinds of turrets, space station supports and plugins at your disposal. Please use your resources wisely, build your defense, face against all kinds of enemies, and explore the unknown secrets of Xhono.
developers: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio
publishers: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio

details.title: Digital Druid
details.short_description: Build synergistic Gardens in this abstract roguelike deckbuilder. Push your luck and find the balance between growth and corruption. The Garden must Bloom.

details.title: Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business
details.short_description: A co-op restaurant management game where every successful day creates bigger problems. Cook, serve, survive chaos, pay the bills, and see how long your business can stay alive.

details.title: Thousand Ward
details.short_description: Thousand Ward is a tactical collector RPG where you build a 3x3 Band of Wardens, master turn-based Hold, Break, and Surge combat, conquer 1,000 levels across 10 realms, collect 200+ Wardens, and climb ranked online battles through strategy, synergy, and smart play.

details.title: Feastfall
details.short_description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

details.title: Cute & Dead
details.short_description: A fast, absurd VR arcade shooter about a nerd, a zombie apocalypse, and thirty girls who need rescuing. Ridiculous weapons, a very good dog, and a dance floor waiting at the end of every run.

details.title: Climb the Fools
details.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

details.title: The Waiting Game
details.short_description: With This Game, You Can Wait!

details.title: Last Rail
details.short_description: Lead a train carrying the last survivors of humanity across a frozen world. Manage resources, explore abandoned locations, and make difficult decisions that will determine the future of Convoy 07.

details.title: Project Matter
details.short_description: Project Matter is a 2D factory automation game about turning raw inputs into an ever-expanding production web. Place buildings on an infinite grid, draw connections between them, and research new processing chains, waste recovery loops, and advanced materials.

details.title: Burn Tree Burn
details.short_description: An incremental about burning down a forest. Drag a flame across the trees, watch the fire chain from grove to grove, and bank charcoal to make every burn hotter, hungrier and in a larger forest.

details.title: Super Interactive Cats - Desktop Pets
details.short_description: Let adorable cats make your desktop their home! Adopt different breeds, care for them, play with toys, prepare meals, and send them on adventures. Whether you’re working or relaxing, enjoy their lively company throughout the day.

details.title: FrontierLord
details.short_description: FrontierLord is a pixel strategy game to build and guard frontier forts. As lord, build villages, collect wood and ore for production. Place siege gear and wall traps, train troops to repel raiders. Balance building and defense, craft your fort and create your frontier legend.

details.title: The Lost City of Gold
details.short_description: The discovery of an adventurer's journal starts you on an unforgettable journey into the heart of an uncharted wilderness in search of the legendary Lost City of Gold. A relaxing, first-person adventure with light puzzles and platforming across 15 levels.

details.title: DEFAUT
details.short_description: DEFAUT is a 2.5D platformer. As a restoration unit, collect flowers to gain resources and trigger special actions. Your choices in restoration shape the world's fate across different endings. Through overlapping footprints, a hidden narrative slowly reveals itself.

details.title: The Wind And The Snow
details.short_description: An amnesiac dream agent, a snarky black cat who claims to be his subconscious, and a girl in red he can’t quite remember. Wander a snowbound dream of Wilder’s own childhood, school days and lost years, and find out what he’s spent so long trying to forget.

details.title: BricksPhilosophorum
details.short_description: [点金方块]BricksPhilosophorum is an automated game that uses an assembly line to study alchemy. The game starts with collecting minerals, purchasing land, unlocking technology, and building automated production lines.

details.title: Starship Contractor: Galactic Tycoon
details.short_description: Shape the Galactic Arms Race. As CEO of a private space arms company, design modular ships, research breakthrough tech, and win faction tenders. Outmaneuver rivals in prototype races and make critical choices that make every playthrough unique, from a startup to galactic dominance.

details.title: Peace by Piece
details.short_description: Restore peace - one piece at a time. Start a rebellion with a handful of loyalists in this chess roguelike, and grow your army as you free a war-torn kingdom. Gain banners that bend the rules and build devastating synergies as you race to topple a tyrant before his army returns!

details.title: Tutsak
details.short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

details.title: 犯人当てラジオ
details.short_description: This is a mystery novel game where you read short mystery stories and identify the culprit. The game features a total of six scenarios. Read through various mystery stories set in different times and places, and use cards and charts to deduce the answer.

details.title: AKASHA
details.short_description: Welcome to AKASHA. This zen-puzzle platformer will have you questioning your every move. Discover the abilities of the Soul Sphere, solve abstract puzzles, and reunite the Lost Eidolons to reconstruct the pieces of your inner self.

details.title: Too Many Flies
details.short_description: Too Many Flies is an incremental game about exterminating many many flies, exploring a mysterious house and getting that sweet sweet cash.

details.title: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents
details.short_description: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents is a cozy 2D game where you grow flowers, craft beautiful bouquets, and blend fragrant perfumes for your customers. A relaxing experience focused on gentle progression, creativity, and cozy daily routines. 🌸🌿

details.title: Edroseph's Tower
details.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based roguelike RPG with 25 classes and deep buildcraft. Climb the tower solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players, combine talents and equipment, and adapt your party to every run.

details.title: The Heroic Tale of Illumina: 0
details.short_description: The great world tree, Yggdrasil, has long stood watch over the world, providing shelter and bounty for its people. However, the arrival of Dark Lord Asmodeus has Yggdrasil and the world at large on the brink of ruin.

details.title: AstroFrame
details.short_description: Take a seat, engineer! AstroFrame is a 2D sci-fi roguelike that challenges your strategic planning, adaptability, and spaceship designing skills. The cosmos is hostile and your survival depends on your ingenuity in an ever-changing galaxy.

details.title: Gecko: Wall Hacker
details.short_description: A stealth action-puzzle game where you climb walls and ceilings, blend into surface materials, and hack security systems. Use full-surface movement, adaptive camouflage, and spatial positioning to infiltrate guarded environments.

details.title: 找勺子LOOKING for MYSPOON
details.short_description: A horror walking simulator play as a character searching for a lost spoon in a fantastical world You will experience a surreal world, from diverse swimming pools to strange houses. I hope you enjoy it.

details.title: Lyden Lys
details.short_description: Lyden Lys is a knowledge-based metroidvania about an existential journey through a lost homeland. Control the surroundings through music, explore a smoldering world, discover what happened to your people, decide the fate of your successors, and find yourself.

details.title: Realm's Last Stand
details.short_description: An unforgiving tower defence game focused on strategic placement, unique enemy mechanics and progressively demanding levels

details.title: Rectangle Dudes
details.short_description: Prepare to be one of the dudes! Challenge yourself in one of the best, precise yet silly, skill-based platformers. Built for co-op fun, mastery solo... or absolute chaos in party mode! Take a trip back to the age of classic platforming, with awesome secrets, arcade energy, and satisfying challenges.

details.title: The Mirrion
details.short_description: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

details.title: SuperHookGirl Ultra Challenge!!
details.short_description: Soar through the skies with your mouse! Experience high-speed hook-swinging action in Super Hook Girl Ultra Challenge!! Simple controls — but tough to master! Hook onto anything to discover shortcuts and advanced movement techniques!

details.title: Kumori Village
details.short_description: Shine your flashlight into the darkness and navigate a survival horror experience where you must evade monsters. Use, equip, and combine randomly spawned items to uncover the village's mysteries and survive.

details.title: Girl of the Ruins
details.short_description: “Girl of the Ruins” is a horror-mystery adventure game set in the future. One day, a girl who looks exactly like you suddenly appears. As you follow this suspicious girl, you will eventually uncover the truth of the world.

details.title: Right As Rain
details.short_description: Right as Rain is a weather themed head-to-head bullet-hell. Control the projectile deluge by means of a boss character, or be the one to dodge the oncoming raindrops, collect pun-ishing powerups and fight for the Right to Reign.

details.title: Astro Company
details.short_description: Build the path. Defend the Core. Combine towers, cards, and artifacts into broken synergies in an endless tower defense roguelike.

details.title: Izakaya Izakoza
details.short_description: “Izakaya Izakoza” is a deckbuilding roguelike that combines card battles with grid-based strategy. Fully animated, lively characters jump through the battlefield! Live a day that begins with a conversation, flows through food, and ends with a climactic fight.

details.title: The Bespoke Cards
details.short_description: A deck-builder RPG where you customize the attributes, abilities, and aesthetics of your cards and form unique strategies based on your deck's strengths and weaknesses.

details.title: Survival Menu Live
details.short_description: A chaotic Co-op survival cooking game! Team up with friends to gather ingredients, cook, serve dishes, survive monsters, and upgrade your gear to keep your deadly kitchen alive.

details.title: CactusLamp
details.short_description: Take on the seven deadly sins in CactusLamp, an intense 2D action-platformer centered around unforgiving boss battles. Each sin is embodied as an epic boss inspired by Brazilian culture, requiring precision and fast reflexes to be victorious in this unique pixel art world.

name: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~

details.title: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~
details.short_description: This is a stage-based 3D action game starring the cute magical girl Mina. Use various costumes with different skills to clear stages and defeat the boss at the very end!

details.title: Cell 413 : Mine & Survive
details.short_description: A survival game in the life of a prisoner digging a hole to escape. Explore the procedurally generated underground, outsmart the guards, build your base, craft tools and find a way out of there!

details.title: STACK'EM!
details.short_description: Stack cards together, create unique creatures, experiment with wild combos! Prove your creativity in this highly strategic, turn-based deckbuilder against toys.

details.title: Shorekeeper
details.short_description: You wake up on a quiet beach with empty pockets and a whole island to call home. Grow crops, fish off the pier, dig for treasure and cook something warm at sunset. Feeling brave? The caves are waiting. Take it slow, the island isn't going anywhere.

details.title: Local Zombies
details.short_description: Shape unique characters in this choice-driven life sim, then turn them into zombies. Each human’s attributes determine their zombie form and skills. Build your undead squad and conquer Hippo City in automated battles.

name: Plenty of Cards in the Sea

details.title: Plenty of Cards in the Sea
details.short_description: Gather around the table and play a variety of card games with your friends!

details.title: 4Below
details.short_description: A co-op extraction roguelike with active ragdoll chaos. Descend into ancient underground ruins, recover priceless relics, survive the unknown, and escape with enough to meet the quota... together!

details.title: 雾卷·知白
details.short_description: Mist: Conscious of the Light​ is a 2D top-down rogue-lite game. Players can assume the roles of different characters, acquire various weapons and items, and engage in combat by attaching pages with diverse effects to their weapons. Seek out story-driven items, complete individual narratives

details.title: The Joy of Sculpting
details.short_description: The Joy of Sculpting is a 3D party game about sculpting, describing, and ruining each other's art. Shape anything from a huge object library and clay-like blobs, then pass it between friends across four multiplayer modes and watch it mutate into something gloriously unrecognizable.

details.title: Gutterspace
details.short_description: Gutterspace is a hand-drawn, human crafted, poetry-powered couch co-op game about sharing one body and surviving it.

details.title: Dont Look
details.short_description: Your boat stops working. You are forced to the nearest dock. A fog-covered island lies before you. Abandoned buildings. Dense forest. No guidance. Blood everywhere. Warnings remain. You need to leave. Something is watching. It wants you to look.

details.title: Slot Siege
details.short_description: Build defenses by day and fight off hordes and bosses by night in first-person co-op. Spin for gear and keep your team’s slot machine standing through 10 nights.

details.title: Shadow Runner
details.short_description: The first FPS where enemies are invisible? You see only their shadows. To fight, you must follow the light—control it, even create it. With one gun, fireflies, and fireworks, survive a little longer. A minimalist system with unexpected depth. An FPS poem about light, shadow, architecture, and memory

details.title: Mira - Shadow of the Past
details.short_description: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

details.title: Pumpkin Survivor
details.short_description: Pumpkin Survivor is a whimsical cartoon-style survival game where you’ll experiment with countless weapon builds to defend against relentless enemy waves. Mix and match abilities, upgrade your pumpkin hero, and survive as long as possible in this roguelike adventure!"

details.title: Booost!! CleanSweep
details.short_description: Take control of the 'Cleaning Cart' and clean up a filthy city! But beware of the Litterbugs who scatter trash everywhere! Faster, cleaner, better. This is a score-attack car action game.

details.title: TapRacer
details.short_description: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

details.title: Marble Mill
details.short_description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

details.title: Whisker Works
details.short_description: Whisker Works is a chaotic 1–4 player renovation game! Clean, repair, demolish and rebuild with your cat crew, because we clean, we fix, we PURRFECT!

details.title: Australian Hunter
details.short_description: Australia is facing a wildlife overpopulation crisis. You will play as a hunter, surviving, hunting, and working in the Australian wilderness to help the Australian people solve this ecological disaster.

details.title: No Man's Idle
details.short_description: Endless stars, idle fingertips. Harvest planet resources, research exploration tech, and warp your ship across the galaxy — one step at a time toward the Galactic Center.

details.title: spin boom boom
details.short_description: Toggle pivot points via key presses, dodge collisions, and take on the ultimate test of timing and precision.

details.title: Peel Me
details.short_description: Peel wallpaper, dry each layer and rip it away in this strange first person peeling game. Earn Peelcoins, buy better tools and keep working your way through hundreds of layers. Just don’t peel too far. You might find something you weren’t meant to.

details.title: Kingdoms in Ink
details.short_description: A fantasy world's history unfolds on a single map. In this grand strategy game, kingdoms rise, borders shift, and kings and generals pass through the generations. Simply watch, or command a nation and unite the world. Follow towns, people, dragons, and adventurers through a history all your own.

details.title: Lane Siege
details.short_description: > Sack eight castles or die trying. Build your keep on a grid between battles, then > command the fight live — spending food to field archers, knights and siege engines down > one brutal lane. Every castle you take pays plunder. Every one after is tougher.

details.title: GILDEN
details.short_description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action RPG with retro pixel art. Fight through dense hordes of enemies, discover powerful weapons, defeat deadly bosses, and descend 50 floors into the depths.

details.title: VELKOR
details.short_description: Survive a post-apocalyptic open world solo or in co-op for up to 3 players. Brave storms and emissions, build vehicles from scrap, establish your faction’s base and uncover the past. Make choices that shape lives and faction relations: every decision has consequences.

name: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut

details.title: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure with Bahamut, a billion-gold dragon financed through a residual-value loan. Entrusted with the dragon by God, adventurer Leon takes on quests to make his monthly payments. Can he defeat the Demon King and reclaim his peaceful life…?

details.title: Charmwick: Magic Village Market
details.short_description: Claim a plot in a cozy magical village, build your shop, and craft goods from mana and elemental essences. Hire staff, stock your shelves, and watch a market full of quirky visitors decide what they buy in this charming fantasy shopkeeper sim.

details.title: Doomsday tidy up
details.short_description: Every inch of space matters in the apocalypse. Organize firearms and survival supplies inside your shelter, find a place for every item, and turn cluttered storage into orderly reserves for the days ahead.

details.title: ULTIMATE将棋
details.short_description: This game currently supports Japanese only. ULTIMATE SHOGI combines authentic shogi with magic cards and AI assistance. Follow the AI, or play unaided to earn more mana. Build a 20-card deck, bend the rules of shogi, and turn losing positions into unexpected wins.

details.title: W勇者之剑
details.short_description: A red scarf. A hometown forgotten by the world. Follow Ryan from Windbell Village to mysteries in the capital. Explore hand-drawn-style scenes and fight fixed-position turn-based battles. Includes the prologue and Chapter 1; later chapters are unfinished. In-game text is Simplified Chinese.

details.title: Teeth Are Money
details.short_description: An incremental horror game about pulling teeth from a living monster. Grip, shake and yank each tooth free, then spend the money on research that turns one hard-won tooth into handfuls at a time. Keep pulling before the contamination fills, and watch the mouth grow.

details.title: Core0
details.short_description: Core0 blends incremental defense with auto-battling combat. Deploy units, combine automatic weapons, and turn each run into permanent upgrades. Experiment with builds and withstand increasingly fierce attacks.

details.title: MAYBE YOU!
details.short_description: Somewhere in that herd of 30 animals, one is a real person. Find them and shoot first. Your 29 NPC teammates move on your ping. Killed by an NPC? Possess an ally and keep hunting. You only lose to the real player. A 1v1 hide-and-seek FPS across a resort, sinking pirate ships and a Halloween castle.

details.title: Tactical Combat Simulator
details.short_description: *Tactical Combat System* is a realistic modern real-time tactics game set in the turbulent early 21st century. Command your own brigade through large-scale wars, configure every unit, and experience the responsibilities of a battlefield commander.

details.title: Hungry Dancing Wizards
details.short_description: Eat, dance, repeat! Get lost in a musical adventure where quick reactions meet rhythmic flow. Challenge your friends to ridiculous dance battles, chase high scores, and see who truly is the hungriest wizard!

name: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant

details.title: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant
details.short_description: A desktop AI companion who lives on your screen. Chat by text or voice, hear her answer in her own voice, call her face to face, and hand her errands she finishes while you're away. She remembers you and keeps her word.

details.title: Quick Quick Serve!
details.short_description: Turn a four-table diner into a bustling idle restaurant! Serve dishes, hire waiters, and upgrade your kitchen as every coin brings the next upgrade closer. A relaxed incremental game with patient customers and a satisfying journey from hands-on serving to automatic earnings.

details.title: Novus Deus
details.short_description: In a city controlled by a rising techno-religious cult called "The Church of Convergence", Kara fights her way through the corrupted districts to find her sister and save her from becoming a part of the mindless followers of Novus Deus.

details.title: Sandcastle Kingdom
details.short_description: A cozy sandbox for building sandcastles. Shape your island, castles and courtyards with dynamic sand. Dig canals, ponds and fill them with realistic water. Decorate your island. Share your home with cute animal friends, help them with their quests and gather around the campfire as the sun goes down.

details.title: Agoonis
details.short_description: Agoonis is a neon turn-based strategy game where you spend 300 gold to build a custom army, upgrade pieces into new movement patterns, fight over Soul Shrines, and capture the enemy Empress. Play Story Mode, challenge the bot, or take your questionable strategy online.

details.title: Sort The Mart
details.short_description: Sort The Mart is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort hundreds of toys, food, cars, plushies, sports items, and more onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy mart into a perfectly organized store, one shelf at a time, at your own pace.

details.title: Fishing Town
details.short_description: This is a desktop idle fishing game. Collect rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build your own pond and aquarium.

details.title: 美职篮奇迹梦之队
details.short_description: 【NBA官方授权，真实赛场共振】 本游戏内搭载拟真工资帽体系，每位球员的身价、能力值与综合战力，均依据每日NBA真实赛事表现进行实时联动。 【无界交易，市场自由流转】 除交易市场挂售、购买球员外，经理人间还可互相交易，在谈判中探寻价值匹配点，达成交易后球员即可互换东家。 【战术大师，出奇制胜】 50位教练，上百种真实战术，供经理人自由搭配。 临场还可启用自由战术，实时调配球员出手倾向，激活巨星效应。

details.title: Sector Zero: Freedom
details.short_description: A sci-fi incremental simulation where you work as an Imperial slave, build your own business, survive inspections, join unions, and buy your freedom.

details.title: DwarVein
details.short_description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

details.title: Math Defense Protocol
details.short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.
developers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio
publishers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

details.title: Touhou: Cirno's Snowball
details.short_description: Nobody's buying Cirno's bingsu because it's too small, so she's rolling a snowball around Gensokyo to fix it. Strawberries stick. So do crates, rocks and frogs. See what kind of bingsu you can make.

details.title: Spear Dive
details.short_description: Hunt 80+ fish species in a first-person freediving sim. Learn their habits and manage oxygen and body heat. Gear up with spears, fins and wetsuits to dive deeper. Explore seas with daily changes in temperature, murkiness and waves, fill your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

details.title: Arcade Together
details.short_description: Run the arcade. Play the arcade. Together. Team up with friends to run your very own arcade! From classic cabinets to extreme experiences, from a corner shop to a grand entertainment center — build your arcade empire, side by side!

details.title: Dungeon Typist
details.short_description: Dungeon Typist is a typing-driven dungeon roguelite where every word becomes an action. Type words to move, attack, and cast abilities while enemies act in real time. Dodge danger, collect gear, and build powerful combinations as you venture deeper into the dungeon.

name: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market

details.title: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market
details.short_description: Cozy first-person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort gifts, sweets, decorations, toys and festive treats. Tidy up the Christmas market, earn points and restore order before the holiday crowds arrive!

details.title: Arcane Circuit
details.short_description: ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite. Socket Core Cards into Emitters, chain Modules together, and create fully automated arcane circuits. Explore the wastelands, collect powerful Relics, and build your very own spell-slinging machine gun!

details.title: Re:Red
details.short_description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

details.title: Me VS Demonking?Seriously?
details.short_description: This is a proper auto-battler game... right? Aside from the characters being a bit odd, the equipment a bit bizarre, and the skills a bit baffling... everything else seems pretty normal.

details.title: Pickup Point Chaos
details.short_description: Run your own pickup point! Receive, scan, sort, and shelve packages. Find customer pickups, then weigh and label outgoing shipments. Carry several boxes to save time, but customers may knock them down. Handle package rain, fragile items, and explosives—and don’t blow up the place!

details.title: Devour & Evolve
details.short_description: Born at the bottom of the food chain in a first-person labyrinth. Devour what you weaken and keep one of its skills or traits, or bind it and breed it at home: its egg is your next body. The blood remembers. Train what you eat, fuse it into new arts, and evolve into branches your line never had.

details.title: Fishing Spot
details.short_description: Fishing Spot is a relaxing fishing game about discovering unique fishing locations and the species that inhabit them. Generate new spots with their own ecosystems, fish populations, bite schedules and bait preferences, chase records, and build your collection — all at your own pace.

details.title: Over The Gnome!
details.short_description: Become a giant gnome-crushing boulder. Chase the treasure gnomes, shrink the giant yetis with your shrink ray, grow and improve until you crush them all. Travel through 5 unique worlds, prestige, and unlock permanent talents to become unstoppable.

details.title: MechInfection
details.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 2–4 players. By day, scavenge supplies across shifting locations; by night, defend your shelter from the things outside. Craft weapons, set traps, cook, survive together, and break out of a dead world before dawn.

details.title: Haeresis
details.short_description: Haeresis is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by the classic solo card game, Scoundrel, where you purposely put enemies into your deck. Climb your way up a dark, ruined cathedral to discover what truly lies behind the doorway of your religious pilgrimage.

details.title: Mystery Box Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own mystery box business! Source returned shipments, storage finds and second-hand treasures. Hunt for hidden gems, identify valuable items, restore them and create the perfect mystery boxes to satisfy your customers while maximizing your profits!

details.title: Genius Simulator
details.short_description: **Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!** In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

details.title: Sontaku Soul: Read the Boss
details.short_description: Fail and you're fired! SONTAKU SOUL is a collection of rapid-fire microgames about Japanese business etiquette. Play as Tamako, a brand-new employee, and find the right move in every situation—bowing, business cards, seating order, toasts and more—to survive the harsh world of work.
developers: ブラック企業サークル
publishers: 株式会社セブンコード

details.title: Paceweaver
details.short_description: Backstab for double damage. Every enemy move is telegraphed in advance. Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike fought on a single lane, where distance and facing decide everything. Slip between telegraphed attacks and get behind your foe.

details.title: 露娜2：拾光之约
details.short_description: 《露娜2：拾光之约》是七龙游戏运营的3D-MMORPG游戏。以Q萌画风、奇幻故事、三大种族设定、三大职业等多元化的游戏内容深受玩家喜爱。农场种菜、河边钓鱼、小屋装扮等等那些年最纯粹的玩法，如今悉数回归。最经典的版本，最原始的感动，让我们一起重返蓝色大地，开启这场奇幻的冒险之旅吧！
developers: 江苏三九互娱网络科技有限公司
publishers: 江苏七龙网络科技有限公司

details.title: Die Asche von Dornhain
details.short_description: A fully voiced German narrative game where choices open different scenes, relationships, and endings. Levin and his friends can die, go missing, or survive profoundly changed. No single playthrough reveals the whole story.

details.title: Roll Brighter
details.short_description: Tether up and prove your teamwork in Roll Brighter, a physics-based driving game filled with chaotic traps and fun obstacles! Coordinate with friends via a physics rope, or relax in solo mode as you navigate a vibrant, atmospheric world designed for a satisfying casual driving simulation.

details.title: Set, Bounce, Cheese!
details.short_description: Guide Squeaky, a courageous little mouse, on a physics-based quest to save his village from tyrannical cats! Instead of controlling Squeaky directly, place an unlimited supply of bouncy gadgets along his path to guide him past traps and collect every last piece of cheese.

details.title: ProutoPulsion: Fart on your friends!
details.short_description: Have you ever dreamed of farting on your friends? ProutoPulsion is a fart-ass-tic couch game where up to 4 players fly and fight each other using their ultimate weapon: large, loud, unbreathable farts. Show your friends who is the true martial fart-ist!

details.title: Doctrine Strike
details.short_description: Modern real-time strategy in real cities. Pick a place on Earth, generate its real landmarks in 3D, shape the terrain, design your own units and factions, then fight combined-arms wars with superweapons on the map you built. Free to play.

details.title: Hand Stretched
details.short_description: Run a wood-fired pizzeria covering three key roles, Chef, Waiter or Manager, over frantic 6 minute shifts! Can you and up to two friends keep the customers fed and the accountants happy? Or see off a rival shop in a head-to-head, best of three/five battle with up to five other players?

details.title: Restock Master
details.short_description: The doors are locked, the parking lot is empty, and the aisles are in complete disarray. Restock Master is a first person supermarket organization game. Pick up scattered groceries, sort them out, and fill every empty shelf. No clocks, no customers, no stress.

details.title: The Wind from the East
details.short_description: A hand-drawn school visual novel. In 2004, five students handed in a blue-cloth folder; it came back with the last page cut out. Twenty-two years later you sift the archives - race sheets, carbon copies, loan dates - to find those five and decide whose ending gets put back. Nine endings.

details.title: Hood
details.short_description: England, 1216. Experience the true story behind the Robin Hood legend as you control Williken of the Weald in this 2D pixel art stealth platformer. Explore, sneak, and fight your way through the forests, villages, and fortresses of Kent to take down the ruthless Castellan and save your family.

details.title: Catadel: Slot Defense
details.short_description: Command an army of cats in this slot-defense roguelite. Pull the lever, chain cascading matches and hold the castle, then push your luck on the multiplier wheel for up to ×10 damage. Damage becomes Gold, and the royal tax always comes due. No real money, just risk and reward.

details.title: Grenade Party
details.short_description: A party game for up to 8 players where the crowd throws grenades, bombs and food onto the field. Catch grenades and throw them back to survive, and mix kart races, football, basketball, hockey, beach volleyball and obstacle courses into the same match.

details.title: WILD DECK
details.short_description: One friend with a shotgun, the other friends turn into random animals and try to survive. Asymmetrical action for up to 11 players, varied maps, funny animals, and absurd deaths

details.title: SCP: Rapture
details.short_description: The city has fallen. Multiple factions now race to secure the information buried in Facility 9's ruins. You're part of the backup team — one mission: get the information, and get out. The anomalies that were once contained now roam free, and they're unlike anything anyone's ever seen.

details.title: Bounced Out!
details.short_description: In Bounced Out! go it alone or team up with a friend to staff The Pound, a chaotic nightclub owned by "Mad Dog". As bouncers: check IDs, defuse situations, fight customers and make as much money as you can to avoid being fired by the boss!

details.title: The Frog Prince: Unfrogged
details.short_description: Once a prince, but accidentally turned into a frog. Lash your tongue to collect insects, feed the witch’s cauldron, and turn catches into magical essence. Upgrade your skills, survive nasty bugs to restore your prince status in this cozy incremental clicker.

details.title: The Seeker
details.short_description: The Seeker is a three-character roguelike deckbuilder with a separate furry LGBT visual novel. Combine characters and classes into one shared deck, choose your route, collect cards and Tarot Blessings, and earn rewards to unlock stories and new build options.

details.title: Money Grabber
details.short_description: GOLD Digger is a cute, lighthearted Vampire Survivors-like game. 2026, the Year of Big Results! Join Sensen and Liuliu as they frantically dig up money, items, and teammates in a resort hotel—and use the power of money to dig a way out of the zombie horde!

details.title: Castle Reborn
details.short_description: Castle Reborn is a 45-degree isometric voxel action roguelite. Enter an ever-changing cursed castle, cut through hordes of undead, collect weapons and relics, shape a new build each run, and push deeper into the endless night with every return.

details.title: Just Make Sense: Instinct Lab
details.short_description: A laboratory for your gut feeling, most rounds over in 15 seconds: eyeball distances, nail the timing, predict trajectories, count at a glance. 12 instincts, a main map that grows tile by tile, and 570+ everyday scenarios. No trivia, no math — just your instinct. It's sharper than you think.

details.title: Keyboard Companion
details.short_description: A tiny pixel monkey that types along with you. He sits at the bottom of your screen, hits the same keys you do, and when you take a break he snacks on bananas, yawns and dozes off. It never records what you type.

details.title: Scrapyard Survivors
details.short_description: A top-down mech survivors-like. Sixteen minutes of bullet heaven to survive and call yourself the Scraplord. Kill enemies, gather XP, gain more guns. Rinse and repeat.

details.title: Fly Chicken Fly
details.short_description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

details.title: MoonShot
details.short_description: A local coop space arcade game- Shoot your friends while orbiting a variety of celestial bodies. Balance hunting down your friends and staying in a safe orbit while picking up powerups and picking your friends off to win!

details.title: Deduction Society
details.short_description: Seven mystery games in one: Murder Mystery, Identity Hunt (Werewolf), Undercover, Visual Novel, TRPG, Situation Puzzle, Creepypasta. Solo play, no party needed. 20+ roles with AI players, 100+ scripts, 10+ detectives, skill cards for multi-mode deduction.

details.title: Taptown Funk
details.short_description: Taptown Funk is a groovy incremental rhythm game about growing a tiny funky town into a booming city. Hover to build, tap to the beat, catch coin combos & feel the heat. When the music stops, disaster detonates. Upgrade, rebuild or just automate! Can you find the groove, or will Taptown Funk you up?

details.title: Live on, Until we can't
details.short_description: Between a child's first cry and someone's final breath, a tribe's history takes shape. Place its people in buildings, answer unexpected events, and lead the tribe for as long as it can endure in this turn-based tribal survival rogue-lite.

details.title: Clobbo
details.short_description: A physics brawler where nothing despawns. Every enemy you clobber stays where it fell, and by wave ten you are fighting on top of wave one. Blood pools, bodies pile, the map remembers every swing. Die, spend the loot, send in the next robot.

details.title: Horror Doner
details.short_description: Step into your late brother's van run a donertruck through haunted cities full of disguised monsters and deadly anomalies among humans. Survive from dusk till dawn by meeting your daily quota and carefully deciding which terrifying customers to feed, and which are deadly traps waiting to devour you.

details.title: PONK
details.short_description: Battle your way through thousands of mobs and bosses, in this modern rogue-like take on Pong. Build your run with hundreds of combinations and evolutions, unlock everything to become more powerful, and try to defeat the final boss!

details.title: Kingdom Puzzles
details.short_description: A BOSS RUSH of logic puzzles—a feast for the mind. Explore a castle, tackle puzzles, collect treasures, and defeat the King! The kingdom's puzzles always put you in the toughest possible situations. Careful reasoning is your key to success. Welcome to Kingdom Puzzles!

details.title: Defcoon Vaulted
details.short_description: Located deep within a secret vault, you are tasked with overseeing the operations of a classified surveillance program. Play has the Overseer... from the first day to your eventual death.

details.title: TySina
details.short_description: Bring your own character to your desktop. Every time you type or move your mouse, your character moves diligently with you.

details.title: FREESTYLE FPV
details.short_description: Freestyle FPV is a realistic FPV drone simulator built in Unreal Engine 5. Fly multiple drones across varied maps, customize gravity, weight, thrust, PIDs and more, and choose from beginner-friendly modes or full Acro control for a true FPV experience.

details.title: Neonrise
details.short_description: Neonrise is a solo and co-op roguelite brick breaker. Climb from a machine-ruled city's darkest streets into scientifically mapped space. Customize your paddle, unleash wild power-ups, and keep earned cores to grow stronger between runs.

details.title: Cue Career
details.short_description: Build a career in pool and snooker. Control your stroke and spin from a first-person view, enter tournaments, climb separate rankings and practise your position play across American 8-ball, 9-ball, English 8-ball and snooker.

details.title: HEXPANSE
details.short_description: Hexpanse is a real-time space strategy game. Build your ships and stations block by block, mine asteroids, program the doctrine of your autonomous fleets, and conquer a procedurally generated galaxy. Play solo or in multiplayer.

details.title: Valdrys
details.short_description: An isometric MMORPG you buy once. No subscription, one live server for everyone. Five classes, ten specialisations, keyed dungeons for one to five, world bosses, a ranked team arena, and the Bloodgrounds, the one zone where dying costs you everything you carried.

details.title: Re:act
details.short_description: Every stone, every pane of ice, every turn lands on the beat, so the music tells you what’s coming. Crash, rewind, try again, until it clicks and you know it by heart. Every mode is a different way to answer the music. No note highway. The level is the song.

details.title: King's Descent
details.short_description: Ten floors down, a hundred kinds of monster, magic, crossbows, and a king who never came back. A turn-based, party-based dungeon crawler in the 8-bit style: name up to four adventurers, then fight, bribe, loot and level your way down. Every descent is new. A party that dies stays dead.

details.title: CIV Watchers
details.short_description: Guide evolving civilizations across the ages on a living 3D globe, compete for influence on a changing political world. Easily manage complex systems directly on the map with the FlowLines™ visual interface and release your tactical genius in grand battles using WarLog™ battle marks & log system.

details.title: Creators of War
details.short_description: Creators of War is a medieval sandbox strategy game with an open-world campaign and real-time battles of up to 400 vs 400. Command squads, build or serve a kingdom, trade, besiege castles, and shape a world at war.

details.title: Phase War
details.short_description: Phase War is a tactical card strategy game spanning WWI to the near future. Collect and craft 130+ unit cards, deploy your mechs, and watch auto-battles unfold in real time — position formations, load mods and auras, enjoy the show. 100-mission campaign, base building, intel crafting, idle income.

details.title: That Corridor in the Backrooms
details.short_description: Descend into the Backrooms. Walk through an infinite yellow corridor. Inspect the doors and try to find a way out.

details.title: Ping & Prowl
details.short_description: Map the darkness, revealed only by movement. Play as a Ping searching for an escape or a Prowl hunting by echoes and footsteps in this asymmetric game of stealth, pursuit, and quick decisions.

details.title: Turing's Hive
details.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you build computation from simple rules. Route numbers through a honeycomb grid, solve puzzles to create new computational building blocks, and work your way from +1 to arithmetic, algorithms, and beyond.

details.title: 挂机魔女：星夜
details.short_description: 《挂机魔女：星夜》是一款融合桌面宠物、挂机探索、事件系统、合成制造与自动战斗的魔法养成游戏。配置技能链、研究科技、打造装备、获得伙伴，探索由骰子驱动的多重世界与事件。

details.title: Auto Forge: Idle RPG Craft
details.short_description: Idle blacksmith RPG. Forge weapons from a wooden club to a plasma rifle across dozens of eras, gear up your hero and duel real players in the PvP arena. Your hero keeps battling while you're away — come back, collect the loot and forge something stronger.

details.title: Vessel
details.short_description: Search for your missing brother in VESSEL, a first-person UFO abduction horror game. Explore an isolated hospital and surrounding woods, examine objects left behind, and follow his trail beneath strange lights and an unexplained presence.

details.title: 宗门经理人 - Sect Master
details.short_description: <Sect Manager> is a single-player cultivation sect management sim. Build and upgrade your sect, craft equipment, and train disciples. Send them into the Spirit Abyss to gather materials, then prepare your team with equipment, techniques, and formations to battle monsters and bosses.

details.title: The Mysterious Cat Tower
details.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, follow the story of a woman fighting off a terrible curse in order to save a loved one. Discover spells, choose talents, adjust attributes, recruit powerful allies, and reset your build to explore new strategies in order survive the treacherous world ahead.

details.title: The Caretaker: Block 9
details.short_description: "The Caretaker: Block 9" is a horror game set in 2000s Poland. You play as Janusz Nowakowski, former caretaker who returns to his initial occupation. At the beginning everything seems to be just a little scary but at the same moment ordinary...

details.title: KICK//LINE
details.short_description: Dribble, dodge and shoot your way through the city in KICK//LINE, a 3D football running action game. Chain feints, jumps and slides, wow the crowd with freestyle tricks, and challenge street rivals across five cities.

details.title: The Last Summer Holiday
details.short_description: A cozy story game about one summer with your grandparents on the Mongolian steppe. By day, learn the old ways with your own hands. By night, Grandpa tells a folktale and you dream your way into it: a fifteen-headed mangas, a serpent, seven burning suns. Six tales. Six dreams. One goodbye.

details.title: Synthellia: Awakening Protocol
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious 2D sci-fi world where fragmented symbols slowly become meaning. Uncover hidden truths, solve environmental puzzles, and descend deeper into the Awakening Protocol.

details.title: Alien Snap
details.short_description: Explore an alien planet, snap pictures of wildlife and build relationships with your crewmates in this heartfelt sci-fi Point & Click - Visual Novel.

details.title: 阴阳妖怪
details.short_description: Creature collection + text AVG + adventure! Catch 200+ unique yokai, meet distinct companions in a story of conflicts, feelings and secrets. Kincyo, town of human-yokai harmony, is in crisis. Team up with Miumiu to expose the villain—you hold its fate.

details.title: My Bookshop Dreams
details.short_description: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, pet kitties and puppies, collect literary works while helping authors, as you grow your reputation across cities and build a legacy.

details.title: Amanita
details.short_description: Amanita is an introspective journey into your mind where the path seems to be only one, and it does not seem to be easy. Let yourself be guided by surreal characters in your thoughts, clash with your memories with sword blows, wander in your memory, play cards with your fears.

details.title: Table for None
details.short_description: "Table for None" is a pixelated, bite-sized open world, food truck cooking adventure game. Explore diverse regions, discover new recipes, and prepare meals to manage your food truck!

details.title: 救済の日
details.short_description: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

details.title: The C0RE
details.short_description: Welcome aboard The C0RE! A fun, fast action dodger in space where you have to deflect bullets and capture as many powerups as you can! The C0RE has POWERUPS, MODES, A SKIN SHOP, LEADERBOARDS, and soooo much more!

details.title: Beast Reality
details.short_description: 3d Smash Bros inspired fighting game where animals in the distant future need to fight for entertainment.

details.title: Trigonometric Equations
details.short_description: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

details.title: Lunar Lakes
details.short_description: Who said death is the end? In Lunar, death is just the start. Catch mysterious creatures, uncover wandering merchants’ stories, make new friends, and build your own trading empire. All of it happens in the corner of your screen. Still think death is the end?

details.title: Barrel
details.short_description: Don't control the barrel. Become one with it. -- A simple mechanic with tension, triumph, and panic.

details.title: BirdBalcony
details.short_description: BirdBalcony is a cozy desktop companion where you feed birds, decorate your balcony, and collect letter fragments to uncover hidden stories. With changing time and weather, each visit feels alive—you never know who will come next.

details.title: Total Destruction
details.short_description: A 2D side-view action game focused on dynamic destruction and awesome explosions, featuring tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers, ships, APCs, IFVs, artillery and more. May contain nuclear weapons.

details.title: Spheromania
details.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

details.title: A Service Call
details.short_description: Your first assignment alone. An island where no one has lived for thirty years. A lighthouse that stopped shining. The job was only supposed to take a few hours.

name: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-

details.title: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-
details.short_description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

details.title: Tindalos
details.short_description: Fly through a vast fractal temple where ancient voices outlive their makers. Evade hunters, uncover lost memories, and seek a way out in this first-person cosmic horror flight game. Escape draws you onward. The mystery asks you to stay. PC and optional VR.

details.title: Behind Her Door
details.short_description: After work, you visit your older sister’s house. The rooms feel wrong, familiar sounds carry through empty halls, and something may be watching from beyond the windows. Explore, uncover the truth, and survive the night.

details.title: Liberty Station
details.short_description: Estación Libertad is an immersive first-person psychological horror and puzzle experience. Trapped in the shadowy depths of an old, abandoned station in Santiago, Chile, you must confront the oppressive silence of the tunnels and your own fears to find a way out.

details.title: MERVARYN 2900
details.short_description: Start with a small cargo ship and build your way into an interstellar trading company. Buy and sell goods, discover profitable routes, expand your fleet, automate trade and establish your own production facilities in a retro-inspired space economy.

details.title: LOST IN MIND - Chapter 1
details.short_description: "Lost in Mind" is a single-player psychological horror game. Play as a successful and renowned psychiatrist with a secret method. Delve into your patients' nightmarish inner worlds to uncover hidden truths, traumas, and repressed emotions while surviving terrifying creatures.

details.title: Octodefense
details.short_description: Commandeer the galaxy's defense in OctoDefense, a sci-fi tower defense with 10+ hours of tactical action. Master shifting tentacle paths, level up your turrets, and crush colossal cosmic bosses to an epic synth soundtrack across campaign and survival bonus modes.

details.title: Deviant District
details.short_description: Step up to the mic as a fully animated animal comic. Deviant District is a live social comedy club where your voice drives your avatar's face, the crowd reacts in real time, and the host runs the room. Book a set, work the crowd, and build a name on the District's stage.

details.title: Popwork
details.short_description: PopWork is a lightweight roguelite about popping bubbles on an endlessly regenerating bubble wrap. A tribute to the classic Ten Drops: chain-detonate with cross-shockwaves, earn coins, buy items, grab snacks, learn tips, adapt to random events and stage effects, and spend every bubble wisely.

name: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night

details.title: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night
details.short_description: BulbKeeper: Tidy Up the Night is a cozy single-player organizing game. Return scattered bulbs to their original places along the Bulb Street and light up the night. Complete sets of Lights to grow stronger, and use your abilities and strategy to return over 1,000 bulbs as quickly as you can.

details.title: Backrooms: Steal the Furniture
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror comedy. Noclip into the Backrooms, steal the furniture, sell it upstairs and make rent before the smiling thing finds you. Then blow the rent at the company casino. Some nights the elevator opens somewhere else. Every death is on tape.

details.title: Meow Game: Island Exploration
details.short_description: After a storm leaves Nurung the cat stranded on a deserted island, build a raft and set sail. Lend a paw to the cats you meet, brave the Mouse Den with your companions, and make a home on Paradise Island where you can fish and grow crops.

details.title: Age of Nightfall: Tactics
details.short_description: Fight for Dracula or Van Helsing in a turn-based strategy game. The towns you build and the research you choose shape your army. Follow either side's story campaign, battle the computer in skirmishes or face other players online.

details.title: 撕下你的伪装
details.short_description: A modern suspense game. Follow Lin Mo, undercover in a nightclub to find her missing brother. She uncovers organ trafficking—and his lookalike runs the crime group. 4 romanceable leads, multiple endings.

details.title: Skribline
details.short_description: Draw lines to help the skribman cross gaps and avoid neon hazards! Try Endless mode, or beat levels to unlock new skins, effects and backgrounds.

details.title: 永恒传奇之六道觉醒
details.short_description: 围绕这个奇幻大陆展开探索、战斗与角色成长，将传奇系列的装备追求、职业配合和公会对抗融入立体世界。 ⛏️ 独自深入矿洞，寻找成长所需的资源；与队友挑战首领，追寻稀有装备；或集结公会，在沙巴克城下争夺荣誉。选择你的职业与伙伴，开启属于自己的传奇征程！

details.title: InCrimiNation
details.short_description: A cutthroat mob twist on the classic property-trading board game. Buy up territories, run protection rackets, launder your dirty cash before the Feds catch on, and settle scores with Turf Wars, Hits, and Arson. Full lobby multiplayer — every player runs their own copy.

details.title: Flowfish
details.short_description: Catch cute, hand-drawn water creatures in Flowfish! Race your fastest catches and use their unique skills to earn money. Hunt for rare and legendary fish, train your favorites, try your luck at the black market, and upgrade your gear at the fishing shop.

details.title: Shoot Mine Upgrade Repeat
