details.short_description: Fire bouncing bullets into a mine of breakable blocks. Collect gold, equip unusual abilities, and merge items into stronger upgrades. Shape your next shot with lasers, explosions, and cactus needles, then invest in permanent upgrades and dig deeper.

details.title: Invoker Tactics: Conquest
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy RPG combining chess-like grid combat, army building, and a unique unit-merging mechanic. Outplay your enemies through strategic positioning and creative combos. Discover your own playstyle as you recruit new units and expand your kingdom.

details.title: Low Sun
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics on colorful 3D miniature battlefields. Capture buildings to fund your army, combine land, air and naval units, and keep them supplied. Use terrain and positioning to break through enemy lines and seize their headquarters.

details.title: CLUELESS
details.short_description: Your friends secretly choose who you are. Everyone else can see it - you can’t. Ask yes/no questions, follow the clues, and figure out your character! Supports 2-8 players, and only the host needs to own the game.

details.title: SLAPPED SILLY
details.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

details.title: Doodle Academy
details.short_description: Doodle Academy is a card autobattler set in a school where students settle scores with card duels. Spend gold to recruit and upgrade cards, then arrange your team for automatic battles. Uncover the academy’s secrets in the solo campaign or test your lineup against other players’ teams.

details.title: Rap Or Die
details.short_description: Nobody knows your name. Your studio is small. Your ambition isn't. Create beats, write lyrics, record tracks, start beefs, and build your underground rap empire from the ground up.

name: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats

details.title: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats
details.short_description: Cats have one simple demand. They must be petted. Step onto a little patch of grass, find a cat, and give it some attention. Tap to get a cat's attention, then keep petting when it rolls over and reveals its belly. Fill its satisfaction meter and watch it happily run off...

details.title: Rally Together
details.short_description: The whole rally, with your friends. Fix the car in the service park, jump in with your co-driver and race it on the stage. What you left loose you feel in the next corner, and what you break comes back to your bay. Online co-op for 1 to 6.

details.title: Observer Effect
details.short_description: As an unwilling contestant, take part in a twisted game show, a first-person psychological thriller where you solve puzzles, try your luck, test your aim & face unpredictable games. Uncover the secret objective, outsmart the host & race against the clock to survive the show... if you dare.

details.title: Dreams About Fireflies
details.short_description: A first-person dreamcore game of collection and exploration. Chase fireflies through dreamlike worlds, unlock and upgrade various tools to catch them. From infant to adult, experience life's challenges, rediscover forgotten memories, and find the strength to heal yourself.

details.title: Tide & Tails
details.short_description: A cozy desktop idle fishing game made to keep you company. Fish, collect, and display your favorite fish while you work or study. Upgrade your gear, explore new waters, and let your journal record the journey.

details.title: SinEater
details.short_description: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

details.title: The Gaslight
details.short_description: The Gaslight is a chaotic social deduction game where one player is the Murderer, one is the Detective, and everyone else is trying to survive. Talk, lie, complete missions, use your pepper spray, and figure out who you can trust before someone gets stabbed.

details.title: Claire: Operation Velvet
details.short_description: Play as Claire to battle the evil forces invading the world. Harness the power of souls to wield weapons and complete missions. Uncover Claire's story and discover what the malicious Velvet wants to achieve.

name: Mind Echoes: Broken Vow Collector's Edition

details.title: Mind Echoes: Broken Vow Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Forgotten memories haunt the old estate. Uncover a doomed love story and stop the servant hiding deadly secrets within Graven Manor. Follow the tragic fate of Count Graven and his vanished bride Lydia as restless spirits awaken inside this cursed hidden-object mystery.

details.title: UNSPELLED
details.short_description: Cut limbs. Cut names. Be the last one standing. In this chaotic multiplayer brawler, every letter of your name is a life. Lose them all, and you're UNSPELLED.

details.title: Marsheez
details.short_description: A candy-coated party brawler for 1–8 players. Shove, skewer and toast your friends across a dozen sugar-fueled modes, on the couch or online. Squishy marshmallows, silly hats, absolute chaos.

details.title: RE:CHAINED ~Links of Redemption~
details.short_description: Bill climbed the Abyss Tower for cash. Freeing minds in red chains became a rescue he never meant. A comic SRPG of grid tactics and decks. Eight companions seek resurrection. What will they choose?

details.title: Towerburst
details.short_description: An incremental tower defense game where you fight enemies using unique tower combinations. Gather resources from fallen enemies, unlock and upgrade your towers, discover new tower synergies and defeat every enemy before your towers run out of shots.

details.title: Rewind Together
details.short_description: Join your brother on an epic time-travel adventure! Solve puzzles together across Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West to find your way back home. Don't forget to take photos!

details.title: SubQuest
details.short_description: SubQuest is a productivity game that grows with you, right on your desktop. Cute characters, endless adventures, and a diorama where your heroes rest between quests — decorate it however you like! Notes, to-dos, Time-Quests — get your work done side by side with your hero party!

details.title: VORA
details.short_description: Seeking shelter from the bitter cold after a car accident, you take refuge in an old cave. What seemed like salvation quickly turns into a nightmare.

details.title: Doodle Figure
details.short_description: Doodle Figure is a VR party game for one headset and a room full of phones.

details.title: Laurus
details.short_description: Rig the machine until it pays out wrong. Draw symbols from your bag across five reels, chain paylines, and slot circuit-board artifacts into combos the house never accounted for. A roguelike deckbuilder about the arithmetic of very bad odds.

details.title: Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie
details.short_description: In Qinghe County during the Northern Song, manage businesses and household affairs, build relationships, gather rumors and evidence, and set schemes in motion. As Ximen Qing, balance time, wealth, reputation and favors while your choices reshape lives, fortunes and endings.

details.title: Ribbit Robber
details.short_description: A challenging stealth game where every move matters. Sneak, trick, and outsmart enemy guards using creative abilities in a medieval world of frog people.

details.title: The 8 O'clock Block
details.short_description: A retro-inspired puzzle game featuring 11 unique game modes. Stack, match, chain, battle bosses, discover powerful items, and chase endless high scores across a variety of fast-paced block puzzle challenges.

details.title: Jackshot
details.short_description: JACKSHOT is a 2-4 player FFA online first-person shooter featuring fast-paced arcade combat, weapon pickups, and a slot machine-inspired upgrade system. Build your character between rounds and use powerful bonuses to gain the upper hand. Just don't get cursed!

details.title: Starwake
details.short_description: Command a starship through a dangerous, procedurally generated galaxy in this fast-paced roguelike where every pinball shot can mean the difference between victory and destruction.

details.title: Saveseeker
details.short_description: Embark on a quest to overwrite save points in Saveseeker, a turn-based RPG about a time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

details.title: Riot Control Simulator
details.short_description: Take on the role of a Riot Control officer and control a riot. You can either brutally deal with the crowd or use more reasonable options. Will you decide to support a nascent dictatorship?

details.title: Project Warlock: Lost Chapters
details.short_description: Jungle rot. Space horror. Pirate nightmares. Rip through three warped worlds of monsters, mutants and mayhem with an arsenal of spells and dozens of guns - from anchor launchers to chain spears to akimbo M60’s - in this new, standalone game featuring Warlock.

details.title: Cross Reverie
details.short_description: Follow the story of Eight of the land of Xylera’s bravest combatants and their descent into the madness known only as The Trial of Nightmare in this JRPG-inspired title featuring turn-based combat and a character-focused narrative.

details.title: Detained: Too Good for School
details.short_description: ☆A 2D action RPG delinquent schoolgirl simulator!★ Take control of a delinquent schoolgirl freshly liberated after half a year behind bars. Attend classes, fight gangsters, work various part-time jobs, and cause all manner of mischief however you choose in this gorgeous 2D action RPG!

details.title: Deadstick - Bush Pilot Simulator
details.short_description: A career-driven bush flight simulator where judgement, skill and reading the terrain determine whether you make a profit. Take on flying jobs across unforgiving wilderness, build crucial infrastructure and earn a reputation among the island's scattered communities.

details.title: Mike goes on hike
details.short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

details.title: FortressCraft : Phoenix
details.short_description: The third iteration of the game that invented the Factory genre, FortressCraft :Phoenix takes the over-the-top base building and survival gameplay and cranks it up a hundred times. Build your mining base with hundreds of thousands of machines in it, explore alien landscape, heading deep underground.

details.title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
details.short_description: Prologue version of Orc Warchief. Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

details.title: DROSS
details.short_description: DROSS is a procedurally Generated FPS, set in a derelict facility infested with alien bugs. Explore, collect powerful weapons and equipment, to upgrade your gear and fight the Dross.

details.title: On The Hook
details.short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

details.title: Magtong
details.short_description: Airhockey meets magnets! Magtong is a fast-paced, physics-driven sports game where magnetic mayhem rules the rink. Play solo or in teams, locally or online, and outmaneuver your opponents with skill and polarity!

name: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon

details.title: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon
details.short_description: Run five casinos through 1970s Las Vegas, from a sawdust joint downtown to a marble palace on the Strip. Real cards, wheels, dice and keno draws, cheats and card counters, a pit boss on the floor, staff with quirks, headliner shows, and a corporation that wants your house.

details.title: The Final Witness
details.short_description: The Final Witness is a first-person psychological horror detective game where every case tells a different story. Explore a haunted family mansion, uncover hidden truths, analyze conflicting evidence, and identify the true killer before the darkness consumes your sanity.

details.title: Chill Boats: Sailing & Boat Simulator
details.short_description: A physics-based boat game, from sailboats to powerboats. Take the helm of foilers, catamarans or RIBs on a sea that really decides your speed. Race against opponents, or just sail wherever you want.

details.title: America Survival
details.short_description: You are the last Native Americans, the masters of the ancient land of the Americas, hunting, building homes, fighting off invaders, and surviving.

details.title: Ancient Duel
details.short_description: Ancient Duel is a free-to-play historical turn-based strategy card game. Build 40-card decks, combine ancient factions, position units and commanders, and outplay opponents in tactical 1v1 battles where timing, energy and formation matter.

details.title: Text Shelter
details.short_description: Text Shelter​ is a text-based post-apocalyptic idle game. Construct your shelter, plan production lines, and balance power and resources. Venture into the No-Man's Land, upgrade survivor stats, and invest in doomsday industries for greater profits. Expand your camp into a true Ark of the End Times.

details.title: Kito: Lost Trail
details.short_description: Kito: Lost Trail is a cozy 3D platforming adventure where you play as Kito, a young leopard searching for his missing mother. Explore wild environments, overcome platforming challenges, discover hidden collectibles, and grow your abilities along the way.

details.title: Time Traveler: Divergence
details.short_description: A systemic medieval RPG where you play a stranded traveler from the future. Rebuild your device, replicate technology, shape a living kingdom through trade, diplomacy or force, and beware: its people — and History itself — will remember what you do.

details.title: Elixir of Immortality
details.short_description: A cultivation incremental game where alchemy is the key to survival. Recruit minions, manage your alchemy room, seek elixirs to extend your lifespan, and reincarnate when your time runs out. Reincarnate again and again on your path to immortality.

details.title: INNER EKO
details.short_description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

details.title: Best Dam Game
details.short_description: Chew trees, throw logs, blow stuff up. Best Dam Game is co-op physics chaos for up to 4 beavers building one seriously big dam. Take the contract, beat the rising river, fire your friends out of a cannon, and hunt down some very important hats.

details.title: Das Hochhaus
details.short_description: Build and manage your own high-rise in a 2D business simulation. Combine apartments, offices, hotels, shops and cafés, plan elevators and utilities, and balance rental income, running costs and your tenants’ needs as your tower grows.

details.title: Dear Passengers
details.short_description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

details.title: Save Me, Hero!
details.short_description: Explore an eerie world, gather loot, and fuse cards through devouring. Save Me, Hero! is a first-person card RPG. Forge gear and combine talents to craft your own build. Find an opening in turn-based battles and decide who lives as cries for help echo around you.

details.title: Santa's Escape
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 2003. Mid-delivery, the chimney gives way and Santa falls into a dark, silent house in Cedar Hollow, North Carolina. He isn't alone. Search the rooms, uncover what happened to the Stier family, and find a way out of the house that won't let him go.

details.title: The Serena Villa Files
details.short_description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

details.title: Antopolis: The Ant Colony Simulator
details.short_description: Found a colony, dig a nest, and raise an empire of ants in a giant's back garden. A top-down colony sim of pheromone trails, brood and castes, foraging, and three-way war. Survive a whole backyard food chain of spiders, birds, frogs, and rival ant colonies.

name: 魔物娘捕获大陆-堕落篇

details.title: 魔物娘捕获大陆-堕落篇
details.short_description: 从纯爱岛出发后，玩家来到了大陆岛屿的另一侧，这边充满了堕落的气息。 同时也存在着各种各样的魔物娘，他们在不同的气候和地区等待着跟她们一起旅行的队长。 渐渐的，主角发现，这边的魔物娘不仅可以融合出新的形态，还拥有一种名为高潮化的特殊技能。 随着进度的发展，暗处的骚动，也终将登场。

details.title: ACE Football
details.short_description: ACE Football is a football club management game featuring player development, squad building, tactical strategy, and 3D matches. Recruit talented players, train rising stars, build your dream team, compete in leagues and tournaments, and lead your club to championship glory.

details.title: Liminull
details.short_description: Liminull is an atmospheric journey through liminal spaces. Explore, find secrets, solve puzzles, and interact with the world if you want - or simply keep moving forward, toward a place where everything feels so familiar, yet long forgotten.

details.title: Vesper Hollow
details.short_description: A veteran salvager. A dead mining station. A routine job that was anything but. Explore Vesper Hollow — a sci-fi horror roguelite where oxygen is always draining and the station's secrets run deeper than you think.

details.title: Seikyu Let’s Go!
details.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op campervan trip through the yokai-filled wilderness. Snap photos of elusive creatures, decorate your van together, and help the locals you meet along the way. Camp, cook, and clamber across diverse biomes, from misty swamps to snowy mountains. Adventure awaits, so Let’s Go!

details.title: Incremental Magic
details.short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

details.title: DUAT
details.short_description: DUAT is a first-person survival horror game blending exploration, puzzles and psychological horror inside ancient Egyptian pyramids. Explore forgotten tombs, solve deadly mechanisms, uncover ancient secrets, evade relentless horrors, and survive the darkness.

details.title: The Backrooms : Threshold
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

details.title: CASHKET
details.short_description: Make a fortune off the dead. Open stolen coffins for an evil company, sell the loot, and gamble your finds for bigger rewards. Automate the dirty work, unlock the coffins of giants and titans, and crack open rocks to uncover ancient fossils.

details.title: Loss Prevention: Prologue
details.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

details.title: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You
details.short_description: Share quiet campus dorm life with Yiling in an idle companion game. Focus with a Pomodoro timer, track plans and ideas, relax to Lofi and white noise, and choose outfits and decor. Explore her future world through stories fully voiced in Chinese, and uncover secrets about yourself.

details.title: Morpheus
details.short_description: Locked, loaded, on the beat — reclaim the boy's lost memories! Morpheus is a futuristic arcade rhythm game built around heavyweight impact.

details.title: Starfall Samurai
details.short_description: Starfall Samurai blends slash-based action with incremental progression. Drag the mouse to aim your slash, then release as asteroids cluster together. Clear the screen in one strike, collect carrots, hone your sword techniques, and venture ever deeper into space.

details.title: Primal
details.short_description: You will become a primitive man who hunts and tames dinosaurs, survives, and builds a home.

details.title: Sanitarium Enhanced
details.short_description: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium™ returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

details.title: Horror Mahjong
details.short_description: Expect the unexpected! Play mahjong and stay alive in a haunted tea house. Pretend you can't see them—good thing you're well armed. Stock up, shoot, throw tiles, revive friends, and win your hand to get up and cover them. Survive until dawn and escape together, or keep watch with paper tablemates.

details.title: TOUHOU IDLE
details.short_description: An idle RPG that lives on your desktop. Gensokyo's 3D chibi heroines battle along the bottom of your screen while you work, study, or browse. Build a party of four, collect gear, and push ever deeper. Free demo available now!

details.title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
details.short_description: Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. You tap the keys, he swings the hammer. Mostly it is horseshoes or kettles, sometimes a legendary sword. Brygida sells it all in their shop. You type, he smiths. Together, the work goes faster and feels better.

details.title: Speed RPG
details.short_description: Play one card, discard one — both sides commit in secret, then everything resolves at once. Read your opponent on a 13x8 grid, build twin Move and Action decks, and climb the 100-Man Kumite, where turn timers shrink to 6 seconds. Short matches, fast decisions, one more run. Solo-dev alpha, JP/EN.

name: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG

details.title: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG
details.short_description: An idle ARPG for loot goblins. Slaughter monsters automatically, hunt build-changing gear, craft ridiculous builds, unlock new classes, then rebirth and do it all again—stronger.

details.title: The Last Lunch
details.short_description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

details.title: Midnight Haunting
details.short_description: The road home is never safe. Midnight Haunting is a 2D survival action game that demands the deliberate controls of a classic cinematic platformer. Survive a haunting, twisted midnight street riddled with deadly traps to reach the safety of your front door. Your next step could always be your last.

details.title: Holy Relic Shop Simulator
details.short_description: A medieval shopkeeping sim about appraising holy relics. Examine bone, metal, wood and documents in your pilgrim city, find the detail that doesn't fit, pass your verdict — then decide what to do with the truth. A mother begs for a miracle you know is fake. What do you sell?

details.title: Normal Human Jobs
details.short_description: A first-person incremental shooter about eight regular office jobs disguised as an evil robot experiment. Sweep, sort, shoot and buy upgrades until the job runs itself. Finish all eight and the CEO chair is yours.

details.title: KISI: The Deja Vu
details.short_description: 〈KISI: The Deja Vu〉 is a 3D anomaly-detection psychological horror adventure game based on the eerie sense of familiarity felt in a sanity-bending experimental facility—the phenomenon known as "Déjà Vu."

details.title: Across the Dark
details.short_description: A perilous quest to the Demon Lord's castle, where one mistake means death. Conquer foes using 4 heroes—Bloodslayer, IronGuard, GrandMage, SwiftHealer—and 8-slot card synergies. No fast reflexes required. Only your meticulous deck building and health management will save you.

details.title: Colosseum Infection
details.short_description: "Build your unique strategy stress-free, with zero time pressure! Combine synergies, augments, and items to form an unstoppable army. Step into immersive unit-view combat, taking direct control with manual movement and tactical potion throws to reverse the odds in this strategic auto-battler."

details.title: Out Of Sync
details.short_description: Keil, a junior employee at Vanta Inc., has been searching for his missing friend Marcus. As he finds a note in Marcus's handwriting, Keil steps into a parallel world, only to face an unforgettable reality at the final door.

details.title: WayBackers
details.short_description: WayBackers is a 2D puzzle game built on the core mechanics of Minesweeper. Control your character to navigate through blocks filled with hidden mines. Use your Minesweeper logic and instincts to forge ahead without stepping on a single one!

details.title: Rogue Machines
details.short_description: A roguelike building physics puzzle game. Buy blocks to build better machines to get the ball in the goal. Unlock more blocks, levels, and upgrades as you play more runs.

details.title: All Hands
details.short_description: Build walls, blast the terrain, and reroute thousands of furious customers through your own killboxes. All Hands is an incremental tower defence game about defending HQ, engineering excessive solutions, and turning corporate catastrophe into career advancement.

details.title: DoNotOpenTheBox
details.short_description: Do Not Open This Box is a 3D first-person room escape game where players solve puzzles to escape after opening a forbidden box. Find, repair, and manipulate objects among antiques such as toys, books, and wine bottles. The space subtly changes as each puzzle is solved.

details.title: Repentless DX
details.short_description: You are the imprisoned dictator. People of your country come visit. Survive as long as you can.

details.title: Frog Racing League
details.short_description: Recruit frogs, and turn them into champion racing frogs! Kit them out with hats and potions, then read the odds and bet your way to the top of the league. A pixel-art frog management sim that will satisfy your inner frog manager.

details.title: One Neck Ahead
details.short_description: In One Neck Ahead, you play as Kid Giraffe on a journey towards the heart of the forest, where dreams come true. Carry your own ground, create your own platforms, and meet a cast of memorable characters, each introducing a new twist to the adventure.

details.title: You Got Me Killed!
details.short_description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

details.title: Keep It Checked
details.short_description: Trapped in a looping corridor of an anomaly research facility, you must watch every detail. Spot an anomaly? Turn back. Everything normal? Keep walking. Make the right call eleven rooms in a row to find the exit and break the loop.

details.title: The Hope Incident
details.short_description: In The Hope Incident, you take on the role of a nighttime supermarket employee. What starts as a regular shift quickly turns into a terrifying test of your skills. Serve suspicious customers, deal with the devastating effects of underground anomalies, and uncover the mysteries of GSO-7.

details.title: Baron Local
details.short_description: Rise from ordinary citizen to political kingmaker in a pixel-art political life simulator inspired by Romania. Build alliances, launch projects, survive scandals, and navigate corruption as you climb from local politics toward national power.

details.title: Nostos
details.short_description: A mint-tin sci-fi survival horror dungeon crawler involving dice, cards and nerve. Generate nailbiting stories in short runs that fit around your life. Lead a salvage crew through a derelict stalked by a predatory Endoparasite. Push your luck, scavenge to survive, and reach the evac in one piece.

details.title: Ancestral Trace : Singkawang
details.short_description: Ancestral Trace: Singkawang is a cozy 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you help Lie Jun Hao, a young man who returns to his childhood city after eleven years away, uncover the story his family left behind.

details.title: Cardfight: Conspiracy
details.short_description: A story-rich RPG told from multiple perspectives. A fusion of turn-based card battling and quick-time defense. Six classmates, each with their own decks - and their own secrets. Your name is SPARTAN JACK, your new friends are part of a deadly secret society, and you have a conspiracy to uncover.

details.title: MANDATUM
details.short_description: A Clay-Style online co-op game, with 4-player missions, about the maximum contribution of players to the boss's local elections. History is written by the winners, right? So we’re doing whatever it takes. MANDATUM.

details.title: Petricor: Tower Defense
details.short_description: Face off against hordes of shambling skeletons in this magical rogue-like tower defense! You're just cat-sitting for a shopkeeper, but an evil necromancer has other plans! Summon living statues to defend the shop and discover powerful spells to create devastating combos!

details.title: Sufficiently Advanced Witchcraft
details.short_description: "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic!" Practice witchcraft, summon daemons, harness crystal vibrations, and never EVER let the Magic Smoke escape as you help the villagers, protect the kingdom, and strive to unlock magic's deepest secrets in this cozy, witchy sim!

details.title: Alien Nature Rampage
details.short_description: A Topdown action game where you play an alien entity that must destroy all industry on earths major cities. Viewing the world from above the player selects a city to the help "save" from industry pollution.

details.title: Clock-out Denied
details.short_description: Clock-out Denied is an asymmetric multiplayer stealth game where Employees build shadowy office hideouts, complete tasks, and sprint for the clock-out machine while one Boss hunts them with light. Hide in the darkness you created, whisper with coworkers, and escape overtime before the final second.

details.title: Slammo
details.short_description: Conquer a charming woodland world in a grid-based strategy game where everyone moves at once. Expand your territory, predict rival plans, and fight dice-driven battles as adorable animal factions clash for control.

name: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle

details.title: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle
details.short_description: Red Chamber Chronicle is a classical Chinese life simulation and visual novel with multiple endings. You play as Jia Baoyu in the Grand View Garden, where daily life, relationships, and choices shape your branching story and different outcomes.

details.title: Wild East: The Straw Man
details.short_description: 1993, just after Czechoslovakia split in two. Play as reporter Marek and investigate the death of a company director in name only. In Prague, journalist Eva pursues a case of her own. Explore locations, read documents, and uncover where their cases meet in a classic 2D point-and-click mystery.

details.title: Mega Golf
details.short_description: Smash your friends into the ocean and bowl through buildings in your giant armored golf ball! Race through the chaos . Smash your way through buildings, navigate boosts and bounce pads, avoid landmines and oil slicks as you explore and devastate the courses.

details.title: Football Club Builder
details.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own football club from Division 4 to European glory. Expand your stadium and facilities in 3D, compete in league and cup competitions, and create a football dynasty by making the right decisions in this fast-paced football manager game.

details.title: Devil in the penthouse
details.short_description: Slay bosses and climb the demonic skyscraper in this stress-free incremental RPG. Gather loot, unleash powerful active skills, and upgrade your knight to achieve ultimate power. Can you reach the Penthouse and defeat the Devil?

details.title: Affictionate
details.short_description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
publishers: Just a single guy publishing this game

details.title: Chopex
details.short_description: Combine ingredient cards, use kitchen tools, and serve orders before time runs out! Chopex is a pixel art card game where you chop, grill, and plate your way through increasingly hectic kitchens.

details.title: Unheenged
details.short_description: Unheenged is a cooperative horror extraction game for you and up to 3 friends. featuring proximity voice chat, scary monsters, multiple items and doors... Lots of doors.

details.title: Plant Game
details.short_description: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

details.title: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
details.short_description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Turn your own images into puzzles, assemble them together in real time, discover community creations, and share yours through the Steam Workshop.

details.title: Touhou Mushroom Defense
details.short_description: Touhou Mushroom Defense is a Touhou Project fan-made game. It’s a defense game where Marisa turns mushrooms into towers to defeat enemies. In the game, you need to gather materials to build towers and construct towers to block the enemy’s path.

details.title: Kernel Override
details.short_description: INFILTRATE THE SYSTEM! Kernel Override is a fast-paced cyberpunk bullet heaven. SURVIVE intense 10-minute rounds against escalating waves of anti-virus software, MODIFY your malicious code with powerful upgrades, and UNLOCK permanent meta-progression to crack the core.

name: 遗珍拍卖所 Lost Relics Auction House

details.title: 遗珍拍卖所 Lost Relics Auction House
details.short_description: Lost Relics Auction House is a single-player/multiplayer strategy sim about relic repatriation, legal auctions, and information play. Gather clues, read rivals, judge hidden value, use intel tools, and bid wisely without overpaying or missing priceless treasures.

details.title: STICKBIT
details.short_description: Escape from the Tower of Madness! STICKBIT is a fast-paced 2D Action Tower-Defense Rogue-lite where you build defenses, collect powerups, and blow up lots of barrels! It's loud, colorful, and much safer than the real world. Just keep playing.

details.title: PixelRift
details.short_description: A 2D side-scroller platformer game with level creation features.

details.title: Shootrix
details.short_description: Shootrix is a fast-paced strategic puzzle game where you shoot and place blocks to create explosive 2x2 combos. Master chain reactions, outsmart opponents, and compete in real-time arena battles against players worldwide.

details.title: Super Kickmen
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelike and turn-based soccer game that brings soccer to a 7×5 grid. Aim for the top of the world with the ultimate team you’ve built!

details.title: Lucifaria
details.short_description: After two other priests vanish, a retired exorcist is called upon to eradicate an ancient demon. Enter a thrilling single-room turn-based horror RPG requiring strategy, sacrifice, and perseverance.

details.title: Snackrifice
details.short_description: Satisfy your ravenous appetite by slaying the Old Gods of a ruined, forsaken realm, and use their corpses as ingredients for the ultimate divine sandwich! Master your skills, timing and determination to deflect their unique and challenging attacks in this Boss Rush.

details.title: Tempus Triad
details.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

details.title: House Of Slendrina Remake
details.short_description: House of Slendrina is a spine-chilling first-person psychological horror game where danger lurks in every dark corner. You find yourself trapped inside an ancient, decaying family residence but you are far from alone.

details.title: Revelation of Decay
details.short_description: Revelation of Decay is a zombie survival game that’s less “scary” and even a bit lively. Explore this pixelated world full of bizarre anomalies, awaken supernatural powers, and, amid endless zombie hordes and mutated monsters, gradually uncover the truth behind the invasion.

details.title: Playable Alpha
details.short_description: As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization. In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

details.title: Dungeon Baller
details.short_description: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball.

details.title: Acts of Blood
details.short_description: Master the art of hand-to-hand combat in Acts of Blood, a gritty and fast-paced third-person brawler with brutal combo chains and blood-soaked revenge.

details.title: Guns Undarkness
details.short_description: A command battle JRPG by Shoji Meguro, known for scoring and directing on the “Persona” and “Shin Megami Tensei” series. The adventure takes place in a near-future world on the brink of destruction. Become a member of the private military company BTI's Alpha Team, and carry out grueling missions.

details.title: ASCENDANT
details.short_description: High stakes, high chaos, and the most unpredictable twist on capture-the-flag yet. Outwit ruthless opponents, face mutant wildlife, and secure four biocores in this fast-paced FPS where wild events can turn the tables in an ever-shifting BioPunk arena. This is ASCENDANT - bring backup.

details.title: Bunker Builder Simulator
details.short_description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

details.title: BLEAK Remastered
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

details.title: LATITUDE OF THE CULT
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 1997. A Michigan town sells its Dogman legend to tourists. It never speaks of the cult , or the song beneath the frozen lake. This winter, all three came back. Seventeen walked into the fog and never returned. The sheriff has vanished. Survive the night. Find out what the town buried.

details.title: Stone of Adventure
details.short_description: Fuse CCGs, roguelikes, and hex-grid tactics. Scavenge cards & artifacts. Master the interactive battlefield: topple trees onto foes and shove them off cliffs. Your clashes bridge shattered worlds to avert catastrophe. Forge your path home!

details.title: DOSMIC
details.short_description: In a world teeming with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out to find the missing girl Snoa. Use a range of movement abilities, solve mysterious puzzles and sometimes fight otherworldly horrors in DOSMIC, a cinematic puzzle platformer.

details.title: Social Hook
details.short_description: Catch powerful monster cards with your fishing rod and battle against other players in exciting duels.

details.title: TohoKids
details.short_description: Shinjuku doesn't forgive. A village panda chasing neon lights. Join the legendary TohoKids, hack your enemies, and remember: here, your data is worth more than your life. How far will you go to avoid becoming just "meat for the slaughter"?

details.title: Ghost Sector
details.short_description: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

details.title: In Banjiha
details.short_description: It is a first-person horror game. Escape the damp, dark semi-basement. Overcome your fear and find a way out.

details.title: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
details.short_description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

details.title: Ritual Tides
details.short_description: Ritual Tides is a story rich, psychological horror game set on the dark, atmospheric, isolated British island of Hortus. Explore the island, uncover its dark past, loot food, ammunition and supplies, evade the cult of the Fallow Parish, as you fight for survival against Lovecraftian horrors.

name: My Little Sister Is an Angel

details.title: My Little Sister Is an Angel
details.short_description: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

details.title: Cozy Cooking: Lo-fi Beats
details.short_description: Cozy Cooking: Lo-fi Beats is a casual, anime-inspired cooking simulation game. Prepare your favorite meals in real-time, accompanied by soothing lo-fi music and ASMR-soundscapes. Personalize your space while gazing at calming views outside the window.

details.title: Panzer Strike
details.short_description: Authentic RTS gameplay straight out of the 2000s. Command your troops, develop strategies, and win World War II battles. Huge maps, thousands of units, long-range firepower, and no building mechanics!

details.title: Dual Cores
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic team-based sword-and-sorcery action RPG with tons of overlapping choices you can use to design your ideal battlemage.

details.title: TDS
details.short_description: A dystopian survival action game hits Early Access soon: battle factions, manage gear, face endless foes. Wield Nanite powers to endure a fractured world on the brink. Fight to survive, Survivor!

details.title: Road Truckers: New Beginning
details.short_description: Be a TRUCKER, not a truck. Haul cargo, restore a forgotten town, and grow your trucking business in the first true trucking RPG. Get on foot to forge relationships, then jump back into your fully customizable rig to rule the road.

details.title: The Abyss Break
details.short_description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

details.title: Ruins of The Titan
details.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

details.title: Chinese Strange Stories
details.short_description: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

details.title: Hide The Corpse
details.short_description: Hide Gus before the cops arrive in this chaotic VR physics sandbox. Drag, throw, and cram a fully simulated body into absurd hiding spots across unique environments while the clock ticks down. Includes the Gusimir Mansion DLC.

details.title: Age of Respair
details.short_description: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom🏰⚔️

details.title: Dream Bar Simulator
details.short_description: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

details.title: METACRAFT: Arena
details.short_description: METACRAFT: Arena — an online action RPG with a wide selection of melee and ranged weapons, PvE and PvP raids, leveling and build customization, clan activities, base upgrades, crafting, player trading, and much more!

details.title: Infinitory
details.short_description: Infinitory mixes city-building, automation, and tower defense in a in a rogue-lite top-down game. Expand your base vertically in limited space, a strategic planning challenge. Automate resources to produce ammunition and upgrades, crucial for stopping waves of enemies on procedurally generated maps.

details.title: Hot Dog Simulator
details.short_description: Start your own hot dog stand business, find the perfect spots in the city, upgrade your stands, attend festivals, and serve influencers. Expand your business by opening new branches and perfecting your hot dogs.

name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister

details.title: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
details.short_description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

details.title: Into the Void
details.short_description: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?

details.title: Bounty Fusion
details.short_description: Suit up as a mecha bounty hunter in a gritty faraway galaxy! Fuse cards to unleash powerful combos, chase high-stakes bounties, and build the ultimate deck in this action-packed roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: T-Ghoul :: Dorobou Yameta Youkei Poppu!
details.short_description: A mischievous Thai ghoul trades haunting for farming in this 2D isometric horror-comedy. Steal, sell, or raise chickens, avoid shamans, and decide your fate in a ghost-filled village. Survive, thrive… or devour.

details.title: DeskTrack
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion with toy cars and a focus timer. Let a little car cruise while you work or study, earn miles to collect cars and scenery, then build your own tracks or take the wheel for a break.

details.title: Dragon survival
details.short_description: Stranded on a mysterious island with a baby dragon, survive and grow stronger. Gather resources, build your base, and overcome trials left behind by ancient explorers. An open-world survival RPG blending exploration, crafting, combat, and dragon growth.

details.title: Voiceless
details.short_description: Voiceless is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Go live from a mysterious mansion, complete viewer challenges, and gain subscribers. Team up with your friends or sabotage them - choose your own path to popularity.

name: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze

details.title: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze
details.short_description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

details.title: Paver Simulator
details.short_description: Design and craft stunning pavements with precision and style. Choose from various materials, earn money, and build your reputation as a master paver. Are you ready to pave your way to the top? Test your creativity skills and create a masterpiece in Paver Simulator!

details.title: Thalassophobia
details.short_description: Thalassophobia is a 4-player co-op horror diving game set in the crushing darkness of the deep ocean. Complete high-risk objectives and uncover long-forgotten secrets. The further you descend, the less safe you are.

details.title: CrisisX
details.short_description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and establish your territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world

details.title: Keyframes
details.short_description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

details.title: Fatal Run 2089
details.short_description: Atari’s Fatal Run 2089 delivers over-the-top driving action across a post-apocalyptic landscape. You’ll have to race against a countdown clock at incredibly high-speeds and destroy enemy vehicles by any means necessary. Fail to complete your missions and you put humanity in jeopardy.

details.title: Love Nest
details.short_description: 《爱之巢》是一场关于血肉、爱与救赎、恨与纠缠的冒险。密室逃脱也好、视觉小说也好、电子宠物也好……这些都只是这场冒险的冰山一角。唯一重要的只有……属于你的少女——『晴』，永远在你们的《爱之巢》，微笑着等着你。

details.title: SacriFire
details.short_description: SacriFire is an upcoming RPG boasting a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art, and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Ezekiel Ridan, a young priest, struggles to keep his faith as the world he loves is threatened by a war between gods and demons. The adventure begins!

details.title: Island of Winds
details.short_description: Journey through a mystical 17th century Iceland inspired by authentic folklore and mythology. Play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper who uses magic, empathy, and puzzle-solving to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to a fractured world.

details.title: Cosminers
details.short_description: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

details.title: Farm Renovator
details.short_description: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

details.title: Life After End
details.short_description: Dive into the harsh world of post-apocalyptic Siberia. Extreme climate, limited resources, wild animals, and other players - all this is part of the daily struggle, where only the strongest survive. Are you ready to find out what life is like after the end?

details.title: Everstorm
details.short_description: Classic MOBA combat meets battle royale PVP, with roguelite elements. Fight other players, customize your abilities and survive hordes of monsters long enough to face the final boss. The last team standing wins. Earn permanent upgrades in between matches, then dive back in for more.

name: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World

details.title: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World
details.short_description: Take care of a cute crocodile girl and make it through the Apocalypse while your bossy step-sister and some mysterious organizations are getting in your way!

name: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child

details.title: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
details.short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

details.title: Hairpin Legends
details.short_description: Hairpin Legends is a tabletop slot racing game where every millimetre matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit, race across varied circuits, build your own tracks, compete in tournaments, and challenge friends online.

details.title: Last Ward
details.short_description: A top-down horde survivor. Choose from nine classes, push out of the Ward into corrupted wilds, borrow attacks from other classes, then return to the Refuge to rebuild your gear and talents.

details.title: Climbing Gym Manager
details.short_description: Build, set and run the climbing gym of your dreams. Shape every wall, reset routes zone by zone, and watch a cosy community grow, where every climber queues, projects, falls, cheers their friends on and tries again.

details.title: Runemoor
details.short_description: 10v10 PvP capture the flag. Pick one of 31 champions, steal the enemy Rune Banner and carry it home in fast-paced team battles where any fight can turn in seconds.

details.title: Lantern Hearth
details.short_description: A cozy 2D MMORPG in the spirit of the classics. Build your hero stat by stat, party up against bosses, raise loyal pets, and keep your World's lantern burning when the shadows come.

details.title: Corner Cutters
details.short_description: Top-down racing for people who love a good fight for a corner. AI drivers defend and make mistakes. Tyres wear and grip best when warm. Rubber builds up on the line, and in changing weather the track dries where the cars drive. Best played with a controller. Race a season or go online.

details.title: 信息素留白
details.short_description: Alpha？Beta？又或是Omega，他们的性别会因为你的选择而改变…… 升学后，青春期的大家陆续开始性别分化，你的行为与选择会让在意你的两位男主分化成不同的性别……当然，你也在被很多目光注视着，在影响他们的同时也在被他们影响，你又会分化成什么性别？ 在信息素的影响下，温柔的人会嫉妒到发狂，高傲的人甘愿跪在你的脚边，当爱意染上信息素的颜色，一切都会变得微妙起来……

name: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!

details.title: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!
details.short_description: Threads & Things is a cozy organizing simulator where you return over 4000 scattered craft supplies to their proper places in a cluttered craft store. Sort yarn, fabrics, threads, buttons, embroidery hoops and more, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized craft store.

name: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!

details.title: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!
details.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,096 paint cans by color. Dig them out of a mountain of mixed-up paint, shelve each one in its row and watch the store turn into one giant rainbow.

details.title: Resonance Shift
details.short_description: Resonance Shift is a pixel-art action roguelite that blends survivors-like combat with strategic party management. Use the tag system to switch between party members, chain their skills to create powerful synergies, and choose the right upgrade cards to defeat relentless waves of enemies!

details.title: Zombie Recorder: Undead Divas
details.short_description: Fight the horde—or become an undead diva. Mix gunplay, melee combat, weapon customization and over 100 character looks. Between battles, gather a dance crew, put on a simulated livestream, and frame the chaos with drone cameras and cinematic filters.

details.title: MOMOKOO MERGE
details.short_description: Drop food, hatch momokoos, and merge matching ones to expel them from the gut. Six momokoos, six expel effects — see what's coming next and choose where it lands. No account needed, and one global leaderboard for every player.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: House 01
details.short_description: You work a night shift as a camera operator in an ordinary house. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Backrooms
details.short_description: You watch the Backrooms through security cameras. Move between the levels, notice what has changed in each place and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Gold Below
details.short_description: A pixel-art loot roguelike. Start every run with junk gear, buy and merge pieces into rarer ones, stack a set until the numbers get silly, then fight thirty floors down to the dragon at the bottom. Everyone who dies leaves their gold to his hoard.

details.title: Let It Snow
details.short_description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

details.title: BazaarBorn
details.short_description: Start with a handcart and work your way to an antique shop in BazaarBorn, a second-hand trading sim. Buy and sell, get to know customers, and back up your offers when bargaining. Take orders, trade online, bid in Storage Battles, join item auctions, invest in property, and face unexpected events.

details.title: Hellobnb Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a run-down house on a beautiful Greek island into a thriving vacation rental empire! Renovate, decorate, welcome guests, buy properties, and expand your businesses. Explore island life and build your dream solo or with friends in 4-player online co-op!

details.title: Doomsday: M.A.D.
details.short_description: Nuclear strategy on a living planet. Nations are born, build their towns, economies and railways, trade, rebel and go to war, century after century, all the way to nuclear fire. Watch the world live, or take control of one nation.

details.title: Shelf Therapy
details.short_description: Shelf Therapy is a relaxing first-person 3D shelf-organizing game. Pick up everyday products and place them freely in their designated sections. Arrange drinks, snacks, ready-to-eat meals, and more without fixed slots, and enjoy turning empty shelves into neat displays.

details.title: 仙武三国
details.short_description: A premium single-player idle RPG blending Three Kingdoms warfare with cultivation. Recruit generals, form armies, and conquer. Gather dragon energy over 20 reincarnations, rising from soldier to True Dragon Emperor. No in-app purchases or online requirement. Includes a complete 100-chapter story.

details.title: The Gloaming Hand
details.short_description: A free one-on-one card battler where the sky decides the fight. Plant units at Dawn, let them ripen through the Day, strike before Dusk and bluff through the Night. Five lanes, four phases, one sundial: every card is worth something different at every hour.

details.title: Ambulante Simulator
details.short_description: From a cooler on your shoulder to a penthouse by the sea! Shout into a real mic, sell water, mate, popsicles, coconuts and açaí on Copacabana beach, and work your way up to your own stall and kiosk. Play solo, build a career with up to 4 friends, or compete with up to 6.

details.title: Galaxy Unwritten
details.short_description: Pilot your own ship in a single-player space sandbox. Fight, trade, mine and salvage, then turn your earnings into a fleet and modular factories. Fine-tune your ship's loadout, board enemy vessels and create local mods with built-in visual tools.

details.title: XBPlayer
details.short_description: Stream games from your own Xbox console or from Xbox Cloud Gaming to your Steam Deck or Linux PC, at home or away. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. Pay once, no ads. Games and Game Pass are not included.

details.title: Industeria
details.short_description: Build and defend a growing industrial colony on a hostile alien world. Mine resources, automate production lines, expand a massive factory, and protect your territory from relentless alien attacks in this top-down 3D strategy game.

details.title: WhiskersOS: Click and Survive
details.short_description: Your family computer has been infected! In this survivor-like roguelite, battle through hordes of viruses using your desktop applications as weapons. Recover corrupted data to level up, then upgrade your apps and drivers to purge the infection for good.

details.title: Stockroom Syndrome
details.short_description: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

details.title: Meme Exam: Cats
details.short_description: MEME EXAM: CATS challenges memeologists from all over the world! Test your knowledge of the most famous meme cats and prove you’re a true memeologist!

name: Living with a Runaway Girl ~A Lovey-Dovey Life with Lowkey Gamer High School Girl~

details.title: Living with a Runaway Girl ~A Lovey-Dovey Life with Lowkey Gamer High School Girl~
details.short_description: Your cousin, a lowkey high school girl Hikariko, ran away from home and came to live with you! Have a chat, get lap pillows, sleep side-by-side! Enjoy a cool yet super sweet, affectionate yet nonchalant, lovey-dovey cohabit simulator with Hikariko♪

name: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ You Can Do Better!

details.title: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ You Can Do Better!
details.short_description: Cultivate, study, and work through a modern-day life. Choose techniques and set their order before automatic battles. When a life ends, leave a final wish and pass your legacy to the next generation. How many generations will it take to ascend? A demo is available now.

details.title: Mosaic of Life
details.short_description: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

details.title: Joy Loader Crew
details.short_description: Joy Loader Crew is such a cozy 1-4 player co-op building party game! Hop on excavators and bulldozers to tackle all kinds of construction missions. With cute cartoon graphics and super simple controls, it's perfect for family gatherings or hanging out with friends. Come drive an excavator now!

details.title: Group Commander
details.short_description: Take command of a World War II heavy bomber group over occupied Europe. Read the field order, weigh the target against the men, and send your forts. A player-paced command sim where every mission is a decision and every empty bunk is one you signed for.

details.title: Too Many Pieces
details.short_description: Why are puzzle pieces scattered everywhere? Who wrote the letters guiding Mei? And most importantly, why is she here? Explore 9 strangely familiar rooms, recover the scattered pieces, complete 34 hand-illustrated puzzles, and put the space back together.

name: The Last Home : Curse of Lanna

details.title: The Last Home : Curse of Lanna
details.short_description: The Last Home: Curse of Lanna is an FMV horror game that takes players into the mysterious land of Lanna, filled with supernatural tales. Featuring cinematic 4K visuals and immersive sound, it delivers a chilling, movie-like experience.

details.title: PawTop Cats
details.short_description: PawTop Cats is a cozy app with animated cats that live on top of your windows. Choose different skins, interact with your fluffy assistants, and add a little cute chaos to your desktop.

details.title: PROTOCOL: VOID
details.short_description: PROTOCOL: VOID CONTRACT is a cyberpunk top-down action RPG for 1–4 players. Take on dangerous contracts, fight hostile systems, collect randomized weapons and cyberware, shape powerful builds, and upgrade your gear to survive deadlier missions.

details.title: Lights Out
details.short_description: The lights go out and Mr. Snuffles comes looking for you: a giant, much-repaired plush pig who can't see in the dark but hears everything. Hide with up to 3 friends, stay quiet and survive till morning... or be the pig.

details.title: Robot Vacuum Simulator
details.short_description: Take the controls of a tiny robot vacuum in a first-person cleaning sim. Cut clean paths through grime, steer around furniture, grab and sort clutter, scrub dishes, chase fresh pawprints, and put new tools to work on bigger jobs.

details.title: ADVENTURES OF MOR̂ABOB
details.short_description: MORABOB is a 90s-inspired action-adventure side-scroller heavily focused on giant boss battles. Survive, attack, and fight titan bosses hundreds of times your size, each with surprising, unique attacks. Meet the mysterious evil in fog and rescue the kidnapped adventurous girl, Asaly

details.title: Card Idler
details.short_description: An incremental card idler about collecting cards and expanding your deck. Farm, mine gems, kill monsters and cook meals to help your progression. Unlock new upgrades and merge your cards into their ultimate form. Will you complete your collection?

details.title: Interlude
details.short_description: A roguelike dungeon crawler where each room is a different world inspired by classical painting. Dying brings you back to your starting point, but the upgrades you unlock, the friends you make, and the secrets you uncover will help you explore further each time.

details.title: The Demon Wins
details.short_description: Build each mercenary from the ground up in a permadeath dark fantasy auto-battler where there are no classes - only combinations. Find powerful loot, mutate attacks, combine skills, choose paths, and turn what you find into the power to win.

details.title: Beyond the First Star
details.short_description: Beyond the First Star is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Choose your pilot, shoot down supply carriers for weapon cards, stack up to four support weapons that fire all at once, and take on handcrafted stages and bosses with unique attack patterns.

details.title: The Helios Accord
details.short_description: The Helios Accord is a post-scarcity science-fiction grand strategy game. Govern by consent, set doctrine, negotiate with civilizations, and send Citizen Minds beyond known space. Then Serenity of Dawn disappears. No wreckage. No distress call. Only an impossible signal that changes when observed.

details.title: Iron Grave:Planet 9
details.short_description: Iron Grave: Planet 9 is a sci-fi mech survivor game. Pilot multiple mechs with unique skills and evolution, slaughter enemies, unlock upgrades. Set on the ninth planet over a century from now, fight alongside your squad and become a hero.

details.title: Human Echoes
details.short_description: One day, a disaster known as "The Great Blank Event" erased every artwork in the world. As AI came to dominate art, science, politics, and society, you—a painter—lost an art competition to an AI and abandoned your passion. Everything changes when a mysterious black-haired maid appears at your door.

details.title: Bow Warfare: Multiplayer Combat
details.short_description: Step into a fast-paced archery arena where timing and precision mean everything. Outmaneuver rival players, adjust to changing battlegrounds, and make every arrow count. Ready your bow and dominate the field.

details.title: Electric Noosphere: Prologue
details.short_description: Play the free prologue to Electric Noosphere, a story-driven sci-fi RTS. Fly a top-down mission through space, hold out against endless spawning waves in Survival, and take on the AI in Skirmish. Single-player, no purchase required.

details.title: Sluismaker
details.short_description: Build a blocky warship in your own dry dock, flood the dock and hope it floats, then sail out and sink the enemy. Real buoyancy and flooding physics, cannons, rams and grenades, and crews of up to 5 per side online, over LAN or against AI captains.

details.title: Animal Fort Defense
details.short_description: Survive waves of monsters in a colorful tower defense game for 1–5 players. Build and upgrade animal-themed towers, manage your resources, and defend your base against powerful bosses. Play solo or team up in online co-op.

details.title: Hose to Mars
details.short_description: Your mission is to terraform Mars. However, a crash landing destroyed all your gear leaving you with just a spoon! Start watering the soil with your spoon, earn MarsCoin, and upgrade your equipment. Turn the Red Planet green solo or with friends!

details.title: Re-Truco
details.short_description: A solo roguelike card game built on truco, the bluffing card game of the Río de la Plata. Build envido and flor hands, shout truco at your rival, collect jokers at the bar and beat eight antes in a neighborhood bar, with every score chalked on the table.

details.title: Clash of Cogs
details.short_description: Up to 8 players get 30 seconds to secretly program 5 moves—then watch every robot execute at once across a lethal factory of conveyors, lasers, and molten pits. Ram, suplex, and outsmart friends online, in couch hotseat, or against bots! Nobody's plan survives the assembly line!

name: Hold Then Break: Tanks on the Rhine, 1985

details.title: Hold Then Break: Tanks on the Rhine, 1985
details.short_description: 1985. Colonel Volkov has more tanks than you. He always will. Command an outnumbered British battlegroup in a hand-crafted Cold War RTS: Chieftains to hold the river line, Harriers from hides in the woods, artillery to break him. Hold the line. Then break him.

details.title: Cozy Moka
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art idle game about a neighborhood café. Serve your first espresso, hire baristas, decorate and grow across the city, from a tiny corner shop to a grand confectionery, one cup at a time.

details.title: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
details.short_description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

details.title: Node Wars
details.short_description: Node Wars is a short, neon-soaked incremental game. Smash glowing nodes, earn upgrades, and carve your path across a sprawling skill-tree grid. Easy to pick up, satisfying to optimize, and designed to be finished in a single sitting of a few hours.

details.title: NayBlades
details.short_description: Spin, bump and bounce through 20 hazard-packed levels with three friends. In NayBlades every player is a Naydo, a spinning tornado that sends anyone it touches flying. Work together to survive four worlds of obstacle courses, or knock each other out in the Arena.

details.title: Switchroom
details.short_description: You were naughty this year. Now you're stuck in Santa's warehouse with your friends. Every switch might drop a toy, kill the lights or let something in. Find the toys on the list, ship them, and survive each other.

details.title: Catnip Wars 2: Empires
details.short_description: Play your way in an infinite galaxy of cats!. Haggle at ports. Hack the yarn. Become a bounty hunter. Be an ace pilot in your own custom fighter! Compete in demolition style racing in the Nine-lives circuit! Create or join a house. Play with others on the official server or create your own.

details.title: New Eldarian
details.short_description: A free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG with turn-based combat, exploration, character progression, dungeons, loot, crafting and cooperative online play. Explore a shared world, join other players and build your character.

details.title: Treasury of Lies
details.short_description: Run a small country for ten years and survive the truth. Plant stories, turn spies, calm the bond market and outlast the fake feeds, before the voters, the lenders or a squirrel in the substation finish you off. A noir turn-based strategy game of money, spies and lies.

details.title: The Cozy Tree Co.
details.short_description: The Cozy Tree Co. is a relaxing game about chopping, decorating and selling Christmas trees. Search the winter wonderland for the perfect tree, get creative with your decorating, and sell your creations to spread holiday cheer!

details.title: 2027 毕业生工作
details.short_description: Where should the Class of 2027 go? (This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

details.title: Linked Wheels
details.short_description: Drive a cart through chaotic physics-based obstacle courses, alone or in online co-op. Coordinate both sides, jump, crouch, and survive deadly traps without destroying your friendship.

details.title: Job Burnout
details.short_description: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

details.title: The Kingdom's Merchant
details.short_description: Build your fortune in a living medieval kingdom. Establish shops, manage caravans, master a dynamic economy, and outmaneuver rival merchant houses in single-player or competitive multiplayer as you build the realm's greatest trading empire.

details.title: Quantum Gomoku
details.short_description: A stone's color isn't decided until you "observe" it—a competitive five-in-a-row puzzle in flux. Black or white is drawn the instant you observe, and knowing when to spend your limited observations decides the match. A fresh take on strategy where luck meets mind games.

details.title: 72 Seconds
details.short_description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

details.title: Chase Buddies
details.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

details.title: StoryRealm: AI Interactive Story Games
details.short_description: Create, edit, and play real-time AI-generated dialogue-based interactive games and visual novels.

details.title: Deslot
details.short_description: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

details.title: Tiny Trouble
details.short_description: Race toy cars across breakfast tables, bathtubs, pool tables and sandboxes. Shove rivals into the cereal, squash the peas and fly off the toast. 18 cups, a sticker album to fill, party modes for the couch, online races and a track editor. Small cars. Big trouble.

name: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I : DayRise

details.title: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I : DayRise
details.short_description: Grendel Jinx, the megalomaniacal kleptomaniac has returned to Chichester, England for a secret mission. Can the protagonist stop her?

details.title: Screen Nook
details.short_description: A book nook for your desktop. Tiny, lit 3D worlds that live at the edge of your screen and follow your real hours. Nothing to win, nothing to grind. Just somewhere lovely to glance at while you work or study.

details.title: Samt
details.short_description: Samt is a 2-player online co-op stealth game. Silence keeps you alive. Real voice, footsteps, and movement are heard by hunting AI drones in a dead, neon-lit mega-city. Stay quiet. Survive together, or evaporate trying. This game requires a co-op partner: no solo play.

details.title: IPredictedYouPredictedMe
details.short_description: A unique two-player fighting game where you must predict your opponent’s moves before they act, while preventing them from predicting yours. Plan five actions each round and outsmart your opponent in a fair battle of wits. Enjoy the thrill of mind games!

details.title: Daisy la Fleur
details.short_description: A PS1-esque art nouveau action-adventure game inspired by classic 90s games. Something strange has arrived in early 1900's France! It looks like Daisy is the one to stop it! Uncover the mystery behind these, tentacle monsters, jelly fish creatures, and even escaped brains! Welcome to Daisy la Fleur!

details.title: Aposis: Infinity Hero
details.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

details.title: Script Strike
details.short_description: Script Strike is a strategy game where you fight with code. Command your knight and solve levels in your favorite language, from variables and loops to algorithms, debugging, and concurrency. Collect weapons, unlock skills, and face the challenges of a medieval fantasy battlefield.

details.title: 白日梦Daydream
details.short_description: "Daydream" is a light puzzle game that is based on the connection between real life and dreams. The inspirations gained by the player in the dream give them strength, which makes them more powerful in reality.

details.title: Isolation Dolphin Tank
details.short_description: You fall asleep on the train home and wake at an unfamiliar station: Cetacea City, a town lost in endless night beneath two hazy moons. Your only clue is a dolphin hymn heard in a faint dream. Talk with its curious residents and gather fragments of lost memories in this dreamy, hypnotic adventure.

details.title: Annie's DineInn
details.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

details.title: KUMANO
