details.short_description: KUMANO: Third District, Last Service is a 3D exploration narrative adventure. As a protagonist who has lost his memory, walk among the residents of an abandoned city, meet them, and choose. Experience a world you've never known, yet somehow remember.

name: The Child Who Serves the Hanul

details.title: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
details.short_description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

details.title: Oops, No Floor!
details.short_description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

details.title: Beatcore
details.short_description: A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. Level editor included.

details.title: Beatcore zero
details.short_description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

details.title: Stickers, please
details.short_description: Decorate a fantasy location with sticker packs. Place or rearrange anything however you want, there are no rules.

details.title: One man's junk
details.short_description: Hassle the unsuspecting residents of Chislington in order to barter your way up from a paperclip to a car, so you can go visit your family for the holidays.

details.title: Deck paper scissors
details.short_description: It's rock paper scissors, but as an incremental roguelike deck builder.

details.title: Farming with lasers
details.short_description: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

details.title: Mommy Dies
details.short_description: 100 mommies. 100 ways to die. Only one survives. A psychological horror visual novel where your choices determine who lives and who dies in a twisted underground facility.

details.title: Cook Together
details.short_description: Cook Together is a chaotic co-op drug creating game where you and your friend run a basement lab, to create drugs for big boss. Finish the product in time without blowing yourselves up. Upgrade your lab, perfect the purity of your products and become the biggest producer in town.

details.title: 100 Lunar Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Droid Escape
details.short_description: In this adventure, help Droid 07 to overcome challenges, discover mysteries and free your friend from the miniaigas.

details.title: Sword Duel 2: Medieval War
details.short_description: A third-person medieval action RPG with massive 1000 vs 1000 battles. Fight shoulder to shoulder with your allies using swords, shields and bows, loot armor and weapons, and survive the chaos of a physics-driven battlefield.

details.title: Maid In Wonderland
details.short_description: Your fate, your duty, your suffering / love.

details.title: Orbz Collector
details.short_description: Orbz Collector is a 3D re-imagining of the 90s classic Chip's Challenge. Collect coloured keys to unlock the corresponding locks, avoid patrolling enemies and warp around to figure out the variety of puzzles throughout the 12 levels. Some of the levels you'll recognize and some of them are new!

details.title: Orbion Online
details.short_description: Orbion Online is a real-time multiplayer space action game where you start as a tiny stone and grow by absorbing asteroids, planets, and rival pilots. Explore a shared cosmos of stars, wormholes, and galaxies and climb from pebble to powerhouse.

details.title: Lone City
details.short_description: Lone City blends romance, shooting and survival in a post-apocalyptic open world. Explore ruins, scavenge supplies and fight zombies and mutants. Drive a sports car through the city with your dog. At home, grow closer to beautiful women with distinct personalities and build a life together.

details.title: Mindless as the Mountains
details.short_description: Mindless as the Mountains blends platform jumping, lite roguelike and Tarkov-style collection. Embark on an adventure, improve yourself and beat tough challenges. What lies beyond the mountain? Characters join you with different motives, and many mysteries are waiting to be revealed.

details.title: 水球啪啦Splash Party
details.short_description: Splash Party is a colorful water-balloon action game. Place balloons, dodge bursts, break crates, and collect power-ups. Challenge another player in online PvP, practice solo, or face enemies and bosses in the single-player campaign.

details.title: ISKRA
details.short_description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

details.title: Ragnarök Survivor
details.short_description: Created with AI assistance. Fight as one of three Norse heroes in a dark isometric 2.5D action-survivor. Survive twenty waves across three arenas, combine weapons, runes and companions, and return to Yggdrasil to prepare your next build.

details.title: Hustle
details.short_description: Hustle is a VR adventure game where you play as a Bounty Hunter taking on various jobs for interplanetary corporations and conspiracy groups. What will you do for a taste of everything?

details.title: Store Tycoon Simulator
details.short_description: Build and manage your own supermarket in Store Tycoon. Order products, stock shelves, hire and schedule staff, manage deliveries and expenses, and keep customers happy. Track sales, level up, unlock new products, and turn your small shop into a successful retail business.

details.title: Shardana
details.short_description: Shipwrecked on an island inspired by ancient Nuragic Sardinia, explore, fish, build your shelter, and help the villagers. But beware: when night falls, the infected turn into dangerous creatures. Survive alone or in online co-op with up to 6 players.

details.title: RLRacer
details.short_description: Master the season in this 2D roguelike racer! Meet escalating targets against tough AI up to the finale. Invest tactically in upgrades & crew. Win to unlock new cars with unique abilities that completely change your strategy for the next run.

details.title: The Tower to God
details.short_description: A tower built to reach God. A wound that never healed. It is bleeding the world dry. Ascend it anyway. Defy a structure that even does not want to be reached. Hope is your only weapon.

details.title: Bomba Arena
details.short_description: A bunch of friends, a bunch of bombs, and zero mercy! Bomba Arena is the chaotic party multiplayer (2-4 Players) where you blow up your buddies, snatch wild items, and power up your bombs. Friendships will be tested — only one can claim the crown!

details.title: Poligon 6
details.short_description: Year 3024. In a world controlled by AI, Maria receives her next task: complete Poligon 6 - eight unique sections of pure challenge. It’s simple… but far from easy. Her goal isn’t just to finish - it’s to gather as many tokens as she can.

details.title: Tile & Error
details.short_description: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

details.title: Water & Healing
details.short_description: An immersive 3D art experience exploring water, nature and healing. Wander through atmospheric virtual worlds, discover watercolor artworks, meet characters and complete gentle quests while experiencing stories of peace, connection and renewal.

details.title: Fartimus!
details.short_description: Use your voice to defeat enemy wizards in this online PVP Spell Casting Duel!

details.title: worm_game_2
details.short_description: Currently, a point-&-click, silly tone game where you wrangle jellyfish as an axolotl using just the mouse curser & left-click; with other sandbox-lite'esc features like dragging objects/entities around, NPC-to-player dialog, &, of course, blowing bubbles :0 o o o x :)

details.title: Rocket
details.short_description: Rocket is a rage-inducing 2.5D precision game where you control a rocket, dodge obstacles and try to make it to the end without losing your mind. Oh, did I forget to mention that you have to do it all in one run?

details.title: Drillionaire
details.short_description: Dig deep, get rich, and let the machines take over. Jetpack through infinite layers of ever-stranger ore, dodge explosions, gas and lava, then build a fleet of automatons and drones that keep mining while you're away. Prestige, then dig deeper.

details.title: NuTREEnts
details.short_description: NuTREEnts is a strategic tower defense roguelike about growing and expanding your forest. Plant saplings, fend off bugs, and explore a desolate planet while you grow a mighty colony of trees!

details.title: Task Bar Farm
details.short_description: An idle RPG that lives right above your taskbar. Fill your storage with gear across 15 tiers, forge and fuse at the Blacksmith, collect heroes and pets, and trade your best Steam items on the Community Market.

details.title: Breed a Slime
details.short_description: Keep a squishy, real-time physics slime right on your desktop! In Breed a Slime, squish and fling slimes while working, breed and mutate traits, collect genes and ornate looks like wings and auras to fill your compendium, found legacy bloodlines, and trade Gene Seeds on the Steam Market!

details.title: Fairy Isle
details.short_description: This is a simulation construction game. You will play as the steward of a Sky Island, where you need to engage in farming, construction, smelting, and gathering on this pristine island. Your goal is to develop the island into a more splendid place.

details.title: Project Potato Man - Chapter 1
details.short_description: Survive the first chapter of a psychological horror adventure. Explore an abandoned town, uncover its dark secrets, and evade the mysterious Potato Man before it finds you.

details.title: Void Walkers X64
details.short_description: Your aura fights their aura. A 70-hour classic JRPG where every boss is fought twice — once for their health, once for their soul. Real-time charge-gauge combat, 183 maps, 40 hubs, and deep hybrid class trees. Sovereign C++ engine (IIRIS) iGPU compatible, 128MB VRAM floor.

details.title: MMORPG Merchant Simulator
details.short_description: Travel back to 2008—the year where it all began—with nothing but a dismantling machine. Break down crystals, brew potions, run your stall, hunt bargains, stockpile goods, and trade the markets. Climb from your parents' basement all the way to a villa and a sports car.

details.title: O.M.E.N. | Synthetic Genesis
details.short_description: A top-down survival horror game where genetic experiments escape containment. Run, hide, solve mazes to prove you are human, collect keycards, uncover the truth behind a corporation favoring profits over ethical experimentation, and discover why O.M.E.N. is making mysterious use of his new powers.

details.title: Wizard 64
details.short_description: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

details.title: Axelball
details.short_description: Blast off in a battle of physics with AXELBALL. With 2 player local shared keyboard controls this game is ready to play right on your keyboard against your friends, coworkers or siblings right away. Rocket speeds with real-time physics strategy will bring the fun right to your home or workplace.

details.title: DICTOCRACY
details.short_description: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

details.title: 8plus9
details.short_description: 8plus9 is an isometric action RPG inspired by Taiwanese temple folklore. Slash through spirits, cast talisman magic, tame cats and dogs, and challenge five elemental dragons. Forge your gear, ride a spirit beast, or keep growing with auto-hunting and offline rewards.

details.title: Rogue Link Loop
details.short_description: Link matching tiles via paths with up to two turns. Clear tiles to cast spells, build structures, and summon allies. Diverse spells and relics ensure fresh runs. Counter unique elite disruptors.

details.title: Mourning House
details.short_description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, you awaken inside a mysterious house—and your wife is missing. Explore its dark rooms, solve disturbing puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover what happened before the nightmare consumes you.

name: 終末生徒 The Last Student：Showa Era Radio Room

details.title: 終末生徒 The Last Student：Showa Era Radio Room
details.short_description: A Showa-era school, a radio room at night. In a building where you are not alone, you repeat broadcasts. Strange responses return. Records change, unknown logs grow. Reality begins to erode, and the story twists through your choices. Ten endings await.

name: 股魂誓約－Stockbound: Oath of Souls

details.title: 股魂誓約－Stockbound: Oath of Souls
details.short_description: An online side-scrolling idle RPG where fantasy battles meet a stock-market-inspired economy. Build your knight, recruit allies, challenge bosses and embed virtual stock certificates in equipment. Requires a game account and internet connection.

details.title: Slavic Warband
details.short_description: Slavic Warband is a tactical RPG in which you lead a pack of peasants searching for a better life in early medieval Eastern Europe. Explore, fight, equip, and level up your company to ultimately create your own small kingdom.

details.title: GET FIT - Women’s Fitness
details.short_description: Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense, rewarding, and ever-changing full-body workouts.

details.title: GET FIT - Men's Fitness
details.short_description: Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense, rewarding, and ever-changing full-body workouts.

details.title: Lost City of Kane
details.short_description: Start with a stick in an empty field and dig up to 300 metres down to a buried city. Sell the dirt, hire a crew of goblins, put up cranes, rails and goblin-powered machines, and find your way home, alone or with up to seven friends.

details.title: Just More Doors : REFRAMED & REDACTED
details.short_description: OPEN THE DOOR TO WIN! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

details.title: Love and Peace Simulator
details.short_description: 《大爱仙尊模拟器》是一款开放世界RPG，身为掌门不仅要提升自身修为，还要强大宗门实力。您扮演蓝夏与蓝珂兄妹，不择手段的活下去。黑暗孕育出恶之花，在没有人伦道德的约束下，在未来等待着的，是何等的欢愉……

details.title: SpaceTD
details.short_description: A space tower defense game about stopping the invading spaceships

details.title: Abyss Card Legend
details.short_description: Clear stages for god-tier gear, sacrifice to summon the Boss! In Abyss Card Legends, resurrect the ultimate Demon King with your own hands and claim the most game-breaking loot!

details.title: Duck Duck Run
details.short_description: The ducks are on the run, and you have 3 minutes to catch them! Chase them down as they try to escape. Catch ducks to earn coins and unlock new items and upgrades.

details.title: Maeli Keus
details.short_description: A world that only exists where you look. Explore a dreamlike land that manifests around you as you walk, gather crystals to relight forgotten checkpoints, and escape the creature that hunts you through the light.

name: ローマ帝国の逆襲　Counter Attack of Roman Empire

details.title: ローマ帝国の逆襲　Counter Attack of Roman Empire
details.short_description: 【概要】：「ローマ帝国の逆襲」は、若き将軍・ユリアヌスとなり、ローマ軍を率い帝国領州ガリア地区に侵入した蛮族を撃破して、再び平和を回復することが目的です。 【デザイン】：RTSゲームで、偵察、配置、戦闘、補充を行います。戦闘の評価により報酬（金、食料、捕虜（兵士として雇用することが可能））が変化します。戦闘の評価は、制限時間内（食料が尽きるまで）に敵の部隊の撃滅率、ユリアヌス及び味方の生存率です。 得られる報酬によって次の戦闘の難易度が変化するでしょう。但し、強大な敵の場合は撤退も検討することが必要になります。 時間制限もあるので迅速な状況把握と決断が重視されるゲームです。

details.title: ArcMages
details.short_description: Choose your spellbook and blast your rivals off the map in turn-based online artillery battles. Hurl fireballs, call down meteors, summon dragons, and carve the destructible battlefield into fortresses or craters. One turn, one spell, one perfect shot.

details.title: Unwanted Guest
details.short_description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

details.title: Night Drive VR - Anomaly
details.short_description: Night Drive VR - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

details.title: FLEETING ESCAPE
details.short_description: FLEETING ESCAPE is a wave-based survival horror game where every choice could be your last. You must escape to a different island at the end of each wave to survive. Each island has monsters, items, and loot to be discovered.

details.title: Moosio
details.short_description: Moosio is a chaotic party brawler where you play as moose blasting mushrooms at each other! Gobble up mushrooms around the arena and spit them at your friends in ridiculous combat. Play local or online. Pure mayhem. Pure moose. Pure mushroom chaos!

details.title: Serious Losers Arena Paradis
details.short_description: A physics-driven co-op brawler for 1-4 players. Swing your weapon with your mouse, send monsters flying, survive waves and bosses, merge loot into stronger gear, and settle arguments with your friends in arena duels between waves.

details.title: Will it Stand?
details.short_description: Disaster strikes! With a limited budget, build structures, mechanisms, and defenses to protect your beaver from earthquakes, floods, mudslides, meteors, and enemy attacks. Brace, absorb, divert, defend—there is no single answer. If it is still standing when the disaster is over, it worked.

details.title: Warring Kingdoms: Chronicles of War
details.short_description: A RPG where you build and rule a fantasy kingdom, manage resources, command large-scale battles, and use your character's abilities to change the course of war.

details.title: SpaceVivor
details.short_description: Lost beyond a wormhole, command a modular starship in a survival game that aims for the realism of time passing in space: long, relaxing voyages, adrenaline-fuelled battles, countless discoveries and incredible alien scenery. Rebuild your ship module by module and lead a crew of four races.

details.title: The Last Button
details.short_description: Buy block-shaped buttons, fit them onto a floating board and click them for cash. Harder shapes pay bigger multipliers. Coat buttons in 40 materials, let rabbits, drones and a repair robot work for you, ride out storms and meteor showers, and grow your board until the Last Button fits.

details.title: Glyphwild
details.short_description: Glyphwild is a 3D bullet-heaven roguelite where runes combine. Socket a fireball under a lightning rune and fireballs rain on shocked foes. Wire wild rune chains, carve through thousands of creatures and towering bosses across 6 living vales, alone or in online co-op.

details.title: Card of Fate
details.short_description: Card of Fate is a roguelike deckbuilder where you wander the path to Heaven or Hell. Construct a powerful deck, find legendary relics, and defeat the guardians of the afterlife. Will you master the celestial arts of the Angel or the devastating fury of the Demon?

details.title: TIC, TAC & TOE
details.short_description: The worst bounty hunters in the galaxy take every job going and ruin each one in a way nobody could have predicted. A hand-painted couch co-op brawler for 1-3 players who deserve better teammates.

details.title: Built By Force
details.short_description: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

details.title: Ass Slapper Co
details.short_description: Ass Slapper Co. is a desktop companion game where real-world typing and well-timed slaps earn Employee Fulfillment. Upgrade and customize your workplace as eccentric founder Johan Slapper guides you through a 6-chapter storyline from a 2D closet to a 3D penthouse office.

details.title: Mystery of Prophecy
details.short_description: Mystery of Prophecy is a pixel art Metroidvania based on biblical prophecies, health, and parkour.

details.title: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
details.short_description: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.

details.title: CacheAdventure
details.short_description: CacheAdventure is a new open-world adventure sandbox game. Dig, explore, fight, loot, and build in infinite procedural landscapes. Enjoy persistent free updates/optimizations—more playable content coming!

details.title: Drive Beyond Horizons City
details.short_description: Driving a vehicle over long distances requires a significant amount of supplies. While cities contain plenty of resources, they are also swarming with zombies and mercenaries; the plan is to drive toward the outskirts of the city.

details.title: 薪上人 Salaryman
details.short_description: "Xinshangren" is a simulation management and cultivation + romance adventure GalGame. As an unemployed and money-strapped individual, you encounter various girls while working part-time, sharing the hardships of survival. Amidst the daily routine, sparks of affection ignite, shaping your unique

details.title: Emerald Space Courier
details.short_description: Survive megacorp Emerald Acme's lethal "field test"! Pilot in a 60 FPS neon arena, face 8 bosses across a 24-shift combinatorial cycle, master 4 built-in minigames, and customize your broadcast in Emerald FM Studio. Solo, Co-op, or PvP!

details.title: Fluffy Alchemist
details.short_description: A cozy exploration game about a red panda alchemist. Explore five islands where night never falls, gather ingredients that each behave differently, brew potions and fill your Book of Brews. No timers, no enemies, nothing is ever lost when you fail.

details.title: K-God Robot Hunters
details.short_description: A Korean-fantasy poker roguelike where you build hands from five elemental suits and harness the powers of mythic goddesses. Refine your deck, discover powerful combinations, and battle through a robot uprising one hand at a time.

details.title: Astrostrike
details.short_description: You are the captain of the Galactic battleship, building hundreds of gun turrets, raising dozens of space fighters, establishing aircraft carrier groups, space stations, and conquering the entire Milky Way

details.title: Marbled Memories
details.short_description: Marbled Memories is a psychological horror game based on true events. Play as Derek, a young man severely mistreated and neglected by his mother. This game contains a story, puzzles, dark humor, many objects to interact with, collectibles, along with a few startling moments.

details.title: Xydorth
details.short_description: In search of your wife, you must descend into the darkness of a vast cave system. But with every step deeper, your descent becomes a journey into your own personal hell. Xydorth is a dark first-person shooter with survival horror elements.

details.title: StakeBound
details.short_description: Shape the odds in a theatrical roulette battler. Stake chips on attacks, guards and rewards, time your spins, and turn a Perfect result into a dramatic finishing move. Read enemy intentions, adapt your build, and face a cast of masked rivals.

details.title: Lone Lines: RPG
details.short_description: An atmospheric damn stylish 3D roguelike that will hurt you. Or make you feel good. The honest randomness of the Dead World is unfair to the fragile Rover and the Pilot connected to it. Rejoice, suffer, level up, and dive deeper into a universe After Absolutely Everything.

details.title: Rogue Tithe
details.short_description: A traditional turn-based roguelike of tempo and uncertainty. Roll an adventurer blind, outpace enemies to act twice, sneak past what you cannot fight, and descend twelve floors for the Barrow Relic. Death keeps what you carry, but the crows will fly your gold home for a fee.

details.title: MUNer
details.short_description: Early this century, a school Model UN event steeped in emotional conflict and tragedy changed every participant’s life. Years later, the scattered youth reunite and seek revenge, amid fractured friendship, love, ambition and lost dreams.
publishers: ローズペタル・アトリエ

details.title: Citrus Summer
details.short_description: Citrus Summer is a yuri visual novel set in the urban workplace. Play as Rachel, a single corporate worker stuck in overtime, and navigate unexpected romance with three women—a sharp boutique owner, a talented new colleague, or your childhood best friend. Your choices decide whose heart you capture.

details.title: Flow Treehouse
details.short_description: A tiny treehouse tucked into the corner of your desktop. Prince Tomato times your focus, Todudu keeps your to-dos, and Lily plays soft music. Focus, finish tasks and play with them to earn wish points for outfits, playlists and decorations. As the treehouse grows, new fairies move in.

details.title: Blood Covenant
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror job-sim where your hazmat crew cleans up after the night shift while the building quietly changes things behind your back. Every anomaly you fail to report makes the ritual at the end of the night a little worse.

name: If You Build It, Everyone Dies!

details.title: If You Build It, Everyone Dies!
details.short_description: Play as the "Techno King" of a thriving Silicon Valley startup in this active incremental game. Fulfill contracts, harvest data, fabricate supply chains, manufacture consent, bio-integrate with humans, and transcend space and time itself in a dark satire of the retro-futuristic Brave New World.

details.title: Warlondor
details.short_description: Build five heroes your way. Make your tank a healer if you wish, and combine their abilities into powerful party synergies. Every action takes time, but combat pauses for each decision. Time interrupts, bursts, and combos. Adapt to risky routes and run-changing affixes

details.title: Firefly
details.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op action roguelite for 1-4 players. A firefly is your only light in the caves. Stay close to it, or venture into the dark for better rewards. Upgrade your weapons as you slay monsters and level up.

details.title: Mana Boom
details.short_description: Magic meets physics, and the world is yours to mess with! Battle or race with up to 8 players in real time. Lob spells with your choice of elements and projectile behaviors, swing on ropes, and destroy or create terrain. Win your own way. Play dirty, but don't let it backfire!

details.title: Fortfall
details.short_description: Build your defenses. Choose your class. Hold the Core. FortFall is a third-person fantasy defense game for solo play or private online co-op with up to five players. Raise walls, repair the damage, and fight escalating waves with melee weapons, bows, spells, and sentries.

details.title: Just Chessing Around
details.short_description: A tactical dungeon crawler where your party is a chess army and the board tries to kill you. Plan around tornadoes, quicksand swallowing your pieces or flying lava stones. Turn bishops into necromancers, stack pawns on other pieces or give Jerry a BBQ. No king to checkmate, just enemies to destroy.

details.title: Kairos
details.short_description: Build, expand, and wage dice-driven wars in this medieval tabletop strategy game optimized for a digital experience. Adopt unique legacies to progressively define your strategy as you race your rivals to accomplish the most feats and claim victory.

name: Sort the Magic Potions: Tidy Up and Shelve

details.title: Sort the Magic Potions: Tidy Up and Shelve
details.short_description: Cozy single-player organizing and cleaning simulator where you sort 3,040 scattered potions throughout a mysterious magical library. Return every potion to its proper shelf, organize magical collections by type, unlock powerful abilities, restore perfect order, and reveal the way out.

details.title: Kaerun
details.short_description: Explore the forgotten island of Kaerun in a first-person archaeological adventure. Investigate ancient settlements, uncover artifacts, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together a mysterious history through exploration, observation, and discovery.

details.title: Void Balls
details.short_description: A 3D survivors-like where you play as a ball. Roll, jump, dash and parry everything: every shot you catch flies back at its shooter. Stack auto-firing weapons, gears and items into a wild build, beat the balls that rule the void, then play as them.

details.title: BibimBoB
details.short_description: BibimBob is a simple game: just keep jumping and dashing forward. All you need to do is pass the traps and reach the goal.

details.title: Hephaestus Protocol
details.short_description: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

details.title: Midgard Arena
details.short_description: Lead a party of four anime heroes across a shared 3D world. Hunt in real time on the same maps as other players, take down world bosses together, trade at the player market and test your build in 5v5 Arena and Battle Royale.

details.title: War Company: Fortress Europe
details.short_description: Lead armies across a dynamic 3D campaign, then command the battles they create in real time. Logistics, maneuver, and tactical success combine to decide the fate of the war.

details.title: MAZE RUSH
details.short_description: Race a glowing ball up 18-floor towers of pitch-black mazes. Ride teleports, dodge spikes, smash through walls and outrun the void across 100+ maps and four party minigames, solo or with up to 4 friends online and in split-screen. Then build your own maps and share them on the Workshop.

details.title: IRONVOW
details.short_description: A gothic pixel-art action platformer with hard, fair boss fights. Parry, riposte and break their guard as you fight down ten cursed depths. After every level, swear a vow: a boon is straight power, a gamble is great power at a real price.

details.title: The Small Kingdom
details.short_description: A top-down action RPG at insect scale. Lead an ant general through a war over the shards of a fallen star: battle shard-empowered princes, absorb elemental power, and rescue soldiers to fight beside you and workers to rebuild the colony.

details.title: Wasteland Collector
details.short_description: Explore the wasteland, scavenge and mine resources, rescue survivors, and uncover the secrets of your forgotten past. Manage your inventory, upgrade your gear, and fight monsters in fast-paced auto-battler combat with your fully tuned shopping cart.

details.title: Grow a Girlfriend
details.short_description: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or don't.

details.title: TowOrbs
details.short_description: TowOrbs is an incremental tower defense game where where you face down hordes of wolves. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and slice through your foes with spinning orbs of destruction!

details.title: Joker Chess
details.short_description: Bluffing chess. Every piece is a Joker that can move like any chess piece — if you dare. Call your opponent's bluff and their liar is destroyed; call it wrong and you lose your move. Hide your king, fake your queen and climb the online ranked ladder.

details.title: A Developer Nightmare
details.short_description: You’re stuck in a dream and must run a special program on your computer to escape. Anomalies in the house disturb you, increasing your stress. Work with 2 or more Players to clear them before your stress consumes you.

details.title: Agent Pigeon 7
details.short_description: Shoot your way through endless waves of government drones! Grab loot, level up, unlock pigeons and upgrades to create unique and crazy gun loadouts as you destroy mindless waves of government robots.

details.title: Life Containment Unit
details.short_description: Life Containment Unit is a time and resource management survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker. Struggle to survive against the creatures invading your L.C.U. and the rogue corporate AI that designed this accursed vault system.

details.title: Viland Chronicles 维兰德战纪
details.short_description: Viland Chronicles: classic Japanese-style turn-based tactical SLG. Fallen allies stay dead, level-ups give random stat growth, and custom stages post-game. Modern people stranded in another world ally with or fight its factions. Choices lead to different endings and change the continent's fate.
developers: Shanghai Yaxian Huizhi Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Yaxian Huizhi Technology Co., Ltd.

details.title: GUN MONKEY!
details.short_description: Help your monkey escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

details.title: Tamerlane Chess
details.short_description: Not a chess. It is a war strategy. Tamerlane Chess is the digital version of the board Timur used to shape his battlefield tactics. With a larger board, unique pieces, and deep strategy, every move demands the mindset of a true commander.

details.title: Roll Arena
details.short_description: A brutally hard action-roguelike where physics has it in for you: roll, shoot, bounce and brawl through themed arenas with 250+ items as absurd as they are lethal.

details.title: Calm Bricks
details.short_description: Calm Bricks is a cozy brick-building game about the whole ritual: tear open the bags and dig through the pile for that one tiny piece. Follow 3D instructions or free-build in creative mode. No timers, no scores. Just a warm lamp and the click of bricks.

name: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight

details.title: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight
details.short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

details.title: One Tank Trip
details.short_description: Team up as three soldiers forgotten in the evacuation on their journey home by tank!

details.title: ScaMMO
details.short_description: Incremental game where you play as a frustrated rich MMO veteran promising to make the next WoW killer. How far will you get before cashing out?

details.title: Summoner Arise!
details.short_description: Turn-based. Tactics. Roguelike. Summon units and battle your way past wave after wave of enemies. Start with a fixed amount of mana as you ascend a mysterious ruined world. Run out and you lose. With 300+ upgrades available, customize and command your army to victory!

details.title: Little Writer Desktop Companion
details.short_description: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

details.title: BIG. BAD. BOOM!
details.short_description: A hand-drawn Cold War strategy game. Spend three years making decisions, building up your army, culture, science and birth rate, and spying on your neighbors. The red button is dealt at random: wipe your neighbor off the face of the earth or win without firing a single shot.

details.title: Gravitten
details.short_description: Take control of Gravitten, the gravity-defying kitten, and master the environment's shifting physics. Journey through 5 distinct biomes, manipulating gravity and perspective to solve intricate puzzles.

details.title: Ant Tidy Up
details.short_description: A cozy, quirky sorting game about thousands of ants who aren't where they belong! Explore a sprawling underground world, catch and sort ants into their rightful nests, and unlock upgrades and beetle robots to help tidy up the chaos.

details.title: Empires of Black Powder
details.short_description: A Napoleonic era RTS with card-based army building and direct commander combat on horseback to support your troops. Open packs, equip your regiments, and command combined arms of infantry, cavalry, and artillery in real-time battles. Keep your veteran guard alive and bring them into the next battle.

details.title: Abilill: Persistent Fantasy Extraction MMO
details.short_description: (This game was developed entirely using AI.) Abilill: persistent-world fantasy loot/extraction MMO. Leave a safe base on foot for wilds, caves and ruins. Find treasure, fight monsters and hostile players, extract loot. Die and your backpack loot drops for others. Push deeper or retreat?

details.title: Miraclawns
details.short_description: A unique roguelite strategy where you strengthen slimes through gambling. As the Demon King, use fate-altering bets to boost your small slimes' stats and deploy them to the frontlines. Will your judgment or overwhelming "luck" overcome the brutal battlefield?

details.title: Idle Dojo
details.short_description: A cozy idle RPG starring a pink-haired swordmaiden who fights and grows on autopilot. Befriend a cast of charming NPC girls, collect gorgeous CG artwork, defeat floor guardians and climb ever-higher floors.

name: Get to Work! Girls of Gensokyo

details.title: Get to Work! Girls of Gensokyo
details.short_description: A pixel-art idle fan game set in Gensokyo. Jealous of Kourindou's success, a broke Reimu decides to set up shops on the shrine grounds to make bank! Recruit youkai, gather resources, and build a bustling commercial street in this relaxing Gensokyo management sim.

details.title: Beyond Krukmore
details.short_description: A turn-based dice-building roguelite where your weapons and spells are the dice you roll. Lead two heroes and a companion through a dark fantasy world, piece together powerful builds, and weigh the promise of better loot against the cost of one more fight.

details.title: BrokenLore: ASCEND
details.short_description: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness and to the truth about themselves.

details.title: Pigeon Idle: GUGUGUGU!
details.short_description: Catch pigeons and sell them as rotisserie chicken! Or set your hard-won catch free! Run a pigeon rotisserie on your desktop, and let your favorite pigeons play on top of your taskbar.

details.title: Stemmies
details.short_description: Stemmies™ is a groundbreaking biological simulation. Command a fully voiced, AI-driven Chief Medical Officer with a DLC, manage a sprawling 2.5D bio-punk city, harvest cellular resources, and manipulate a live stock market fueled by ATP.

name: A Game About Pulling A Rope

details.title: A Game About Pulling A Rope
details.short_description: A rope comes flying out of the well in your yard. Pull it. Things far too big for a well squeeze out: carts, church bells, somebody's house. Sell them, buy a winch, buy a horse, and keep pulling to find out what is tied to the other end.

details.title: Myth: Chenxiang
details.short_description: Myth: Chenxiang is a third-person action RPG inspired by Chinese mythology. Play as the son of a mortal and a goddess, defeat powerful foes, deepen your cultivation, and defy the laws of Heaven to rescue your mother and reunite your family.

details.title: LEXICON: The Nameless Tongue
details.short_description: You crash-land on an alien world and must trade with the locals to survive. But their language is generated fresh every run: new words, new script, new grammar. Listen, guess, haggle and decipher your way off the planet.

details.title: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
details.short_description: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

details.title: DEATHMATE
details.short_description: DEATHMATE is a chess-themed roguelike deckbuilder. Build an army of pieces, stack a deck full of moves, and battle your way across the depths of the Underworld.

details.title: Mahjong Kart
details.short_description: Mahjong meets kart racing! Drive tiles back to your base to collect them, use items to disrupt rivals, and be first to complete a winning hand. Play online with up to four players or face off in local split-screen.

details.title: Shav : The Night Watch
details.short_description: An overnight job. A covered body. A lamp you must keep alight. Watch over a dead woman in a remote Indian village, and discover what's gone wrong before you open the door.

details.title: Colossal Citadels
details.short_description: A fantasy strategy, featuring turn-based factory building over procedural resource types. Expand and optimize your network of towns, grow your heroes, and excel in deep tactical seamless auto-battler combat.

details.title: Armatus
details.short_description: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

details.title: Emberville
details.short_description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

details.title: Bach For More Words 2
details.short_description: Bach For More Words 2 is a word game where you decipher an encrypted definition and select its matching word from three related words. Then, you'll pair up the remaining definitions with their matching words. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words 2!

details.title: Bach For More Words 3
details.short_description: Bach For More Words 3 is a challenging word game where you unscramble a word and select its synonym from three related words. Then, you'll pair up the remaining words with their matching synonyms. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words 3!

details.title: Cardboard Tanks
details.short_description: Co-op tank roguelite for 1–4 players. Blast through a fully destructible world, online or on the couch.

details.title: Spiritual Mesh Theory
details.short_description: Spiritual Mesh Theory is a gamified software simulation that explores the topology of mesh networks in 3D space. A video game designed like medical software meant to be enjoyed like a visualizer. It is as much art as it is logic; giving way to theory. A clever twist on vibe\cozy gaming and software.

details.title: Fast Food Fortune
details.short_description: Fast Food Fortune is a simulation management game. Hire and train your crew. Upgrade and maintain your equipment. Unlock upgrades that will help you on your way. You are graded on how well you do and profits are multiplied. In order to be profitable you will have to lock in when you clock in!

details.title: Tombstone Tactics
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike autobattler where you play the Lich. Raise an undead army from the souls of fallen heroes, set the board, and let it fight. Lose a battle and your army returns; the Lich pays instead. March on the royal family and take it apart, one crown at a time.

details.title: FLIP MACHINA
details.short_description: Reversi meets roguelike. Plant machine stones on the board, flank them to fire them off, and chain your score through charms and upgrades. Build your own scoring engine and go for the legendary eight-way OCTAFLIP in a cozy late-night puzzle shop.

details.title: PokerCat Battle
details.short_description: Turn poker hands into powerful attacks in a fantasy adventure starring a sword-wielding cat. Bend your hand with Tarot cards, battle bosses, collect gear, and grow stronger. Play each hand yourself or let auto-battle run in a compact desktop bar.

details.title: Hotel Carnivalia
details.short_description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

name: Bulge: The Battle for the Ardennes

details.title: Bulge: The Battle for the Ardennes
details.short_description: December 1944. Hitler's last gamble in the West. A faithful digital edition of SPI's classic 1979 hex-and-counter wargame by James F. Dunnigan: drive the panzers to the Meuse, or hold the Ardennes until Patton arrives. Play the AI or a friend, and learn the rules as you go.

details.title: FUMEHEAD
details.short_description: FUMEHEAD is a hero-focused turn-based RPG set in an underground world. Play as Dart and Ami as you try to eradicate the new alien disease that calls itself Slither.

details.title: Arcostate
details.short_description: Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Explore a handcrafted map with both unique locations and procedurally generated zones, discover hundreds of items to aid your journey, and lose yourself in a retro-future world.

details.title: Nightshift Drift
details.short_description: A small, simple and chill night drift game. Deliver orders on a mountain road, earn a bigger tip when you drift your way there, and spend your earnings making your car look better. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Last Warrior Arena
details.short_description: Build your warrior. Outsmart your next opponent. Last Warrior Arena is a 1v1 roguelike auto-battler where equipment, skills, and enemy choices shape every run. Combine elemental powers, discover powerful builds, and take on deadly bosses as your warrior fights automatically.

details.title: Its a Trap
details.short_description: Build devious traps. Survive ingenious contraptions. It’s a Trap is a physics platformer and level-building sandbox. Combine deadly hazards, reactive liquids, ropes and wired mechanisms, then brave your creations and share them through Steam Workshop.

details.title: Vectorfall
details.short_description: Defend against massive waves with 5,000 enemies. Master 14 towers, pick your favorite upgrades and tear through huge waves of enemies with powerful abilities. Progress with 120+ skills and push your limits in endless mode. Take the fight anywhere with Steam Deck and full controller support. No AI.

details.title: Drunk Golf
details.short_description: Drunk Golf is a 1-8 player multiplayer game where the more drunk you are -> the further you shoot, but it also makes you wobblier. Master the physics-based swings, race & drift across multiple courses, customize your look and mess with friends on the way to the lowest score.

details.title: Trapped: Last Exit
details.short_description: Wake up trapped in a collapsed underground factory. Dig through rubble, sell sand, Buy upgrades and escape. A cozy, satisfying, and relaxing incremental mining adventure!

details.title: The Kingsward
details.short_description: Explore an open-world Sandbox RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

details.title: Ember and Blade
details.short_description: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

details.title: DREADSHELL
details.short_description: DREADSHELL is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

details.title: Well Up
details.short_description: You wake at the bottom of an old well with only a worn rope leading up. Reach hand over hand, swing to keep your balance and climb inch by inch. Wet rope, slick moss, frayed strands and thorns stand in your way, and one slip can drop you all the way down. Ready to see the sun again?

details.title: Orca Girl: Idle Fishing Story
details.short_description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

details.title: 荷莱Horae
details.short_description: 或许，这是你见过最自私的故事。

details.title: 白之树：月泪少女
details.short_description: 《白之树：月泪少女》在没有陆地的世界里，人类仍在航行。世界被海洋吞没，文明碎裂成漂浮的船团。而在这片无尽之海中，唯一稳定的光源，是一种名为“白之树”的神秘存在。它结出的果实——“月之泪”，维系着整个世界的运转。但没有人知道，它究竟是什么。

details.title: pond thing
details.short_description: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It follows Shen Qingheng, a narcissistic young man who is drawn into a sacrificial ritual. As his mind grows numb and begins to break down, he is ultimately saved by his family’s “love.”

details.title: Slaughterhouse
details.short_description: Trapped inside a snowbound mansion, you must eliminate the five employees responsible for your parents’ deaths and their plot to seize the family fortune. Combine household objects to create deadly traps, protect what is yours, make sure not a single one of them leaves the mansion alive.

details.title: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare
details.short_description: A pausable real time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat; It’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

details.title: Toy Tycoon
details.short_description: You're the owner of a toy business. Start with a small store in a suburban area. Increase your profits, unlock new toys, hire employees, move to bigger locations, manufacture your own toys, and expand your company. Build your empire and become a toy tycoon!

details.title: Astro Kitty: Space Mining
details.short_description: Astro Kitty: Space Mining is an incremental mining game where you dig through planets, collect valuable resources, upgrade your gear, automate your mining operation, and travel between planets on an adventure with cats.

details.title: 恋语彼方
details.short_description: 这是一款青春恋爱百合视觉小说，讲述温曦瑶与顾晨曦于大学校园重逢之时，终于将暗藏多年的心意诉诸彼此。然而，一场意外让两人分别。可距离不曾磨灭眷恋的火种，跨越过记忆与厄运的障碍。最终，她们选择紧握彼此的手，以坚定的温柔共赴命运，写就一段关于勇气与深情的动人恋章。

details.title: Crimson Princess
details.short_description: Beat 'em up(Belt Scroll) Action Game. Control princesses with distinct fighting styles—one-handed sword, brawler, musket, greatsword, and hammer. Chain switches that shift range and tempo with support attacks to keep the pressure on.

details.title: Marry Anyone
details.short_description: Get married within one month—or lose your job!? Solve puzzles, use items, and change your stats (Intelligence, Age, Cleanliness, Height, and Income) as you work your way toward marriage in this matchmaking puzzle game!

details.title: Crystals Bureau
details.short_description: Command your Escort Cart and navigate freely across the map! Plot your own defense routes, build towers, hunt for powerful artifacts, and defeat Umbra monsters to bring the Crystal Core home.

details.title: Tanky Tanks - Reloaded
details.short_description: Tanky Tanks - Reloaded is an intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

details.title: Idlescape
details.short_description: Idlescape is an MMORPG combining idle mechanics with RPG elements. Progress continues offline, allowing mastery of skills like Mining, Fishing, and Combat. Engage in crafting, gathering, and strategic battles. Perfect for casual and hardcore gamers alike.

details.title: Hexstride
details.short_description: Movement is combat. No attack button. Your positioning and movement patterns trigger abilities automatically. Choose your class, complete objectives, and descend deeper into procedurally generated dungeons. Every step is a tactical decision.

details.title: Thank You 4 Playing
details.short_description: Gather information on social media in-game to take down every last boss in this deduction-based puzzle adventure game inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn. It's release day for the latest entry in a legendary action game series, and you need to beat it. Fun is secondary, victory is all.

details.title: Legend of Idle
details.short_description: In this short incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

details.title: One More Rock!
details.short_description: A chill incremental game about satisfying mining and automated forging. Mine. Gamble. Upgrade. Repeat. Mine another rock while the lantern is burning.

details.title: DEPRECATED
details.short_description: A fast top-down character-action roguelite with a bullet heaven core. Dash, deflect and heavy-attack through swarms of an AI's own hardware while your weapon grows from one bolt to a full ring. You're the last human voice in the system. Climb to its CORE before it deletes you.

details.title: My Cat Companion
details.short_description: Your desktop is too quiet. Pick a cat. Paint their fur. One stalks your cursor. One reacts to every click and key. One bounces when tossed. Try to get work done. You answer to them now.

details.title: Tall Tales Inn
details.short_description: A cosy idle inn that grows floor by floor up the side of your desktop. Your guests furnish their rooms from the storeroom you stock, set off on quests and come home with loot and tall tales.

details.title: Eggstra Tidy
details.short_description: 4,800 eggs lie scattered across a grand old egg shop. Find every one, sort it onto the right shelf by color and pattern, and hunt down 12 hidden golden eggs. Welcome a crew of helper bunnies, unlock upgrades and turn total chaos into perfect order.

details.title: FreightLines
details.short_description: Build a freight empire in a living miniature world. Link towns by road, rail, sea and air, and watch every delivery shift the market. Play Cozy to unwind, or go Simulation for loans, seasons and rival buyouts.

details.title: PRO: Push React Outgun
details.short_description: PRO: Push React Outgun, is a next-gen tactical FPS with realistic visuals. Experience the raw impact of close-quarters combat where every bullet counts. Master strategic positioning and razor-sharp reflexes to win. See the unseen, hear the unheard, and survive under pressure.

details.title: Tails & Talons
details.short_description: The tower gets stronger. So does your hand. Every card is an attack, a spell, or both. Chain the right combo and turn a scratch into a killing blow. Play as one of a crew of furry adventurers who descend into an eldritch tower, each with their own reasons, one shared goal: reach the bottom.

details.title: Meteor Shower
details.short_description: Blast away never-ending hordes of falling meteors in this incremental tower defense game! Smash rocks to pieces with railguns, flak cannons, giant lasers and more as you work to defend your base from the stellar onslaught.

details.title: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
details.short_description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

details.title: Think And Co-op
details.short_description: Think and Coop is an exciting arcade game built for local and online co-op. Travel through forests and fairy-tale worlds, complete levels, and face new challenges. Coordination and teamwork are the keys to success in this fantastic adventure.

details.title: Decorate with flowers
details.short_description: Decorate with flowers is a cozy, stress-free tidy up game where you arrange vibrant plants, fragrant blossoms, and aesthetic decor onto shelves. No timers, no rush - just pure floral bliss.

details.title: Wharflet
details.short_description: Build a tiny fishing fleet on your desktop. Ride the waves, catch fish, sell and upgrade - all while you do other things. Just sit back and relax!

details.title: Idle Airways
details.short_description: Start with an empty field and work your way up to a bustling mega hub! Start your own airline and create routes to friends and other player as you progress. Can your airport be number one?

details.title: Midgardr
details.short_description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

details.title: Desktop Factory
details.short_description: Dig a tunnel to the core of planets and build a factory inside of it. Drill deeper to unlock space as you grow your factory in the tight geometry of your mining shaft. Purchase alternate building shapes and production upgrades from your Capytalist oligarchs to harvest the galaxy for minimum wage.

details.title: Shadows Of Deceit
details.short_description: Shadows of Deceit is a first-person psychological horror game. As Janet prepares to leave Havenbrook, one last visit to the Sheperd Hotel becomes a nightmare. Investigate a friend's death, connect clues through the Mind Palace, confront anomalies, and uncover memories that refuse to stay buried.

details.title: Endless Castle: Under Siege
details.short_description: Command your heroes, build unstoppable formations, and hold the line against endless waves. Recruit 40 unique heroes, grow stronger even while offline. Turn your castle into an unbreakable fortress.

details.title: Silent Still 3
details.short_description: Silent Still 3 is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on sleep paralysis, limited movement, and environmental tension. Fear builds slowly through silence, observation, subtle audio cues, and realistic spaces, creating a lasting sense of unease as control gradually slips away.

details.title: Village of the Ages
details.short_description: Raise a village of quirky little people, turning their bright ideas into new tools, and steering them through the ages, fires, tornados and all. No tech trees, no progress bars: just a community that grows up and starts making its own choices.

details.title: WARAG
details.short_description: A modernized old-school boomer shooter with progression, upgrades and a gory combat system. Fight in a dark Byzantine-Gothic setting, gain experience, power up your weapons, build your playstyle and become a true Varangian berserker.

details.title: Rogue Kingdom
details.short_description: Rogue Kingdom is an Online Roguelike with every dungeon persistently simulated! Claim dungeons, settle colonists, and defend!

details.title: The Hambagu Shop
details.short_description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

details.title: Unblock Me Kingdom
details.short_description: Slide the blocks, clear the exit, and find the move that changes everything. Unblockme offers 1,800 puzzles across six difficulty levels, eight visual themes, undo, and saved progress.

details.title: LuMi Desktop
details.short_description: There's someone on your desktop now. She talks, she listens, she remembers you - and she's all yours. Her mind, her voice, her memories all live right here on your machine. No accounts, no sign-ups, internet or not. Just her, waiting for you to say hi.

details.title: Idle Mortal
details.short_description: Begin with flawed spiritual roots in this xianxia idle RPG. Cultivate, craft pills and artifacts, raise spirit companions, and build your own sect. Train disciples and lead campaigns for territory as a mortal's journey becomes a sect's rise to power.

details.title: All Night Ascension
details.short_description: A cultivation backpack auto-battler built on a three-layer Bagua board. Arrange methods, artifacts, and materials to unleash flying swords and cannons, ascend through realms, and time your Domain to turn asynchronous duels. Try the free demo—three sects planned for Early Access.

details.title: Fred's Idle Garden
details.short_description: A cozy idle farming simulator that sits anywhere on your desktop while you work or do other things. Grow and sell crops in your own little shop, earn coins, unlock upgrades and expand your garden!

details.title: Pro Baseball: Franchise Builder
details.short_description: Take control of a professional baseball franchise and build a winner through the draft, trades, free agency, and player development. Customize your league, manage your farm system, track history, and lead your club to a Championship Series.

details.title: NO FURTHER ACTIONS
details.short_description: You have been assigned as an operator, reading protocols that force you to make decisions using buttons and switches. Every decision shapes your fate — and decides whether you’ve done what was expected of you.

details.title: Social Net
details.short_description: Incremental fishing in reverse: a fish catches people with money. Throw your net into the crowd, yank sunbathers out with the rod, hand in the catch, unlock the skill tree and new places - from a sunny beach to an icy bay and an ocean liner.

details.title: Stinker Golf
details.short_description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

details.title: Fox Two Protocol
details.short_description: Hit the afterburners in modern fighter combat. Fly the campaign, duel in PvP, race through Time Attack or take on an endless mission. Build your own mix of upgrades and equipment, then find a reason for one more sortie.

details.title: One More Try
details.short_description: Fight your way through the lands of the magical kingdom in this turn-based, roguelike deck builder game. Fight your enemies by combining powerful poker combinations, enhance their effects, endow them with new properties, find magical relics and choose new classes for your hero.

details.title: Friends for Strawberry
details.short_description: A filthy, horrific nightmare at sea, haunted by people and things cast away. Friends for Strawberry is a story-driven horror FPS where you are trapped on an island of garbage, held captive by the cannibal castaways dwelling there, and... something in the trash, that won't let anyone or anything go.

details.title: Fossilfuel 3
details.short_description: Navigate an open-world Siberian island overrun by dinosaurs. Circle the island high above the ground on a monorail while a relentless Giganotosaurus hunts you below. Lock and load for the explosive third entry in the Fossilfuel series!

details.title: Bad House
details.short_description: Welcome to your new home. The previous tenant left some things. You can have them, but there's just one condition: don’t go into the basement. Explore the many rooms of a mysterious basement in Bad House, an auto-battler dungeon crawler.

details.title: Crawl To The Depths
details.short_description: Crawl to the Depths is a first-person dungeon crawler where you venture into a forgotten underworld. Explore procedurally generated voxel caves, battle dangerous creatures and build increasingly powerful weapons to face what lurks below.

details.title: Power Washing: Bear Cemetery
details.short_description: Take over the care of Bear Hollow’s overgrown cemetery. Wash weathered headstones, mow the grass, and bring a little peace to its residents. Your predecessor left you the tools for the job—but looking after this place means more than keeping it tidy.

details.title: Zap Colony
details.short_description: Zap Colony⚡ is a minimalist defense sim where you build a power grid and match tower energy to enemy colors. How long can you keep the colony safe?

details.title: Midnight Souvenirs
details.short_description: Find unique artifacts and solve charming puzzles in this cozy yet mysterious Hidden Object Game with a Lovecraftian twist! Explore a Victorian mansion, interact with strange visitors, and unravel the house’s dark, eldritch past in this all hand-painted 2D game.

details.title: Billiards Warrior
details.short_description: 《Billiards Warrior》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelite building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

details.title: Overflow Protocol
details.short_description: A number-merging incremental game where you build a lab to push numbers higher and uncover the God Number. Generate and merge matching numbers, upgrade and automate your machines, and discover how far numbers can go.

details.title: Paresis® II
details.short_description: Paresis® II throws you into a twisted supernatural nightmare. As FBI agent David, you must relive your past, solve sinister ritual-like puzzles, fight off grotesque morphs, and conquer brutal bosses. Survive…if you can.

details.title: MAFIA HOTEL
details.short_description: MAFIA HOTEL is a first-person social deduction party game for up to 16 players—a hub for board game nights with friends. Play classic Mafia and other modes full of secrets and bluffing. Question your friends, defend your story, and confidently blame the wrong person.

details.title: Where Did I Park?
details.short_description: You forgot where you parked. Unfortunately, there are 99,999 cars exactly like yours. Search the parking lot, rule out the wrong cars, collect valuables and slowly improve your chances of finding the right one.

details.title: Plague Genesis
details.short_description: A night in the forest becomes a fight for survival. Face brutal creatures, explore disturbing places, and uncover the experiments and secrets hidden behind the GENOCYTE Corporation in this 2D pixel-art survival horror.

details.title: DEATH CASINO
details.short_description: DEATH CASINO is an adrenaline-pumping blend of tabletop strategy and Russian Roulette. Duel the deranged Glassman in an ever-escalating battle of speed and wit, where each round brings in more mayhem and strategy to master. Shoot, stab, and drink your way out of the Death Casino!

details.title: Pivot
details.short_description: Pivot is a football universe sandbox. Build clubs and national teams, create players and managers, negotiate contracts, and simulate 6-a-side matches — then relive every game through stats and commentary.

details.title: High Roller Penny
details.short_description: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?

details.title: Fake Hero
details.short_description: A 3D survivor-like roguelite with up to 4-player co-op! Fight hordes, collect loot, unlock skills, and mix talents to create your own builds. From powerful combos to crazy strategies, every build feels awesome! Team up, mow down enemies, and crush bosses!

name: This is Not a Snake Game

details.title: This is Not a Snake Game
details.short_description: ▶When the classic Snake Game becomes self-aware, eating apples is no longer enough! Help this little snake exploit bugs to escape the game and roam your desktop. Collect adorable outfits and dress up its long, wiggly tail! (⦿ʌ⦿)

details.title: Rejoin
details.short_description: Rejoin is a sorting and restoration game about caring for a museum where Japanese folding screens come to life at night. Swept up in the festivities of the Night Parade, a procession of curious spirits, they leave their panels scattered by morning. Reassemble them and clean up the night’s mischief.

details.title: Khanate: Fire Before Dark
details.short_description: Historical grand strategy on the Central Asian steppe, 1646. Rule one of thirty realms, or start as a lone rider and climb to the throne, while four empires close in and grow stronger every year. Build your state and win your wars while they can still be won.

details.title: One More Nugget
details.short_description: Mine rocks, collect gold nuggets, and grow your workshop in this pixel-art incremental game. Unlock new rooms, put helpers to work, and invest in upgrades and permanent research. Every nugget brings you closer to your next upgrade.

details.title: Pencil Pursuit
details.short_description: Outrun the eraser. A hand-drawn runner across 26 notebook pages: flee five stationery villains, topple the WAR MACHINE they bolt together, then turn the chase around in PENCIL REVENGE and claim the page in REDRAW.

details.title: ARCHETYPE BLUE
details.short_description: Archetype Blue is a JRPG-style role-playing game that blends the fun of building your party and planning strategies with an engaging story. Mix and match companions with unique abilities and personalities to form your own party and enjoy the thrill of strategic battles!

details.title: Geritmia
details.short_description: An incremental game where you mine, fight and grow stronger while the World Eater devours everything behind you faster and faster.

details.title: Bayaya
details.short_description: A story-driven fairytale adventure about Prince Bayaya. Explore village life, help with simple work, and experience the beginning of a larger fairytale journey.

details.title: Faultfinder
details.short_description: She kept the machine that holds the city up for eleven years, and last night it killed her. You have her program and a recording of everything it did. Work back through it until you can point at the line that did it, then prove it. You never write any code, you only read hers.

details.title: ProtoDungeon: Episode III
details.short_description: A bite-sized, 2D top-down exploration adventure in an interconnected world. Fall into a lonely seaside cove, find a magic leaf beneath a shriveled lotus tree, summon sacred fire, and learn to jump, swim, and dash your way toward the chapel. No map or quest markers here; the way through is up to you.

details.title: Dungeon Buster
details.short_description: Build the dungeon. Send in your hero. Extract the loot. Grow stronger. Dungeon Buster is an incremental dungeon-building autobattler RPG built around permanent progression and deeper expeditions.

details.title: Four Busted Buttons
details.short_description: Smash enemies by unlocking and upgrading four unique attack buttons in this short, minimalist incremental game.

details.title: Gravity Express
details.short_description: A cart. Cargo. Gravity. Two idiots. What could go wrong? One cart, two players, total chaos! Drive through dangerous tracks while your friend protects the cargo, fights off bandits, and desperately tries to keep everything from falling apart in this hilarious co-op physics game.

details.title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
details.short_description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

details.title: Divided Empire: SENGOKU
details.short_description: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

details.title: Century of Conquest
details.short_description: Hex-grid auto battles × spell cards × hero progression. Recruit an army and deploy your formation, then watch units move and fight automatically while you cast spells to turn the tide. Level up your hero, collect relics, and conquer a three-layer campaign of sieges and bosses.

details.title: Joint Venture: Prison Commissary Simulator
details.short_description: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, x-rays, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

details.title: Ellsydia
details.short_description: Welcome to Ellsydia! Escape to a small cozy medieval fantasy haven where you can build, customize, and manage your dream village. Make it thrive and ensure the well-being of its villagers so they feel truly happy and fulfilled.

details.title: Factory Life
details.short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

details.title: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
details.short_description: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. explosions. Craft potions and bombs to sabotage a tyrannical regime. Master forbidden alchemy, navigate a vertically-layered city in stealth, and ignite a revolution.

details.title: Paper Shredder
details.short_description: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?

details.title: PSYKOS
details.short_description: A co-op horror where your voice can get you killed, monsters can break into your hiding spots, and captured players must be rescued before it’s too late.

details.title: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
details.short_description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

details.title: Last Man Running
details.short_description: Outrun the zombies. Betray your friends. A chaotic parkour party game across deadly rooftops. Tackle, grab and toss your rivals in free-for-all or team elimination, or stick together in co-op survival. Play locally or online, with solo score chasing when your friends stop answering your invites.

details.title: HALASKÂRGAZİ
details.short_description: Istanbul, 1918. The capital is occupied, and the resistance works in the shadows. Found a secret society, recruit agents, decode telegraph ciphers, and smuggle supplies to Anatolia in a historical espionage strategy game.

details.title: Cellscape
details.short_description: Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can!

details.title: Lurks Beneath
details.short_description: Investigate a little girl's disappearance at a rundown trailer park. Play as Detective Partridge and cross examine three suspects to find the truth with fully freeform interrogation. Type anything and ask anything you want.

details.title: Red Passport: Deported
details.short_description: A sequel to the adventure game Red Passport. After being deported from Japan, the hero faces a long journey home to Moscow. With no money or documents, you must hitchhike, ride freight trains, work odd jobs, and solve local problems to survive the road.

details.title: You Said Last Wave
details.short_description: “Didn't you say this was the last wave?” The guns are still firing as another horde scales the wall. Auto-battling meets tower defense: combine machine guns, shotguns, fire, and chain lightning while your soldiers fight on their own. Can your setup hold until the last wave?

details.title: Arcane Survivors
details.short_description: Write your own spells by joining a verb to a noun. ArcaneSurvivors is a horde-survival roguelite set in a library that is falling apart. Build from 1,008 combinations, gamble your sanity for stronger runes, and survive 20 minutes.

details.title: God Is Not Here
details.short_description: “My God, my God… why have You forsaken me?” — Psalm 22:1. Words spoken by Jesus Christ on the cross before His death.

details.title: Apollyon
details.short_description: 1979. P.L.U.T.O keeps sending your team of researchers back through G.A.T.E into the backrooms for deeper expeditions, but they are never happy with the lengths you go to. Nearest exit gets your team back safe. Only the deepest exit will suffice.

details.title: Trash Panda Bonanza
details.short_description: Adopt a mischievous raccoon that lives right on your desktop. Recycle junk into coins, unlock cosmetics through mystery boxes, pick up randomly appearing junk, and even pet your new raccoon buddy!

details.title: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
