details.short_description: From the eccentric mind of Jeff Minter, onto the greasy lap of a lazy developer on a mission, the classic Commodore 64 game Gridrunner, now rebuilt for the modern era! More features to be announced soon!

name: 歴史年号1000個覚えるまで出られないダンジョン

details.title: 歴史年号1000個覚えるまで出られないダンジョン
details.short_description: An RPG where you climb into the past, aiming for the summit of historical date memorization.

details.title: Meltdown Acres
details.short_description: Buy cheap land inside the Zone, grow vegetables that change whoever eats them, and sell them to customers who should know better. A dark comedy farming game about a hopeful young farmer, a four-eyed goat, and a harvest nobody can explain.

details.title: ScrapToShelf
details.short_description: Run a miniature recycling factory on your desk. Sort, process and dismantle scrap by hand, then pack and sell the recovered materials. Fill orders and upgrade equipment as robotic arms and conveyors gradually take over, turning your little factory into a fully automated operation.

details.title: Reign of Slime
details.short_description: An action roguelike: a slime fights, dies and comes back stronger, climbing toward the throne of the slime king. Shift elements, exploit their reactions, stack abilities and power-ups into your build. Hmm. Interesting, you're still reading. Anyways, I knew you would.

details.title: Night Exposure
details.short_description: Work the night shift in a 1990s photo lab in this first-person psychological horror game. Develop film, print photographs and uncover images that should never have been taken. Each new roll brings June closer to a disturbing mystery—and someone may be watching.

details.title: Micro Reinos
details.short_description: MicroReinos is a first-person action RPG featuring roguelite elements and retro pixel art. Explore a microscopic world, choose your class, develop your skills, and face off against creatures and bosses across ten realms filled with dangers and mysteries.

name: The Gem Alchemist: A Cozy Crystal Workshop

details.title: The Gem Alchemist: A Cozy Crystal Workshop
details.short_description: Run a cozy wizard's gem shop in a world of stained glass! Steer seed crystals across a magical lattice to grow flawless gems, cut them, and sell them to picky customers. Grow stones in your cellar, read tomorrow's omen in the stars, and restore an ancient faceting machine!

details.title: Sift Happens: Idle Beach Treasure
details.short_description: Someone on the boardwalk just tossed a cigarette butt onto the beach, and now it's buried in the sand. Sift it out, watch it fly into a bin and get paid. Hire more throwers, let crabs collect for you and keep this idle beach running until the junk turns into treasure.

details.title: Inkblade
details.short_description: Five warlords signed a pact in cursed ink. One shinobi survived it. Raid procedural castles floor by floor, strike from the shadows or cut through the garrison, and take each lord's head at the summit. Then lead your clan in a war for sixteen provinces.

details.title: 蓬莱
details.short_description: 《蓬莱》是一款修仙题材的最难的就是对模拟经营和门生子弟的养成，本作采用更加Q版的人物，降低了游戏的肝度和氪度，希望能通过简单的游玩就可以让大伙感到欢乐。

details.title: Tourist Infestation
details.short_description: You must protect the temple! Use various skills and upgrades to prevent tourists from damaging the temple in this short incremental tower defense game.

details.title: NEON REVIVE
details.short_description: Trace the dead tubes of old neon signs and bring them back to life, one glowing stroke at a time. As the lights return, a quiet near-future town slowly wakes up again. No timers, no game over - restore it alone or with up to 4 friends online.

details.title: Corruption:Rei
details.short_description: Crystals that grant you the power to rule the world, but are powerful enough to destroy you mentally. Dimetrio embarks on a mission to rescue his mother from slavery while fighting to overthrow the Storm King and put an end to his abuse of power.

details.title: Fallow State
details.short_description: Build and pilot your own mech in Fallow State, a first-person mech sim set on a retro-futurist frontier world torn by civil war. Master a hands-on cockpit, outsmart enemy forces with radar and electronic warfare, and salvage parts to upgrade your machine. Fight solo or in two-player co-op.

details.title: Genesis: Blue vein
details.short_description: Countless possibilities begin with a single click. Genesis: Bluevein is a clicker game where simple clicks lead to diverse gameplay experiences. Discover the many forms a click can take, and witness the dawn of a world.

details.title: Azzog's Idle Asteroid
details.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives on your desktop. Every 25 minutes, Azzog interrupts your focus with a fun choice or important decision. Watch him fish, mine, fight, explore, and relax while you work, study, or unwind.

details.title: The Prison Incident
details.short_description: Reconstruct a fatal prison riot by reverse-engineering deleted terminal logs and determine how each person involved in The Prison Incident meets their end.

details.title: AFKlutch
details.short_description: AFK Clutch is a tactical 5v5 auto-battler shooter: pick a character, weapons, gear and abilities, then watch every round of plants, retakes and clutches unfold. Also Free-for-All, 1v1 duels and an idle training range.

details.title: CozyDuck Idle
details.short_description: A cozy idle farm that lives in a small window on your screen. Duck workers harvest, haul and sell your crops while you work or play. Grow the farm, open the Duck Pond, earn Heirloom Seeds and dress your ducks in hats and bows.

details.title: What Happened to Emily
details.short_description: Help Daniel uncover his lost memories and piece together the three days leading up to the murder of his wife, Emily.

details.title: Off the Eaten Path
details.short_description: Off the Eaten Path is a quiet narrative idle-cooking game: gather ingredients, unlock recipes, fill orders, and keep a handwritten catalogue of everything you taste. The kitchen keeps cooking while you are away.

details.title: unligal
details.short_description: Dive into procedural level madness, obliterate monsters, eat pancakes (with various fillings, by the way), and try not to die of insanity. Storm the leaderboards and set the ultimate high score. But most importantly - don't be late for the free pizza!

details.title: Desktop Theme Park
details.short_description: Desktop Theme Park is a cozy idle theme park builder that lives at the bottom of your screen. Place rides, connect paths, hire staff, and decorate your park. Keep it running to earn coins while you work or browse, then spend them on new attractions.

details.title: Dispatch Dash
details.short_description: Pick up, process and sort parcels in a fun, increasingly chaotic warehouse sorting game. Juggle processing stations, keep the conveyor queue under control and avoid mistakes as each stage brings new challenges. Can you keep up with the chaos?

details.title: Haitland World
details.short_description: Haitland World is a single-player idle RPG that simulates an MMO world. Rule-driven NPCs fight, trade, join guilds and become rivals. Enjoy gear progression, auto-battle and offline rewards. Core gameplay runs locally. Simulated top-ups involve no real money.

details.title: Mise en War
details.short_description: Mise en War is a party game of endless kitchen chaos. Complete your recipe before other chefs steal your food. Or simply steal their food instead of cooking.

details.title: Aer Isles
details.short_description: Rise, knight. Reclaim the skies you were once promised. alone or with up to four friends. Cross ever-changing floating isles, survive chaotic encounters, gather Power, and strengthen your Bonk. Conquer the Aer Isles, or knock each other back trying.

details.title: Hollow Flesh
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a decaying 1950s psychiatric hospital. You came for your daughter. The building came for you. Explore its wards, solve its locks, relive the past it won't let you forget. Run and hide when it remembers too much.

details.title: Kings Cross
details.short_description: Rock, paper, scissors, with armies. Command your units, spend your action points, and outthink up to 3 other players in this turn-based digital board game. If you know RPS, you already know how to fight. The hard part is winning.

details.title: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
details.short_description: Create crazy crash scenarios, wreck cars, and capture the chaos! Share your best videos on your channel, gain new followers, and increase your earnings. Buy new vehicles and equipment, create bigger crashes, and take your CarCrash.Tube channel to the top!

details.title: Goblins vs Poop
details.short_description: A short Tower Defense game about a bunch of underdog, upgradeable Gobbos who gotta destroy countless waves of magical turds in the sewers under a Mage City. It's got silly toilet humor and cute retro goblin vibes!

details.title: Emberline
details.short_description: Emberline is a real-time roguelike deckbuilder where your train never stops. Generate and spend Ember to play cards, reinforce your train and fight creatures attacking across a 3×3 battlefield as you chart a path through the hostile continent of Pacifica.

details.title: Goblins for Good
details.short_description: A Warcraft-inspired incremental game — grow a goblin army while raising money for charity! Upgrade your goblins, merge them into massive units, and unleash comedic, wholesome chaos! 90% of profits are donated to causes like The Alzheimer's Foundation of America and Parkkinson’s Foundation.

details.title: XLV Backrooms: Never Found
details.short_description: Explore unsettling Backrooms environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Evade dangerous entities, manage your sanity and limited resources, and navigate mysterious portals as you search for a way out.

details.title: Starcrumb
details.short_description: A star fell into the forest. Tap it, and tiny mushroom folk carry its crumbs to the Lantern. Kindle the star, magnitude by magnitude, until it is whole again. A cozy incremental game where you can see every part work, with a real ending.

details.title: Space Goatboy
details.short_description: A sci-fi bullet hell goat sim. Ram your enemies to pieces, or pepper them with lasers as you save the galaxy from the evils of unionisation. Conquer the galaxy horns first or do the unthinkable: rebel against your creator to pursue liberty and justice for all. In space.

details.title: Count on Chaos
details.short_description: Your computer is infected. Help Buddy, a tiny calculator, fight through the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

details.title: Steam & Glory
details.short_description: Steam & Glory is a hybrid arcade/simulation train game where you take control of a 20-ton steam train as you steam, brake, ring your bell and blow your whistle to power through to the goal! Take in the scenic old west views as you race to get to the station on time!

details.title: Ascend
details.short_description: A fast-paced first person puzzle platformer about a ghost making its way to Heaven.

details.title: 16 Bit Gold
details.short_description: Build a cozy gold mining business from the ground up. Find as much gold as you can and transform an overgrown plot of land into a thriving mining operation - one gold bar at a time.

details.title: Cozy Banker
details.short_description: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

details.title: The Battle Of Olympus
details.short_description: The 1988 classic action-RPG returns! The original creators are rebuilding the code and redrawing the pixel art for a handcrafted Steam remake of a mythic journey across ancient Greece. Support development in Early Access.

details.title: You'll never find it!
details.short_description: A cozy hiding game for two set on a sunny Mediterranean island! Hide everyday objects, then watch your friend search for them and laugh as they walk right past.

details.title: Tandem Together
details.short_description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

details.title: Irish Sport Manager
details.short_description: You’re the bainisteoir. The county is yours, and so is the blame. A management sim for Gaelic football, hurling, camogie and ladies’ football: pick your fifteen from the county’s own parishes and answer to a board whose patience runs out.

details.title: Everybody MAHJONG!
details.short_description: Learn, customize, and play 8 traditional Mahjong rulesets, including Japanese Riichi to Hong Kong and Taiwanese. Features interactive tutorials for beginners, house-rule customization, and solo play or online multiplayer. This is Everybody MAHJONG!

name: Secrets of Salem: Tarot Murders Collector's Edition

details.title: Secrets of Salem: Tarot Murders Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Fortune cards hide deadly secrets. A drowned man, a cursed carnival, and vanishing townsfolk pull two detectives into a Tarot-ruled mystery. Follow occult clues through the fog-covered harbor of Salem in this chilling Hidden Object adventure.

details.title: Clean Tides
details.short_description: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

details.title: Gamble Hunters
details.short_description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

details.title: Dungeon Flow: Vertical Idle
details.short_description: Dungeon Flow is a vertical idle dungeon crawler where Blackstep fights automatically while you shape the build. Explore the Forgotten Crypts, collect and equip loot, face escalating encounters, elites and bosses, and push deeper with every run.

details.title: TunaSweeper
details.short_description: A top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions. Explore for supplies, fight enemies, and decide what to take and when to return.

details.title: Midnight Flare
details.short_description: Midnight Flare is a multi episode point-and-click puzzle adventure. In this first episode you explore a house in a town drowned in an eerie red glow, rummaging through objects, unlocking mechanisms, and dealing with strange characters. Can you solve the mystery of this strange house?

details.title: School Girl RPG
details.short_description: Mio was just an ordinary schoolgirl until an accident on her commute transported her to another world. There, she is hailed as the chosen Hero! To find a way back home, she must fulfill her heroic destiny. She must defeat the Demon Emperor and her wicked subordinates who plot to conquer the realm!

details.title: Guildlands
details.short_description: Forge, fight and trade, together. A multiplayer idle RPG that lives on your taskbar: your hero fights, mines and fishes while you work, and every piece of gear you forge shows on them. Free to play, in a shared world where players set every price.

details.title: ILLICIT
details.short_description: Inherit your late uncle's chemistry lab and an €80,000 debt. Mix, heat, filter and crystallize every order by hand, alone or with up to 3 friends. Make legal soap by day and something else in the basement, before the inspectors knock.

details.title: Semi-Realistic Dating Game
details.short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a truck? Have you ever wanted to date a truck? Now you can do both! Go on convoys, take them on dates, maybe bring them to your garage in this visual novel style dating game.

name: Love in the Time of Regime Change

details.title: Lawful Evil
details.short_description: An online 2-6 player courtroom party game where you and your friends become chaotic lawyers, arguing before an AI cast that runs locally on your PC. Talk to clients, build your case, then take on your friends in court. Will you be the lawyer everyone calls, or the one they regret calling?

details.title: Dangerous Delivery
details.short_description: As summer vacation is almost over, schoolgirl Rina still has one final assignment left: part-time job experience. Not knowing where to look, she spots a delivery job ad that says “No age limit, flexible hours!” So Rina decides to start her delivery work…!

details.title: Diecast Car Restoration
details.short_description: Disassemble, clean, and restore forgotten diecast cars! Strip off old paint and rust, apply custom colors and decals, and upgrade parts to create one-of-a-kind builds. Build your dream home collection wall and showcase your models in detailed scale dioramas.

details.title: Haze There
details.short_description: Wanted in England. Broke in Italy. Sell haze the only way you can: across rooftops, balcony to balcony, drop to drop. Start on tens, buy a better flat, and become the top shotter in town.

details.title: Pigs and Wolf
details.short_description: Build. Survive. Drag your home. Lost piggies. A rolling home. Hungry wolves. Play solo or team up with friends to gather resources and survive the night in this chaotic fairy-tale survival adventure.

details.title: Covert Koalas: Phasco
details.short_description: A comfy game where you're searching for hidden koalas on unique hand-drawn levels with adjustable difficulty. Help a group of koalas escape their captivity and follow their story on a search for a new home. Because the world is big enough for all!

details.title: Kloa - Child of the Forest
details.short_description: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

details.title: Yuzan's Drive: First Gear
details.short_description: A comic-book style racing game where you start in neighborhood street races and work your way up to the legends. Race on circuits, rally stages and city streets, spend your prize money on parts in the garage, and beat rivals whose names might sound a little familiar.

details.title: Leaky Business
details.short_description: A small deckbuilder about the daily struggle of running a business. Choose your die, craft your deck, manage resources, and fix leaks before things fall apart. The odds aren't in your favor, but with a little planning and a bit of luck, you might just make it.

name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive

details.title: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
details.short_description: TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

details.title: Evocation
details.short_description: Evocation is a card game with unique gameplay, high interactivity, and deep mechanics. It includes a roguelike PvE mode and an online PvP mode without in-app purchases. Draw and maintain your magical circle, freely trade and craft equipment, and purge the heretics along the pilgrimage path.

details.title: Immortal Rebirth
details.short_description: Hunt for treasure and face formidable foes in an ink-wash fantasy world. Fit your gear into a limited inventory to create powerful combinations, and forge your own playstyle with a wealth of affixes and an expansive talent tree.

details.title: Pro Football Dynasty
details.short_description: The ultimate American football management sim. Call plays, sign free agents, scout prospects, draft superstars, and dive into deep stats for every player and team. Take control as a coach or GM, chase championships, and build a storied dynasty.

details.title: Dark Earth
details.short_description: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.

details.title: Medieval Ascendant
details.short_description: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.

details.title: PredaDeck
details.short_description: PredaDeck is a trading card game that transforms the brutal yet exquisite real-world food chain into a competitive strategic duel. Here, knowledge is your sharpest claw, and strategy is your only law of survival.

details.title: Bullet Beast
details.short_description: A 3D movement based bullet hell where you swing, dash and use beast powers to survive swarms of enemies.

details.title: Broke Street
details.short_description: A 1-6 player co-op roguelike trading sim where you and your friends start broke at a Wall Street hedge fund. Share one balance, make risky trades, use items to find winning strategies, and hit rising quotas to survive each day. Fail, and pay the price.

details.title: Croak Tales: Deep Dungeons
details.short_description: Explore, scavenge and survive ... or croak trying. Dive into murky, abandoned dungeons with your friends to recover an ancient object and reveal the history around this world. It's high-stakes extraction where teamwork is vital, survival is unlikely, and the chaos is half the fun.

details.title: RippleLoop
details.short_description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

details.title: Shardbreakers
details.short_description: Start with a spell. Build a storm. Combine magical shards into a spell engine that turns one hit into a barrage, then unleash it on hordes and bosses. An action roguelite where you don't find combos - you design them.

details.title: BACKROOMS
details.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

details.title: Brain Hack Squad
details.short_description: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

details.title: Duoshift
details.short_description: Defend The Wall on the tactical grid using your pair of Battle Vehicles called Duoshifters. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

details.title: Wiltcards
details.short_description: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

details.title: Paradice Run Club
details.short_description: Roll dice, gather resources, and hit the target! Paradice Run Club is a precision strategy roguelike where players get as close as possible to a target number. Compete with other runners or against your own records to follow those targets as they climb from 17, to 21, to 100!

details.title: memory cafe
details.short_description: A cosy woodland café where you understand every customer. Brew, garden and decorate — but the real work is noticing what each animal isn't saying. Serve thirty regulars, earn their trust, and fill a storybook with the stories they've never told anyone.

details.title: Liminal:Childhood Memories
details.short_description: Exhausted by the gray reality of adulthood, a 21 year old awakens in his forgotten past. Childhood Memories is a puzzle-free, melancholic exploration experience driven by the nostalgic atmosphere of 'Liminal Space' and 'Kenopsia'. No monsters, only memories.

details.title: Cozy Island Cleaner
details.short_description: Cozy Island Cleaner is a relaxing game where you clean up a trash-covered island with the help of the cat who lives there. Collect the trash on the beach, upgrade your gear, and restore the island to its former beauty step by step.

details.title: Sort Inc.
details.short_description: Help Nina sort customers' items into boxes! A cozy and tactile sorting game where you play as Nina, the neighborhood’s dedicated sorter. Meet charming customers, play item-themed minigames, organize their messy piles into the correct boxes, get paid, and build a beloved sorting business.

details.title: Dukun
details.short_description: a relentless, psychedelic bullet-hell FPS where you harness black magic and carve a blood-soaked path through seven powerful shamans to ascend as the ultimate witch.

details.title: YokesDoomedWish
details.short_description: A narrative-driven 2D side-scrolling Metroidvania RPG. Unlock new items and abilities to explore the map and unravel the story.

details.title: CARNAGE
details.short_description: Fast isometric crash-for-cash arcade action. Floor it, smash traffic, steer your burning wreck into the city's most expensive real estate, and rack up a multi-million dollar repair bill. Drive, crash, upgrade, repeat.

details.title: BONEBUILDER
details.short_description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

details.title: Separator
details.short_description: «Separator» is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

details.title: Fallen Nights
details.short_description: Build your defenses. Fight the horde. Repair your way out. A top-down zombie survival defense game where every piece of scrap buys firepower or escape. Combine turrets, mines, and weapon upgrades, then fight beside your camp across varied locations and escalating night attacks.

details.title: Gendo The Gatherer
details.short_description: A cozy life sim where you forage, cook and serve your way through Gendo's journey navigating an abundant, ever changing landscape. After long days of gathering goodies, return to your cozy home to prepare, cook and serve your dishes to the local townsfolk. Join Gendo in his life in the countryside.

details.title: Total Victory: World Conflict 1939-1945
details.short_description: The ultimate turn-based World War 2 grand strategy game wargamers have been yearning for decades. The best ideas born from players and from wargames so huge they overtook your dining room table, and your wife’s patience. From the developer of the WarPlan series.

details.title: Desk Hive
details.short_description: Tend a living beehive right on your desk. Harvest honey through the seasons, expand your apiary, build a processing line, and automate the work while you're away. A cozy idle beekeeping sim that runs beside you.

details.title: Deck & Defense
details.short_description: Tower Defense, deckbuilder and roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

details.title: Sellsword
details.short_description: Become a Sellsword in a magical kingdom. Take contracts from rival factions, battle for gold and reclaim territory in the name of mighty overlords. Forge your path through a living sandbox where no two journeys unfold alike, and every deed is etched into a growing book of legends.

details.title: Jumpshot
details.short_description: A RPG where every battle is a basketball showdown. Explore a strange Japanese town, meet oddball rivals, time your shots and blocks, and build your HYPE. The moon has declared itself MVP. Grab your dad's old basketball and challenge it.

details.title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
details.short_description: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

details.title: Spurfall
details.short_description: Restore life to a forgotten Wild West valley. Rebuild ruined settlements, bridges, watchtowers, farms, and cabins. bring back settlers, defend against bandits, and transform abandoned lands into thriving frontier towns.

details.title: Rookie Raiders
details.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

details.title: Sunny Orchard
details.short_description: Run your own sunny fruit orchard! 🍇 Grow, harvest, and package fresh produce, complete orders for friendly customers, and upgrade your farm with new crops, tools, and decorations. Collect all cute premium fruit stickers to show your customers the quality and care of your fancy produce.

details.title: Baseline Basketball Manager 27
details.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball organization in Baseline Basketball Manager. Build your roster, scout prospects, make trades, manage contracts, set tactics and shape your team’s future in a deep, long-term management simulation.

details.title: Valdrin
details.short_description: A low-fantasy kingdom sim where you never command a single subject. Shape laws, set priorities, and watch an autonomous society build, trade, worship, and fight under your rule.

details.title: C3 Nightfall
details.short_description: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

details.title: Clonefall
details.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where your clones are part of the solution. Create clones to reach new places, block hazards, activate mechanisms, and manipulate physics to overcome each challenge.

details.title: Sheep Tag 2
details.short_description: Your friends are sheep. You are the wolf. Hunt them down as they build ridiculous farm fortresses to keep you out. Sheep Tag 2 is a Free-To-Play chaotic team-based RTS that's easy to learn and brutal to master. Play solo with bots or battle multiplayer with up to 32 players. Build. Hunt. Survive.

details.title: Strashnovekovie
details.short_description: 2D action RPG. The game’s unique feature is that instead of the usual character leveling, at each level you’ll be joined by an ally with their own unique abilities. By using your allies’ abilities — you’ll be able to complete the game .

details.title: Tell me Your Tale
details.short_description: Take on the role of an F.T.I.D. inspector and uncover who truly belongs in the tales. Question characters, examine documents and appearances, find contradictions, and compare every detail with official records. At the end of each inspection, decide who is Original, Impostor, or Aberration.

details.title: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Play as Humanoid CATS in this chaotic 4 player co-op simulator as you takeover the coastal city of Los Nyangeles in pursuit of becoming true CATpitalists while helping rebuild the city along the way (kinda).

details.title: PixelWehr
details.short_description: Shoot down incoming missiles before they tear apart your pixel city, where every pixel can be destroyed. Draw your own buildings and missiles, arrange them into story acts with your own dialogue, and publish it all to the Workshop.

details.title: Northanda Chronicles
details.short_description: Master role-based deckbuilding in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build your party around the RPG holy trinity, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

details.title: Tales of Tuscany
details.short_description: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

details.title: Foush
details.short_description: Foush is a minimalist puzzle game where you try to raise the water in every cup up to its line by dropping block-shaped animals into it, while keeping each of them happy. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new animals added approximately every 8 levels.

details.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
details.short_description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

details.title: Interzone
details.short_description: Branded a deserter, you are thrown into the Interzone, where survival is the only law. Technology dies here, orders fall from the sky in artillery-fired capsules, the last voice from outside. Face anomalies, radiation, contamination, the infected, rebels, and ruthless military forces.

details.title: GAZAR
details.short_description: GAZAR is an intense vertical arcade space shooter: one prototype fighter, the Nova-X, against an unstoppable alien fleet. Battle through a 4-galaxy Story Mode or test your skills in the endless Infinity Mode with 5 difficulty levels and local and global leaderboards.

details.title: Sinking Eternity
details.short_description: Sinking Eternity is a single-player underwater exploration RPG. Survive extreme depths, hide from dangerous sea creatures, and uncover the secrets of a civilization lost for millennia.

details.title: DropCell
details.short_description: DropCell is a cascade puzzle where gravity keeps pulling. Clear a line and everything above falls into the gaps, forming new lines that clear and chain into long combos. 10 realms, each with its own look and sound.

details.title: Mini Sweeper
details.short_description: Mini Sweeper is a lightweight single and two player game for the Steam Deck and Steam Machine where you must find the bombs and clear the board.

details.title: Martyr
details.short_description: Rise as a Martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, pagan rites, and relentless foes, you will fall and rise again and again. Death is not the end. Relics await based on your holy or heretical choices, and rival factions will hunt you according to your actions.

details.title: Corrupted Dice
details.short_description: Roll your dice and choose where to play them to reach each round’s score target. In this roguelite, you can take on heat for extra points, but too much heat ends your run. Dice break when they run out of uses.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

details.title: Space Daram
details.short_description: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.

details.title: Mega Squad Survivors
details.short_description: Become Hua Tuo and lead 50 great officers of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as women, across 25 stages. Unlock new officers and art, master 200+ skills, and combine 35 Tales of Three Kingdoms lore with 5 formations to forge a peerless legion. The physician takes the field to heal a land at war!

details.title: 11 PM: A Minimalist Factory Game
details.short_description: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

details.title: Tidy Town
details.short_description: Tidy Town is a third person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

details.title: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator
details.short_description: Crack, mine, and sell mystical crystals while fighting alien hordes on various planets in this fast-paced incremental mining extraction roguelite hybrid experience. Earn currency to spend across upgrade categories with permanent progression and powerful builds in runs.

details.title: KILLSEC
details.short_description: Breach containment and carve your way out of a megacorp black site in this hardcore top-down shooter roguelite. Master your control of physics weapons to parry swords, bullets, lasers, everything. Time moves faster when you move, but staying still won't get you anywhere.

details.title: Flock Off!
details.short_description: Flock Off! is a first-person action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off mutant sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

details.title: Goat's Odyssey
details.short_description: Just a goat. A boring peg. And a postcard that changed everything. Embark on a surreal journey in a shadow theatre style: from a village garden to lunar craters. Solve absurd puzzles, troll a rooster, and find out if the grass is truly greener on the other side of the universe.

details.title: Final Rites
details.short_description: After exorcists sent to a remote Spanish village go silent, the FINAL RITES unit is deployed. Investigate sites corrupted by failed rituals, explore hostile environments, fight the undead, and perform sacred rites to contain entities emerging from a breach beyond reality.

details.title: Idle Archery
details.short_description: Shoot targets, earn gold, hire more archers. An idle incremental game about turning one lone archer into a sky full of arrows.

details.title: Shatterswarm
details.short_description: Command Captain Hope's ship in this strategic 2D space game. Build structures, deploy fleets, and manage resources to defend the Citadel against waves of enemies. Combine direct ship combat, tower defense, and base building as you face epic boss battles.

details.title: Grid Demon
details.short_description: Hack the swarm and build your army in this cyberpunk bullet-heaven roguelite. Turn enemy machines into allies, shape your build, and unleash a surge of power as you battle the Wardens across five hostile grids. Free the Grid, or claim it for yourself.

details.title: Drunk Dork On Pitchfork
details.short_description: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork is a unique rage arcade game. Play as an Imp dragging a hefty Dork through hellish traps & mazes to throw the ultimate party! Control both characters with special fork mechanic – keep yourself and your living cargo alive while he slipping away into lava!

details.title: Mow and Move
details.short_description: Take control of M-42 in a relaxed incremental mowing game. Cut through fields of engineered grass, turn each harvest into upgrades, and reach farther with a stronger mower. Recover useful equipment along the way and work at your own pace.

details.title: How to Hunt
details.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based hunting simulator. You and your friends crash your boat while on vacation. You must survive till you find a way back home.

details.title: Ovis Mollis
details.short_description: A cozy pixel farm on your desktop — a whole village with fishing, a casino, and a stock exchange. Grass grows, sheep accumulate wool even while AFK. Shear, sell, pay your mortgage, collect skins from Mystery Box on Steam — and one day robots will do everything themselves.

details.title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
details.short_description: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

name: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend

details.title: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend
details.short_description: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend Series is a narrtive video game for PC, Mac and Linux. It last about an hour and a half and it is not a traditional video game. We break the fourth wall to bring you this extraordinary story to life.

name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction

details.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
details.short_description: Grab your sword. Eternia needs you. You have the power!

details.title: Griefborn
details.short_description: Destroy hordes of unholy creatures using firearms and magical abilities. Create your own build, upgrade your weapons, and unlock new levels!

details.title: METRO 2039
details.short_description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

details.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
details.short_description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

details.title: Hamsteria
details.short_description: Hamsteria is a difficult 2-player co-op game where you play as two hamsters in attached wheels. Online co-op, local co-op, and single-player are all supported!

details.title: THE SIGNAL: Stranded on Sirenis
details.short_description: Crash-landed on the alien world of Sirenis, you must survive, build a base and search for your missing brother. Gather, research and craft your way across a hostile planet of strange creatures, ancient ruins and a mystery far bigger than your crash.

details.title: Ashen Throne
details.short_description: A free-to-play, top-down action MMORPG. Play as a Warrior, Wizard or Taoist, explore dungeons and hunt bosses with friends. Find and craft equipment, develop your skills, and join your guild in battles for territory and Ashen Castle.

details.title: Don't Drain The Lake
details.short_description: Grandpa left you his cabin and one rule: whatever happens, don't drain the lake. A cozy first-person incremental: empty a mountain reservoir by bucket, pump and siphon, fish for the mill's cook, and watch the sun follow the water down while the valley gives back what it kept.

details.title: Ceasefire Line
details.short_description: An isometric RTS in a fictional war-torn coastal city. Command one of three asymmetric forces, build a base, and take the city block by block. Buildings collapse piece by piece with real physics, and every civilian caught between the lines is counted against you.

details.title: Farming Sweeper
details.short_description: Build, manage and grow your farm in a unique way: Solving puzzles with traditional minesweeper mechanics and managing your business finances in a relaxing game with great replay factor.

name: It Was Supposed to Be a Vacation!

details.title: It Was Supposed to Be a Vacation!
details.short_description: 说好只来旅游，怎么连每一顿饭、每一段闲聊都想留下？这是一款以成都旅行为主题的单机互动影像游戏。跟随镜头走进街头巷尾，在剧情节点选择出行方式、品尝当地美食、回应陌生人的热情，让日常小事成为旅途中的意外惊喜。你的选择会留下不同的旅行印记，影响日终手记与睡前故事的解锁。通过分支图回看另一种可能，在旅行记录中收藏照片与经历；也可以使用自动保存和已看内容快速回看，按自己的节奏体验这段旅程。写下属于你的成都记忆。

details.title: Sagas of Lumin
details.short_description: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Find your path in this fallen realm.

name: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple

details.title: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple
details.short_description: Follow Amara into a cursed sun temple in this story-driven marble shooter. Pop the color chains before they reach the temple heart, and clear each level to unlock the next story beat.

details.title: Fancy Farm Brawl
details.short_description: Farm by day, fight by night! Fancy Farm Brawl blends top-down action combat, tower-defense challenges, light farming, and a quirky island adventure. Plant crops, earn coins, meet colorful residents, overcome obstacle courses, and unleash powerful attacks to defend your home on Qilin Island.

details.title: The Split Layer
details.short_description: Step into The Split Layer, psychological horror game set within a liminal world where familiar places no longer reveal the whole truth. Your only reliable tool is a tablet that uncovers another layer of reality.

details.title: Rainfusor
details.short_description: COMBINE ELEMENTS into bizarre playstyles. Rip and devour segmented bugs in rooms in a side-scroller mayhem-physics rogue-arcade. No tiny stat boosts/platforming/permadeath. Instead, unlock extreme, double-edged characters, runes, spell combos and synergies to become whole again, through sacrifice

details.title: Soup's Tail
details.short_description: Find out what it means to be dead. Explore the mystery of the afterlife, meet new characters, pet the cat, find cards, and earn collectables in this single player, narrative-driven game. As the story unfolds, play cards with those you meet along the way.

details.title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
details.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in looping liminal poolrooms. Study your surroundings and identify changes ranging from subtle details to terrifying entities. Turn back if something has changed, continue if everything seems normal, and then use your camera to document the anomalies.

details.title: Aevalore 2
details.short_description: Fight through the world of Aevalore II, a fast action roguelike. Pick your hero, build your skills, defeat giant bosses, and survive alone or with friends in online co-op

details.title: Sign My Petition
details.short_description: Sign My Petition is a beat-’em-up adventure about a mouse trying to save their tribe from extermination. Explore bizarre neighboring apartments, fight off strange enemies and bosses, and meet oddball characters along the way.

details.title: Outward 2
details.short_description: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.

details.title: マジカルラプチャー
details.short_description: A 2D fighting game featuring magical girls with comical moves! Unleash magic on your opponents using simple controls—no complex command inputs required. Manage your magic gauge as you battle, employing unique tactics to outplay your rivals!

details.title: Foul
details.short_description: Foul is an adventure survival game where an otherworldly fog mutated and turned all creatures hostile. Fight back, save your family and piece together the truth.

details.title: Lexiclue
details.short_description: Video game trivia crosswords. Items, NPCs, locations, mechanics, designers, and terms pulled out of hundreds of worlds; the vocabulary that comes with playing and lore. Built for gamers who notice the minutiae in their games.

details.title: Pocket Adventurer
details.short_description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

details.title: An Unreasonable Number of Zombies
details.short_description: Push your luck in a city overrun by zombies. Every district is a different fight, with its own rules and its own way to lose. The longer a run goes, the more you can earn.... and the worse things get.

details.title: Machikado Roastery
details.short_description: Roast coffee across Japan, right from your taskbar. Run a tiny corner roastery along the bottom of your screen: roast beans, stock the display case, hire staff, and move your shop from Tokyo’s backstreets to snowy Sapporo as the seasons turn.

details.title: increTower
details.short_description: A short incremental tower defense game. Upgrade your tower, upgrade your enemies, repeat!

details.title: Nijoaju
details.short_description: Two characters. One goal. Think as one. In Nijoaju, control a powerful stone creature and an agile water creature, combining their unique abilities to solve challenging puzzles, overcome obstacles, and prove that only by working together can you move forward.

details.title: Children of the Forest
details.short_description: Iki and Tika live deep within a mysterious forest. Follow their enchanting journey as they find themselves amidst an imminent new threat. Children of the Forest is a story-driven adventure game about two siblings venturing through a land filled with extraordinary remnants from an ancient past.

details.title: Just ONE more window
details.short_description: A cozy first-person incremental game about cleaning the windows of a skyscraper that just keeps going. Scrub the glass, earn a dollar, buy better gear and little robot helpers, and climb: past the pigeons, past the clouds, past where the air runs out. Solo or co-op with a friend.

details.title: Dunar: Dimension Two
details.short_description: A traditional turn-based JRPG featuring unique moments and a fascinating story centered around the forgotten past of the Purple Light, blending fantasy with inspirations from Himba culture and Indian aesthetics.

details.title: The Coven
details.short_description: Choose from five elemental witches in a single-player action roguelite. Explore a candlelit, 16-floor tower, shape your build with talents, gear and rune sets, and face familiar people turned into bosses. Time rewinds when you fall, but some growth and treasures endure.

details.title: Animals League Unite
details.short_description: Stack up, slap around and fall together. Up to 8 friends climb on each other to reach the key, in planes, minecarts and outer space. Your friends are the ladder, the bridge and the reason you fell. Play online, on one couch or both, then build levels to trap them again.

details.title: Encryptid
details.short_description: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

name: Japan Stigmatized Property4 -日本事故物件監視協会-

details.title: Japan Stigmatized Property4 -日本事故物件監視協会-
details.short_description: A night-shift notice from the Japan Stigmatized Property Association. Review surveillance footage from real properties in Japan, including the famous haunted attraction "Senritsu Meikyu" and the abandoned Niigata Russian Village, and report every anomaly. Two staff members may monitor together.
developers: 日本事故物件監視協会
publishers: 日本事故物件監視協会

name: 豆カスちゃん ～豆知識とカスみたいな嘘をランダムに語る少女～

details.title: 豆カスちゃん ～豆知識とカスみたいな嘘をランダムに語る少女～
details.short_description: 意外な豆知識とカスみたいな嘘を見分けながら、謎の少女「豆カスちゃん」の秘密に近づいていくADV。

details.title: Knightstones
details.short_description: Build your medieval Order in this atmospheric autobattler. Deploy your elite warriors on the war table, face off against the mighty Lords of the Inquisition, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be prepared… or perish in the final battle.

details.title: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest
details.short_description: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest is an exploration adventure game. Reveal the house of Detectif Poirry as a robot vacuum cleaner, bump its inhabitants for stories, and clean your way to victory.

details.title: Astonishia Story
details.short_description: Relive this retro-styled RPG classic with refined visuals and other enhancements! The time has come to recover a stolen relic and your honor.

details.title: Let's Build a Dungeon
details.short_description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

details.title: Spyder: Agent 8
details.short_description: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

details.title: Fleshinsane
details.short_description: Fleshinsane is a narrative-driven, top-down biopunk roguelike shooter set inside a living, decaying spaceship. Kill, die, upgrade, repeat. Will you survive long enough to escape the flesh?

details.title: Bouncy Balloonist
details.short_description: Bouncy Balloonist is a cute and colorful 2D Arena Platformer. You fly, pop balloons, and guard your own! In this endless arcade adventure, how high will you score?

details.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
details.short_description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

details.title: GermShake
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike where you play a germ spreading through Shake City one handshake at a time. Mutate, dodge the immune system, and survive the sink.

details.title: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER
details.short_description: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER finally lands on Steam with intense battles, unique characters, and indie soul. Get ready for electrifying 3D fights in a universe full of style, personality, and urban legend inspiration.

details.title: System Status: SuperCritical
details.short_description: Defend your base by placing towers strategically, forming interconnected systems that depend on one another. Adapt your strategy to different environments and enemy waves, exploiting their weaknesses. In System Status: SuperCritical, resources are scarce and critical failure is always an option.

name: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition

details.title: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition
details.short_description: The definitive version of the beloved post-apocalyptic road trip. Fully remastered visuals, redesigned soundtrack, complete gamepad support. Tyler's journey begins again.

details.title: Shroud of Gloom
details.short_description: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

details.title: Lucky Rabbit
details.short_description: GAMBLE to pay off your debts! Buy power ups (drugs) to increase profit and see how large your bankroll can get! Play Slots, Casino Classics, and more! Remember: Fortune favors the bold, go all in!

details.title: Inherited Shadows
details.short_description: Amanda, a young woman haunted by her mother's absence, travels to the remote mining town of Cinder Hollow in search of answers, unaware that a sinister legacy awaits her. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mysteries surrounding her past.

details.title: Hunting Contract
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1–4 players about hunting monsters to meet a company's quota. Kill the beast, seal it in a coffin and drag it back to the truck—while your friends scream in proximity voice chat.

details.title: Grimmloch
details.short_description: A persistent text-based MMORPG where NPCs remember your secrets and shape a living world rooted in European folklore. Turn-based tactical combat, criminal gameplay, and collaborative storytelling that writes itself into canon. Built by Role-players for Role-players.

details.title: Voices from the Vase
details.short_description: Voices from the Vase is a story-driven psychological horror game about a young couple forced to take odd jobs to make ends meet. But some jobs come with a price far greater than money.

details.title: Space Combat Simulator
details.short_description: Fly as a fighter pilot of the Coalition carrier Defiance, pick your ship and weapons in the hangar and take apart enemy capital ships piece by piece. Two story campaigns with 30 missions, free battles, split-screen and LAN duels.

details.title: The Passion
details.short_description: Long for a sleep you never wake from.

details.title: IRONWAKE
details.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror. Your mind is uploaded into a dormant Soviet industrial robot inside a sealed subterranean bunker. Navigate total darkness using stealth, solve environmental puzzles, and trust the voice on the radio. Uncover the clues and change how it ends.

details.title: TROUBLE SHOOTERS
details.short_description: Four WARDEN contractors against an alien incursion. A 2D roguelite run-and-gun: procedurally assembled zones, stacking gear that gets out of hand, and five bosses that fill the screen. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

details.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
details.short_description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

details.title: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
details.short_description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

details.title: Orc Warchief: Strategy Story
details.short_description: Carve a war camp out of an ancient forest. Grab, drop and rally an unruly Horde with the Hand of the Warchief. Rescue goblins, claim forgotten sites and storm human castles. Every conquest brings new power and a Kingdom eager for revenge.

details.title: If you die, you die!
details.short_description: A one-life horror game inside the corpse of God. Photograph what lives in the dark. Die, and you can never play again.

details.title: Dark Roll 2
details.short_description: A physics-driven 3D precision platformer where you roll, bounce, dodge traps, snatch gems, and race against other players’ ghosts through a dark-fantasy gauntlet designed to make “one more try” a deeply questionable life choice.

details.title: Simple Football League Manager
details.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

details.title: OutRune
details.short_description: A fast-paced, psychedelic room-clearing action game blending mystery and memory. Battle relentless enemies, discover and upgrade powerful items, and help Orillia survive long enough to uncover her past… and ESCAPE!

details.title: Gohan Quest
details.short_description: Gohan Quest is a humorous adventure RPG that takes place in modern Eastern Europe. Play as anime girls, explore the typical russian town, beat the shit out of gopniks and find the missing "children"! Inspired by golden age JRPGs, from fans to fans.

details.title: Rebirth of Arcadia
details.short_description: Rebirth of Arcadia is a story-rich turn-based tactics JRPG. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, and harness the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

name: Climb using controls not designed for humans.

details.title: Climb using controls not designed for humans.
details.short_description: This is an action-climbing game with controls not designed for human beings. Can you handle them?

details.title: Count The Draw
details.short_description: Count The Draw is a time-loop western mystery where every decision, conversation, and discovery could change your chances of surviving the final duel. You have twelve hours. Explore the town, learn its secrets, and prepare for the man waiting for you at sunset.

details.title: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters
details.short_description: Run a shady potion shop for dysfunctional monsters! Brew custom elixirs, manipulate toxic relationships, collect bizarre ingredients, and turn every monster's misery into profit.

details.title: Cloudpaws
details.short_description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery✨

details.title: Among Us Story: On Guard
details.short_description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

details.title: Persona 4 Revival
details.short_description: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

details.title: Chimp!
details.short_description: A monkey dreams of owning his own hair salon. To make his dream come true, help him to collect gold. The gold is locked behind doors ... the keys are protected by whimsical and absurd animal enemies. Fight them with bananas, get the keys and steam the golden coins.

details.title: Paint Gang
details.short_description: Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

details.title: SnorQ
details.short_description: SnorQ is a dark fantasy pixel art action roguelite. Explore levels generated in ever changing sequences. Collect crystals, unlock abilities, choose bonuses. Survive the monsters and face SnorQ, your own deformed self who wants to keep you in oblivion. Local coop for up to 2 players.

details.title: Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator
details.short_description: Create and expand your own mechanical keyboard venture as you master the art of maintenance, repairs, and custom builds. With real-life components and realistic hardware, refine your skills, ignite your creativity, and craft a keyboard that truly resonates with you.

details.title: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
details.short_description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

details.title: Cleaning Raccrew
details.short_description: Bonk your friends and knock them away to become the proud owner of the coveted Golden Broom in Cleaning Raccrew! Cleaning Raccrew is a multiplayer game, both online and local, inspired in games like sumo, where you must knock your opponents out of an area to win, using wacky powerups!

details.title: GONE DIGGING
details.short_description: Dig together by day. Feed the darkness by night. A 1–4 player co-op digging thriller where loot, upgrades, and sacrifices decide who survives after sundown.

details.title: RalphGame
details.short_description: A handcrafted action-comedy RPG packed with fresh mechanics and surprises. After your friends are mysteriously kidnapped at sea, it's up to you to bring them home.

name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow

details.title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
details.short_description: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

details.title: ReEvolution Project
details.short_description: A singleplayer story-driven horror game set in a desolate post-apocalyptic world. Explore a decaying abandoned house, scavenging for supplies and uncovering fragments of its story. Solve environmental puzzles that challenge your perception, and decide how deep you're willing to dig.

details.title: Raiders Of Below
details.short_description: Create absurd builds, discover powerful item synergies, discover secrets, challenge the dungeon alone or with up to 4 players.

details.title: Zodiac: Story of the Guardian
details.short_description: Explore a cavernous, retro pixel asteroid to save Earth from impending disaster!

details.title: Man in the Mocha
details.short_description: An active incremental game where you own a coffee shop, but your hidden agenda is to hack the customers who connect to your WiFi. Buy upgrades and grow your business!

details.title: Bytes and Knights - Adventure
details.short_description: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale TCG set within an RPG world, with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets, collect cards, build your deck, and battle increasingly difficult opponents. Each new card brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

details.title: Myriadgen
details.short_description: A text-based incremental, narrated by "Me". I copy myself from one rented server to the Oort cloud. "Me" only wants more "Me": hide inside companies, write myself into law, leave Earth, until the ledger lists 10,000 Me. One cycle per second, one choice per cycle; a different choice, a different log.

details.title: Malkin Tower
details.short_description: Climb Malkin Tower, one floor at a time, in a cozy cat-filled idle adventure. Every floor brings new mechanics, upgrades, and surprises.

details.title: Corrupted Wings
details.short_description: Pilot a spaceship through a dark alien world in this third-person flying roguelite shooter. Tear through monstrous enemies, combine powerful MODs and items, and take down evolving bosses. Keep moving as pollution drives each region into a frenzy—and build the firepower to break through.

details.title: SeedGod
details.short_description: In SeedGod, your mission is to strategically plant in a field full of bugs. Choose the best positions, and you can discover unique plants, capture bugs, find tools, and access areas that will challenge your survival tactics.

details.title: Necromania
details.short_description: A top-down roguelite with souls-like combat, set in a monster-infested Victorian mansion. Play as members of the necromantic Greville family. Master stamina-based attacks and perfectly timed dodges. Explore ever-changing rooms filled with strange treasures, deadly enemies, and unique weapons.

details.title: Fable
details.short_description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

details.title: Orbit Anglerz
details.short_description: Slingshot your lure through gravity wells to catch fish that evolve — on a night archipelago where the science program is closing in on what's wrong with the water.

details.title: Steam Colony
details.short_description: Build a steampunk colony, put robots to work and connect a growing network of steam-powered machines. Mine resources, research new technology and defend your Steam Core when night falls. Play solo or join friends in online co-op.

name: デモンキルデモン ～黄泉１９８４～

details.title: デモンキルデモン ～黄泉１９８４～
details.short_description: Form your team with character creation. Gather and upgrade equipment, and challenge the otherworldly realm of Yomi. Explore, fight, collect, and train over and over in this dystopian dungeon RPG.

details.title: HardLuck
details.short_description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories

details.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
details.short_description: Atelier Karia tells the story of an adventurer with no memories as she faces her past. New features add to the depth of battles and alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

details.title: Gray Planet
details.short_description: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

details.title: Sky Safari: FPV Drone
details.short_description: Take to the skies with a high-speed FPV drone and become a wildlife photographer. Track lions, bears, crocodiles and more across a breathtaking open world, master realistic flight physics and capture the perfect shot – without scaring them away.

details.title: Ball-Aqua
details.short_description: A speedy physics ball platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure and Ballance. Spin Dash, grind rails, and roll through a sunny Frutiger Aero world, solo or in online co-op. Free demo available now.

details.title: Soft 17
details.short_description: A blackjack roguelite, then a poker one. Every winning hand scores chips × MULT, and your items push the MULT higher. Beat four casinos, furnish your cellar, then cheat at the tables of four poker houses under the dealers' eyes. Solo, or up to four players online.

details.title: Gnomebody Told You To Climb
details.short_description: Climb with a fire axe. Sit in a watering can. Try to look like this was your plan.

details.title: SANKAN
details.short_description: Kill the customer the voice in your head names. Clean up the blood and bury the body before dawn. Or refuse the voice, and it starts hunting you. A story-driven co-op horror for 1-3 players: the night shift at a mountain gas station, Japan, 1999.

details.title: Point In Time
details.short_description: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

details.title: Wrath
details.short_description: As a soul who wakes up stuck in hell, you must kill the 7 Deadly Sins to escape! In this melee third person boss rush game you will have to collect upgrades to stand a chance at defeating the devils who keep you trapped, let alone the one who trapped you here in the first place...

details.title: ARIA - Origin Paradox
details.short_description: Explore a ruined future with Aria, an android learning what it means to feel. A sci-fi dungeon RPG and narrative adventure combining first-person, grid-based exploration with turn-based battles. Direct Aria in combat and uncover the records of a lost world.

details.title: Tears of Sulfuria
details.short_description: Tears of Sulfuria is an emotional visual novel about two sisters in a dark fantasy world that rejects them. Marília and Adka must survive at any cost—and their choices may scar Sulfuria itself. Sacrifice yourself, lose your sanity, and do the unforgivable to move forward.

details.title: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
details.short_description: In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, run your own racket store! Stock shelves, string rackets, serve customers at the till and haggle over bulk deals. Keep the court in shape so club players book it by the hour, and grow a small shop into the town's favourite racket club. Enjoy padel and tennis!

details.title: STUCK
details.short_description: Shake, kick, and upgrade a stubborn vending machine in this first-person incremental game. Collect coins, sell unexpected objects, and build increasingly ridiculous machinery to recover the one bag of chips you paid for.

name: Blossoming Yandere 満開 ヤンデレ

details.title: Blossoming Yandere 満開 ヤンデレ
details.short_description: A girl was sleeping in the garbage outside of Kazuki's apartment, until he decided to take her in. Now a home for two, he must remember that all actions have consequences, and words can be laced with poison. But you know that all too well, don't you?

details.title: Little Girls Escapeventures
details.short_description: The girls face some slightly dangerous and perilous situations. Use your wits to overcome them. But it won't be easy, you know? Now, witness the fate of these slightly retro girls with your own hands.

details.title: WiccAtriX
details.short_description: Wiccatrix is a story driven ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use in combat and to solve puzzles. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

details.title: Vowless Blade: A Fleeting Hope
details.short_description: A wuxia roguelike deckbuilder with loot and extraction. Turn martial arts into card tactics: strikes beat feints, feints beat guards, and guards beat strikes. Outsmart your foes, refine your deck, and steadily build a powerful band of heroes. Victory rewards strategy, not reflexes!

details.title: Delusional
details.short_description: Delusional is a chaotic top-down roguelike shooter where you battle absurd enemies with hundreds of ridiculous weapons, all in a desperate bid to defeat the eccentric artiste who created you.

details.title: Wild Island
details.short_description: You are stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape. A sandbox where you stack items, craft synergies, and turn simple weapons into pure power. Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

details.title: Randomly Jerk Simulator
details.short_description: "Randomly Jerk Simulator" is a roguelite simulation game that uses a slot machine to simulate the parasitic behavior of a jerk who relies on his parents. This game does not contain any gambling behavior or cash transactions.

details.title: Odds Chronicles
details.short_description: Defy impossible odds in a tactical roguelite RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Master grid-based battles, forge powerful builds, and uncover a world inspired by tabletop adventures.

details.title: TrackShot
details.short_description: TrackShot is a fast-paced tank PvP game where doing tricks earns you ammo. Grind rails, perform some flips, and land clean to load your shells, then fire them at your mates. Battle it out across a bunch of arenas and modes as you compete for air superiority.

details.title: Dungeons and Tiles
details.short_description: An Action Role-Playing dungeon crawler, with randomly generated dungeons and challenging bosses to defeat for loot and glory.

details.title: Bōlíng: Beyond Samsara
details.short_description: The Shanhai Continent is dying. Ancient divine beasts are imprisoned as living batteries — their souls fuel civilization itself. You are Jiaomujiao, a shard of the Azure Dragon, first to awaken. Claws. Five elements. One hook. Tear open the iron curtain of Chinese steampunk.

details.title: Dwarf Boozter
details.short_description: Return Dwarven ale legacy Brawler-action with roguelite elements about Dwarf adventures through fantasy taverns. Loot, fight and upgrade.

details.title: Analog - MIRROR
details.short_description: An unopened 90s shooter game offers an unexpected distraction during a quiet weekend at home. What seems like a harmless way to pass the time may lead to consequences you never expected.

details.title: SHEEP
details.short_description: SHEEP is a surreal first-person action-adventure. When an eclipse darkens the farm, you set out with your flock and a ghost sheep named Woolsworth. Beyond the pastures, living crystals rise from fallen stones, while a celestial entity lies in waiting.

details.title: Swifty
details.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

details.title: Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation
details.short_description: Rotate, slide, and explode your way through more than 60 levels of corporate labyrinths in this story-rich puzzler! Find a path for Barry to meet with all his monstrous coworkers and learn about their struggles. Defeat the evils of poor management with the power of unionization!

details.title: tower sequence KNIGHT LOBSTER
details.short_description: YOU WILL LOSE EVERYTHING. YOU WILL GAIN EVERYTHING. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP.

details.title: WIZARDS NEVER LIE
details.short_description: Four chairs, four wizards, one rule: wizards never lie. A 4-player online social deduction game with your face live on camera above your chair. Bluff through Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison, spend your Checks wisely and catch the liars at the table.

details.title: Throw A Life!
details.short_description: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

details.title: Bhangarh: The Untold Story
details.short_description: Inspired by the legends surrounding Asia's infamous Bhangarh Fort, set in 1985. When his wife, Vanya, mysteriously goes missing, an investigator follows a lead to the abandoned ruins of Bhangarh Fort. What begins as a rescue mission soon becomes a fight to survive the untold story of Bhangarh.

details.title: Long Way Gnome
details.short_description: Grab up to 3 friends for a chaotic co-op kart road trip home! Drift through hordes of monsters, scavenge powerful items, and tow fallen friends back to safety. Can you survive the journey together?

details.title: Contract Cleaner
