details.short_description: Contract Cleaner is a 2D pixel-art top-down cleaning simulator. Take on nightly contracts as Hank Bucket, clean messy locations, upgrade your tools, and build your cleaning business.

details.title: Echophobia
details.short_description: Echophobia is a multiplayer game where sound is your only vision. A blind Hunter hunts through sound and microphone detection, while Runners navigate complete darkness to complete objectives and escape before being caught.

details.title: Trenchblocks
details.short_description: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

details.title: Spill The Ink
details.short_description: Draw one continuous line, then watch gravity turn your ink into the solution. Guide the paper ball through handcrafted chambers, chase three-star clears, and build, test, and share your own puzzles.

details.title: INROOMS
details.short_description: A cooperative psychological horror experience up to four players where you and your friends must survive the deepest, most distorted liminal spaces of the Inrooms, the deepest levels of the Backrooms.

details.title: A Court of Seven Crowns
details.short_description: Navigate a web of intrigue and assassination to make peace among warring fae! The fate of their realms and yours is in your hands! A text-based interactive novel.

details.title: Lunar Eclipse ~ Vol. 0
details.short_description: Tread lightly or perish! In this pixel style Action RPG, slash and dodge through grueling foes as a dreary elven swordsman and a conniving feline assassin, discover hidden secrets in expansive environments, and survive in a world healing from war.

details.title: DEEP RESET
details.short_description: Dig through destructible terrain and defeat enemies in this top-down 2D looter shooter. Craft your own build and venture ever deeper.

details.title: Worlda
details.short_description: Worlda is a 2D top down pixel-art sandbox adventure where you play as young grizzly bear Jonas as he sets forth into a charming, infinite world, battling brutal bosses and building beautiful bungalows. Will you make it through the night, or will you bear-ly survive?

details.title: Grilluminati
details.short_description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

details.title: Dream Cola
details.short_description: A short PSX-style horror game featuring light scares, humor, and a mysterious story. Supports Arabic and English And no Music In This Game

details.title: A Taste of Heat
details.short_description: In your restaurant kitchen, will love simmer, or will lust boil over? Sharpen your ambition, create decadent recipes, and light the flames of passion. A text-based interactive romance novel, 500,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

details.title: OxyDungeon
details.short_description: You wake up in a bizarre pop-art world, armed with a baseball bat and only four buttons: Up, Down, Left, and Right. Input dance-game-style arrow combos to create items, then smash and launch them with your bat to obliterate enemies and survive the chaos!

details.title: High Typer
details.short_description: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

details.title: Daemon Doors
details.short_description: Defeat all Daemon Guardians through the Doors of the Daemon Server. Your only job is to choose the best Doors. Use inventory management and risk taking choices to enhance your buffs and prevent a Weak late game.

details.title: Reach The Beat 2
details.short_description: Take target constellations apart to the beat. Shoot through rock and electronic tracks in reactive arenas — from concert lights to an alien nightscape and the ocean depths. Play on a monitor, in PC VR or in 3D SBS.

details.title: Idleplace
details.short_description: Place hovering land on your sky island. Close a region to construct your buildings, then muster an army to fight the invaders landing. Collect gear from bosses as well as gaining gear in village. In battle turn on auto and your island fights on while you're idle, even floating on your desktop.

details.title: On The Come Up
details.short_description: Start small and work your way up in On The Come Up, a co-op crime game about making money, stealing cars, dodging police, and building a home for your crew. Follow a story that gets personal, or take a break from the missions and see what you can get away with around the city.

details.title: Toy or Not ?
details.short_description: Toy or Not ? is an online hide-and-seek party game for up to 8 players. Sneak around as a toy, collect batteries, and rescue your teammates—or play as a kid, spot suspicious toys, and send them back to the toy box. Turn an ordinary room into a playground of sneaky tricks and surprises!

details.title: Seolhwa Dungeon
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike where you fight monsters from Korean folktales, and they act the way they do in the stories. Let the Imugi live too long and it becomes a dragon. If the reaper sees you for three turns, he calls your name. When you die, you start over in a new dungeon.

details.title: Kill the Thing
details.short_description: Kill The Thing is a challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

name: 未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring

details.title: 未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring
details.short_description: In Kunming, Yunnan, during her first winter break after entering high school, a fifteen-year-old artistic girl is melancholy with longing, but unexpectedly gets drawn into a wondrous adventure born of myth—behind it all lie her forgotten memories and a wager.

details.title: Merciless Mines
details.short_description: A hardcore 2D multiplayer extraction RPG featuring PvP/PvE, proximity chat, unique spells and classes, raid bosses, GAMBLING, and much more. Party up with friends, break terrain, and explore a dangerous open world filled with monsters, rival explorers, and loot worth fighting for.

details.title: Wilderwake
details.short_description: A 2D pixel-art action adventure about waking a dead world with a powerful gauntlet. Crush fruit and the ground blooms, little dinosaurs come home, fish ponds and rebuild your camp, explore a vast world full of secrets and fight crystal creatures to free giant machines.

details.title: Hold On Together
details.short_description: Hold On Together is a physics-based online co-op game for four players. Team up with friends or other players, enter a random map from the lobby, and tackle chaotic jobs in rounds lasting about five minutes. Keep your team on its feet and the job going!

details.title: Closed Case
details.short_description: Team up with a friend and help Marcus and Cloe escape in this co-op point-and-click puzzle game! In Closed Case, you and your partner must solve a variety of riddles to escape the mysterious house while uncovering the identity of its enigmatic owner.

details.title: Your New Family
details.short_description: They offer you a bed, a seat at the table and a new family. All you have to do is stay. A narrative psychological horror adventure in a community where everyone is kind and nobody quite answers your questions.

details.title: SPIDERBOT EXTINCTION
details.short_description: The spiderbot horde doesn't march in lines — it flows like a flood. Place turrets freely, then use gunfire, mortar blasts, flame and more to push, split and redirect the swarm before it drowns humanity's last strongholds. Tower defense meets pest control at the end of the world.

details.title: EVICTIO
details.short_description: You've been hired to clear a haunted house. Read the briefing, complete your tasks and make it back out alive. Every creature inside behaves differently, and a single mistake in the wrong room can cost you everything.

details.title: Exchange Alley
details.short_description: Trade shares, spread rumours, exploit bubbles and chase your fortune in the chaotic coffee houses of 18th-century London, birthplace of the modern stock market.

details.title: 弥莎莉尔的救赎
details.short_description: Guide Misa through a dreamlike world in a single-player story and card-battling adventure. Shape your deck with helms, accessories and new cards, plan actions across three combat phases, and choose your path along a road of sacrifice.

details.title: Shot Rock
details.short_description: Shot Rock is a curling game where you call the shot, throw it, and sweep it home, presented like curling on TV. Two full teams take the ice in arenas and club venues. Play the AI, a friend, or players online.

details.title: Wilderune
details.short_description: Explore a voxel world across seven biomes, face towering guardians and find your style among 49 weapons. Craft equipment, combine movement accessories and tame animal companions in Wilderune, an action RPG built around exploration.

details.title: Wind and Splinters
details.short_description: Play as a musketeer in boarding fights, a gunner in cannon duels, or the helmsman of a 17th-century ship, all in first person. Fight solo or team up with friends, battle each other or the AI, and command your crew. Snap masts, smash hulls, tear ships apart — literally. Use the wind to win.

details.title: Patadas
details.short_description: Quesito & Turrón are two ducks with puzzles to solve. Coordinate, push things around, and find your way to the end of each level in this small free game for two. Play on the same screen or remotely with Steam Remote Play Together.

details.title: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense
details.short_description: Master English listening with the ultimate dictation challenge! This real-time tower defense game lets you build and upgrade defenses by typing what you hear. Use 12 tower branches and the Fever system to sharpen your intuition. The faster you listen and type, the stronger your defense!

details.title: Giusto
details.short_description: Bidding for tricks in the forest. Be perfect, or be punished. Giusto is a tabletop, turn-based, strategy card game that rewards how well a player can predict the outcome of their hand BEFORE each round starts. Players are scored based on the accuracy of their pre-game predictions. Low score wins.

details.title: THE BUTCHER WARD
details.short_description: Your night shift was supposed to be simple: restore power to an abandoned hospital. Repair electrical systems, explore the darkened wards, and survive the monstrous butcher stalking its halls.

details.title: No Truce With The Groceries
details.short_description: Can you shop for groceries? In 🗽America🗽? In this economy? No Truce With The Groceries is a Disco-lite narrative point-and-click adventure that seeks answers to these questions and more.

details.title: Idle Commander
details.short_description: Build your own path in Idle Commander. Discover powerful gear, experiment with wild builds, and reshape your strategy with every drop.

details.title: The Needle
details.short_description: The Needle is a SciFi RPG roguelike game like nothing you've ever seen. In the tradition of FTL, Crying Suns, and others, it's a deep and immersive space combat sim, with the presentation of a movie....... That you can talk to. Fight your way to the alien homeworld, by speaking aloud.

details.title: Don't Get Attracted
details.short_description: Shoot magnets, not bullets. Magnetise anything - crates, girders, the friend next to you - then watch matching poles blast apart and opposites slam together. An 8-player online party platformer about climbing one enormous tower, right up until somebody decides you'd look better falling off it.

details.title: Runecast
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where the cards are letters. Draft runes, spell real words to cast spells, collect powerful relics and scrolls and fight your way up the tower. Seven modes, including an asynchronous online Arena. Play in English or Greek: two dictionaries, two different games.

details.title: Unlisted
details.short_description: Your son is missing. Then the unlisted videos start arriving, recorded by grieving parents searching for their own lost children. You don't just watch them, you live them: each in a different place, each facing a different threat. Will they bring you hope... or dread?

details.title: 萌塔物语
details.short_description: Monster girls are adorable—collect them all! Defeat monsters, possess their bodies, or capture them for your Body Vault. Switch forms to conquer the tower, then fuse, evolve, and teach skills to grow stronger bodies. Hunt rare, mutated, and prismatic variants. Start with a tower. Take every body!

details.title: Per My Last Email
details.short_description: You are the new hire. The account you inherited is not new — it belonged to E. Vale, who is no longer with the company. Ten business days of email in which you choose what you say, then choose who sees it. The routing is permanent. Someone is still reading.

details.title: Ante Inferno
details.short_description: The poker RPG. ANTE INFERNO is a roguelite card battler where you play poker hands as attacks, tear through hell with forty class abilities, and stack boons until the damage counter gives up on digits.

details.title: CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations
details.short_description: Run a childcare plant where babies spend their first year in automated care. Build conveyor networks for feeding, sleep, hygiene, and play. As babies grow, their needs change. Keep your factory efficient while adapting to each child's unique reactions.

details.title: MUTINY!
details.short_description: MUTINY! is a multiplayer platformer fighter game that allows up to 10 players per round! Using different kinds of bombs and the power of physics, ensure your victory as the last man standing on pirate ships, treacherous waters, and other dynamic maps that aren't exactly on your side either.

details.title: TRACE
details.short_description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

details.title: The Broken Oath
details.short_description: Bound in a cell beneath a cathedral, freed by a dying spirit. Descend the dungeons of a paladin order that forgot what it swore. A short, heavy souls-like, built one floor at a time. In Early Access: Floor One and its two bosses, about forty minutes.

details.title: Hidden Doodles: Medieval Town
details.short_description: Explore a hand-drawn medieval world in this relaxing hidden object adventure. Search for hidden items, peek inside cottages, and click on villagers and animals to discover their playful reactions. Travel from quiet villages to bustling towns full of little surprises.

details.title: Lines of Conquest
details.short_description: Take control of a nation and conquer Europe one base at a time. Move your armies, attack enemy territory, upgrade your bases and manage your resources as you continue to expand your territory.

details.title: Spirit Sealer
details.short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey through portals in Spirit Sealer, a narrative-driven card game where you seal Spirits in strategic battles. Master a dynamic 3x3 grid battlefield, wielding your customizable Sealer and four Spirits against unique foes in each zone.

details.title: You Go First!
details.short_description: A 4–12 player multiplayer deathrun about surviving deadly obstacle courses while one of you secretly controls the traps.

details.title: Somewhere Else
details.short_description: A cozy 2-player co-op puzzle platformer. Play as Chimp and Chip on one couch or online with Remote Play Together, explore six strange and beautiful worlds, solve puzzles that need both of you, beat bosses and find your way back home.

details.title: Hardware Pirates
details.short_description: Your PC was a pirate ship all along. Turn monitors into Digital Sails, RAM into ramming power and USB ports into gunports. Explore the Corrupted Caribbean, upgrade your ship and master ballistic naval combat. Sail solo or join friends in online co-op and PvP.

details.title: NO FISHING!
details.short_description: An incremental autobattler about fishing where you're not allowed to fish. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and destroy the navy before they take you down.

details.title: Taboo Eternal Life
details.short_description: An Incremental Idle Exploration Game, Awaken in a silent, blood-soaked medieval vampire palace—where your kin lay dead. Who slaughtered them all? Uncover the chilling truth, break the endless loop of immortality, or sacrifice everything to restart the taboo cycle.

details.title: World of Slime
details.short_description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

details.title: Runan Ritual
details.short_description: In Runan Ritual, you step into the boots of Vitz, a warrior caught in the crossfire of a planetary invasion. After a devastating encounter with the Runan, Vitz is left changed no longer fully human, but not quite one of them. Fight back against the shadows!.

details.title: Pluffy Nightmare
details.short_description: Blast through a surreal nightmare in this fast-paced roguelike FPS with funny weapons! In Pluffy Nightmare, your mind is dragged into a doll´s body to battle possessed plushies, dolls, and toys in bizarre fantasy worlds.

details.title: Haramball
details.short_description: Haramball is a multiplayer football tactics card strategy game where you pick the players, merge their attributes, set up the best formations and then watch your tactics unfold in real-time. Will you play beautiful football or become the football terrorist you were always meant to be ? You decide.

details.title: LOVE D3ATH LOVE
details.short_description: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

details.title: Turbo Loop
details.short_description: Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game focused on simple, fun gameplay - easy to learn, but hard to master. Challenge AI opponents or race a friend in head-to-head matches, unlock and customize cars, compete across dozens of tournament tracks, or create your own with the track editor!

details.title: Smokey Mike
details.short_description: In stand-up, talent isn't always enough. In this point and click adventure you have to improvise, survive and fail with style until you craft the five minutes that could change everything.

details.title: Spin Sacrifice Survive
details.short_description: Break the system. Test your luck. Spot the lies. Experience the thrill of gambling for your survival. Optimize your strategy to pay an crushing debt, grow your power, and survive ten nights of paranoia.

name: End of Empires: Breaking the Cycle

details.title: End of Empires: Breaking the Cycle
details.short_description: A Sci-Hy game exploring CenLib: separate private property from the means of production. Second game in the genre WILLSWAYSTUDIOS is pioneering. Multi-Perspective 3D strategy-ARPG—survive, craft, build, fight, counter-economics, direct democracy. Custom engine builds every asset from code.

details.title: Tight Tactics
details.short_description: Be ready for turn-based combat in this roguelite to kick off with the enemy opening fire on you first, trying to keep you from regrouping, and one bad decision leading to the death of your entire upgraded squad

details.title: 時折記 -Tokioriki-
details.short_description: Every person you choose leaves someone else behind. Spend your limited afternoons building relationships, exploring the town, and recording each day in Kanata’s diary—then face timed Shadow Choices as an old book begins to fracture his ordinary life.

details.title: Immortal Sect Defend
details.short_description: Cultivation meets tower defense. As a core disciple, you are the last line defending the Sect Eye against waves of demonic hordes. Deploy immortal towers and formations, outthink every enemy, then take up your sword to raid secret realms and seize rare treasures. Command the battle—or fight in it.

details.title: Idle Mining Manager
details.short_description: An idle asteroid mining management simulator. Earn credits and advance through corporate tiers to expand your range of mining tools, policy upgrades and resource efficiency. Unlock the history of interstellar mining since the NofVS and, with a little help, uncover the truth behind the propaganda.

details.title: PROTOCOL: Zero-day
details.short_description: Dive into a brutal isometric Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Master fast-paced Hack'n'Slash combat during intense 5-to-8-minute incursions. Face infected hordes, optimize your build, and break the loop. Death is part of the protocol.

details.title: AstroDiner Manager
details.short_description: Become a manager for your own diner on a lonely asteroid. Order snacks and drinks, cook dishes, and serve them to quirky alien slimes. Talk, hire, investigate, and keep an eye on the visitors to reveal the hidden mystery behind this place.

details.title: Ghost Hunter
details.short_description: Ghost Hunter is a co-op horror escape game for 1–4 players. As the owner of a supernatural agency, you accept ghost-related cases and carry out cleansings. You’ll need to choose your gear wisely, and you can tackle the cases solo or team up with others to survive and succeed.

details.title: I Have Been Here Before?
details.short_description: A psychological exploration through a liminal dreamscape: no guides, no paths, just you and small environmental mysteries.

details.title: Fastrak : Metro
details.short_description: Fastrak: Metro is a simcade train game where you drive Aussie trains on real railways to get the highest score!

details.title: Telera
details.short_description: Roll your dice, and score increasing amounts of points. Complete the goal target to move to the next level - unlocking new dice, and providing resources to upgrade your existing dice. Roll, Score, Upgrade, and repeat - TELERA provides a challenge as long as you can complete each level. Good luck!

details.title: These Roads are Terminal
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a wage-slave and work the graveyard delivery shift at Vito's! It's not glamorous, but it pays rent. Leave the safety of your car and step into the streets of a decaying suburbia. Deliver to peculiar customers while trying to ignore that feeling of being watched...

details.title: Void Eaters
details.short_description: Play as a powerful mage shaping an army of mythical creatures in this semi-idle incremental game. Destroy enemies and gather resources by casting spells or simply watch your army at work. Explore, upgrade, craft, and customize your forces to fit your strategy.

details.title: Miracle Mage: Awakened Elements
details.short_description: "Awakened Elements" is a match-three strategy RPG where chaos spreads as the Demon King shatters elemental balance. As a young mage, awaken lost powers, rally elven allies, and battle through thorny paths to restore order before darkness consumes the world.

details.title: Screams Echo
details.short_description: Screams Echo is a dark top-down action roguelike where you must fight through hordes of mutants in a procedurally generated underground complex. Find powerful items that can completely change the course of a run, combine them with weapons and hero abilities, and build insane synergies that turn desperate survival into total chaos.

details.title: Kaori
details.short_description: Kaori is a first-person puzzle and adventure game. Explore ancient ruins on a sun-drenched archipelago and uncover the many mysteries of a lost civilization.

details.title: The Last Night Train
details.short_description: A story-driven puzzle adventure about Ovid searching for Thera, his love who vanished aboard a train where the night never ends… but what if she was never the one he needed to find?

details.title: Piece of Cake: Cozy Bakery
details.short_description: Restore a cozy café in this relaxing merge puzzle game. Combine pastries, tools, and decorations, complete customer orders, unlock new story moments, and bring every corner of your dream café back to life.

details.title: GRIMOIRE - The Lost Ritual
details.short_description: “On the unseen side of everyday life, a story begins.”

details.title: Oscar Will Be Fine
details.short_description: Oscar's mother always told him he'd amount to something, but she didn't specify what. His greatest challenge: surviving a Modern Art Museum. Casual fun, no complicated instructions, no language dependency. Single player, best with a controller.

details.title: Static Line
details.short_description: Take control of an airborne mecha and fight your way home in a side-view action roguelite. Break through enemy lines, defend key positions, and turn the tide alongside allied forces—then rebuild your machine with interchangeable parts, weapons, and movement styles.

details.title: Organic Mechanic
details.short_description: Organic Mechanic is a bee-first automation, creature capturing, machine manufacturing game! Explore multiple vibrant biomes, build mechanical factories and play with your? friends? maybe? Catch, Built & Profit from BEES!

details.title: 100+ Bored Games
details.short_description: Mini games you can play with your friends or with bots during any time!

details.title: LOTTERY
details.short_description: The only game in the world to bring the joy of tactical FPS games into the single-player experience. Fight the entire world with superpowers gifted to you by sheer luck as you wipe out thousands of the world's most elite defenses while they try predicting, learning, and adapting to your every move.

details.title: Ikigai - Party Game
details.short_description: Grab, shove and flail your way through a gauntlet of physics-driven party games. Up to 8 players, wobbly ragdoll limbs and a fresh minigame every round — sumo showdowns, chaotic football and frantic fishing, wrapped in Japanese folk charm.

details.title: Necromancer´s Ruins
details.short_description: A hand-painted 2D roguelike platformer about treasure hunting, magic, and dangerous ruins. Fight monsters, collect upgrades, and try to go further each run.

details.title: The Sixth Die
details.short_description: The Sixth Dice is a dice-building roguelike with poker hands. Roll five dice, re-roll and modify them to form pairs, straights, or five-of-a-kind. Collect runes, skills, and relics to forge unique builds. Defeat the final boss to unlock the Sixth Dice—showing any number you choose—and endless mode.

details.title: Magehold Wanderlight
details.short_description: A black storm of living ink is swallowing the world. Gather a small crew, build a cozy house on giant legs, and walk ahead of it. Harvest, trade and grow your walker by day, defend it by lamplight at night, until you are strong enough to turn around and face the storm.

details.title: Finistry
details.short_description: Build a living aquarium in a world changed by a mysterious pandemic. Breed fish, discover species, manage water quality, fulfil research orders, and respond to unexpected events in this relaxing aquarium management game.

details.title: Alia Domus
details.short_description: Explore and colonize an unknown planet in this pixel art survival RPG. Collect resources, complete quests, and craft technologies from different eras of humanity to turn Alia Domus into a home. Start with basic survival and reach civilizational splendor.

details.title: Conquering Other Planets Idle - COPI
details.short_description: A deep idle RPG where numbers go up, gear gets weirdly strong, and prestige when you want to be stronger or weaker. Build your permanent wardrobe across prestiges, pick your gear to start a run with, but be prepared to upgrade.

details.title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
details.short_description: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

details.title: From Basement with Love
details.short_description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the height of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher classified intelligence to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, cover your tracks, and escape before it’s too late.

details.title: Aftershock
details.short_description: When your own mind becomes the enemy, can you protect the one who matters most?

details.title: Ant
details.short_description: Build a living ant colony that can stay on your desktop while you work. Hatch unusual ants, place nest and food rooms, collect coins, and expand from a glass habitat into drawers, pipes, walls, roots, and the forgotten depths below.

details.title: Golden Retriever Simple Life
details.short_description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

details.title: GTJ: Grand Theft Japan
details.short_description: Become an untouchable U.S. military soldier in Japan! Combine the wild, chaotic humor of Goat Simulator with the lawless street action of Saints Row. Smash rogue ninjas, unleash chaos, and turn the city into your ultimate playground!

details.title: Literally A Flying Brick
details.short_description: "Literally A Flying Brick" is a spaceship-building 2.5D action-shooter game. The year is 2088, and humanity is at war with AI and aliens in space. Triumph in intense battles using your own fully customizable spaceship and a strategic skill deck!

details.title: Remnant Afterglow Tower Defense
details.short_description: This is a creative and challenging real-time strategy tower defense game where players need to constantly expand, build complex battle lines on the map, and fight against groups of enemies. The game has unique rules and beautiful pixel style, with each level filled with tense and exciting battles.

details.title: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co.
details.short_description: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co. is a fun 2D art & management sim. Paint what’s in the minds of quirky customers with top accuracy, showcase your art in the gallery, sell it at auctions, and compete online with friends!

details.title: Dent & Paint: Body Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own body shop and fix cars by hand. Inspect, quote and win the job, then strip, cut out rot, weld, fill, sand, mask, mix and spray the paint, polish and wash. Deliver on time, earn good reviews and work your way up from apprentice to foreman.

details.title: Off-Road With Your Friends
details.short_description: Pack your friends into boxy 4x4s and head into the wild. Up to 8 players drive one convoy through autumn forests, rivers and snowy passes, get stuck in the mud, winch each other out, change flat tyres and camp at dusk. Nobody gets left behind.

details.title: Bedtime Battalion
details.short_description: When the house falls asleep, the toys go to war! Command wobbly toy soldiers across a child's bedroom and six ages of history, from cavemen to tanks, in physics battles where a vacuum cleaner, a giant ball or the lights going out can turn any fight.

details.title: Cosmic Inferno
details.short_description: Explore 100 star systems, battle pirates, trade, mine asteroids, and salvage wrecks. Buy and customize spaceships, upgrade your weapons, and chart your own course. Your onboard computer A.R.E.S. is always by your side. Whether you like it or not.

details.title: Timber Together
details.short_description: Grab up to seven friends and build a logging company in a stylized forest valley. Fell trees, buck them into logs, haul them through mud and rivers in 11 vehicles, and sell to the buyers who pay best. Buy land, hire loggers, grow your company.

details.title: True Vikings
details.short_description: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

details.title: Hegemony
details.short_description: 214 states, thousands of regions, and limitless strategic possibilities! Manage your economy, shape politics, forge diplomatic ties, strengthen your military, and shift the global balance of power. Establish your own world order and leave your mark on history!

details.title: Meowgic Laundry
details.short_description: Run a magical laundry on the verge of chaos! Toss single-use detergents into a physics-driven washer, chain collisions into escalating scores, buy machine parts, sign contracts, and survive nine rounds of increasingly unruly laundry.

details.title: Fawn's Gambit
details.short_description: Guided by fate, you enter a mysterious card-and-board battle. Collect monster cards, build your deck, defeat legendary heroes, and uncover buried secrets. When the truth emerges, you will fight alongside heroes of old against the darkness.

details.title: Tailgun
details.short_description: A minimalist snake-survivor roguelite. Steer through enemy swarms, build your arsenal with weapons and upgrades, and unlock new content with every run.

details.title: ボンドセレクション
details.short_description: 「きんかんなまなま」が楽しめるのは、ともゆき先生のゲームだけ！新種の接着剤を開発し品評会で最優秀金賞を目指せ！石川県珠洲市狼煙町を舞台に新種の接着剤の開発にかける者たちの苦悩を描く調合RPG（体験版）。ご当地ネタ満載！石川県の事が気になっていたけど、クラスの友達に噂されると恥ずかしいから……気にせずプレーして良し！言葉遊びが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？テキストが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？ここに、あるぞ！読み応えしかない……ッ！ 純文学を読んだような読後感！自称世界で2番目に面白いモンスター図鑑を搭載！圧倒的クオリジナリティー（クオリティー+オリジナリティー）殆ど神ゲーここに、あるぞ！
developers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）
publishers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）

details.title: Habitus
details.short_description: Detective RPG • TTRPG-Style Interrogation • Dark Political Thriller In Zehergrad, crime is a disease. As Inspector Mehmed Başar, break suspects in brutal interrogations and make the political choices that will decide the city's fate.

details.title: Outdraft
details.short_description: Lead an esports team in a MOBA discipline, draft heroes, manage players, and guide your organization to championship glory in a strategic autobattler with deep management elements.

details.title: The Last Reel
details.short_description: Escape a Japanese nightmare in this 2D rubber-hose horror adventure. Play as a protagonist living with depression, manage his sanity, solve puzzles, and survive monstrous encounters, deadly traps, car chases, and airplane pursuits.

details.title: Lattice Defense
details.short_description: A tower defense game meets top-down shooter. Build a maze of walls and elemental towers by day. Defend yourself by night. Dash, build, and blast your way until dawn. Play solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Spin & Win: Casino Business Sim
details.short_description: Their luck. Your business. Build your casino, work the floor, and hire a crew to keep the cash flowing. Draw crowds with live shows, then join your guests for poker, blackjack, or a spin on the slots.

details.title: Assassins for Hire
details.short_description: Four mercenaries, six contracts, one plan. Sneak, distract, knife and sabotage your way through guarded compounds in a real-time tactics game in the classic style, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

details.title: Witchhammer
details.short_description: Face relentless hordes of enemies and overthrow the Inquisition in our gripping real-time deckbuilding roguelike. Harness the magic of your tarot deck to shape your destiny and avenge your fate. The future lies in the cards, witch!

details.title: Caliban
details.short_description: A strategic blackjack roguelike. Stack drinks, runes, and gems into game-breaking combos. Beat cursed bosses. Chase the leaderboard. One deck. One dealer. Infinite builds.

details.title: Ascend from Dis
details.short_description: A comic-ink roguelike deckbuilder where noise is a resource. Scavenge loud and the horde answers in waves — or fight quiet and stay poor. Outplay enemies that run decks of their own: peek, steal, and sabotage their next move while an infection ticks toward turning you.

details.title: Kaput
details.short_description: KAPUT is a chaotic co-op horror comedy game for up to 6 players. Explore abandoned places, repair failing machinery, and salvage high-value scrap while avoiding terrifying anomalies. Work together, handle hazardous breakdown events, and escape with your loot before everything goes kaput!

details.title: Who's the Biggest Degen?
details.short_description: You and 3 friends owe Tony the Octopus a lot of money. Gamble on 30 casino games across 8 floors, slap, rob and sabotage each other, and pay Tony every night, or he takes your stuff, pants included. After 5 nights, only one of you is the Biggest Degen.

details.title: Crash Agency
details.short_description: Crash Agency is a ragdoll comedy about staged accidents. Set the scene, throw yourself in front of cars, off ramps and under pianos, break bones in slow-motion X-ray and file the claim. 105 jobs in a busy town and a snowy mountain village.

details.title: NecroMerc
details.short_description: Play as X a mercenary whose job is being replaced by robots and is reskilling into necromancy.

details.title: Ocean Ark: 100 Below
details.short_description: Build a tiny steel platform on the open sea into a cozy home, floor by floor. Salvage drifting cargo, spear fish, cook, purify water and fix your workbench. Then suit up, dive into the sealed chambers below your home, find blueprints and build your first submarine.

details.title: Enjoy Your Stay
details.short_description: Spot surreal and grotesque anomalies to escape a 1960s hotel that refuses to let its guests leave. Explore hidden liminal spaces, collect strange items, and discover the fates of those who checked in before you.

details.title: Artificial Violet
details.short_description: A visual novel about identity and validation on social media. Step into Violeta's shoes and make decisions that will define who you really are.

details.title: JAILPOT
details.short_description: Inmate 4417. Forty years. Nobody here has ever been released. In here money is cigarettes: scratch, roll, spin and bet your way across nine prison gambling tables, pay every boss his cut before roll call, keep your family's rent paid, and gamble your way out.

details.title: The Widow's Shadow
details.short_description: Following her husband's death, a widow haunted by her town's whispers enters a twisted reality where she must confront the shadows of her past. A psychological horror visual novel inspired by German Expressionist cinema, featuring three different endings.

details.title: Unbox the Room 2
details.short_description: The cozy unboxing and interior design experience returns — bigger, warmer, and more reactive. From homes to small businesses, each space responds to your choices and reflects its owner’s personality.

details.title: Game Of The Chosen
details.short_description: Enter the horror escape game *Game of the Chosen*, where your decisions can mean survival or death. Navigate through rooms filled with puzzles and traps while ghosts and demons make your journey more difficult. Each game is unique, with randomly generated levels and interactive objects.

details.title: Pyramid Wars
details.short_description: Pyramid Wars is a fast, top-down pixel-art RTS. Fight massive RTS battles against an overwhelming enemy. Cast abilities and automate your base. Buy boosterpacks to get legendary units and increase your army even further.

details.title: Orb God
details.short_description: In a distant future, war between humans and orbs has destroyed nearly half the galaxy. Save a broken world and awaken your frenzied kin in a top-down action roguelite. Combine gear and Divine Gifts; play solo or with 2–4 players via Steam or LAN, as allies or rivals.

details.title: Korean Noodle House
details.short_description: A Singleplayer cooking experience. Exploring Korean cooking recipes and culture in a cozy environment. Make customers happy with delicious dishes, gain experience and level up, earn achievements and discover pieces in the art gallery!

details.title: KnighTD
details.short_description: An endless tower defense where towers do not shoot. They empower the units fighting around them. Build, branch units into classes and elements, and hold the Fort through boss waves, loot, and shifting biomes.

details.title: Card Kingdom
details.short_description: Stack cards, merge them and grow your kingdom during the day, and protect your land against waves of bandits at night. A survival micro-RTS card game that takes you from survival to ruler of the island.

details.title: Siegehand
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every minion must choose: attack or build. Destroy their Castle or raise your Monument first. Draft through a challenging rogue-like Campaign, challenge rival decks in asynchronous PvP Expedition, and earn every pack. Collect over 350 cards. No microtransactions.

details.title: Tide Pools
details.short_description: Rake the beach before the tide comes in! Uncover shells, fossils and lost treasures, fill your seaside museum with visitors and grow your rake across ten shores in a cozy pixel-art incremental.

details.title: PowerPitch
details.short_description: Take their ankles, bend one around the keeper, supercharge your shots, and finish the cross with a bicycle-kick. Fast-paced arcade football with no throw-ins, no offside, and no mercy. Win tournaments, collect trophies, and unlock powerful upgrades and new arenas.

details.title: Swingfall
details.short_description: A minimalist physics puzzle about timing. Click a joint to let it go: swing pieces, throw them and drop every last one off the screen. Ten chapters, each with a new rule, 200 levels, and a soundtrack that turns your clicks into music.

details.title: Auto Cats
details.short_description: Build a squad of evolving cats in a tactical roguelite deckbuilder. Your whole team shares one hand: combine cards, positioning, and 100+ Cat Toys to set up powerful combos. Bond duplicates into stronger forms, then command each turn or let Auto Play run your build.

details.title: Seat of Power
details.short_description: Build an ancient kingdom as the Chinese, Egyptians, Greeks or Olmecs. Grow towns, run trade routes, win over independent cities, hunt monsters and summon your god in a real-time strategy game of economy, war and diplomacy. Then lead Atlantis in its own story campaign.

details.title: Fathoms
details.short_description: Fathoms: Narrative psychological horror meets anomaly game. Survive 24 days in a row with your wife in an apartment in the underwater city of Fathoms while you lose your mind or die – and the nightmare starts all over again...

name: Gametsuki Kingdom: The Great Crown Grab!

details.title: Gametsuki Kingdom: The Great Crown Grab!
details.short_description: Steal. Betray. Become King! Duel rivals for gold and turn the tide in a competitive board-game RPG. Planned for launch: English and 14 more languages (interface, subtitles and full voice acting), up to 4-player online PvP, shared-screen local PvP, and solo play.

details.title: Grid Poker
details.short_description: GridPoker is a roguelike deckbuilder. Master grid-linking strategies to unleash vastly different scoring potentials from the exact same divine card combo. Beat diverse bosses across changing poker layouts, and enjoy another layer of fun via casual asynchronous card swapping.

details.title: Desktop Mart
details.short_description: Run a cozy little supermarket right on your desktop. Stock the shelves, serve happy customers, and grow your tiny store — a relaxing idle game for your second screen.

details.title: StickType
details.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

details.title: Demolitors
details.short_description: Command powerful Demolitors, battle enemy machines with unique Insignias, upgrade each machine through its skill tree, unlock even stronger Insignias, and defeat formidable bosses.

details.title: Lycans 2
details.short_description: A chaotic social deduction game for 4 to 16 players with proximity voice chat. Werewolves hide among your friends! Bluff, vote, bonk and fight to survive. Goofy effects, terrible plans and betrayals turn every match into a messy night with friends.

details.title: Buratino
details.short_description: Buratino is a 2D arcade game with light adventure elements for the ZX Spectrum 8-bit computer.

details.title: DeckFarm
details.short_description: DeckFarm is a cozy card-stacking farming & management strategy game. Stack cards to plow, plant crops, and process raw ingredients into regional recipes. Expand your farm, satisfy trade contracts across global scenarios, and automate production chains before time runs out!

details.title: IMMRAMA: Voyages of the Otherworlds
details.short_description: A story-driven RPG you play with text or voice. No jargon, use your own words and the game understands. A hand-written world of myth responds. Real dice, factions, and consequences underneath; a complete, cinematic voyage you can actually finish. Every word human-authored. AI only does the telling.

details.title: RailTangle
details.short_description: RailTangle is a minimalist, Zen puzzle game where you lay tracks to continue your train's journey. Untangle rail networks, find the perfect spot for every tile, and watch your railway expand as you set new high records.

details.title: Mini Meadows
details.short_description: A cozy incremental farming game where you and up to three of your friends feed and grow a frog with the help of a bunch of little bugs. Decorate your island, collect new bugs, explore new biomes and keep on growing that frog.

name: Tales of Linxi: Idle Wuxia Village

details.title: Tales of Linxi: Idle Wuxia Village
details.short_description: A massive narrative idle game with extremely rich systems: farming, logging, fishing, cultivation, reincarnation, recruiting heroes, building a town, raising an army and conquering nations until you unify the continent. Includes over 300,000 words of story. Idle while reading a visual novel!

details.title: Wavertree Mountain
details.short_description: A 2D top-down MMORPG on an island the humans left behind. Choose one of six species, pick a side, and dig a burrow of your own. Gather, craft, build and fight your way across the island, run the local economy with your wares, or just go fishing. You choose.

details.title: Conaganda
details.short_description: A satirical 3D story game about a normal kid in a school that has lost its mind. Stamp the propaganda, sneak past Prefects, hack the school, out-argue teachers in tier-list debates and decide what you believe. 16 chapters, 12 endings. Nobody tells you what to think.

details.title: Mage Escape 2000
details.short_description: A 32-player extraction ARPG. Battle monsters and rival squads for priceless loot as the Isle collapses around you. Die, and lose it all. Extract, and live to raid again.
developers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra
publishers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra

details.title: Gacha Fiend
details.short_description: A gachapon roguelike about luck, builds, and a debt that grows with every spin. Shake the machine, combine stickers and relics, and survive Mr. Ossório’s collection visits.

details.title: The Abyssal Diplomat
details.short_description: Humans and Monsters can't agree on what year it is, a conflict that threatens to tear apart their sense of shared reality. A mysterious creature is called upon to bring the two communities together. The Abyssal Diplomat will do its best. But will its best be enough?

details.title: Peso Pena
details.short_description: Train, build your fight plan, and watch it play out. A boxing game with incremental training and automatic bouts, where winning is only half the job: eleven owners share your contract. Buy yourself back, one share at a time.

details.title: 三国梦想家
details.short_description: Forge your path through the Three Kingdoms. Choose a historical faction or create an officer, govern cities, organize armies and plan supplies. Command troops in real-time field battles and sieges, using formations and officer skills to shape your campaign.

details.title: Industrial Empire Online
details.short_description: Build a complete industrial empire: extract resources, produce steel, aluminum, fuel and polymers, manage logistics, manufacture heavy equipment, and compete for tenders against other players. Rent or build enterprises, control costs, fulfill contracts, climb the ranking. Every point is built.

details.title: Goblin Mode: Loot & Lunacy
details.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player online co-op physics sandbox where goblins live for loot, destruction and mayhem. Explore, steal and build ridiculous contraptions with your friends. From platforming to car chases to fighting giant beasts, these little goblins can do it all.

details.title: 雀神 Sparrow God
details.short_description: Mahjong hands meet roguelike deckbuilding. Choose a faction, collect Jokers and talismans, and beat score targets with limited plays. Take on eight chapters and 24 blinds, then push your build further in Endless Mode.

details.title: No Good Friends
details.short_description: “It's a Blade.” Is it? Pass a face-down card across the felt, name it and look your friends in the eye. Every card ends in a verdict for someone. Collect the wrong ones and the table executes you: poison, a knife or the rope. No good friends here. 2–6 players, voice chat.

details.title: Aftermyth
details.short_description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

details.title: Fool King
details.short_description: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat!

details.title: Fox Arcana
details.short_description: FOX ARCANA is a pixel art roguelike survivor. You play a fox against hordes of monsters, backed by the creatures you free, in a world that shifts to a new season with every boss you defeat.

details.title: Mineral Craft 2
details.short_description: Fascinated by minerals and crystals? Turn your curiosity into knowledge, and your knowledge into profit. Combine real chemical elements, fine-tune temperature, pressure and cooling time to create 140+ real minerals, fill your Mineralopedia, and grow your own mineral business.

details.title: Poetry in Purgatory
details.short_description: After dying under mysterious circumstances, Isobel awakens in the afterlife... with a dangerous mission. Explore a strange world of mystery, character and heart as you uncover Purgatory's secrets in Poetry in Purgatory, the first part of The Dead Poetry Trilogy of visual novels.

details.title: Hi Planet Save The Earth
details.short_description: Six explosive chapters. Thirty-one stages. Smash through robot swarms and battle a boss at the end of every comic-book chapter. Every chapter is a battle.

details.title: State Breakers
details.short_description: State Breakers is a chaotic top-down PvPvE extraction shooter. INTERSTATE A.I. has turned against humanity! They must be infiltrated and destroyed! Resist solo or in a team - kill zombies, hack the map, outwit rival humans, loot, level up - and overthrow the clanker scum!

details.title: Dino Warband
details.short_description: Build your dinosaur warband! Recruit, evolve, and position prehistoric giants and pack hunters, then watch your strategy clash with rival beasts. Adapt between battles and take down mighty bosses in this thrilling single-player auto battler.

details.title: A Cultivator's Death
details.short_description: A text-based litrpg where choices matter and death is permanent. Experience the brutal survival of a weakling, or the moral trappings of a hero. See what it really takes. Achieve A Cultivator's Death.

details.title: Lost Legends
details.short_description: Lost Legends is a roguelike card game set across seven hand-painted kingdoms. Choose your Kingdom, build your deck, and explore a world that is randomly generated every run. Destroy the heart of Darkness in 7 days or the world ends.

details.title: Idle Mage: Conquest
details.short_description: An idle incremental RPG where a mage battles through escalating waves across multiple zones. Master five elemental spell schools, defeat bosses, craft gear, and Ascend for permanent power. Optimize your build, watch the carnage unfold, and keep conquering while you're away

details.title: Come Pick Me Up
details.short_description: Your sister texts you from a hospital after visiting hours. She needs you to pick her up. Search the wards, follow her messages, examine belongings and piece together unsettling records in this first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: Fortress of the Fallen II
details.short_description: Build by day. Fight by night. Lead one of six heroes through a branching campaign of thirteen outposts. Rebuild each fortress, carry research forward, and fight beside towers and troops. Then face eighteen nights of Classic Defense and its unlockable challenges.

details.title: Crown & Courtiers
details.short_description: Rule a medieval kingdom through the people around your throne. Hear petitions, bargain with nobles and clergy, and take part in hunts, tournaments and feasts. Manage supplies, weather crises and pass the crown—and your unfinished promises—to the next ruler.

details.title: White Lotus: Vows Beneath Heaven
details.short_description: A historical narrative management game set in eighteenth-century China. Guide a White Lotus community through fragile livelihoods, conflicting loyalties, and promises that come due. Plan each turn, care for your companions, and shape the lives they leave behind.

name: The Good Stuff: Story of a True Hero

details.title: The Good Stuff: Story of a True Hero
details.short_description: The Good Stuff is a rich-story, contemporary RPG set in the colorful, unassuming suburb of Cheddertown. The game is a grounded RPG, mixing typical turn based combat with optional dynamic gameplay, for a truly unassuming experience. Learn what it means to be a true hero in this quirky RPG!

details.title: Luckforge
details.short_description: The House always wins. Unless the whole table cheats. Luckforge is a co-op casino auto-battler for 1-4 players, online or on one couch. Spin a cursed slot machine for heroes, merge three into one, line them up and watch them clash. What could possibly go wrong?

details.title: Overgrid
details.short_description: Overgrid is a tactical tower defense game where capturing the territory is just as important as defending it. Build and upgrade your defenses, capture strategic locations, and unlock new technologies across a 30-mission campaign set in the middle of a war between artificial intelligences.

details.title: Woollings
details.short_description: Tiny sheep turn your desktop windows into a cozy little civilization. Discover 20 unique sheep, watch nests and bridges take shape, and enjoy their gentle company while you work or study. Lend a helping hand, or let the flock find its own way.

details.title: Ghost Trap: Underworld
details.short_description: John Ghost is back with a vengeance in this retro-metroidvania. But this time, he's going to hell. Explore the underworld, face its horrors, and fight to bring peace to the tortured souls of your loved ones.

details.title: Dustwire
details.short_description: The machines took over Wirehaven, a bright overgrown city, and now they hunt you. Drop in solo or in a squad of up to 3, loot, fight hunter drones and giant machine bosses, beat rival squads to extraction... or lose everything except the one item in your Safe Pocket.

details.title: Oh No, Meteor!
details.short_description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

details.title: Gift Shop Organizer
details.short_description: Unpack boxes, discover charming items, and find a place for every piece in a cozy little gift shop. Upgrade your skills to make organizing easier, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting things in order. No timers, no penalties - just time to unwind.

details.title: Bannertide
details.short_description: A compact, replayable fantasy strategy game. Choose your difficulty and faction, march your armies along a branching network of roads, and capture mines, dwellings, and castles. Defeat your rivals and claim the entire island!

details.title: Warlords of Archaios Online
details.short_description: Command the Kingdoms, Orcs, Undead, or Elves in a fantasy RTS with pixel art. Build your base, equip your warlords, and conquer camps. Battle alone or online across randomly generated maps with changing weather, day and night, and natural disasters.

details.title: kitty Limited Trade Union
details.short_description: Run a guild of cats in this pixel-art incremental game. Hunt monsters with clicks or recruit cats to fight for you. Earn gold, plan your talents, mix drinks and forge weapons as your guild grows with each rebirth.

details.title: Prisma Orbits
details.short_description: A puzzle game with just two controls. Red, green and blue stars circle on their own — all you can do is slide every star outward or inward at once. Steer them past walls, vines, water and wormholes until all three lights meet and become a single white star.

details.title: Operation Crimson
details.short_description: A story-driven top-down action shooter. Venture into hazardous zones consumed by a biological catastrophe, battle mutated creatures of all shapes and sizes with firearms and melee weapons, and gradually uncover the truth behind the disaster as you advance through tense, tightly paced linear levels.

details.title: Tongyou Town
details.short_description: A town that runs itself. You decide who ventures out, where they go, and what the town sells. Recruit, form squads, farm regions, craft gear, and run the market — the rest happens without you.

details.title: Idle Caravan
details.short_description: A cozy idle adventure you can play in a small desktop window. Ride your giant bison across a magical world, deliver packages, discover creatures, and let your journey continue while you do other things.

details.title: SPEARHEAD
details.short_description: Eastern Front, 1944. Command the entire battle as a commander — then climb into your ace tank and fight it out yourself. real penetration physics where armor thickness, impact angle, and ammunition decide everything. WW2 RTS and tank simulation collide in a single battle.

details.title: Joseon Delivery
details.short_description: Walk and run across the eight provinces of Joseon-era Korea as a courier. From the stone-wall lanes of Jeju to the foothills of Geumgangsan, carry parcels and letters, hear the story behind each one, and collect a song from every town. A cozy journey on foot, with no combat and no failure.

details.title: Brawliens
details.short_description: Punch your friends off a flying saucer. Sneak snacks past a sleeping cat. Race karts across a giant kitchen. Brawliens is a first-person party game for 2–8 players online: 43 minigames, sneaky gadgets and one FINAL BRAWL where even the leader can lose.

details.title: Duke Saith
details.short_description: A fantasy island city-builder where elves, vampires, and minotaurs live together. Meet the Duke's demands or his fall will unleash the Empire's legions, manage each race's Mind gauge to prevent arson and strikes, run train logistics, and grow strong enough to claim independence!

name: 深夜閲覧 Midnight Reading：Showa Echoes

details.title: 深夜閲覧 Midnight Reading：Showa Echoes
details.short_description: Midnight Reading is a short horror adventure set in a Showa-era Japanese school. As a library committee member, search for overdue books. Read, return, and make choices as the story branches into three routes and a True Route.

details.title: Hearts Gone Black
details.short_description: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down zombie survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world. Manage your base and survivors, scavenge, gather resources, craft equipment, and defend against infected while endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices can slowly wear you down.

details.title: Dust & Dig
details.short_description: Dig anywhere for buried treasure, wrestle rattlesnakes with fully physics-driven hands, and haul the loot back to town to sell. Buy bigger shovels, follow legendary treasure maps and take on three desert bosses: alone, or in online co-op with up to 3 friends.

details.title: OCULUM
details.short_description: OCULUM is a challenging first-person platformer set within a strange and unsettling world. Every step is a gamble, and every mistake is brutal. Climb toward the summit, uncover its secrets, and face whatever is waiting above. Will you endure?

details.title: One Step Higher
details.short_description: This is a 3D platformer where you must utilize the unique traits of two distinct spheres. Switch between them on the fly in 3D scenes to overcome challenging obstacles. There are currently 21 playable levels.

details.title: Portopia Serial Murder Case
details.short_description: The legendary "THE PORTOPIA SERIAL MURDER CASE" is reborn! Under the executive direction of Yuji Horii comes an all-new entry featuring five brand-new investigation files. Set in 1980s Kobe, conduct your investigation alongside a new cast of characters and uncover the secrets hidden behind the case.

details.title: MMA Career Simulator
details.short_description: Create your MMA fighter, develop their skills, build winning game plans, and promote yourself to a global MMA superstar. Every fight is simulated based on your preparation and in-fight decisions, where smart choices can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

details.title: ONE MAN'S DECEIT
details.short_description: One Man's Deceit is a survival horror first-person game where you are on a mission to find a missing friend. Explore a world filled with secrets, search for clues, follow your instincts, survive deadly encounters, and fight different creatures on your journey.

details.title: Videogame Automation Engineer
details.short_description: In this visual programming game, you become a video game tester for different clients. Using intuitive image sensors and logic wiring, you automate a vast collection of minigames to make your circuit press the right virtual gamepad buttons at the right time.

details.title: MOM SAID DON'T OPEN
details.short_description: The whole night lies ahead! Lock the door. Don't open it to strangers. Some have come to help. Some simply knocked on the wrong door. And some... have come for you. Remember — a locked door won't always save you.

details.title: Tiny Takedowns
details.short_description: The Rebels thought they had their shrinking weapon under control, until the Spies turned it against them! Uncover the Spies or cause chaos as a Rebel in Tiny Takedowns! With unique skills and chaotic rounds, every match offers a fresh and thrilling experience.

details.title: Game Over: Spring
details.short_description: Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and step into the future your choices create. In this first-person narrative adventure spanning 1963 to 2087, a thriving greenhouse can become a lifeless room. Return to pivotal decisions and discover what could have been.

details.title: Broke2Blocks: Crypto Mining Simulator
details.short_description: Start in your parents' basement with a single USB stick miner. Plug in every cable yourself and sell your coins. Move into an old gym, then into a huge warehouse full of racks. Buy broken miners on the black market, fix them screw by screw and keep the heat under control.

details.title: MINSK: APOCALYPSE
details.short_description: Survive apocalyptic Minsk. Manage health, food and water: search for resources or complete missions to stay alive. Fight demons, Templars and criminal factions as you investigate the apocalypse and those responsible. A survival adventure in development.

details.title: MATCHO
details.short_description: MATCHO is a narrative first-person action adventure. Tag targets, build chains, and execute combos with an innovative real-time Match-3 combat. Join Max as he fights through an alien invasion, uncovers the truth behind his illness, and races to find a cure before Earth falls under alien control.

details.title: Uncover Space
details.short_description: An incremental idle game where you fling asteroids and comets into the dust that hides planets, moons and suns. Every broken stone pays for more projectiles and upgrades, and your shots keep breaking dust while you are away.

details.title: Keep the night
details.short_description: Build your fortress by day and defend it by night. Construct walls, recruit troops, draw powerful cards, and lead your hero into battle against ever-growing enemy armies.

details.title: Railtown
details.short_description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

details.title: Nessi
details.short_description: Explore Loch Ness alone or with up to three friends in a first-person horror investigation. Gather evidence, photograph sightings and upgrade your boat and equipment. Try your best to prove the existance of the Loche Ness Monster.

details.title: SWIFTNESS
details.short_description: This game is all about speed and not getting eaten by the spreading corruption.

name: Ganja Ricochet: Cut Kush. Make Cash.

details.title: Ganja Ricochet: Cut Kush. Make Cash.
details.short_description: A chaotic 3D pinball-pachinko game: cut Kush, build combos, unlock 12 scissors, 12 plants, 12 pots, tons of upgrades, and defeat 4 Boss Plants.

details.title: Sushi Bar Manager
details.short_description: Run a conveyor-belt sushi shop in Japan. Buy fish, keep the plates moving, wash every dish and pay the bills each night. Hire staff, decorate, survive bad weather and clumsy customers, and see how many days your shop can last. 🍣🥢

name: Two Demon Catgirls: A Nocturne of Evil

details.title: Two Demon Catgirls: A Nocturne of Evil
details.short_description: 🍂🍷A mystical and devilish visual novel about two demonic catgirls, a lonely author, and the nature of Evil — with music, philosophy, dark humor, and hand-painted gouache artwork.

details.title: The Window Across
details.short_description: Three days before her childhood home is demolished, Emi relearns the secret language she once spoke through a window with a boy across the courtyard: lamp light and cardboard shadows. A pixel-art story about the things we never said. Demo coming soon.

details.title: Duelike
details.short_description: Duelike is a poker roguelike where you play cards across three zones, build poker hands, and use card abilities to bend the rules. Win 2 of 3 zones, upgrade your deck between battles, and later test your build in online PvP.

details.title: Eternal Anima
details.short_description: Embark on an adventure across eras in this love letter to JRPGs. Journey between the past and present to uncover the truth behind a lost history. Control your fate in turn-based combat by using Future Sight to foresee enemy actions and strategically rewrite the future.

details.title: Scrapman Simulator
details.short_description: Start by collecting cardboard from the streets, turn scrap metal into cash, upgrade your home and vehicle, and grow your business. Build your own recycling empire by playing solo or with your friends in a living city inspired by Istanbul.

details.title: Barty's Adventure
details.short_description: The world resets every three days, but not everything has to be forgotten. Choose what carries into the next loop as you uncover secrets in a cozy metroidvania set in a world of children's toys.

details.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
details.short_description: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. A dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA. Wield acrobatic Chinese martial arts and conquer the vast battlefields of the Three Kingdoms, where mighty generals and demons stand in your way.

name: Unity Sanctuary: Rampage of the Void

details.title: Unity Sanctuary: Rampage of the Void
details.short_description: This is a roguelike tower defense action strategy game where you must protect Unity-chan as she is forced to march toward “initialization.” Players use weapons and skills to fend off the hordes targeting Unity-chan as she charges forward on her own.

details.title: Shitty Shift: Toilet Sim
details.short_description: Even a public toilet has a probation period! Collect entrance fees, deal with bizarre visitors, clean up disgusting messes, or just relax on the couch and let the chaos unfold. Will you become employee of the month or the laziest toilet attendant in town? It's your shift. Your rules.

details.title: Code Grid
details.short_description: Place instructions on a grid, plan the path, and let the machine follow your logic. CodeGrid is a programming puzzle game with no traditional coding required—use simple commands to build loops, conditions, and data processing, then create increasingly complex programs within a limited space.

details.title: Building to the Sky
details.short_description: A tower-building management sim you can read like an architect's drawing. Build a classic side-on 2D tower or a 3D landmark you can slice open floor by floor, run it for thousands of tenants, and switch any time between rendered, blueprint and CAD views.

details.title: SRD: Slightly Random Dungeons
details.short_description: A tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) simulator. Gather a company of quarrelsome mercenaries and set forth through the adventures of the Guilds and Gutters Campaign setting, or use the intuitive adventure building tools to craft your own campaign to challenge your friends or unleash upon the world.

details.title: Desk Fantasy
details.short_description: Desk Fantasy is an anime idle companion that lives in a transparent window on your desktop. While you work, Noa auto-battles mischievous yokai on a tropical island. Grow her on a 75-node Evolution Grid, roll dice in a 10-chapter visual novel and find one of 4 endings.

details.title: Lonely Dung Beetle
details.short_description: You are the only dung beetle for miles. Roll your ball, crack open treasures, and explore a big little world full of neighbours who need your help. A cosy game about rolling, collecting and never being lonely again.

details.title: CRUCIBLE OF THE ABYSS
details.short_description: Slot, fuse, and discover. A dark fantasy first-person dungeon crawler where you build every action from parts, melt them together into new powers, and descend fifty floors into the abyss.

details.title: Trine 6: Together in Time
details.short_description: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fairytale world.

details.title: Breaker League
details.short_description: Puzzle-battle mayhem on one shared board. Drop pieces, chain combos, and invade your rivals' turf in frantic 1–4 player matches online or on the couch. 37 ridiculous fighters, 12 game-changing specials, and a 32-level story campaign.

details.title: Megabait
details.short_description: A brutal top-down obstacle course where every second counts. Master precise movement to survive deadly hazard rooms, leave a bloody trail of your past mistakes, and uncover every secret on your path to 100% completion.

details.title: Necro Heist
details.short_description: Turn the casualties of war into an undead looting empire. Raise your skeleton army from battlefield corpses, steal fallen riches, and grow your necromantic power through a vast skill tree. In Necro Heist, every battle fuels your incremental rise.

details.title: Folders On The Run
details.short_description: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

details.title: BreakFree
details.short_description: A first-person block breaker from 1995: you are the paddle. Keep your fireballs alive and break the walls of 72 levels. Chase medals and the Daily Challenge, or build levels for Steam Workshop. Runs natively on modern PCs, with the original DOS game included.

details.title: FSPunch
details.short_description: A physics party brawler for the living room and LAN party. Animals in boxing gloves punch, kick and carry each other off crumbling platforms. Play brawler, scooter, dodgeball, scooterball or soccer, build your own maps, and settle it in splitscreen or over LAN.

details.title: Dungelo
details.short_description: One dungeon a day, the same for everyone. Dungelo is a turn-based pixel roguelike you can finish in 15 minutes: read what each monster is about to do, answer it, and beat the floor 5 boss. Your first run counts on the daily board. Yesterday's best set today's challenge. Difficulty shifts with you.

details.title: RoboSquare: Recharged
details.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

details.title: Spinvestor
details.short_description: Spinvestor is a fun, risk-free alternative to winning millions while gambling in a casino where the house doesn't have the edge for once. Win big, invest in stocks, and run your own businesses while becoming the highest ranking VIP at Steak, the best casino where the house always loses.

details.title: Moltenfall
details.short_description: Moltenfall is a fast-paced survival roguelite set in a world where every pixel is simulated. Fight increasingly dangerous swarms of enemies, collect experience and grow stronger with every upgrade. Watch your step as collapsing terrain, acid, lava and other materials reshape the world around you.

details.title: I Launch
details.short_description: This is a game that lets you relive the experience of what it was like before you were born, alongside your goofy friends.

details.title: Radical Centrists
details.short_description: A deckbuilder where your cards are real politicians with questionably historical abilities. Discover new combos and accumulate wealth and influence. Push your luck with volatile politicians and make sure your party doesn't go off the deep end!

details.title: Touhou: Don't Spill It!
details.short_description: One jar of water, two friends, and all of Gensokyo trying to make you spill it. Cirno dashes across the road, fairies throw stars, barrels roll in. Stop short and the water surges over the rim; a hard knock cracks the jar. What's left at the finish is your score. A Touhou Project fan game.

details.title: Towerworks
details.short_description: Build your tower floor by floor and watch tenants move in. Grab a mop, fix what’s broken and keep the lifts moving. Hire staff when you can afford it, a manager when you can’t keep up, another tower when you’re ready. It looks cozy but the sim is unforgiving if you overborrow or disaster strikes.

details.title: Wobblebound
details.short_description: A physics stacking roguelite where every toy has a face. Draft toys and lucky charms at every bell, spend coins at the toy shop and beat six bosses as one of six toymakers. Then race friends or robots, or build one tower together, with up to four players on one PC or online.

details.title: Wispward
details.short_description: The cloaked spirits on your road aren't attacking. They're fleeing. Hold the road for 120 levels of tower defense: lumberjacks and miners earn the Smoke that builds towers, masons lay free tower foundations, barricaders trap the road. 21 fully voiced story videos ask what they're fleeing.

name: FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That

details.title: FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That
details.short_description: Your files are coming for you! Become a weaponized Recycle Bin, blast endless waves of hostile data, collect powerful perks, and survive the ultimate digital apocalypse in this chaotic bullet heaven roguelite!

details.title: Rus: source
details.short_description: Historical novel with RPG-elements about the Origins of the Rus’ state. Four knyazes. Four lives. The only mystery. Your decisions influence on who you are going to become, and who you are in the new circle.

details.title: Nocta
details.short_description: "Before the beginning, Time and Nothingness danced..." Become Nocta, the Embodiment of Time, and safeguard Creation from the abyssal hands of the Void in an original cosmic creation myth. Hand-drawn stained-glass art by 花凛. Wishlist now!

details.title: Zero Distance
details.short_description: Fight overwhelming zombie hordes in a 3D bullet heaven where packing your case shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, gear and supplies to unleash fire, lightning and explosive combinations. Survive 20 minutes, defeat the boss and earn your extraction.

details.title: TOX-17
details.short_description: Analyze real video footage to solve a poisoning case. Discover the country, city, neighborhood and final location. Every detail may be a clue.

details.title: Eddie on Fire
details.short_description: Rescued at birth from a life of bondage, Eddie resolves to win his mother’s freedom from the tyranny of his father by defeating him when they meet in the arena. Join Eddie as he fights for his life in this non-combat adventure to dethrone a champion and rescue a slave.

details.title: Barbe-Yeux
details.short_description: A comedy narrative adventure in 6 chapters. Explore islands, lead your crew into battle, go fishing, play dice at the tavern and lose all your gold again. You play a captain convinced he's a legend, flanked by two companions whose entire vocabulary is almost "Gloubi".

details.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
