details.short_description: In "Ring Craft," you will play as a ring forging master, using various materials to add useful or useless attributes to the rings. You will explore the secrets of nutrition, oop, I mean, enchantment. Whether it's miracles-craft or disaster-craft, it's all up to you!

details.title: Tallawa Game Nights
details.short_description: A Caribbean Tabletop Game Collection. Slam dominoes, throw 3D dice around the room, team up as allies or betray them and challenge 10 different AI personalities with hidden grudges in Arcade and Story. No copy? No problem! Play together using your phones!

details.title: Pry Into The Void
details.short_description: Delve into the hearts of monsters and people in this bleak monster-taming RPG. Exploit enemy weaknesses, confront difficult moral choices, and recruit surreal creatures by uncovering the truths hidden within their souls.

details.title: Skyclimbers
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed universe.

details.title: Kakurenbo Neko
details.short_description: Kakurenbo Neko, a cozy hide & seek kitty collecting game.

details.title: NIA
details.short_description: Drill, smash, leap and slide through this 2d puzzle platformer mashing retro graphics & icepunk aesthetics. Explore dozens of hand crafted worlds in well over 100 different levels.

details.title: Hack The Stars
details.short_description: Earth, 2040. The powerful are quietly preparing to leave for the stars. Fly a drone into their facilities, plant access, then command AI agents from your illicit Shadow Cloud to breach layered networks, train stolen models and expose who gets to go.

details.title: TREAD: Arcade Tank Combat
details.short_description: Fast-paced top-down online tank battles where skill, teamwork, and strategy decide every fight. Customize your tank with specialized hulls and turrets, each with unique stats and abilities.

details.title: Midnight Horde
details.short_description: Leap, slash, and soar through gothic ruins in Midnight Horde, a high-mobility auto shooter where parkour meets reverse bullet hell. Battle through swarms of monstrosities, upgrade deadly weapons, and build strongholds to push back the creeping dark.

details.title: Insect Worlds
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of insects. Explore fascinating forests and learn about their way of life. Complete quests and mini-games, fight or collect resources and cards. Admire the microcosm from a completely different perspective and learn new facts about plants and insects.

details.title: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
details.short_description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

details.title: Omni Axes
details.short_description: Trust your instincts - evade, aim, and shoot! Omni Axes is a shooting game that takes place in a 3D space where you can take down an endless number of enemies coming from all directions.

details.title: Project Sundive
details.short_description: Project Sundive is wave-based arena auto-shooter roguelite, focusing on ship customization and ridiculously overpowered builds

details.title: Drift
details.short_description: Drift is a narrative sci-fi horror adventure set on a desolate deep-space outpost. With your mission gone horrifically wrong, you face an unspeakable, monstrous foe. Explore the station's dark recesses, restore failing systems, survive terrifying encounters, and confront your own tormented past.

details.title: Parkour Bot
details.short_description: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

details.title: Unwalkable
details.short_description: Unwalkable is a silly physics based open-ended puzzle platformer where you control a wobbly character. Without just one way to solve puzzles, you must use your imagination and ingenuity to create solutions to unthinkable problems.

details.title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
details.short_description: A 2D platform game that comes to life through the myths of the Huni Kuin people. Overcome challenges in the Amazon, use the knowledge of the shamans and explore the world of spirits in this adventure illustrated by indigenous artists.

details.title: Definitely a Unicorn
details.short_description: Startup chaos for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Everyone is a co-founder and everyone thinks they're the CEO. Ship it half-baked, bluff investors, fight over the last dollars. Become a unicorn — or a meme.

details.title: Homeplanet
details.short_description: Homeplanet is a space combat simulator with Newtonian physics and a story-driven campaign. Step into the boots of a combat pilot of the Troiden clan! Take part in the saga of exile from your home world—and the struggle to conquer a new one.

details.title: Civlands
details.short_description: Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom in this pixel-art real-time strategy game. Your people build, farm and haul on their own while you decide what matters. Trade with rivals or march on them, bind spells to your armies, and build a wonder worth defending. Reign well, or not for long.

details.title: Unexpected Tasks
details.short_description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

details.title: VoltHaven
details.short_description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

details.title: Situation Normal
details.short_description: You're a secret agent. Get in. Destroy the boss. Get the hell out. An action platformer where the faster you move, the more chaos you unleash at once.

details.title: Team Hero Coder
details.short_description: Assemble your team of heroes. Program their strategy with PseudoC or C#. Watch them battle in a classic RPG-inspired arena. Learn from what happens, and improve your code. Are you game to code?

details.title: Mad Chess
details.short_description: Mad Chess is a turn-based strategy game that vastly expands on the classic game of chess. Explore a colorful fantasy world, recruit up to 20 unique factions, fight-off an alien invasion in a single-player story mode or battle your friends online!

details.title: Psychonesis
details.short_description: Psychonesis is a survival extraction pursuit co-op game where you play as patients imprisoned by an evil billion dollar corporation. Betrayed by those you trusted most, you must outsmart and outmaneuver their private security in this ultimate prison break/police chase game!

name: Suburban Manager:From Corner Store to Regional Price Cartel & Supply Chain Trust

details.title: Suburban Manager:From Corner Store to Regional Price Cartel & Supply Chain Trust
details.short_description: Suburban Manager is a hardcore supermarket sim based on Chinese business logic. Scout locations in a 3D sandbox and build a gridless store. Procure goods via App, manage logistics, and handle realistic payrolls including net salary and social security. Experience a pure retail journey.

details.title: Dream Loop
details.short_description: A first-person music-puzzle adventure. Wander surreal dreamscapes, record the world around you, and mix what you find into original tracks. Turn up your headphones and drop out.
developers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc
publishers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc

details.title: Shrooms
details.short_description: Explore a dark isometric forest alone or in 1–4 player co-op. Gather and test hundreds of ingredients, brew potions and monster oils, build a home, and uncover why a dwarf village has held exactly thirty-four souls for two centuries.

details.title: Demon Spore
details.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

details.title: Trailthread
details.short_description: Trailthread is a turn-based JRPG where players weave together brand-new attacks each turn. Follow three young adventurers as they scale Anvite Mountain and tumble through time to defeat the Obsidian Drake. Use game-changing Augments to cast dynamic combos and carve your path to the summit!

details.title: VoidMania
details.short_description: A neon arcade territory game. Carve lines through the void and seal them to the wall to claim space, but if an enemy touches your open line, it burns. Trap the sector bosses, chain your cuts and reveal every sector across 48 levels.

details.title: Vampire Rancher
details.short_description: Rancher by day, Vampire by night. Manage your time and resources to restore your sleepy little town to its former glory, all while satisfying your vampire needs for blood. Oversee shops and saloons, farm crops and humans, and explore ancient vampiric ruins in the Weird Wild West!

details.title: Hexforger
details.short_description: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

details.title: Elemdian
details.short_description: A mystical action-adventure where you shift between human and wolf, combining elemental powers to cast powerful spells. Explore islands alongside a fairy survivor, and uncover the connection between a mysterious attack and a spreading Dark Mist.

details.title: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
details.short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant sim that starts on an empty lot. Build the dining room and the kitchen, choose from over 200 dishes and drinks from around the world and hire a team that knows how to make your menu. Win over the judges and take home awards.

details.title: Hell Games
details.short_description: Get ready for Hell Games: In this action packed player vs player arena brawler 4 fallen athletes, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Knock out opponents with sports gear, power up, and strive to be the last one standing.

details.title: Fantastic Haven
details.short_description: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.

details.title: A Little Less Desperation
details.short_description: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

details.title: My Paper Plane Is Better
details.short_description: Throw a paper plane into a city built for flight. Every run you finish becomes a track, and other players race your ghost on it. Skim rooftops, thread alleys, pop balloons and chase the longest glide.

details.title: Notoris 2: Warlords
details.short_description: A dark meets high fantasy strategy RPG. Play as ruler, administrator, or officer. Wield influence to sway allies and rivals alike. Command vast armies in tense tactical turn-based battles. Inspired by the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

details.title: Wishbound
details.short_description: An ancient djinn has awakened but some bonds are stronger than magic! Help Erika and her friends face the supernatural together in this story-driven turn-based RPG. Explore the city, customise your party and uncover mysteries. Every moment brings you closer to saving the city - and each other.

details.title: INFINITE CHUMP
details.short_description: INFINITE CHUMP is an ultra-fast, boomer shooter roguelite tripfest where you graft spell-casting arms to your body. Put rings on your new fingers to create spells on the fly. Inspired by 90's FPS games with a trippy twist.

details.title: Head Chef
details.short_description: Head Chef is a restaurant management game. Supply the kitchen, select your staff, overcome challenges, create a delicious menu and… cook! Make your guests happy and find your way to the stars. Keep control of your team and finances, because the higher you climb, the harder you fall.

details.title: Limbival
details.short_description: One moment you're under a guillotine, the next you've lost every limb. The crowd wants a show. You want to survive. Rip the limbs off circus monsters, attach them to yourself, master them, and clear wave after wave to escape the circus.

details.title: Kardaviik
details.short_description: Kardaviik is a 3D factory automation game set in a voxel asteroid belt. Your mission: harness energy, ascend the Kardashev Scale, and save Earth. Conquer the expansive procedurally generated belt by harvesting resources and extracting fuel, and build your ultimate space factory!

details.title: Arctic Unrest
details.short_description: Arctic Unrest is an intense experience of survival set in a hand-crafted frozen arctic world. Hunting, fishing, building, crafting & fighting are required to survive. Vehicles & Parkour & Traversal system enable you to explore the vast frigid world. Wishlist it Today. Keep frosty & Keep Alive

details.title: Ascent: Rivals
details.short_description: Ascent Rivals is an Award-Winning Indie Combat Racer. Race. Shoot. Upgrade. Outplay Your Rivals.

details.title: Decurion
details.short_description: Decurion is a skill-based, top-down shooter about scoring under a one-shot, one-kill rule. You get the score via combo chaining while trying to defend your base.

details.title: Squid Grid
details.short_description: Each puzzle reveals a ray of light scattered across this moody hand-inked Steampunk Ocean. Can you crack the peculiar yet (eventually) obvious logic of the Squid Grid?

details.title: Glitch Core
details.short_description: In the far future where AI has been deemed too dangerous and sent to the moon, you play as a rogue AI agent fighting through battle simulations to unravel the true purpose of your design in this tactical, immersive, procedural FPS rogue lite with split screen co-op where the code FIGHTS BACK!

details.title: Legends of Castile
details.short_description: To fulfill her dream of becoming a nun, María de Salazar must outsmart the creatures of Castilian folklore using her wit and a mysterious bestiary in this comic fantasy point‑and‑click adventure set in 19th‑century Spain.

details.title: Snap Quest
details.short_description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

details.title: Stop the Crawl
details.short_description: Stop the Crawl is a roguelike autobattler where you assemble a deck of monsters to defeat the invading heroes. Discover which monsters work well together, strengthen them with items, and create an unstoppable team.

details.title: No Humanity - Internship
details.short_description: No Humanity - InternShip is a chaotic physics-based space survival game where interns swing, smash, and build their way to survival. Use rope mechanics to collect resources, battle enemies, and expand your space colony. Explore humorous cave biomes and survive absurd corporate tasks in deep space.

details.title: Western Brawl
details.short_description: In a quiet western town, the righteous gunslinger Hannah finds herself surrounded by enemies from all directions inside a saloon. Draw your revolver, take down waves of ruthless outlaws, and fight your way through intense gunfights to carve out a path to survival!

details.title: Razgovor Online
details.short_description: Razgovor Online is a Social MMORPG-Lite open world game, providing ways to explore, socialise, and grow, with Jobs, Mini-Games and player housing, or even taking long drives with your friends, the freedom is yours!

details.title: Lady Hunt
details.short_description: Lady Hunt is a pixel art action platformer, set in a dark gothic world, where blood has been infected. You play as a huntress, who must find a way to purify this world, inhabited by monsters and beasts.

details.title: Dungeon Roll
details.short_description: Descend beneath your family estate to uncover the truth about the crusader heroes of your bloodline, re-rolling your path floor by floor through a labyrinth built on real Crusades history. The souls of legendary crusaders grant you boons and the seven deadly sins guard the way down.

details.title: Echoes of the Stars
details.short_description: Confront fate and the gods themselves in Echoes of the Stars, a 2D Handpainted Action RPG. Explore diverse biomes, gain new skills, fight challenging foes, unlock new abilities, play mini-games, and unfold the epic journey of Eldric and Rin.

details.title: 光影の塔
details.short_description: An online 3D shooting game where players divided into 2 teams, "Light" and "Shadow" and buttles 4 vs 4 in max. Players ride on a machine which moves automatically and occupy "Tower" which are placed in stages. It is important for players to get power up items and weapons in the stage.

details.title: Train Kingdom
details.short_description: This is a railway history simulation game.Set in the United States of the 19th century. Get a railroad network that connects cities in the pioneering America. Use locomotives to carry supplies, passengers, and get money through trade. Complete various quests and gain fame.

details.title: Taste Of Heaven
details.short_description: Taste of heaven is a 2D cooking RPG with a pinch of roguelite ! Master the art of crafting dishes for celestial gourmets while forging bonds with a cast of unforgettable characters. Discover hidden recipes and explore a vibrant, ever-changing world brimming with charm and mystery.

name: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon

details.title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
details.short_description: Squad-based tactical RPG, with auto turn-based combat and real-time-with-pause map movement. Build your army, defend your territory, and unite Wales against the English invaders. Inspired by classic JRPGs including Ogre Battle and Ogre Battle 64.

details.title: Luminescence
details.short_description: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

details.title: First Spartan
details.short_description: Zeus has banished his ancient enemies into a parallel world – and they are about to break free. Enter as a warrior without gear, survive, build and craft, and reawaken the energy temples. A co-op action survival RPG in a procedural world inspired by Greek mythology.

details.title: Tiny Planet Protectors
details.short_description: Welcome to the TPPA! The galaxy is yours to explore. Unfortunately, you owe the company that owns it. Take strange jobs across alien worlds, discover bizarre anomalies, and rebuild a bar on a tiny asteroid.

details.title: Contract Cafe
details.short_description: A letter from your Master brings a mysterious girl into your life. But the first thing you need to face is a café that could go out of business at any moment. Amidst your efforts to rescue the café and navigate peculiar customers, secrets about the shop begin to surface...

details.title: Deep Sea Sweep
details.short_description: Switch between free movement and platforming while carrying heavy treasures to navigate each level. Swim, jump and bonk meanies on their head in more than a 100 short but challenging levels with tight controls. Clean up the sea of all these filthy treasures chests plaguing the various biomes!

details.title: Re:Connect
details.short_description: Re:Connect is a programming puzzle adventure set in a digital world, where you connect code to change the rules! Become a Debug AI, solve electronic circuit puzzles, and set off on a grand adventure to repair the “Heart Bugs” of the AIs!

details.title: Sapphobos
details.short_description: Sapphobos is a mystery and horror VR game. Explore, find clues, make deductions, choose the right conclusions, and maybe you will understand what happened to your missing colleague...

details.title: THE BACKWORLDS
details.short_description: RUN, JUMP, ESCAPE. Endlessly high buildings of dead ruins are towering over a giant chasm of green mist. But the reality of our world is seeping in, and some familiar places are now stuck there. This is how you are invited there - against your will. Enter the hostile realm of the BACKWORLDS.

details.title: Wick & Slate
details.short_description: Descend into a malice-soaked underworld in this intensely oppressive single-player "loot, fight, extract" roguelite deckbuilder. Play as a Stone Folk hero, battling monsters in a grotesque gamble. Build your deck mid-run, scavenge eyeballs and skulls, dissect bosses for mystery rewards.

details.title: 仙侠涤尘箓
details.short_description: 《Xian Xia Di Chen Lu》is an open world ARPG game that includes real-time combat, dating development, and multiple plot side options. Its unique feature is that the combat system adopts a rare move mode in RPG genre, hoping to bring players a different experience.
developers: 常州市华蓝德软件科技有限公司
publishers: 常州市华蓝德软件科技有限公司

details.title: Folder Dungeon
details.short_description: What if your desktop was a dungeon? Explore folders, slay bugs, collect relics, modify them and create broken combos in this OS-themed roguelike dungeon crawler!

name: Primland The Magus -プリムランド　ザ　メイガス-

details.title: Primland The Magus -プリムランド　ザ　メイガス-
details.short_description: A dark fantasy 2D action game that revolves around the mysterious girl Magus and a desolate island which was turned into hell! Collect mementos and acquire skills. Dive into a thrilling world of action as you face mysteries and tough foes!

details.title: Card Shards
details.short_description: Your cards, your rules! Create your own cards and immerse yourself in a world of limitless creativity. Challenge opponents, discover new strategies and become the architect of your own legend. Ready for your adventure?

details.title: 遥遥领先
details.short_description: You transmigrated back to the 1980s, you decided to start a business and accurately seized every opportunity for success. You hired legendary managers to work for you, allowing your products to dominate both the national and global markets. Eventually, you became a "far ahead" business legend.

details.title: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134
details.short_description: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is an intense horror/puzzle adventure game for PC and VR, set in an abandoned Soviet bunker. Seek safety by restoring power, lights, and machinery. Learn about the long-gone personnel, solve sinister riddles, and find a way to escape. But stay quiet... You’re not alone.

details.title: End Of World - Story
details.short_description: Colony Sim meets 2D Sci-fi Action RPG in End Of World - Story. Manage your space farm and recruit colonists among Space Apes, Sentient Penguins, Humans or Cyborg Beasts. Go on missions to exotic locations armed with quantum bombs, find the relic and triumph. Inspired by Among Us, Cult of the Lamb.

details.title: Turkeygeddon: Feast of Fury
details.short_description: A co-op, bullet-heaven, twin-stick shooter for 1-8 players - blast turkey swarms, fight bosses, dodge arena hazards, and build ridiculous loadouts by leveling up and purchasing items in the shop.

details.title: Boom Die Repeat
details.short_description: Blast zombies & mutants in this fast-paced post-apocalyptic top-down roguelite! Run, dodge, and shoot through randomized biomes while combining weapons, loadouts, and mutations into ridiculous builds. Mutations makes you strong, but come with a price. Die, unlock perks, and dive into a brutal run!

details.title: The Bakerville Case
details.short_description: Get ready for a first-person horror, adventure and survival experience, enter the darkness in this adventure inspired by true events and enjoy incredible graphics generated in real time with Unity engine. Play as Thomas Baker and explore a remote town to discover the terrible evil that awaits there.

details.title: Dark Tidings Online
details.short_description: A classic, Tiny-MMORPG experience. From a penniless nobody dropped with no memories into an unknown world, to a hero ... or a villain? Join a faction of your choice and learn a wide array of skills. Help out villagers in need, battle in the wilds and explore dungeons. Alone or with friends!

details.title: Divided Land
details.short_description: Explore a vast medieval world haunted by the undead. Craft gear, build a settlement, farm, and tame animals as you develop your skills. Adventure alone or join other players to reclaim cursed lands, restore life to the wilderness, and defend what you've built.

details.title: Compicactus
details.short_description: Compi is a little cactus on your windowsill, and it wants to keep a diary. Help it write about your days with a few taps: the people you love, what you did and how you felt. Watch it grow and bloom, dress it up, and read your days as Compi saw them.

details.title: NAME OF THE WILL
details.short_description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

name: Burial for a Butterfly - a Singing World

details.title: Burial for a Butterfly - a Singing World
details.short_description: Learn to listen to the melody of this singing world and explore an ongoing slice of life story of my personal experience seeking refuge in the woods, befriending trees, talking with mysterious doomer owls, burying a butterfly and grieving the dying of species and forests.

details.title: Nowhere Manor
details.short_description: House of stolen devil bargains and indolent angelic aristocracy: Nowhere Manor is doomed to disappear. You can leave if you’ve got a soul … but that’s not an option for an artificially created servant such as Liber. Just how far are you willing to go escape?

details.title: Whispers of West Grove
details.short_description: You're trapped in a psychiatric hospital. Your dreams are turning into nightmares. And your flashlight can change reality. Explore the twisted worlds of West Grove, solve puzzles that defy expectations, and use your strange new power to escape. Just remember: every world plays by different rules.

details.title: Galactic Diner
details.short_description: Galactic Diner is a cooking-themed RPG full of minigame mayhem. Explore a planet full of friends, food, and mysteries, and cook your way to the top of the galaxy!

details.title: VICE Undercover
details.short_description: VICE Undercover is a point & click narco-thriller set in an alternate 1980s Miami - where every choice matters. You play as undercover agent Vida, and for one hour per day, you're taking control over a cartel-run computer using Amigo OS, a fully-functional 1980-inspired operating system.

details.title: Galaxy Gang
details.short_description: JUMP into the Ultimate Universe as Danny, a ten‑year‑old kid who suddenly finds himself wrapped up in a cosmic adventure way bigger than he ever expected. Galaxy Gang gives you a fast, colorful introduction to the worlds, characters, and movement that define the game.

details.title: Titan: The Ascension
details.short_description: Titan: The Ascension is a colony management strategy game on Saturn’s moon Titan. Build and expand an off-world industrial colony, extract ice to produce water for Earth, trade resources, and defend against ancient automated systems that react to technology growth. Will you prevail?

details.title: Fire and Brim Co.
details.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

details.title: Fantasy Boy
details.short_description: Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Car Rental Simulator tests your skills in management, marketing, and fulfilling customers' unexpected needs. Solo or in co-op! Grow a small rental company into a true empire in Winston Springs.

details.title: HexLands
details.short_description: Forge an island kingdom one card at a time. Each card you play raises a farm, mill, or harbor on procedural hex islands. Crack the challenge each new shore gives you before setting sail, carrying your relics and upgrades onward. No combat. The land, the weather, and your own draw are the challenge.

details.title: Optiminer
details.short_description: Optiminer is a minimalist incremental about mining radioactive materials. Dig through the rock to extract raw ore and radioactive materials, then pour it all into a branching upgrade tree and go deeper.

details.title: Lexomancy
details.short_description: A fantastical deckbuilding rouguelike, all packed into a traditional word game. Play as a Lexomancer, a magic user who can channel their power through Runic Tiles, and venture fourth on a quest to find the ever elusive Necrolexicon

details.title: Undercroft
details.short_description: A first-person pixel-art roguelite. Climb a dead king's castle from its sewers to his throne as one of three heroes, through rooms laid out fresh every run. Read each enemy's tell, take what relics you find, and when you fall, start again from the camp.

details.title: Ants in Space!
details.short_description: A roguelike strategy game where you evolve and mutate your space ants to repel an invasion of asteroid termites! Combine fast-paced exploration of tiny planets with spaceship travel across the galaxy. Find the ultimate ant DNA combination to withstand the unstoppable force.

details.title: God Codex
details.short_description: A cinematic 2D pixel-art action adventure. Slay the Demon King, then awaken within her memories as two girls struggle against fate in a collapsing world. Heavy combat, environmental storytelling, and immersive cinematic presentation with almost no UI.

details.title: Your Momo
details.short_description: Shortstack, Interaction, Desktop Companion. Your Momo is a narrative, cozy desktop game. Talk with Momo through playful spanks on her butt and build a deeper bond. Unlock new items through conversation and watch her draw freely on your desktop as time passes.

details.title: Melody Flow
details.short_description: Catch the notes. Save the melody. Fly through procedurally generated musical worlds, dodge shifting obstacles, and compete for high scores in fast-paced arcade gameplay. Play solo or challenge a friend in split-screen multiplayer.

details.title: Fuel Needed
details.short_description: Race against time or other players through difficult levels full of obstacles.

details.title: STEEL CORE
details.short_description: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

details.title: Knights v Zombies
details.short_description: Knights. Zombies. Pirate ships. Giant robots. A chaotic 1-4 player couch co-op hack and slash that starts medieval and ends in maximum carnage. If that sounds like the ravings of a six-year-old, that's because it is! It was designed by a kid with crayons and built by his dad in Unreal Engine.

details.title: The Heretic's Seal
details.short_description: Two heretics. Sixty-six ways to break a seal. A dark party RPG where your equipment, gold, and levels carry forward — only the dungeon resets. Pick your pair. Descend. Survive. Or come back stronger.

details.title: The Deconsecration Initiative
details.short_description: A short incremental game about building a machine to kill a god. Fire your laser, collect the shards and grow your base. The god will corrupt your workers into slugs, crystal trees and worse. Put them to work anyway.

details.title: The Singular Ones
details.short_description: Help a group of teenagers with unique powers uncover the mystery of the Soul Mirror in this cozy logic mystery puzzle game. Place characters and objects in the right rooms at Corvane Academy by following a set of coexistence rules.

details.title: The Villages That Cave
details.short_description: With just three decisions before each battle, build a defence against creatures emerging from caves that turn your villages into more. In this turn-based strategy, exploit terrain, grant villages special powers, use wildcards to wipe out chunks, and upgrade your units and structures.

details.title: + SHORTCIRCUIT -
details.short_description: You've accidentally installed a virus on your old 90's computer! Run through your PC's folders and kill the virus before it deletes precious pictures of your dog!

details.title: ASTRA LIMES: Belt Operations
details.short_description: Command fleets in this indirect control RTS game set within treacherous asteroid belts. Easily design your own skirmishes for a quick 15-minute battle or dive into a campaign of high-risk surgical strikes and systematic border advancement.

details.title: 7Komada
details.short_description: A GAME TO BE PLAYED WITH ONE'S WHOLE LIFE. A killing game based on Werewolf and Mafia, set in an alternate-universe Europe. Your graduation trip is cut short with your entire class kidnapped and locked in an abandoned mansion. Figure out who's behind it, and who you can trust.

details.title: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
details.short_description: It's Wizard VS Wizard in this isometric arcade battle blaster! Dominate a gauntlet of Best-of-5 duels across unique, destructible arenas that change with every match. Out-maneuver rivals with your chosen fighter's special moves to an eclectic electronic score by inflexi0n.

details.title: Beep Beep Until You're Rich!
details.short_description: A cozy incremental treasure-hunting game about digging up buried loot with your metal detector, unlocking upgrades, and building a pirate fortune. Help Bia buy her very own pirate ship!

details.title: Final Signal
details.short_description: A signal has been detected deep inside the Backrooms. Go on your first mission with PATROL, explore levels, avoid entities, and work together to find John B., before all that's left of him is his Final Signal.

details.title: Crystal Siege
details.short_description: Explore, build turrets, and prepare your defenses. When night falls, face relentless waves of enemies to protect your crystal. Inspired by Kingdom Two Crowns and Terraria, Crystal Siege blends strategic Tower Defense with 2D action combat, where you must fight alongside your defenses to survive.

details.title: Medimon
details.short_description: Medimon is a medical-themed monster-taming RPG. Capture, battle, and evolve creatures symbolizing medical concepts, turning intricate organ systems and diseases into an interactive and captivating game experience. Dive in and make medicine an adventure!

details.title: Project: rEvolution
details.short_description: Project: rEvolution is a tower defense game set in a dystopian Cyberpunk world. With placeable and wieldable turrets, modular upgrades, and evolving enemies, it blends strategic depth and replayability, offering a fresh experience within the genre.

details.title: Speechbound - A language RPG
details.short_description: In Speechbound: a Language Learning RPG you'll step in the role of Zero to save the planet! Engage in a captivating narrative, battle formidable foes, tackle exciting language exercises, and discover the beauty of Babyl Moon. Learn a language, save the world!

details.title: The Facility
details.short_description: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

details.title: Bonds of the Zodiac
details.short_description: Rei, a grieving girl, is drawn into a mystical realm where the Zodiac spirits are bound by the Jade Emperor. Mediate their inner struggles and guide them toward freedom in a first-person journey steeped in myth, conflict, and emotion.

details.title: Rookie Taoist
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game rooted in Chinese folk traditions. Team up with 1–4 players to survive haunted locations, use ritual tools, uncover hidden truths, and escape the grip of evil. But beware—your arrival may only be the beginning of a greater nightmare...

details.title: Reng Azure Requiem
details.short_description: No jumping. Only 4-way teleportation. Travel through eras, collect Skill Gravestones, defeat bosses, explore armor sets, and choose your final act in search of resurrection in this 2D pixel art Metroidvania.

details.title: PC Versus
details.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

details.title: Ultra Damage
details.short_description: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

details.title: Wheel Wills
details.short_description: A roguelike where every attack is a gamble. Spin the Wheel to decide what each day throws at you, fill your grid with Gambits that either hit or miss, and repaint the Wheel itself to bend the odds your way

details.title: Troop vs Troop
details.short_description: Tactical turn-based combat in WW2. Lead U.S. infantry, tanks, and artillery through procedurally generated battlefields. Use cover and clever tactics to outmaneuver German forces.

details.title: TEKNOKRAT
details.short_description: Enter the city of Nu-Vika as a cyborg repairman in TEKNOKRAT, a thriller romance visual novel. There's a conspiracy brewing beneath this techno-metropolis, and you find yourself an unwilling participant. You will meet three clients, cyborgs with secrets and aspirations of their own.

details.title: Where the Chips Fall
details.short_description: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with your abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

details.title: IsekaIdle
details.short_description: A fantasy idle progression game inspired by deep skill-based systems. Train skills through use, conquer dungeons, manage your settlement, and optimize every system at your own pace, with no prestige resets and permanent progression.

details.title: Don't Get Fired!
details.short_description: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

details.title: My Axion Shop
details.short_description: Build your own Axion shop, collect rare parts, create powerful combinations, and battle your way to becoming a Pro Axioner! My Axion Shop offers a unique gaming experience blending strategy, trading, and collection elements.

details.title: First Age
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time?

details.title: Battlecaster 2
details.short_description: Battlecaster 2 is an intense top-down action roguelite. Descend to the center of a hostile world where control, precision, and aggression decide every fight. Push forward and dismantle enemy pressure through skillful play. Shape powerful, expressive builds as danger rises.

details.title: Rustborn - Outland Threat
details.short_description: You’re a cowboy abducted by aliens who accidentally ends up with a biomechanical arm. Run, climb, and shoot like crazy to survive hordes of deadly robots in this third-person bullet-hell shooter. Conquer the mothership and find your way back home!

details.title: Grav My Balls
details.short_description: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

details.title: Drudgemark
details.short_description: The dark marches on the King's Realm and you stand at its border. Forge steel, build up your keep and command your soldiers in formation. Then draw your own blade and fight beside them in first person, alone or with your friends in co-op.

details.title: Lots at Stake
details.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

details.title: Punch Punch!
details.short_description: 在节奏明快的夏日小镇中参与单词挑战！输入单词、连续出拳，把敌人痛快击飞！与小镇居民轻松互动，通过基于记忆曲线的复习机制，让背单词更有趣，也记得更加牢固。

details.title: Untamed Ehizia
details.short_description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with unusual game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

details.title: Top Drifters
details.short_description: A minimalistic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, Experience physics-based, drift-focused driving at ultra-high-speed. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats. Challenge your friends online in 20+ semi-destructible, chaotic races and become the world's "Top Drifter".

details.title: RUNE GUNNER
details.short_description: RUNE GUNNER is a 1-4 player co-op roguelite shooter where you combine guns and magic to create game-breaking synergies. Each room hits harder, so you must mix classes mid-run and collect runes to become overpowered.

details.title: The Alchemist Of Alderglen
details.short_description: The Alchemist of Alderglen is an alchemist simulator where you nurture rare plants, harvest exotic ingredients, and brew potions using your recipe book and alchemy tools. Unlock new plants, upgrade your workspace and run a thriving potion shop.

details.title: WorldWasGray
details.short_description: A relaxing game about painting a gray world back to life.

details.title: Kwad
details.short_description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

details.title: Veriventure
details.short_description: Combine a toolbox of enemies, hazards, items and objects to build dungeons filled with puzzles, traps, and combat. Alternatively, cartwheel into levels created by other players, or ready your weapon and explore the story mode, in this retro-inspired 3D Dungeon Maker.

details.title: THE FORMIO PROGRAM
details.short_description: Terraform the moon Io from an isolated, fully simulated outpost as an operator for the F.O.R.M.I.O program. Master interconnected devices, take your (MANDATORY) daily dose of RADOX, and ignore the robot :)

details.title: My Cozy BookShop
details.short_description: Run your own magical bookshop in a cozy fantasy world! Stock your shelves, decorate your shop, meet curious customers, and venture beyond town in search of rare books, magical ingredients, and secrets. Build the bookshop of your dreams ~one adventure at a time~

details.title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
details.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

details.title: Rift Tavern
details.short_description: Gather materials, cook meals, serve patrons, and defeat foes! Welcome to your new life as the owner of the 'Rift Tavern'. Restore the former glory of your run-down tavern by night, and explore the depths of dangerous portal zones by day!

details.title: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
details.short_description: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

details.title: Crow's Requiem
details.short_description: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

details.title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
details.short_description: Humanity Echo is a turn-based tactical RPG set in cyberpunk Odesa, 2044. Lead a squad as an engineer: prepare for every contract, fight from cover, overload transformers, set off explosive barrels, loot better gear, and make choices the people around you will remember.

details.title: Auto Grind: Dungeons
details.short_description: AUTO GRIND: DUNGEONS is a singleplayer auto-attack dungeon crawler that fuses party management with snap decisions. Build your party, synergize skills and masteries, discover unique relics, craft items and adapt your allies' combat tactics in real time as you fight your way through enemy hordes!

details.title: VOIMA
details.short_description: VOIMA is a sandbox where you build freely - no grids, no limits. Draw shapes, place blocks, and defend your creations from monsters. Mod the game in real time - no coding needed. Play it. Then make it yours.

details.title: Ascend and Fall
details.short_description: Ascend and Fall is a dark-fantasy multiplayer autobattler where the order of your spells decides the outcome. Build your spell loadout, fight monsters for loot, and unleash powerful arcane combos against rival players. Sequence your magic right to rise while they fall.

details.title: Rhea of the Remnant
details.short_description: “Rhea of the Remnant” is a mecha Tactical RPG where you command a small group of allies to take on a powerful enemy force. Anticipate enemy moves, combine your allies' abilities, and devise the best strategy to secure victory!

details.title: Liar-for-hire
details.short_description: Follow the new worker of the disinformation agency day by day. Decide how to oppose news and people through the use of fake scandals and redirections. Ensure a win for your employers - or find some conscience after all.

details.title: ExoDomia
details.short_description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.

details.title: Winemaker Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a winemaker. From growing your vineyard to harvesting, from crafting wine to trading, every decision shapes your future. Will you be the one who creates the most exquisite and valuable wine? 🍷

details.title: Small Living World 2
details.short_description: Is a peaceful ecosystem simulator, bringing every aspect of nature to life. From the water cycle and plant growth, to animal behaviors and reproduction, observe your small living world evolve. All the tools are at your disposal to create your perfect forest.

details.title: Margin of Error
details.short_description: Princess Elyra is bound to a cursed grimoire. Lead her party through six monster-filled regions in this deckb-building roguelite RPG, where every attack is a numbers puzzle: play number and operation cards to hit each enemy’s exact target. Miss it, and the monster makes you pay.

details.title: Rollout Rally
details.short_description: Race solo or with friends in Rollout Rally, a physics-based marble racing party game. Play with up to 4 players in split-screen on one PC, or up to 6 online or over LAN. Team up in 3v3 races, steer, boost, shove rivals with Pulse, block hits with Shield and roll to victory!

details.title: Hunt for the Lost Folktales
details.short_description: A folklore hunting, turn-based battling, creature collector adventure where you follow trails to hunt escaped folktale beasts, engage in strategic tactical battles where fear is your strength, and capture the lost folktales so they may live on in memory. Will you be another folktale to be written?

details.title: Pinkwilds
details.short_description: A sci-fi multiplayer survival RPG with no guns - fight with weapons and magic instead. Explore an alien world, gather resources, craft gear, and build your base. Trade, form alliances, raid, or betray other players to survive.

details.title: Uncivilized
details.short_description: A short-form empire building strategy game. Explore the planet and grow your colony, while attempting to negotiate with the many characterful rival factions. Make friends, break allegiances, or just drop nukes on them.

details.title: Born Without Rights
details.short_description: Born Without Rights is a third-person, story-driven action-adventure with stealth, gunfights, and exploration. Inspired by The Last of Us and Max Payne, experience a tense linear story of survival and resistance in a world without freedom.

details.title: Shapesetter
details.short_description: An open-ended puzzle game about building machines that make modernist art. Program mechanical arms to paint, cut and weld shapes into finished pieces, then refine your machine to be faster, smaller or cheaper.

details.title: Astrobound
details.short_description: Survive and explore space in Astrobound! Visit strange planets, encounter cosmic calamities, and keep your crew alive as you journey through the stars in a retro-inspired whimsical space adventure.

name: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor

details.title: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor
details.short_description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

details.title: Hexabot Stranded: Defend Or Die
details.short_description: Action tower defense with physics & couch co-op: carry your turrets, hurl objects, and survive swarm attacks.

details.title: Aphasia
details.short_description: Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back? Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are. As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

details.title: Seal of Solitomb
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelike that takes solitaire and puts it in a dungeon. Stack cards into poker hands and rid your deck of the monsters within. Assemble an invincible build and beat the demon threatening the kingdom - at least until the next run!

details.title: Eisenkiefer
details.short_description: Eisenkiefer is an asymmetrical horror multiplayer game for quick sessions with friends. Play as a Pig, hide, sabotage a giant meat grinder, and rescue your teammates – or become the Butcher and process the Pigs before they destroy your machine.

details.title: Broken Relic
details.short_description: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.

details.title: SLAMTOWN - Brawl Together
details.short_description: SLAMTOWN is a co-op beat 'em up arcade style 2.5D game for 1–4 players — punch, kick and throw enemies at your teammates for devastating chain combos. Slam bosses with powerful and unique arena movements and make your way through a city where wrestling is the only law.

details.title: H.A.I.N
details.short_description: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

details.title: Dino Citadel
details.short_description: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: AVROPOLIS
details.short_description: VR action-adventure with fully physics-based movement. Climb ruins, fight mysterious creatures and enemies, survive deadly traps, solve ancient puzzles, and manage your gear as Leonardo uncovers the lost civilization of AVROPOLIS. Story-driven campaign with strong accessibility options.

details.title: Crimson Skyline
details.short_description: Set the skies ablaze in this aerial combat bullet hell! Target enemy carriers to cripple fleets, dodge relentless anti-air battleships, and outmaneuver fighter jet squadrons. As a Phoenix Squadron pilot, you are the final rampart against tyranny and your nation’s last hope to rise from the ashes.

details.title: Catena
details.short_description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

details.title: Crystal Rail
details.short_description: All aboard the Crystal Rail - a train game set in a crystalpunk fantasy world of extinct animals, hand-painted environments, and political revolution!

details.title: Addie Shen
details.short_description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

details.title: Five More Minutes
details.short_description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

details.title: Untitled 2D Isometric RPG
details.short_description: Explore a dynamic 2D isometric fantasy RPG with procedurally generated worlds, adaptive AI, deep crafting, and story-driven quests. Shape your destiny through choices, combat intelligent foes, and forge legendary gear in an ever-evolving, immersive adventure.

details.title: Ayre Battles: Heritage Academy
details.short_description: A tactical card fighter where reactions, timing, prediction, and momentum matter. Build a 30-card deck, outplay your opponent with fighting game-inspired mechanics, and master strategic battles against an adaptive CPU or other players.

details.title: Everforge Legacy
details.short_description: Single-player action RPG inspired by Final Fantasy XI. Six Jobs, weapon skills, skillchains, elemental days, and Named hunts, rebuilt for one hero, with up to two Trusts at your side. Three origin stories through a complete Chapter 1 storyline.

details.title: Hopfall
details.short_description: Build your team in this froguelite autobattler. Tame corrupted frogs, equip them with powerful items, and discover team synergies to overcome mysterious enemies.

details.title: Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids
details.short_description: Welcome to Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids – where every splash brings a smile! In this enchanting idle clicker creature collection game, traverse hand-drawn lakes, hatch unique Mermeows, and upgrade serene habitats. Collect pearls and let magical currents carry you into a world of calm strategy.

details.title: Type for Speed
details.short_description: Your keyboard is the gas pedal. Type to accelerate, chain clean words into combos and nitro, and race friends or bots on 10 tracks. Survive the endless highway or just cruise in Free Drive. 129 cars to collect, 10 languages, each typed in its own script.

details.title: Maze Maou
details.short_description: A game about the struggles of an office worker in an anachronistic medieval fantasy setting. Strategically employ monsters and cursed items to keep adventurers away from your dungeon.

details.title: Pinewater
details.short_description: Pinewater is a cozy first-person fishing game about restoring a run-down lakeside cabin. Catch rare and legendary fish, restore and decorate your lakeside home, plant trees, and shape the surroundings to your liking — all at your own pace.

details.title: Story of Leaves
details.short_description: Start your new life! Build your dream farm, grow crops, craft, mine, fish, and forge heartfelt connections with charming townsfolk. Explore a vibrant world, uncover mysteries, and shape your own unforgettable story in this cozy farming / life sim RPG.

details.title: 财神模拟器
details.short_description: Become a novice God of Wealth! Grant fortunes or ruin fates with a touch. Your choices build "Virtue" for ascension or lead to轮回. Uncover the truth behind your divine power.

details.title: BOILED
details.short_description: America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter, set in the 1920s Old West.

details.title: Firewheels Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Co-Op Firewheels Shop Simulator lets you manage a diecast model store. Organize shelves, assist customers, and expand your shop in a detailed, realistic world. Hunt for rare and chase cars, trade with customers, and grow your diecast empire.

details.title: Spin Power
details.short_description: A short incremental building game where everything functions with your Spin Power. Build structures, mine resources, unlock new lands, upgrade yourself inside the big skill tree, automate resource mining to increase your income and awake the mysterious water tank from eternal slumber!

details.title: Auto-Astra
details.short_description: Auto-Astra is a voxel-based automation game set in a space sandbox. You design and build ships block by block and then use scripting to control them. Your logic, your empire.

details.title: Underground: World War
details.short_description: A brand new game inspired by the Def Jam series. Create your own fighter or play as some of your favorite rappers in this over the top fighting game.

details.title: Evoplasm
details.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

details.title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
details.short_description: A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, ushering in a new era of mysticism.

details.title: 玫昙 She From TheFuture
details.short_description: Mei can see hidden memories. Two years ago, Her lovers Tan died in a fire, ruled suicide. She became a detective. Then she discovered she can travel through time. She must return to the night Tan died—can she change it or just watch it burn again?

details.title: Dark Queen of Samobor
details.short_description: Experience a thrilling adventure through the dark and atmospheric world of medieval Croatia where an evil queen rules from the shadows and her haunted guardians await you. Venture into a dark fantasy tale wrapped in a cinematic action side-scroller with a unique 2.5D style.

details.title: Extinction Force
details.short_description: Battle across time to save humanity from giant arachnids in this multiplayer third-person action shooter.

details.title: Sa[meow]rai: Silverwing Stray
details.short_description: "Sa[meow]rai" is a top down action role-playing game centered around one-hit kills and rich interactivity.You play as a law-enforcer with an implant called "Gyakugawa Emergency Reboot Device," fighting for every second of your remaining time in a morally ambiguous cyberpunk city.

details.title: Impious
details.short_description: Impious is a dark turn-based RPG set in a world where human imperfection is no longer tolerated, those deemed impious are captured and dragged underground. You wake inside a system designed to break you and your only way is forward:fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out.

details.title: Chaos Bringer
details.short_description: Outsmart foes in fast-paced tactical dungeons, then become a raid leader who stops time to command your party. Explore, craft, and conquer giant bosses single-handedly for the ultimate MMORPG-level satisfaction.

details.title: Dino Cleanup
details.short_description: Clean giant dinosaurs and save cute prehistoric friends in a world flooded with goop! Unlock vacuum overdrive abilities for new ways to play and collect tons of hats in this nostalgic 3D platformer.

details.title: Shine On, My Little Sun
details.short_description: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

details.title: Loot Goblin Inc.
details.short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

details.title: Scramble Heart City
details.short_description: Scramble Heart City is a 3v3 tag-team fighter that's easy to pick up and play. It's time to beat up your friends and find new ones! Battle anywhere with local and online multiplayer and browser cross-play.

details.title: Water Walls
details.short_description: Enlist the help of UFOs to collect and evaporate water! Use the falling blocks to contain the water for collection by building Water Walls. Can you create a solution to bring you to the top of the leader boards in this easy-to-play hard-to-master block stacking game?

details.title: Call Of Resistance
details.short_description: Call of Resistance is a real-time tactics game where you lead a group of resistance fighters in occupied France during World War II. Step into the shoes of shadowy heroes and discover the sacrifices and strategies needed to stand against the enemy

details.title: Crafters Heaven
details.short_description: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox where you design and build your own items piece by piece. Create unique weapons, tools and equipment, build your base, fight wild creatures, and explore an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

details.title: Bygoner
details.short_description: A medieval road-movie parable blending rogue-lite action and journey management, wrapped in vintage cinema aesthetics. Follow a nameless knight through the southern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine) at the beginning of the 16th century.

details.title: Pay Your Space Debt
details.short_description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

details.title: Lightbound : A Rolling Ball Game
details.short_description: A racing platformer. Take control of a ball and set off on a wildly dangerous adventure. Master your momentum, chain power-ups, outwit the enemies on your tail, and whatever you do — don't fall. Solo or split-screen for up to 4 players.

details.title: Age of Space
details.short_description: Evolve from being a nobody to being the center of power! Age of space combines real time resource management with tactical combat. Work as a mercenary for clients in our solar system as you gradually get dragged into a liberation war between the Martians and the UEA. Who will you side with?

details.title: Wizards
details.short_description: Four wizards. One arena. One furious ball. Protect your library & spellbook, sling five arena-warping spells, and outlast everyone. Local AI and Steam multiplayer.

details.title: The Night Janitor
details.short_description: You were hired to clean. Nobody mentioned the ghosts. Craven & Moor Associates needs their offices spotless before the morning shift. What their employees can't know won't hurt them. Mop up the mess, take out the trash, and don't let anything catch you doing it. Five nights. One mop. Don't die.

details.title: Solar Core
details.short_description: Survive to the end of each track in fast, rhythm-driven combat in this top down twin-stick roguelike.

details.title: DuoFall
details.short_description: Pieces fall from the top and rise from the bottom - and you play both fields at once. Can you do it? Longer than your friends? Challenge them: same seed, live duel or leaderboard - every run is proven by replay. One mind. Two fields. Many blocks.

details.title: MixUp!
details.short_description: MixUp! is a CO-OP focused, fast-paced color mixing and management roguelite. Enter the unique, black and white world of "Malben." As a Visionary Painter, your life mission is to restore color to this monochrome reality, one customer, one day, one city at a time, friends may join you on your journey.

details.title: My Army Getting Stronger
details.short_description: A short relaxing incremental auto-battler where you grow an unstoppable war machine and grind your way forward through enemy territory. No stress, no micromanagement — just growth, upgrades, and glorious mass battles.

details.title: Tiny Street: Taskbar Tycoon
details.short_description: Tiny Street: Taskbar Tycoon is a taskbar idle game where a tiny street sits right on the taskbar while you work, relax, or simply watch the people come and go. Passerbys will randomly shop in your colorful, hand-drawn stores, and slowly help grow your little economy.

details.title: Buddington
details.short_description: Buddington is a 2D life sim blending restaurant management, light action combat, and story adventure. Battle pests for ingredients by day, then plan the menu and run the canteen with friends come sundown.

details.title: MSP Mayhem
details.short_description: Run a chaotic IT service company with your friends! Answer the phones, fix the servers, calm the customers and land that big enterprise deal — all before the SLA clock runs out. Inspired by Overcooked-style couch co-op mayhem, set in the world's most stressful open-plan office.

details.title: Court of Karma: Soul Check
details.short_description: Every soul has a past. Every sin demands a price. As an underworld judge, uncover the truth behind each soul's life and decide their fate. Will you deliver justice, or condemn the innocent?

details.title: PARRUITS!
details.short_description: Swallow a watermelon, become a watermelon. A 2–6 player party brawler where parrots turn into whatever fruit they eat, then use one ridiculous ability each to knock each other into the sea. Last parrot on the island wins. Couch or online. A minute to learn, ten minutes to lose a friend.

details.title: The Pineapple Conspiracy
details.short_description: An impostor survival reality show for 4 to 10 players. Craft a raft in twenty minutes while impostors work against you in secret. Survive, betray, and find the Golden pineapple!

details.title: Harvesters
details.short_description: A short incremental management game where every harvester has a name and a story. Upgrade your favorites, your spaceship, buildings and explore different planets. Optimize your production to meet the Council's requirements. It's all about watching the lil people do their thing.

details.title: Hedra
details.short_description: A scientific blunder tears open a portal, and the Hedra pour through. Build a shifting collider from six tile shapes, grow monster dice, complete patterns, battle rival Overlords, and devour physicists in this solo digital board game.

details.title: Fleeting Requests: Freya and Ray
details.short_description: Caught using magic to steal a game, Raymond Wong En is spared from arrest and recruited by Cheng Li Fang Freya into the Spell Casting Crusaders. Engage in a point and click, character driven narrative using magic to fulfill requests, each revealing deeper layers of the group’s story.

details.title: NAND²
details.short_description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate, together: online co-op for up to 4 players on one board. Wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. Level editor and Steam Workshop.

details.title: OneThought
details.short_description: One thought to ascend, one thought to fall. A cultivation roguelike deckbuilder where six disciplines light up like auto-battler synergies: stack 3/6/10/15 cards of one school and become what you build. Join a sect, collect the lore, survive the Tribulation, then reincarnate and run again.

details.title: CoreVore
details.short_description: CoreVore is a first-person voxel mining sandbox. Explore a persistent atlas of destructible planets, scan for rare ore, shape tunnels, deploy machines, and evacuate your cargo before instability turns your route into a trap. Return later—the planet remembers what you changed.

details.title: Goodly Trials
details.short_description: Hire a storied leader, build a crew around them, bargain for gear, and grow your company to survive your journey home in this tactical auto-battler. Play solo, face a tournament of trials in multiplayer, or team up in co-op.

details.title: Wirehawk
details.short_description: Wirehawk is a neon vector shmup in the spirit of 80s arcade classics. Play it your way: razor-sharp mouse control, or a dedicated controller mode rebalanced for the stick. Blast asteroids and alien waves, dodge bullet storms, slow time with stasis. Autofire always on.

details.title: Sunset Painter
details.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

details.title: Hop Slasher
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade battler where you slice your enemies from any angle. Once you start moving your momentum never stops, use quick reflexes to dodge attacks and perform trick shots to score more points! Slash through waves of unique enemies and bosses!

details.title: BumpFlip
details.short_description: Choose and place bumpers to build your perfect pinball setup. Hit the target score before the 90-second timer runs out.

details.title: L'Eternel Retour, Death Gamble
details.short_description: A bullet heaven roguelite. Caught in a loop of death and return, hold back a surging horde, draft a build, and find a way to save what's left of civilization. Die, come back, unlock new items and weapons. Solo or online co-op.

details.title: Melodan
details.short_description: Command mythical legions to victory in a fantasy auto-battler where every placement matters. Draft your troops, unlock magical upgrades, set your formations, and let the battle begin. Pure strategy, no clickfest. Prove your brilliance in 1v1 and 2v2 matches, or survive the escalating Co-op Horde.

details.title: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
details.short_description: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

details.title: Pongcremental
details.short_description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

name: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy

details.title: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy
details.short_description: You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!

details.title: Color Factory
details.short_description: Connect nodes to generate, transform, and blend colors in a relaxing factory automation game. Discover new recipes, unlock powerful nodes through research, and design increasingly efficient production networks as your color factory grows.

details.title: TOWN of HIDDEN MURDERS
details.short_description: The tranquility of Peaceville was shattered by a single gunshot. In a back alley, a reporter was found shot and killed. Meanwhile, Detective Song Sun had been investigating a series of murders—but what was the truth he uncovered...?

details.title: Tactical Dungeon Slayers
details.short_description: Slay the Spire-style roguelite deckbuilding meets high-mobility tactical combat and terrain strategy. Find the perfect position to unleash powerful deck combos and AoE attacks, wiping out enemies while avoiding the enemy’s kill zones.

details.title: Filthy Fly: Horde Survivor
details.short_description: A gross-out horde-survivor where you play the pest. Buzz over picnic tables and sewer guts, stack six revolting weapons, evolve them into screen-clearing monstrosities, and outlive the entire insect kingdom. Die, mutate at The Heap, and go again.

details.title: Hotel Stardust
details.short_description: Would you like to win $1,000,000? Survive the night at the Hotel Stardust, capture every anomaly on camera, and the prize is yours. Be careful, some anomalies aren't very friendly.

details.title: A Pile of Tile
details.short_description: A Pile of Tile is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about Loki, a cute little cat who recently graduated from art school and started his first job in a tiles shop. Loki faces multiple challenges in his new job, your goal is to help him make the tiles for customers and keep his job.

details.title: Arithmetrick
details.short_description: Arithmetrick is a math-based deckbuilding roguelite. Arrange operation cards into equation chains — addition,subtraction, multiplication, division — to hit escalating target scores. Collect a permanent deck across runs and mixthree color factions to discover deep card synergies

details.title: Armory Doctrine
details.short_description: Armory Doctrine is a real-time grand strategy game where you run a private arms empire and fight your own wars in a modern world sliding toward war. Expand your factory, master the global weapons market, and decide the fate of every shipment: sell it for profit, equip your own forces or arm a proxy.

details.title: RingOut
details.short_description: A 3D arena shooter inspired by Super Smash Bros.: no health bars. Every shot heats enemies up, raising their temperature in degrees (°). The hotter they are, the farther they fly: launch them off the arena to win. 23 fighters, 13 weapons, 29 arenas, 6 modes. Solo vs bots or online.

details.title: Starworks Inc.
details.short_description: Harness the riches of a star system in this incremental game. Unlock new technologies, transform raw materials, build warships and win an interstellar war !

details.title: Saturnia
details.short_description: A blocky survival game where you mine ore, smelt it and forge your own tools and weapons on the anvil. Build wands and staffs piece by piece, learn fire spells, and explore volcanoes, cherry groves and old tombs while a frost golem, a minotaur and a dragon wait for you.

details.title: Yarrr
details.short_description: Hordes, plunder and a kraken, in first person. Play one of four pirate captains, combine 40 spells and 60+ relics, chart your course across ten islands and take on the Kraken, alone or with up to three friends.

details.title: Tripartite: Magical Engineering
details.short_description: The defense of the castle is up to you. Build your own network of roads and towers and discover the magical combos necessary to defend your home, all while training soldiers and siege weapons to bring the fight back to the enemy. Capture their castles before they capture yours!

name: Into the Chaos: Reliable Delivery Riders

details.title: Into the Chaos: Reliable Delivery Riders
details.short_description: Four riders. One drop-off. Questionable teamwork. Grab orders and dodge security in a 4-player co-op delivery sandbox. Ride ridiculous vehicles, kick your friends, and deliver the most orders for double earnings. Knocked down? Get back up. Caught by a guard? You're out!

details.title: Keep Harvesting
details.short_description: Your farm is decaying - every harvest keeps it alive. Turn a tiny field into a massive harvesting machine in this incremental idle roguelite. Combine hundreds of skills, automate your harvest, invest your resources in permanent upgrades, and grow stronger with every run.

details.title: Purrfect Hand
details.short_description: Settle into a cozy poker-inspired card game. Hold cards, build stronger hands, earn chips, and unlock upgrades as you chase royal flushes. Befriend a cat, discover playful minigames, and enjoy one more deal over a warm cup of coffee.

details.title: Choo City
details.short_description: Choo City is a cozy train puzzle game. Lay tracks, flip switches and dispatch your trains to deliver coal, wood and people to construction sites. Avoid crashes, beat the clock and build 24 unique buildings to bring your toy town to life.

details.title: Bingolazo
details.short_description: A colorful bingo roguelite. Pick which balls to call, mark your cards and chain lines, diagonals and full cards into huge scores. Collect lucky charms that bend the rules, play legendary balls like Saturn and beat the club's bosses, in endless runs or the story mode.

details.title: 斗域经理
