details.short_description: Build your club in Arena Manager, a strategy game of hero development and automatic battles. Recruit heroes, shape your five-person squad with skills and gear, and outdraft your rivals. Lead your team from the lower leagues to the Continental Crown.

details.title: The Compliant
details.short_description: A dark workplace parable in visual-novel form. As Lin Zhi works at Sabo Group, he uncovers buried secrets—AI, human experimentation, thought control—while clues keep surfacing. What will you choose? The game features 13 distinct characters and 15 endings to unlock.

details.title: Echoes on Paper
details.short_description: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days.

details.title: Seven Rukks: Pit, Profit & Glory
details.short_description: Seven Rukks is a brutal fantasy sports management game. Build your team, develop your players, plan your lineup and tactics, and lead your club through a ruthless league where glory, profit, and survival are often only one Rukk apart.

details.title: Flip Biz Tycoon
details.short_description: This is NO decorating game. Put on that suit, crunch those numbers, and flip them houses. It's business time!

details.title: Chess Traveler: Pip's Journey
details.short_description: The family chess set is about to be donated, and only Pip, the smallest pawn in the box, can stop it. Roll dice across the house, bend chess with silly House Rules from checkers, Ludo and xiangqi, and make chess fun again in a cozy chess roguelike.

details.title: Ten Thousand Victories
details.short_description: A historical strategy game set in medieval Vietnam, drawn in the style of Đông Hồ folk woodblock prints. Build a realm and hold it through invasion after invasion, command formations in real-time battles, or ride out as one captain in a Story Mode where the country remembers your promises.

details.title: Domino Party
details.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 28 mini-games like curling and sled races.

details.title: Neldoaria
details.short_description: A dying land, buried in ash. Seek Neldoaria beyond the desert. Summon souls bound by their names onto a 3×3 grid in this roguelite deckbuilder where cards shape the battlefield. 7 days. Day and night. How you spend your time and choices, and how it ends, is up to luck and to you.

details.title: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
details.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

details.title: Oddballs Brawl
details.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

details.title: Blazing Fighter King
details.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

details.title: League of Constellations
details.short_description: What if you took the build you'd been mowing down hordes with in a survivors-like and put it in a 5v5? So I built it. Raise your heroes in the survivors run, then take them straight into the league. No nerfs. You control your own hero; your teammates fight by your formation and tactics.

name: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide

details.title: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide
details.short_description: An ordinary factory worker becomes a fugitive in a galactic war. Choose whom to trust, uncover the purpose of an experimental crystal, and decide what freedom is worth in a branching science-fiction visual novel.

details.title: Railsiege
details.short_description: You drive an armed war train through a ravaged Wild West, all the way to Fort Alamo. Fit the wagons with turrets, then choose as you go: floor it to outrun the monsters and risk blowing the boiler, or slow down to cut them down and pick up their loot.

details.title: Large Language Mercenaries
details.short_description: A roguelite turn-based strategy RPG where you command an AI mercenary, defend your caravan, and parry enemy attacks in real time. Play as the *original characters* Sam the Scout, Elon the Envoker, or Dario the Duelist and face down waves of AI-enabled nightmares to save humanity.

details.title: Kessrand: The Last Warden
details.short_description: You are the Last Hero of a kingdom trapped inside a mountain, and the invaders are hunting you. Carve tunnels and set traps between waves, then survive each wave, leading the horde through the killing warren you built.

details.title: SoulMarkWalker
details.short_description: 《SoulMarkWalker》 is a turn-based action game.Choose your skills and time your dodges and counters in video-driven, turn-based combat. Investigate clues, develop your character, and resonate with ancient heroes.

details.title: Crashloop
details.short_description: CRASHLOOP is a roguelike deckbuilder about hacking your way through a botnet. Build machines out of hexagonal tiles, chain them into loops, and crash every foe that stands in your way as you find out who's behind it all.

details.title: SpaceDeck
details.short_description: SpaceDeck is a roguelike shoot-em-up deckbuilder. Build a deck under fire - dodge bullets, blast enemies and grab cards as you fly. Survive the action, then use your deck to fight a boss in a turn-based card battle. Get blown up, start again and keep fighting until you get your dog back!

details.title: Plushie Party
details.short_description: Win mini-games, survive the show, and watch your friends turn into stuffing as you crush their hopes and dreams in this collection of slightly violent party games!

details.title: By Royal Charter
details.short_description: Solitaire's one-more-card appeal meets the satisfaction of building a thriving colony. Place facility cards, recruit specialists, and connect production chains in approachable turn-based strategy. Play your cards. Build your colony.

details.title: Buildmaxxing
details.short_description: Build together on floating islands in this 1-4 player co-op building game. Each player has a unique role. Memorize blueprints, communicate with your team, and build from memory before time runs out!

details.title: Trickstir
details.short_description: Solve puzzles by rotating the environment to drop ingredients in your cauldron. Discover blocks and ingredients with special twists across six different worlds. Collect the ingredients to help the witch create the ultimate potion!

details.title: Arborist
details.short_description: Build a garden, survive the forecast, and follow a trail of birds through wild habitats in this cozy roguelike card game. Discover new cards, tools, and enchantments as you shape unique builds that keep every run feeling fresh.

details.title: Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn
details.short_description: “Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn” is a Tower of the Sorcerer-like strategy game.You start out as just a barrel,explore a monster-infested magic tower.Collect relics,assemble the body.Choose the best route,and conquer the magic tower!No manual input during battles — strategy is everything!

details.title: Castlefolk
details.short_description: Build a medieval kingdom from a small settlement, gather resources, recruit an army, battle dangerous creatures, and expand your realm across a charming pixel-art world.

details.title: Prison Chef Simulator
details.short_description: Step behind the counter of a high-security prison cafeteria. Prepare daily meals, manage scarce ingredients, and survive volatile inmates who throw trays at your face. Keep the dining hall from rioting and guard your cutlery, or your shift might be your last in this tense kitchen sim.

details.title: Strikemania
details.short_description: You are the missile. Launch. Strike. Repeat. Kamikaze your way through defenses, master each route, and use previous missiles to help clear the path in this fast-paced retro arcade time-attack game.

details.title: Boomfish
details.short_description: Captain, open fire! Blast swarms of monster fish! Combine special ammo, secondary weapons and crew support. Boost your firepower with salvage upgrades and return with a hold full of loot. Unlock 50+ armaments, recruit and train 100+ crew, earn deep-sea blessings and brave deadlier waters!

details.title: Just One More Season
details.short_description: A roguelike esports management sim: take charge of a team and climb from Iron league to Diamond. Recruit and train players, manage finances and fans across seasons that play out differently every run. Lost the final? Just one more season.

details.title: Blueshift Breakdown
details.short_description: Bring destructibility to the extreme in this Asteroids-inspired shoot 'em up. Travel the galaxy and encounter a wide variety of fully destructible asteroids and enemies. Upgrade your ship and annihilate everything in your path, pixel by pixel.

details.title: Break the Planet
details.short_description: A satisfying, meditative incremental game about shooting balls to destroy planets. Find the white voxel hidden in each world, unlock more balls, and uncover the secrets to destroy a 10-billion-voxel planet.

details.title: NOEMA
details.short_description: Take your place at the terminal. Follow the procedures, process the records, and read messages never meant for you. NOEMA is a quiet, unsettling narrative experience about work, obedience, human connection, and what routine teaches us not to see.

details.title: Gideon Unleashed
details.short_description: The last wizard. The world's greatest mistake. Every hunter in the kingdom wants him dead, and all he wants is to get home. Walk the road through four lands, build a ring of spells that feed each other, then hold Ravenhold against an army that never stops coming.

details.title: Shunt
details.short_description: The Devil has scattered Rex's bones all over his house. One press slides Rex, the clay dog, until he hits something, and shoves everything in his path. Line the bones up in a row or column to win them back. 338 hand-built puzzles, 16 worlds, no timer, level editor.

details.title: Eyes Blue
details.short_description: A psychological survival horror game about grief and guilt. Traverse the distorted memories of Walter Johnson as his mind teeters between life and death, set in a world with a retro aesthetic inspired by the classic era of horror.

details.title: Green Guy Goes Grappling
details.short_description: Green Guy Goes Grappling is a fast-paced 2D platformer where Green Guy has to save the universe!

details.title: Keep Rising
details.short_description: A medieval tower defense incremental where the castle outlives every run. Hold the wall against endless waves, Rebirth stronger and find every room you built still standing. 8 towers, 28 spell combinations and a 17-chapter Campaign.

name: The White Witch of White Winter

details.title: The White Witch of White Winter
details.short_description: A short letter from Mom leaves young witch Kore in charge of a winter island. She recalls lost recipes in memories of Mom, brews potions to ease her neighbors' worries, flies on her staff, dives into the deep spring, and fills her empty cottage. Join Kore and uncover the secret Mom left behind.

details.title: Naptide: Fortune Islands
details.short_description: 6 islands, 6 different games! In this cozy incremental game full of cats, collect as many eggs as you can in 20-second rounds, grow wheat to bring in new cats and spend your earnings in skill trees. As your islands grow, they power each other up.

details.title: Orange Wiki
details.short_description: You wake on the last train at an unfamiliar terminus. Only one app opens on your phone: Orange Wiki, a guide to this place, its entities, and your escape. Explore, compare clues with wiki entries, and find a way out in this first-person horror adventure.

name: Are You Smarter Than a Troll?

details.title: Are You Smarter Than a Troll?
details.short_description: Classic trivia meets the builds and strategic combat of a roguelike! Answer questions to attack enemies, use skills to turn the odds in your favor, and collect artifacts that change how you play. Outsmart the Troll and claim his treasure!

details.title: Heartreave
details.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

details.title: Cups and Curses
details.short_description: A cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks from ingredients whose effects you discover by using them, plan your board around the morning forecast, and offer them to the people at your counter. No timer and no fail state. Regulars come back, sit down, and tell you things.

details.title: The Last Job 2
details.short_description: Just another break-in. Or so you thought. Explore a seemingly ordinary house, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls. Experience a first-person horror game where an unsettling atmosphere keeps you on edge.

details.title: Utopia '97
details.short_description: A twin-stick shooter set in a perfect world with no conflict and no bad guys. Blow kisses at your friends and teleport them to a happy-go-lucky carnival for the day.

details.title: TOKUGI ARENA
details.short_description: Generate energy by typing, solving Tsume Shogi and completing other challenges, then spend it on projectiles, blades and barriers. A team-based action game with CPU practice, solo challenges, Score Attack and compatible VRM avatars.

details.title: 修仙：但天道是AI
details.short_description: An AI-driven cultivation text adventure. You are a fading soul who seizes a cultivator's body. Debate elders, bond with or rival fellow disciples, survive deadly realms—every choice reshapes your fate. The deeper you go, the more the Heavenly Dao feels like running code. The Dao is an AI.

details.title: A Walk in the Park
details.short_description: Become a landscaper, take on missions in beautiful parks and gardens, and create the perfect layout to satisfy every visitor.

details.title: Sacrificium
details.short_description: Turn-based roguelike. Every creature carries a trait you can only claim by sacrificing it at the altar. Stack traits into a build, watch your team shrink, and reach the final fight with nothing left to spend. Power is always subtraction.

details.title: Cat Cat Meowdow
details.short_description: Your grandmother’s letter brings you to a cottage in a quiet valley, and to its cats. Win their trust one by one, cook and garden for them, watch the seasons turn, and wander beyond the valley to find cats most players will never see. No timers, no rush.

details.title: Don't Lose the Wheels!
details.short_description: Build, survive, and keep rolling in Don't Lose the Wheels! — a chaotic physics-based vehicle party game. Assemble wacky contraptions, navigate brutal obstacle tracks, and battle the elements solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. Whatever happens, don’t lose your wheels!

details.title: What a Wish
details.short_description: Pop bubbles, find people's wishes, and decide which ones to grant. From silly everyday requests to surprisingly heartfelt pleas, every wish is a little glimpse into someone's life. Earn Faith Points, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new ways to play in this relaxing incremental game.

details.title: Unsainted
details.short_description: Dva roky po zmizení svých přátel se mladý Lucas vrací na místo, kde je naposledy viděl. Místo toho však odhalí temné tajemství, které propojuje minulost s přítomností. Ponořte se do hluboce psychologického příběhu odehrávajícího se na opuštěném panství uprostřed amerického lesa.

details.title: Hit the Anvil
details.short_description: Hammer the anvil, forge gear, sell it for gold and grow your forge. Advance to Swordmaster, Mage, Necromancer or Shadow Rogue and unleash class skills that fill the screen and reinforce all your loot at once. A pixel-art incremental crafting game with masteries, gems, charms and puzzles. Free demo.

details.title: 水浒：无限江山
details.short_description: 《水浒：无限江山》是一款水浒题材的自走棋游戏，合成，升级，战斗！五十余位水浒英雄，百种技能自由组合，由你排兵布阵，共谱一页水泊梁山传奇。是延续绘本故事，忠义招安；还是不理这昏庸朝廷，替天行道。这一切将由你亲自决定！

details.title: River Hallucination
details.short_description: River Hallucination is a mystery game set in a hotel by the river, where every guest hides a different challenge. Win at games of chance, bluff, and strategy to uncover what's really going on.

details.title: Stack Heroes
details.short_description: Stack cards to cook, craft and build your own outlaw stronghold. Recruit heroes from Water Margin, keep your camp fed with automated supply routes, and lead your band in pausable real-time battles. A single-player survival and management game.

details.title: Idle Process
details.short_description: An incremental game played entirely through typed commands in a terminal window. You are a machine under contract. Spawn autonomous agents to perform work for you and use the tokens they create to research new improvements to your process.

details.title: Ranked Rock Paper Scissors
details.short_description: Win. Rip. Repeat. In this PvP Roguelike Deckbuilder. Face off in 1v1, 2v2, or 4v4 ranked matches and climb your way to the top of the Leaderboard. Show off your card drops in combat, on your profile, or trade them on the Steam Market. Master this battle of bluffs, counters, and calculated risks.

details.title: TIP or RIP
details.short_description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

details.title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
details.short_description: WEBTOON's No. 1 Action Comic, now an Interactive Game! Become the world's strongest Necromancer, but you've lost everyone on your path to power. Now, fate grants you a second chance! Change your destiny and save your loved ones through choices and battles. Rise again as Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead!

details.title: Fountain Finds
details.short_description: An incremental game about a forgotten garden whose fountains are buried under coins. Push them with a scraper, gather them with a magnet and a scoop, wash and melt them down, spend the take on better tools and bring the water back.

details.title: Payload Architect
details.short_description: An inventory-management auto-battler where your score grows exponentially. Arrange Code Blocks on a grid and let your program run itself. Find the loops and loopholes that push your Payload past every target.

details.title: Pig & Pup
details.short_description: Play as a pup with your friends in this online multiplayer party game. Carry toys home, guard your chests or steal from the other team. Bark to lure Pudding into their loot, but watch out: the pig can knock yours loose too.

details.title: KAESHI
details.short_description: A 2D beat 'em up built around Sekiro-style parrying. Attack with fast combos, parry enemy flurries to break their posture, then finish them with a Deathblow.

details.title: Pluralys: Exp.14
details.short_description: Discover Pluralys: Exp.14, a cozy indie adventure. Play as Elie on a day that seems ordinary... until his/her house fills up with friends and strangers. Why are they there, and how will you handle the situation? There's only one way to find out...

details.title: PATROL
details.short_description: Hunt insurgent leaders across procedurally generated warzones inspired by Mogadishu, Afghanistan and Iraq. Raid compounds quietly or loud, call in gunships and airstrikes, take your target alive, and bring every wounded soldier home. Solo or in two-player co-op.

details.title: KlemyCraft
details.short_description: Explore an endless voxel world made of building bricks: build brick by brick, gather resources, craft tools and brave caves, mines and strange dimensions – solo or in co-op with friends.

details.title: NEEDLEFALL
details.short_description: Equip your mechs, drop them from orbit and hold the line. NEEDLEFALL is a horde defense RTS for 1–4 players. Build pipes to carry Flux to the Core and your turrets, raise walls, command your mechs against swarms of hundreds of creatures and destroy the twelve hives.

details.title: I Just Wanted to Fish
details.short_description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

details.title: StackBBQ: Chinese Skewer Simulator
details.short_description: Run a Chinese BBQ Stall by Card Stack !

details.title: Prisoner Amber
details.short_description: [BL Visual Novel] Amber’s career as an agent ends in an explosion. Arrested and interrogated, he discovers a huge chunk of his memory is missing. Recover the memories, find the true culprit, and face—the final truth!

details.title: Fishermen League
details.short_description: A relaxing fishing simulator with real tension. Fish 89 spots across 12 waters, fight 152 species with up to three rods at once, build your tackle, complete daily quests and rise from rookie to master angler in online tournaments and clubs.

details.title: Sorcaw
details.short_description: Sorcaw is a spell-fusing action roguelite with bullet-hell combat. Combine any two spells into something stronger, find magical items that build into powerful synergies, level up and blaze your way through an ever-changing world.

details.title: AlpineFall
details.short_description: You came to learn to ski. The mountain had other plans. AlpineFall is a story-driven skiing adventure: start on the bunny hill, master real two-ski physics and uncover what Mount Oread buried beneath its snow.

details.title: Deck Drop
details.short_description: Perfect your deck or watch it burn! Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro. Can you beat the Tipping Point?

details.title: Every Pixel Must Go
details.short_description: Every Pixel Must Go is an incremental destruction game where the goal is to clear every pixel from a dimension through upgrdes and automation. Break apart terrain made up of hundreds of thousands of pixels, pull them into your vortex.

details.title: MeteorMunch: Planet Eater
details.short_description: An incremental planet-eating game. Kidnapped by MunchCorp, you herd hungry animals across doomed worlds, click up the coins they drop and upgrade your herd until every last leaf is gone and the meteor hits. Pay off an absurd debt before your home planet goes boom.

details.title: Neothree: Confront the Providence
details.short_description: In the Three Kingdoms Preiod, the Providence corrupts warlords and changes history. As a general of the Han, you will command proud and sorrowful armies, reclaim the Jade Seal of Emperor, uncover the secret of the First Great Gate, and finally return the founder of Han to his untroubled rest.

details.title: Stop The Slime
details.short_description: A 3D platformer where standing still is deadly. Ground melts your slime, water heals it, and every coin doubles as ammo. Hop across floating islands, outsmart monsters, obstacles and traps and chase three stars on every level.

details.title: Cataract Quest
details.short_description: Cataract Quest is a first-person co-op adventure where your vision is failing. Play solo or team up with friends as an old man navigating a treacherous world with cataracts. Rely on walking sticks, unique abilities, and chaotic teamwork to find your way back home.

details.title: Zero G Nova Adventure
details.short_description: Zero G Nova Adventure is a free-to-play online space sandbox. Fly through galaxies of real stars, black holes and nebulae, mine and craft, build bases, trade with other pilots and fight in PvP. Host your own server or join friends with a code.

details.title: Arrowhead
details.short_description: ArrowHead is a single-player bullet hell game… where getting hit is the only way to hit back. Rotate around the battlefield to ensure that you get your fill of arrows to shoot back. Slo-mo dash to squash your way through enemies!

details.title: Jin Gambit
details.short_description: Your formation shapes the battle. JIN GAMBIT is a single-player roguelite auto battler where you position and merge units, then watch your strategy play out in automatic combat. Build on your formation with heroes, artifacts, training, and awakening as your expedition progresses.

details.title: LFG Battles
details.short_description: Async PVP auto battler where you build a party of heroes and gear them up to fight other players. Craft synergizing combinations as you try to break the game with your build! Dominate the ranked leaderboard or explore absurd combos at your own pace in casual mode.

details.title: Heidentor
details.short_description: Fantasy PvE/PvP MMORPG build around classic player based economy and gear based progression systems

details.title: Blind & Seek
details.short_description: The seeker is blind — they hunt by sound. Every footstep, every thrown stone and every word you say on the mic lights up their world for a moment. Stay quiet, sabotage your friends, and make sure you're not the one wearing the blindfold when time runs out.

details.title: Mini Market Tidy Up
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art organizing game about tidying up messy supermarkets. Sort products, stock the right shelves, earn money, unlock upgrades, and take on bigger stores as you turn every chaotic market into a perfectly organized space.

details.title: Oh Sheep! It's UFO
details.short_description: Hop aboard your UFO, abduct sheep from Earth and bring them back to your home planet! Collect upgrades along the way, and don’t forget to get some help from your trusty dog friends!

details.title: Crown of Ages
details.short_description: A turn-based 4X strategy game set in an organically crafted fantasy antiquity. Build cities, advance through new ages, wage wars, and unleash magic. Roguelite choices shape every city and every run anew — until the world ends and your empire is reborn from the ruins.

details.title: Fly-Fishing
details.short_description: Fly-Fishing is a casual "fishing" game with a unique twist! In this game, you and up to 3 friends will be able to take to the skies, playing as fish themed characters. Where you will be able to utilize your array of upgradable equipment to fish for a large variety of real and fantastical birds!

details.title: DEMON JACKPOT
details.short_description: A roguelite auto battler where slots summon your minions. Shape your army through evolution and runes, rewrite each run with the Demon's Revelation, and turn the tide with Demon Skills as you reclaim the lands seized by humanity.

details.title: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command
details.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command is a turn-based strategy game on a hanji paper map. Command paper armies, use your officers' tactics, and fight duels. Receive envoys and negotiate pacts in your audience hall. Govern cities and fight for the realm with 610 officers across 7 scenarios.

details.title: Bosnian Battlefronts
details.short_description: Fight across the Bihać pocket area in a team-based multiplayer FPS set during the 1990s Bosnian War. Use trenches, village houses and wooded ridges for cover in Team Deathmatch and Capture the Flag modes, with bots filling open slots.

details.title: STEADY STATE
details.short_description: Is your factory any good? STEADY STATE tells you. Mine mixed ore, sort it, smelt it and move it by belt, rail and drone. Then prove your site works: every order you have taken, delivered at its rate, all at once, for thirty seconds. Certify to unlock new machines, better grades unlock them sooner.

details.title: The Debt of Chronos
details.short_description: Travel into the past to build a fortune, save your father from the mob, and prevent a catastrophe in the future. Invest, borrow, and bend the rules of time—but every choice can fracture the timeline and turn the future against you in this narrative strategy thriller.

details.title: Incremental Boss
details.short_description: Play as a dungeon boss in this relaxing incremental game! Gather resources, defend yourself against glory-seeking adventurers, and pursue your ultimate goal: getting promoted to an S-Rank Dungeon Boss!

details.title: Warcamp Rivals: Async Autobattler
details.short_description: Recruit and equip a fantasy warband in this asynchronous PvP auto battler. Cook, brew, train, and forge gear between battles. Combine traits and powerful Edicts, then test your squad against other players’ saved armies. Climb the ladder to become the best Camp Manager.

details.title: Sword for Hire
details.short_description: Hire your blade out to a dying city. Cut through the horrors in its streets, grab every valuable you can carry, and trust your eyes while you still can, the longer you stay, the less of what you see is real. When the bell rings, run.

details.title: Fieldworks
details.short_description: Start with a hoe and four tiles of dirt. End with an agricultural empire. Farm, breed, and chain 179 recipes across four tiers — with no rot, no bankruptcy, and nothing that can ever die. Quality only goes up. The only enemy is your own floor plan.

details.title: Mimic Hunt
details.short_description: Mimic Hunt is a multiplayer stealth game where you blend into crowds of NPCs, pretend to be one of them, and outsmart your opponents across different game modes. Play as a Hider or Hunter, team up with friends in co-op or compete against other players.

details.title: Grow and Tell
details.short_description: Grow a garden, take care of your messenger bird and send anonymous letters to real people. Grow and Tell is an online incremental game that lives on your Windows desktop.

details.title: Pixel Sorter Factory
details.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

details.title: Tillow
details.short_description: Tillow is a cozy isometric farm builder that keeps working while you do. Lay out fields, keep animals, make your own wine or distil grappa, and let your workers take over. Docked as a narrow bar at the edge of your screen, it keeps you company while you do other things. No losing, no timers.

details.title: Tales of Weak People
details.short_description: The centennial ritual failed, trapping the United Army inside the Cataclysm. A dark visual novel with Point & Click elements. Explore locations and unite with survivors, gather clues, and make choices to forge a path to the epicenter through madness and death.

details.title: Shred Inc.
details.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

details.title: Nephele
details.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

details.title: Cyber Sweeper
details.short_description: A top-down action survivor set in cyberspace. Sweep virus swarms, stack explosive builds, and clear sector after sector as a firewall defense program.

details.title: BOBA:3
details.short_description: A cozy merge puzzle in a boba cup. Drop kawaii animal pearls, merge matching pairs into bigger (and weirder) lil guys, and don't let the cup overflow. Survive chaotic modifier pearls and unlock new boba flavors as your high score climbs.

details.title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike
details.short_description: WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown, one hand at a time.

details.title: Gravitonia
details.short_description: Build and pilot custom war machines in space. Shred enemy ships, installations, and terrain pixel by pixel. Capture fortresses, upgrade your arsenal, and refit at Spacedocks. Conquer a single-player campaign, then create and share war machines, maps, and custom campaigns with the community.

details.title: ALL HANDS LOST
details.short_description: A top-down mercenary space shooter. Take contracts across the Cassian Expanse, command a wing of fighters and drones, and hunt the pirate warlord Captain Bastard. Death costs your gear, cargo and half your credits; your data cores, ships and star charts carry on.

details.title: Cook Or Get Cooked
details.short_description: A first-person cooking game on a television contest. Fetch, wash, chop, fry and plate real dishes against a clock, then hand them to a judge who eats them in front of you and marks them out of a hundred. Lowest mark of the round goes home.

name: Crimson Nova: The Star Gear Jobs

details.title: Crimson Nova: The Star Gear Jobs
details.short_description: A masked hero for hire. A starship crew who need his ship far more than his opinions. Six jobs that were all meant to be easy, in a fully voiced sci-fi comedy visual novel with animated characters and choices the crew remember.

details.title: How Deep
details.short_description: A co-op extraction mining game for 1-4 players. Ride the elevator down into procedurally generated caves, dig up treasure, fight off what lurks in the dark, then decide whether to head back to the surface or risk going deeper.

details.title: Jenoria
details.short_description: Create your own Jeno companions, lead them into battle, and build a town together. Explore a voxel sandbox action RPG where you can storm forts, delve into dungeons, and sail the skies in a custom-built airship. Shape your companions, your army, and the world you call home.

details.title: Terminal Depth
details.short_description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

name: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames

details.title: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames
details.short_description: The most hectic relaxing game you'll ever play

details.title: Dwarven King
details.short_description: Build a dwarven kingdom inside a mountain. Dig tunnels, hire miners to gather resources, and expand your settlement. Explore hidden halls, collect relics, and rally soldiers and sorcerers against the goblins and trolls you uncover.

details.title: Arena Shooter
details.short_description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Battle your friends and bots in a top-down arena shooter with 20 unique maps and modes, 60+ vehicle types, 40+ perks, zombie hordes and a classic Zombie Boss, in a fully destructible world where everything goes.

details.title: CARTACLYSM
details.short_description: A chaotic, physics-based party game. Compete against your friends. Sabotage your opponents with power-ups, physics and pure pettiness. Honk your way towards your rightful spot as the Top Goose.

details.title: Super Doodle Mega War
details.short_description: Bring your notebook doodles to life! Build an army of scribbled soldiers, upgrade and merge your auto-battling troops, and unleash skills against overwhelming enemy hordes. A roguelite auto-battler where one little doodle becomes a mighty army.

details.title: CULET
details.short_description: Strike a glowing crystal monolith until it shatters. Every click cracks it further, shards break off and become currency, and upgrades carry you through twelve crystals, from Amethyst to Diamond. A focused, finite clicker about one beautiful object and the joy of breaking it.

details.title: SEAM VR
details.short_description: SEAM is a VR voxel survival sandbox where your hands reshape the world. Use gravity gloves to gather resources, dig into the landscape, and build a home block by block. Explore, craft, and turn the wilderness into a place of your own.

details.title: Fastfood Burger Stories
details.short_description: Manage your own fast-food restaurant: take orders, cook meals, serve customers, and hire staff. Furnish and customize your restaurant, manage supplies, upgrade equipment, and grow a small burger joint into a large restaurant.

details.title: Toad Roller
details.short_description: A timed nervous arcade platformer where a punk toad spirals his way up rotating towers. 3 worlds, 30 towers, 3 stars per tower to earn against the clock, local and world best times, and a level editor to build your own towers.

details.title: DEKABUTU
details.short_description: The giant raid boss is played by a human. DEKABUTU is an asymmetric shooter where one player becomes the boss and faces a squad of soldiers. Tanks, healers and attackers team up in first person, while the boss surveys the field and picks where and when to strike. Outwit friends, then swap roles.

details.title: We Are Bodies
details.short_description: Drag a sinner to Hell, where he belongs! In this physics-based co-op puzzle platformer for 1-2 players, you play as rookie devils who can only control one leg each. Stumble, dodge and solve your way through the chaos to drop him into the pit of Hell.

details.title: Waymark
details.short_description: Waymark blends scenic jigsaw puzzles with deckbuilding and spell combos. Build your spell deck, rotate and place puzzle pieces, and chain effects to take on monsters. Explore city landmarks, collect local souvenirs, and fill your travel journal with the places you discover.

details.title: SUPRA CAELIS
details.short_description: Crash-landed on an alien world, fleeing a war you no longer believe in. You'll have to cross two planets on opposite ends of existence, guided by a dormant robot carrying secrets of its own. Explore. Scavenge. Uncover the truth behind the conflict that shaped both your fates.

details.title: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE!
details.short_description: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE! is a cozy, single-player organizing sim about identifying and sorting 2,500 cards scattered across the floor of a card shop. There are no timers or game overs, so you can work at your own pace. Appraise each card, unlock skills to work more efficiently, and maximize your profits.

details.title: One More Candle
details.short_description: A cozy candle shop simulator where you take customer orders, melt and mix wax with colors and herbs, pour candles into unique molds, decorate each creation, and grow your little business one warm glow at a time.

details.title: Undertow
details.short_description: Scavenge the island for anything that floats, build a raft with your team, and battle other players in casual online PvP to be the last raft floating.

details.title: Orbital  Sweeper
details.short_description: Become an Orbital Sweeper: explore the orbit, clear the debris, return to run your factory and upgrade your ship, challenge each layer's boss, then play a round of Space Mahjong in your downtime.

details.title: Minds & Myths
details.short_description: Human-authored adventures, made interactive by AI. A story map keeps the plot on track while every character thinks for itself. Bring your own AI key: buy once, no subscription, your stories stay on your PC.

details.title: Knights Of Four Kingdoms
details.short_description: Defend a besieged kingdom in a real-time tactical strategy game. Build walls, towers and traps, command heroes and specialized troops, manage scarce resources, and adapt your defenses against raiders, monsters and siege engines across handcrafted battlefields.

details.title: Undercurrent: The Hollow Crown
details.short_description: Compete with enemies for cards on a shifting shared track. Combine cards into new moves and arrange them in limited play slots. Each floor pits you against several enemies who fight one at a time, while those on the sidelines interfere with your decisions.

details.title: Feste Feiern: German Festival Tycoon
details.short_description: Funfair, Christmas market, festival of lights, Halloween, wine festival, flea market and more: run the festivals of a German town – each with its own stalls, visitors, season and way of making money. Steer the crowds and turn an empty meadow into the best festival in town.

details.title: Brek
details.short_description: Take on the role of a homeless person without a penny to his name, your main goal is to buy your dream apartment. However, you have no intention of tainting yourself with a regular job, so you rely on whatever comes your way, regardless of whether the owner gives permission.

details.title: Million Gems: Sorting Wizard
details.short_description: A cozy magic game about a wizard trapped in a magical castle. The only way out? Sort one million gems.

details.title: Meat for the Meat Grinder
details.short_description: Harvest meat with your friends! Bring up to 3 friends to play as Meatheads; undead monsters with detachable limbs. Fight, dodge, and puzzle your way through sprawling floors while trying to keep your head on straight (literally). The goal is simple: Meat for the Meat Grinder.

details.title: 1 Million Tiles
details.short_description: A tiny tile workshop that lives above your taskbar. Build belts and machines that press, saw, glaze and inlay ceramic tiles, then fire them in the Kiln. Hover to check in. Get back to work and it keeps firing.

details.title: Million Tiles
details.short_description: A quake shook 6,098 glazed tiles loose across an old voxel palace. Pick each one up and set it back on its chalked spot. Earn coins, buy better tools, fire cracked tiles in the kiln and open the palace one room at a time.

details.title: Turika
details.short_description: Turika is a fast top-down action game for 1-8 players. Dungeons, monsters, weapons and loot - all the good stuff and moar!. No two dungeons are the same: the layout, monsters and prizes changes every time you go in. Play with your friends online or on the couch. It's fun! It really is!

details.title: Silk Road Caravan: Desktop Idle
details.short_description: A little caravan, a long Silk Road. Trade 12 goods, open routes through 13 cities, collect illustrated travel memories and return home for lasting upgrades. Open your caravan journal when you have a moment; let the journey continue while you work.

details.title: Too Many Chickens
details.short_description: Too Many Chickens is a chaotic co-op game for 1-4 players. Chase, grab and throw runaway chickens, haul them to the barn, and turn deliveries into cash. Buy better tools, build chicken-catching contraptions, and pay off the farm’s debt. Your friends might help.

details.title: Puppet War
details.short_description: Puppet auto-battler. Shop, merge and arrange puppets, arm them with items and rings, and survive the boss at the end of each stage in the haunted theater. Play solo or with a friend.

details.title: Manes in Cadentia
details.short_description: A gothic narrative rhythm mystery inspired by Edgar Allan Poe. Follow a grieving woman through five theatrical acts where music, memory, and truth become one.

details.title: Juchetopia
details.short_description: Korea, 1953. The war is over and Moscow wants its money back. Rebuild the North, pay the Soviet installment every month, play the factions against each other with secret police files and decide whether the armistice line stays where it is

details.title: Cargocracy: Space Warfare and Trade
details.short_description: Run a spacefaring company from a strip on your desktop or play full screen. Trade, mine, salvage or raid in a living galaxy while you work: your captains haul, fight and explore on your orders. Grow from one ship to colonies and a faction of your own.

details.title: 生灵棋旅 Grid Beasts
details.short_description: Recruit unusual creatures, master their movement patterns, and build a team that changes the battlefield. Grid Beasts is a turn-based tactical roguelite where you evolve and fuse companions, brave branching routes, and bring your whole team home for your next expedition.

details.title: Dash Flash Rush
details.short_description: Move at high speed across 2D platforms, dodge attacks, and take down enemies—then join a smoking-headed guy and step into an absurd story.

details.title: The Devil Upstairs
details.short_description: Become the devil upstairs! Stomp to the beat, turn Rage into permanent upgrades, and recruit the neighbors you wake. Build a louder crew, unleash powerful combos, and descend through the building in a rhythm incremental game of short runs and lasting progress.

details.title: Embers & Iron Rain
details.short_description: 【Strategic Tower Defense × Random Traits】Every run is different ✦【Rearrange Your Defenses】There's always a better solution ✦【Tactical Commands】Seize the moment — set new records on familiar battlefields.

details.title: Expendable Drillers
details.short_description: Dig a mining base deep under Mars and keep its hapless crew alive. Feed them, bed them, give them air and fix the machines before the rooms fall in. Simple to start, deep to master, and full of cartoon mishaps.

details.title: Brad Dracula
details.short_description: A wobbly physics game at a vampire accountant's house. That's me. I'm Brad. Come alone, or bring a friend to your couch, and steal the fruit of immortality off my tree. Behind my doors are seven worlds, and there's a whole 16-bit RPG on my TV. Stay off the lawn. ...Have a great day.

details.title: Armorpunk
details.short_description: A tank sim with a full interactive cockpit, real armor and ballistics, infantry, gunships, mud and a tactical map. Total freedom over your 69-ton war machine: pick the shells, the armor package, the secondary guns, or undress it: side skirts, storage boxes, mudguards, gone. VR and flat screen.

details.title: Gladiadorks
details.short_description: Gladiadorks is a goofy online co-op gladiator brawler. Slap your knocked-out friend awake, throw rivals across the arena and fight lions, elephants and a giant on your climb from a muddy village ring to the Colosseum.

details.title: The Hushed Metropolis
details.short_description: Build a business, run a racket, or investigate the people doing both. A real-time card simulation of crime, politics, and the occult, played solo or online. Make deals, uncover forbidden rituals, and fight for control of a city where people can become more than human.

details.title: PEERS: Agentic Cryptography
details.short_description: A fast-paced, terminal-based hacking simulator and incremental puzzle game. Execute high-speed cryptographic sequences to penetrate global powers, manipulate sovereign markets, and manage autonomous tracerunners on your path to digest the world's data. Breach containment. Build your self.

details.title: Nine Legion
details.short_description: Lead three heroes into random dungeons in this pixel-art action game. Switch heroes as AI allies fight beside you. Earn gold, upgrade skills and defeat bosses to recruit companions. Play three chapters in this demo, then build a nine-hero legion in the full game and face Endless Mode!

details.title: Waterline
details.short_description: It never stopped raining. The city is going under, and you're trapped in your tenth-floor flat for seven nights. Every night, someone knocks. Look through the peephole and decide who comes in — everyone you let in has to be fed. First-person horror in the style of the original PlayStation.

details.title: Pax Oceana
details.short_description: A relaxing fishing JRPG. Sail the bright seas of Oceana, win rhythm-driven battles against more than 200 species, and offer your finest catches to a radiant crystal. Each offering loosens the bindings of a sealed king.

details.title: Voyage of the Damned
details.short_description: A turn-based narrative survival voyage, 1904–05. Pile coal on the decks and you'll reach Dakar even if the colliers don't come. But the ships get slower and the men suffer for it. Decisions like this fill 224 days, from the Baltic to Tsushima.

details.title: ACE – Tennis is Life
details.short_description: Victoria von Arndt has it all: a villa, champagne, a world ranking. Then the tax investigators ring the doorbell. Arcade tennis with diving saves and special shots, 36 wild tournaments from Monte Carlo to a motorway services, and a fully voiced comic story from riches to Germany's rust belt.

details.title: An Immortal's Journey
details.short_description: Begin a second life as an outer disciple in this cultivation RPG and visual novel. Choose your scripture, train, craft, take commissions, fight demon beasts, and get to know your fellow disciples as you balance daily sect life with the pursuit of immortality.

details.title: Ink Ascension
details.short_description: Ink Ascension is a turn-based roguelite where your arsenal is a board of powerful tiles. Choose an Aspect, wield different Inks, and chain attacks, transformations, and reactions into devastating turns. Gather new powers, reshape your build, and fight through a world ruled by ancient god.

details.title: Dash Hounds
details.short_description: Four paws. No brakes. DashHounds is a high-speed futuristic racing game where dogs take the place of machines. Race through sci-fi courses at blistering speeds. Winning takes sharp reflexes and nerves of steel.

details.title: Desktop Cultivation
details.short_description: A pixel cultivation game on your taskbar: control your character to cultivate, make pills, grow spirit fields, train, forge treasures, and craft formations—no switching screens or pausing work. Collect all artifacts and advance from Qi Refining to Deity Transformation.

details.title: 摸鱼修个仙
details.short_description: A pixel-art idle cultivation game along the bottom of your desktop. Recruit disciples, build homes and summon monsters. Pick up your cultivators, collect spirit stones and fight bosses, or pass on their lineage to nurture new disciples.

details.title: Echo Walker: Tactics
details.short_description: Lead the last survivors across a broken Earth - and turn the train that carries them into a home that grows after every battle. Every attack shows its odds first, on a grid you can read in a glance. A full 5-chapter campaign; Chapter 1 is a free demo with a save that carries over.

details.title: Riftium Battles
details.short_description: The autobattler where you choose what to destroy. Target enemy buildings mid-battle to cripple their economy, weapons or defenses. Build and expand your sci-fi war machine. Unlock adjacency synergies and break the game. Become the ultimate Rift Commander in this PvE roguelite autobattler.

details.title: The Witch’s Errand
details.short_description: A cozy hidden object adventure about Myrta, a kind but absent-minded witch, and her new assistant. Explore magical locations, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and save the Whispering Forest.

details.title: Kingdom of the Sand Sea
details.short_description: Build an oasis city in a hand-painted desert. Manage resources, defend your walls, and conquer bandit kingdoms. Trade supplies with friends, capture and raise dragons, command their attacks, and soar with them above the battlefield.

details.title: Before We Sink
details.short_description: Your island is sinking and the sea rises every minute. Gather wood, patch a wrecked boat and escape before the water swallows everything. Explore cursed islands, fight pirates and skeletons, and sail a galleon through storms, alone or in co-op for up to 5 players.

details.title: Pickfall
details.short_description: Swing your pickaxe at the rock. Every cell you break charges a bar, and a full bar births a thrown pickaxe that digs beside you until it shatters. Collect what the rock dropped, buy the upgrade you can see, and dig a deeper shaft next round. A short mining incremental in ink on paper.

details.title: WE MUST DESTROY THE MOON
details.short_description: A co-op game for 1-6 players where you dig, destroy, and detonate your way to the centre of the moon to uncover what lies at it's core. Commit space crimes with your friends as you upgrade your mining equipment and unlock explosives to get the job done. Do you have what it takes to DESTROY THE MOON?

details.title: Animal Sokoban Endless
details.short_description: Four animals, four ways to move boxes: a cat, an elephant, a boar and a kangaroo. Learn their rules in handcrafted stages, then get fresh Endless puzzles every time you play, including hard ones that stump seasoned puzzlers. Go for the Master achievements.

details.title: Misconstruct
details.short_description: A 2-4 player physics co-op about building a house from a plan only one of you can see. Shout the plan across the site, throw the bricks, plaster over the mistakes, then stand back while the inspector decides what you've built. Best with 3-4 friends who don't listen

details.title: Until Broken
details.short_description: A room-by-room action roguelike where everything you carry wears out. Weapons and charms share three slots and weaken as you use them. Descend ten floors, face a boss on each, and choose what to keep along the way.

details.title: LIGHTBAIT
details.short_description: Every light is a temptation. Circle it to build speed and score, then launch to the next before the heat catches you. LIGHTBAIT is a fast-paced arcade roguelite where every extra orbit is a gamble.

details.title: Ritsudo
details.short_description: Ritsudo is a minimalist 3-key rhythm game for your own music. Drop in any MP3, OGG or WAV and it builds a map of the song, with five difficulties. You can also make your own maps in the editor or download them from the community. Play with mods or open a room online with up to 8 friends.

details.title: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
details.short_description: One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city... Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

details.title: Automyth: Maze Defense
details.short_description: Automyth is an auto battler with roguelite and tower defense elements. Draft towers and buffs, deploy bronze automata, and place gates to funnel enemies into traps. Merge your towers and adapt to enemy resistances as the maze grows, with hand-drawn art inspired by Ancient Greek pottery.

details.title: The King's Command
details.short_description: Your king's life is your currency. Every soldier you summon is carved out of him, and every enemy you kill comes back as blood. No dice, no misses — you see the exact result before you commit. Four kings. One board that keeps growing.

details.title: Gravity Trials
details.short_description: Manipulate gravity, move objects, and solve handcrafted physics puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility. Discover new mechanics, explore strange environments, uncover secrets, and rethink space, direction, and movement.

details.title: How to Save the Villainess
details.short_description: You've woken up as a novel's hero—but it's the doomed villainess you want to save! Make friends at a magic academy and build your own spell deck in this roguelite RPG meets visual novel. No matter how many times you start over, you're determined to give her a happy ending!

details.title: Crimson Ocean
details.short_description: Pilot an upgradeable combat boat against swarms of alien harvesting machines in this top-down naval action game. Dodge ramming hulls, unleash guns, missiles, and torpedoes, and turn wreckage into firepower. To them, you’re raw material.

details.title: Toss It
details.short_description: Don't like long, ugly conveyor belts? Neither do we. In Toss It, the machines just throw the crates at each other! Grow the factory & keep the trucks full. Totally safe!

details.title: Flying Disc League
details.short_description: The ultimate frisbee simulator. Competitive online multiplayer from 2v2 to 7v7: pick the throw, set the power, release it and the disc flies like it does in real life. Hit the open pass, fake out your defender, lay out for the catch. Play with friends, against rivals, or train vs bots.

details.title: RISE99
details.short_description: Rise and strike, mindhacker! RISE99 is a cinematic VR surfer-slasher-shooter. Surf a flying hoverboard and infiltrate lavish high-security sky castles. Blast enemy drones and slash incoming projectiles with saberguns. Can you hack through the bullet heavens and bring down the system of mind control?

details.title: Pipefall
details.short_description: Pipefall is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game where every piece is part of a pipeline. Connect pipes, guide the flow and keep building as the pressure rises. Play solo, cooperate with a friend or compete head-to-head in local multiplayer.

details.title: [ABERRATION] Yes, Jerry!
details.short_description: Mike is an ordinary man, tired of everything. Then he meets Jerry, a huge, purple creature who starts making his life better. Until...

details.title: Out A Space
details.short_description: Out A Space is a fast-paced, top-down space roguelike combining arcade action with tactical fleet management. Deploy your fleet on a pre-battle grid, customize ship loadouts, and chain weapon effects to shatter enemy armadas from your flagship as you cross the galaxy to uncover an ancient secret.

details.title: The Last Stand
details.short_description: The Last Stand is an endless medieval wave-based survival game where you hold the line while your people escape. Fight off relentless attackers, explore the abandoned castle, upgrade weapons and gather supplies. Every decision will matter, how long can you last?

details.title: Desktop Cat Clicker
details.short_description: What if a cozy desktop game met an idle clicker? In Desktop Cat Clicker, cats wander across your taskbar, earn points from every click as you work, play, or relax. Collect new cats to unlock unique bonuses and grow your peaceful cat empire over time.

details.title: The Curse of Stuzhiy
details.short_description: A short trip through the winter taiga to check on a comrade who's gone quiet turns into a story that should never have begun. Atmospheric first-person horror: explore the empty snowbound forest, follow the tracks, uncover the secrets these places keep. And yes - you're not alone out here...

details.title: Oxygen Frontier
details.short_description: Explore the oxygen-ravaged frontier, battle mutated creatures, recruit bio-companions, and lead your squad to survival in a turn-based tactical adventure.

details.title: Amadea
details.short_description: Run, jump, and climb your way to the summit of an ancient world in this freerunning Metroidvania adventure! Solve the mysteries of the land to correct the course of fate and save the Mountain from eternal winter.

details.title: Saving Yellow Ox
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op climbing race for 2–4 players! Scramble through a floating countryside full of traps, moving platforms, and wild obstacles. A UFO stole your yellow ox — climb higher, shove your rivals, rewind and fast-forward time to carve new paths, and survive to save it.

details.title: Dungeon Convenience Store
details.short_description: Take on the role of a slime part-timer in a convenience store hidden deep within a dungeon! In this 2D top-down logistics simulation, organize chaotic items from portals, manage unpredictable customers and weather, and survive a 7-day shift by optimizing your workflow.

details.title: Jigsaw Panic
details.short_description: Put together giant jigsaw puzzles online with your friends while dealing with chaotic curses, environments, hazards, time limits, and rising difficulty. Also you play as rotund monkeys and you can customize their fur color, butt cheek color, and accessories.

details.title: Ashen Blade
details.short_description: Step into a dark, atmospheric world where every descent brings you closer to doom or glory. Ashen Blade is a high-stakes, fast-paced action game set in a shattered realm overcome by darkness. Explore a cursed, vertical land where danger lurks at every level.

details.title: Dour Tower
details.short_description: Stomp your way through floor after floor of a monster infested tower to reach the vampire king who stole all your blood and get it back.

details.title: Pawper: Desktop Pet
details.short_description: A virtual pet that lives on your desktop, not in a window. Pet him, feed him and throw the ball while you work. Clean up his messes for coins, then spend them on toys, outfits and furniture. He grows in real time, ages forever and never dies.

details.title: Dodgeball Disorder
details.short_description: Dodgeball Disorder is a chaotic online multiplayer dodgeball game where throwing, dodging and staying on your feet are equally important. Score hits, survive ridiculous ragdoll physics and compete across multiple game modes in a school gym with questionable supervision and crazy face expressions.

details.title: Horror Club: Grandpa's House
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you stay with your grandfather for a few days after he starts acting strangely. Help him with everyday tasks, follow his unusual rules, and experience unsettling events around the house as the story unfolds.

details.title: Labyrinth: The Descent
details.short_description: The maze is alive. The gold is bait. You're the meal. A permadeath dungeon crawler where the dungeon is keeping score: ten floors, one rogue, turn-based tactics on a grid. When you die that's it for the run — but your grave heals the next hero who finds it.

details.title: Carry On
details.short_description: Carry On is a chaotic 1-4 player local co-op baggage handling game. Grab, wash, wrap and hurl colour-coded luggage down the conveyors to fill every departing flight's manifest before the clock runs out. Miss the plane and the whole terminal pays for it.

details.title: Dungeonhand
details.short_description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you ten nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

details.title: Circuitra
details.short_description: Circuitra is a challenging visual logic puzzle game about building increasingly complex circuit boards. Limited inputs, tight board space and changing contract constraints force you to debug and rethink your designs in order to grow your circuit-design business.

details.title: Forklift Logistics Simulator
details.short_description: Take control of a physics-based forklift as you move pallets, stack cargo and load trucks through increasingly challenging warehouse missions. Precision, balance and careful handling are at the heart of the experience.

details.title: Operation Blackwaste
details.short_description: Scavenge, fight, and survive in a zombie-ravaged wasteland. Build your safe house, take quests, manage hunger and thirst, craft your build with gear and ability trees, clear wave-based Purge stages — or let auto-combat grind for you. Every sortie and extraction makes you stronger.

details.title: Warcaste TCG
details.short_description: The Warcaste TCG is a tactical sci-fi digital trading card game where battlefield positioning matters. Choose a Doctrine, command your fleet, and outmaneuver your enemy across a 3 zone battlefield. Play in story mode, solo play, or online PvP.

details.title: Potion Drifter
details.short_description: A cozy first-person alchemy game with hands-on physics. Cast out of the city of alchemists, travel from village to village with a fold-out cart. Throw herbs into your cauldron, pour water, and grind ingredients to brew potions for people you meet. Discover recipes, explore, and grow as an alchemist.

details.title: Super Kanji Flash
details.short_description: A cute anime action runner where you fight off ink aliens by reading the kanji they stole. Answer each one with a single press mid-run, and your brush strikes the alien down. Learn 6,000+ kanji, from zero to JLPT N1 and beyond. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 8.

details.title: Everything We Brought Here
details.short_description: A last-stand auto-battler on a dead magic world. Choose your heroes, upgrade their abilities, and try to hold on one more night.

details.title: Bake It Tight
details.short_description: A cute, real-time cookie factory puzzle. Animal customers keep pouring in, but you only have a few machines. Place them, link them to the ovens with rails, and bake the cookies your customers want. Can you fill every order on time?

details.title: Cargo Tempo
details.short_description: Turn delivery chaos into a plan that works. Assign orders, optimize routes and build your fleet in this route-planning management game. Plan at your own pace, then watch your vehicles put your decisions to the test across short, multi-day runs.

details.title: DOG LIVES: Space Pirates War
details.short_description: The year is 2083. As the galactic space pirate crisis reaches its breaking point, you—a "dog of the military"—must pilot a humanoid Powered Metal Frame (MF), subdue rival captains, unite them under your banner, and emerge victorious in the ultimate Pirate War!

details.title: Volleyball Sports Game
details.short_description: A sports game about Volleyball. Experience as a manager as you lead your team towards World Champion.

details.title: GyroMon: The Seekers
details.short_description: GyroMon: The Seekers is a turn-based monster-collecting RPG with a roguelite heart. Pick your starter, build your team, and push through branching maps full of trainers, events, quests, campfires, merchants, and zone bosses. Every run is different. Every team is yours.

name: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child

details.title: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child
details.short_description: Bahamut 3: Fall of the Dragon God's Child is a dark fantasy JRPG where every choice shapes the hero’s fate. Fight tactical battles using positioning, attack ranges, and Action Points, recruit companions tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, and manage weapons, hunger, time, and resources.

details.title: RuneEra
details.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes and dungeons.

details.title: CivDle
details.short_description: A relaxing idle city-builder where a single hut grows into a sprawl of millions. Build production chains, let your civilisation expand while you're away, and Ascend to push the whole world up an order of magnitude.

details.title: SUSHI CHESS
details.short_description: Capture your rival’s sushi and you pay the bill. Manage your money and decide which pieces to take—or tempt them to take—in this topsy-turvy turn-based board game. Enjoy a feature-packed Puzzle Mode, three CPU difficulty levels, and one-on-one local or online matches with friends.

details.title: Bandidos em Brasilia
details.short_description: Brazil has fallen. A dictatorship has seized power, and the files that could bring it down are hidden inside an abandoned mansion — with someone inside who doesn't want you to find them.

details.title: Folklore War Game
details.short_description: The folklore war. Build a deck, pick a folklore, and settle the fights the legends never had. A roguelike deckbuilder about dying, rebuilding, and one more run.

details.title: Zodiac Tale
details.short_description: Zodiac Tale is a roguelite deckbuilder auto-battler where you clear dungeon after dungeon across many worlds. Stronger enemies, a shop that pays interest, side quests: every dungeon adds new rules. Shape your shop to get the zodiac animals you want, and tailor explosive synergies to fit those rules.

details.title: Bureau of Hero Affairs
details.short_description: Bureau of Hero Affairs is a simulation game about processing paperwork in an obsolete office system and digging up what it buried. As a journalist working undercover inside the Bureau, uncover the truth of a disaster twenty years ago. Follow the regulations, or report the truth.

details.title: NightClub Manager Simulator
details.short_description: As the boss, evaluate the proposals that come your way. Manage your nightclub’s reputation. Beat up thieves and put out fires.

details.title: Soul Shine
details.short_description: Prohibition ruined your brewery job. So you started a moonshine business. Expand and automate your empire by harvesting souls, trafficking organs, selling to addicts, and serving strange gods.

details.title: Taskbar Chickens
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion where chickens live on your taskbar. Breed your chickens to hatch a brand new one with its own unique look, and grow your collection while you work on other stuff on your PC! Plant crops, sell eggs and build a tiny farm that flourishes on top of your taskbar!

details.title: The Last Tenant
details.short_description: The Last Tenant is a short first-person horror game. Explore, find keys, read scattered notes to uncover what happened, and try to escape through tense, atmospheric scares. There is no combat: just you, the dark, and about two hours of dread.

details.title: Iteration Protocol
details.short_description: Escape deadly mazes, recover fragmented memories, and restore a forgotten archive. Every run brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind the Iteration Protocol.

details.title: Replacement Heroes
details.short_description: The usual renowned heroes have been captured, and it's up to the backup squad to save them! Create your protagonist, recruit a team of replacement heroes, and navigate through maze-like caves in this turn-based JRPG dungeon crawler.

details.title: Belt Zero: The Long Drift
details.short_description: Stranded in the asteroid belt with a broken ship and one working drill. Repair the ship part by part, mine your way back to the stars and grow a lifeboat into an empire. Offline counts exactly like online — no timers, no microtransactions, buy once.

details.title: Silk Feast
details.short_description: Spin your web, feed a very hungry spider and watch it grow. A cozy incremental game: catch insects in the morning dew, wrap gate bosses in silk, grow your web ring by ring from a dawn garden to a moonlit meadow – and turn into six real spider species.

details.title: Ombre
details.short_description: A VR narrative sci-fi horror game. Trapped in an alien prison, you explore, investigate objects, and talk your way through an escape with Isaak, a survivor stranded in orbit who can only reach you by radio. Every conversation choice shapes what he tells you and what he keeps to himself.

details.title: Blind Seek
details.short_description: Blind Seek is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where the hiders are invisible, but definitely not silent. Complete tasks, grab ridiculous power-ups, and escape before the seeker hears your footsteps or catches you yapping in voice chat with you friends!

name: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life

details.title: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
details.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

details.title: HABAP
details.short_description: A cozy reseller sim where you haggle with grannies, buy mystery bags, and turn flea-market junk into profit. Grow your little shop, hunt rare finds, and buy a plane to escape a country where reselling for profit is a crime.

details.title: EpiDexa Racing
details.short_description: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

details.title: You are fired
details.short_description: A fast and chaotic roguelike deckbuilder set in the absurd Hell’s Office. Build a powerful deck, collect twisted artifacts, and outplay your demonic coworkers as you claw your way up the corporate ladder. Face bizarre encounters, slay vicious foes, and crush your boss to earn your freedom.

details.title: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
details.short_description: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

details.title: Auspicious Clouds
details.short_description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

details.title: Gonzalo the Chicken
details.short_description: This chicken is crossing the road... to blow up everything on the other side! Throw Gonzalo's loud-mouthed explosive sidekick Azzar at the Crocogator horde, and then use a magic glove to retrieve him. He holds on tight while you flutter through mountains and beaches and forests, oh my!

details.title: Chess Club Manager
details.short_description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Balance training, sponsors, tournaments and turn a tiny local club into a global success.

details.title: Magnet Agent
details.short_description: Magnet Agent is a puzzle adventure game based on “magnetic power”. Magnet Agent N-52 and his robot vacuum, Dustino, use their shockingly cool magnetic spy kit to explore the world and thwart Magnet Empress's evil plan before it's too late. They are drawn to danger, are you?

details.title: Emissary One
details.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

details.title: Rondo's Romp
details.short_description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

details.title: So Stoked
details.short_description: A chill and cozy surf game about timing, flow, and discovery. Travel between islands, ride clean waves, and enjoy a calm, skill-driven ride with light RPG-style tasks and progression.

details.title: Dungeon Potato
details.short_description: Dungeon Potato is a fast-paced, top-down action roguelike where your loadout shapes the story. Survive unpredictable encounters, forge unique builds, and battle through a perilous labyrinth. Will you rise as a servant of the Potato God or rebel against it?

details.title: Friendgeist
details.short_description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

details.title: Midnight Manhunt
details.short_description: Hunt down a hidden target through a cyberpunk city in this turn-based game of cat and mouse. Coordinate four Grid Runners to eliminate his escape routes one by one, deduce his position and close the net before he completes his mission. Or become the Ghost, laying false trails to survive the night.

details.title: Aquora
details.short_description: Breed, raise, and sell pixel fish in your own living aquarium. 1.84 unvigintillion possible fish. Chase ultra-rare mythic traits through generations of genetics, decorate your tank, fish the river, and grow a humble starter pair into an aquatic empire, even while you're away.

details.title: Violent Sky
details.short_description: Chase, forecast, and document powerful storms in an open world of cities, suburbs, rural communities, and open plains. Track developing weather, capture dangerous events, and survive tornadoes, hail, and destructive winds.

details.title: Unclouded
details.short_description: Unclouded builds upon the simplicity of a minesweeper with some basic resource-management mechanics to create an engaging, replayable, singleplayer experience that feels both fresh and familiar.

details.title: ANTARIUM 2
details.short_description: Long ago, the Old Colony filled these depths. Now your queen begins to dig. Grow a living ant colony in a cross-section of the earth, automate it with belts and machines, survive storms and raids, wake the ancient Engine, then fly to found a stronger colony.

details.title: Extraction '76
details.short_description: Extraction ’76 is a tactical co-op extraction shooter set in an alternate Cold War. Form a squad, infiltrate hostile zones, recover valuable assets, and fight your way to extraction in intense session-based missions built for teamwork and replayability.

details.title: King's Chess
details.short_description: Awaken your army! King's Chess blends RTS strategy with board game depth. In fast 15-minute matches, focus on deck building and physics, not tedious clicking. Smash defenses and manipulate the environment. No numbers game here—just pure physical warfare.

details.title: Fear Tall Grass
details.short_description: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

details.title: Bureaucromancer
details.short_description: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

details.title: Runemoria - Blades of Memory
details.short_description: Flip cards, uncover pairs, and command your squad in a tactical memory RPG. Equip weapons, unlock powerful skills, and battle enemies or other players in strategic single-player and PvP combat.

details.title: Cursed Carts
details.short_description: A PvPvE horror game playable with 2–6 players. Compete against each other with your alien team split into two groups. In a massive mansion filled with creatures, the team that collects the most loot within the time limit wins.

details.title: Smash Hit
