details.short_description: Smash Hit is an online party brawler for up to 12 players. Grab a random loadout of ridiculous weapons, knock your friends off the stage and play to the crowd. Climb to the top of the scoreboard and become TV's next SMASH HIT!

details.title: PERKS
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-6 player physics brawler where you battle your friends with game-breaking perk synergies. Stack wild abilities to fire homing multishots, bounce rapid-fire lasers off walls, or summon an orbital cannon inside a swirling twister. Steal the best perks and turn the tide!

details.title: Mysteries of Black Hollow
details.short_description: The shop is yours by day. The dark belongs to something else. Raid the abandoned houses of a cursed town, drag your loot home before your lantern gives out, and spend everything you earn on rituals that might just save it or you.

details.title: Criterion
details.short_description: Criterion is a space optimisation puzzle game about designing efficient solutions under constraint. Process the color fluxes. Control their strength. Solve increasingly complex networks where every tile matters. There is always a solution, the question is how elegant yours will be.

details.title: Forgefolk
details.short_description: Forge weapons and tools by hand, repair what others have broken, and uncover the stories buried in old steel. In Forgefolk, every scar means something — and what you find may force an old master smith to face the one thing he never managed to fix: his past.

details.title: Horns
details.short_description: Horns is an evolving dark fantasy RPG inspired by retro ARPG adventures of the late ‘90s. Join Lyssandra on her search for the king in a collapsed, magical world as she grows more grotesque on her trek for truth. Fight the darkness — or become it — and watch the world react accordingly.

details.title: Void Nebula
details.short_description: Create, customize and fuse every card in this sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder where you battle foes, stack absurd items, and drag your handmade deck to the heart of the Nebula.

details.title: Pocket Pilot
details.short_description: Pilot planes, helicopters, and drones to clean, restore, and rebuild multiple unique islands. Water crops, power-wash monuments, airlift cargo, and clear toxic smog at your own pace in this cozy aerial restoration simulator.

details.title: MindGate CornerGet
details.short_description: A free-to-play hack-and-slash that fights on in your taskbar. Chibi heroes meet the enemy inside a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. All you do is swap the gear they picked up and respec their skills when you feel like it. No connection needed; the rest happens in the corner of your screen.

details.title: LITERA
details.short_description: Enter a true name and an essence, then watch a one-of-a-kind Textus take shape with its own abilities, moves, and battle role. Build a team from the creatures your words create in this fantasy 3v3 summoning RPG.

details.title: マキコマレイド
details.short_description: Lure enemy bullets, sweep them in, and send them crashing back! An intuitive shooter anyone can enjoy! A boy named Alta stumbles upon a mysterious disc—and sets off into the vast "Sea of Data" that lies within.

details.title: Tiny Cultivation
details.short_description: Raise a tiny cultivator on your desktop. Watch them train, nap, fail, reincarnate, and build a unique cultivation story while you work, study, or play. Every life is different. Every reincarnation leaves a legacy.

name: Business Jet Tycoon: Age of the Turbofan

details.title: Business Jet Tycoon: Age of the Turbofan
details.short_description: In Business jet tycoon you run and manage fleets of private jets for clients. Build airports, design interiors and set your markup.

details.title: Boy with One Eye
details.short_description: Boy with One Eye is a psychological, philosophical visual novel featuring a unique children's story-like art.

details.title: Quit Stalin
details.short_description: Stalin's on your couch, and one wrong word sends you and your family to the gulag. Get inside his head before he decides you're the problem. Freud, Adler, Jung - pick your psychological method. A dark comedy about therapy, power, and what it costs to tell a tyrant the truth.

details.title: Autorun
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder that runs on a dying retro desktop. Insert floppy discs, stack CDs into drives, and flood the screen with windows. Breaking the game and crashing the machine are the same move.

details.title: PREEMINENCE: World on the Brink
details.short_description: You promised not to touch pensions. The debt says otherwise. Lead one of 200 real countries, alone or with friends: push your laws through parliament, face the streets, ride out global crises. Every number has a reason, and every decision has a price.

details.title: Cloud Arch Simulator
details.short_description: A reverse tower-defense puzzle for engineers. Architect cloud systems that survive brutal traffic surges — place CDNs, caches, load balancers and databases, hit deploy, and watch your design hold or collapse under a live storm. Real patterns, real tradeoffs, a live YAML mirror.

details.title: Tumbal 1985
details.short_description: Tumbal 1985 is an atmospheric and psychological horror-mystery game set within the confines of an Indonesian tobacco distributor office. Explore, clean, collect, and solve mysteries as a night janitor to uncover the insidious truth behind the paranormal.

details.title: Sea of Silence
details.short_description: Sea of Silence is a turn-based naval fleet-building card strategy game. Buy, combine, and upgrade warships, balance immediate strength against long-term shop growth, arrange formations of up to six ships, and test your fleet against other players' lineups across a 20-round campaign.

details.title: The Ignition Protocol
details.short_description: The Ignition Protocol is a slow-paced, top-down incremental asteroid-mining game. Fly your ship in zero-g, mine and tow asteroids, transport resources, automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

details.title: It Could Be Worse
details.short_description: Speed bends time. Build momentum with weapons designed for movement to slow the world around you and tear through enemies at superhuman velocity.

details.title: Anachronistic Survivors
details.short_description: Something shattered time. Survivors from every era fight waves of temporal aberrations in a dark arena. Combine weapons from across history to forge powerful fusions. 9 base weapons. 36 fusions. 6 characters. Every run is different.

name: ABYSS: The Shadows of Elder Cities

details.title: ABYSS: The Shadows of Elder Cities
details.short_description: A signal was buried in 1985. Now it's calling you back. Descend into wireframe cities steeped in cosmic horror, rendered in haunting ZX Spectrum aesthetics. Campaign, roguelike, and 2-player versus modes.

details.title: Hexroads
details.short_description: Build a small kingdom by day and survive the night. Hexroads is a fantasy city-builder RTS where you capture towns, grow your economy, command defenders, cast spells, and choose new rewards each dawn.

details.title: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
details.short_description: Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

details.title: Souls Divided
details.short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

details.title: Who's Got the Legs
details.short_description: Control a single character together in this chaotic co-op platformer where each player handles a different action. Coordination i key... or everything falls apart

details.title: Moorhaven: Cozy Canal Life
details.short_description: Customise a narrowboat, live aboard, and slow right down. Fish, forage, befriend a floating community and build your dream floating home with - one very needy cat along for the ride. A heartwarming life sim about shaping your perfect floating home and community.

details.title: The Wrong Ones
details.short_description: The Wrong Ones is a single-player social deduction game where you study characters dialogue, detect contradictions, and uncover Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight. Analyze each claim carefully and decide who can be trusted before making your final accusation.

details.title: CYBER SCOUTS
details.short_description: Cyber Scouts is a space simulator. Build your ship block by block, script your autopilot in Lua, and battle the rogue AI NEXUS in a story campaign. Play solo or co-op with up to 10 friends — no accounts, no global servers.

details.title: STAFFUP
details.short_description: Two friends turn their new startup into a quadrillionaire corp by hunting candidates in this local co-op cozy incremental top-down shooters. Suck candidates, collect blueprints, register patents, and renovate the office into a massive corporate cashing machine while firing employees along the way.

details.title: Miner Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

details.title: Stellar Office
details.short_description: Stellar Office is a room‑based point‑and‑click exploration game centered on observing and researching almost everything in the room. Through association and interaction with objects, as well as analysis aided by external tools, players will continuously deduce the hidden logic behind phenomena.

name: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1

details.title: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1
details.short_description: Fully voiced in Cantonese. Free demo with the full Chapter 1 out already! You wake as a bastard prince facing execution—and you can read more than what people say. Use Inner Voice, Sincerity, Appraisal, and X-Ray Vision to expose lies and secrets, win allies, and rewrite a kingdom’s fate.

details.title: Star Curve
details.short_description: Star Curve is a single-player logic puzzle game. Explore an old observatory in a seaside town, examine the puzzles on its walls, infer their rules, and solve a series of carefully designed logic puzzles at your own pace.

details.title: Beat Juicer
details.short_description: Crunch beats, upgrade your build, and craft the ultimate song. Beat Juicer is a short incremental game that blends arcade action with a music sandbox to create a satisfying symphony of sights and sounds.

details.title: Wish I Could Fly
details.short_description: Burn your life to fly, go higher, this is a game I made on my own, hold W to spray blood and fly up, A and D turn her instead of walking, wobble your way up a tower in the sea floor by floor, someone she knows waits on each one, the demo is chapter one with six floors plus an endless mode

details.title: The Chains Of Yme
details.short_description: In this tactical roguelike you control five adventurers as you explore procedurally generated ruins to reach and conquer a Titan. Fight deadly monsters, utilize power-ups, and improvise while your knowledge of the world deepens. Persist when your adventurers are left behind, killed, or sacrificed.

details.title: The Final Lane
details.short_description: The Final Lane is a 3D Deckbuilding Roguelite about Bowling in Hell where the BALLS ARE THE CARDS! Draft a sinner-gistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle other sinners as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

details.title: My Mom Says I’m Fine
details.short_description: A creepy survivors-like played on a child's tabletop. Fight swarms as a tiny toy while a giant Kid looms over the battle. Pick level-up cards, merge your powers and build a ridiculous arsenal. Mom says he's fine. You'll see.

details.title: Eatery At Ridge Station
details.short_description: A short, cozy, and heartful narrative experience with cooking elements. Play as Felix Cook, the elderly owner of an eatery, on his last week in town sponsoring the restoration of his favorite park. Cook up a new menu, say farewell to regular customers, and attend the grand reopening of Mabel’s Park.

details.title: A Trans-Siberian Tea
details.short_description: Snowbound for decades, a Trans-Siberian train holds its passengers exactly as they died. Talk to the frozen dead, uncover the identity of a legendary thief, and decide how far you're willing to go for the truth.

details.title: Eldritch Boyfriend
details.short_description: Eldritch Boyfriend is the only skill-based visual novel dating sim where your sanity—or lack thereof—turns the very act of choosing the right dialogue options into a series of challenging mini-games.

details.title: Amelia
details.short_description: In this first-person narrative experience, you step into the shoes of a young girl. Explore a rural farmhouse and witness everyday family life through her eyes. Across 13 consecutive days, you'll realize that your family is not what it seems. Will you notice what everyone else leaves unsaid?

details.title: Global Parity
details.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance the budget, pass laws through parliament, win elections, sign treaties and fight on a moving front line, while AI nations build, trade and go to war around you.

details.title: HALFLIGHT
details.short_description: A survival horror roguelite about a house that erases itself behind you. Learn to read doors, solve puzzles, and survive things you cannot fight. Every step is permanent, there is no way back. Find the way out.

details.title: Bonsai Island
details.short_description: Grow, shape, and sell your own fully simulated bonsai trees to adorable animal customers! Turn your humble little bonsai cart into a thriving business on a cozy island.

details.title: Mereni
details.short_description: A casual Hexcells-like puzzle game where you reveal hidden drawings among the stars.

details.title: Not Monsters
details.short_description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

details.title: IVORY
details.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

details.title: Idle Dig
details.short_description: Idle Dig is an idle mining game that sits on your desktop and plays on its own. Collect 125 unique gems and items, unlock 15 skins, complete quests, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the planet.

details.title: Expedition Bonk
details.short_description: A short turn-based RPG where three F-tier heroines set out to defeat the Goblin King. Time your attacks and blocks, make every skill count, and power up your party through a shared incremental skill tree. Built to be beaten in about 4 hours.

details.title: Ruler of Empires
details.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

details.title: Gökbörü
details.short_description: Draw a line, close the loop, crush every demon caught inside. A 3D arcade action roguelite born from Turkic mythology — every open line is a gamble. Power up with divine Boons, face 10 mythic bosses and chase the high score.

details.title: NIGHTRAIN POOL HALL
details.short_description: Break and bend the rules of pool in this billiards roguelike deckbuilder! Tilt the table, swap and levitate balls, and build powerful combos. Not everything will be smooth sailing, the table itself fights back with stone balls, rising walls and gravity vortices that pull shots off course.

details.title: DANCE DANCE INCREMENTAL
details.short_description: Hit incoming notes to collect bytes. Spend them to upgrade your device, build your army, and download new tracks! Dance Dance Incremental is a rhythm incremental game inside your own Y2K mp3 player.

details.title: Wuxia Life
details.short_description: You never truly knew your father. Wuxia Life is a single-player wuxia RPG set on Yingzhou. Investigate his death and your origins, expose the Blacktide Gang's betrayal of Yingzhou, and shape your ending through ATB combat, Five Inner Voices, inner demons, and the Heavenly Storyteller.

details.title: SALMON
details.short_description: You are a salmon, performing platforming that feels satisfying and ridiculous. Jump off walls, race against your friends, explore the strange world. Most people don't realise how athletic salmon can be.

details.title: Blooming Canvas
details.short_description: This is a visual novel game themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the art exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and uncover the truth behind the painting.

details.title: Spasiba!
details.short_description: Build a scrappy deck, chain actions, and outscore your rivals in Spasiba!, a courtyard deck-building card game. Choose your kingdom, find card combinations, and turn a modest starting hand into a winning engine.

details.title: Landers
details.short_description: Pilot a nimble combat ship through hazardous terrain, complete high-speed objectives, destroy ground threats, collect hidden rewards, and master precision flying in a single-player action campaign built around skill, momentum, and replayability.

details.title: Conquer
details.short_description: Build, trade, and fight in this competitive multiplayer shooter played on a board. Build settlements and roads across a shared island, trade resources with your rivals, and gun down anyone who stands between you and the victory point goal. You can Conquer the world!

details.title: Crittermancy
details.short_description: Become a Crittermancer in this roguelike deckbuilder with real-time combat. Master the art of critter alchemy: combine, transform, and mutate critters to discover new cards and build your deck. Venture deep into the dark forest and unleash your creations against the monsters lurking within.

details.title: Chobisuke's Weird Farm
details.short_description: Protect the farm by any means necessary. Grandpa’s secrets, the mysterious villagers, and the yokai that emerge at night... Every mystery and a thrilling battle await you!

details.title: Get Up, Man!
details.short_description: Get Up, Man! is a ragdoll comedy about Kolya, an engineer taking part in the first public experiment in crossing between universes. Four limbs, three actions, one voice off-screen and a very long way home.

details.title: Mad Cafe
details.short_description: Serve coffee, pastries, and smiles to increasingly disturbing customers in this atmospheric psychological horror game. Keep the café running, master the perfect brew, and try not to lose yourself as each shift becomes more unsettling than the last.

details.title: Another One
details.short_description: Flip 7 cards without a repeat and you'll hit like a truck. Draw a double? Bust, your whole hand is gone. A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder with silly boosters, bosses that cheat, a Daily Challenge leaderboard and a mode where you build your deck from scratch.

details.title: Recruiting Against Rodents
details.short_description: View resumes, hire employees, train them into roles, and defeat the rodents! Recruiting Against Rodents is a small indie roguelike auto-battler where you, a hiring manager, must build a team to fight 15 waves of rats from a nearby cave.

details.title: Beetle Island
details.short_description: Beetle Island is a relaxing idle game for beetle lovers. Buy beetles, raise them and sell them to grow your fortune! Turn an empty patch of land to a buzzing oasis filled with exotic beetles, wacky decorations, and love!

details.title: Jellscape
details.short_description: Jellscape is an arcade-style fast paced race against doom. Control your gloopy ball to navigate daunting trails and obstacles. Each death is just another chance to prove you have what it takes to beat the next level!

details.title: 明末：甲申年
details.short_description: Set during the fall of the Ming dynasty in 1644, this historical grand-strategy narrative game lets you rule as the Chongzhen Emperor, fight for the Shun regime, lead another faction, or survive as a commoner. Govern, wage war, manage resources, and reshape history through AI-assisted court debates.

details.title: Primal Tactica
details.short_description: Recruit a team of Primals, then equip and evolve them to survive deadly encounters! Loot powerful Relics and Augments and stack synergies to create wild gamebreaking teams. Primal Tactica is a roguelike autobattler where TFT meets Slay the Spire, with thousands of possible builds.

details.title: Blightsilver
details.short_description: Join a paranormal investigation where card battles are the key that uncovers the conspiracy beneath the city. Duel on a secret 5×5 grid. Reveal your opponent’s hidden information—while they hunt for yours.

details.title: Silas' Speakeasy
details.short_description: The local speakeasy has been closed down for quite some time due to an undisclosed incident involving the local mob. You've been given the job of finding your way inside, locating, and destroying any and all incriminating evidence that you can get your hands on before it can be used against you.

details.title: PROTOCOL BOUND
details.short_description: BOUND is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

details.title: Rogue Striker
details.short_description: Draft. Play. Upgrade. Win. Combine fast-paced football action with roguelite drafting strategy to build the perfect team and reach the World Finals.

details.title: Harrowgate Asylum
details.short_description: HARROWGATE ASYLUM is a first-person survival horror where fighting back is not an option. Study patrol routes, slip between hiding spots, and hold your breath while something walks past you in the dark. If you are seen, running is all you have left.

name: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~

details.title: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~
details.short_description: A super-authentic hardcore strategy simulation fantasy that blends respect for tradition with a challenge to the unknown, nostalgic yet new.

details.title: System // Crash
details.short_description: A momentum platformer, with combo-centered hack 'n slash combat. Use your trusty sword, TyBreaker (Among other weapons), to cut and destroy every TyCorp drone in your way. Cut the drones, and take back the world.

details.title: Imma Potato
details.short_description: ImmaPotato is a survival sim where you play as a potato farming crops, cooking meals, automating machines, and launching food into a giant's mouth to keep it happy. The longer you survive, the tastier the recipes get and the harder the giant becomes to please. Machines and automation are the key.

details.title: What Was That?!
details.short_description: A cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home full of mysterious encounters after dark.

details.title: Seed of Light
details.short_description: Seed of Light is a cozy roguelite city builder about bringing light into a world swallowed by a dark fog. Manage your resources, find synergies, generate enough light to overcome the darkness and expand your territory!

details.title: The Iliad - Wrath of Achilles
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder of Greek myth that faithfully follows Homer's Iliad. Achilles' wrath is your weapon: the angrier he grows, the harder he strikes and the more Troy fears him. But to win the last fight, he must master it. Told in real engravings and paintings from the 17th to the 19th century.

details.title: Bordertide
details.short_description: Grow a small banner into an empire, one tile at a time — alone against cunning computer nations, or online with up to 7 friends. Expand, build, sail, strike and make pacts in quick 10-minute matches, on fresh maps or a real map of the Earth.

details.title: Ash Company
details.short_description: A command-and-management game about running a mercenary company. Hire mercs, fit their gear, mark routes on the op map and send them into the ruins. During an op, the only way to intervene is by radio. Loot carried out by the squad pays wages and grows the base.

details.title: Last Embers : Fire Hero
details.short_description: Grab the hose, rookie. The city is on fire! Drown roaring flames, rescue a city full of characters, spend your coins on 90+ upgrades and race across town to answer every call... but something is lurking deep in the flames.

details.title: Night Shift: Grandma's Rules
details.short_description: You are the last night guard at a closed Thai hospital. Follow your grandmother's rules, solve what each night leaves behind, and find out why the building is still counting its dead.

name: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again

details.title: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again
details.short_description: An incremental game about a hungry flock that eats straight through the Earth, all the way to New Zealand. Sweep your cursor over the sheep and they bite the ground beneath them. Grow the flock, hire dogs and shepherds, and keep going down.

details.title: You Can’t Clock Out
details.short_description: You dozed off at your desk. Now your coworkers have horses’ heads. You Can’t Clock Out is a first-person horror game about escaping an office gone terribly wrong. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and follow company rules as you make your way downstairs. Don’t let your coworkers catch you.

details.title: Vector Rush
details.short_description: Sink into space and music in this neon sci-fi twin-stick shooter. Blast through swarms of vector enemies, take down the giants guarding each world, grow stronger with every run, and escape a collapsing star system.

details.title: Feudal Fall
details.short_description: The king burned your village to the ground. Raise your capital on its ashes, keep your people alive through the winters and muster armies hundreds strong. Bring down the lords of the feudal pyramid one by one, then lay siege to the king's own city. A real-time city builder and siege strategy game.

details.title: A Sheet-ton of Bingo
details.short_description: Fill one whole bingo sheet out of a thousand before the old regular across the hall yells BINGO. Call numbers, dab squares and buy auto-daubers in this incremental race to find the bingo in a sheet haystack. He has been doing this for decades. You have no idea how good he is.

details.title: Aldorian Saga:Farming Hero
details.short_description: You are the last survivor of the royal family, and the power the goddess gave you is... just farming? But you won't give up! Sell crops for gold, open up mines and forests to craft trade goods, brave dangerous trade routes, and earn the funds and raise the army to take your kingdom back!

details.title: Windwhisper Saga
details.short_description: Set out from Windbell as an adventurer in a pixel-art, side-scrolling action RPG. Explore dungeons, face bosses, and craft gear from the materials you bring home. Get to know the locals along the way, or take on a Demon Pact when you’re ready to risk more for better loot.

details.title: Tick or Kick!
details.short_description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.

details.title: GIGALANCE
details.short_description: Build a planet-shattering beam cannon from scratch. Combine reactors, accelerators, and cooling systems to unleash devastating firepower. But push too far, and your own weapon could melt or tear itself apart. Design, rebuild, and fire your ultimate creation to save Earth.

details.title: Corner Club
details.short_description: A tiny pixel nightclub living in the corner of your desktop. Put on any music and the dancers move on its beat!

details.title: The Atomic Mage
details.short_description: Mix hundreds of unique spells into thousands of wild builds! Mod wands and guns, link auto-casting crystals into chain reactions, and defend walls from tanks, jets and steel giants in a side-view defense Roguelite. Reunite with old friends and uncover a reborn Earthling's secrets across two worlds.

details.title: Idle Fish: Aquarium Legends
details.short_description: Build your own pixel aquarium! Open chests, collect rare fish, feed them to grow, and combine three into a higher rarity. Sell fish for pearls, decorate your tank, and assemble a team of three for automatic battles. Your next legendary discovery awaits.

name: You Don't Have to Be a Hero!

details.title: You Don't Have to Be a Hero!
details.short_description: A cozy raising sim inspired by Princess Maker. As homeroom teacher, spend three years beside one student at Sebit Academy: plan her weeks, share small everyday moments, and help her find a future of her own. She doesn't have to be a hero.

details.title: Into Ember Depths
details.short_description: A free online bullet-hell RPG where everyone shares one island. Its 41 bosses are built for groups, so whoever is nearby can jump in. When a hero dies, it is gone for good, and the foe that killed them may take their name. Below the island, the Descent has no bottom.

details.title: Piston & Co.
details.short_description: You spent years at someone else's bench. Now the sign carries your name. Diagnose the fault, choose the part, look the customer in the eye — then buy wrecks, hire a crew, build a plant and put your marque on the tank. No interest, no gambling: honest trade wins.

details.title: The Greedy Mimic
details.short_description: You are the chest. Heroes raid the dungeon, you eat them and keep their gold. Buy upgrades mid-run from 150 skills in 10 trees, set traps, summon minions and survive a threat that grows every minute. Die, ascend, get greedier.

details.title: Struggle of Empires
details.short_description: Write your orders, wait for the turn, then open your realm's newspaper to find out who betrayed whom. A play-by-email empire game in the old style: rule a fantasy realm, a steampunk power (1750 to 1914) or a real people from 5000 BC to today, against friends, strangers or the computer.

details.title: Generations Of Steel
details.short_description: The PvE and PvP Tank Battle game from WW1 to 1941. Fight in 30v30 battles over objectives and a career mode that you can customize yourself.

details.title: Popscraper
details.short_description: Pop one million balloons in a cartoon first-person incremental shooter. Ride the elevator up the tower as every floor holds ten times more, turn confetti into silly weapons and idle machines, and pop the King Balloon on each floor to reach the top.

details.title: Mortis Survivors: Blood Arena
details.short_description: Dark-Fantasy Horde Survivor & Action Roguelite: Conquer 6 fortress arenas, unlock 6 champions, evolve weapons into Mythic forms and Divine or Demonic fusions, forge 64 artifacts & 6 gear sets — solo or in 1–4 player Online & Local Co-op!

details.title: Battle for Noalea
details.short_description: Battle for Noalea is a turn-based fantasy wargame for two players. Lead one of four factions and its hero, seize settlements and outmaneuver your rival in battles without dice and without hidden information. Play against real people online via Steam or in hotseat mode on one screen.

details.title: Pinball Boss Quest
details.short_description: Pinball meets block breaker in a pixel-art fantasy quest. Bat the ball through minion waves, smash breakables and topple ten legendary bosses as a Sword, Bow, Javelin, Mage or Summoner, solo or in local co-op where you team up on the boss but compete for the top score.

details.title: Lost Firmament
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world of floating islands in this 3D Action RPG. Fight strange creatures, discover forgotten secrets, and forge your path through a world falling into ruin.

details.title: Karanan: Gravebound
details.short_description: A dark turn-based adventure game where you explore deep dungeons, solve puzzles, and fight monsters. Find hidden secrets and rebuild a forgotten graveyard.

details.title: Tower vs Zombies
details.short_description: Hold the line against relentless zombie hordes! Build and evolve industrial turrets — cannons, machine guns, missiles, flamethrowers, frost and more — grow a huge upgrade tree and defend your command post through a city under siege.

details.title: Lancet & Linen
details.short_description: Nuremberg, 1382. Live the life of a bathkeeper: diagnose patients, perform period procedures by hand, and run a bustling bathhouse with hired staff. Travel across nine towns, raise an heir, answer to the city council, and shape your house across three careers and six endings.

details.title: HELLFIGHTERS
details.short_description: A physics-driven co-op game for 4 players about goose firefighters tied together by one fire hose. On the way from a burning city down to Hell, stack into a wobbly tower, fly over pits on extinguisher recoil and haul your friends back up. But if one goose slips, everyone falls...

details.title: Secret Shelter
details.short_description: Once a corporate tycoon, you now run a shelter in a nuclear wasteland. Use cards at your corporate terminal to oversee production and research. Decide who you can spare for expeditions, fight with skill cards, and choose which survivors to trust as you piece together the truth behind the war.

details.title: PaperKrieg
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of paper soldiers and fantasy. Build brigades, arm them from your city, and choose formations that counter the enemy. Overwhelm them with trains, balloons, dragons, or tanks. Seize key points on the map, or hold out in endless defense against a paper horde.

details.title: Defender of Rome
details.short_description: A tower defense game about the steadfast defenders of Rome's cities. Build an unbeatable legion, raise veterans and use everything at hand, from shield walls to geese and burning pigs. Defeat five nations, sworn enemies of Rome, in 18 missions from foggy Britain to the sands of Parthia.

details.title: Paunchy Pets TD
details.short_description: A Paunchy Pets Tower Defense game. Stop the evil veggie army from stealing your candy stash. Build Paunchy Towers, draw Upgrade Cards to bolster your defenses, and smash all of the Veggie Bosses.

details.title: Pay Up, Piggy
details.short_description: You're the kid who owes Finn the loan shark. Smash piggy banks, stack the coins and pay the Boss's weekly cut, or you're done. Upgrade your hammer, call in Favors, survive the Showdowns and climb Port Penny's mob.

details.title: Grave Train
details.short_description: An action roguelike where your party is a train of chaos and blood. Arrange your team of monsters. Charge through waves of unwilling sacrifices. Perform a ritual summoning of the strongest beings, and kill them all.

details.title: Pinata
details.short_description: Hit a giant piñata with up to 3 friends in first-person co-op. Coins fall out, roll down a spiral funnel into your vault and buy you bigger weapons: a bow, a machine gun, a hwacha, archers. When it bursts, a bigger one comes down from the clouds.

details.title: Bank Life Simulator
details.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own bank branch! Handle teller transactions, spot fake IDs, and offer loans and deposits to a living population. Hire and train staff, trade on the stock and black markets, survive strict audits, and rise from a small branch to a financial empire.

details.title: RE: Rags to Royalties
details.short_description: Build a web-novel empire in this incremental management game set in 2004. Tap, upgrade and unleash FEVER; win readers, sign contracts and run a busy studio. With AI-assisted creation, turn your own ideas into a novel you can actually read. Your cat is already on the keyboard.

details.title: GHOSTGRID
details.short_description: Take freelance hacking jobs in a port city. Break into fictional networks with real commands, investigate breaches, write the report, then go out and pay the rent. Everything you do leaves a record, and investigators read them. 153 real techniques, and the game checks that you did them.

details.title: Round One, Fight!
details.short_description: A laid-back incremental auto battler straight off a '90s video-store shelf. Build your fighter, let him throw the punches, and come back stronger after a beating. 25 opponents, 5 acts, a skill tree, and a little romance.

details.title: Liquidation Inc.
details.short_description: A co-op physics horror for 1-4 friends: buy out the contents of haunted, foreclosed homes and haul everything to your van before the timer runs out. Every scratch costs money - and something still lives there.

details.title: Cave Saga
details.short_description: Explore the caves in this action-adventure platformer. Jump, dash, pick up, and throw objects or creatures to help escape the various complex cave systems. Each biome you explore contains unique mechanics and aesthetics. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local co-op!

details.title: Fishly: Desktop Aquarium
details.short_description: A tiny pixel-art aquarium that lives on your desktop. Your fish swim, eat, sleep at night and earn gold while you work. Breed rare colours, fill your album, decorate your tank or let them swim across your whole wallpaper

details.title: Seoul Night Bites
details.short_description: Run a tiny Korean street-food stall after midnight. Pick ingredient cards, cook 64 real Korean dishes and chain recipes into huge combos in this cozy roguelite deckbuilder. Pay the rent, then see how long you last in Endless Nights.

details.title: SkyAceBlitz
details.short_description: Top-down roguelike aerial shooter. Engage in realistic inertia dogfights, shoot down foes with machine guns and homing missiles. Gather random upgrades every run for distinct builds. Play with friends via Remote Play Together!

name: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!

details.title: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!
details.short_description: The fighter jet prize is no joke. This cola company actually delivers. Crack open colas, rack up points, and fight with powerful prizes. The ultimate goal: a fighter jet. A top-down shooter incremental where you grow endlessly stronger and collect dangerous prizes.

details.title: Breaking Protocol
details.short_description: Dodge bullets in a fast bullet hell boss rush against parodies of AI models. Every attack is telegraphed and you build your own playstyle from 64 exploits. Singleplayer, two players locally or online, plus 2 to 8 player raids.

details.title: Clickbait Arcade
details.short_description: You've seen the ads. Pull the pin, pick the door, run through the x3 gate. The games never existed... until now. Clickbait Arcade is 12 fake mobile-ad games made real, in a neon arcade, with no ads, no energy timers and no pay-to-win.

details.title: Captain's Wake
details.short_description: Loot, level, legend! Captain's Wake is a pirate action RPG on a cutthroat sea, where rival captains level up, loot and hunt just like you. Every ship has a captain with a fortune to chase and a long memory. Will you be friend or foe? Chart your own course and become a legendary pirate.

details.title: Monsters & Banknotes
details.short_description: Open a backstreet monster shop on borrowed money. Buy, breed, raise and sell 141 species, build valuable bloodlines, prove them in the arena and trade at the grand auction. Pay the underworld tribute or defend your shop in this pixel-art management sim.

details.title: Streaming Raptae
details.short_description: A one-button platformer about a streamer trapped inside his own livestream. Your score is your viewers, your chat throws bombs at you and every death is clip-worthy. Jump, hold to jump higher, and never let the stream get boring.

details.title: Bayani: Auto Ascent
details.short_description: A naked hero. A ten-floor tower. A Rival who drafts from the same cards you do. Build your hero piece by piece - gear, spells and fighting techniques - and watch the fights play out automatically. Take the card they need, or the card you need? At the top, you duel to the death.

details.title: Little Brigade: Desktop Battler
details.short_description: A relaxing (because apparently you're not involved) idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you go about your day.

details.title: Moji Snake
details.short_description: Fight to survive this snake roguelike with quick adventures or endless runs.

details.title: Earn Your Stripes
details.short_description: A single-player WWII shooter where you start as a Private, rank up, and gain command of an entire army. Fight in battles of hundreds of soldiers on procedurally generated battlefields, from the Normandy beaches to the Rhine. Lead a squad, plan attacks on the map, crew tanks and call in bombers.

details.title: Realmwake
details.short_description: Recruit and merge an everchanging roster of combatants in this roguelike autobattler. Arrange your squad, discover powerful synergies, and venture through a world shattered by the four colliding realms.

details.title: Fever
details.short_description: Experience the beautiful horror of a hostile alien planet in this co-op survival FPS. Explore, mine resources, craft weapons, and fortify outposts with turrets and traps. When the sky rains blood, fight hundreds of creatures and survive the Fever.

details.title: NEON DESCENT
details.short_description: Half human, half machine, D dives into a neon cyberspace with J, the AI who refuses to leave his side. Fuse together, outsmart 12 bosses that each demand a different strategy, and descend to the Core to learn why the children vanished.

details.title: Kill the AI
details.short_description: An action roguelike set in a dystopian future where the tech titans who built the AI are sent to kill it. Gun down swarms of glitching machines, level up, hack terminals, build your loadout and transform your weapon mid-run. No permanent upgrades: every win is pure skill.

details.title: Ladder of Numbers
details.short_description: Ladder of Numbers turns arithmetic into combat skills: charge with addition, multiply into clones, fire with subtraction, divide to split. Climb its steps through thunderclouds and imaginary-number storms to the edge of the sky.

details.title: They Are Zombies
details.short_description: Gather by day. Survive by night. Team up with friends, collect resources, and craft what you need before the zombies come. Survive 15 nights of attacks—and find out whether your brilliant plan can actually get you through to morning.

details.title: Math Combo Chain
details.short_description: A tower defense where ammo is limited and math is your reload.

details.title: Bukchon Anomaly
details.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror game on a looping street inspired by Seoul's Bukchon Hanok Village. You get one photo per passage. At the gate, report whether anything changed. Three wrong reports end your run, and some anomalies come for you before you get there.

details.title: Toque: Restaurant Tycoon
details.short_description: A restaurant tycoon where you are part of the crew. Work wherever you want, in the kitchen, at the register or on the floor, build your place yourself and pick one of four restaurant types. Grow your menu with cooks who know the dishes and rise above the city's rival restaurants.

details.title: Monster Hunting Supplies
details.short_description: A supernatural mystery game where customers bring disturbing rumors and strange encounters to your workshop. Ask questions, study your field guide, and prepare the right ammunition. Every story holds a clue, and some are connected.

details.title: Second On Ice
details.short_description: Fast, top-down ice hockey with a story-driven single-player career. Skate, pass, check, and score from snowy neighborhood rinks to pro arenas as you step out of your brother's shadow. Play quick matches, league seasons, and international tournaments in a pixel-art hockey world.

details.title: XenoTrax
details.short_description: Race powerful alien off-road vehicles across five extraordinary worlds. Choose your driver, tackle rugged tracks, compete in championships, and chase your own ghost. Take on computer rivals or race with friends in up to four-player local split-screen.

details.title: Ocean Dredgers
details.short_description: Dive solo or with up to 3 friends, dredge sunken wrecks for lost treasures, brush and rinse your finds, and display them in your shipboard museum to earn upgrades and explore deeper waters in first or third person.

details.title: Simple Tech Startup
details.short_description: Found a small game studio in 1975 and grow it into an industry giant. Build rooms on your own lot, hire a team, create your own engines and release games, while loans, taxes and rival companies keep you on your toes as the decades roll on into the age of AI.

details.title: Forget Me Notes
details.short_description: You wake in a white room with no memory. No key will open this door. Type anything you like to the person inside, earn their trust, and recover your shared memories. Five women and no dialogue menus.

details.title: 魔兽远征：挂机与冒险
details.short_description: A single-player idle RPG that keeps you company on your desktop. Choose from six classes, shape your build with gear and talents, explore towns and wilds, and tackle dungeons with companions. Sort loot, plan routes and pick your next collection goal while battles unfold automatically.

details.title: Hot Seat Manager
details.short_description: One PC, one couch, up to four managers. Build your club, hijack your mates' top transfer targets, and pin secret sticky notes to the market. On matchday, everything plays out live in the round-up—and by the penalty shootout, cushions will fly.

details.title: CatCat Panic
details.short_description: CatCat Panic is a chaotic online party game for 3–4 players! Pick your cat and battle your friends in 14 crazy mini-games: rob Nazif’s house, escape the vacuum monster, hop on your skateboard and race. Only one cat takes the crown!

details.title: Royal Escort: Idle Battles
details.short_description: Escort your king on an epic journey to reclaim his kingdom! Upgrade and strengthen your army in this idle auto-battler. Recruit soldiers, discover powerful skills, collect valuable loot, and craft powerful equipment as you battle your way through a realm filled with danger.

details.title: Shaft Nine
details.short_description: Work the shift. Meet the quota. Go a little deeper. A 2D pixel art mining game about a job that gets stranger the further down you go: less automation, more discovery, and secrets that don't stay underground.

details.title: Mad Racer
details.short_description: Hit the gas and tear through the wasteland in this top-down incremental roguelite about a rusty car, a tiny fuel tank and a growing horde of raiders. Wreck, loot, upgrade your ride and climb all 18 wanted levels!

details.title: Consume p/pixelplace
details.short_description: Hack a fully simulated pixel canvas. Build your botnet, spread the Void, and watch fictional communities fight, rebuild, and complain on Pixxit. A single-player incremental game with active and Idle modes, territorial drama, and far too many crabs.

details.title: Necrowake: Bone Legion
details.short_description: Lead an undead army through waves of enemies in this action roguelite. Recruit elite minions, choose your formation, and combine equipment skills to build your legion. Pick your next battle through portals, defeat bosses, and spend your shards to grow stronger.

details.title: Doomsbell
details.short_description: An auto battler where every protocol plays by its own rules and your Commander fights beside your army. Choose your road through wagers, stories and bosses, merge and fit out your machines, then outbuild other players' armies, one turn at a time.

details.title: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey
details.short_description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

details.title: Apartment Empire
details.short_description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.
developers: I Was Supposed to Be Studying for My Exams and find an intern but Somehow I make a game and became a Game Developer and Accidentally Started My Own Studio Despite Having Absolutely No Experience, No Employees, No Budget, and No Idea How My Life Works, but Now I've Already Paid Steam $100 So I Guess I Have No Choice but to Finish This Game Before My Parents Find Out That I've Been Spending More Time Debugging Unity Than Studying for My Degree, and Even Though I Promised Myself I'd Go to Bed After Fixing Just One More Bug, It's Already 5 AM and the Bug Has Somehow Become a Feature.™

details.title: Cursed Luck
details.short_description: The Devil owns your debt. The reels hold your fate. Cursed Luck is a dark fantasy roguelite where you build powerful symbol combinations, unleash explosive chain reactions, and bend luck in your favor. Chase massive wins, survive rising demands, and pay your debt before the Devil claims your soul.

details.title: Junk Mountain
details.short_description: Dig through mountains of junk for a hard drive holding 8,000 bitcoin. Find drives, test them on a computer and follow five clues from a backyard junkyard to orbit. Sell scrap, upgrade tools and hire workers to build a junkyard that runs itself.

details.title: Kixball
details.short_description: Kixball is top-down physics football where you are one player on the pitch. No animations, no auto-aim: just you, the ball and the walls. Train, earn transfer offers and rise from the lowest division in your career, or play with up to 3 friends on one screen.

details.title: Deep Rescue
details.short_description: Pilot a small rescue sub through a dark, glowing ocean. Gather schools of glowfish in your beam, outwit poachers, lead rare animals home and stay clear of the Gloam, the huge thing in the deep that hunts anything that glows.

details.title: Lost Subject
details.short_description: You are the result of a mysterious experiment, trapped in a dark underground facility. Solve puzzles, explore dangerous locations, unlock new characters, battle bosses, and find your way to freedom!

details.title: My Little Animal Care Center
details.short_description: Run a cozy little animal clinic in the heart of a colorful town! Treat hurt pets on the care table, pamper your boarders in their pens, welcome over a dozen species and grow your small center into a whole neighborhood of care.

details.title: NOSTRA: Crystalbound
details.short_description: An action roguelite from the world of NOSTRA. It is the year 860 of the Charter: crystal grows everywhere and no kingdom guards the roads. Take the merchants' coin as the Rune Warrior, etch runes into your abilities on every run and fight through three regions of a broken land.

details.title: Proviantmeister 1756
details.short_description: His Majesty’s army shall march – provided you keep it supplied! Manage depots, organize wagon trains, procure provisions, fodder and ammunition, and contend with weather and war. A historical military logistics simulation set during the Seven Years’ War, 1756–1763.

details.title: The Forgotten Workshop
details.short_description: A cozy alchemy idle game: brew potions, serve customers and hire little clay homunculi who keep the shop running, even while you're away. Explore the Grimoire, risk strange mixtures in the cauldron and bring three workshops full of surprises back to life.

details.title: One More Wave: Tower Defense
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you build towers along a road and hold off one wave after another. There are 9 towers with two upgrade paths each, 17 enemy types, 5 final bosses, 7 hand-made maps plus random ones, and an Endless mode.

details.title: Frog Express
details.short_description: Collect frogs and upgrade your express in an active incremental game! Power up manual collection, install automated modules, or combine both. Merge hats, fill your frog album, and unlock permanent upgrades to travel further with every run.

details.title: StarRanger
details.short_description: Lead a field team in a story-driven sci-fi RPG with turn-based squad combat. Build your squad's skills, choose its equipment, and make difficult calls on assignments with the Star Rangers - all while searching for your missing brother.

details.title: Battle Winds
details.short_description: A galaxy of over 7,000 stars lives on without you: trading, waging war, and falling back before the Reapers. Take the helm, jump to any star, set your ship down on a planet, and step outside, rifle in hand. Every battle, deal, and sortie you make reshapes the map everyone sees.

details.title: Dopamine Cube
details.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite shooter where every level-up is a slot machine spin. Dodge bullet storms, stack wild upgrades, fuse synergies into your own abilities and merge your guns to see how far your build can go.

details.title: Fantasy Guild Manager
details.short_description: Your heroes handle the fighting. Everything else is your problem. Recruit and level up adventurers, send them into auto-battles before quest timers run out, and grow your Guild Town in real time while Chaos creeps across the land.

name: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf

details.title: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf
details.short_description: Manage a historical shipyard: design ships for customers, organise materials and skilled workers, negotiate contracts and expand your business. From simple rowing boats to great sailing ships, craftsmanship, quality and smart business decisions determine your success.

name: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes

details.title: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes
details.short_description: Six skeleton heroes, one bony adventure. Slash, shoot, smash and cast through 16 story chapters overrun by slimes. Swap heroes mid-fight to hit each monster’s weakness, unleash a super for every hero and topple giant bosses in this colorful third-person action RPG.

details.title: Blobbardment
details.short_description: Blobbardment is a turn-based artillery party game where every fighter is a blob of jelly. Swallow a bomb and spit it back, split in two, freeze the sea into a bridge, then knock your friends off the map. Play online, on one screen, against bots or in a story campaign.

details.title: Incremental POP: Fishing
details.short_description: A hoop net, fifteen seconds, a lot of fish. Every round you buy something sillier: harpoons, depth charges, a sea serpent, a whale. Keep going until the screen is mostly fish and the numbers stop making sense.

details.title: Pocket Post.
details.short_description: Deliver the mail. Pocket Post is a minimal strategy game about managing post routes.

details.title: Jarlfall: Strandhögg
details.short_description: Strike the shore before the tide turns. Lead Viking raiders through tafl-style battles on sinking boards, grab loot village by village, and sail home to grow your Great Hall before luck runs out.

details.title: Cityterium
details.short_description: Cityterium is a multiplayer voxel sandbox where the real world becomes your canvas. Choose a city, build freely, tear things down, and reshape it with others, one block at a time.

details.title: Not Your Keys
details.short_description: Not Your Keys is a Bitcoin roguelike deckbuilder. Draft NFT cards, evolve them into stronger forms, and fight junk coins, frozen exchanges, and the Federal Reserve itself across a 21-block run to The Final Block.

details.title: Drone Operations
details.short_description: Pilot combat drones through diverse missions with realistic FPV flight simulation. Scout targets, drop grenades, launch explosive strikes and fire mounted weapons against enemies who flee, seek shelter or escape in vehicles. Earn stars to unlock new operations, drones and upgrades.

details.title: Aquarium Naturalist
details.short_description: An aquarium sim built in Unreal Engine 5 where equipment, feeding, and water chemistry interact like they do in real life. Hardy fish are as forgiving as the real thing; delicate ones demand real care. Crossbreed new morphs, or selectively breed delicate lines to handle tougher water.

details.title: Sandgrave
details.short_description: Rise, Captain! Sandgrave is a pixel-art, top-down sandbox about big flying ships, real-time fleet combat and life between trading and fighting pirates across the vast desert! Design your vessel, fight by boarding, broadsides or bombardment! Play solo or in an online open world!

name: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险

details.title: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险
details.short_description: Your desktop is now a tiny planet. MONOVA is a cozy auto-battler ARPG about collecting adorable creatures, building a trio of battlers, and hunting game-changing loot — all while your pets live right on your taskbar.

details.title: Crown of Rust
details.short_description: One mech against an entire royal court. Bolt weapons onto every slot, fuse them into something far worse, and hold the throne hall against waves of knights, cultists and hounds that never stop coming. A horde-survival roguelite about building the perfect war machine.

details.title: Beat Bound
details.short_description: Glowing pads explode to the beat! A rhythm dodge game on an 8×8 launchpad. 42 songs across 9 cities, from EASY all the way to PERFECT, where a single hit ends your run.

details.title: CANON CANON CANON
details.short_description: Stack cannons on your units, chain their effects and hold the line! Defend your garden against waves of furious animals in this roguelite lane defense.

details.title: THE LAST DELIVERY
details.short_description: The world ended. The orders didn't. Deliver food and parcels across a dark neon city in VR: drive your own car, climb balconies and radio towers, fight off zombies, and spend every hard-earned euro turning an empty flat into a home.

details.title: Capital Backstab
details.short_description: Starting with you at the bottom, the company’s cutting the fat. In this point and click adventure, you have to give your co workers the “Capital Backstab.” You had what it took to get in, are you able to stay?

details.title: Super Empire
details.short_description: Build a supermarket from a corner store to a hypermarket. Stock shelves that really empty, staff real shifts, price against rival stores, and keep every shopper happy, from dawn delivery to closing time, through every season.

details.title: Grocery Architect
details.short_description: Open the doors to your very own grocery store as you design, build, and grow it from a tiny corner shop into a bustling supermarket. Stock the shelves, keep impatient customers happy, and hire your crew in Grocery Architect, the cozy supermarket building and management sim!

details.title: Pepper Patrol
details.short_description: Pests have invaded the garden! Survive 20 waves as a brave Bell Pepper whose garden tools attack on their own. Merge tools, call Corn, Onion and Tomato to help, shop at the Worm's Compost Shop and ripen all the way to Tricolor.

details.title: RUGGED
details.short_description: RUGGED is first-person survival for one to four players. Fell trees, haul logs back to camp, craft tools, and hunt for food. Build a cabin on your own or host your existing world for friends through online or LAN co-op.

details.title: Prank Panda: Zoo Simulator
details.short_description: You are the zoo's worst-behaved panda. Prank visitors, raid food stands, outsmart the guard, and turn every enclosure into chaos — one mischievous mission at a time. A first-person comedy sandbox where being bad feels SO good.

details.title: Breach Inc.
details.short_description: 3:12 a.m. The medical practice is encrypted, the extortionists are very polite, and your admin went for coffee. Run a tiny IT security firm through the night shift: stop attacks, pay the ransom or don’t, and grow your basement office into your own SOC.

details.title: Talero
details.short_description: Roll the dice, build your combo, and push your limits! Modify your dice, combine powerful Jokers, and create wildly overpowered builds in this roguelike where every roll can change everything.

details.title: Trust Me, It's a Shortcut!
details.short_description: Buy a wreck in the Maun bazaar and drive it round the Kalahari for ten days with up to three friends. No GPS, a blank paper map, a budget that buys nothing good, and a friendly local who keeps saying: trust me, it's a shortcut.

details.title: Purrfect Circuit
details.short_description: Coach a cast of racers through training days, personal stories, and spirited competition. Find your favorite, help her shine, and cheer her down the home stretch. You can also challenge your friends in online races for up to six players!

details.title: Grief the Server
details.short_description: The admins are away. Grief a voxel server in this single-player incremental: sabotage builds, unlock outrageous cheats and become everyone's problem. Simulated players repair, fight back and unite against you. Play in first person or send a bot in Idle Mode.

details.title: Incremon Story
details.short_description: A monster-battling incremental with a story and lots of humor. Hatch your monster, watch it evolve, catch new creatures and take on bosses that don't play fair. Saving the world is the easy part. Getting your mom to stop calling is another story.

details.title: Forsakia
details.short_description: You're a bounty hunter working off a depot's job board: fly into zones held by armed contractors, slip past or break their patrols, loot what you can carry, and hold an extraction zone until the helicopter takes you home.

details.title: OVERPULSE
details.short_description: OVERPULSE is a fast-paced neon roguelite shooter built around intense 20-minute runs. Choose a weapon, stack upgrades, unlock its Overpulse, and survive escalating swarms, minibosses, and a final boss as your build grows from simple to screen-filling chaos.

details.title: Sharktooth Bay
details.short_description: Dig for shark teeth, sift through the sand, and stock a seaside fossil shop with what you find. Set your prices, arrange your displays, and sell to visiting beachgoers. Keep your favorite finds for your own collection.

details.title: Scrap Flood
details.short_description: Thousands of robots flow across the map like water and crash against your turrets. Lost? Collect the scrap, upgrade and come back stronger. Blow up barrels, drop cliffs on the horde, repair old turrets mid-battle and turn the steel flood into scrap.

details.title: Flipside 86
details.short_description: A coin-flicking roguelike in a neon 1986 casino. Slingshot coins into the bowl, bounce them into a JACKPOT CHAIN, stack CHIPS × MULT, then spend the winnings at Lucky's bar. 100 tables, 10 venues, one House to break. Then let it ride.

details.title: Planet Harvester
details.short_description: Planet Harvester is a sci-fi automation and resource management sim where you deploy autonomous drones, harvest planets, transfer resources to your mothership, buy upgrades, solve bottlenecks, and expand across the galaxy.

details.title: Doug's Playground
details.short_description: JOIN THE FIGHT AGAINST WATER! For generations, the Muck have suffered under the tyranny of water. Now Doug’s patented Playground Protocol lets you simulate war scenarios to assist those in the field. Support your Muck troops today!

details.title: ZAPLOOPA 4040
details.short_description: ZAPLOOPA is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

details.title: RIPPLES
details.short_description: Gather the group. Negotiate. Take risks. Rule the board. RIPPLES is an online board game for up to 6 players where strategy, negotiation, and luck collide every match.

details.title: Polliwoggle
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite where you're a frog going on a fishing trip. Roll and allocate dice to catch the biggest fish. Draft trinkets and stickers to help you out on your journey and race the clock to get a train ticket and continue your fishing trip.

details.title: RenewCity
details.short_description: Small budget. Hard choices. No perfect fixes. Revitalize real neighborhoods in Detroit, Seoul, and Leipzig, and find out whether you helped the people who live there or replaced them.

details.title: Wheel You Drive?
details.short_description: Grab a friend and take control of the same RC car in this chaotic 2-player co-op game! Each player controls a different part of the car, so you'll need to communicate, coordinate your movement, and somehow make it through every obstacle together.

details.title: Shroomanoid: breakout action roguelike
details.short_description: Forget classic breakout games. In Shroomanoid, you are the projectile. Control the frantic flight of a giant mushroom, smash enemies into a bloody pulp with precise ricochets, and stack insane combinations of abilities.

details.title: The Sievert Scale
details.short_description: A surveillance horror based inside a nuclear power plant. Monitor CCTV, Identify hazards, document incidents and keep operations running. Report too much and you fail the weekly audit, too little and danger spreads. What’s happening deeper inside the plant was never meant to be monitored.

details.title: Crown & Spores
details.short_description: Medieval CO-OP simulator where you grow magical plants, brew potions, create illegal products, trade with customers, and build your own underground empire in a fantasy world.

details.title: Raging Blasters 2
details.short_description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

details.title: Subclidean
details.short_description: Subclidean is a puzzle based single-player where you traverse and navigate infinite worlds, solving non-euclidean based puzzles and uncover the truths about the secrets of why you are here and how to escape.

details.title: Retire in the Fairy Mountains
details.short_description: Retire in the Fairy Mountains is a Chinese-style farming game that integrates planting, fishing,cooking, mining and free building. Players take on the role of a farmer at the foot of the Immortal Mountain, unlock various interesting items and build their own world.

details.title: Devils on the Moon Pinball
details.short_description: A classic-style Creature Collecting Pinball game based on old school masterpieces with modernized gameplay. Pixel-crafted in full monochromatic glory.

details.title: 搭搭大战（DaDa Wars）
details.short_description: Dada Dazhan is a casual real-time strategy game. No frantic micromanagement—just focus on your troop formations and city management. Grab a cup of coffee and watch these little cartoon soldiers charge into battle for you.

details.title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
details.short_description: A point-and-click mystery game. Search for the truth in 26 days, playing as two different characters, in a town during 1907.

details.title: Inertial
details.short_description: Inertial is a 2D arcade space racer. Race against the clock or against your friends in this reality-adjacent racing experience. No speed ceilings, no warped physics, just realistic gravity, thrust and skill.

details.title: The Murder Of Yesterday
details.short_description: A psychological horror crime experience featuring Story mode and Anomaly mode. Where time is your only weapon.. travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

name: Day by day：东京留子生存日记

details.title: Day by day：东京留子生存日记
details.short_description: A pixel-art life simulation about studying, surviving, and chasing your dreams as an international student in Tokyo. Every day, every choice, shapes your future.

details.title: Mind Over Dice
details.short_description: Mind Over Dice is a tactical roguelike where luck becomes a weapon. Roll dice, assign values to your heroes, and outsmart cunning enemies. Heroes, acts, secrets, artifacts, and much more! Every roll is a choice. Every face is fate.

details.title: 这活你来！
details.short_description: Your first job as a project manager: get an office moving. Nobody acts without instructions. Turn actions you have already given into employee handbooks, share copies, and finish each delivery with fewer instructions. A single-player pixel-art puzzle game.

details.title: Just a Stupid Room
details.short_description: A first-person 3D puzzle adventure escape room game for logic fans. Explore 30 standalone rooms filled with mystery and original puzzles. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious in this unique exploration challenge. The door won't open itself.

details.title: Gamercury World Engine
details.short_description: Turn one idea into a playable AI world. Gamercury World Engine helps creators build detective mysteries, dress-up dramas, simulation games, and cinematic interactive stories with AI-generated plots, quests, character dialogue, voice, cutscenes, and 3D scenes.

details.title: Mars Inc 98
details.short_description: Mars Inc 98 is a retro Windows 98 styled incremental game about terraforming Mars. Mine ore, craft parts, build machines and launch rockets to turn the Red Planet from a dusty wasteland into a habitable world.

details.title: Rockblaze
details.short_description: Rockblaze is a 2.5D physics-based puzzle platformer. Move with thrusters or weapon recoil as you pilot your ship through a simulated futuristic prison. Upgrade your ship, experiment with builds, learn from failure, and uncover the secrets of the simulation.

details.title: Hex & Tonic
details.short_description: A poker-hand roguelike deckbuilder about brewing potions. Draw reagents, brew reactions, stack catalysts until the numbers get silly — then break the Hex. Six covens, fifty hidden recipes, a Daily Brew and an Endless cauldron. Fair odds, shown to you. No hidden RNG.

details.title: Can Collector Simulator
details.short_description: Pick up piles of scattered cans in a casual first-person collecting sim. Recycle your haul at reverse vending machines, cash out printed receipts, upgrade your pickup speed and capacity, and look for oversized prize pull tabs hidden in the mess.

details.title: Wilds of Lumithra
details.short_description: Explore the hand-crafted open-world of Wilds of Lumithra, where every cliff, chasm, and hidden path is yours to discover. Turn natural obstacles into shortcuts as you gather, craft, build, and fight your way to survival - solo or online with friends.

details.title: My Beautiful Aquarium
details.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

details.title: Steps To The Stars
details.short_description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

details.title: Dreams of Suffering
details.short_description: A cinematic psychological horror game where you explore a haunting dream world, investigate mysterious environments, solve surreal puzzles, and face unknown entities. Experience a deeply atmospheric journey where sound, fear, and instinct guide you through the darkness.

details.title: B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled)
details.short_description: A crazy roguelite straight from Hell! B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled) is a wild 2D shooter with chaotic movement mechanics.

details.title: SOULLOOP
details.short_description: A steampunk roguelite FPS with deckbuilding. Draft a card after every floor: your revolver chains lightning, your saw thrower freezes enemies. Combine powerful builds, bank your souls when you die, and spend them to make your next descent stronger. Free demo out now.

name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?

details.title: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
details.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

details.title: Slipstreak
details.short_description: A free-for-all arcade shooter where speed is your damage. Bhop, wallrun, slide and rocket-jump to fill your streak and hit harder, then beat everyone to the big guns on the map. 2–8 players over Steam or LAN, with bots and time-trial courses. The movement is the whole game.

details.title: Where's my order?
details.short_description: Deliver food across town, solo or with friends, in a chaotic world of physics-based vehicles, flying food and ragdolls. The competition is fierce and the police are watching, but customers are hungry and the money won't make itself.

details.title: Raccoon Inc.
details.short_description: Bin Dive is tired of eating from the trash! Help this enterprising raccoon build a business up from flipping junk to a sprawling mega corporation unlike the world has ever seen. Start businesses, upgrade them, hire animals to help you, sit back and watch the money flow in this idler tycoon.

details.title: Conversation Simulator
details.short_description: Conversation Simulator is the practice tool for interviews, negotiations, difficult talks, and language skills. AI characters run entirely on your computer. No internet needed during play. Open source, fairly priced.

details.title: Burnknowe Golf Club
details.short_description: A cosy golf club tycoon in a painted Scottish landscape. Design the course, sculpt the ground, keep the greens perfect and your members happy, and grow your club from a handful of holes into a destination worth the trip.

details.title: Frostmason
details.short_description: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

details.title: How Much For It?
details.short_description: Run a second-hand shop. Hear out your customers, value strange items, and make your offer. Some lie, some hide important details, and some deals may bring more into your shop than you bargained for.

details.title: St. Grimsby’s Thaumaturgical
details.short_description: Hexcare Mutual welcomes you to the night shift at St. Grimsby’s, our condemned emergency room for magical creatures. A 1-8 player co-op comedy horror game about treating patients with instruments that lie and getting the paperwork up the tube before the bell.

details.title: BIG JUICE
details.short_description: Grow fruit, crush it with outrageous machines, and sell the juice in this incremental farming game. Automate your harvest, upgrade your blender, and expand to new planets. Play solo or team up in two-player co-op.

details.title: Winston Manor Mystery
details.short_description: In 1981, a fire swept through Winston Manor, leaving Lord Edward dead. In the aftermath, Damian, a lawyer who was present that night, seeks you out for help. He hopes your gift can reveal what really happened at the manor.

details.title: Idle Pluto
details.short_description: "Idle Pluto" is a MU-style idle RPG. Pluto, once a star god jailed in the sun, breaks free and reclaims power across the solar system. Mix four powers freely—no fixed class. Farm gear, upgrade to +9, grow wings. Black Hole Ladder, Space Rifts, Nine-Star events, and rebirth await.

details.title: Dock 7
details.short_description: A cozy shipbreaking game about peeling wrecks apart with a laser, one layer at a time, and bringing home what's left inside. No timers, no debt, no game over. Put the radio on, cut at your own pace, and fill your little dock with the things you find and the people you rescue.

details.title: Lowtown
details.short_description: A tiny pixel-art village lives right above your Windows taskbar and grows all on its own — from the first tents to a city of skyscrapers — through days, nights and seasons. You just watch: clicks pass straight through, and the village fades away when your cursor comes near.

details.title: Linglong Duel
details.short_description: A two-player strategy board game of Chinese craftsmanship. Gather precious materials, build workshops, and outwit your rival as the court’s clock advances. Compete for commissions and imperial patrons. Play solo, share a device, or challenge a friend online.

details.title: Tending
details.short_description: Tending is a cozy game about houseplants. Buy plants, figure out where each one likes to live, water them and watch them grow. Take cuttings to grow even more. Nothing dies, so if a plant is struggling, just move it somewhere better.

details.title: Deliveryman in Zhmurino
details.short_description: Ring once. Leave the box on the doorstep. Go. And don't look back if something is breathing on the stairs. Seven night shifts as a courier in two buildings that change every night, where the residents somehow know your name. Pixel-art rules horror: some mistakes cost money, others your life.

details.title: Quiet Hours
details.short_description: It's 2AM, the truck is loud, your friends are louder, and everybody on this street is a light sleeper. Quiet Hours is online co-op for 1–4 players on a night garbage route, where your real voice is noise the street can hear. Microphone strongly recommended.#

details.title: Zombie Mall Defense
details.short_description: Zombie Mall Defense is a game in which you defend your malls from ever-bigger zombie hoard waves that come from every direction. Expand the map, build and discover new turrets, find new zombie types and destroy their houses...

details.title: Undead Showdown
