details.short_description: 4v4v4v4 zombie survival. Hold your stronghold through ten rounds, gear up from a shared bank, and risk it at the casino. Your first eligible survival death gives you one chance in Limbo. Then the gates open: last squad standing wins.

details.title: Ink Left
details.short_description: You are a stick figure on an unfinished page, abandoned mid-stroke. Draw bridges, ropes, springs and mirrors with the ink the artist left behind — every line obeys real physics. Slip past crossed-out beasts across fading paper. Ink runs out. In the end, you will have to erase part of yourself.

details.title: I, Hurricane
details.short_description: You are the hurricane. Spawn storms across five seas, steer them toward the coast and push them toward 300 mph while humanity promises to act “by 2050.” Or switch sides and defend it: run the hurricane hunters’ base, fly into the eye, forecast the track and issue the warnings.

name: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace

details.title: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace
details.short_description: Read the case files, interrogate the robots, and decide their fate: back to society, or into the furnace. Your verdicts genuinely shape how the city develops — and watch out for the robots who refuse to jump.

details.title: Web Scaping
details.short_description: You are a cursor loose on WikiNet, a living encyclopedia. Crawler bots are hunting you. Click from article to article to reach your target before the swarm indexes you.

details.title: Dread Bids
details.short_description: A first-person horror auction. Bid against three desperate rivals on cursed relics, read their nerves and snipe before the hammer falls, then survive whatever you bought. Every night, the poorest guest does not go home.

details.title: Drift Goblin
details.short_description: Drift a pickup truck through thousands of goblins while the voxel city around you breaks apart. Bolt on a new build every run from a goblin dealer's hundreds of parts: flamethrowers, rocket pods, wrecking balls. Also, one of the goblins stole your cow, Betsy. Get her back.

details.title: Sigilbound
details.short_description: A dark fantasy auto battler RPG you buy once. Collect champions from six factions, build your team of five, then sit back and watch it fight. No energy, no shop, no paid summons: every champion is earned in play.

details.title: Roof UP!
details.short_description: Build a cozy floating hex island where every building grows as tall as it is happy. Cottages love trees, windmills love fields, lighthouses love the sea. Place each piece where its neighbors lift it up, and watch your skyline climb through the seasons.

details.title: Ring Hunt
details.short_description: Ring Hunt: an original 2-8 player online movement-driven social deduction — trapped together, you may only kill your next number, then inherit their target until only you remain. Kill wrong and YOU die instead. 10-min matches — bring all your mind games against your frenemies to outlast all watching

details.title: Gnome Acres
details.short_description: A cozy farming game where a village of gnomes does the work. Draw fields, pick what grows, and watch your gnomes plant, water, harvest and haul every crop through spring, summer, autumn and winter.

details.title: $1 Pizza Slice
details.short_description: Run a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt one slice at a time.

details.title: Hopworth the Wizard
details.short_description: Hopworth the Wizard is a challenging, colourful 2.5D platformer. A Gargoyle King has taken over Hopworth's Wizard tower while he was off questing. Journey home through forests, hills and mountain passes, leap the King's enchanted boulders and climb the tower to serve its eviction notice.

details.title: Treasured Carpets
details.short_description: Run a cozy carpet shop in an Istanbul-style bazaar. Buy rugs, wash away dirt, scrub grime, dry the fibers, and restore faded patterns. Unfold your finds for customers, match their tastes, and turn careful restoration into a thriving little showroom.

details.title: EDGE-FI
details.short_description: Don’t rush to figure out what’s going on in a place the world has discarded, where dim neon flickers through the haze. Discover how the devices around you work, and lose yourself in atmospheric music as you bring the city back to life. So, when progress moves on without us, where do we belong?

details.title: Quest For Stoken
details.short_description: A gloriously weird skateboarding sword platformer. Grind rails through ancient Greece, outer space and the depths of Atlantis, slash your way past frogs, aliens and killer bees, and battle bosses that make no sense at all, all to collect the mysterious Stoken.

details.title: Pegoda
details.short_description: Climb a haunted Japanese Pagoda in this pachinko roguelite. Build a bag of enchanted balls, fuse powerful evolutions, and place pegs mid-shot to turn a falling ball into a huge combo. Unlock new characters and defeat the guardians standing between you and the Emperor.

details.title: Crack & Stack
details.short_description: Race up to six friends to stack dice and crack puzzles in this chaotic party game! Based on the 2025 board game, Crack & Stack, you can now play online, split-screen, or solo against the commentary team, and turn on Chaos Mode for rounds that bend all the rules!

details.title: Horizon of Steel
details.short_description: Horizon of Steel is an idle ARPG. Instead of controlling the fights, you build your character's skills, equipment and strategies, then send it into combat to farm or level. The fights are drawn in ASCII with dynamic lighting, and a replay shows one exactly as it happened.

details.title: The Last Homecoming
details.short_description: A top-down mystery horror game rooted in Korean folk beliefs. Return to your childhood village after twenty years. Explore by lantern light, solve puzzles, and escape pursuit as buried memories surface. This homecoming may be your last.

details.title: Not a Bug: Idle Defense
details.short_description: Not a Bug is a relaxing incremental idle defense game. You can’t lose, since every bug dies the moment it reaches the glitch. Install apps, feed the bugs and watch the chaos. Remember: it’s not a bug, it’s a feature.

details.title: Domino Tinkerer
details.short_description: Become a domino tinkerer in a physics-based sandbox! Fly through rooms, deploy gadgets like cannons and funnels, and trigger chain reactions to clear every checkpoint. Build the ultimate domino machine solo or team up with up to 4 friends online!

details.title: Motor Park Architect
details.short_description: Build and manage the motorsport park of your dreams. Choose from a variety of racing categories, manage your staff, and create a world-class motorsport destination hosting a wide range of competitions. Take on the fastest drivers from different championships and beat their lap records.

details.title: CTRL Chaos
details.short_description: 15 singleplayer minigames. Different rules. Total chaos. Blast hooligans with a water cannon, fight space swarms, solve cargo puzzles, build a tower, or grow a garden. Pick your next challenge or play a series.

details.title: Floor Show
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike on a live TV game show. You are the contestant. Push rivals into spikes, lava and barrels to earn hype, your XP. Take sponsor deals, and face returning rivals made from whatever killed you last time.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
details.short_description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business. Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

details.title: Spiral Scramble
details.short_description: A co-op obstacle course for you and your friends. Work your way around a spiral of creatures, traps and hazards to reach the center together. One touch knocks you down, and only a teammate can pick you back up. If everyone goes down at once, it's back to the start.

details.title: City Safety
details.short_description: City Safety is a game about taking your city back from the mass surveillance that has infected every street corner. Join your friends in riding around the city, wreaking havoc, and challenging authority.

details.title: Cubies
details.short_description: Find and collect Cubies in this cube-sized 3D puzzle-platformer!

details.title: Residential Phenomena Hotline
details.short_description: You're the night agent at a paranormal support hotline service. Callers contact you when something goes wrong in their homes and send photos, videos, and voice notes. Question them, search the company files, find what doesn't belong, and tell them what to do. Get it wrong, and face the consequences.

details.title: That's a lot of Zombies
details.short_description: Rain hell from an AC-130 as millions of zombies climb over each other to reach your squad’s rooftop. Deploy sentry guns, flamethrowers and claymores before each night. Call in A-10s, B-52s and every bit of firepower you can get. Hold the roof until the rescue helicopter lands.

details.title: Foilage TCG : Collectors Edition
details.short_description: Foilage TCG: Collectors Edition is a single player fantasy trading card game. Build your ultimate deck, open booster packs, trade on the market, and hunt for rare Foil Refractors to take on your opponents. Collect and build your ultimate collection to load your binder and hard cases.

details.title: MimiCreate
details.short_description: Even aliens have exams! In MimiCreate, Mimics must learn to hide among humans before earning a license to visit Earth. Build disguises, blend in, and dodge the Inspectors in chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek.

details.title: SPATHA
details.short_description: A side-scrolling shooter flown from the cockpit. Read what's ahead through the canopy, the terrain in the side view and the lanes in the top view — all three on screen at once. Harvest magic stones from alien beasts, buy the weapons you want, and dive into seven worlds the Ordo turned into nests.

details.title: Circuit Valley
details.short_description: Grow a thriving valley with a crew of little robots. Play as Pip to tend crops and build workshops, then put your helpers to work hauling harvests and keeping production moving. Turn a handful of apples into a place that hums with life.

details.title: Chip Factory Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own semiconductor factory in first person. Process wafers, operate machines, connect conveyor lines, automate production, and ship advanced chips as your factory grows.

details.title: DUNSPIN
details.short_description: Pull the lever. Recruit whatever heroes the reels hand you. Then watch them fight. DUNSPIN is a slot-machine auto-battler roguelike with deckbuilding, where one lucky spin can turn a losing run into a winning one.

details.title: Soul Crypt
details.short_description: Explore cursed crypts in Soul Crypt, a dark fantasy adventure filled with intense combat and terrifying creatures. Face deadly enemies, uncover the secrets of the depths, and fight to survive the darkness.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: AlphaBonk Farm
details.short_description: A is for AlphaBonk! Join Farmer Bonk and the Gigglebone Gang for a trip through the alphabet down on the farm — letters, rhymes, real farm photos and a barnyard full of silly games. A fully restored 1995 Headbone Interactive classic.

details.title: Aether Oblivion
details.short_description: Aether Oblivion is a story-driven, tactical turn based strategy game set in 2490 during the rule of the Stellconian Empire. Command your fleet, manage resources, and lead High Admiral Caelus on his mission to uncover the conspiracy behind the late Emperor's demise.

details.title: Tiny Drift
details.short_description: TINY DRIFT is a pixel-art drift-combat survivor. Drift, charge and ram your way through waves of enemies. Upgrade your car with unique drifting weapons and survive intense battles as you build the ultimate combat machine.

details.title: Linkisa
details.short_description: Linkisa is a hand-drawn Metroidvania set in a world inspired by Malagasy folklore and steampunk aesthetics. Play as General Linkisa, stripped of his memories, and explore the rain-soaked regions of the Empire of Orana in search of your past and the restoration of order. Masina ny orana.

details.title: CounterMind
details.short_description: A planetary RTS against an adaptive enemy that learns how you play. Lead machine legions or the hive swarm across ground, sea, air, and space. The enemy doesn't cheat. It plays smarter. Can you outsmart the opposing minds?

details.title: Jester Under Pressure
details.short_description: Diskarte, jester of the high castle, has one job: entertaining the queen. This would be easy except Queen Bahaghari has a penchant for magically exploding the heads of subjects falling below her exacting standards. Can Diskarte avoid this frightening fate?

details.title: YiShi Contagion: Versus
details.short_description: Plague Hunters 🏹☣️ Join the hunt with your friends in the world of YiShi Contagion, a fast-paced 1v1 action game where you fight through enemy waves, collect power-ups, build your character, and race your rival to defeat the final boss first 💥

details.title: Paragon Colonists
details.short_description: Settle uncharted lands in Paragon Colonists, an economy-focused, turn-based 4X strategy game. Build thriving colonies, meet local Orc clans, defy the Ashen Horde and break with the Paragons to fulfill your dream of an empire of your own - solo or in asynchronous multiplayer!

details.title: Working From Home
details.short_description: You went freelance the week before lockdown. Now stuck at home with no boss and no office, your days are your own. Work enough to pay the bills, manage your needs, blow your wages on gambling, shopping, and vapes, and try to survive the lockdown that never ends.

details.title: Fuman Ghoul
details.short_description: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

details.title: DREAMFEAR
details.short_description: Escape the nightmare filled with your own fears using various weapons and upgrades in a fast-paced, surreal roguelite. Can you survive in your own mind?

details.title: StarStruck
details.short_description: StarStruck is a High-Octane Roguelite TPS! Blast, burn, and mutilate your way through rounds of escalating carnage. Hunt secrets, upgrade your arsenal, hunt Bosses and Mow down creatures by the hundreds!

details.title: Connecta
details.short_description: Build bridges in this roguelike deckbuilder. In Connecta, you build a deck of bridge pieces, connect them across grid maps, draft new cards and upgrades, or use a milkshake to freeze a volcano... All just to get back home.

details.title: Fwoofs
details.short_description: Grow a multiplying population of adorable creatures and guide them as they rebuild their world. Assign tasks, gather resources, and watch your colony come to life as their numbers rise. Turn a handful of creatures into a thriving world and uncover all their secrets in this cozy, incremental game.

details.title: Hop Slash
details.short_description: Jump, slash and collect with Hop, the non-stop hopping Bunny Knight in this 3D platformer in the spirit of the N64 and PS1 classics, with a twist: he won't stand still, so chain your moves across the floating islands of Celestina.

details.title: Unpatched
details.short_description: "Unpatched" is an action-RPG in the isekai genre. Play as a QA tester trapped in the body of an undead assassin inside the MMORPG he's testing. Your raid boss is in danger, the heroes are already close. Your weapons are blades and knowledge of unfixed bugs. Fight hordes of players and save your boss

details.title: WerkstattManager – Uncle Karl's Legacy
details.short_description: Take over Uncle Karl's run-down backstreet garage. Investigate symptoms, spend precious time on tests—or trust your hunch—then prepare a quote, repair the car, and rebuild your reputation in this warm, nostalgic management game.

details.title: Third Surveillance Bureau
details.short_description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

details.title: Fifth Tier
details.short_description: Fast, readable football management. You don't just pick the XI — you own the club. Take a small side from the fourth tier of a five-tier pyramid towards the top: tactics, wages, stands, academy, shares. Then sell up and buy a bigger club. A whole season can be played in an evening.

details.title: Space Industry
details.short_description: Build and automate your own modular space fleet in this sandbox base-building game. Mine asteroids, expand your ship, fight enemies, explore new star systems, and uncover the deepest secrets of the universe.

details.title: 时装工坊
details.short_description: You are a fashion designer and run your own fashion design room. An ordinary template can be made into anything you imagine. You can also design clothes for pets and put on your own clothes to wear after the design is completed. Match the scenes and actions and take a photo of your work.

details.title: TrueClash
details.short_description: An emotional visual novel following the journeys of several fighters. Your choices shape their lives and dictate how the story unfolds. These characters have souls of their own—will you bring yours into the mix?

details.title: Parcel Point Simulator
details.short_description: Sort, Scan, Deliver and Grow — Turn a corner parcel point into a fully-automized money machine, and build your logistic empire.

details.title: CatBall
details.short_description: CatBall is a physics-based roguelite builder: arm your cat, toss it into battle, watch it roll, crash, and swing on its own, and switch weapons at the right moment to send enemies flying.

details.title: Nightmare Delivery
details.short_description: Enter distorted minds and deliver packages to the darkness within. Play alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players, explore nightmarish locations, solve environmental puzzles, outsmart dangerous entities, and escape alive.

details.title: INFAZ
details.short_description: Fight your way through tense tactical firefights. Plant or defuse the bomb, take on the opposing team, or test your aim in solo matches. Use your weapons, grenades, sound awareness, and the minimap to gain the advantage

details.title: Dead Sector: Rogue
details.short_description: Pick a core, rewrite how you fight. Reload and meteors fall. Ice spikes rise, dash to shatter them. Sprint and lightning strikes. Fight in style to climb from D to S rank and make it all strike more often. A fast FPS roguelite with two guns, a combat dog and a station stuck in a time loop

details.title: Farm Hand
details.short_description: A brain-bending deckbuilder about setting up huge harvest combos! Enhance your deck, discover game-changing synergies, and plan your harvests to maximize your score. Every crop has a timer. Every harvest is a puzzle. Every combo feels incredible.

details.title: Blindstep
details.short_description: A robot with no forward vision. You can only walk backwards and the moment you turn to look where you're going, the screen goes black. Ten sectors of collapsing floors, hydraulic presses and things that patrol the dark. Every jump is taken blind.

details.title: Delphyr: The Deep Whispers
details.short_description: Dig to the last living core of a dead world. Delphyr is a 2D action roguelite where every death sends you home to the family whose bond the Deep cannot break — upgrade with them, then dig deeper. Hand-crafted spells, a grapnel, telekinetic mining magic, and titan bosses await below.

details.title: LockLine
details.short_description: LockLine is a tense turn-based tactics game. Think 3-in-a-row, but lining up your units calls down an orbital strike. Outthink an enemy trying to do the same to you. Grab jetpacks and shields, pin enemies, drop barriers and smoke screens, and face boss commanders who change the rules.

details.title: Subsector Zero
details.short_description: A liminal space horror game inspired by the backrooms, with levels actually being infinitely long.

details.title: Minipia
details.short_description: Minipia is a cozy desktop idle game. Make a tiny island your own, right in the corner of your screen, while you work or relax. Decorate freely, collect cute animals, discover their stories, and unlock new islands.

details.title: Sound Agent
details.short_description: Sound Agent is a narrative puzzle game where you solve cold cases by listening. Use the sound device to rewind to crime scenes, listen to the sounds at the scene, and uncover truths hidden in plain sound.

details.title: Milling Machine Simulator 2: Machine Shop
details.short_description: Step into your own machine shop. Operate manual mills and lathes, write CNC G-code, and turn raw stock into finished parts with real-time material removal. Experiment in Free Play or put your machining skills to work in Career mode.

details.title: GtFckd: Planet Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the horde on a tiny planet, alone or with up to 3 friends. Pick one of 8 ridiculous champions, stack spells that cast themselves, gamble on slot-machine chests, bargain with shrines, and slay the Rift Tyrant before the planet gets you first.

details.title: Rotten Batch: Bear Inspector
details.short_description: Inspect Fruit Patch Bears for defects, decide which category they belong to, and keep the line moving. Make sure you identify the cursed ones if you want to keep your job...and your life.

details.title: Porcelain
details.short_description: Porcelain is a first-person stealth extraction game set in a dark steampunk city. Infiltrate guarded districts, stay hidden, recover mysterious Reveries, and escape before you are caught. No guns. No easy way out.

details.title: Mombasa Conspiracy
details.short_description: Join Connor O'Ryan and his inseparable friend Brian Moloney in a classic Point & Click thriller that will take them from the gloomy streets of Dublin to the sweltering heat of Kenya, where they will become embroiled in a conspiracy hidden in time.

details.title: Payday Poker
details.short_description: Play a fresh spin on traditional Poker centered around receiving a payout to bet with at the beginning of the round instead of betting real money! Play as one of several outlaws all wagering their own cut of the spoils as you duke it out to take the entire stack home. Are you ready? NOW DRAW!

details.title: Curling Simulator
details.short_description: Call the shot, find your weight, and sweep it home. Take on AI opponents or play with friends online. Shape each delivery with mouse or controller, build an end with tactical shots, and watch your best moments again with saved replays.

details.title: Queen's Pact
details.short_description: Queen’s Pact is a dark roguelite deckbuilder with auto-battler combat: sacrifice, chain and scale your cards into loops that should not be allowed. Break the game until the Queen is impressed.

details.title: Lord Of The Ants
details.short_description: Dig the rock. Raise the walls. Make the swarm walk your road into your guns. Lord Of The Ants is a top-down ant tower defense with rerouting enemy path mechanics. Boss fights, builds, active/passive skills and more.

details.title: Too Slow Again
details.short_description: A first-person shooter where every level is a race against the clock. Clear the enemies, reach the finish, then do it again, faster. Every hit costs two seconds and restarts are instant. 100+ tracks across four weapon circuits, from assault rifle to sniper.

details.title: Roswell: Redacted
details.short_description: On a summer night in 1947, an unexplained light lit up the sky outside Roswell. That same night, the younger sister of a teenager named Tom Wilson disappeared from their home. Where exactly was the mysterious voice guiding him trying to lead him?

details.title: Gamble Cats
details.short_description: A top-down survivor game where you guide an addicted gambling cat through enemy hordes, dodge danger, collect XP, and grow stronger with auto attacking weapons, stat upgrades, and chest rewards.

details.title: Rise of the Seraphyn
details.short_description: An old-school 3D isometric MMORPG. Roam 100+ tiered zones, shape a character on a sprawling skill web, tame beasts, craft in 20 professions, run trade wagons for your guild, bet on arena duels, and choose a side: fight for one of four cities and let your karma decide what your wings become.

details.title: Starship! Starship!
details.short_description: Blast through asteroids and enemy ships in Starship! Starship!, an arcade space shooter inspired by Asteroids. Fly solo or team up in local co-op, upgrade your ship, and grab power-ups to survive the chaos—or challenge your friends in PvP.

details.title: Main Character Energy
details.short_description: Ever dreamed of time-traveling or a perfect romance? Tired of dumb protagonists and restrictive RPGs? Here is the answer. A text adventure where you set the world and make every decision. Drive a tank on an ancient battlefield, or turn a ghost into your lover. Become the hero of your own story.

details.title: Territorium
details.short_description: « Conquer the world, one border at a time. » Territorium is a real-time multiplayer grand strategy game for up to 128 players. Upgrade your facilities, unlock devastating nuclear arsenals, and dominate the map in solo, co-op survival, or exclusive team modes.

details.title: The Saga of Three Realms
details.short_description: A classic sandbox MMORPG. Tame animals and monsters to fight at your side. Plant your house right in the open world, no instances. Master any skill by using it, craft gear that matters, trade across the realm and carve your own legend. No pay to win, no cash shop.

details.title: The King Must Grow
details.short_description: A physics-based co-op incremental about overly loyal jesters, each with one very important job: Feed cute, entirely innocent slimes to the ever-hungry Slime King. Throw them by hand, then see if you can build systems that do it for you. Play solo, or be lazy and make a friend do the work.

details.title: Bloomtop
details.short_description: A cozy idle gardening game that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Water, harvest and cross-pollinate pixel-art plants while you work, discover 58 hybrids, and grow a flowering vine up your monitor's edges until it frames your whole screen.

details.title: Photoncytosis
details.short_description: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation. A tiny organism feeds on the light of your screen, stores energy in its cells, and grows while you work. Shape its evolution, inspect it under the microscope, and help it survive a changing desktop ecosystem.

details.title: Deckhound
details.short_description: Somebody took Birdie's slipper, and she wants it BACK! Pick two of eight real pets, build a deck of dog tricks, and chase off squirrels, garden gnomes and one very big goose. Play solo with both pets or couch co-op for two. A cozy, silly roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Bouncery
details.short_description: Bouncery is an incremental bouncing game where you smash grumpy geometric shapes. Start by clicking and fill the board with balls, saws, lasers, black holes and many other weapons. Ascend and break it all again, faster.

details.title: Foldvalley
details.short_description: A cozy pop-up storybook village builder. Lay paper tiles that pop up off the page, welcome villagers home and make their wishes come true. Read your village's story in its own storybook, then build without end on a map that keeps unfolding.

details.title: Dark Ages Battle Simulator
details.short_description: What happens when 20 skeletons face a dragon? Or an army of goblins challenges a colossal demon? Create your own dark-fantasy matchups, build your armies, and watch monsters, warriors and legendary beasts clash in a brutal cinematic battle simulator.

details.title: Fruitless Campaign
details.short_description: Set the azimuth, elevation and launch speed, read the wind and the weather, and lob shells across endless procedurally generated islands to destroy every fruit. Play untimed on Easy or race the clock on Normal and Hard. Earn weapons from airdropped crates, or take on up to three friends online.

details.title: Capital Circuit
details.short_description: A chaotic 3D party board game for 2–6 players: buy America's biggest cities, rig your rivals' dice, blow up their buildings with a bazooka and settle scores in 14 first-person minigames — beer pong, bobsleigh, darts, water pistol duels and more. Online or on one screen.

details.title: AfterCursor
details.short_description: Your cursor leaves copies behind. Now they hunt you. Collect folders, dodge phantom cursors, and chase high scores in an eerie desktop arcade game. Uncover a 50-level story between emails, or test your reflexes in Endless, Maze, Waves, and Relay.

details.title: Cloudwright
details.short_description: A cozy factory game for 1-8 players across a vast sky of floating islands. Every island holds something new, and it all connects: belts, ropeways and airships tie your islands into one ever-growing factory. Explore, meet the islanders, friend and foe, and brave the caves below.

details.title: Rooklite
details.short_description: A minimalist chess roguelite played on 4×4 boards, with the classic pieces and all the beauty of chess. Build your board and fight for checkmate.

details.title: Alandys
details.short_description: You don't catch creatures here: you are one. In this co-op action roguelite, every guardian plays like a raid boss: read the telegraphs, solve the mechanics, raise your kin and climb to the Summit. Solo, with AI teammates or up to 3 players online. Free to play.

details.title: Art Monolith
details.short_description: Discover art, one brick at a time. A relaxing clicking game where you break a giant cube. Painting masterpieces hide under every layer. Collect hundreds of them to hang in your own gallery, or join the world to break one massive cube in multiplayer mode.

details.title: The Last Warden
details.short_description: You are the last guardian of a city in a medieval post-apocalyptic world. An unknown plague has spread across the world, and every day is now a struggle for survival. Decide who may pass through the gates — and who must face the final sentence.

details.title: Saving San Martino
details.short_description: A stealth adventure where you spray graffiti to reclaim Sicily from the mafia. Pick locks, tag turf, and build your base on the Mediterranean coast.

details.title: Plasma Sky
details.short_description: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

details.title: Astral Bounty
details.short_description: Astral Bounty is a demanding 2D arcade side-scroller straight out of the ’90s. Blast through hand-built enemy waves, hunt four bounties, earn credits and blow them on beefy upgrades in the shop. You’re going to need them. 3 difficulty levels, 4 ships, mercy optional.

name: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon

details.title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
details.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite action RPG where you master the power to grow giant or shrink tiny. Build your character by collecting weapons and companions, then challenge colossal legendary monsters. Supports 2-player local co-op.

details.title: Project L.U.N.A
details.short_description: Project L.U.N.A is a pixel art bartending visual novel set in cyberpunk Seoul. Run the bar Unknown as L.U.N.A, listen to your guests, and mix cocktails. Your choices and every drink you serve can change their relationships and fates.

details.title: Virtus Arenae
details.short_description: Choose your tribe and step into the arena. Angels, demons, specters or sylvan folk: your creatures come to life on a 5×5 board. Move them, wield your magic to reshape the battlefield and break through enemy lines to crush your opponent.

details.title: Break the Witch
details.short_description: Manage the duality of defending while using the enemy projectiles in your favor to face challenges an progress through the game. To improve collect boons along the way. Try different builds and find the one that best suits your play style.

details.title: Helltower
details.short_description: A Roguelike RPG mixing spectacular action and rhythmic combat, in a dystopic hell where each soul has to accept their death, and the regrets that come with it.

details.title: UpBRELLA
details.short_description: A witch's adventure with nothing but an umbrella. Upbrella is a puzzle platformer where every trick you discover reopens the world in a new way, wrapped in cozy pixel art and a wordless friendship between a girl and a strange little creature.

details.title: Guild of Elemental Quests
details.short_description: Welcome to the Elemental Adventure Guild! Pick your adventurer, clear elemental blocks to strike enemies, gather diverse elemental gems, and craft your personalized battle style. Survive each mission's battles and complete every challenge that comes your way.

details.title: Cold Case: Unfinished Sentences
details.short_description: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

details.title: Sportvida Foodimals
details.short_description: Half food. Half animal. All adventure. Team up with friends in this VR co-op adventure where you'll hunt ingredients, collect adorable Foodimals, and cook up a world of fun.

details.title: When Stars Rest
details.short_description: Stars are out of energy. The black hole is hungry! Charge stars that fall on your island to earn coins. Will you upgrade weapons, unlock powerful items, and put Tesla coils and UFOs to work—or feed that black hole's growing appetite? It's all up to you!

details.title: SCRAP CROWN
details.short_description: In the junkyard arena, the winner rips the weapons off the loser. Bolt a hammer to a fridge and a rifle to a microwave, beat the scrap gangs one by one, rebuild your crew from what you take and climb to the Scrap King's crown. A voxel roguelite auto-battler.

details.title: MEGAWATT
details.short_description: The electric roguelike. MEGAWATT is a deckbuilder where you wire up reckless machines, let a single spark loose, and chase outrageous power surges before the city goes dark. Then take the time machine back to 1871.

details.title: The Black Below
details.short_description: Classic grid-based dungeon crawling, rebuilt: a 3D dungeon reduced to stylized one-bit art, a score synthesized live, automapping, skill trees, and a party whose dead stay on the roster. Under a city that lives off a hole in the ground, something is sleeping, and nobody agrees on what it is.

details.title: Polybarius
details.short_description: NEW from UMBRIA ELECTRONICA! The arcade sensation of 1981, now in your own home! Eight thrilling chapters, one mighty boss and a high score table just waiting for your initials. Each coin is one life. Maximum 3 credits per player. POLY was waiting for you.

details.title: Convoy Inc.
details.short_description: Build a freight empire on a watercolor-style map of the real world. Start in 1980, 2000 or 2030 with one truck and one driver, take jobs across 207 countries, weather storms, rivals and tired drivers, and grow a fleet where every risk is visible before you take it.

details.title: REISIR0b: PIZZA RUN
details.short_description: 🍕A fast-paced 2D Metroidvania about an elite combat android mercenary who shoots, tears across land, space, and water, opens boxes with random upgrades, and takes on the craziest job in the galaxy — ALL FOR PIZZA.

details.title: Conatus - Forgotten Depths
details.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon offers a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and descend into a world humanity chose to bury.

details.title: Froginko
details.short_description: A cozy pachinko roguelike. Bounce bugs through a pond full of frogs, merge frogs into bigger frogs, and get your best score in Challenge Mode, where one drop decides your place on the leaderboard.

details.title: Astrobreaker
details.short_description: Astrobreaker is a short incremental game about making a spaceship faster and more powerful. Mine planets, gather resources, and upgrade your ship.

details.title: Obolisk
details.short_description: COSMIC COMBAT DECIDED ONE COIN AT A TIME... Obolisk is a turn-based tactical roguelike where your party of Obols use coin flips to attack, defend, and unleash unique abilities. Plan ahead, survive each encounter, and see if you can make it to the OBOLISK.

details.title: Tales of Twin Souls
details.short_description: "Tales of Two Souls" is a 2D open-world xianxia RPG. Explore, fight, and cultivate with the soul bound to you. Uncover your family's fall, rebuild your ancestral home, meet allies and rivals, and forge your own path.

details.title: Kingdom TD: Draft Your Demise
details.short_description: Choose the enemies. Risk a deadlier wave for more gold. Build winding defenses, upgrade your towers, and ride between them to boost their power. How much danger will you draft to defend your campfire?

name: GRUBSTAKE: A Post Apocalyptic Pawn Shop

details.title: GRUBSTAKE: A Post Apocalyptic Pawn Shop
details.short_description: GRUBSTAKE is a single-player, first-person, post-apocalyptic pawn shop sim. Run a barter shop in the wasteland... if you can out-haggle the survivors at your counter. No money. No price tags. Trade, craft, restock, repeat. Be on the caravan by day 30.

details.title: The Deep Calls
details.short_description: Build every hero your way in The Deep Calls, a turn based Lovecraftian roguelite dungeon crawler. Choose distinct Disciplines, mix unlocked Skills , embrace dangerous Traits, and equip hard won relics. Forge powerful party synergies, then risk those builds in branching dungeons with no retreat.

details.title: Age of Crowns
details.short_description: Captain a free company across a medieval kingdom of four crowns. Hire swords, keep them fed and paid, and climb seven rungs from sellsword to king. Your veterans earn names, the captain who beats you may come back with one, and every fight is decided by orders you read before you commit.

details.title: LIMEN Company
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1–4 players in procedurally generated worlds. Pick a door, gather the data and stay quiet — they can hear you.

details.title: While I Still Remember
details.short_description: An adventure game about an artist who has lost her sight and must learn to live in the unfamiliar, dark and frightening world that has become her reality

details.title: Clay Rumble
details.short_description: Claymation wrestling with hand-sculpted clay fighters. Punch, bodyslam, dive off the top rope, grab the folding chair and settle it outside the ring. Couch brawls for two, six-fighter Clay Rumbles, tag team chaos and tournaments.

details.title: Kingshatter
details.short_description: KINGSHATTER is a chess roguelike about building a ridiculous army and finding out just how much trouble it can cause. Fight across small boards, collect powerful upgrades, and take on opponents with a few unpleasant tricks of their own.

details.title: Masterstroke
details.short_description: Painting is a cover; haggling is the real art! [Masterstroke] is a roguelite fusing canvas jigsaws, poker hands, and tense bluffing. Chain resonant cards on a 3x3 grid, trigger 8-way paylines, and fleece wealthy buyers for rent. Just don't push too far!

details.title: Gravity Defied Reincarnation
details.short_description: An unofficial remake of the 2004 keypad phone classic. Lean the rider to keep the bike balanced, ride over hills and drops and reach the finish on 30 tracks. Original mode rebuilds the classic physics, Modern mode rides smoother. Four bikes, pixel art and 31 original songs.

details.title: Grimoire Paradox
details.short_description: A clumsy apprentice witch botches her first spell and gets a grumpy 500-year-old witch stuck in her head. To part ways, they have until dawn to find nine strange items in a town full of monsters. A hand-painted comedy point-and-click adventure.

details.title: Kinfall: An Idle Dungeon Crawler
details.short_description: An idle dungeon crawler that plays beside your work. Your family of heroes dives, fights and loots on its own. Take over at any moment. When a hero falls for good, an heir carries on with the family's gifts and legends. You make the important decisions, the hero fights for you.

details.title: ICE Wars
details.short_description: 3v3 vehicle combat on the rain-soaked streets of East Los Angeles. Advocates race to get families to safe houses while ICE races to reach them first. Ram, shoot and outdrive the other team in a fight for every passenger, where every delivery decides who gets to stay.

details.title: Last Load
details.short_description: A night shift at a 24-hour laundromat. Sort, wash, dry and fold your customers' loads by the care labels. Then a green work jacket with a white stripe turns up in a bag where it doesn't belong. Every wash brings the blood back. The man who owns it is waiting at the window.

details.title: COREHOLD
details.short_description: Stranded after a shipwreck, gather resources, build a base and descend into dark, procedural caves. Craft weapons, master furnace heat and brew potions, then repair your ship and escape. A top-down pixel adventure where every trip underground brings you closer to home.

details.title: EPIBDA
details.short_description: Iceland, October 1989. For seven nights you keep the light on a remote lighthouse. Out in the fog stands EPIBDA, a thing 120 metres tall. It moves only when no one is looking. Keep the beam on it, guide the ships past the reef, and don't let the lamp run dry.

details.title: 6 Days Out
details.short_description: A broken leg, a tent on a mountain pass, six nights. By day your friends go out for supplies. At night they walk back to your GPS signal. And something knocks at the entrance. It speaks in their voices and looks exactly like them. Open up or not.

details.title: Zondbeland
details.short_description: They used to be people. Then they got smartphones. Now the ZONTBE are a horde and STASS herds them. Go live, grab a shotgun and clear five levels of fast, bloody retro FPS action while your chat watches every kill.

details.title: NII-058
details.short_description: Winter, the nineties. You climb onto the roof of a shut-down research institute to strip its copper, and the rusted roof gives way. The doors are welded, the windows bricked up. Something walks in the dark. Find a way out before it finds you.

details.title: PIZZA 66
details.short_description: 1997. A roadside pizzeria on a dead stretch of Route 66. You work the night shift alone: roll the dough, spread the sauce, bake, slice and box every order by hand. And when the red lamp over the window lights up, you have five seconds to drop the shutter.

details.title: Sunbed Simulator
details.short_description: Take over an unlicensed beach with a few sunbeds and become king of the coast! In this first-person business sim, serve guests, hire staff and grow your resort – solo or in online co-op with friends. Bribe the police and sabotage the hotel next door. On this beach, you make the rules!

details.title: Wizard Castle
details.short_description: A tactical card duel of wizards. Summon creatures, bind enchantments, hide traps, raise barriers and claim the battlefield with a domain. 167 cards, three manas, ten ready decks, CPU rivals and online 1v1.

details.title: Memories of Memories Anthology
details.short_description: Ten stories, where memories are for sale.

details.title: Silk & Cannons
details.short_description: Trading and real-time naval combat. Canton, 1840: one year to make your fortune. Buy where goods are made, sell where they are scarce, fire broadsides at pirates and ride out the typhoons. Three seas, three eras: China, the Indian Ocean and the Mediterranean.

details.title: Fishy Ring
details.short_description: Fish back your ring and try to save your wedding in this gentle gameboy-core fishing RPG where you’ll have to deal with the consequences of your actions as you try to mend a troubled community.

details.title: Whisperwell
details.short_description: Whisperwell is a first-person multiplayer social deduction game where cute cats hide deadly secrets. Complete missions, use role-specific abilities, and discuss and vote to expose the killers, or deceive the village and eliminate anyone who gets in your way.

details.title: Resupply
details.short_description: Your towers have limited ammo, and it's your job to deliver it. Resupply is a tower defense game where logistics is the real challenge. Move ammunition with workers, conveyor belts and autonomous bots, and keep your defense supplied as the waves get harder.

name: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape

details.title: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape
details.short_description: Escape a world ruled by chess as a curious, shapeshifting chameleon. Capture guards to borrow their movement, use tactical cards, and solve turn-based room puzzles. Every new form opens a different route—but the guards have plans of their own.

details.title: Monster Cove
details.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

details.title: Ancient Crowns
details.short_description: Build your captain in 3D, raise your banner and ride out across a curving world to claim the ancient crowns. Recruit armies, fight turn-based battles on land and at sea, besiege towns or hold your own walls. Three peoples, three campaigns, a map editor and hot-seat. In English and Hungarian.

details.title: Frontline: Hold the Line
details.short_description: A WWII tactical roguelite about holding the line. Dig in, deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, tanks and anti-tank guns, then call in artillery and air strikes as waves of enemy infantry and armour crash against your defences.

details.title: Peblings: A Creature Bag-Builder
details.short_description: A creature roguelike in the spirit of Luck be a Landlord, where your creatures fuse and evolve. Draw your bag onto the grid and watch their effects chain: a few dozen damage at first, thousands by the end. Eight bosses per run, out of 32, and they fight back.

details.title: Bad Company
details.short_description: Never enough firepower or room for loot? This multiplayer extraction shooter has the cure! Form a convoy with friends or quirky AI buddies. Start with basic rifles, storm forts in tanks, and haul maps clean with heavy trucks. Backpack full? Drive off with the crates and the vehicle!

details.title: Dark Kitchen
details.short_description: Dark Kitchen is a 2–4 player co-op game, playable online or in split-screen. Survive the kitchen rush while your friends race across town to deliver orders on time, and guard your food from rivals who'll stop at nothing to steal it!

details.title: Resortful
details.short_description: Resortful is a cozy island management sim. Start with a harbour and a beach, then build bungalows, cafés, hotels and water parks for the guests who sail in each day. Balance prices, upkeep and reputation as your relaxing resort grows.

details.title: Monster Battle Master
details.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.

details.title: Sus Chef
details.short_description: A chaotic first-person online multiplayer cooking and social deduction game for up to 12 players. Take orders, cook, serve and keep the restaurant clean to improve the rating while hidden saboteurs try to cause chaos and bring the restaurant to ruin!

details.title: Raccoocket
details.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

details.title: Our Hollow
details.short_description: The Crown has nailed an eviction notice to your Heart Tree: forty days to quit the wood. Lead a ragtag band on a turn-based d20 adventure through hand-made towns, haunted roads, a sun-scorched isle and frozen mountains, and find out who really holds the paper.

details.title: Wallet Street
details.short_description: A first-person stock market sim where the market is rigged, and you're the one rigging it. Trade on the news, buy a blog to spread rumors, lobby against companies, install a puppet president, or skip stocks and win big at the casino.

details.title: In the Margins
details.short_description: Run a cozy bookstore in a small riverside town. Listen to what each customer is after and find them the right book from over 1,400 real titles. Stock the shelves, decorate, host story time and book club, and grow the shop one room at a time. There's a cat.

details.title: A Mountain Called Hope
details.short_description: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

details.title: The Bank
details.short_description: a finance mmo with the goal to compete in a virtual economy

details.title: Skill Issue
details.short_description: Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill-master.

details.title: Kill to Zero
details.short_description: Seek revenge in a frantic top-down hack and slash! Cut enemies in half, master the Parry, and take down a cyberpunk megacorporation!

details.title: Shape Wars
details.short_description: A fast-paced auto-battler where Squares, Triangles, and Circles clash in an endless lane war. Build your army, manage your economy, and destroy the enemy Nexus before they destroy yours.

details.title: Star Talent
details.short_description: Run a Hollywood talent agency from a one-room office to the top of the industry. Scout unknowns, sign stars, negotiate the deals and fight rival agencies for every role, in a living, deeply simulated film world where every career is yours to make or break.

details.title: Vanguard Tides
details.short_description: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

details.title: Farmdustry
details.short_description: Cozy farm automation game: lay roads, send out cute cargo bots and turn wheat into bread, then bigger recipes. No timers, no fail states. Play solo or co-op with up to 4 friends.

details.title: SpellMart: Monster Girl Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build your dream magical shop in SpellMart! Stock modern potions, set competitive prices, and manage a quirky team of Monster Girls in a vibrant neon world. A stylish tycoon simulator where retail strategy meets anime charm. Can you turn magic into big business?

details.title: Quadfort
details.short_description: Build a ring. Break theirs. QUADFORT is an arcade strategy party game for 1–4 players: snap walls around your fortress, arm it with cannons and aim every shot yourself. Play with friends on one screen or online, or climb the 15-stage solo campaign. A new island every match.

details.title: Belt Nine
details.short_description: A neon vector shooter on rails. On the run in a stolen ship, slide down the Belt and blast through corpo hunters, fighter squadrons, krakens and things that should not live in space. Stack power-ups, ride the turbo for score, and see how far one hull can carry you. The run never ends. You do.

details.title: Most Scuffed Golf
details.short_description: Tired of the same old mini-golf courses? In Most Scuffed Golf, you and up to 3 friends build a course that’s entirely your own! Complete with windmills, ramps, funnels, and the occasional visit from a whale. The longer the round goes on, the bigger and more chaotic the course gets.

details.title: No One Returns
details.short_description: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

details.title: The Infinite Library
details.short_description: A narrative incremental where the UI tells the story. Discover rare Words, craft Phrases, fill shelves until reality buckles. Each prestige resets the world, but the Library remembers.

details.title: XGA SPECIAL EDITION
details.short_description: Survive the nightmare of XGA! Trapped in the rotting corpse of a space station, you must explore, fight and hide in this intense Horror-Metroidvania! But remember, XGA is hunting you.... PROUDLY USING NO GENERATIVE AI

details.title: 江湖藏锋
details.short_description: Jianghu: Hidden Edge is a hardcore turn-based Roguelike RPG blending deckbuilding and inventory management. Lead your martial artists through the perilous grid map—will you risk all for legendary gear or retreat with your haul? Uncover the conspiracy brewing in Songhe Town.

details.title: Choo Choo Kingdom
details.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

details.title: Quillzyra
details.short_description: Create persistent AI characters, shape their personalities and relationships, and chat privately on your own device. Three conversation quality levels are included. Add local portrait generation with the optional NVIDIA DLC.

details.title: Tiny Desk Pot
details.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

details.title: Quack Ball!
details.short_description: Defend your goal as a rubber ducky in chaotic 4-player 3D pong! Battle friends in local multiplayer across wacky arenas. Lose a round? Draw a power-up card. Stack synergizing cards into wild builds and quack your way back to victory.

details.title: Fatemender
details.short_description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

details.title: Dfiance: Dominance
details.short_description: Three worlds at war. Grind ranked, crush enemies, or go for tournament glory. Build your deck, trade skins, play solo or with friends. Three factions, endless strategies. Free to play. Your dominance starts now.

details.title: The Necessary Evil
details.short_description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

details.title: Mech Support
details.short_description: Mech Support is an action focused, multitasking game, featuring frantic tower defense elements. Up to four players take control of "US Inc" engineers, tasked with defending military outposts and crafting powerful ammunition, in order to destroy waves of dastardly "THEM Co" enemy mechs.

details.title: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon
details.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Grow your empire season after season and prove you have the guts to be a world-class haunter.

details.title: Chicks vs Ducks
details.short_description: Tag, push and parkour your friends off the map. Chicks vs Ducks is a 2–10 player online party game: team hunts, free-for-all brawls on rising lava, and co-op egg heists against sharks. Wall-run, dash, grapple and get back up, or drag a friend up with you.

details.title: Utopia: Haven
details.short_description: Explore three distant planets in this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania, developed for the Game Boy Color. Face mysterious creatures, discover powerful upgrades and uncover lost secrets. The fate of humanity is in your hands!

details.title: Watch Out: Shark!
details.short_description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

details.title: They're Gonna Get In
details.short_description: "They're Gonna Get In" is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

details.title: Cryotank Rogue
details.short_description: Cryotank Rogue is a fast-paced 2D sideview twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a brutal cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through procedurally generated levels, loot weapons and augments, and evolve into a deadly machine to survive permadeath runs.

details.title: Static Maw
details.short_description: You take the night shift at StaticCore, an antenna station built over a sealed mine. The old mining machines never left. Keep the station running, track them on radar, drive them back with radio waves, and find out what the antennas are really listening for.

details.title: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck
details.short_description: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where a debt‑ridden goblin builds cursed card hands to survive. Equip bizarre relics and trigger outrageous score combos to defeat relentless monsters in each run.

details.title: Hidden Shore
details.short_description: After many years, you have finally reached this mysterious place. Now, will you be able to uncover all its secrets and finally find what you have been seeking for so long? Explore a secret island, solve puzzles and riddles to uncover the truth.

details.title: THE WITCH'S GRIMOIRE
details.short_description: An atmospheric experience in the dark and eerie world of classic fairy tales, progressing solely through your choices. No complex mechanics; just sit back and focus on the story. Make the right decisions to avoid danger and try to survive the twisted endings of these tales.

details.title: Ram Fights
details.short_description: Get ready to headbutt your way to glory in this hilarious physics-based brawler! Customize your ultimate animal gladiator, master the art of the perfect charge, and send your rivals flying with epic ragdoll physics.

details.title: Moonlight Apothecary
details.short_description: Brew concoctions, befriend Ravensport's many fantasy inhabitants, and unravel the mystery of the Evernight as the newest apprentice of the Moonlight Apothecary.

details.title: polymorphite
details.short_description: Rhythm-dodging adventure game about a mysterious set of murders. Come then; decide the past, so that we may glimpse at a better future.

details.title: Tsuki Journey
details.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

details.title: Rows Of Earth
details.short_description: A detailed zombie-survival colony sim where you create a settlement on an infested island. Guide your workers as they build walls, grow crops, dig trenches and plant their flag in the land. Help them to fight hordes, form families, and uncover old technologies. Write their story...

details.title: Grandpa Golf
details.short_description: A golf roguelike about making really big numbers. Sink shots, buy powerful items, and build ridiculous score combos as you push deeper into Grandpa Golf’s golf course.

name: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game

details.title: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game
details.short_description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

details.title: Beards Go Underground
details.short_description: The Mining Deckbuilder. Blow up the mountains using explosive card combos! Build your deck, prepare your strategy and BOOM! - call gold and gemstones your own.

details.title: Traffic Monster
details.short_description: Traffic Monster is a fast-paced endless runner! Dodge heavy traffic, collect power-ups, and customize your dream car. Challenge real players in online multiplayer, place bets, and survive the chaos!

details.title: NGC-404: Fractured Sector
details.short_description: Lead a small fleet in a cut-off 2D space sector where trade, colonies, fuel, supplies and battles decide who survives. Build your faction, explore unknown systems, develop colonies, fit ships and shape a living simulated galaxy alone or with friends.

details.title: Caution Ahead: Part 3
details.short_description: Descend into darkness as John, a search and rescue officer, reaches the final destination of his journey. Explore claustrophobic mines in this horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration with stealth-based survival.

details.title: BattleSpinners
details.short_description: A fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart. Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

details.title: OVER SAND
details.short_description: Take to the steampunk skies! Defend your flying ship over endless sands from mechanical hordes. Master turret firepower, switch weapons, and craft synergistic perk builds mid-wave. No movement — pure skill!

details.title: Evergrowing
details.short_description: Play as a squirrel in a cozy adventure about growing your tree home. Help woodland neighbors, build along the branches, and travel by balloon to other trees. Venture beneath the roots and discover what’s waiting below.

details.title: Pirate & Darkmage
details.short_description: A life simulation RPG set in a world of pirates and magic. Farm, fish, build friendships, and set out on adventures at your own pace. Complete goals without feeling restricted, and shape your own story through the choices you make.

details.title: Totally Normal Ramen
details.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

name: Interactive Language-Learning Novel: Interview with Emma

details.title: Interactive Language-Learning Novel: Interview with Emma
details.short_description: Emma starts journalism school: new friends, awkward first meetings and maybe her first love. Listen to voiced dialogue, click any word and learn English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese or Turkish inside a living story. The free demo is out now.

name: 戚继光 Qi Jiguang: Art of War

details.title: 戚继光 Qi Jiguang: Art of War
details.short_description: Gunpowder vs Samurai: A Tower Defense + Auto Battler. Wield the Ming dynasty's cluster bombs, rockets, drones, and cannons against pirate fleets from the sea. Build formations, set up artillery, can you replicate Qi Jiguang's legendary 0:2000 kill-to-loss ratio?

details.title: Applied Shamanism
details.short_description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

details.title: The Old Parish
details.short_description: A cozy top-down farming and life sim in a rural Irish parish. Sow and harvest the family farm, mow and bale the hay, raise cattle and sheep and fish the lake. Then head into a town where every door opens, for Sunday Mass, a pint at O'Brien's and a hand of Twenty-Five.

details.title: The Long Mine
details.short_description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

details.title: Don't Wake the Queen
details.short_description: Protect the peaceful sleep of Your Meowness in this infinite incremental tower defense. Place fierce warriors, build your own path, unlock a ton of new skills and infinitely upgrade EVERYTHING.

details.title: Thousands of Chroma
details.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

details.title: Worst Airline Ever
details.short_description: Build an airline from scratch in this multiplayer co-op airline management game. Fly airplanes inspired by real aircraft, design and upgrade your plane, serve passengers, and grow your airline from a small regional carrier into a world-class airline.

name: When the Moon Falls, We Speak

details.title: When the Moon Falls, We Speak
details.short_description: The moon is falling, and the world nears its end. You play as Hill, a museum curator who chooses to stay on Earth. There, you meet 12, a mysterious red-haired woman who keeps you company as the world fades. Through your final conversations, you uncover her secret—and perhaps, the reason you stayed.

details.title: STARLET☆DISORDER
details.short_description: Join STARLET☆DISORDER, the reality show: get famous, loved, watched. Live with rivals. Perform love. Survive confessionals. Go viral. Truth is ammunition. But there’s no clean truth. Broadcast turns your week into a story that never happened. Go live and swear you didn't mean it. It’s all recorded.

details.title: Gambition
details.short_description: A chess-inspired tactical roguelike where every battle becomes a puzzle of sacrifice and manipulation. Evolve chess pieces, build powerful armies, and turn clever sacrifices into devastating synergies.

name: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island

details.title: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island
details.short_description: Welcome to Phantasmal Neon Island! In this sleepless city, you inherit your father’s legendary host club after his accident. Manage debts, recruit new hosts, and survive rent hikes and rival clubs. Will you build a nightlife empire—or fall in love and lose it all?

details.title: Auto Ball Arena
details.short_description: Strategy meets physics autobattler. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

details.title: Infini Orbis
details.short_description: A sci-fi automation game with deep RPG progression and RTS fleet combat. Command humanity's last ark, Mothership, on a desperate mission back in time to build a fleet powerful enough to change the destiny of the galaxy. Automate local and interstellar supply networks to purge cosmic threats.

details.title: Long Trip
details.short_description: Long Trip is a dark fantasy VR action RPG where you explore the shattered lands aboard the skyship The Dust, battle bosses, ride legendary mounts, summon allies, and uncover ancient secrets across a world scarred by war.

details.title: Zero Hero
details.short_description: Zero Hero is a fast, endless roguelike shooter. Jump through a broken timeline, stack wild weapon upgrades, and survive waves of monsters and bosses. Bank your loot or risk it all. A free demo is available now — wishlist the full game on Steam!

details.title: Apawcalypse: Corrupted Brain
details.short_description: Lead a team of three animal survivors in a roguelike deckbuilder where every character has their own deck. Coordinate a shared Action Point pool, Intercept attacks to protect allies, and build powerful team synergies to survive the corruption.

details.title: Woks & Works
details.short_description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

details.title: BlackHole Collapse
details.short_description: You are a stationary black hole, growing more powerful with every run. Devour crystals, fend off relentless swarms and volatile anomalies, and unleash devastating gravitational blasts to survive the void in this fast-paced action roguelite.

details.title: Hollow Orbits 4x
details.short_description: Hollow Orbits is a turn-based space 4X with the tension of a board game. Roll a die for every weapon, then choose which enemy ship takes each hit. Expand, trade, negotiate or conquer your way across a galaxy of ancient ruins and rival powers. Play solo, against AI or online with friends.

details.title: Bottopia
details.short_description: A cozy idle collecting and decorating game that lives on your desktop. Make progress while using your computer, fish up new decorations, and turn your bottle into a tiny world that's uniquely yours.

details.title: Archive of Fate
details.short_description: A single-player card RPG blending Tarot mysticism, roguelike deckbuilding, and lasting progression. Use a wide variety of cards alongside all 56 Minor Arcana, brew potions, explore randomized regions, and unleash rule-breaking Sequence skills to reshape battles, events, and fate itself.

details.title: ZUNKS
details.short_description: ZUNKS is a top-down action game where you wipe out swarms of monsters and battle against powerful bosses in a ruined world. Save the world with ZUNKS, with all your might and a cheerful spirit!

details.title: Nookmaker
details.short_description: You're the new interior designer in a small town. Read your clients' letters, decorate their rooms and discover hidden furniture combos along the way. Then spend what you earn on your own little home, where nobody asks for anything.

details.title: Wreck & Profit
details.short_description: Swing a wrecking ball, knock down buildings, and get paid for every brick. Buy machines that do the swinging for you, sell the company, and take on a bigger city. A short incremental game with real physics & some automation with an actual ending.

details.title: Circusar
details.short_description: Circusar is an action roguelite where you play a clown battling waves of enemies while balancing on a unicycle. Two core tensions drive the game: physical balance and crowd rating. Build item synergies, entertain the crowd, and don't fall!

details.title: Quackyard
details.short_description: A cozy incremental farming sim about helping your duck friend clean out their backyard. Dig, mine and farm your way to clearing up the space so that a tea party with friends can be hosted.

details.title: Wyrm Warrior
details.short_description: WYRM WARRIOR is a brand new JRPG in retro style. Step into the shoes of a hero fighting for justice in an unfamiliar land! Brave a world full of monsters, bosses, dungeons, NPCs, and loot! Grow stronger through fighting and exploration! Can you defeat THE WYRMLORD?

details.title: Fox Idle
details.short_description: Go on an adventure with cute fox-eared companions! Gather resources, craft gear, fight monsters, complete quests, and most importantly, make progress together with foxgirls in this incremental idle RPG.

details.title: Wands & Whiskers
details.short_description: Rescue cats, discover rare coats, and grow a cozy network of shelters in this idle cat collector. Wave a wand for a roomful of playful chaos, decorate their favorite spots, or relax while the donations roll in, even while you're away.

details.title: Tabletop Tycoon
details.short_description: In Tabletop Tycoon you start your own board game company from a single desk and grow it into the biggest name in the industry. Design games that sell, design your own box and make every piece fit inside. Research new genres and mechanics. Build and decorate your office as you outgrow your rivals.

details.title: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
details.short_description: Fast-paced 1v1 street soccer arcade game! Control unique heroes, use spectacular combat-style moves, and defeat opponents in real-time. Upgrade your characters' skills, conquer global leagues, and become a superstar in thrilling online PvP football matches

details.title: Skuffle
details.short_description: 4-player splitscreen online party shooter. Couch and online players in the same match. Maps, Modes, Skins, Monkeys, Guns, Cigarettes! Oh My! WHAT ELSE DO YOU PEOPLE WANT?

details.title: Christmas CEO
details.short_description: Run Santa's Workshop in this cozy management sim. Assign workers, manage resources, survive crisis events, and make enough toys before Christmas.

details.title: Wretched Tales:Cinderella
details.short_description: A familiar Cinderella fairy tale is twisted into a grotesque puzzle adventure. Observe static 2D scenes, interpret the hidden reactions of objects, and complete the cruel procedure that leads to the ball.

details.title: RAPIDS
details.short_description: Dare to Deliver in RAPIDS, a frantic co-op roguelike. Either solo or as a group of friends, navigate a hazardous river while delivering packages. Master magic, charm cute critters, and upgrade your boat, one fast-paced run at a time

details.title: Forgotten Towns
details.short_description: Build a flourishing settlement above a dangerous cave system. Explore unique biomes, manage happiness and grief, invite traders, defend against invasions, train soldiers, recruit heroes, defeat world bosses, and prepare to dig into the depths below.

details.title: Luminons: Seeds of Starlight
details.short_description: Farming sim meets monster taming. Grow crops to feed and strengthen your Luminons. Compete in beauty contests or strategic 3v3 battles.

details.title: Barns & Beams
details.short_description: You are a city kid who can no longer afford housing, but luckily, your grandfather has left you his disastrous farm in the middle of nowhere as an inheritance. You will have to learn to manage farm life and, along the way, deal with "Them."

details.title: Duskfire
details.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where tactical positioning matters as much as the cards you play. Collect new spells, recruit and modify powerful creatures, upgrade your spells, and build a unique deck every run. Master strategic battles and grow stronger through a roguelite progression system.

name: My AI read my diary - Dating Sim

details.title: My AI read my diary - Dating Sim
details.short_description: It started as a simple tease. Yet, your devoted AI companion has crossed the line and pried into your secret diary. Your choices will dictate the final outcome of your relationship in this AI yandere romance.

details.title: Cursed to Type
details.short_description: Every word you type keeps the office's corrupted objects contained. Build a keyboard that fights back in this spooky typing roguelike deck-builder.

details.title: How to Use
details.short_description: No instructions. No hints. Just you, mysterious controls, and over 15,000 possible combinations. Experiment your way through this unique puzzle experience.

details.title: Toxic Dating Simulator
details.short_description: Atakan'ın Binder'da eşleştiği, yaşam tarzları birbirinden farklı olan 3 kadınla randevulardan sağ çıkmaya çalış. Yapacağın seçimlerle Atakan'ın karakterini şekillendir. Kılıbık ol, alfa ol, yalancı ol, dürüst ol, manipülatif ol. Seçimini yap ve sonucuna katlan.

details.title: Toypact
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of Toypact. Step into a miniature world, collect unique toys and grow together! Think through strategy, mix and match equipment, and build your own ever-changing combat style. Every choice may spark new surprises—and the strongest doll will be cultivated by your own hands!

details.title: Bestseller Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a publishing house, one book at a time. Discover authors, shape manuscripts and decide which stories deserve a place on your list. Balance literary ambition with the cost of keeping the business alive in this publishing management sim.

details.title: KAGERO
details.short_description: Fight solo or in up to 4-player co-op to destroy the houses that tried to erase you. Harvest the souls of the fallen, grow stronger with every battle, and fuel the ritual to awaken an ancient spirit.

details.title: Tabernacle
details.short_description: Tabernacle is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game. Once holy places have been forsaken and corrupted by sin. Do your duties as inquisitors of the church; collect evidence of evil, reclaim sacred sites, and banish the unholy that seek to extinguish faith. Stand between the innocent and the damned.

details.title: Lost in the Fest
details.short_description: The rhythm RPG where swords are guitars and potions are beers.

details.title: Siegelock
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about laying siege to a trespassing kingdom.

details.title: Maze Builder TD
details.short_description: A strategic tower defense where your towers are the maze. Funnel enemies through fire, ice and lightning, spend your gold on stronger defenses or risk investing for bigger payouts, and unlock permanent upgrades to push further into endless waves.

details.title: SlimeRunner Reborn
