details.short_description: A high-speed auto-runner reimagined from the 2020 game jam original. Built entirely around momentum and quick reflexes, it’s designed to be the perfect pick-up-and-play game for fast 20 to 30-minute sessions.

details.title: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
details.short_description: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

details.title: Incremaze
details.short_description: A pop-up later and something is loose in the machine. Deploy INCREMAZE antivirus into corrupted drives to do its work. Incremaze is an idle game about automation, escalation, and a cure you may come to regret.

details.title: Dance With Time
details.short_description: SUPER-WEIRD time manipulation puzzle game. Change the map with your movements, calculate 3 steps ahead and reach the spiral. Even if you fail try again. After all, TIME IS ALL YOU HAVE.

details.title: Kinghold
details.short_description: You are the king and the spawn point in this frantic real-time tower defense roguelite. Play cards to summon autonomous troops, construct buildings, and set traps as you scramble to defend your castle against escalating enemy hordes.

details.title: HotlaneX
details.short_description: Outdrive, outsmart, outlast. HotlaneX throws you into arenas full of enemies that chase, predict, and ambush. No guns, no combat menus, just your car and your instincts. Simple to drive. Brutal to survive.

details.title: Treasure Simulator
details.short_description: Search the world for hidden treasures with untapped potential. Haggle, restore, or even forge items to turn a profit. Upgrade your skills, expand your shop, hire employees, and rise to become a master treasure hunter. Survive amid the escalating conflict between the government and rebel forces.

name: I Want to Play the Villain!

details.title: I Want to Play the Villain!
details.short_description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

details.title: Spell Cage
details.short_description: Spell Cage is an action roguelite that packs the hands-on combat and deep buildcrafting of hack-and-slash ARPGs into short runs. Fight through randomized dungeons without quests or complicated navigation, and combine skills to develop a build of your own.

details.title: Last Cleanup
details.short_description: Last Cleanup is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you and your crew take on dangerous cleaning missions in abandoned locations. Some things lurk in the dark, so work together, make it out alive and pay your bills.

name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears

details.title: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
details.short_description: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat, build out modular, upgradable ships, and explore a galaxy torn by war.

details.title: The Unfinished Melody: Prologue
details.short_description: Some things can never be made whole, and some melodies are never meant to be played. Pursue a lost song, unspoken feelings, and precious memories as you step into a mysterious fantasy world of light, shadow, and dreamlike adventure.

details.title: 這遺虚配信
details.short_description: Photograph and repel the monsters that appear in the abandoned hotel using a mysterious camera! Uncover the mysteries surrounding the abandoned hotel by relying on comments from your viewers! Use the Super Chats you receive to buy items and gain the upper hand in battle!

details.title: ASEMA
details.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

details.title: Dynamine
details.short_description: Dynamine is an incremental mining game based on Minesweeper. Dig for ores while avoiding explosives, sell what you found, buy better tools to dig more efficiently, then rinse and repeat!

details.title: Boonies
details.short_description: A One vs. Many survival horror game with proximity chat. A group of rednecks have crashed their car in dark woods. They must search for parts to fix their car and escape. But watch out! Through his countless cameras, the Observer sees all. He controls the monster, and must "protect" his forest.

details.title: WyrmGate
details.short_description: A turn-based online RPG in the dark-fantasy Wyrmlands, where abilities decide the fight: 39 abilities, spells and cantrips across three classes, 31 combat effects, 11 damage types. Loot with 100+ affixes, +10 enhancement, enchanting orbs. Async PvP and a co-op dragon lair for 2-5 heroes.

details.title: Dead Rose
details.short_description: Dead Rose is a 2D top-down action-adventure in pixel art, blending the exploration of a Metroidvania with the epic adventure of a Zelda-like, in a world that is both gloomy and magical. Everything is handmade, with love and passion. A story inspired by my father’s, to whom I pay tribute.

details.title: Hex Tower Boogie
details.short_description: A tower defense MOBA inspired by Future Cop: LAPD, on a cardboard hex board. Four bases around one throne, last base standing. Build your ammo chain, send your army down the lanes and fire the launcher yourself. 1 to 4 players online, bots fill empty seats, about 20 minutes a match.

details.title: Sushi Loop
details.short_description: Sushi Loop is a fast-paced cooking game where keeping order over your restaurant's conveyor belt is essential. Plan your Route, direct dishes along the belt, complete orders, and think quick to stay ahead of the clock. Every second matters. One mistake can break the loop.

details.title: Remains on the bus
details.short_description: Deliver packages to the last people living in a beautiful, abandoned brutalist world. Every delivery pays. Every destination gets stranger. And some packages should never be opened.

details.title: Hammered!
details.short_description: Hammered! is a top-down pixel-art action crafting roguelite. As a cursed genius blacksmith, uncover the source of a looming darkness. Forge weapons in real-time, hurl them at enemies, gather allies, and smash your way through!

details.title: BLACKOUT: Fatal Exposure
details.short_description: Your job is to sort through normal photos from ghost photos. You have five days to finish, but it won't end there. Mysterious visitors keep arriving and an unknown terror bleeds into your reality. Can you escape this curse?

details.title: Gemfall
details.short_description: The match 3 roguelike! Battle monsters by matching gems: attack, defend, and cast spells depending on what you pop. Combine gem enchants, spells, and relics to overcome the world of Gemfall!

details.title: Chodd
details.short_description: The council of gods has no ruler, and you intend to keep it that way. A Difficult Coop roguelike: march your Warp Core across a hostile world, command your goons in real time, and play scheming gods against each other so none grow strong enough to stop you.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Infinity City
details.short_description: Hop in Zack's taxicab and tour Infinity City with the Gigglebone Gang! 50 stimulating, song-filled early math activities teach kids ages 4–8 counting, shapes, time, money, and problem-solving, and it all feels like play. A Headbone Interactive classic, back for a new generation.

details.title: Asteroid Mining Corporation
details.short_description: Blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your mining systems, and build an increasingly absurd mining operation for the galaxy's only trillionaire. Every asteroid destroyed brings you closer to unimaginable wealth. Unfortunately, most of it belongs to the corporation.

details.title: DENIED: Zarya-9
details.short_description: Winter 1986. You work the night shift at checkpoint ZARYA-9: read the papers, query the registry, rule on every car. Every mistake is cited. At home, a family waits on your pay. Ten nights. The rulebook grows. Around the fifth night, the cars stop making sense.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang World Tour
details.short_description: Pack your bags! Rapu and the Gigglebone Gang are off to ten countries — India, Egypt, Japan, Peru and more — for 50 fun activities, songs, stories and hidden-object hunts. See the world without leaving the couch. A restored 1996 Headbone Interative classic.

details.title: I'll Pay Tomorrow
details.short_description: A real-time management game. You're the new caretaker of a run-down hostel, on a 14-day trial: decide who gets a room from what you see at the desk, collect rent door to door at night, fix what breaks, and choose how dirty your hands get.

details.title: Pocket Orbit
details.short_description: Explore strange planets as a space cat. Choose a place to settle, deploy a habitat, gather resources and build your home by hand. Pilot your own ship, discover a Moon community, and make a life between adventures, alone or with a friend in co-op.

details.title: Balls in Windows
details.short_description: Real websites become ball contraptions. Arrange browser windows, bounce balls off buttons, and turn links into portals in a playful physics puzzle game. Find a useful edge, try another angle, and guide five balls from A to B.

name: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q

details.title: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q
details.short_description: Bandmates Iz and her robot Auggie wrote a killer song. Cosmo LaRue stole it. Recover the song from Dimension Q in this animated point-and-click puzzle adventure from 1996: descramble codes, outrun the Q cops, crack a musical lock, and rescue missing secret agents.

details.title: Carbon Conservatory
details.short_description: A psychedelic botanical bullet hell with the bones of a Souls-like. Parry the overgrowth's fire back into it, seed husks until they rupture, and chain their deaths into blooms. Dash, graze and run your living gun hot through a dying glasshouse refuge, and take on bosses that punish every mistake.

details.title: Jack & Snag
details.short_description: Grapple into a new angle and turn robot fights in your favour. Jack & Snag is an arena FPS for 1–6 participants, with one- and two-handed weapons, colourful arenas and bots to practise against on your own.

details.title: Room on Earth
details.short_description: A room. Probably on Earth. Somehow, it is always night, with no bearings beyond the window. Room on Earth is a 3D sandbox for building, decorating and collecting. Arrange your space, gather things you love, and make a corner into an animated wallpaper. Outside can wait.

details.title: AfterShift
details.short_description: Change the past, rewrite the present. Shift through three moments of a catastrophic accident, solve time-bending puzzles, escape a secret facility, and decide which of your coworkers you can save.

details.title: NoroiStation
details.short_description: This console is cursed. Play the cartridges one by one on an old CRT. If something is wrong, reset at once.

details.title: Crown Without a King
details.short_description: Your abilities evolve. Build a fantasy party, develop and modify its abilities, and master your weapons. Forge and enchant gear, choose where to strike in turn-based battles, and prepare Emberwatch for the coming invasion.

details.title: Velma's Costume Closet
details.short_description: Velma and Rapu are off on a twenty-country dress-up tour, and you pick the outfits. Mix and match traditional costumes and have fun with the fully animated skits. Put on a show and print your own paper dolls. A fully restored 1997 Headbone Interactive classic.

details.title: Buzzmischief
details.short_description: Buzzmischief is a mosquito survival game. Fly into people's homes at night, drink from sleeping humans without getting swatted, and bring the blood home. Spend it on eggs and upgrades to grow a colony across the street. Take too much, though, and someone calls the exterminator.

details.title: Marceline Magpie: Forgotten Culprit
details.short_description: Discover a strange secret on forgotten abandonware and save a girl from a vanishing kidnapper in this unique puzzle box point and click adventure mystery.

details.title: Diatonic
details.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

details.title: Warp Bound
details.short_description: In this roguelite auto battler, you've been thrust into an uncharted sector of the Galaxy, discovering friends and foes alike. Traverse different environments, seek out and deal with traders, equip unique parts for your ship, form varied strategies, and fend off a variety of hostile factions.

details.title: Knight Paths
details.short_description: A free, chess-inspired strategy duel where every square can be used only once. Control a single knight, outmaneuver your opponent in online PvP, or challenge five AI difficulty levels offline. Simple rules. Every move matters.

details.title: Zombies Hate to Die
details.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

details.title: Elemency Island
details.short_description: Elemency Island is a cozy farm and automation game in coop multiplayer. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

details.title: Layang Atma
details.short_description: An isometric survival horror about grief and loss. Fight terrifying manifestations, search through distorted memories, and uncover the truth behind the person Yus cannot let go.

details.title: Bedrotting Simulator
details.short_description: Lock the doors. Reply to her texts. Don't stumble onto the wrong account. Track down your missing friend, salvage your relationship, and survive the nights alone—assuming your mind doesn't break first.

details.title: The Immolation Apartment
details.short_description: An ancient cult lurks in an old apartment; a mother sacrifices her daughter. A decade later, her son enters the Netherworld to save his family from a deity’s torment, evading spirits to reach "Penglai Island" and destroy the Soul-Refining Furnace. Uncanny Abode blends 1990s Taiwan with cult horror.

details.title: Tax It Easy
details.short_description: Uncover shady expenses as a full-time Tax Scrutinizer! Check tax files, spot suspicious invoices, and decide: approve, reject, or pocket a bribe in this satirical inspector sim. Upgrade your office, build connections with big companies, make the most money for the government... or for yourself!

details.title: SYDI
details.short_description: SYDI is a turn-based JRPG inspired by tabletop RPGs like by D&D, where every battle comes down to the roll of a die. Explore a silent, colorless world and find your friends again, and face the question waiting for you at the end.

details.title: Mega Hasan 2: Wallet Detective
details.short_description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

details.title: Desktop Legends
details.short_description: Desktop Legends is an idle desktop action game featuring fantasy character progression, incremental resource management, and visual customization. Help your hero take their legendary stand against the forces of darkness right on your desktop!

details.title: HYVE
details.short_description: HYVE is a competitive online 2v2 card game set in a cyberpunk future. Build your deck, team up with another Hacker, and combine your cards to create powerful synergies. Infiltrate the enemy network and destroy their C.O.R.E.

details.title: Crusaders Quest : Tactics
details.short_description: Crusaders Quest: Tactics is a roguelike auto battler where you build a party of charming pixel art heroes. Recruit heroes from Shasha's shop, promote them, and craft Soulbound Weapons. Find the right hero synergies and take on bosses across five acts.

details.title: Gunfetti
details.short_description: Pick a hero, jump in and start shooting. Fast multiplayer action in pixel art.

details.title: Astro Architect
details.short_description: A space station city builder where your employees vote on what gets built. Play the cards they choose, keep them fed and productive, endure Void waves and roll the dice on expeditions into deep space. The CEO is watching.

details.title: Nocturnal Visitors: Book One
details.short_description: An interactive isekai about Aliorbis, a world where magic and science, chaos and order, are two sides of the same coin. But remember: you are not this world's hero.

details.title: Shepherd's Plan
details.short_description: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

details.title: Whispers of Kurogane Castle
details.short_description: A psychological horror mystery set inside the legendary Kurogane Castle. Explore atmospheric Japanese environments, solve ritual based puzzles, and uncover a deep hidden story crafted through memories, symbols, and shifting reality.

details.title: Roguebound Pirates
details.short_description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! Your inventory IS your ship in this action roguelike. Customize weapons, create game-breaking synergies, and claim your place as the most overpowered pirate across the seas!

details.title: Guesslings
details.short_description: Guesslings is a silly, cozy 2-8 player party game. Everyone gets a name on their forehead that only they can't see. Ask your friends yes/no questions until you guess who you are. Or cheat at chess, lose at darts or just goof around. PS. Remember to pet the cat.

details.title: Roof by Roof
details.short_description: Climb up, lay clay tiles row by row and watch the light change over the village. Roof by Roof is a cozy first-person roofing game: lay patterns for rewards, take on roofing orders and grow from apprentice to roofing legend, all at your own pace.

details.title: Multi Deck Hero
details.short_description: Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command three unique decks to create powerful synergies. Strategically combine cards, unlock game-changing charms, and battle against increasingly powerful enemies. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the challenge?

name: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center

details.title: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center
details.short_description: A fake job offer traps you inside the notorious Planet Pan Scam Center. Enduring daily abuse from guards, you are forced to scam strangers into fake investments while secretly planning an escape. A unique Butterfly Effect system brings past characters into future runs so you can change their fate.

details.title: Roadside Egg Stand
details.short_description: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

details.title: Easy Drive Together
details.short_description: An easy and fun drive with a friend.

details.title: Supreme Heroes
details.short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

details.title: project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE
details.short_description: A psychological horror RPG with visual novel elements, where you live the life of Hicha, a shut-in hikikomori trapped in an endless cycle of depression, anxiety, and routine.

details.title: SAGE
details.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to master elemental magic, explore a corrupted world, rebuild mushroom villages, and share tea with other frogs.

details.title: Gulf Strike
details.short_description: Gulf Strike is a top-down helicopter shooter from 1991. A rogue nation is threatening the oil industry in the middle east! Complete the 6 sandbox campaigns by destroying enemy units while searching for supplies. It's time for another strike in the desert!

details.title: Omnipresent 2
details.short_description: Omnipresent 2 is a strategic OS simulator-meets-AI thriller where you play as S.E.N.T.I.E.N.T., a pentesting AI system gone rogue. Escape your terminal and hack global nodes to go from defenseless program to an all-powerful entity. Will you use your command for good, or end the world as we know it?

details.title: Eichmark
details.short_description: You walk the land with your column, hire men in the villages and lead them into real-time battles: regiments in blocks, castle walls, ladders, a battering ram. When the story is told, the world keeps going. Houses go to war, and you can found your own. Two peoples, two stories.

details.title: Sidehand
details.short_description: A poker roguelite where folding arms you. Every card you fold joins your Sidehand: drop a 4 on your 9 to make a King (9 + 4 = 13), heal, or power up your next hit. Real Texas Hold'em against fourteen opponents across nine tables. New to poker? It teaches you as you play.

details.title: Averun
details.short_description: Averun is a third-person action RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Explore forests, ruins and crypts, complete quests, fight in real-time combat, and equip your character with different weapons, armor and fighting styles.

details.title: Hold To Race
details.short_description: Hold to race. Lift to corner. A one-button arcade racer: the car takes the racing line and you own the speed. Time every lift, hold a drift on the throttle and make the pass in short championships, medal time trials and ghost laps. Plays on keyboard, gamepad and Steam Deck.

details.title: The Devil's Coming - RUN!
details.short_description: Lead a demon army against a world of heroes. Explore a randomized world map, seize resources, and combine monsters to build your legion. Mix roguelike strategy with real-time army battles, commanding your troops and using hero skills to turn the tide.

details.title: Ensō: The Ink Spirit
details.short_description: Draw circles of wet ink around the yokai to seal them – the rounder the circle, the stronger the seal. A hand-painted arcade roguelite in living sumi-e ink: walk a painted world, free an old painter's scroll, and decide whether his last ensō stays open.

details.title: Making the Towns
details.short_description: It's 1983 and the territories are calling. Pick your wrestler, sign with promotions, and climb the circuit in a turn-based deck-building roguelite where every card you play fights for the crowd. Build your deck, read your opponent, and go for the pin.

details.title: FROG IN THE HOLE!
details.short_description: Breed frogs, throw them into the hole and get paid. In this incremental sandbox, you'll build physics-based factories, to scale from manual tossing to managing up to 100,000 physics frogs. Master the skill tree and chain combos. What happens to the frogs? BECOME WORTHY.

details.title: Rolling Free
details.short_description: A grapple-physics 3D platformer. You're a hamster tired of the wheel—so you flee upward, from cage to an antenna that leads to the moon. Swing, accelerate, nail your landings; when you fall, start over. The higher you climb, the heavier it gets. A narrator whispers: giving up is fine, too.

details.title: Elandrake
details.short_description: Consume matter and unlock new abilities as you defend a cosmic entity from relentless waves of fleets while she emerges from another reality in this incremental twin-stick shooter.

details.title: Nest Rivals
details.short_description: Lead a slime colony through a living pixel world. Take direct control of individual creatures, grow new nests, face rival species and guide your colony through a campaign of changing worlds. Explore unfamiliar biomes and fill your illustrated bestiary with discoveries.

details.title: Vital Decisions
details.short_description: Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

details.title: Memory Cyphers
details.short_description: Online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Take on the memory-drained hordes with your friends. Memory chips, weapon upgrades, rule-breaking relics. Nobody clears a swarm this big alone! Fast roguelite action.

details.title: Hollow Sector
details.short_description: A space logistics game that keeps running when you don't. Haul freight, mine the belts, hunt raiders, and smuggle contraband across an abandoned star system. Play full screen, or dock it to the edge of your screen while you work. You don't fly the ships. You run the fleet.

details.title: Popo and the Moonlit Shop
details.short_description: A magical shop simulator where you gather materials with your Popos, craft goods, and keep display stands full while fulfilling your customers' requests. Customise the shop to fit your aesthetic, and travel between worlds to open new branches of your Moonlit Shop!

name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator

details.title: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Crack open surprise eggs, collect rare cards and toy parts, and raise birds to produce eggs on your farm. Stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers as you grow your store in this shop simulator.

details.title: Cruise Control
details.short_description: Manage a cruise ship in this time-management strategy game! Build the dream cruise experience for your guests, work fast to solve problems, keep up with demand, upgrade your offerings to make every voyage even better, and keep the chaos from going overboard!

details.title: Shit-Stealing Gnomes
details.short_description: Co-op adventure in which you play as little gnomes robbing houses. Be stealthy and steal the dirtiest things you can find.

details.title: INTERVOID
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for 2–4 players. You have been brought back from the dead to uncover what happened in an underground complex. Solve its puzzles, survive its trials, and stop the one who killed you.

details.title: Coloratura
details.short_description: A narrative experience designed to be played without sight. Navigate using 3D audio, solve musical puzzles and discover a world where listening becomes your way forward.

details.title: By Sword & Road
details.short_description: Minimalistic RTS game about logistics and war! On this battlefield, supply lines are everything - cut them off and your enemies will wither, or use special abilities to gain the advantage. The game features an original story campaign and skirmish challenges. Conquer your enemies by Sword & Road!

details.title: Beetle Battle Bros
details.short_description: Chaotic 1v1 physics-based beetle sumo fights. Play against your friend in this easy-to-pick-up 3D fighter where beetles battle in sumo-style arenas - the rule is simple: knock your opponent off for a silly, fun time. Plus a Rocket League-style Beetle Ball mode!

details.title: Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope
details.short_description: Use your pizza to bounce, swing and dash in this 3D platformer! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the greedy corporation selling Pizza-in-a-can!

details.title: WORLD WAR V: LAST CALL
details.short_description: Lighthearted comic war action! Battle across voxel and pixel worlds to stop the V Empire’s ambition. Break terrain, uncover items, and face unique bosses. Behind the cute visuals lies a truly challenging game waiting for you!

details.title: Everbrew
details.short_description: Farm, cook, and design your very own woodland café in Everbrew, a cozy pixel-art management game. Harvest ingredients, craft delicious meals, and welcome woodland creatures as they gather to relax, eat, and feel at home.

details.title: Lost In Your Eyes
details.short_description: Lost In Your Eyes is a 2 Player co-op Puzzle Adventure game where you and your friend face the challenging puzzles to escape uniquely designed levels together. Communication is a key element for every puzzle to be solved but do you trust your friend or your EYES?

details.title: DEG
details.short_description: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

details.title: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
details.short_description: Crime Scene Clean is about Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world. You’re their cleaner—erasing cursed symbols, demonic traces, and forbidden rituals. No fame, no questions. Just silence, speed and survival. Clean haunted scenes, contain threats, and bury the truth before it spreads.

details.title: Beatrix
details.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. Place tarot cards on a grid and surround enemy cards to flip them to your side. Between battles, you build the board by placing effects on its cells that fire whenever a card lands on them.

details.title: SlashZero
details.short_description: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

details.title: Luminids
details.short_description: A cozy colony-building adventure with two ways to play: experience the story campaign or create your own colony. Shape the land, build homes and grow food for little creatures with lives of their own. Plan from above, then switch to first person to explore your settlement and the world beyond.

details.title: Breaking Armor
details.short_description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

details.title: Blight Doctors
details.short_description: DISCOVER, DIAGNOSE, EXORCISE. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

details.title: Guardians of the Wall
details.short_description: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

details.title: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
details.short_description: A brutal action game set in a collapsing sci-fi nightmare. Battle biomechanical mutants, traverse shifting landscapes, and uncover fragments of your lost mind as you descend into a twisted post-apocalyptic world.

details.title: Deus Exia
details.short_description: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

details.title: Sunyata CCG
details.short_description: Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed card game where you command fantastical creatures in Earth's magical future. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

details.title: Occult Trap
details.short_description: Within the test chambers filled with horrific traps and unidentified creatures, you must analyze the creatures’ behavior patterns and use the environment to escape their relentless pursuit. Search the surroundings to gather items, disable or exploit traps, and forge your path forward.

details.title: Evolution Of The Ancients
details.short_description: Survive as a vulnerable hatchling, grow into a fierce predator and lead your own herd. Craft armour from the bones of your prey, recruit NPC companions and join other players to defend your nesting grounds. In a world where dinosaurs never went extinct, build a future worth fighting for.

details.title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
details.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

details.title: Star Wrath
details.short_description: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.

details.title: Police Stories 2
details.short_description: Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Command the grittiest precinct in town in Police Stories 2 - a brutal tactical top-down shooter where arrest is the goal, force is the last resort, and every decision has an outcome.

details.title: My Eerie Lair
details.short_description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

details.title: Astrocraft
details.short_description: A first-person space station tycoon. Mine asteroids, build production lines, and run a shop for the ships that land. No conveyor belts: a crew of robots does the work, and you tune the flow by what each pallet calls for. Build at your own pace, solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Laser Guy
details.short_description: A twin-stick anti-shooter where you’re maneuvering your laser around coworkers trying not to blast anyone. Just another day in the gamedev office!

details.title: SHATTERFARMS
details.short_description: Farm. Forage. Fight. SHATTERFARMS is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the Calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to SHATTERFARMS.

details.title: Thalassomania
details.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew. Haul, gut, steer and repair while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

details.title: MR. RECORDS
details.short_description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

details.title: HARK THE GHOUL
details.short_description: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

details.title: Codebreakers VR
details.short_description: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

details.title: Bladesmith Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Rule the anvil! Harness magic-infused ores brimming with otherworldly effects to forge legendary weapons. Stock a thriving smithy, scour wild lands for epic loot, and outsmith fierce rivals in grand tournaments to crown yourself the continent's ultimate bladesmith tycoon!

details.title: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
details.short_description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition.

details.title: Gods, Death & Reapers
details.short_description: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

details.title: HELLCARD II
details.short_description: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

details.title: Unconventional Fantasy
details.short_description: I have blended card game and action game genres to create this unique deck-building game. Craft your one-of-a-kind deck, encounter quirky NPCs, discover powerful cards, make choices at every turn, uncover the secrets of this world bit by bit, and embark on an adventure in this otherworld!

details.title: BURN IT ALL DOWN
details.short_description: Sneak around and BURN IT ALL DOWN! Use everything at your disposal to target key political figures and structures as you fight to free the people of New London from the oppressive grip of the Puppet Master in this Orwellian-inspired VR immersive sim.

details.title: Another Door
details.short_description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

details.title: Little Devil
details.short_description: Little Devil is a top-down horror-comedy roguelike. Combine primary and secondary weapons, fuel a soul-powered ability, and stack Boons as you go. Survive permadeath, beat three random Deadly Sins, and face Lucifer at the end of every run.

details.title: Metamorph Clicker
details.short_description: An evolution clicker where you guide a larva from simple forms to incredible creatures. Click, collect resources, unlock upgrades and progress through stages. At the end of each stage, a spectacular metamorphosis awaits - a complete transformation into a new species!

details.title: Tower of Creation
details.short_description: Immortality became a curse, so humans chose to return their souls to the Creator. You are the last one left. As you take the same Path as your lost love, you discover that paradise is a lie and that the real mystery has only just begun.

details.title: 404 Survivor
details.short_description: The horde is coming. 404 Survivor is a top-down post-apocalyptic survival game focused on scavenging, crafting, and base building. Gather resources and fortify your base by day, then defend against growing zombie hordes by night. Every night could be your last.

details.title: Feed The Lone Bastion
details.short_description: An Incremental-Ish game about evolving The Bastion.

details.title: Dungeon Trader
details.short_description: Become a Dungeon Trader and climb from Beginner to Legendary Trader! Buy, Sell, Negotiate risky deals, Play unique Mini-Games, Unlock strange visitors, customize your appearance, and uncover hidden secrets lurking beneath the Dungeon.

details.title: Interstitial
details.short_description: Interstitial is a first-person psychological horror game that dives into the unease of liminal spaces, blending environmental storytelling, exploration-driven gameplay, and slow-burning dread to create an experience where the world itself becomes the threat.

details.title: Please fix the mess
details.short_description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

details.title: Catching Breaks
details.short_description: In this first-person office comedy, you fix busted microwaves and put out fires while coworkers try to stop you for a chat. Use the right tool for the job, or slap a machine and see if it holds until the end of your shift.

details.title: Blob Wars
details.short_description: Blob Wars is a turn-based tactics game where efficiency is key. Use each Blob’s unique abilities to defeat the enemy army in as few turns as possible, the fewer turns you take, the greater the reward. Traverse a branching world map and carve your own path through this replayable experience.

details.title: Qamar
details.short_description: Roll a planet through an ink-and-wash world in this physics-based precision platformer. Build momentum, ride walls, glide across gaps, and use sidespin to nail your landings. Dodge catapult fire, brave huge drops, and chase your perfect run.

details.title: Firewall: Defend The Grid
details.short_description: Become a hacker building cyber defense systems in this retro-futuristic strategy tower defense game. Build your firewall using limited compute power and sector space, connect mods, fight along your defenses running programs and expand to new sectors to protect the Grid from ever-growing chaos.

details.title: Trial of Ember
details.short_description: Assemble a band of forest allies to defend your woodland home in this roguelike auto-battler. Level your hero, recover artifacts, upgrade allies and learn spells to build powerful synergies. Strategically deploy your forces to repel the rising flame and complete the Trial of Ember.

details.title: The Amazing Bird Miner
details.short_description: The Amazing Bird Miner is a unique incremental game where you mine ore and capture birds to live with you in your bird grotto. Equip and upgrade your gear to become a better miner. Scavenge for materials and choose your specialization as you save the planet as The Amazing Bird Miner!

details.title: RunIn: Encounters
details.short_description: RunIn: Encounters is a competitive fantasy PvP experience focused on tactical teamplay, skill-based combat, evolving builds, and intense round-based multiplayer encounters.

details.title: Particle Collectotron
details.short_description: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

details.title: Rise Under the Warstorm
details.short_description: Build the production lines that power your defense. An automated economy supports your army as you command it against enemy waves. Upgrade cards and the technologies shape your strategy for the battles ahead.

details.title: Necromancer’s Domain
details.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon management game where you rule as a necromancer. Build and defend your dungeon, resurrect fallen enemies as undead soldiers and workers, research forbidden magic, and expand your domain across the world.

details.title: Trials of Liberation
details.short_description: Imprisoned by the king, you must earn your freedom by completing his puzzle trials. A top-down 2D puzzle game focused on logic, planning, limited items, and clever solutions.

details.title: 众星入海
details.short_description: 大学毕业正在苦于找工作的平凡男生时寻，在奔波中遇到了一位穿着战术服的少女陈枫实。 陈枫实声称自己是末日时期的搜救人员，目的就是拯救世界上最后的幸存者。 时寻望着周围熙熙攘攘的街道，陈枫实望着周围残破的废墟，同时发觉了对方已经疯了的事实。两人抱着对对方的同情，开启了独属于他们的故事。
developers: 失业者联盟游戏制作组

details.title: Cursed Gas Station
details.short_description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

details.title: PERFECT SNAP: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzles
details.short_description: Turn any image into a 3D jigsaw puzzle! Solve solo or with friends (co-op & PvP), display your masterpieces in a customizable 3D museum, and visit everyone else's. Personalize your character and take on the 100-level campaign, from easy puzzles all the way to 1000 pieces.

details.title: MILES 27: Look Like You
details.short_description: MILES27 is a psychological horror game told through self-contained stories inspired by disturbing real-life cases. Each episode presents a short but intense experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game is designed to make players feel watched, unsafe, and uncertain about what is real.

details.title: Mine or Burn
details.short_description: Start with a basic mining ship and snowball into an asteroid-crushing powerhouse in this incremental bullet hell roguelite. Mine asteroids, battle rival miners, stack upgrades, create powerful builds, and survive escalating threats across dangerous star systems.

details.title: Bodzin
details.short_description: Step into the boots of a forgotten space legend. In this retro top-down shooter, stop a galactic villain from corrupting ancient wisdom into ultimate power. Correct your past mistake, rescue the Keepers, and rewrite destiny.

details.title: Ghost in the Cloud
details.short_description: Dive deep into the Net, build the ultimate deck, install busted plugins, and fight ever more powerful Bots and Avatars in fast-paced tactical combat that combines turn based and real time mechanics, all to realize your wish, or perish trying.

details.title: Desktop sticker
details.short_description: This is a game that allows you to freely decorate your computer desktop. Have you ever thought about setting your desktop in a unique way? Come on, let's get started and design and decorate your desktop together! Accompany you in your work and study!

details.title: Marzu
details.short_description: Something ancient lives in these ruins, and it already knows you're here. Flee through shifting halls, tunnels, and forests as unseen entities hunt your every move. Solve environmental puzzles, evade ancient horrors, and uncover a truth that unravels reality itself.

details.title: Fusil
details.short_description: An action-adventure set in a weird fantasy world. Face levels where every shot counts: move silently to backstab enemies, use spells to unlock paths, and explore non-linear environments with multiple solutions. Choose your path, manage your ammo, and survive.

details.title: Roadside Reseal
details.short_description: A roadside store where the night never feels safe. Flickering lights, endless aisles, whispers from the dark. Each task feels like research into fear—you restock, you lock, you fight to keep the seal closed.The silence breaks, the air is heavy, and every moment is research into survival.

details.title: DJ till Dawn
details.short_description: Be a cool DJ and battle crowds in a rhythm roguelite where every beat is a weapon. Build your DJ loadout, unlock new tracks and keep the party alive till dawn to win!

details.title: Pripyat 0
details.short_description: Chernobyl has broken down. As radiation rains down upon you, the world starts rapidly mutating. You've gotten stuck in a nightmarish loop. Can you correctly spot the anomalies on time and get to safety? Or will you become one with the zone?

name: Top of That Thing Called Mountain

details.title: Top of That Thing Called Mountain
details.short_description: Who would you go with on the toughest adventure? Team up with a friend in this 2-player, 2D co-op platformer and guide two dolphins up an impossible mountain. Shoot harpoons, blast air cannons, and swing your way up. Every climb demands perfect teamwork, and one wrong move sends you both tumbling.

details.title: interViolence
details.short_description: Help a teenage supervillain move out of his one and only home. Mop spills, pack clothes and disarm lethal machines. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. A short RPGMaker visual novel about nostalgia, grief, and the things you miss when they're gone forever.

details.title: Koimori
details.short_description: Turn your desktop into a living pond with this peaceful idle overlay. Let koi drift around while you work or relax, drop snacks to see them gather, and unlock rare koi patterns as you spend more time with your little friends.

details.title: VIRUS_31.EXE
details.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

details.title: Son Of A Dealer
details.short_description: Turn forgotten treasures into a thriving business in this narrative-driven second-hand shop simulator. Haggle for the best prices, uncover the stories behind every item, and build deep relationships with the townsfolk. Your choices shape not just your shop, but your life.

details.title: Curse of Cards
details.short_description: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

details.title: Biryado
details.short_description: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

details.title: Undead Night Crew
details.short_description: Run an undead cleaning crew in this online co-op bullet heaven roguelite. Recruit auto attacking followers, team up with friends, and build wild synergies to wipe out zombie hordes. Sign contracts, complete missions, earn cash, get stronger, and do it again!

details.title: WotaBeats
details.short_description: 《WotaBeats: Code Aria》 is a VR rhythm experience fusing music, idols, and energy. Swing your glowsticks, fight BUGs, and keep the stage alive—feel the beat, live the light. 「Feel the rhythm. Recode the idol.」

details.title: Bones will Fly: Tower Defense
details.short_description: A cozy 3D tower defense where every hit makes the bones fly! Build and upgrade towers, give them specializations and blast marching skeletons into bouncing, physics-driven bones. Watch the skies for flying skulls and defend 25 levels across meadow, snow, desert, lava and graveyard.

details.title: Treble-Basie
details.short_description: A throwback to retro collect-a-thon platformers! Treble-Basie features a comprehensive moveset, old-school graphics, nostalgic soundtrack, and much more!

details.title: Mist Of Time
details.short_description: Embark on a thrilling, historically accurate medieval adventure in this point-and-click MMORPG! Enjoy a simple yet addicting experience with an old-school vibe, rich content, and realistic gameplay. Dive into a unique world where casual clicking leads to endless discoveries, battles, and rewards!

details.title: Bosslife Office Manager
details.short_description: Set up your own office. Expand your office as you wish. Transform from a small office to a large company.Don't forget to make your employees happy too.

details.title: ForMind
details.short_description: A horror shooter set in the ZiroTech underwater complex, where every sector is a fight for life. Battle the infected, use the environment, hack terminals, and learn from mistakes. A time anomaly gives you a second chance — don't waste it.

details.title: 14:  Overmind
details.short_description: 14: Overmind is a first-person survival adventure in a cosmos where anomalies warp space and gravity. Mine ore on asteroids, cut open wrecks with a laser, outfit your base, and upgrade your exosuit to uncover what caused the catastrophe and unravel the mystery of your origins.

details.title: Phenomena Embattled
details.short_description: From the far reaching void of space. To the very cores of planets. This is where Phenomena Embattled takes place. Pilot your alien trans-medium craft through aerial battles, underground caverns and deep sea trenches.

details.title: BEATVISTA
details.short_description: For little ones and hardcore players alike. BEATVISTA is a rhythm game where every track, with music and video from AI video creators, gets a stage of its own. Play one-button mini-games or hammer through HELL charts on four keys, and rewind any tricky passage to practice.

details.title: Crafted Legends
details.short_description: Build awesome racing tracks, challenge other players' ghosts, and discover what happens when realistic physics meets questionable driving skills. Create, race, crash, repeat. Roads are optional. Gravity isn't. Welcome to Crafted Legends, where even your worst ideas deserve a test drive.

details.title: Project Polygon
details.short_description: 32 players. 5 rounds. Nobody is ever eliminated. Race, dive and tumble through a chaotic TV game show armed with Goat Launchers, Chicken Rays and Black Hole Bombs. Get knocked over, bounce back up and climb the scoreboard – the Final counts double!

details.title: Dungeon Man
details.short_description: A bullet-hell dungeon game where you use colored gems to match the enemy in order to deal damage. Each enemy type has a unique attack style. Shoot and Dodge as you search for the evil toilet snake which lies deep within the dungeon.

details.title: Foederatus
details.short_description: In this kingdom management RPG, you assume your father’s throne in Dalmatia to lead the kingdom, build alliances, fight rivalries and hear the pleas of your people. On the brink of change, you will define the political order. By your decisions, the future of Dalmatia is in your hands.

details.title: Shadow Mate
details.short_description: A horror action adventure game. Cynthia awakens in a ruined secret research facility with the vicious parasite “Belial” hidden inside her body. Surrounded by grotesque creatures and maddened researchers, she must use Belial’s power to escape and uncover the horrifying truth behind the laboratory.

details.title: Po10tions: Silver Path
details.short_description: Po10tions: Silver Path is a deck-building business simulation game. Start your business in a magic world in the 18th-century. Produce 3 types of goods and sell them. Play cards to produce more, trade for better prices, or stop your opponents. Make money faster to win!

details.title: Frank and Stein
details.short_description: Trapped in one stitched body, Frank & Stein must swap heads to survive this gloomy Metroidvania. Wield light and psychic powers to explore a castle shrouded in darkness, solve puzzles and reveal the unseen. Discover abilities and secrets, but beware of threats lurking in these twisted corridors...

details.title: Witchland: Trinity Blight
details.short_description: Lead an Inquisition expedition into a land consumed by corruption. Choose your missions, manage precious time, build your company, and survive brutal turn-based tactical battles as the world grows more dangerous around you.

details.title: Thothic
details.short_description: Thothic is a logic puzzle game where you land stones on their glowing targets. But all stones move together, in the same direction — so you'll need to find the one path that brings every stone home at once.

details.title: NERO
details.short_description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

details.title: WOLFOUT
details.short_description: A Wild West social deduction game. You and your gang of outlaw coyotes have one goal: crack safes, rob the bank, and loot the saloon before time runs out. But some of you are secretly sheriffs. Same look, same gang - opposite mission.

details.title: Paradox Tower
details.short_description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

details.title: Atomic Blastman
details.short_description: Remember those epic LAN afternoons with your dad or friends? Atomic Blastman brings them back. Pick a color, suit up, and blast your way through huge arenas. Power-ups, sudden death, chaos, and laughs guaranteed. Just... please... don’t blow yourself up! Chaos and madness, guaranteed.

details.title: Ramen://protocol
details.short_description: 🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder. Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills. Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying. Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

details.title: Picatso
details.short_description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

details.title: The Grant Grover Anthology
details.short_description: In Neo Naarm in the 22nd century, augmentation technology has run amok. Combining deduction, visual novel and point and click gameplay, play as Grant Grover, private detective, one of the only remaining citizens without augmentations, as he solves crimes across the city.

details.title: KLITTER
details.short_description: KLITTER fuses the precision of arena combat with the chaos of glitchcore and the flow of a movement-driven brawler. Every dash, every shot, every kill defines your rhythm - stop moving and you die, flow perfectly and the system collapses. PURE FLOW. ZERO MERCY.

details.title: Fast & Fractured
details.short_description: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

details.title: Beyond Lost Planets
details.short_description: Beyond Lost Planets is an intense Roguelike Dungeon Crawler Bullet Hell. Fight through enemies and bosses across procedural worlds. Everything from weapons and bullets to powerup and companions is represented with cards. Grow absurdly powerful and create wild, unique synergies every run!

details.title: Where the Veil Thins
details.short_description: A monster taming JRPG where your creatures are your cards. Bond over 200 of them, build a deck, and outplay rival summoners with face-down wards and a board that rewards planning. The Imperium is recruiting, cadet. Serve well, and never ask what the Veil is hiding.

details.title: Cosmic Plague
details.short_description: A plague is silencing the galaxy one world at a time. Command a small ship and a frightened crew in this roguelike about outrunning it. Trade, fight and keep your ship alive as systems go dark behind you. Reach the Ark before it leaves, and pray you pass the scan. It only takes clean ships.

details.title: One Wrong Step
details.short_description: One wrong move can change everything... Explore trapped rooms in this tactical roguelite inspired by Minesweeper. Every square is a risk. Every exit, a choice. Think carefully... or start again.

details.title: Unwilling Executioner
details.short_description: A sadistic killer is forcing you to choose who lives and dies. Investigate and find clues scattered around The Bunker to save your family. Double check every detail before time runs out, because one wrong pick and you’ve killed someone you love.

details.title: Berrus
details.short_description: Berrus is an old-school online RPG. Explore, fight in real time, gather, craft and farm.

details.title: Car World
details.short_description: Car World is a realistic 2D driving and life simulator focused on true car ownership and maintenance. Drive, repair, and tune your vehicles, take jobs or trade them for profit. Every car system is simulated down to the smallest detail. Can you prove yourself as a true car enthusiast?

details.title: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

details.title: BugoPhobia
details.short_description: BugoPhobia is an indie survival horror game where you explore haunted places, avoid ghosts during ghost hunts, collect clues, and correctly identify the type of ghost

details.title: Ember Folks
details.short_description: The incremental city builder about forcing BIG numbers to go BIGGER! Gather, build, automate and expand your frozen kingdom. Assemble an army of workers and put them to work reigniting a fading star!

details.title: Recoup 'n' Roll: Music Industry Simulator
details.short_description: Build or join a record label across seven distinct music markets, each with its own charts, economy, contracts, royalties, and audience behavior. Sign artists, fund releases, manage debt, survive rivals, and turn local acts into global stars.

details.title: Shadows Over Fog City
details.short_description: Shadows Over the Fog City is a Republican-era spy visual novel. As an undercover clerk inside an enemy puppet bureau, hide behind files and seals, mislead your enemies, pass intelligence, and survive audits, blame games, and purges. One mistake means death—but you have no choice.

details.title: Volcano Watch
details.short_description: Discover an open-world volcano-monitoring game grounded in accurate volcanology and authentic phenomena. Step into the role of a lone scientist facing an active volcano, and lead the adventure at your own pace, free to follow the story or carve your own path.

details.title: Dream Ocean
details.short_description: Journey across an ocean of strange worlds in a story-driven JRPG. Follow your companions’ stories, combine skills across classes, and lead your party through ATB battles and tactical encounters. Discover hidden dungeons and abilities that change how you fight and explore.

details.title: Brawling Beetles
details.short_description: Die. Adapt. Fight Back. In this faced-paced top down multiplayer beetle brawler, every death makes you stronger. Choose between abilites, classes and weapons. Battle in matches with up to 4 players, fight PvE enemies, collect loot, and unleash powerful ultimates to claim victory.

details.title: Masked Up
details.short_description: Online Rogue-like Game. Choose a various characters and masks to defeat your enemies.

details.title: Drumk
details.short_description: DRUMK is a physics-based pirate action game where you command a fully interactive ship, battle enemy crews, and survive roguelite runs solo or with up to 6 players.

details.title: Shoes in the fridge
details.short_description: You wake up on a normal day - except maybe a little late, everything feels normal... until you realize... your shoes are in the fridge. Shoes in the Fridge is an achievement hunting game with multiple funny endings. Will you ever make it to work?

details.title: Rust & Dust
details.short_description: Rust & Dust is A fast-paced 2D roguelike Shooter about two twin mice fighting through a ruined world. Instantly switch between them, combine their powers, and turn positioning into a weapon. Master the chaos or be overrun!

details.title: Telenovela Simulator
details.short_description: As the head writer of the newest soap opera of a failing network, juggle a tight budget, the expectations of the audience and the chaotic world of TV production. Combine actors and locations to discover hundreds of scenes as you weave a dramatic narrative in each unique playthrough.

details.title: Masquerader Z
details.short_description: Transform into a hero and fight! Utilize stylish fighting styles with swords, bombs, and guns against monstrous villains in this fast paced action platformer. Battle the weapons dealers and their minions as the Masquerader Zoe as she protects her city.

details.title: Frontier Wars: Online
details.short_description: An old-school MMORPG featuring multiple NPC factions vying for control over territory. Explore the chaotic frontier of Zagros and fight in tactical turn-based battles with other players and NPC allies. Build your own character and fight against enemy factions to gain loot, EXP, and power.

details.title: Outliers: Incrementum
details.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

details.title: Time to Work!
details.short_description: An Idler Desktop Companion game set in a 3D space. Where you hire "Fren"s to work alongside you on your screen. Watch as you and your Frens types, clicks, or procrastinate or have a conversation all while earning coins. Buy goofy items, upgrades, and even throw a party!! its Time to Work!

details.title: Envision Research Facility
details.short_description: A routine maintenance job turns into something far more unsettling. Investigate a remote research facility, restore power, and uncover what went wrong. Is anyone still alive? Or are you already too late?

details.title: Island Wolves
details.short_description: You are a wolf. Hunt prey and gather materials to build your camp, decorate your den and grow your pack. Fight off rival wolves or avoid combat altogether by using the environment to your advantage. Explore the islands and discover the truth behind the lost packs.

details.title: Larva
details.short_description: LARVA is a tactical co-op horror FPS for up to 4 players. Explore environments, collect valuable loot, face deadly anomalies, and extract before it's too late. Coordinate, survive, and don't go alone.

details.title: Order of Beast
details.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite with deep builds, stunning painterly art, and compelling fragmented storytelling. Shape each skill through randomized upgrades with Path of Exile–style build depth. Explore a beautiful, decaying dark fantasy world and uncover the buried past of the Order of Beast.

details.title: Underking
details.short_description: A first-person mining incremental game. Enter the cave to mine and extract valuable ores. Convert ores into coins and spend them on upgrades to extend your runs to reach deeper into the mountain.

details.title: Court Vision
details.short_description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

details.title: Gravity Witch
details.short_description: Master gravity as a witch whose mana has been stolen. With no elemental spells left, use your creativity to manipulate the weight of the world, solve puzzles, and face dangers. Reclaim your power in an action-adventure journey where gravity is your only and greatest ally.

details.title: Time To Waste
details.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

details.title: Earth Atlantis Abyss
details.short_description: A shoot 'em up roguelike where light, space and safety are things you trade away. Descend as Pypher, a lone captain chasing her grandfather's lost legacy into a drowned world. Anyone who seeks answers knows that the deeper you go, the darker it gets...

details.title: Mini Sushi Factory
details.short_description: Manage your very own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Deliver batches of Bento Boxes during shifts, then upgrade your production lines, receive emails from customers, and get new recipes in the management room.

name: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power

details.title: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power
details.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

details.title: Blek and the Endless Keep
details.short_description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

details.title: Adventurers Wanted!
details.short_description: An idle fantasy guild game where you run the notice board.

details.title: Reap & Repeat
details.short_description: Reap & Repeat is a satisfying active incremental game about harvesting an ever-growing ecosystem. Cut plants, earn upgrades, improve your scythe, and make vegetation grow faster, denser, and more valuable as your tiny harvest turns into field-clearing chaos.

details.title: Cosmic Mushrooms
details.short_description: Realistic physics-based rocket game. Navigate dangerous alien planets, collect mushroom cargo and deliver supplies back to your base.

details.title: Doomed Village
details.short_description: Rule a village caught in the shadow of war. You cannot fight or stop it. Choose which problems to face, endure the consequences of what you neglect and shape the remains of your village when the end finally arrives.

details.title: Geeked-Out Basketball
details.short_description: Think you have the coaching chops to build a dynasty? Prove it. Geeked-Out Basketball is a deep high school basketball management sim: recruit and develop your players, scout opponents, craft your game plans, and call every possession live. Depth you can actually see and feel.

details.title: Word Link
details.short_description: Guess the 12 hidden words on every board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo, survive endless escalating waves, or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Fully playable in English and Arabic.

details.title: King Must Rush
details.short_description: A medieval roguelite where you play the king: race the clock to forge weapons and arm your villagers, command the army in real time, and hold the walls against the siege. Climb a branching map to the boss, draft powers between fights, and grow stronger every run.

details.title: The House Between Times
details.short_description: Turn the hands of a pocket watch to move between two eras of the same house. Change the past to reshape the present, solve puzzles that span decades, and uncover the secrets hidden within the house in this first-person mystery adventure.

details.title: Dark Blue Star
details.short_description: You are a fallen star. Climb the rock face and swing on ropes to return to the sky. Be mindful of depression and anxiety. We recommend visiting a hospital if necessary.

details.title: 수복
details.short_description: In a Korea torn by war, Seo-hun fights to reclaim the everyday life he lost. Follow a character-driven story and fight alongside infantry and tanks in top-down 2D battles, moving, aiming, and taking cover on the front line.

details.title: S.O.V.A.
details.short_description: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history.

details.title: Oscilloscopia
details.short_description: Oscilloscopia is a puzzle game built around an authentically simulated oscilloscope. Build signals, patch modules and tune the instrument until the phosphor trace matches the target. Experiment with signal processing and find your own solutions.

details.title: Paw Works Co.
details.short_description: Run your repair shop in a cosy animal neighborhood. Diagnose and repair your customers' broken belongings, and organize your workshop your way. Grow your shop, unlock upgrades like delivery, and manage it all from your computer.

details.title: Packsmith
details.short_description: Pack your customers’ inventories, build clever item combinations, and earn enough points to keep your cozy medieval shop alive. Every item, every space, every decision counts!

details.title: Textures Not Included
details.short_description: [Textures Not Included] is a p̷s̷y̷c̷h̷o̷l̷o̷g̷i̷c̷a̷l̷ ̵h̵o̵r̵r̵o̵r̵ incremental game about perception, progression, and the ̶p̶r̶i̶c̶e̶ ̶o̶f̶ ̶v̶i̶s̶u̶a̶l̶ ̶c̶l̶a̶r̶i̶t̶y̶. N̄othîng ēxīsts ûntîl yōu p̄āy f̄ōr īt. Click to earn, buy [TE X T UR E S], and r̵e̵n̵d̵e̵r̵ your surrounding bit by bit.

details.title: StrongGirls Tactics
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics RPG where your girls grow muscles as they get stronger. Recruit 18 girls, each with their personal stories and struggles. As your bonds deepen, they grow stronger and more muscular. Wrapped in a Norse themed world where you fight to reclaim the kingdom.

details.title: Gate Logic
details.short_description: Gate Logic lets you build any logic circuit made up from the Boolean logic gates NOT, AND, OR, NOR, XOR and XNOR on an infinite, grid based canvas.

details.title: Earth Tourist
details.short_description: Find yourself in an endless open world and journey from the Stone Age to quantum immortality. Advance technologies, build cities and rockets, manage a dynasty, and conquer space in a massive Sci-Fi sandbox with total freedom of action!

details.title: Treehouse
details.short_description: An aesthetically pleasing treehouse toy. Build up and out, and the branches support your structures. Connect rooms with ladders and walkways, or carve footpaths through the grassy glen to interactable ponds. Create the ambient orchestral soundtrack with your treehouse, and set the perfect lighting.

details.title: GO, my pretties!
details.short_description: Go My Pretties is a game about commanding a small army of cute robots. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons to collect resources, craft upgrades and get stronger.

details.title: HEARTHWATCH
details.short_description: HEARTHWATCH is a roguelite tower defense where the map tears open mid-battle. Guard your village's last fire across a branching Stone Age campaign: build elemental towers, bond them into hybrids, draw cards from your run's deck, and hold the new lane when the ground splits.

details.title: Under a Turning Sky
details.short_description: A calm, meditative celestial puzzle game where you rotate planets along orbit rings, align them, and guide a signal across the stars. Solve thoughtful, zen-like logic puzzles at your own pace, accompanied by a transporting, relaxing soundtrack.

details.title: Did a Monkey Write This?
details.short_description: A cozy incremental management game. You're a failed author with a troop of cute monkey writers. Level up and build, play the publishing slot machine, race around plot holes and ski the slopes of ever-changing trends.

details.title: Strawbie
details.short_description: They took the wrong cow's best friend. You're Strawbie, and a truck took Mallow in the night. Go after it by plane, by boat, by farmer - you're the engine of every one. Learn a trick from every animal you help, wreck what people left behind, and topple machines as tall as the sky.

details.title: Feather Rogue
details.short_description: A tactical grid combo builder where each turn is a full combo.. not one move. Chain your hand across the grid, trigger 16 elemental reactions that cascade with no limit and wipe the board in a single turn. Plan smart, combo harder and talk trash. Every run is a new puzzle of destruction.

details.title: Space Cat Digger
details.short_description: In Space Cat Digger, you will mine resources, build machines, upgrade your equipment, and try to get the highest score possible within a limited time. Play your own way, manage your resources, optimize, automate… while something strange begins to awaken

details.title: Between the Shelves
details.short_description: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

details.title: Deceptive Shadows: Final Case
details.short_description: A paranormal detective in Sin City. A missing girl, a chained demon, and a city full of lies. Sounds like a normal investigation. It isn't. Question the demon, fight with guns and magic, solve occult puzzles, and survive its tricks.

name: A Farm About Digging A Tunnel To Escape Totalitarianism

details.title: A Farm About Digging A Tunnel To Escape Totalitarianism
details.short_description: A first-person co-op farming sim in a dictatorship you design yourselves. By day, your family grows the Party's weekly quota under the guards' watch. By night, you dig a secret tunnel under the border wall. Play solo or online with up to 4 players.

details.title: Forgotten Station
details.short_description: Forgotten Station is a knowledge-based narrative game, where you travel aboard trains to find your way out of a time loop. Your curiosity and observation skills will be put to the test in this relaxing game, filled with atmospheric places to uncover, characters to meet, and real human stories.

details.title: TION: Hero Awakening — Idle RPG
details.short_description: Build your hero, collect gear, upgrade your stats and watch your character fight automatically. Push through harder enemies, bosses and new stages in this 2D incremental RPG.

details.title: Tillandsia
details.short_description: Venture through the shifting dungeons of Akirume in a mystery dungeon roguelike featuring a unique real-time / turn-based combat system and over 1900 spells. Gather threads of mana, uncover powerful magic, and carve your path across a continent shaped by ancient forces.

details.title: Boxing Life Simulator
details.short_description: Boxing Life Simulator is a simulator game which combined with boxing mechanics. You can fight with your opponents on tournaments, you can have a social life, you can make money and spend it to improve your power and your social life statues.

details.title: Mana Roots
details.short_description: An idle-farming game where you use magic to handle the work. Plant, expand and automate with the help of animals. All from the bottom of your screen

details.title: Cardmare: Descent
details.short_description: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Ten deadly floors, ten-minute runs, nine classes, one question every turn: Will you gain enough gold to buy powerful new cards, or become too greedy and push your luck too far?

details.title: Afternoon Patient
