details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. As a patient tethered to a cold, mobile IV pole, you move through silent, haunting liminal spaces. Time feels frozen, and every step tests your rhythm, patience, and courage as you face isolation and psychological terror.

details.title: System Says Normal
details.short_description: You were hired to watch. Not to ask questions. Night shift. Corporate building. Cameras, reports, anomalies. Your predecessor left no final report. Now you're going to find out why. Please proceed.

details.title: Action & Automation
details.short_description: Action or automation? In this asymmetric, side-scrolling action-RTS, fight on the front line yourself, let your machines do the work, or do both at once. Each of the three species plays by its own rules.

details.title: Valley of Stability
details.short_description: Crash-land on a dying alien world and bring it back to life. Build automated factories, master real chemistry and nuclear physics, and terraform the atmosphere one gas at a time — while sandworms hunt the power signature of everything you build.

name: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words

details.title: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words
details.short_description: Learn a language by finding hidden objects 🔎 in a cozy, funny family game where everyone keeps losing things — except super‑mom, who can find anything. Search for items, learn words in context, and enjoy short family scenes. Free demo coming soon — wishlist the game.

details.title: Decommission Protocol
details.short_description: Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?

details.title: Rock From Home
details.short_description: Type emails in the 90s to buy tiny hats for your pet rock! Handle strange workplace situations, and choose how you respond. Spend your hard-earned money on silly stuff like your weekly bills, and things that truly matter: ridiculous accessories for your rock.

details.title: Late Night Manifest
details.short_description: As Marco, you wake up to a reality where the world is shrouded in darkness, forcing you to fight for survival while seeking answers in abandoned darkness.

details.title: Rush Tower
details.short_description: Rush Tower is a Tower Defense game where new paths are procedurally added over the course of the game. Can you keep up as the enemy builds more paths in this ever more hectic war?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

details.title: Sekigahara
details.short_description: The fate of Japan is in your hands! Sekigahara is a digital adaptation of the acclaimed two-player strategy board game set in 1600, during the epic campaign that unified Japan. Command hidden armies, manage loyalties, and outmaneuver your rival!

details.title: MonsTile
details.short_description: A groundbreaking roguelike deck-building defense game on an 8x8 board! Strategically place monsters and trigger synergies to fend off adventurers. Having fled across dimensions from an unbeatable hero, you arrive in worlds of fantasy, apocalypse, wuxia, and cyberpunk to battle their heroes.

details.title: Be Positive!
details.short_description: Move Mr Positve around the arena by converting the cubes around him to reach his goal, Ms. Negative. Play on desktop or in VR.

details.title: Abyss Chamber
details.short_description: Maintain an underground research facility full of abyss entities. Fulfill their needs and survive long enough to solve all of the mysteries. Abyss Chamber is a lore-rich, first-person psychological Horror game.

details.title: Bumpers & Dragons
details.short_description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

details.title: 鱼干集团那些事：征途
details.short_description: 《Furry Journey in Other World》 IP Furry Anime 2D Role-Playing Visual Novel GameYou will take control of the protagonist — HuiYuan — and continue writing the story of Yugan Group in this sci-fi world. Embark on an epic journey together with your friends and comrades-in-arms.

details.title: KUBIKA
details.short_description: KUBIKA is a Sokoban-like puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity and guide charming little cubes across three-dimensional, perspective-twisting puzzles. Master each world’s unique mechanics, build and share your own puzzles using the built-in Level Editor. Free Demo available today !

details.title: WarSlice
details.short_description: Take command of your army in WarSlice! Fight for the glory of your favorite faction, choose your commander, and rally your troops to victory in strategic turn-based battles. With intuitive controls and simple mechanics, even newcomers can engage in intense matches!

details.title: Antarctic Grave
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in an Antarctic research station. Explore the frozen complex, search for tools and weapons, keep the generator fueled, and outsmart mutants to survive the harsh conditions.

details.title: Deathless Oath
details.short_description: Become an ancient unholy creature rising against mankind to claim its right to exist through fire and steel. Cut through crowds of enemies, crush them in brutal melee combat, and turn the medieval battlefield to ash. Death waits. The oath remains.

details.title: Covenantum
details.short_description: Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management RPG inspired by Ars Magica where you guide a growing magical covenant through decades of political intrigue, supernatural events, magical research, and strategic seasonal planning in Mythic Europe.

details.title: Scent of You
details.short_description: Inherit a quiet little perfume shop and blend scents for customers who can't quite say what they're looking for. Listen for what slips out, open their drawer of keepsakes and bottle a memory in three notes. No wrong answers — but everyone has one thing they'll never accept.

details.title: Hex Party
details.short_description: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.

details.title: 100 Bodies in the Grass
details.short_description: 100 Bodies in the Grass is a wave-based co-op defense game, set against the backdrop of the Third Mongol Invasion of Vietnam, combining elements of roguelikes and tower/hero defenses with the combat of an isometric ARPG.

name: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们

details.title: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们
details.short_description: 承接著名的《亲吻那片花瓣》系列作品，《米迦勒的少女们》在原有剧情基础上拓展了各位少女们的故事——这些情节跨越了数月时光，描绘了她们生活中的种种磨难。在少女们不断成长并相互扶持的过程中，百合终将绽放。

details.title: SpartanBit
details.short_description: SpartanBit is a voxel arena FPS for competitive battles and custom game nights. Fight over flags and control points, survive 50-wave BitHorde with up to 8 players, or build your own levels in Creator Mode. Multiplayer battles support up to 24 players.

details.title: WorldOS
details.short_description: Rule a superpower in 2026, command armies in World War II, unite China in the Three Kingdoms or seize Rome after Caesar. Type any order and an AI game master plays out the consequences: borders move, rivals scheme, allies betray. 200+ hand-picked worlds, plus an editor to build your own.

details.title: Not Us
details.short_description: A solitaire style card game where you forage for plants, manage your inventory, and try to stay alive.

details.title: Holy Ocean
details.short_description: Ride your bike through the ocean of meat, alone or with friends. Raiders on your tail. They built a tower on that head island. Sneak in. Take down their leader. Destroy the whole island if needed. It is all for the love of Rose

details.title: LightSup!
details.short_description: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

details.title: BECROWNED
details.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

details.title: Stars of Icarus
details.short_description: From the devs of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. Captain frigates, pilot fighters, and man the guns. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Victory or death, together.

details.title: Toxic Frontier
details.short_description: The world ended a long time ago. Unlock powerful cards and build a safe haven for your people within its ruins. In this roguelike city-builder, deploy cards across a hex grid to expand your colony and purify the land, buying another day of survival in the noxious wastes.

details.title: Metropolis 1998
details.short_description: A fresh, modern city builder with charming aesthetics. Detailed agent-based simulation and scheduling. See inside buildings. Design and customize almost anything. Business-specific zoning, and mixed use zones too!

details.title: The Button Effect
details.short_description: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

details.title: Alpine Lake
details.short_description: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

name: Daily Life With The Herb Girl

details.title: Daily Life With The Herb Girl
details.short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

details.title: METAMORPH PROTOCOL
details.short_description: Online co-op horror for up to 5 players. Descend into Army Facility 7, a buried military lab where sample M-7 copies the shapes, voices and faces of whatever it touches. Carry your fallen friends, survive every floor and get out together, or not at all.

details.title: SCP Idle: SECURE. CONTAIN. PROGRESS.
details.short_description: In this incremental game you are in charge of managing a SCP facility site. Construct and upgrade new containment chambers, prevent devastating breaches and complete the Thaumiel Containment Engine.

details.title: Senpo Mahjong
details.short_description: "This is not cheating—it's magic!" Online mahjong with Skills: see through opponents' hands, control your draws, boost your score. Skills cost MP—timing your trump card decides the game. Real-time 3D tables, 4P & 3P modes, CPU practice, spectating, replays, private rooms, and ranked play.

details.title: Log Drop
details.short_description: A physics sandbox with one noble goal: get more logs into the core than physically reasonable. Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Kick back and let it flow, or engineer the perfect cascade. Your sandbox, your rules.

details.title: Magical Girl
details.short_description: A pixel-art magical-girl action adventure. Transform, chain attacks, time Perfect Guards, and master new fighting styles. Explore a haunted city and collect forbidden books, then return to school life, phone chats, and a place to call home.

details.title: Coup de Grass
details.short_description: Start with a single sickle and a small field. Cut and sell grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

details.title: LEXICON: Lingua Obscura
details.short_description: An old terminal in an abandoned office is still on, long after everyone has left. Why is ECHO-7, a cryptic AI, still running? Why does it want you to play? Twist strange rules and chain letter combos in a word roguelite where every run feels one step away from revealing something bigger.

details.title: Destruction Brothers
details.short_description: A demolition game where every wall, plank and joint is accurately modeled. Enjoy four-player co-op sandbox chaos or progress through a solo career. An innovative, fully deterministic physics engine means when you knock out a building's supports, every brick lands in the same spot on every screen.

details.title: Cheesteroids
details.short_description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

details.title: Welcome Back to Aeris
details.short_description: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

details.title: CRIMSON PANDEMIC
details.short_description: CRIMSON PANDEMIC: A tale of the 'Rubrum'—a crimson light that mutates living beings into entities driven by resentment—and 'Belle,' a girl who has lost her dreams, embarking on a journey of promise aboard a Ark.

details.title: Phantom of Orion
details.short_description: A WW2 submarine sim in space. Alone in an unfinished stealth prototype, run cold and dark through alien convoy lanes, strike from cloak, then vanish before the swarm sweeps back. The cloak that hides you also blinds you.

details.title: Roma Eterna Sons of Mars
details.short_description: Gather your legions, build defenses, and conquer territory for ROME! Explore a doomed world, research new technologies, and uncover the legacy of Mars. "Roma Eterna: Sons of Mars" is a strategy and tower defense game. ROME WILL NEVER FALL!

details.title: UNCUT
details.short_description: UNCUT is a tactical police raid shooter seen through a bodycam. Shout real orders into your mic and suspects react: some comply, some run, some open fire. Clear houses solo with two NPC officers or in co-op with up to 4 players. No raid plays out the same.

details.title: Greenrise
details.short_description: Greenrise is a short and cozy incremental game about chopping wood, breaking stones and mining gold to buy upgrades and grow your island.

details.title: Project Poker
details.short_description: Project Poker is a single-player poker experience with smart opponents, memorable personalities, and tons of quality-of-life features. Build your bankroll in Career Mode, master four poker variants, and play your way with game speeds, fast-forward, quick betting, full controller support, and more.

details.title: Floors of Fury
details.short_description: Floors of Fury is a fast-paced 2.5D beat ’em up roguelite. Fight through crowds, slam enemies into walls or each other, collect upgrades, shape your build, and punch your way from the bottom of the company to the top.

details.title: Sudokucide
details.short_description: Experience a new, fast-paced game inspired by Sudoku combined with action reminiscent of late-nights spent in the arcades of the 90s. Sudokucide brings the traditional game into the 21st century with exciting new mechanics and pumps the action up to 11. Face the challenge or commit Sudokucide.

details.title: COMETROX!
details.short_description: Nobody told the keyboard it wasn't a guitar.

details.title: 3D Nuclear Reactor Simulator
details.short_description: Operate and maintain a nuclear power plant in this immersive first-person simulator. Control a pressurised water reactor, diagnose equipment failures, repair machinery, manage critical systems and respond to emergencies where every decision matters.

details.title: Dunderbeck
details.short_description: Cincinatti: The Queen City, the Paris of America, Porkopolis. This city is a mess, Dunderbeck. Your job is to fight that mess, build with that mess and - I'm sorry to say - eat that mess. It's a dirty job, but that's how the sausage is made.

details.title: Wild Wild Eden
details.short_description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

details.title: Moochy
details.short_description: Your coins are your health. Spend them on guns, or hold onto them and stay alive longer — your call. Dumb co-op for 1 to 4.

details.title: Nox Mortalis
details.short_description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

details.title: Little Cheese Works
details.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

details.title: Red Dust Colony
details.short_description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

details.title: Sirens
details.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

details.title: No Neutral Ground
details.short_description: Master magnetic polarity in a fast-paced, physics-driven robot party game for 1-8 players. Attract, repel, dash, and outmaneuver rivals across 20+ Mini Games, Magnetic Football, and a sprawling Scrap Raid. Customize your machine and claim the arena.

details.title: War Table Arena
details.short_description: War Table Arena is a real-time collectible card battler.[/h2] Energy pours in continuously and both commanders deploy onto a three-lane tabletop, where units march, clash and lay siege to the enemy citadel while you are still deciding what to play next.

details.title: Anispo
details.short_description: Anispo is a fast paced 2D real time strategy game set inside a digital warzone. Command streams of bytes of data, capture network nodes, reinforce your defenses, and outmaneuver computer controlled or online rivals across customizable cyber battlefields.

details.title: Arcanum Solitarius
details.short_description: Poker solitaire with an arcane twist. Each row and column of the 5x5 grid is a poker hand, scoring as it fills. Repeat a hand and it's worth half. Purify the cursed Arcana, corrupted tarot cards that penalize your play. Draft Jokers for unique powers and power up your deck and board for bonus chips.

details.title: SCREW IT
details.short_description: Co-op space mercenary simulator. Take on high-risk contracts, upgrade your gear, and turn a profit.

details.title: Phosphor Command
details.short_description: You command a forward operating base in a world ravaged by war and shadow contracts. Deploy squads into real-time tactical combat, research upgrades, manage a fragile economy, and push back a front that never stops advancing.

details.title: Masc, Mask & Masked
details.short_description: Masc, Mask & Masked is a game that combines mini-games with a visual novel in a terrifyingly cute 2D style. Search through your mobile, chat to your potential dates and recover the powerful mask of Niarlatoted.

details.title: Red Recon: 1944
details.short_description: Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactics game with stealth elements, where you command a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944, on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive. Be the first in the enemy’s lair!

details.title: Project:Null Hypothesis
details.short_description: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

details.title: Project SEVER
details.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

details.title: HellPunk: Purgatorium
details.short_description: HellPunk: Purgatorium is a roguelite that combines stylish action with inventory management. Equip gears, manage your grid, and conquer the tower.

details.title: ON ANY JOURNEY
details.short_description: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage. Play locally or online with a friend!

details.title: Nonolith
details.short_description: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

details.title: Revertices
details.short_description: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

details.title: Starfinder: Afterlight
details.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

details.title: Tesera
details.short_description: Beyond the familiar lies a world of uncharted lands, strange creatures, and the remnants of a lost civilization. Explore, gather, craft, build, and fight - make this alien world your own, solo or with friends.

details.title: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint
details.short_description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

details.title: Bit by Bit
details.short_description: Build a ridiculous game with your friends in minutes, then jump in and play it together. Draw the weapons & items, record the sound effects, draw the world, modify the rules and see what kind of cursed game your group creates.

details.title: Croak
details.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK. -DEMO OUT NOW!-

details.title: Death By Misstep
details.short_description: The robots can hear you breathe. Match your breathing to the music, stay out of sight and find a way off the Samos, a luxury cruise turned into a massacre. First-person horror and stealth where every breath can give you away.

details.title: Roam
details.short_description: "Roam" is a 2D Action-RPG platformer set in a procedurally generated world. Explore the surrounding lands and delve into the depths of mysterious caves that have lain hidden for centuries beneath the Azure Lake.

details.title: Feed Your T-Rex: Desktop Companion
details.short_description: A tiny T-Rex lives at the bottom of your screen while you work. Feed it rabbits, chickens and other critters. Once it's big enough, you can even feed it... humans! Decorate its Containment, keep it happy, and when it dies, use its DNA to breed an even better one.

details.title: Tearoom of Terror
details.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 22 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try to solve the mystery of your aunt's murder before Halloween - or end up on the menu yourself.

details.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
details.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

details.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
details.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

details.title: Glowfall
details.short_description: Glowfall is a co-op survival shooter for 1–4 players. Head into an abandoned laboratory, fight off failed experiments, grab what loot you can and make it out alive — then sell your haul, gear up and go back in.

details.title: Paleokin
details.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

details.title: ZomBMart
details.short_description: ZomBMart is a couch co-opetition game where the chaos of a casual supermarket job meets the zombie apocalypse. 1-4 players clock in to their casual job, compete and cooperate to complete tasks and make sure all customers are satisfied (especially the undead ones).

details.title: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
details.short_description: Mordagan forces are marching toward Derinchai Castle, and you have only a few days to prepare for their arrival. When the enemy finally reaches these walls, every choice you have made will follow you onto the battlefield.

details.title: A Risky Rocky Resort
details.short_description: Manage your resort and "win big" in an action packed resort sim. Cater to resort patrons, dismantle fallen robots for upgrades, and complete your resort. Payback your debts with the help of Uncle Richie. Become an unstoppable money making machine. Get stupid rich.

details.title: Spintal
details.short_description: The sun is gone. Help Atlas keep the world powered in this physics-based incremental game. Smash atoms together, collect quanta and upgrade your reactor. Turn a few small collisions into an ever-growing source of energy.

details.title: Sticky Floors
details.short_description: A bartender sim roguelite. Ditch the corporate grind and run the family dive bar. Pour, mix, slide and serve the townsfolk and a few stranger patrons while cards & dice rewrite the rules every night. Survive 30 nights to earn the deed. Pickled eggs, cats, vomit, and attitude. Enough said.

details.title: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails
details.short_description: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is a compact idle hunting game that lives along the bottom of your screen. Let your hunter track beasts while you work, watch videos, or do something else. Collect loot, improve your gear, unlock useful skills, and conquer new biomes.

details.title: My Friend is a Moron
details.short_description: A 1-3 player tactical roguelite. Shared dice, real elemental combos, and an AI teammate who knows... thinks he is the smartest guy in the room. He has a plan. You can stop him... sometimes!

details.title: Burnt Order
details.short_description: Run the kitchen together. With 3-4 players, one of you is secretly ruining it. Chaos meets betrayal. Playing solo or with 2? Try traitor free endless co-op.

details.title: Pro Endurance Series: Running Manager
details.short_description: Pro Endurance Series Running manager: take your athlete from prospect to legend. Plan training, nutrition, gear and staff, pick your 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon races, and live every event in a real-time simulator where you set the pace and tactics.

details.title: ARUS-1
details.short_description: Your rescue pod crashes on Mars at night. Survive alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op, reach the habitat, expand your base, weather deadly sandstorms – and find out who else is out there on this planet.

details.title: Constellations: Space Company Simulator
details.short_description: From a scrappy start-up to an aerospace titan: build a private space enterprise from the ground up using real-life-inspired rockets. Accept contracts, upgrade your base, design custom satellites, and scale massive constellations to fund your journey to the Moon.

details.title: Cartomancer Cafe
details.short_description: Cartomancer Cafe is an exquisite Tarot reading experience that teaches you how to be a Tarot Reader. Receive readings with our quirky and insightful reader personalities and beautiful custom Tarot decks. And battle the forces of Darkness (or Light) in our Tarot card battle game!

details.title: Little Storm
details.short_description: A classic, orthodox JRPG in which you gather a "family" of non-blood relatives along your journey. An adventure for adults that depicts two paths of growth and two inner struggles.

details.title: Goblins Gotta Go
details.short_description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

details.title: La Cosa Nostra
details.short_description: La Cosa Nostra is a story focused, cinematic 2.5D side-scrolling action game set in 1920s Prohibition era US. Play as Johnny, an Italian American immigrant forced into a life of crime, combining melee combat and shooter gameplay within a noir mafia themed narrative.

details.title: Tombbound
details.short_description: Welcome to the afterlife’s most dangerous internship. In this co-op extraction horror, you serve Anubis. Raid cursed tombs, dodge mythological horrors, and collect enough cursed relics to meet the God of Death's quota. Remember: The scales of justice do not tolerate lighter wallets.

details.title: Orbit to Riches
details.short_description: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

details.title: Asteroid Rodeo
details.short_description: Asteroids are worth trillions. They're also spinning at 200 meters per second. You are a Wrangler—harpoon tumbling rocks, wrestle them to a dead stop with your custom-built ship, and mine them for credits. The pay is good. The survival rate is a conversation people avoid.

details.title: MEATBALLS GARDEN
details.short_description: Meatballs Farm is a fast-paced first-person farming game. Farm, fish, and gather by day. Monsters come at night. You have only 30 days to pay your debt to the King. Miss the payment, and you’re dead.

details.title: Mental Break
details.short_description: Manage our AI girlfriend product as the newest engagement lead at Bigger Tech Corp. Make the tough choices for Alice as she slowly drives her user insane. A satirical choose-your-own-adventure with beautiful pixel art and widely branching narrative.

details.title: The Trial of Progress
details.short_description: A fast-paced city-building experience inspired by the concept of civilization. As you advance your technologies and attract some of the greatest historical figures, you will face the trial of progress and strive to create a lasting legacy.

details.title: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell
details.short_description: A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses. DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

details.title: Fruit Auto Fighters
details.short_description: A fruit-themed async PvP auto battler. Pick a gardener, choose your fruits, and grow a team that can take down other players before your fruit starts rotting. Play at your own pace, try new team combos, and pair fertilizer effects with weapons to find synergies that break the game.

details.title: Fruit Slicer
details.short_description: Slice fruit with precision - using your mouse or real hand! Dodge bombs, master combos, and push your reflexes to the limit in this fast-paced arcade slicer.

details.title: Reverie Eclipse
details.short_description: You are the president of the student council at a high school. Six lovely girls are ready to help you! Spending time with them... is it as easy as it seems?

details.title: Dont Stop Walking
details.short_description: A co-op survival extraction game for 1 to 6 players. A purple storm is coming down the canyon and it never stops. Walk, scavenge, craft from grass to iron, fight what lives in five abandoned places, and get your haul home to your floating outpost before the storm takes it all.

details.title: Cafe Life Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your dream cafe, but don't stop there. In this comprehensive simulation, explore a living city! Drive cars, build relationships, work side jobs, and build your empire. From brewing coffee to becoming the most famous name in town—how will you live your cafe life?

details.title: Magic Moon
details.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

details.title: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets
details.short_description: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets is a multitasking action roguelike where combat and block puzzle happen at the same time. Devour scrap to grow stronger, create your own build, and survive against endless machine hordes.

details.title: The Missing Threads
details.short_description: [DEMO available now!] Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

details.title: The Endemic : Best Mates
details.short_description: Endemic: GONGWAN is a cozy farming game inspired by a CCC comic. Taiwanese foods like Gongwan and dumplings come to life as cute creatures called Endemics. Play as a researcher, rebuild the park, farm the land, and befriend unique companions.

details.title: Reflectory
details.short_description: An idle incremental game about bouncing balls that lives in the corner of your screen.

details.title: Depono
details.short_description: Play against your friends in this fast paced, competitive card game. Bet, scheme and bluff your way to victory. Craft your deck with secret cards, change the playing field with items and become unstoppable.

details.title: Lone Tower
details.short_description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

details.title: Pinball Realm
details.short_description: A pinball Roguelite where the board is yours to build. Fortify your defenses, stack outrageous synergies, and unleash game-breaking combos as you save the kingdom from endless waves of monsters!

details.title: Pull the Lever
details.short_description: Pull the lever, send a tiny train hauling cargo. Click storms and breakdowns mid-run to protect the take. Chase jackpots, hire staff to automate the dull runs, and grow a living model railroad. You won't know the payout until it arrives.

details.title: Graveline
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror operation sim. Drive a steam locomotive through one night. Feed the boiler, read signals, and hold the deadman's lever while something advances car by car. Kill the light to hide and lose your gauges. Make noise to survive and it hears you. One life.

details.title: MODice
details.short_description: MODice is a dice-building roguelike. Roll five dice, then rearrange them for higher scores! Socket gems and combine sets to turn scores into board movement. Choose your landing spot, build and upgrade, and shape a stronger build to overcome changing Boss rules before your rolls run out.

details.title: Nightfreight
details.short_description: A single-player body-horror roguelite auto-battler. Draft vat-grown mutants, pay for power in flesh, arrange your squad on a train-car grid, then hit DEPART. Fights resolve automatically. Most upgrades corrupt their host; a unit pushed too far mutates, seizes up, or turns on its own squad.

details.title: Lively
details.short_description: Lively is a puzzle-platformer where two rival creatures fight for control of the planet. Use ever-changing powers to make your way through a unique world !

details.title: Doll Arena
details.short_description: A dark 2D metroidvania steeped in Slavic folklore. Play as a red motanka doll with button eyes, armed only with needles – stab, throw, parry, reclaim. Explore an interconnected hand-drawn world, then battle up to 3 friends in local or LAN PvP arenas

details.title: Song of Larithea
details.short_description: Larithea is a cute anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding your way back from the darkness. Craft your own spells from sigils, then lead a team of five young mages through turn-based battles on a grid. Others have walked their road before. Few found their way back.

details.title: Mayhematic
details.short_description: Mayhematic is a bullet heaven where the next door is always worth the trouble behind it. Blast through cartoon hordes solo or in 4-player online co-op, spend your kills on doors that go deeper, build something ridiculous and put your name on the leaderboard.

details.title: Mercenary Guild Manager
details.short_description: Raise a banner and run a mercenary guild in a grim medieval fantasy realm. Recruit and read your blades, negotiate contracts, send them into procedural missions, and survive a living political web where every payday bites and nothing is ever certain.

details.title: Lethal Tournament
details.short_description: Lethal Tournament is a deckbuilding roguelike set in a dystopian megastructure. Build a deck, reshape it with Items, and bend the rules with Charms as you fight your way up the Tournament to find out what it's actually for.

details.title: Gemtide
details.short_description: A short and satisfying incremental game about collecting gems underwater. Break rocks, get gems, go deeper, repeat.

details.title: Worlds: Dome Vanguard – Alien TD
details.short_description: Worlds: Dome Vanguard – Alien TD is a single-player Tower Defense game that combines elements of strategy, general leveling, combat vehicles, and searching for powerful weapons to eliminate aliens. Learn talents and perks, build unique vehicles, and defend different planets from hordes of aliens.

details.title: Never Ending Trail
details.short_description: Build a custom mobile fortress on legs. Crash-land in the Wild West, scavenge your wrecked ship, transform it into a walking mech base and roam an endless, procedurally generated western frontier. Build, Loot, and Survive your way through a world that never lets you stop.

details.title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
details.short_description: In a single night, your family's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Build up your power base by brewing the best drinks and retaking the town... or, you know, by *fixing* the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

details.title: Moldborne
details.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op turn-based roguelike. The Father stopped answering prayers years ago. Then the mold came up out of the ground, and the dead started getting back up. They remember everything. So do you.

details.title: Keep It Up!
details.short_description: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically [redacted] test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up!

details.title: Turnveil
details.short_description: Turnveil is a turn-based roguelike where every fight is a tactical puzzle built on three pillars: clever skill combos, using the environment, and choosing your targets wisely. One wrong move, and the enemies will tear you apart — they're getting smarter right alongside you

details.title: Fields of Aaru
details.short_description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

details.title: Pizzapoly
details.short_description: PIZZAPOLY is a chaotic co-op pizza restaurant game where you cook, serve, make deliveries, and survive the rush in a lively city. Run your pizzeria with friends, keep your customers happy, and grow your small shop into a local favorite.

details.title: False Echo
details.short_description: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

details.title: Lost Floor — Not My World
details.short_description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

details.title: The Incentive Program
details.short_description: A dopamine-fuelled match-3 roguelite set within a surreal corporate nightmare. Rig the odds, exploit the system, and unleash impossible combos as you fight to escape the program.

details.title: Super Chasm Hunter
details.short_description: An unforgiving extraction-roguelite adventure. Gear up and descend alone into the Chasm, fighting enemies and searching for loot. Take risks for better rewards, or extract and return home with what you've earned to sell, craft, decorate, and farm.

details.title: Where Giants Fall
details.short_description: Fight your way from desperate survival to overwhelming power in a 3D fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite. Combine weapons and active abilities into devastating builds, outmaneuver swarms and bring down towering giants. Take on greater danger for richer rewards.

details.title: KAGE
details.short_description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend 👹

details.title: Void Hunters
details.short_description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

details.title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
details.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

details.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
details.short_description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

details.title: Sovereign Strike: Submarine Supremacy
details.short_description: Become the captain of a Los Angeles-class attack submarine. Strike without warning, sink enemy ships with different torpedoes, dominate the global rankings, and explore a living underwater world packed with historical wrecks and forgotten secrets. Fast, tactical, and fun submarine warfare.

details.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
details.short_description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

details.title: Army of the Potomac
details.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

details.title: Susia - Wolf Life Simulator
details.short_description: Live the fun life of a wolf! Find a mate, start a pack, hunt together and survive in the wild! Befriend other packs or defeat them to become the sole wolf pack. Adventure through the island and settle down or keep moving, it's all up to you!

details.title: Warband
details.short_description: Warband is a wave-crusher, boss-rusher and mystery-busting roguelite. Choose your commander, recruit for your warband and stock up at the shop to create unique combinations every run whilst fighting off waves of enemies and bosses a plenty. Can you turn the tide and get Thornhallow back on its feet?

details.title: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
details.short_description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

details.title: Outer Empires 2
details.short_description: A top-down space MMO where every action shapes a persistent, player-driven galaxy. Trade, fight, explore, and colonise as you build your empire. Run supply chains, wage faction wars, and customize ships in a living economy driven by real supply and demand.

details.title: Lurking
details.short_description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

details.title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
details.short_description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

details.title: Green Inferno
details.short_description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

details.title: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
details.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

details.title: Starting a Village from Zero
details.short_description: “This is your own little village.”You are a familiar summoned by the apprentice witch Lily. In her place, build houses and create a thriving village.A new kind of “garden world × roguelite × turn-based strategy” game.

details.title: Unnatural Worlds
details.short_description: Innovative yet familiar real-time strategy game in development. Grand-scale RTS game played on maps/planets of any 3D shape. It emphasizes strategy, base building, logistics, and reduces micro-management of individual units.

details.title: Last Life
details.short_description: Last Life is a breathtaking adventure game set in NeoNova, a cyberpunk city where high technology and dark secrets intertwine. Our protagonist, a cute cat controlled by players, will embark on a mysterious journey to find their lost lover.

details.title: As One We Survive
details.short_description: Survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge resources, build up a homestead, form a community, and defend yourself against a lawless world in a challenging survival sandbox.

details.title: Bluff or Bust
details.short_description: Bluff or Bust is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Persian Gol ya Pooch, where players hide and track a Goal ball using observation, intelligence, and reading body language.

details.title: Courier Beware
details.short_description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

details.title: Caravan Bazar
details.short_description: Caravan Bazar is a chaotic co-op physics adventure in a procedurally generated world. Find precious loot, load it into your cart, punch gnomes, fight trolls, repair broken wheels. Try to survive and reach the end. Complete missions, fly on gliders and live the life of a goblin.

name: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]

details.title: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]
details.short_description: A comedic meta Visual Novel with a cinematic presentation and an interactive world where everything responds to your clicks, while you and the characters constantly blur the boundaries between the story, the creative process, and reality itself.

details.title: My Demon Academia
details.short_description: Raise a runt into the King of Demons, battle its siblings and overthrow the Demon King. Power is earned. Family is optional.

details.title: Perplexicube
details.short_description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

details.title: import robots
details.short_description: Program robots in Python to collect the resources scattered across each planet. You never control them directly. You write the code, hit run, and watch it work. No programming experience needed, just learn as you play.

details.title: RED RESET
details.short_description: RED RESET a thrilling fast-paced combat, story-driven adventure where you come across memorable characters in a world where not everything is as it seems. Experience a history filled with secrets only the keen-eyed will unveil. Following chapters will be available for purchase soon.

details.title: Escape from Tower
details.short_description: Escape from Tower is a hardcore first-person extraction shooter set in the fallen realm of Grivion. Gear up, enter the raid, outfight rival squads and scavengers with your wands and loot the ruins. Reach an extraction and it's yours. Die, and Grivion keeps it all.

details.title: Chronicle of Gods
details.short_description: You are one god in a pantheon of rivals. On living worlds of wandering peoples, rising cities and warring realms, gods compete for faith and mortals toil. Older than any realm, the Chronicle remembers the deeds of mortals and gods alike. Can anyone prove which were yours?

details.title: Sarmatian Heroes
details.short_description: Sarmatian Heroes is a turn-based strategy RPG where you explore the ancient world, develop heroes with unique skills, command armies, and build fortified cities your way. Fight tactical hex-based battles in the open field and defend your custom-built cities during sieges.

details.title: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys
details.short_description: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys is a cozy desktop idle game where every click and keystroke boosts your high-speed train. Travel through scenic countryside with adorable animal passengers, enjoy local dishes, and receive beautiful postcards along the way!

details.title: Houston, We Have a Spungus
details.short_description: A living space fungus is eating our colonies, and it grows back faster than you can shoot it. Build turrets, call in orbital strikes, combine flamethrowers, tiny suns and lightning, and hold the line until HQ nukes the source.

details.title: Bottled Gleams
details.short_description: A cozy incremental idle game for your desktop. In the Cat Squeeze bottle, scoop up and pet a cat hunting for dried fish. In the Deck of Harvest bottle, moles mine and ship their haul for coins. Tap keys or click to boost output. Spend idle earnings on capsules for skins, weather and décor.

details.title: Whisperborne
details.short_description: Turn-based collection JRPG on a continent the gods walked away from. Gather the lost heirs of the Sword-King, build a ten-slot weapon board for each of six elements, and raid alongside up to 30 players against the things still walking through Mira.
developers: Liufenyu Games 六分鱼游戏工作室

details.title: THE IRON GAMES
details.short_description: The Iron Games is a medieval battle royale where 24 players fight to the death. Loot armor and weapons, build unique combinations to become as strong as possible, and fight to be the last team alive.

details.title: COILBREAKER
details.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

details.title: Temporal Minesweeper
details.short_description: Reason across time: a cell that is safe now may be a mine the next moment. With only the clues and rules, solve the puzzle step by step — without ever guessing. Combined rules build on one another for a pure brain-teaser.

name: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE

details.title: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE
details.short_description: Explore Yokohama through real-world photographs and brawl with biker gangs in giant robots! A dramatic action-adventure following a coup led by the city’s “Mobile Biker Gangs.”

details.title: Mame, Kana Desktop Companion
details.short_description: Learn hiragana and katakana without sitting down for it. Mame is a desktop companion who turns your idle moments into tiny, painless reviews: spaced-repetition drills for kana and vocabulary, with no streaks and no guilt. A study buddy in the corner of your screen.

details.title: The Inkwell
details.short_description: Monitor. Identify. Purge. Watch haunted cartoon feeds, identify entities by the anomalies they leave behind, and perform precise exorcisms. Keep the corruption contained, or the broadcast will claim you next.

details.title: Doji Run: Stock Market 3.0
details.short_description: Welcome to Stock Market 3.0. DOJI RUN is a real-time cyberpunk stock market roguelite deckbuilder: play chips onto a live 60-second chart, draw the lines the price bounces off, pump it, short it, and beat the boss the Exchange sends every Friday. 100+ edge chips. One rigged market.

details.title: MINES SET!
details.short_description: The roguelike minesweeper. MINES SET! is a satisfying puzzle game where you open an endless board, find game-changing sponsors and set off huge combos.

details.title: Omega Transmission
details.short_description: Omega Transmission is a short PSX-styled action-platformer, set in a dystopian future where AI has taken over civilization. Humanity's last chance is a secret network deployed through antennas on the tallest skyscrapers of the Megalopolis. Activate the antenna in each city to enable the revolution.

details.title: Taco Truck Simulator
details.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

name: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop

details.title: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop
details.short_description: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

details.title: Whispers
details.short_description: Whispers is a psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned hospital, investigate its dark secrets, and follow the final footage of a missing vlogger. Listen for unsettling whispers, uncover clues, and navigate a reality where you can no longer trust what you see or hear.

details.title: Railminer
details.short_description: Turn a tiny drill into a massive mining machine. Extract resources, sell your haul, and expand your train with cutters, lasers, rockets, and drones. Every run pays for your next upgrade in this incremental mining game.

details.title: Dragopocalypse
details.short_description: In Dragopocalypse, you play as a giant, dragon girl who destroys towns and plunders ingredients to keep her café afloat... Using their immense power, bring destruction to different worlds...while also bringing delicious ingredients to the café!

details.title: Bonaparte 1789 AD
details.short_description: The game of power, intrigue and freedom. Europe, 1789: lead France, Prussia, Austria, Russia or Great Britain through revolution and war. Rule month by month, keep your estates and rival courts in check, forge alliances and fight hex battles – all the way to an imperial crown or your downfall.

details.title: No Light at Sea
details.short_description: Turn an abandoned lighthouse into your last refuge. Salvage, fish and craft alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Brave the storms, rebuild floor by floor and uncover what lurks behind the legends of Brittany. Bring back the light. Before you lose your bearings.

details.title: Crown Me Again
details.short_description: Defend against waves of adventurers, collect tons of loot, create powerful builds and climb your way back to the top of the ladder as the fallen Skull King. Incremental Clicker meets Loot-Driven Action RPG.

details.title: Company Coal
details.short_description: Have you ever yearned for the mines? No? Too bad. Welcome to the Consolidated Coal & Iron Company family! Dig coal, meet your quotas, and try to pay down a debt that grows by the day. Solo or online co-op, for your convenience.

details.title: CORD:EX MAGIAS
details.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelite where your hand is the puzzle. Weave your cards into Cores and unleash combo attacks. Explore a 2.5D world and meet every telegraphed strike head-on until it BREAKs. When hearts resonate, strike as one with up to five companions and face the truth at the end of five tales.

details.title: My Cat Is a Maid!
details.short_description: A short, slice-of-life romance visual novel. As an anime merch shop clerk, you meet a cat-eared maid "cosplayer" while running an errand for your manager. Her request? Adopt her! Wait—she’s a real catgirl?! Your cozy life with an adorable catgirl begins!

details.title: Harmony Strike
details.short_description: A party-based survivors-like where you lead a whole party of heroes instead of a single character. Each boss you defeat adds a new hero to your team, heroes fighting side by side combine their elements, and dozens of runes and relics shape every run.

details.title: Tea House: One More Glass
details.short_description: Your father left you a traditional teahouse and a debt you have to close. Brew tea, keep up with orders, keep your regulars happy and look after your family. Four seasons, match days and a family waiting at home. Run the teahouse well and grow the shop before the debts bury you.

details.title: Elancia Replay Online
details.short_description: A free-to-play 2D MMORPG in development, with combat, gathering, crafting, and trading planned. Early Access is targeted for mid-to-late March 2027. Follow development and help shape the game through your feedback.

details.title: Smash & Settle
details.short_description: A cozy idle game about smashing and settling. Break open trees, rocks and ore, build huts and kitchens, give every villager a job and let your islands run themselves. When the purple corruption creeps in, gather your soldiers and clear its dungeon.

details.title: Learn Abroad: Japanese
details.short_description: Learn Japanese through a cozy study-abroad simulation. Attend guided classes, practice with interactive activities, and complete homework to earn money. Explore Shibuya, recharge at cafés and ramen shops, and build a daily routine around learning something new.

details.title: The Last Inn
details.short_description: Welcome to The Last Inn — become the innkeeper! Build a refuge on the Radiated Continent. By day, serve guests, farm and raise livestock; by night, hunt, scavenge and gather ingredients. Recruit companions as helpers or lovers. Build an oasis and unravel the mystery over three great shelters…

details.title: Dragon's Tear
details.short_description: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

details.title: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion
details.short_description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories. Explore the Hundred Acre Wood, unravel secrets and make decisions that can change the course of events.

details.title: Slavlands: Tribes at War
details.short_description: Build a Slavic stronghold from a few huts, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

details.title: Tidy Up Bukkos!
details.short_description: Hope you had fun making a mess by throwing all the Bukkos around because you're not going anywhere before putting everything back to its place! Tidy up this eccentric library and its puzzle shelves in this comedy oriented organizing game.

details.title: Fronts of Steel
details.short_description: Fronts of Steel is a pausable real-time operational wargame on WWII's Eastern Front. Draw battle plans on a staff map and command divisions to break enemy lines, cut supply routes and close encirclements. Exploit terrain, keep troops supplied and choose when to advance or withdraw.

details.title: Dirty Dispatch
details.short_description: Dirty Dispatch is a management game where you dispatch emergency teams across an isometric city while pulling the strings of its criminal underworld. Respond to calls, expand your operation, and face the consequences of the risks you create.

details.title: My Little Market
details.short_description: Grow it, stock it, sell it. Run a farm and a market side by side in this farming and shop management sim. Plant and harvest your fields, fill your shelves, serve customers at the checkout, and hire staff to keep up. Every harvest pays for your next field, shelf, or expansion.

details.title: Emanet: What Was Left Behind
details.short_description: Datça, 1987. Run a seaside left-luggage counter: compare claim tickets, items and the ledger, catch the lies and decide who walks away with what. By night, chase Elif, who vanished seven years ago, through crayon-drawn dreams that regain their colour as you draw near.

details.title: One Million Bolts
details.short_description: Take industrial machines apart as a robot worker, solo or with up to 3 friends. Unscrew bolts, cut welds and recover valuable parts. Upgrade your tools, deploy robot helpers and bring heavy loads to dispatch in a first-person dismantling simulator with progress you can see.

details.title: Eternal Xiuzhen
details.short_description: This is a cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

details.title: Odd Rock Out
details.short_description: You're locked out, and your spare key is inside a fake pebble somewhere among 5,000 real ones. Pick them up, shake them by your ear and listen for the one that rattles. A short, quiet game about patience: no upgrades, no countdown. Solo or with up to four friends.

details.title: ELYSIUM
details.short_description: ELYSIUM is a next-gen third-person MMORPG forged by Mercenary Games. Explore a living open world, AI companions & step into realm Full Sandbox Roleplay (RP) with a living economy Free to play with built-in purchases and a self-contained in-game economy — your progression, your ecosystem, your story!

name: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game

details.title: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game
details.short_description: Every leap brings you closer to glory… or back to the beginning.

details.title: Dirty Dogs
details.short_description: An online party game for 3 to 10 players. Among Us meets Cluedo, in a dog park. Mark your territory, sniff out the strays in disguise, and argue it out at the pack meeting.

details.title: Stock Baron
details.short_description: Stock Baron is a strategy sim set in a fictional stock market. Become a market titan with vast capital, superior intel and an arsenal of trading tactics. Your moves sway prices, while other market players seize their chances. Enter a battle of wits amid fear and greed, and make your fortune!

details.title: Harvestin Season
details.short_description: Harvestin season is a chaotic 1-4 player online co-op. It's almost harvestin season, and you know what that means? Fertilize the Crops, inject steroids into your livestock, and by nightfall SLAUGHTER THEM ALL.

details.title: DUSTY CANVAS: Restore the Masterpiece
details.short_description: DUSTY CANVAS is a meditative game about restoring genuine works of art. Clean and restore paintings, unlock new tools, and discover interesting facts about masterpieces and their artists.

details.title: Blade & Barrel
details.short_description: A roguelike action game where you fight a multitude of different enemies, each ruling over their own room. Use your sword and gun to clear out each room, allowing you to purchase upgrades. Each enemy is more difficult than the last, so play tactically. You only get one life, so play smart!

details.title: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
details.short_description: Ever wonder how a GPU draws a triangle? In Hello Triangle, you build one yourself. Wire comparators, adders, and multipliers into graphics hardware, press Run, and watch your circuit draw the screen pixel by pixel—from a single triangle up to a rotating 3D cube.

details.title: Glimtide
details.short_description: A tiny island of jelly creatures that lives on its own, for everyone at once. Glims eat, sleep, fall in love, build villages and pass their skills to their babies. Watch them, bring a treat, adopt a favourite, design your own species, or drop a banana peel.

details.title: Joker's Wild
details.short_description: A blackjack roguelike deckbuilder. Build wild Joker combos, strike risky pacts with the House's Boss dealers and beat the House, one hand at a time.

details.title: Smoothie Chaos
details.short_description: A co-op slime restaurant game for 1 to 6 players. Raise slimes in your garden, feed them strange things to see what they evolve into, then blend them into smoothies for a dining room full of hungry humans and robots.

details.title: Gembound
details.short_description: Roguelite match-3 RPG where the board is dealt from your gem satchel. Build your deck, match gems, and cast spells.

details.title: HAZPIT
details.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

details.title: EconoCity
details.short_description: A shared-world city builder and economy game. Buy land, lay roads, build block by block, sell power and water, and set your rent. Every rival is a real player, every price was set by one, and the city keeps running when you log off.

details.title: CRUMBKINS
details.short_description: A 1–4 player physics-based co-op heist comedy about tiny, hungry thieves. Climb giant furniture, steal food for picky clients, and decide: deliver the loot, throw it to a friend, or eat a pepper and shoot fireballs.

details.title: Dear Maid
details.short_description: I spent every penny I had and signed up for 60 monthly payments on a maid robot. Then the world ended.

details.title: Too Angry to Clean
details.short_description: A co-op destruction game for 1-4 players where the best weapon against the undead is a falling house. Tear down walls, towers and castles with magic and bury undead hordes under the rubble. Level up and unlock new spells. Set records and find out who’s strongest in an arena you can wreck too.

details.title: SLASHER NIGHT
details.short_description: A single-player VR slasher simulator. Stalk targets through Redcastle, strike with hands-on weapons and face physical NPC reactions. Choose your approach and survive escalating resistance as witnesses flee and authorities respond.

details.title: Roadworn
details.short_description: Roadworn is a dark fantasy sandbox RPG. Lead a squad across a new world of rival states, wild factions and bandits, get drawn into intrigue around the thrones, fight turn-based hex battles and rise from nobody to legend

details.title: Deadline Detective
details.short_description: An offbeat retrofuturistic deduction game: build your career across hundreds of investigations. For each, you have 48 hours and one accusation. Question and confront suspects, rise through the ranks, and unlock new tools. The same mysterious signature keeps appearing: the Archivist’s.

details.title: Tiny Club Manager
details.short_description: Lead a tiny club from the Sunday League to the top of the world. Watch every match in a living pixel-art stadium, shout orders from the touchline, train your squad with cards earned from what went wrong, and grow your ground from a roped-off pitch into a roaring arena.

details.title: Boomside
details.short_description: A roguelike twist on Minesweeper. Dig up houses, signal towers and parks for points, chain power plants into huge multipliers, and read every hint to steer clear of the gas mains. Hire helpers, build your combo, and secure all eight key sites to redevelop the district.

details.title: Mini Hotel Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own hotel in a charming miniature world. Design rooms, arrange furniture, hire staff and care for your guests. Grow at your own pace, from your first hotel to new properties.

details.title: MALMORT
details.short_description: A first-person tower defense set in the Louisiana bayou, 1850. The dead are rising from the black water. Choose one of four heroes, build traps and turrets on stilted walkways, and fight the horde yourself to protect the last totem holding back the evil. Solo or 2-player co-op.

details.title: OUTIS
details.short_description: A 1–10 player PvE/PvP rules-horror game. Follow the rules of the urban legend—or deceive them—to survive and escape. The objects you bring back from inside the legend will be used to advance technology for humanity's survival.

details.title: Pack Goblin
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion and card collector. A little goblin lives above your taskbar. Your typing and clicks fill its meter, then it sneaks off and brings back booster packs. Rip them open, chase foil legendaries, fill your binder and decorate its yard

details.title: Hide and Freak
details.short_description: A goofy online ghost hunt, a seeker with a magic lantern, and a whole room of ghosts hiding in plain sight, posing, dancing and sneaking up behind you. Rainy graveyard, PS1 look, up to 16 players with room codes.

details.title: Blunderball
details.short_description: Arcade football where the ball sticks to whoever touches it. Dash to steal it, shoot it along the line you push it, and throw your character's magic: a hat that becomes a hole, a slowed-down world, two decoys. 1v1 or 3v3 with friends or bots. Three minutes, at least one blunder.

details.title: Open Boat: Charter Fishing Simulator
details.short_description: You're the captain now. Take paying customers out on simulated real-world waters, find the bite with real fishing knowledge, cast a few yourself if you want, and turn the small skiff into the best charter boat on the dock. Fill the bucket, rain or shine.

details.title: CROST : Crown, Coin & Steel
details.short_description: 권력은 왕관에, 살림은 금화에, 힘은 강철에 있다. 왕관 없는 왕국 아르덴의 지휘관이 되어 부대를 이끌고 곳간을 채워라. 마법 없는 사실적인 후기 중세 전쟁 전략 게임.

details.title: DeepSteep
details.short_description: DeepSteep is a fast-paced action arcade shooter set in the Void, in which world yet not exist, break Chaos and bring back Order.

details.title: OFF SOUNDINGS
details.short_description: A trading and sailing RPG where you buy and sell in port, schedule your crew on the voyage, and aim your broadsides at sea. When the hulls collide, boarding becomes a card battle fought by the sailors you raised.

details.title: Little Chefs
details.short_description: Little Chefs is an incremental cooking game where you forage, chop food and recruit little animal chefs from around the world that help you sell soup and buy back the deeds to their forests.

details.title: Pebbles
details.short_description: Pebbles is a cozy, hands-on puzzle game about picking up stones and putting them exactly where they belong. Fill in patterns, draw your own, or just let your imagination fill in an empty sandbox. No timers, no scores, no pressure. Just you, a pile of stones, and something nice to fill in.

details.title: The Last Elementalist
details.short_description: Master the elements in a pixel art action roguelike. Explore different weapons, armor and spellbooks, imbue them with swappable gems to reshape how each piece behaves and embark on procedural elemental expeditions.

details.title: Cathode Arcade
details.short_description: Six arcade machines, seven skill trees, seven currencies, and more than 400 upgrades. Revisit some of your childhood memories and turn them up to 11 within this escalating incremental 80s and 90s neon-inspired arcade game.

details.title: I'll Keep It
details.short_description: I’ll Keep It is a first-person management game about running a neglected Mediterranean getaway. Welcome guests, plan their stays, clean, repair, restock and serve - and somehow turn the place into something worth keeping.

details.title: Goblin Backpack
details.short_description: Your backpack is your battle plan! In this solo strategy autobattler, equip summon cards to build and position your team. Swap weapons for power and melee or ranged combat. Choose unique priests, fit items into limited space, improve your build with battle rewards, advance the map, and fight bosses!

details.title: Turkish Casino Simulator
details.short_description: Your mate Kristos bet the whole country. Win it back from Demon Pokure II, Metal Emperor of Hell. One week, 15 real casino games, from roulette and blackjack to craps, Sic Bo and tavli, solo or with up to 19 friends. Lose and Hell takes the country.

details.title: Roguelette
details.short_description: Build your own luck in a roulette roguelike. Choose three bets, lock useful results, and reroll the rest. Upgrade your table, change number colors with tricks, and stack charms to beat rising score targets.

details.title: Curious Paws: Pawsitive Journey
details.short_description: Embark on a cozy journey through vibrant isometric dioramas! Help a curious cat repair an old steam locomotive by exploring heartwarming locations, interacting with quirky animal locals, and solving clever puzzles — completely text-free.

name: With a HEART and a GUN you [...] ASCENDed [...] to the status of the Beholder. Applaud, Praise [...] SHOOT or DIE.

details.title: With a HEART and a GUN you [...] ASCENDed [...] to the status of the Beholder. Applaud, Praise [...] SHOOT or DIE.
details.short_description: With a HEART and a GUN you [...] ASCENDed [...] to the status of the Beholder. Applaud, Praise [...] SHOOT or DIE. is a GROTESQUE FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER. Their LIFEBLOOD is your AMMO. Your AMMO is your HEALTH. Make your way to the end. ASCEND or DIE TRYING.

details.title: THE LONG FORGETTING
details.short_description: The Forgetting is eating the world behind you. Run. An ink-and-gouache chase platformer through a dying mind: four movement keys to earn, lost memories to steal back from the dark, and a wall of ink that never, ever stops.

details.title: RUG THEM ALL
details.short_description: A satirical political sim where you start as president with $1,000,000 and one term to become a billionaire. Move markets with a single post, front-run the crash, rug your own memecoin, and bet on disasters you cause - while the auditors build a file on you.

details.title: Don't Drop It
details.short_description: Carry a fragile power core to its socket with a friend, and don't drop it! Whoever holds it can't jump: throw, catch and keep passing. Swinging cranes, steam jets and crumbling floors stand in your way.

details.title: Topiary: A Pruning Puzzle
details.short_description: Grow trees into beautiful shapes in Topiary, a peaceful puzzle game about pruning and planning ahead. Cutting a branch doesn't just remove it, it changes where your tree grows next. Take your time with each puzzle, or challenge yourself to make every season count.

details.title: Taboo Village: Tokimeki Card Game
details.short_description: Play a deadly roguelite card game with a mysterious animal-eared girl in your dreams. Build melds, upgrade your cards, gain powerful abilities, and defeat bosses. Lose, and you'll never wake up—but as long as she's there, maybe staying in the dream isn't so bad.

details.title: Loop Apartment: Visitor
details.short_description: You visit an old friend, but Room 305 is empty - and the hallway outside has changed. Explore a shifting apartment through a retro interface, gather clues, and face tabletop RPG–style dice checks. Each time you lose consciousness, the building reshapes itself. Your clues carry over to the next loop.

details.title: Mato
