details.short_description: Mato is a narrative card adventure steeped in Chinese folk horror. Swipe to make choices, manage hunger and sanity, and fight grotesque creatures. Explore branching stories across cycles of death and rebirth, using what you learn to find a way off the mountain.

details.title: SumMon
details.short_description: Capture monsters and shapeshift into them, several at once. Combine their elements in turn-based battles on a hex-grid battlefield. Embark on an adventure to defeat the Summoner Masters and become one.

details.title: PumpUp Fugu
details.short_description: Tap a PumpUp Fugu and it puffs up in a huff — use that to shove the Fugu Queen out through the coral wall and set her free! 160 hand-built levels, plus more once you have cleared them. An action physics puzzler with times worth chasing.

details.title: Hunt Soul Infinity
details.short_description: Embark on an epic journey through a breathtaking world where every split-second decision can mean the difference between victory and defeat!

details.title: Drain the Galaxy
details.short_description: Thousands of space dwarves vs. one planet. The planet loses. Land, strip it bare in short runs with pickaxes, lasers and missiles, haul the loot home and grow a huge upgrade tree. You can't lose. You can only get richer

details.title: Morality
details.short_description: **MORALITY** is a psychological interactive game where every choice matters. Explore a mysterious computer, uncover hidden secrets, and make decisions that can change the course of the story. **What are you going to do?**

details.title: The Last Stash
details.short_description: Run the last shop in a post-apocalyptic town. Stock shelves, set prices, and complete contracts. Drive into an abandoned town at night, search for supplies, and fight mutants and raiders. Bring back what you find to sell in your shop or keep it for your own survival.

details.title: Stop Reading the Cards
details.short_description: Build a deck, define its priorities, and watch your strategy execute itself. In this satirical single-player roguelike, cards become parts of an automated combat system. Create absurd synergies, adapt your rules, and survive a tower that treats every run like a badly managed show.

name: ERROR: Me, Cyber Guys, and Weird Block Battles

details.title: ERROR: Me, Cyber Guys, and Weird Block Battles
details.short_description: A casual strategy game combining block-placement combat, roguelite module builds, and interactive stories for a female audience. Explore an anomalous network and conquer personalities who watch, respond to, and may even sense the real “you” as you claim your permissions.

details.title: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
details.short_description: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

details.title: NO KING IN HELL
details.short_description: Awaken as the late Demon King's children, a brother and sister with no realm of their own. Explore an HD-2D demon world, recruit monsters, and reclaim a home. Seize weakened enemies mid-battle, raise them through classes, evolution and fusion, and lead squads in a turn-based strategy RPG.

details.title: Precious nightmare
details.short_description: How do you deal with love if, every time you chase it, it ends up hurting you? That’s the question Rosa asks herself every day. One day, she works up the courage to find an answer and heads to… a police station? Dive into her worst nightmares to discover how she’s reached the situation she’s in.

details.title: Piggy Bang
details.short_description: Piggy Bang is a satisfying incremental game where you smash piggy banks to earn coins and gems, upgrade your hammer, and build your fortune. Can you expand your bank-breaking operation to infinity and beyond?

details.title: Stealthmate: A chess puzzle
details.short_description: Use chess moves to sneak past guards and plan clever escapes through handcrafted puzzles, solo or in local and online co-op. Switch to real-time chess battles, then create and share your own puzzles in the full game.

details.title: Penthouse
details.short_description: Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you (and your friends) stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat. As you do, you must find clues and use devices to discover what happened in this Penthouse. Solve the mystery of the Haunting.

details.title: All-in Tide
details.short_description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

details.title: Kalmareth: Rune Duel VR
details.short_description: A 1v1 VR magic duel fought with your hands. Draw runes in the air to cast — six strokes, no menus, no HUD. Read your opponent's motion, commit to a stroke, and strike before they finish theirs.

details.title: Idol Shell
details.short_description: Idol Shell is a retro-style FPS inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Fight relentless mechanical enemies, explore interconnected levels, uncover hidden secrets, and discover the mystery behind their creation.

details.title: Only Guns
details.short_description: It's like Only Up but with guns. Only Guns! A third person puzzle-platforming-shooter. Race against the clock! Jump, Climb and Shoot your way up through a series of realms until you reach the very top.

details.title: Warband Heroes
details.short_description: Draft a warband from 18 heroes, arm them with items and abilities between fights, then let them loose in this arena mayhem roguelike autobattler.

details.title: Astella Walker
details.short_description: Leave it to luck, or engineer the odds? Instead of cards, carve strike angles on your roulette to control probabilities. When the triple rings snap into place, your chained strikes explode. Caught between exponential loot and lethal curses, decide when to fold (STOP) and when to press on (GO).

details.title: Tetragrade
details.short_description: Embark on your own odyssey, stack hand-cut materials, watch treasures pour into the bowl and spend your rewards on the favour of ten Greek gods. Tetragrade is a compulsive block-stacking roguelite about the pleasure of a perfect fit.

details.title: Frutiverse
details.short_description: Your planet is doomed. In Frutiverse, a space game driven by orbital physics and destructible environments, you fight incoming threats, destroying asteroids or pushing them off their collision course. Gather resources and build an evacuation ship to save your fellow Fruits, alone or in local co-op.

details.title: A Million Orcs
details.short_description: Huge-scale tower defense: over a million orcs march on your keep. Wall in your town, raise towers, dig traps and place archers, spearmen and cavalry. Then sound the horn and hold, with god powers and dragon riders on your side.

details.title: Ragtag Fleet
details.short_description: Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite. Tear apart enemy ships, expose their Cores, and turn the spoils into weapons, drones, and modules. Build a makeshift fleet into overwhelming firepower.

details.title: Night Killaz
details.short_description: A multiplayer game where you either hunt or be hunted. 1 invisible vampire. 4 Night Killaz. Complete your objectives as a human, or become the vampire and take them out. The vampire feeds on mistakes. The team works together, and fights back. Can humans outsmart the invisible threat?

details.title: God Sight Road of Ashes
details.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical turn-based RPG with free-roaming exploration. Lead a band of travelers across a dangerous world, recruit companions, manage food and exhaustion, and fight strategic battles using magic and unique abilities.

details.title: ChameleonCraft MMO: Hide Your Piñatas!
details.short_description: An incremental idler MMO: Paint & hide your gold-generating piñatas while hunting & stealing others’ poorly hidden treasures in a massive persistent world! Build wealth, spend on upgrades, hide & protect your passive-income empire, customize your character, get revenge, find rare items & show off!

details.title: Deep Sea Survivor
details.short_description: Explore the ocean with adorable robots in this pixel-art bullet heaven action roguelite! Choose and upgrade diverse weapons, defeat swarms of sea creatures, and survive deadly traps. The deeper you dive, the greater the danger becomes. Create a new build on every run and survive the depths!

details.title: The One Who
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a father searching for his missing daughter in a nightmare world. Explore eerie, shifting locations, hide in the dark from unnatural creatures, and follow a mysterious voice to piece together the truth before it's too late.

details.title: HOOKLINGS
details.short_description: Hook. Swing. Boom. A fast 2.5D arena shooter about tiny round critters with grappling hooks. Swing through 3D arenas that fight back, yank rivals under the press and pop them into confetti. Play online, on the couch or against bots, and earn outfits, hook skins and rare finishes.

details.title: Pixel Xanxia
details.short_description: A pixel art cultivation RPG inspired by Idle Xanxia. Hunt spirit beasts, master techniques, rebuild your shattered Dantian, and uncover the mystery behind the attack that destroyed your cultivation.

details.title: VALD in EUROPA
details.short_description: Become Vald, the Mercenary King, and conquer an impossible Europe ruled by history's queens. Execute a captured queen, recruit her, or free her? The queens from your history books, brought to life in 1,000 watercolour-style illustrations. Strategy meets romance. 50 turns, 7 rivals, 4 routes.

details.title: Today I...
details.short_description: Try balancing your life, work, gender dysphoria, relationships, and a growingly time-consuming activist involvement in a queer association..

details.title: New World Trading Company
details.short_description: Found a trading company in the age of sail. Start with one small ship and an empty cove, hunt pirates and smugglers on a realistic sea, and grow a mighty fleet and a thriving harbour town. A single-player naval strategy game where wind, waves and every broadside matter.

details.title: Townfall
details.short_description: A city-building survival game centered around a dynamic moving world. Expand your town into new lands as old ground crumbles into an endless abyss! Lead your town through perils, stave off the dangers of the world and ensure the survival of your people before its townfall.

details.title: Space Query 2
details.short_description: The real Solar System, down to the second, powered by NASA JPL data. Fly freely across 26 worlds, watch real upcoming eclipses, tear planets apart in the gravity sandbox, or relive Apollo 11 with original mission audio and film footage.

details.title: AuraFalls
details.short_description: Game night, on an island. Up to four friends meet in a seasonal hub, then dive through portals into zombie survival, races, physics bowling, duels and explosive sandcastle building. Most wins takes the cup, and every cosmetic is earned just by playing.

details.title: Feast, Flee or Starve
details.short_description: Feast, Flee or Starve is a multiplayer survival party game where stranded players must gather scarce resources, make uneasy alliances, and decide when to cooperate and when to look out for themselves.

details.title: Sumo Pixel
details.short_description: Grab three friends and shove them off the stage! A physics party brawler for up to four players, on the couch or online. Sling off ropes, smash through the floor and send your friends flying as the stage crumbles around you. Last square standing wins.

details.title: This is Ikebukuro
details.short_description: Poop without getting caught!" An absurd stealth comedy in an electronics store! Sneak past staff to drop a load in the target zones and escape undetected. Get caught or leak, and it's game over! Hide in boxes, spray away the stench, and master the art of "Defecate & Escape" to hit high scores!

details.title: Glintland
details.short_description: Glintland is a magical factory-building card puzzler. Place tiles from a deck to build enchanting production chains, light up the land, and discover a cozy world full of secrets. Each Glint is a short, satisfying journey of automation and alchemy.

details.title: Never Be Alone
details.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

details.title: Come to my party!
details.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

details.title: BLOODY HELL 2
details.short_description: Pulverize demons as a small angelic birb wielding a giant demonic hammer. Explore hell's deepest layers, and uncover the truth behind the fall of heaven in this bullet-hell metroidvania. Will you succeed, or die in the chaotic depths of BLOODY HELL 2?

details.title: Crypts Of Carith
details.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

details.title: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
details.short_description: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

details.title: Nighthold
details.short_description: Sandbox survival RPG where days are for preparation and nights are for survival. Gather resources, build and fortify your shelter, fight the Rot and raiders - solo or with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Backroom Cleaners
details.short_description: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.

details.title: Black Flame Tactics
details.short_description: A dark fantasy autobattler roguelike. Build your party and lead it to the bottom of the world, where the Black Flame burns. Every run brings new heroes, relics, mysterious events, bosses, ancient pacts and more. Brave the descent solo or with a friend in online co-op.

details.title: JOIN US
details.short_description: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

details.title: Tiny Tree Talk
details.short_description: Grow and shape bonsai trees, build tiny dioramas, and find a new sense of belonging on a wholesome 2000s internet forum, TinyTreeTalk. Enjoy full sandbox freedom or bring requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props and enjoy chill lofi beats and a nostalgic mid-2000s Japan.

details.title: Teamcrafter
details.short_description: Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build the perfect adventuring party in Teamcrafter, a cozy crafting roguelite where your heroes fight the battles, but you craft the victories. Explore serene procedural biomes, optimize your team’s build load out, and uncover the mystery of the Portals.

details.title: Gunnar Malakor
details.short_description: A FULLY BLIND-ACCESSIBLE AUDIO ADVENTURE You are Gunnar Malakor: thief, failed mercenary and escape artist. Sentenced to death in the dungeons of Lysanthir castle, you'll need cunning, improvisation and a little luck to break out and leave the kingdom.

details.title: Redneck Redemption
details.short_description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

details.title: Centuries
details.short_description: Grow a small camp into a thriving medieval settlement. Shape its expansion, develop its economy and care for the households that call it home. Balance your ambitions with the everyday needs of a growing community.

details.title: Shuffle Farm
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where farming meets the arcane. Build powerful synergies, master production chains, explore uncharted lands, and face formidable challenges - all with the help of a mysterious god. Or just chill and plant some crops... you can do that too!

details.title: Village vs Rock
details.short_description: Village vs Rock is a physics based incremental game about crushing mountains. Raise your village of orcs to wage war against the rock that keeps popping up in your backyard. Hurl mammoths, unleash spells, and upgrade everything to DESTROY THE ROCK!

details.title: Lost Arsenal
details.short_description: Lost Arsenal is a challenging movement-heavy melee action game. Stylishly maneuver through areas by teleporting to your thrown weapons, and use each weapon's unique power to carve your way through a summoner's invasion.

details.title: Forest Keeper Lookout
details.short_description: Take a temporary job as a forest ranger deep in the mountains. Complete daily tasks, maintain equipment, and enjoy the quiet, until strange things start to happen.

details.title: The Mirage Project
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game where you explore an abandoned research facility, travel through different timelines using a broken time machine, and uncover shifting, liminal spaces created by the Mirage. Survive evolving shadow-like entities and uncover the facility’s dark secrets.

details.title: Hextalia
details.short_description: Build the path. Then defend it. Hextalia is a hex-based tower defense where you control the battlefield. Shape enemy routes with your towers, combine abilities to discover your own build combinations, and survive levels that punish careless builds.

details.title: Bookie
details.short_description: The horse racing roguelike, with cards. Bookie is a fast paced deckbuilder game, in which you build your own stable of horses and try to figure out which one will win the race. Manipulate the odds by modifying the cards and buying game-changing charms that will help you get all the trophies!

details.title: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
details.short_description: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!

details.title: LOVE WMC
details.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

details.title: Whale Life Simulator
details.short_description: Experience the life of a whale. Hit the streets, earn cash, and pour massive amounts of money into an online game. Use your maxed-out account to crush other players!

details.title: Shutter Story
details.short_description: Examine a family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

details.title: Cassette Beasts 2002
details.short_description: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

details.title: miniopolis
details.short_description: Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Build the way you want in this resource-free city-building sandbox.

details.title: Decision Point: Battlegroup Operational Simulator
details.short_description: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

details.title: Bottled Ambition
details.short_description: A Prohibition-era moonshine sim, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Grow corn, mix your own blends and run them through a copper still. Smuggle the jugs past the sheriff and rival bootleggers by truck or on horseback. Hire workers and build your empire.

details.title: Age of Balls
details.short_description: Lead your own countryball, grow your army and build up your nation. Besiege cities, expand through diplomacy and conquer the world!

details.title: Coal Rush 1990
details.short_description: Eastern Europe, 1990s. Janusz is 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and an inherited coal mine might be his only way out! Dig for resources, hire workers, build machines, and automate production. Start with a shovel, build a mining empire, and pay off your debt before the creditors come knocking!

details.title: Stay Human
details.short_description: Stay Human is a chaotic co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players. You’re part of an ambulance crew in a city overrun by a zombie apocalypse. Take emergency calls, rescue bitten people from zombies, and rush them to the hospital before they turn.

details.title: Demon Balls: A Bowling Roguelike
details.short_description: A bowling roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit demons, deal with devils, cast spells and feed worms to your ball. Roll up through the heavens and kill God.

details.title: Ember Citadel
details.short_description: Build a colony on the ruins of a lost machine age, master black powder and hold the walls. Somewhere out there, the Citadel is looking for you. Hold out alone or with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Ex Simulacris
details.short_description: Challenge the Simulation in this sci-fi autobattler. Recruit a growing roster of unique Operators, design fireteams, deploy them into increasingly difficult battle sims, gather data, upgrade, and try again. Log in, Administrator – the Simulation awaits.

details.title: Fraggers
details.short_description: Fraggers is a fast-paced, chaotic first-person arena "bomber" where grenades are your only weapons! Grab your powerups and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Bring your friends for explosive split-screen and LAN multiplayer mayhem!

details.title: Grass Planet
details.short_description: Stranded on an alien planet, you must mow endless grassy hills to uncover the materials needed to rebuild your ship. Upgrade your lawnmower and uncover the mystery of the planet in this short incremental adventure.

details.title: Far Acre
details.short_description: You leave the city for an overgrown block and an old sawmill. Read each log before the blade goes in: chalk where you think the knots and the rot are, and how deep, mark your cuts to guide the blade and plan out your orders. The saw shows how well you read, and the boards build your homestead.

details.title: BENEATH PARADISE
details.short_description: Fight for Nambara in a first-person open-world action adventure. Liberate outposts, rescue civilians, and expose the Council that controls the islands.

details.title: Internet Provider 98
details.short_description: Bring the world online in an idle incremental game with a retro ’90s desktop aesthetic. Send data packets, upgrade your hardware, automate your network, and speed up research with an icon-matching minigame. Grow from your first customers to a global internet provider.

details.title: Pastel Squad
details.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! Build your team from 30+ unique members and fight with terrain and skills in real-time squad tactics. Includes three modes: Story, Missions and Roguelite.

details.title: Sundered Reach
details.short_description: Rise from cadet to commander in a living star system. Build your warband, fight real-time fleet battles, board enemy flagships and lead sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side, while something stirs at the edge of the Reach.

details.title: Taso Idle
details.short_description: Taso Idle is an incremental game where you flip tasos at recess and sell your stack for cash. Rip open snack packs for rare tasos, buy upgrades and leave the collecting to your little brothers. The bullies can take everything but your name. Start with a bottle cap, become the Schoolyard Legend.

details.title: Just Another Soldier
details.short_description: Die, and rise again as just another soldier in this Trojan War action roguelite tower defense. Hold Troy's walls against thousands of Greeks and mythic monsters. Pick level-up cards, call on the gods, fire siege engines yourself, then upgrade your fortress for good with Soul Gems.

details.title: Motorsport Dynasty Manager
details.short_description: Build your team, develop your cars and bikes, and call race strategy from the pit wall. Choose from 70 championships across seven motorsport disciplines, balancing race-day decisions with the work that shapes your next season.

details.title: Kick Rocks
details.short_description: Kick a rock until it's round. That's the game. Then sell it, buy better shoes and kick a harder one.

details.title: Spexl
details.short_description: Spexl is an incremental game where you destroy planets made of pixels and collect every particle they’re made of to upgrade your ship. Fly, shoot, and get back to base before you run out of fuel. The challenge is to push farther and farther out.

details.title: Booster Beast
details.short_description: Booster Beasts is an incremental pack-smashing game. Equip up to six mythical beasts, and unleash all their skills with every strike. Combine elemental bonuses, evolve your beasts, and build the firepower to crack tougher packs and take on bosses.

details.title: Ironclads 3
details.short_description: A hardcore historical naval combat sim set in the Age of Iron & Steam, built around meticulous historical detail. Command a warship and its specialist crew as they man guns, operate steam propulsion and shipboard machinery, keep the vessel battle-ready, and fight fires and flooding under enemy fire.

details.title: Entropy - The Struggle Of Fate
details.short_description: Every eighty years, eight Ollutir warriors appear at the edge of the Frainnan village, sent by God, they believe, to fight and die. Varnel was meant to die with them. Instead, the man who defeated him let him live, and now a strange Frainnan girl keeps visiting his cell.

details.title: The Endless Museum
details.short_description: Wikipedia turned into a museum you can walk around, where every article is a room and every link is a doorway. You can wander wherever the links take you and read about each room as you go, race friends between articles, or look for the secret passages, puzzles and hidden rooms behind the bookcases.

details.title: Solaria Moon Remake
details.short_description: A 3D space adventure aboard the Taranis, a huge cargo ship, full of puzzles to solve and secrets to uncover. Already own Solaria Moon? The remake is free for you.

details.title: Same Day Tycoon
details.short_description: Someone just ordered a giant rubber duck, and you promised it today. Every order is a real parcel: follow it from the shelf to the box, onto the van and up to the doorstep. Build the warehouses, hire the crew and send vans, trucks and trains across North America to keep your promise.

details.title: Alt-Tab Legend
details.short_description: An incremental multiboxing game where you run every game at once on one PC. Pull games from blind boxes, pack hardware into a grid case, place plugins on your keyboard, and raise Keysprites to hit keys for you. No game over, just more games every night.

details.title: 坠于浮华的赤色神女
details.short_description: 世人只知神女可召神，却不知神女每晚都能闯入神使的梦里，甜蜜与执念，旖旎情愫在此交织。穿越到架空神话里，和只属于你的神使们开启一段浪漫缱绻的故事。

details.title: Rainfed
details.short_description: Build and run your own farm in a pixel-art management sim. Grow crops, breed livestock and turn your harvest into products to sell. Buy land and machinery, hire workers and set plans to keep the work moving. Expand the business, shape the farm and try not to go broke.

details.title: UNHOLY PEPPERONI
details.short_description: A tiny pizzeria. A sister you love. A tragedy you can't escape. Run a pizzeria where the nights are unsettling, and every slice comes with a side of something sinister. But no matter how hard you try to keep the business, some things refuse to stay buried.

details.title: MAGICA☆REVERSI!
details.short_description: Reversi, but magical girls fire rocket launchers. Shuffle the board, flip every disc, warp in for a one-hit win. Fall behind and your comeback magic charges up. Lose the disc your character stands on and you lose on the spot. Every disc you're ahead is in-game prize money. 50 3D boards.

details.title: PaleBlueRose
details.short_description: A free-to-play online medieval city builder. Start with a founding wagon and a little grain. Grow a town, build production chains, trade with thousands of players and go to war, all in one shared world. Win by holding 90% of the world's yearly economy.

details.title: Cosa Nostra – The Dark Empire
details.short_description: From errand boy to godfather: build a criminal empire of protection rackets, moonshine and smuggling in a rain-soaked city, buy officials, make deals or wage war with six families and keep the Heat down. Turn-based mafia strategy with voice-over and multiple endings.

name: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!

details.title: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!
details.short_description: Become the curator of a vast, magical museum! In this relaxing game, find the right place for over 3,000 paintings, restore damaged works and uncover their fascinating stories. Upgrade your curator, work faster and unlock new galleries!

details.title: Voretsk
details.short_description: Voretsk is a 3D First Person Extraction Shooter where you play as civilians trapped in the middle of a war zone. Alone or with a friend venture into the cruel Voretsk Zone, fight or hide, scavenge and get back. Complete missions, uncover a way out, and leave the Zone behind and reclaim your life.

details.title: PAIN(T)
details.short_description: You have one job: paint the wall yellow. All of it. PAIN(T) is a co-op dystopian comedy for 1-4 colleagues sharing one shaky lift, with proximity voice chat. Whoever drives it ruins everyone's stroke. Buy bigger rollers, and try not to ask what the doors are for.

details.title: SALUS Protocol
details.short_description: You and up to three friends are part of an independent contract crew in second-hand war surplus mechs, doing the dirty work for large corporations. SALUS Protocol is a co-op roguelite horde shooter. Fight against thousands of enemies, build reputation and unlock better parts.

details.title: Kesselgrid
details.short_description: Turn-based grand strategy on a hex map, set in the First and Second World Wars. Run a nation's industry, politics and diplomacy, command its armies, fleets and air force, and break the enemy front. Play alone against the AI, in co-op or online against your friends.

details.title: Sprinkle Gnomes
details.short_description: Sprinkle Gnomes is a cozy first-person co-op game about bringing the scorched badlands back to life. Find hidden wells, build watering automations and ride camels across the dry land until grass springs up again. Play solo or team up with friends and turn every dusty corner green.

details.title: I Missed the Apocalypse 2
details.short_description: You missed the apocalypse. Now it’s up to you to take back the Earth. Gather, craft and build your base with your flying companion Eddy, survive Alien attacks every night, free mind controlled humans and smash every Alien Heart, from Scandinavia to the whole world.

details.title: Cleared for Profit: Airline Management
details.short_description: Run an airline in one evening. Open routes across North America, set every fare and buy or lease every aircraft, then watch the month play out. Every number explains itself, Corvane Air fights back, and you can go broke. Buy once, no timers.

details.title: Bricked
details.short_description: Bricked is a city-building sandbox set on a tabletop above the clouds. Build a toy-brick city piece by piece, set kaiju, mechs and armies against each other, and watch every strike tear it apart. Put every brick back with one click, then fly, drive and ride through the city you made.

details.title: Find The Clover
details.short_description: Sweep a meadow of a million clovers. Upgrade your cursor, send bees and robots to harvest, catch leprechauns and hunt for the legendary rainbow clover.

details.title: GALLOP
details.short_description: Ride, explore and puzzle your way across a wild medieval land with your friends. Reach the far-off castle, rescue the queen and return her to the king – past bandit ambushes, untamed nature and the occasional friendly shove off a cliff.

details.title: Oath of the Huan
details.short_description: 100,000+ simulated soldiers on screen: Take the reins as the Son of Heaven in this massive stylized RTS with visuals inspired by Chinese traditional paintings and groundbreaking real time simulation. Titans, cataclysmic world-shattering events.

details.title: Cannonade
details.short_description: A stylized Napoleonic RTS: smoke, violins and blood. Micromanage everything or delegate to your trusted lieutenants. React and battle against an adaptive and smart AI opponent in multiple challenging campaigns.

details.title: Forged in Formation
details.short_description: Round up the scattered rebels of '98 on a Crown-held Caribbean island and lead them out past redcoat volleys, charging boars, alligators and one very angry gaoler. One button snaps your crowd into Column, Line or Square. Pick the right shape in time and the danger walks straight past you.

details.title: Driftworn
details.short_description: Lead a squad of drifters through a solar system still broken by a decade old war. Fight, trade, salvage and build across the planets and moons of Sol in an open-world sandbox where nobody is the chosen one, then buy a ship and start your adventure

details.title: Couch Potato
details.short_description: Tiny Spud is a little potato who lives on your desktop. He binge-watches TV in a panel beside your work, cooks disasters, plays his retro console, takes calls from his inventor brother and wanders out onto your taskbar for a nap. You work. He couches.

details.title: Homicidy
details.short_description: Somebody had a very bad night. Now it's your shift. Scrub fifty crime scenes spotless in this cozy-macabre pixel-art cleaning game: mop, foam, vacuum and luminol your way to three stars, then spend the pay on a nicer mop. You do the crime. We do the grime.

details.title: Pirates Republic
details.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.

details.title: Stellar Girls
details.short_description: Build a K-pop group. Watch them fall for each other—or fall apart. Match-3 comebacks and intimate VN moments reveal chemistry, rivalry, trust. Your choices shape their bonds and performance. Then graduation forces an impossible choice: who stays, and who says goodbye?

details.title: Mexico 1920-1940: Heirs of the Revolution
details.short_description: A turn-based narrative political sim: govern Mexico from the presidency, 1920–1940. Build your cabinet, lobby Congress, negotiate with rebels and send troops into battle without knowing how far they’ll obey. What if Zapata had become president? Or Villa? 75 endings, from historical to far-fetched.

details.title: Planet Sim
details.short_description: Land on an untouched planet and build a factory colony that reaches the stars. Harvest, haul and produce without conveyor belts, launch rockets to orbit and the Moon, wake your colonists, defend against what lives here, and rebuild the broken colony Ark to finish the journey.

details.title: Roll Call: Hero League Manager
details.short_description: Build your superhero dream team from 888 playable characters and take on 35 bosses. Negotiate transfers, brave dangerous missions, and keep clashing egos and the payroll under control. Outthink 49 rival clubs in a turn-based management game where every roll can change your season.

details.title: Deadgate
details.short_description: Bir sözleşme al ve zombilerin istila ettiği karantina altındaki adaya gir. Ganimet topla, rakip takımlara karşı hayatta kal ve gece yarısından önce tahliye noktasına ulaş. Aksi takdirde yanında getirdiğin her şeyi kaybedersin. 32 oyunculu bir extraction shooter. Sözleşme yoksa çıkış da yok.

details.title: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners
details.short_description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, and hunt for rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically on your desktop!

details.title: Jetstream Blitz
details.short_description: Jetstream Blitz is a high-speed 2D jetpack shooter built on one rule: if you fight, you fly. Chain weapon recoil, grappling hooks, and 125 km/h aerial dives across a full-voiced roguelite arcade campaign, solo arenas, and 5v5 PvP!

name: Dragon's Keep: Tidy Up the Treasure!

details.title: Dragon's Keep: Tidy Up the Treasure!
details.short_description: Dragon’s Keep is a relaxing first-person treasure sorting game. Organize over 4,000 treasures, repair ancient artifacts, and unlock magical abilities to make sorting faster and more satisfying. Discover the secrets hidden within the dungeon, and find your way out.

details.title: Roads Taken
details.short_description: A tactical role-playing game where every adventure is new: the story, the heroes, the world and its battlefields are drawn from a single seed. Lead your company through a land at war, forge bonds that change the fight, and live with the roads you take.

details.title: One More Siege
details.short_description: One More Siege is an Incremental Strategy game with massive auto-battling armies. Plan your building placement to counter the enemy, break their ranks and destroy their castle. Every battle earns you Honor, which you can spend to upgrade your army.

details.title: Herb Z
details.short_description: The world is ending. Business is booming! Run your own survival supply shop in a zombie-infested city. Grow herbs, craft essential supplies, stock your shelves, and serve desperate survivors in this retro-inspired survival horror shop simulator!

name: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim

details.title: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim
details.short_description: A tiny guild base keeps running on your taskbar. Your adventurers push the monster horde back and bring home wood, stone and iron. Grow your facilities, set rules for crafting and selling, and the loot sorts itself. Desktop Smash! is base building and automation at the bottom of your screen.

details.title: Blitz: Last Stand
details.short_description: A top-down roguelite horde shooter. Hold one perimeter for 100 waves as one of six operators, evolve 11 weapons into Mythics and break ten bosses. A new upgrade every second level, a commander every tenth wave. Black Site ECHO-7 fell in eleven minutes. Nobody mentioned extraction.

details.title: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
details.short_description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

details.title: Totally Legal Logging
details.short_description: A co-op physics comedy about a crew of dwarves running a totally legal logging business. Fell trees with real physics, feed them to questionable machines, load the truck and get out before the forester arrives. Your friends are also a resource.

details.title: GEARSMITH
details.short_description: GEARSMITH is a pixel-art action roguelite for 1–4 players. Fight from the cellars to the desert with 14+ weapons, each with its own way to fight. Take the gear you find to the forge, socket runes into it and upgrade it into an artifact.

details.title: Musicality
details.short_description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

details.title: Moonlit Vigil
details.short_description: Moonlit Vigil is a first-person narrative horror game where you are the cemetery's new caretaker. Explore the grounds and uncover what really happens to bodies once they're buried in this atmospheric nightmare filled with jumpscares.

details.title: Legio Impera
details.short_description: Found a Roman colony, run its economy and pay your legions. Legio Impera is a city-building RTS set in Marian Rome: govern a province during the Cimbrian War, subdue Gauls and Germanic tribes, and stop the horde before it reaches Italy.

name: Summon, then build an invincible harem

details.title: Summon, then build an invincible harem
details.short_description: Spiritual Summoners-They can use the Mana in their bodies to summon spiritual people from another world. Your mother is going to travel far, and only left you a letter, and a...beautiful spirit war girl "Shirley". what are you going to do with the summoning technique of the spirit?

details.title: Plastic
details.short_description: You're a plastic soldier battling on 5 acres of backyard. Fight on foot, crew tanks, fly helicopters, and command bots in a combined-arms shooter. Capture toy cities, requisition equipment, and establish defenses as you advance toward the enemy base.

details.title: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
details.short_description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

details.title: Barely Developers
details.short_description: Build a gaming empire in this first-person, co-op game development simulator! Start in Mom's garage, create hit games, hire chaotic employees, design your own consoles, and grow into a AAA studio. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

details.title: Bono
details.short_description: A calm first-person village life and survival game. Chop wood, catch fish and collect scrap, do daily jobs for the shopkeepers to win their friendship and secrets, drive the mountain road, and get through four seasons in a small village below the mountains.

details.title: Tower Power: Wall Fall
details.short_description: Build your tower, reinforce its walls, and reduce your rival's to rubble in a turn-based fantasy card strategy. Master three resources, five distinct decks, and three paths to victory.

details.title: Halve
details.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

details.title: Into The Haunted Land
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

details.title: Barkour
details.short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

details.title: 8 More Lives
details.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Lead a mercenary company of outcast cats through a gritty procedural open world. Take contracts, count coin, bury the dead. Battle rival warbands and night horrors. You have 8 more lives - try not to waste them all.

details.title: From Misfortune Comes
details.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

details.title: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
details.short_description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

details.title: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods
details.short_description: 「TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods」 is a Touhou fangame.This is a "reverse-construction" action rogue-lite.Koishi vs. Kokoro! But as the playable character, Koishi uses various enhancement cards to continuously strengthen Kokoro. Can she ultimately defeat the Kokoro she has built up herself?

details.title: Into The Deep
details.short_description: Into the Deep is a tactical adventure RPG where you lead a troop of dwarves through a lost city. Plan turn-based battles, recruit survivors, explore catacombs, solve puzzles, and defeat dark forces to save the city.

details.title: XGUN
details.short_description: A co-op zombie extraction shooter set on a drowned Persian Gulf resort island. Loot the flooded hotels, survive the infected, and reach extraction before dark. Play online, solo offline, or split-screen on one couch - no server required.

details.title: Virtualord, The Virtual Conqueror
details.short_description: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

details.title: BUNNY-HOP
details.short_description: A first-person bhop and surf game inspired by Counter-Strike’s community servers. Hop across rooftops, ride ramps, and find out how your friend took half a second off a run you thought was clean.

details.title: FIGHT-QUEST
details.short_description: Punch, slash, and blast through hordes of fairy-tale creatures in this first-person action roguelite. Stack absurd abilities, conquer deadly arenas, and bank your hard-earned gold for new unlocks.

details.title: Productive Plants
details.short_description: Productive Plants is an idle desktop game about growing and collecting house plants that rewards productivity.

details.title: 动物城往事
details.short_description: 《动物城往事》是一款模拟真实经济的城市建设游戏。扮演被委派到偏远自治小镇的动物市长，规划你的城镇，发展工业，调整税收和补贴，完成上级的任务，吸引移民，聆听并解决各种可爱的小动物们的需求，将你的动物城从一无所有建设成繁华的大都会！

details.title: Don't duck with me
details.short_description: Cook with the fruit you kill in a cozy fantasy incremental. Cut down fruit monsters, blend them into delicious smoothies and grow your beach bar! Your goal: a boss with 1.5 billion HP.

details.title: Sarco
details.short_description: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

details.title: Bamboo Beat
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through the world of Bamboo Beat. Attack, block, and counter to the beat, and take down one formidable foe after another.

details.title: Drag and Conquer
details.short_description: A fast-paced, easy-to-learn grand strategy game. Drag your orders across the map and conquer enemy territory. Manage your economy to keep your armies supplied with troops and equipment. Play historical 20th-century scenarios or create your own in an advanced editor.

details.title: AscendiA
details.short_description: For anyone who ever dreamed of being a shonen manga hero. You wake in a strange forest, left with only a tower and one word: “Climb.” Ascendia is a pixel action roguelike where the powers you choose awaken as new skills and hidden secrets as Astras. The path you walk becomes your own ending.

details.title: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
details.short_description: Build a maze. Send an army. Win as a team. Rampartloom is a free-to-play 3v3 tower defense game where every attack grows your income. Draft a faction, defend your lane, and coordinate assaults to break the enemy team’s defenses. Play the free demo.

details.title: Magic Shop Chaos
details.short_description: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

details.title: Run Friend Run
details.short_description: A party game for 1–8 players where one races to the finish and everyone else tries to stop them! Hide traps where your friends least expect them, then send them flying when they get close.

details.title: Axolotong
details.short_description: Now that's a funny little axolotl! Make your way through this puzzle platformer by pushing and pulling with your tongue, and discover new ways to interact to uncover all the secrets hidden in this maze.

details.title: Diss Diss Discussion
details.short_description: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

details.title: Theoria: A God Simulator
details.short_description: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

details.title: BoBOTs
details.short_description: BOUNCE against your friends in this frantic 4 player physics party game! Choose your Bobot and PUSH your way to victory in different chaotic game modes. Dominate the toybox and RULE THE WORLD! Or the couch ;)

details.title: Thank you,  Next please!
details.short_description: Run a local shop in an eastern totalitarian state. Provide rations, alcohol and medicine, but watch out for fake ration cards. Deny them goods or give them what they need to survive, knowing the Ministry is watching. Help the revolution, reunite families, and bring peace to the neighborhood.

details.title: Hoverwick: Village in the Sky
details.short_description: A cozy medieval village floating in the corner of your desktop. Peek in between emails, put up a new house, plant flowers or paint a river, then get back to work. The villagers take care of the rest: they bake bread, go fishing and build snowmen, even when the game is closed.

details.title: Unextinct
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic online evolution game. Wake up as a cloned microbe at the bottom of a drowned world and evolve into a virus, a predator or something new. 180+ evolution paths, 90+ locations, riddle quests and real-time PvP with other players.

details.title: Flight Deck: Pacific 1942
details.short_description: Command a WWII carrier task force in real time. Find the enemy first, arm and launch your squadrons, plot their attack runs and survive the counterstrike. Fight six battles of 1942 by day and by night, design warships in the shipyard, share maps on the Steam Workshop and battle friends online.

details.title: The Silent Wild
details.short_description: A realistic first-person open-world survival game for one player, or two in split-screen co-op on one PC. Build with physics-based blocks, hunt, craft and cook, then hold out as creatures break through your walls, tornadoes tear homes apart and the cold freezes every drop of water.

details.title: Clanker Buster
details.short_description: Build an armed truck, wire your weapons and command your crew in this action roguelike. Raid machine-controlled ruins for supplies and survivors, bring them back to humanity’s last settlement, and unlock permanent abilities for your next expedition.

details.title: We Will Die For You
details.short_description: Destroy & defeat disease in an incremental action game where you guide a white blood cell through the human body. Fight disease, earn Protein, die, and buy permanent upgrades for the cells that follow. Unlock powerful abilities and confront disease bosses. EVERY CELL DIES. YOUR BODY REMEMBERS.

details.title: Hendichen
details.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 2 or 3 players, with real recipes and a real kitchen. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

details.title: Toss-Up
details.short_description: Heads or tails? It's time for a Toss Up! Welcome to the dungeon where every toss matters. Strategically distribute your numbers and flip your coins to claim victory. Sometimes, you'll have to risk everything!

details.title: Arcane Reckoning
details.short_description: Skill-shot wizard battles for up to 12 players. Aim every spell by hand, knock rivals into lava and the void, and survive arenas guarded by ancient bosses. Free-for-all or 2–4 teams, a spell shop between rounds, and bots that fill every empty slot.

details.title: Family Gambling
details.short_description: A first-person narrative resource management game where you gamble with your son's organs to survive. Pay your debts, manage your home, and decide how much of your family you're willing to sacrifice.

details.title: DigiDuels
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder card game that will make you remember the classic TCGs: learn the game across a classroom desk, then ride the metro into a branching run of rivals, shops, and big choices.

details.title: KICKSHIFT
details.short_description: An alternate Rocket League-like game if you are looking for a unique take on the genre, that's built with Rollback netcode.

details.title: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
details.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Tokyo, finding small sparkling things for its notebook. Pack its lunchbox and the journey shifts. It scribbles along as you type, and may leave a letter if you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of discovery and collection.

details.title: 5-Star Taxi
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

details.title: Shipping and Handling
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op delivery game about traversal and teamwork. Get a shared payload through hostile environments while navigating terrain hazards, managing limited resources, and dealing with enemies along the way. AND DONT FALL OVER!

details.title: Scaredy Cats
details.short_description: Where resource management meets dungeon crawler. Collect rare loot, strategize monster encounters, and push your luck to descend to the bottom of the dungeon!

details.title: Boopie Island
details.short_description: Build a cozy village for your Boopies! Keep them happy with swings, flowers, and plenty of cozy surprises. Assign professions to them and enjoy watching your village grow.

details.title: Dungeonery
details.short_description: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

details.title: Last Floor: Paradox
details.short_description: An elevator that doesn't obey the laws of space. Descend through impossible places, spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive whatever waits on the Last Floor.

details.title: Green Mist over Portland
details.short_description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

details.title: PrayPal
details.short_description: PrayPal is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play as an overworked god, build divine Authority decks, and squeeze faith out of mortals to survive your next performance review.

details.title: Dwarven Shift 98
details.short_description: Dwarven Shift 98 is an incremental mining game in short timed shifts. Break rock walls layer by layer, each richer than the last, and fill the screen with an explosion of ore and gems.

details.title: Silicon Architect
details.short_description: An incremental hardware engineering game with a Windows XP themed UI. Configure and optimize processor components, build your own CPU, and run automated benchmarks. Harvest telemetry and gather research funding to unlock new hardware, and scale your processing power.

details.title: Supernatural Archives：The Frontrooms
details.short_description: A first-person light psychological horror exploration game. Explore unknown spaces, observe environmental anomalies, discover hidden clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets behind the Frontrooms.

details.title: Oh, For Bugs' Sake!
details.short_description: Team up with a cute spider family in this cartoonish asymmetric co-op platformer where communication and coordination are crucial. Avoid electrified cables and dodge one extremely angry giant finger who really, really wants to squash you.

details.title: Sail On
details.short_description: A stylized pirate roguelite with asynchronous run-based PVP, where you combine projectile properties to create devastating combos and dominate the seas even after your run ends. Die loud, rebuild louder and "Sail On"!

details.title: Coldline: Disconnect
details.short_description: It's not who you are, it's what you do that matters! As an agent inside the enemy base, repair devices by solving puzzles! Plant your bug in the correct device! Listen on the radio at night and transmit critical intel. You are entirely alone in every decision, but your choices will affect everyone.

details.title: Groove Core
details.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

details.title: Disaster Crew
details.short_description: Disaster Crew is a co-op action-adventure for up to four players. Take on unusual contracts, explore locations packed with traps and obstacles, and share an adventure filled with unexpected dangers and spectacular events..

details.title: Billionaire Life Simulator
details.short_description: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

details.title: Slime to Me
details.short_description: Guide your brother's soul, trapped inside a slime, by interacting with mana sources. Solve puzzles and find the path to the portals to bring his soul back home and return it to his body. Can you find the solution with the fewest clicks in each level?

details.title: Standard Procedure
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op espionage experience where you and your friends do dirty jobs for the government.

details.title: SKEW
details.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

details.title: AI Slop TCG
details.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelike where a cheating AI drags you through a digital wasteland of twisted creatures. Build your deck, survive the chaos, and win a game that doesn’t want to be fair.

details.title: Freshly Caught
details.short_description: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. 🎣 Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

details.title: War in Asia
details.short_description: Take command of any faction in the East Asian theater of World War II (1937–1945). Govern your nation’s military, economy, and transportation through realistic simulation systems, and direct your forces via a structured chain of command across a 7 km-scale map to conduct operations.

details.title: Portal Protectors
details.short_description: Take the journey of the Portal Protector as you defend the portals to the divine realm from evil. Use strategy and skill to aid you in your defense against evil using magic, sword skills, and defensive towers. For you are the Portal Protector!

details.title: Ghost'Inn
details.short_description: GHOST'INN is a coop game up to 4 players , in which you go fishing for ghost in a charming breton style inn. Flush out spirit, capture them with your fishing rod and become rich !

details.title: Imprinted
details.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

details.title: Family Time
details.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

name: The Tidy TeaShop: Tidy Up the Tea Collection

details.title: The Tidy TeaShop: Tidy Up the Tea Collection
details.short_description: Tidy Up 2130 tea boxes with no time limits in this cosy organising game. Read the labels and study the packaging to return every blend to its proper shelf. Organise the shop and help the occasional customer find the tea they want, always at your own peaceful pace.

details.title: Pillow Punk
details.short_description: Fight waves of enemies and towering bosses in a third-person action roguelite. Spend the points you earn on the Patch Board to build your own fighting style. Play solo or bring up to three friends into online co-op.

details.title: The Last Iron Sentinel
details.short_description: A first-person zombie roguelike shooter. Humanity is down to one last shelter, and you are its last sentinel robot. Mow through hordes of 100+ zombies, freeze time to draft upgrades, turn your bullets into fire, ice or lightning, and rip chainsaws and missile packs off elites to bolt onto yourself.

details.title: Stick Wars: The Laneborn
details.short_description: A 2D stickman strategy game on three lanes. Minions and waves push on their own while you decide gold, deployments and upgrades. Allied champions, bosses that switch lanes and a 10 level campaign. The free demo has 3 levels and online 1v1.

details.title: Regret & Rewind
details.short_description: Welcome to 1989. In this retro style first-person job simulator You work alone in a tiny yellow drive-thru photo kiosk somewhere in suburban America. Customers want cassettes, family portraits, questionable passport photos... and memories they probably shouldn't keep.

details.title: Goblin Kaboom
details.short_description: A fast-paced casual auto battler. Raise your army, fortify your base and watch invading monsters splatter upon your defenses.

details.title: Farm Factory
details.short_description: Farm Factory is a cozy farming automation game. Plant six empty fields by hand, then build sprinklers, harvesters, mills, bakeries and conveyor belts until your farm runs itself. Research, upgrade, raise animals, sell on a living market and grow Grandma's farm into a factory that feeds the world.

details.title: Crafty Idle
details.short_description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

details.title: The Understack Society
details.short_description: Build a society of misfits, one card at a time. Stack cards to gather food, craft equipment and expand your settlement in this dark fantasy survival game. Recruit citizens, open mysterious parcels and explore new districts. Keep everyone fed, armed and alive.

details.title: TowerCard: Digital Edition
details.short_description: Gather resources, raise your tower across five stages, and follow Thomas on his journey through five worlds full of unforgettable characters. Play the story mode or quick matches against the AI – multiplayer arrives soon in Arcade Mode.

details.title: KEDR
details.short_description: KEDR is an extraction horror game where you take on the role of a trader in a vast underground complex. Avoid direct confrontations with monsters, search dangerous areas and rooms with extreme caution, use the creatures’ weaknesses to your advantage, and make it out of the complex alive.

details.title: Marsfall: Origins
details.short_description: A desert RTS: lead an armored expedition, build a frontier base, harvest Emburrn, command combined arms, and survive sandworms.

details.title: Dragon Jump
details.short_description: One button, one dragon, one desire. Finish every level as fast as you can to regain your human body. Practice, build or cheat using machine learning. In Dragon Jump everything is permitted.

details.title: Odyssey of Elemental Elysium
details.short_description: Five elemental realms. Decades of lore. One of the largest RPGs ever made. Experience the Odyssey of Elemental Elysium.

details.title: Alpha Draconis
details.short_description: Three civilisations, three worlds, one abandoned human experiment. Command the desert Tali and their living planetary web, the Nerros and their steam-driven exosuits, or the Phobarian hive and its bred swarms in a fully 3D real-time strategy game built on asymmetry, not reskins.

details.title: Diet Survivor
details.short_description: Survive the first day of your diet in an action-packed survival roguelike where junk food comes alive. Run, dodge, collect fruits, grab power-ups, and face dangerously delicious enemies that grow bigger, faster, and harder to avoid.

details.title: Draught King
details.short_description: The world's first pub-like. A deckbuilder where your cards are the ingredients - serve drinks to customers to meet an ever-increasing target, featuring crazy combos and insane effects.

details.title: Brute Tusk : Feral
details.short_description: Play a wild boar in an open wilderness: click to run and forage, right-click to dodge or wind up a charge—smash obstacles and send wolves flying. Eat your fill, pick evolution upgrades, and fight through four seasons to topple each land’s apex predator.

details.title: MONSTERGOTCHI
details.short_description: Feed and grow your own monster in the virtual pet game MONSTERGOTCHI! 😀 The type of pet you get depends entirely on you!😮 Explore a dangerous world, find food, and give it to them! 😍 Hurry up, IT'S HUNGRY!

details.title: Arcane Beyond
details.short_description: Arcane Beyond is a living magical world where players rise from humble spellcasters to legendary mages. Every action pushes you toward Radiance or Umbra, unlocking unique abilities, transformations, and story paths.

details.title: Matchward
details.short_description: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

details.title: SHIFTMARE
details.short_description: Stock shelves. Get promoted. Hunt your coworkers. SHIFTMARE is a competitive online party game for 2–10 players. Race to stock a supermarket, become a boss with a bat, or run and hide from the coworkers who beat you to the promotion. Be the last employee standing.

details.title: Orbit Foundry
details.short_description: Turn a handful of machines into a bustling factory around a growing star. Orbit Foundry is a space incremental idle game where you reinvest your output, research upgrades, and automate your fleet. Watch production climb as your star changes color.

details.title: Test Cricket Manager
details.short_description: Take managerial control of the National cricket team (of your choice) and prepare to take them to Glory! YOU pick and train the players, YOU hire and fire the staff, YOU choose the tactics under pressure, YOU get the glory when things go right ... but YOU take the blame when things go wrong.

details.title: Mad Combo Squad
details.short_description: The maddest combos you’ve ever seen! Mad Combo Squad is a classic, tactical in-line auto-battler featuring charming pixel-art heroes. Assemble your ultimate squad to create the perfect build.

details.title: Plants One Shot!
details.short_description: 《Plants One Shot!》 is a party game for up to 4 players. Your sect has been attacked by villains. To revive your sect and uphold justice, you must kill monsters and obtain better spells and equipment so that you can gain enough power to defeat the villains!

details.title: 再跑亿遍
details.short_description: Change & Run is a 2D side-scrolling construction simulation game. There are no shortcuts here. With the help of Code Girls, each with her own distinct personality and abilities, you will place code blocks to rebuild shattered terrain
publishers: 上海苍星昂霄网络科技有限公司

details.title: AL-SARAB
details.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game inspired by Silent Hill set in a distorted Gulf neighborhood, where familiar places turn hostile and every alley hides something wrong.

details.title: DON’T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND
details.short_description: DON'T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND! JUST DON'T DO IT! Stranded with 1-3 friends in online co-op, you have to haul your scattered gear up the mountain and build camp. The tent is heavy, nobody agrees which way is left, and something out there is listening.

details.title: Mr. Panas
details.short_description: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

details.title: Gnom
details.short_description: The largest RTS you've ever played, and it's about gnomes. Grow a colony in an enchanted forest, get through nights that get worse each time, turn gnomes into giants or into swarms of nano gnomes, then go take the rest of the forest. Online co-op for up to 4.

details.title: Red Rust
details.short_description: As a tough Soviet KGB agent you travel around the world fighting street gangs and giant mechanical monsters on direct order from Comrade Stalin.

details.title: Not a Trolley Problem!
details.short_description: A trolley-problem incremental where morals gave way to growing numbers. Instead of choosing whom to save, you throw people onto the tracks yourself, earn coins, grow an upgrade tree and hunt for rare residents.

details.title: Tiny Kitchen: Burger Edition
details.short_description: Stack, flip, and drop your way to burger glory in this cozy physics-based cooking game. Whether you’re actively grilling or letting orders wait, Tiny Kitchen is perfect for focused breaks and relaxed chaos.

details.title: Over or Under
details.short_description: You have one job: make all 10,000 toilet paper rolls in this endless restroom face the same way. Your fickle boss won't say whether he wants "over" or "under" until you finish. Plunge clogs, mop spills, and pray the final 50/50 goes your way. Get it wrong and the shift starts over.

details.title: Withstand The Horde
details.short_description: Withstand The Horde is a strategy and base-building game. Raise a walled city, recruit soldiers and hold off waves of enemies: 4,000 zombies simulated, up to 1,050 drawn on screen. Includes a guided tutorial. Build, defend, expand, and withstand the horde.

details.title: BlastMorph: Pinball
details.short_description: I took pinball and VIDEO-GAMIFIED it! Where else can you play video game bonus stages and play from INSIDE the pinball table!?

details.title: Gridpaper
details.short_description: If you're shooting more than once, you're doing it wrong. At the junction of the physical and informatic realms, Gridpaper is a high-precision FPS headshot speedrunning game where missed shots are punished. Destroy brains, harvest their Informatica for speed, and climb the global leaderboard.

details.title: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
details.short_description: “Wonder Air: Lunara’s Adventure” is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

details.title: Odyssey Bridge Quest
details.short_description: Command a starship on the edge of known space. Pick your bridge officers, keep the ship alive, and face first contacts, derelicts and diplomatic crises where every order has a cost. A text-driven captaincy sim with branching episodes and multiple endings. What kind of captain will you be?

details.title: Real Estate Investor
details.short_description: Real Estate Investor is a deep, turn-based economic simulation focused on realistic property investing. Hunt for bargains, haggle over the price, and turn run-down flats into a thriving portfolio. Sign the deed, collect the rent, quit the rat race and become a property millionaire.

details.title: Planetbase 2
details.short_description: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.

details.title: Roller Coaster Park Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your very own Roller Coaster Park! Play alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op. Design your own coasters, hire staff and serve your guests... or just mess around. There’s plenty to break, crash and blow up!

details.title: Shot
details.short_description: Stand your ground in a Western shooting gallery roguelite. Hit weak spots, shoot down incoming attacks, and combine perks into powerful builds. Face varied enemies and bosses in combat where precision, quick reactions, and every reload matter.

name: Little Beast in the Big Maze

details.title: Little Beast in the Big Maze
details.short_description: A fantastical, atmospheric Metroidvania platformer where you jump, fight, and expand your abilities to escape your exile and confront the beastly Queen who banished you. But will this fairy-tale end with you becoming a hero, or a beast?

details.title: Headwaters
details.short_description: A short fishing game early in development :-). Collect fish population samples for WDOE as you rebuild a once great public transportation network with the help of your new REALLY REALLY cool bird friends. Also unlock a bunch of new areas, fishing rods and upgrades!

details.title: Neuroma
details.short_description: A fast-paced vertical shmup where a living brain controls a combat ship to battle grotesque alien creatures across biomechanical worlds filled with massive bosses and intense arcade action.

details.title: Kaiju Ace
details.short_description: Pilot fighter jets against colossal kaiju in this combat flight simulator. Fly from the cockpit or chase view, and defend cities and convoys. Purchase aircraft and weapons in a persistent career with generated missions.

details.title: Project BOTNET
details.short_description: An idle tycoon about running an illegal bot farm inside a fictional MMO. Boot bots on virtual machines, farm gold, sell it to whales for real cash and reinvest in rigs, proxies and scripts, all from your oldschool desktop. Just keep the GMs from noticing.

details.title: M.A.Y.A
details.short_description: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

details.title: Stranded in the Abyss
details.short_description: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

details.title: 4D Builder
details.short_description: A spatial puzzle game about building, folding and exploring shapes in four dimensions. Start with familiar 3D ideas, then tackle gradually more mind-bending 4D challenges involving construction, folding and colouring - or experiment freely in the sandbox.

details.title: Congratulations, You Failed!
details.short_description: Pilot a rocket through tough training courses in a physics-based arcade game where failure comes with commentary. Dodge machinery, deliver swinging cargo, and upgrade your rocket while an unimpressed announcer keeps track of your mistakes. Prove them wrong, eventually.

details.title: Ink or Not
details.short_description: Ink or Not is a competitive score-attack game where a grid appears and on it some of the squares have ink and some don't. Click on whichever squares there are more of before the timer runs out. When you click on all the correct squares you go to the next round and you have slightly less time.

details.title: Mytheria
details.short_description: Explore the wilds, free the Keepers and take back Mytheria. A satisfying action adventure with building, automation and lots of loot. Craft, gather, discover secrets and expand your base. For 1 to 4 players, on the couch or online.

details.title: Blue Dynasty:Town Defense
details.short_description: Blue Dynasty is a Medieval ARPG blending fast-paced Hack & Slash combat with strategic Tower Defense. Upgrade your hero's equipment, master a massive passive tree, clear deadly dungeons, and build impenetrable defenses to protect your kingdom from relentless hordes.

details.title: Blobituary
details.short_description: A 2D party game for 1-4 players, on the couch or online. Shove, brawl and betray your way through 26 mini-games in the world where cute blobs go to die.

details.title: Fewer Mornings
details.short_description: A short first-person game about everything you do before you leave the house. Unpack, cook, do the dishes, feed Saki, answer your mom, leave by eight. Five days in one apartment across twelve years, and there's never time for all of it.

details.title: Scrivo: The World Maker
