details.short_description: Scrivo is a tiny guy made of crumpled paper, in a cozy game, exploring the scraps of a world that vanished long ago. Use a magnet to collect scraps and create hex tiles, then snap them together to build your own floating island. Complete quests, discover forgotten relics as your little world grows.

details.title: EXODUS
details.short_description: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

details.title: Danu: Rise of the Templars
details.short_description: Danu: Rise of the Templars is an open-world MMORPG & co-op action RPG set in a fantasy medieval world inspired by the legends of the Knights Templar. Explore dangerous lands filled with mystery, battle powerful enemies alongside friends, and earn rare gear through PvE adventures & 4–8 player raids.

details.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
details.short_description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

details.title: Night Run EX
details.short_description: Race your motorcycle through an endless neon night. Hit checkpoints fast to build your multiplier to 99x, weave through traffic, and chase the ghost of the rider one place above you on the leaderboards. Ride and vibe to the underground electronic soundtrack in this first person arcade racer.

details.title: Plausible Deniability - Cover Your Tracks
details.short_description: A satisfying incremental game about breaking boxes, shredding paperwork, and upgrading your operation to keep up with an endless flood of documents.

details.title: Stolen Frequencies
details.short_description: Run a pirate radio station in this open-world life and business sim set in 1980s England. Collect 59 playable songs, secretly record gigs and stay ahead of the police. Explore eight towns, repair radios, build businesses and work towards your own music venue.

details.title: Hushwell
details.short_description: Hushwell is an atmospheric 2D metroidvania. For a hundred years, nothing has been born. Something deep below has woken you, the last small spark near the surface. Go down through fourteen areas, past old things grown vast in the dark, and find out why the world went silent.

details.title: MAD: Mutually Assured Destruction
details.short_description: Turn-based 3D artillery with real physics and cinematic free-fly cameras. Every dollar is a choice: a bigger bomb or a better bunker. Nukes, B-52 carpet bombing, deformable terrain and 25+ battlefields from the desert to the Moon. 1-8 players: online, LAN or couch. Biggest crater wins.

details.title: Little Bear`s Honey Shop
details.short_description: Little Bear's Honey Shop is an incremental game where you battle magical plants, gather flowers and ingredients, and craft sweet honey products. Build powerful combinations on a honeycomb skill tree, sell honey to customers, and grow a tiny shop into a bustling honey empire.

details.title: Money Sweeper
details.short_description: Minesweeper with powers. Money Sweeper is a nerve-wrackingly tense roguelike chipbuilder where every search counts. Unlock powerful chips, combine wild synergies, and detonate massive cascades of riches

details.title: REFLECT89
details.short_description: Turn enemy bullets into your weapons in REFLECT89, a fast-paced arcade shoot 'em up. Master Perfect Reflections, unleash the Pulse Cannon or Pulse Radial, and climb the global leaderboards. Try the free demo now!

details.title: Striders
details.short_description: Plunge into the sea trenches and command an army of summoned allies. Upgrade you and your team, stack devastating synergies, as you overwhelm the relentless HORDE. Transform from a lone diver into an unstoppable force backed by an ocean of allies in this Vampire Survivors–inspired action roguelike.

details.title: Godsever
details.short_description: Long ago, humanity rose against the gods - and learned they could bleed. Hunt ten colossal gods alone or with up to two friends as the last of the Order: bind them, bleed them, and sever them, piece by piece. Learn every god, survive its cataclysm, and climb to Rank III.

details.title: Desert Struggle
details.short_description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges against the AI or online in PvP matches.

details.title: Vapor Strange
details.short_description: Select a Universe to explore. Then jump into bizarre psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, while experience shifting rulesets, and mini-games for a wild and truly strange experience.

details.title: Gnomonatics
details.short_description: Gnomonatics is a third-person action-adventure game. Explore an open island, solve ancient puzzle dungeons, and battle corrupted creatures with sword and crossbow as the shadows transform everyone around you.

details.title: Mine Mage Minion
details.short_description: A mining game where you play as a mage digging deeper into the earth. Gather resources, craft weapons and armor for yourself and your minions, defend your operation from enemy waves and bosses, and protect your underground colony from creatures trying to sabotage your progress.

details.title: The Creator: Live Together
details.short_description: The Creator: Live Together — a world built for creativity. Take on jobs, build your career, or create freely in Sandbox Mode. Design dream homes, craft cozy spaces, and play with friends.

details.title: Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams
details.short_description: 10 world-renowned experts are trapped together and must cooperate to survive... until conflicts arise, and they discover the greatest threat to their lives isn't the system they're resisting: it's each other! Discover the truth of who's living a lie in this fully voiced murder mystery adventure.

details.title: Ridiculous Racing: Retro Arcade Racer
details.short_description: Floor it into the ’80s. Thread the traffic, throw your car into a smoky slide, and hit the turbo toward 600 km/h as bold pixel-art worlds rush at you. Take the other branch next run, or settle it on the couch in 2–4 player split screen.

details.title: Lostade
details.short_description: Lostade is an arcade style ARPG about robots, character building, mystery, and mass Monsters annihilation that Focuses arround an Endless mechanic where each time you finish the game, it extend with new lore, maps, quests, enemies, items, difficulty and random events !

details.title: Ammo Garden
details.short_description: Bullet-Hell Roguelite where you Grow and Defend the last Farm in a Post-Apocalyptic Wasteland. Farm Crops, Upgrade Weapons and Kill every Creature that tries to invade your Farm!

details.title: Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life
details.short_description: Live the life of a footballer. Play every match yourself but never control the team. Live a footballer’s career from your first contract at 16 to retirement: 100+ hours, 775 clubs. Chase fame, money and love and face the consequences that follow you beyond the 90 minutes.

details.title: Leon&Suharto
details.short_description: In the Slums, people kill for a drop of noble blood. And Leon has it. Lies, revenge, a connection that bleeds, and a game that stares back at you. A dark episodic novel about those who survived — and are still paying the price.

details.title: Cat's Fish Stall
details.short_description: Discover dishes, open specialty shops, and connect them through customer flow. Combine up to 3 ingredients with a cooking method, choose facilities and timed events, balance traffic against profit, and clear 8 market scenarios—or test your own operating plan in Sandbox Mode from the start.

details.title: The Silver Witch
details.short_description: Dead, and now an angel—but Heaven's rules feel wrong. Jailed for forbidden Hell magic, Uriel escapes with Ailena, a girl met in prison, to start a second life in Hell, the Land of Demons. A two-person turn-based dark fantasy RPG in an afterlife where neither salvation nor judgment can be trusted.

details.title: NimerWorld: Shadows of a Promise
details.short_description: Welcome to Valdix, a kingdom consumed by darkness. Rescue the kingdom's ducks and put an end to the plague. As you progress, everything becomes stranger. Will you be able to reach the top and overcome this challenging journey?

details.title: How Much is Happiness?
details.short_description: You lost Bun, a cheerful orphan girl, who was the only joy for you in this cruel world. Tired of the harsh life, she went to Paradise, but you didn't accept it. At great cost, you dragged her back into the place she desperately wanted to escape. “How Much is Happiness” is a story of joy and despair.

details.title: CottageCore
details.short_description: Build freely, shape cottages and towers, and welcome a village into your glade. Organize village life and prepare homes and supplies for winter. A cozy building game about making a place of your own and caring for the people who live there.

details.title: FRENCH DREAM
details.short_description: A completely stupid game that demands you be extremely good. A top-down die & retry set in France in the middle of a presidential election: one bullet and you're dead, one bullet and so are they. Baguette, wine bottle, FAMAS: anything lying around is a weapon.

details.title: Vein-Weaver Knitting
details.short_description: Activate, Jump, Bomb, Out Run, Get Power Ups, Find Hidden Items, Speed Run, Pull Levers, Activate Switches, Out Smart Enemies, And Unravel The Story And Destroy The Dimension Crafted By An Ancient Craft Called Vein-Weaver Knitting.

details.title: Tiny Kopitiam
details.short_description: Tiny Kopitiam is a cozy management sim inspired by Southeast Asian coffee shops. Build your dream shop, hire staffs, then jump inside as the boss. Sit back, relax and watch your dream kopitiam come alive.

details.title: Tartaria: Frozen Frontier
details.short_description: Lead the ruling clan of a confederation in early-medieval Siberia. Develop cities and crafts, manage specialized vassals, prepare supplies for the harsh winter, and defend the entire confederation in this turn-based survival strategy game.

details.title: HANDBUILT: Korean Construction Simulator
details.short_description: Not a construction sim that just fakes it. Every block, every shovel of mortar, every excavator scoop — real Korean job-site work, by hand, with friends. The site manager watches every step. You can wing it, but take it lightly and you'll get collapsed walls and docked pay. Co-op for up to 4.

details.title: Stencil of Judgement
details.short_description: Step into a realm where every shadow whispers of forgotten power and ancient relics hold unimaginable might. A magic and melee take on the Musou genre: hack-and-slash games where a single, overpowered hero battles hordes of enemies including bosses on massive, tactical battlefields.

details.title: PSYCHO DEAD
details.short_description: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

details.title: Conflict 2026
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of Israel’s or Iran’s leader. Can you outmaneuver your rival, control the escalation, and win this historic struggle? A fast, turn-based geopolitical strategy game for 1–2 players

details.title: Lost in the Blizzard Abyss
details.short_description: Welcome to the Blizzard Abyss! Explore a vast, mysterious frozen wilderness filled with dangers and exciting discoveries. Brave the blizzard, find five Crystals, obtain the Frost Crown, and offer it at the altar to stop the storm. Can you survive for 60 minutes? Your frozen adventure begins here!

details.title: Vanguard Fusion
details.short_description: Merge three units into one and hold the line in a pixel-art auto-battler with tower defense. Every merge adds a star, and the unit gets stronger and changes how it looks. 24 heroes, 5 biomes, Endless mode and a brutal Boss Rush.

details.title: Hollow Winter
details.short_description: The war is over. The winter is not. Years after a global conflict, the dangers that surround you in the north are not zombies or looters. It's the cold, the ashes, the wolves and the fire you manage to light. Keep it burning.

details.title: Gunmetal Switchyard – Tower Defense
details.short_description: Build and upgrade nine tower types, reshape enemy routes, and recover stolen data orbs in a sci-fi tower defense campaign. Fight through 20 missions, restore an abandoned network, and uncover the truth behind Command’s orders.

details.title: Plants Need Some Space
details.short_description: The world's sweetest grocery starts with a little cozy chaos. A mafia boss tomato, a comrade potato, a disco lettuce, and dozens more oddballs who can't stand each other. Good luck! Plant everyone in the right spot to sort out the chaos, sell the harvest, and design your own shop.

details.title: OmniRing
details.short_description: OMNIRING is a world-hopping tactical RPG for multiple playthroughs. Build a squad of Samsarans, fight, interact, and shape events through your choices. Grow your squad through cycles of adventure, face the Apocalypse's final battle, and become an immortal Ascendant.

details.title: GoldRush
details.short_description: Build your fortune in a 2D mining strategy game set during the American Gold Rush. Bid for land, scan for deposits, mine gold and rare treasures, and upgrade your equipment. Time your sales as prices shift, manage debt, and outsmart rival prospectors.

details.title: Grimlane
details.short_description: Build a deck of towers, buildings, and spells to defend your town against endless waves. Grow your economy, upgrade your defenders, and try new combinations on random maps. Play solo or with a friend, and meet Grimlane's characters in the story campaign.

details.title: Alchemill: A Witch's Workshop
details.short_description: Alchemill is a cosy falling-sand brewing game. Brew what villagers need by hand in a living cauldron, gather from the land, mend a ruined house, and become a witch in earnest.

details.title: Crown Bluff
details.short_description: Crown Bluff is a game of betrayal for 2 to 12 players. Everyone hides a secret role. A loyal knight, a hidden rebel, or a traitor smiling at your side. Find who shares your goal, and take down everyone who doesn't.

details.title: Hotel Beresford
details.short_description: 1929. The Beresford Mansion once again becomes the stage for a tragic story. Follow its new owner, Samuel Chapman, on his descent into madness in this dark visual novel.

details.title: DREADMINER: Millions Below
details.short_description: Real-time strategy in the deep. Mine contested gold and crystal deposits, stretch your power network across hostile caverns, and command a brass-and-lightning battery as the swarm breaks through from new directions. A gothic steampunk tower defense RTS where every coin is a choice.

details.title: Ninpo Renju
details.short_description: Link four to unleash ninpo. Link five for a chance to strike with ninsatsu. NinpoRenju blends five-in-a-row tactics, ninja combat, and roguelike builds. Collect special pieces, synthesize your deck, and challenge friends online. Five in a row is only the beginning.

details.title: Dead Man's Pass
details.short_description: The dead cast no shadow. Guard the gate to the afterlife in this checkpoint horror game, catching demons grinning inside your sacred mirror and living trespassers weighing down the river ferry before one bad stamp comes back to haunt your next night.

details.title: Signarchy
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle game about road signs. Help a delivery truck reach the market before it opens and keep a bus out of traffic jams. Change signs during the shift, pause to think, and use cards to find out what caused a crash or jam.

details.title: Stronghold 4
details.short_description: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

details.title: The Iconoclast
details.short_description: A sci-fi turn-based RPG and a homage to the great RPGs of the past, featuring an innovative battle system where you can fight with up to 6 of your party members at once. Plus several fully 3D animated PS1-style FMV cutscenes!

details.title: Little Red Riding Hood
details.short_description: Experience an expanded retelling of the famous fairy tale, Little Red Riding Hood, in this terrifying yet beautiful adventure horror game. Discover an enchanted forest as you solve puzzles, run, hide, and sneak to avoid the Big Bad Wolf.

details.title: Nanna's Farm
details.short_description: Raise a flock where every bird has a job: roosters scare eagles, turkeys heal the sick, blues and reds drop silver and gold. Sell eggs or hatch them, fend off eagles, wolves and rats across 30 timed missions, and spend your stars on perks to help your farm survive.

details.title: Dank Wizard Saga
details.short_description: Explore a handcrafted fantasy world, solve puzzles, battle dungeon bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades in this retro-inspired action-adventure with stoner comedy.

details.title: MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA
details.short_description: With refined battle mechanics and new characters joining the fray, the moonlit mania enters the next stage. A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream...

details.title: LIGHTPUNK: Law of Inertia
details.short_description: Forced to abandon Inertium, Barnicle Strass returns to Quark Corp to salvage his legacy. But inside this heavy steampunk facility, a different reality awaits. As the sole carbon lifeform among light entities, he must navigate the machinery. Inside these walls, LIGHT IS ALL THAT'S LEFT.

details.title: Face Picka
details.short_description: Play board games with friends using faces you draw yourself! FacePicka is a board game café simulation where you create your own faces, enjoy fun mini-games, pull pranks, and switch expressions as you play.

details.title: BURN THE WITCH
details.short_description: THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH. ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING. I'M NOT AGAINST IT

details.title: Ministrelli's Cardboard Circus
details.short_description: You are the new light board operator and it's your job to let the artists shine. Aim lights, control soundboards, blast smoke and shoot confetti! All at the right timings. Can you juggle all the tasks? Keep an eye out for director Ministrelli's countdowns and you'll be sure to have great success.

details.title: Build Survivors
details.short_description: Drop onto a hostile planet, blast through endless hordes and grow absurdly powerful! Hunt down every boss, rip out its power core and make it back to your ship alive... or lose it all! Level up, unlock characters and stack crazy builds with no limits!

details.title: Shadow Of The Union: Survival
details.short_description: Fight back against the rebellious machines in an alternative USSR! Join forces in a team of up to 4 players and survive in a dangerous open world. By day, explore and gather resources. By night, defend your base against waves of combat robots!

details.title: Two Robots: Unleashed
details.short_description: The first competitive card game where players can create their own cards. Build your robot, craft your deck, and brawl in 1v1 arenas in the sci-fi world of Rennova. Climb the ranks, earn your place among the elite, and design cards that change the game forever.

details.title: SCP Loop
details.short_description: You are an SCP Foundation employee in Site-19. One day, you find yourself going through corridor, only to later realize, that the rooms you are walking through are repeating themselves. Explore SCP-970 and find its anomalies, in order to escape.

details.title: Lord of Kensai
details.short_description: Build and govern a Japanese-inspired metropolis in the Katana-Ra universe. Balance your populace, rival factions and the four seasons on a world map. An accessible city builder with real strategic depth.

details.title: Miramar
details.short_description: Set in a hard sci-fi universe, Miramar follows a group of Tac Marines sent to investigate why contact has been lost with a far off colony. Exploration, turn-based combat, and roguelike gameplay collide. Can your squad survive?

details.title: Don't Die! You got 1 Life!
details.short_description: A permadeath dark fantasy action roguelike (with a twist) about climbing a tower no one has ever beaten. Choose to study enemies or go in blind, and make choices that impact you in real time.

name: Bionic Shield: Battle for Space Nebula Omega

details.title: Bionic Shield: Battle for Space Nebula Omega
details.short_description: You are the Bionic Shield, humanity's last hope against the Automaton invasion. Win the space battles, drop onto new planets in your combat suit, take the wheel of drones and tanks, and shoot your way through the machine hordes. No two invasions play the same.

details.title: Mariachi Legends
details.short_description: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

details.title: fCorvus
details.short_description: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Learn about the fabulous corvus.

details.title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
details.short_description: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

details.title: JUST: REFLEX TEST
details.short_description: Fast, flashy action and hardcore challenges! Conquer all 20 stages and claim the Battle Master's crown. Your enemies grow faster and stronger with every victory!

details.title: DEWORLD AURALIS
details.short_description: The village was alive. The factory was running. Then they found something. Now inside remains only what they believed in… and what their madness became.

details.title: Home:Ward
details.short_description: It is 1907. You wake with no name, a spear in your hand, and a torch that barely holds back the dark. Every sound is a warning. Every flicker of light could give you away. The way out is somewhere below. Find the gate. Get home.

details.title: They Are Rising
details.short_description: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

details.title: Great Lakes Captain
details.short_description: Start with small boats and work your way up to massive Great Lakes freighters. Navigate ports, bridges, narrow channels, changing weather, and open water in a first-person maritime simulator focused on realistic vessel handling, progression, and life on the lakes.

details.title: Wild Light: Darkest Isles
details.short_description: Survive unforgiving nights in this topdown roguelite... explore the island, set up camp, and slay Titans in souls-like combat as you hunt the source of the desolation. But beware, the longer you survive, the darker the nights become

details.title: Hyper Snatch
details.short_description: 5v5 Capture the Flag. No guns, just tag. Skill-based movement.

details.title: Echoed Realms
details.short_description: Echoed Realms is a Casual Stylized Fantasy RPG focused on player experience and dynamic gameplay. Play it your way, even if that changes every day.

details.title: Property Pro
details.short_description: Your tower is falling apart and your staff came from the classified ads. Build the rooms, take in the guests, then hire the people to keep it standing. Send the plumber to the burst pipe, not the front desk. Put the wrong worker on the wrong job and you'll watch your guests walk out.

details.title: OrbGuard
details.short_description: Defend Earth against waves of deadly cosmic threats determined to destroy your civilization! In this Rogue-Lite Auto Shooter, you’ll place Celestial bodies and upgrade them to unleash chaos on your enemies. How long will you survive?

details.title: Hazard Protocol
details.short_description: Race the horde in a 1–4 player top-down co-op horror shooter. Complete objectives, improvise with scarce supplies, rescue downed teammates, and reach extraction through tense 10–30 minute missions whose pressure adapts to your squad.

details.title: Last Ones Down
details.short_description: A social survival game for up to 16 players. Reveal your traits, argue your case, and vote on who gets into the bunker. There’s only room for half of you, and keeping the wrong people could doom everyone inside.

details.title: Gun for Your Life
details.short_description: A top-down Western roguelite shooter. Your bullets fly to where you aim, so you can shoot past one bounty hunter and hit the one behind him. Build your outlaw between waves, then hide in the bushes or rush in the open. Somewhere out there is the man who put a price on your head.

details.title: Grave Company
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op zombie game for up to 10 players! Fight your way into creepy cemeteries overrun by hordes of zombies, grab bizarre objects and race against the clock. A random toilet in the middle of a cemetery? No time to ask questions!

details.title: Alarion: The Ruined King
details.short_description: Alarion: The Ruined King is a dark fantasy action game. A dead king awakens through the power of his own blood and sets out across a demon-infested kingdom. unleash forbidden blood powers, battle deadly enemies and bosses, and face Malachar to end his reign.

details.title: Maw of Apophis
details.short_description: Build your deck. Break enemy rites. A dark Egyptian roguelike deckbuilder where reading the next attack matters as much as the cards you draw. Master four champions, shape powerful combinations, and choose your path through the underworld.

details.title: Pawlifters!
details.short_description: A 2–6 player party heist game, local or online. Cute animal thieves hide in plain sight: grab the loot and blend into the crowd. Or become the guard and whack your friends with a baton — just don’t mix them up with the visitors!

details.title: Rockhounds and Gloomstones
details.short_description: Powerful Gloomstones await daring rockhounds in this Match-3 Roguelike. Build your bag of Gloomstones for use both during combat and throughout exploration. Match gems, smash skulls, and detonate wild bombs to stack massive combos.

details.title: ONE BRAINCELL
details.short_description: Two bodies. One brain. Zero common sense. ONE BRAINCELL is a 2-player online co-op puzzle platformer where only one of you can think at a time. Pass the brain, steal it at the worst moment, yell secret codes across the room and fail gloriously together.

details.title: Ossuvar
details.short_description: 96 spells. 8 schools of magic. Soak a pack of demons and let lightning tear through them, or spend your own life to unleash three waves of fire. Shape Isquara’s build with 500 blessings across the paths of Heaven and Hell, then fight alongside Tess through 10 maps in this isometric action RPG.

details.title: Battlemap Factory
details.short_description: Forge complete 3D battlemaps in seconds. Pick a theme, roll a seed, and get a furnished, lit, multi-storey map for your tabletop game. Export it to any virtual tabletop, or play right here with tokens, fog, initiative and dice.

details.title: NULL Heart
details.short_description: A roguelike, bullet-heaven-inspired railshooter where you build game-breaking damage engines. Tinker with item mod combos to discover unexpected synergies until projectiles melt the screen.

details.title: Planetron
details.short_description: Command a space carrier in a blend of real-time strategy and first-person action. Deploy air and ground units to capture alien facilities on procedurally generated spherical battlefields. Take direct control of any unit when the battle demands it.

details.title: Unclean Hands
details.short_description: A PS1-style horror card game. Play Durak against Slavic spirits in a bathhouse after midnight. They cheat. Catch them. Cheat back while they look away — alone or with up to three friends online. Lose, and you lose a finger.

details.title: Cardmarch
details.short_description: Build your deck, move animal allies across a tactical board, and break through enemy lines. Unlock six heroes with personal stories, cast spells and face bosses across six regions in this single-player card battler. Storybook artwork draws on the look of classic 1990s animation.

details.title: Jash Retro
details.short_description: Inspired by classic retro games such as Double dragon/Target renegade, Ikari warriors/Commando, Contra, Golden axe. Follow the story and explore all the games for fun moments!

details.title: DriveLine
details.short_description: Return to the track in DriveLine: follow your comeback in the Season Book career, buy and sell used cars, build your garage, and make every car yours with the livery editor. Race circuits, rally stages and drift events in dynamic weather, online or in optional VR.

details.title: MAEVOR
details.short_description: MAEVOR is a 1-4 player co-op horror game set in a cursed forest where every sound can get you killed. Recover three ancient artifacts, break the Harpy Vampire Demon's curse, and survive against creatures that hunt by sound while fear distorts your senses.

details.title: Cherry on Top
details.short_description: Chain abilities, get rich, and bake an unbreakable defense!

details.title: Fist of Goal
details.short_description: Fist of Goal is a soccer tournament for one-wheeled robots with levitating fists. Score goals, outsmart your opponents, knock them off their wheels, and use anything you can get your hands on. Preferably for its intended purpose. / Keep going / Think fast / Beat 'em up /

details.title: Penny Potluck
details.short_description: A cozy cooking roguelite where you combine ingredients, apply seasonings, discover recipes, and build powerful culinary synergies to satisfy an ever-growing hunger and score big.

details.title: Skyline Sim
details.short_description: Build your airline from a single aircraft into a global carrier. Plan your network, schedule every aircraft, manage the operation, and compete in a living aviation market.

details.title: Echo of Me
details.short_description: Echo of Me is a psychological narrative game about memory, loss, and a truth that cannot be left behind. Explore a maze of memories, solve puzzles, avoid enemies, and uncover notes as you piece together a story in which every new answer changes the meaning of what came before.

details.title: The Lantern Man Cometh
details.short_description: Become the Lantern Man of the lakes in this spooky incremental roguelite. Use your mystical light to lure boatmen to their doom, harvest their souls, and upgrade your powers.

details.title: The Hungering Lake
details.short_description: A village is starving and the lake is taking its children. Fish to keep them alive, but every catch angers what lives beneath the surface. A top-down Finnish folklore horror game about hunger, debt and a name hidden in the logs of the lost.

details.title: Im not an Idiot
details.short_description: Durak in 4D: the fourth dimension is time, because you can rewind. Bring your friends to the table, throw the cards into the middle, stick on stickers that rebuild the game, and argue about who the idiot is. Not me.

details.title: Ominous Descent
details.short_description: A deep-sea twin-stick action roguelite. Alone or with a friend, blast through deadly swarms and slay powerful bosses every few minutes. Your headlight grants bonus damage and is key to taking down certain foes, so manage its charge carefully.

details.title: PRE-ECHO
details.short_description: A co-op horror mystery. August 1994: in the small town of Greyford, an old radio picks up events before they happen. Explore by day, survive the Resonance Storm by night and change what is coming, alone or with up to three friends.

details.title: Void Horizon
details.short_description: A roguelite bullet hell where eight bosses each break a rule. Pick a co-pilot, upgrade your ship after every fight and fire a screen-filling ultimate when it counts. Then switch it up: a survivors-like horde mode, an on-rails run across seven worlds, Boss Rush and couch co-op.

details.title: LSR 12x12 Military Tactics
details.short_description: You are the Commander, You have the Control. Dictate & Dominate this 12x12 battlefield; Command units with unique movement & abilities, Build structures to block movement and Line Of Sight. Capture/Destroy the enemy Commander, or use tactical precision to reach the other side. Your Move, Commander.

details.title: Your Ancestor Stories
details.short_description: Live as Bara in a cozy prehistoric life sim where farming, fishing, hunting, crafting, livestock, tournaments, festivals, and survival shape daily life on a mysterious island filled with tribes, wildlife, and untold stories.

details.title: Sword & Soil
details.short_description: A top-down pixel action RPG in the spirit of Dragon Warrior and NES Zelda. Farm, fish and cook, then take what you grew into real-time fights. Four classes, puzzle dungeons and five towns. All of Chapter One is in the free demo.

details.title: Ashen Marches
details.short_description: Ashen Marches is a classic fantasy tabletop RPG, stripped down to the fights and character building.

details.title: LAZARUS
details.short_description: LAZARUS is a hardcore sci-fi precision platformer. Jump, dash and slash through 40 levels as an obsolete exoskeleton that rebuilds instantly every time it dies. Master shifting physics across 4 chapters, topple 4 multi-phase bosses and climb to the top of an AI god's world.

details.title: Paperlings
details.short_description: A desktop pet you actually raise. A papercraft creature lives in a little window while you work — and behind its door: a whole town, a 99-form collection, and a family story that outlives every pet.

details.title: Ouroboros Break
details.short_description: A glitching open-world extraction roguelike set inside a collapsing simulation. Hunt bosses, build modular skeletal minions, and survive a world that rewrites itself around you.

details.title: The Lostwood
details.short_description: The Lostwood combines a hardcore turn-based roguelike of strategy and resource management with PvP mind games full of laughs. Prepare your loadout, automate combat loops and explore a dark forest. Or join 2–8 player Steam battles for bold reads, clutch plays and wild comebacks.

details.title: GuildBound
details.short_description: A cozy idle guild manager that lives on your desktop. Recruit heroes, send them on quests and contracts, gear up at the vendors, and rally the whole guild for raids. Your guild keeps working while you do, and the loot is waiting when you look back.

details.title: Gudu! Witch & Meltdown
details.short_description: Brew, toss, and trigger explosive chain reactions! Gudu! Witch & Meltdown is a chaotic anime-style roguelite where you play as a quirky witch crafting volatile potions. Combine recipe ingredients, build exponential multiplier synergies, and hurl nuclear-level flasks to melt monster HP!

details.title: SECTOR GAMMA
details.short_description: SECTOR GAMMA - an atmospheric horror simulator set in the Soviet Union, 1968. You are an intern at a secret Soviet facility. Your job: dispose of anomalous waste, fight dangerous robots, and survive on a limited budget. Ready to sign the contract?

details.title: Electric Crust: Galactic Pizza Delivery
details.short_description: Fifteen stages of side-scrolling arcade shooting, wrapped around the worst pizza delivery route in the galaxy. Bullet patterns, boss tiers, and a rank ladder Ace never asked for. One-time purchase. No ads or data collection.

details.title: PROFANUM
details.short_description: PROFANUM is a first-person dark fantasy horror action RPG built around weighty, commitment-based combat. Fight the Profane with melee weapons, shields, bows, crossbows, and Faith-powered miracles as you uncover what happened to Briarholt.

details.title: Necromancer's Last Stand
details.short_description: Bound by death and driven by vengeance, a fallen king must raise armies of the dead and tear through the wreckage of forgotten worlds to break free from a god’s cruel game you must strenghten your armies

details.title: Maddy's Meadow
details.short_description: Maddy’s Meadow is a cozy flower simulation that sits on a part of your screen allowing you to work on other tasks while caring for your meadow!

details.title: Champions of Sparta
details.short_description: Champions of Sparta is a brutal action RPG where elite Spartan warriors face deadly arena trials across ancient empires. Master melee, ranged, and magic combat to prove your worth and secure Sparta’s path to domination.

details.title: Ashborn
details.short_description: A demanding roguelite Souls-like in 3rd person view. Dodge, hit, die and start again in a dark and broken world.

details.title: The Witch's Realm
details.short_description: Escape and explore a mystery puzzle adventure where you must manage sanity, solve challenges, and uncover the dark secrets of a cursed town. Navigate eerie environments, find hidden objects, and survive the witch's realm.

details.title: TECTON
details.short_description: TECTON is a bullet-hell adventure set in a metropolis turned machine fortress. Control a powerful robotic body as you dodge relentless projectiles and tear through enemy strongholds on your mission to confront the force behind the city’s downfall.

details.title: Lirai: Heir Of Darkness
details.short_description: Lirai: Heir of Darkness is an upcoming third-person action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies and demons, where the obsession to dominate and control the world leads to fear, violence, destruction and, worst of all, extinction.

details.title: We Grew Up in War
details.short_description: This narrative adventure tells stories of children from Sarajevo and Ukraine based on locals’ testimonies. See contemporary war from an overlooked perspective, highlighting resilience and imagination of kids whose future was taken from them.

details.title: Ash Dawn
details.short_description: Dodge or Die! You are out of potions.

details.title: Carpet Racers
details.short_description: Carpet Racers invites you to 90s good old make belief playtime chaos. Compete against your friends (and enemies) using your favorite racing machine, in and around numerous arenas from your childhood (your house, school, backyard, playground and many more).

details.title: Academ Dreams
details.short_description: An unhinged genius returns to his childhood town in search of a dream, only to uncover dark secrets from the past. People vanish in the forest, fires that raise the dead burn by the “cursed” sea, and demon bikers throw wild parties. Can he find himself amid the chaos?

details.title: Solo Grinding
details.short_description: Solo Grinding is a Tactical RPG Roguelite. Fight your way floor by floor and enter a tournament alongside 5 powerful warriors. The goal is simple, reach the legendary Last Floor. Learn skills directly from enemies and create unique builds to fight your way to the top and uncover hidden secrets.

details.title: PNG RPG
details.short_description: A pixel-art RPG in a 3D open world where you can build towns, manage people, explore a infinitely generated world, and battle monsters and foes alike.

details.title: Viral Dependency
details.short_description: Turn a rookie VTuber into a streaming star! Click and idle to build hype, upgrade her setup, and choose what Vivi talks about. As chat fills with messages and gifts, each stream wears her down. Off camera, she shows another side. Your choices shape who she becomes—and how her story ends.

name: Home Is Where I Left You

details.title: Home Is Where I Left You
details.short_description: A cosy hand drawn atmospheric puzzle game with a gentle mystery to uncover. Organise, decorate and collect letters in a beautifully mysterious house, floating in the night with over 30 puzzles. Go at your own pace, choose your perfect ambience and relax with a dreamy yet melancholic lofi soundtrack.

details.title: Munzi Island
details.short_description: Grow crops, automate your farm with worker bots, turn washed-up trash into useful resources, and reclaim land from the sea—all while defending your island from the Black Munzis.

details.title: Empire Autobattler
details.short_description: Lead one of history's civilizations from Warriors to Mech Walkers in a single run. Buy and merge units, work your island's land, research techs and pick governments, then watch your army clash against rival empires. Nine civilizations, eight eras, one autobattler.

details.title: Hatchbar
details.short_description: Hatch eggs in a thin strip above your taskbar while you work. Fuse any two Hatchlings into a new species, then hand them to your adventurers as weapons. An idle RPG with 47 creatures to discover. Never steals focus, clicks pass through. One price, no ads. Free demo out now.

details.title: GUTTERGLOW
details.short_description: A bowling roguelike with real pin physics. Aim and throw, score points for every pin that falls, and build your ball with pins, tricks and upgrades until one throw multiplies into a huge score. Ten levels, twelve bosses that change the lane, three modes.

details.title: Mushroom Mushroom
details.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer. Control a small mushroom, create clones, and swap positions with them. Master clone swapping through puzzles and challenges, explore the many possibilities of this ability, overcome obstacles, and help the mushroom find its way home.

details.title: Super DullanGO
details.short_description: Embark on an Adventure, Durango! It's Super Durango!!!

details.title: Supervite
details.short_description: Supervite is a HIGH-SPEED momentum-driven 2D-platformer with PHYSICS-BASED movement ; reach the checkpoints before the timer runs out, or race against others in online multiplayer tracks

details.title: MONSTER LEGION
details.short_description: Build a team of four monsters, equip them, and watch them fight. Your opponents are teams built by other players — asynchronous online battles with no matchmaking wait and no disconnects. Over 70 units and 100+ items and augments. No two runs build the same.

name: Pourhouse: Last Call Is Your Call

details.title: Pourhouse: Last Call Is Your Call
details.short_description: Pourhouse: Last Call is Your Call is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art bar management game. Serve thirsty customers and cut them off before they get carried away. Play 40 levels across 4 different bars. Upgrade your bars and unlock power-ups to help you along the way!

details.title: ナノスダソス
details.short_description: A resource-gathering, deck-building board game for up to 6 players. Lay your cards face down, then everyone reveals at once and resolves them in order. Read your rivals and race to be the first to reach 10 victory points.

details.title: Write With Shion: Lo-Fi Focus
details.short_description: Work, study and write a sensual story with her, one line for every minute of focus. A focus timer, relaxing lo-fi and Shion on the other end of the call: shy, playful and writing a brand new story with you. Play your way, pure focus or with chats.

details.title: CrazyVolleyball
details.short_description: A first-person volleyball game built around physical ball contact and teamwork. Receive, set, spike and block in online 2v2, 3v3 and 6v6 matches, or practice in solo matches and training. Position yourself, time your swing and keep the rally alive.

details.title: No Good Pirates
details.short_description: Build a pirate empire one leaky boat at a time. Trade, fight and board your way across a living low-poly archipelago where factions go to war, ports boom and bust, and sea monsters want a snack. Sail alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op.

details.title: Lumina Cube
details.short_description: Build your circuit, automate the fight, then let her grow stronger while you idle. Arrange glowing cubes to decide how Yura moves, which skills she casts and when. Every rebuild makes her faster and smoother. A dreamlike, bittersweet pixel-art hack-and-slash.

details.title: Rise of Furax
details.short_description: A dungeon crawler RPG set in the Heroes of the Seven Islands universe, where every element, from sprites to textures, was hand-drawn on paper. Assemble a team of five heroes, explore the three islands off the coast of Rivelune to discover the origin of Furax.

details.title: TRADOTTA
details.short_description: From the first carriage you build, work and drive your train. A first-person management game on a train that never stops, in a frozen world. On the first day there is only you. Then people board at the refuges, up to two hundred, and nobody is an extra.

details.title: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump
details.short_description: Build your dream body in the ultimate gym simulator and bodybuilding game! Experience real-time body transformation, train with other players online, break strength records, dominate arm wrestling, and knock out rivals in physics-based multiplayer boxing. Rise from amateur to global champion!

details.title: Vitrified
details.short_description: Team up with ALAN the robot in this atmospheric post-nuclear metroidvania. Explore and fight your way through a beautiful but deadly post-nuclear wasteland, upgrade ALAN with abilities that unlock new areas, and uncover the secrets of The Worm.

details.title: Golel
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the disturbing world of a first-person, Dungeon Crawler, Golel. Leverage the environment to your advantage, drop a bookshelf on an enemy, or kick them into a pit. Golel brings innovation to turn-based combat.

details.title: Nonogueram
details.short_description: Nonogueram is a fast-paced, procedural nonogram puzzle roguelike. Solve increasingly difficult puzzles, race the clock, experiment with a myriad of item combinations, and test your wits against bosses who manipulate and modify the very world itself.

details.title: Rites of Accord
details.short_description: Turn-based hex tactics with six radically asymmetric factions. Climb the Survival leaderboard or outsmart a rival in a full match in 30-40 minutes. Raise the dead as Echoes, spread living terrain, or share damage across the Choir. Free demo available now.

details.title: Pistonica
details.short_description: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

details.title: Burrowlings
details.short_description: Grow four tiny hard-hatted burrowlings into a swarm of over a hundred and dig to the planet's core before the oil lamp burns out. A short incremental game: spend the gold in a web of upgrades, dig again, deeper. Solo, or online in co-op and versus, where a block of ice freezes a rival's shaft.

details.title: Kingdom Courier
details.short_description: Carry the King's mail across a kingdom that remembers you. Plan routes over a hex map, act on rumors only as good as the village that told you, and choose between the villages who feed you and the crown who pays you. A turn-based strategy roguelite. You can't keep both happy.

details.title: Exoplanet Settlers
details.short_description: A turn-based 4X space strategy game built around deep logistics and open-space movement. Use cosmic geography to your advantage, disrupt enemy supply networks, custom-build your fleets, and construct interconnected planetary complexes to conquer the galaxy.

details.title: Slag Run
details.short_description: Fly the gunship. Lead the rebellion. Slag Run is a single-player twin-stick shooter with battlefield strategy and roguelite progression. Shred enemy armor, direct allied squads, and capture territory as you build your loadout and fight to topple an oppressive dictatorship.

details.title: Dear Reader
details.short_description: Lumen who discovers that his own words are betraying him. As his writing grows increasingly unfamiliar, his mental state begins to unravel. That is, until he realizes his editor has been slowly twisting his work into an uncanny counterfeit, all under the guise of optimization...

details.title: Garden Apocalypse
details.short_description: Once a thriving alien world, now a vast desert—devoured by the relentless Swarm. These towering insect invaders have left only scattered oases and buried ruins. Grow food, craft powerful resources, and uncover lost secrets to push back against the tide and restore balance to a dying world.

details.title: Heritage Flipper
details.short_description: Cozy house renovation simulator where you renovate historic old ruins into luxury estates. Clean, restore & decorate homes in American, French, English, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese & more styles. Uncovering the secret history of each home.

details.title: GUN SOLVER
details.short_description: GUN SOLVER is a mind-bending top-down shooter where every gunfight is a puzzle to be solved. Use experimental bullets to dodge, teleport and kill enemies in slow motion. Strategize, improvise, and destroy the corporation that wronged you.

details.title: Bad Goons
details.short_description: Blast through cover, carve trenches, and build massive fortifications to dominate the battlefield. Adapt to ever-changing environments and discover new tactics with every match. Outsmart your enemies with pure War-IQ. No more gooning around! It’s time to join the fight.

details.title: electric strategy
details.short_description: A turn-based tactics game where every action costs energy. Command robots across a grid-based battlefield, transfer power between units, and help machines reclaim their will.

details.title: Radar Identified: Tower & Approach
details.short_description: Radar Identified: Tower & Approach is an air traffic control simulator. Run Tower, Ground and Approach: clear pushbacks, taxi aircraft, manage runway traffic and sequence ILS arrivals at five airports in Germany and the United States.

details.title: Sojourn Saga
details.short_description: Sable and his party are trapped in a town nobody can leave. A retro turn-based roguelite JRPG inspired by Lufia II’s Ancient Cave: build your party, raise evolving Foomy companions, master gear and ornament combinations, and delve into the ever-shifting Warren to find answers.

details.title: The Witch's Fairy Tale
details.short_description: "The Witch's Fairy Tale" is an action rogue, role-playing game developed by "a little Han Han Duck OVO", you will play a witch, to find magic around the world, your adventure along the way will be written as a fairy tale to pass on.

details.title: Default Zombie Shooter
details.short_description: You and your team woke up in a ruined city. Hordes of zombies roam the streets. There will be no answers. Grab a gun and shoot!

details.title: Electronic Universe II
details.short_description: Electronic Universe II is a music runner game where the scenario was built specifically to capture the sounds of the music and represent them on a visual way, the character can move to the left-right and jump, and your goail is to avoid colliding with the objects of the scenario.

details.title: Pipe Dream
details.short_description: A micro-MMORPG in 2008 Brooklyn for you and 31 friends. Hold a job or rob the bank, own the bar or the building, talk to anyone with your voice and watch the city remember it. The news runs your face. You owe Tony $1,500 by Sunday. The city doesn't care how you get it.

details.title: Mindfulness TD
details.short_description: Roguelike tower defense. You are King Mark, a fallen king protecting what remains of your kingdom. Defend your people. Each time you fail, spend mindfulness on a progression tree, pick yourself back up, and defend them better the next time.

details.title: Indie Hoverboard Racing
details.short_description: A high-speed sci-fi hoverboard racer. Survive hostile regions, defeat elite rivals, and earn your place on the Nocturnia City Circuit.

name: Quiet Grove: Lost in the Fog

details.title: Quiet Grove: Lost in the Fog
details.short_description: A cozy survival adventure set in a mysterious fog-covered forest after a plane crash. Explore hidden paths, gather resources, fish, cook meals, upgrade your camp, and uncover the secrets lurking beneath the forest's peaceful surface.

details.title: Dress Your Meat
details.short_description: Dress Your Meat is a cooking horror game where you work at a dumpling restaurant. Take orders, prepare dishes, and do your best to keep your chef happy. Sounds simple enough, until things in the kitchen start getting seriously disturbing.

details.title: Tiny Kitchen: Sandwich Edition
details.short_description: Click to drop ingredients and build your own chaotic deli-style sandwich in this cozy physics cooking game. Stack it tall, stack it wrong — just don’t forget the bread!

details.title: Dash It!
details.short_description: A pixel platformer about jumping and dashing. Race up to 8 players in real time, chase the world No. 1 ghost in Time Attack, clear 72 stages across 12 themes, and build and share your own maps. Hang out in the lobby, change outfits and decorate your own house.

details.title: Fenix
details.short_description: Step into a vibrant 3D open world platformer inspired by classic adventures, where you play as Fenix, a curious fox exploring a lively forest. Discover unique NPCs, memorable landmarks, enemy encounters, and hidden secrets as you freely navigate an unforgettable world full of mystery and wonder!

details.title: Clone. Optimize. Sacrifice.
details.short_description: Build a city of science and magic, power up cloned heroes through automated dungeons, inherit their strength through cloning, and recycle the rest for science in this casual idle city-builder with deep RPG progression and competitive auto-battle leagues.

name: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM-Episode One: The King, The Prince, and The Peasants

details.title: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM-Episode One: The King, The Prince, and The Peasants
details.short_description: "The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..." KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

details.title: Dangerline
details.short_description: An old-school real-time strategy game set in a modern war. Build a base, raise an army and fight street by street with two sides that play nothing alike. Walls and hills really block sight and bullets, so take the high ground, hold the houses and bring the town down on the enemy.

details.title: Secret of Havendor
details.short_description: Can you preserve your humanity in a world ruled by blood and gold?

details.title: Palmora
details.short_description: Palmora

name: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster

details.title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
details.short_description: A mysterious disease is turning people into picture books. When her sister contracts Paper Mortis, Mono must do everything she can to save her—even if that means making a deal with a veritable devil.

details.title: Heartland
details.short_description: Heartland is a meditative strategy puzzle where you shape the landscapes of new worlds by placing hexagonal tiles. As you build, your worlds come to life and react to the events that unfold. Villages grow into cities, and castles rise into kingdoms, each with its own inhabitants and chronicles.

details.title: Iron Tracer
details.short_description: Iron Tracer is a tactical shooter where you play as a spec-ops soldier sent across the globe to stop threats before they happen. Every mission demands stealth, precision, and quick decision-making, one wrong move can end the the mission.

details.title: Lens Of Fear
details.short_description: Realistic, hyper-immersive, intense action-adventure horror game. Developed by PlayableGraph as their debut title. This game combines a portable camera perspective with highly detailed environments and immersive sound design to deliver an authentic horror experience.

details.title: Age of Medieval
details.short_description: Age of Medieval is a single-player medieval real-time strategy game. Found a village with four families and a wagon, build it house by house, open roads and trade routes, then raise an army for battles and sieges. When your lord dies, his heir inherits it all.

name: Fishing in the Dark: Lake of Monsters

details.title: Fishing in the Dark: Lake of Monsters
details.short_description: Cast. Haul. Gamble. Fire back. Build a fishing village in the dark, turn your catch into gold, luck and ammunition, and defend your pile from the monster rising out of the lake.

details.title: One Command Ahead
details.short_description: Stack command blocks, press Run, and watch a very literal robot follow your plan. Jump gaps, dodge lasers, and find clever loops in a sci-fi puzzle adventure.

details.title: Anima Reaver
details.short_description: A co-op space shooter where you fly with a squad of up to four, online or on split screen, through missions, boss fights and deathmatch. Take flagships apart turret by turret, master 18 ships, and unveil the secrets of the universe.

details.title: Make The Dead Dead Again
details.short_description: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

details.title: Jamir
details.short_description: Jamir is a free-to-play fast paced sci-fi tactical shooter created by one person. Master your abilities and items to destroy creatures and enemies. Upgrade your character, guns, abilities and items to become the most powerful along the globe.

details.title: Land and Sword
details.short_description: Lead a group of survivors in a new land, build a functional settlement, manage deep production chains, and prepare defenses to face growing hordes of creatures. Balance growth, logistics, and survival in a world scarred by a creeping plague.

details.title: Age After Age
details.short_description: Age After Age. Build a thriving settlement, shape society across multiple eras, and dominate a living world economy. Choose your path - classic history, Steampunk, Gothic, and more in a deep city-building strategy with evolving logistics, citizen classes, diplomacy, and research.

details.title: Street Football: Foul Play
details.short_description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

details.title: KOTA: The Survival
details.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world abandoned by humans, control robots as they gather resources, fight enemies, and rebuild the planet using recycled materials. KOTA: The Survival lets you revive nature and craft a new future!

details.title: Bonk Universe
details.short_description: Explore an infinite universe with unlimited possibilities, Conquer the Celestials, Build civilizations, and more! This is an open universe sandbox game, and not even the sky is the limit!

details.title: Mr Bear Goes to Washington
details.short_description: A satirical hand-drawn 2D action platformer where a grizzly bear runs, jumps, and mauls his way through enemies in solo or local co-op. Blending fast-paced combat and platforming with a nostalgic, poster-inspired art style, every level feels handcrafted and full of character.

details.title: Finguedom
details.short_description: Finger everything in the sandbox. Build your dream seaside retreat on a tropical island, Fuse structures with concrete, Shape multi-story homes upon the terrain, manage resources and workers, and construct roads, overpasses, canals, and vehicles to bring your island to life.

details.title: ROOM 307
details.short_description: ROOM 307 is a first-person psychological horror game set in an abandoned hospital. Explore its decaying halls, uncover disturbing records, survive paranormal encounters, and discover what happened at 03:17. Some memories were buried for a reason.

details.title: Cursed Cards
details.short_description: Build a deck of hungry monsters in this roguelike autobattler. Position your creatures, feed their powers and turn sacrifices into devastating combos. Fight zombie swarms, collect strange relics and choose your route through a cursed world.

details.title: ZRAGG
details.short_description: Defend your home planet from hordes of creatures in this retro styled roguelite!

details.title: Luminleaf Chronicles
details.short_description: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is a local multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players that combines elements of survival, adventure, and roguelike genres. Acquire items, upgrade your skills, and defeat the continuously appearing bosses to survive tooth and nail in the game world, ultimately face the Skeleton King!

details.title: Torebia Online
details.short_description: Torebia: Island Odyssey is an old-school sandbox MMORPG. No classes, no pay-to-win. Craft, fight, trade, and rise through the Adventurer's Guild ranks your way. One shared world. Pure adventure.

details.title: Golden Steam
details.short_description: Golden Steam is a thrilling arcade-puzzle adventure where you collect Golden Steams and activate machine parts to recover artifacts scattered through fractured time. Navigate 10 worlds, master geometric rotations, and control time itself in a steampunk sci-fi universe where every second counts.

details.title: BUG SQUASH
details.short_description: Defend your Command Centers against relentless waves of mutated insects! Customize powerful tanks with an arsenal of weapons and tactical modules in this action-packed tower defense game. Go solo or team up with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Aethelon
details.short_description: Aethelon is an infinite, open world creative voxel sandbox. Build across massive procedural worlds with realistic biome systems. Share your world with reproducible seeds. Experience infinite creative freedom at impressive scale.

details.title: Silurian Planet
details.short_description: Silurian Planet is a first-person survival horror game. Survive on a hostile and oppressive planet, seek shelter, manage resources, and make decisions to escape creatures lurking in the darkness.

details.title: Shred-A-Bunch!
details.short_description: Shred zombies in slow-mo while drifting with your good old tractor?! Harvest crops, slaughter zombies, overcome epic boss fights and upgrade your vehicle. Rinse and repeat.

details.title: Shady Business
details.short_description: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

details.title: Counter Ducks
details.short_description: An asymmetric FPP/TPP shooter with two different game modes. In PvE, hunt ducks solo or in co-op, earn money, and upgrade your gear. In PvP, switch roles and play as a duck against hunters in chaotic 4v4 battles!

details.title: Echo Tide
details.short_description: Create your protagonist and inherit a house in Caelmere, a coastal village where romance, mystery, and hidden mermaids are only the beginning. Investigate your uncle's death, meet 15 unique love interests, and choose whether to become a mermaid or something far more mysterious.

details.title: THE MAZE WITHIN ME
details.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror in which you explore dark, maze-like environments, evade lurking threats, and uncover fragments of a troubled past. Face the memories that shaped you and decide what your fate truly means.

details.title: Mystery At Windmill Farm
details.short_description: One missing egg. A farm full of stories that don't quite add up. Play as Reed, a duck detective, in a cozy 3D mystery. Explore a colorful miniature farm, question eccentric animals, follow the clues in your notebook, and trade cheese for gossip. Can you untangle the truth?

details.title: DELTA // SURGE
details.short_description: DELTA // SURGE is an action roguelike bullet hell shooter with deckbuilding. Draft cards mid-run, fight 30 waves of enemy fleets and bosses, and unlock new Flight Frames and permanent upgrades to push your next run further.

details.title: Shape Fulfillment Center
details.short_description: Sublime Shape Fulfillment Experience

details.title: Corner Quest
details.short_description: An idle auto-battler in the corner of your screen. Your Mage fights on her own while you work. Choose her Spells, reshape them with Forms and Runes, and fight through 50+ waves in 15 Biomes.

details.title: Rogues & Fate
details.short_description: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.

name: Buried Magic: A Story about the Unseen

details.title: Buried Magic: A Story about the Unseen
details.short_description: Hollowmoor is plauged by a series of strange disapperances — and at the core of it all lies centuries old Trinity Acadamy of Witchcraft. Step into the shoes of young Ruby and her house spider Mifi to discover the truth behind the schools dark secrets.

details.title: G.E.E. (Ghost Evade & Extraction)
details.short_description: 1-4 player co-op horror extraction. As disposable scouts, you raid dangerous zones for relics while unkillable monsters hunt in swarms. You can't kill them—only stun, repel, and control the creatures, then flee. Grab loot, drag friends out, and reach extraction... if your friendship survives.

details.title: NS Drive Simulator
details.short_description: A driving simulator featuring realistic driving, diverse vehicles, and multiple driving environments.

details.title: Sprite Garden
details.short_description: Incremental games meet Pacman in this expanding maze shoot-em-up. Move along the paths of your garden, collect flowers, kill imps, find sprites and earn tiles. What powerful sprites will you find in your garden? How big will your garden get?

details.title: Blind Gavel
details.short_description: The auctioneer is lying, and he has secret partners hiding among the bidders. Blind Gavel is a 4 to 8 player social deduction party game: bid on items you cannot value, find the partners, and send the accused into a deadly minigame

details.title: The Dust of Battle
details.short_description: A lightning‑fast turn-based tactical game with explosive progression across 40‑minute campaigns, where every battle becomes a high‑stakes Strike vs Counter duel.

details.title: Wizard Tower Wars
details.short_description: A multiplayer fantasy RTS with deckbuilding. Choose your wizard and tower, customize your spellbook, and battle up to 3 friends. Summon armies and buildings, cast spells, and level up while your forces fight on their own, so planning beats micro. Ally, betray, or fill empty seats with AI.

details.title: Oogie’s Chicken Quest
details.short_description: A short, quirky 3D action adventure where Oogie sets out to find his legendary chicken, Cluck Cluck, who lays diamond eggs. Explore small open worlds , solve puzzles, battle odd enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in vibrant levels!

details.title: SHOOTOSYNTHESIS
details.short_description: The plants have taken control, and the army sent you in! Farmers! Defend the Photosynthesis Core for 7 waves, alone or with your friends. A whole mutant flora ready to kill you, a multitude of weapons, and mutants you'll have to uproot before they grow back!

details.title: Before the First Fire
details.short_description: Survive, teach, and evolve across 5.6 million years of human prehistory. Gather resources, build a tribe of companions, and guide your species through 7 eras, from the forest floor to the eve of civilization.

details.title: Socialiskigrad
details.short_description: Welcome to the Republic of Socialiskigrad, a budding nation to shape with bags of cement! Build working-class districts, develop national industry, and govern the metropolises of each region. Only you can become the shining President the country deserves!

details.title: Haunted Paws
details.short_description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

details.title: CORE//PULSE
details.short_description: Defend a stationary Core against escalating waves of geometric enemies. Build each run with upgrade cards, satellites, orbital weapons and automated skills, defeat unique bosses, earn currency, and return stronger for the next run.

details.title: Innards
details.short_description: Innards is a deranged non-Euclidean adventure, set in the hyperbolic folds of the long-abandoned Internet, with a unique eccentric visual style.

details.title: Routine
details.short_description: A job simulation game that tests your memory and adaptability.

details.title: Cherry Pick
details.short_description: Open packs to collect a variety of shrimp, then breed them to discover even rarer ones. Decorate your own aquarium and watch your shrimp slowly grow in this cozy aquarium game.

details.title: Little Timmy
details.short_description: Blast through hordes of monsters and tear enemies apart with brutal executions. Feed your blood-thirsty shotgun until it upgrades, graft boss organs into yourself, team up with up to 3 friends, and descend into the depths to rescue your mom before it's too late.

details.title: Ratmageddon Underground
details.short_description: Splat your way through infested underground stations, sewers and tunnels overrun by zombified rats. Armed with improvised weapons, deadly traps and a well-aimed foot, help Alan fight his way home on a night he'll wish he could forget.

details.title: Paid in Blood
details.short_description: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

details.title: Way to Oasis
details.short_description: Way to Oasis : a post-apocalyptic visual novel. You lead a six-member caravan after the captain’s death. Manage scarce resources, navigate moral dilemmas, and face hidden threats. Your choices decide if the group survives or perishes.

details.title: Case Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Open cases, collect rare skins, try your weapons, and run a shop where you sell, trade, and grow your arsenal.

details.title: Switch Ball Deluxe
details.short_description: Switch colors on the fly to destroy all energy bricks in sight! Bounce, boost, and race the clock through more than 160 handcrafted levels across 10 power plant themed worlds in this arcade puzzle-platformer. Chase S-ranks in Adventure Mode, or put your skills to the test in the Gauntlet!

details.title: Arcane Shores
details.short_description: Arcane Shores is a city-building strategy game infused with magic. Build, defend, and expand your settlement while casting powerful spells that bend nature, restore what’s broken, and turn the tide against your enemies.

details.title: Battle Worms
details.short_description: Get your parts, build your creature, go! Compete with your friends in a series of minigames, adding new parts along the way, to see whose custom creature is the best… or maybe just the funniest. Featuring online PVP, procedural physics and open-ended creature building, how you play is up to you!

details.title: Banana Guy Running Hard
details.short_description: A compact fast-paced platformer! Run everywhere, jump everywhere and get everything!

details.title: Depth Perception
details.short_description: It’s the 1980s. A rural cop investigates a fellow officer’s disappearance. With limited ammo and failing gear, you'll explore eerie landscapes, piece together clues, and face your own fears; no jumpscares, just tense psychological unraveling. Will you find the truth… or lose yourself?

details.title: Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition
details.short_description: Sauce it, top it, drop it! Build pizzas with flying ingredients and bouncy physics in this charming, low-pressure cooking sim. Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition is part chaos, part calm — all cozy.

details.title: Shadow Breakers
details.short_description: Play as Ultra, Apola, and Mozez as they battle shadow demons unleashed by the Cursed, a group seeking to restore balance through chaos. With their robot companions, they must split up to stop the demons and thwart the Cursed’s sinister plans.

details.title: Space Evolver
details.short_description: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

details.title: Baan Khok
details.short_description: If the city feels too big for you, come home to Baan Khok — a peaceful little village in the Thai countryside. Start anew: work the fields, grow vegetables, raise animals, and wander the lively temple fairs. Let life drift with the breeze, find love, and build a warm family of your own.

details.title: Click the Download
details.short_description: Click the Download upgrade your skills to multiply your speed, and conquer every game out there. Become the fastest downloader alive.

details.title: Foturians: Myth and Reality
details.short_description: Foturians: Myth and Reality is a non-linear visual novel where you change the probability of events. Your power depends on mood, character, and experience, while the universe's fate is decided by a dice roll. Every choice shapes who you become in the cosmic game's finale.

name: please have fun in the dream

details.title: please have fun in the dream
details.short_description: A card game where battles unfold in dreams — use your wits and luck to win fun, exciting duels.

details.title: The Undergrowth
details.short_description: The Undergrowth is an online multiplayer survival experience where you begin life as a tiny, vulnerable creature in a massive ecosystem filled with danger, opportunity, and other players. Hunt, scavenge, grow, evolve, and carve your place in a brutal world where survival is earned, not given.

details.title: Drone Farmer
details.short_description: First-person farming sim in the middle of a drone war. Shoot down AI drones and explore the village to find seeds and ammo. Use your farm drone to fulfill vegetable quotas faster. Will you let AI replace you, or will humanity prevail?

details.title: Shochimiki: The Eater's House
details.short_description: You are just another victim of the House — a living organism that remembers everyone who entered. Corridors change, rooms deceive, and escape is almost impossible. Listen, observe, and uncover the dark rules of a place that watches and hunts you.

details.title: Deadrise
details.short_description: Pilot a boat through fog and swell while something hunts you. Sonar is the only way to see, and every ping draws it closer. Find seven drifting bottles, reach Cape Wrath Light, then try Coast Guard rescues, hurricanes and a sandbox sea.

name: 送り火のうた ～邂逅の夜～

details.title: 送り火のうた ～邂逅の夜～
details.short_description: Escort a sacred festival float through the streets of night Kyoto during Obon. Play as Uta, fight off waves of spirits in fast action combat, and build your power with roguelite cards and weapons in this tower-defense action roguelite with a Japanese dark-fantasy mood.

details.title: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
details.short_description: Your son is counting on you, alone on an island crawling with creatures that stir in the dark. Feed him, build shelter, set snares, grow a garden and hunt to survive. The days are barely safe, but when night falls the real horror begins. Free demo available now.

details.title: Roadshift
details.short_description: Roadshift is a fast-paced arcade racing game featuring 42 handcrafted circuits, a full Career mode, challenging AI, local split-screen multiplayer, Time Attack, custom races and cups across seven distinctive environments.

details.title: Death's Legacy
details.short_description: Embark on an open-world adventure as a necromancer wielding dark magic. Explore vast landscapes, summon the monsters that were once your enemies, and uncover ancient secrets in an immersive experience.

details.title: Head Full Of Zombi
details.short_description: 1948, post‑war England. On Holy Island, a buried alien artifact known as The Eye corrupts prisoners, monks, and guards into flesh‑hungry ghouls. Technology fails, chaos reigns. You crash‑land among the wreckage—supplies scattered, hordes closing in. Survive or be consumed.

details.title: Superstore Rush
details.short_description: Build, expand, and manage your dream store in Superstore Rush! Unlock groceries, electronics, clothing, and more while serving customers and tackling challenges like spills and power outages. Grow your shop, stock shelves, and rise to the top as the ultimate store manager!

details.title: Oddsmaxxing
details.short_description: The odds manipulating roguelike. Oddsmaxxing lets you flip loaded coins and try to achieve specific outcomes and combos while chasing increasingly egregious targets. Unlock and use special coins to increase your chances in this satisfying gambling roguelike. May the odds be ever in your favor.

details.title: Crazy Lemmings
details.short_description: Control entire horde of lemmings and solve puzzles!

details.title: Greyskin
details.short_description: Crawl through countless dungeons, fighting hordes of monsters in this unique, fast-paced Action RPG. Class-up, mutate, and survive as you loot, shoot, upgrade, and repeat. Descend into the depths of a strange and dark world filled with mysteries and uncover its secrets.

details.title: Isles of Krom
details.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down roguelike where progression is carved into the world itself. Master challenging, Souls-inspired combat as your Wards push back the Pestilence, claim each isle's lasting power, and reclaim the Krom Archipelago run after run.

details.title: Ship of Theseus
