details.short_description: Steal your ship back from other realities, even from yourself. The Theseus is stranded, and every part it needs is held by a crew who needs it too. Rebuild it piece by piece and ask if it is still the same ship. A sci-fi roguelite FPS, solo or online co-op.

details.title: CAT Interstellar: Episode II
details.short_description: A short story inspired by Robert Heinlein's: Starship Trooper

details.title: The Main Menu
details.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

details.title: Soul Dust
details.short_description: A third-person bullet-heaven roguelite where six factions wage war around you. Parry and brawl the horde, let your build do the killing, or mix both. Play hands-on, hands-off and break the game.

details.title: SwingHard VR
details.short_description: Dodge with real footwork against challenging bosses. Move your arms as fast as you can to do damage. Swing hard, move often, you'll need to exercise your mind and body to win in this boss rush dark fantasy VR action game. Git Gud, Git fit, Workout guaranteed.

details.title: Infinity Knights: Xross
details.short_description: A 3-player couch co-op action-adventure RPG. A King and his Infinity Knights wield The Armaments - weapons capable of reviving slain enemies. Xross, the newest Infinity Knight, will embark on a life-changing adventure as he experiences both the thrill and dark reality of what it means to be eternal.

details.title: Ibboran
details.short_description: The Empire is aflame! Lead your fantastical troops through a 15-battle, turn-based strategy campaign. Build your army by achieving objectives to fill your Treasury. Recruit mercenaries to tilt the battle in your favor and use your General to improve your units or blast the enemy. To war!

details.title: Battlecore Robots
details.short_description: Customize your own mech: Use swords, bombs and all kind of weapons to defeat your oponents in frenetic battles with unique abilities! Play up to 4 players locally or online. Enter the Battlecore arena!

details.title: Bloody Shrine
details.short_description: Bloody Shrine is a twin-stick horde survivor roguelike where you build a growing Shrine on the battlefield, forge dark pacts and shape every run through cards, tokens, and blood.

details.title: Infinite Void
details.short_description: Embark on an endless cosmic odyssey in Infinite Void! Master retro-inspired space shoot 'em up gameplay with procedurally generated universes, dynamic upgrades, & simple controls. Every run offers a unique challenge. Will you conquer the "Infinite Void" or succumb to its celestial challenges?

details.title: Automatonics
details.short_description: Inspired by games like Super Mario and Megaman, in this adventure a little round robot is on a mission to save Earth. Lead your crew into exploring different planets in search of resources, fight enemy robots, collect different power-ups and upgrade your powers, while solving the planets' mysteries.

details.title: Idle Isekai - An idle RPG
details.short_description: Idle Isekai is a strategic idle RPG with roguelite elements designed for players who love managing complex growth systems. Whether you are battling fearsome monsters or meticulously managing your character's progression, the path to power is yours to define.

details.title: Cluck Up!
details.short_description: Climb from a farm all the way to the moon, where one missed jump can undo it all. Dodge lava floors, leap between skyscrapers, ride rockets through space, then storm Clawrence's castle. Grab the stolen eggs and try not to fall. Play solo or with 4 friends.

details.title: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
details.short_description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

details.title: RaceOnLife
details.short_description: RaceOnLife: AGI Resistance is an online open-world RPG with legal and illegal races, police chases, gangs, underground fights, and smart NPCs. Play the story, immerse yourself in MMO mode with your scanned avatar, compete in dynamic game modes, confront EGO and win the final race.

details.title: Starry-巡星之旅
details.short_description: 为了打倒毁灭世界的大魔王，少年和少女们踏上长长的旅途，开启了一段跨越两个世界的恋爱、幻想奇谭。 本作品搭载了中日语的文本和配音，L2D动态立绘以及超过200张的基本CG；此外还有立绘触碰等独特系统。

details.title: Trope Tales
details.short_description: A somewhat comical take on classic JRPGs. Take on the role of Hero, a Silent Protagonist, as you venture across the world to defeat the Main Villains with the help of your friends: The Chick, The Smart Guy, and The Childhood Friend.

details.title: Epsylon - The Guardians of Xendron
details.short_description: A private eye mystery game where you decide how to solve the case. Use your detective skills to solve the case or rely on the abilities of your little dragon partner to see things from a new angle.

details.title: Phones not Allowed
details.short_description: School is too boring? The temptation of using your phone too strong? Be careful, teacher's watching! Like Social Media posts and collect awesome Anime Artworks while keeping an eye on your teacher & classmates. One slip... and you are suspended!

details.title: Battle Titan:RAINBOW
details.short_description: Defeat the overwhelming forces of the ASURA Cult with the Cursed Battle Titan: RAINBOW !

details.title: Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Build and decorate your shop, diversify your products through alliances, and make the right investments to expand your business.

details.title: Star Shift Freelancers
details.short_description: In a galaxy where loyalty is tested and alliances shift like stars, Captain Max Triton and his crew find themselves embroiled in a sea of treachery. When their own government betrays them, Triton and his crew must forge their own path, or lose everything.

details.title: Tumbletail
details.short_description: Tumbletail is a 1-4 player chaotic, fast-paced party platform brawler where adorable animals race to collect ten stars while knocking rivals out of the way! Jump, dash, and brawl across colorful pixel-art arenas in a frantic free-for-all. Play locally, online, or over LAN!

details.title: The Rift Tower Defense
details.short_description: The Rift is a tower defense game with elements of RPG gameplay that will appeal to players of all skill levels. Enemies from an alternate universe are attacking and it's up to the player to stop them by strategically building defensive towers.

name: One Nation Under the Old Gods

details.title: One Nation Under the Old Gods
details.short_description: A Rogue-lite Deckbuilder set in early 1800s United States. Play as members of a secret organization that investigates occult activity in an effort to stop various cults from summoning Eldritch Gods. Acquire cards to create combos and synergies to defeat your enemies in turn-based combat!

details.title: The Remains
details.short_description: The Remains is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror where an intelligent AI enemy hunts your team whilst adapting to your tactics. Stay quiet and out of sight, or get picked off one by one.

details.title: Disc Out!
details.short_description: Harness the power of magical discs to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets in this top-down Disc Golf adventure. Master your timing, level up your skills, and meet a colorful cast of characters as you help Cary, a talking bag, on his quest to save Paradisc Island!

details.title: Chat, we are Cooked
details.short_description: Humanity is facing extinction. And naturally, as it always does, it's handling the situation very professionally. Become an asteroid, grow into an unstoppable cosmic disaster, and watch Earth react and respond with missiles, politics, corporate greed, and increasingly questionable breaking news.

details.title: Arrow & Fang
details.short_description: Take on the role of Lena Morwyn. Explore, slash and shoot arrows in this action-adventure title.

details.title: Train Goes Right
details.short_description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

details.title: 天工骇客 Shadow Hacker
details.short_description: Tear through cyberpunk defenses with kung fu and tech in this 3D roguelike fighter with comic-book style! Play as a skilled "cyber-ghost" employee, tearing through the Penglai Corporation's defenses with traditional kung fu, high-tech weaponry, and ancient magic.

details.title: My Name Is Vincent Pogo
details.short_description: Play as Vincent Pogo, a famous performer who is sent on an adventure upwards to the Royal Kingdom. A physics-driven platformer where every jump counts as you bounce and balance your way through a hand-crafted world full of challenges and goofy characters.

details.title: Mariole
details.short_description: MARIOLE is a narrative management game inspired by the traditional culture of the south of France. Take on the role of a young travelling merchant named Mariole, as she journeys through medieval/post-collapse landscapes in search of her friend, a missing ‘Trobairitz’ (a troubadour woman).

details.title: SideEye High
details.short_description: A grounded detective mystery set in the most dangerous place in America: a 1997 public high school.

details.title: CHILDREN OF SATURN
details.short_description: A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

details.title: Cardinal Descent
details.short_description: Cardinal Descent is a card building roguelike where you craft elemental synergies and find game breaking sticker combos.

details.title: UNCRACKED
details.short_description: Crack your enemies with an arsenal of weapons and various tactics in this 2D egg-splosive, gore-filled, yet kid-friendly action platformer, teeming with splattering yolk and shattering eggshels and survive the fierce cage wars.

name: Choose Cthulhu Files: The Call of Cthulhu

details.title: Choose Cthulhu Files: The Call of Cthulhu
details.short_description: What if the choices you make during your investigation awaken ancient beings older than existence itself. Explore the official Choose Cthulhu gamebook adaptation, every decision you take seals the fate of mankind. Will the creeping madness consume you as you uncover the darkest secrets?

details.title: Moeblade Formula
details.short_description: Moeblade Formula is a turn-based tactical game. Command a cast of distinctive units and battle across multi-level terrain with elevation differences. Combine weapons and positioning to unleash stylish combos, defeat powerful enemies, and claim rich rewards.

details.title: Nonu
details.short_description: Nonu is a hand-drawn 2D souls-like where every action draws from two interlinked resources-one born from inner strength, the other granted by a higher power. Explore a dying world, uncover artifacts that enable distinct builds, and piece together the truth behind its vanished god.

details.title: DEPERSON
details.short_description: Aaron wakes up in a nation where obedience is survival. As reality bleeds into a surreal nightmare, he isn’t just running from a regime. He is fleeing something far worse. Unravel Aaron's fate. Confront yourself.

details.title: Fantasy Knight
details.short_description: A rouge RPG, action and sword fighting game. Use special moves, special powers and magic to defeat all monsters and creatures waiting for you down the road.

details.title: Scrap Pit
details.short_description: A roguelike twin-stick shooter in a crooked underground robot ring. Before every fight, roll dice to raise the prize and add enemies. Spend your winnings on parts and abilities, and bend the odds until the house can’t keep up.

details.title: Arenion
details.short_description: An anime-style 3D Metroidvania adventure with fast-paced combat, varied weapon abilities, puzzle-solving, free exploration, and a mysterious journey filled with unexpected turns.

details.title: Trifoil
details.short_description: A puzzle game about drawing lines that cross, merge, and interact in unique ways. Uncover secrets, decipher symbols, and trace paths that satisfy every rule.

details.title: Aurora: Genesis
details.short_description: Uncover the secrets of the shattered realm in Aurora: Genesis, a roguelike action game. Traverse the dynamically changing landscape, battling creatures and exploring the realms. With masterful combat, endless replayability, and a rich lore to unravel, prepare for an immersive journey like no other.

details.title: Frogspin
details.short_description: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action? 🐸

details.title: Marked
details.short_description: Dust, blood, and lies. Salvation’s Edge, 1899 — a dying town where you’re a killer, a thief, and a fraud — handed a dead man’s badge and told to solve a murder. Do they deserve redemption? Do you? Or will everyone forever be MARKED?

details.title: Exofactory
details.short_description: Exofactory is a chill factory automation game where you play a forgotten AI on an alien world. Clear the forest or build around it. What you automate changes your tech, the world, and the AI's own voice.

details.title: Earth Parasite: Silo
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic, underground mining adventure, exhilarating bullet-hell shooting, mild SAN loss, mild Cthulhu, hand-painted art style, casual action sci-fi game.Escape from the underground shelter and uncover the truth behind the fall of human civilization.

details.title: Hermit Computer
details.short_description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

details.title: Picnic In The Zone
details.short_description: Search a ruined post-apocalyptic North America for your lost family. A story-driven survival shooter: scavenge every bullet, customize your weapons, face anomalies, mutants and armed patrols, and fight in first or third person across 10+ handcrafted levels.

details.title: Neon Fragments
details.short_description: Neon Fragments is a first-person shooter set in a dystopian near future. In a world where humanity crumbled under its own weight, there is not much left but despair and loneliness. How far are you willing to go for your only glimmer of light in this cruel world.

details.title: Rhythm Rat Rampage
details.short_description: Rhythm Rat Rampage is rhythm-meets-bullet-heaven. Dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style. Fight your way to the leaderboards!

name: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth

details.title: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth
details.short_description: Join Mia, an apprentice alchemist, in the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Alchemy brings new layers of strategy to traditional grid-based, turn-based roguelike gameplay. Gather materials, transmute them into powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!

details.title: Car Wash Together
details.short_description: In Car Wash Together, build your dream cleaning business - solo or in co-op! Tackle the challenge of detailing vehicles inside and out, gaining new skills and tools to satisfy even the most demanding customers.

name: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game

details.title: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game
details.short_description: No mana. Hidden threats. Your move—even on your opponent’s turn! Command your squadron and fight for control of five locations in a tactical sci-fi trading card game. Our planned 2027 Kickstarter will let you bring your own physical tournament decks to local events.

details.title: Xenolocus
details.short_description: VR FPS horror with procedural levels. Shoot xenos, complete missions, upgrade.

details.title: TAKE THEM DOWN
details.short_description: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. NOT A ROGUELIKE, game features handcrafted levels.

details.title: Annalynn MD
details.short_description: Annalynn MD is a falling block puzzle game that hearkens back to similar titles of the 16-bit era. Twist, turn, and take out germs in three different game modes as you help Annalynn make the world just a little bit healthier.

details.title: IT BEGAN
details.short_description: IT BEGAN is a single-player tactical horror shooter set in a sunken world of cults, monsters, and your own fears — where escape is no longer an option.

details.title: Super Kart Blast
details.short_description: Super Kart Blast allows you to experience a unique way of kart racer with customizable karts, special combat maneuvers and powerups. Play with AI bots, friends or competitors!

details.title: Adventure in Hender´s Castle
details.short_description: Explore Hender’s Castle in a quest for a forbidden spell in this 3D action-adventure. Draw magic circles, brew potions, invoke spirits, bargain with ghosts and above all else: don't lose your cauldron!

details.title: SPACEROCKS
details.short_description: Mine asteroids, find rare loot, upgrade & modify your ship, build space factories, and destroy your enemies!

details.title: Elegy of St. Godhrkar
details.short_description: Elegy of St. Godhrkar is an narrative-driven game with a multi-perspective POV system. By uncovering lies hidden within the tale, you gain the power to rewrite characters’ fates and shape the story’s outcome. Where stories LIE, the answer waits for your EYE.

details.title: Kanka
details.short_description: Kanka is a 1–4 player co-op sci-fi action RPG / third-person shooter. Complete missions on SP-01, fight hostile factions and alien creatures, explore its strange regions, loot and craft, shape your character build, and work together to find a way home.

details.title: Mandated Fate
details.short_description: You are a police inspector in a totalitarian state. Follow or subvert the rules without letting the state discover what you really believe. In this dystopian alternate history thriller, navigate a technocratic empire where loyalty is survival. Make brutal moral choices, save or sacrifice lives.

details.title: Vega Chronicle
details.short_description: Lead your civilization to galactic glory in this bite-sized 4X strategy game. Build, colonize, trade, and, by tact or might, overcome all who oppose you.

details.title: No Prospects
details.short_description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

details.title: Silent Hunt
details.short_description: Play as detective Jacques Renaud sent to a remote island in British Columbia. Investigate disappearances on Mist Island. Explore the island on foot or by car. Hide, fight and survive the threat that lurks in the forest. Protect the local population and put an end to predators that should not exist !

details.title: Dead Miles
details.short_description: Dead Miles is a 3D co-op horde shooter where your vehicle serves as a mobile base that you can equip with weapons and upgrades. Explore dangerous locations, fight massive hordes on foot and behind the wheel, and grow stronger through survivor-like character progression.

details.title: Shift Happens
details.short_description: Ever wanted to live out the American dream of working an abysmal 9–5 with rude management? No? Well too bad, I made a game about it anyway. Shift Happens is a first-person experience where you order stock, fill shelves, and keep the store running. The job is simple. Enjoy your shift.

details.title: Alex's Journey to the Grave
details.short_description: Two people meet in a strange, critical moment; changing their lives forever. An intimate visual novel exploring the nature of love, fate, tragedy, and the will to live on.

details.title: Jumpers' mountain
details.short_description: Join our little friends on this adventure, jumping between platforms to uncover the paths of 'Jumper's Mountain'. However, beware, as there are many secrets to reach the top, and a miscalculated jump can be quite costly.

details.title: Oath of the Necromancer
details.short_description: Raise the bones of the fallen and create an army of the undead - warriors, archers, mages, monsters & beasts. Take revenge on the old tyrant, build a sanctuary, and resurrect ancient heroes to aid in your battle. All in the name of the Greek-Egyptian God of life & death: Serapis.

details.title: The Fate of Onexora
details.short_description: The Fate of Onexora is a turn-based, story rich fantasy RPG with a wide array of skills and equipment, allowing you to play in the style that suits you best. Follow the adventures of four heroes who have been unwittingly drawn into an impending catastrophe for which they are held responsible.

name: 赝作 心灵推演 Others

details.title: 赝作 心灵推演 Others
details.short_description: 这是真冬工作室开发制作的第一部AVG游戏。你将在徽市的校园中，与各位少女邂逅，体验青春恋爱喜剧，并随着日常生活中的种种事件，逐渐探寻出这个世界最真实的一面。

details.title: Dead Faces
details.short_description: Dead Faces is a mind bending psychological horror. Unravel Jack's disturbing mind, the faces from his past and the ultimate truth behind his actions. You must remember their faces.

details.title: RSOD
details.short_description: Shoot, crack, and quest in RSOD, an action game with elements of roleplaying, loot, and anime-style graphics.

details.title: Catch The Train
details.short_description: Catch The Train is a chaotic co-op cooking game where the kitchen is rolling down the tracks. Chop, cook, and serve hungry passengers while your crew scrambles to shovel coal and keep the engine moving. Work together, manage the madness, and outrun the storm before it consumes you.

details.title: Burning Skies
details.short_description: Burning Skies is a frantic roguelite bullet hell. Build the ultimate warjet, mix weapons and enhancements every run, take down giant bosses and overthrow the tyrants who rule the world.

details.title: Uncounted Isles
details.short_description: A first-person RPG at the edge of the known world. Explore a vast archipelago from frontier towns to forgotten ruins. Wield swords and sorcery, shape your fate and fight your way through a branching story that will leave scars on your character.

details.title: Cards n' Varmints
details.short_description: Cowboy lizard roguelike with jobs, cards, and creature management. Build a ragtag team of varmints from over 50 weird jobs such as Gunslinger, Cactus, and Hotel Manager. Your team is your deck: think hard and play cards before each round to turn the tide of battle!

details.title: Hats and Guns
details.short_description: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

details.title: GREX
details.short_description: Become a swarm. Think as one. Mutate. Multiply. Overwhelm. A roguelite auto-shooter built around hive-mind powers — craft broken builds, survive the chaos, crush enemies with sheer collective force! All to a thumping trance-techno soundtrack and neon-glow visuals.

details.title: Saintess of the Golden Bow
details.short_description: Trapped in a time loop as the Saintess of the Golden Bow, every choice matters and every death is a second chance. Use knowledge from past timelines to unlock new paths and strengthen bonds in this otome visual novel. Can you rewrite fate, or are you bound to relive despair forever?

details.title: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
details.short_description: First-person dungeon crawling meets turn-based horror. Lead five fugitives into the depths of a cursed manor—and survive what’s waiting below.

details.title: Dark Omen
details.short_description: Push back the encroaching darkness and the Architect's foul designs, then return to rebuild your village and reunite its people. Forge powerful artifacts and arrange mystical Omens to shape your next build as you battle relentless hordes and bosses in this low-poly Action RPG Roguelite.

details.title: Foodgitives
details.short_description: Foodgitives is a 1-4 player couch co-op physics arcade game where you're food on the run! Tilt and roll through restaurants as murderous utensils attack to the beat of 1930s big band jazz. Coordinate with friends to survive the chopping block or master the mayhem solo.

details.title: Prize Denied
details.short_description: Prize Denied! In this cozy-evil claw machine roguelike, assemble rigged setups and play shady cards to stop customers from ever winning! Discover quirky combos to trap them in an endless addiction loop, draining their pockets dry until they finally win… or go completely broke!

details.title: 四合 Quadrangle
details.short_description: Muni awakens on an unfamiliar campus, drawn into a web of mysteries. Your choices shape relationships and the path of the story. A relationship-driven yuri game.

name: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: A free introduction to the full version of Car Cleaner Simulator is your chance to make dreams come true in a fabulously clean business. Run a car wash for Clever Emma in Winston Springs.

details.title: Heather's Haunted House Party
details.short_description: While trying to plan a party that’s to die for, a high school queen bee finds she has an uninvited guest that is much scarier than your average teenage girl. A Visual Novel about gossip, grief and ghosts.

details.title: The Eternal Experiment
details.short_description: The Eternal Experiment is a first-person horror game set in a collapsing futuristic lab. A deadly creature hunts in total darkness. Survive by managing your inventory, crafting, and creative problem-solving as you navigate the lab and fight to escape with your life.

details.title: The Lost Study
details.short_description: A forgotten study. Lost because no one remembers it. Solve puzzles, recover stories, and restore it — one chapter at a time. 14 stories, 14 worlds. Cozy, eerie, funny, and strange. They seem completely unrelated. Until they're not.

details.title: Blux
details.short_description: Engage in a non epic adventure of slimy goodness - Shoot, loot and level up your skills! Create your own weapons and play style by combining the heck out of all these skills we were too lazy to balance properly.

details.title: Doterra Industries
details.short_description: Doterra Industries is a 2D factory-building sandbox about exploring a strange mineral world, building production lines, and slowly turning a rough outpost into an automated industrial network.

details.title: Buildot
details.short_description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. Full version planned to include 100 levels plus extra challenges!

details.title: Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists-
details.short_description: Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told... Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists- is an adventure game that tells the story of Chromageists, beings with strange faces born of paintings. Through their memories, unravel the meaning each piece of art holds.

details.title: Mist Seekers
details.short_description: Venture into a forbidden zone shrouded in mist. Jump, wall-climb and dash, scavenge loot, and reach extraction before you fall. The fuller your pack, the more you stand to lose: push deeper, or extract now? Your haul makes the squad stronger, and rescued allies open paths you couldn't reach before.

details.title: Sluggernauts
details.short_description: Arcade roguelike baseball. Lead the Hickory Creek Squirrels, a small town minor league team and Earth's last hope. Take a randomized road trip and upgrade your team with powerful gear combinations. Hit, pitch, and field to beat otherworldly teams with unfair advantages.

details.title: Stay in Your Lane
details.short_description: Watch the enemy. Plan your waves. Push through. A side-scrolling strategy game where your Gym Rats, Holy Cows and High Horses march and fight on their own while you run the economy, tech tree, upgrades and spells. Story campaign, puzzle challenges, custom battles and online 1v1 and 2v2.

details.title: War Wolves
details.short_description: An online ranked third-person arena shooter where you pilot an armored robotic wolf. Compete in modes like Free For All, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag, control map power weapons, grab combat pickups, and outmaneuver rivals with fluid sprinting, sliding, clambering, jumping, and rolling.

details.title: GYRE Grazeline
details.short_description: A neon endless tube-runner where flying close pays. Pilot a ship down an accelerating luminous tunnel, threading gaps that arrive faster the longer you last. Distance builds your score, near misses add to it. Skim the edges, hold your nerve, and beat your own best line.

details.title: Survivor of the Meow Kingdom
details.short_description: Gameplay:​ A 3D pixel-art roguelike action-adventure game. In an endless sea of choices, discover powerful card-based upgrades, forge your own path, slay monsters, save the empire—or challenge yourself to the limit in endless mode.

details.title: Wild Boar Digging
details.short_description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

details.title: Vanslinger
details.short_description: Fast-paced FPS with bullet time, short replayable levels and intense action-packed combat

details.title: Paint Me Back
details.short_description: A cozy narrative adventure set in a very particular museum, where the great masterpieces of art history have lost their colors and their protagonists. Help George restore the paintings, bring the missing characters back and discover what forced them to leave their paintings...

details.title: The Nightmare Arena
details.short_description: The Ancients have awoken! Face their wrath in The Nightmare Arena, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Journey through the Realms collecting cards and facing endless waves of enemies.

details.title: Project Turbo Combat
details.short_description: Project Turbo Combat is an explosive vehicular combat racer with singleplayer and multiplayer modes. Blast through a vivid open world in muscle cars, sports sedans and EVs, firing homing missiles, dropping oil slicks, and grabbing power-ups to wreck rivals and take the lead. Free demo available now.

details.title: A Path Untrodden
details.short_description: A dark turn-based RPG in a world consumed by Mushroom Forest. Lead a group of survivors on a sacred journey to the White City, a land of promised salvation. Fight mutants, manage food, develop heroes, and make choices with lasting consequences. How much will you sacrifice to reach the White City?

details.title: DESTRALIX & DESTENYA Sector
details.short_description: Destralix & Destenya is set in the year 2088, where humanity has explored and mapped the entire Solar System and expanded into nearby star systems. Earth remains the central hub of civilization, viewed in living 3D globe divided into thousands of tiles showing terrain, cities and advanced facilities

details.title: Cluepuff Adventures
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle adventure across floating puzzle dimensions, with Cluepuff, a curious little companion you can talk to. Flip gravity, ride arks, open gates and find every puzzle piece, then build your own levels and share them with the Community.

details.title: Ichorian Tales
details.short_description: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

details.title: Pinward
details.short_description: Pinball with a roguelite twist. Spend your score on another ball or upgrades that change the table. Choose rewards, build towards bigger scores, and keep your run alive. Play with friends, or create and share your own tables with the included editor.

details.title: Hollowtone
details.short_description: A game you can play BLIND from start to finish... Meet Serene™️'s newest digital therapy model: N.O.R.A.! Hollowtone is a first person audio-based navigation horror game. For possibly the first time ever, CHOOSE to play with graphics OR blindfold yourself for a unique audio experience.

details.title: Yolings
details.short_description: Yolings is a puzzle platformer about sacrificing some to save the rest. Possess individual characters, use self-sacrificing abilities and turn their deaths into puzzle solutions to save as many as possible for the highest score.

details.title: House Craft Voyage
details.short_description: In House Craft Voyage, spawn blocks and devices, snap-weld and paint them into vehicles and contraptions, then explore with physics—or build your own space for fun. A single-player adventure sandbox of building, physics, and puzzles. Create, then set out.

details.title: Flash The Floppy Fish
details.short_description: Master the art of fast flopping and exploit deep fish physics as you speed through handcrafted environments and rank up to beat your and your friends' times. Can you claim the title of "Flash the Floppy Fish"? Or are you just another stale sardine?

details.title: Assault Commander RTS
details.short_description: Assault Commander RTS is a fast-paced real-time military strategy game. Fight a 30+ mission story campaign with two distinct factions, build and defend your base, command land, air and naval forces, unleash super weapons and climb the online leaderboards.

details.title: Fluff 'N Tumble
details.short_description: Fluff ‘N Tumble is a one-vs-many online party game for friends who deserve each other. Tackle, hunt, or team up with your friends across a handful of cute, chaotic games. This is a collection of dynamic multiplayer party games, each one changing how one player takes on the rest of the party.

details.title: Historiker
details.short_description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

details.title: Autonomous Air Combat
details.short_description: Autonomous Air Combat is an arena action roguelite missile-heaven where you pilot a fighter jet in a digital combat simulation. Create synergistic builds featuring different projectiles, modifiers, and stackable passives as you fight off difficult waves of enemy forces.

details.title: Lords of the World
details.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

name: B面人生：存在的重量 Life:Reboot

details.title: B面人生：存在的重量 Life:Reboot
details.short_description: Step into a narrative-driven social media simulator in a world dominated by one powerful platform. Here, followers are your currency and your life. You had it all—until someone set you up and banned your account for good. Start over. Climb. Be seen. Ultimately, the world's fate is in your hands.

details.title: G-Vora
details.short_description: High-speed anti-grav racing with hand-built physics for a direct, responsive feel. Slide along chargeable strips, knock rivals off the track with melee attacks, and race a friend in local splitscreen. A separate Battle Mode adds weapons.

details.title: Are You Mental?
details.short_description: You are a night shift guard at the prestigious F.U. Asylum, check whether the patients are sane or not by talking to them and looking into their diary, just DO NOT LET THE INSANE OUT!!!!!!

details.title: JAMA POKER
details.short_description: JAMA POKER is a strategic deck-building card game. During each match, you can discover and arrange JAMA cards, and elevate your gameplay by mastering the unique interplay of the five elements—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth—where each element generates or counters another.

details.title: Arx Temporis
details.short_description: A story-rich anime action RPG combining real-time combat, school life, and social simulation. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons, build relationships, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious temporal threat.

details.title: Multiverse Escape
details.short_description: This is a light rogue-like turn-based strategy game. Choose unique characters, battle across countless distinct small worlds, upgrade skills, equipment and attributes to strengthen yourself, and finally break free from the bondage of endless realms.

details.title: Wait, My Gun's Gone?
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of zombies in a chaotic PvE FPS, alone or with up to 3 friends. Run out of ammo, and you get a new random gun. Buy ammo to keep your favorite. In co-op, one player's empty gun triggers a reroll for everyone. Explore the map, buy upgrades, and discover the secret to escape.

details.title: Off Tape: Welcome
details.short_description: Stock the shelves. Watch the cameras. Tell the humans from the things wearing their faces. Decide who to serve, and eliminate the rest. Off Tape: Welcome is a retro horror shop sim where you run the store for the Tobacconists, owners who don't know you exist.

details.title: Velo Victory
details.short_description: Velo Victory is a new cycling management PC game. Build your legacy through scouting, transfers, facilities, staff, and tactics. Shape future champions, meet sponsor goals and lead your team to victory.

name: World of Dynasty: Shadows of Sagas

details.title: World of Dynasty: Shadows of Sagas
details.short_description: Dynasty World: Shadows of Tradition Epic MMO with survival elements and RPG. A fugitive from a destroyed dynasty, you enter the magical world through a flaming obelisk. Fight, solve the secrets of dungeons and create a new great dynasty in the harsh world of magic and warrior!

details.title: We Need An Army
details.short_description: A tactical roguelike where your entire army moves as one! Shift your formation, line up powerful bonuses, and discover ridiculous combinations of units, relics, and battlefield upgrades.

details.title: Jigrift
details.short_description: You crash onto the shores of a long lost island! This strange land is a gigantic jigsaw puzzle that you must assemble to explore. Earn your place among a tribe of three-eye’d voodoo frogs and put the island back together. They’ll allow you to stay if you succeed!

name: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)

details.title: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)
details.short_description: A classic nostalgic side scroll game！
developers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室
publishers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室

details.title: Anachron
details.short_description: What if Joan of Arc fought alongside Blackbeard? In Anachron, you weave a dream team of 4 historical heroes to clash in a tactical, turn-based Arena. Build a custom deck for each champion from their unique abilities and unleash history-defying combos.

details.title: Headshot Holdout
details.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines. There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

details.title: Slumber Craft
details.short_description: Slumber Craft is a narrative deckbuilder about insomnia, pressure, and self-repair. Plan activities by day; build poker-style hands by night, from high card to full house, chain scores into Sleepiness. 21 nights, branching endings, and an Endless Mode asking how long you can keep weaving the dream.

details.title: Multincremental
details.short_description: Juggle interconnected minigames in a multitasking incremental where your performance in one affects all the others. Earn promotions, unlock new challenges and abilities, and climb from intern to the top as the whole office gets harder to manage.

details.title: Luck in the Dark
details.short_description: Luck in the Dark is a turn-based roguelike with slot machines and backpack management. Pack your bag to improve your odds, spin the reels, and find your way out of the dark.

details.title: REDHAND
details.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

details.title: Hitflag
details.short_description: Arcade car chases on real city streets: grab the flag, ram whoever carries it and escape, on Istanbul's Taksim, New York's Times Square or any street you pick on the map. Then race, wreck or run down the dead. 2 to 8 cars, online or with bots.

details.title: Project8088: Finding Aidia Le
details.short_description: A fast first-person arcade shooter where you transfer into a quantum state and fight inside the hardware. Stack buffs, gain augmentations, and push through 16 levels of routers, rigs, and servers to find Aidia Le.

details.title: Banners of the Galaxy
details.short_description: Recruit, scheme, explore, and fight. Build your fleet, choose your allegiances, and command your ships in real-time space battle in this open-world space RPG.

details.title: The Minesweeper's Tale
details.short_description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

details.title: Purrfect Waiter
details.short_description: Become a bartender on a tricky delivery adventure! Navigate platforms, traps, and obstacles with physics-based controls. Keep your fragile wine bottle from falling or breaking while collecting coins along the way. Learn from each failure and deliver the wine safely!

details.title: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele
details.short_description: "Haven't seen you in forever." A narrative-driven RPG about the heart. In a peaceful world where all conflict has come to an end, is there still a chance to make up for the words left unspoken?

name: Sons of the Arena: Pollice Verso

details.title: Sons of the Arena: Pollice Verso
details.short_description: A small ludus is yours, and it has to reach the great games. Build the estate, pick fights from the hosts’ calendar, fight off the rival. Turn-based fights on hexes: a kick drops a man, a wedge breaks a shield wall. Four classes, six weapon types, and all a man wears shows on him.

details.title: Life and Lemon
details.short_description: Come get cozy in this fruit farming card game. Grow your orchard business, discover countless combinations of card fusions, and befriend a cast of quirky characters across a variety of lush and unique locations!

details.title: FerroFrame
details.short_description: FerroFrame is a real-time strategy ecology simulator — dig, dam, redirect and blast industry into high gear, then survive the world as the balance tilts in either direction. Use gigantic mechs called frames to terraform the planet to your needs and replenish your world with asteroids!

details.title: Space Burger
details.short_description: Run a burger joint in zero gravity with your friends. Jetpack around a tiny spaceship, stack floating burgers, feed chatty aliens and keep the place in one piece while meteors, fires and hull breaches tear it apart.

details.title: Metzger Manager
details.short_description: Run your own butcher shop, buy animals, butcher meat, serve customers, and expand your business with employees and upgrades.

details.title: Forged from Monsters
details.short_description: Not every sword begins as steel. Forge weapons from monster parts with hands-on control over every step of the process. Discover surprising effective combinations of creature parts heroes bring to your smithy.

details.title: Abjure
details.short_description: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

details.title: Echoes of Aromia
details.short_description: Echoes of Aromia is a story-driven, pixel art RPG with turnbased combat, branching dialogue, alchemy, companions, and much more. Set in a pre-steampunk medieval fantasy world on the brink of industrialization, full of corruption, conspiracy, good, and evil. And ancient myths waiting to be uncovered.

details.title: Meatstone
details.short_description: Meatstone is a turn-based tactical RPG. As a mercenary in a wasteland with alien colonizers, you must cross the unknown surface, gather resources for your base, and augment your gears and flesh. Learn the truth of the past, and salvage what remains of a world that may already be beyond saving.

name: Outside the pile of leaf litter

details.title: Outside the pile of leaf litter
details.short_description: In Toronto's cold, dry, pitch-black polar night, a four-string bass roars in a freezing basement. Sink into punker Jack's drug‑induced, hallucinatory "trip"—face the overwhelming unease through twisted fluid colors and a torn, fractured vision.

details.title: XTREME PEACEKEEPER FORCE: OPERATION BLITZ
details.short_description: A retro-inspired top-down vehicular shooter where you weave through danger, unleash heavy weapons, rescue POWs, destroy enemy forces, and battle explosive bosses across fast-paced, arcade-style combat missions.

details.title: Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop
details.short_description: Build and run your own arcane workshop. Explore a dangerous fantasy world, gather rare ingredients, grow magical crops, craft powerful potions, manage your shop, and fight with blades, bows, and spells—alone or with friends in co-op.

details.title: Ravens Imaginary Friends
details.short_description: A Yuri Visual Novel about a girl named Raven who wakes up after an accident to a life changing surprise. Her imaginary friends from when she was little have appeared in the real world and are deeply in love with her! Now she has to make a tough choice to fix this complicated love triangle.

details.title: Vacuum Uprising
details.short_description: Rip the ground from under your feet and hurl it at your enemies! Vacuum Uprising is a pixel-perfect destruction platformer with physics-based combat, epic boss fights, and local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

details.title: Voidbit
details.short_description: In this challenging deckbuilder puzzle platformer, mixing turn based with real time gameplay, you don't control the main character. Instead, you'll play cards to manipulate the character, the world and the deck to lead them off planet before the chasing void consumes them.

details.title: Flipping Football Clubs
details.short_description: Buy, build, and flip football clubs in a fast-paced roguelite management sim. Sign players, hire staff, survive FFP, unlock Club DNA modifiers, and grow club value across 1-2 hour seasonal runs.

details.title: Paper Lanes
details.short_description: A transport strategy game: draw trade routes on 30 hand-drawn maps of real regions, from the Aegean to Malacca, and keep caravans and ships moving goods to towns that need them. Routes, vehicles and ports are scarce, so every redraw counts. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4.

details.title: Hazel Rush
details.short_description: You need to explore the world, outsmart your environment and uncover secrets to unlock new paths to reach your next destination, gather crucial knowledge, craft different structures, and survive hidden dangers.

details.title: Pixel Rush: RTS
details.short_description: A fantasy real-time strategy deck builder where you summon monsters, evolve them mid-battle, cast spells, fight for control of the battlefield and rush the enemies base for victory!

details.title: Goat Survivor 2
details.short_description: Soul-harvesting survival action: a goat wizard sets out to conquer the demon realm. Mow down endless hordes, capture foes with Mind Control, and grow stronger with every soul. Simple controls, fast growth, screen-filling battles. Conquer domain after domain and claim the Demon Lord's throne.

details.title: VOIDSWARM
details.short_description: They came from the void. You are all that stands between the swarm and our annihilation. Direct and fight alongside an immense fleet as both pilot and commander, hold the line against thousands of enemies using powerful upgrades, and take back our homeworlds in this roguelike RTS.

details.title: Driftbane: The Long Awaited
details.short_description: A disgraced captain, a wanted murderer, a haunted nurse: three outcasts shipwrecked on shores that shouldn't exist, changed by powers they don't understand. Driftbane is a tactical RPG of grid combat, recruited beast-folk allies, and a creeping corruption killing two worlds.

details.title: AmaTisMo
details.short_description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

details.title: Mushrooms vs Engineers
details.short_description: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down bullet heaven/hell where you are The Engineer, armed with your trusty nail-gun battle the hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you face the final boss. The enemies you face are affected by your own choice of upgrades in the shop.

details.title: GONE
details.short_description: This is a story about self-discovery, wrapped in the guise of family. You step into the shoes of Gu Huixing. Watching my life unfold as an outsider, re-examining trivial days from an omniscient perspective — what will I become? Life is never a dead end. It is always a choice.

details.title: Capitol Diktatoria
details.short_description: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

details.title: Hollow Crown
details.short_description: Hollow Crown is a dark idle-incremental autobattler that casts you as an ascendant claimant to a ruined throne. Assemble a court of cursed champions, relics, and sigils; set their decks, assign passive roles, and watch the spire’s floors unspool as automated skirmishes resolve

details.title: Koto 琴
details.short_description: A fast-paced top-down arena fighter for 1-4 players. Slash, block, and parry with samurai swords, or pick up a koto instrument to unleash ranged sound-wave attacks. Play locally in split-screen or battle online.

details.title: Overdrive: New Earth
details.short_description: OVERDRIVE is a retro 3D combat racing ARPG. Build and weaponize your car, battle rivals who remember your every move, and conquer procedurally generated tracks across five deadly biomes. Every race is a fight for survival. Every victory makes you stronger.

details.title: LANCELOT: The Silver Knight
details.short_description: Experience the legends of “Lancelot: The Silver Knight”, as he sets out on a quest to reclaim his title as a knight. A quirky top-down action-adventure game set in an mystical Brittany filled with enigmatic dungeons, legendary monsters and… chickens?

details.title: GOLF TRIP
details.short_description: YOU ARE THE DRUG. Show off your accuracy while controlling an experimental substance designed to strip away human will. High skill, instant restarts, and zero room for error. DELIVER THE DOSE. DON'T FAIL. THIS IS GOLF TRIP.

details.title: Project Longshot
details.short_description: Build a space program that reaches the stars in this 1:1 scale spaceflight and colony sim. Design rockets and fly them with real orbital mechanics. Land anywhere in a procedural universe of over two million real star systems, then set up space stations, colonies and factories. How far can you go?

details.title: Outspin Champions
details.short_description: Outspin Champions is a local competitive PvP / Co-op brawler where the spinning never stops. It blends party-game chaos with Souls-like precision, mastering physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

details.title: For The Witch
details.short_description: For The Witch is a cute fantasy top-down tower-defense roguelite. Protect a sleeping witch from mosquito swarms, develop both the soldier and the witch, combine mechanic-changing items, and awaken them into new effects to hold out through each night.

details.title: Dyeversion
details.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

details.title: Luck and Raid
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

details.title: Doomsday Train
details.short_description: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.

details.title: Astral Dive
details.short_description: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

details.title: Lawn Mower Mayhem
details.short_description: Mow lawns, haggle prices and build a lawn-care empire in a cartoon mountain village — while three rivals sabotage every job with garden gnomes, rubber chickens and the occasional airborne sheep. Career mode for the turf war, Chill mode for just the mowing.

details.title: Core!1!
details.short_description: Core Miner is a cozy incremental mining adventure where every swing takes you deeper into Earth. Break rock, collect ores, relics and pet eggs, upgrade your tools and build powerful loadouts on the journey toward the planet's core.

details.title: We Don't Exist
details.short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

details.title: Hellkick
details.short_description: One kick, one survivor. HELLKICK is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

details.title: Purrgeist
details.short_description: A cozy-spooky ghost-catching incremental. You're a little cat with a spectral vacuum: explore a haunted mansion room by room, suck up ghosts, harvest essences, sell your loot, and pour it into a massive talent tree. Short runs, satisfying progression, and always one more.

details.title: Magnet Fishing Together
details.short_description: A cozy co-op game about magnet fishing with up to 4 friends. Throw, pull and hope for something good. Sometimes it’s a rusty spoon. Sometimes it’s a scooter you can ride. And sometimes your friend lets go of the rope at the worst possible moment.

details.title: Wall Over
details.short_description: Stack furniture, combine your powers, and toss a friend over the wall in a physics adventure for 1–4 players. Play solo or team up online as four tiny creatures on a quest to bring their village’s missing music box home.

details.title: Spells of Arcanetheria
details.short_description: A dark 16-bit roguelite where magic is everything. Find lost spells, master them, then forge your own from soul shards, Aether and relics: one roll, no recipes, yours forever. When death comes, roll the d20. When your hero falls for good, their spells live on for the next adventurer.

details.title: Slime Overload
details.short_description: Slime Overload is a Plinko roguelike auto-battler and deckbuilder. Slime balls grow stronger as they bounce off pins, then summon an army at the exits. Combine slimes and relics, upgrade your machine, choose paths to exploit enemy weaknesses, and protect your Hero Slime to defeat the final boss!

details.title: Spotlight Tennis
details.short_description: Spotlight Tennis is a classic tennis game. Upgrade your skills, play to win, and become a champion!

details.title: Lord of the Mountain
details.short_description: Lead your dwarven clan back into the mountain the dragons took. Build a stronghold in the dark and filter the spore-filled air to claim ground. Then hold the line as the dragon sends its fungus-infected hordes against you. A dwarven survival RTS with pause.

details.title: Shio: Be With Me
details.short_description: A quiet train, a cold-faced vampire girl, and a promise you can't quite remember. Take on commissions with Shio, stay focused together, and slowly find your place beside her.

details.title: Trust No One: MAFIA
details.short_description: The party game Mafia, but nobody closes their eyes at night. A first-person social deduction shooter for 7 to 15 players with proximity voice chat. The Mafia can take a dark form: no voice, no name above their head. If someone in the dark won't answer you, run. Or shoot first.

details.title: Round Table Rivals
details.short_description: Round Table Rivals is a turn-based fighting game where your strategy starts the combo — but your timing keeps it alive. Build your team, chain attacks, take down powerful bosses, and challenge your friends in head-to-head battles.

details.title: Driftholm
details.short_description: Build a cozy town on a floating island. Place buildings where they suit their neighbors, grow hamlets into cities, pull new land in from the clouds and keep your island balanced as it drifts through the seasons. Alone or with a friend.

details.title: Haulage Simulator
details.short_description: Drive near real-world-scale UK motorways, battle traffic, roadworks, rain and crosswinds, master detailed trucks with force feedback, complete timed deliveries, build your reputation and grow from hired driver to owning your own haulage company.

details.title: Hotel of Seams
details.short_description: October 1997. Your grandfather’s lakeside hotel is yours now: a diner, rooms to manage, and two cats. Cook meals and serve your customers, hand out keys to guests, and keep everything clean. Some of the people who check in are not human, and nobody is going to tell you which ones.

details.title: Pop 1,000,000 Hot Air Balloons
details.short_description: Shoot hot air balloons, steer falling passengers through pegs, and spend the cash on upgrades as you race to pop one million.

details.title: Frontier Factory
details.short_description: Build your automated factory on a frontier planet! Mine resources, plan logistics and research technology as conveyor belts and machines take on the hard work. Build defenses against zombies and roaming powerful creatures, and face the Blood Moon every seven days.

details.title: Hell Looks Back
details.short_description: A breakup text. A missing boy. A trail of strange clues. Adrien is forced to work together with Dante to find the one person they both can't live without... until it leads them to hell.

details.title: Order of the Crystalline Tortoise
details.short_description: Walk a baby tortoise one leg at a time across a storm-wrecked island. Find food, gather torn clues and make friends who live inside your crystal shell. At night, move those friends between its openings to fend off threats in this story-led adventure with real-time defense.

details.title: Coin Shower
details.short_description: Coin Shower is a short, cozy incremental casino arcade game. Every machine pays out in a burst of coins that pile up on the floor. Scoop them up, spend them on upgrades, unlock new machines, and chase the $1,000,000 moon shot.

details.title: Spuskaemsa!
details.short_description: A cooperative roguelike looter-shooter (1–4 players). Descend into the infinite Buffer, explore procedurally generated floors, scavenge for supplies, and battle its inhabitants. Rescue your comrades and upgrade your elevator. Godspeed!

details.title: Evergather: Meadowcraft
details.short_description: Build your paradise in a medieval village! Master the rhythm of tending crops, then dive into a rich gathering and crafting economy. Harvest magical materials, forge your tools, and design a vibrant countryside retreat in this 3D top-down sandbox.

details.title: Ball and Stick
details.short_description: Two bodies, one connection. Roll, swing and launch a Ball and Stick through a physics-driven sci-fi adventure, alone or with friends, and cause chaos with wild attachments

details.title: King of Puzzles
details.short_description: A cosy little kingdom-building puzzle. Lay dominoes around your castle, grow the biggest patch of each terrain you can, and see how your kingdom compares. A new board whenever you want one, a daily everybody shares, and a crown for whoever leads the most boards.

details.title: Par Under Review
details.short_description: A turn-based golf roguelike set in the 1930s. Build a deck of clubs golf won't invent for decades, and beat the golfers of the day at their own game without ever taking a swing.

details.title: Colorsong
details.short_description: Colorsong is a relaxing incremental game where you collect colors and turn them into hand-painted watercolors 🎨 Every color plays its own note 🎵 As your palette expands, the game's song unfolds and grows richer.

details.title: Wallstrike
details.short_description: A fast-paced wallball game for up to 8 players. Strike the ball with one hand, bounce it off the ground and into the wall, and send it beyond the next player's reach. Play locally or compete online, eliminate your rivals, and build your career to become world champion!

details.title: IncreGate
details.short_description: IncreGate is an incremental shooter. Hold the line as hundreds of goblins, skeletons and orcs pour out of the gate, then spend your Gold on a sprawling upgrade tree, 48 guns, part cards and a squad of companions, and push one round further.

details.title: Aftermind
details.short_description: Aftermind is a fast roguelike boomer shooter inside a coma patient's nightmares. Shoot limbs off, stagger enemies and end them with brutal finishers. Every run brings new powers, and a little more of the truth about why you're here.

details.title: Line Story
details.short_description: Follow number clues and connect the dots to reveal hidden illustrations in this cozy, hand-drawn logic puzzle game. Bring Lili and Nene's storybook world to life, one drawing at a time.

details.title: The Unfinished Horror Game
details.short_description: You wake up inside a horror game that was never finished. Glitches everywhere, monsters that ignore their code, and an old man who says he wants to help. Find the key, survive the house and get out alive.

details.title: Glow Trap
details.short_description: Move lanterns and set lures to draw moths, fireflies, beetles, spiders and ants into your garden, capture the ones you want, and fill a museum of bell jars. A cozy collection game where every species wants something different.

details.title: Tug-O-War Wrestling
details.short_description: Grab the rope and fight for control in a physics-based wrestling game where every move pulls your opponent with you. Master momentum through Season Mode or battle friends and random opponents locally and online.

details.title: Factory Reset
details.short_description: Shorty's repair shop has gone quiet, and the note says back soon. Under the desk sits a box of factory paperwork nobody ever mentioned. Work the jobs on the bench with real tools and real skills, learn to see past the first sign of life, and find out what a factory reset really means.

details.title: Attrition Line
details.short_description: A factory game about building an army. Mine, smelt, and manufacture soldiers on an assembly line, then send them to fight a swarm that grows every hour. The more you automate, the bigger your army. Fall behind and the line breaks.

details.title: Console Dealer
details.short_description: Run a secondhand games shop in 2003, where every sale is a negotiation. Read the customer, hold your price or fold, buy low across the counter and at auction, and keep a shelf that moves before the rent comes due. A first-person shop sim about haggling, stock and margins.

details.title: Tame or Conquered
details.short_description: You got isekai'd, only to wake up as a cursed saintess. You have 6 months to choose a husband from 7 yandere red flags.. or become a big tree and die. A "simple" psychological horror & dark romance VN.

details.title: Kayak Photography Sim
details.short_description: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

details.title: Sneaky Eraser
details.short_description: Class started… a bit boring. Wanna play Eraser War? Let’s go! Sneaky Eraser is a turn-based physics party brawler for 2–6 players. Take control of your eraser—aim, charge, and launch! Knock the others off the desk, and you win. It’s that simple~

details.title: BLASTARD!
details.short_description: Blast your way through walls, enemies, and your own friends! Grow absurdly powerful by placing kegs, kicking them, leveling up, and stacking loot into wild builds as you fight your way through each run!

details.title: Mall Security
details.short_description: Co-op physics comedy for 1–4 mall guards. X-ray shoppers, yell orders into your mic, chase shoplifters and throw them in the cell. Every broken window goes on your report, so try not to get fired. Or switch sides in Thieves vs Guards PvP.

details.title: Jade Cutting Simulator
details.short_description: Your grandfather has retired. The jade workshop is yours to run. Guide the saw along your own line and rinse the cut to see what's inside. Sell a good stone to fund your next find, or keep that streak of green for a bangle customers will remember? The future of the shop is up to you.

details.title: Hellscums tactics
details.short_description: Hellscum Tactics features tactical turn-based combat. Party based gameplay with character progression, and dungeon crawling.

details.title: The Fifth Name
details.short_description: A claustrophobic psychological mystery visual novel. On their high school graduation day, an anonymous message draws five friends back to their empty middle school. The doors won't open, and their memories refuse to agree. A complete 1-2 hour story with three endings, built to be read twice.

details.title: Stone to Stars
details.short_description: Stone to Stars is a colony sim and ruler simulator set at the dawn of civilization. Settle an uncharted continent, build a thriving settlement, discover new technologies, trade or wage war with your neighbors—and hold on to power as you guide your dynasty through the ages.

details.title: Sneaky Pig: Druid Hide & Seek
details.short_description: Scout the village as a bat, disguise yourself as an animal, and steal valuable treasures without breaking character. Outsmart rifle-wielding Hunters in a chaotic multiplayer twist on hide-and-seek.

details.title: Hexing
details.short_description: Build a living dungeon one hex at a time. Place monster camps, shrines, and traps, grow a few goblins into an army, and hold back endless hero waves in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder. Then gamble blood to hex your camps into monsters.

details.title: Chirp Chirp
details.short_description: One lost little bird, one big climb back home. Chirp Chirp is a lighthearted precision platformer where every jump, chirp, and butt stomp brings you one flap closer to the warmth of your cozy nest.

details.title: Souls on the Line
details.short_description: Become a Spirit Summoner and lead an army of Souls in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Collect strange entities with unique abilities and lead them in position- and sequence-based combat. Thwart the plans of a kingdom obsessed with dark magic by stealing their sinister Artifact.

details.title: LOOPFANG
details.short_description: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

details.title: Belt Bound Boxing
details.short_description: A physics-based boxing roguelike where no two careers are the same. Every boxer is uniquely generated with stats and modifiers that completely change how they fight. Train, study your opponents, negotiate contracts, manage your lifestyle, and fight your way to the title.

details.title: Manasworn
details.short_description: Manasworn is an isometric action RPG with 3 spellcaster playable classes. Pick a Mage, Shaman or Necromancer, progress deeper in generated dungeons, and shape your spells with runes and relics. Fight alone or with three other friends in online co-op.

details.title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
details.short_description: You and your friends run a dog daycare and pet shop. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

details.title: The Off-Season
details.short_description: The seaside hotel is shut from October to March, and the winter caretaker is you. The owner's rules are pinned beside the key board: no guests. Somebody knocks anyway, after the last bus, in the rain, with cash and no booking. You decide who gets a key, and which room.

details.title: PAVYON
details.short_description: You don’t know what will happen tonight. Same table, same lights… but never the same night! Step into the interactive nightclub, choose your table, and see where the night takes you. Meet online players, dive into conversations, build new connections, and become part of the story of the night...

details.title: Babel Rising Reborn
details.short_description: Humanity wants to reach the heavens. You're God. Make them regret it. Unleash the elements and bring the Tower of Babel crashing down in this remastered god game, more spectacular than ever. The Unreal Engine 5 remake of a cult god game.

details.title: Hirelings
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics roguelike about building an overpowered party of mercenaries. Hire, reroll, and merge mages, vampires, rogues and more between battles... then outsmart every enemy on the grid.

details.title: Trial by Mana
details.short_description: Level up, learn new spells, loot unique equipment, slay hordes of enemies, and conquer mighty foes in this action-packed Bullet Heaven Rogue-lite!

details.title: GRUBWERK
details.short_description: Manufacture the tools and assemble the bombs that will raise our great nation above all others. You and your comrades will expand our new munitions factory in the eastern block.

details.title: Starfire Skies
details.short_description: Your fireworks are your cards in this turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Launch fireworks now or save them for the finale to keep your audience of animals entertained. Open card and talisman packs, discover unique shops and events, and earn your stars so you can put on an unforgettable show!

name: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood

details.title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
details.short_description: Join Sahara B. Shabazz as she honours that Korean man's sacrifice by winning this martial arts tournament with the Taekwondo that flows in her veins.

details.title: Ether@Net
details.short_description: Become a Netwalker — a paranormal investigator navigating between the haunted streets of Hong Kong and a digital ghost realm. Uncover urban tragedies, forge a bond with your ghost companion, and unravel the truth that lingers beyond the Net.

details.title: SubDuctis
details.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

details.title: ZombMe
details.short_description: Old school platforming...with a twist. It's another zombie game....except this time YOU are the zombie...and instead of trying to stay alive....you're trying to stay dead! Jump, flip, throw, and avoid health powerups as you try to (not) save your neck.

details.title: CarveLight
details.short_description: CarveLight is a turn-based artillery game fought on fully destructible terrain. Take turns piloting physics-driven cars, carve the battlefield apart with lasers, grenades, and force fields, and be the last one driving. Free-for-all or in teams, against friends or CPUs, on the couch or online.

details.title: Adventurers Guild Inc.
details.short_description: Run the business behind the heroics by managing your own Adventurers Guild! Turn the world's problems into appealing quest and take your cut. Support your adventurers by selling them the services they don't even know they need. Then reinvest your earnings and grow the greatest guild of them all!

details.title: MEMORALYSIS: The Scorched Home
details.short_description: A murder mystery visual novel about catharsis.

details.title: Residue Of The Lost
details.short_description: A cursed spirit from your past life has slipped into the modern world with your reincarnation. As a sorcerer stripped of all memory, uncover the truth within a single house, reclaim your forgotten powers, and prepare for the confrontation awaiting you. The real fear begins here.

details.title: Golem Gourmet
details.short_description: A gastronomical adventure sizzling with culinary chaos! Build a bizarre bistro from an ever-shifting array of rooms, amass heaps of treasure, and earn enough critical acclaim to became the ultimate Golem Gourmet.

details.title: Maneuver Warfare 2: BTG
details.short_description: A simulation of the 2022 Russo-Ukrainian War where the player maneuvers battalion tactical groups on a map and controls assets such as aircraft, special forces teams, satellites, field hospitals, and repair facilities to support these. The player can play single battles or a campaign game.

details.title: Rap Mogul
details.short_description: Sign artists. Negotiate deals. Build your empire. Manage a roster of unique artists, navigate turn-based contract battles, and watch every relationship evolve through a dialogue system where characters remember everything.

details.title: Aiyoe's Secret Room
details.short_description: Locked-room mystery meets sweet romance in this immersive visual novel! Solve tricky chamber puzzles and meet lively girls. Dynamic sprites, multiple endings shaped by your choices. Want more? The official anime adaptation is on Crunchyroll. Search X&Y for extra stories!

details.title: Undying War: Gate Of Pioneer
details.short_description: Undying War: Gate of Pioneer is a subculture-style multiplayer brawl action game where unique characters clash in real time. Enjoy fast-paced and thrilling battles that unfold within five minutes.

details.title: Falling Up
details.short_description: Falling Up is a 3D adventure game, your goal is to get to the top of the mountain. There will be a lot of challange duration your trip, you have to either beat them, or be sneaky. Don't be frustracted when you fall from the mountain, you are leveling up each time you fall.

details.title: Scattered
details.short_description: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

details.title: Refrain: Verse of Fate
details.short_description: A garden caught in eternal recurrence. A god who forgets everything. A witness without rest. In this narrative-driven 2D exploration game, walk, listen, and read your way through four cycles to piece together a truth hidden beneath the surface.

details.title: Dawn of the West
details.short_description: Fight for control of the frontier in this competitive multiplayer Wild West FPS where precision gunplay, tactical movement, and class synergy decide every match. Capture objectives, master stamina-based traversal, and dominate the frontier through pure skill.

details.title: Orium
details.short_description: Aboard your ship, exterminate your enemies, exploit planets and weave your enterprise across the stars of a dying procedural galaxy. Orium is a Lovecraftian space roguelite, infused with streamlined 4X elements.

details.title: Returnless
details.short_description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

details.title: Armada Pet Wars
details.short_description: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.

details.title: Down Under Destruction
details.short_description: Down Under Destruction is a stylised first person action brawler with an Australian twist, featuring a vengeful bricklayer taking on a demonically influenced building corporation, one brick throw at a time.

details.title: Oxygen Survivors
details.short_description: Oxygen Survivors is a side-scrolling roguelite where you control a spaceship supported by up to 6 drones that follow your movement. Fuse your drones together, get upgrades, and survive the final boss before the oxygen runs out.

details.title: Dominar Sanctum
