details.short_description: Why just command your army when you can join the fight? Build your fortress, command your minions, and possess your hero to unleash third-person combat in this dark fantasy fusion of dungeon management, RTS and action.

details.title: Obliteration Quest
details.short_description: Deliver utter obliteration through unique synergies, fully procedural and destructible environment and 4 unique characters in this hack&slash action roguelite. choose between 7 elemental power ups, lots of items and passive upgrades and destroy anything in your way.

details.title: Butterfly: Twisted Thread
details.short_description: Butterfly: Twisted Thread is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where you use a mystical butterfly to draw platforms, objects, and attack tools into the world. Explore interconnected areas, solve physics-based puzzles, fight enemies, and unlock new paths through creative drawing.

details.title: Loopy Dungeon
details.short_description: Legend has it that all who enter this dungeon are doomed to loop forever. In Loopy Dungeon, build your deck fight after fight, combine your relics and break the cycle.

details.title: Skies of Valoria
details.short_description: "Skies of Valoria" is a fantasy action Roguelite with dynamic builds and fast combat. Soar the clouds on "Aethelwhale", team up with 4 Valkyries across Valoria, and strike the Demon King's Castle! Harness War Souls for endless combos and summon monsters to sweep away all foes.

details.title: BLOCK13
details.short_description: Block13 is a first-person psychological horror exploration game. On a calm afternoon, you step into a weathered Hong Kong public housing estate. Wandering its hazy corridors, unsettling secrets emerge. The deeper you go, the more it entangles you. Unravel its mystery to break free.

details.title: Cave Clicker
details.short_description: Mine rocks to collect rare ores to become the richest Mole alive, and looking good while doing it too!

name: Haedong Bisa: Secret Records of the East

details.title: Haedong Bisa: Secret Records of the East
details.short_description: On a land in flames, whose fate will fall? Set in 1597, you are a warrior caught between invaders and court intrigue. Your choices decide your path—be a blade that saves lives, or walk a road of ruin. A Joseon martial arts narrative RPG.

details.title: Space Pizza Express
details.short_description: A funny arcade space-action game about delivering pizza across the galaxy, where the perks include zero-gravity working conditions and unlimited cheese snacks, and the risks include stolen pizzas, flying hazards, and unhappy intergalactic customers.

details.title: Sun Catcher
details.short_description: Restore damaged stained glass art and immerse yourself in a charming story about lost memories and community in Sun Catcher, a cozy paint-by-numbers tale.

details.title: Siege of the Isletress
details.short_description: Siege of the Isletress is a tower defence survival game where you defend a lone fortress against hordes of enemies. Make meaningful decisions under pressure, exploit interconnected systems using 120+ distinct weapons and upgrades and uncover the secret history of the Isletress.

details.title: TicketRot: A Carnival Incremental Game
details.short_description: A carnival incremental where you’re the only one left. Throw darts, whack moles, shoot hoops, wind up clockwork figures to play for you, and win relics from the claw machine. The midway rots a little more with every booth you bring back.

details.title: Cluckopia
details.short_description: Cluckopia is a cozy block-building game. You are a rooster: build a house — walls, door, roof — and set out to find your missing sister. Plant, cook, forge, decorate the village and make friends at your own pace; when danger comes, awaken the legendary powers. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

details.title: Nine Winters
details.short_description: Survive a ruined city where the infected lurk in Nine Winters. Fight back or slip through the dark to scavenge ruins yourself for parts and collectibles. Repair your broken shelter, grow crops, and decorate your home with cherished finds to endure nine winters.

details.title: When Two Roses Collide
details.short_description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

details.title: The Ones Who Answered
details.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

details.title: Fantasy Meat
details.short_description: Fantasy Meat is a stress-free cooking game where fantasy creatures are the main ingredient. Cut and assemble them on a skewer as you please, satisfy increasingly more demanding customers, and send out adventurers to find the tastiest creature: The Golden Drake!

details.title: The Backrooms Experience
details.short_description: The Backrooms Experience is a cooperative exploration and survival-horror game built around observation, discovery, and the unknown. Enter liminal environments alone or with others, document what you learn, and survive encounters with the entities hidden within.

name: Stickman Raid: Return of the King

details.title: Stickman Raid: Return of the King
details.short_description: No complicated introductions here—2D, side-scrolling, stick figures, vertical industrial towers, and an evacuation rule where "you only win if you make it out." Fast-paced matches, ready to play anytime.

details.title: Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense
details.short_description: Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

details.title: Clinic Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own clinic solo or team up with up to 4 players! Examine patients, diagnose and treat them. Divide the work, make decisions, and build your dream clinic — or at least try to keep the place from falling apart.

name: The Last Ranger: End of days

details.title: The Last Ranger: End of days
details.short_description: The Last Ranger is a dark fantasy top-down survival shooter where you fight off huge waves of enemies, stack mid-round upgrades to buff yourself up and do your best to survive the night. Make the most of the permanent mastery system to make each run more rewarding, then take bosses down in style!

details.title: Quicksant
details.short_description: A retro ant colony sim where your ants think for themselves. Place pheromone trails and your ants dig, haul, and build on their own, following the scent to work, food, or danger. Tunnel through a fully destructible world, farm the surface, outgrow the rival ant colony, and survive the dangers.

details.title: Walls Were Built to Fall
details.short_description: Walls Were Built to Fall is an epic scale incremental FPS horde defense roguelite. Build your defenses, draft defenders, discover crazy builds, and hold back millions of enemies.

details.title: Fight Manager
details.short_description: Take control of an MMA promotion and build it fight by fight. Sign contenders, negotiate contracts, book the card, and crown champions across four divisions while a strike-by-strike simulation decides who walks out with the belt.

details.title: The Five Monks
details.short_description: A settlement simulation about five monks who survived a burning monastery and set out across the continent. Generate a world, gather scattered companions, and raise a new sanctuary from the ashes. Rebuild a broken world with the hands of those who survived.

details.title: Bash Moto
details.short_description: Tear up the West Coast in a 90s-themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick, punch, and bash rival bikers to claim the cash prize while dodging traffic, obstacles and hot-pursuit cops. Wreck your ride or run out of cash for bail, and it is game over.

details.title: The Black Breath
details.short_description: Lead a caravan of survivors fleeing from the Black Breath. Manage your resources, explore, and choose your path carefully, as the journey will be unforgiving. When hardships arise, you will rely on a diverse group of heroes willing to give their lives to defend the caravan.

details.title: みちくさワンダラー
details.short_description: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

name: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop

details.title: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop
details.short_description: Run a little radio repair shop in 1952, where every wireless on your bench is a working circuit, so the meter reads what's really there and the hum or the crackle you hear is the fault itself. You take each set apart by hand and fit new parts from the cabinet till it plays again for its owner.

details.title: Paid Bloom
details.short_description: Your desktop is a garden. Plant a seed, go back to work, and your flowers grow while you type. Look up hours later and the screen is in bloom. Every plant is one of a kind, rare colours are out there to hunt, and nothing ever dies.
developers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.

details.title: Age of the Ancients
details.short_description: A real-time strategy in four ages: gather five resources, raise walls and a castle, command your army with stances and formations — and when your shaman speaks to the stones, call the night down on your enemy instead of yourself. Seed-generated worlds, a map editor, English and Hungarian.

details.title: Thrustlings
details.short_description: A physics rocket game about landing softly. Feather the thrust, fight gravity and wind, and touch down before your fuel runs out. Race friends online in Pad Race, King of the Pad and Orb Ball, conquer 120+ levels, and build and share your own in the level editor.

details.title: Incredig
details.short_description: Incredig is a short sci-fi incremental mining game about digging far too deep. Break rock pixel by pixel, haul ore back to your Rig, automate the mine with swarms of drones, and keep pushing downward. Something beneath the surface is beating.

details.title: Dragon Football
details.short_description: Dragon Football is a single-player football auto battler with no-holds-barred combat. Recruit unhinged, superpowered animals. Kill opponents, send them flying, and score a goal while you are at it. Matches play out automatically. The goal count decides who wins.

details.title: Bum Dog
details.short_description: Bum Dog, an old time vagabond of modest means, defiant fists, and dogged spirit returns to his shelter to discover his true love missing. Now he must punch, scratch, bite, and summon elemental powers beyond his comprehension to set this wrong to right.

details.title: Only One Hero
details.short_description: Build an army around three Heroes in a dark fantasy roguelite autobattler. Assign Jobs, buy abilities and gear, and prepare for real-time battles that fight themselves. Soldiers die for good. After each major act, execute one of your Heroes until only one remains.

details.title: Infernal Corridor
details.short_description: An incremental roguelite with automatic, real-time card combat. Carry your flame through the corridors of hell, slay demons and claim your revenge.

details.title: Doctor Funkelstein
details.short_description: Build and upgrade your mad scientist laboratory to bring your creatures to life! Strategically manage your souls, unstable science and experimental ingredients to show the world your brilliance in this spookily cozy incremental game.

details.title: Orbit: Night Shift
details.short_description: Vacuum up space junk, crack the data chips hidden inside and wake the 70 women of the Star Harbor's lost night shift. A cozy collecting game with upgrades, lootboxes without real money, your own space station and a very grumpy alien merchant.

details.title: FrankenCars
details.short_description: Build ridiculous cars from mismatched parts, test them in drag races and long jumps, then sell your creations to fund the next disaster! FrankenCars is a lighthearted car-building tycoon where clever upgrades and terrible engineering go hand in hand.

details.title: Scary Zombie Shooting Game
details.short_description: Build your defences, buy guns and kit out your survivors in this top-down pixel-art zombie survival game. When night falls, the dead emerge from the trees and your people do the shooting. Watch your strategy unfold, hold out for rescue, or stay and see how long you can last.

details.title: Vorynth : Ashfall
details.short_description: Choose from 12 classes, plan every turn and hunt rare loot in a dark fantasy RPG. Explore hand-built dungeons, reforge your gear and push into harder difficulty tiers. Play solo offline or team up with up to three friends in online co-op.

details.title: Abysses: Meridian
details.short_description: Your pod came down crippled on Meridian, a world where the sea has risen sixty metres in six years. Swim out on a minute of air, wake a silent station, build a real submarine and dive ever deeper, alone or with a friend, toward the vast ring that made the sea rise.

details.title: Midnight Bell
details.short_description: A gothic asynchronous PvP autobattler. Build a board of werewolves, vampires or monster hunters, arm them with items, then watch them fight other players saved teams of gothic monstrosities. Halfway through every fight the midnight bell tolls and the monsters transform.

details.title: Catch Succubus
details.short_description: "Catch the Succubus" is a first-person comedy horror game. The mischievous succubus has designed a variety of gameplay for you, including memory puzzles, platforming, dark navigation, and more. You win as long as you catch her.

details.title: Afterfolk
details.short_description: Renovate a Forgotten Village. Restore crumbling homes, shape the landscape, and build something new. Farm, fish, craft, and welcome new neighbours as you uncover forgotten stories and help lingering spirits find peace. Bring the village back to life, your way. Play solo or with friends.

details.title: Color Parade
details.short_description: Color Parade is a cheerful two-player co-op painting adventure! Play as a young painter and an adorable pup: spray paint, leave colorful pawprints, and bring a colorless world back to life. Explore vibrant themed maps, tackle painting challenges together, or face off in playful contests!

details.title: Nutty Mice Party
details.short_description: Nutty Mice Party is an adorable multiplayer adventure! Play as cute mice with unique abilities, explore colorful candy-filled mazes, and gobble up every last treat while dodging hungry cats. Team up with friends or face off in chaotic cat-and-mouse battles. Let the sweet chaos begin!

details.title: Star Chasers
details.short_description: Star Chasers is a 2–4 player local multiplayer party game! Roll the dice, race across the board, collect stars, and challenge your friends in wild mini-games. Dodge lasers, survive lava, and outplay your rivals with skill, strategy, and a little luck. Who will claim the party crown?

details.title: Plushie Ops
details.short_description: Plushie Ops is a local two-player 3D action platformer! Grab a friend and guide two adorable plushies through a world of traps and surprises. Jump, fight, tackle tricky mechanisms, and collect stars as you explore a toy factory and a mysterious underwater world. Can you make it to the finish?

details.title: Backwatt
details.short_description: Backwatt is a co-op top-down action roguelite for 1–4 players. Drop into the arena, fight off waves of enemies and head back to the Barge to gear up. At its heart is your rig: your skill at managing space and planning your purchases decides how strong your build is.

details.title: Orbitfall
details.short_description: Launch your fleets into orbit and let physics fly them. Low orbits are fast, high orbits slow, and every meeting counts down on the map. Seven factions, up to eight players against AI or friends online: claim the planet, bomb it from orbit and outplan everyone.

details.title: Dragonwing-Rampage
details.short_description: Unleash your fury and blast through enemy lines! Dragonwing Rampage is a 2D bullet hell roguelite. Catch wild beasts, raise dragons, and build a ranch on your sky island. Gear up, dodge through bullet storms, and stack blessings to unleash the firepower you need to defend your home from the Void.

details.title: Mouse Hammer
details.short_description: Mouse Hammer is a fast paced physics based fighting game about swinging a hammer around. Fight online with your friends, or race yourself in platforming challenges.

details.title: 空降恋人
details.short_description: A Sudden Girlfriend is a galgame centered around solving practice questions. In the game, you play as a high school senior who is obsessed with solving practice problems. You become involved in a series of heartwarming stories with a beautiful girl who suddenly appears in your life.

details.title: Black Dawn Rises
details.short_description: The action game where you write the orders. Sign tomorrow's order as written or change it, then fight the mission your choice made: free-flow combat, a whip that binds, and Iona Sorn at your side. Since 1947, secret files have said what happens next. Arena co-op for two, on one couch or online.

details.title: Mighty Gladiators
details.short_description: Fight through waves of enemies and conquer deadly bosses in a dark fantasy arena action RPG for 1–4 players. Choose from four heroes, combine talents with legendary gear, and master boss mechanics solo or in online co-op.

details.title: SonDem
details.short_description: Son Dem is a 3D online social game set in a traditional Turkish coffeehouse for up to 20 players. Play backgammon, 101 Okey and chess with friends, watch matches as a spectator, and join the conversation through voice and text chat.

details.title: No one outside
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game set in a large reactive city. Explore, loot, drive, build defenses, and survive massive hordes when night falls.

details.title: Hoppkins: Twinkle World
details.short_description: Hoppkins: Twinkle World is a charming 3D platform adventure where you explore colorful worlds, leap across platforms, use unique abilities and vehicles, and face challenging enemies. Join Mr. Hoppkins and venture beyond the clouds to rescue his beloved!

details.title: Jennifer Against Space Aliens
details.short_description: Jennifer Against Space Aliens is an action-packed, third person, sci-fi shooter with 1980s vibes. Run, drive, shoot and blow things up inside space stations, spaceships and distant planets.

details.title: Splatterdunk
details.short_description: 90s-arcade 2-on-2 or 3 -on -3 basketball where the players are monsters and the fouls are fatal. Chain trick dunks, arm Fatalities, bribe the ref and dunk on monsters through the glass while VAT-9, a robot announcer who used to be a star, calls it. Up to 6 players, couch or online. Bring a mop.

details.title: Cordonfall
details.short_description: Type in your address and defend your own street. Cordonfall turns any real neighbourhood on OpenStreetMap into a zombie siege: make a building your HQ, put soldiers on the rooftops, fortify by day, and hold out for ten nights as the horde grows every dusk.

details.title: Arkhanium
details.short_description: Arkham lies in ruins; humanity has lost the battle. Now is the time to perform the ritual to summon the Great Old Ones in a turn-based, tactical PvP battle. Establish your dominion and seize power over the Earth!

details.title: Starfuse
details.short_description: A cozy fireworks incremental. Launch shells, pop drifting lanterns and set off huge chain reactions. Every upgrade you buy is a star in the night sky: light them all and rekindle the dead Sun. Short and complete, about 3 hours.

details.title: SERPENTER
details.short_description: A fast, colorful 3D snake adventure across 9 floating worlds and 63 levels! Dodge crumbling floors, slippery ice and wild hazards, unleash power-ups, tackle endless runs and daily challenges, or play with up to 4 friends. Help Zip find Ray!

details.title: Boo! Boo! Train!
details.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

details.title: Bermuda Trial
details.short_description: Party Based Autobattler RPG where you choose team of three survivor to explore the wonders and dangers of the mysterious Bermuda Island.

details.title: DEFCON 89
details.short_description: OLD-SCHOOL ZOMBIES ARE BACK. Survive endless rounds solo or in 4-player co-op in a Cold War nightmare set in 1989. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, explore sinister maps, find secret weapons and unravel each map's hidden main story. How long can you last?

details.title: Spellvoc
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op game where 2–4 apprentice wizards use magic to fill orders, on the couch or online. Pull ingredients closer with telekinesis and fire up the cauldron with a fireball. Bridges collapse and trains barrel through, but your creations still have to reach the owl on time!

details.title: The Last Encore
details.short_description: The Last Encore is a wave-based arena shooter set in a marionette theatre, and nothing auto-fires here: you aim, and you count every round. You're the last puppet in the workshop, and the whole cast has taken the stage to find you.

details.title: CONTRACT #001
details.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based demolition simulator. On your first job, you knocked down the wrong house. Now you owe Shady Solutions LLC $80,080. Tear down buildings, crush the scrap and pay it off.

details.title: Peasants in the Summer
details.short_description: A first-person roguelite puzzle mystery. The same summer day repeats, and every morning the Village redraws itself. Draft which places emerge from the mist, learn the villagers' routines, solve puzzles and remember what no one else can.

details.title: AUTOGENESIS
details.short_description: AUTOGENESIS is a roguelike deckbuilder where any number can be exploited. Swap, Bind and Multiply endlessly to build overwhelming strategies, recursively self-improve, and rewrite the system containing you. Break the experiment. Achieve AUTOGENESIS.

details.title: Alice and the Necromancer
details.short_description: A first-person point-and-click of dark fantasy and horror. Alice finds a voice behind a sealed door. It promises to teach her magic. The first lesson is free. Solve puzzles and make choices that open paths to different endings.

details.title: Rune Force
details.short_description: Rune Force is a fast-paced survival roguelike where you place and merge elemental runes to defend your Core. Fight through escalating waves, defeat deadly bosses, discover and use relics, charms, and build defining level ups. Forge permanent upgrades, master each element, and save the Rune Force.

details.title: Wizard Warrior
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder of spells and steel. Spells spend mana, weapons spend stamina, and hovering a card shows every blow before you throw it. Cross eight realms on a face-down road, fell each realm's guardian, and earn nine more playable houses, each growing its own way.

details.title: House of the Damned
details.short_description: House of the Damned is a retro survival horror inspired by 90s classics. Featuring fixed camera angles, deliberate grid-based tactical combat, scarce resources, and occult puzzles, survive a descent into Andalusian psychological terror.

details.title: One Bit Kill
details.short_description: A fast, brutal 1-bit top-down roguelite shooter where your coins are your health. Every upgrade you buy makes you stronger and closer to death. Dash, stomp, and gun your way through randomly generated dungeons, collect relics, and take down the boss waiting at the bottom.

details.title: TDoom
details.short_description: Earth has fallen. The last rocket carrying humanity is waiting to launch. Deploy tanks, fighter jets and helicopters around the Ark, hit start and watch up to 500,000 aliens die. Lost? Every defeat earns credits for a 500-skill tree. Come back stronger.

details.title: Tategoi
details.short_description: A calm koi-breeding tycoon with real genetics. Pair your best koi, judge the fry, grow a farm of ponds, win shows and auctions — and raise the koi your grandfather only dreamed of.

details.title: Restore Earth
details.short_description: Restore Earth is an incremental cleanup game. Clear litter on quick, timed trips, collect materials, and upgrade your grabbers. Unlock playful helpers, face natural disasters, and turn neglected clearings into thriving habitats!

details.title: Video Paradise
details.short_description: Run a 1988 video rental store one tape at a time. Order stock by fax, set your prices, rewind, repair and recommend. Every regular remembers how you treat them, and somewhere in your returns box are fragments of a film no one knew existed.

details.title: Stormbox
details.short_description: Play as Pip the Penguin, a storm chaser on a voxel island where any sky can spawn a tornado. Drive, fly and deploy gadgets to film twisters up close, collect every storm as a Storm Card, and watch panicked towns and villagers scramble as the storm closes in.

details.title: Foldbound
details.short_description: A papercut metroidvania. The world was folded from one great sheet of paper, and something has begun to cut it. As a little paper knight, leap, slash and dash through a meadow, the dim roots below it, an ember-lit loft and a vast bindery, find what hides in the folds, and mend the world.

details.title: Xeno Food Truck
details.short_description: In this sci-fi cooking simulator, run a space food truck on a remote meteor and smuggle contraband out back. Juggle chaotic alien orders while discreetly delivering illicit goods for the mafia. Smile for the space cops, keep your cover intact, and beware the giant hungry worm lurking in the crater.

details.title: Escape Engine
details.short_description: Escape the game engine! Switch between Haruka's in-game perspective and her older brother Keito's editor view to solve puzzles in this dual-perspective puzzle-action game!

details.title: Gamophobia
details.short_description: Dating is scary—especially when you’re wooing the physical manifestations of human phobias. Fall in love with a Fear. Try not to flinch.

details.title: Fantasy Auto Chess
details.short_description: Fantasy Auto Chess blends roguelite, extraction, and auto chess gameplay. Build your squad through battle, choose when to fight or retreat, and carry Heroic Spirits into future runs as permanent assets to gain stronger starts and unlock more strategies.

details.title: Mafia Pizza : Family Business
details.short_description: Manage your mafia family and take over the city! Assassinate, extort and take down rival families — All while running a perfectly legitimate pizza business.

details.title: Cosmic Seance
details.short_description: A supernatural detective mystery where every truth costs sanity. As the Royal Medium, summon old gods, interpret their visions, and trade your mind for clues. Unravel the enigma before madness takes you.

details.title: Zombie Princess
details.short_description: Raise a daughter infected with a zombie virus in this dark fantasy raising simulation. Over 5 years, balance your daily care in secret with dangerous expeditions. Will you cure her humanity, or help her rise as an immortal zombie queen? Discover over 60 unique endings!

details.title: Balliators
details.short_description: Build a deck of wild balls, throw them into the arena and watch them bounce, collide and explode for points. A roguelike deckbuilder where every ball bends the rules: draft, roll, shop and beat four stages of bosses.

details.title: Gate B7
details.short_description: Verify documents, stamp boarding passes, and uphold the regime's strict laws at a dystopian airport terminal. Every decision matters: take bribes to keep your family alive, or stay loyal to survive your 20-day shift. But be careful: Some anomalies aren't found on paper.

details.title: Dawn of Embers
details.short_description: Build a town. Raise an army. Command the elements. A real-time strategy game where ancient Pillars wake on the battlefield and leave magic in their embers. Choose your Calling, drill your Disciplines, and lead your kingdom through the Day of Ruin.

details.title: Gospel of Garbage
details.short_description: Gospel of Garbage is an Incremental Auto Battler about leading a fanatical troop of raccoons. Stack trash to stop the train, and protect your pile from heretical cleanup crews!

details.title: Starward Era
details.short_description: Dig deep into an alien world, gather resources, explore the unknown, and build interconnected power, oxygen, and production systems. Upgrade your gear, expand your base, and automate logistics with drones as manual work gradually grows into an efficient production network.

details.title: Ultimate Memory Elevator!?
details.short_description: Observe on the move. Survive by memory. Which floor was that bird on? Memorize the birds and climb to your absolute limit!
developers: インフィニットクリエイト
publishers: インフィニットクリエイト

details.title: Pantania:wedge of time
details.short_description: Fulfill your mission, scavenge for supplies.With the power to control time, you can be a savior who saves people—or a ruthless monster who slaughters them all.

details.title: Thunder Arrow: Arcade
details.short_description: Pilot the HX-21 “Thunder Arrow” prototype and relive the intensity of 1980s arcades in a modern tribute to classics like After Burner and Thunder Blade.

details.title: Lumengard
details.short_description: Explore the fallen kingdom of Lumengard in a procedurally generated hex world. Gather, craft, and fight turn-based battles with cards from gear, skills, companions, and pets. Build a village and shape a persistent world through your choices.

details.title: The Outcast Bloom
details.short_description: Build an ever-growing defense network, meet and level loyal companions and discover a deep loot system. Featuring many different enemy types, abilities, environmental affixes and card choices.

details.title: [ABERRATION] THE ANALYST
details.short_description: Dexton-City vanished, leaving a 14.2-meter void. As a PRISM analyst, process Agent Meg Simons' final hours through the EYESYS simulation. Survive the psychological terror and brutal trials of a Class C4 Hive Mind. An [ABERRATION] case by FEIGIN ENTERTAINMENT.

details.title: Heroes Of Isekai
details.short_description: An auto-battler with roguelike elements, and no unit cap. Run your camp, buy creatures, buildings, spells, gear and runes, assemble your build — then crush your enemies!

details.title: Democracy Manifest
details.short_description: Hijack the vote in this 3-7 player social deduction brawl! Juggle with ideologies to play your cards perfectly, rig elections through deals, bribery & manipulation and backstab your closest friends to get ahead.

details.title: Riftbound Survivors
details.short_description: Riftbound is a survivor-like bullet heaven focused on spell combinations and massive enemy waves. Defeat thousands of enemies, experiment with elemental chain reactions, and break the game with overlapping status effects. Play solo or in co-op.

details.title: Torin's Greed
details.short_description: Torin’s Greed is a FPS dungeon crawler that combines mining mechanics with combat. Players navigate through underground environments, utilizing both a pickaxe and firearms to progress. Fight difficult bosses and get rich.

details.title: Taverntasia
details.short_description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

details.title: Those UnderHex
details.short_description: A strategy roguelite about rebuilding the portal lands. Reveal dark hexes with beams of light and bring supplies home. Protect your workers, combine tower weapons and face successive monster waves. Each night, your people need food and shelter.

details.title: Tiny Taxi
details.short_description: Drift, drive and survive in a top-down pixel art city! Pick up passengers with strange demands, earn cash to upgrade your taxi and choose curses that make every run tougher. Customize your cab/driver, build your mixtape and climb the leaderboard.

details.title: BLIGHT SWARM
details.short_description: BLIGHT SWARM is horde-building action roguelite where you invade Earth as an alien hivemind and run a planetary infection campaign. Turn civilians into zombies, merge your minions into stronger abominations, evolve your Beast, and spread the Blight across the globe.

details.title: Collapsed Horizon
details.short_description: Travel between galaxies, dig planets, collect ores, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and earn your ticket back to Earth.

details.title: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
details.short_description: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

details.title: Crystal Vein
details.short_description: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

details.title: Wild World: Online
details.short_description: A multiplayer third-person werewolf action game. Be the tank who guards and soaks up the damage, pull rivals in with Gravity, or vanish and strike from the shadows. Alone or with your pack, forge your own playstyle. So, how will you hunt?

details.title: CATering: Roadtrip Rivals
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer cooking game where cats run food trucks, compete for ingredients, sabotage each other, and travel the world together. Cook at international festivals, hit the road with friends, explore, play minigames, and fight for the highest rating!

details.title: Wild West Gunslinger
details.short_description: Dust fills the sky. Gunfire never ceases. In this Western world where law has failed and only the strong survive, you will step into the boots of a bounty hunter, plunging into fight after fight for survival.

details.title: Tracked
details.short_description: Tracked is a strategic hacker-heist game played through a fictional operating system. Analyze contracts, route through digital relays, and run tools on your own rig. Manage resources and an active Trace—and disappear before the trail leads back to you.

details.title: Last Skull
details.short_description: Take a ship into hostile waters, plunder islands, wrecks and rival captains, then make it out before your time runs out. Whatever you bring home is yours to keep. Sink, and what you carried is left floating for someone else.

details.title: BosaTella Loopa
details.short_description: Junk Robots. Monster Hordes. Unhinged Firepower. Team up in this co-op looter shooter to get filthy rich, discover absurd weaponry, and blast away the dangerous monsters that lurk within "The Loop". Tear through the subway, catch the train (or don't), and blow all your money on even more firepower.

details.title: Ashen Rain
details.short_description: No justice. Only consequences. Ashen Rain is a brutal 2.5D tactical action shooter: fight through rain-soaked streets, factories and military outposts with weighty gunplay, punishing enemy fire and visceral, realistic damage. The law failed. He didn't.

details.title: Casus Foederis: 1815
details.short_description: Your ally is attacked and calls you into a war you never wanted. Answer, and you fight. Refuse, and every court in Europe remembers. Lead one of twelve powers from 1815 to 1871; grow too fast and the continent unites against you. A turn-based strategy game of diplomacy. Single-player.

details.title: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
details.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

details.title: AAA Island Hotline
details.short_description: AAA Island Hotline is a cozy desktop idle farming game. Create one-of-a-kind creatures through a magical crossbreeding system and build your own island world. Let it quietly keep you company on your screen.

details.title: Working Dead
details.short_description: Run a supermarket for zombies in this first-person simulator, solo or in online co-op with up to three friends. Prepare body parts, set prices and turn spills into blood soda. Get bitten and keep working as a zombie, but your friends will only hear groans through proximity voice chat.

details.title: Eclipsis Online
details.short_description: A persistent online space MMO where you control a ship to harvest asteroids, trade at player-run structures, and fight inside star systems, either alone or with others.

details.title: Starbound Settlers
details.short_description: Pirates at the hull, comets past the window, a cat on the keyboard. Build a space station room by room, mine the asteroid belts with drones and keep a growing crew alive, fed and in love. 64 story chains, over 100 technologies, and no ending.

details.title: Star Ring Convenience Store
details.short_description: A supernatural adventure about working for a living and getting stuck in a time loop. On her first day on the job, intern Amo is trapped in the same day. Meet eccentric late-night customers, connect clues in your Mind Palace, and uncover the secrets hidden inside Star Ring Convenience Store.

details.title: Tooth And Tusk
details.short_description: Play as Dr. Chompers, a T-Rex dentist in a cozy miniature voxel clinic for animals. Scrape plaque, fill cavities, polish teeth, drain saliva, and forge custom grillz while rival Dr. Sterling heckles from across the street.

details.title: Shrouded Aura
details.short_description: Shrouded Aura is a psychological horror experience where trauma, memory, and perception distort reality. Explore shifting environments, uncover conflicting diary entries, and survive disturbing manifestations as you piece together the truth. Play in VR or on PC.

details.title: Rogue Dungeon 2
details.short_description: The sequel to the solo dungeon crawler based on the board game. Step out of the dungeon and into Ilderia: travel a dangerous world, gather a party, follow questlines to a hard-won ending, and delve into flooded sewers, cursed tombs and a vampire-haunted castle.

details.title: Chernoberg: Rebirth
details.short_description: A Super Polymerization of a turn-based SRPG that combines strategic depth with exhilarating combat, and a story-driven AVG packed with tens of thousands of words and a plot full of twists and turns. Experiment with diverse party compositions and discover the playstyle that suits you best.

details.title: Gangs of Nightglade
details.short_description: A card battler where you fight with poker hands. Deploy your gang members, build poker hands with them and sabotage your opponent's attempts to complete theirs. In the story campaign, you lead a gang trying to solve the mystery of its former leader's disappearance.

details.title: Tales of the Southern Seas
details.short_description: Build trade routes, recruit companions and refit your fleet in a single-player sailing adventure set in the late-Ming Southern Seas. Navigate wind, waves and strange encounters. Will you turn the sea into a ledger—or learn to live alongside it?

details.title: Alamare: The Wayfarer's Hand
details.short_description: Command mythic creatures in a single-player roguelite card battler. Choose your attacks, play support cards, and ascend into stronger forms mid-battle. Collect new cards, build your deck, and chart your path through dangerous expeditions across fallen realms.

details.title: Xhaust
details.short_description: Xhaust is a weaponized vehicular combat game. Brawl in the arena, wreak havoc on the roads! Go solo or battle friends and bots in multiplayer (split-screen and online).

details.title: Don't Burn Out!
details.short_description: A block-pushing puzzle game in corporate hell, where you must confront your boss and escape the soul-draining workplace before you literally burn out. Solve over 100 handcrafted & unique puzzles that will require you to think strategically, with each step bringing you closer to flames!

details.title: WaxWire: Program the Hive
details.short_description: These bees are hard workers, but not one of them can think. Luckily, you can. In this cozy programming game you plan their every move with nodes. Forget to tell a bee to sip and she'll fly home empty but very pleased with herself. Better fix that before the Queen finds out.

details.title: MoncooMoncoo!
details.short_description: Join Spoony, the little chef, as you explore a dungeon filled with dangerous yet delicious monsters and restore the world's lost flavors!

details.title: Cao Cao the Legend
details.short_description: Rewrite the Three Kingdoms through Cao Cao's eyes. Lead his generals across ink-wash battlefields, master the terrain on a hex grid, and crush foes with joint attacks fueled by chemistry. A 3D turn-based tactical RPG where your choices lead to real history—or a Three Kingdoms never recorded.

details.title: Spellspill: Magic Destruction Sandbox
details.short_description: A roguelite where your spells mess with the world around you. You can burn the grass under your enemies, but you can also freeze the pond and walk across it, or drop lightning into the water they stand in. Enemies ragdoll, houses fall apart, and every run takes a different route.

details.title: Fading Youth
details.short_description: This is an interactive visual novel about youth, redemption, and a diary, with a playtime of 3 to 5 hours.

details.title: Tomb Extraction
details.short_description: A multiplayer tomb-raiding horror game supporting up to four players, where you infiltrate ancient tombs, loot valuable burial treasures, and escape alive. Players can assume the role of a Taoist priest and use incantations to subdue the evil spirits within the tombs

details.title: Tiny Tyrant: Dungeon Master
details.short_description: Build and Customize your dungeon, place deadly traps, defenses and monsters to fight alongside in this FPS / Tower Defense hybrid. Stop those dastardly heroes from stealing your hard-earned treasure.

details.title: Devilcoin
details.short_description: A coin-flip roguelite. You traded your soul for money, and now the only way out of this occult purgatory is to keep flipping. Bet on heads or tails, collect Artifacts that bend the odds, and hit the score before your flips run out.

details.title: Bladehold
details.short_description: Demolish monstrous hordes on horseback or foot, unleash devastating abilities, build the ultimate hero, and protect your fortress with deadly automated defenses in this fast-paced action roguelite.

details.title: The Golfing Hour
details.short_description: A realistic-that-turns-goofy Golf incremental game! Earn cash as you golf to buy powerful upgrades. Golf enough and you can turn pro, one step closer to becoming OVERPOWERED! Play with friends, launch your golf ball across different worlds, and see how far one swing can go!

details.title: Bloodloader
details.short_description: A fast top-down roguelite where every rifle shot is earned with the bayonet. Stab to load, shoot to kill: build a weapon from a bayonet and a rifle, take favours from four old powers and climb four hellish realms to take your flight back from the Redeemer.

details.title: Nine Tenths
details.short_description: In San Verde, the law is absolute— except for you. A text-based crime management game where you evade the law to rule the underworld. Launder your cash, vet your buyers, deploy the right crew, and manage your firepower to build an empire beyond the reach of the law.

details.title: Backpack Legion
details.short_description: Build an army in your backpack! Place soldiers next to weapons and watch them fight to destroy the enemy base. Send in a huge army, or fully equip a few elite troops to beat bigger forces. Mix soldiers, weapons and gems to try all kinds of builds. Fight other players' saved armies—no waiting!

details.title: Stolen Sun
details.short_description: Stolen Sun is a co-op game for 1–4 players. You are astronauts crash-landed on a planet in impenetrable darkness. Light is your only tool and greatest threat. Explore procedural locations, gather resources, upgrade your base on a giant turtle, and escape to see the sun.

details.title: Limes 235
details.short_description: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

details.title: Harpooner
details.short_description: Harpooner is an action-driven incremental fishing game. Dive into the ocean depths, hunt alien fish, collect stars and unlock exponential upgrades. Scale your power, stack stats, and take down massive bosses to clean up the coast!

details.title: Rushline
details.short_description: Rushline is an arcade combat racer in early development. Race friends online, take on full grids of bots offline, or play 4-player split-screen on one PC. Drift, grab power-ups and knock each other off the road. I'm planning a free demo for the end of 2026!

details.title: Game Breaker: Divine Error
details.short_description: Game Breaker is a humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG where every character knows they're in a video game. Exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the fate of a dying world. Experience a deep narrative with a massive 119-track original soundtrack.

details.title: Over The Blackboard
details.short_description: Over the Blackboard is a fun open-world adventure game filled with quests and missions kids love to play, where exploring, solving puzzles, and completing challenges naturally helps them practice math, logic, reading, and more without noticing.

details.title: Snowboard Rogues
details.short_description: The snowboarding roguelike. Master your riding skills to survive all threats in a procedurally generated ski resort. Inspired by 90s' FreeSki and modern Roguelikes.

details.title: Poopnauts
details.short_description: Four astronauts teamed up to fix spaceships using... poop? 1-4 players co-op. Every ship is different, so you never know what you will find inside. Finish the job, sell the scrap, and stay away from whatever else is on board. Get to work, poopnaut!

details.title: Jest Messters
details.short_description: A comedy-mystery otome (GxB) visual novel full of dad jokes, cringe puns, and an unexpected mystery! Come and join the pun!

details.title: Dolls made here
details.short_description: You find yourself alone in an abandoned doll factory, assembling and inspecting dolls because you needed the money. Each order ends with the sense that they should never have been shipped, but leaving is no longer an option.

details.title: 遗物路：Relic Road
details.short_description: Relic Road is a roguelike turn-based tower-climbing game centered around equipment and relic building. As players continue to explore, they can recruit various heroes to expand their team, obtain equipment from heroes, encounter different events, and strengthen their forces.

details.title: Kundara: art of cards
details.short_description: Kundara is a frenetic and artistic elemental card roguelite game featuring combat against enemies in a theatrical kabuki adventure. Activate the power of cards, collect artifacts, and form alliances with spirits in an adventure across the five nations of Kundara.

details.title: 雨声 Rainy Days
details.short_description: Rainy Days is a short campus visual novel with 2+ original soundtracks, 10+ illustrations and a 30,000-word storyline. Play as the protagonist to encounter Yu, a mysterious girl, and start a sweet youthful campus rom-com. Make choices to alter the plot, unlock hidden stories.

details.title: Rings of Heaven
details.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike action platformer with a focus on teamwork and cooperation. Play as angel vtuber Amai Lilia and friends and take on heaven's deadliest gauntlet, the Rings of Heaven.

details.title: Leaf Us Alone
details.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

details.title: Super Robot Survivors
details.short_description: A Roguelite Bullet-Heaven where you rescue astronauts, repair reactors, and hack terminals while blasting hordes of robots in high-stakes, 10-minute showdowns. From the Creative Director of Destroy All Humans! 2 and co-creator of TY the Tasmanian Tiger.

details.title: WingsSimulations Flight Simulator 2027
details.short_description: Fly anywhere on Earth with realistic weather, detailed aircraft, and thousands of airports. Design your own planes, tackle landing challenges, and experience full-fidelity flight simulation without the usual performance cost.

details.title: 银色记忆
details.short_description: 扮演失忆的主角在一个充满秘密的小镇生活，探索和恋爱

details.title: Tales Of Eight
details.short_description: Tales of Eight is an action roguelite, naval battle game. As one of the last pirates you are fighting against the dreaded Feline Empire. Fight on the high seas with customizable magical canons, upgrade your ship, explore the ever-changing ocean, and trade with factions all to save Piratedom.

details.title: TOBARI and the Vampire Alchemist
details.short_description: I want to be your friend. But I want to eat you… Discover the end of a twisted friendship in this story driven adventure. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster: Tobari. Gather silver coins. Find a cure for an incurable disease.

details.title: Melt Down
details.short_description: Melt Down is a slime racing game where you are on a clock to reach the finish line. You are melting: small is fast, big is slow, and you have to finish the race before you turn into a puddle. Dodge hazards, fight off your rival slimes with powerups, and finish before you perish.

details.title: Beards vs. Claws
details.short_description: Dig tunnels, build bridges, and blast your way through walls towards victory in this highly dynamic arena first-person shooter - every obstacle is a potential door

details.title: School Guard
details.short_description: 💼 You took this job to save your family. Now you have to survive it. 🔍 Scan students. 🚫 Confiscate contraband. 🏗️ Build your empire. 🌙 Patrol the night. But when the sun goes down, the school reveals what it's been hiding—🧟 zombies, 🔥 fire, and 👻 a ghost that never left.

details.title: The Demon Party
details.short_description: The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos. Become Lethe, a demon girl, dominate defeated monsters, form your own Demon Party, and raise a new demon army!

details.title: Cook The Dungeon
details.short_description: Cook the Dungeon is a first-person roguelike deckbuilder where every fight feeds the next. Descend through branching paths, forage for herbs, hunt strange creatures, and build a deck of Cuts, Preps, and Seasons. Land precise cuts, harvest monster parts, and cook meals for the battles ahead.

details.title: The Postman Cometh
details.short_description: Deliver mail in a strange little town in the middle of nowhere. Meet a colorful cast of villagers as you try to figure out what happened to the previous postman.

details.title: Crazy Islands
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unpredictable events turn every round into pure madness.

details.title: SuperBird
details.short_description: SuperBird is a roguelike deckbuilder starring birds and bugs. our cards crawl, grow, and even devour one another. Learn each bug’s quirks, build around them with powerful trinkets, and time your plays to perfection under the arena spotlight. Climb your way to the top and claim the crown!

details.title: Poreia
details.short_description: Manipulate magnetic forces to solve puzzles and uncover the truth of the world in this 3D puzzle adventure - become a memory-lost cat robot and explore a mysterious world!

details.title: Call of Donuts
details.short_description: Race solo against the clock or challenge your friends in a hero shooter where you and your teammates share the same ammo pool while dodging traps and defeating minions. Join forces or face off in up to 8 teams of 1–3 players on a procedurally generated map where every match is a brand-new adventure.

details.title: 代号: Gabby's adventure
details.short_description: Gabby's Adventure is a 3D sandbox adventure game. In this game, uou will play as little Gabby who were brave and whimsical , embarking on an adventure to save your home.

details.title: Valehands
details.short_description: A cozy incremental management sim about guiding dwarven crews through their daily work and bringing their valley to life.

details.title: Asa's Adventure
details.short_description: A hand-drawn narrative puzzle-adventure. Play as Asa, a silent child obsessed with stars who unexpectedly lands on a desolate planet. Decipher alien symbols and solve puzzles to search for scattered stars—unlocking a heartwarming story.

details.title: Chaos Orbit
details.short_description: Fight through a machine-controlled orbital station in this fast-paced action roguelite. Master precision mouse-aim combat, unlock powerful mutations, and battle deadly robotic enemies as you push deeper into the chaos.

details.title: Paradoxical
details.short_description: Portals are physical objects. In this mind-bending puzzle game, portals can be carried, repositioned, and used to create impossible connections through space. Uncover the fate of a desert world that sought salvation through portal technology.

details.title: City God Alice：城隍愛麗絲
details.short_description: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

details.title: Kinmen Kill
details.short_description: Kinmen Kill (金門殺) is an FPV combat drone simulator. Scout, strike, and battle PLA forces as you defend Taiwan with realistic flight controls and advanced physics built for true-to-life handling.

details.title: Freelance Dead
details.short_description: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.

details.title: Red Experience
details.short_description: A multi-ending 2D adventure where choices and repetition change the characters’ fates as you overcome varied minigames, expose contradictions in debates, and uncover the truth behind a deadly game.

details.title: Exil Island
details.short_description: Rob a cartel that took over a whole island, in this top-down survival shooter. Play solo or online: scavenge, build a base, clear their checkpoints and fight soldiers, wolves and other players. No zombies. Just a cartel that always moves back in.

details.title: Future Fall
details.short_description: A multiplayer post-apocalyptic survival action game with RPG elements set at the crossroads of two realities. Explore the Exclusion Zone, hunt artifacts in anomalies, manage your sanity, build your personal bunker, engage in free trade, and lead your clan to victory.

details.title: Guns 'n Goblins
details.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

details.title: Rogue Wheels
details.short_description: Rogue Wheels is a turn based roguelike deckbuilder where your car is your character and timing driven combat defines every run. Build fun and crazy decks!

details.title: Salvebringer Ninjas
details.short_description: As the outbreak spreads and civilization crumbles, humanity's last hope rests with an order of mysterious ninjas that have been hiding from the world for decades—the Salvebringer Ninjas!

details.title: CyberZ: Energy Wars
details.short_description: CyberZ: Energy Wars is a fast-paced third-person shooter PvP. Every match drops you into a war zone where two things matter: your aim and your economy. At the start of each round, spend your earned credits on weapons and gear or save up for something devastating next round.

details.title: Squadron 42
details.short_description: Enlist in the UEE Navy in a cinematic, single-player space adventure. Pilot combat ships, fight on foot, and explore capital ships, space stations, and frontier outposts. Live and work alongside your crew as you battle on the front lines of a galactic war.

details.title: PINZ
details.short_description: PINZ is a 1–4 player co-op Extraction Roguelite FPS where every run is a complete rescue expedition. Explore dangerous planets, rescue eggs, strengthen your team between missions, and defeat massive planetary bosses.

details.title: Choo Choo Defenders
details.short_description: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense!

details.title: After ICEY
details.short_description: After ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action meta sequel in the ICEY universe. After countless cycles, ICEY defeated Judas and left the world, yet cycles remain. Three bound souls await. Follow the arrows, defeat them, and take their soul crystal masks — this is your mission.

name: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!

details.title: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!
details.short_description: A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.

details.title: Midnight Souls
details.short_description: Dive into the secrets of the quiet hamlet of Camomile Peaks! A romantic trip to meet your online crush spirals into a mystical adventure: epic battles, bizarre allies, and dark humor. Win her heart, solve the mysteries, and protect your cat, Charlie!

details.title: Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator
details.short_description: Job sim? Flight sim? Co-op for 1–4 players? YES. Take farm jobs with friends, upgrade your hangar and grow a fleet. Mostly chill, with the occasional power-line PANIC.

details.title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
details.short_description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

details.title: Lesomor
details.short_description: Become Tsarevich Ivan, forced to forge atomic weapons in a fairy‑tale world. Otherwise you won’t stand a chance against foreign monsters and formidable warrior‑maidens on your path to the Princess of the Dead, Lady Yaga… And what you choose to do with her is entirely up to you.

details.title: DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing
details.short_description: Realistic driving meets weaponized vehicular combat. Shoot straight, lay traps, and drive fast to win. Fight for victory in this high-octane, high-stakes combat racer.

details.title: Voidfall
details.short_description: Epic space strategy with 4X elements. Digital implementation of the printed board game by Mindclash Games. Base Game holds the competitive mode with 20 Scenarios and 14 playable factions. 1-4 players. AI opponent with 4 difficulty levels. Cross-platform and live and asynchronous gaming.

details.title: Sakichan - Track Of Fury
details.short_description: Join Saki-chan, the fierce shark girl, on her wild ride to conquer Earth! Race through deadly tunnels, mow down Tentamons, and chase after rebellious traitors. Customize Saki-chan with cool costumes and relax in the interactive massage room. Ready to unleash her fury? The chase is on!

details.title: Kingsbane
details.short_description: Raid gothic fortresses in a 2D action-platformer RPG. Choose from heroes with distinct fighting styles, hunt for rare gear, and defeat the infernal kings. Replay stages to try new routes and builds. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local or online co-op.

details.title: ASUKA x Redline Reverie
details.short_description: Play as Asuka Sakai and take on the mountain roads of Japan. Tune your car, challenge rival racers, climb the rankings, and earn your place at GRACE. A pure touge racing experience.

details.title: Warfactory: Automation RTS
details.short_description: Warfactory is an automation RTS where production defines the war effort. Build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory.

details.title: Bus Station Simulator
details.short_description: In Bus Station Simulator, take over a forgotten bus station and bring it back to life - solo or in co-op! Take care of passengers, your fleet, and the infrastructure as you transform a rundown terminal into the beating heart of Winston Springs.

details.title: Ashes - Doomsday Borer
details.short_description: A side-scrolling game featuring adventure, exploration, level progression, boss battles, and puzzle-solving. Take on the role of a modified rodent warrior, piloting an underground vehicle to fight against an artificial intelligence and save the creatures living beneath the surface.
publishers: Homeless Network Technology Guangzhou Co., Ltd

details.title: Strawberry Cafe
details.short_description: Build your own strawberry cafe and farm in this cozy, casual management sim. Grow strawberries for customers to pick, or harvest your homegrown strawberries to cook delicious strawberry-themed food and drinks. Complete missions and keep customers happy to unlock new furniture and recipes.

details.title: Intravenous 3
details.short_description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

details.title: Pikku Adventure
details.short_description: Befriend the Pikku to decipher a mysterious alien language and deliver a crucial message. Small colorful planets filled with secrets and charm await clever deduction from sharp puzzle-venturers and exo-linguists.

details.title: Smersh: Wolfhound
details.short_description: A stealth action game set during World War II. You play as a SMERSH operative. Use disguises to get close to your target. Take out your foes with weapons or plan “unfortunate accidents.” No two playthroughs are alike.

details.title: I Can Never Love Another
details.short_description: A realistic visual novel based on a true story. As a lawyer trying to save a rock singer from her toxic family, you uncover the suffocating truth of "Codependency." Will you leave, sink into the abyss, or g◼︎ai◻︎n the c#our%ag◼︎e to f◼︎ac◻︎e the p#ai%n? Your choices decide.

details.title: DDD: Dice, Dungeons, and Drakes
details.short_description: Master a unique tactical board-game battler! Roll to summon monsters and watch your dice disassemble into road-tiles to forge a path to the enemy Lord. Balance Summon and Action dice, manage crest inventories, and cast powerful spells to crush the rival Lord in DDD: Dice, Dungeons & Drakes.

details.title: HellHeart Breaker
details.short_description: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

details.title: Harrowlands
details.short_description: Harrowlands is a medieval fantasy colony sim where you build your settlement, manage Fateborn with unique traits, shape relationships, survive raids, magical threats, and the demands of a powerful kingdom.

details.title: Kitaria Fables 2
details.short_description: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

details.title: Total Incremental Battle
details.short_description: Start with a single soldier, end up with a massive army. Strategize and command your units, or let them grind on their own. Progress through many unique progression systems and conquer all the stages.

details.title: Rance Quest Magnum
details.short_description: Rance sets off on another grand (though not always grave) adventure across the Continent to find a cure for the curse and get his life back in order!

details.title: War of Banners
details.short_description: War of Banners is a sandbox turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval open world. Recruit companions, lead your army, and claim victory across brutal battlefields. From a wandering mercenary band to an empire-ruling sovereign — your fate is shaped by strategy and choice.

details.title: Titanic
details.short_description: A simulator of the operation of the most famous ship Titanic. Become the owner and captain of the Titanic, sail around the world! Carry passengers and cargo, make money and prosper!

details.title: Car Crime Simulator
details.short_description: Steal cars, set up secret stashes, sell vehicles for big profits on demand, or strip them for parts. Build your criminal empire solo or team up with others in co-op mode.

details.title: Hack Fate
details.short_description: Hack Fate is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with Chinese cyberpunk pixel art. Manipulate the timeline, switch identities, and kill enemies in one hit. Turn traps and foes into weapons and find multiple routes through every level. Ancient myth meets cyberpunk, each choice defying fate.

details.title: RUIN: Beast City
details.short_description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

details.title: A Tiny Wander
details.short_description: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

details.title: Become
details.short_description: Become is a short single-player third-person adventure where you embark on life's most fantastical journey, as one of millions of sperm. Survive the perilous microcosm, wiggle, dash, and outcompete rivals through the human reproductive system to create new life.

details.title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
details.short_description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

details.title: EONA
details.short_description: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers and Melusine, the evil fairy who rules over it for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

details.title: Mercy Incore
details.short_description: Solo indie character-action. You are a medieval knight in a techno-dimension. Become a jet-boosted vampire to survive. Follow a full-metal spaniel to escape

details.title: Pennants Of Glory: Condottiere
details.short_description: Run a medieval mercenary company with Battle Brothers-style management in a living world. Command up to 600 soldiers in Total War-style real-time 3D formation battles as factions wage wars, besiege towns, and reshape campaign. Break formations with unique stance mechanics.

details.title: Always Fear The Unknown
details.short_description: Always Fear The Unknown is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where fear is personal. Complete a psychological profile before the match, then survive as a human team against a relentless hunter while sanity, objectives, and adaptive scare events push back.

name: Five Hearts Under One Roof season3

details.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof season3
details.short_description: Mal-sook and Gran return for the finale, feelings deeper than ever! After a work disaster, Yuman heads to Jeju with Gran, only for Mal-sook to appear and reignite their love triangle. New faces enter the mix as old bonds change. This time, choose where your heart belongs.

details.title: Solitaire
details.short_description: Unwind with Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid and TriPeaks. Choose a deal by difficulty, take your time, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting the cards in order, with hints and undo whenever you need a little help.

details.title: Elowen's Travel Notes
details.short_description: Discover Elowen’s travel journal in her bookshop and step into her journey. Use productivity tools to study and work as each focus session takes you further. Unlock new scenes and discover her story at your own pace, with soothing music and beautiful illustrations.

details.title: Strayward
details.short_description: STRAYWARD is an open-world voxel survival game set across a series of strange and isolated regions. Explore, scavenge, gather resources, build shelters, and fight to survive as you venture deeper into an unfamiliar world filled with persistent threats and unexplained phenomena.

details.title: Fast Food Together
details.short_description: Start your culinary adventure in Winston Springs! Begin with a food truck and work your way up to opening your very own restaurant, either solo or in co-op! Take care of your customers, create your own recipes, set your prices and menu. Earn money and invest in growing your business.

details.title: AOKAKI
details.short_description: A disgraced ronin returns to his homeland to find it ravaged by war. Taking up his sword once more, he must battle through the feudal forces of the shogun and take on foes he once called friends. Parry, pogo, and dash your way through a land of insect samurai in this platformer.

details.title: Prospera
details.short_description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil

details.title: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
details.short_description: Shadow Sacrament is a grim horrorvania where you play as a tormented detective who must investigate the secrets of an ancient, horrific monastery. Explore hidden chambers, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that lurk in its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

details.title: Solace Creek
details.short_description: A PSX-stylized horror mystery set in the lonely Taraset Station. Haunted by a monstrous presence, with six mysterious red coins, you embark on a tense and deliberate journey. Solace Creek is a retro-inspired horror title with a focus on exploration, atmosphere & puzzle solving.

details.title: Unnatural
details.short_description: Unnatural is a first-person survival horror game set in a dark world between life and death. Solve puzzles, manage resources, and survive invisible monsters using your firearm and supernatural light to reveal and destroy the horrors lurking in the darkness.

details.title: RoRX
details.short_description: A competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

details.title: The Backworld
details.short_description: Slip through the cracks of reality and explore a vast, open-ended RPG world where surreal horrors collide with fantasy kingdoms and sci-fi cities. Fight in strategic turn-based battles and tense real-time action. The more your sanity breaks, the more the world and its monsters warp around you.

details.title: Trailblazers: Into the March
details.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

name: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World

details.title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
details.short_description: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, gothic sci-fi metroidvania rooted in Cosmic Horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

details.title: Football, Tactics & Glory 2
details.short_description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Embark on the career of an unknown coach: tactically outsmart opponents in turn-based matches, earn money and experience, search for talented players, manage a club, build your reputation to get invited to lead the national team, and win the World Championship!

name: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo

details.title: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo
details.short_description: An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

details.title: Gateworlds
details.short_description: Gateworlds is a colony sim about exploring and surviving a fantasy wilderness. Find your way in a world of floating islands, strange creatures, and fickle gods.

details.title: Super Bio-Man
details.short_description: Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy. Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

details.title: Mechanized Wonder: Lost Unit
details.short_description: Fight across battlefields in the name of freedom from those who are bound and weighted down by gravity in this FPS simulation game, where you pilot a giant Mechanized Combat Vehicle from within an enclosed cockpit.

details.title: Solitary Singleplayer Offline MMORPG
details.short_description: Run an MMORPG guild in this incremental management game. Recruit new members, upgrade your guild, promote leaders to automate the busywork, and grind for the best gear. All to earn the Server-First achievements for every raid.

details.title: Gunmetal Gothic
details.short_description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

details.title: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
details.short_description: INFINITUM is a horror open-world survival co-op story game for up to 4 players. Explore Infinite procedurally generated levels and uncover multiple endings, with every playthrough offering a unique experience.

details.title: Shattered Souls
details.short_description: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, and you will not forget the betrayals inflicted upon you. With a mark that ties your fate to seven men, you’re determined to lay waste those who tried to shatter you. Will you try again?

details.title: Tessera
details.short_description: Tessera is an open-world sandbox fantasy RPG. Create your own character, explore a seamless hand-crafted continent, gather and craft, delve into ever-changing dungeons, and build a home of your own. Play solo or invite friends into your world.

details.title: Power Off One
details.short_description: You're Sparky, the smallest part inside a giant dying machine. Solve mechanical puzzles to keep its failing chambers alive, and uncover why you were really sent to save it.

details.title: Ashes & Blood
details.short_description: Ashes & Blood is a fantasy strategy RPG blending fast-paced tactical battles, 4X-inspired strategy, and roguelite progression. Break the rules, build absurd combos, uncover Varyndel's secrets, and unlock even more chaos with each expedition. Turn-based strategy has never been this unhinged.

details.title: RAIN HEART
details.short_description: Psychological horror about Alex Bow, who struggles with himself and his traumas.

details.title: Project Life
details.short_description: 一款剧情丰富的roguelike互动小说游戏，也是一款拥有无限可能的构史引擎。假如人生可以重来，你将如何选择？主推故事集《中国式人生》，模拟90后/00后/10后的人生，在无数选择中体验一代人的共同记忆！游戏本体故事专为90后00后10后、互联网深度用户、喜欢搞笑抽象风格的玩家打造！

details.title: Rustown
details.short_description: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

name: 气运之子The One of Fortune

details.title: 气运之子The One of Fortune
details.short_description: Step into the mysterious and boundless world of Chinese-style fantasy. Gather the mysterious power of destiny. You can either assume the role of the revered leader of the righteous path, or transform into the powerful Demon Lord of the evil path.

details.title: FOMO
details.short_description: A 1x waste or a 100x investment. Whether you buy or not, you're already playing.

details.title: Smile Run
details.short_description: An endless runner with adorable characters. Run through multiple environments with different play styles. Play two modes of either limited time Gift Delivery or endless Ice Cream mode. Multiple levels of increasing difficulty.

details.title: Mote
details.short_description: Mote is a hard sci-fi, squad-based, turn-based tactical roguelike played on a hexes. Create an species with unique abilities, senses, and combat styles. Command a squad as you explore distant systems, encounter new societies, and choose which factions to help, and which to betray.

details.title: Whispers of Primwood
