details.short_description: A story-driven wuxia RPG. Play as your sect's only male disciple, train, get to know five heroines, and fight alongside your companions in tactical card battles as you learn to become their sect leader.

details.title: Spells Dungeon
details.short_description: Spells Dungeon is a roguelike dungeon crawler adventure with multiple endings and a challenging adventure for those who dare to try.

details.title: Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights
details.short_description: Survive in an open world inspired by 14th century Europe. Immerse yourself in crafting based on real historical methods and experience true inventory system and realistic resource management. Take control of your destiny and embrace a world full of possibilities.

details.title: RABAUKEN - Spirit Resort
details.short_description: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

details.title: Rover's Tale
details.short_description: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

details.title: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
details.short_description: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

details.title: The Mangust
details.short_description: The Mangust is a high octane action platformer. You play as the Mangust, a lone drifter with a loose grip on reality. Blitz through enemies with an arsenal of customizable guns and special abilities. Explore different environments, defeat iconic bosses, and stop the plans of the Evil Dr. Cassowary.

details.title: Dig Dig Boom
details.short_description: Dig Dig Boom is a strategic mining roguelite set in a fully destructible world where time moves only when you move. Dig, blast, explore and fight your way through procedurally generated caves using a wide selection of mining tools with unique effects.

details.title: Regen Protocol
details.short_description: Sci-fi progression/idler game with many unexpected twists. Build modules, set protocols and help your ship grow to get it back to it's desired destination after the ships Regen Protocol is initiated.

details.title: Unheeded Influences
details.short_description: A spiritual journey in the life of an elemental soul in our mythologies and legends. A unique adventure infused with 12 elements: fire, time, shadow, water... Unlock powerful spells and influence the game of other players. Fast travel through spirit realms, and try to survive in physical ones.

details.title: Changer Seven
details.short_description: 3D Single-Player Action-Adventure! Explore a Vibrant World, Recruit Colorful Teammates, and Swap them during Combo-Driven Battles! ❤️ A Love Letter to the Toku-Sentai, Shounen Anime, Mahou Shoujo, and Classic Morning Cartoon Shows of our Childhood!

details.title: SUMMER ROAD 10-Minute Auto Roguelite
details.short_description: Dress them up, feed Mogmo, pick your path. A cozy roguelite RPG you can finish in 10 minutes a run. Battles play out on their own. Your choices shape the adventure.

details.title: From_.
details.short_description: One morning, Makoto the postman opens his eyes to find a strange and inexplicable visitor standing at his bedside. Soon after, he learns of a grim rumor spreading through Aquaria. As the letters he delivers bring writer and reader together, a once-forgotten truth begins to resurface.

details.title: Super Vecter Elite Turbo
details.short_description: Explore, fight and race across the real world in the sequel to one of the best runner games out there. Real cities, real mountains, real scale, all waiting for you to discover and unlock. Customize your ship, unlock new ones, and fight enemies at crazy speeds.

details.title: Blazing War World
details.short_description: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.

details.title: Mountain Resort Manager
details.short_description: Build a cozy alpine resort where gondolas glide, guests explore, and your mountain evolves through seasons. Place trails and buildings, manage staff and finances, and watch the resort come alive at your pace.

details.title: Cartomantic
details.short_description: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

details.title: Rustwater
details.short_description: Rustwater is a cozy post-opocalyptic cleanup simulator. Pilot your boat across a flooded world, using immersive cutting mechanics to dismantle structures and rotting ships to gather resources. Sail through isolated settlements, repair homes, and trade goods to help survivors rebuild their lives.

details.title: Last Patrol
details.short_description: You are an Orderlord — a mutating meatball cop battling cultists in a surreal post-human dystopia. Evolve your form, investigate an intergalactic conspiracy, and prevent cosmic annihilation in this top-down horror shooter.

details.title: Born from the Soil
details.short_description: Conquer the apocalypse using gritty dirt bikes and explosive ordnances in Born from the Soil, a blend of classic turn-based tactics, modern gameplay polish, and 16-bit retro charm.

details.title: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning
details.short_description: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning is a third-person bullet hell shooter. Join Cosmo Clean Co.'s Special Cleaning Division, drop onto high-risk planets, and recover the planet cores a former operative stole. Absorb incoming fire, slow the field with Time Dilation, and hit glowing weak points.

details.title: First Blood : Persian Legends
details.short_description: First Blood : Persian Legends is a linear story-driven real-time-tactic strategy game based on ancient Persia, Sassanid Empire. Our story is heavily inspired by true events. Can you help saving the Sassanid Empire from within?

details.title: Total World Liberation
details.short_description: Open World Survival Automation Crafting Building Turn-Based game, yup that's a huge mix of genres and it works!

name: My Hidden Pets: Find My Duck

details.title: My Hidden Pets: Find My Duck
details.short_description: Step into the unique world of duck searching. Bring a friend and see how many ducks you can find in the latest adventure of the My Hidden Pets series

details.title: ノロワレサイクル
details.short_description: Mayuhara City, Tokyo. The wounds of the mass suicide event of Mayuhara Academy from eight years ago have finally begun to heal. The rumors of the “Mayuhara Curse” are still whispered amongst the students.

details.title: Zehlar
details.short_description: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

details.title: Elite Rogue
details.short_description: Elite Rogue – BOUNTIES. CHAOS. BETRAYAL. Every contract is a high-stakes gamble in this unpredictable roguelike! Hunt alone or with up to 10 players, earn Darkmatter to unlock game-breaking powers, manipulate reality, and outsmart rivals. Adapt or be erased. WISHLIST NOW!

details.title: Bloody Horror Plant
details.short_description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

details.title: Limbo Control
details.short_description: Limbo Control is a 1v4 asymmetric horror game where a supernatural creature takes over the area in an attempt to anchor itself in our world, while four hunters fight to reclaim control before it’s too late.

details.title: Exodus of Descent
details.short_description: Descend into an online third person PvE RPG dungeon looter inspired by RuneScape and Dark & Darker. Party up with your friends to solve escape-room type puzzles, collect over 150+ lootable items, level up your character, create unique classes and unlock new abilities. Escape Your Descent!

details.title: QUADREMOR
details.short_description: A first-person shooter where you play as one of the last human mercenaries, driven by vengeance for the annihilation of humanity. Dive deep into a dark and unforgiving realm fueled by cruelty.

details.title: TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls
details.short_description: “TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls” is a TouHou fan game.In the game, because of someone's conspiracy, Reimu turned into Kedama and caused her power to weaken.Reimu then had to embark on an adventure to recover herself and finally uncover who was behind the scenes.

details.title: Subway Outbreak
details.short_description: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

details.title: Clown Meat
details.short_description: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

details.title: Magic Potion Liberators
details.short_description: A bullet heaven action game that gives you a comfortable feeling of being a warrioress. Knock down the onrushing monsters and push forward deep into the enemy territory! Create powerful builds with reinforce potions and crush the witch's servants!

details.title: Dungeon Cleaner
details.short_description: IT'S NOT CLEANING, IT'S SAVING THE WORLD. Grab your trusty detergent and join the bubble guy in this rogue-lite with unique mechanics. Bounce on walls doing acrobatic stunts, meet charismatic characters and dive into dungeons to clean up the chaos that plagues the world of Dungeon Cleaner.

details.title: Fallen Symphony
details.short_description: The world of Fallen Symphony is full of heated battles, engaging puzzles, and fearsome dungeons. Prepare yourself for a unique battle system which is inspired by brawlers from late 90s and gameplay based on the JRPGs of old.

details.title: Endless Samurai
details.short_description: A turn-based action RPG centered around parrying. Roguelite × Loot draws you into the Infinite.

details.title: Valley of the Old Masters
details.short_description: You are an inspiration-seeking wandering artist who mysteriously ends up in a faraway Valley. Will you find the inspiration you crave, or will you be lost to the mysteries of the Valley?

details.title: Mental: The Dark Night
details.short_description: Mental is a single-player exploration and psychological horror game with multiple stories and maps to uncover. Immerse yourself in a captivating visual and auditory experience as you take on the role of an investigator at a paranormal research company.

details.title: The Razorform
details.short_description: Infiltrate a classified research facility and unleash the Razorform, a time-warping entity from a dimension of nightmares and chaos. Spray gunfire, uncover military secrets, and slice through enemies with electrified blades. The Razorform is a single player atmospheric sci-fi action game.

details.title: Tower Builder
details.short_description: Tower Builder is online Co-op or single player building and design game.

details.title: Age of Amelorn
details.short_description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

details.title: Rasna
details.short_description: "Rasna" is an historically accurate Etruscan tale: a legend as it might have been told in ancient times when people gathered around the fire. A single-player, story-driven historical open-world game to jump 2500 years in the past.

details.title: FEAR BOUNDS: Amelia story
details.short_description: Through phobias to the truth. Embark on the chilling journey of the girl, Amelia. Monsters and horrors born of a child's imagination rise up, revealing the deepest secrets of her family's past. Fight or flee, hide or jump! Learn, solve puzzles, and explore these terrifying, twisted worlds.

details.title: Fear of Horror
details.short_description: In 1944, you take on the role of Jason Miles. On behalf of the OSS, you are sent to a waterworks near the Schneiden in the heart of Germany, because according to reports, a Nazi scientist is researching how to resurrect fallen soldiers as ghosts.

details.title: Arcadice
details.short_description: Play a top-down shooter on an arcade machine you’re handcuffed to. Buy vices between levels and abuse them to power up your run. Load dice like bullets and shoot dice-headed enemies. This is not a dice game.

name: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei

details.title: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei
details.short_description: A third-person stealth adventure set in the late Ming dynasty. Play as Jinyiwei agent Xie Guxian and travel with a mysterious girl. Observe patrols and connections between people. Use Threadweaving together to create openings for infiltration and rescue, and find a way through danger.

details.title: Battles For Glory
details.short_description: Battles for Glory is a free MMORPG where opposition of parties and control of the world map are combined.

details.title: AFTER 9PM
details.short_description: AFTER 9PM — a game where reality and nightmare merge into one. Your parents left you home alone. It’s already late. Every time they left you like this, you had strange nightmares. Each time, they became more and more real. And now you’re not sure… if it’s just a dream anymore.

details.title: Sunset Suckerpunch
details.short_description: Meet K8E: a talking, transforming motorcycle-greatsword-gauntlet-pistol. Drive her to meet your enemies, and wield her to crater them into the asphalt. Turn the bodies of your enemies into supersonic projectiles in fast-paced, power-tripping combat. Don't let them take her voice.

details.title: No One Leaves the Field
details.short_description: A first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware—something ancient walks between the stalks.

details.title: SPRKLS.exe
details.short_description: ˚ ̴̡̢̛̼̬̠̰̀͟҉̢C͊͊ ༘⋆ ⟡̷͛ SPRKLS.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven puzzle-platformer visual novel about friendship and apocalypse that unfolds entirely on YOUR desktop 𓂃˗ˏˋ⟢ 𓂅 ⋆. ˖𓏲ּ𝄢 ⟡̵̂ ִֶָ 𓂃⊹

details.title: Shadow over Bishkek
details.short_description: Shadow Over Bishkek is a 3D Action/RPG with the top down camera view. A student from Bishkek gains the superpower to travel to the Darkland and interact with ghosts. During the day, he lives an ordinary life of a student, but at night, he fights evil spirits.

details.title: Visitant
details.short_description: Hire & level-up hunters, accept contracts to investigate paranormal activity at haunted locations and collect evidence using an arsenal of tools in this psychological horror ghost-hunting simulator, alone or with friends. But it won't be easy! The tormented spirit terrorizes those who meddle with it

details.title: Wukong: Time to Deal
details.short_description: Embark on your Journey to the West!《Wukong: Time to Deal》is a Journey to the West roguelike game featuring core deck building and demon slaying gameplay. Experience random adventures and rich rewards, with distinctive desktop interactive content offering relaxed casual gameplay.

details.title: Synarchy
details.short_description: Every space game hands you a gun. Synarchy hands you a ledger. Found a corporation with one ship, then haul, trade and build a fleet across 250 star systems in one shared, always-online galaxy where the news moves the markets in real time.

name: Pooh's Parables: Regarding the Dream Thief

details.title: Pooh's Parables: Regarding the Dream Thief
details.short_description: Help the Sandman as Winnie-the-Pooh, Christopher Robin, Piglet, and more of your familiar friends combine their special abilities to solve puzzles with light platforming elements, best foes in turn based combat using engaging Action Commands, and bring back everyone's stolen dreams!

details.title: Project Gears
details.short_description: Charge! Smash! Don't stop! Survive! Race through chaotic city streets as Engine Heart and Motor Soul. Upgrade each hero's unique abilities, blast through enemies at top speed, and keep your engine running. If your power runs out, so do you.

details.title: Scrappers: Adhokin
details.short_description: Build your hideout with wasteland salvage, then head out again. Scrappers: Adhokin is a solo top-down extraction shooter with base building and resource management. Place structures and furniture, manage power and fuel, and return alive with gear, blueprints, and loot.

details.title: CLAM
details.short_description: Clam is an odd pet rat; googly-eyed, unpredictable and hyper-vigilant. One night Clam gets spooked and escapes the rat mansion with no way back in. Now she’s a tenant. Is the sharehouse as hospitable as home? Be a rat, be a renter, survive a sharehouse - it’s CLAM!

details.title: Legend of BAKEHIME
details.short_description: A thrilling Japanese-style action game featuring Saya, a half-yokai princess who fires spiritual arrows from her bow, and Jubei, her kind-hearted retainer who wields a spear with mastery. Together, they stand against waves of terrifying yokai through the power of their bond!

name: Choice of Life: Become a Witch

details.title: Choice of Life: Become a Witch
details.short_description: Leka has always dreamed of becoming a witch. But the real magical world turned out not to be what she had imagined. Will she be able to uncover all its secrets? Including the one that connects her to magic.

details.title: Endless Night Sonata
details.short_description: Endless Night Sonata is a hand drawn metroidvania with classic style animation. Follow the quest of Nicodemos in the "Worlds-in-middle", an unforgiving and dangerous land controlled by demonic forces on a epic mission to find his purpose...

details.title: I'M YOUR HOST
details.short_description: An audio deduction game where you have one task: restore a series of lost podcast episodes.

details.title: Ariki
details.short_description: A co-op colony sim for up to 10 players. Wash ashore on a Pacific archipelago, raise a village with colonists who work the land, win over rival villages in dance-offs, then sail your canoes side by side and navigate by the stars to new islands.

details.title: PATRICIDE
details.short_description: "PATRICIDE" is an adventure RPG about girls who killed their father. It features a story of love and hate, hybrid action and turn-based combat, and cute anime-style heroines. Master the "Emotion System" to weaken enemies through empathy, and survive a ruthless, suffocating modern society.

details.title: Sticks and Stones
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid impact.

details.title: DesktopDaily
details.short_description: Ami Koharune and Tsukuyomi-chan live on your PC. Chat with voiced characters whose gestures match their words, or watch them cook, read and sleep in a shared home that doubles as a live wallpaper. Free to download, with trial credits for chat.

details.title: Where The Light Stays
details.short_description: A contemplative pixel art platformer. Carry a living light across a mountain lost in the night. And somewhere at the summit… something awaits you.

details.title: ECHO//NULL
details.short_description: An isometric action MMORPG of androids and erased cities. Wake in Cradle-19 as a Ninth Generation Wanderer, fight machines with blade and Drone, shape your build with Plug-in Chips, and remember the places the world was made to forget.

details.title: Abdication
details.short_description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

name: Petals and Pots: Plant Shop Simulator

details.title: Petals and Pots: Plant Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own cozy plant shop! Order supplies, stock shelves, and serve customers. Plant, water, and repot houseplants, restore and decorate your shop, and customize your character. Grow your business, meet the locals, and help a struggling little town bloom again.

details.title: The Radio Tower
details.short_description: Your job is to climb the tallest towers in the world to maintain them, this time you were called urgently to fix the only tower providing cover to the small Crimsonpine city that is currently on quarantine.

details.title: Read of Mask
details.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle game set in Eastern Europe, 1999. Explore a surreal black-and-white world, decipher an invented alphabet using a reality-altering mask, and unlock the story letter by letter.

details.title: Click Here!!
details.short_description: You’ve installed “U,” the so-called “best” UI software. It promised maximum productivity, but in reality, it turned out to be a nightmare that throws your PC into total chaos?! Conquer the worst interface ever created and force it to uninstall!

details.title: Munchy Lair
details.short_description: Munchy Lair is a 2D strategy game fusing turn-based snake combat with roguelite tower climbing. Plan WASD paths, preview enemy moves, then resolve. Kill snakes by collision, grab items, buy buffs, advance floor by floor within a turn limit. Endless mode unlocks after three boss layers.

details.title: Blade & Burgers
details.short_description: Make burgers, whale in a pay-to-win game, and simp your heart out in this parody roguelite made as a “love” letter to mobile microtransaction grindfests. It’s not the Darkest Dungeon. It’s the greediest one.

details.title: Boba Bears
details.short_description: Run a cozy boba shop 🧋 for bears, discover hidden drink and topping combos, decorate your space, prep ingredients through playful minigames, and meet new bear customers at your own pace. No timers, no pressure, just sweet drinks, curious experiments, and soft village moments.

details.title: Mystery of the Sacred King
details.short_description: You are the Lawspeaker, a defender of justice. Decode local rituals. Seek the truth. Dismantle conspiracies to save the innocent from execution. Put an end to the deception by revealing the mystery of the Sacred King in this deduction puzzle game.

details.title: CORVIDTALISM: Win at Life
details.short_description: Help a lazy low life get back up on his feet. Make him work, use persuasion, ignore his cries, and make choices for him. "Don't say you don't want to win at life."

name: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace

details.title: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace
details.short_description: Be the family BBQ master and try to grill in peace while your chaotic relatives turn everything upside down. Manage the grill, handle food orders, complete quests, and capture memories.

details.title: EverestBaseCamp
details.short_description: Manage Everest Base Camp, prepare climbers for dangerous expeditions, and guide your team from early route pushes toward an eventual summit attempt.

details.title: Click-A-Bao
details.short_description: Click the buns, catch the buns, don't eat the buns. A hidden objects game where you don't have to find everything. You'll unlock bun helpers that will search the pictures with you! Decorate your office, get new pictures, upgrade your buns and collect them all!

details.title: Aleph's Garden
details.short_description: A platform-puzzle Metroidvania where knowledge unlocks the garden—learn, open new paths, and solve mysteries in more than one way.

details.title: Cinema Deals
details.short_description: Play as a cashier in a cinema theater! Take orders, print movie tickets, prepare popcorn, drinks and more! And don't forget today's deals!

name: Night of her vanishing in fireworks

details.title: Night of her vanishing in fireworks
details.short_description: The Night She Disappeared in the Fireworks is a short visual novel set in a small Chinese city and centered on esports. You play as Liu Lan, a high school esports player, as he faces three life-changing matches and, together with two heroines, witnesses a fate rewritten by fireworks.

details.title: Necro Pop
details.short_description: Necro Pop is an all-new action genre platformer we lovingly refer to as Arcadevania. On your adventure, you will discover new abilities, upgrades, secrets. You can free your ghostly friends using multiple combat abilities, magics, and maybe even a minion across multiple re-playable dungeons!

details.title: RePair in the Space
details.short_description: RePair in the Space is a game where an alien and a robot must repair their ship. Whether playing with a friend or embarking on this journey alone, you’ll have to craft and use items to fix every sector of the ship, battling against time, haste... and sometimes against your friend or even yourself!

details.title: Snooze Control
details.short_description: An arcade driving game about mastering the art of the nap - while driving! Steer a brakeless truck through traffic on never-ending roads while skillfuly managing your Snooze-O-Meter - read the road, pick your moment, and keep the truck in control.

details.title: Becoming None
details.short_description: Becoming None is an RPG about the loss of identity and homogenization. Experience a story told through collectable memories you can view at your own pace, alongside deep turn-based combat, customizable classes, and countless secrets.

details.title: Divination & Survivors
details.short_description: Survive spirit hordes in an ink-wash bamboo grove. Toss three coins on level-up, pick an upgrade, and evolve five skills from 64 hexagrams. Face three bosses, then see how the hexagrams you formed shape a reading on the theme you chose.

details.title: Little Dao
details.short_description: Little Dao is a 3D eastern fantasy MMORPG where players explore a floating mainland shaped by the rivalry between Ru and Mo, battle otherworldly monsters in real-time combat, complete quests, improve gear and skills, and build guild power with friends.

details.title: City Party
details.short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

details.title: Mahou Shoujo Y
details.short_description: A visual novel that combines two popular genres: mahou shoujo and yuri. Help the girls fight evil in turn-based battles and nurture their relationship. Only you decide how the story ends.

details.title: Splashdown
details.short_description: Fend off hordes of evil floaties in treacherous lazy rivers with your trusty water gun!

details.title: Triglav Online
details.short_description: Real-time strategy meets MMO. Pick your faction – Elven Empire, Demon Cult, or Steampunk Dwarves – and command armies in massive PvP battles with hundreds of players. Build guilds, forge alliances, play politics. Session-based. Free to Play.

details.title: H.E.M.A.
details.short_description: In this four-player cooperative survival horror first-person shooter, you and your group must search for failed experiments, manage scarce loot, and escape the abandoned corporate facility before it's too late.

details.title: House Heroes
details.short_description: Cut, paint and screw your way to success, alone or with friends. Bring back the House Heroes team and fight against the real-estate mafia in this local coop construction simulator adventure. Will you be able to save your failing family business?

name: The End of the World Club

details.title: The End of the World Club
details.short_description: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

details.title: MASH Commander
details.short_description: Manage camp morale and army resources in harsh conditions. Direct the flow of wounded, take control of individual cases, and develop your skills and those of your staff. Live in the camp and come to know the people you command. Meet expectations in Survival Rate and Camp Efficiency, or be replaced.

details.title: Aeriea
details.short_description: Aeriea is a tower-defense × roguelike × survivor game where positioning, weapon builds, and tower placement work in tandem. Maneuver through waves of enemies, fortify your defenses, and outlast the storm in timed survival skirmishes — every run is a fight for survival.

details.title: Gorilla Warfare
details.short_description: Apes together strong. Explosively strong. Gather your friends, pick your grenade, and wreck the arena until you're the only one left standing.

details.title: The Black Bahr
details.short_description: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

details.title: Spirit of Diwata
details.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A co-op action JRPG inspired by SNES classics, for up to three on one screen or online. Play instruments to calm the angry creatures of an Asian fantasy world, and watch each one become a friend who brings a little more hope.

details.title: Ocean City Killer
details.short_description: Ocean City Killer is an open-world corporate dungeon crawler. You play as Rick Atlanta, a private eye investigating the death of a former colleague. What starts out as a routine case pulls you into the dark labyrinth of a seedy megacorp. Hop in your muscle car to explore the city!

details.title: Pileus Bad Trip
details.short_description: Put yourself in the role of a surviving village mushroom and try to fix what happened while you were asleep!

details.title: Chunky JUMP!
details.short_description: Chunky JUMP! is a survival-horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

details.title: Rise of the Spellbaker
details.short_description: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

details.title: Skyland Farmer
details.short_description: In Skyland Farmer, farm in peace on your own Sky Isle. Till the fields, enrich the soil and breed better crops in this farming sim. Sell your harvest at your farm stand or put it to the test in contests. Your endless farming life starts here!

details.title: DIGGY DIGGY
details.short_description: In DIGGY DIGGY, you dig up rare fossils, collect shiny minerals and showcase your findings in a museum. Explore unique locations and bond with eccentric townsfolk in this delightfully silly, cozy adventure.

details.title: Stella: into the Shadow
details.short_description: Stella comes to Blackwood for a few days to write about an old case: in 1988, four teenagers drove out to the lake and never came back. Then a murder happens in town, and leaving is no longer an option. A detective visual novel about an investigation and feelings that arrive at the wrong time.

name: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale

details.title: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
details.short_description: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

details.title: As We Unite
details.short_description: As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

details.title: Aetherfall
details.short_description: Aetherfall is an elemental post-apocalypse extraction RPG set on a modern Earth where technology has failed and elemental power rules. Master fire, earth, air, and water, combine them into new elements, and risk everything as you fight to survive and grow stronger.

details.title: GUNtai
details.short_description: Craft your gun. Shoot down enemies hordes. Upgrade weapon, remake weapon, combine weapon. Unlock new characters and new modules. Make great gunsmiths regret their inventions!

details.title: Junkyard Space Agency
details.short_description: Build ships from scrap and fly them in a gritty space sim. Venture solo or team up. Hunt for parts, haul vital resources, and keep your space agency afloat.

details.title: Kaguya
details.short_description: Not a regular shmup player? No worries! This is a super chill, low-difficulty, fully voiced bullet hell shooter just for you! Wipe out the AI machine armada attacking from all directions!

details.title: DIGI-DOLL
details.short_description: Mauve takes on the job of a decorator. Design and decorate dollhouses for different ragdolls and appease their unique tastes. Use the retro DIGI-DOLL console to explore the attic, unlock various dollhouses, befriend characters, and discover stunning furnishings to fill them with.

name: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard

details.title: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard
details.short_description: A romantic fairy tale set in a fantasy medieval Rus'. Play as Ivan, a young bard with a gusli in hand, on a quest to win the love of the elusive Novgorod princess. Learn tunes, make choices!

details.title: Diner Simulator 🍔
details.short_description: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!

details.title: Sugar Sling Showdown
details.short_description: Sling candies and fling sugar bombs at your friends in this tongue-based, chaotic, physics party game. Play against each other or join forces against enemies. Win rewards and use them to build your own ToffeeTown in a candy-coated world.

details.title: Hyperflex ULTRA
details.short_description: Dodge obstacles, switch gravity in ways you never even thought possible and see just how hard you can FLEX in this endless action platformer. Think you've got what it takes to master all four levels and achieve the VIBE?

details.title: The Shores of Stellaluna
details.short_description: Sail between fractured islands, gather what you can, and rebuild what was lost. Grow stronger, unlock the mysteries, automate production, and shape the world around you using a single resource for everything. In this world, the more you take, the less it feels like it was yours to begin with.

details.title: Mount Lomyst
details.short_description: You need to go up... but you cannot jump! Mount Lomyst is a 2D platformer where you must reach the summit using only a grappling hook and your climbing skills.

details.title: Street Shift
details.short_description: You are a professional racer who was set up right when you had your last chance to stay in the championship. The hero decided to enter the world of illegal racing, choosing between dirty and very dirty tactics — but keep in mind that the police aren't going to play fair either.

details.title: Road Valkyries
details.short_description: Rider Valkyries is an adventure game blending open-world riding, romance, life together, and motorcycle racing and combat. The neon never fades, and the engines are roaring. Welcome to a vertical city where every road climbs and every turn leads somewhere new — Cyber Chongqing.

details.title: Bloodfront
details.short_description: Bloodfront is a top-down dark fantasy survival game where you build a village by day and defend it from endless demonic hordes by night. There are no second chances. When the village falls, the run ends.

details.title: 白之追猎 Hunter White
details.short_description: White Hunt is a 2.5D open sandbox co-op hunting game. Every weapon features unique branching attack chains. Mix and match countless talismans to forge your exclusive combat style!

details.title: Ultimate Arcade Overdrive
details.short_description: Master challenging 8-bit mini-games while the arcade world comes alive around you. Stay focused, maintain your hydration, overcome distractions, and prove you're the ultimate multitasker on the global leaderboards.

details.title: Tricky and the Dream Caster
details.short_description: A surreal, retro-inspired, free form 3D platformer that takes you through a world of dreams and nightmares!

details.title: Bite the Crown
details.short_description: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

name: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep

details.title: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep
details.short_description: The game is a narrative-driven horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill and Fears to Fathom franchises. Live through two terrifying stories: a man’s summer getaway turns into a nightmare at a shady hotel, and a child grows up knowing something watches from the forest—always waiting.

details.title: LingoRogue
details.short_description: The language flashcard roguelike. LingoRogue is a dopamine machine of a deck-builder. Find the cards you need to spin crazy combos off your words. Play with endless variety and learn new languages without effort.

details.title: Switcheroo
details.short_description: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

details.title: Golemcrafter
details.short_description: Golemcrafter is a single-player survival crafting game where you, as a golem, explore a magical world, gather resources, build a base, harness the local wildlife, and craft powerful golems like yourself. Make friends, gain powers!

details.title: Galo's Strife
details.short_description: 『ガロゥズストライフ』は、人間が異形の怪物に変わる事件の最中、超常の力を得た主人公の少年ガロゥと少女ハイマを中心に描くダークファンタジーRPGです。バトルやイベントシーンでは、鮮やかなドット絵のキャラクター達が賑やかに動きます。仲間を集め「ルラガルド」へ旅立ちましょう。

details.title: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis
details.short_description: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis is an action, platform and adventure game. The action takes place in mythological times. Argol and his companions must face Nemesis the goddess of vengeance.

details.title: THE FATUM
details.short_description: The Supreme Committee congratulates you on your promotion. Your task is to identify citizens infected by the unknown virus. Interrogate, inspect, pass a verdict. Test your deduction in a world of total control. Remember: the Standard above all.

details.title: Souls End
details.short_description: Souls End is an auto-battler roguelike where you'll draft unstoppable armies, placing units and items in just the right way to create awesome synergies! Cast spells while battles unfold and find relics to further elevate builds. Will you defeat life itself-or will you meet a Souls End?

details.title: 90FX
details.short_description: Straight from the 90s, 90FX recreates the feel and experience of once revolutionary racing games of the early 90s. 90s Kids will remember this.

details.title: Weebles vs Grebals
details.short_description: Battle endless Grebals in a fast-paced isometric roguelike bullet hell. Master unique Weebles, create powerful builds, and survive solo or in online co-op.

details.title: ABSTRACTICA
details.short_description: In this fast-paced third person shooter with roguelike elements, you are tasked with recovering art that has mysteriously gone rogue. Fight abstract shapes like triangles, tangrams and even an abstract Mona Lisa to uncover the mystery of ABSTRACTICA.

details.title: Roots Of Ruin
details.short_description: Build your defenses, fight beside them, and reclaim your kingdom from the corruption. Expand your land, command powerful towers, and take direct control of one of four unique heroes to defend against relentless enemy waves and devastating bosses.

details.title: Isle of trees
details.short_description: Revive the lost forests of the Isle of Trees in this cosy open-world game. Wander around, make friends, catch worms, and restore forests back to life! Dinner’s at seven!

details.title: Curse of Dominion
details.short_description: Lead captains in grid-based battles across a conquest map where every victory expands your territory and income. Invest in regions, upgrade gear, and build class paths and loyalty bonds in a campaign focused on strategy, growth, and momentum.

details.title: Loco: Rails & Tails
details.short_description: Chaotic co-op for 1–4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

details.title: Elemental Shifter
details.short_description: Elemental Shifter is a top-down 2D roguelite where you harness the power of 'Elemental Shifting' adapting your abilities based on the last damage you took. Choose your path, battle mages, grow stronger, discover new weapons and defeat powerful bosses on your way to the Mage King.

details.title: SUPER ADVENTURE
details.short_description: Turn around to parry and block! Equipped with a shield on your back, jump your way through vivid levels, meet funny characters, and face challenging bosses. Fight using a quick-firing Alien Blaster or a melee-focused sword! Choose the path you want to go in this SUPER ADVENTURE!

details.title: Grapple Car
details.short_description: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

details.title: Into the Rootforge
details.short_description: Into the Rootforge is a unique fusion of runner, roguelike and card-based action combat. Master customisable attacks to delve further with each attempt. Uncover the secrets of the Rootforge and grow your true power through the skill trees of The Garden.

details.title: Clawback: Police Corruption Simulator
details.short_description: A narrative-focused crooked cop game. Manipulate death investigations and file false evidence to reap ill-gotten gains in a dystopian future. Save yourself.

details.title: Miniature Painter Simulator
details.short_description: Take up the amazing hobby of miniature painting! Run your own online store selling your painted miniatures & handling various jobs from clients. Create the most amazing miniatures with minimal limitations and even import your own custom models! Take a seat, grab a brush and relax.

details.title: Swarm Chess
details.short_description: Chess with thousands of pieces. Place your towers then relax and watch the chaos of battle unfold in this incremental auto battler.

details.title: Hell Loop
details.short_description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler with Chinese mythic horror. Play as an ancient butcher, trapped in the cycles of the underworld. Seek redemption, gain the aid of heavenly gods, and fight for freedom—and for the wife you still love.

details.title: Full Steam Undead
details.short_description: OPEN WORLD STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE VR ACTION! Ride the rune train, explore Necropolis Island and slay the undead. For Queen Victoria, it's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

details.title: Dreamcraft: Lumberjack
details.short_description: Chop the sick trees to purify the forests. Gather lumber, upgrade your axe, and improve stats. No rush, no stress, relax in cozy and beautiful lands, rescue animals, and unravel the secrets of the wilderness. Nature must be preserved so cut the shadow and restore the light!

details.title: 拉斯普特的龙与魔女
details.short_description: 由蒸汽和魔法驱动的世界——人类创立的先进都市拉普斯特 肩负重任的落魄贵族之子于此邂逅龙与魔女 在友情与爱恋的迷宫不断回旋，指向出口的答案究竟为何？

details.title: 3Souls
details.short_description: A world at the crossroads of forgotten technology and magic, filled with grim guardians and anomalies. Guide three heroes through the mysteries of a floating archipelago, upgrade your camp, and unlock their potential in an isometric action RPG with immersive mechanics.

details.title: Clean
details.short_description: Every room has something to hide.

details.title: Ethereal: Clash of Souls
details.short_description: Ethereal is a 6v6 third-person MOBA featuring a first-of-its-kind class system and extreme vertical lane design. Fly, climb, teleport, and destroy as you push lanes to defeat the enemy Elder. Play Early Access for exclusive skins, premium currency, monthly patches, and direct dev feedback.

name: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life

details.title: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life
details.short_description: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher’s Life is a top-down story adventure game about an unusual research life between a sloppy senior student and a helpful junior.

details.title: Pin-Crawl
details.short_description: Pin-Crawl is a dungeon crawling pinball rogue-lite! Bop, bash and dash your way through a dungeon of weird and wacky foes as you collect abilities and upgrades on your way to defeating the Evil Sorceress!

details.title: 雨中的生命之歌
details.short_description: 《雨中的生命之歌》 是以虚拟主播社团ReliveProject其附属世界观扩展而来的一款视觉小说游戏

details.title: Carcade
details.short_description: CARCADE is a fast-paced racing game with a bold art style by ICONIC GARAGE. Compete in time trials, race against ghost opponents, AI, or real players. Tune your car for different terrains, master hidden mechanics, and unlock secret achievements. Speed, strategy, and skill will define your victory!

details.title: Clawsome
details.short_description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

details.title: Roughly Crafted
details.short_description: Roughly Crafted is a laid-back crafting shop sim with a comedy story and creative freedom. Iron makes a fine sword. So do watermelons, zombie fingers and other things never meant to be weapons. Figure out what customers need, and haggle over every coin while your uncle runs his business schemes.

details.title: Overrun Protocol
details.short_description: OVERRUN PROTOCOL is a solo survival game where you face hostile machines on a mysterious island. Explore, hack systems, craft weapons, and uncover the secrets of an out-of-control AI. Your survival will depend on your ingenuity and adaptability.

details.title: Vizarri
details.short_description: A monster-taming RPG set on the planet of Valaar. Capture and train mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri. Battle other trainers in tactical, turn-based combat on a dynamic grid. Explore islands, collect items, and outsmart a rising enemy force. These are the Adventures of Valaar.

details.title: Bushcraft Survival
details.short_description: In this realistic bushcraft survival sim, a helicopter drops you in a frozen forest with what you packed. Build a shelter from logs and moss and keep your fire alive. Fish through the ice and keep your food away from bears. Survive the days you planned, then fly home and unlock new tools.

details.title: Once Upon a Knight
details.short_description: Once Upon a Knight is a single-player adventure game with an isometric view, focused on exploration and combat. Control a hero, face enemies, overcome challenges, and master shifting perspectives as you progress using keyboard, mouse, or controller.

details.title: GAL BOCCHI
details.short_description: GAL BOCCHI is an internet artist simulator ADV where you control the dogshit female artist “aimisu_u” and become the legendary artist she so desperately wants to become! All the time left for the not-so-young-anymore aimisu_u to escape reality for her dream is…drum roll…1 single year!

details.title: Reveniev: A Day in Nassiriyah
details.short_description: Get your revenge in REVENIEV!

details.title: Lecture Me Later
details.short_description: Just having a pleasant chat with one of the most popular guys in the University. Nothing weird about that, right? So why is he kinda... different than you've imagined?

details.title: Gretel's Honesty
details.short_description: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

details.title: Dignaut
details.short_description: Take on a peaceful mining mission that leads to something far more mysterious. Dig, upgrade your tools, and slowly awaken an ancient alien temple buried beneath the surface, bringing its forgotten music and light back to life.

name: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story

details.title: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story
details.short_description: Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens, explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an, and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.

details.title: In Another World
details.short_description: In this Isekai Anime RPG. Enjoy a more realistic skills system. Bring a race to extinction. Or live the quiet life farming in a pocket dimension. Fast paced real-time combat. Mostly medieval ecstatic. Hope you enjoy and find all and more of what you are looking for in another world.

details.title: Gambit
details.short_description: A chess roguelike where every run bends the rules. Build your army, wield powerful kings, and survive deadly variants on your way to proving a human can still beat the machine. Shape your build, outlast the chaos, and choose when to command the board yourself.

details.title: Threaded Dungeons
details.short_description: A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

details.title: Les Nominés du Néombre
details.short_description: Les Nominés du Néombre is a cooperative and strategic card game where you play as a group of explorers embarking on a collective adventure. Each battle tests your strength in the Vermalian lands, which have turned hostile since the emergence of the Néombre Rift.

details.title: HOLE WAR -The Abyss-
details.short_description: 「今こそ語りましょう。『もしも』の物語を……！」本作は、「職」と「食」から力を得て戦う長編RPGの体験版です。時には職業を変えて新たなスキルや能力を得て、時には料理を食べて一時的なバフを得て冒険しましょう。

details.title: SkyLeague
details.short_description: Master an acrobatic Skycar in competitive car-soccer. Build speed, control the air, outplay rivals with advanced mechanics, and shape a machine that is unmistakably yours.

details.title: ADAPTERS: Tower of Primus
details.short_description: A playful & cute handcrafted pixel art Roguelite / Hack & Slash Action RPG! Play as an "Adapter" with extraordinary growth potential—take on quests to save a small village raided by bandits, and reach the top of the mysterious tower! Supports up to 4-player local & Remote Play Together co-op!

details.title: The Standard Model
details.short_description: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

details.title: Gummy Nightmares
details.short_description: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth.

details.title: SkullStars: Supernova
details.short_description: SkullStars: Supernova looms over us in the funk of outer space! A 2D anime fighting game with stylish 3D models. Fight your way to become a SkullStar with an electrifying soundtrack. The five points of the universe will reconnect!

details.title: Pebbles Quest
details.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

details.title: Palettopia
details.short_description: Paint beautiful island cities with a brushstroke in this cozy puzzle game. Explore endless islands and solve puzzles while balancing the serene landscapes and your growing urban districts. Discover vibrant biomes and their adorable inhabitants as you paint your own perfect utopia in Palettopia.

details.title: Love in Space
details.short_description: A Sci-Fi Karaoke-Musical where your choices shape the story and your decisions become the lyrics. Escape Earth, make questionable friends, find unexpected love, and sing your way to a better future. And don't worry about hitting the right notes, you've got bigger things to worry about.

details.title: Legend vs. Legion
details.short_description: Legend vs. Legion is a roguelite HERO defense! A twist on the traditional tower defense game, play as a legendary hero empowered by a random arsenal of powerful spells and artifacts. Defend against hordes of monsters using strategy and reflexes, and save the realm of Valia.

details.title: Sea of Brave: Beast Island
details.short_description: Prisoners on a legendary island! Rescue your crew in this turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Think carefully about every move: your actions decrease each enemy's countdown, bringing them closer to their turn. Combine transformations, manage your energy, and escape Benryu!

details.title: Tinycraft
details.short_description: Demons from another world are coming, leading the allied forces of the Six Races to resist them. Choose your hero, build and continuously strengthen your team, and enjoy the collision of traditional RTS and Rogue mechanics in this world of sword and magic!

details.title: Rise of Realms
details.short_description: Rise of Realms is a 4X RPG, for 1-6 players, in a medieval fantasy setting. Command an empire and recruit heroes to lead your armies. Use your tactical abilities to conquer the lands and reshape them in your image. Wishlist now.

details.title: Everise
details.short_description: Reach the top of the Tower before raiders destroy your town. Scavenge the furniture and loot monsters to collect resources along the way, then empty your inventory down balconies to upgrade and defend your town!

details.title: Dangerous Connections
details.short_description: 1987. The Soviet Union is cracking from within. As special agent Dan Morris, navigate a world of shifting loyalties, covert operations, and ideological fractures in this story-driven Cold War FPS.

details.title: Mouse Holme
details.short_description: Your precious mouse home has been destroyed! 🐭 Start from scratch, build a thriving nest... and defeat the villainous cats! 🐈

details.title: Savage Gears
details.short_description: Savage Gears is a violent, single-player alt-history Africa Cold War shooter. Armed with an Iron Fist and an arsenal of devastating weaponry, you play as Ero Lei'Bourne, a S.P.E.A.R. operative, in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

details.title: GRIDHACK
details.short_description: GRIDHACK is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where hacking = fighting nonogram battles. Chase a rogue program and chip away at the galaxy's strongest firewall to uncover the conspiracy about what happened to Earth!

details.title: Fateful Bullet
details.short_description: A third-person anime arena shooter where you can bring a sword to a gunfight. Wall-jump across the city, dash through the crossfire and win with a blade or a bullet. Build your own cute fighter and take on real players in fast online PvP.

details.title: Deck of Memories
details.short_description: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

details.title: Rat Race Ritual
details.short_description: Poison your boss with your friends. Trap him, get him fired, and make him guess your next move. Or hide in cloak mode, sneaking through pipes and covers. Clocks that speed up time, tools to block paths, and 10 player lobbies!

details.title: Battle Mutants
details.short_description: Experience arcade chaos! Smash through 12 explosive stages as badass mutants in this modern beat 'em up. Enjoy unique level mechanics, brutal bosses, and stylish pixel art. Grab a friend for epic co-op mayhem!

details.title: Thor's Wrath
details.short_description: Embody a formidable and somewhat brute warrior, face hordes of enemies alone while protecting the city's treasures. Your goal is to climb the ranks of the best warriors ! The real challenge lies in your ability to wield yourhammer and cast spells with precision.

details.title: Umblight
details.short_description: Descend through the corrupted underworld in Umblight, a gearpunk roguelike deckbuilder about merging your cards together. Build a deck of shadow and light cards strong enough to survive, but is it enough to reach the bottom of the world?

name: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada

details.title: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada
details.short_description: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

details.title: Founders
details.short_description: Founders is a city-building survival game for 1-10 players, where medieval robots with evolving memories and unique personalities create a truly living world. Build and defend your city against relentless threats while shaping your character’s skills.

details.title: Just in Crime
details.short_description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

details.title: Dōbumon
details.short_description: Dōbumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Dōbumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Dōbumon champion.

details.title: Traceback
details.short_description: Traceback is a next-gen ultra-realistic bodycam shooter built with the power of Unreal Engine 5. Make every move count — your choices decide who survives. Prepare for intense bodycam firefights where precision matters, and every decision shapes the fate of your mission.

details.title: Abyssal Echo
details.short_description: Abyssal Echo is a stylized third-person adventure game. Players awaken in a world of absolute darkness, exploring their surroundings by emitting visualized sound waves. Players must evade horrible creatures, collect a sufficient number of items, and ultimately escape from the extraction point.

details.title: Tomebound
details.short_description: Rescue corrupted books from your library, harness their power and rally their forces to fight for you in this hexgrid tactics deckbuilder! Combine cards to create uniquely powerful spells. With thousands of permutations to explore every turn, no two battles will ever be the same.

name: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores

details.title: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
details.short_description: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.

details.title: Rogue Maze
details.short_description: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

details.title: Omega Redux
details.short_description: An episodic sci-fi adventure where you explore doomed open worlds one hour before their destruction. As a relic hunter and his playable robot companion, search for strangely meaningful artifacts while cinematic catastrophe approaches with every passing second. Get out in time—or meet the end!

details.title: 1992: Rasputie
details.short_description: Take a place of a politician in the post-Soviet space and immerse yourself in the struggle for power amid the ruins of the former empire. Your decisions will determine the path of the young state's development.

details.title: MaskuLand Survival
details.short_description: You are Masku, an explorer who crash-landed in an unknown world carrying a rare cure for your son! To breathe you need special Masks, each one grants you a unique ability! Repair your balloon and get supplies, fight you way back home! His life depends on you! You need to SURVIVE!

details.title: The Guiding Spirit
details.short_description: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

details.title: Di Renjie:  The Legendary Investigator
details.short_description: Become a legendary detective of ancient China! In "Di Renjie: The Legendary Investigator", play as Di Renjie, solving thrilling cases across Bianzhou and Bingzhou in the Tang Dynasty and uncovering the truth.

details.title: Whist
details.short_description: Become a healer in Whist – a single-player turn-based RPG. Challenge cunning diseases. Learn the art of healing, brew and stock up on potions, and solve puzzles. Plan your moves ahead, allocate your talents, and don’t rush to reveal all your cards — illnesses are not as simple as they seem!

details.title: Everything is Gun!
details.short_description: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

details.title: Tamer Town
details.short_description: Build and manage a town where humans and elemental creatures live and work together. Design neighborhoods, match Mokiton to jobs, and keep them happy to boost production. Produce and sell goods, then invest in new homes and land as your town grows.

details.title: The Ardron Universe
details.short_description: Your choices carve scars across realms. One universe. Multiple games. No second chances.

details.title: Wild Terrain
details.short_description: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

details.title: Curry Princess GOLD
details.short_description: A casual kawaii action game where you collect falling spices, earn gold, and cook delicious curry.Including Classic mode, Story mode, and 2P mode offers both competitive and cooperative play. There is also a curry catalog and leaderboards.

details.title: Zomb Zerro - 999
details.short_description: Psychological VR horror built around immersive physical interaction. Protocol 9-9-9 is compromised deep in a secret mountain facility. Science collided with occult rituals - something horrific awoke. Explore, scavenge scarce ammo, fight for survival, and uncover the truth.

details.title: The Dropouts
details.short_description: A spooky choices-matter mystery set in 2004 Switzerland. Many students have disappeared in Noirmont High over the past century. You're Lou, you just transferred here, and weird stuff immediately starts happening... will you be the next dropout?

details.title: Other World Strike: Helicopter Rescue
details.short_description: A third-person helicopter action shooter featuring realistic physics-based flight enhanced by alien technology. Extract stranded soldiers before hostile alien forces capture them across open maps set in three distinct biomes, with optional first-person gameplay and four selectable camera views.

details.title: Mindwarp: Island Detective
details.short_description: Up to 4 players in online co-op. Talk to characters, learn their stories, search for clues and pass judgment before sunset in this unique detective.

details.title: NO EXIT
details.short_description: No Exit is a small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, as you try to escape the crooked dimension you're trapped in.

details.title: Space Diner Simulator
details.short_description: After buying a rundown diner, you need to repair it and bring it to its full glory. Manage, renovate and upgrade the diner to attract more customers, and meet their demands. Bring a piece of home to the edges of space with Earths best recipes.

details.title: Giggy Shangri-La
details.short_description: Welcome to [Giggy Shangri-La], an exhilarating staff music action x live house management simulation. With guitar in hand, conquer dungeons and experience being a bartender at a live music club visited only by monsters! Would you like to explore the cute and eerie world with Yu Furuiido?

details.title: Planetary Delivery Boys
details.short_description: A co-op horror comedy about delivering furniture with your friends across the galaxy! Up to 4 players must physically lift couches and chairs, handling them carefully to reach rogue planets.

details.title: Katakamuna Idle
details.short_description: Experience cosmic harmony in this Katakamuna-inspired idle game. Gather "Ka," the essence of all existence, and weave the 80 verses of the Katakamuna Utahi. As an idle game, actions automate as you progress, allowing you to create harmony through color and sound, even when offline.

details.title: Floorball Practice
details.short_description: Run, dribble, shoot, score—repeat! Unleash your inner pro through practice and determination. Hone your Floorball skills, level up, and upgrade your gear with advanced Floorball sticks, stylish clothing, and more.

details.title: Cybreach
details.short_description: Cybreach is a cooperative FPS with tower defense elements. Set traps, use abilities, and destroy hordes of incoming cyber-zombies!

details.title: Rabanaz
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a steampunk casino run by ravens. Rewire the machine in your favour and they won't take it quietly. Blend your chips into new colours and change what "random" means to steer a run toward the build you have in mind.

details.title: 风旅人 Wind Traveler
details.short_description: This is a semi open world ARPG game with HD2D pixel style. In the game, players will play the role of the story protagonist "Red haired Suka" and embark on an exciting adventure in a beautiful continent called Wind Canyon.

details.title: Eggstraordinary Goose Chase
details.short_description: Not your everyday goose chase—this time, the goose is on the hunt! Sprint through vibrant levels, dodge obstacles, collect berries, stomp enemies, and take bold risks! Keep running, push your limits, and reclaim what’s yours!

details.title: 能動的ダンジョン
details.short_description: This game is a simple, high-difficulty RPG for people who are tired of the same old turn-based command-based RPGs.

details.title: EverCastle
details.short_description: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

details.title: 天罚
details.short_description: A 3D xianxia RPG of spell duels. Explore a vast world to hone your cultivation, compete with fellow cultivators in martial arts, and duel to prove your Dao.

details.title: Frontier Control : Invasion
details.short_description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

details.title: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
details.short_description: The lazy genius scientist "Dr. Mememe," who just wants to sleep forever, has invented Kawaii Sheep that induce sleep with their mysterious healing powers. An exponentially cute sheep-carrying game with expanding production × easy 3D action for casual enjoyment.

details.title: DebugDebut
details.short_description: A debugging simulation game in which you complete debugging requests from a game generation AI that suddenly appears. Debug games of various genres and aim to win high rewards.

details.title: Don't Forget the Phone
details.short_description: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

details.title: The Shadow Beneath
details.short_description: Rescue Akhenaten, the banished pharaoh, from an eternity beneath the sands. Wield the gifts of Aten's last disciples, unleash sacred techniques and battle the relentless guardians of the forgotten tombs in a fast-paced Action Roguelike.

details.title: Word To Angel
details.short_description: Play as five human heroes in this pacifist 2D RPG taking place in a world where some friendly (and not so friendly) angels conduct balance and harmony together... and where your only instruments for fighting are words and melodies.

details.title: Bake Until Done
details.short_description: Bake Until Done is a baking-themed, turn-based roguelite. Take control of a muffin as you battle devious desserts to break the spell of a magical bakery that is endangering your town. Fight back with your muffin’s morsels, but be careful not to lose too much…

details.title: Slum Dweller
details.short_description: Slum Dweller is a physics-based fighting game about typical situations that slum dwellers encounters on a daily basis. Try on the role of a slum dweller trying to survive in a harsh criminal environment or a street fighter taking part in underground tournaments.

details.title: Neko's Rage
details.short_description: Neko's Rage is a pixel art rogue-lite platformer set in a post apocalyptic future overrun with dangerous biomechanical robots. Play as the cyber Neko-01 unit and collect always more loots to upgrade your Hub and character.

details.title: Critical Upload
details.short_description: Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!

details.title: Figure KnockOut
details.short_description: Prepare for an no-nonsense fighting experience in Figure KnockOut! Drawing inspiration from the Guilty Gear series and the Smash Bros series, this game combines the best of 2D fighting and platform fighting with innovative accessibility features to offer an intense, yet user-friendly combat system.

details.title: Angel
details.short_description: ANGEL imbues breakbeats with networked aesthetics in this rhythm/racing adventure. In a network devastated by digital climate change, what does it mean to be connected?

details.title: Watch Out For Goblins!
details.short_description: The world's most accurate goblin simulation! Run and jump a ragdoll goblin through this hilarious physics adventure! Gobland is in trouble! Find the lost cogs, restore power, and become goblin royalty! Alone- or with a friend in split-screen, there's no stopping the BIG GOBLIN ENERGY!

details.title: Uncursed
details.short_description: Be Uncursed like every soul, Sent to save them, that’s your goal. With a crew or on your own, Venture through dungeons unknown. On Isles and seas, adventures await, With the perils that won't abate. But when night falls, hurry back quick; While the light fades, shadows grow thick.

details.title: SOS: Forgotten Planet
details.short_description: A survival horror where Morse code is the key to everything. Tap it to open doors. Listen and decode it to crack open supply caches. Every run rebuilds the lab. And it hides a different truth to uncover. Survive it, and walk away actually knowing Morse.

details.title: Horn of Balance
details.short_description: Explore an intricate new world of secrets and adventure. Features solid 2D Zelda-like gameplay, 12 vast non-linear dungeons and a wholesome story about the young golem Linden.

details.title: Soaked
details.short_description: Soaked is a multiplayer platforming sandbox. Push, grab, throw, dive, crawl, climb, spin, and dig into a variety of game modes!

details.title: Cut the Cards
details.short_description: Create your own cards in this roguelike deckbuilder by cutting and pasting throughout your deck! Journey to the chasms, fighting off dragons and Boviks alike as you manage scarce resources.

details.title: Upon Dusk
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of Upon Dusk, a new PvPvE survival shooter. Set in Avalon, you were sealed in a city that was left for dead while the government finds out what went wrong outside the walls. Will you survive?

name: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk

details.title: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk
details.short_description: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk is a 2D platformer with lots of different mechanics and a little bit of humor down the road.

details.title: XWarShooterVR
details.short_description: Dive into "XWarShooterVR": an amazing VR world that combines dynamic shooter, techno-magic and base-building strategy. Make your way to victory in tactical battles and attacks on other players' bases. Add to wishlist now and become a legend in the VR world.

details.title: triMIno
details.short_description: A tile-matching roguelike. triMIno is a satisfyingly strategic tile puzzler where you crack open booster packs, draft your perfect tile set, and connect colours and shapes to unleash huge scoring chains. Every tile counts. How far can you push your next run?

details.title: Micro Rogue
details.short_description: Fight, Upgrade, Repeat! Micro Rogue is an action roguelite where you battle room by room against enemies that upgrade just like you. Build your power, outsmart evolving foes, and see how far you can climb before either side breaks the game!

details.title: Frankenstein's Monster
details.short_description: Solo, or online for 2-4 players. Compete to build the best monster, by collecting a matching set of monster parts, helped by whatever weird creature assistant you can design. Take on the single player campaign or go mad scientist against friends (with prox chat).

details.title: Pakku Pony
details.short_description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

details.title: Groove Defense
details.short_description: Tower defense meets music game. Your towers build the soundtrack, enemies move to the rhythm. Defend to the groove!

details.title: Family Reunion
details.short_description: Your typical incremental family dinner table simulator where you play as a very bored child trying to speedrun the evening.

details.title: Appetite of the Abyss
details.short_description: Appetite of the Abyss is a survival cooking roguelite about hunger, discovery, and consequences. Learn what an abyssal creature craves, prepare meals to satisfy it, and protect your tribe. Will you master its appetite, or suffer its wrath?

details.title: No Critters Were Harmed!
details.short_description: No Critters were Harmed is a co-op dungeon-delving adventure for up to four players where players must rush against the clock to escape a collapsing dungeon with a powerful MacGuffin that works to thwart their escape. Treasure, glory, and really cool hats await those who make it out alive!

details.title: Down Forward
details.short_description: A roguelike FPS where the level rewrites itself while you fight. Battle VHS-era horrors in liminal spaces that shift mid-combat. No two runs are physically the same.

details.title: Where's My Red Ball?
details.short_description: A lonely cat is waiting for her red ball. Only the right one will do. In a charming hand-drawn world, open boxes, wipe away paint, and tinker with curious machines to find it. No timers, unlimited retries, just a cozy point-and-click puzzle that slowly reveals why that ball means so much to her.

details.title: Bher
details.short_description: Delve dungeons, craft items and build relationships as you work to recover your memory. Bher is a town under siege, and you are an amnesiac with nothing to your name. Search dark woods and caves for resources and craft powerful weapons to delve into infested mines, forgotten swamps, and worse.

details.title: Anubria
details.short_description: Exploration. Silence. Echoes. Wander a shifting pyramid where rooms change and reality bends. No monsters, just atmosphere, isolation, and subtle unease. Uncanny, immersive, and unsettling. Solve light environmental puzzles across 8 levels. Experience the pyramid alone - empty, yet somehow present.

details.title: Torched
details.short_description: Lost and alone, a light kindles in the darkness. Brandish the torch, save the others, find the way out. Journey through an ancient gauntlet and meet those who tread it before you. Hand crafted, solo developed, a labor of love.

details.title: Survive: The Alien Tracing
