details.short_description: A survival game where you uncover the mystery of the alien civilization "The Fallen of Elun". Navigate a dark world, solve complex puzzles, face hostile creatures, and use many weapons to survive while searching for the truth behind your missing son.

details.title: FireQuest
details.short_description: Ignite your destiny in a blazing 2D pixel platformer where every jump, dash, and strike keeps the flame alive.

details.title: Rot Together
details.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for up to four players set in a medieval world. Explore a module map and fight a mysterious cult. Brew potions, kill monsters, chat with your friends. Survival is not guaranteed!

details.title: Their Sky
details.short_description: Their Sky is an idle deck-builder. Select cards and strategies as you build decks that can win on their own. Rather than managing moves, Their Sky all in on deck building: turn your favorite cards into self-running engines.

details.title: Tim & Harpy
details.short_description: Tim & Harpy is a revival of the classic retro 3D platforming collectathon adventures. Explore rich, unique worlds, gather many different items, and help the duo save the planet while meeting new friends along the way.

details.title: Plate And Profit
details.short_description: Can you make rent with a spicy bowl of lettuce and ketchup? Run a chaotic kitchen in this Cooking Roguelite! Manage ingredients, build your synergies and strategies with spices and decor, and serve customers before their patience runs out.

details.title: ZLEEPI
details.short_description: ZLEEPI is an exciting hyper-speedy 2D platformer, where you play as a cute alien escaping Area 51! Use your PVC pipe to bounce off of walls, floors, and ceilings to get to the exit as quickly as possible! All while eating pipin' hot pizza slices on your way!

details.title: Findosaurs
details.short_description: Casual hidden creature game featuring dinosaurs and other prehistoric life illustrated in a lumpy potato fashion living in ecosystems. Lesser known dinosaurs, non-dinosaur archosaurs, synapsids, temnospondyls are represented alongside the charismatic mega fauna.

details.title: LED Bringer
details.short_description: The sun has gone out, and darkness has consumed the planet. You ended up here by accident, but now you must become a glimmer of hope. Even if it's just… an LED. Take control of a combat drone, expand your base, navigate the darkness, and uncover the secrets of a dying world.

name: 西游肉鸽：杨戬的100种死法

details.title: 西游肉鸽：杨戬的100种死法
details.short_description: "Roguelike Journey to the West: 100 Ways to Slay Erlang Shen" is a 3D light-strategy roguelike that blends shooting, action, and tower defense into fast-paced gameplay. Gameplay:Auto-attack while equipping any 6 weapons—survive 20 waves, defeat all final bosses to win!

details.title: Friendship Simulator
details.short_description: Experience old school couch split-screen gaming as if you had friends.

details.title: The 7th Shift
details.short_description: Work the overnight shift alone at Founder's Choice Market. Inspect shipments, decide what’s accepted or denied, and stock the shelves. But be careful, your performance is being evaluated, and it determines your fate. Escape after seven shifts or be forced to join the staff that never clocks out

details.title: Breadieval
details.short_description: Create unique baked goods by combining ingredients you find at the market. Befriend the puppet villagers by baking their favourite recipes or by combining tasty flavours. Have fun, you don't have to follow a recipe here.

details.title: Revery Effect
details.short_description: Revery Effect is a 2D side-scrolling sandbox game. Players survive in a fantastical world and are free to destroy and build anything they can imagine.

details.title: Freedom Inside
details.short_description: You've found yourself in a madman's game. Solve his intricate puzzles and escape his nightmarish lair before you become his next victim. Every second counts.

details.title: Non Eternals
details.short_description: A single-player command action RPG with MMORPG-style combat. Features a quirky system where placing skill commands next to the UI boosts their power! Rescue the creators from the Dark Lord, who manifests their inner darkness as monsters!

details.title: SteamPanic: Last Shift
details.short_description: In this game, you'll take on the role of an engineer repairing machinery in a steampunk factory. You must keep an eye on the latest "marvels of technology"—they break down constantly, and the management isn't too happy about that.

details.title: Pattern Ring
details.short_description: A roguelike alignment deck builder. Where you align your runes to cast spells to defeat enemies. Build your deck and craft your spells to meet the challenges ahead. Feed and grow your companion to aid in battle. Before it's too late, journey to the center of the maze and restore the Pattern Ring.

details.title: The Bestest Alchemist
details.short_description: Solve puzzles and brew potions in The Bestest Alchemist, a strategic puzzle roguelike! Freely arrange ingredients to create magical combinations, discover 100+ new recipes, and upgrade your collection to build powerful synergies. Your journey to becoming a master alchemist starts now!

details.title: Aetherion
details.short_description: Aetherion is a 2D action-adventure with exploration, combat and terraforming. Travel through five connected realms as Spark and reshape their landscapes. Your actions affect the Essence Light that holds the world together: where it fades, decay spreads.

details.title: Kitty Haven
details.short_description: FInd the perfect spot for picky little furballs: whether they’re greedy, have sensitive noses, or keep getting into stubborn cat fights, arrange the space to bring back peace. Create your own haven by unlocking items and new residents. Solve puzzles and decorate the ideal sanctuary for your kittens!

details.title: When Voices Died
details.short_description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

details.title: Card Cricket Quest
details.short_description: Card Cricket Quest is a single-player roguelite deck-builder that combines deep card-matching gameplay with the ball smashing action of cricket! Complement your deck with outrageous special cards, wield powerful willows, and collect obscure trinkets to become a cricket legend. One RUN at a time.

details.title: Chrono Seoul
details.short_description: Chrono Seoul’s unique Time Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.

details.title: Mt. Quack Legend
details.short_description: A single player 2D anime rogue-lite RPG. Join a new born duck girl's adventure in a aggressively cute world. Beat up cute wild creatures and level up to different bird classes as you explore this place.

details.title: Deep Hunger
details.short_description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

details.title: WishBreaker
details.short_description: A genre-fusion ARPG. Every class plays differently, Warrior plays as Hack n' Slash, Rogue as Stealth rougelike, Cleric is decision based, Druids play creature collecting/farming, Wizards are puzzles, secrets, and code casting and many more! PVE and PVP including Bullet Hell and Soulslike areas!

details.title: GambaSim
details.short_description: Build and expand your own casino in a high-stakes gambling and manager simulator. Play classic casino games, beat rival casinos with unique playstyles, and climb through increasingly dangerous tiers where every bet can make, or break, your future.

details.title: Pizza Agent
details.short_description: Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

details.title: Shadow Hills Manor
details.short_description: Shadow Hills Manor is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and looting. Break into the manor left behind by greed and decay. Search for valuables, but the more you take, the angrier the manor becomes. Your choice of greed shapes how the manor reacts.

details.title: Reign & Shuffle
details.short_description: As an emperor, rule your dynasty and handle state affairs year by year. Each decision you make will shape its destiny. Will every choice today alter your dynasty's future trajectory? Classic roguelike card gameplay collides with real historical events—what sparks will fly?

details.title: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!
details.short_description: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok! It's a co-op game about a band of funny Vikings who must raid villages across all nine realms to pay off their debt to Hel and carve their path to Valhalla! Grab the treasure and carry it to the ship! Fight off the weak, hide from the strong, and do it all for the loot!

details.title: TILLY'S ROLL
details.short_description: A turn-based creature dice battler where every roll counts! Capture creatures, collect dice, and battle with strategy and luck to win THE CROWN JEWELS TOURNAMENT!

details.title: Spectral Report
details.short_description: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.

details.title: 红夏
details.short_description: 《红夏》是一款以剧情体验为主的视觉小说游戏。八月末的某天，二十多名师生被神秘地困在学校里，等待他们的将是一场自相残杀……

details.title: Architect Fray
details.short_description: A dramatic Deckbuilding RPG featuring artwork by Satoshi Matsuura. Carry only a few cards into the dungeon. Master preparation, time your Parries, and dive into a story where every skill holds a memory. A massive scenario awaits in this fusion of strategy and narrative.

details.title: Dungeon Treaders
details.short_description: A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

details.title: NORMA: Story of One Platform
details.short_description: Explore the secrets of this world and discover what the local government, working alongside powerful corporations, has planned in its pursuit of complete control over the population.

details.title: Conveyor Crew
details.short_description: A 1970s analog horror where you descend into a dark 3D warehouse to scavenge parts for your conveyor puzzles while something stalks you in the shadows. Think harder to survive less, or survive more to think less. At Ironside, your survival is just a bonus.

details.title: Mind's Edge
details.short_description: Leia's 12th birthday turned into a nightmare when masked, unidentified individuals kidnapped her. Following the traces, Vincent and his childhood friend Antonio arrive at an abandoned mansion, where they run across something they never expected.

details.title: Another Shoplifting Simulator
details.short_description: Pocket snacks. Dodge guards. Profit. Sneak your way through the store as the shoplifter to make enough money, with the goal doubling daily in this casual FPS simulator!

details.title: Recycling Shift
details.short_description: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

details.title: Misdecayed
details.short_description: An adventure RPG about life, death, rebirth, and robots, from the team that brought you vivid/stasis.

details.title: Gnome Glen
details.short_description: Gnome Glen is a relaxing survival colony sim / city builder that blends cozy charm with satisfying depth. Gather resources, build homes, farm crops, research techs and watch your gnome village come to life.

details.title: Insanity Path
details.short_description: A plague spreads alongside a spree of sudden disappearances... You don't need more to get on with your adventure. Step into the world of an Auto-battler/Roguelite, where each of your mistakes will send you further down the path of Insanity. Will you be able to free the forest from this tragic curse?

details.title: Tafl Throne Breakers
details.short_description: Play like a Viking in this cunning game of strategy - help your Jarl escape the battlefield or capture them before they do. Endlessly enjoyable with multiple variations, AI and online opponents and regular events to determine who is the grand master of Tafl!

details.title: Hardcourt Balls
details.short_description: Hardcourt Balls is a fast-paced, turn-based adaptation of the real-world game of tennis. With just a few simple rules, the roll of dice, and tactical use of skill "cards", it manages to capture some of the nuances and excitement that make tennis such a great sport.

details.title: Blood Court
details.short_description: Blood Court is a Souls-like action RPG within a dark fantasy, horrifying world. Explore PSX styled Environments, battle blood hungry monsters, and piece together a story told through environments, and voiceless cinamatics.

details.title: Praxium
details.short_description: Praxium is a 2D precision platformer that blends fast-paced movement with strategic deckbuilding. Gain movement abilities, transform scoring rules, and even modify levels themselves to achieve the highest score possible while running, jumping, and sliding across 100 levels of pure platforming fun!

details.title: Mascot Mayhem (Asymmetrical Horror)
details.short_description: Asymmetrical Mascot Horror survival game where two mascots must team up to kill ALL the survivors. Featuring crossover characters from all across the mascot horror universe (and beyond!)

details.title: Black Mountain of Tlaltecuhtli
details.short_description: Third-person supernatural action-adventure in a living Aztec mountain. Climb collapsing ruins, shift dimensions to fight reality-warped enemies, and navigate Loop Zones where environments reset. The deeper you go, the closer you come to what the Aztecs sealed away.

details.title: Loafing Dungeon
details.short_description: Loafing Dungeon is a fully automatic desktop idle game. Build your hero team on the desktop, equip them with gear and skills, and then launch the adventure on auto-pilot. The game runs continuously in the background, ensuring your progression and rewards are always fight, whether you're busy or free

details.title: Bird Roll 64
details.short_description: This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world. Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

details.title: NO PAROLE
details.short_description: Up to 16 players, one prison, friendly fire on. Raid a city where the dead get back up unless you burn them, haul the loot home and hold the walls when the government comes to bury the evidence. Then it sets the city on fire. Your crew dies for good. You don't. You just don't know why yet.

details.title: 4Born
details.short_description: A tactical roguelite RPG where every run forces you to adapt. Explore procedural dungeons under fog of war. Learn spells, gain items and forge each of your four heroes into one of many powerful classes. Build your team with what you get and break the game.

details.title: BELOW
details.short_description: BELOW is a co-op horror game about scavenging and cleaning trashed, abandoned deep sea outposts and research sites to repay your debt to a shady corporation!

details.title: Zombie Industrial Complex
details.short_description: Exterminate zombies using the might of the military industrial complex. In this active incremental game, you'll earn money by defeating zombies which can be used to buy weapons, purchase upgrades, call in airstrikes, and send in the tanks!

details.title: Ashenburrow
details.short_description: An underground survival and simulation game. Wildlife hunts, NPCs make camp, talk and fight… with or without you. Lead your expedition, alone or with up to four players, and remember: even underground, night falls.

details.title: Legendary Creatures 3
details.short_description: Return to the core auto-battler experience: pure recruiting and economy, faster-paced combat. Evolve both heroes and gear, with a legendary evolution for every path—then forge your own build through skills, equipment, and emblems.

details.title: Orb Orb Magi
details.short_description: Orb Orb Magi is an arcade Pinball Bulletheaven inspired by action roguelites and early Pinball videogames. Play Pinball like a Magical Girl with lots of different weapons and upgrades.

details.title: Murderplanet
details.short_description: Fight to the death in the arena-based action game show, Murderplanet. Make a loadout of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.

details.title: The Orphaned House
details.short_description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

details.title: Blind Spin
details.short_description: A 1-4 player fusion of Roulette and Poker. Bet on a rigged wheel with hidden odds and bluff your opponents to steal the pot. Use items to cheat and sabotage your rivals. Who will end up the richest?

details.title: Keyboard Smash
details.short_description: Run a shop. Help weird customers. And definitely make everything worse!

details.title: Dream Travel
details.short_description: 来一场在现实与梦境中的探索与冒险吧！平淡的暑期宅家生活、奇幻的野外回合战斗、惊险的图形机关解谜、生死攸关的鱼儿推理和毛毛虫的房间逃脱……丰富的剧情和玩法等着你来体验！

details.title: Island Of Ash
details.short_description: A 3rd-person action-adventure inspired by cult classics. Explore a unique, solo-developed world and vanquish foes in intense battles. Level up your hero and reveal the secrets of a civilization that crumbled into dust five centuries ago.

details.title: Dice and Daydream
details.short_description: Roll five dice, use limited rerolls to shape the result, and play cards powered by your dice total. Combos like pairs and straights trigger bonus effects. Build your deck in a childhood-daydream roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Necroblobicon
details.short_description: Necroblobicon is a roguelike where your enemies become your army. Raise the dead, gear them up, and arrange them around positional relics on a 5x5 formation. In battle, you pick who dies first and who gets back up on your side.

details.title: Herd
details.short_description: Build your set, outplay your rival, and win the Mélodus in a cute musical card battler where every match becomes a live performance.

details.title: Peak or Die
details.short_description: Peak or Die is a narrative-driven survival game about leading a team of adventurers up a deadly mountain, where every decision has lasting consequences. Manage oxygen, food, and team morale while facing moral dilemmas, random events, and an unforgiving environment. Reach the summit — or fail trying.

details.title: The Duke is Dead
details.short_description: Duke Damian has been murdered! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and deduce the killer. Follow a growing trail of crimes and unravel the conspiracy tying them all together.

details.title: Confined Space
details.short_description: Pilot a customizable spaceship, battle through procedurally generated arenas, and adapt your build with modular abilities to survive escalating enemy waves in this fast-paced 2D top-down roguelike shoot ’em up

details.title: Vocal Horror Stories - Gaja
details.short_description: The first episode of a voice-sensitive episodic horror game, in which you play as Shivani, a young woman battling with phonophobia. Why did her mother go missing? Who is the elephant-headed entity she keeps seeing? Can you speak to him?

details.title: SinsKiller
details.short_description: SinsKiller is an isometric action arcade shooter set in a Dante-inspired Hell. Play as a fallen battle-mage wielding arcane power to obliterate demonic hordes and face brutal bosses. Face your sins. Kill them. Earn your redemption.

details.title: Dead 4 Now: Extraction
details.short_description: Survive the outbreak or become it in a PvPvE FPS extraction shooter. Scavenge loot, use experimental stims, and fight to extract as a survivor. Or enter a raid as a zombie, hunt other players, and evolve into a monstrous boss.

details.title: Alien Colony
details.short_description: Lead a squad of four cloned marines through an infected mining colony where every death creates a new soldier, but slowly destroys what remains of your humanity.

details.title: Auto Arcana
details.short_description: Devise the ultimate spell rotation and watch it obliterate your foes in this roguelike auto-battler. Seek forbidden knowledge to craft overpowered spells, assemble devastating combos, and break the game.

details.title: QSO7
details.short_description: A space RPG with an insanely rich story line filled with mind-bending puzzles, deep philosophical conversations and gorgeous alien species. If you are the first person to unlock the game 100% you will gain access to a hidden cash prize.

details.title: Multi Class Quest
details.short_description: Traverse a forgotten fantasy world in this classic Beat Em Up hack and slash! Fight through hordes of unique monsters as one of five different classes...then, mix the skills you learned into another class to create your unique fighter!

details.title: Bread and Iron
details.short_description: A brutal medieval survival sandbox blending crafting, base building, and combat as players struggle against harsh environments and dangerous creatures.

details.title: Helenland
details.short_description: Helen finds a mysterious video game on her doorstep and starts playing it. But as she progresses, strange events begin to happen around her...

details.title: Wisword: The Calamitous Starfall
details.short_description: A classic dungeon-crawling RPG set in the fantasy world of Eutolant. Create your own party and face deadly traps and monsters in the depths of labyrinthine dungeons. When it's all over, will your name be written into legend — or onto a headstone?

details.title: Siren's Wrath
details.short_description: A point-and-click adventure where you are trapped in a psychological loop, relive a tragic event, and return the cursed artifacts to escape the loop, before the curse claims you. But remember, she is watching.

details.title: Boing Boing Animals
details.short_description: Raise Tamagotchi-style pixel animal friends right on your desktop! Care for slimes from outer space and help them grow into bouncy 'Boing Boing' Earth animals. Feed and play with your adorable friends while completing the Codex! Your tiny companions will always be by your side.

details.title: The Other Order
details.short_description: A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

details.title: Gag Order
details.short_description: The Research laboratory's Guardian Unit faced with a hellish mission to exterminate invincible cephalopod creatures in this one-of-a-kind immersive co-operative Horror FPS.

details.title: Survive The Oasis
details.short_description: Survive The Oasis is a co-op open-world action RPG with survival elements, focused on exploration, combat, character progression, and a journey toward enlightenment.

details.title: Kalamor
details.short_description: Kalamor is an action roguelike with strong Souls-like influences. During a run, you'll explore dark dungeons, face challenging enemies, and discover chests with random upgrades. Outside of a run, you can spend the experience you've earned to improve your character or unlock new weapons.

details.title: Decimate Drive 2
details.short_description: Fight back or escape an all-American mountain town where every vehicle is a ruthless killing machine. Supercars charge at breakneck speed, unmarked vans lurk in the shadows and heavy-duty trucks stop at nothing to hunt you down. Run like hell in this dark, terrifyingly fast-paced indie horror game.

details.title: X Killerz
details.short_description: A fast, bloody Y2K arena war built from three connected game types: hovercraft racing, close-quarters FPS, and a fortress-assault MOBA that run back to back in a single match. Nine stages at launch. Kills are both your score and your currency. LAN, online, or bots.

details.title: Palette Panic
details.short_description: A billiards defense game where you hit approaching enemies with balls of matching color. Mix and split colors to make the one you need, bank shots off the walls, and stop the enemies before they cross the board. Test your skills in over 100 levels.

details.title: Nyancrement
details.short_description: Clicker × Idle × Cat Story — an incremental game. Nyancrement follows a cat lost in the Between as it collects 10 billion Coins to return home. You click to charge the Wish Orb and level up Relics, helping the cat collect even more Coins.

details.title: DREAMSTAURANT
details.short_description: DREAMSTAURANT is a singleplayer game made in a charming low-poly style in which you start and manage your own dream restaurant! Build your own company by your own rules! Create your own custom dishes, design your own restaurant, master time managment and of course, satisfy your hungry customers!

details.title: YOGRAK
details.short_description: The world was ending, until Yograk's nap did. Play YOGRAK, LICH SUPREME. Battle endless hordes of demons, trolls, and piranha-mancers. Unlock 9 characters, armaments, doctrines, relics, and demonic candies. Freeze time. Unfold the FRACTAL DOMAIN. Your disciples are waiting.

name: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister

details.title: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister
details.short_description: Late Tang turmoil unleashes ghosts and fiends, turning the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun into a haunted wasteland. Play as a general’s second son, journeying south with your ghost elder sister and fox-spirit younger sister for the fabled paradise. Will you find it?

details.title: Rio Beachside
details.short_description: Team up with your friends to run a beach tent in Rio de Janeiro! Take orders, prepare food, manage supplies, help beachgoers, and deal with unexpected challenges as you grow your business and keep the beach thriving.

details.title: Cases from the Murder Wagon
details.short_description: Take control of the Murder Wagon investigation team and cooperate to solve the world’s strangest cases in this asymmetrical co-op horror game.

details.title: Infernal West
details.short_description: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

details.title: Just get the flag
details.short_description: In this puzzle game, you are RED, a little red square whose purpose is only to reach the flag. But be careful… it moves in the opposite direction of you. Will you manage to take the right path to finally capture that stupid flag?

details.title: Cargo Thieves
details.short_description: In this co-op multiplayer game, you run an ordinary supermarket, but instead of honestly ordering products for sale, you steal them from the docks while disguised as dockworkers. Use crowbars, lockpicks and trucks. Expand your store, outsmart the cops, steal & sell anything from food to supercars.

details.title: Voxel Dynasties
details.short_description: Lead a civilization from the first stone tool to the atomic bomb in one match. A voxel RTS where every block can break, fortresses fall block by block, and you can jump into any unit in third person mid-battle. Free demo with multiplayer out now. Solo-developed.

details.title: STAREDOWN
details.short_description: A stealth roguelite where a giant eye learns how you play. Gather essence to open the hatch, evade its watchtowers and scouts, and descend to the next floor. Change your habits as OKO changes the hunt. Every run, a new eye.

details.title: Triple Dice Monsters
details.short_description: Dice × Monster Raising × Party Building! Raise monsters through a board game-style adventure, then make them even stronger with the Inheritance System. A turn-based RPG where dice and strategy decide every battle. Challenge unique bosses!

details.title: Candleborne
details.short_description: Climb a tower consumed by darkness in this top-down action roguelite. Grow your flame, choose upgrades with dangerous tradeoffs, stay within the candlelight, and defeat each floor’s guardian to continue your ascent.

details.title: DiceBound
details.short_description: DiceBound is a dark fantasy dice-building roguelike where you roll dice, bind soul, and forge your run to create powerful combinations, overcome enemy-imposed rules, and survive a branching path of Trials.

details.title: Winner Takes Tea
details.short_description: Summon familiars with cards, seize lands, and repaint the board. Witches duel for the victor's cup of tea in a board game × card battler. All 180+ cards unlocked from the start. Build decks and play online with 2–4 players or against BOTs. No microtransactions, ever.

details.title: ADA
details.short_description: ADA is a psychedelic platformer featuring an intriguing story, challenging gameplay, and unique mini-games set in a surreal dreamlike world. Explore mysterious environments, meet strange characters, make new friends, and uncover the secrets hidden within ADA's colorful and unpredictable universe.

name: 烟雨山异闻 - The Mystery of Misty Mount

details.title: 烟雨山异闻 - The Mystery of Misty Mount
details.short_description: The Mystery of Misty Mount is a 2D mystery puzzle-adventure game. In order to save his father who has turned into a parrot, players take on the role of Wang Di and go into Misty Mount to uncover the truth of an accident that occurred fifteen years ago.

details.title: Keepguard
details.short_description: Keepguard is a medieval tower-defense roguelite where the map is your build. Expand and defend your kingdom: bind towers to powerful rites, uncover unusual relics and create game-breaking synergies to keep back the endless hordes.

details.title: Recursive Nightmare
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you can't fight back. Hide, run and listen as creatures hunt you through flooded, dreamlike nightmares that never let you catch your breath. Someone is turning your fear into power.

details.title: My Hardware Store
details.short_description: Build your own hardware store – solo or in multiplayer with up to 8 players! Order over 50 products, set prices, hire employees and expand your shop in a huge open world. Over 100 hours of content – from a small shop to a tech empire!

details.title: Hive and Harvest
details.short_description: Death is dying, and five hives are fighting over the rot that's left. A trading card game about insects you grow from parts, a card at a time. Plant a parasite in an enemy creature, seed it with spores until it changes sides, or just break it and race your opponent to the pieces.

details.title: Doughn't Panic!
details.short_description: A co-op adventure where 2 players share the controls of a single pizza, bound by a spell neither asked for. Explore a world never built for your size.

details.title: Evac
details.short_description: Co-op marines vs. the alien hive. Fight through infested outposts where the layout shifts every round, call the dropship and get out. Every marine who dies rises as one of them. 1–16 players, with AI filling any empty slot.

details.title: Video Gamer Legacy
details.short_description: Run a shop that buys, restores, and sells old games. Money isn't the score. Influence is, and you only earn it two ways: preserving games, and treating people well. Spend it to save the companies that really went under, and put the consoles they never got to make on your shelves.

details.title: Dustlings: The Hidden Wilds
details.short_description: You stumble into a mysterious, uninhabited wilderness—but you're not alone. The little beings that glow at night will be your closest companions. Bond with extraordinary plants and animals, build a home together, explore the wilds, and follow scattered diary pages to uncover the truth.

details.title: Scavenger Survivors
details.short_description: In this 1-4 player top-down roguelite/survivors hybrid, the machines already won. Now, you scavenge! Play as fat scavengers hauling loot from the ruins of the world. Grab and throw anything that isn't bolted down, cram it into your armored RIG, and survive the robot swarm until extraction.

details.title: Ogre Stampede
details.short_description: Ogre Stampede is a physics-based bullet heaven with incremental upgrades set in a chaotic mosh pit. Waves of hopelessly stupid trolls and ogres are running wild and pushing and shoving each other around. Level up your strength and fight to be the last one standing and become the new chieftain!

details.title: ACT OUT
details.short_description: A chaotic online party game of 3D charades. Grab a floppy puppet, act out your secret word on a live theater stage, and race your friends to guess it before the clock runs out. Push-to-talk voice, custom Workshop maps, and a winner's podium. Best with 3+ friends.

details.title: Ship Happens: Pirates Wanted
details.short_description: A co-op game for 1–4 players where you and your friends dream of becoming fearsome pirates, but for now you're sailing in a leaky tub you call a ship. Patch holes, put out fires, raid weaker ships, flee from stronger ones, and upgrade your vessel. Work together, because at sea... Ship Happens!

details.title: Documancy
details.short_description: An incremental management game where you use magical documents to empower an auto-battling warrior. Every victory unlocks a new document, introducing a new way to improve your warrior. What will the next one do?

details.title: Cat Stack
details.short_description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

details.title: Cyberlink Chaos
details.short_description: Cyberlink Chaos is a fast paced online multiplayer arena-slasher. Jack into your PMNCU and fight in the cybernetic forever war. Encased in metal, your soul is reborn - will you fight?

details.title: Urban Green
details.short_description: A romantic visual novel about love, life and loserdom. Take the role of Jack, a young man starting a new job at an environmental charity in search of a jumpstart to his stalled life. What he'll find, be it love, heartbreak, or just more of the same, is up to you.

details.title: DATUM: Rescue One
details.short_description: A single-player helicopter search and rescue game. Fly through storms and darkness, locate survivors with FLIR, confirm with your searchlight, and bring them home. No weapons. Only the sea, the night, and time.

details.title: Alice in BLUE
details.short_description: Alice in Blue is a deckbuilding roguelike strategy game featuring tactical roulette combat. Slot cards onto a spinning wheel, adjust their positions, and unleash powerful card synergies to overcome the dangers of a bizarre dream world.

details.title: Freeze, Dummy!
details.short_description: Freeze time, hang your bullets and grenades across a frozen world, shove enemies into each other's crossfire, then let time run and survive the chaos. A physics-driven FPS sandbox about directing explosions: chain reactions, style scoring, replays.

details.title: CAPTIVE LOVE♡MELTY HOLIC
details.short_description: Ruito, a popular underground idol, is suddenly kidnapped and confined in an unfamiliar abandoned building. Blocked by tricky traps and relentlessly pursued by obsessive stans—can Ruito safely escape this building of madness...?

details.title: Anomaly Logistics
details.short_description: Entities, objects, and domains that defy the laws of physics to wield powers beyond human comprehension—these are collectively known as "Anomalies." Suppress these myriad Anomalies, strip them of their power, and harness it to descend into the deepest abyss. What truth lies waiting at the very end?

details.title: Coin to Crown
details.short_description: Build your adventuring career in a fantasy tactical RPG for 1–4 players. Take guild contracts, travel between towns, and master turn-based battles with timed blocks and dodges. Discover traits through your deeds, upgrade your gear, and rise through the ranks.

details.title: Observation Protocol: The Observed
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you wake, again and again, inside a facility that studies you. Each cycle the rooms change, the pattern deepens, and something begins to take shape. The longer you observe, the harder it becomes to tell where the simulation ends.

details.title: Virus Promoter
details.short_description: Welcome aboard, Virus Promoter! One card sparks a chain reaction. One Trinket bends the rules. One combo sends the numbers spiraling out of control! Build your outrageous deck and spread your viruses on an unprecedented scale! Your success is the world's catastrophe!

details.title: Last Drop Tavern
details.short_description: A psychological roguelite gambling game set in an oil-painted bar between this life and the next. You and a rival take turns dropping coins into a single glass; whoever makes it overflow loses their chance at the afterlife. No interface, no numbers, just the rising liquid and the coin in your hand.

details.title: FatCat Nexus
details.short_description: A challenging 2D action platformer featuring unique weapons, precise gameplay, and intense combat. Master your arsenal and defeat dangerous enemies in a world full of challenges.

details.title: Pnevmo-Capsula: Dieselnautica
details.short_description: Navigate a mail capsule to deliver a crucial letter to the Captain across a flying scrap-city. Collect lamps: the toll for passing Checkpoints - solve physics puzzles, dodge traps and fines. If you don’t have enough lamps, the hammers will crush you. A grim puzzle-platformer where every lamp counts.

details.title: Midwatch Engineer
details.short_description: You are a ship engineer, keep watch at night, build and repair stuff on a lathe and a milling machine by day. In this Game you will machine parts from raw metal instead of just combining items to craft. You directly control the axis of the lathe.

details.title: The Hanging Game
details.short_description: Hangman on paper is over. Here, you are in the noose. Explore a malevolent graveyard for letters while an eerie, deceptive voice whispers in your ear—learning from your mistakes and actively lying to you. Can you solve the word before the rope snaps?

details.title: Scarlet Hunt
details.short_description: Dive into a world of fleeting hope in this thrilling dark romance visual novel! Feel the fear, survive the hunt and navigate through danger on a daunting quest for freedom.

details.title: Ecosystem Architect
details.short_description: What happens when an elephant shares its habitat with a Spinosaurus? Design ecosystems with nearly 50 species of plants and animals, shape the land, and balance predators and prey in a science-inspired simulation where every creature lives, hunts, and raises a family of its own.

details.title: Aspiel: Edge Of Chaos
details.short_description: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

details.title: Salary-Mon | Hiro Versus His Demons
details.short_description: Help Japanese Salaryman Hiro overcome his inner demons by facing his fears head on, battling his worst traits, and becoming more powerful with each victory to ultimately take down his oppressive boss in this Poke-like JRPG adventure.

details.title: Surface Labyrinth KURUMABU
details.short_description: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

details.title: Twinspell
details.short_description: Twinspell is a cooperative roguelike where two players explore procedural dungeons and face enemies in fast-paced, frenetic combat.

details.title: Sato
details.short_description: Manipulate space and time in this planetary puzzle-platformer. Learn the rules to unravel more of the world and the secrets within. Do you remember? 183 15.

details.title: Bulbo's Belief System
details.short_description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

details.title: Heretic Red
details.short_description: In this story-rich detective game, uncover clues through a card-like system to solve a series of bizarre murders. Combine pieces of evidence to build your case against the most likely culprit from within an eclectic cast of unusual characters.

details.title: Fate's Masquerade: Otome Visual Novel
details.short_description: In this animated, manhwa-inspired otome, romance the princes you were meant to hate. First, earn their affection and try not to die. Then save the empire, or burn it to the ground. Fairytale romance or villainess revenge? You decide.

details.title: Yuki-Tundra
details.short_description: Build your store empire, help the local community and keep the shelves stocked in a bid to boost your stores reputation while you rise from the ashes. Yuki-Tundra blends the casual store management genre with classic RPG adventures.

details.title: Goblin God
details.short_description: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

details.title: Shadow of Backrooms
details.short_description: Shadow of Backrooms is a co-op horror game set in endless liminal rooms. Explore the Backrooms with up to 4 friends, solve puzzles and escape the entities before they catch you. But be warned: you are not alone.

details.title: Skippy's Grand Escape
details.short_description: Escape increasingly complex mazes as fast as possible. Select skills tactically for each level. Optimize your path. Watch out for enemies, traps, anomalies and more in this space themed top down maze runner.

details.title: Particles of Reality: Remembrance
details.short_description: Congrats! You've landed a dream job as a paranormal scientist with the government! Downside? Outside contact is limited and monitored. You learn it is 'who' (not 'what') you are researching, and... you're the reason these supernatural beings are here? Ignore the lurking Guardians of Reality...

details.title: Lull: Rest After Crying
details.short_description: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

details.title: Wandering Within
details.short_description: Wandering Within is a 2d solo survival game where you have to cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest. Gather resources, find water and build tools to increase your chance of survival

details.title: Sonic Valkyria: KANON
details.short_description: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

details.title: Eight Bells
details.short_description: A pixel-art naval roguelike in the spirit of FTL. Command a Navy warship room by room, crew it with humans, merfolk and stranger things, and hunt pirate captains in real-time-with-pause broadsides on a sea where 10+ monsters lurk. Keep your crew alive. Keep the sea outside.

details.title: Pact Warden
details.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

details.title: Trick-Taking Rogue
details.short_description: Trick-Taking × Roguelike! Trick-taking games fused with roguelike elements like skills and shops! Features 9 trick-taking games including Spades, Oh Hell, and Schnapsen!

details.title: Pawcision
details.short_description: Pawcision is a 2D retro-style LITERAL Precision Platformer with an Interactive Music System. Play as a cat with one goal: climb as high as you can. Like a cat, every jump you make must be PRECISELY calculated. Customize your look and conquer challenging obstacles with pixel-perfect reflexes.

details.title: Frost Protocol
details.short_description: Fight your way through turn-based expeditions across Terminus. Restore abandoned mining outposts, extract Veyrite under mounting Nadir pressure, and fight your way back to extraction. At base, manage survivors, scarce resources, damaged robots, and your crew's mental strain.

details.title: Mahoshii Swap
details.short_description: Mahoshii Swap is a 2D platformer with retro roots and a unique twist. Play as Shiina and other characters, each with distinct abilities, and swap between them to conquer challenging levels. Classic in spirit, but powered by fresh mechanics that reinvent the genre.

details.title: Resolute Bay
details.short_description: Forelegs are better than two as you journey across mountains, thickets and plains in search of your lost herd. Master Fight, Flight and Freeze responses to fend off foes in snappy, turn-based battles of wits, then take in the scenery and have a good roll before trotting on.

details.title: We'll Always Have Callisto
details.short_description: Your senior class trip to Callisto has been doomed by time anomalies and untold apocalypse. Rewind the week, save your classmates, and fight back with real-time combat powered by collectible Galactic Baseball League cards. A pixel RPG about what it means to be a hero at the end of the world.

details.title: Abhay
details.short_description: A first-person, story-driven psychological horror game. Play as Abhay, a teenage boy searching for his missing sister in a cursed village. Face possessed villagers, uncover a sinister cult, and survive as his past and present spiral into darkness.

details.title: Software CEO
details.short_description: Build your own software empire from scratch. Manage projects, recruit staff, design components, and grow from a garage startup to a tech giant. Create SaaS platforms, sell software, or fulfill contracts. Balance quality, deadlines, and innovation in this relaxing yet deep business simulation game.

details.title: BioRogue
details.short_description: Grab a living cybernetic fish. Fire it. Mutate it. BioRogue is a 3D twin-stick roguelite bullet hell where 100+ mutagens let you splice together a build that's yours alone. Die, adapt, and go again, until the regime that built this island out of genetic exploitation finally falls.

details.title: Infinite Alliance
details.short_description: Heroes and villains from 17 Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, CrossCode, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

details.title: Parasensor
details.short_description: When Marisol accepts a job as a telecom technician, she finds herself in a quarantine zone where civilians are mutating into insects. Connect with strangers, confront grotesque creatures, and unravel a conspiracy at the heart of the metamorphosis.

details.title: FoldLoop
details.short_description: FoldLoop is a detective game that emphasizes logical reasoning. To escape the curse of endless cycles, you'll observe the sandbox from a higher dimension, analyze the rulebook, and deduce the secrets of the real world.

details.title: Regions
details.short_description: Build a living region, from the first street to a network of towns and cities. Shape the land, grow neighborhoods, plan public transport, and guide the economy. Follow residents through their daily lives in a deeply simulated city builder where every connection matters.

details.title: The Fish
details.short_description: Escape the corporation's laboratory and save the ocean poisoned by mutagen. Cleanse biomes, build and develop your base, use a variety of vehicles, communicate with civilizations through gestures and gifts, fight mutants, and explore the interactive world solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Pickle Panic
details.short_description: Steer the jar with your pickles inside. Roll through trap-filled courses! A 1–4 player physics-based co-op chaos: clear obstacles without shattering the jar, return to checkpoints, and try wild tactics with friends. Easy to learn, hard to master.

details.title: Greta Sees Ghosts!
details.short_description: Greta Sees Ghosts! is a lovingly crafted cozy adventure filled with quirky ghosts, witty dialogue, and clever shape-based puzzles. Explore remote islands, help the dead move on, and uncover Greta’s quietly touching story. One odd encounter at a time.

details.title: Rust Born
details.short_description: Rust Born is a neo noir top-down shooter about survival, loss of self, and a city devoured by corporations. You are Detective Gabriel, trapped in a twisted dystopian city where every shot could be your last, and every decision changes the world. Atmosphere, plot, survival.

details.title: Quill & Sword: Fate of Eryndor
details.short_description: A fantasy grand strategy game where you lead any realm you want, manage resources, forge alliances, and command armies across a hand-painted world. Plan, negotiate, and conquer to shape the balance of power in Quill & Sword: Fate of Eryndor.

details.title: Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated
details.short_description: Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?

details.title: Beyond the Doors
details.short_description: Explore an office building hiding a sinister lab underneath. Question reality as the world is warped and distorted around you. Every door leads to a new nightmare. What is real deep down in the recesses of your mind? Some demons cannot be defeated - you can only keep running.

details.title: Ishing
details.short_description: Ishing is a rogue-lite, top-down, action adventure. You'll sail through an ever-changing archipelago, slay sea monsters, and fish fish.

details.title: SCP: Rift Moles
details.short_description: Single-player and co-op survival horror game set in the SCP Universe. You are sent on a one-way mission into unstable parallel dimensions, armed only with a strange machine. Navigate unforgiving environments, evade hostile anomalies and survive for as long as you can while gathering resources.

details.title: Motocon
details.short_description: The premiere unmanned motorsport - MOTOCON. Take home the most cash with your robo-motorcycle by destroying the opposition with gadgets and brute force.

details.title: Fowl Legacy 2: Heavenbound
details.short_description: What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to... Heaven? Yeah, now he's mad. Travel across the weirdest places, leap gracefully over the abyss, discover mysterious and powerful secrets, and fight to escape this "heavenly" prison!

details.title: Gravity Goblins
details.short_description: A gravity-bending roguelite collectathon where you ascend an ever-shifting tower. Manipulate geometry to your whims, snag some coins, and play the night away at the local arcade! You'll need all the upgrades and trinkets you can gather to discover the secret buried at the top of The Old Stipe...

details.title: Lulu Dimensional Leaper
details.short_description: Warp through the stage at high speed, dodge attacks, close the distance in an instant, and overwhelm powerful foes in this easy-to-play, exhilarating 2D action game! Enjoy the cool action of a cute girl, along with plenty of meta, lighthearted conversations!

details.title: Duckbound
details.short_description: Welcome to Duckbound, a light-hearted turn-based RPG where mischief meets quackery.

details.title: Carmagist
details.short_description: Civilization vs. the Demon Lord?! Carmagist is a deck-building strategy game set in a ruined world where the Demon Lord has shattered civilization. Lead a nation on the brink of extinction and build up Tech, Funds, and Population to reclaim the future — every choice shapes your nation’s fate.

details.title: Wild Shapers
details.short_description: Weaken enemies with Runes, then consume their weaknesses with a Heavy Attack to unleash chain reactions. Develop your Runes and your hero’s signature abilities to change how you fight in this fast-paced hack-and-slash action roguelite.

details.title: Dungeons & Meows: Hero Cats
details.short_description: Find hidden cats in a medieval fantasy setting. Use heroic skills to rescue kittens in a charming hand-drawn hidden object game.

details.title: Fossil Quest
details.short_description: You have always dreamt of creating your own dinosaur museum and now you finally have the space to do it! Dig for fossils, assemble your exhibits and create the museum of your dreams in this relaxing, wholesome life sim.

details.title: ReThink | Evolved Free
details.short_description: ReThink | Evolved Free is a free first person puzzle game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve. The game features a somewhat toned down difficulty progression.

details.title: Summer Syndrome
details.short_description: "Summer Syndrome" is a sci-fi mystery visual novel set in the near future. Eerie plane crashes, shadowy organizations operating in the dark, and the increasingly prevalent "Summer Syndrome"... Players will experience a non-linear narrative through chapter-based choices and uncover the truth.

details.title: Quinquennial
details.short_description: An RPG adventure featuring real-time dungeon crawling, exploration, and turn-based tactics battles! Choose your character class. Fight, loot, level up, gain perks, improve stats and skills. All-original 3D voxel graphics, interactive environments, many different dungeon styles, crafting, and more.

details.title: Tale Of The Tape
details.short_description: Tale of the Tape is a visceral, high-impact boxing experience where every punch carries consequence.

details.title: Gift of the Primordials
details.short_description: A fantastical ecology puzzler. Balance soil nutrients by carefully arranging plants, and support a habitat for the local creatures! Uncover the mystery behind the crisis of the Kaanvell plateau!

details.title: STEEL PRINCESS
details.short_description: Explore an open field, hunt powerful enemies, unlock and evolve skills, and choose which bosses to face first in this Souls-like 3D action RPG.

details.title: Fragments of Self: Thoughts
details.short_description: My life has changed drastically: a new country, university, dormitory, work. Drowsiness and fatigue have become a habit, just like the silhouettes I’ve started seeing in my peripheral vision.

details.title: Alterfauna: A Weirdlife Park
details.short_description: Join Neli as she takes her first steps in the Alterfauna (super)natural preserve. Attract, tame, and photograph over 40 species of hand-painted creatures, fantastic monsters and ferocious beasts. Your new friends will accompany you as you discover a world full of magic.

details.title: 13 Germinal
details.short_description: A historical and narrative RPG set in the world of Emile Zola's novel. You are a young man in 1866, forced to work deep in the mines to survive. But every day, the work gets harder and the meals get smaller. Organize a strike, reignite the smoldering revolt, and try to change this unjust world.

details.title: Legless
details.short_description: A co-op game where you have no legs. Search different maps and clear trials to appease Gods and earn your freedom - all while a giant, quirky pair of legs hunts you down.

details.title: Purrfect Collars
details.short_description: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. As a witch, design collars, enchant them with potions, manage your shop and meet interesting new customers! Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!

details.title: Follow These Steps
details.short_description: In the mood for a bit of puzzle building? Put on relaxing tunes, open the box, and start putting together things out of colorful pieces — step-by-step instructions included!

details.title: Tiny Archer
details.short_description: Tiny Archer is a roguelike action adventure. Explore a shifting archipelago, grab wildly different treasures, and grow into something you didn't expect - every run is a new growth curve. Work your bow with wit, and you might shoot through the fog and survive.

details.title: Slime Vendor
details.short_description: Raise slimes. Sell them to dungeon lords. Feed them, clean them, pet them, learn which one hates the cold — then crate them up on delivery day. Catch rare slimes in the wilds, breed new ones, and get to know your strangest clients: the dungeon lords.

details.title: Escape the Exomoon
details.short_description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk survival horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

details.title: Dungeon Roller
details.short_description: Roll into action with your snowman warrior as you journey through dungeons filled with enemies, traps, and challenges. Each new chapter brings more danger—can you survive them all?

details.title: TANKLE
details.short_description: Tankle is an amazing action packed multiplayer or singleplayer top down shooter, you have to dodge bullets and defeat enemies to progress and grow stronger!

details.title: BUSINGO
details.short_description: BUSINGO is a first-person survival game for solo or co-op play in a dry, post-apocalyptic world. You travel in one bus, search for water and fuel, and customize the bus. Theft and violence affect your reputation with the factions along the road.

details.title: Word Hack
details.short_description: Word Hack is a roguelike deckbuilder where you hack your enemies by finding patterns in their names. Gain prestige, spend it, and trade programs to hack enemies and friends! All in a terminal user interface (TUI) style presentation.

details.title: Backpack Syndicate
details.short_description: Your backpack is your build. Explore first-person dungeons, take on enemies in this backpack auto-battler, and unlock new characters as your syndicate grows.

details.title: Editor Simulator
details.short_description: Go from a broke video editor to an industry icon working with top creators and making serious money. Land clients, improve your skills and upgrade your setup as you climb your way to the top of the industry.

details.title: Fat Justice
details.short_description: You are the newly appointed Judge in the Stone Age trying to keep a chaotic island from falling apart. Listen to bizarre testimonies while balancing absurd laws and deadly politics. Pass judgment, shape the island's fate, and uncover the truth behind your father's mysterious disappearance.

details.title: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
details.short_description: The world is flat. Everything is cardboard. Your soul is like a car made of paper parts. No thing can reach the end. Can you make it to the Garage of the Queen of Ice? Drive, scrap, and find your way through a universe made of paper and ink.

details.title: Rummy Attack
details.short_description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

details.title: Beyond Opening Day
details.short_description: A character-driven card management game about rebuilding a small shop in 30 turns. Choose cards, grow your money, reputation, and popularity, and aim for better outcomes together with a partner who reacts to your business decisions.

details.title: By Your Name
details.short_description: BY YOUR NAME is a nonlinear psychological thriller about exploring a cursed mansion, recovering other people’s memories, and uncovering the lives of those whose names nearly vanished along with their past. Explore the house. Return the names. And decide how this story should end.

details.title: Grumble Burger
details.short_description: Grumble Burger is a first-person cooking thriller where you take over your late Uncle Frank's food truck. Frank believed the bond between cook and customer was paramount. However, you'll soon discover that orders are handled differently here. And the customers are not your typical diner patrons...

details.title: Hero Investor: Business Tycoon
details.short_description: Build an investment firm, trade fictional markets, acquire income-producing property, and create your own ETFs as you grow from a small office into a financial empire in this player-paced management simulation.

details.title: Keyb Out
details.short_description: Keyb Out is a roguelite wave defense game about defending your PC from viruses and hackers by using your keyboard as a weapon.

details.title: TreeLine
details.short_description: Grow strange trees that don't exist in the wild, chop them down swing by swing, fill the morning truck, and pay off what you owe — one day at a time. A first-person orchard sim about honest work and heavy debt.

details.title: SoulForged:Ashborn
details.short_description: Seoul has fallen to the ARCHALIS. One year later, android girl ASH rises from the ashes. An anime-style hack-and-slash action RPG across Seoul's landmarks — five weapons, parry-driven soulslike boss duels, research-based levelless growth, and a 30-day countdown to reclaim the city.

details.title: LILITH
details.short_description: Every head is a world. LILITH is a folk-art puzzle-platformer set inside nesting dolls: climb into heads, hang characters on your tree to wear their skills, and descend through an İstanbul of graveyards, malls and rooftops, until you find the man in the shower.

details.title: The Sundered Anvil
details.short_description: A party of greenhorn adventurers acquires a contract to retrieve an anvil stolen from a remote village, only to discover the job is more than they bargained for.

details.title: Spur of Life
details.short_description: You’ve woken into a world that wants you slaughtered. No weapons. No combat. Escape the oppressive, liminal space that doesn't want you, as things that shouldn’t be there hunt you from the dark.

details.title: Soulstone
details.short_description: Be anyone, go anywhere, do anything. Live a new life in a fantasy world.

details.title: Crawlbound
details.short_description: Survive a grid-based roguelite by selecting game altering bugs to endure each level. Dodge traps, battle bosses, and draft upgrades to build your run. Spend your loot on permanent upgrades to push deeper into the dungeon.

details.title: Video Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own video game store in this first-person retail management simulator. Order new titles, unpack deliveries, stock shelves, set prices, serve customers at the register, and reinvest your profits to customize and expand your growing business.

details.title: ワカレタナビ
details.short_description: This is an action-adventure game where you navigate an unfinished title riddled with bugs, relying on guidance from a navigator. However, interacting with certain stage gimmicks apparently causes my personality to switch...

details.title: TALES UNFOLD
details.short_description: Explore different worlds, share clues, and change each other’s surroundings as you restore tangled tales. TALES UNFOLD is a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure inspired by Korean folklore.

details.title: War Mart
details.short_description: The apocalypse is here and the shelves are emptying fast. You and your friends must get that last toilet paper roll in this co-op mayhem. Steal carts, sabotage your rivals, and fight dirty to reach the checkout first. Get what you need by any means necessary.

details.title: Deadship Protocol
details.short_description: Co-op action for 1 to 4 players, online or on one screen. Fight through four areas of a dead ship full of monsters. Your guns fire on their own: you move, dash and use your skill. Pick an upgrade after every room and beat a boss in each area.

details.title: Looking for a Property?
details.short_description: Listen to your customers, find out what they really want, and search for the right property to recommend in this real estate simulation and story-driven adventure. Work alongside your boss, Hisui Odate, at a small neighborhood agency and help each customer find a place they can truly call home.

details.title: Cairnforge
details.short_description: A sandbox based fantasy survival game. Invent. Craft. Use. Flourish.

details.title: HIVEROT
details.short_description: HIVEROT is a hardcore round-based zombie FPS. Fight evolving hordes across 10 maps, build powerful loadouts, discover secrets, and stand your ground against a wide variety of enemy types that stumble, burn, break, and fly as you cut your way through them.

details.title: Pingorile 2
details.short_description: Pingorile is back! In this 2D platformer, explore new and bigger levels, overcome obstacles and discover new environments. Can you build a rocket and fly to the Moon?

details.title: Slasher Manager
details.short_description: Become the slasher in a darkly comic horror clicker set inside a killer’s hand-drawn notebook. Turn Screams into ridiculous upgrades, chain combos, and automate the hunt—then take on bosses that change the rules. Nine locations. One very questionable career.

details.title: Thirst Game
details.short_description: Good evening, viewers! Welcome to The Thirst Games! Tonight’s lucky contestants are you and your unlucky friends! Place your bets, run the gauntlet, trip each other up—and see who gets rich overnight and who ends up as roadkill.

details.title: Tactical Squad
details.short_description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player campaign, then settle the score in PvP.

details.title: Sudden Death Golf
details.short_description: Minigolf that ruins friendships! Ball-to-ball collisions, crazy powerups, chaotic game modes and a powerful map editor. Nobody said it would be a fair fight :)

details.title: Bonbaran!
details.short_description: Bonbaran! is a 2D action puzzle about using bombs and digging to make your own way. Place, stack, kick, ignite, and chain bombs, reshape terrain, and find your own solution. If an attempt fails, take control partway through the replay and try a different move.

details.title: Rush Hour of the Dead
details.short_description: A roguelite action game where ordinary people - firefighters, electricians, bank tellers - fight for survival against relentless zombie hordes. Mix and match 20+ jobs and 60+ abilities, adapt to shifting weather, and rescue civilians for powerful rewards in this deep, replayable build system.

name: Thirty Days with My First Love Sister

details.title: Thirty Days with My First Love Sister
details.short_description: A pure love story with your childhood sweetheart who returns from abroad. Spend thirty heartwarming days together, make choices, deepen your bond, and unlock multiple sweet endings in this fully video-based interactive romance game.

details.title: TREUD
details.short_description: Rule your society through 12,000 years – from the Stone Age to the present day – in a grand strategy game with a living simulation where real historical processes are recreated, but nothing is predetermined. Build, conquer, exploit. Crisis is part of history: keep power or side with the revolution

details.title: Auction Simulator
details.short_description: Build an auction career where every bid is a tell. Buy, research and sell valuable objects, read rivals in poker-inspired psychological auctions, build collections, run your own auction house, or become a dealer in the dark market. Every bid is information. Every object could be an opportunity.

details.title: Polygrounds
details.short_description: Master rally-car physics in a neon 2D roguelite physics shooter. Navigate procedural vector dungeons, survive claustrophobic ambushes, face interesting foes, pick new guns, and draft run-defining cards. Will you build a game breaking deck or face an untimely end?

details.title: Unhex
details.short_description: Unhex is a replayable co-op survival-horror game. Your goal is to figure out which demon has possessed the victim, and to exorcise it once you know it. You do this by searching for occult items and observing the possessed’s behavior and interactions with the environment - all without being caught.

details.title: Gas Station Simulator
details.short_description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

details.title: Wall of Symbols
details.short_description: A roguelite siege defense played on an alchemist's table. Spin, place, and let symbols ripen into forms your deck never held. Every neighbour feeds the next, and one transmute turns the whole board into damage.

details.title: Swords & Adventures Mythlands
details.short_description: Choose a powerful hero and embark on an adventure that will take you across unknown lands, facing countless enemies and uncovering the secrets hidden in every corner of Mythlands.

details.title: Labygoudene
details.short_description: Welcome to Labygoudène ! A cooperative game that will put your friendship to the test. Explore a shifting, unstable maze of menhirs filled with surprises, where every turn can bring you closer to the exit… or tear your team apart for good. Stick together !

details.title: Thym
details.short_description: Thym have to find all the plants who hide in the wild countrysides of the kingdom. To acomplish this mission, he can count on his plant-scrapping book, and his flying ship.

details.title: Titan Sword
details.short_description: Sword. Giant. Boom. Grab a massive sword, hunt titans, and cut through everything in your way.

details.title: Fangjie:Shattered Altars
details.short_description: Wake in a shattered voxel world and set out to restore its lost altars. Explore wilds that are different every time, shape your playstyle with a class, skill tree and styles, tame nearly forty companions, and take on bosses with NPC allies or friends on Steam.

details.title: Break Free
details.short_description: Break Free is a First person speedrunning game about breaking free of your restraints, including the level itself.

details.title: YokaiRou: Shoppe of Mystique
details.short_description: A cozy supernatural mystery about listening to your customers' stories, uncovering the yokai troubling them through divination and deduction, and finding the right ritual to set things right.

details.title: Demon Kitty: Trials!
details.short_description: Demon Kitty: Trials! is a hidden object adventure that plays like a roguelite. Help countless kitties across multiple runs, find lost objects in mysterious ancient ruins. Gain powers, transform your kitty, find the objects and collect as many kitties as you can!

details.title: The Last Code
details.short_description: Your gun shoots, pulls and pushes. Move objects and enemies, solve puzzles and use portals in this 2D sci-fi puzzle-platformer. You are an AI awakening on a space station overrun by machines.

details.title: Neironaut
details.short_description: Solve a mysterious case of disappearance with an unexpected help from your own dreams!

details.title: Odd Shop
details.short_description: Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late.

details.title: SoulGraft
details.short_description: The spell-crafting bullet heaven where you earn your god-tier endgame. Graft runic circles to your soul, then unleash your creations on the daemonic hordes. Create 10^30 possible spell combinations and ascend to godhood.

details.title: Atomic Hockey
details.short_description: Every hockey player is strapped to their own rail. So what now? You pass... and you pass before the bomb goes off under your stick. Atomic Hockey is a wild couch game for up to 12 people. Each of you controls hockey players on rails, trying to beat the other team. Usually not the way you’d expect.

details.title: BoneHeads
details.short_description: BoneHeads is a physics-based sword-fighting party game where every swing is under your direct control. Fight locally or online with up to 4 players, and keep battling as every bone you lose becomes a weapon.

details.title: Immortal Loop: Doom Cycle
details.short_description: Transported to a cultivation world, you face apocalypse in one year. Every world‑ending catastrophe sends you back to the start. Keep resources and boost your aptitude across loops. Explore, uncover secrets, seek treasures, and survive doom in this real‑time action cultivation RPG.

details.title: Blue Blood Love Song
details.short_description: A multi-ending visual novel blending romance, sci-fi, and mystery. A perfect reunion gradually gives way to unsettling inconsistencies. As your relationship with him deepens, you must choose between trust and doubt—and every decision may change your bond and the ending that awaits you.

details.title: Mini Gladiators
details.short_description: Mini Gladiators is a minimalist gladiator roguelite with satisfying ragdoll physics, where your choices can turn your little fighter into an unstoppable force that gets the crowds going and enemies flying.

details.title: Crude Empire
details.short_description: Build an oil empire in boomtown Texas: find oil, drill the well yourself, lay pipelines, refine gasoline and run your own gas stations. Every stage can become the bottleneck, and rival oil companies fight you for every field and every customer.

details.title: Merge Mutants
details.short_description: Merge Mutants is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where hostile scientists try to keep you locked up. Synthesize their remains into healing, abilities, and loyal mutants, then merge matching units into bigger and more powerful ones. Break out of the lab or die trying.

details.title: TL;DR
details.short_description: A typing incremental game where you type real novels. Work through 15+ classics, turn every word into gold, and keep upgrading until whole pages fill themselves faster than you can type. Too long; didn’t read. Type it anyway.

details.title: BAUSFIGHT
details.short_description: BAUSFIGHT is a fast-paced battleground for 2–8 players, packed with short multiplayer modes. Choose a weapon-based class, master its unique abilities, and unleash wild combos to ruin your foes’ day. Fight solo to be the last one standing, or team up with friends and conquer the lobby together.

details.title: On & Under
details.short_description: Build a fantasy settlement, guide unique villagers, reshape a fully destructible world, and lead your people in real-time battles against monsters, raiders, and rival factions. Raise a homestead, a druid's grove, a wizard's spire, a necromancer's deep lair—or something only you can imagine.

details.title: Solakrats
details.short_description: The Commandments never change: Awaken for the first time, climb down into the depths, and claim your birth halo. But the world turns, it lies to you. A full inversion twists directions, down becomes up. And after all, it's your home, and that home is the lie. So... which way is down now again...?

details.title: Stem The Tide
details.short_description: Lead the last bastion against the Swarm in this hybrid auto-battler and roguelite. Build your camp, recruit and merge units, create faction synergies, upgrade your warriors, and survive procedurally generated waves of monsters to save the world from destruction!

details.title: WireDive
details.short_description: A PS2-inspired grappling action-platformer set in a high-fantasy realm under siege by eldritch invaders from another dimension. Wield arcane technology, build momentum and swing through each level as you destroy every Blight and chase faster times.

details.title: Dominus Orbis Maris 1400: Mare Nostrum
details.short_description: DOM 1400: Mare Nostrum is a strategy and economy game set in the 15th century Mediterranean. Build trade routes, meet the needs of the social classes and dominate the market in a bottom-up economy driven by scarcity. At sea, the wind decides the battles. In development.

details.title: Dark Money
details.short_description: An incremental, true-crime-inspired money-laundering game. Build a criminal network from back-alley cash drops into a global empire of shell companies and corrupt governments. When a journalist reaches out, will you blow the whistle or embrace the dark side?

details.title: Bub
details.short_description: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.

details.title: Dead Star Prison
details.short_description: Dead Star Prison is a unique combination of Deck Building and strategy based Auto-Battling. Build you deck of prisoners and be sure to place them in the most strategic position on the battleground to conquer your enemies in either PVP mode or the single player story mode.

details.title: Curious Calvin
