details.short_description: Join Calvin - a small, curious, and kind-hearted creature - on a quest for answers deep underground. Navigate treacherous tunnels, effortlessly swap between three unique forms, and aid other creatures in need along the way.

details.title: Used Car Dealer Simulator
details.short_description: Buy and sell used cars Find cars at the right price, add them to your dealership, and sell them for profit. Run your own car dealership Manage your car lot, organize your vehicles, and grow your business step by step.

name: Jesus Christ: A Gospel Visual Novel

details.title: Jesus Christ: A Gospel Visual Novel
details.short_description: Step into the age of the Gospels and witness the teachings, miracles, and redemption of Jesus Christ. This visual novel, centered on biblical stories, presents a journey of sacrifice and hope through dialogue and chapter-based storytelling.

details.title: Idiots 4 Order
details.short_description: Swipe deliveries, scream directions, juggle pizzas and drive like a maniac in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op delivery game. One moped, 4 idiots, infinite chaos.

details.title: ALONE TOGETHER
details.short_description: ALONE TOGETHER is a psychological survival horror game drawn entirely by hand. Explore strange and oppressive locations, solve puzzles, and try to find your missing sister. As you search, you’ll discover that something is trying to stop you.

details.title: GLITCHVERSE
details.short_description: GLITCHVERSE is a knowledge-lock Metroidvania puzzle game. You will explore this unknown and perilous world, acquire a variety of wondrous abilities, discover unexpected ways to use them, and ultimately unravel the secrets of this world.

details.title: Fox Wanderer
details.short_description: Fight, explore, and collect. Step into the role of a wandering fox in this Eastern-fantasy Metroidvania, braving a beautifully crafted world fraught with danger.

details.title: TINY ASTRONAUTS
details.short_description: Become a tiny astronaut and escape from an unknown planet where you crash-landed in a dream! A 2D vertical-scrolling action puzzle game where you use gravity to clear a path forward.

details.title: Geo Survivor
details.short_description: Explore procedural geological caverns in a 2D mining roguelite where your hammer is your only tool and weapon. Collect, combine, and exploit 200+ hammer upgrades to survive hordes of enemies and gather precious crystals.

details.title: Lost ages Hunting
details.short_description: Experience realistic hunts for animals from different eras. T-Rex, mammoths, saber-toothed tigers, as well as fantasy and mutated creatures await you. Explore vast worlds (64 km²) inspired by real locations. Build your own unique trophy collection.

details.title: Kotamas
details.short_description: A cozy pixel dog who lives on your desktop and runs your focus sessions. Start a pomodoro and he naps while you work, quietly clears the distractions you choose, and celebrates every block with you. Play fetch on your breaks, pick from nine breeds and counting, and never work alone again.

name: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time

details.title: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time
details.short_description: The Labyrinth At The End of Time is a retro inspired platformer. Run, jump, dash, die and repeat to get back home, all the while getting ridiculed by a fifth dimensional weirdo in control of this brutalist absurd world that's out of some deranged nightmare.

details.title: The Lost File
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror. Investigate serial murders in locations that exist on no map. Each location has its own fixed laws of survival. Break them — and you die.

details.title: Chromatic Boom
details.short_description: A challenging, short, colorful, and high-energy arcade game. Move your character, shoot and teleport. You will pass between lasers, cross portals and color the levels as you succeed. A difficult challenge in a minimalist experience of just under an hour.

details.title: Ashes of Berlumvale
details.short_description: Ashes of Berlumvale is a hand-drawn 2D horror detective game. Return to a ruined war-orphan asylum in 1951 to reclaim your past. Survive terrifying ghostly encounters, relive the victims' final moments, and use brutal deductive reasoning to uncover the dark truth behind a tragic fire.

details.title: The Lonely Golem
details.short_description: A retro style fantasy adventure combining open world exploration with turn based combat. Travel the seven realms fighting your way through elemental dungeons as you search for a way to cure the enchanted forest from a poisonous blight...

details.title: Obsidia
details.short_description: Obsidia is a 2.5D action/adventure game 2.5D inspired by Zelda and Silent Hill in which you are a hazmat technician. Explore the city of Sibodia, fight against tainted entities and solve environmental puzzles to get out of a city which remembers your actions, leading to one of many endings.

details.title: 牛马兄弟职场记
details.short_description: Cow & Horse Bros.: Office Diaries is an anthropomorphic workplace sim. Featuring cel-shaded anime art, it recreates real office routines & teamwork with funny stories. Casual story-focused gameplay, simple controls for relaxing spare-time fun.

details.title: Reactor 13
details.short_description: Reactor 13 is chaotic local co-op for 1–4 players. Grab, wash, charge, and craft Dark Matter blocks to power everything from one house up to a whole planet. Overcharge for huge output; the chain reactions are half the fun, the meltdown is not. Play solo or have someone else to blame.

details.title: Shadows of Absence
details.short_description: After years of missing out on life, the journeys, the friendships, the experiences, you are prescribed an experimental medication to help you reclaim your life. The side effects were supposed to be minor, but as you drift off to sleep, you wake up in your childhood home.

details.title: The Forsaken Crown
details.short_description: Master unforgiving combat in a minimalist world. This low-poly Soulslike challenges your reflexes with precise dodge rolls and brutal timing. Explore bleak landscapes with a charming retro flair and conquer monumental bosses.

details.title: A Sea of Ashen Tulips
details.short_description: A Sea of Ashen Tulips is a fantasy Text-based RPG where players control a former mercenary who searches for allies in investigating and combatting a colonial occupation.

details.title: Brassfang
details.short_description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and strange experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

details.title: BULLETPROOF
details.short_description: A story-driven retro FPS set in early-2000s Seattle. Dismantle the criminal empire you built in a brutal campaign of revenge behind a bulletproof mask.

name: gumball: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast

details.title: gumball: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast
details.short_description: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast! dispense gumballs, pop pegs, and stamp your candy-coated arsenal with game-breaking modifiers on your way to mastering the pegs. built solo from from my wife's basement in utah, gumball is a vibrant peg breaking physics rogue-like where every run rewrites the rules.

details.title: RUNLENGTH
details.short_description: You are PID_0x7F, a rogue process fighting to survive inside a dying computer. Outrun the system's daemons, solve living data-structure puzzles, and reconstruct the truth your creator tried to delete — before the machine wipes you for good.

details.title: D.I.P.
details.short_description: Rush to the bucket, dip into the paint, hook onto the ceiling, and smear your colorful body all over the walls... Oh, and you're a cute dormouse. Paint fast, grab bonuses, and become the top dormouse among your friends in D.I.P.: Dormouse Is Painting, a chaotic local party game for up to 4 players.

details.title: Fling-A-Ring
details.short_description: A retro-styled stretch-and-release physics game. Your ring will zoom about colorful procedurally generated arenas of increasing difficulty filled with whimsical obstacles and collectable sparks and powerups.

details.title: Kimbap Factory
details.short_description: Automate the ultimate Korean kitchen. Route belts, watch ingredients transform, and physically assemble each kimbap roll step by step. Discover new recipes, fulfill requests, and expand your kitchen at your own pace. No pressure, no timers, just a satisfying and unique casual factory experience.

details.title: Dance with the Moon
details.short_description: A boy who hates the night meets a vampire girl who loves it. As they steal blood packs and help those in need under the cover of darkness, the two gradually fall in love. A multi-ending visual novel that gently illuminates the lives of those lost in the night and offers comfort to the lonely.

details.title: Tropical Romance
details.short_description: At an elite academy for fruit-family heirs, Geum Gyuri, a kumquat farmer’s daughter, is drawn to a pair of polar-opposite twins—only to uncover the “rotten” truth beneath the school’s “fresh” facade.

details.title: A Dialogue Within
details.short_description: A psychological narrative experience where perception fades and reality unravels. Explore, observe, and feel the descent into the human mind.

details.title: Shadow Business
details.short_description: A single-player crime auto-battler: your gang against theirs. Drag your crew into the lanes and watch them punch through enemy lines. Wreck the rival limo before the cops arrive!

details.title: Antropico: Colonies
details.short_description: A large-scale space strategy game focused on building and maintaining power within a simulated galaxy. Build, develop, and survive in a galaxy shaped by history and consequences.

details.title: Arcane Souls
details.short_description: Enter a fantasy world full of magic in this action soulslike RPG. Master deadly combat, shape your own unique spells, and face colossal bosses. Survive the unforgiving challenges alone, or spill blood alongside a friend in full online co-op.

details.title: Project Substrata
details.short_description: Dig, build, connect—and watch your factory come to life. Shape the terrain, link mining and production lines, and manage power in a first-person base-building and automation game. Restoring a ruined planet is our long-term development goal.

details.title: Football Life
details.short_description: Beyond tactics and transfers, build and run your club as the manager—facility expansion and upgrades, staff, budgets, board relations, and youth recruitment and academy intake.

details.title: Legion Draft
details.short_description: An async PvP card auto-battler filled with dogs! Each card represents an ever-growing troop of soldiers. Draft, recruit, and build a powerful legion. Discover fantasy races reimagined as different dog breeds, explore unique synergies, and outsmart your opponents to become the ultimate strategist!

details.title: Intrigue Romance
details.short_description: Step into Asterhaven’s open world for a strategic RPG with boundless possibilities! Interact with 1,500+ rNPCs of diverse classes, ethnicities and personalities, forming a vast social network and branching storylines.Every decision triggers a butterfly effect, altering the world’s trajectory.

name: ROTRDS - Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon and Snake

details.title: ROTRDS - Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon and Snake
details.short_description: ROTRDS is a visual novel RPG inspired by traditional Korean mythology. Only half of the Twelve Zodiac guardians remain with fragmented memories. Gigi has less than a week to gather all the Oksae seals and save the world.

details.title: The Umbral Seal
details.short_description: WoW raid mechanics meet FTL's pause-and-plan combat. Command 5-20 heroes through 30+ tactical boss encounters. No grinding. No filler. Pure single-player boss-rush strategy.

details.title: Flavio The Ghost Clown
details.short_description: Battle challenging bosses in this Run & Gun action game. Generate resources in a tycoon-style workshop and upgrade your equipment in the shop to guide Flavio through these bizarre battles!

name: 伴我同行 Walk alongside me

details.title: 伴我同行 Walk alongside me
details.short_description: "Walk Alongside Me" is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Command a dynamic duo, using seamless rotation and card synergy to build a unique combat system on your quest to rescue your family and save the world. Choose your heroes and begin your journey!

details.title: White Crow Castle: Loop
details.short_description: A fantasy mystery otome RPG with time loop mechanics. Explore a cursed castle, collect clues, solve puzzles, make critical choices, and experience branching storylines, emotional bonds, and life-or-death survival in an inescapable cycle.

details.title: BloodSpiller
details.short_description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

details.title: Gardoon
details.short_description: The blackjack roguelite of the Persian Book of Kings. Beat the Deev at 21 to win the right to rule on a hero's prayer, then grant it or deny it. Five chapters of Rostam and Sohrab, four starting decks, and a demon that plays to win.

details.title: Sweatpants Savior: Worlds Beyond
details.short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

details.title: Amazon Warrior
details.short_description: A Puzzle with Bossfights! Join Tayana and save the Amazon exploring amazing Scenarios, Enemies and Bosses! An Evil is haunting the heart of the Amazon! Among breathtaking landscapes, forge powerful alliances and unleash divine powers to survive deadly trials and shape the fate of the forest.

details.title: RTG
details.short_description: RTG is narrative sci-fi puzzle/platformer about a guy with no memories stranded inside strange world, where initially nothing makes sense. Solve gradually challenging puzzles and, piece by piece, unravel mystery behind what you see and experience.

details.title: Sisters of Solitude
details.short_description: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

details.title: HIIT: Stranded on Zaruma
details.short_description: Trapped on the mysterious planet Zaruma, use tools like the Drone, Scanner, and Hookshot to explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and uncover what happened before your arrival.

details.title: Happy Village: The Broken Timeline
details.short_description: A narrative RPG of three intertwined stories, hidden secrets, and a broken timeline only the player can repair. Every ending reveals new paths, if you know where to look.

details.title: Alchemist's Arcana
details.short_description: A narrative puzzle game where you return to your hometown as an Alchemists' Guild clerk and unexpectedly become the acting alchemist. Relearn forgotten alchemy, help the townsfolk, and survive with your companions in a world slowly falling apart.

details.title: Forgotten
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Shipwrecked on a remote island, Evelyn searches for the missing lighthouse keeper, her only way home. But the people of this island were forgotten long ago. Explore, solve puzzles and hide as you uncover who they were.

details.title: Magic Tower: Legion
details.short_description: "Magic Tower: Legion" is a roguelike Magic Tower-like game. You will play as a legion commander and lead your team into the magic tower. Use each character's strengths to defeat powerful enemies. Remember to plan every step carefully, for all resources in the magic tower are non-renewable.

details.title: Some Puzzles
details.short_description: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

details.title: Lock In
details.short_description: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

details.title: 魂途 Xoul
details.short_description: Xoul is a uniquely styled 2D ARPG. You can use the game's distinctive "Custom Combo" feature to create your own chain attacks, defeat various enemies, experience diverse stories, unravel the mysteries of this world—and then make your choice.

details.title: VASED
details.short_description: VASED is a simple, yet challenging fast-paced arcade against-the-clock puzzle game about vases.

details.title: Gumblaster Mayhem
details.short_description: Gumblaster Mayhem is a 3D retro-style first-person shooter game where you, as a player, shoot out some gumballs using the three weapons that you must use to take down the sour mutants to survive.

details.title: Labyren
details.short_description: Labyren is a medieval-themed Tower Defense game centered on multi-waypoint mazing and vision. While traversing through the campaign, discover countless unique strategies building with your ever-expanding arsenal and unravel the story underneath!

name: The Story about princess 8 out of 10

details.title: The Story about princess 8 out of 10
details.short_description: Once upon a time, there was a perfectly average princess — 8/10 at best. No singing animals, no magical destiny. Just an annoying father-king and a whole bunch of creepy barons trying to marry her off.

details.title: Tad-Bubble!
details.short_description: Tad-Bubble is a boss rush shoot ‘em up for the Game Boy Color! Fight off waves of dangerous boss bugs, boss fish, and boss more in this brand-new retro experience.

details.title: Captain Speedfin
details.short_description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

details.title: Waffles' Cranked Stories
details.short_description: Waffles' Cranked Stories is a selection of mini-games set in the same universe as Inspector Waffles, originally released exclusively on the Playdate console. This time, follow the adventures of Chance and Spike and discover new stories that expand on the previous ones!

details.title: Faraway Galaxy
details.short_description: Faraway Galaxy is a new roguelite deckbuilder framed as a bizarre tabletop adventure narrated by a battle-hardened space wolf. Master intense tactical battles and meaningful choices between them. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

details.title: A Trivia Roguelike
details.short_description: Your actions are dictated by trivia questions and answers in this roguelike RPG with a trivia twist. Collect loot and level up to impact your chances of survival, take down dangerous foes and defeat the evil Trivia Arch Lich.

details.title: SHROT
details.short_description: Welcome to SHROT! A fast, funny, and unapologetically stupid first-person boomer shooter where a Slavic trucker gets stuck in an alien apocalypse and handles it the only way he knows how: with beer, cigarettes, and unresolved anger issues.

name: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia

details.title: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia
details.short_description: "The truth is not found in what you see… but in what you tune into." Survive a deceased scientist's memories in a strange 1930s German town. Manipulate frequencies to reveal what is hidden, face unsettling entities, and keep an impossible promise in a tactile, HUD-less psychological survival horror.

details.title: Temple Siege TD
details.short_description: Relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe: Hero-towers, distinct roles, unique abilities, powerful combos and rising challenge.

details.title: Fishy Dish
details.short_description: Create and sell sushi in this roguelike inventory-management sushi-builder game. Collect fish, sauces, and tools, arrange them on a grid to trigger synergies, survive each round’s sales target, and build the ultimate sushi lineup.

details.title: General Chaos - MAJOR SNAFU
details.short_description: "Currently, GENERAL CHAOS - MAJOR SNAFU is considerably more than halfway to the finish line! This time around, its a sprite-based, multiplayer PC Game that uses an Xbox-style Game Controller &/or Keyboard & Mouse .

details.title: GENKAI SHURAKU
details.short_description: Rebuild a collapsed remote village in this crafting–farming–settlement game. Gather resources, cook, manage fields, survive raids, and run a small stall to restore the community.

details.title: Never Clean
details.short_description: Clear mountains of trash, sell the junk, and finish building an abandoned park! Take a break from work and have some fun, but remember: your boss is watching you from his window. Complete bizarre tasks, crack the code to the safe, and discover what your boss is really hiding.

details.title: Road To School
details.short_description: Road to School is a physics-based parkour platformer where you ride a bicycle up a treacherous mountain. Jump, balance, and explore hidden paths while tackling brutal challenges on your journey to school. Play alone or with friends in a co-op experience.

details.title: What Lies Within
details.short_description: What Lies Within is a co-op first person psychological horror. You and your team must work together to complete objectives within abandoned facilities owned by your employer, 'M-E-L'. A bioengineering company conducting top secret biological experimentation on aliens, humans and more...

details.title: Kkokko Industry
details.short_description: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

details.title: GOP POST
details.short_description: It's 2090. GOPPOST is a co-op Papers Please-style game about defending a MEGA-TOWER. You and your GOP-SQUAD must hold the stairwell check papers, keep the beer flowing, and stop whatever's crawling up from below. Will you survive the shift?

details.title: Tetrabonk
details.short_description: Tetrabonk is a 1–4 player co-op roguelike. Explore procedurally generated locations, fight with swords, bows, or firearms against hordes of enemies and powerful bosses, and build your character through upgrade cards — no run is ever the same.

details.title: Hot Stuff
details.short_description: Hot Stuff is a casual action oriented party game, with procedural elements and simple controls, suitable for different types of players to quickly pick up and play together, achieving cooperation within the chaos.

details.title: Master of Jewelry
details.short_description: Master of Jewelry is a detailed jewelry crafting simulator where you rise from apprentice to master, repairing and creating pieces in your own workshop. Immerse yourself in the delicate art of working with precious metals and gemstones in the cozy town of Diamond City.

details.title: CrossSwords: FPS Crosswords
details.short_description: Solve the crossword and start shooting! Race your opponents to solve clues, earn ammo and power-ups, and then fight in an arena built from the crossword grid itself. Battle friends and players online!

details.title: VPetlings
details.short_description: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

details.title: Zantar & Other Stories
details.short_description: Acclaimed artist and solo developer Mitchell F. Chan tells six funny, gripping, and heart-breaking stories about a fictional video game, the ambitious CEO driven to make it the most valuable platform in the world, and the would-be millionaires who are pulled into its orbit.

details.title: BoB - Battle of Bots
details.short_description: Welcome to BOB, a heavy metal bullet-heaven roguelike Mecha game where your skills are the only thing standing between humanity and endless waves of berserk bots! Survive as long as possible while obliterating waves of enemies, terrifying bosses and the megalomanical AI DAVE!

details.title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
details.short_description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

details.title: Evelume
details.short_description: An atmospheric 2D adventure about a schoolkid in a small town where adults are stuck in a gray, monotonous life. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, and try to uncover the something that has drained people of joy.

details.title: Meowniverse
details.short_description: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

details.title: Essentia: A monster catching adventure
details.short_description: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

details.title: Space Hood
details.short_description: Defend your outpost in this tower defense with a raiding twist. Battle the ruthless Nova Roma Corporation as you build, loot, and survive relentless assaults.

details.title: OEDO DEVELOPER
details.short_description: “Oedo Developer” is a city builder featuring Ieyasu Tokugawa's Edo. Story and free play modes are available, the first offering a history based city building experience, and the second allowing you to freely develop the lands. Plan, build, distribute, and learn as you make the Edo of your dreams!
developers: 株式会社ドリームスレッド
publishers: 株式会社ドリームスレッド

details.title: CatchMaker
details.short_description: Embark on a cozy, 3D adventure where you catch bugs... and match them for perfect romance! Explore a world abuzz with cute critters and help them find their perfect date through playful minigames. Befriend the locals, uncover your past and embrace your destiny as steward of a magical island.

details.title: Gourmet Steak Odyssey
details.short_description: A resource management platformer where you play as Sweet Baby Jesus on a quest to make the perfect steak. Use your gun to propel yourself through levels and use your feet viciously to crush your foes.

details.title: Lunarift
details.short_description: DESCEND. BUILD. EXTRACT. Lunarift is a single-player roguelite FPS set inside a lunar station torn open by a dimensional rift. Fight through shifting sectors, turn salvaged technology into lethal builds, and choose when to push deeper or escape with what you found.

details.title: Last Stand Legends
details.short_description: Will you rise as a Legend or fall to the darkness? Your courage and skill will decide the fate of humanity. Step into a world overrun by the undead, where every battle is a fight for survival. Stand alone or rally your allies as you carve through hordes of zombies and deadly bosses.

details.title: KARATE ROGUE
details.short_description: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

details.title: Decay of Worlds
details.short_description: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

details.title: Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival
details.short_description: Fall into a chill survival adventure, with a talking campfire as your guide. Explore, craft, fish and hunt during the day, and ask your fire three questions each night. Choose wisely: Winter isn't the only surprise in this beautiful, hand-drawn world. Playable in cosy or realistic mode.

details.title: MULTIMATUM
details.short_description: MULTIMATUM is a fast-paced top-down shooter with roguelite elements about unfortunate multiworld adventurers, trapped in isolated worlds. Fight the protagonists’ tormenting past projections and return the blade of God to its owner in order to return home.

details.title: The Darkness Delivers
details.short_description: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

details.title: Soulscape2 Fragments of The Present
details.short_description: Dive into a dark cyber noir conspiracy in this solo developed, story rich CRPG. Set in a dystopian near future, guide Blake Turner and his squad through isometric exploration, deeply strategic turn-based combat, branching dialogue, and infinite post game progression.

details.title: JungoJam
details.short_description: JungoJam now boasts a hip downtown strip, tranquil beaches, and islands perfect for unleashing your creativity. Here, you can be anyone you dream of! Team up with friends from across the globe to explore an interactive wonderland, design your Original Characters！

name: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo

details.title: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo
details.short_description: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo is the definitive animated carpark chaotic parking simulator!!! Park cars before its too late!

details.title: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
details.short_description: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

details.title: Love Notes
details.short_description: Love Notes is a romance game that can be completed in ??? minutes.

details.title: STENCH
details.short_description: STENCH is a story-driven life-sim RPG set in the 80s. A strange diagnosis brings you to the city. Live day by day, make weird friends, earn money, roam the city, and fight clueless thugs, while a conspiracy grows in the shadows.

details.title: Rage of the Elder Gods
details.short_description: Rage of the Elder Gods is a turn-based tactical game blending board game mechanics with RPG elements. Hunt down fanatical cults across the mythical locations of H.P. Lovecraft’s universe. Face cosmic horror and survive the madness!

details.title: Appa
details.short_description: Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. Predict, counter, and outmaneuver manifestations of grief while uncovering a heartfelt story somewhere between dreams and reality.

details.title: DRIVE IN THE RAIN
details.short_description: A newly licensed boy drives a highway on a torrential night. In the back seat, his girlfriend is consumed by a "Paranormal Phenomenon" born of a social media firestorm. Beside him, a self-proclaimed expert in modern Paranormal Phenomena. A horror road-movie adventure by playwright Keisuke Tagawa.

details.title: Impermanence
details.short_description: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice from beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and refusing to let go as a force older than love pushes back.

details.title: My Yandere Streamer
details.short_description: You're just a regular streamer with a modest audience. She invited you over to her place... The moment you turned your back, your yandere girlfriend Aiko locked you in her basement. Can you escape before time runs out? Or... do you even want to?

details.title: What Remains Of Me
details.short_description: After an injury shatters the future he had planned, Jake Turner returns to the small town he thought he'd left behind. With old feelings resurfacing and unexpected attractions becoming harder to ignore, he must confront who he was, who he's expected to be, and who he actually wants to become.

details.title: Print in Progress
details.short_description: A cozy 3D printer simulator. Pick your colors, start your prints, and watch voxel models grow. Snap off the supports, ship orders, and buy upgrades for your workshop. Engage actively to grow faster or leave it as a relaxing idle companion on your desktop that you check in on.

details.title: JOB
details.short_description: JOB is a bleak and surreal corporate mystery that incorporates and subverts incremental/idle, rogue-lite, and traditional puzzle mechanics. The Company is looking for new Contractors and they ask, "Would you sign away three years of your life for the possibility of unimaginable wealth?"

name: Frozen Christmas Magic: Santa’s Hidden Village

details.title: Frozen Christmas Magic: Santa’s Hidden Village
details.short_description: Unleash the magic of Christmas in a cozy adventure puzzle game. Armed with your magic shovel, clear away the snow burying a legendary village, solve puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and rediscover the wonder of Christmas through a unique Advent calendar.

details.title: R.override
details.short_description: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

details.title: World on a Plate
details.short_description: Cook your way around Europe in this cozy co-op kitchen adventure for one to two players. Prepare authentic regional dishes, keep your kitchen running smoothly, and manage busy restaurants across diverse European cultures and cuisines, while uncovering Grandma’s story behind her legendary restaurant.

details.title: Exodrift
details.short_description: Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.

details.title: Liquid Swarm
details.short_description: Swallow swarms of monsters, earn XP, improve your stats, repeat. Minimalist active incremental roguelite with rewarding and satisfying gameplay. Reincarnate to get permanent XP bonuses and to unlock perks and Epic Bosses. Play alone or with friends.

details.title: MushHero
details.short_description: MushHero is a cooperative roguelite defense game where players fight together against waves of monsters and powerful bosses. Build unique strategies through randomized weapons, evolving skills, and a node-based progression system that creates a different combat experience every run.

details.title: Netherspire
details.short_description: Explore the ruins of a colossal tower and fight those who threaten its ancient vault in this short 3D Metroidvania.

name: Sacred Stakes: Starring VEINIEST DUKEM and his ludicrous blackjack skills on a holy crusade into the depths of THE gambling hell itself

details.title: Sacred Stakes: Starring VEINIEST DUKEM and his ludicrous blackjack skills on a holy crusade into the depths of THE gambling hell itself
details.short_description: Outplay cheating ghosts in blackjack as a musclebound exorcist. Build your deck and survive a roguelike descent where the house doesn’t just cheat: it haunts you. Bend the rules, use powerful items, uncover each spirit’s tricks, and turn their own scams against them.

details.title: Urine Nation
details.short_description: A SCORE ATTACK adventure through the UK and Ireland, where your goal is to soak everywhere in your urine! USE ALL THE URINE IN YOUR SYSTEM to drench every inch of the level while completing objectives and gaining crazy combos!!!

details.title: C01n
details.short_description: A nostalgic visual novel set on a quiet, remote island somewhere in Japan. Follow the words of the islanders and the small things that feel slightly off in everyday life, and draw closer to the truth this place has kept hidden. This is not a story about exposing the truth.

details.title: Whiterock Bay
details.short_description: Take on a big mystery in this first-person adventure inspired by old-time horrors. Explore the desolate town, face the anomalies, solve puzzles and search for traces of your missing sister in Whiterock Bay.

details.title: Pulsewave
details.short_description: Fly a ship through tracks built from the music. Every trap, ring and star lands on a beat. Dodge lightning, cross lava canyons and crystal caves, hit the Puls on the beat, chase an S rank and climb the Steam leaderboards. Load your own songs and fly them too.

details.title: The Races
details.short_description: The horses aren't real. The money isn't real. The emotional rollercoaster very much is. Bet, buy, train and sabotage from your phone in this Teletext-era horse racing party game, for a room full of friends or just you and the bots.

details.title: 不动列车StationaryTrain
details.short_description: " stationary Train" is a post-apocalyptic horror exploration pixel-style RPG. You will play as Luna, an adult woman and the last survivor of this world. you set out to recover your lost memories, and together with the conductor Diqiu, you return to a world ravaged by monsters and plague...

details.title: My Friend, Dysentery
details.short_description: A darkly comedic "Horribly Realistic Fantasy Travel Simulator" survival adventure roguelike inspired by Oregon Trail. Journey to the Promised Land to kill a dragon! Fight monsters, manage supplies & disasters, and learn that fantasy journeys are nothing heroic like the films, but cripplingly brutal.

details.title: Benson Bones
details.short_description: A top-down pixel art action RPG. You wake in a graveyard, a dog finds you, and then a portal takes him. Learn every enemy's tell, take down bosses that punish button-mashing, and cross hand-built realms to bring him home.

details.title: 404: The Absent God
details.short_description: A hand-drawn 2D metroidvania. Planet 404 doesn't exist on any map, but Vexya lands there anyway, on the trail of her missing mentor. Explore, shoot, unlock new abilities, and beat the Zorgs to the Eye of Vyr'Nox, relic of the Absent God.

details.title: 旧梦夏日
details.short_description: On her twelfth birthday, Xiaohan makes a wish—but more than candlelight fades. Her reflection blurs, and her best friend Xiaoyu disappears. Through dual perspectives, explore a dreamlike millennium town, battle with card marbles, and uncover its hidden truth.

details.title: Broken Cycle
details.short_description: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically while you engineer their battle tactics and loot, craft, and enchant their gear.

details.title: Echoes of Memory
details.short_description: Japan, 1992. Neurophysiologist Ren Adler travels to Mizunari to investigate missing people, memory gaps and contradictory evidence. Search the village, connect analog clues and make decisions that can have lasting consequences.

details.title: FIVILYN
details.short_description: A psychological RPG where you switch between two perceptions of reality and discover that not everything sweet is innocent.

details.title: Songs of the Past
details.short_description: Go on an adventure and become a mighty hero who will save the world from an evil villain! ♫ Songs of the Past ♫ is a story-rich RPG where you choose from 6 classes, travel across regions, solve puzzles, complete quests, recruit companions & uncover the mystery of the magical songs shaping the world!

details.title: The Death... And After?
details.short_description: You are in a coma. Reality is shattered, and the laws of logic no longer apply. "The Death... And After?" is a psychological horror game where you must navigate eerie hospital labyrinths and dark caverns of a fading mind. Is it a dream, or is it death? And what awaits us after?

details.title: Rogue Gambit
details.short_description: Chess, but every run is different. Draft jesters, wizards and bureaucrats, forge strange abilities onto them, and climb a branching map of battles, relics and bad bargains. A roguelite for people who thought they were good at chess.

details.title: Jacob's Islands
details.short_description: Jacob’s Islands is a minimalist pixel art platforming adventure where you explore mysterious islands, uncover secrets, and take time to enjoy the beauty of nature.

details.title: BLACK WALLS
details.short_description: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

details.title: My Brother Hacker
details.short_description: Your brother is gone. He left behind a USB stick with an unknown system and an AI that teaches you to hack. Break into networks, uncover who he really was, and question everything you find. A terminal-based hacking thriller set in 2036.

details.title: Naron
details.short_description: Co-op mining roguelite for 1-4 players. Dig into a dying moon, complete objectives and fight your way back to your drillship. Every step of progress makes the return more dangerous. Tunnels can collapse and bury you. 47 crews failed to reach the core. How deep will you go?

details.title: glitch.exe
details.short_description: glitch.exe is a free-to-play hacking horror game where you infiltrate corrupted systems, uncover hidden secrets and piece together a story that was never meant to be found. Explore a unsettling digital world full of mystery, tension and things that should not exist.

details.title: FLS: Fleeting Light and Shadows
details.short_description: A story-driven vertical space shooter made by young, passionate devs. Play as EOX-375, a robot born of a fallen golden age. Journey into post-apocalyptic peril, avenge humanity against its instigator, and seek one unverified truth: the future need not follow set rules. What do we exist for?

details.title: Caravanier
details.short_description: Lead a post-apocalyptic caravan through the dark wreckage of a fallen colony ship. Caravanier is a 2D top-down trade-based RPG where you exploit lucrative trade routes, barter with rival survivor factions, stave off the encroaching darkness, and shape the fate of this divided world.

details.title: Dawar: Ashes of the Snow
details.short_description: Dawar is a third-person action-adventure game. Carve your path in a punishing, UI-less world. Master the combat mechanics. Dismember your enemies. Reach your goal.

details.title: Let's make SILLY ART!
details.short_description: Time to make SILLY ART! Help Charlie rediscover the joy of making art in this cozy and creative point and click. Tidy your house, find inspirations, collect stickers and create authentic artwork to build your portfolio!

details.title: Over Package!
details.short_description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

details.title: Chain Shotgun
details.short_description: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

details.title: Be the Block
details.short_description: Be the Block is a Sokoban-inspired 2D puzzle game where you don’t just push the blocks, you ARE the blocks. Solve a collection of carefully hand-crafted puzzles that are by design simple yet challenging.

details.title: Yrdenwatch - The Dragon from Lidoriya
details.short_description: This game is about piloting a giant mech with wings that has multiple guns attached to it. It's explosive, fast-paced, skill-based, and full of gun violence. It's also a story-driven game where you explore a spaceship and talk to your fellow crew members!

details.title: Meal Quest
details.short_description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

details.title: Deadlight Manor
details.short_description: A stylized survival horror built on community. Squad up with your team, battle endless waves of the infected, and let your stream audience fuel the chaos in real time.

details.title: Friends of a Feather
details.short_description: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

details.title: Frozen Echo
details.short_description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

details.title: FROB
details.short_description: The happy life of a whimsical little frog called Frob was turned upside down when his tadpoles were tadnapped by a heron. Now it's his quest to collect them all in this silly 3D platformer!

details.title: After Hours: Library
details.short_description: Survive a haunted library's overnight shift by balancing authentic librarian duties with stealth as a relentless supernatural entity hunts you. Uncover hidden secrets, survive until morning, and discover what waits between the shelves.

details.title: 8-bitBot
details.short_description: 8-bitBot is a programming puzzle game where you place simple instructions in a program to make your bots transport objects in a factory environment.

details.title: Stellar Mole
details.short_description: You will play a role of Agent Vanø—infiltrating an alien colonial corporation. Your mission: gather Earth intelligence for alien while weaponizing every dirty trick to torment your alien colleagues, dismantling their operations from within.

details.title: Grove Bound
details.short_description: Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG where you chop, fish, cook, mine, and craft to explore a dark forest. Manage fatigue, light your way with a lantern, and upgrade tools while meeting quirky NPCs and uncovering secrets at your own pace.

details.title: Underpond
details.short_description: Delve into the depths of the amphibian afterlife, the eponymous UNDERPOND, in this procedurally generated, hand-drawn, frog-hopping roguelite.

details.title: Enlighted
details.short_description: Enlighted is a dark fantasy, dungeon crawler game that shows no mercy for mistakes. Explore randomly generated dungeon levels, find a legendary equipment and manage your light - it protects you quick death.

details.title: Fake World 2: Real World 1
details.short_description: Fake World 2: Real World 1 is a VR first-person shooter where weapon color matters. Match red and yellow weapons to enemy attacks while you grapple, jetpack, and teleport through surreal sci-fi environments in a fast-paced, atmospheric campaign.

details.title: Keep Crafting
details.short_description: Keep Crafting is an asymetrical cooperative party game : One player must guide the other players using a manual to craft complex items !

details.title: Drift Market
details.short_description: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

details.title: SCRIMBLO SCRAMBLE
details.short_description: Put it all on the line in this roulette-themed incremental game where you torment your scrimblos in order to manage and eventually escape hell.

details.title: Spider Matrix
details.short_description: Expedition is dead, but your mind woke inside a mechanical spider. Become a fatal glitch in the Machine Swarm network, which arrived for a fifth-dimension fragment. Scale walls, strip enemy weapons, and destroy the Hive Mind to save the planet.

details.title: Corban's Station
details.short_description: In this first-person puzzle exploration game, walk the liminal spaces of a long-abandoned service station. Reprogram aging computers, physically reroute damaged and fading connections and restore fragments of their waning memory.

details.title: Daydream Drifters
details.short_description: A roguelike stealth horror where dungeons, enemies, and items are procedurally generated. With dynamic events over time and changing weather, hide from enemies with distinct abilities—or prepare to fight. Explore 3 seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream.

details.title: SteelFall
details.short_description: Pilot an armored mech and fight giant kaiju with steel fists and an arsenal of ranged weapons. Punch, parry, and shoot your way through a world overrun by monsters in a third-person beat ’em up where every hit shakes the ground.

details.title: OmniGun
details.short_description: Obliterate hostile automatons in this vibrant physics-based roguelite FPS. Master the OmniGun, a prototype gun capable of firing any ammunition imaginable as you shoot, explode, burn, shock, slice, freeze, shrink, and impale your way to the exit.

details.title: Flushed Forward
details.short_description: Control a limbless sewer creature on board a large speed boat pursued by a massive sewer tidal wave in this Arcade experience! Defend against enemies by vaulting across your boat to stomp on their heads!

details.title: BLACKFRAG
details.short_description: BLACKFRAG is a fast-paced competitive arena FPS focused on precision gunplay and intense multiplayer combat.

details.title: Marble Machina
details.short_description: You wake up in a surreal factory with no memory of how you arrived. Punch cards operate strange machines, floors rise and fall beneath your feet, and teleporters lead who knows where. You’re fairly sure you haven’t gone mad. Still, just to be safe, you’d better collect all your marbles.

details.title: Spy Diner
details.short_description: "Spy Diner" is a click-and-run adventure game combining restaurant management and spy infiltration. Players run a diner by day next to the century-old "Old Chiang's Braised Pork Rice" as a good neighbor, and execute takedown plans by night under handler orders.

details.title: Mighty Tiny Railways
details.short_description: Build a steam railway where the network you build determines how it operates. Deliver cargo and passengers on time, grow towns and industries, and optimize your network. Invite a friend to build together in online co-op.

details.title: 囚人カウンセリング
details.short_description: An interactive prison adventure. You play as a psychiatrist, working one-on-one with inmates who have committed crimes. Use case files to choose appropriate responses and hand out items from the drawer to maintain their trust. Your choices can either open up or close the inmates.

details.title: Battle of the Kyoshin
details.short_description: A miko gal and a Kyoshin go head-to-head with an enemy Kyoshin! Power up your Kyoshin as you fight, and take them down! Finish them with a trump-card Kamiwaza!

details.title: FEMBOY SLEEPOVER - Episode 2
details.short_description: You've been invited to the Femboy Sleepover! In episode 2 of this cute yaoi visual novel series, look for ways to exorcise the demon you summoned.

details.title: The UFO Phenomenon
details.short_description: In this horror strategy roguelite inspired by Dispatch, become part of MAJESTIC; a clandestine force tasked with guarding humanity’s darkest truth. Disinform, spy, and endure as paranoia, catastrophe, and the unknown threaten everything you know.

details.title: Sepak U - Sports Fighting Game
details.short_description: Smash-Like Volleyball - Fighting Game meets Volleyball and Football with 1-4 players, 21 characters, 21 arenas, with over 10 hours of solo/co-op content, minigames, and epic boss battles. Based on Sepak Takraw, a cultural Asian sport.

details.title: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit
details.short_description: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit is the grand finale to the tactical RPG trilogy. Command a massive cast of returning heroes in the series’ most strategic entry yet. Master evolved turn-based combat, guide your army through tactical challenges, and witness the conclusion to every character's story.

details.title: Fluffy Spider
details.short_description: A fluffy spider. Tricky jumps. A web to call home. Explore a colourful 2D platformer, find secret worlds, then build a network of insect traps in your idle hub. Collect silk, unlock talents and characters, and fill your radio with original songs.

details.title: The Silent Fare
details.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

details.title: GridLock
details.short_description: Command a 3-soldier squad against AXIOM, a rogue AI spreading across the battlefield. Every turn the Grid grows, buffing enemies and punishing your troops. Destroy every Node before 75% of the map is consumed. Fast, tight, tactical.

details.title: This Week
details.short_description: A hardcore parkour game that tells the story of Ania, a kid with mental health issues and a lot of stuff to go through in life. Meant to make you experience how someone feels in a weird, but familiar way.

details.title: Grandma(88)
details.short_description: Of course Grandma loves you — but she loves it even more when you simply listen. Dive into her labyrinth of memories, challenge her stories and watch everything around you fall apart. Can you escape her version of the past?

details.title: Specters of the Sun
details.short_description: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

details.title: Nightborn
details.short_description: Fight, sneak, or charm your way through a gothic modern New Orleans as a Vampire detective of your creation. Unravel a vast centuries-old conspiracy involving Vampire factions, Werewolves, and far stranger horrors. Try to survive as a Nightborn without losing yourself to madness or damnation.

details.title: Eternal Summer
details.short_description: unmixing reality

details.title: Psychotic Bathtub
details.short_description: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown Jesus. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

details.title: Ecosphere
details.short_description: A Fantasy / Steampunk Visual Novel in which you'll make hearts skip a beat! You are Arane Kross, a talented engineer capable of controlling nature with a machine: the Ecosphere! What will be your impact?

details.title: Isolation One
details.short_description: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where you need to survive at any cost.

details.title: DRINKRIME
details.short_description: On the first day of a long weekend, you pick up a talking liquor bottle on a bridge. It's Jin, a demon judged by the Demon King. Cursed to stay by his side, you team up to Jinterrogate sinners hiding around town. A Fill-in-the-Crime Interrogation Adventure in retro, limited-palette pixel art.

details.title: Fishing Echoes
details.short_description: Fishing Echoes is a fantasy fishing game where you catch elemental fish to save the realm from a world-devouring maelstrom.

details.title: Eternal Wanderer
details.short_description: Live. Die. Reincarnate. Return decades later as a human, rat, dog, bird or other lifeform and face the world your choices created. Carry karma and knowledge across dozens of lives in a narrative RPG spanning centuries, where every life becomes part of your story.

details.title: 梦之彼方-fate prologue
details.short_description: “一位名叫蓝原逸的少年，在多年之后重返家乡，转入了小镇唯一的学校。八年的时光，小镇的一切已经发生了翻天覆地的变化，那些遗失的美好，珍贵的回忆，慢慢苏醒……这就是所谓的奇迹吗？男孩显得有些疑惑。此后，他与自己的青梅竹马相逢，结识了文学部的众人，开始了一日日平凡的校园时光……”她，如此这样地说着。 片刻的沉默，少女已然整理好了头发，系上了心爱的蝴蝶结，努力挤出了一个微笑，望向窗外。 “至少现在，已经足够了哟~因为你已经很坚强的努力过了，所以，已经不用再逞强了哟~” “在这个充满着奇迹与希望的世界里，无论是快乐的事，还是欣喜的事，全部，都会再得到延续。” “所以，已经足够了哟~”

details.title: AAS Mos Apocalypse
details.short_description: A small accident was occurred in the laboratory, which lead to an apocalypse. Not just an apocalypse, but a 'mos apocalypse'. What's a Mos? It's is a bigger version of a mosquito. Those mos are the reason many people have gone missing. Play as every member of the AAS team and stop the apocalypse!

details.title: Cosmorons
details.short_description: The Overlord demands you Conquer the Universe! Grab your friends in a 1-4 co-op roguelite shooter and deploy as grappling robot Drudges. Battle the alien swarms, complete missions and destroy the Cosmos! Stack outrageous upgrades to build the Ultimate Drudges or delve deeper into the Universe!

details.title: Beautiful in Death
details.short_description: A first-person game with a focus on dialogue and historical accuracy, set in the Victorian Era. You will step into the shoes of a photographer with a stern mustache who specializes in post-mortem photography. The game is emotionally heavy, melancholic, and full of skeletons in the closet.

details.title: Brickhaven
details.short_description: Create your gang from nothing. Start off with just yourself and take it from a single member to a sprawling criminal empire. Extort businesses, deal drugs, sell guns, and much more. Customize your gang to partake in whatever crimes you want them to. What kind of boss will you be?

details.title: The Neath
details.short_description: Beneath you go. Below the bones of the earth and lower into the darkness. Find your way through twisting passages past vile monsters. Explore, discover and conquer your way to greater depths and greater rewards.

details.title: Blood Being 2
details.short_description: Work has ended. Something told you to find the tower. You can only get in by obliterating your brain. What comes next?

details.title: Far Away Kingdom
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade gallery shooter inspired by Wild Guns and Cabal. Play solo or in local co-op, switch between fire and ice, dodge intense bullet patterns, and take down powerful bosses. Unlock hidden routes, discover secret encounters, and chase high scores.

details.title: Crowned Games
details.short_description: A party game collection for groups of 2–8. Six wildly different minigames, one shared lobby. Bring your own images, audio, and quizzes — or just jump in and play.

details.title: Arthur’s Tale
details.short_description: Guide Arthur through a world that’s out to get him! Sprint, leap, and faceplant your way through a vibrant adventure overflowing with devious traps, oversized bosses, and enough "Try Again" screens to last a lifetime. It’s colorful, it’s chaotic, and yes—you’re probably going to fail. A lot.

details.title: Whose Story (아무개전)
details.short_description: A Korean-style action roguelike set in a dark Joseon-inspired world. Fight supernatural enemies and survive ever-changing dungeons.

details.title: Flaming Fried Nutrition: Daydream
details.short_description: You raise a living hamburger as a pet. Adopt more hamburgers.

details.title: RWR:Renegade
details.short_description: Hand-to-hand combat, firearms, and an upgradable motorcycle against mimic worms. Play as a biker nomad who crushes everything in his path to the sound of rock-chip tunes.

details.title: The Gunner’s Campaign
details.short_description: Command a Napoleonic artillery battery from Austerlitz to Waterloo. Lay your bearing, read the fall of shot, keep the gun drill going under counter-battery fire, and earn your promotions across twenty historical missions.

details.title: The End of Magic
details.short_description: Explore a world where magic is falling into wicked hands in this top-down action adventure. Cast spells to fight enemies, break barriers, and pull distant levers. Absorb magic from fallen foes, or rely on your staff when it runs dry.

details.title: Deadly Voyage
details.short_description: A chaotic murder party aboard 1930s ocean liners. As a passenger, you must find and kill your target. But be careful. Someone is also hunting you. Bonk your target with a champagne bottle, drop a chandelier on them, or slip them a wallet that goes bang. Just don't let security see.

details.title: NUMISMATOR
details.short_description: A cozy digging and coin-collecting game with the three felt puppets of the Balanzone Troupe. Dig to a rhythm while your companions race each coin to the bucket, or teleport it there. Every coin is real history, with a museum photo and its own story in the troupe's travel log.

name: Brick by Brick: Build and Play

details.title: Brick by Brick: Build and Play
details.short_description: Become a brick creator and bring your ideas to life, one brick at a time. Design custom models, working vehicles and moving dioramas. Build, test and play alone or with friends. Your imagination is the limit!

details.title: The Hollow Moors
details.short_description: Halloween, 1999. A camping trip on the Yorkshire moors, then the fog rolled in and your friends vanished. Chop wood, scavenge supplies and keep the fire burning through the night, because the boggarts and lampers want it out. Cozy folk horror survival, solo or with friends.

details.title: Log to Lodge: Carpentry Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a single tree into a whole house. Log to Lodge is a cozy woodworking and carpentry sim: fell trees, run your own sawmill, plane lumber into planks, build furniture for village customers and grow your workshop.

details.title: PUFF-N: Proto-Utility Flying Forager-Navigator
details.short_description: Fly around as PUFF-N, a robotic puffin designed to help restimulate a dying ecosytem. Explore a colorful, stylized open world, dive into the water to catch as many fish as you can, and learn more about the alternate future where PUFF-N lives.

details.title: Stay Tuned
details.short_description: A narrative broadcast-desk game: cut cameras, bleep swearing, and fill every second of live TV by day, then go home to your family by night. When the war starts on air, you decide what the country sees.

details.title: Shelter for Stalkers
details.short_description: Lead a community of survivors in a post-apocalyptic bunker. Overcome scarcity, grow the economy, earn money, and choose your own path in politics and governance. Make your shelter thrive: money and influence are not the goal, but the means to fulfill your ultimate mission—saving the world

details.title: Tethered Dread: The Blind Spot
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your fear gives you away. Search for an exit from a system that harvests human terror, resist an invisible tether, and use your imagination to outwit its faceless custodians. They will not kill you. But you can break.

details.title: Homeland Reclaim
details.short_description: A roguelike RTS where any warrior can wield any weapon! Build a deck of fantasy fighters, arm them with swords, spears and hammers, unleash mighty spells and win fast-paced battles where the whole battlefield fits on one screen.

details.title: 通魂纸 Tonghun Paper
details.short_description: Tonghun Paper is a first-person horror exploration game. Search for clues, read old letters, and piece together a hidden past while evading danger.

details.title: Terramiasma
details.short_description: Terramiasma is an extraction adventure game where you play as a Prospector exploring the dangerous regions of Terra, a planet covered in a toxic gas known as the Miasma. Gather resources, fight off numerous creatures, and above all... survive!

details.title: INFRAMON
details.short_description: INFRAMON® is a first-person Lovecraftian horror game that combines adventure, exploration, combat and puzzles to tell a psychological horror story for adults set in the Cthulhu Mythos in the 1920s, near Barcelona.

details.title: Unstitched
details.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

details.title: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain
details.short_description: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain. You know BranchCorps’ computer systems better than anyone. Now the AI it once used for medical research is trying to break out. Scour company documents, dig into personnel files, and solve expert-level puzzles to shut down the AI. And to uncover who is trying to stop you.

details.title: LASTWORLD
details.short_description: LASTWORLD™ (Early Access) is an old-school inspired RTS, fast-paced, chaotic voxel fusion. Built for multiplayer and competitive play. Unlock generals, skins, and items. Build your own unique playstyle to wreak havoc on the battlefield!

details.title: Workshop Keeper
details.short_description: You bought the cheapest plot of land in town. Then the first tax bill arrived. Gather, craft, automate. Link your workshops into a trade network, ship goods across the sea, and get rich enough to show the City-State who's boss.

details.title: Echo Ridge
details.short_description: Echo Ridge is a first-person mystery set around a quiet remote forest caught in a time loop. Explore, climb, and gather what you need to find a way out before first light. If you don't make it, there's always tomorrow. OR you don't have to escape if you don't wanna. You could just hang out.

details.title: Tower Reborn
details.short_description: The fires of the North burn once more. Zar'Keth's hordes are sweeping over the kingdom, and only you can bar their way. Raise your towers, forge them into weapons of war, send your heroes charging in and rain your powers down on the enemy. Hold the line. Take back the kingdom!

details.title: Panda Flora
details.short_description: A cozy first-person game where you run your own flower shop. Grow flowers in your garden, make bouquets by hand to match your customers' wishes, and grow your shop step by step. Unlock new flowers and complete your album.

details.title: Racing Season Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a racing team for a full season. Plan your next move, make the big decisions, and lead your team towards success.

details.title: RATS!! - Co-op Tower Defense
details.short_description: The rats found the barn. All of them. Grab up to three friends, run out among your towers and hold the farm against hordes of thousands: build mid-wave, cable two machines into a fire lane, bowl the survivors to a hungry catfish. Solo, couch or online co-op. Then the kings arrive.

details.title: We're Gonna Die
details.short_description: A goofy co-op game where you and 1 to 4 friends play Gladiators in a wild Roman coliseum. You must survive the dangers, the crowd, and the backstabbing of your "friends". Everyone is an enemy, and everything is a weapon.

details.title: Misty and the Last Breeze
details.short_description: Platform it, then skate it. Jump, wall-run and vine-swing through bright hand-built stages, then call your air board mid-run to grind vines, ride waterfalls and kickflip across canyons. Chain it all into one fast line and chase the gold time.

details.title: World of ALPA
details.short_description: Explore a pixel-art world with magical Kaka companions. Build a cozy home, tend an ancient tree, and craft tools and weapons. Brave dungeons and protect each other in battle. With Alpa by your side, recover lost memories and uncover the mystery of a changing world.

details.title: BATTROPICA
details.short_description: Treasure at sea, pleasure by night. A single-player action adventure about Mia's 10-billion-gold debt. Hunt treasure, battle, work and invest to grow your earnings. Build fame, buy bigger ships and reach new islands, then unwind with flirty fun. No interest, no deadline. Sail on after repayment.

details.title: flingkeep
details.short_description: Grab invaders. Fling them skyward. Smash them into each other. Defend a growing castle across 150 sieges with weighty physics, strange enemies, brutal chain reactions and devastating magic. Keep the walls. Break the world.

details.title: Tricolore: Learn French
details.short_description: Learn French at every level in a cozy, illustrated adventure. Explore 8,000 verbs, 2,000 grammar exercises and everyday conversations. Discover French classics, history and exam practice. Build your listening, speaking, reading and writing skills. Fully offline.

details.title: The Oink
details.short_description: A thriller about free will. Perform the daily livestock slaughter, find ways to escape, or try to uncover the truth. FORGET AND OBEY ███████

details.title: Line & Lode
details.short_description: Cast the mining claw, tune its pull, and haul ore before the chain snaps. Choose routes, upgrade your rig, and build a camp across eight regions.

details.title: Dungeon Parkour Block Puzzle Adventure 2
details.short_description: Use blocks falling from the ceiling to build a path for the adventurer. Uncover the mystery why the blocks keep falling from the ceiling. Solve the puzzles and finally the mystery. The puzzle adventure continues.

details.title: Wrong Way Buddy
details.short_description: Drive the wrong way down a packed highway. Skim bumpers for CLOSE calls, fire BOOST to smash through traffic, or FREEZE time and slip through the gaps. Runs last seconds. Most end in a fireball. Retry is one key, and the ATTEMPT counter in the sky keeps count.

details.title: Sol Mortum
details.short_description: Fight through a hand-painted world of creatures and guardians with weapons and spells you've created to find the source of its unexplained decline in this twin-class ARPG dungeon crawler from the 3-person indie studio Nightwake.

details.title: Restora: A Poster Restoration Game
details.short_description: Step into your workshop and give vintage movie posters a second chance. In this calming restoration sim, restore as many posters as you can before the day ends. Inspect each poster, repair damage through mini games, and bring it back to glory. How many posters can you save in time?

details.title: Goblin Industries
details.short_description: Ever wanted to be a hard-working goblin? Me neither, but here we are. Every goblin dreams of the easy life on the surface, and to get there you’ve got to put in your shift. This is your chance. Come underground with us: mine, smelt, and get the factory running.

details.title: Bear’s Desktop Cake Shop
details.short_description: Run a cozy cake shop in a corner of your desktop! Grow ingredients, build automated production lines, and hire little bear couriers to deliver delicious cakes to adorable animal customers. Discover recipes and grow your shop while you work, study, or unwind.

details.title: The Anomaly Inspector : Hotel Anatolia
details.short_description: Congratulations, you have been hired as the new Anomaly Inspector for Hotel Anatolia. Good Luck!

details.title: Metaversus
details.short_description: A round-based 4v4 competitive shooter. Build defenses and routes, buy weapons and gadgets, then fight for territory with one life per round. Surviving structures carry into the next build phase. Request playtest access below.

details.title: Baleful Tactics
details.short_description: You are a demon lord, using history’s famous dead to climb the ranks of Hell. Their traits determine your play style. Death leaves them with a wound. Decide who to save, star-up, gear up or sacrifice for more power. Achilles, Genghis Khan and Cleopatra, await your command!

details.title: Revenant Dusk
details.short_description: A top-down zombie survival game for solo or online co-op with up to 8 players. Scavenge a vast procedural world by day: craft, farm, fortify, build vehicles and level skills as you use them. Every Horde Night is bigger than the last. How many sunrises can you see?

details.title: 战国立志传
details.short_description: 《Warring States:Path of Power》 is a role-playing game set in ancient China’s Warring States period. Play as a historical figure and experience their story, or create your own character and begin life as an ordinary person.

details.title: Idle Wardens
details.short_description: A pixel-art fantasy idle RPG. Walk the Knight and Wizard paths as one Warden, turn your estate into a self-running production line, and push north through fog-covered lands toward the Abyssal Anchor. Progress keeps going while you are away.

details.title: Mikitti: Pirate Cats
details.short_description: Four cats, one pirate ship! Team up in 4-player co-op to steer, shoot, resupply and repair. Battle the navy and a giant Kraken. Grab more loot or sail home safe? Pick your skin, grow beautiful Cat Tower Island, and build new ships and weapons for bold adventures with friends!

details.title: 末日後書店
details.short_description: The perfect AI shut down without warning. Without its guidance, technology regressed, society crumbled, energy ran short, and the world fell into chaos. As a bookstore owner, listen to customers' stories with your android partner, offering food and the scent of books as a brief respite.

details.title: Curiopia: Fresh Finds Daily
details.short_description: Here is a tiny island on a shallow sea, where animals sail in for curious finds. Build your world and shop from voxels; fish, cook, and stock your shelves. Invite friends to build and live together. A slow, cozy island life in pen and wash.

details.title: 1999 Lockdown Unit
details.short_description: Autumn 1999: A rainy night, a sudden quarantine. As a virus mutates your neighbors, barricade your apartment, survive the lockdown routine, and outlast the nightmare.

details.title: Overflow: Roguelite Network Builder
details.short_description: A tense minimalist network roguelite. Draw Traces between Nodes, let your Runners carry Signals to your Hubs, and hold the system together as pressure escalates. One overloaded Node ends the run, instantly and permanently. Upgrade between Cycles, trigger emergency abilities, and delay the crash.

details.title: Engines of Hate
details.short_description: You're a mercenary space-ship captain. Drop war machines and infantry from orbit, call down orbital strikes, and micro every unit in slow motion. No base building, no mining, just combat. Every unit you lose costs Credits to replace.

details.title: JoustVille
details.short_description: A ruined name, an empty manor, a single horse. It's all that's left. Bond with your horse, take up the lance, and ride into a world that watched your family fall, but hasn't heard of you. Yet. Will you be a knight to remember? A medieval jousting RPG of horses, heraldry, and reputation.

details.title: Paintra
details.short_description: Leap, roll, and swing through a vibrant watercolour world under threat by the spreading Smudge! Master momentum-based platforming, launch yourself with a trusty boomerang, and chain moves together to unlock secrets in this challenging, physics-infused 2D platforming adventure.

details.title: C.C.C.: Contract Cleaning
details.short_description: You're a contract janitor in Cosmo Clean Co.'s Contract Cleaning division. Your weapons fire on their own. Your real job is vacuuming up shards, filling pods, and hitting today's quota. Then call your ride home and make it aboard alive. Solo or co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Super Optimal Amount of Punching
details.short_description: Punch everything. Learn nothing. Lord Evil's shining nipples await you.

details.title: Dalam Kelam: The Night Shift
details.short_description: Welcome to the night shift. Your tasks are simple: follow the nightly janitorial routine and ignore all disturbances. Last seven nights to earn your transfer to headquarters.

details.title: CANNABIS
details.short_description: Beast-themed drug novel RPG

details.title: Paws Up!
details.short_description: A challenging precision platformer where cats jump up dark, ominous and fantasy type environments. Master tight jumps and timing, customize your cat with collectible outfits, and seek out what awaits for your cat at the top!

details.title: About Bullshit
details.short_description: A STUPID 3D PLATFORMER WITH FOCUS ON WEIRD VISUALS AND HUMOURISTIC ENCOUNTERS AND A LOT OF COOL HATS TO COLLECT

details.title: Dither Cleaning World
details.short_description: Dither Cleaning World is a relaxing 1‑bit pixel cleaning game. Use different tools – brush, water gun, vacuum – to wash away dither dirt in themed worlds like City, Game World and more. Discover hidden eggs, trigger funny penalties. Just click and clean, no stress.

name: Cast of the Three Kingdoms: Rise

details.title: Cast of the Three Kingdoms: Rise
details.short_description: Cast Of The Three Kingdoms ：Rise is a Three Kingdoms-themed, diorama-style turn-based tactical RPG that blends enemy capturing, loot grinding, and equipment crafting.

details.title: Let Us Cook
details.short_description: A chaotic physics-based co-op cooking game for up to 4 players. Scavenge ingredients, mash them together by hand, and race to feed an ever-hungry volcano before it feeds on you instead.

details.title: Battle Quads
details.short_description: Command a squad of six specialists in explosive 4v4 multiplayer battles. Make real-time tactical decisions as a commander, or take direct control of any specialist at critical moments.

details.title: Holod
details.short_description: You are an American spy. But cold and hunger don’t care who you are. Maintain a Soviet polar station, analyze samples and venture into uncharted Antarctica. Master the work of a polar researcher to survive. And keep your cover — the KGB is always watching.

details.title: Dry Jerky
details.short_description: You owe $100 in rent. You have $10. You have 5 days. Dry Jerky is a survival RPG set in Oasis, a desert city with a rat problem, a shady snack industry, and a cast of characters you probably shouldn't trust. Find work, make questionable decisions, and try not to starve before the landlord shows up.

details.title: Carbon Rain
details.short_description: Explore a beautiful yet dangerous post-apocalyptic pixel-art world. Step out of your bunker, battle mutated creatures, gather resources, upgrade your oxygen reserves and weapons, and push deeper into new, increasingly dangerous biomes.

details.title: FROM THE DUGOUT
details.short_description: Manage your team to glory in this text-based football manager. Win trophies, master the transfer market, and live the life of a real coach. Balance locker room egos, manage your personal wealth, and work your way up to buying your own club. Your life off the pitch matters!

details.title: Anvil United!
