details.short_description: Anvil United! is a action-adventure for up to four players focused on crafting, management and skill. Gather materials, follow recipes, avoid hazards, optimize and manage your team. Become a legendary blacksmith and save the Kingdom!

details.title: A Simple job 2
details.short_description: 💼 One simple task. Countless choices. But what if your job was never the real objective? 😏 Experience absurd humor, discover bizarre endings, unlock achievements, and uncover what's really hiding behind it all.

details.title: Creara Select
details.short_description: Creara is a spider woman with eight distinct personalities, held captive in a military facility. Investigate her biology over seven days and choose her fate in this biological-investigation romance adventure.

details.title: Nightshift Remastered
details.short_description: Welcome to the Nightshift! Spend six nights at a totally normal office job in this branching narrative. Bond with your dayshift coworker, uncover fantastical mysteries, and experience unexpected transformations. With an optional card game and plenty of endings, what will you make of your time here?

details.title: More BrainZ
details.short_description: You lost your job and your home. All that's left is an old camper... until the zombie apocalypse turns your rock bottom into humanity's last nightmare. After isolation, depression, and anxiety, you decide to Survive. Scavenge. Fight. (¬ ´ཀ` )¬

details.title: King of the School
details.short_description: A transfer student with amnesia arrives at Myeongcheong High. Beneath its peaceful days lies a brutal night power struggle of bullies, gangsters, and corrupt elites. Uncover lost memories to unlock skills and fight the dynamic evil. Stand by, or conquer this brutal ecosystem?

details.title: Synemancy
details.short_description: Sling spells to overwhelm your opponents in card-based online duels, or immerse in a deep single-player story about the pursuit of knowledge and power, where every choice matters. Stake your very mind and become a Synemancer!

details.title: Drowned Echo
details.short_description: Drowned Echo is a narrative-driven VR horror experience in which you explore a sunken ship, using your hands to swim, interact with tools, and uncover a Lovecraftian presence that is corrupting the environment.

details.title: Camping Keeper
details.short_description: Build your campground from the ground up: tent sites, cabins, showers, pools, and the pipes and power lines behind them. Watch autonomous campers live, complain... and review you. Set prices, hire staff, and climb from a muddy one-star field to a five-star resort.

details.title: Boungeon
details.short_description: A block-breaker-inspired roguelite deckbuilder where you blast enemies with bouncing magical projectiles. Combine projectiles, skills, and relics to create your own strategy and conquer the dungeon.

details.title: Novella Oscura Reverie
details.short_description: Novella Oscura Reverie is a dark fantasy RPG set in the ruined kingdom of Albion and the mysterious Dreaming Realms of humanity. Explore a dying world, uncover its darkest secrets, and face enemies in a unique combat system that seamlessly blends real-time action with turn-based strategy.

details.title: Gniewomir
details.short_description: Open-world RPG with deck-building elements allowing you to combat weird enemies in a weird world where you play as weird characters. Go punch a dog for being ugly, or a stork for being horny. You can even punch a dinosaur!

details.title: AMATERASU【 天照 】
details.short_description: A dramatic bullet hell shooter where you master your Shot, Bomb, and the Yatano Kagami System, which transmutes enemy bullets into resources, as you fight to overthrow AMATERASU, the Stellar Management System that has launched its assault on humanity.

details.title: Archmage Divine
details.short_description: Archmage Divine is a 2D RPG featuring strategic card-based combat and deckbuilding. Explore vast cities and kingdoms, gather unique items and equipment, and enhance your deck as you progress on your journey. If you’re just looking to battle, our Roguelike mode is available at any time.

details.title: PLEASE EXPLAIN
details.short_description: You are a corporate internal affairs investigator. Confront suspects, sift through records, and expose lies behind fraud and harassment. Punish or pardon? Your word dictates their fate.

details.title: Bacon Cannibal
details.short_description: EVERYTHING IS GOOD IN THE PIG! Run your own pork restaurant, cook delicious pork recipes for your customers, expand your menu, manage your stock, grow your restaurant, and build your rind empire!

details.title: Nowhere Dawn
details.short_description: Nowhere Dawn is a survival action game set in a collapsed world. Move through cities and towns haunted by the infected, and follow the traces left behind by those who disappeared.

details.title: Operation Serval
details.short_description: Operation Serval is a tactical multiplayer armored warfare game where you command tanks and combat vehicles against enemy teams on realistic battlefields, where positioning and precision decide the outcome.

details.title: Ghostarium
details.short_description: Ghostarium blends haunted house management, ghost catching, and otherworldly exploration. Venture into another world and capture ghosts to work in your haunted house! Build your ghost collection, expand your attraction, and turn visitors’ screams into cash!

details.title: Night Mass
details.short_description: You’re a Priest defending your Church from the horrors that come each night. Gather resources, explore the forest, and build your defenses while the sun is still shining. When darkness falls, stand your ground, survive until dawn, and let the Night Mass begin!

details.title: Canal Tycoon
details.short_description: Canal Tycoon is a unique transport builder set in the canal’s golden age, with mechanics not seen elsewhere in the genre. Move industry’s goods across period-map landscapes, manage contested water, politics and rivals, automate operations to reduce grind, then survive the railroads.

details.title: Pale Cantons
details.short_description: A first-person sandbox RPG set in a secluded canton ringed by impassable mountains. Learn trades, fight, barter, earn the locals’ trust, and search for your missing sister but remember: the only way out leads through an ever-changing labyrinth.

details.title: RETROBOTS
details.short_description: The year is 2109, and RETROBOTS is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to KICK SOME BOT?

details.title: VeilRaun
details.short_description: Become an Explorer of fractured realities in Veil Raun, a third-person dark fantasy action RPG. Take expeditions beyond the Veil, battle Hollows, rise through the Explorer ranks, and uncover the mystery behind the Fracture.

name: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes

details.title: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes
details.short_description: Little Boy, a narrative game where you play as a robot assistant helping people find happiness!

details.title: Dimensional Breach
details.short_description: 4-player online co-op. The rifts are open, and every dimension hides a different threat. Dive in with your friends, tear the nightmare out by its roots and seal the breach or be lost to the dark.

details.title: Marrowood
details.short_description: Haunted by the suppressed memories of your childhood, you receive a letter from the town you grew up in. They need you to rebuild your family's farm. It's time to remember, welcome home.

details.title: Rogue Fortune
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where your treasure is your health bar. Gamble your gold for the power to survive a hostile temple that wants it back. Arrange geometric relics into a puzzle grid to build devastating synergies.

details.title: Gummy Tummy
details.short_description: A co-op mining game set in a world made of candy. Bite tunnels through gummy terrain, haul loot and a bellyful of sugar back to the hub, then craft sharper teeth, bigger stomachs and soda-bottle jetpacks to dig deeper. Push past your tier and your teeth corrode go see the dentist!

details.title: 3100: Far from Earth
details.short_description: Stranded far from Earth in the year 3100, repair your ship, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what waits beyond the stars in a hand-drawn sci-fi point-and-click adventure.

details.title: Card Shop Duelist
details.short_description: Run your own trading card shop. Rip packs chasing the big pull, price the shelves, hire staff, and duel your customers in Battleforge, a full TCG built into the game. Play solo or with up to seven friends online.

details.title: IconicQuest
details.short_description: For players who remember when MMOs respected their time. A pixel-art, top-down MMORPG with real-time skill combat, branching class specializations, and loot worth keeping. Built solo, in the open.

details.title: Minesweeper Maker
details.short_description: Minesweeper Maker is a grid based logic game where you can play and create countless puzzles with friends and the community.

details.title: NOEMATICA: Digital Dollhouse
details.short_description: Behold the humble Noem! Beguiling and silly-pilled, fully customizable, monstrous or adorable: with an n-dimensional vector space of fantasies and memories. An urban digital dollhouse, constructed top-to-bottom with a focus on simulation fidelity.

details.title: Keeper of The Strait
details.short_description: You are the gatekeeper of a vital strait. Inspect manifests, collect fees, and block hostile ships in this hybrid of bureaucratic simulation and tower defense. When diplomacy fails, deploy tanks and bunkers to protect your base.

name: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机

details.title: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机
details.short_description: If life’s pressure were a physical shredder, could you outrun it? > Balance Health and Wealth on a razor’s edge in this minimalist survival-gambit. Utilize "Class-based Speed" to outsmart Death. Can you tear through the veil and reveal the truth behind the machine before your strength fails?

details.title: Veil of the Black Ark
details.short_description: A classic fixed-camera survival horror game set in a cursed medieval town. Search for your missing sister, solve puzzles, survive the roaming dead and unveil the secrets of the Black Ark.

details.title: THE SHOW
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror extraction gameshow. Enter deadly labyrinths, solve puzzles, steal valuable loot, and build a fortune for the masses' entertainment. Push your luck, go deeper, and extract before you lose everything...

details.title: Gravitten VR
details.short_description: Grab, climb, and turn your world upside down! Become Gravitten, the gravity-defying kitten, and master the environment's shifting physics. Experience 5 distinct biomes where up is down and left is right.

details.title: SIDEROS
details.short_description: Iron, the fundamental element of the world, was cursed by the magic lords of earth, water, air and fire to rust. In this high fantasy turn-based RPG you take the role of the iron knight in his quest to stop rust from destroying the world.

details.title: PODER
details.short_description: Run a district in a 12-million Latin American megacity in a political strategy about power, compromise, and dirty deals. 100+ starting combos, 75 population groups, and no decision without consequences. Can you do better than those you love to hate?

details.title: Travel the Backrooms
details.short_description: "Travel the Backrooms" is a horror puzzle game that supports 1-4 players! Explore a variety of levels, solve the unique puzzles of each level, and be careful not to get caught by the "Entities"...

details.title: Cyber Demon Protocol
details.short_description: An antique computer has granted you the ability to summon cyber demons. Seeking power from demons is like dancing on a tightrope, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil, how will you choose? Will you collude with the wealthy, politicians, stars, and artists, or change this decadent society?

details.title: Plesiotopia
details.short_description: A wholesome marine sanctuary sim, where you take care of giant sea reptiles from the dinosaur era. Nurse ichtyosaurs, plesiosaurs and mosasaurs, train them for the wild, then search the Pacific Ocean for a suitable marine ecosystem where you can release them.

details.title: ESCAPE: Orphanage
details.short_description: A psychological thriller set in Scarlet Orphanage, where every choice shapes the fate of the residents. Nothing is as it seems. Are you facing ghosts… or something far worse?

details.title: Backpack Roguelike
details.short_description: Arrange, merge, and synergize gear inside a growing backpack, then survive real-time waves and brutal bosses. Every slot shapes your build in this strategic action roguelite with persistent progression. Experiment, adapt, and turn limited space into your strongest weapon.

details.title: Slime Game
details.short_description: Slime Game is a retro rage platformer for the modern day! Run and jump through over 70 levels, all while collecting power-ups, stomping enemies, and finding hidden collectibles.

details.title: Franky Psychedelic Adventure
details.short_description: Join Franky on an epic journey across breathtaking dimensions to reclaim the stolen cookies. Harness powerful psychedelic abilities to overcome challenges, master impossible obstacles, and conquer extraordinary worlds.

details.title: Alight
details.short_description: Photograph birds, decorate your lighthouse, and find companionable peace in Alight, a heartfelt cozy adventure about aging and absence

details.title: The Evaluation
details.short_description: A first-person horror puzzle game about solving cryptic puzzles and surviving a deadly night inside an abandoned drive-in theater.

details.title: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cook your strategy. As a Cook, manage your Hero’s Appetite and Cholesterol, and build powerful combos with food cards and kitchen tools.

details.title: Stellar Fixer
details.short_description: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

details.title: My Perfect Nails
details.short_description: My Perfect Nails is a retro simulation game inspired by the 2000's web games, where you create the perfect set of nails for your customers! Choose between many options and accessories to create the nails of their dreams! ✨🌸

details.title: Desolation Arcanist
details.short_description: Craft your own magic in this Action Roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

details.title: Scriven Mage
details.short_description: The only VR game where you cast spells by actually writing them. VR spellcasting PvP/PvE. Write real glyphs in the spellbook to prepare spells. Find every combination. Master the art.

name: Yokai Batting Game in Kawagoe おまつりようかいバッティングゲーム in KAWAGOE

details.title: Yokai Batting Game in Kawagoe おまつりようかいバッティングゲーム in KAWAGOE
details.short_description: Blast yokai away with just one button! A fast and satisfying one-button casual action game set in Kawagoe! Hit the yokai. Save Kawagoe. There’s only one control. Hit! Hit! Home run! Smash them out of the park! Save the souls of the cursed yokai!! Bring peace back to Kawagoe with your bat!

details.title: Keep Making
details.short_description: Keep Making is a fantasy room builder fit for the creation of old-timey castles, cozy corners, and trap-filled dungeons. Design and decorate without goals, to relax or to prep for tabletop play. Then, export and share.

details.title: Iron of Dust
details.short_description: The SciFi shooter that makes you think twice.

details.title: Up'N'Up: Mountain Express
details.short_description: Join the Up'N'Up delivery crew, upgrade your vehicles and climb the mountain in this off-road driving roguelike. Look after your vehicle to overcome any challenges the mountain and delivery items can throw at you. Climb solo or tackle the mountain with friends locally or online.

details.title: UpUpApple
details.short_description: A stage-clear 3D action game! Control an apple, overcome traps, and defeat the final boss. Roll, bounce, and dash through linear courses. Too hard? Use Leaf coins to spin the Gacha for helpful items! Use their power to crush the boss and claim victory!

details.title: HOSHiN ENGi Re:surrection
details.short_description: Wield mythic treasures, ride spirit beasts, and hack and slash through ever-shifting dungeons in an all-new roguelite steeped in Chinese myth, based on Ryu Fujisaki's Weekly Shonen Jump manga. A new hero, a new story, thirty years on.

details.title: Rotted - A Brain Rot Simulator
details.short_description: Rotted is a chaotic time-survival game about doomscrolling your way through an endless list of chores. Use your phone to earn cash and build broken upgrade combos while managing hunger, anxiety, and the chaos around you.

details.title: Last Float
details.short_description: Explore and survive in this shattered world. Build, defend, and repair your raft. Search for secrets and uncover information about what happened - and most importantly, don't drown!

details.title: Yuzutsu
details.short_description: Samurais. Ninjas. Snow monkeys. Hot springs. You are Taomaru, a capybara monk who treats every battle like a minor inconvenience. Casually stroll through a perilous mission, swapping places with enemies to outsmart them and turn their own attacks against them using the ancient art of Yuzutsu.

details.title: Pachinko Realms: Tiki-Taka
details.short_description: Master the pitch in this physics-based soccer pachinko game ! Launch your ball through traditional 3D Pachinko boards, chaining "Tiki-Taka" passes to reach the next stage ! Explore diverse stadium realms, collect tactical power-ups, and face goalkeepers in epic boss fights.

details.title: HITORIASOBI
details.short_description: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

details.title: Hidden Folks 2
details.short_description: Search for hidden folks in interactive miniature landscapes. Scare some giraffes, ride a few rides, appreciate some art, and push around some astronauts. Wheeeeeeee!!!

details.title: Saw-Ker
details.short_description: A fast-paced soccer game with no rules, no referee, and giant spinning saw blades on the field.

details.title: Eco Exodus
details.short_description: 300 years after humanity abandoned Earth, a team returns with one mission: make it habitable again. Explore a devastated planet, restore ecosystems, face dangerous threats, hack forgotten technologies, and uncover what happened during the centuries we were gone.

details.title: Makina
details.short_description: Build. Defend. Automate. MAKIN-A is a top-down shooter merged with deep tower defense and resource management. In a deserted cyberpunk wasteland, you are the last line of defense. Engineer a fleet of mining robots and build your reliable cannons, fortify your base against relentless machine swarms.

details.title: BEAUTY OR THE BEAST
details.short_description: BEAUTY OR THE BEAST is primarily a 2.5D action game, with some rhythm game elements. Defeated enemies become the player's fans. Only the character with the most fans among your allies will get to fight the boss. Otherwise, you'll end up playing a rhythm game. Gain fans and become the main character!

details.title: ScrapCrew: Running on Fumes
details.short_description: Command a squad of distinct personalities in this turn based tactical RPG. Drive armored vehicles through a harsh wasteland, salvage scrap to upgrade your convoy and shape your squad’s combat style and narrative through a dynamic influence system. Can you reclaim what was stolen?

details.title: Clicky Keys
details.short_description: Clicky Keys is a tower defense game where your keyboard is the battlefield. Every key activates a weapon. Fight off enemies and make the right upgrade choices to survive. Can you reach day 20?

details.title: Dendrophobia
details.short_description: A twisted pixel-art horror thriller about death, ancient gods, and a persistent waiter. Explore The Willow’s Embrace hotel, solve puzzles, and gather paranormal evidence. Challenge the madness to find a way out and avoid becoming part of an eternal nightmare.

details.title: Graveyard Warden
details.short_description: Inherit a neglected graveyard, prepare graves, craft coffins and tombstones, and manage daily burials. Restore your cemetery, explore the surrounding area, and uncover the secrets behind your inheritance.

details.title: Trimson
details.short_description: TRIMSON is a system-driven zombie survival game where you play as a rescue operative sent into infected zones to save survivors. Every injury, infection, resource, and survivor lost has lasting consequences.

details.title: The Sworn
details.short_description: A deep US police precinct management simulation. You are the Captain. Hire officers, manage your fleet, respond to a living city, and carry responsibility for every officer under your command. The job has a cost. So does ignoring it.

details.title: Into the Dust
details.short_description: Top-down tactical co-op extraction shooter. Up to four players scavenge, fight, and rebuild in the harsh, post-apocalyptic wastelands of Dust Bowl America.

details.title: Mineral Zone
details.short_description: Build a factory by day, defend it by night. Mine ore, automate it over belts and keep the grid alive, then hold the line with towers your factory feeds and your own ship in the fight. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Novus Terminus: First Flags
details.short_description: Novus Terminus: First Flags is a cozy logistics city builder. Found settlements, design road networks and watch your carriers transport goods from flag to flag. Three unique clans, visible supply chains and a handcrafted low-poly world await you.

details.title: Lynehold
details.short_description: Break through enemy waves and destroy their base in this tug-of-war PvP auto battler inspired by Direct Strike. Counter your opponent, unlock formation bonuses and strengthen your army with items and upgrades. Balance economy with aggression, then watch your strategy unfold. Play 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3.

details.title: Dice Crawler
details.short_description: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

details.title: QuilomboZ: Palmares
details.short_description: Lead elite warriors like Zumbi and Dandara in a real-time tactics game to defend the legendary "Quilombo dos Palmares". Use stealth, terrain, and coordinated abilities to outsmart Portuguese forces and mercenaries. Channel Orisha powers through the Axé system to overcome overwhelming challenges.

details.title: Blightrole
details.short_description: Blightrole is a dice-based game, a role-playing campaign you won’t escape from. Face an original dark fantasy world with a touch of black humor. Will you uncover the Master’s secrets, or will your campaign end before its time?

details.title: ChessBox
details.short_description: The match alternates between 2 minutes of chess and 2 minutes of boxing. First to KO or Checkmate the opponent wins. Brains or brawn? In ChessBox, one will win.

details.title: Pixel Vale
details.short_description: Pixel Vale is a medieval fantasy city-builder game, focused on building up your city while managing external threats. Fight or trade with other cities, explore through the fog of war, and defend against goblin raids. Research new buildings to expand and keep your citizens happy.

details.title: Entered
details.short_description: Entered ■■■■■■■... A retro-style horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

details.title: Ludus Saltuum
details.short_description: A third person 3d platformer! Jump forward, unlock skills and buy upgrades! All at your own pace! Handcrafted levels procedurally presented! How far can you get? 🇧🇷

details.title: UNBIASED
details.short_description: Salvation or Damnation? Measure the worth of human souls in this psychological anime & FMV visual novel about moral dilemma! Will you allow your prejudices to call the shots? Or can you remain unbiased?

details.title: Roots n Roofs
details.short_description: Build whimsical homes within roots and wood, and transform an old stump into a little world. A relaxing sandbox with no pressure - just a quiet, peaceful place and your imagination.

details.title: Until Mom Comes Home
details.short_description: After a tragic event changed his life forever, Ethan moves to Rottenpine with his mother. As strange occurrences begin to shake the town, the boundary between reality and nightmare slowly starts to crumble.

details.title: Gun Game
details.short_description: Gun Game is a tense psychological party game for two friends where trust is too expensive. Bluff, compete in agility and try your luck in dangerous mini-games! Do you trust your friend?

details.title: Knight Vows
details.short_description: KNIGHT VOWS is a dark medieval visual novel set in the 13th century. You are a newly initiated knight of the Order of Saint Féran, a religious order that spreads its faith through iron and blood. Will you remain faithful to your vow... or to your humanity? Your choices will speak for you.

details.title: Kyklos
details.short_description: In this Turn based RPG You must seek out the first gate lost to time. While many myths relate to its existence, only yours will lead to eternal enlightenment. Go out and explore towns, temples, and caves which depths seem to grow stranger the deeper you go.

details.title: Almost At Pity
details.short_description: Almost At Pity is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your gacha pulls define your run! Limit break your characters with limited resources, master powerful synergies, and conquer the final boss

name: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride

details.title: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride
details.short_description: You’re Bigfoot. You have a bicycle. And it’s really hot. Ride across the country with your friends, survive the wilderness, and try not to completely destroy your bike (and yourself) along the way!

details.title: PeachBlossomPastry
details.short_description: Peach Blossom Pastry is a single-player cooking simulation game that lets you enjoy making traditional pastries in first-person, immersive style. There are no customers and no orders. With a recipe in hand and all ingredients ready, all you need to do is to enjoy the pleasure of making pastries.

details.title: MAKINA
details.short_description: In a world where Emotion is energy, a vengeful pilot boards a dangerous, desire-fueled Makina and descends into the emotion-addicted city. Defy the twisted rulers—a scientist, architect, K-pop idol, and director—to tear down their grand plan. A hybrid adventure of mech action and stealth: [MAKINA].

details.title: SHADOW WIZARD MONEY GANG
details.short_description: A game about greed. A chaotic heist co-op roguelike shooter where wizards blast through rooms, gamble with magic, and turn money into health, power, and upgrades. LEGALIZE NUCLEAR BOMBS

details.title: AMIMI
details.short_description: A child and a mysterious creature explore a magical world where every corner hides a surprise. Meet curious characters, experiment with inventive puzzles, and discover a story of friendship, transformation, and nature.

details.title: No Beer Left Behind!
details.short_description: 2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved. But sometimes you need to drink a beer!

details.title: Lock 87
details.short_description: Work the night shift at Lock 87, a canal checkpoint in a brutalist dystopian 1992. Inspect vessels, authorise passage, and earn enough to escape the district - while strange transmissions and security footage suggest you may not be alone.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Classic: Korea
details.short_description: Lead Goguryeo, Baekje, or Silla in 660 in a real-time strategy game with pause and speed control. Manage treasury and provisions, raise armies, and march by land and sea as Tang and Wa pursue their own aims. Command field battles and sieges yourself, and carry every result back to the front.

details.title: Ode to War
details.short_description: A civilization MMO: from a single town to a galactic empire. The server ticks once an hour and keeps running while you sleep. You administer towns, not a nation, so each one holds its own stores and anything you need from a neighbor has to be traded for.

details.title: Ruminate: The First Oath
details.short_description: This is a dark fantasy where the world has been divided and cursed. Your party will go on adventures and have the chance to remove the curses from the kingdoms and unite them! The world depends on you. Will you be their saviour or their downfall?

name: Heroic Hop: The Colorful World of Blocks and the ChromaLords

details.title: Heroic Hop: The Colorful World of Blocks and the ChromaLords
details.short_description: Jump into a vibrant retro platforming adventure! Defeat the five Color Lords, conquer deadly traps, collect Enemy Badges, uncover hidden secrets, and restore the colorful Block Kingdom. Includes a playable demo!

details.title: Yuoh　～Escape from the Empire～
details.short_description: A sleek, fast-paced vertical bullet-hell shooter. Harness a vast arsenal of gear and shatter the tactics of the relentless enemies closing in.

details.title: Moonfeather
details.short_description: While searching for the truth behind the massacre of your home village, you unexpectedly encounter the fallen Moon Goddess; she chooses you and possesses your body, passing on her divine powers. Forced to accept her mission, you must battle your way through waves of monsters, fighting ever deeper.

details.title: Wyrdane
details.short_description: Wyrdane is a tactical online card game where every decision matters. Build unique decks, master strategic battles, collect powerful cards, and outplay your opponents in a dark fantasy world shaped by magic, mystery, and skill.

details.title: Pactum
details.short_description: Summon angels and demons, fuse them and watch them evolve on a floating island. A calm, relaxing incremental to unwind: upgrade without limits, watch your creatures grow, and enjoy the journey at your own pace.

details.title: Blooming Days
details.short_description: Grab your watering can, find some seeds and make the desert around you bloom. - No combat, no death, no timer. Just you, your animals and your garden.

details.title: Electric Noosphere
details.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi RTS. After the Third World War, flesh and machine became one: the Singularians. Following a signal from the Veil, their fleet is torn out of hyperspace and crashes near the source, a world that is already a nest. Two asymmetric factions, one campaign.

details.title: Space Crawlers
details.short_description: Clear out space battlefields using a physics-based grappling hook. Salvage wreckage, recycle it into resources, upgrade your equipment, and grow your salvage business to unlock increasingly lucrative contracts.

details.title: Hordia
details.short_description: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

details.title: Heavenlode
details.short_description: The online scifi roguelike. Conquer planets, foil other players, create game-breaking builds, and secure the Heavenlode.

details.title: Orbital Strike
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of orbital warfare. Build satellites, launch them into chosen orbits, and fight for control of the sky. Your assets stay invisible until an enemy sensor finds them. Every strike depends on being overhead at the right moment.

details.title: A Week to Remember
details.short_description: Help Elliot recover his memories and unlock the truth of what happened before it's too late. A Mexican-American gothic, queer visual novel, featuring interactive spell crafting and point-and-click exploration.

name: Give It Up for The Last Time!

details.title: Give It Up for The Last Time!
details.short_description: Go through rapid-fire seconds long microgames to uncover the mystery of Radio Valley in this visual novel take on the microgame genre!

details.title: Stream Snipers
details.short_description: Stream Snipers is a multiplayer battle game about doing ANYTHING for content! Fight your friends for followers, grow your totally real audience, get rich taking on ridiculous challenges from chat, and strive to stay alive in the deadliest live competition.

details.title: Sound of Space
details.short_description: A first-person music producer sim trillions of miles from home. Create music with TRAX Audio Engine: no theory, just tweak the dials until it sounds right. Press tracks to cassette, find aliens that like your music, solo or with friends. Beware the black hole in the sky: it's only a matter of time.

name: FORGIVE THIS VESSEL and All Harm It May Cause

details.title: FORGIVE THIS VESSEL and All Harm It May Cause
details.short_description: Bodies appear and disappear in a small town. A robot writhes under stolen flesh. A woman bears witness to her own apathy. FORGIVE THIS VESSEL and All Harm It May Cause is a supernatural visual novel about connections in a small town.

details.title: Void Inspector
details.short_description: Void Inspector is a hands-on deep-space customs simulator. Operate heavy machinery, sweep vessels with tactical scanners, cross-reference paperwork, and deliver your verdict. Just remember: every switch you flip is billed to your account.

details.title: Democracy Simulator
details.short_description: Lead one of several political parties through fully simulated elections, where your decisions and policies affect the outcome! The economy is also simulated and will affect elections! Form a coalition government, write laws, pass a budget, respond to events, and more! Made without AI.

details.title: Dead Link
details.short_description: An aging encrypted terminal. A past deliberately erased. Follow the guidance, solve puzzles one by one, and close in on a buried truth. Who used this computer before you? What happened to them? And now, it is your turn.

details.title: What Iron Cannot Hold
details.short_description: Something impossible is clawing its way through an industrial containment machine. In this 360° ricochet roguelite, weaponize every rebound and build a run powerful enough to force Khaos back into the dark.

details.title: The Pale Banner
details.short_description: Your Father, The king of all of Aldrain, was slain and his crown broken into five pieces by his betrayers when you were only a small child. After many years of training, you set out with your band of followers, The New Order of Light, to take back your throne.

details.title: Dustium
details.short_description: Dustium is a turn-based tactics roguelite where you analyze enemy actions and plan multiple moves for three characters in advance. You may know what the enemy will do, but predicting the outcome is up to you.

details.title: Deadly Bloodline
details.short_description: Survive the horrors of Angel Hill as James K. Sam and his family. As they struggle to escape the city, they must face murderous demons and fight for their lives! In this pixel art survival horror adventure, will you help James and his family make it out of Angel Hill alive?

name: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－

details.title: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－
details.short_description: Make music with apples in a world of fairy tales. Connect different kinds of apples with a single stroke to create chains and complete challenges. Play puzzles like little pieces of sheet music, and wander through familiar stories. But something is strange… the characters are turning into wolves…?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: Alchemist is a re-playable narrative game which puts you in the shoes of an Alchemist in a medieval fantasy world. Craft potions, earn Tarot Cards, and seek knowledge, taking what you learn into the next playthrough to unlock hidden secrets.

details.title: Islands Collide
details.short_description: Islands Collide is a bullet-heaven roguelite about ramming islands. Crash into other islands to weld them on for good, clear whoever lives there, and grow bigger with every crash, until the sea raises a living continent to swallow you.

details.title: Order Of The Jarl
details.short_description: Answer the Jarl's summons and wield magic and blades in shifting dungeons to rescue the Right Hand from the Archdruid. In this first-person dungeon crawler, delve into '90s-inspired combat, loot items, face strange creatures, and unforeseen danger in a roguelike world where death = starting over.

details.title: Fleeting Light
details.short_description: Fleeting Light is a speedrun platformer. Racing through dark and gloomy cities, cut off from the Selfish Sun's light, across 50+ short, dopamine-fueled courses. Beat levels. Then beat your best time. Then crush everyone else's.

details.title: 無慈悲な笑顔Re
details.short_description: A remake of an exploration-based adventure game about gods and girls. Return once more to their story—and uncover the truths that were never told.

details.title: Your Complaint Has Been Received
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure about municipal maintenance. The pipes leak, the van's broken down, and you're the new boss. Explore courtyards and offices, deal with residents and coworkers, and choose how to solve their problems.

details.title: Cursor Quest
details.short_description: Cursor Quest is an action RPG where your mouse cursor is the character. Swing weapons with your movement, dodge attacks, gather resources, train skills, craft gear, explore dungeons, and grow your cursor into a fantasy hero.

details.title: Veilreach
details.short_description: Descend into The Lost Temples of Veilreach, a roguelike deckbuilder where OSR dungeon crawling meets tactical poker-hand synergies. Master unique abilities and talents, and build a powerful deck to survive dungeons where every choice has a brutal consequence.

details.title: Vacancy: Hotel Inspection Simulator
details.short_description: Every room needs your approval. Inspect hotel rooms and a presidential suite, uncover overlooked faults, photograph the evidence, and decide what happens next. Clear it for guests, send housekeeping, call maintenance, or close the room.

details.title: Save Some Princess
details.short_description: Survive the horde in this fun action RPG roguelike. Discover millions of build combinations with unique hero abilities, itemized loot, and procedurally generated levels. Play by yourself or with up to 3 friends. Are you ready to descend into hell to save some princess?

details.title: MOONHIDE
details.short_description: MOONHIDE is a dark fantasy card roguelite where every choice shapes your run. Fight turn-based battles, build powerful ring combinations, balance Blood and Humanity, and adapt to shifting moon rules as you push deeper into the night.

details.title: Autork
details.short_description: Aut’ork is a strategic auto-battler where you build an army from the ground up. Shape your composition, experiment with powerful combos, and lead your race to victory in PvE or PvP battles.

details.title: Visceral
details.short_description: A turn-based horror roguelike where your flashlight is your best weapon. Awaken on a cursed farm, reveal the monsters hiding in the dark, and put them down with 51 weapons and 91 omens. Every run is randomly generated. Survive the night, or be torn apart trying.

details.title: SHOT EDIT
details.short_description: A rogue-lite nightmare in a shooting range! Hit the score quota with trick shots — or get cut from the film. For good.

details.title: Fleshwounds & Feathers
details.short_description: Enter a world of bird wielding knights! Fight your friends in this online, PvP, free for all, deathmatch, arena shooter. Explore the map, find new goofy weapons to help defeat your friends. You set the playtime and score to beat. Enjoy all this along with game adaptive medieval drum and bass!

details.title: Slacklord
details.short_description: Turn everyday typing into progress. Slacklord is an input-driven idle game with incremental progression, designed to run while you work - upgrade switches, keycaps, and accessories to build stronger scoring combinations.

details.title: BEAST NEGOTIATOR
details.short_description: Fighting isn't the only way. Explore dungeons, negotiate with the monsters you meet, and recruit them. Command your party in side-view turn-based battles - a 2D dungeon RPG built around befriending monsters.

details.title: Vector Front
details.short_description: Pilot a customizable starfighter into massive multiplayer fleet battles. Hunt enemy fighters, tear ships apart piece by piece, and lead assaults against enemy warships with your own customizable support fleet. Made for VR and PC.

details.title: Mosaic Moon
details.short_description: A nonlinear puzzle-platformer about decoding a mysterious language of logic. Determine the meaning of each symbol to find and place colored tiles correctly to progress. Explore at your own pace and unravel the mysteries of the an ancient, unknowable alien entity!

details.title: Archive Protocol
details.short_description: Fight, build and preserve what remains. VEIGLER: Archive Protocol combines top-down action roguelite combat with base building and tower defense. Expand your Signal Network, defend the Broadcast Core and recover lost Archive data before you extract.

details.title: Gooboventure
details.short_description: A hand-pixeled platformer about a blob of goo. Ledges carry you up, ceilings don't drop you, narrow cracks are doors. Goo is both your health and your ammunition, and it comes from fighting. Find your scattered neighbours before winter.

details.title: Voluntary Consent
details.short_description: Your job is something between an autopsy and a survey. In this detective visual novel, you are an interrogation inspector who extracts information from still-living brains. Every day you analyze documents, gather evidence, and make a tough choice: to follow conscience, duty, or voices in own head.

details.title: Starcatcher
details.short_description: Wish upon the starry sky for the power to slay your enemies in this hack 'n' slash action roguelite.

details.title: Malloc
details.short_description: Malloc is a short atmospheric exploration game. Wander through a nostalgic city on a summer afternoon, explore on foot or in a utility mech, meet the residents, and bring the district back to life one small repair at a time.

details.title: Iris Dissolution
details.short_description: Iris Dissolution is a classic survival horror game where you explore increasingly surreal places, manage scarce resources, and fight for your life against horrid creatures as you struggle to come to terms with loss.

details.title: When Livia Disappeared
details.short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in the 1920s. Perform ritual magic, craft potions, and uncover the secrets of the Order that maintains the balance between worlds.

details.title: Lootspire
details.short_description: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

details.title: Scaledeep
details.short_description: Roguelike. Turn-based dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated environments, over 200 unique monsters, and dynamic class customization. 20 different storylines. 6 professions. Countless deaths. Play solo or team up in local couch co-op and battle hordes of enemies.

details.title: Ismene
details.short_description: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

details.title: Taishō Romance Theater
details.short_description: A romance-suspense visual novel set in Taishō Japan. Amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma grapples with a dear friend's bizarre death, the awakening of his magic, and the blood ties that haunt him. As the truth unravels, shape Kotori's final choice: return to his bloodline's embrace, or pursue true freedom?

details.title: 🎧 Yellowcake - The Audio Game 🎧
details.short_description: A first-person audio game, telling the tale of a blind yet gifted hero. Make your way through a 3D environment without receiving any visual cues. Put all your faith in your ears and help our hero in his quest to uncover the sinister secrets of these twisty uranium mines, which he calls his home.

details.title: Bloodfly Keeper
details.short_description: Breed unruly bloodflies, craft forbidden cures, and rise from outcast to underground healer in a city ruled by a corrupt medical regime.

details.title: Evolized
details.short_description: Evolized is a fast-paced evolution roguelite where your creature changes in real time. Build your biology, push deeper into a storm that escalates the world every minute, and extract before you are wiped out.

details.title: Typewriter Monkeys
details.short_description: Infinite monkeys with infinite typewriters will eventually write Shakespeare... right? Find out in this cozy automation idler! Strategically place different kinds of monkeys with typewriters then level them up as you type longer and longer words!

details.title: Blackmail Directive
details.short_description: A gripping visual novel set in modern-day Japan, featuring cute anime-style heroines and branching storylines that lead to multiple endings. Every choice you make shapes the story—and determines Arisa's fate.

details.title: Fear Hour
details.short_description: Insane mistakes brought you to a life-or-death judgment. Fight off a terrifying Killer, or kill those who trespass on your territory in this tense (1v5) online experience. Where following your instincts might help you escape, or kill them all.

details.title: Sword of Mejor
details.short_description: A unique rpg experience where you follow the path of a sword, rather than 1 set character! Follow the Sword of Mejor as it travels the lands swapping hands through battles, trades, gifts and more! With more paths and endings to count, every playthrough is different!

details.title: INFECT½
details.short_description: 《Infect½》is a Cthulhu-themed group portrait micro-horror AVG, players can control a total of seven characters in the game to advance the story. As members of the last remaining human settlement, as you explore, you slowly uncover the truth that led to the beginning of all this catastrophe...

details.title: PARALLAXIS
details.short_description: PARALLAXIS is a hardcore, First-Person Slasher, with mind-bending GRAVITY mechanics. Be fast, relentless, optimize your path - even if that means breaking the laws of reality.

details.title: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
details.short_description: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk is a point-and-click game where you explore the woods in the springtime. Talk with animals and observe plants as you head through the forest on your journey to enjoy a meal under the cherry blossom tree!

details.title: Fecal Freighter
details.short_description: Become a sewage truck operator and survive the foul dangers: drive your ZIL, battle sludge demons, complete tasks, explore a grim world, and uncover the mystery of an alien conspiracy.

details.title: Jeller Fellers
details.short_description: Bounce, squish, and launch through a vibrant, stylized world in Jeller Fellers, where you *attempt* to control a wobbly jelly cube. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and explore diverse environments in this challenging, physics-based precision platformer

details.title: DollHouse: survive  or death
details.short_description: A stately, huge, beautiful mansion... Where is this?Opened the door of the mansion with a nervous heart, and the moment , I knew there was no turning back.

details.title: The Wake of the Wyrm
details.short_description: A crown upon your head, danger all around. Rule, marry, scheme, raise heirs, wage wars, fulfill prophecies, and survive the waking Wyrm. An interactive text-based dark fantasy novel, 850,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

details.title: Five Day Detective
details.short_description: Five Day Detective is a point and click style adventure game featuring multiple murder cases and a twisted sense of humour.

details.title: MESS
details.short_description: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

details.title: CactusBandido
details.short_description: Love your friends? Too bad: in Thorn City, you're going to steal their loot. Face off with up to 6 players, outsmart the sheriff, and let the richest cactus win!

details.title: Suspended Animation 💽
details.short_description: A sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

details.title: Winter of the Arbyen
details.short_description: 'Winter of the Arbyen' is a game that combines adventure and store manage simulation. In the world where the Ice Age has come, you must survive as a shopkeeper in a coal mine village. Find the missing father, chase the 'Firestone'. Various characters are waiting to help you or take advantage of you.

details.title: Apathic
details.short_description: Apathic is a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate your brother's disappearance in a mysterious facility. Shift gravity, decipher sounds, and explore underground ducts while evading a creature determined to capture you at all costs.

details.title: War Trigger
details.short_description: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

details.title: Syncron Arena
details.short_description: Reject mindless stat checks in this evolved Souls-like Auto Battler! Master Time Freeze, Parry, & Poise Break to dominate the battlefield. Use "Logic Bridging" to craft god-tier builds that defy common sense. You aren't just a spectator—conquer the broken world as a decisive ally.

details.title: Time Crack
details.short_description: A thriller and mystery visual novel about broken trust and the search for truth, when a high-school student is accused of his parents’ brutal murder. Every choice might bring you closer to the truth... or end in tragedy.

details.title: Eldritch Horror: Digital Edition
details.short_description: Uncover ancient cults, battle horrific monsters and thwart the rise of unfathomable Ancient Ones in a 1920s-themed adventure. In this faithful adaptation of the classic board game, you must race against time to save humanity from ancient powers and dark secrets before all is lost.

details.title: Campus Confidential
details.short_description: Campus Confidential is an LGBTQ slice-of-life dating sim with a supernatural subplot. Enjoy your campus experience, choose your subjects, study hard (or not), meet potential love interests of different genders... and try to uncover the mysteries shrouding the campus!

details.title: Red Moon Cafe
details.short_description: Red Moon Cafe is a story-driven barista sim set in a rough Russian neighborhood. Survive on your paycheck, manage the protagonist's well-being, and save for the essentials. The authentic city and lifelike NPCs are so detailed that the atmosphere and daily grind feel almost like real life.

details.title: Filled Up
details.short_description: Filled Up is a first-person survival horror/comedy hybrid featuring LGBT characters and themes. After a horrific accident, you awaken in the town of Hunksville, alone. An ancient and corrupt evil has taken over the town - can you save not only your friends, but the town of Hunksville itself?

details.title: Havenreach: Last Refuge
details.short_description: Fight for your people’s survival in this turn-based strategy game as you compete against other refugees for land. Expand tile by tile, defend your borders, and sustain your people through gathering or force. A streamlined 4X experience designed to finish in one sitting.

details.title: Another 2D Platformer
details.short_description: A 2D platformer that starts simple, then keeps changing the rules with new mechanics, strange level gimmicks, and plenty of fourth-wall-breaking nonsense.

details.title: Rock Wager Scissors
details.short_description: Rock Wager Scissors is a logic & gambling game, where you get rich by adapting to your opponent's playstyle in Rock Paper Scissors. Make bets, use perks, study past moves, figure out your opponent's playstyle, and go all in!

details.title: Mega Sokofox World
details.short_description: Help Sara, the fox, overcome anxiety and leave her comfy labyrinth, to visit her beloved vampire girlfriend in this 16-bit Sokoban Adventure for the Mega Drive!

details.title: Boingo!
details.short_description: Bounce through colourful worlds, overcome wild platforming challenges, and help Boingo save his family in this energetic 2D platforming adventure!

details.title: Winner Takes All
details.short_description: A sci-fi themed business simulation. Start as a nobody and build your empire. Invest your winnings to make more money or use them to gain influence. Go toe to toe with the underground or operate in the shadows. Remember; winner takes all, you have no other option.

details.title: Already Recorded The Statement
details.short_description: Your statement is already on record. Search messages, social media, and your calendar for evidence. Connect related records from all three apps to answer the investigator's questions. Decide who takes responsibility. Your evidence and choices will shape the investigation and the story.

details.title: Worst Lifeguards
details.short_description: Four-player online co-op physics comedy. Run the world's worst beach lifeguard service in eight-minute shifts: real wave physics moves every swimmer and object, the tourists fight rescue, and the whole beach is filming. Bring three friends - there is no solo mode.

name: Tales of Kureha: The Outer Gate Academy

details.title: Tales of Kureha: The Outer Gate Academy
details.short_description: A pixel-art JRPG × card battler — and it's not a roguelike. Fight your way past the boss guarding every floor as you climb toward the top of the tower, collecting new cards, gear, and companions along the way, and freely tune your own deck and playstyle.

details.title: Apocalypseed
details.short_description: Become the alien invasion in this 2D real-time strategy game! Command an army of carnivorous plants, devour humans to grow stronger, evolve into monstrous creatures, and build an underground colony. Expand your horde and crush humanity's resistance!

details.title: Rush & Deliver
details.short_description: Rush & Deliver is a driving and resource management roguelike where you work as a package delivery driver. Deliver packages, pay your bills, buy upgrades, and make difficult choices as you struggle to provide for your family.

details.title: Aboard Titanic
details.short_description: The Titanic is yours to master. Explore 100% of the ship, race through challenges, navigate by instinct, interact with history. The ultimate spatial puzzle awaits.

details.title: Something Really Evil Inc.
details.short_description: Take down an evil corporation by spreading memes and chaos with cute characters! Each week brings a new project, and each project is a chance to annoy and ragebait the CEO as you get projects delayed and cancelled.

details.title: Magic Link
details.short_description: Magic Link is a roguelike magic bullet-hell game. Play as a variety of fantasy characters, harness the power of magic, and defeat your enemies!

details.title: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
details.short_description: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.

details.title: Stillwell
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

details.title: Escape the Doom
details.short_description: A physics-based endless runner that demands precise vehicle control. Fly fast and dodge hazards as you race through time to escape the impending Doom.

details.title: Parabless
details.short_description: Explore life and spiritual warfare in Parabless card game. Grounded in a biblical moral code and driven by artistic expression, every card represents a facet of existence in a broken world.

details.title: LineForgeBlackSmith
details.short_description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

details.title: Daybreak Torch
details.short_description: DaybreakTorch is a pixel-art party-based RPG that combines real-time tactical combat with traditional sRPG's squad building. Assemble your own elite hero squad and embark on a heroic, classic adventure set in a mythological world.

details.title: Void Crawlers
details.short_description: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.

details.title: MioAquaria
details.short_description: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

details.title: Where Dragons Once Ruled
details.short_description: Step into the wings of a young dragon, one of the last. Roam diverse biomes, meet strange creatures, glide, breathe fire, and uncover an emotional story told through platforming and exploration. The journey of a dragon awaits.

name: The Other Side of the Wall

details.title: The Other Side of the Wall
details.short_description: Julian Reed is a 13-year old student at a New England all-boys Catholic boarding school in the early 1980s. When people begin disappearing and no one else seems to remember they ever existed, Julian investigates, with the help of a girl he has never seen, separated from him by a wall.

details.title: Trial By Magic
details.short_description: All spell casters must one day prove their skill in the TRIAL BY MAGIC Those who overcome this deckbuilding challenge are forever known as Wizards, a title carried with pride. Those who fail are branded Wimps, forever shamed. So the question to you, spell caster, is: ARE YOU A WIZARD OR A WIMP?

details.title: ShrednSpread
details.short_description: A mysterious egg crashes to Earth. Out pops a tiny Kaiju — hungry, googly-eyed, and impossible to please. What do you do? Easy: order snacks, shred them, and spray-feed the little monster until it grows... and grows... and grows.

details.title: Motorsport Park Manager
details.short_description: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.

details.title: ARO: Tales In The Dome
details.short_description: "ARO: Tales in the Dome" is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure game. Play as Aro and explore an elemental world sealed beneath the dome. As the journey unfolds, uncover the hidden conspiracy and face the truth about the world, the dome, and yourself.

details.title: Is This Farming?
details.short_description: A co-op first-person farming game where your crops fight back. Till, plant and water, then grab your hoe when the harvest wakes up swinging. Ship what you beat, craft turrets and bombs, and take down Guardians with up to three friends, or on your own.

details.title: Diabolocracy
details.short_description: Diabolocracy is hatemail for corporate bureaucracy in roguelite turn-based tactics form. Build your team of corporate hellions, battle other Sins for supremacy, survive meetings, and choose your SIN-ergies wisely. Can you complete your hostile takeover before the boss gets back from vacation?

details.title: G Squad
details.short_description: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.

details.title: Avemary Rocket -Captain Patchwork-
details.short_description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

name: The american dream of Gunther Aims

details.title: The american dream of Gunther Aims
details.short_description: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

details.title: C6: Frontlines
details.short_description: C6: Frontlines is a bullet hell co-op roguelike where only YOU (and your friends) can bring the Azapall galaxy to peace. Wield 30+ weapons and gadgets of mass destruction to even the playing field, wave after wave, against a seemingly endless onslaught of evil!

details.title: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
details.short_description: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

details.title: Loaded Dice
details.short_description: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in this fast action-strategy party game.

details.title: The Jotun Queen
details.short_description: Embark on a journey to a land inspired by real world mythology and meet a cast of colourful characters. Fight tactical battles and save the world from the icy hatred of The Jotun Queen

details.title: Lethal Grace
details.short_description: Order received. Target identified. Proceed with elimination. Play as Grace, a killer android, in this dynamic shooter.

details.title: Blackroots
details.short_description: Blackroots is a co-op fantasy/horror game where players work together or alone to resist a dark force known as Ul'vorran.

details.title: < STRECT >
details.short_description: Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation! < STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players. Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

details.title: REAL DEAL
details.short_description: Run your own electronics store chain. Buy phones, tablets, computers, fridges, and more in bulk, transport them with your truck, and sell them at prices you choose. Manage up to 4 stores with hired employees, but fail to plan well and you won’t be able to pay rent, bills, or salaries.

details.title: Pathways Lost: Reclaim
details.short_description: Send customised troops and your powerful mech into battle in this strategic auto battler. Spawn units, equip gear, unlock skills and reclaim lost worlds. Optimize your army and master ever increasing challenges. Fast-paced matches, endless depth.

details.title: ROGUE COLLECTOR
details.short_description: ROGUE COLLECTOR is a hex-grid tactical roguelike where you don't collect gear: you collect the Rogues. Rescue procedurally generated Rogues from dungeons, extract them in time, or lose them forever. Trade your Rogues on a live player-driven marketplace.

details.title: Fast Food Architect
details.short_description: At the dawn of American fast food, build and manage your fast-food restaurant. Create your burgers, coordinate service, and grow your establishment over the decades.

details.title: Zombies & Battery
details.short_description: Zombies hunt by the sound of your heartbeat, and only static from a government radio can hide it. Keep the battery alive, drive your camper van to the safe zone, and scavenge, sneak and revive fallen friends in casual co-op zombie survival for 1–4 players.

details.title: Godlings Unleashed
details.short_description: Godlings Unleashed is an action roguelike.Encounter all kinds of bizarre characters, defeat or recruit them, upgrade your powers, and mix and match gear and treasures to create unique builds. Fight your way through a chaotic world full of surprises, absurdity, and laughs, and make it to the end!

details.title: Aelwater
details.short_description: Memory has weight. The departed are not gone. Step into a village drowned by flood and memory, and search for the final answer about guardianship and farewell among the shattered past.

details.title: Colors of Memory
details.short_description: A cozy adventure across two realities — a mysterious world of memories and the land of the living, where every choice matters. Wander the edge of forgetting, uncover lost stories, and find your own path — one that might change everything and paint the world in a whole new light.

details.title: Rust Onslaught
details.short_description: Rust Onslaught is a top-down shooter where you play as the robot R-75, as he takes out everything he sees. Humanity Is Dead, Robots Own The Earth, and you have become a danger.

name: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape

details.title: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
details.short_description: "The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape"is a dark fantasy style pixel Arpg. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

name: To Shake, or Not to Shake

details.title: To Shake, or Not to Shake
details.short_description: Your late grandfather left you his bar. Listen to the order, pick the ingredients, layer and shake — but the bartender drinks too: drink and your hands start to shake, stay sober and the voices in your head won't stop. A story-driven bar sim where every drink comes at a price.

details.title: Kill the Stream
details.short_description: The end of the world, streamed live. Climb a deadly tower broadcast in real time to gods, mystical creatures and demons. And you're just a pathetic guy picked at random to represent humanity and challenge the tower.

details.title: Tape Us Out
details.short_description: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

details.title: Dungeon Dominator
details.short_description: Build and expand your own warm, cozy dungeon where your minions live miserable lives and do their evil things. Take part in thrilling battles against humans, angels, and powerful bosses, defending your domain. Conquer the world by commanding an army with a wave of your hand!

details.title: Valiance
details.short_description: A fast paced FPS where you create your own character by choosing your arsenal of abilities and weapons. Craft your build and chain together devastating ability & weapon combos to rip apart hordes of ravenous monsters.

details.title: Compress(space)
details.short_description: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

details.title: Bound Beyond
details.short_description: A dark, mystical first-person adventure. Investigate the disappearance of a renowned archaeologist. Explore locations where shadows may hide a threat, and every sound can be your final mistake. Solve immersive puzzles and use sound, physics, and tools to survive before an ancient secret consumes you

details.title: Old School RPG II
details.short_description: Old School RPG II: Dawn of the Orc is a party-based RPG. Create a group of adventurers whose destiny is forged by the actions they take and their choices will matter and impact the game world. Featuring advanced class customization options, strategic turn-based combat, and trap filled dungeons.

name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks

details.title: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
details.short_description: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

details.title: Life Souls
details.short_description: Life Souls is a cooperative roguelike for 1–6 players featuring dynamic arena combat, free-form skill combinations, epic bosses, and permanent progression.

details.title: Ham's Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own retro game shop! Stock shelves, manage customers, collect rare games, and even play the ones you sell. Upgrade your store, host launch events, and build the ultimate gaming destination in this cozy simulation game.

details.title: TOKENS: Rogue Club
details.short_description: Launch explosive combos and master your luck in TOKENS: Rogue Club, a tic-tac-toe deckbuilder roguelike. Every flip counts while you forge synergies with Arcanes, Effigies, and Harmonies. Paris's nightlife in the 1920s with its artists, magicians, and exciting challenges awaits! Welcome to the club!

name: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally

details.title: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally
details.short_description: This game is a confinement suspense & love romance escape game in which the main character, who has lost her memory, aims to regain her memory and escape from the room she was confined in.

details.title: Drone Armada
details.short_description: Pilot and command massive drone swarms in real-time action-strategy battles. Research powerful tech, upgrade your fleet, and adapt your tactics to push back the invasion spreading across Kaelisia.

details.title: Endwell
details.short_description: One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As a Cat Courier, it's your job to deliver packages across a cozy town on the eve of the world's end. Help residents find connection, hope, and meaning before the last sunset.

name: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift

details.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
details.short_description: Point & Click Fantasy Thriller: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you must uncover the truth behind magic, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

details.title: IN SILICO
details.short_description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

details.title: Gatekeeper's Week
details.short_description: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

details.title: Taptron 1999
details.short_description: Taptron 1999 is a short roguelite clicker where you must prevent Y2K using the power of a mouse click.

details.title: Burger Rush Simulator
details.short_description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

details.title: Scratchcard Hero
details.short_description: Get to scratchin' in this realtime rogueli*e deckbuilder where all your cards are lottery scratch-off-micro-game tickets! Make your build of scratchcards and gadgets, and 1v1 battle other scratcher enthusiasts on your way to the source of your town's gambling problems.

details.title: UNRETURNING
details.short_description: No one is known to have reached the end of the abyss, but one thing is certain: something must be there, and it must be seen. Explore the depths of the abyss in a game that blends adventure, horror, and dark fantasy. This time, it’s not about the destination, it's about THE JOURNEY.

details.title: Little Crossroads
details.short_description: Escape the rush of your other life in this multiplayer Cozy RPG. Advance in a deep progression of skills like Fishing, Mining, and Bug Catching. Unlock cute and cool cosmetics to customize your character. Experience the "cozy chaos" of random events. All solo or with friends. Welcome home!

details.title: Last Front
details.short_description: Modern armies, unique commanders, tactical battles. In Last Front, each faction offers its own style of war and exclusive units. Build your base, lead your army, and prove your superiority on the battlefield.

details.title: Bearskull 2
details.short_description: A vast open world, ruthless Vikings, powerful bosses, and an epic co-op mode – rise to the challenge! ⚔🔥🐻💀

details.title: End the Endless
details.short_description: End the Endless is a dark fantasy Monster Collector set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness every resource at your disposal, including your own party members to slay a variety of horrors. Explore the Afterlife, meet the ones who call this land home and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.

details.title: Vox Manipuli
details.short_description: The king is dead! Tame chaos in this unconventional strategy with autobattler and puzzle elements, set in a fantasy setting. As the King's Regent, manage your Councilors so that they vote accordingly to your will. Manipulate, trigger synergies and win debates!

details.title: Dawn Watcher
details.short_description: Lead your army

details.title: Voyage Router
details.short_description: The further you go, the more the universe turns against you. Voyage Router is a navigation-driven roguelite strategy game where you explore dimensional oceans, chart optimal paths, and risk everything for a greater haul.

name: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family

details.title: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family
details.short_description: A Cambodian-American family becomes haunted by a ghost. Enjoy this story-driven narrative as the haunting unfolds. Inspired by horror movies in the late 2000s-2010s.

details.title: Contagion Protocol
details.short_description: Survive an endless undead horde in this brutal auto-battling roguelike. Slash, upgrade, and evolve your arsenal as chaos unfolds to the pulse of an industrial metal soundtrack. Contagion Protocol is fast, bloody, and built for replayability.

details.title: Saw Counter
details.short_description: The killer is here, and now he's coming for you!!He will put you through trials, play with your emotions, your mind, and your body. Are you ready?

details.title: Fizz Flow: Factory Management
details.short_description: Fizz Flow is a strategy and management game that takes place in a setting without competition regulations. In old America, where the beverage industry is on the rise, build your own factory, make your own unique recipes, weaken your opponents and maintain your hard earned success at the market!

details.title: Tramp: Become President
details.short_description: Start from picking through trash, collecting, crafting, and trading hundreds of items. Explore sewers, hire workers, run businesses, withhold wages, dodge taxes, and buy votes on the black market. Turn trash into assets, and assets into power. One day, you too will sit atop the President's desk.

details.title: Death By Pixel
details.short_description: Death By Pixel is an action RPG shooter with exploration elements. Experiment with elemental weapon combinations, exploit enemy weaknesses and trade your defenses for devastating abilities.

details.title: One More Depth
details.short_description: A fast-paced, 4-player co-op action RPG. As an orphan, dive into twisted realms to retrieve the legendary "Precious." Don't let the cute art fool you—lethal threats await in the abyss. Dual-Class Builds: Mix and match classes with diverse loot to craft thousands of unique combat styles.

details.title: Talas
details.short_description: Shoot your way across deep space. Shred through waves of enemies, unravel the secrets hiding beneath the surface, and explore the endless synergies in this retro-inspired action roguelike.

details.title: serverBound
details.short_description: Corporate AI broke the internet, so people rebuilt it by hand. Now something is eating it. Walk their paper-and-ink web islands, read each one like a crime scene and work out the rule of whatever's attacking it. Then fight it in a turn-based duel with no dice, no levels and no excuses.

details.title: Cutting Edge: Roots Of Mutation
details.short_description: Perform life-saving operations in this fast-paced surgery sim. As lizard surgeon Dr. Peri Maddock, you'll treat injuries, excise tumors, and hack corporate organs with speedy, surgical precision. The patient's life is in your claws!

details.title: Tenancy
details.short_description: Tenancy is a roguelike deckbuilder about managing the costs, risks, and unique effects of angry little ladies so you can live off their paychecks. While tenants may be lackluster on their own, when played together they can be extorted for maximum value!

details.title: Morphing
