details.short_description: Morphing is a 2D adventure puzzle game where you possess the ability of morphing. This power allows you to transform and acquire the traits of certain objects or creatures. Use this unique skill to overcome challenges and explore the world.

details.title: Embers Of Spiritflame
details.short_description: Embers of Spiritflame is an Emotional Point & Click detective adventure about the exploration of an old abandoned house. Inside, you go through comic book-inspired levels and begin to uncover why everyone is missing. View events and memories of the place and piece the story together.

details.title: Wretch
details.short_description: Find the violent stalker hiding inside an abandoned school. Piece together broken lore and solve a long lost mystery. What happened here and who's to blame?

details.title: Project JS
details.short_description: You are the one chosen by Nezha. This time, you will carry out justice on behalf of Heaven. The player takes on the role of the next Jishen, successor to the novel’s protagonist Jay, becoming the chosen one of Nezha and using pog card to battle demons and spirits.

details.title: 2 FAST 4 YOU
details.short_description: Race through challenging levels and annihilate killer bots. Master your movement to create your own fastest paths to the finish line. Use unique abilities to speedrun your way to the top of the leaderboards. Catch and banish the evil folder - your cat’s life depends on it!

details.title: Dungeon Ward
details.short_description: Dungeon Ward revives old‑school grid‑based dungeon crawlers and focuses on fast‑paced combat with flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and defeat challenging bosses in this action‑packed RPG.

details.title: Rise of Lambs : Awakening
details.short_description: 《Rise of the Lambs: Awakening》 is a 3D Roguelike where you play as a young lamb. After a brutal coyote pack invades your peaceful sheep tribe, you must protect your home, uncover the truth, and awaken your powers to stop the war and save the world from apocalypse.

details.title: Rogue Battalion
details.short_description: Command your troops in Rogue Battalion, a WW2 auto-battler blending strategy and action! Build your forces, unlock upgrades, and use powerful abilities like airstrikes and artillery to survive relentless waves. With meta progression and endless tactics, every run brings new challenges.

details.title: Blitloop
details.short_description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.

details.title: Galaxy Frame
details.short_description: Galaxy Frame is a space Roguelite game players control their aircraft to survive the attacks of alien insects. By understanding the characteristics of aircraft, skills, and props, players can build their own decks and challenge stronger enemies. Arcade mode to challenge the world leaderboard.

name: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人

details.title: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人
details.short_description: 《井底》是一款2024年3月立项的文字类galgame，题材是“超能力悬疑推理故事”，画风是日系校园风格的 故事主要讲述了游戏女主王语韴作为一个业余“侦探”，遇到各种疑难问题，并在侦探事务所所长天翔及其妹妹天音的帮助下，解决案件的故事。 游戏主要使用鼠标点击来推进剧情

details.title: Far From The Darkness
details.short_description: A first-person multiplayer game inspired by the Werewolf concept. Depending on your role, investigate and hunt werewolves or betray your squad. Strategize, collaborate, and survive while communicating through proximity chat!

details.title: Celestial of Dolls
details.short_description: Lead a humanoid squad from a roaming settlement base into a Dyson megastructure built by runaway AI under a binary star system. Fight the AI Guards, the Empire, and the Humanoid Cult, use Scarlet Particles and terrain tricks, and escort Io to rewrite civilization’s fate.

details.title: Artemed
details.short_description: In a world consumed by The Black Echo, a pandemic spread by whispers within 2 meters, play as Alex, a grieving uncle facing loss and humanity’s collapse. Explore haunting environments, manage scarce resources, and survive the chilling echoes of a shattered past.

details.title: MythoMania
details.short_description: You angered every god from every mythology! Stack powerful items, unlock new skills, and make tenuous alliances with gods to fight back in this platformer Roguelike inspired by Risk of Rain and Hollow Knight.

details.title: ZaciSa: Idle Defense!
details.short_description: A Tower Defense game mashed with Idle Clicker mechanics set inside a wonderful world of crayons. Build out your defenses, go grab a snack and watch your forces take on enemy units.

details.title: Terminal Reign
details.short_description: Operate a remote armoured vehicle for the glory and whims of a dying empire. Undertake tactical missions, configure your command desk with an array of devices, and remain in favour to survive.

details.title: Galaxy Pilgrim
details.short_description: High-stakes physics platformer where you can't walk so you fly! Boost a reluctant engineer through chaotic pinball levels dodging deadly traps and collecting ore for his country.

details.title: Chicken Show
details.short_description: Play as chickens in a TV show for 2 to 4 players, where you must betray your friends to win! Peck, grab, and throw your rivals to gain the upper hand throughout your adventure. Outsmart your opponents and leave them featherless!

details.title: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
details.short_description: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

details.title: Steinvar
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious, atmospheric world and cleanse creeping corruption using the power of light. Discover secrets, restore lost places, and shape your journey in a story-driven fantasy adventure.

details.title: Heliodawn
details.short_description: You start with a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, and a farm. You end with rockets flying, colonies on the Moon and Mars, and cargo flowing between every world you've built. An idle incremental game about building humanity's space program from the ground up.

name: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things

details.title: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things
details.short_description: The residents of Mothville are always losing things and need the help of someone with eagle eyes! Explore the town’s diverse neighborhoods, talk to the animal residents, complete their quests, and find everything that’s gone missing in this wacky, story-driven hidden object game.

name: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer

details.title: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer
details.short_description: A mystery set in Fukuoka, Japan. Former cop Kengo Kamiya and assistant Hikaru tackle a high school girl's disappearance. A "Photoreal Novel" fully utilizing actual photos and AI. Enjoy snappy banter and unexpected twists in this simple, choice-driven mystery visual novel.

details.title: BaeSplit: Chaos Down Under
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring Hakos Baelz and her friends from hololive! Discover a re-imagining of the Outback as you join Bae on a quest to save her homeland and herself.

details.title: Fear Tide
details.short_description: Fear Tide is a single-player zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog brave infected zones for the supplies keeping your bunker alive. Fight together, track valuable resources, carry what you can, rescue survivors, and extract before the horde closes in.

details.title: Cafe Connect
details.short_description: Repair, upgrade, and build PCs for your first customers to pave your way to self-employment. Open your own internet café, build custom gaming PCs, and expand your shop step by step. Your success starts with a screwdriver.

details.title: Kiwi Boing
details.short_description: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

details.title: Operation Paranoia
details.short_description: Operation Paranoia is a psychological survival horror in which you browse the dark corners of the deep web, uncover conspiracy theories, and hide from relentless killers. Manage your food and medicine supplies, run your vlog channel, and survive another day.

details.title: Iron Dogs
details.short_description: In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1940's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through beautifully hand-crafted environments.

details.title: Sprig
details.short_description: Sprig is a cozy 3D exploration game about discovering real-world animals, solving gentle environmental puzzles, and filling your nature journal as a curious rabbit. Explore peaceful, no-stress levels at your own pace in a short, wholesome adventure with a clear ending.

details.title: DAMNED
details.short_description: DAMNED is a nerve-wracking survival/management experience where you are the only one who can keep a colossal dam from collapsing.

details.title: Rebel Talos
details.short_description: Pilot your TALOS mech to defend humanity’s last bastion in this high-speed action roguelite. Craft overpowered builds, crush the Automata Empire, and expand your arsenal every run.

details.title: Orbital Code: 2044
details.short_description: Become a top secret agent in VR and embark on a continent-spanning stealth action adventure. After Corp One's plan to seize New York City by force is leaked, a covert international taskforce of former special operations members sends you to infiltrate the megacorp's heavily guarded downtown HQ.

details.title: Nodebreak
details.short_description: Nodebreak is a fast-paced, kinetic precision puzzle game, where you launch from node to node at breakneck speeds in an interconnected branching node network. It is an easy to understand, but hard to master test of reflexes and spatial awareness!

details.title: NCH: Chronos Rebirth
details.short_description: A sci-fi narrative visual novel focused on historical intervention, espionage, mind games, and tactical choices. You are a life scientist from the future, sent back to the eve of the Great Cataclysm. How will you rewrite the past to change a divided future?

details.title: Robot Rhapsody
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG following Selva, a retired mercenary; Aurum, a poetic "robot bard"; and allies including engineers, luddite artists, and survivors fighting back against AI-controlled "utopias". Recruit machines to your side, upgrade with salvaged tech, & explore bizarre pockets of human resistance.

details.title: Brickstrike
details.short_description: Brickstrike is an online multiplayer first-person shooter set in a fully destructible and buildable voxel battlefield. Team up to dominate in a variety of competitive game modes. Featuring a variety of official and player-created maps. Enlist today!

details.title: Star Squadron
details.short_description: Star Squadron is a narrative-driven space combat simulator built for maximum immersion. Command your wing with freeform voice recognition and experience a dynamic campaign that calls you by name using our proprietary Voice Mimic System. Don't just play the game—live it.

name: Krodha: A Tale of Vikram & Betaal

details.title: Krodha: A Tale of Vikram & Betaal
details.short_description: Krodha is a Dice + Deck + Slot-building roguelike rooted in the Indian legend of Vikram and Betaal. Draft your deck, slot cards into a board, roll the dice and piece together a mystery told by three "very" unreliable narrators.

details.title: Cards of the Abyss
details.short_description: Cards of the Abyss is a roguelike deckbuilder where movement is your only defense. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, trigger countless chain-reactions and unleash overpowered card combos as you dive deeper into the Abyss.

details.title: Battles of Chaos
details.short_description: Battles of Chaos is a medieval fantasy real time strategy and tactics hybrid game, blending the best elements of the two genres. Play great, realistic open-field battles or sieges in single-player, cooperative or PvP mode, where the emphasis is on combat, with base building elements.

details.title: Those Far Stars
details.short_description: Discover a vast, procedural galaxy as a lone pilot. Trade, fight and explore alien worlds with turn-based encounters. Upgrade your ship, gather relics, and uncover secrets lost to time and space.

details.title: Nova Assault
details.short_description: Step into Nova Assault, the first-person extraction shooter that blends immersive realism with strategic depth: extract valuable resources, survive high-risk missions, and amass wealth through a dynamic in-game economy and advanced progression system.

details.title: AEROCUBE
details.short_description: AEROCUBE is a Ski-Fi Roguelike + First-Person Boomer Shooter in a huge mysterious cube that always rotates randomly. Each room of AEROCUBE is different, but one thing stays the same: something’s always behind you, ready to kill.

details.title: Voidwatch
details.short_description: Voidwatch is a silky-smooth space shooter roguelike. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes!

details.title: coalescent || tidal rapture
details.short_description: In the ocean depths, merpeople are evolving, and there are whispers of a new form of connection. Dive into deep waters, deeper desire, and trying to get over your ex in this hypnagogic 3D swimming adventure game and dating sim about separation and entanglement.

details.title: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements
details.short_description: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.

details.title: Glider64
details.short_description: Collect, steal and blast your way through the Glider League! Build a massive chain, fight off your rivals and race to the Gate to score big.

details.title: Eclipse
details.short_description: Three friends known as The Ghost Hunters are documenting abandoned locations. What begins as a normal episode suddenly turns into a nightmare inside The Holloway Mansion. Something terrifying happens, leaving Jack to survive alone in the mansion and face the horrors.

details.title: GAS
details.short_description: A co-op road trip horror for 4 players from the fan of Spintires, MudRunner and SnowRunner. Loot by day. Survive the night. Defend your car from skeletons, monsters and bad decisions. Go GAS! Go FUN!

details.title: Project: Story about
details.short_description: An RPG where you live life after life in a constantly evolving world, and your choices and relationships influence future cycles.

details.title: In Vino Veritas
details.short_description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

details.title: Hemlon the Grey
details.short_description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

details.title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
details.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

details.title: Darn Guy Adventures
details.short_description: Darn Guy Adventures is an RPG adventure following the titular Kishan "Darn Guy", Tinta and Norton as they are sent into a mission they are utterly underqualified for. Encounter verbose bushes, mathematical rocks and very loud wolfmen on the quest to save a town with an expiration date.

details.title: Revenant Maze
details.short_description: A first person, action-roguelite that centres around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes and architects intent on defeating you. Create the strongest synergies and blitz all in sight.

details.title: Unlucky
details.short_description: A bullet-heaven wave-based survival gambler roguelike where gambling-powered abilities determine your fate. Survive endless waves in an open world, level up with randomised upgrades, and master the chaos with luck on your side... hopefully.

details.title: Astrolander
details.short_description: Astrolander is an action-packed modern take on retro platformers featuring innovative 2.5D+3D gameplay and unique optional local co-op chaos! Attack enemies with your CDjector, dodge cassette launching boomboxes, and more on your quest to save the Most Valuable Programs!

details.title: Ember Glimmer
details.short_description: This is an anime-styled 3D third-person shooter that seamlessly blends real-time combat with loot mechanics. It features a diverse weapon system including a wide range of distinctive firearms and melee weapons, with combat enhanced by characters' elemental specialty skills.

details.title: DHALMAN
details.short_description: DHALMAN is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

details.title: VoxelForge
details.short_description: Build block by block. Furnish down to the smallest detail. VoxelForge is a single-player creative building game combining a cubic world, realistic materials and built-in interactive furniture. Design your home, shape its surroundings and explore your creations in first person.

details.title: Broom - The Card Game
details.short_description: A solitaire inspired by the italian game "Scopa". Complete the challenges before you run out of cards! Empower your Cups, collect Coins, transmute with Clubs, and cut through with Swords. And don’t forget the Brooms!

name: Tonald Dump: Make News Fake Again

details.title: Tonald Dump: Make News Fake Again
details.short_description: Lead Tonald Dump through a satirical, turn-based presidential campaign! Manipulate the media, influence voter groups, build political connections and navigate 600+ events across four campaign stages. Control the headlines. Win the election!

details.title: Touhou Chihaya Battle Festival
details.short_description: A fan-made Touhou Project 5v5 and 3v3 multiplayer battle game. Most of the Touhou cast is here, with free choice of items, lanes and skill loadout. Even leaving mid-match is free: something came up? No problem, your teammates take over your character. Oh, and a rabbit delivers your items.

details.title: Mars Divided
details.short_description: A turn-based grand strategy game about factions fighting over Mars. Research technologies, trade with Earth, wage war and forge alliances, push laws through your parliament, ride out dust storms. And beneath it all live tens of thousands of colonists — and the game simulates every one.

details.title: Spellthief: The Borrowed Galaxy
details.short_description: Steal the powers of every enemy you defeat. Combine them into your own constellation, dodge bullet-hell patterns, and take down towering guardians in a top-down sci-fi roguelike. Bring back the dawn.

details.title: Hide & Prey
details.short_description: Night falls on the orphanage, and the nun has awakened. In this 1 to 5 player cooperative horror game, hide, run, and unite to escape before she catches you. The slightest noise can betray you. Play as the orphans, or embody the nun and hunt your friends.

details.title: Ashenreach
details.short_description: Home lies in ashes. Follow a fallen star into Ashenreach, an old-school online RPG for small groups: tab-target combat, 4 classes, 260 voiced quests, dungeons, a raid, 14 crafts, your own home. Closed playtest: December 2026, dates to be announced.

details.title: Midnight Debt
details.short_description: A first-person night shop sim set in a town swallowed by fog. Read the news, stock up, haggle with strangers and serve shady buyers to pay off your debt. At 04:30 the street lamps begin to die. At 05:00 the fog takes anyone still outside.

details.title: POKUS
details.short_description: Sling spells and shatter friendships in a chaotic wizard tavern. In this online card battler for 2-6 player, play as petty mages whose hexes hilariously backfire. Break fragile alliances and haunt your friends from the grave in frantic 15-minute bouts of magical mayhem.

details.title: Alura Quest
details.short_description: A top-down action adventure in the spirit of the classic 8- and 16-bit quests: one big overworld, dungeons, caves and secrets everywhere. Unravel the mystery of the world of Gildilox and overcome the darkness that overtakes it.

details.title: BookBuster
details.short_description: The bookies ban winners. Become their worst nightmare in this incremental management game: find the odds they got wrong, hide your winnings across a network of accounts, and let your models and bots do the work until every bookmaker is bankrupt.

details.title: Card Thunder
details.short_description: Select cards from a 5x5 grid, stack powerful boosters and perks, and outscore escalating target scores in this spatial poker roguelike.

details.title: かみひより ～弓張り編～
details.short_description: Command four humans and four spirits in real-time tactical battles. Transfer spirits, manage spiritual energy, and analyze the lunar army to uncover its weaknesses. Combine careful planning with quick decisions to turn a desperate defense into a counteroffensive.

details.title: Gravewell
details.short_description: Defend the last Beacons in a first-person tower defense where you build on the battlefield and fight alongside your towers. Place defenses freely, wield weapons and powerful abilities, and battle through 24 handcrafted levels with over 150 tower variants.

details.title: Blackthorn: The Unquiet
details.short_description: A text-based dark fantasy RPG with pixel art and optional auto-combat. Take jobs in town, train talents, and upgrade your gear. Explore woods, mines, and graveyards, or stay closer to home to grow crops, cook, and brew.

details.title: Explode
details.short_description: Explode is a 1-4 player co-op FPS where you wreck swarms of robots with a ridiculous arsenal, grab the loot, and haul it all back to the van.

details.title: One More Shift
details.short_description: Welcome to the family! Our company turns yesterday's waste into everything you use today. In this factory roguelite you build the line behind a giant recycler, turn scrap into anything from toasters to salvage robots and meet the quota. Mr. Quota is watching. Fondly.

details.title: Rails of Fortune
details.short_description: Build your transport company across Europe from 1850. Connect cities with trains, ships and airships, carry passengers and supply factories. Plan profitable supply chains, research new technology and compete with rival companies.

details.title: Barely a Village
details.short_description: Grow a tiny village on floating tiles,. Every day you only have a few actions, so use them wisely. Enemies hunt your villagers, smash your buildings and infect your land. When your village falls, unlock new research and try again.

details.title: PixelOffice
details.short_description: A tiny pixel office sits in a corner of your desktop and keeps you company while you work. Start the focus timer and its coworkers get to work; take a break and they wander off to the lounge for pool and small talk. Level up to grow the team, dress them up, and yes, you can pet the dog.

details.title: Run away from BLEB
details.short_description: You are a young female streamer trapped in a terrifying house by a maniac named Bleb. Outsmart him and escape... If you can.

details.title: Campaign Season
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical board game that sees the player take on the role of an Officer in the Empire's army, recruit Soldiers, lead them on Campaign, and command them in battle.

details.title: Sire, We Must Redraw!
details.short_description: Sire, the raiders are coming. Play building cards to grow your town, troop cards to raise an army, and pick champions and relics that change how every run plays.

details.title: Muka
details.short_description: Fast, brutal, unforgiving. A 90s boomer shooter reborn with modern light and darkness, set in a twisted Eastern Bloc, from Chernobyl to the Czech Republic, where the evening news says everything is fine.

details.title: Secant
details.short_description: A short incremental ARPG where your cursor is the weapon. Defend the Origin against waves of figures, loot gear with rolled affixes, craft it, grow a huge skill tree, and take your hits from single digits to octillions. One final boss, a real ending.

name: Signs of Fear - The Hunt of Graystone

details.title: Signs of Fear - The Hunt of Graystone
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror adventure. In 1897, the brother of Everett Holloway disappeared in the town of Graystone, Montana. 11 years later the town held a record for most missing person cases in North America. Now a grown adult Everett returns to the town to look for his lost brother.

details.title: Crazy Alchemy
details.short_description: Crazy Alchemy is a roguelike where you take over a bankrupt alchemy workshop, draw ingredients from a bottomless bag, shake your cauldron to merge them, and combine tools to fulfill commissions and get the workshop back on its feet.

details.title: Kyrie
details.short_description: Kyrie is a first-person parkour roguelite built for speed. Sprint, slide, wall-kick and parry through procedurally generated worlds, outrun what hunts you, beat each world's boss and chase a better time, solo or in online co-op.

details.title: FUCHI's Chick: Mini Many PANIC
details.short_description: Up to 4 players hatch baby chicks and lead them to the shipping yard! A cute, chaotic party game starring the deadpan chicks of FUCHI, the illustrator behind the hugely popular LINE stickers. Lead a wobbly parade, dodge thieves and enemies, and dress up in collected outfits. Play locally or online.

details.title: Project Polaris
details.short_description: Project Polaris is an action roguelike following Eunhasu's story. Combine weapons and drones to create your own combat build, and shape her fate as Corruption changes her appearance, abilities, and how others react to her.

name: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings

details.title: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings
details.short_description: A Short Hike meets a late-night Adult Swim show. A witch just set her cat on fire, and now she wants Sylvia Sparrow to hunt down her lost paintings. Adventure across Witch Isle and meet mean, creepy, ugly and brutally honest characters who’ll help you find every last one.

details.title: SilentCordon
details.short_description: SilentCordon is a 3D top-down tactical shooter. Enter a city under lockdown, alone or in 2–4 player co-op, to find your missing sister. Scout enemy positions, use cover and tactical gear, and complete rescue and escort missions. Face off against other players in deathmatch and bomb defusal.

details.title: Othria
details.short_description: Othria is a dark pixel-art action RPG with survivors-like autocast combat. Fight endless hordes, watch them burst into loot, craft gear with orbs and grow your passive tree. Beat each island's boss to open the next. One permanent hero, nothing resets: every level, item and point you earn stays.

details.title: Spellstride VR
details.short_description: Your legs get you there. Your spells get you through. Move to advance, look to aim, and choose the right spells as enemies approach. Take on a new route every day, level up your wizard, and collect loot in this movement-driven VR spellcasting game.

details.title: The Last Bookshop
details.short_description: Reopen your father's bookshop. Stock the shelves, find the right book for each reader, and make friends around town. Follow the trail of your family's missing books.

details.title: Gravity Caverns
details.short_description: Explore vast underground caverns in this physics-based spaceship adventure. Master gravity, manage your fuel, recover containers, assist scientists, and overcome hostile robots. Navigate 30 challenging levels and safely return to your starting platform!

details.title: The White Light
details.short_description: The White Light broke, and its shards fell into six cursed worlds. Go down after them in a dark co-op roguelike for 1-4 hunters: carve through hordes, fight bosses that strike on the beat and build your hunter from 300 cards. Stay together. Alone, the dark will eat you.

details.title: Nobody Survives
details.short_description: A psx/ps1-style horror game telling the story about Bane, a former construction worker whose brother has gone missing. As a sequel of the game "Error 2351", search through old case files, talk to the residents, face the so-called "test subjects" and uncover the truth about scientist Jake Kron.

details.title: Shield Operator 2
details.short_description: You are an air defense operator. Night falls, sirens wail, and radar detects drones, missiles, and bombers. Every miss costs a home or a power grid. Hold the line, save your missiles, then strike back: launch your jets and crush enemy positions. The city remembers every strike.

details.title: Making Ends Meet
details.short_description: Sandra is 40, her son speaks in memes, her dad sees flash mobs everywhere and she has $31.40 to make it to payday. A playable story in ASCII, with turn-based battles, where your health is your money, avocado toast is the enemy and your choices matter.* (*They do not.)

details.title: Hidden Archipelago 2 New Winds
details.short_description: Return to the peaceful islands in Hidden Archipelago 2, a charming hidden object adventure featuring relaxing puzzles, beautiful coastal scenery, and delightful mini-games.

details.title: No Zombies in New York
details.short_description: No Zombies in New York is a mystery comic adventure game: read manga-style chapters and answer multiple-choice quizzes to solve the mystery. In present-day New York, you wake in a hospital with no memory and read a tablet comic, The Food Eaters, to learn who you are.

details.title: Codex Suite Master
details.short_description: Codex Suite Master is the definitive workspace for preparing your RPG campaigns and settings. Manage NPCs, maps, encounters, quests, and more to play with your friends.

details.title: Bitnook
details.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Tiny Bit Friends guard your desktop from mischievous bugs while you work: they fight, build and grow on their own, and parade out to tell you what they did when you come back.

details.title: Junction Zero
details.short_description: Junction Zero is a cyberpunk action roguelite where automatic weapon cycles meet manual twin-stick aiming as you choose a character, shape a tactical build with weapons and cyberware, and fight through escalating enemy hordes in the locked-down city of Palisade.

details.title: FLICK: Knockout
details.short_description: Every flick counts in FLICK: Knockout, a physics-driven competitive arena game. Aim your shot, knock rivals out, and turn precise hits into big plays. Build your puck lineup, master the angles, and switch things up in BOB mode. Small move. Big consequences.

details.title: Runic Cairn
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you build cairns to protect your mana orb against the shadows. Socket your runes of choice in the cairns and they can either be a full on damage dealer or a means to suppress the shadows.

details.title: Entangled
details.short_description: > A Survival Horror-Adventure RPG about coming to terms with futility. Run, hide, die, and repeat in order to keep your avatars alive. Please take care of them.

details.title: Torvane
details.short_description: Torvane is a skill-based online melee team game for PC. Take a role as tank, DPS or healer, read your opponent and win the duel with timing and spacing. Server-authoritative netcode, no pay-to-win. Your first fighter is the Khaedr, a warrior from an original sci-fi honor culture.

details.title: 忒修斯之女
details.short_description: You saved your daughter Xiaohe with an illegal operation. Now another girl's memories surface in her words and expressions. In this full-motion video adventure, trace the other side of the surgery and face a choice: bring back the girl you remember, or hold on to the one she is now?

details.title: CarCity
details.short_description: Run your own neighborhood car garage. Fix customers' cars, buy and customize your dream rides at the dealership, and race them down the drag strip. Grow from a single lift to the best shop in town, one job at a time.

details.title: 东方河城天下 ~Kawashiro Indie~
details.short_description: A chat with Hina Kagiyama gives Nitori Kawashiro an idea: turn everyday life across Gensokyo into her own Kawashiro Indie. Follow her from Youkai Mountain onward, reading prompts and tackling one fast-paced microgame after another.

details.title: BONK! The Mole Show
details.short_description: Whack-a-Mole, but one BONK can set off the whole machine. Move the hammer, pick the column and watch Tesla moles zap, bombs blast and golden chains roar. Build a wild combo engine in a pixel-art fairground roguelite.

details.title: ScrapHeads
details.short_description: Smash it all and get paid! ScrapHeads is a chaotic co-op game for up to 4 players. Scrap spaceships, mechs, and anything else that lands in your yard with ridiculous tools, explosive mayhem, and wild physics. Feed Panzarius and turn every shift into a disaster!

details.title: Limbs for Lives
details.short_description: Co-op survival after a plane crash. Every survivor is missing something: legs, arms, sight. Nobody makes it alone, so build, hunt and call for rescue together

details.title: Em the Emissary
details.short_description: Join Em the Emissary in an adventure to restore the hearts of his friends, in a cute 3D platformer! After Dis the Disciple was given the Scales of Ma'at, the jackal began weighing everyone's hearts without any counterbalance, forcing beings into a state of unrest and in need of saving.

details.title: Beaver Kart
details.short_description: Race to save the zoo! Eight animal racers, eight homemade rides and an adventure beyond the finish line. Explore colorful hubs, stack power-ups and tackle Grand Prix and boss showdowns. Drift, boost and battle solo or race friends in 2–4 player local split-screen.

details.title: The Furnace Below
details.short_description: You must keep the town warm. A mysterious Russian voice gives the orders. A short horror game where the better you work, the worse it gets.

details.title: Yonder Shores
details.short_description: Yonder Shores is a relaxing island diorama builder. Sculpt land from the sea, place cozy coastal cottages, and design charming harbours that adapt to the terrain. Featuring dynamic wildlife, weather, and zero timers or failure states, craft your peaceful seaside sanctuary at your own pace.

details.title: DELF
details.short_description: Explore a dark and dangerous cave with your team. Gather resources, craft equipment, and manage your oxygen and stamina. Evade the creature lurking in the depths, work together, and find your way out alive!

name: It's Always Grey: Serial Detective Stories

details.title: It's Always Grey: Serial Detective Stories
details.short_description: It's Always Grey is a detective mystery serial, inspired by real true crime cases. In a city of perpetual rain, Detective Molly Grey investigates a horrific discovery made years after the crime took place. Search for clues, highlight critical evidence, and connect the dots to find those responsible.

details.title: Good Boy Good Waves
details.short_description: Set out on a relaxing paddleboard journey across scenic island waters with your faithful canine companion. Catch the rhythm of gentle waves, balance your board, explore peaceful coastlines, and uncover tranquil island secrets together.

details.title: No;Heaven
details.short_description: No;Heaven is a short, single-player FPS featuring anime-style characters and gritty visuals reminiscent of early 2000s games. A young woman who has lost everything, including those she held dear, takes up arms. Witness where her path of revenge leads.

details.title: The Hearth That Waits
details.short_description: Build your whole party around one shared dice roll. Every companion reads the same result through their own runes, then acts in turn to chain combos. Plan your team in town, then set out on a warm, light-hearted fantasy adventure.

details.title: Silentes: Cursed Children
details.short_description: Explore Brazilian cities threatened by supernatural roots in this top-down 2D RPG. Investigate the source of the calamity alongside three heroes with special abilities tied to Brazilian folklore.

details.title: Amberly Hollow
details.short_description: A Life Sim RPG set in an isolated village. Train and master a variety of skills, collecting resources and rewards as you complete quests, upgrade your home, and discover the secrets of the village of Amberly.

details.title: Look Far
details.short_description: A narrative adventure that begins inside a star. You are a carbon atom, born alongside a beam of light. Your paths part. Drift through oceans and forests, and into a human life. Six and a half billion years pass for you. For the light, not a second.

details.title: Fondaco – A Venetian Merchant's Tale
details.short_description: January 1400: you are a novice merchant, unknown and with a couple of ships. Rise to the top of the Mediterranean markets, where events and rival companies can sink your trading house. Open Fondaco abroad, produce, trade and fight when you must: shape the future of the Mediterranean.

details.title: Kazu the Cassowary
details.short_description: Run, leap and claw-kick through an Australian-inspired world in this colorful single-player 3D platforming adventure. Help Kazu rescue his captured parents, explore varied landscapes and discover secrets along the way.

details.title: Beakwood
details.short_description: As a stork, deliver packages across Beakwood, a cozy town that changes with every season, while a gang of jealous, gadget-crazed hawks glide, hover and rocket in to sabotage your route.

details.title: ENGINEBOUND
details.short_description: ENGINEBOUND is a first-person survival game about a train that is bound to your soul. Keep its fire burning, drive an endless procedurally generated line, craft your way up the engine bond, and hold off the monsters that hunt in the dark.

details.title: Her Little Witch
details.short_description: A cozy yuri visual novel with dual perspectives, choices, and multiple endings! An otherworldly witch ends up living with a socially anxious manga artist. Through misunderstandings, unspoken feelings, and ordinary days, two very different girls slowly become part of each other's lives.

details.title: Something Under
details.short_description: Dig, dodge falling rocks and collect gems in an underground action-puzzle game. Play solo at your own pace, or share the cave in split-screen and local co-op over WLAN. Read the terrain, plan your route and bring everyone back as the caves get stranger below.

details.title: Grunt
details.short_description: Medieval Grunt Simulator. Wage battles of thousands as a king and then survive them as a common footsolider.

details.title: Touhou Kourindou: Appraisal Records
details.short_description: Run Kourindou, Gensokyo's odd little curio shop. Dig up strange things from the Outside World, work out what they do, and sell them to Marisa, Reimu and the girls of Gensokyo, all while a scarlet mist creeps over the sky. A cozy Touhou Project fan game of appraisal puzzles and haggling.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey Horizons
details.short_description: Voxel survival in the Satellite Odyssey universe. Explore whole planets from 400 thousand to 40 million blocks: gather, craft and build, hunt, and beware of bandit camps and infected settlements. Free on official servers. The Full Version adds your own offline world and your own server.

details.title: Abyss at Hand
details.short_description: Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord! Abyss at Hand is a multiplayer action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Experience thrilling, adrenaline-pumping battles in a vast fantasy world!

details.title: Cripta
details.short_description: A co-op roguelike for up to five heroes. Descend a crypt that changes every run, pick gifts, curses and relics, level your skills at the anvil and face the Kings of six worlds, alone or with friends, all the way down to the Hollow Seraph.

details.title: Seed & Deed
details.short_description: You rented a farm without reading the contract. Cut the weeds, plant, sell, automate and survive a landlord who keeps adding clauses. A cozy pixel-art incremental with a real ending: buy the deed before the fine print buys you.

details.title: Splash Bash: Hot Springs Party
details.short_description: A two-player party game! Team up or go head-to-head, and get this hot spring town buzzing again!

details.title: Steel Tide
details.short_description: Tanks, warships, jets and a nuclear silo. Rain blinds your scouts, night hides the enemy's assault, and one warhead can end it all. Fight through the Gulf War of 1990–91 under other flags, outwit four levels of AI, or face friends on PC, phone and browser in the same match.

details.title: Mad Rat Cafe
details.short_description: Top-down roguelite about a post-apocalyptic cafe where you cook orders and shoot your way through mutant waves. Fix broken kitchen machines and stack wild upgrades to survive every shift.

name: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure

details.title: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure
details.short_description: A top-down single-player game blending maze exploration and mechanism-based puzzles. Seek treasure chests with limited sight and fading memories of explored paths. Mix and match arcane items, solve puzzles along the way, and find a way to survive monsters and disasters.

details.title: Big Cock Inc.
details.short_description: A cozy farm sim where you arm your cocks with AK-47s and bet the rent on them in club fights. Breed the best chickens, steal and sell their eggs, send the rest down the conveyor to the fryer, and serve them through your own fried chicken drive-thru.

details.title: Yemen: The Lover
details.short_description: You travel to a remote village in Yemen to meet the woman you fell in love with online. But the locals warn you that nobody lives there anymore. So who has been waiting for you?

details.title: BloodBuild
details.short_description: BloodBuild is a roguelike deckbuilder built around build-crafting, where the challenge isn't collecting items - it's making them work together. You progress by fusing, enchanting and combining your loot into ever more powerful builds, against ever stronger enemies.

details.title: Crown of Jerusalem
details.short_description: Rule a kingdom, lead its knights, and choose the turning points of the Crusades. November 1177: the Leper King, sixteen and ill, faces Saladin's army. Ride out, or wait for help? A historical strategy game of the Crusader states, 1098–1191, with 1,500+ real figures, field battles, sieges and duels.

details.title: Creative Racers
details.short_description: Race for first place using offensive and defensive items on the other players while the course booster to gain speed as well dodging hazard. Play for fun online with friends or others. Or speedrun for for glory. Have fun your way in this fun and cute racing game.

details.title: Eldritch Drift
details.short_description: A cartoon-goth kart racer where drifting wakes the gods. Forge runes into spells, blast rivals with plasma, rift bombs and walls, and race six ghoulish drivers through a haunted mansion and a temple adrift between worlds, alone or in 2-4 player split-screen.

details.title: Tinycube Tales
details.short_description: A funny, colorful 2.5D platformer for the whole family! Play as 11 unlockable cube heroes, stomp mischievous animals, dodge giant rolling boulders and face huge bosses across 7 wild worlds, with a controller or keyboard.

details.title: Worst Wizard
details.short_description: Burn 100,000 marshmallows in a single stage. A wizard, furious that someone put sugar in his coffee without asking, wipes out the cute horde with fully automatic spells. Grow your skill tree, unlock new spells, and make every run flashier and more brutal in this incremental game.

details.title: Afterglow Interstate
details.short_description: A relaxing synthwave motorbike ride through neon cities, glowing seas, desert dunes, aurora skies and zero-gravity tubes, all moving to an expanding soundtrack. Just drive, or take on the beat, your echo, and your friends whenever you feel like it.

details.title: RhizoMana: Arbor Magna
details.short_description: A cozy adventure for a magic academy graduate: restore the disrupted mana flow, grow the best garden, unravel the mysteries of alchemy, and save a remote village from rampaging slimes.

details.title: True Cult
details.short_description: True Cult is a 2D auto-scrolling shooter blending roguelite progression with shoot 'em up action. Lead a procession escorting the Pretender to the site of their sacrifice: the Holy Hole. Enrich the Cult, obtain powerful relics, upgrade your cultists, and sacrifice every Pretender!

details.title: Uphill Both Ways
details.short_description: Two penguins, one snowball. Lean together to roll it down a six-world mountain, grow it huge, bowl through cheering crowds and chain big-air combos, then ride it all the way back up. Co-op physics comedy for two, online or on one PC, or solo with a stick per penguin.

name: Onka: Echoes of the Spirit Prison

details.title: Onka: Echoes of the Spirit Prison
details.short_description: Even those you fear once had lives of their own… Explore a Japanese manor in another realm, solve puzzles, and escape vengeful spirits as you uncover a family's past in this story-driven 3D Japanese horror adventure.

details.title: Bin There
details.short_description: sneak out at night, dig through the neighbours' bins for little treasures, trade them with a town of animal shopkeepers, and bring the good stuff home to make your den the coziest one on the block. a small cozy pixel game about trash critters.

details.title: Animal Chaos
details.short_description: Animal Chaos is a 2–5 player physics party game where oversized, round zoo animals run, roll, fight, race, and try to escape. Work together, panic in proximity voice chat, betray each other by accident, and survive the chaos.

details.title: Not Yet Recorded
details.short_description: A broadcast tape from 1955 is still warm. Rae Calloway, night host of a 1997 call-in show, falls asleep listening to it and wakes on the morning it was recorded. Take the calls, pin what the town says, and change what happened. Only she will remember.

details.title: YATAI: A STREET COOK'S TALE
details.short_description: Cook Japanese street food with your own hands: toss noodles in a wok, grill yakitori, fold gyoza. Start with a tiny cart by the station, feed the city through rain, snow and festivals, and work your way up from a humble stall to an elite restaurant.

details.title: Formula Rogue
details.short_description: You don’t drive – you make the call. Racing manager meets roguelite deckbuilder: Command two drivers with radio cards through practice, qualifying and race. Gamble on tyres, react to rain and safety cars, and build a team dynasty across eras of new regulations.

details.title: It's Not Me
details.short_description: Become a nameless Princess inside an unfinished video game from 1986. Explore, interact and choose your responses in a narrative adventure about identity and self-determination, with nine chapters and four endings shaped by your choices.

details.title: Mulligan Mayhem
details.short_description: Golf, but the course is cursed. Tee off in peace, then fight the undead horde that wakes the moment your ball lands. Launch zombies with your driver, bowl them into each other and knock them into water hazards, with up to 4 players in couch or online co-op.

details.title: Dead Apples Dream
details.short_description: The hitchhiker who went missing playing the "Dead Apples Dare"...it turns out she recorded a second tape. Tranquil green spaces change to dark corridors...it's like she's stuck in a dream...or nightmare. Watch to the end to solve the mystery...and remember to leave room for pie.

details.title: Increlight
details.short_description: Paint light into the dark in a short incremental adventure. Shape the frontier as up to 100,000 autonomous workers hold its edge, gather resources, and fuel your growth. Explore worlds that change the rules, awaken ancient Sources, and grow stronger with every dawn.

details.title: Realistic Battle Simulator
details.short_description: Two knights or twenty thousand a side: pick who fights and watch it play out. Every soldier fights by his own armour, reach, speed and nerve, and an army breaks when its courage does. March the Warpath, paint battles in the sandbox, and forge your own units and fields.

details.title: Sunflower Dance
details.short_description: Atlatonan is a 19 year old who starts her journey to Granda Oaso, the biggest commune in Gardesta, as part of the Cultural Exchange Program. Learn new things, make new friends, and find love~ This is a Solarpunk slice of life about learning stuff and enjoying whatever that makes you happy.

details.title: Pay to Think
details.short_description: An incremental game centered on intelligence as its core asset. Once, humanity became the master of the Earth by virtue of its intelligence; now, intelligence has found a new master. Intelligence no longer belongs to the smartest humans—it belongs to whoever possesses it.

details.title: Shameless Supreme
details.short_description: Shameless Supreme is a story-rich pixel RPG with turn-based combat and dark humor. Explore crumbling worlds, build your party, and combine status effects for deadly reactions. Use optional mic-powered trash talk to weaken enemies and break their defenses. Survive, and find your way home.

details.title: The Last Dry House
details.short_description: October 1999. The dam has failed, and yours is the last dry house on the hill. Each night strangers climb out of the floodwater and knock. Type any question you like through the door. Some are survivors. Some drowned days ago, and they don't know it yet.

details.title: KINETIC SINGULARITY
details.short_description: Harness the raw power of a collapsing reactor core in this minimalist physics rogue-lite. Launch kinetic sondes into a dynamic matrix, trigger high-energy chain reactions, and balance the fatal risk of the Overcharge mode. Every shot counts. Can you survive the singularity?

details.title: The Dig Show
details.short_description: The Dig Show is a cozy digging game about finding treasures on a fake TV stage. Use a metal detector, wash the dirt off your finds and show them on air. Viewers pay to watch. Upgrade your gear and dig a little deeper every day.

details.title: DWARKA
details.short_description: Dive beneath the waves in DWARKA, a first-person underwater exploration adventure in development. Prepare your gear, sail aboard SAMUDRA, manage oxygen, and investigate ocean mysteries. The full game is planned for solo play and online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Burnline Madness
details.short_description: Race, brawl and boost through traffic in Burnline Madness, a single-player motorcycle combat racer. Punch and kick rival riders, switch between unlockable weapons, chain takedowns and spend your earnings on bike upgrades across five distinct routes.

details.title: Rúnafall
details.short_description: A retro-styled co-op action roguelike in Viking-age Norway. Raid as one of five black-metal Vikings, carve through draugr, trolls and corpse-ravens, and topple the monsters who rule three cursed regions, to an original industrial metal score by Norway's Melt Motif. Solo or with up to three friends.

name: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语

details.title: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语
details.short_description: Type to mine, smelt, and forge gear with random affixes. Welcome residents, battle monsters and village trials. Stronger residents mean faster automated production. Start with one blacksmith shop and grow your town!

details.title: Sports Founder
details.short_description: Sports Founder is a turn-based strategy game where you invent a sport and grow it from a backyard game into a global obsession. Write the rules, spread it around the world, run the flagship league and outmaneuver the established sports, who won't give up their fans without a fight.

details.title: Tea & Fae
details.short_description: In late-19th-century London, Rorenna runs the shabby little tea shop her parents left behind. Grow tea, serve your guests, and brew a cup worthy of the fairy kings to earn their approval and revive The Romance Tea Room. Based on the author's original novels, with multiple romance endings.

details.title: Fernweh
details.short_description: Plan and design expansive campsites, manage resources, accommodate travelers and enjoy organic growth toward the ultimate camping experience you’ve always dreamed of.

details.title: The Hollow Crown
details.short_description: A dark, emotionally intense, and occasionally peaceful story-rich RPG where every victory can change who you become. Absorb powerful enemies, build a broken but fiercely loyal party, and choose when power is worth the cost. Become The Devourer and decide what kind of monster, or man, you become.

details.title: Primetime Overkill
details.short_description: A top-down action roguelite on a death-game TV network. Four drones shoot for you, you handle the katana, and it never stops raining in the back streets where VOXZERO films its contestants. The chat votes to send in the hounds, and the black hole in your contract is billed by the second.

details.title: SHOCKWAVE
details.short_description: An anti-gravity racer drawn in pure light. Seven wireframe tracks, eight ships and real racing physics — the desktop edition of a racing game built for the 1982 Vectrex, the console that drew with an electron beam.

details.title: Higanbana
details.short_description: A co-op souls-like, where a young Samurai and cursed Doll work together to traverse an abandoned land swarmed with Yokai. Together with a spear and magic, they must defeat the challenging foes and unforgiving bosses to restore the Dolls original body and save the Samurai’s village.

details.title: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden
details.short_description: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that sits in the corner of your desktop, on top of your windows, while you work. It carries on without you: water flows, koi and crabs go about their day, and night falls when it does outside. Reach in to dig, pour and build whenever you like.

details.title: Fors Magika
details.short_description: Fors Magika is a strategic card game where your hand is your battlefield! Choose a wizard, cast elemental spells, use Blessings and Curses, and outsmart your opponents. Uncover the enemy wizard and defeat them in fast-paced battles where every card counts.

details.title: Ink And Table
details.short_description: A cute action roguelike where you play a tiny doll defending a girl’s possessed home, one tabletop at a time. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with simple left-right movement as you command flying swords and fire ink bullets at haunted teacups, ink paintings, and even braised pork.

details.title: Double Trouble Delivery
details.short_description: A two-player online coop physics game. One of you drives, the other keeps the packages balanced. Solve mini-games, dodge obstacles, and find the right house before the dogs steal your cargo.

details.title: Manga Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Sales by day, loot hunting by night. Stock the shelves of your shop with fresh manga volumes and serve your customers. By night, open your eyes in a dungeon spilling off the page, defeat monsters and collect your loot. What will you find to display in your shop?

details.title: Sunderkin
details.short_description: Venture into a broken land and forge a hero strong enough to overthrow its tyrant. Loot gear, collect spells, and combine them into a build of your own. Then put it to the test in brutal turn-based duels where every blow counts.

details.title: The Last Bureau
details.short_description: In this pessimistic and atmospheric grid-based horror game, you wonder if still being alive really is a blessing, or a fate much worse than death.

details.title: Porta Patrol
details.short_description: A co-op comedy game for 1-4 players running a porta-potty service at music festivals. Drive the tanker, pump out full toilets, pressure-wash the mess, crane-lift cabins with someone still inside and hose down gatecrashers. Keep the festival clean to win bigger contracts. It's just another shift.

details.title: Forgotten Tactics
details.short_description: Fantasy grand strategy on the map, turn-based tactics on the field. Govern 71 counties, strike treaties and break them, while 17 rival houses and roaming fiends move at once. When armies meet, lead your champions into skill-card battles where one careless push can cost a whole company.

details.title: The Somnus Fracture
details.short_description: First-person psychological horror. Alex Reed signed up for Project Somnus to finally sleep. Every session drops him into a dream built from his own past, and something that knows his name is waiting there. Hide, run, and put back the life he can’t remember.

details.title: Gemwood
details.short_description: Run a cozy jewelry workshop in the woods. Mine for gems, cut and polish them, then design rings, necklaces and brooches for your animal customers. Mix metals and decorations, wrap each order and haggle over the price, or craft freely and display your favorites.

details.title: Little Rug Shop
details.short_description: Run a cozy little rug workshop. Draw rugs for your clients on an iPad, tuft them stitch by stitch, flip the frame for the big reveal, then shave and carve them by hand. Worn rugs come in too: wash out the stains and re-tuft the damage.

details.title: NIGHTSOMNIA
details.short_description: Work the night shift as a federal crisis analyst. Investigate kidnappings, disappearances and threats via live messages from people in danger. Trace phones, review CCTV and search databases as time runs out. Your decisions determine who makes it home. Not every threat comes from outside your agency.

details.title: Shadow Fruit Duel
details.short_description: Shadow Fruit Duel is a chaotic 2-player arena brawler starring adorable fruit ninjas! Dash, strike, throw weapons, and outsmart your rival across colorful arenas packed with traps and hazards. Grab power-ups, turn the battlefield to your advantage, and fight for fruity glory!

details.title: Hamster Special Agent
details.short_description: Hamster Special Agent is a 2-player co-op platformer! Become two chubby hamsters and work together to deliver cargo through seesaws, lifts, and spinning obstacles. Keep the crate from falling, reach the finish line together, and aim for a three-star clear!

details.title: Spadegrave
details.short_description: What if poker hands were your greatest weapons? Spadegrave combines roguelike deckbuilding with poker-inspired combat. Build pairs, full houses, and four of a kind to unleash powerful effects, outplay enemies with higher cards and trumps, and bend the odds with game-changing relics.

details.title: Robot Crucible
details.short_description: Build a fighting robot in 5 minutes, or perfect it over 5 hours, then destroy your opponents! Sketch out a chassis, snap on some motors and wheels, choose a weapon, and throw it into the arena against the AI or friends in local multiplayer.

details.title: Glimm&Grimm
details.short_description: Glimm&Grimm is a RTS | TD. Set in the far dark Future! Using Ones Glimms and their Unique Abilties, Defenses, and Powers against the Nightmares of the Grimm, that are longing for ones Soul! There are Many Areas, causing varied Strategies along with changing Wheather, Seasons and Obstacles over Time!

details.title: Lithari
details.short_description: A competitive PvP card battler where every card is unlocked from day one. Build your deck or hit Wildcard for a random one, pick a Helper, draft Augments mid-match and channel three veins of power (Mana, Fury and Will) to outplay your opponent.

details.title: The Happy Place
details.short_description: A psychological horror adventure about a small light. Keep your glow alive in the dark, explore a village that forgot how to play, talk to the people still waiting there, and make choices you can't take back, each one leading the story down a different path.

details.title: Pro Yakyu Front Office
details.short_description: Take charge of a fictional Japanese pro baseball club as general manager. Draft players on your scouts' judgment, set the lineup and the rotation, earn from sponsors and the ballpark, manage the payroll, and answer to the owner. The games play themselves; the decisions are yours.

details.title: BRAZUELA
details.short_description: Start from scratch and build your own path in Brazuela, a political and life simulation game set in Brazil. Work, study, join a political party, run for office, build relationships, earn positions of power, and take part in the decisions that shape the world around you. Which path will you choose?

details.title: Blind Dial
details.short_description: A pixel-art co-op action RPG for 1-4 players, online or on one screen. Dial a Gate to worlds nobody has charted, fight your way down, and decide when to turn back. What you bring home rebuilds the base. What you lose stays out there.

details.title: Slab Drifter
details.short_description: Slab Drifter is a space-based tactical physics destruction game. The Slab was fractured. The Lords were born. All that remains are corrupted machines and the drifters who scavenge among them. Pilot your drones to hunt the massive Lords and discover their weaknesses.

details.title: Thicker than Ichor
details.short_description: Blood is thicker than water. Ichor is thicker than both. Aliens spliced you by mistake, and now you're whipping, shooting and punching your way out of a mutated hotel in a totally fictional city in a first-person roguelite brawler.

details.title: Frog Forage
details.short_description: Become a frog forager in a cozy incremental farming game. Explore four biomes, hire helpers, brew jam and power up your upgrade tree to make every run better than the last!

details.title: The Last Engineer on Earth
details.short_description: Survive alone on a wild Earth, ten thousand years after the machines won. Craft by hand, then build robots and program them with drag-and-drop blocks to run your base. The map is the whole real planet, and you choose where to land.

details.title: The Time-Seeing Cat: Prologue
details.short_description: The world has already ended once. Knowing what awaits, the protagonist returns two months into the past. Foresee future events, change people's fates, and even use knowledge of the future to overcome powerful bosses. A suspense-driven JRPG where knowing the future is itself part of the gameplay.

details.title: Station Between
details.short_description: A cozy, small-scale, coffee shop and talking simulator. As a raccoon barista, you have a gift for warming people’s hearts: brew coffee, match flavours to your customers and discover their stories. Help travellers sort out their final errands before they catch their last train.

name: 追光探偵物語 FOLLOWSPOT — A Detective Story

details.title: 追光探偵物語 FOLLOWSPOT — A Detective Story
details.short_description: A retro-flavored, command-based detective adventure in the style of classic Japanese PC games. Set in the early 2000s. Japanese only.

details.title: Oath Eternal
details.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

details.title: Big Top
details.short_description: Big Top is an active carnival incremental where every shot, throw, and swing earns tickets. Collect game-changing prizes, build powerful combinations, and conquer the carnival on your quest to claim the legendary Super Playbox!

details.title: Hallowers the pilgrimage
details.short_description: Hallowers, the pilgrimage, is a Card and Creature collection turn based RPG where you command the spirits of the Kin Realm in your first Hallower pilgrimage. Train them, fight with them, give them forbidden attacks and evolve them into powerful beings at the height of the very Gods.

details.title: Fateward
details.short_description: An RPG that plays out in film and bends with every decision and every path you take. A young adventurer leaves his home and walks into legend: a sentient blade at his side, gods watching, an old danger stirring at the frontier of the kingdom. The fate of the world is yours to shape.

details.title: Hadal Zone
details.short_description: Survive this puzzle-horror adventure and uncover the truth behind the terrible story hiding in the depths of the aquarium! But beware: once you cross the point of no return, there is no going back...

details.title: Starter Dungeon
details.short_description: A challenging Tower Defense game set in the world of a fantasy game. Manage a dungeon by reading through monster resumes and choosing who to hire, then summoning them to defeat the waves of incoming heroes after your treasure!

details.title: Chronogoblin
details.short_description: An incremental platformer about a goblin, a sarcastic time machine, and many, many clones. Run parkour courses across history, beat your best time, then buy clones of yourself that run it forever, earning while you explore. They don't mind. Right?

details.title: Expand TD
details.short_description: Expand TD is a tower defense roguelite. Explore the map between waves, build your defenses, and discover useful locations, strange encounters, hidden rewards, and dangerous threats on every run.

details.title: 300 Seconds Before Darkness
details.short_description: While venturing in total darkness, your only goal is to survive. Collect precious resources while fighting off hordes of monsters coming for you with your army of drones. But be smart, as your flashlight can give out at any time... To be bold or play safe, the choice is yours. May the best survives!

details.title: Clock Mayhem
details.short_description: Clock Mayhem is an action platformer with timed levels that force players to complete each stage under pressure using tight controls, character skills, and unique abilities.

details.title: Bird
details.short_description: A simple yet addictive puzzle where characters lay eggs, connect them, and clear the board. Move them in four directions to reshape the field and match three or more of the same color for satisfying chains in quick, strategic turns.

details.title: Little Bastard
details.short_description: A crazy co-op run from a hungry monster will test your friendship to the limit! Team up or double-cross each other: lock your friend in a washing machine, dunk 'em in a toilet, or extend a helping hook — all for resources! Between matches, develop your business: a nightclub. Chaos and trash-fun!

details.title: Cookwagon
details.short_description: Play your cards into the pot and serve up signature dishes! Cookwagon is a fantasy cooking roguelike deckbuilder with no traditional combat. Manage three pots, serve guests before they lose patience, and collect cards and relics to shape your playstyle.

details.title: Feather Trace
details.short_description: Inside vast biodomes, embark on a one-of-a-kind birdwatching journey built around deck-building, Birdpedia collection, and long-term progression. Explore diverse habitats, meet birds of every kind, and study them through card-based play to fill out your Birdpedia.

details.title: Shanhe Builders
details.short_description: Lead one to five companions in a Chinese-inspired 3D home-building survival sim. Gather and haul supplies, build timber, stone and adobe homes, and manage farming, cooking and rest. Command your group from above or take direct control as your camp grows into a home.

details.title: ROUDO OF THE HERO
details.short_description: A time-attack-style 3D action game where you control a cast of unique characters as you race from the grasslands to the Demon King’s Castle. Will you fight the enemies, or ignore them and rush ahead? The ending changes depending on your route and the time it takes to complete the game.

details.title: The Lost Cape
details.short_description: The Lost Cape is a first-person survival game set on a mysterious tropical island. Explore, build, hunt, and uncover its secrets. When night falls, beware of a blind creature that hunts by sound. Play solo or in online co-op and find a way to escape.

details.title: Shadow Wake
details.short_description: Shadow Wake is a classic retro-arcade game with an 80s vibe. Lasers. Neon. Space. Battle hordes of aliens in fast-paced combat, manage your ship’s energy, and upgrade your gear.

details.title: Shouhon
details.short_description: Shouhon is a roguelike Metroidvania game. You play as a ghost who falls into an underground tomb and possesses the body of an abandoned jiangshi doll. Your goal is to escape the tomb by harnessing the powers of various talismans and relics.

details.title: Gilt & Grime
details.short_description: Cast out penniless, stripped of your name and your love, you come to Tradeshaven, a town that respects only money. Build the fortune to win it all back. Honest work is slow and never quite enough. The other kind pays better. A medieval life-sim about how high you'll climb, and what it costs you.

details.title: Claim the Gods
details.short_description: Would you dare to defy the gods? Claim their power? Then battle in this roguelike deckbuilder where you can win new cards, power up and Claim the Gods! But be warned mortal, if you fail, there will be consequences!

details.title: Songkran Hazard: 4Lom
details.short_description: Lock, load, and stay dry! Step into the soaked slippers of Rookie Cop “Lee” in this high-octane survival “horror?”. Armed with water guns and wet powder, escort Anchan through Bangkok's chaotic Silom Road during the wildest Songkran outbreak ever. Can you survive the Songkran hazard?

details.title: Water's Bounty
details.short_description: Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly.
publishers: Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios

details.title: Chronicles of the Six Sages
details.short_description: This game is a Turn Based JRPG with real time mechanics in order to overcome the enemies attacks. The game features a fully unique gear system, allowing for the player to fully customize their party to their choosing

details.title: Banners & Frontlines
details.short_description: Hold the line in a single-player, turn-based card strategy game. Combine infantry, archers and cavalry, commit reserves and pull battered troops back to reform. Fight historical campaigns or keep a mercenary company alive through contracts, recruits and captured banners.

details.title: Tiny Lords
details.short_description: Build your own army, command your soldiers, and join chaotic multiplayer medieval battles powered by physics-based combat. From massive castle sieges to intense arena fights, experience a unique blend of skill, strategy, and unforgettable action.

details.title: Windrest Chronicle: Dragonport Diner
details.short_description: Your hometown rests on a great sea dragon. Farm, fish, forage, and explore as it carries your town across the ocean. Gather ingredients, cook for locals and travelers, restore the diner, discover recipes, make friends, and fall in love. Make Dragonport the warmest light on the sea.

details.title: Our Fleet Is In Orbit
details.short_description: A single-player space-strategy roguelite about reconquering a shattered empire across a procedurally generated galaxy. Plan fleet battles that unfold on your orders, and drive ground invasions front by front across the planet below. Every ship, crew, and army you lose is gone for good.

details.title: FEYFAE
details.short_description: A whimsical horror roguelite with 2D bullet hell platforming, strange companions, and lovely things hidden in unlovely places. Descend, survive, and fight your way down a collapsed research facility to uncover the truth of what was done to your family.

details.title: A Mission Full of Cats
details.short_description: A Mission Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you help Fofiño bring all the cats back to Gattaca! This intergalactic vacation is coming to an end, and it's time to track down all the cats scattered across the universe!

details.title: Nostalgiallo
details.short_description: A surreal point-and-click with vote-based combat, taking place in a corrupted world based on Spanish "Tebeo" slapstick comics.

details.title: dungeons and glory
details.short_description: Dodge enemy fire alone or in online co-op as you raid 5–25 minute portal expeditions. Shape your build through equipment, skills, stats, and risky loot, defeat the boss, and bring your haul home—assuming the Directorate’s plan survives contact.

details.title: OVERQUOTA
details.short_description: Build compact machine networks, route packets, manage heat, and crush rising quotas in this factory-building roguelike. Buy new machines, stack powerful relics, and survive run-changing Boss Blinds.

details.title: Planet Gray Starlight Episode
details.short_description: An adventure game where you travel through the galaxy together in a shiny spaceship.

details.title: Alien Exterminators
details.short_description: Grab your gear, take a contract, and exterminate hostile alien infestations with up to three friends across unpredictable planets full of chaos, danger, and bad workplace conditions.

details.title: Evening, Boss.
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror about keeping a London cab firm located deep in the forest running after dark.

details.title: The Cardkov
details.short_description: Turn poker hands into weapons in this single-player, top-down extraction shooter. Collect discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, build a hand, and use your new weapon to uncover the factory's secrets. Grab one more card, or make it back alive with the hand you've got.

name: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation

details.title: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation
details.short_description: Your boss won't let you quit. So this is a boss fight. Read the excuses, answer with strategy cards, and put the evidence on the table. A resignation-negotiation ADV.

details.title: Late Stage Gambling
details.short_description: Here you don't pick up loot. You gamble for it. In this top-down shooter roguelike, you wager before every wave to get your gear. The higher the stakes, the stronger the rewards and the more it hurts when you lose. Fight through a blood-soaked casino to pay off a debt built to kill you.

details.title: Before The Meteor
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person adventure built around exploration and discovery. Travel through breathtaking landscapes, encounter dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden across a vast and mysterious world.

details.title: My Dream Closet
details.short_description: My Dream Closet is a free retro dress up game inspired by the 2000's girl games! You'll have to create your perfect outfit for a night out! Discover the theme and follow your creativity to design the most incredible outfit! ☀️

details.title: Ruru & Lala: Wonder World Adventure!
details.short_description: Ruru & Lala is a 2D action-puzzle game where you control two characters simultaneously. After Ruru is pulled into a mysterious mirror, she meets Lala, another version of herself from the mirror world. Together, embark on a great adventure through a mysterious world!

details.title: Dragons Invasion
details.short_description: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.

details.title: Little Magic Fish Story
details.short_description: Little Magic Fish Story is a life sim and party-based action RPG. Farm, cook, fish, and raise animals in Anyu Town. Turn harvests into supplies and command companions in the Silent Forest. Amid warm days and strange disturbances, the adventurers' story begins.

details.title: WARDER
details.short_description: You are a police officer sent to investigate a call from an abandoned mansion. Deep beneath the mansion lies a hidden medical facility connected to the mysterious Dr. Warder. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and hide from the doctor as you uncover what happened inside his facility.

details.title: Cravecrops - Farming Defense
details.short_description: Grow suspicious experimental plants by day and defend your plantation from hordes of addicted animals by night. Sell your harvest, upgrade your defenses, and expand your operation in this farming defense roguelite.

details.title: Pressure Express
details.short_description: Pressure Express is a 1–4 player co-op party roguelite where delivery droids operate a submarine, manage failing systems, protect temperamental cargo, and survive the dangers of a flooded world.

details.title: Mind Mirror
details.short_description: A puzzle game set in a millennial-era household. Featuring immersive, retro-styled puzzles full of nostalgic vibes, alongside abundant dreamlike elements.

details.title: Upwell
details.short_description: Upwell is a fast-paced rocket jumping roguelike. Explode yourself to climb an ever-changing well full of rising lava and fleshy monsters. Battle bosses with airborne acrobatics and ascend in search of a way out.

details.title: LUNAR PULSE
