details.short_description: "LUNAR PULSE" is a single-player roguelite card game. Ultra-short battles decided within 60 seconds. Experience soulslike tension where a single move leads to instant death. It features a game system where players act simultaneously with hands revealed.

details.title: In Perfection
details.short_description: A writer is trying to finish his "perfect work," but things keep getting in his way. He is poor and full of anxiety. In this retro lo-fi visual novel, fix the problems with point-and-click, explore the depths of consciousness. Forgive yourself? or stare into the dark and fall deeper? It's up to you.

details.title: We Believe in No Gods
details.short_description: Awaken as a forgotten deity in a post-apocalyptic wasteland ruled by staunch materialists. Listen to desperate prayers—bestow miracles or watch with cold indifference. Extract faith to survive, manipulate mortal minds, and shape the ultimate fate of a world where We Believe In No Gods.

details.title: His Last Film
details.short_description: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

details.title: Depth-Bound
details.short_description: 🌊 A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. 🚀 Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. 📸 Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

details.title: The End of Allegoria
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG where your choices determine the fate of the world. Traverse a world that changes as you explore it, find new companions, and combine different class skills by mastering a multitude of equipment.

details.title: Grid Grief
details.short_description: A roguelite plinko style deckbuilder about escaping the space between heaven & hell. Forge powerful synergies, trigger chaotic effects and rack up huge scores to secure your resurrection.

details.title: Rotten Chamber
details.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

details.title: Ciella's Casebook
details.short_description: Mystery adventure game set one year after the war, following the journey of a war-veteran detective Ciella and her assistant Ricky in the industrial city of Actain.

details.title: Heirlooms
details.short_description: A letter has just arrived for you, Jack. Reclaim your legacy in this lovecraftian old-school dungeon crawler. Uncover misteries, face once buried horrors and survive. Fear what should be left forgotten.

details.title: Scindistella
details.short_description: Scindistella is a fast-paced space arcade game about a large-scale war between two powers. Take part in fighter battles, destroy cruisers and stations, fight in planetary orbits, and invade enemy systems.

details.title: Arc of Icarus
details.short_description: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

details.title: Papaya Plaza
details.short_description: Rebuild a faded tourist town as its new mayor! Place shops and decorations, staff them with quirky villagers to earn cash each day, and help out with their favours. Every night the judges score your town, so rank up, unlock new buildings, and get that coveted 5-star rating. Peep peep!

details.title: Code Cross
details.short_description: A game where you must solve puzzles to see the full picture.

details.title: Endless Endless Ocean
details.short_description: Suddenly appearing in existence, clinging onto your fragile life, travel an endless ocean in a goal of finding out if you can escape. Survival isn't just about food and shelter, but you're bound to finding that out.

details.title: Sang-Je
details.short_description: Will you master the movement and techniques to infiltrate a crumbling research facility in the far future. In a race against time you must uncover the harrowing secrets that lie deep beneath. Something has awakened there, something that threatens to change the world forever.

details.title: Kolchanovo: The Manor
details.short_description: A journalist arrives to investigate a children’s sanatorium in an old merchant house that was reported burned down. But the building stands completely intact. Everything feels surreal and wrong. A little girl watching him from one of the windows might be the only one who knows the truth.

details.title: Withering State
details.short_description: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

details.title: The Lost Froglins
details.short_description: What if Vampire Survivors was a platformer? 100 lost baby froglins are trapped in a cave. Every one you save joins your swarm and fights for you. One is cute. Ten is trouble. A hundred is unstoppable. Die, upgrade, go again. A roguelite side-scroller.

name: Singularity Simulator: Click Is All You Need

details.title: Singularity Simulator: Click Is All You Need
details.short_description: A clicker/incremental game where you run an AI development company and aim for the technological singularity. Click to write code, hire researchers, build data centers, and turn the galaxy into computing resources.

details.title: HearthFall
details.short_description: A cosy fantasy RPG where you build and run your own tavern, alone or with up to 3 friends online. Raise it storey by storey, cook and brew for named guests who remember you, rent rooms to travellers, and farm, fish and hunt for your kitchen.

details.title: Supernova Deliveries
details.short_description: Haul cargo across a rusty asteroid belt in a duct-taped space truck. Your trailer swings with real zero-g physics, how you pack it moves your centre of mass, pirates want your load and Vito the loan shark wants his money. Don't forget to HONK.

details.title: Drained Creatures
details.short_description: Drained Creatures is a multiplayer 3D arena brawler for up to 8 players locally, playable using gamepads only.

name: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure

details.title: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure
details.short_description: Mana & Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure is a 3D open-world platformer filled with fun and exploration, inspired by classics like Banjo-Kazooie. Join Mana on a journey to learn magical abilities and help restore her master to his rightful body.

details.title: Chimaera Evolution
details.short_description: Pixel art monster-capture RPG with tactical turn-based combat. Track elusive Shiny Chimaeras, cross-breed perfect genes through egg breeding, and craft survival gear to conquer a vast world. Master evolution and build the ultimate squad.

details.title: Digital Civilization: Evolution
details.short_description: Build your own empire! Evolve from a primitive civilization and rise to become the strongest and greatest empire of all! Manage resources, construct buildings, and engage in diplomacy with other nations, as you grow your civilization step by step into an unstoppable powerhouse.

details.title: Beast Survivor 3D
details.short_description: Battle thousands of monsters in this 3D action-survival game. Harness elemental resonance to unleash magic, from ground spikes to celestial meteors. Adapt your evolution mid-combat, using rapid skill combos and domain buffs to reign as the apex predator of this savage world.

details.title: Annexation
details.short_description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in Arcade Missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

details.title: Oneiron Expanse
details.short_description: Your world is abruptly erased. Only the Oneiron Expanse remains; a Plane where your mental state evokes lethal potential. Embark on a deckbuilding odyssey where every card is a fragment of your will. Find the Dreamwright and dream your reality back into being... before your memories fade

details.title: Shadow Seeker
details.short_description: Shadow Seeker is a 2D survival-horror action game with a noir detective story. You are Carlos Ramirez, a detective from the Amorita Police Department. You must solve a mysterious case while braving the looming evil that awaits you at every turn.

details.title: Asteroid Hopper
details.short_description: Asteroid Hopper is a cute space adventure puzzle game set in a colorful cosmos. Hop between asteroids, explore, optimize your path, manage resources, and survive in the hazardous depths of space.

name: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints

details.title: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints
details.short_description: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

details.title: Faryloopa
details.short_description: Build the board. Play the cards. Roll the dice. Faryloopa is a roguelike deckbuilder meets boardbuilder where every run is a new layout, new synergies, and bigger scores to chase.

details.title: ALLARA
details.short_description: Allara is a 2D pixel-art Metroidvania soulslike set in pre-colonial East Siberia. Play as a shamanka defending her homeland, exploring mythic realms of the sacred world tree, battling brutal bosses, uncovering relics, and mastering a strategic single-skill combat system.

details.title: Mahfam: The Cursed Village
details.short_description: In 1970, eighteen children vanished overnight across eight Iranian villages. Two were later found near Mahfam Village. According to their accounts, Mahfam is no ordinary place but a terrifying site inhabited by supernatural beings. Photographer Farshid heads toward this village of horror.

details.title: She Hunts
details.short_description: She Hunts is an exploration focused narrative action-adventure game set in a fairy tale forest. Battle corrupted creatures with your trusty crossbow and lay clever traps for your foes. But beware the night, for the setting sun heralds the coming of the Beast...

details.title: Revery Realm
details.short_description: Revery Realm is a Turn-based, DICE-building Roguelike where you lead a party of three through a mysterious fantasy world. Roll and customize your dice, discover powerful Sigils and Guardians, and combine their unique effects to create builds of your own.

details.title: Party Ships
details.short_description: Party Ships is the party brawler that's secretly a physics sandbox. Mix ridiculous items into accidental synergies and unleash them on your mates! Last one standing wins. Simple... right?

details.title: Feetball
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person football game where precision, skill, and chaos collide. Take full control of every touch, tackle, and strike with realistic ball physics and fluid physical movement. Master the pitch with friends, or team up with others looking to dominate.

details.title: Lazare's Sacrifice
details.short_description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

details.title: Ad Reditus
details.short_description: A hand-drawn roundtrip roguelike deckbuilder about a pilgrimage and a ring that wants to change you. Build your deck on the way out. Decide what it becomes on the way back.

details.title: Tiny Biomes
details.short_description: A build-your-own aquarium sandbox. Shape the glass, sculpt the substrate, design every plant, hang the lights, then stock the water and live with what you made.

details.title: Meat Block
details.short_description: MEAT BLOCK is a first-person survival horror set in an isolated Siberian city. Explore hostile locations, solve puzzles, scavenge for limited resources, fight the infected, and descend deeper into the hidden infrastructure beneath the city

details.title: Waifus VS Robots
details.short_description: They took the ones they loved. They brought guns. Fight through an army of robots in this action-packed 2.5D roguelite inspired by classic run-and-gun games. Shoot, explode, upgrade your weapons, and make the machines pay.

details.title: One more, please
details.short_description: You're a bartender in a port pub: keep the shift alive and answer for the advice you give from the counter. Your yes and no change your guests' fates, and the drink decides how they live this evening and, maybe, their life. An ironic pub sim on the Melancholy Shores, made by hand.

details.title: Bleach & Blood
details.short_description: A PS1-style, first-person slasher horror game. Work the night shift at a small-town laundromat as a killer stalks the streets. Serve strange customers, uncover a darkening mystery, and survive the nights ahead.

details.title: RAKKA: WAKE 02 - DECEIT
details.short_description: RAKKA: WAKE 02 – DECEIT is a gritty, 90s-inspired psychological mystery visual novel driven by character drama, branching choices and minigames. A chase across Europe pulls you into a mystery that only deepens into a web of lies, danger and deceit.

details.title: Gribble Space
details.short_description: A cube planet, a bubble gun and a pet shop to run. Catch the local wildlife alive, give every species the right pen, set your own prices and serve the aliens stepping out of the portal. Solo or up to four online.

details.title: Elf Shift
details.short_description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

details.title: Tairum
details.short_description: Slash, ram and blast through waves of corporate cops, goons, drones and mechs in this top-down cyberpunk arena auto-shooter roguelite. Pick your route and cut risky deals. Hunt smuggler's caches to fill 5 ability slots. Augment your operatives and upgrade your hideout. Solo or 2-player local co-op.

details.title: WHEN ARMIES WAVER
details.short_description: Break enemy morale and push the line. Command your whole army in a real-time medieval battle roguelite. Advance, defend, or retreat; choose one of three rewards to build your army; and weigh losses against risky routes to the final battle.

details.title: Beyond the Noise: Radio Observatory
details.short_description: Beyond The Noise: Radio Observatory is an indie project created by a radio astronomy enthusiast. Build and manage your own radio observatory. Operate powerful radio telescopes, explore the universe, detect realistic cosmic signals and uncover mysteries hidden beyond the noise.

details.title: Across Crime
details.short_description: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

details.title: Sneak Souls
details.short_description: A familiar cubic aesthetic, an extinct ancient underground civilization, and a living plant. Check out what awaits you!

details.title: Oasis Bloom
details.short_description: Revive and terraform a dead alien planet in this sci-fi farming / life sim. Terraform the frozen wastes, grow rule-breaking mutant crops, team up with an alien AI to revive extinct alien creatures, and build a thriving colony of settlers to befriend and romance.

name: You're Absolutely Right! Or: A lovehate game about technology

details.title: You're Absolutely Right! Or: A lovehate game about technology
details.short_description: The authentic AI industry experience. Answer stupid user questions, make ethical company decisions, and uh... cause nobody any harm! An apocaloptimist game about technology!

name: Mykyta Pylypovych and the antikythera of the steppe

details.title: Mykyta Pylypovych and the antikythera of the steppe
details.short_description: Mykyta Pylypovych, PhD, has a little secret, an inner voice guiding him through difficult situations. Use classic parser commands or advise Mykyta with a natural language, to aid his perilous research activities and, maybe, to save the whole free world!

details.title: He Was Here
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as an unnamed employee of Tervex Industries. Navigate a 2000s-era computer to explore the fragmented memories of Alex Smith, a patient experiencing psychosis. Piece together her distorted memories and uncover disturbing family secrets.

details.title: Share the Load
details.short_description: A co-op adventure where the journey is everything. Travel alone or with friends, protect a powerful orb, and brave a world filled with peril on your quest to destroy it. Every challenge strengthens or breaks your party. Will you reach the end of the road?

details.title: I Hear the Forest
details.short_description: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

details.title: Saturn 94
details.short_description: You are the keeper of Orbita, a Soviet station orbiting Saturn. Keep the failing station alive, assemble cargo rockets, and supply the colonies. Supplies run short, and something aboard never made it into the reports. Obey orders, or defy the Party? Lives depend on you.

details.title: Hameldaeme
details.short_description: Hameldaeme is a real-time sandbox lifesim set in a little canalside village. Decorate indoors and outdoors, make friends with townsfolk, partake in year-round village events, collect trinkets, pick up litter, go fishing, and help a village on the backfoot return to being a cohesive community!

details.title: MISSING PLAY
details.short_description: MISSING PLAY is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player faces off against the rest. Play as a survivor, cooperate with your teammates, complete objectives, and escape… or become the monster and do everything you can to stop them. It's free and will remain free.

details.title: The Vestige
details.short_description: An action RPG where you play as a cyborg fighting rogue robots with melee combat and improvised weapons. Hack computers to recover your past and take down a tyrant AI.

details.title: The Arch-Enemy of Hy-Brasil
details.short_description: 勇者が敗北した世界で目醒めたあなたは、魔王を倒すために冒険に向かうことになる。停滞した世界で最後にあなたが選ぶのは再生？ それとも、破滅？

details.title: Cardboard Gladiators
details.short_description: A PvPvE inventory management autobattler with asynchronous multiplayer! Build a team of gladiators, craft and equip powerful items, discover game-breaking synergies, and outsmart opponents with clever battleplans.

details.title: Chronos Arena
details.short_description: Heavy armor meets modern ballistics: Battle it out in fast-paced 2D top-down PvP arena matches deep inside the dungeon. Upgrade your arsenal with modular attachments, stack devastating blessings, and master skill-based gunplay to dominate your enemies.

details.title: Humane Farm
details.short_description: Program an army of robots to automate your farm in the year 2049. Under the rule of Robot Overlords, you’ve been chosen for a unique cooperation experiment. Grow crops, care for animals, make ethical choices, and master a visual programming language to automate every task on your farm.

details.title: One Star Express
details.short_description: Cosmic teleportation is down, and no one is happy about going back to spaceship travel! Seat quirky aliens in ways that let you satisfy their quirks and demands throughout the journey. Navigate strange cosmic events, return lost items, earn passenger reviews, and make sure everyone arrives smiling.

details.title: Delta Neutral
details.short_description: The top-down space sim. Fly, trade, and fight in a galaxy shaped by history, where production, freight, and war reshape a living economy.

details.title: Zala
details.short_description: Zala is a roguelike about breaking bricks and catching thousands of gold coins. Combine 100+ game changing upgrades, destroy 1000+ unique stages and fight powerful bosses made of curse bricks. Make the right choices and you'll swim in gold.

details.title: Stackers
details.short_description: Stack it, craft it, explore it. Stackers is a tile-based crafting sim. Start small, experiment with all kinds of combinations, and grow. Journey through nine biomes, defeat the boss of each one, and uncover the secrets hidden in the world.

details.title: Bird Poo Game
details.short_description: Cause chaos from the sky and profit underground. Drop poop on pedestrians to send them rushing to Bob's laundromat. Collect coins, upgrade machines, unlock explosive abilities, and build a bizarre laundry empire one splat at a time.

details.title: Michael Test
details.short_description: This is a test about sin. An audio-driven horror mystery where you reconstruct the hidden timeline inside a painting through sound and expose the sin concealed within.

details.title: Lone Warrior
details.short_description: Lone Warrior is a fast-paced incremental action game built around reaction-based 1-on-1 battles. Dodge enemy attacks, punish brief openings and keep the gold you earn after death to unlock new spells, stats and permanent upgrades.

details.title: Grimwar
details.short_description: Grimwar is a CLASS-BASED MULTIPLAYER FPS where six classes fight for two rival superpowers using WWII-era weapons and magic. Set in the 3040s, it brings back the chaotic, casual feel of classic online shooters, with multiple game modes, ranked matchmaking, community servers, custom maps, and mods.

details.title: Chrono Wing: Cats in Space!
details.short_description: Chrono Wing: Cats in Space!" is a 90s-inspired SHMUP. Master five action-packed stages and use your time-rewinding abilities to dodge the game-over screen and build huge combos.

details.title: Mummy's Escape
details.short_description: After centuries of slumber, Rek awakens to find his beloved Nilo missing. Travel through ancient pyramids, oasis paths, and forgotten ruins, mastering three unique forms to overcome challenges and defeat the guardians standing in your way.

details.title: Whiskers In The Sand
details.short_description: Whiskers In The Sand is a fast-paced survivors-like arena roguelite where battle-ready cats shred through hordes of undead desert monsters. Unlock new cats, collect relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds to survive the pharaoh's second reign.

details.title: FUTURE:ONE
details.short_description: FUTURE:ONE is a living desktop companion designed to feel expressive, reactive, and alive — sharing your screen with dynamic animations, playful reactions, customization, and subtle presence while you work, game, browse, or relax.

details.title: Coin Mechanica
details.short_description: 『Coin Mechanica』 is a VR-compatible roguelike boomer shooter. Crush demonic invaders with a storm of coins and explosive blasts! Rip out the cores of vicious demons possessing treasure, then reduce their bodies to even more coins!

details.title: Hordestomp
details.short_description: Embrace the chaos of thousands of enemies rampaging into your weapons! Kill, loot and skill-upgrade your way to God-like power levels - all in the name of brutal, goblin-slaying megadeath.

details.title: Core Of Havoc
details.short_description: Core of Havoc is a top-down 2D action RPG in space. Take control of the ship, fight enemies in missions, collect the loot, craft ship components and evolve the build over time.

details.title: Gardenhood
details.short_description: A cozy multiplayer gardening game where up to 8 players share one island. Grow rare mutated crops, fish the pond, build and decorate your home, and hang out with neighbors in drop-in public lobbies — or tend your garden solo. Plant something weird. Show it off.

details.title: Wash It
details.short_description: Wash It is a relaxing and satisfying cleaning game where you blast away dirt, grime, and chaos. Watch the world shine again as you unwind and get lost in pure cleaning zen.

details.title: Engagement Protocol
details.short_description: Free game for game developers that that showcases various game development tools that support player engagement.

details.title: Creepy Cases Teen Detective Club
details.short_description: The mysterious death of a girl on the municipal school sports field shook the small town of Sky Cliffs. Haunting days pass, and amid disappearances, paranormal activity, and ghosts, the Teen Detective Club takes on the investigation of these frightening cases.

details.title: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
details.short_description: Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

details.title: Lumory: A Distant Summer
details.short_description: Wander through bright liminal spaces shaped by distant summer memories. Ride a childhood scooter, reveal hidden paths with Dream Vision, and capture surreal moments with your camera. No combat—just calm exploration.

name: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors

details.title: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors
details.short_description: Join Lydia as she takes her fight to expose the corruption in Cypress Ridge to City Hall in the second part of the visual novel series What Lydia Knows.

name: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill

details.title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
details.short_description: A point-and-click noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects in visual novel-style conversations to solve the murder of a fashion icon.

details.title: Afterlight Survival
details.short_description: Open-world sandbox survival horror combining base-building, crafting, and tower defense. Scavenge for supplies and build your home while evading what's left of the government and the undead it created. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

name: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning

details.title: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning
details.short_description: Alone again and abandoned in the house, this time even darker than usual. You return as Jack and set out to search for your missing Friend.

details.title: 盲盒指挥官
details.short_description: Blind Box Commander is a toy brick-style RTS with deckbuilding, blind box draws, and classic base tech. Build a 24-card deck, expand your base, unlock units, and adapt your tactics in real time as every match delivers new combinations and fresh strategic battles.

details.title: Voxnap Party
details.short_description: Jump into the party as a Voxnap, a character built from voxels! Grab the parts scattered across the map and snap them on - arms, legs, torso - to power yourself up your own way. Knock the other guests flat and seize the win! Online play for up to 6.

details.title: TITAN'S CELL: NYMPH
details.short_description: Collect and breed quirky Nymphs inside a universe-sized Titan. Build a team of three for turn-based card battles, choose your route through roguelite expeditions, explore solo or in online co-op with up to 3 players, and test your strategy in real-time PvP.

details.title: Shift Knight
details.short_description: Shift Knight is a horror typing game and a supernatural mystery. Every night the dead rise from the graves along the only road home, each carrying a word. Type it before it reaches the truck. Nobody will say where they came from, and the Order keeps sending instructions.

details.title: Pharmacy Next to the Dungeon
details.short_description: Run a small pharmacy beside a dungeon and care for adventurers! Process and combine ingredients to brew potions, diagnose adventurers with various tools, and prescribe the right remedies. Help adventurers on their journeys and grow your pharmacy in this fantasy management sim!

details.title: Multipolar
details.short_description: Multipolar is a single-player grand strategy game set in the near future. Guide your country through the turbulent times of a multipolar world, using diplomacy, influence, information and special operations. Depending on the country you select, you may go for global domination or for survival.

details.title: Atheria: Monster Tactics
details.short_description: Step onto the battlefield, assemble your ultimate squad of powerful monsters, and master position based card combat. Collect hundreds of unique creature cards and outsmart your opponents in deep, turn-based grid battles.

details.title: Street Witch
details.short_description: A lurid trashy old school FPS. Fight street goblins in frantic scrappy gun fights, kick doors, do magic and get your cat back.

details.title: Hello Mr. Drift!
details.short_description: Part-time courier, full-time drift addict! Race against the clock, dodge obstacles, deliver packages, and drift your way to meeting your quota without breaking the goods.

details.title: Those We Serve
details.short_description: The king is murdered. You are killed too. But death isn't the end. Relive the same cursed day in a turn-based RPG where perfectly timed parries, dodges, and your decisions determine whether you survive long enough to uncover the truth.

details.title: VOIDCORP
details.short_description: Co-op mining in an endless dangerous voxel cave system. Blast & dig with real physics, haul the ore up the lift and sell it to the Company. Black holes, spider nests and worse wait in the dark below. Dig deep, get paid, and don't get left behind.

details.title: Emerald Utopia
details.short_description: Emerald Utopia is a 3d atmospheric, platformer, metroidvania game focused on vertical exploration. Here you'll explore diverse, interconnected worlds to find your missing wife, who vanished years ago during the world's shattering.

details.title: Totally Invited: Party Heist Simulator
details.short_description: Crash parties, blend in with guests, and escape with the valuables in this co-op stealth heist simulator. Then clean up your haul, stock your shop, and set your prices. Turn stolen goods into a growing business, fund your next heist, and watch out for thieves. Apparently, everyone has the same idea.

name: Unidentified Frying Objects: Idle Cafe Empire

details.title: Unidentified Frying Objects: Idle Cafe Empire
details.short_description: Run a cafe for hungry aliens with no taste. Invent terrible recipes, automate your kitchen, play the galactic stock market, feed a black hole, and relocate across the stars to cook the legendary Omni-Meal. A quirky idle game with a news ticker that never stops.

details.title: Overtime at Holiday's
details.short_description: Cleaners Bill and Jules land a weekend job at Max Holiday’s mansion - until they find him dead in the pool. Trapped in an endless overtime loop, they must move his body around while solving quirky puzzles. A darkly funny retro adventure where "Weekend at Bernie’s" meets "Groundhog Day"!

details.title: Malsort
details.short_description: An action MMO inspired by the classic ARPGs. A cursed world of ash and burning thrones, shared with every hero who dares. Hunt in parties, craft from what you slay, sell your finds in your own shop, and raid the world bosses to loot ancient relics.

details.title: We Have Lift Off
details.short_description: Gather resources, upgrade your rocket, and reach new heights in this casual incremental game. Put your little workers to work, research new technologies, and launch farther with every expedition.

details.title: Peppero and The Toad City
details.short_description: What on earth is happening in the toad world?! Help Peppero the mouse escape a dangerous underground city while managing his stress levels, and uncover the dark mystery behind twisted mutation experiments. A hand-drawn dark fantasy world with immersive first-person gameplay.

details.title: Beaked!
details.short_description: Beaked! is a tile-based puzzle-platformer about sound manipulation. Following a little Starling in an abstract world of wooden toys, players will learn to peck buttons, mimic noises and trick people -- all to reach the finish.

details.title: Build&Boom
details.short_description: Build&Boom is a chaotic competitive party game. Builders race to raise a structure from the blueprint while Saboteurs rain rocks, drones, tomatoes and traps down on them. Play three modes from 1v1 to 3v3, online with friends or in local split-screen.

details.title: Decayed Cases: Archive 22
details.short_description: The peaceful, familiar everyday life is completely turned upside down by the chaos that has erupted at the base. The silence of the archive is dissapear, leaving nothing but survival. Will I ever get to tell the story of everything I’ve been through, or will I, too, become a part of the archive?

details.title: Snake Draft
details.short_description: The fantasy football roguelike. Snake Draft is about finding synergies and building your dream team. With 100+ unique athletes shuffling between 22 in-world teams, each run offers a new puzzle to solve. Draft studs, find sleepers, and build a team that is locked in for a championship run.

details.title: Mountain Rescuers
details.short_description: A co-op zombie FPS for 1-4 mountain rescuers who are not very good at rescuing. Arrive by flying rowboat, find the one survivor on each peak and keep it quiet: noise brings the horde. Sell the bodies to the butcher, buy bigger guns, try not to shoot your friends.

details.title: Gnomes Go Boom
details.short_description: Garden gnomes vs. gardeners. Gnomes run screaming "lolololo", then freeze into a perfect ceramic statue among 300 identical ones. Gardeners hunt in first person with a water sprayer: statues drip, live gnomes steam. Spray the right one before it goes BOOM. 2–10 players online.

details.title: Mongle: Cozy Days
details.short_description: A cozy butler simulator where you serve Carrot, a bunny girl who likes things her way, and enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life.

details.title: Modern Frankenstein
details.short_description: Experience the chilling survival horror reimagining of the Frankenstein legend set in a fictional modern time. Dr Frankenstein's experiments have led him to discover the secrets of life beyond death, a new reality. His monstrous creations roam the halls of his home, his only family.

details.title: VR PC Assembly
details.short_description: Build, fix, and upgrade PCs with your own hands in VR. Run your own workshop, one customer at a time, and build a thriving computer repair business in your very own room.

details.title: Dark Forest
details.short_description: Day 4. The tins are gone and help isn't coming. Step out into an endless first-person survival world: scavenge, craft, build, hunt and fish — alone, with up to five Steam friends or on your own server. At night, things come out of the dark. They don't knock.

details.title: Backpack Jianghu 2
details.short_description: Start as a young martial artist. Seek legendary weapons and secret manuals, combine techniques to forge your own fighting style, and turn humble moves into devastating attacks! Fight your way to the summit of Mount Hua, claim the title of the greatest, or challenge real players in live PvP!

details.title: Tarmac Tycoon
details.short_description: Turn a tiny airfield into a roaring multi-runway hub. Draw blueprints and watch your crews build them tile by tile, then keep every passenger, suitcase and fuel truck moving, from a three-seat prop plane to a sky full of airliners. Contains high amounts of jet fuel.

details.title: Fogblower
details.short_description: Fogblower is an incremental game. Clear the fog with the fan on your little boat, discover treasures and strange creatures of the deep, and upgrade your boat until one day you can reach the mainland and earn your freedom.

details.title: Claw & Keel
details.short_description: Build your broadside. Gather your crew. Pick your trouble. Fit cannons, gear and a motley crew of animal scoundrels aboard your ship, then watch clever placement pay off in cannon fire. Refit and take on your next target in this pirate adventure auto-battler.

details.title: Stay Extinct
details.short_description: The wall was built to keep something in. On a sealed dinosaur island only the hunters are infected: raptors, a T-rex and diving pterosaurs stalk the healthy herds, and you. Build and electrify a base, explore the tunnels below, alone or in 4-player online co-op. First-person retro survival horror.

details.title: Xoul:Sync
details.short_description: Xoul:Sync combines auto-battler combat with spatial inventory management. Assemble three Xouls, arrange items in the Sync Case, and choose your route to the next boss.

details.title: Trapout: Dungeon Run
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person precision platformer where every millisecond counts. Run through deadly obstacle courses, race against player ghosts instantly, and create ANYTHING with the built-in level editor

details.title: With flowers, fringe of fondness
details.short_description: Life is suffocating. Almost crushed by the authority known as "normal." Tuyu, who spends their days asking themself, "Do I have a place in this society?", meets a certain friend at university. Those living on the margins find joy, suffer in their insignificant days—and attempt to resist the world.

details.title: Purpose of Visit
details.short_description: Their papers say one thing. Their answers say another. Staff a booth on a tense border, question every traveller, and drag the lie they just told onto the document it contradicts. One of them is a spy. Approve the wrong face and it makes the evening news.

details.title: Feudal Factory
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, automate your production chains, and defend your lands against relentless hordes! In Feudal Factory, combine rail and cart automation with strategic medieval-fantasy fortress management. Extract ores, forge your equipment, train your army, and hold off incoming enemy waves!

details.title: Catriarch
details.short_description: Your subjects are dumpster cats. Your kingdom is an abandoned building in a human city. Your reign is threatened by dogs, fleas, collar bells, bad valerian harvests, fish-bone fortunes — and your own terrible decisions.

details.title: Surging Blood
details.short_description: A dark journey shaped by blood and alchemy. A FPS inspired by retro PS1 aesthetics, and a universe blending steampunk and victorian gothic. Will you uncover the fate of Cinderval?

details.title: Now You're Cooking!
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about running your own restaurant. Cook delicious meals, build an extravagant menu, and keep your patrons happy. Did I mention that rent doubles every month?

details.title: 永恒地牢与刹那之恋
details.short_description: 《永恒地牢与刹那之恋》是基于AI实时推演的动态叙事AVG。在这个视觉小说内，输入你独一无二的选择生成新的世界线与游戏CG。

details.title: Space Hauler
details.short_description: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

details.title: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly
details.short_description: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly is a neo-noir cyberpunk thriller. You play Wendy, an agent with gaps in her memory, investigating a disappearance in Neo-Kyoto. Fierce firefights give way to detective work — until it turns out reality itself is an illusion. But is the truth worth knowing?

details.title: PIECES OF THE DEEP
details.short_description: An auto-run roguelite set in the deep sea where split-second decisions decide survival. Explore procedurally generated underwater dungeons, defeat bosses, and recover relics of a lost civilization. Return with materials to rebuild technology and push further into the depths.

details.title: Mistbound Silent light
details.short_description: Mistbound: Silent Light is a knowledge-based horror where your voice is your greatest power and your worst enemy. Solve intricate puzzles with your voice or master the fog's secrets in silence to survive.

details.title: Chug It 🍺
details.short_description: Grow it. Brew it. Chug it. Run a cozy fantasy tavern, farm your own ingredients, cook food and drinks by hand, and serve a wide cast of customers. Play solo or in 4-player co-op, and let golem helpers handle the chores.

details.title: Wrongbots
details.short_description: Annihilate robot hordes and survive in this roguelite shooter. Hack or smash productive machinery. Grab resources and craft cool items. Swap body parts with glamour or extravaganza. Modify your weapons to absurdity. See how clever AI has become?

details.title: Ammo Station Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your gun shop in Ammo Station. By day, sell and repair weapons. By night, team up with friends to rob warehouses and smuggle illegal arms. Rise from a respectable shopkeeper to the city's ultimate gun baron in this first-person simulation.

details.title: Pray To The Darkness
details.short_description: Tread the path to redemption or cling to your past. Shape destinies or submit to strangers. New society. New secrets. New path. Pray To The Darkness is a narrative psychological horror exploring the complexity of human fate and the world around us.

details.title: Down We Go
details.short_description: A roguelite horror descent across the dimensions under the whim of a supercomputer planet; you are a delver, tasked with exploring, researching, and cataloging what you can find.

details.title: DELUCID
details.short_description: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

details.title: Monster Meals: Big Bite Diner
details.short_description: Cook bizarre meals for hungry monsters using ingredients you gather while exploring. Upgrade your diner through a daily loop of exploring, cooking and serving. Play solo or with friends in full co-op.

details.title: W.A.R.D.
details.short_description: Assume control of an evil intergalactic megacorporation in this sci-fi tower defense. Build a mining infrastructure on alien moons and exoplanets, exploit their precious resources, and defend your operation against defiant natives.

details.title: Pirate Troops
details.short_description: Follow the journey of Sammy Shortlegs in this fun yet mysterious tale! Uncover the whereabouts of powerful pirate relics lost to time, and confront the terrifying Shadowbeard.

details.title: Frex: Ambivalence
details.short_description: A high-speed action game blending fluid movement and stylish sword combat, as you push through intense stages and confront enemies shaped by a broken world.

details.title: Miracle Revolution
details.short_description: A fantastical Bullet Hell game where you absorb and control enemy bullets to create your own firepower! Manipulate food-infused bullets to break through any formation, and use the power of Eggs to overthrow the wicked food goddesses!

details.title: Pet.Net
details.short_description: Hatch and raise your very own PET, evolve them, train their stats, compete in competitions AND MUCH MORE! Designed for either active or passive play, sitting in the corner of your screen while you work on other things.

details.title: Bit Crusher
details.short_description: Roam an open world in your pickup truck, smash stuff into bits, then trade them in for better upgrades, vehicles, and new zones. Explore the island, discover hidden paths and carve your own adventure across the world!

details.title: Idle Chibi Knight
details.short_description: Chibi Knight returns in an idle dungeon crawler! Fighting and exploration happen automatically while you cast spells, acquire loot, unlock new skills, level up your attributes, and push deeper. Replay as multiple classes in this casual, incremental RPG.

details.title: Stick Desktop Expedition
details.short_description: A cozy desktop idle RPG where your stickman squad auto-battles! Train your companions, choose their weapons and skills, build your camp, and send them on adventures while you work or relax.

details.title: Tiny Shaders
details.short_description: Tiny Shaders is an open-ended programming puzzle game about building image-processing algorithms. Connect simple blocks to design complex circuits, and optimise your solutions.

details.title: Medival Adventure
details.short_description: Gather resources, craft tools and build your settlement. Explore a medieval world with villages, wildlife and a day/night cycle. Medival Adventure is in early development: play solo or test experimental multiplayer with a trusted group.

details.title: Trench League
details.short_description: Punch your way to the spiked steel ball and smash it into the enemy cage. The side with the most breaches wins. Knock rivals out and the Reclaim drags them off. Face opponents from different planets of the Solar System and fight your way to the Solar Final! Test your skills against real opponents!

details.title: Hermetica
details.short_description: A world after a great war. Only one reference box survived, and you have it. The vendor sends robots in for inspection, but doesn't always tell the truth. You find where he lied and decide whether the robot goes into battle. Every shift starts at a desk. ...

details.title: Surfin' Landes
details.short_description: Welcome to Contis, a little beach in the Landes, southwest France. In this 100% co-op pixel art game, become lifeguards: one surfs, the other flies a parachute. On the menu: beer, rescues, giant fish, piranhas, dolphins, pelicans, bazookas, a dog… and ever more beer.

details.title: Starlock Arcana
details.short_description: Explore the star-cursed world of Starlock Arcana as an undead mage on a quest to vanquish the Star of Doom. Venture into ancient dungeons, discover powerful spells and battle fierce enemies! Grow ever stronger, choose the spells that suit your playstyle, and bring an end to the star curse!

details.title: You Can't Deliver
details.short_description: All you have to do is deliver a pizza. What could possibly go wrong? In this game, the entire environment stands in your way. Dodge nasty traps, fall victim to absurd surprises, and try again. A rage game with one simple mission: Get the damn pizza to its destination.

details.title: Late Night Check-In
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you work the night shift as a hotel receptionist. Welcome uncanny guests, prepare delicious drinks to fulfill room-service requests, and watch your peaceful night job slowly turn into a living nightmare.

details.title: Brewhaven
details.short_description: Brew magic combat beers that power up your village. Discover hundreds of recipes, run the tavern each night to keep your villagers juiced and happy, then have them work in the village and defend the town from enemy raids, if they can still walk.

details.title: エンゼルモール
details.short_description: Four girls and an android awaken in the deserted "Angel Mall". Explore under a time limit across repeated attempts, piecing together clues and records left behind to uncover the mall’s secrets in this puzzle adventure.

details.title: Little Dive
details.short_description: Explore, poke around, find treasures… and take your time! Little Dive is a peaceful little underwater adventure where you use your tools and the environment to make your way forward, searching for memories of a vanished world… strangely familiar?

details.title: SkyAid
details.short_description: Pilot your aircraft and dive into the disaster zone. Flames, ruins, floods — every corner holds someone waiting to be saved. Fly. Scan. Locate. Find every survivor before the clock runs out. Heal the wounded, transport the rescued, use supplies — every choice you make decides their fate.

details.title: Barely Outnumbered
details.short_description: Incremental tower defense, but there are hundreds of thousands of them and your fortress never resets.

details.title: Tower Maintenance Simulator
details.short_description: Climb hundreds of meters above the ground to maintain and repair communication towers. Choose your tools, secure your harness, diagnose faults and complete dangerous maintenance jobs where one mistake can send you — or your tools — falling.

details.title: THE GROUNDSKEEPER
details.short_description: A simulation-horror game where you power wash and restore a haunted tourist attraction by night, capture terrifying paranormal evidence and post it online for viral hype. By day, you set ticket prices for the tourists and use the profits to upgrade gear and keep the attraction running profitably.

details.title: Boop The Snoot
details.short_description: Venture forth, to a land of seemingly endless critters. For only you can "boop" them all on their cute little noses. Gain points to unlock upgrades, cosmetics, and to aid in your endeavor of "booping" every snoot.

details.title: Pinwick
details.short_description: Every haunted house was built by someone. You build yours one room at a time: saw, glue, velvet, patience, a photograph of everything you finish. Each room is perfect when you latch the glass at night. Some mornings, there are improvements.

details.title: The Gilded Sprig
details.short_description: Build a cozy botanical shop, craft fragrant products, gather rare ingredients, grow plants, and discover new recipes. Hire helpers, delight your customers, and turn a little shop into a flourishing business.

details.title: Spellriggers: Unification Protocol
details.short_description: Heroes of Might and Magic meets Homeworld. Five Spellriggers, six schools of magic, randomly drawn loot cards and generated battlefields: no two runs alike. Build your fleet, master cosmic-scale spells and conquer the galaxy sector by sector.

name: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~

details.title: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~
details.short_description: This is a story about fulfilling a promise made before birth. A guidepost for the journey home—reclaiming the time lost by fulfilling the promise the two made in the past. At the end of a journey spanning countless years, with an eternal promise in their hearts.

name: Chop or Die: Axe of War

details.title: Chop or Die: Axe of War
details.short_description: The world is overrun by wood mutants! Chop trees, gather resources, upgrade turrets, fortify your base, and enhance your Cyber Dog. Fight off nightly mutant hordes and save the planet from a forest apocalypse!

name: プライマリ・ブルーム

details.title: プライマリ・ブルーム
details.short_description: 高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。主人公のザニアはただ一人、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、研究を続けています。部屋で植物を育て、咲いた花をSNSで世界に広めていく、ドット絵・横スクロールのSF×ガーデンシミュレーションです。

details.title: PROTECT MIEKO
details.short_description: Eat the barrage. Turn it into firepower. Pilot Tama, an invincible shield drone, dive into the hail of bullets, and keep Mieko's fighter alive. The more bullets you absorb, the harder her guns hit. A roguelike side-scrolling shooter.

details.title: Vroom Boom
details.short_description: Arcade car combat with big jumps and bigger booms. Launch off ramps, fire rockets, drop mines and set off your car's special. Fight a battle royale against 8 to 12 bots, survive waves and bosses to unlock new cars, or take on a friend in split screen or online.

name: Accrelis: A Game About Forging Planets

details.title: Accrelis: A Game About Forging Planets
details.short_description: Smash a protoplanetary disk with your cursor, choose what your new world is made of, and put it in orbit. Watch life appear, cities spread across its surface and your star system slowly fill up. A short incremental game about building planets.

details.title: Channel 666: Nightmare on Tape
details.short_description: Channel 666 is a Roguelite, Turn-Based Dungeon Crawler with endless challenges within. Choose your gang and see just how deep the horror classics go!

details.title: Stink Buddies
details.short_description: 4 dung beetles and one massive dung ball in this Physics based 4 player coop. Squad up and bring your turd home, get past predators and obstacles, because real buddies go through life together and just roll with it.

details.title: Mushroom Sweeper
details.short_description: First-person mushroom hunting in CryEngine. Sweep a procedurally generated forest, clear the forest floor, track mushrooms with the Sporevision and uncover whole mushroom patches in a Minesweeper-style minigame. Save your grandpa by recovering his mushroom inventions in exchange for prized specimens

details.title: RamiRami
details.short_description: A roguelite deck-building game where you fight with Rami. Be careful to choose wisely the cards you decide to add into your deck after each game ! Discover a strange path through a dreamlike world, collect cards and face bosses with twisted rules, alone or with a friend !

details.title: Aesirbard
details.short_description: Aesirbard is a fantasy Norse-inspired Metroidvania of hard steel and old magic. Sent back from the gates of Hel, fight the corrupted and the restless dead, and rewire the hidden power that underpins the world to free a village trapped by its own ward.

details.title: Soom
details.short_description: SOOM is a quarter-view 3D action-adventure built around parrying and counterattacking. Become a totem deity who once granted human wishes, and set out to pursue a wish of your own in a world where stagnant wishes have turned into monsters.

details.title: WOOJOO
details.short_description: Pilot your ship through a changing star system in this single-player space adventure. Mine and salvage, take escort and raid contracts, then invest your returns in ship upgrades, bases, and a fleet. Survey planets and choose your place among rival factions.

details.title: The Monsters' Child
details.short_description: This is a daughter-raising game set in a world of monsters. As a monster chosen to be her guardian, you’ll raise the only human girl in the world, helping her learn, make friends, and explore a world that is both unfamiliar and welcoming.

details.title: Ore Heads
details.short_description: Head Office is hiring! Dig through seven huge mines in co-op for up to 8 players, fight your way through sealed dungeons, build a home on your own plot and climb the company ladder from Intern Digger to Chairman of the Boulder in this cozy voxel mining game.

details.title: BAJAMAR
details.short_description: BAJAMAR is a first-person point-and-click mystery adventure on an abandoned lighthouse island. Explore, examine everything, combine what you find and solve logical puzzles to follow the trail your brother left for you alone. No combat. No hand-holding.

details.title: Valley of the Omen
details.short_description: A folk horror action platformer in which you play a boomerang-wielding warrior on a quest for revenge. As Aoife, an orphan raised to hunt monsters, you will face the demonic hordes of the sorceress Morrakhad across abandoned villages, cursed cathedrals, and flooded graveyards.

details.title: Schnudergoof
details.short_description: Figure out the demonic secrets of MANA – A freakish phone that has fallen into your hands. Can you make it through the Upper Echelon? Solve riddles from fallen angels, cyber with demons on GRINDAER and choose well who you are talking to. Do you believe: if I can eat god, god has to exist?

details.title: TEST 5
details.short_description: Act as AIB Test 5, operate within a surreal virtual skyscraper, wield an extensive arsenal of weapons and gear, defeat hostiles, collect loot, and complete an infinite stream of test trials.

details.title: Hoppyscotch
details.short_description: Hoppyscotch: a puzzle game about frogs, and equity. Hop into the pond, and create accessible pathways to help get all your froggy friends home together. After all, nobody deserves to be left behind!

details.title: Kharvalen
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of enemies in Kharvalen. Choose a race, switch between two weapon sets, and combine manual attacks with auto-attacking artifacts to create devastating builds. Play solo, in co-op with up to 4 players, or in 1v1 and 2v2 PvP.

details.title: One Pop Planet
details.short_description: A Tetris-like puzzle game, played with a single button, and pieces that fall from all four directions. Match colourful pixel art pieces to feed your planet and hit the leaderboard, all while dealing with escalating speed, meteor storms, black holes, and more!

details.title: I Became a Cat
details.short_description: You woke up as a cat, can you find a way to be human again?

details.title: RULES OF RESIDENCE
details.short_description: You bought your dream home... but it wasn't all you chalked it up to be. As a member of its management committee, rewrite the rules to change the lives of your neighbours and your family for the better in this singleplayer management simulator. Or will you become what you sought to fight against?

details.title: SHORAPAN
details.short_description: SHORAPAN — a dark parable of a strange city beneath an eternal crimson sky. Those who doubt it aloud are the first it takes.

details.title: Stellar Wreck
details.short_description: Repair your spaceship, explore mysterious planets, battle strange creatures, and survive in this sci-fi sandbox RPG where every journey becomes a new adventure.

details.title: Dodo Factory
details.short_description: An incremental game where you construct a giant meat factory to raise dodos and mass murder them (ethically). Grow your factory from a small dodo grinder to a huge processing facility as you collect meat to upgrade buildings and unlock new crazy dodo types.

details.title: Umbraelum
details.short_description: A human and a specter, fused into one being, venture into the heart of darkness in this isometric action roguelite. Combine ancient artifacts and shards of corrupted power to unleash devastating synergies. The more power you embrace, the deadlier the consequences.

details.title: Rebuilt: Last Settlement
details.short_description: Manage the last farmhouse settlement in a zombie-infested city. Grow food, craft weapons, send teams to scavenge, and defend your settlement every night from relentless zombie hordes until you are strong enough to escape.

details.title: Weed Out
details.short_description: A bullet heaven with a slot machine for a level-up. The crops have risen — mow down hordes of mutant plants, spin the reels, and build around whatever drops: buffs, curses and nearly a hundred game-warping Jokers.

details.title: Amara
details.short_description: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.

details.title: Super Tag
details.short_description: Tag, with super powers! Super Tag is a 2D chase platformer: swing, blink and wall-jump away from the endless hord, or hunt down your friends in multiplayer mode.

details.title: Hold the Line
details.short_description: Hold the Line is a top-down 2D roguelite survival game. Survive on a procedurally generated island, prepare by day, endure the night, forge your survival build, adapt to dynamic events, and face the final trial on Day 7.

details.title: The Wyoming Incident
details.short_description: A Wyoming town evacuated overnight in 1982. Your car is dead. The TV is on. Hold onto your sanity while the broadcast gets inside your head, dive into corrupted TVs to silence the towers, and find six keys to get out. Psychological horror with six endings, inspired by the infamous creepypasta.

details.title: HUEMON
details.short_description: A creature collector where your whole team fights at once. Field five HUEMON on a grid where one jumps over others, another anchors nearby enemies, and positioning beats raw power. Collect them across a world still learning to be colorful.

details.title: PIO: A Robot’s Story
details.short_description: PIO: A Robot's Story is a story-driven action-adventure with Souls-lite combat. Journey from the retrofuturistic streets of Moscow to the remote islands of the North Pacific, where every battle, discovery, and step brings you closer to a truth that could change everything.

details.title: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
details.short_description: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

details.title: World Resetter
details.short_description: World Resetter is a CRPG featuring real-time strategy controls and ARPG loot mechanics. Command a squad of up to 5 unique characters as you explore a vast world and interact with dynamic NPCs. Defeat powerful foes, craft deep attribute builds, and uncover the truth behind the world.

details.title: Sky Homestead
details.short_description: Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on floating islands. Rebuild a shattered sky-kingdom: raise crops, chain machines into production lines, hire a crew who work while you explore, and sail cargo balloons between the isles you bring back to life.

details.title: Ionic Drive
details.short_description: Plan your flight path, execute a perfect flip-and-burn manoeuvre and pray that your hull survives any impact in this space flight simulation/racing game. Can you avoid collision and finish your flight?

details.title: Hatched
details.short_description: Run. Fight. Eat. Repeat. In this creature evolution roguelite. Hunt with 100+ abilities and run-altering relics, pick your element and exploit theirs, every boss you beat evolves your body. Twenty minutes, one life, a different creature every run!

details.title: Reaching for The Star
details.short_description: Reaching For The Star is a modern entertainment industry life simulation where you play as a rising actress. Plan your weekly schedule, improve your skills, audition for new roles, build relationships, and shape your own journey from an unknown newcomer to a legendary star.

details.title: Lane Glitch
details.short_description: Lane Glitch is a fast-paced cyberpunk combat racing game where you drive an armed car through neon-lit highways, dodging obstacles and destroying enemy vehicles. Choose your path on a branching map, upgrade your ride, and face powerful bosses.

details.title: Slay the King
details.short_description: Chess, but you build an army, bolt game-breaking augments onto your pieces, and tear through realms of enemies. Exploding pawns, bishops that cleanse the board with holy fire, a king that ascends into a demon slaying god. Stack upgrades, ascend, get rich, Slay The King.

details.title: The Survival Show
details.short_description: Survive the deadliest future game show in The Survival Show! Jump over razor-sharp lasers, dodge killer robots, and hurl live bombs before the clock runs out. Test your reflexes in a top-down arena, entertain the crowd, and claim the billionaire grand prize!

details.title: Within The Experiments
details.short_description: A system-driven turn-based RPG bringing new strategy to the classic Wizardry-style formula. Cut in on enemy actions with the "Interrupt Timeline Battle" system. Lead a five-member party, strengthen your team through combat and item discovery, and explore the dungeon's depths.

details.title: Office Overlord
details.short_description: From Interns to CEOs, every coworker has a role to play. Build your team, discover unexpected synergies, and take on rival companies in a tactical RPG where every coworker can make a difference.

details.title: American Navy SEALs
details.short_description: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

details.title: Send Forth the Brave
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder where you run an Adventurers’ Guild. Combine heroes, weapons, and items into teams, fulfill quirky commissions, deal with difficult clients, and build the most powerful guild in the realm.

details.title: Alone: far from home
details.short_description: A psychological survival horror game on Mars. After a catastrophic expedition, you are left alone on the Red Planet. Rebuild your ruined base, restore contact with Earth, and find a way home while uncovering the truth behind the disaster, before isolation and the fight for survival break your mind..

details.title: 吾之半身乃纯白恶魔
details.short_description: 黑神露娜，是一名喜欢「中二幻想」的普通高中少女。 某一天，一场意外让她的日常彻底改变。一位与她有着不可思议联系的神秘少女突然出现，原本平静的校园生活，也随之卷入了一连串难以解释的事件。 当真相逐渐浮出水面，她们将如何面对彼此、面对命运，又将做出怎样的选择？

details.title: Beyond the Bars
details.short_description: Play as a prisoner, guard, or warden. Scheme, trade, and betray, or lock everything down. In this multiplayer social game of control and escape. The prison is yours to use… or break out of.

details.title: Phone Booth
details.short_description: You are currently trapped inside a phone booth. When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins. From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

details.title: Core Module
details.short_description: In this cyberpunk themed Roguelike card game, you can build your own deck, connect the pathways between cards, and along those pathways cyclically trigger each card's unique abilities. This allows cards to continuously cooperate with each other and unleash powerful combined effects.

details.title: Summer Snow.
details.short_description: Escape the endless midsummer in this time-loop mystery visual novel. Find the "exit key," solve the cryptic MAZE app's missions, and reach the future with your childhood friends! A coming-of-age drama with stunning visuals, a 300k-character voiced script, diverse puzzle mechanics, and no bad ends.

details.title: Dig Dan Dig!
details.short_description: Dig for resources and trade them for powerful biological upgrades in this incremental mining adventure. Transform yourself beyond human limits to escape the underground!

details.title: Whazzy Whizmo
details.short_description: Unleash marble-fueled chaos onto the cosmos! Build zany contraptions that let your marbles soar across the stars. You have full creative freedom, so go wild.

details.title: One More Sin
details.short_description: Become a demon summoner in this roguelike deckbuilder. Discover forgotten sorceries, cursed enchantments and powerful creatures as you craft the perfect deck to crush your enemies and serve your dark queen.

details.title: PAPER.VOID
details.short_description: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.

details.title: Shenanigans Party
details.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all party brawler for up to 16 players. Shove, launch and dash rivals off the map across a dozen fast-paced minigames, then roll the dice on the party board between rounds. Cute characters, absurd chaos, zero mercy. Solo with bots or online.

details.title: Solaris
details.short_description: Solaris is an immersive first-person action game set in an alternate, post-apocalyptic Soviet satellite Poland. You are Irka: a skilled rooftop runner and courier. Sneak, run and climb the roofs of the destroyed city to find a cure for your grandma infected by a mysterious disease called Solaris.

details.title: Oaks vs Orcs
details.short_description: A roguelike kingdom builder with fast runs & crazy builds. Draft cards to grow a stronghold of deadly plants. Route the river to chain powerful bonuses across your tiles. Survive the orc siege and watch your army crush the horde.

details.title: The Night Archive - Sable's
details.short_description: One night alone at the campground he loved as a kid. Closed for years, chained at the gate, rotting. A friend arrives at sunrise. Episode 2 of The Night Archive.

details.title: Tomb Zombies
details.short_description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

name: Last Wail of the Sea King

details.title: Last Wail of the Sea King
details.short_description: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

details.title: Temp Agency
details.short_description: Temp Agency is a chaotic office co-op game where you and a friend race against the clock to survive increasingly ridiculous office jobs through different levels and offices. Answer phones, deliver packages, brew coffee, and work together to keep the office running. Or at least try to.

details.title: Monochrome Rainbow
details.short_description: Monochrome Rainbow is a surrealist card game

details.title: NodeNodeNode
details.short_description: Start with one node in the center and expand the nodes. The more you defeat the thousands of enemies, the more nodes you have in your hands.

details.title: Dungeon4X
details.short_description: "Dungeon4X" is a new type of game that combines 3D dungeon RPG with 4X strategy. As the guild master of an adventurer's guild, you will lead the construction of farms and workshops, build a financial base by selling products, and embark on a grand adventure to obtain the ultimate artifact!

details.title: For Tarnow Eternal
details.short_description: The end of time has come - alas, the emperor of the faraway city of Tarnow has managed to avert the natural flow of time, causing the time space continuum to break, slowly decaying into nothingness. Explore the forgotten lands of Tarnow, defeat mighty foes and give the universe a proper death.

details.title: Watchtowers & Weaponry
details.short_description: Command your forces to victory in this intense tower defense experience! Strategically deploy your defenses to fortify your position and funnel the enemies through intricate mazes. Carefully allocate your resources and adapt your tactics to counter waves of relentless enemy drones!

details.title: Auris
details.short_description: Auris is a 2D Puzzle platformer where you play as a blind kid. Use echolocation to see objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover hidden paths. Find your mother and help other trapped kids along your way out of the evil lab facility.

details.title: Lovers Die
details.short_description: As Juliet, beat the devil at his own dice game to escape the afterlife with Romeo. Upgrade your dice and use them to hit the target score, unlock story branches, and shape your fate. Inspired by the works of Shakespeare and Dante.

details.title: Clickomorph
details.short_description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

details.title: 请在正确答案处咬下
details.short_description: When obedient top student Fang Zhu discovers her childhood friend Jiang Xiangyi is secretly a werewolf, she risks her own academic standing to protect him from their suffocating school environment, toxic classmates, and an unfeeling teacher.

details.title: The Creature Mafia
details.short_description: A 1920s Prohibition-era action RPG where you capture creatures to take on the mob! Set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the full might of the mob?

details.title: You Are Family
details.short_description: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

details.title: SINEK
details.short_description: Sinek is a dark, cinematic adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker, where you guide a swarm of flies to explore a world filled with silent stories of human resilience.

details.title: Resurgis: Rise of the Dead
details.short_description: Resurgis is a 3D dark fantasy action game blending souls-like combat with rogue-lite dungeon crawling. Dismember your enemies with brutal finishers, draft cards in every room to build your unique playstyle, and master a relentless loop where death is only the beginning.

details.title: Ceraphic Requiem
details.short_description: Dive into a ruined world devastated by the gods. Ceraphic Requiem is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania with a demanding combat system. Master elemental magic combos, unravel the mysteries of the decay, and impose your will in the final moments of a moribund world.

details.title: Project ROSS
details.short_description: Project ROSS is a horror/puzzle game where you play as Jason who is struggling to overcome the absence of his father. Explore the abandoned testing facility where he was supposedly last located and uncover the mystery of what really happened all those years ago. Just try to keep your head on!

details.title: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn
details.short_description: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based tactical combat, active dodge timing, and powerful relic and mod builds. Choose your path, manage Mana and Overflow, and survive the cursed inn’s deadly loop.

details.title: Wheat and Wrath
details.short_description: Guide a clan of strawfolk through the dawn of agriculture in this fantasy city-builder. Appease gods for favour and knowledge, while avoiding their wrath. Manage your economy, trade with neighbouring villages, and survive raider attacks. Will your village prosper, or wither, burn, and be forgotten?

name: 彼女のコメント欄管理を任された！

details.title: 彼女のコメント欄管理を任された！
details.short_description: Assigned to Moderate Her Chat! is a game where you become the moderator for rookie VTuber Komeran A. Lerna. Delete toxic comments as soon as they appear! With simple click controls, protect Lerna's livestream and keep the chat safe and friendly.

details.title: Shuffle Bistro
details.short_description: Mix menus and build facilities to hit daily revenue goals. Create brand new synergy builds every run with 100+ types of facilities and 4 distinct theme perks in this restaurant deck-building roguelike.

details.title: Immortal Gambit
details.short_description: Immortal Gambit is a xianxia deckbuilding roguelike. Build your deck, seek treasures, and make trade-offs between Spirit and Bane. When Spirit runs short, Refine Bane to seize power now—and face the consequences later.

details.title: Restive Neverendings
details.short_description: A metaphysical card game about chronic insomnia and tea ceremonies. It is also a game about home.

details.title: Locomotive Works
details.short_description: Build custom steam locomotives and deliver freight on a working railway. Your designs affect performance. Different jobs need different designs, and every choice has trade-offs. Balance power, size, range and cost to build anything from small yard shunters to heavy freight engines for steep climbs.

details.title: Dinosis Zero: Quantum Island
details.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs. Explore abandoned research facilities, uncover the origin of a global catastrophe, craft, build, and fight your way through a dangerous prehistoric world.

details.title: Mingle
details.short_description: A multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you play as a Wolf disguised as a sheep and eat the flock from the inside!

details.title: Cryptwake
details.short_description: Cryptwake is a fast-paced first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Fight through ever-changing floors, uncover strange secrets, wield powerful weapons, build devastating synergies, and survive the horrors that stalk the dungeon.

details.title: Dandy Rat Cricket Club
details.short_description: DANDY RAT CRICKET CLUB IS ARCADE CRICKET FOR THE UPPER CRUST. Bat, bowl and field in an easy-to-learn and impossible-to-master setting. Bamboozle your opponents with deceptively deep and engaging tactics, and magical bowling power-ups. Captain your ragtag team of posh rats from obscurity to glory.

name: KAIMA MV: Mistress of the Void

details.title: KAIMA MV: Mistress of the Void
details.short_description: the world is getting eaten up... will you survive? take control of SEARINA in the fight against the evil prince VIDO, and try to reclaim the world of KAIMA! this version of the game includes brand new art and storylines, so even older fans will have something new to enjoy!

details.title: Have Fun Exploring
details.short_description: Have Fun Exploring is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror. Urbex livestreaming is booming on the Dark Web, and the WR8 Audience pays well for thrilling content. Investigate abandoned locations to uncover who went missing and identify the ghost they became.

details.title: Spirefall
details.short_description: A single-player roguelite deckbuilder where your fortress fights back. Deploy units, cast spells, and unleash fortress weapons in turn-based card battles. Play five factions through three tavern Gauntlets, each ending with a boss who has a few tricks of their own.

details.title: Coppers & Thieves
details.short_description: Coppers & Thieves is a party hide and seek game for 3-8 players that combines strategic stealth gameplay with fast paced party action.

details.title: Me, Bitten
details.short_description: A lone survivalist, perfectly prepared for the apocalypse, just got bitten. Ridiculous? Yes. But you have zero intention of dying like this. Scavenge your surroundings for supplies to craft vaccines and weapons. Hold back the infection and wipe out the zombies. Survive. That's it.

details.title: Sodyba
details.short_description: A short psychological horror game inspired by Baltic folklore. Explore the homestead, complete everyday tasks, discover hidden places, and reveal its dark secret. When evil awakens, can you escape?

details.title: Bullet Maiden: Shoot and Strip
details.short_description: A 2D vertical bullet-hell shooter with polarity-switching and clothes destruction.
