Toggle Light mode to strip clothing or Dark mode to fight enemies and Bosses. 12 characters each have two stages with multi-phase Boss fights. Combo and score-based extra lives reward skilled play.

details.title: Survive the Horde
details.short_description: Face overwhelming hordes of the undead in a hyper-realistic post-apocalyptic world. Build defenses, wield devastating weapons, and unleash powerful abilities as you tear through swarms of zombies in this adrenaline-fueled first-person survival shooter.

details.title: Rollgeon
details.short_description: Build your own collection of customizable dice and battle your way through the dungeon in this turn-based roguelike. Roll, reroll, and create powerful combos inspired by the classic dice game Generala. Enchant your dice, manipulate the odds, and discover new builds with every run.

details.title: The Door
details.short_description: The Door is a first-person horror adventure game. To escape from a dream, the protagonist must confront his past and continue moving forward. What lies beyond the red door? And what truth is hidden within the protagonist’s past?

details.title: Hexborne
details.short_description: Draw one unbroken path across a hex battlefield. Tiles you cross become attack, armor, healing and gold, and how you reach each foe picks your strike. Dark fantasy roguelite RPG. Chapter 1 demo.

details.title: DUSTCROW
details.short_description: DustCrow is a space-salvaging and exploration zero-G VR game where you strip derelict wrecks for scrap, manage your tools and equipment in a zero-G environment, and play in a live, player-driven economy. It's just industrial tools, tactile physics, and the daily grind in the vast emptiness of space.

details.title: Obscurium
details.short_description: Walk a darker Brazil and uncover the creatures its folklore keeps in the deep forest, monsters most players have never seen. A roguelite deckbuilder: sacrifice cards from your hand to summon onto a four-lane ritual board, and seal each one into your grimoire.

details.title: Cursed Soulless Vagabonds
details.short_description: Master a dark fantasy rogue-incremental game. Steer your character through massive enemy hordes while your chosen build of floating swords fights for you autonomously. Survive intense, short runs without active skills or healing potions. Die often, keep your loot, and unlock permanent upgrades.

details.title: Buffet Simulator
details.short_description: Build your buffet empire! Grow your restaurant from the ground up and expand to become the biggest buffet by yourself or in co-op with up to 4 players. Handle the cooking, cleaning, customers, and staffing as you create the most expansive menu possible!

details.title: hexGame: Hero Path
details.short_description: The world needs a hero — choose yours. Any NPC can become the chosen one. Explore a living, procedurally generated hex world, carve your own path, craft unique combinations of weapons, tools, and relics, and fight through relentless hordes in fast-paced combat. Every run is different.

details.title: Sit or Die
details.short_description: Music plays, chairs appear. Lie, cooperate, deceive. In a closed cylinder, up to 12 players face unpredictable survival rounds. Find a chair or be eliminated. It's more than a chair—it involves rules, order, perception, and lies. Who will you trust, and who is deceiving you?

details.title: Mutation
details.short_description: Upon waking, he finds a world transformed. Now, he must face the manor's horde of the undead alone and unearth the terrifying truth behind the nightmare.

details.title: GERPHYON: The Ender Mansion
details.short_description: Will you survive 1000 rooms of pure arcade/horror pressure? Or will you crumble as soon as the lights begin to flicker and find yourself desperately running for your life from the indescribable, aberrant 'FRIENDS' crawling through the bowels of this complex?

details.title: Rusted Frontier
details.short_description: Haul chaotic cargo, drive fully physically-simulated vehicles, and build ambitious projects across a forgotten frontier. Solo, or co-op chaos with up to 4 players.

details.title: User.exe
details.short_description: User.exe is a psychological horror experience set in WinShade, a forgotten operating system from the early 2000s. Inside lives User, a trapped virtual assistant asking for help to finish a failed mission: install a virus to destroy Admin, an entity tied to urban legends and missing people.

details.title: BirdBots
details.short_description: Master a unique skill-based flight system in a post-apocalyptic world. Play the story, survive procedurally generated tunnels, or compete with up to 6 players in multiplayer races and Last BirdBot Standing battles.

details.title: Strike King
details.short_description: Explore the strange world of competitive bowling as you climb the ranks to become the Strike King. Wield 100+ unique balls as you struggle against eccentric bowlers armed with an arsenal of elements, obstacles, and outlandish abilities in this bowling roguelite.

details.title: 検索探偵パテ太郎
details.short_description: Search Detective Patetaro is a free mystery adventure set in a shopping street in 2050. Trace patents, designs, and trademarks with young detective Patetaro, compare testimony and clues, and eliminate impossible answers one by one. All 5 episodes free. Your search query becomes your deduction.

details.title: Here, There Be Monsters
details.short_description: Hunt legendary deep-sea beasts through unpredictable waters, where every passing day drains your vital resources. Choose to hunt bounties, prey on merchant fleets, or turn to piracy just to survive.

details.title: Into the Barrel
details.short_description: This is a single-player, first-person, roguelite action game. Fight bloody battles alongside the weapon in your hand, accumulate wealth and experience through each kill, strengthen yourself, tear through the planet, and become the strongest.

details.title: The Bornless
details.short_description: Welcome to The Bornless, an action horror FPS. Face off against other players, summon demons, and build factions in a Lovecraftian world. Use Black Magick, acquire powerful weapons, upgrade your Safehouse, and strategize to survive.

details.title: Endfaryth
details.short_description: In 5135, a substance called Ash poisoned the sky, and an endless snowstorm consumed the world. You awaken from darkness with no memory of your past. Faced with fragile warmth, will you forget what was and cling to the present, or venture into the frozen wilds to uncover the truth of who you were?

details.title: Dream Village
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!

details.title: Frutiger Aqua Rings
details.short_description: A nostalgic water ring-toss roguelite set in a dreamy Frutiger world. Use oxygen to push rings into spires, turn them into bubbles, and build unexpected combinations that change the way you play. But beware—run out of oxygen, and you'll wake up in a simple, boring monochrome reality.

details.title: Tiny Lands VR
details.short_description: Discover a collection of beautifully crafted miniature worlds in this relaxing VR spot-the-difference experience.

name: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
details.short_description: When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it. Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together? A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Rituals & War: Shan Hai
details.short_description: In the mountains and seas of pre-Qin myth, the way to Heaven is severed; the gods are silent. A turn-based tactical card game with hand-painted ink-wash art: read clues to enemy moves, sequence your actions each round, then cross swords on one shared timeline. One miscalculation can turn the tide.

details.title: Lab Loonies
details.short_description: Lab Loonies is a physics-based descent into madness where "logic" is a suggestion the developer ignored. In this 1-4 player lab experiment, the platforms are lying, the physics are "opinionated," and the Narrator is actively rooting for your demise. Make good choices, or don't. The Lab doesn't judge

details.title: Abyss Prowler
details.short_description: Abyss Prowler is an arcade inspired top-down arena shooter where you should always stay on the move to survive. Dash, reposition and strike. Demo is available.

details.title: Soundscapes
details.short_description: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

details.title: RiffHammer
details.short_description: RiffHammer is a rhythm-driven hack-and-slash where you annihilate enemies to crushing metal beats. Wield genre-infused weapons, rage through procedurally generated dungeons or handcrafted scenarios—and import your own music if metal isn’t your thing.

details.title: Primus Numen
details.short_description: A turn-based, grid-based, tactical RPG where you combine classes and join together to unleash an evolving Nexus Beast.

details.title: COLDFILE
details.short_description: A tactical third-person stealth game, solo or in online co-op. Hide in the shadows, move quietly and outsmart guards who see and hear you. Climb, take cover, grab and interrogate enemies, and choose for yourself whether to kill, knock out or slip past them unseen.

details.title: Zombies Per Minute
details.short_description: An orbital AI dropped you on Earth to take it back. She judges you on ONE number: how many zombies you can kill per minute. Automate a factory that turns raw ore into mass extermination. Stack wild upgrades and keep ammo flowing so hordes melt at your walls. When you fall, drop back in stronger.

details.title: Yarn-Ball!
details.short_description: Yarn-Ball! is a multiplayer sandbox game where you can create & explore various worlds as a silly cat!!! :3

details.title: 13 BONES
details.short_description: A fast-paced card battler. Like BLACKJACK, but with added MONSTERS and VIOLENCE. Build your DECK and push your LUCK to earn your freedom !

details.title: The Book of Prosperity
details.short_description: The Book of Prosperity is a 2D action RPG in a surreal pixel-art Hong Kong where ancient magic seeps through modern streets and skyscrapers. Student Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and buried secrets to uncover prosperity's hidden cost.

details.title: WitchOver
details.short_description: Watch the witches.Don't miss the anomalies.Despairing witches slowly lose themselves and become monsters. 12:00 AM – 6:00 AM.Your job is to manage the “witches.” As the caretaker of a facility, monitor the witches who possess dangerous powers and resolve any anomalies that occur within the facility.

details.title: Dungeon Chess
details.short_description: Dungeon Chess is a turn-based strategy game with roguelike elements where the setting simulates a chessboard.

details.title: TileShire
details.short_description: TileShire is a low-stakes, high-depth strategy game. Combine tiles on a living landscape to grow a home rich with life.

details.title: Wildlife Ballistics
details.short_description: Wildlife Ballistics is a fast-paced, tactical top-down shooter where you manage your team of 5 to kick down doors, clear rooms and neutralize threats. Fight tooth and claw to maintain order in the ever-decaying civilization of the forest.

details.title: Devilbreath: The First Seal
details.short_description: Devilbreath: The First Seal is a dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval frontier, where an ordinary village boy follows a hell-born mist into a dying forest to find its source—and stop it before his village is lost.

details.title: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale
details.short_description: ✦Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. The story mainly follows a Slavic white mouse named "Ivan Viktorovich Belyaev" and its VR memory recordings in the United States.

details.title: Gravity Cannon
details.short_description: Gravity Cannon is a local multiplayer space combat game for up to 8 players. Grab some friends and hop into fast-paced gravity action!

details.title: Resonant
details.short_description: Transcend bodies, time, and worlds. In this narrative hybrid of Point & Click Adventure and 2D Platformer, you are a formless Traveler. Shift between post-apocalyptic ruins and neon cyberpunk cities. Solve puzzles, master platforming challenges, and unravel the nature of consciousness.

details.title: Clatter Throne
details.short_description: Your dice are alive! Recruit heroes, arm them with spells one side at a time, roll, and fight for the Clatter Throne in this tabletop roguelike autobattler.

details.title: TERRORSTORM: Ground Zero
details.short_description: TERRORSTORM is a single-player FPS action-horror game with Soulslike-inspired combat. Survive brutal, high-stakes encounters against dangerous and terrifying foes, uncover dark secrets and bring down horrific underground crime ring. Resident Evil tension meets Dark Souls punishment.

details.title: Emocritical
details.short_description: A story-rich urban battle RPG. As a Nikko University transfer student, freely explore bustling Xijing, raise stats, make friends, and live your days. But beneath the peaceful daily life, dark undercurrents surge. Collect clues, shatter the facade, and face the ultimate crisis when it arrives.

details.title: Soul Tripper
details.short_description: Action roguelite with autoshoot, a parry system and randomly generated levels. Loot resources from your enemies to craft your gear and grow stronger with every run. Dozens of items, skills and characters to unlock.

details.title: Lighthouse Keeper: Lost At Sea
details.short_description: An atmospheric survival and life simulation where you live alone as a lighthouse keeper, maintaining the light, braving storms, and surviving the quiet weight of isolation at sea.

details.title: BLOODMOORED
details.short_description: BLOODMOORED is a first-person psychological horror. Revive a derelict factory by restarting its machinery. The spirits here are unpredictable: one moment they hunt you, the next they are your only key to salvation. Uncover their past to understand their motives and escape this trap alive

details.title: Shieldlinked
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, coordinate your attacks with close allies to overcome the enemy with the unique Link system. Win battles through clever planning, spare opponents to earn their equipment or recruit them to your cause, and resist those who sow division.

details.title: Largely Legal Monstrosity
details.short_description: Summon then enslave all-consuming astral horrors for profit in this incremental bullet heaven. Craft your build in a race to disrupt ineffectual antiquated market leaders. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history!

details.title: ToFaYun 2000: Origin of the Lawcast
details.short_description: 《桃花源二千: 離律之源》是一款香港漫畫風格的推理視覺小說。二千年前的桃花源至今仍然存在，只是暗中觀察著現世的變遷，發展出另一種世界文明。你將化身玄族人，透過道法與現世科技融的「手乩」搜集線索、選擇走向與推理劇情。然而玄族官府的高壓管治，令人變得相當警惕，你必需注意言行，在適當時候切換「謹慎模式」，否則會令人對你起疑，甚至招來橫禍。另一方面，自然界無處不在的「泛靈」，在對你作出誘導的同時，背後似乎有著某種不明的動機。你能否從不起眼的細節，找出恐怖襲擊的元兇，阻止一場人為災難？

details.title: Freewake
details.short_description: A team-based strategy and space simulation game where allies build an empire together while competing to control it. Explore, trade, colonize, scheme, and fight tactical battles shaped by stealth, sensors, and deception.

details.title: Orkoriz
details.short_description: Orkoriz is a stealth-action game set in the war-torn ghost city of Vuhledar. Infiltrate the ruins as NAFO agent Badabumov, navigate ork-infested streets, and uncover the fate of its citizens.

details.title: Endess Elo
details.short_description: where you are transported into a mysterious fantasy realm. Encounter a vibrant cast of characters, wield divine powers, vanquish insidious monsters, and explore distorted dimensions. Embark on a grand adventure to unravel the deep, forgotten secrets of this world.

details.title: ココロノカギ Chapter1
details.short_description: An exploration-based escape game about a girl who has lost her memories and finds herself trapped in a mysterious mansion. Collect the hidden “emotions” within the mansion and combine them to solve puzzles and uncover the truth behind her lost memories.

details.title: ANIMITE -Echoes of the Chasm-
details.short_description: Dive the Chasm: think, fight, scavenge, and get back out alive. A survival tactical RPG that switches between real-time exploration and turn-based combat. Your wolf, and the elemental reactions under your feet, are what get you out of a bad spot.

details.title: Y2K
details.short_description: New Year's Eve, 1999. The Y2K bug is real, midnight fireworks turn on the crowd, chaos erupts. Erin is a hardware tech hacker, she can pick locks with bin scrap, hot-wire a dead mobile, reboot a generator and more. Get across the Harbour to Liam before the night is over.

details.title: Kat Domino: Agent of S.H.E.L.L.
details.short_description: Kat Domino is an agent of SHELL, the organization ruling the world. A routine mission will lead her where she doesn't belong, uncover things she was never meant to see, and unravel a conspiracy that could change everything she thought she knew. With a little luck, her trainee agent will survive.

details.title: SakuSaku Witch
details.short_description: A sharp-tongued, slightly clumsy little witch sets off on a big adventure to rescue her kidnapped little sister! Enjoy tight, responsive controls and plenty of nostalgic SNES-era charm in this cute, bunny-filled 2D platformer!

details.title: Ghostwriter
details.short_description: Write the songs. Hear them sung under her name. No one knows you’re behind the hits. Uncover what’s buried in the music until you're forced to choose what to sacrifice: her career or your own voice.

details.title: Cat Customs Simulator
details.short_description: Inspect adorable cats at the border! Check passports, verify luggage weight, scan suspicious suitcases, and uncover unallowed items. Spot mismatches, catch smugglers, and decide who gets through customs in this cozy cat inspection simulator.

details.title: CD-R Racing
details.short_description: CD-R Racing is a love letter to the racing games of the 90s - a time portal to the rave music, the aesthetics, the vibes and the joy. Conquer all corners of this PS1-inspired world as you race to collect CD-R discs with bangin hot rave tunes. BPM = MPH

details.title: Tribal Mischief
details.short_description: A co-op mischievous adventure in the Stone Age.

details.title: Kipopy: Photocard Collector
details.short_description: A cozy incremental game about unboxing and collecting K-pop photo cards. Open packs by hand, fill your binder, sell duplicates, listen to tracks, play mini-games, and unlock upgrades as you grow your fan collection.

details.title: Order Midnight
details.short_description: Order: Midnight is an arcade motorbike delivery game where speed is the whole job. Thread traffic at triple-digit speeds for near-miss cash, race the shift clock from restaurant to doorstep, and ride a rain-soaked neon island at night.

details.title: I’m Not a Witch
details.short_description: 《I Am Not a Witch》is a narrative-driven adventure game. You play as a herbalist living under an assumed name, evading witch hunts. Every potion, piece of intelligence and favour you hold is a bargaining chip to buy another day of survival.

details.title: Plunge for Your Life
details.short_description: A retro FPS with roguelike elements. Players take an elevator deeper and deeper, fighting unidentified armed hostiles, planting explosives to destroy targets, and uncovering the secrets behind Complex 17. As depth increases, enemies grow more dangerous—can you make it out of the elevator alive?

details.title: Catfight
details.short_description: Team up with a catgirl companion in 2v2 deathmatch tournaments, then head back to the apartment you share. Talk through your microphone and hear her reply, coordinate in combat, and spend your winnings on guns, outfits, and home decorations. Her AI runs locally on your PC.

details.title: Category Connections
details.short_description: Category Connections is a chill puzzle game where you sort 3,000 things into 100 categories. No timers, no stress, just a big grid of things for you to organize. Perfect for a rainy afternoon.

details.title: Afterlife Dreams: Anna - Part I
details.short_description: With no idea what's going on—or where she came from—Anna meets the friendly citizens of Sweet Harbor and Woody Cabins, colorful vacation spots being attacked by horrible creatures that... are looking for her.

details.title: Incrementalism
details.short_description: A free to play collection of incremental games, all in one. Every game is a short run where the weapons fire by themselves and the payout buys the next upgrade. Ant Colony, Paper Space and Pirate Seas are in, with more on the way.

details.title: Second Reign: Reclaim
details.short_description: Reclaim a fallen kingdom solo or in online co-op in a dark fantasy roguelite tower defense. Fight beside your defenders, heal and command them, survive escalating undead assaults and Surge Waves, shape each run with powerful cards, and grow stronger between battles.

details.title: Sticky Note Battles
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you battle your coworkers with sticky notes. Collect notes and rearrange your board against the clock to outsmart your opponents. Fight your way to the top and overthrow your corporate overlords.

details.title: Mezanine
details.short_description: Mezanine is both a literal and figurative small scale sandbox builder where you can construct and recolor your own creations to compliment its gigantic environment.

details.title: Concorrenza
details.short_description: An offensively inaccurate depiction of the competition between Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo Buonarroti told with cartoonish sensibilities. | Ah! To be "vuomo eccellentissimo e singhularissimo"...

details.title: Zynthex
details.short_description: Build an alien-drug business from your inherited shop. Hunt creatures, harvest organs and turn them into products. Stock shelves, set prices and serve customers. Explore a hostile planet for supplies, expand your lab and automate production with robots. Play solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Marrowsteel
details.short_description: Assemble every turret from parts — barrel, ammo, magazine, a second gun on the mount — and hold the last line against a biomechanical swarm hundreds strong. Swap modules mid-battle as the swarm changes. Roguelite runs, bosses, a research tree.

details.title: Orb Ball
details.short_description: A dark fantasy PVP auto-battler… with a ball. Be a reckless wizard: summon monsters, cast spells, get lucky, and destroy your foe. Or be a cunning coach: draw up tactical plays like sweeps and passes to finesse your way to the goal.

details.title: Thou Shall Die
details.short_description: You are a lone ex-mercenary, turned Demigod, the embodiment of wrath – an unstoppable force seeking revenge on a cult that has enslaved humanity, draining the blood of thousands each day with the means to resurrect the god of hatred.

details.title: Mecha Tower Defense
details.short_description: A Tower Defense with Build Strategy. Evolve towers. Level characters. Earn Skill points. Fail until you succeed and complete harder and harder difficulties. This isn't your grandma's tower defense. No two runs will ever be the same. Unlock achievements and Unleash your power!

details.title: Ultra Paddle
details.short_description: A high-speed arcade roguelite where classic physics meet insane abilities. Deflect the ball, survive intense boss fights, and combine 100+ active and passive skills to break the game. Every run makes you stronger. Your goal? Become unstoppable.

details.title: K2-18b: Legacy
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of exoplanet K2-18b. Traverse its unusual labyrinths, uncover a captivating story, and reveal the world's secrets - all set to an atmospheric original soundtrack.

details.title: MONji
details.short_description: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. MONjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !

details.title: My Necromancer's Library
details.short_description: Manage a medieval library: collect books, arrange shelves, assist patrons, and host community events! Hire adventurers to delve into the depths of a dead Necromancer’s lair for rare tomes. Restore and customize books while uncovering a character-driven tale in this peculiar mining town.

details.title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
details.short_description: Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

details.title: The Last Shift
details.short_description: Psychological horror meets an old-school text adventure during a lonely night shift at a police station. Type commands and solve puzzles as sounds, lights and movement in the office echo what you read. How long can you keep your eyes on the screen?

details.title: Spikehead
details.short_description: Spike your friends from below in this fast-paced local multiplayer party game!

details.title: Homo Sovieticus
details.short_description: Homo Sovieticus is a short, indie psychological horror that tells a story of a secret Soviet experiment that you are now a part of. Will you be strong enough not to break and let yourself slip into madness?

details.title: Project Prison: Prologue
details.short_description: Start as a small-time dealer in a prison full of the world’s most ruthless inmates. Push pills, craft contraband, smuggle it past drones, dogs and cops, and hire a crew. Then the gangs come for you. Fight to survive and build a criminal empire from behind bars.

details.title: Silent Click
details.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle horror where you escape control using a TV remote. Explore surreal rooms filled with CRT televisions, switch channels to solve logic-based puzzles, and uncover a haunted smart home system that constantly observes you.

details.title: Crossline
details.short_description: You are an ecologist forced onto a sudden rescue mission inside a secret complex. Face parallel worlds and creatures unknown to science. Piece together the events that led to the tragic disaster and uncover the facility's dark secrets before the cold and madness consume you.

details.title: Eilands
details.short_description: Create and explore your own islands. Sculpt the land, plant trees, draw paths, place and build houses. Inhabit your creations. There is no combat or management, just the joy of creating and experiencing your own island.

details.title: DEADRIFT
details.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi shooter where a failed experiment unleashes mutated horrors inside a secret research facility. Armed with experimental weapons, you must fight through swarms of twisted enemies, and survive the collapse of a world-breaking project.

details.title: Near Nobit
details.short_description: Collision-triggered Card Combos. Near Nobit is a deckbuilding roguelike centered around an auto-activating card system. Perfect your deck’s sequence to trigger near-infinite combos, then witness the chaotic and unpredictable dance of nobits.

details.title: Cloud Infusion
details.short_description: Cloud Infusion is a casual social multiplayer game centered on free, rule-free play. With warm minimalist hand-drawn art and a unique “IV drip” recovery mechanic, it delivers a lighthearted, fun multiplayer experience that embodies gentle courage toward life, companionship, and overcoming hardship.

details.title: Out of Sync
details.short_description: Out of Sync is a classic survival horror game, inspired by the great horror hits but reimagined with a visual style inspired by the sci-fi comics of the 1960s. Guide Sara through this futuristic dystopian world on her mission to save her crew and discover the hidden truth.

details.title: StreamNet Alliance
details.short_description: A cyberpunk visual novel about chasing fame and losing yourself. 30 days. 100,000 followers. Daily choices that shape who Hoshino becomes — and what she's willing to sacrifice to get there.

details.title: Called Shot
details.short_description: Called Shot is a low-poly western battle royale inspired by Bang!. Cards pick your move, but you pull the trigger. Farm a deck, survive the plaza, duel atop a runaway train. Play dead, pass the dynamite, load silver bullets. No honest gunslingers here. Real aim meets hand-reading. Up to 8 online.

details.title: Avante! Atlantis
details.short_description: Lead the world's greatest Strategists through a virtual war. Decide how humanity will approach the mysterious island of Atlantis.

details.title: Drainbound
details.short_description: You are Drainbound, it is your time. A roguelike adventure where you must fight, suffer and sever to discover your true destination.

details.title: Ruinous
details.short_description: Craft devastating decks, gather loot to define your build, and defeat randomized dungeons and ruthless boss fights in a journey of risk, strategy, and ruin in this fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Peeled Eyes
details.short_description: Stealth-Horror where you close your eyes to see what sinister forces and secrets are hiding in the shadows. Use your senses to explore atmospheric environments, avoid supernatural surveillance using stealth, and acquire eldritch artifacts for safekeeping.

details.title: Corrupt Receptionist Elina
details.short_description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. You should pay for your sick sister’s medicine. Will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape your fate.

details.title: Ashes of Bronze
details.short_description: Bronze Ashes, a fantasy action roguelite inspired by Sanxingdui and Jinsha, conjures a cyclically reborn otherworld from ancient Shu's legends. Play alone or with friends: command shape-shifting arms, gather Golden Crow spells, and fight to save Shu from impending doom.

details.title: Sit Still
details.short_description: Sit Still is a first-person puzzle horror set in 1985. Bound to a rolling chair by a radio-obsessed killer, you must escape and survive while uncovering the truth behind a recurring cataclysmic storm that strikes the local town every 20 years.

details.title: Luminere: Final Light
details.short_description: In a world consumed by the Gloom, a group of survivors finds refuge among abandoned ruins. Assemble parties of heroes, set out on dangerous expeditions, and return with resources and new allies as you gradually transform the ruins into humanity’s last bastion.

details.title: Travellin Cats in Canada
details.short_description: Find many cats hidden across Canada in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

details.title: The Dust Remembers
details.short_description: A fallen world. On the wasteland, survival is all that matters. You walked alone—until you met them. Together or against, Trust or doubt, Closer or apart. Every choice leaves a mark, changing the story and your ending. Your decisions define this journey.

details.title: TENEGRAD
details.short_description: You have a new job. There’s only you, concrete megastructures, snow and cold. Deliver cargo, maintain the base, repair vehicles, explore. Just don't stare into the dark for too long and always lock the doors.

details.title: The Grander
details.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world.

details.title: Wars of Empire
details.short_description: Build your empire from a handful of villagers in this 2D isometric RTS. Advance through four ages, command armies, construct fortifications and lay siege to enemy strongholds. Conquer rival civilizations or challenge other commanders in online multiplayer.

details.title: NPC Survey Team
details.short_description: NPC Survey Team is an information-verification simulation game. Cross-check employee credentials, uncover suspicious anomalies, and conduct in-depth investigations on non-compliant female employees.
developers: おいなりソフト(肩引こ）

details.title: CENTAVO
details.short_description: A city sim where money never comes from nowhere. Tens of thousands of residents, each with a name, a job and a pocket. You lay the streets, zone and set taxes; they buy the lots, open businesses and leave if work or food runs out. Grow a camp into a metropolis.

details.title: PEAK MALE FANTASY
details.short_description: Horde-survival action RPG with 1-4 player online co-op. Thousands of monsters on screen, heavy gore, massive bosses. Collect loot, socket gems, upgrade your gear and skills. All progression is persistent: every run makes you stronger. How long can you survive?

details.title: Starmax
details.short_description: Starmax is a base building roguelike bag-builder: a deck-builder where you draw from a bag instead of a deck. Shape your bag, build your base, and combine the two into one engine. Explore hostile planets in a sci-fi universe, scavenge for resources, and ship your cargo before your base is overrun.

details.title: Gunship Delta
details.short_description: A top-down gunship action game with destructible environments. The Cold War has turned into World War III. Fly over open battlefields, choose your targets and decide which to strike first. Take on varied missions, from destroying enemy bases to daring rescue operations.

name: Father Forgive Me: The Sins We Share

details.title: Father Forgive Me: The Sins We Share
details.short_description: A boys love / yaoi visual novel about a forbidden romance between a crossdressing nun and a devious priest. Can true love reform a messenger of God who has fallen from grace? (No.)

name: The Girl I Like Is a Freak Like Me?!

details.title: The Girl I Like Is a Freak Like Me?!
details.short_description: A cute and silly yuri visual novel about two closeted fujoshis who attend a prestigious all-girls boarding school. Let the BL brainrot commence ☆

details.title: The Archives of Trevosa
details.short_description: Decipher the secret history of Trevosa to discover the true heir to the throne. Investigate historical records, translate a mysterious language, and piece together the identities and relationships of a sprawling family tree in this engrossing deduction puzzle.

details.title: FragField
details.short_description: FragField is an FPS that wants you to actually have fun, not to buy a graphics card. Pick your class, head to the front with your team and hold the zones; sometimes the win is a revive at the right moment, not a kill. No pay-to-win. Formerly announced as Flick Frag.

details.title: Crappy Driver
details.short_description: Crappy Driver is a physics-based vehicle builder where you deliver passengers and packages, hoping you don’t lose them along the way. Build from weird parts, drive to the next stop without falling apart and make your vehicle stranger with every ride.

details.title: BOLLWERK
details.short_description: A tower defense game where over 100,000 physically simulated units besiege your fort. Build guns and mortars. Rain down grenades. Let the dead pile up, and pray relief comes in time.

details.title: Daylight Line
details.short_description: Daylight Line is a single-player card roguelite mixing three-person deckbuilding and city life. Take agency jobs with companions, explore changing zones, learn skills, and investigate anomalies around the city. Between investigations, return to Daylight City to run your shop and share everyday life.

details.title: Museum: Escape with Friends
details.short_description: A co-op adventure about a night in the living museum. Together, explore the halls, solve puzzles, and evade hostile exhibits. Your flashlight will guide you, but is it enough to escape?

details.title: GunWhale
details.short_description: 2 - 4 player online experience where players cooperate to pilot a submarine through dangerous waters. Accept missions and hunt deep-sea monsters through interactive controls inside the submarine.

details.title: Task Bar Maid Cafe
details.short_description: A cozy café. A hungry party RPG. Build a crew of five maids, feed demanding guests and face enormous appetites — all in a strip above your taskbar. Level up, equip your team, upgrade the kitchen and come home to your own café.

details.title: Indian Truck Simulator
details.short_description: Be the trucker India runs on. Drive a painted truck down the Grand Trunk Road and Delhi's expressways, on nearly 1,800 km of road built from the real map. Beat the deadline, mind your diesel and your sleep, and stop at a dhaba for chai.

details.title: A Witch's Husband
details.short_description: Scotland, the 1500s. You wake in your own blood. Your wife is gone, taken as a witch. Follow her over the Highland pass and face the men who took her, one sword duel at a time. Block and strike from three directions, parry at the last moment, and strike where their guard breaks open.

details.title: Beneath the Dying Sun
details.short_description: Beneath the Dying Sun is a cozy nautical delivery game set across the mysterious Nadir Sea. Haul cargo, take odd jobs, meet strange people, and try to make an honest living somewhere that really doesn't make it easy.

details.title: Case 27: Noema
details.short_description: The architecture of the visible does not belong to material bodies, but to the numinous abyss we sculpt around them.

details.title: NO SHELTER
details.short_description: Survive a relentless storm, escape a mysterious entity, and uncover the truth behind tornadoes that appear from nowhere. Explore a world between reality, nightmares, and forgotten memories.

details.title: Rage and Fury
details.short_description: Rage and Fury is a fast-paced 2D beat ’em up built like a lost ’90s action movie. Fight through the streets, unleash devastating combos, turn the environment into a weapon, and follow Logan Hunter through a cinematic story packed with action, attitude and humor.

details.title: Feet in Food
details.short_description: What could possibly be better than food? That’s right! Feet in food! LOTS OF FEET! Create food arrangements around the girls, then wash their feet clean of all the food and sauces afterward. You wouldn’t want them to stay dirty, would you?

details.title: Her Milk, My Coffee
details.short_description: The tastiest coffee is made with milk. Or, more precisely, with her milk... Brew coffee, add all kinds of ingredients, serve it to cats, and make money. And you are going to need a lot of money, because you will be spending it all on gifts to take the cow girl on dates.

details.title: Misohagi Crossing
details.short_description: On his first visit to his father's rural hometown in seven years, Hotaru reunites with his first love—only to learn that she died three years ago. Explore Yokomizo, uncover the truth behind a family tragedy, and escape supernatural otherworlds in this Japanese horror mystery adventure.

details.title: THE CROSSING
details.short_description: Explore a world inspired by the landscapes of the Gobi Desert behind the wheel of a rally car. Find your way using nothing more than a paper map, amongst vast steppes and seas of dunes. A sensitive and intimate story of Misheel’s return to the land of her childhood.

details.title: Mindvale
details.short_description: Master frantic bullet-hell runs, turn hard-won knowledge into game-breaking builds and bring resources back to the surface. Craft, expand your base against the ever-enclosing corruption, produce more to heal your land’s mysterious affliction and defeat the Death Core.

details.title: MEGALITH
details.short_description: Traverse an endless winter alongside the last human on Earth.

details.title: Altstadt
details.short_description: A tiny old town that grows under your hands. Set down a house, then another, let a canal wander through, and stay for dusk, when the windows light up one by one. Nothing to manage. Just building.

details.title: Human Forge
details.short_description: Human Forge is a game where you create humans and put them on air to make money. Draw a face, mix traits to create a human, then put them on the show. Every three days, God comes to collect your earnings. Fail and you're fired, but survive to the end and surpass God.

details.title: I Am Plague
details.short_description: I Am Plague is a dark incremental roguelite with automatic combat and permanent progression. Lead a horde of rats, collect mutations, create powerful synergies, and devour your enemies as you climb 200+ floors of a vast underground fortress. Every death makes you stronger.

details.title: Dead Broke
details.short_description: Wanna run a cursed graveyard with your friends? You’ll regret it. Probably. An online co-op (up to 4) physics-based game about you, definitely not ending up Dead Broke.

details.title: Mercenaries Grace
details.short_description: Mercenaries Grace is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world. Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, where character positioning in the front, back, and side of enemy units may very well determine each battle’s outcome.

details.title: Saints of Swagger
details.short_description: Earn your halo the hard way. Go from sinner to savior. Smite hordes of the damned with your friends and make deals with ancient idols who clearly expect better of you. Then the treasure appears, and everyone remembers they're saints in name only.

details.title: Fedanheim
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a factory that treats human bodies as equipment. Lose limbs, scavenge scrap, build crude prostheses, obey the factory’s rules, uncover what happened below, and stay quiet. Something is listening.

details.title: Outblight
details.short_description: "Nothing down there is what the stories say." A turn-based clash roguelite where you operate skills against the enemy's in queue and manipulate of it's order. Between of catastrophe of the dying world, there lives Kirs, who is looking for creatures of the abyss in order to survive

details.title: Duskmont Files
details.short_description: The disappearance of a crooked politician with a taste for the bottle doesn't seem like much of a concern to private detective Ray Hardigan at first. But what appears to be a routine investigation in the perpetually overcast city of Duskmont quickly spirals into something far more dangerous...

details.title: Clown Hole
details.short_description: There are clowns down there, in the hole. An incremental mining game where you mine clowns for profit.

details.title: Two & Two: Agents
details.short_description: Become a secret-agent duo in a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Investigate a strange experiment, exchange clues across different perspectives, and talk your way through puzzles neither agent can solve alone.

details.title: Because It's There
details.short_description: An engineering/survival game where you summit the tallest mountain in a vast, uncharted world. For the journey, carefully construct flying wooden bases with realistic structural failures. Brave thunderstorms, freezing temperatures, bears and wolves. Answer the call of the untamed wilderness.

name: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead

details.title: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead
details.short_description: The apocalypse continues, and survivors still need to eat. In Zombie Wrap Simulator you run a kebab shop serving fresh veggies, smooth sauces and… questionable meat. Grill meals, deliver food to shelters and defend your place at night from furious Zomboners.

details.title: Gold Dredge Simulator
details.short_description: Build your own dredging operation, explore abandoned dredges, recover valuable parts, bring your machinery back to life, and expand operations in your hunt for gold rush. Play solo or team up with friends and see how far your gold rush can take you.

details.title: Estigia
details.short_description: Defeat the eleven Gods of the Greek underworld in this turn-based sliding puzzle. Your fate hangs in the balance. No tutorials, no text. Just your soul and your wits.

details.title: Grand Fantasy Empires
details.short_description: A Grand Strategy Game with Real Time Battles.

name: Medieval Farm Simulator: Co-Op Farming, Harvesting & Building

details.title: Medieval Farm Simulator: Co-Op Farming, Harvesting & Building
details.short_description: Embrace the hands-on age of farming and go from rags to riches! Alone or in up to four-player co-op, cultivate land, grow, harvest and process crops. Head to the local marketplace to sell produce and earn coin! Can you build your dream medieval farm? Farm. Harvest. Sell. Build.

details.title: Duo Escape: Eden Protocol
details.short_description: Play a cooperative puzzle adventure for two. The future is here, and it ain’t pretty. The Earth is wrecked, and humankind has retreated to cryo stasis. The good news? You just thawed, and you’re not alone! Team up with a friend to explore the biodome, solve puzzles together, and save humanity.

details.title: Detective of the Dead
details.short_description: You are a dead detective in the Mexican afterworld trying to find your killer. Undercover you prepare unique tacos to make suspects confess. Find clues and solve puzzles. Step into the shoes of your dog, Xolo, and do magical things. Save the Día de los Muertos.

details.title: Roleplay Passion
details.short_description: Step into a universe where every word matters and every choice opens unexpected paths. This is not your typical dating sim: here, the characters don’t follow fixed scripts they listen, react, and evolve with you.

details.title: Questing
details.short_description: A satirical love-letter to classic 16-bit adventure games, about a chosen hero who never wanted to be chosen.

details.title: Retro Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, and analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming is not dead!

details.title: Burnout Inferno Office Girl
details.short_description: Tokyo, 1992. Office worker Satomi endures one absurd day after another. When she hits her breaking point, she can download alternate versions of herself from other worlds. Borrow their unique personalities and abilities to fight back against work, relationships, and life's everyday nonsense.

details.title: Age of Enlightenment
details.short_description: Shape the destiny of the world as an 18th century ruler. Forge alliances and prepare your armed forces to expand your domain and colonize new lands. Or focus on internal development and help your subjects thrive with prudent economic policy and lawmaking. The choice is yours in Age of Enlightenment!

details.title: Schizophrenia: R.EM. Protocol
details.short_description: Schizophrenia is a game where you have to not go crazy and get out of the bunker. Use all the items you can find to survive. Remember. The main thing is not to go crazy. And further. Don't make loud noises. They can hear you.

details.title: Madness Afloat
details.short_description: Pilot customizable steamships through a Lovecraftian Polynesian archipelago. Explore and survive handcrafted missions, manage cursed cargo, and balance sanity against power. Face the deep alone or in optional co-op expeditions.

details.title: The Dark Aegis
details.short_description: The Dark Aegis blends visceral third-person combat with deep base building. Build up your fortress between missions, then defend it from relentless alien hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

details.title: Love's Time Cycle
details.short_description: A grand sci-fi romance healing masterpiece. Overnight, the beautiful girl around you have falling in love with you. Just as you think you can sink into this sweet trap, the one you love suddenly bids you farewell. In this endless cycle, will you be able to reclaim the love you’ve lost?

details.title: Baba Yaga
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

details.title: Mind The Trunk
details.short_description: Up to 4 friends. One abandoned station. Strip it. Launch it. Sell it. Keep breathing: your oxygen runs through a hose, and it runs out fast. Get back to the lobby or get nothing. Something else lives here. It doesn't want you dead. It wants to play.

details.title: Vagabones
details.short_description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

details.title: Witchling Grove
details.short_description: Witchling Grove is an action-rpg, arena-shooting roguelike.

details.title: Gorecam
details.short_description: GORECAM is a hardcore co-op horror survival game, designed after found-footage horror films. Play with up to 4 friends and try to escape with your life, and maybe some of your sanity.

details.title: Arcane Mayhem
details.short_description: Master the arcane in this fast-paced action roguelike. Grow your spellbook, draft your loadout, and trigger chaotic elemental reactions as you blast through relentless waves of enemies.

details.title: Overpowered Tactics
details.short_description: The 'Nexus' stops time, giving you the power to predict every enemy move in advance. Outsmart their attacks and optimize your actions. Each turn becomes a tactical puzzle where planning and anticipation are key, rather than reaction.

details.title: Peggy's Farm
details.short_description: Combine the cozy crafting of a farming sim with the satisfying physics of a pachinko game.

details.title: Rewind And Reclaim
details.short_description: REWIND and RECLAIM is a horror adventure where time moves when you move. Explore different outcomes for each movies by using your wits and your environment. Uncover their behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all and protect your familly from the curse that took your mother's life.

details.title: Kelp Keeper
details.short_description: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

details.title: The Hydra Experiment
details.short_description: Solve puzzles and fling flasks as a member of a mad scientist collective in this action-adventure RPG. Unlock prototypes and discover new mechanics, using them to explore deeper into 0-Laboratories. Build or burn bridges as you sculpt your persona with branching dialogue and consequences.

details.title: Dark Lessons
details.short_description: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

details.title: Teo Dove Am Skater 2
details.short_description: Skateboarding game in the spirit of THPS. Perform flip tricks, grabs, grinds. Insane lines. Level up your character and learn new tricks. Find hidden secrets. And challenge your rival to a classic game of skate HORSE!

details.title: Choppy Waters
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build your cards, not just your deck. Combine ingredients, each with its own effect, into sushi, then serve it to hungry pirates in turn-based battles. Spend gold to grow stronger, but run out and your voyage is over.

details.title: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
details.short_description: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

details.title: Decaying Salvage
details.short_description: A modern sci-fi survival horror built for people who miss fixed cameras, puzzles, scarce ammunition and being afraid to open the next door.

details.title: SAIGAI
details.short_description: You wake from cryosleep aboard a drifting deep-space freighter. The crew is gone. The ship is dark. Something is moving through the corridors with you. Search the vessel, uncover what happened to the crew, and learn what this ship was never meant to carry before it finds you.

details.title: Mechs and Muskets
details.short_description: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

details.title: Bloodstone Rising
details.short_description: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

name: アスクギア リブースト

details.title: アスクギア リブースト
details.short_description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

details.title: Conjunctivitalizer
details.short_description: Take on six stages of vertical shooting mayhem full of looney pixel art characters and locales. Gamers who are tired of bullet hell and Compile-like shooters can finally rejoice.

details.title: Rendagor
details.short_description: Rendagor is a 2D Top-down Shooter starring a service bot. Just a simple machine... or something more? Uncover dark secrets in Story Mode or master the challenge of Arcade Mode. Shoot, smash, and demolish enemies and destructible environments with a devastating arsenal.

details.title: Simulario
details.short_description: 2D physics based game. Particle physics, soft bodies, rigid bodies, motors, jet engines, forces, vehicles and space ships, explosions and realisic destructability - all kinds of physics stuff. The game contains very different levels, that utilize various aspects of physically simulated world.

details.title: Jailbreak
details.short_description: An asymmetric PvP prison escape game for up to 8 players, where prisoners loot, craft, and scheme their way to freedom while the guard tries to shut the whole mess down. Work together, make bad decisions, and do whatever it takes to break out.

details.title: Banquet of Nausea
details.short_description: Banquet of Nausea is a dark fantasy RPG made in RPGMaker. You will play as Liya — a girl on an epic quest to find her lost kin. Explore sacred ruins, purge festering abominations, and forge bonds with survivors whose fates lie in your hands.

details.title: Feral Metaverse
details.short_description: Feral Metaverse is an Online Multiplayer Game, where players are dropped naked and voiceless into a bleak environment. Their only path to survival is kindness.

details.title: THREAT VECTOR
details.short_description: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

details.title: Trucker 2056
details.short_description: The year is 2056. Democracy is a memory. The highways of future Finland are controlled by the fascistic Institute. Embark on a perilous journey to find medicine for your dying daughter. A high-octane adventure inspired by classics such as X-COM, Space Rogue, and Pirates!

details.title: Crimson Tale
details.short_description: Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth uses blood magic and vampire powers to defy the oppressive nobility. Avoid sunlight, travel through time, and hunt the Golden Guard to end their reign.

details.title: Memoridian
details.short_description: Special knights and explorers that study and fight against the dangerous creatures called Memories. These are dangerous creatures that one day started showing up one by one. Uncover the truth about their origin while protecting your town.

details.title: Burakku Jakku Samurai
details.short_description: A tactical pixel-art roguelite. Manage your Ki up to a lethal limit of 21. Bend the rules of the duel with special cards to alter combat conditions. Risk it all to hit exactly 21 for a Perfect Focus lethal strike. Plan your route and survive. Your strategy is your sharpest weapon.

details.title: Gabby's Odyssey
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

name: Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void

details.title: Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void
details.short_description: Take command of a freight ship traveling through deep space. Every jump brings danger, every decision matters. Manage your crew, upgrade your ship, trade, fight, and survive in a hostile galaxy where resources are scarce and every day could be your last.

details.title: Grimmdustry
details.short_description: Grimmdustry is an automation game with adventure and RPG elements. After finding yourself stranded in a medieval world full of fantasy tropes, use your knowledge of modern technology to find a way home, or use it to make this new world your own!

details.title: UrbexCAM
details.short_description: Horror based Urban Exploration Game

details.title: Coasteroid
details.short_description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!

details.title: Lingering Soup
details.short_description: Lingering Soup is a deckbuilding and management roguelite. Unwilling to be reborn, you run a spicy hot pot stall for Meng Po, serving souls one last meal. Combine cooking cards and relics to help them let go of the past. Can you do the same?

details.title: Mimi's Restaurant Helper
details.short_description: Put on your chef's hat and make food, clean the dishes, take orders and more in Mimi's Restaurant Helper. Become a chef and serve beautiful, hand drawn dishes!

details.title: Cold Steel
details.short_description: A classic RTS with a major twist. Your units are fully autonomous drones. Every unit runs code which you design using an intuitive visual coding interface. Automate everything from mining, to combat, even unit production.

details.title: Cutout
details.short_description: Dismember your enemies and steal their limbs to gain new powers in this side-scrolling action horror game set in a grim, handcrafted fairy tale world made of paper. Rebuild Lena, child of the forest, and shape who she becomes through the choices you make.

details.title: Path of the RNGesus
details.short_description: Play as literal reincarnations of the RNGesus in this curated rollathon experience. Hoard items and perks, manipulate RNG and optimize synergies to vanquish the unholy, non-deterministic chaos that plagues the land.

name: Journey To The Center Of The Lost Waterpark

details.title: Journey To The Center Of The Lost Waterpark
details.short_description: In this first and third-person experience you visit a waterpark unlike any others you have seen before. Your adventure leads you through eerie and beautiful surroundings with puzzles and obstacles while you uncover the secrets of The Lost Waterpark, driven by a Lovecraftian Story.

details.title: Pollinate or Die
details.short_description: Master a variety of abilities to attack, evade and control waves of enemies and epic bosses. Pollinate beautiful flowers to receive strong buffs. Rejuvenate Earth by cleansing pollution, unlocking many fun special abilities. Save your friends and unite the bees.

details.title: ACCURSED
details.short_description: Investigate the cursed town of Midnight Falls in a roguelike horror RPG. Scavenge powerful relics, outlast vicious foes, and cut down the awakened Ancient Deity before it devours everything. Every run is different, and the town hides secrets in every shadow.

details.title: Tarnex Warfare
details.short_description: Command modern military units along a dynamic frontline, plan operations, and fight battles on maps based on real-world terrain.

details.title: You Remembered
details.short_description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

details.title: King of Freshwater
details.short_description: "King of Freshwater " is a fish-themed Boss Rush action game featuring intense combat and knockback mechanics. Players control a small fish challenging dozens of larger aquatic predators in brutal battles.

details.title: Aircraft Dispatcher: Ground Operations
details.short_description: Take charge of airport operations. Manage aircraft maintenance, ground support, equipment, and taxiway movements, then leave the office to inspect aircraft, investigate damage, clear FOD, respond to emergencies, and keep flights moving safely and on schedule.

details.title: What Floor?
details.short_description: What Floor? is a first-person analog horror game where you operate a sealed control room on Level −7. Monitor elevators descending from the surface, inspect passengers for signs of biological impostors, and decide who is allowed to reach the Colony below.

details.title: Unfair Dungeon
details.short_description: A cruel and simple movement clicker game. Starting with a 1-in-4 chance to move as planned, can you collect the Coin of Rehtaeh and escape in 10 steps? Rage, upgrade, persevere, and discover multiple endings.

details.title: Begraved
details.short_description: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

details.title: ALL ADRIFT
details.short_description: A Cosmic Surgery RPG where fire gets wet and water burns. This universe is written in Declarations: operate on a sentence, and reality follows. Take your scalpel to species, creeds, even a planet's nature, and your doctored lines become scripture, then cosmic law. Just paperwork, Imperial Agent.

details.title: Golden Self
details.short_description: A fast paced action roguelike focused on precision combat and punishing boss fights. Embark on a mythic journey to discover your Golden Self.

details.title: Dadum The Dice
details.short_description: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

details.title: Dribble Deck
details.short_description: Dribble Deck is a basketball card game about leading your team through a tough league. Build a deck, upgrade players and trade with NPC’s. Master the game’s flow as you face ruthless coach bosses. The owner has already written you off so you’ll have to win every match or get cut before the finals.

details.title: Whispers of the Veil
details.short_description: Whispers of the Veil is a first-person stealth game. Blend into the shadows and use your wits and tools to navigate the city's dangerous streets. Uncover a secret plot that threatens to cause the city's downfall as you explore a world in upheaval, caught between tradition and emerging technology.

name: The Casket Of The Bygone Witch

details.title: The Casket Of The Bygone Witch
details.short_description: The Casket of the Bygone Witch is a horror/ghost-story/suspense/yuri visual novel. After the abandoned old lab was sealed, student deaths occurred, spreading a witch-curse legend. Protagonist Bai Yu investigates the witch after her friend dies there from the “curse.”

details.title: PROJECT Ω / MEG
details.short_description: A bullet hell where an android girl dodges for you. Build her dodge AI, weapons and outfit, switch her dodge AI for each barrage, and BREAK through brutal patterns from rival girls. Lose, rebuild, retry. As her researcher on PROJECT Ω, you were never told what it is really for.

name: Suddenly Meow Hidden Object: The Legendary Red Dot (Collector's Edition)

details.title: Suddenly Meow Hidden Object: The Legendary Red Dot (Collector's Edition)
details.short_description: Chasing lasers just got serious! Join Tim and Spooky on a hilarious Hidden Object adventure to catch the Legendary Red Dot and save the house from total cat-astrophe!

name: Cozy Cans: Tidy Up The Energy Drinks!

details.title: Cozy Cans: Tidy Up The Energy Drinks!
details.short_description: Cozy Cans is a single-player clean-up game. Search, sort and stack 6,911 colourful carbonated caffeine cans. Laugh at the parody drink brands as you put them back where they belong. From messy floor to neatly organised glory in one afternoon.

details.title: BEHOPPER
details.short_description: BEHOPPER is a skill-based bhop and surf game. Run timed courses, explore procedural worlds, or build your own maps. Race against ghosts, earn medals and watch replays.

details.title: Flarefall
details.short_description: Flarefall is a co-op horde RTS for 1–4 players. Land on the Florida coast, build one shared base by day and hold it by night against the horde, with present-day infantry, armour, boats, helicopters, air strikes and a destroyer's guns.

details.title: 汉末霸业·再起
details.short_description: 《汉末霸业·再起》是《汉末霸业》制作组全新打造的2D大型三国策略游戏。玩家将扮演一方君主，在辽阔的汉末百郡大地图上纵横征伐、逐鹿天下。游戏融合战略战斗、城池建设与内政经营，并通过城内NPC互动还原汉末城镇风貌。在传承《汉末》经典的基础上，进一步拓展战略地图与玩法体系，带来更加丰富的三国历史模拟体验。

details.title: SORE CRATEBREAKER
details.short_description: SORE CRATEBREAKER is a first-person incremental horror game with lots, lots of crates.

details.title: Cupid's Bargain
details.short_description: A matchmaker summons a pair of devilishly fine deities to help save her dying club because, like, who needs a soul anyway? Go fall in love and sell your classmates’ souls in this horror romantic comedy!

details.title: The Sound of Fury
details.short_description: A young virtuoso follows the Devil into hell to save a friend. Make enemies dance to your tune with expressive ground and aerial combos in a surreal, poetic hack & slash adventure. Journey through humanity’s darkest chapters, face forgotten demons, and risk losing your soul.

details.title: It's Snow-Kei
details.short_description: Plow a whole town in a tiny kei truck. Clear driveways and lots one satisfying lane at a time, upgrade your truck, make friends (or enemies) and get paid. Keep on plowing, and don't ask too many questions.

details.title: Downvolt - Downhill Electric Scooter Racing
details.short_description: Race downhill on electric scooters in a multiplayer game built around speed, steep descents and competition. Ride with friends, push your limits and brake sometimes.

details.title: Curse of Beauty
details.short_description: Beauty demands sacrifice. Here, it's literal. Clock in at a factory that makes cosmetics out of people. Mix the ingredients, follow instructions, and try not to dwell on what you're doing. By the end of your shift, your hands will still be dirty.

details.title: Pull Over!
details.short_description: A co-op detective horror game set at a roadside militia checkpoint in 1991. Check papers, search cars and make quota by morning. Some of the drivers aren't human. Spot them and shoot first

details.title: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
details.short_description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

details.title: Internet Cafe Simulator 3
details.short_description: Internet Cafe Simulator 3 is a first-person business simulator where you build and manage your own internet cafe. Assemble PCs piece by piece, customize your space, and hire staff. Keep customers happy and reinvest your earnings to grow your business.

details.title: The Last Coin
details.short_description: Bet your soul against other players in a casino you can't escape. Take turns dropping coins into a glass of whiskey about to overflow, keep your hand steady and cheat with items. Whoever overflows it loses their soul.

details.title: Soul Gear
details.short_description: A retro-evolved 3D Metroidvania that fuses the fast-paced third-person shooter gameplay with strategic RPG spellcasting! Play as Auruma, a soldier from the steampunk town of Iron Junction, and uncover the mystery surrounding her people as they realize their reality is a lie.

details.title: INTAKE
details.short_description: Cut tape, adjust the scales, and label boxes in a small underground inspection room. Compare each delivery with its sample: Intake or Detain. Complete eight inspections a day for eight days. One wrong decision sends you back to that morning.

details.title: JETLINE
details.short_description: A jet-powered roadster with a suction fan, loose in all of Budapest. Grab a wall and ride it up to the roof, backflip over spike strips, lose the police in the back streets, and race across the real city, by night or by day.

details.title: HADAL: Into the Mariana Trench
details.short_description: Pilot real research submersibles from a ship off Guam to the floor of Challenger Deep, 11 km down. No monsters and no timers: your battery, your hull and how deep you dare to go decide every dive. More than 50 real species to find, each with a scientific source.

details.title: Hapaxes
details.short_description: You work at Hapaxes, you are their asset. Drive your way through hordes of zombies in this top-down action-adventure roguelike using solar-powered weapons in this apocalyptic world. Will you be able to save the world from all these threats?

details.title: Eldritch Survivors
details.short_description: Eldritch Survivors is a Lovecraftian roguelite where you kill swarms of enemies, gain insight to the Mythos, and unlock otherworldly powers. Can you survive long enough to stop The Cosmic Conspiracy’s nefarious plans?

details.title: Semaphore
details.short_description: A train simulator with systemic horror. You are the driver and the conductor of a night train in the People's Republic of Ordovia. Drive the train, meet the passengers, check their papers and look after them. Solve the mysteries of Ordovia's railways and fulfil the state's plan.

details.title: Dark Gothic Doll Party
details.short_description: Before her mainspring stops, a wind-up doll girl climbs a gothic clock-tower theatre to meet its master. A bullet-hell shooter across five acts and an extra stage: gather screws to buy time, face six doll bosses, and reach one of four endings that change with difficulty. Relief Mode included.

details.title: Brennia
details.short_description: Brennia is a fantasy RPG featuring turn-based combat and an open world. Explore biomes, solve puzzles, and craft gear for your next dungeon run! Between expeditions, grow crops and expand your island. Play solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Quagmire
details.short_description: A co-op strategy game for 1 to 4 players. You sit in a Cold War bunker, command your branch of the army on a flickering map, and try to meet the state's quota before the money runs out. Every tank you lose comes out of your budget. Everything goes wrong anyway.

details.title: Pump Away!
details.short_description: A railroad adventure that sits at the bottom of your screen! Click to make the car go brrr or let it idle - this cat and dog duo will pump away and liven up your desktop.

details.title: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard
details.short_description: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard is a retro-styled 2D precision platformer. Help Kipper tidy the mountain by collecting every gem and balloon.

details.title: Fractal.OS
details.short_description: Fractal.OS insists you play tic-tac-toe. Again. And again. Build an automated board factory, earn resources, unlock rules, and bend thousands of random matches toward a single impossible task: lose 10,000 times in a row. The system appreciates your compliance.

details.title: Between Gods
details.short_description: A punishing action roguelite where your crusade is to slay every God. Master precise parries, battle relentless foes, discover powerful gear through shops and enemy drops, and grow stronger by spending skill points after every death.

details.title: Sweetheart
details.short_description: Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.

details.title: Blueprint Factory
details.short_description: Every machine follows your instructions. Build automated factories with intuitive visual programming, solve clever automation puzzles, and watch your factory come to life.

details.title: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2
details.short_description: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2 is a lighthearted and fun hidden-object adventure game. A little girl from Earth and an alien kitten embark on a brand-new adventure, solving all kinds of quirky and unusual problems for the locals in a picture-book world.

details.title: The Human Cockroach
details.short_description: Track, Hunt, and be Hunted through a series of dark tunnels. In the pitch-black depths of the caves, you can never be sure whether you are aiming down the right corridor. Think while the footsteps grow louder and louder.

details.title: Bossfall
details.short_description: Bossfall is a Sci-Fi Action RPG where you fight the galaxy's most powerful warriors and monsters to claim legendary loot. Shoot and dash through relentless incoming attacks, customize your character's build, and conquer the arena to become the ultimate coliseum champion.

details.title: Domain Paradox: Growth
details.short_description: Search. Remember. Escape. Or you will never leave the domain. Explore anomalies and unravel the story of a scientist sent on an expedition, avoiding dangers and clinging to the last shred of hope: finding a way out.

details.title: Tiny Track Labs
details.short_description: Build a tiny toy race track piece by piece: loops, wall rides, barrel rolls, jumps, a 3-lane viaduct and portals. Then sit back. Little toy cars race, flip and crash on their own, and a tiny mechanic runs out to fix them. A relaxing idle racer you watch grow.

details.title: Galacto
details.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Run a space gas station, refuel ships, hire bots, chain combo for fat payouts, and rebuild an outpost into the busiest stop in the galaxy!

details.title: Three Kingdoms The Mainland
details.short_description: 在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。

details.title: Hazardous Employment
details.short_description: Hire expendable heroes, arrange their formation, and send them into automated fantasy expeditions in this darkly comedic guild-management roguelite. Manage contracts, injuries, morale, payroll, and debt—then file the paperwork when your best employees fail to return.

details.title: Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026
details.short_description: The Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026 is a showcase of 50 short-form videos and single-player games that encompass a variety of genres from visual novels, platformers, rpgs shooters, rhythm, and puzzle games. Each following a theme of trying to make games that think Outside the Box!

details.title: Scrambled Ships
details.short_description: A Yacht Dice Roguelike set on a ship with a mysterious figure, trapped in an endless game night atop a sunset cruise. Think outside the box, buy items, and progress through the rounds, or fall to the ever-increasing score targets.

details.title: The Dangers of Liminality
details.short_description: A first person survival horror game set in The Backrooms. Explore and survive in this liminal expanse of many levels while maintaining your sanity, with realistic yet distinct graphics. You may attempt to run or fight, but how far will that really get you?

details.title: Walls Have Eyes
details.short_description: A racket. A ball. A court that fights back. A first-person adventure built on real squash, set at night in an old mansion turned squash club, where the creatures you face are part of the courts you play in.

details.title: That Cozy Cat Game
details.short_description: A relaxing online co-op game where you and your friends explore a colorful island as customizable CATS. Go fishing, chat, find new discoveries, earn kibbles, and dress up your cat.

details.title: The Obsessive Shadow: Former Residents
details.short_description: The Obsessive Shadow is lurking... In this 2D Horror Narrative, Uncover the story of what happened to the former residents of Old Diamond Drive... A once thriving community later left abandoned and in ruin. Face what's in the shadows and stay alert... You are being watched at every turn, IT IS HERE.

details.title: More Minions
details.short_description: 100% hand-drawn by me! More Minions is a fantasy roguelike autobattler where you recruit and equip units, arrange small army cards, and watch them fight automatically. Let your plan play out or intervene with tactical item cards and mid-battle repositioning.

details.title: Spell Breakers
details.short_description: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

details.title: Freaky Wheels
