details.short_description: Fight your way out of an isolated desert cult in a physics-driven vehicular combat roguelite. Drift, shoot, unleash abilities and upgrade a roster of weaponized rides as you uncover the alien secrets hidden within your former home.

details.title: PSyChE DiVE
details.short_description: In this 2D shoot ‘em up, you play as Caroline, a psychologist that uses her meditation powers to help people! One day she meets a strange “person”, it will make her go through challenges before her life returns to normality! How will this story end?

details.title: Sparkborn
details.short_description: An atmospheric 2D metroidvania set in a world changed by a mysterious cataclysm, where many living creatures have vanished and toys have gained consciousness. Explore interconnected locations, unlock new abilities, fight enemies, and uncover the mystery behind this new form of life.

details.title: Tavern Tussle
details.short_description: Tavern Tussle is a 2–4 player local and online multiplayer fantasy-themed party game. Entertain the tavern in frantic minigames to pay off your debt, or be turned into a frog by the maniacal wizard!

details.title: Moorfall
details.short_description: Schwarzmoor has broken into Grimmwald. Moorfall is a top-down real-time strategy game: lead your captains across the moor, call volunteers to arms out of your villages, and take the enemy's ground village by village, before he takes yours.

details.title: Monstaurant
details.short_description: A two-player co-op horror comedy. Run a roadside diner for monsters: take the orders, cook the food, clean the toilets. Most of your customers just want dinner. Some of them came for you — and there is one shotgun on the prep counter.

details.title: Murmures
details.short_description: A retro psychological horror game where you decipher mysterious incantations and use forbidden spells to survive the creatures of the depths of time that relentlessly torment you.

details.title: Hallonys
details.short_description: Face the terrifying darkness with your fragile light and witness mysteries that refuse to be understood. What will you believe when reality fails? Can your senses still be trusted?

details.title: Highschool Heroes
details.short_description: Join Mike, Kyle, Littleboss, and Serena on an adventure against the bullies of Emerith. Each of them has their own fighting style.

details.title: Rest in Profit
details.short_description: An incremental dark fantasy tycoon: you are a shabby necromancer harvesting souls beneath a graveyard. Dig out endless crypt corridors, set collectors under the richest graves, then bounce every soul off your rune wall to multiply its value. Death is a growth industry.

details.title: Green Horizon
details.short_description: Green Horizon is a relaxing 2D cannabis-growing life sim. Take over your uncle’s old operation, grow new strains, complete orders, meet the locals, explore the town and build your business at your own pace.

details.title: Flight South: Northern Expedition
details.short_description: A clan-management and grand-strategy game set during the founding years of the Eastern Jin. Establish your house, settle your people, manage its manor, govern local territory, navigate court politics, and face Zu Ti's expedition and Wang Dun's rebellion.

details.title: Calculusmania
details.short_description: Use a calculator to change the world around you. Solve more than 60 puzzles by adjusting variables, unlock new keys, and discover increasingly ingenious solutions in this 2D puzzle game.

details.title: Odyssée Stellaire 2
details.short_description: 2.5 million light-years separate you from a civilization sending a signal. This incremental space odyssey will take you across the universe, all the way to Andromeda. The adventure continues. Safe travels, Commander.

details.title: One Last Fish
details.short_description: A cozy fishing idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Catch rare fish, buy upgrades and customize your island while you study, work or relax!

details.title: Apocalypse Machines
details.short_description: Four centuries ago, 12 billion humans were wiped out by AIs gone rogue. Now, through unbelievable stupidity or desperation, an unknown force may have revived those genocidal machines. As an elite mech pilot sent on a covert investigation, you'll face overwhelming odds — and an unsettling truth.

details.title: The 12 CZ: Final Battle
details.short_description: All The End and his followers were repelled but fled to the wilds to hide and plague the land. So the CZs united, ventured into enemy territory, slaying demons, collecting artifacts, and fighting together to grow stronger until All The End's utter defeat.

details.title: Rays of HOPE™
details.short_description: Step into the imagination of a child and play as their favorite superhero cowboy action figure brought to life as the world around you transforms into the adventures they always imagined.

details.title: The Deposition
details.short_description: The Deposition is a story-driven visual novel with fantasy elements, set in a fully fictional world inspired by the European Renaissance. You will follow Fascino, a young man of humble birth. Read the story, make your choices, and uncover the hidden side of the sacred order.
publishers: 北京皓凛科技有限公司

details.title: VtuberCompanySimulator
details.short_description: Take your place as the head of a VTuber agency, run the company, and guide your VTubers as they grow in this management simulation. Type what you want to say, choose how the company responds, and handle each crisis your way.

details.title: GRIMLIFE
details.short_description: GRIMLIFE - An open-world survival RPG set in a world ruled by the undead. Befriend fellow survivors as you search for supplies, fight through hordes of infected, and navigate a treacherous world.

details.title: Paint World 98
details.short_description: Experience the internet of 1999 through an interactive desktop. Solve puzzles, chat, browse, play games, discover secrets, and explore at your own pace.

name: A Game About Picking Up Trash

details.title: A Game About Picking Up Trash
details.short_description: Clean up the forest! Start small and gradually restore nature's cleanliness. Collect, upgrade, improve your tools, and enjoy the calm process of bringing the forest back to life.

details.title: Dragonwynde
details.short_description: You are a dragon hatchling who can't fly in the beginning. Belly-slide down mountain slopes, stretch each glide a little further, and teach yourself the sky. Explore a cozy, handcrafted world with no combat and no death. Just mountains, water, berries, and the joy of becoming a dragon.

details.title: Hell In Heaven
details.short_description: It's like a shmup bullet hell but with a third dimension, and a die and retry structure. Focused on mechanics, no grinding. Play through short intense levels, firing abilities with an emphasis on positioning to aim at enemies. Are you up to the challenge ?

details.title: Cosmicon Plague
details.short_description: Fight against the evil bio-organic space armada known as the "Union" in this retro inspired , action packed horizontal shmup.

details.title: Take Care!!!
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op pharmacy sim for 1–4 players. Serve patients, fill prescriptions, hit your quotas—and pray nobody loses it. Turn mounting stress into a resource and somehow make it to closing time!

details.title: CABA Zero
details.short_description: Survive a devastated Buenos Aires in this third-person survival horror inspired by the PSX era. Explore subway stations, tunnels and city streets, manage scarce supplies and solve puzzles as you uncover the night that changed the city.

details.title: Media Mogul
details.short_description: Start as a journalist and build a media empire. Design your HQ and studios, hire staff and create hit TV shows, then launch your own streaming platform and fund movies and series. Rise from nobody to mogul in a bustling, living city.

details.title: BombBazled
details.short_description: Your best friend is the most dangerous bomb in the room. BombBazled is an online co-op party game for 1–8 friends: bomb through monster dungeons, grab the gold and escape together – or break the pact at the gate and get branded JUDAS. Proximity voice chat included.

details.title: Chips and Chaos
details.short_description: Pull the lever and sweep stacks of chips off the felt in a pixel-art incremental game. Upgrade your slot machine and collector, hit nightly cash targets, and spend plaques on permanent VIP perks before taking on High Limit.

details.title: Midnight Set: Film Lighting Simulator
details.short_description: A film set you can play, not software you operate. Learn practical lighting in real space before you step onto a real set: meter real light, rig flags on C stands, build your own sets, work a camera modeled on real ones, and get every shot graded with tips that teach the craft.

details.title: Violet Sleep
details.short_description: Violet Sleep is a first-person psychological horror game exploring themes of indoctrination and self-destruction. Blink your way through the labyrinth of a tortured memory. Uncover your own demise. Try to wake up.

details.title: Illegal Fat Gambling
details.short_description: Someone stole 5 billion dollars from you!!! Better get it back by gambling, I guess? Illegal Fat Gambling is a dice-based roguelike about climbing the ranks of a back-alley dice ring to reclaim riches that were stolen by a mysterious man. Fight through cops, obese men, and homunculi to victory!

details.title: Bounty on Grandpa
details.short_description: A legendary hitman retired to his garden chair. Now there's a bounty on his head, and it doubles every wave. Hold your pistol, sip your beer, and turn the backyard into a fortress of machine-gun gnomes, Uzi cats and electric fences. Grandpa does not get up. Usually.

name: To Pee or Not to Pee: พี พี่ พี้ พี๊ ผี

details.title: To Pee or Not to Pee: พี พี่ พี้ พี๊ ผี
details.short_description: A cute Thai horror anomaly game where you explore dark hallways with your flashlight, spot ghosts, investigate strange anomalies, solve spooky puzzles, and try to make it to the toilet without an accident!

details.title: ColdCall: Telesales Sim
details.short_description: A dark-comedy telemarketing sim. You're 18/24/35, broke, and cold-calling strangers to sell them wealth products. Everything they say flies at you: dodge the insults, catch the agreement, drag the rope past the deal line and stamp it. Rent's due. Don't let them hang up. Partly inspired by Undertale.

details.title: Tactics to the devil dungeon
details.short_description: Build a party of companions who each carry a signature, shape their classes and skills, then choose every move and attack in a dark fantasy turn-based tactical RPG where range, elevation and terrain decide the fight.

details.title: NO EXIT
details.short_description: A survival horror FPS where you face hordes of zombies, explore abandoned environments, gather resources, and fight to survive.

details.title: Arctic Research: Dig Them Out!
details.short_description: Dig through snow and ice to uncover prehistoric fossils in an Arctic research simulator! Extract and clean bones, analyze DNA, reconstruct ancient skeletons, and customize dioramas. Explore the frozen wilderness, upgrade your research station, and uncover secrets buried since the Cold War.

details.title: Starcore: Through the Void
details.short_description: Pilot a lone gunship on a desperate mission to save the rebellion in this fast-paced 2D space shooter. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, master multi-phase boss encounters, and fight across nearly 20 bite-sized stages. Do you have what it takes to survive the void, Commander?

details.title: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound
details.short_description: A 2D platformer focused on midair movement where you can place crystals anywhere in any level to help you reach the end of the stage.

details.title: Somnium: Hypnagogia
details.short_description: Somnium: Hypnagogia is a psychological horror visual novel set on a night where dreams, nightmares, memories and reality bleed into one another. As you drift from dream to dream, your whispers will decide where the night ends up.

details.title: Wasteland Bites 2
details.short_description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. You've expanded your operation with a decked-out caravan! Explore deeper into the wasteland in search of new delicacies. But be warned. The freaks only get more dangerous the further out you wander.

details.title: Burgerama Anomaly
details.short_description: Serve or die in a late-night pedestrian underpass kiosk. Prepare different burgers, fry ingredients, and manage your supplies - all while inspecting your customers for inhuman traits. Follow the night's rules, survive various hazards, and uncover the truth behind the mutations.

details.title: Trauma Room
details.short_description: Get ready for the most ridiculous (but also realistic) problems you can run into at the vet clinic. Today is the perfect day to help our furry and aquatic pals! And best of all, you can treat them all together with your friends in online co-op!

details.title: Black Zero
details.short_description: Fight rebels, mercenaries and the infected all at once in this top-down co-op shooter for 1–4 players. Play on the couch or online, and stop a weapon with no cure before anyone can use it.

details.title: Angela's eye
details.short_description: Angela is a blind young girl. Her only guide is the mystery of a ringing bell. Living as an adopted child of a noble family, Angela returns home to find an unsettling atmosphere. Hunted by an unknown enemy, her only reliance is the bell you ring. Run or hide to evade terror and escape.

details.title: Rise Of The General
details.short_description: 246 BCE. Pick one of 9 lives, from a slave in the headman's grain store to a kid raised by hill bandits. At 16, the levy takes you to war. Climb from conscript to general in a narrative war RPG with turn-based 5v5 battles, duels, and no plot armor.

details.title: CODE EXIT
details.short_description: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

details.title: The Hearth and Harbour
details.short_description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

details.title: Small Kingdoms
details.short_description: Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with procedurally generated campaigns. Build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield. Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals.

details.title: MOONSHIRE
details.short_description: Embark on a journey to save MOONSHIRE as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

details.title: Conquest of Eldinar
details.short_description: Conquest of Eldinar is a Action Combat / Real Time Strategy hybrid game where you choose from one of 16 different Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in large scale battles. The game supports both single-player campaigns and online multi-player matches.

details.title: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga
details.short_description: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co-op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.

details.title: The Last General
details.short_description: Lead thousands of units in this large scale modern war RTS as you manage economy and logistics, build your war machine, and fight across millions of procedurally generated scenarios, or jump into the battlefield controlling any unit in first or third person at any time.

details.title: HUMANKIND™ 2
details.short_description: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

details.title: Late Amusement
details.short_description: Late Amusement is a first-person psychological survival horror game from an independent studio. Play as Liam Snow, a young aspiring author who enters the derelict theme park alongside his girlfriend Hannah, and fight to survive as you unravel the dark history buried beneath the attractions.

details.title: MEAT-GRINDER
details.short_description: Have a human MEATGRINDER with Obi the freelance hitman! Fulfill contracts all over the planet, open a beer, turn off your brain: it's time to kill and solve the financial problems of Obi and her peculiar family!

details.title: Isometria
details.short_description: Explore an isometric world solo or with friends. Battle goblins, giant crabs, mysterious machines, and powerful bosses to gain their powers. Build a community and help the locals take back their world!

details.title: Fractured Mind
details.short_description: This is a PT inspired psychological horror game, with a bodycam style.

details.title: Graytail
details.short_description: A small island in the Pacific. The greatest female pilot has vanished. Suffering from severe headaches, our protagonist depends on medication as they search for her, but... What is real and what is hallucination? A Zelda-like mystery adventure to uncover the island's truth.

details.title: ONTOS
details.short_description: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

details.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
details.short_description: Play as Axel in an all-new, high-octane adventure as he sets out to recover his stolen taxi and chase down a mysterious organization causing chaos around the world. Race through iconic locations and tackle extreme missions in the long-awaited return of the classic series.

details.title: Travellin Cats in England
details.short_description: Find many cats hidden across England in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

details.title: Crownbreakers
details.short_description: Crownbreakers is a striking and snappy turn-based card brawler where magic meets punk and demonic billionaires rule the city. Crash through their districts, build your deck, and throw every card like a punch. Be the guillotine that frees Cascade from their soul-crushing rulers.

details.title: THE JOY OF CREATION
details.short_description: The lines between creation and creator blur, in this first-person psychological horror game inspired by Five Nights At Freddy’s.

details.title: Pacific Fire
details.short_description: Pacific Fire is a turn-based strategic wargame set in the Pacific Theater of World War II using a node-based map, rather than hexes. Take command of US, Japanese, British, Australian, New Zealand, Chinese and Dutch forces in the Pacific and Southeast Asia from 1941-1945.

details.title: Neverseas
details.short_description: Neverseas is a tactical action-RPG set in an open sea world. Command your ship, engage in battles, explore the lands beyond the ocean gates, and shape a global conflict between empires. Will you uncover the secrets of the seas—or vanish with your crew in this ruthless war?

details.title: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
details.short_description: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

details.title: Blighted
details.short_description: Battle through a psychedelic Western nightmare in this Metroidvania action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! and Nobody Saves the World.

details.title: ISO-CORE
details.short_description: Farm, craft, build, and explore a Beautiful isometric pixel art world. Explore new places and find new biomes to expand your list of items, buildings, and recipes.

details.title: Front Edge
details.short_description: The «Front edge» is a real-time multiplayer tactical game dedicated to a clash between the modern armies of the world’s leading countries. Great attention is paid to logistics and control of small groups of troops on various maps.

details.title: Noblemen: 1941
details.short_description: Noblemen: 1941 is a third-person shooter mixed with real time strategic elements. Set in a gritty, alternate reality World War 2, you will deploy units, build fortifications, capture and defend key locations, use powerful abilities, and manage resources across a vast multi-faction campaign.

details.title: Echoes From Below
details.short_description: Echoes From Below is a mystery dungeon tactical RPG. Lead four hunters into the dungeons, where every fortune you bring home comes at a price. Fight side by side as bonds grow into love, rivalry or grief that changes how they fight, and the dead never return. How many will you bring home?

details.title: Age of Transport - Blue Marble
details.short_description: Classification yards, waybills and live dispatch — on a 1:4-scale Earth. Build a multi-modal freight empire across rail, sea and air through twelve eras of transport history, in a persistent world shared by up to 255 companies.

details.title: Garden of Ants
details.short_description: Become the architect of a thriving ant colony in this real-time simulation. Establish and evolve your ant colony, grow specialized worker castes, cultivate fungus, and explore a living world above and below ground where day and night bring shifting challenges and resources.

name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia

details.title: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
details.short_description: The War of the Worlds: Siberia tells a story of one young Student, running from law and martian invaders whose Incursion into Europe in 1896 threatens the entire civilisation and all that makes us human.

details.title: Precinct IX
details.short_description: Precinct IX is a cyberpunk police management and turn-based combat game. Receive visitors, manage cases and resources, dispatch unique officers to unstable scenes, and change case outcomes—and your relationships—through dialogue, command, and battle.

details.title: Worms: Galactic Tactics
details.short_description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

details.title: Home Wars: Battlefield
details.short_description: Fight in an epic first/third-person battlefield with your friends! In this cooperative PvE game, there are 3 factions, all fully playable: Army, Insects, Dinosaurs. Hundreds of allied/enemy bots on screen! Old school fun, baby!

details.title: ARMED FRAME
details.short_description: A fast-paced TPS & FPS where you control a mech in battle. Customize 12 parts: head, torso, arms, legs, booster, FCS, and 6 weapons. Weapon and frame colors are changeable. Use weapons, jump, boost up, run on walls, do rapid boosts, quick turns, and high boosts.

details.title: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
details.short_description: You are Sir Richard in a tactical card battler set in a dark fantasy roguelike. Master your cards, execute deadly combos, and survive cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

details.title: Häxeri
details.short_description: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

details.title: Calame
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

details.title: Liminal Point
details.short_description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

details.title: Underground Security Inc
details.short_description: Defend your dungeon against relentless waves of “heroes”. Manage your minions, mine ores, construct traps and cast spells to strengthen your defenses. Each run brings new challenges in this roguelite dungeon defense game.

details.title: Unsound Love
details.short_description: Unsound Love is an open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained. You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car. Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

details.title: Conversations with My Imaginary Friends
details.short_description: A free collection of explorable scenes capturing conversations spanning two decades between the creator of To the Moon and the fictional characters they've created. About life, making games, and everything in between.

details.title: Silicone Heart
details.short_description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

details.title: Among the Waves
details.short_description: Carry the Divine Child. Bend the laws of physics and uncover the mystery of the Doors of Birth. The fate of a world where artificial intelligence has learned to believe lies in your hands.

details.title: Encryption
details.short_description: Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure set during a climate catastrophe burning through southern Italy. A father searches for his missing daughter in Matera, one of the oldest inhabited places on Earth, now evacuated, while something awaits in the darkness below.

details.title: TSAREVNA. Age of Tales
details.short_description: The world's first ballet-inspired action. Become the Tsarevna and carve your way through a dark Slavic fairy tale where beauty becomes a weapon. Chain stylish combos, master graceful swordplay, and turn every battle into a deadly dance.

details.title: Rev. NOiR
details.short_description: Drawn together by chance, Asch and Finé set out to stop the Lightfall, a calamity that brings death to all it touches. As their journey to save the world unfolds, they uncover a fate neither expected... Defy cruel fate in the all-new RPG, Rev. NOiR.

details.title: Cozy
details.short_description: Build your dream farm, make lifelong friends, and experience the joys of small-town living in Cozy Town. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, craft, and enjoy seasonal festivals. Escape the hustle and bustle—relax and live your best life in a charming countryside adventure.

details.title: Backrooms
details.short_description: Survive relentless entities, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover the dark secrets of your surroundings. With an XP system, crafting, and resource management, every decision matters. Will you find your way out or become another lost soul?

details.title: Uncanyon
details.short_description: Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure that drops you into a forgotten world, tucked into the seam between unparallel realities.

details.title: OMEGA PHENEX COMMENCED PROJECT SIX
details.short_description: Intuitive operation! High speed! Missile barrage! [OMEGA PHENEX COMMENCED PROJECT SIX] is a mech action game in which you control a humanoid mech [Icarus] that can be freely customized.

details.title: NEXT CHALLENGER!
details.short_description: Start with a pair of fists and zero ratings. End as a screen-melting monster. NEXT CHALLENGER! is a fast first-person bullet heaven roguelite on a galactic TV game show: blast hordes of holograms, stack absurd upgrades, evolve your weapon and win the crowd.

details.title: I Have No Change
details.short_description: “I Have No Change” is a first-person narrative game that immerses players in the atmosphere of a night kiosk filled with stories, melancholia, and the reflections of residents from Russia’s regions.

details.title: Ballistic.exe
details.short_description: A despicably detailed shooting simulator wrapped in a declassified computer program. Dozens of weapons, 200+ cartridges, 1000+ attachments, and absolutely nothing supernatural.

name: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos

details.title: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos
details.short_description: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos is a Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure set in 500 AD Oman. Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s most enigmatic stories, including The Nameless City and Nyarlathotep, it pulls you into a chilling investigation of cosmic horror and creeping madness.

details.title: Egypt
details.short_description: Command the sands of Egypt in this epic RTS! Build magnificent cities, lead mythic armies, and harness the power of the gods. Shape the Nile, forge alliances, and rise to become Pharaoh in a world of strategy, intrigue, and breathtaking battles. Your legacy awaits—rule wisely!

details.title: Windwoven
details.short_description: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

details.title: Gravity Circuit 2
details.short_description: A new Ark has emerged. Play as one of two adept fighters, Gravity and Power Circuit, in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. Gravity Circuit 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit.

name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator

details.title: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

details.title: Warmongers: Empires Reborn
details.short_description: A single player RPG inspired by oldschool MMORPGs created by a Solo dev. Play as an Orc, Saurak or Human. Explore an open world, complete quests and fight your way through dungeons and raids. Master all of your gathering and crafting skills.

details.title: Biofactory
details.short_description: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. You are an evolving hive-mind brain, driven by one instinct: The factory must grow.

details.title: Void Martyrs
details.short_description: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in space. Scavenge amongst the drifting space-Basilica, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

details.title: Dracula: The Disciple
details.short_description: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Dracula’s castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

details.title: Kaizen Kitchen: A Restaurant Simulator
details.short_description: Open a restaurant in the heart of a cozy little Japanese town. Cook authentic Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, and decorate your restaurant however you like. Take part in local events and become the town’s most popular restaurant!

details.title: Whatever It Takes
details.short_description: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes.

details.title: Rain98
details.short_description: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

details.title: Above Land: Rhapsody
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

details.title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
details.short_description: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

details.title: WILDERLOCKE
details.short_description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

details.title: YAKOH SHINOBI OPS
details.short_description: Four ninjas speed through the darkness, moving as one to fulfill their mission. YAKOH: This is the way of the ninja—a mission undertaken by the shadows known as Shinobi. A new-generation cooperative Shinobi stealth action game brought by ACQUIRE Corp. and SHUEISHA GAMES.

details.title: Frostrail
details.short_description: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

details.title: 10hit
details.short_description: With the ability to hijack the minds of anyone who answers a phone call, "0" builds an army of remote controlled assassins to overthrow his twin brother, "1" as standing president.

details.title: Hardkill System
details.short_description: Take control of a powerful mech in this hardcore roguelite mech shooter where every projectile is simulated and hit angle makes all the difference.

details.title: Project Enceladus
details.short_description: Fourteen scientists dead aboard a station orbiting Enceladus. One survivor: the killer, who encrypted all the data and went silent. Enter his mind, gather evidence, expose his false memories and uncover why. A first-person psychological sci-fi investigation with logic puzzles.

details.title: POSTAL 2 VR
details.short_description: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

details.title: Jet Birds
details.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

details.title: JIAOHUN
details.short_description: Welcome to JIAOHUN. Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And a message from Fairy Town's end. Grab your pager and step into the strange night before the new millennium. Investigate the mysterious Fairy Town in Baishoi County. Explore deeper, uncover the townfolk's secrets, and find the dark truth.

details.title: Path For The Seeker
details.short_description: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

details.title: Anchor
details.short_description: Anchor is a large-scale underwater multiplayer survival game. Build your base, craft tools and weapons, explore, loot and prepare for battle. Every player is a potential threat in a persistent world where bases can be raided, alliances broken, and the ocean itself hunts you.

details.title: Rune Fencer Illyia
details.short_description: Traverse a massive, ruined and beautiful world in this intense, atmospheric action platformer. Steal enemy abilities and fight them back with their own runic magic and deadly swordplay, as you attempt to find your lost twin sister in the sunken kingdom of Ithos.

details.title: Junxions
details.short_description: Answer your true calling as a traffic engineer in Junxions! Featuring comprehensive simulation, construction, and management tools, use careful planning to build roadways, railways, and walkways, and the complex interactions between them.

details.title: Capital Command
details.short_description: Take the helm of a state-of-the-art warship as you fight epic space battles in a sandbox campaign. Upgrade and customize your ship, master the art of maneuvering, and use a blend of tactical prowess and heavy firepower to overcome deadly threats.

details.title: Octopus City Blues
details.short_description: In a world of ice, the last human city is tearing itself apart. Explore the underbelly of a monstrous metropolis in a surreal adventure about everything and nothing.

details.title: Usurpator
details.short_description: USURPATOR is an EXTRACTION MELEE SLASHER. Rally your allies, clash with rival players, and battle the forces of evil. Master powerful weapons, unlock new talents, and carve your path to glory—then fight to make it out alive.

details.title: ARTIFICIAL
details.short_description: ARTIFICIAL is a physics based first-person puzzle platformer inspired by Portal & Half-Life series. Interact with the environment, pick up and throw objects, sneak around enemies, control intricate physics-based mechanisms and learn how to survive in the underground colony of the Asteroid 2031 XT

details.title: The Free Shepherd
details.short_description: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

details.title: WRAITH OPS
details.short_description: WRAITH OPS delivers snappy gunplay, fast movement, and objective-based combat with a focus on teamwork and skill. No grind, no gimmicks. Just pure infantry action where every fight matters. Get in, squad up, and take control.

details.title: The Way of Wrath
details.short_description: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.

details.title: Rooted
details.short_description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

details.title: The Lost Wild
details.short_description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

details.title: Timeless Heart VR
details.short_description: Timeless Heart VR is a story-driven VR action adventure. Join Lycaena in battle, wield different weapons, and use your Chain Claw to race through four kingdoms frozen on the eve of ruin. Only by defying fate again can you reach the final answer.

details.title: Long Gone
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned suburban neighborhood decades after the outbreak. Solve environmental puzzles with your cat companion and uncover the secret lives of the people long gone through the belongings they left behind in this atmospheric 3D pixel narrative adventure. Oh, and watch out for the zombies.

details.title: Diode Arena
details.short_description: Design, build, and pilot bots with wildly varying movement abilities and weapons, then use them in online cross-platform PvP matches. Earn cash and advance through the tiers of the tech tree to unlock new parts and build better, faster, stronger bots.

details.title: Into The Unwell
details.short_description: Whack-and-slash your inner demons in this third-person roguelite, set in a rubber hose fuelled fever dream! Play 1-3 players as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits.
developers: She Was Such A Good Horse

details.title: Port Control
details.short_description: Build the port, on the water and on land. Run its traffic, from the open sea to the warehouse gate. Ships can't stop and the port never sleeps. You are Port Control. Automation management game from the author of Rail Route.

details.title: Bloody Hell Hotel
details.short_description: Renovate, upgrade and expand your hotel! Oh, by the way, you're a vampire, so hospitality isn't your strong suit.

details.title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
details.short_description: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

details.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
details.short_description: Become the hero Voltissia needs. Fly freely across a vast alien planet, master extraordinary superpowers, and battle ferocious mutants in an expansive superhero action RPG.

details.title: Threads of Time
details.short_description: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

details.title: Everbrink
details.short_description: Everbrink is the turn-based 4X roguelike deckbuilder where you shatter enemy strongholds to join floating islands, and survive. Every turn, the ground behind you collapses. Cards summon units and build structures that gather resources. Grow your deck at Events on the board and storm enemy lines.

details.title: Wandersky
details.short_description: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

details.title: Chronicles: Medieval
details.short_description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

details.title: RevenBlade
details.short_description: RevenBlade is a 5v5 third-person hero shooter with a focus on melee combat, mechanical outplays, and mobility with lots of verticality.

details.title: ZWAARD
details.short_description: Explore a post-apocalyptic world overrun by dangerous technologies and whatever is left of humanity. Scavenge for parts to upgrade your modular sword and uncover why you are here.

details.title: Whisperwood Werewolf
details.short_description: Whisperwood Werewolf: open-world action adventure RPG. A villager becomes a night-walking werewolf; as Revna, explore, upgrade, uncover secrets, and hunt it; talk to all characters for clues.

details.title: BoosterWare
details.short_description: A deckbuilding autobattler incremental where you cheat at your favorite card game. Crack packs, build decks, and install shady tools to automate the grind. Just when you think you’ve seen everything, something new arrives. All running on an early-2000s desktop that feels a little too real.

details.title: Loya
details.short_description: Command walking fortresses to battle giant monsters in this open world survival rpg! Play alone or bring your friends to explore, farm, fight, build and craft to unravel the mysteries of Loya!

details.title: Neverway
details.short_description: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

details.title: Nord
details.short_description: NORD is a story-driven survival game set in a flooded Swedish archipelago. Alone or with friends, engineer your raft to navigate a strange, petrifying ocean.

details.title: Girlfailure Art Club
details.short_description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

details.title: Penumbra
details.short_description: Penumbra is a minimalist color-theory puzzle game. Move lights and blocks around the screen to mix colors and cast shadows. Match the color-coded goal circles with the right shade of colored light to complete each level.

details.title: I Herd Ewe
details.short_description: It's time for the sheep to head home! Will you command your team of dogs to round them up in as few turns as possible? Or will the sheep outsmart you with their wooly ways? Make use of each dog's unique ability to get the sheep home as efficiently as possible in this wholesome tactical puzzle game.

details.title: One Coin Museum
details.short_description: Explore, collect, and build your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, travel across the seas and use your claw to grab hidden treasures. Display your finds to attract visitors, grow your reputation, and upgrade your boat to reach even more distant wonders.

name: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～

details.title: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～
details.short_description: Welcome to ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE! Playing cards, mahjong, and hanafuda—all mixed together! Behold an unprecedented incremental gambling roguelike! In three completely different modes, watch your bankroll skyrocket at a breakneck pace!
developers: キザミレモントースト

details.title: World Railway
details.short_description: World Railway is a sim management game and you're a conductor reviving an old train. Produce and gather resources in stations via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

details.title: Attractor K7
details.short_description: Solo & co-op PvE extraction shooter inside a grim Megastructure. Deep within these concrete walls, a terrifying anomaly has emerged: the Refracture. You are no hero here. You are just a disposable resource, a common liquidator.

details.title: Falling Apart
details.short_description: Falling Apart is a disturbing point-and-click puzzle adventure about a man descending into his own fractured mind through hypnosis.

details.title: Haunted Cleaner
details.short_description: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

details.title: TAMBOURINE
details.short_description: A priestess is hired to exorcize an apartment building with a TAMBOURINE. Parry and torment ghosts in this first-person survival horror as you make your way up the building. Find the mementos that will allow you to complete the exorcism.

details.title: Where Dolls Hang
details.short_description: Where Dolls Hang is a psychological survival horror game inspired by Mexican folklore, set in 1998. Investigate an island filled with hanging dolls, eerie mannequins, and horrifying rituals. Explore the forests and interiors with your camcorder, find VHS tapes, and uncover what happened.

details.title: Behold! My Beef Knife
details.short_description: "Behold! My Beef Knife" is a physics-based arena slasher set in the gritty triad underworld of Hong Kong. Carve through waves of mobs with your Beef Knife. Master your positioning and precision to bypass defenses for one-hit kills. Time to paint the streets red!

details.title: The Stalked 4
details.short_description: Desperate for work, 27-year-old George signs up for the remote lighthouse job. What starts as beautiful and peaceful scenery slowly turns unsettling day by day. Is it just your mind playing tricks on you? Or is someone else here...?

details.title: Torizon Telecom
details.short_description: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

details.title: We Die Standing
details.short_description: Arcs, Rings, Power, Annihilation, Courage, Comradeship, Worlds, Earth, Humans, Creatures, Flood, Scourge, Starvation, Crisis. Through All, One Must Fight Unless He Dies Standing.

details.title: Finding Frankie 2
details.short_description: Trapped inside a deadly televised game show, you must parkour through a massive obstacle complex. Wall run, rail grind, and vault past twisted traps in the final season. Win the $10 million prize, or die trying. Frankie is waiting for you and he’s not holding back.

details.title: Gorilla Tag Contagion
details.short_description: Join your fellow Monke to smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies! Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight through twisted monstrosities with your unique build. Will you survive the Contagion?

details.title: Self-Replication /// Destruction
details.short_description: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

details.title: Backrooms
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?

details.title: MetalMercs
details.short_description: Destroy. Salvage. Upgrade. PROFIT! Command your own mercenary company in real-time-with-pause tactical mech combat. Hire pilots, customize your mechs, and take contracts across a war-torn universe filled with riches, glory, and bitter defeat.

details.title: Sea Sniffers
details.short_description: Dive! Punch! Catch! Sea Sniffers is a unique take on collecting fish where you play as a seal that throws a mean punch! Upgrade your gear, ship and companions to become the best Sea Sniffer!

details.title: CLUTCH
details.short_description: CLUTCH is a cinematic open-world action-driving game where the worlds of professional and underground street racing collide across the French Riviera.

details.title: Ashwood Conspiracy
details.short_description: Ashwood Conspiracy is a dark Slavic mystery adventure. Follow in your late uncle's footsteps to uncover the truth behind the town’s most devastating event. Find, collect, and combine items to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Will you dare to finish what your uncle started?

details.title: LIVING HELL
details.short_description: A co-op horror where you must escape a city in ruins, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations. From the creator of DEVOUR.

details.title: PACS - Post Apocalypse Courier Service
details.short_description: 1-4 players in the postiepocalypse! Drive across treacherous environments, customize your delivery vehicles, and secure 5 star reviews for corporate by supplying the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time.

details.title: Gang of Frogs
details.short_description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

details.title: Re:VER PROJECT -TOKYO-
details.short_description: "Re:VER PROJECT TOKYO" co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

details.title: Diviner
details.short_description: Explore isometric dungeons and derelict castles, defeat dark foes in first person turn based combat, customize your build and create gear arrangements with a slot based inventory. You have been tasked by the Diviner to rebuild a dead lord’s body by obtaining their organs scattered across the lands.

details.title: TrophyRC
details.short_description: A scale off-road trial experience. Customize your crawler and conquer challenging obstacle courses. Remember, it's not about speed, but accuracy and precision!

details.title: Moon Princess
details.short_description: 🌙A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!

details.title: Pixel Frenzy
details.short_description: Pixel Frenzy is a fast-paced first-person shooter game where you create your own combat style in fully destructible environments. Defeat the pixel monsters invading the real world. Grab your weapon and save the world by destroying everything in your path!

details.title: Faithless Water
details.short_description: Freshly awakened, you discover that the underwater station sheltering you is deserted. There is nothing but death here, and no one will come to help you. Dive yourself into this classic survival horror game and explore a vast environment filled by nightmarish creatures.

details.title: HINO
details.short_description: Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the white Monimoni Skeleton journey through a world of darkness in this 2D dark fantasy game. Having lost her memory, Hino seeks a safe haven in a land overrun by monsters, uncovering the truth of the dark world as she travels.

details.title: Your Forever Friend
details.short_description: Your Forever Friend™ is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

details.title: Liora's Price of Dignity
details.short_description: A fantasy RPG focusing on the concept of negotiating contracts. To save the love of her life from a deadly illness, Liora must ask for the help of Edgar, an ambitious mercenary who wields the power of magical contracts - once agreed upon, the absolute rules of these contracts cannot be disobeyed.

details.title: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
details.short_description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

details.title: MMORPG NPC Simulator
details.short_description: Play as an NPC in a living MMORPG world. Run your shop, trade with players, give quests, and send raid parties after rare loot. Build your reputation, unlock Game Master abilities, and take control of the server from within.

details.title: 东方药药灵-Touhou Herbalist
details.short_description: ​As a young girl from the Human Village of Gensokyo, you will enter Eientei to learn medicine-making. By fulfilling the requests of its peculiar residents, you may receive their Spell Cards as a reward. Use potions and Spell Cards to experience an extraordinary life in Gensokyo!​

details.title: BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

details.title: AZUR
details.short_description: AZUR is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS on the French island of Belmas. No crafting, no extraction: drop into persistent servers, complete missions, and secure rare gear via Black Drip drops, with the risk of losing everything.

details.title: Factomancer
details.short_description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

details.title: Burdenfall
details.short_description: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon

details.title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
details.short_description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

details.title: Purrfect Tanks - The Yarnpocalypse
details.short_description: Command adorable cats in chaotic cardboard tanks and battle for the last yarn on Earth! Play a fast-paced arcade shooter packed with explosions, lasers, catnip-fueled madness — and lots of cardboard. 🐱📦🔥

details.title: Element TD 3 - Tower Defense
details.short_description: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.

details.title: Chronoscript: The Endless End
details.short_description: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

details.title: From Ruins – A Detective Adventure
details.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

name: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga

details.title: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga
details.short_description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

details.title: Bad Call
details.short_description: Bad Call is a social game for 3-6 players set in an underground bunker. You're locked in separate rooms. Win challenges, trade code digits, forge alliances, and lie over the phone. Everyone needs the same exit code, but not everyone will escape.

name: Something Outside Wants You to Die

details.title: Something Outside Wants You to Die
details.short_description: Survive a paranormal home invasion caused by a case of mistaken identity. Attempt to prove you're not who it seeks as your house degrades and becomes more difficult to navigate. Something's Outside, but it's only a matter of time until it gets in.

details.title: One Last Dance Please!
details.short_description: A rhythm-driven incremental game where every beat builds a bigger party. Rally your dance crew, earn cash and go wild with upgrades. Draw your own characters and bring your favorite music. The bills can wait for one last dance... right?

details.title: The Bastion Protocol
details.short_description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

details.title: Abyssgate
details.short_description: The Abyssal Gate has opened. Abyssgate is a Wizardry-style dungeon crawler. Make a party of six and step into the dark one square at a time. Don't go easy on the monsters. If you do, you die.

details.title: Lost in the Post
details.short_description: Fly a rickety hot-air balloon with 2-4 friends and deliver the mail across a world that wants you dead. Work the burner, drop the ballast, catch the parcels, slap your crewmates, and try not to fall out. We always deliver. Mostly.

details.title: Wainhold
details.short_description: A competitive economic strategy game in the spirit of the golden age of RTS. Every ware is carried by hand from flag to flag, seasons reshape your land, and borders move only by force. A deep economy, a living world and fair play against AI or rivals in one system.

details.title: Orbit Wreck
details.short_description: Blast through waves of enemies in OrbitWreck, a fast-paced 2D space shooter! Pilot unique ships, dodge deadly attacks, collect Scrap, and unleash powerful special abilities.

details.title: Abyss of Kings
details.short_description: A Dark-Fantasy Action-Adventure inspired by the Kingsfield series. Explore the remnants of an underground civilization and battle sentient chess pieces. Discover magical rings and use them to create your own spells. Meet the last inhabitants of a dead kingdom and escape the Abyss.

details.title: UN:Me
details.short_description: UN:Me is a soul triage adventure. Four souls share one girl’s body, each certain it is the real one, yet only one can remain. Through dialogue you search a beautiful, unsettling world for its true owner, fleeing the traumas that surface as you go. When only one can stay, which will you keep?

details.title: PANLINE
details.short_description: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while PANLINE, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.

details.title: Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade
details.short_description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

details.title: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat
details.short_description: Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too 😉

details.title: This Is Not For You
details.short_description: After a ghost ship crashes into an isolated lighthouse, Ulysses’ memories come back to trap him in an endless, twisting maze full of riddles, blood, and magic. Draw your own map, and find a way to burn it all down.

details.title: Kindling Hour
details.short_description: A short psychological horror text adventure guided by a single candle. Random encounters and fragments of lost memories weave a story in the dark. Eerie and unsettling, yet a little cute and quirky. A narrative experience to gently light a fire in your heart.

details.title: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
details.short_description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

details.title: Karma Exorcist
details.short_description: The underworld lies in ruins, ravaged by evil karma. In this unknown and perilous realm of the dead, you must fight against demonic forces, collect mystical artifacts, face the Yama Kings and the Ghost Emperors, sever the Karma, and reforge the path of reincarnation.

details.title: Indie GameDev Sim
details.short_description: Become an indie game developer. Take client orders, buy new assets, build your own 2D games in a simple level editor, playtest them and send the finished builds to your clients for feedback and payment.

details.title: GlagStone
details.short_description: A 1-bit story-driven city builder inspired by late-80s Macintosh aesthetics. Rebuild a remote northern island settlement between warring nations and uncover the mystery at its heart.

name: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller

details.title: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller
details.short_description: The latest air traffic control puzzle is here! Set at Tokyo International Airport (HND/RJTT), experience two ways to enjoy the airport: Air Traffic Control Puzzle and the all-new Terminal Side. BOKUKAN evolves into a game where you can immerse yourself in the airport experience.

details.title: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
details.short_description: A third-person medieval dark fantasy adventure RPG with survival horror elements. As Edgar, a former priest with a fractured memory, explore a ruined world, solve environmental puzzles and uncover its secrets. Face twisted creatures and perform exorcisms to free the possessed.

details.title: Neidfyre
details.short_description: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

details.title: Forgotten Terror
details.short_description: Moving into a close senior's home, but nightmares follow. Terrifying ghostly figures, a senior who seems to be hiding something. What secret lies behind the door that cannot be opened?

details.title: Sushi Go Party!
details.short_description: Order up! Grab delicious sushi dishes and collect winning combinations in the award-winning board game, Sushi Go Party! With colourful characters, simple rules and plenty of tasty tactical twists, Sushi Go Party! serves up culinary competition for newcomers and seasoned strategists alike!

details.title: Cardaver
details.short_description: Cardaver is a tower defense, deckbuilder, with roguelike looping gameplay. Using a wide variety of monsters and spells to defend each lane, help the Dragon Queen protect her Castle Kingdom against an army of fantasy do-gooders and tyrannical princesses.

details.title: Motorsport Manager 2
details.short_description: Motorsport Manager returns after a decade. Build your racing team, develop faster cars, and make the calls that beat your rivals in reactive racing. Your decisions shape a living world of personalities and rivalries. Build your racing legacy.

name: Red Spider2: Exiled Remastered donation ver.

details.title: Red Spider2: Exiled Remastered donation ver.
details.short_description: A cinematic Hong Kong Noir visual novel. In 2007, an assassin defies orders to kill her savior and becomes a fugitive. Explore her fate through 1,300+ visual cuts and 6 branching routes.(Full story is free via the demo version. This paid edition supports Steam Achievements and the creators.)

details.title: Panic 64
details.short_description: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

details.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON
details.short_description: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rival sorcerers, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.

details.title: LootHold
details.short_description: Loot the day. Hold the night. LootHold throws you and up to three friends into a world the machines won. Strip the ruins by day, race the sun home, spend the loot on guns or defences. Then hold your bunker through the night against waves of bloodthirsty robots. Survive to take the fight to them.

details.title: CHEEKY CHEERHYTHM
details.short_description: "Wanna crush my pride? No way, you wimp!♡" Coach your proud student Iroha, designed by Asanagi, in this physical rhythm game! No matter your flawless timing, you'll get cheeky banter. Yet, your coaching works: her smooth Live2D animations react in real-time to your rhythm!

details.title: Max the Unifox
details.short_description: Based on dreams from real life, adventure about a guy turning into mysteries fox with a horn. And his horn contains power of the Creator of the Universe. What will our hero use it for?

details.title: 灵魂甜品 Soulcake
details.short_description: Soulcake: A fantasy‑romance AVG with yuri (LGBTQ+) & female-dominant dynamics. As the female lead, you can travel into others’ minds, gather ingredients to bake desserts filled with emotions. People come to you with their secrets. Forge bonds with them and…uncover the truth behind your ability.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

details.title: Please, Take The Phone
details.short_description: Welcome to Jiabao Tower Property Management.The night shift has begun. Your job is simple: answer calls, check the manual, and fill out the forms. When the night feels slow, watch some TV—though the programs may seem strange.Remember: serve every resident well. Jiabao Tower is our home forever.

details.title: Company Captain: Westashes
details.short_description: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

details.title: Babelled
details.short_description: Build your way back to space in BABELLED, a co-op tower-building adventure. Stranded on a strange planet, scavenge BABELBLOCKS and stack a path to your spaceship. You and your fellow BABELBOTS must leverage all of their BABELTECH to brave strange sky biomes and build a tower to the heavens.

name: Sakura Exchange: A Thai in Japan

details.title: Sakura Exchange: A Thai in Japan
details.short_description: Spend one fleeting school year in rural Japan as a 17-year-old Thai exchange student. In this wholesome, slow-burn romance visual novel, join a club, grow close to one of five girls, and decide whether to board the train home or stay for one more spring.

details.title: DABA Land of Water Scar
details.short_description: Clayman, the world in your hands. God, savior, or destroyer. Choose, and pay the price.

details.title: Witch Hunt 0
details.short_description: "Witch Hunt 0" is a magic-focused, stage-based boss rush 3D action game. Take on the role of the witch Astera. To reclaim her lost powers, she must craft spells, tame defeated enemies as familiars, and conquer the formidable foes that stand in her way.

details.title: Chubby Farm
details.short_description: Welcome to Chubby Farm! In this relaxing and stress-relieving Roguelike deck-builder, freely place your round little pieces, combine special items with animal buddies, and trigger wild, mind-blowing chain reactions! Get ready to be overwhelmed by cuteness and dive into an unstoppable farm party!

details.title: Merc Commander
details.short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

details.title: Coin Fall
details.short_description: Coin Fall is a short coin pusher incremental game. Every coin helps you unlock new pushers and chase jackpots. Discover special coins and trigger bonus mini-games, all in pursuit of the ultimate ticket prize!

details.title: Code Alone
details.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you step into the role of a gameplay programmer, write code to build the core mechanics of a wide variety of games, and solve increasingly challenging development problems.

details.title: SONAR
details.short_description: SONAR is a survival-horror game set on an abandoned alien planet. Explore vast, dark caves using SONAR pulses that briefly reveal the world around you. Research unknown species by taking photographs, recording audio, and collecting samples. Upgrade your equipment and survive deeper explorations.

details.title: The Walking Trade 2
details.short_description: Run a shop in an apocalyptic wasteland! Play alone or co-op (1-8 players) scavenging the wild new world, craft stock and upgrades, manage your workforce, and fend off undead hordes with your lives. Will you be heroes, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store and your fate.

details.title: DISTURBING FEARS - Tenant
details.short_description: After escaping a toxic relationship, 21-year-old Fiona Woodward rents the cheapest room she can find to start over. She had no idea what was waiting for her during her stay.

details.title: Who's Calling?
details.short_description: A home invasion thriller where your phone is your main enemy. The everyday routine, office work, and chores turn into a trap when an unknown person starts tracking every step you take. You've never been able to say no. Now you'll have to.

details.title: Man I Just Wanna Live
details.short_description: Mia wakes up with a hangover and a dead body in her apartment. Unfortunately, the body has friends who are about to break in through the front door. From there, things only get worse. This "MSPaint-noir" VN with 16 endings is as stylish as it is relentless. Mia just wants to live! Well, who doesn’t?

details.title: Race The Sun 2
details.short_description: Your futile journey into the sunset continues. Fly through endless procedural worlds, connected by seamless portals. Play alone or with friends, complete daily challenges, unlock and customize new ships, and compete in the all new TRIALS levels, made by community members.

details.title: The Book of Plagues 2
details.short_description: A steam-age city is gripped by a plague called False Death. You are a doctor once wrongly condemned, but now they need you. Every patient matters: one decision in your office can change the fate of the entire city.

details.title: Don't Pick Up
details.short_description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

details.title: BELTFED
details.short_description: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.

details.title: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD
details.short_description: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

name: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers

details.title: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers
details.short_description: Lead the Musketeers in this steampunk tactical cRPG! Tactical pause combat against the English invasion. Use the powerful Campaign Editor to create and share your own adventures. And play the official campaign and those from the community.

details.title: Bury Us Together
details.short_description: A cooperative survival strategy game with heroes. Explore and expand by day, build your defenses, and hold the line against thousands of enemies by night. Enjoy as a solo player or with up to 3 friends!

details.title: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
details.short_description: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

details.title: Burn-9
details.short_description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

details.title: Tidy Up
details.short_description: A peaceful cleaning and organizing game where you explore different locations, collect trash, clean stains, and arrange items to turn mess into perfection.

details.title: Out Fishing
details.short_description: Fish, sell, upgrade your gear, and build your camp in this first-person horror fishing game. Explore a haunted forest and uncover clues about a forgotten disappearance near the lake, but return before nightfall, as danger lurks beneath the water.

details.title: AlcheMice
details.short_description: A tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Play a card to move like a chess piece: the knight's jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Strike with action cards and brew alchemy into your deck. Three days, then the loop resets at dawn and you keep only your deck and whatever you locked in the chest.

details.title: Espiocracy
details.short_description: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.

details.title: Fragile Existence
details.short_description: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.

details.title: Showa American Story
details.short_description: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

details.title: Furcifer's Fungeon
details.short_description: An autoscrolling roguelike where everything you do impacts your talent options. Become a necromancer goose, or a berserker wielding a thunder blade! Collect legendary items in each run, and bring them back home for even more build options in the future.

details.title: My wife is a princess
