details.short_description: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

details.title: Mars Tactics
details.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

details.title: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
details.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

details.title: SPINE - This is Gun Fu
details.short_description: SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies. Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

name: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea

details.title: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
details.short_description: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

details.title: ILL
details.short_description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

details.title: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
details.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

details.title: BLACKFROST: The Long Dark 2
details.short_description: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

details.title: Base Boomers
details.short_description: Fire cannons, blast holes through enemy walls and watch entire bases collapse in this chaotic physics-based destruction FPS for up to 4 players. Gather resources, build and defend your base. Play free-for-all or in teams. The last base standing wins!

details.title: Gatto's Pizzeria
details.short_description: Run a cozy first-person pizzeria as an adorable cat! Prepare authentic Neapolitan pizzas step by step, serve hungry human customers, and upgrade your restaurant with new recipes, ovens, and decorations while relaxing in a hand-drawn 3D kitchen.

name: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds

details.title: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
details.short_description: A point and click noir mystery, set in a grim and corrupt Wonderland. Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds is a complete remake of the classic Flash game trilogy, including all new art, added puzzles, expanded lore, and plenty of secrets for old and new fans alike.

details.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3
details.short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3 is a wholly-new Dragon Ball experience, where you decide the hero you want to be in an unexplored Dragon Ball world: AGE 1000.

details.title: Beasts of Steel
details.short_description: Beasts of Steel is a WWII combined-arms game. Fight as a rifleman, tank crew or pilot in the same battle, on maps generated from real landscapes, or command the whole war in a turn-based campaign. Play online with up to 64 players, or offline with bots in battles of up to 128 soldiers.

details.title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
details.short_description: Unravel the dark history of the Bloodstained universe and explore a hauntingly immersive 16th-century England steeped in a 2.5D gothic atmosphere, enthralling players in strategic battles, crafting, and exploration across a sprawling, cursed land.

details.title: Everbloom
details.short_description: Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

details.title: Dicewood
details.short_description: A tiny pack of tiny creatures was lost in the woods. The food was scarce, they had to choose who will be left behind... Fight through the dark forest and save all the creatures.

details.title: Still Above: Orbital Refuge
details.short_description: A 3D space-station survival builder. The Earth below is gone; your station is still falling. Salvage the orbital graveyard, fit out empty hulls rack by rack, and keep air, water, power and fuel flowing long enough to turn one fragile module into humanity's last refuge.

details.title: Cthulhu's Cleanup Crew
details.short_description: You’re Employee #1 at Cthulhu’s new reality repair business. In this relaxing restoration game, clean up impossible disasters with a cosmic paint gun and upgrade your gear and workspace. Just try to ignore whatever’s screaming behind the walls.

details.title: Kero Quest 64
details.short_description: Kero Quest 64 is a Collectathon 3D Platformer inspired by other games in the genre, especially those from the late 90s. You take control of Kero, a blue frog seeking to stop a prince from spreading evil Shards across the Kingdom of Bunnabaria!

details.title: Pizza Super Slice
details.short_description: Cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an living slice of pizza. Explore a strange, cartoon town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages. There's something interesting in every nook and cranny!

details.title: Badassgard
details.short_description: Vikings with shotguns?! Team up in a high-octane, 1-4 player co-op shooter set in a fast-paced roguelite world. In Badassgard, maximize your firepower with unique strategies every single run. Face ever-changing dungeons, survive the chaos, and dive into a stylish battlefield!

details.title: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
details.short_description: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

details.title: Envido
details.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

details.title: Beachside Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own dessert restaurant in a French beach town! Cook crepes, waffles, ice cream and more. Serve tourists and locals, and expand your menu. Manage supplies, hire employees, upgrade your equipment, and grow your space to build your dream seaside dessert spot.

details.title: Westlanders
details.short_description: Survive a wild-west open world alone or with friends. Travel the land with your wagon, build settlements, fend off foes, and weave a powerful economic network across the wilderness. Forge your legacy in the Westlands.

details.title: Antichrist
details.short_description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

details.title: CIVIREVIVAL
details.short_description: In this 4X + RPG strategy game, lead humanity’s last ark and rebuild a new home among the mysterious ruins of the stars. Starting from nothing, you will develop technology, build powerful fleets, resist external threats, and shape the rebirth of human civilization.

details.title: Mayak
details.short_description: A signal from a star // 3571 → 3559 → 3557 → … → 0 // 336 years remain // You and her, staring up at the sky. A hand-drawn sci-fi adventure about first contact.

details.title: Date Survivor
details.short_description: Date survivor is a dating simulator mixed with escape room puzzles and psychological horror. Four dates, four houses, and multiple ways to either get closer — or get out before it’s too late.

details.title: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager
details.short_description: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and build a deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

details.title: Project ReMind
details.short_description: In this realistic first-person puzzle game, you’ve created the first Artificial Consciousness. Moments after its birth, it says goodbye and disappears. Every puzzle you solve restores a fragment of your shattered memories, but something not quite human has altered them. Is your mind still your own?

details.title: War Alert
details.short_description: As the frontline crawls through ruins and smoke, you command infantry, armor, and air support to shape the chaos. Capture points, break lines, encircle and counter-encircle. With no pay-to-win, only clear strategy and teamwork earns victory.

details.title: Souls of the Dead
details.short_description: A bio-catastrophe has engulfed the world, transforming people into bloodthirsty creatures. The only way to stop this plague is to damage the infected's brain. Try to survive this hell – alone or with a partner – while trying to maintain the line between a human and what you're forced to destroy.

details.title: Sherpa's Caravan
details.short_description: 🏔 🚐 ⛺️ 📦 🍳 🛶 Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics

details.title: Why's It Getting DARKER?!
details.short_description: The light is your only lifeline. Descend into a crushing, thalassophobic abyss where every photograph could be your last. Investigate unpredictable deep-sea horrors and explore the vast, dark unknown - all while being 'assisted' by a darkly sarcastic AI.

details.title: No Walls In Heaven
details.short_description: No Walls In Heaven is a first-person exploration platformer about losing yourself in the hostile vastness of the cosmos. Grapple, leap, and fight your way through the towering concrete and metal landscapes of a lost megastructure that seems to disobey all laws of physics and reality.

details.title: Shrine Labyrinth
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op Japanese horror game. Beyond the torii gate lies an otherworldly labyrinth whose layout changes randomly. Work together to escape as you run from, hide from, and sometimes confront terrifying supernatural entities!

details.title: City of None
details.short_description: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

details.title: ZOMBIE KEBAB VR
details.short_description: Cook kebabs and fight zombies in this fast action game. Explore streets, gather ingredients, and feed survivors. Unlock new tools and recipes as you survive each night. Fast, funny, and brutal. Known online as the “4 a.m. fast-food simulator”

details.title: My Time at Evershine
details.short_description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

details.title: SACRATA
details.short_description: SACRATA is a Diablo-like roguelite looter with horde-survival combat. Fight through relentless hordes, create skill builds, unlock a roster of heroes, challenge formidable bosses, and claim ancient Relics. Experience the thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

details.title: Golf With Your Friends 2
details.short_description: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

details.title: Scourge of the Reptiles
details.short_description: Command dinosaurs. Master tactical combat. Shape your fate. Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric low-fantasy world, where a devastating meteor grants magical powers to humans, elves… and dinosaurs. The result? War. Chaos. And something far worse.

details.title: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
details.short_description: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

details.title: The Subminer
details.short_description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

details.title: Aerocore
details.short_description: Aerocore is a liminal walking simulator about the future they promised you and never arrived. Explore the corporation's simulation environments in this atmospheric experience. Alter the architecture by solving puzzles in impossible spaces and lose yourself in nostalgic aesthetics.

details.title: 异世轮回录：If
details.short_description: 诸君！这个世界很无趣。生为牛马，我只是一个行走的NPC。谁不想当主角？ 在地球OL已经不可能办到了。但至少在异世轮回录中，我们可以！《异世轮回录：If》是一款多结局多周目轮回式人生模拟团队卡牌肉鸽游戏。你被女神召唤来到剑与魔法的异世界，新的人生你要选择怎么样的天赋？本以为是一次王道转生，但没想到这个世界危机重重，选错一步就只能迎接死亡。无数次轮回，你一点点探寻这个世界的隐秘，在最后的世界线，或许就是所有人都能幸福的Happy End?

details.title: Astral Enterprises
details.short_description: As CEO, build a ruthless corporate empire! Solve spatial factory puzzles, master complex supply chains, and manipulate dynamic markets to maximise profit. Mobilise local workforces, fund high-tech R&D, and construct colossal megaprojects to satisfy your demanding Parent Company.

details.title: MAW
details.short_description: What's it like to be queer in a totalitarian regime? Explore your identity as a wolf detective working for the state. Sniff for clues. Interrogate or date other characters. Make lasting choices. Will you fight your instincts or embrace who you really are and face the consequences?

details.title: KVLT
details.short_description: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

details.title: Red Rebellion
details.short_description: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

details.title: NO LAW
details.short_description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

details.title: Sunkissed City
details.short_description: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

details.title: Ardem
details.short_description: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

details.title: Thorny Times
details.short_description: Lead a mercenary company through story-driven fantasy scenarios. Capture castles, manage scarce resources, evolve your fighters, and solve puzzle-like turn-based battles where positioning matters more than brute force.

details.title: Gilded Destiny
details.short_description: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare.

details.title: Cosmic Holidays
details.short_description: In an unknown world, help Cibo reach his vacation resort. Through a stunningly rich fauna and flora, Cibo can glide, bounce, propel himself, get stuck, absorb shocks, or roll all simply by inflating his head. Tame this unfamiliar nature and turn it into your ally

details.title: Crescent County
details.short_description: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Get into gossip, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

details.title: Fellowship of the Oak
details.short_description: Fellowship of the Oak is a cozy crafting sim where you gather a fellowship of heroes, providing them with everything they need to succeed on their adventures. Build cozy homes, craft gear, farm provisions and manage expeditions in order to collect powerful loot!

details.title: At Fate's End
details.short_description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

details.title: The Plague Lords: Black Death
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

details.title: Arcane Eats
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

details.title: The Whims of the Gods
details.short_description: The Whims of the Gods is a strategic, cooperative city-builder created for joint gameplay in online co-op mode. Build and protect the ancient city, face enemies, and manage resources together! 🏠

details.title: Sunaba
details.short_description: Sunaba is a 3D First and Third Person Singleplayer and Multiplayer Sandbox game centered on User Generated Content. Inspired by games such as LittleBigPlanet, Roblox, Minecraft and Garry's Mod, with an art style inspired by cartoons, and anime.

name: The Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG

details.title: The Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG
details.short_description: Jump straight into the very last hour of a 1000-hour RPG. The beginning and the end of the To the Moon series.

details.title: Horu
details.short_description: Command hundreds of thousands of units across land and space in a galaxy-spanning RTS and 4X hybrid.

details.title: Alchemic Beasts
details.short_description: A monster-taming RPG where the social chemistry between your beasts shape how they bond, battle, and build. Join Zieg and Mioni to reclaim the wild paradise of Mizu, tame powerful monsters, and restore the resort to its former glory.

details.title: Truck World: Australia
details.short_description: A trucking simulator set in Australia. Haul cargo on highways and off-road, step out of the cab, hitch trailers, connect hoses, refuel, and service your truck by hand. You don't just drive a truck - you work as a trucker.

details.title: Militsioner
details.short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

details.title: Sidera Caeli
details.short_description: A first-person multiplayer space sim with no loading screens: gear up at the station, walk to your ship, power it up and take off. Fly in six degrees of freedom, jump between worlds, land and explore on foot or by rover, and take contracts with your squad in a persistent shared universe.

details.title: Bosslords
details.short_description: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!

details.title: Forgery Craft
details.short_description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

details.title: Rugby Playbook
details.short_description: Rugby, played with cards. Take a village club from the cow field to the World Cup, one cup at a time. Read what the other team is about to do, play your hand, win the scrum, keep the referee sweet. Between matches, fill your playbook, fight for the table and grow your club.

details.title: Nekolpos — Colossal Cat Care Simulation —
details.short_description: Shrunk to just 5 cm tall, you’re now being cared for by the cat you once owned. Talk freely with a gigantic nekomata, cuddle her fluffy fur, ride on her back, and enjoy a life together with your roles completely reversed.

name: Epica Primera: Guardians of the Forest

details.title: Epica Primera: Guardians of the Forest
details.short_description: Turn-based JRPG. Guide a group of cute girls through the forest and try to survive the horrors lurking inside using a language-based syntax spell system.

details.title: Automotive Empire
details.short_description: Start with one kart in a small garage. Expand your team from karting to the pinnacle of motorsport. Compete against 172 teams in 21 championships. Design every part, build and expand your campus. Enter the road car and racing parts markets and face another level of competition.

details.title: SPARK//RUSH
details.short_description: SPARK//RUSH is a high-speed rhythm-action game. Shoot, slash, and dodge through intense rail stages driven by electronic music before facing colossal bosses.

details.title: Traffic Check
details.short_description: An arcade racer where traffic is your weapon. Slam cars into each other, drift, boost and keep scoring even after you crash. Every map is procedurally generated, with new highways, biomes, towns and back roads to tear through, solo or up to 4-player splitscreen. Never stop burning

details.title: RITZEN
details.short_description: A brutal retro horde shooter set in a ritualistic world. Fight endless undead, uncover secrets, complete objectives, and face terrifying bosses - alone or in co-op.

details.title: Raid Haven
details.short_description: Build your haven and fortify it to withstand 100 waves of increasingly dangerous raids. Strategically place walls, traps, turrets, and defences, equip your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, and adapt your base as each wave pushes you closer to the breaking point.

details.title: Hollowreach - Wasteland
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Dmitry Sokolov crosses ruins and hostile territories, fighting the living and the dead in search of his father. Scarce ammunition and difficult choices mark every step through a city in decay.

details.title: Ranchonauts
details.short_description: A slapstick co-op game about herding alien sheep across a dangerous frontier. Work solo or with up to 5 friends to keep your flock together through physics-fueled disasters, pay off your ship-repair debt, and get home in one piece.

details.title: The Stars Are Never Still
details.short_description: The Stars Are Never Still is a 2D space sandbox. Shape a galaxy and watch 16 unique races colonize, trade, ally, betray and wage war. Observe, or intervene with technology, aid, discord, disasters, new life—even black holes. Chronicle millennia of history. No set goals. No empire lasts forever.

details.title: Sword Dancer
details.short_description: Inspired by Gongsun Daniang, the legendary sword dancer of Tang Dynasty China. Chart her blade-dance through enemy ranks—every step is set before the first strike. Route planning × roguelite building: choreograph the perfect dance, then watch it cut through the chaos.

details.title: How to Chemistry
details.short_description: How to Chemistry is a first-person co-op chemistry simulator, where you run your own lab with no safety regulations. Get an order, use your chemistry skills and deliver.

details.title: Five Star Crew
details.short_description: Run a tour boat with up to three friends through waters full of deadly sea life. Steer, cook, patch leaks and protect your guests on the way to the next dock. They paid for five-star service. Try to keep them alive long enough to leave a review.

details.title: Countryside Big Catch
details.short_description: Our protagonist moves to a countryside island. Here, the rent is free as long as you can fish. On this mysterious little island, a good hand with a rod is all it takes to make all his wishes come true.
developers: サークル☆フェアリーフラワー

details.title: Condotta
details.short_description: Lead a fifteenth-century mercenary company in Condotta, a historical tactical roguelike. Hire fighters, command them in turn-based battles, and decide what trouble to take on as you travel. Fulfill your contract—and live to collect your pay.

details.title: French Tax Simulator
details.short_description: Take on the role of a tax inspector and track down tax evaders! Your mission: to reduce the public deficit. Cross-check the supporting documents, uncover inconsistencies and decide who to audit. Your career in the civil service depends on it....

details.title: Under One Roof
details.short_description: Under One Roof is a pixel-art apartment management sim. Furnish rooms, welcome tenants, collect rent, and help them grow. Watch them build careers, make friends, fall in love, and start families as you create your dream apartment, grow a lively community, and follow stories across generations.

details.title: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
details.short_description: An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players! Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system! Friendship or betrayal? Money or power? Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

details.title: Gnomageddon
details.short_description: Roguelike tower defense meets the gnome apocalypse. Pick upgrades, build towers and defend your garden from hundreds of thousands of gnomes.

details.title: Just Be Alive
details.short_description: You can't attack. You can only dodge. Team up in 1–4 player co-op (friends or bots) and climb a tower full of cute bosses and mechanics. If at least one of you is still standing at the end, the whole team wins.

details.title: Gate Guard Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

details.title: Inkblood
details.short_description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

details.title: Your Painting, Sir
details.short_description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

details.title: Road to Jukai
details.short_description: You work the night shift as a taxi driver in a remote region of Japan. Not all of the odd passengers you pick up after sunset are what they seem. Sometimes it's safer to just keep your eyes on the road, especially when a fare leads to the strange, massive forest the locals whisper about.

details.title: Perceptum
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

details.title: Elestrals Awakened
details.short_description: The elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. Long ago, divine power was shattered across the stars, giving birth to the creatures now known as Elestrals. As darkness stirs and conflict brews, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise. Will you protect the world?

details.title: Quarantine Zombies 2: Day Zero
details.short_description: From the lead game designer of Quarantine Zone and Quarantine Zombies comes a new mix of inspection sim and open-world shooter in Chicago. Determine the stage of infection and transport infected refugees through hostile streets to the Captain before they turn. Continue Hank and his brother’s story.

details.title: All Army Attack
details.short_description: Hold onto your clucks! All Army Attack is a chaotic large-scale roguelike auto-battler. Unite animals and plants, build an army that spills off the screen, gamble it all with every battle, and fight your way toward a formidable cosmic threat!

details.title: Smoke and Steel
details.short_description: Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe in Smoke and Steel, a turn-based wargame combining grand strategy with tactical battles. Choose diplomacy or war. Build your economy, forge alliances and negotiate trade deals, then command your armies in battle. Outthink, outflank, outlast.

details.title: Dragon and Mahjong
details.short_description: Dragon & Mahjong is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes from three very different walks of life, escape the endless games of exploitation, and take on the evil goblin corporation that rules the city—all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

name: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler

details.title: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler
details.short_description: Return to the enchanting world of Spirit of the North in a cozy shopkeeping idler. Send your Fox Guardian exploring, gather treasures, stock the Raccoon’s traveling shop, and journey across the Northern Isles in charming pixel art.

details.title: SanararaR
details.short_description: It was something that could’ve happened to anyone… A somewhat mysterious story… One day, I was approached by a girl I didn’t recognize. She told me that she could grant any wish I desired but… While I stood in disbelief, she began to explain how it worked. A classic visual novel from NekoNeko Soft!

name: Sayagatari - Promise of the Cursed Blade -

details.title: Sayagatari - Promise of the Cursed Blade -
details.short_description: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

details.title: Squid Arrives：Make Squid Great Again
details.short_description: In XXXX, deep-sea squids receive "nuclear food" from the islands. This unnatural feast triggers their awakening, reviving the lost memory of cephalopod world domination. Note: Inspired by fried calamari. Contains allegory. Don't overthink it! (laughs)

details.title: HODKA
details.short_description: Roam a wild map with your trusty metal detector to dig up scrap. Upgrade your van and tools for better loot but finish work before nightfall. For that is when the dark fog creeps in and will claim its due.

details.title: Monster Cuisine
details.short_description: Best a beast and serve a feast in Monster Cuisine, an action-RPG where you're a tavern keeper hunting fabled creatures in a forbidden forest to cook mythical meals and grow your business. Craft unique weapons and armor sets to take on stronger monsters that are as delicious as they are dangerous.

details.title: Cards & Cannons
details.short_description: Build your own realm and turn every path into a devious trap in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

details.title: Things to Forget – Lighthouse
details.short_description: Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace.

details.title: GRIDLANDS
details.short_description: GRIDLANDS is a PvE extraction shooter set in a fallen world where sentient machines hunt what remains of humanity. Scavenge, survive, and extract through hostile industrial dead zones where every run could be your last.

details.title: Carnholt
details.short_description: Build your victory upon the corpses you leave behind. Carnholt is a roguelike deckbuilder in which death is not the end, it’s just another card to play. Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerful spells, fight in tactical battles, and slay a God that refused death.

details.title: Block Crime
details.short_description: Imagine GTA, but in a blocky style with a living online RP world. Block Crime is a crime simulator where you choose your role: police officer, gangster, or ordinary worker. Take over districts, participate in gang wars, create businesses, and become the boss of Los Palms city!

details.title: ShipIt Galactic
details.short_description: Manage and grow your intergalactic shipping company! Play alone or with friends as you fly your truck, pick up deliveries and process them in your hangar. Purchase machines, place conveyor belts, hire drivers, and build the best logistics company in the galaxy!

details.title: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

details.title: Respect The Horde
details.short_description: You're outnumbered. Outsmart them. Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

details.title: Intercept Course
details.short_description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

details.title: Restoraether
details.short_description: Restoraether is a cozy magical survival crafting game where you explore the isles of magic, mysteriously abandoned by their powerful Mage inhabitants, and restore the balance of aethers to bring magic back to the world.

details.title: Polyzonia
details.short_description: An ecosystem sim set in the Amazon rainforest. Grow plants, create habitats for animals, and click to hunt prey, pollinate flowers, eat fruit, and poop to spread seeds. Unlock automation and make the rainforest grow and thrive on its own.

details.title: BRO GHOST
details.short_description: When you die, you don't leave the game. You become one of the deadliest things in it. A co-op horror for 4 players — return as a spirit, help your friends, or haunt them until they break.

details.title: Hamster Time
details.short_description: Your desktop hamsters run on their wheels in response to your keyboard and mouse input. Get things done with friends while collecting cute hamsters and stylish wheels. Enjoy a variety of multiplayer modes, plus a timer and to-do list.

details.title: Foxwood Adventure
details.short_description: A cozy survival game designed to be relaxing and approachable. Explore, craft, and learn the basics of survival alone or with someone new to the genre.

details.title: Full Belly Breakout
details.short_description: Navigate the hidden dangers lurking within a wide variety of dishes, savor every bite, fill your stomach, and escape from a terrifying cell. An overwhelming dining experience where eyeballs crawl out of plain rice, sharks burst from soup, and entire universes unfold upon your plate.

details.title: After School: Days Gone By
details.short_description: After School: Days Gone By is a collectible battle game about childhood corner-store duels. Challenge friends with marbles, round cards, and spinning tops; collect rare toys, build decks, customize tops, and relive the noisy fun of after-school play with light roguelite progression.

details.title: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
details.short_description: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

details.title: HOMUNCULCHU
details.short_description: Guide fragile homunculi with limited lifespans through humanity's final bid for survival across six hostile worlds.

details.title: Heroes of the Underworld
details.short_description: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.

details.title: Chaincast
details.short_description: A PvP roguelike auto battler where you build a squad and arrange their skills into escalating combos. Battle rival squads and set off a chain reaction that grows stronger with every link.

details.title: Hole Punch Cocktail
details.short_description: "Drink. Kill. Drink. Kill." Enter the dream of Ms. Hangover, a young office worker with a slight alcohol dependency, fight against a twisted reality, and successfully finish your daily routine.

details.title: Trouble in Our Skies
details.short_description: A retro PS1-style action game set in a lo-fi cyberpunk metropolis, where fast-paced movement meets chaotic clean-up-and-combat gameplay. You are Lammy, a dormant caregiver bot revived to save a sky city from total collapse.

details.title: Dust till Dawn
details.short_description: A retro-paranormal powerwash simulator, where you're a maid restoring a quiet rural Japanese village. Dust, mop, squeegee to your heart's content...but don't stay too late!

details.title: Normandie
details.short_description: Normandie is a narrative ocean crawler set in the wake of World War II. Suit up as Charlie, a rookie salvage diver aboard the Shomesh. Work with your crew to explore the wrecks of the legendary ocean liners that once ruled the Atlantic.

details.title: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
details.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

details.title: The Money Man
details.short_description: In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes

details.title: Order 13 VR
details.short_description: A psychological horror VR experience where you work the night shift inside a mysterious warehouse while taking care of your cat. Fulfill orders, survive the darkness, and uncover what hides between the shelves.

details.title: Nymble 2
details.short_description: Jack returns in Nymble 2, a turn-based puzzle-platformer where every step and jump matters. Solve 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new enemies, traps, and hazards that react when you move. Find the seedling, plant it, and climb the beanstalk to reach the next level above.

details.title: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
details.short_description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

details.title: Monster Fantasy
details.short_description: Hunt giant monsters and build a beautiful home! Monster Fantasy is an action RPG with cozy life-sim elements. As an amnesiac hero, explore Eldoras, battle monsters with companions, befriend villagers, and enjoy fishing, cooking, gathering, and crafting.

details.title: ACORN: Seed of Resistance
details.short_description: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

details.title: Nightmare Journey 1135
details.short_description: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

details.title: Insomnia Club
details.short_description: A grounded emotional visual novel about urban insomnia, moral dilemmas, and intimacy. By day, you monetize insomniacs' pain and privacy. By night, you seek help at a real Insomnia Club and meet the women treated as collateral. Are you helping them—or turning them into a better product?

details.title: Way of the Warrior
details.short_description: Become a samurai in Way of the Warrior, a souls-like PvP and boss rush game. Face other players in intense duels or fight a gauntlet of powerful warriors in a world inspired by feudal Japan. Parry, dodge, feint and attack until only one of you is left standing.

details.title: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse
details.short_description: Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

details.title: One-Time Trigger
details.short_description: Carefully observe the seven patients. Identify the one who doesn't belong, fire your one and only bullet, and complete the test. Shoot the wrong one and you die. You get only one chance.

details.title: Farlane
details.short_description: Command a Nomad-class Frontier Runner and lead your crew on the edge of a fading galactic empire. Take on freelance contracts, explore unstable farlanes, upgrade your ship, and survive where civilization ends.

details.title: NOSTRA
details.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where side-view party battles turn on timing: build Boost, raise a Ward, parry on the frame and break the guard. Loot rolls with affixes, sets and runewords. Three kingdoms hold a fragile peace while something older stirs. Play the alpha demo now.

details.title: Dominus Manager
details.short_description: Take the mantle of a Lanista in ancient Rome. Build your ludus, scout and train fierce gladiators, manipulate political factions, and schedule high-stakes arena battles in this deep management simulation. Blood entertains the crowd, but gold builds an empire.

details.title: Llamero: Incremental Herd
details.short_description: Run around herding magical llamas, gathering mountains of wool, and upgrading your skills to help a struggling wool village. A cozy, story-rich incremental game about a herder and the responsibility he carries.

details.title: Illusive Domain
details.short_description: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

details.title: Ghost Ripper
details.short_description: In Ghost Ripper, you play as Heather, a night-shift waitress abducted and held captive in an abandoned asylum by a sadistic serial killer known as the Ghost Ripper. Hide, survive, and uncover his dark past as you search for a way out.

details.title: Voidwood
details.short_description: Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game, where your voice can save your friends or give them all away. By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive the hunt. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.

details.title: On Donuts and Holes
details.short_description: A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?

details.title: Mirealle
details.short_description: A cozy isometric puzzle adventure about a girl who sets out to find a cure for her loyal dog, Zephyr. Rotate the world, wake ancient mechanisms and find out why it broke into floating islands.

details.title: The Secret of Weepstone
details.short_description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

details.title: SOS Recordings
details.short_description: A lone mountain in northern Japan. Two hikers rescued alive from its silent maw. In their wake, a perfect SOS made of tree trunks, built years before anyone was lost. Based on the real unsolved 1989 SOS Incident. The recordings are waiting.

details.title: HOST
details.short_description: Host is a multiplayer horror game where you and up to three friends compete to find out who is the most fearless, smart and agile. You play as prisoners taking part in a show that inculdes five different games.

details.title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
details.short_description: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

details.title: Shattered Realms
details.short_description: Battle hordes of enemies, unlock powerful abilities and new characters, and conquer unique bosses in this dark fantasy roguelite ARPG packed with loot, upgrades, and deep build customization. Traverse the Shattered Realms and reclaim the fragments of a broken world.

details.title: Economic Miracle
details.short_description: Take charge of any nation and lead it to greatness in the most ambitious geopolitical simulator of the modern era. Manage economy, laws, military, and diplomacy. Build the future without compromise!

details.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn
details.short_description: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

details.title: Gothic Scythe
details.short_description: 敵の猛攻を掻い潜り、撃破していく高難易度アクション。大鎌使いとなりホムンクルスに支配された街を取り戻しましょう。

details.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
details.short_description: Play a sneaky, ruthless Skaven assassin and slay your way up the ranks of the ratmen in this grim and dark new 2D stealth-action platformer. Escape. Kill. Ascend. Become a Deathmaster.

details.title: Necrofane
details.short_description: A dark power is rising. Defeat the necromancer and his generals before they conquer the kingdom. In this old school dark fantasy RPG, explore cursed dungeons, battle monstrous foes, master forbidden magic, and gather powerful loot in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

details.title: The Little Ones
details.short_description: Join the little guardians of the earth in an adventure that adds a touch of strategy to the top-down shooter tradition. Plan every move, meet new allies, unlock weapons and abilities to hunt down evil humans and return these lands to their rightful owners.

details.title: The Last Raccoon
details.short_description: Survive as a raccoon in an abandoned mansion filled with zombies. Solve puzzles inspired by dark fairy tales and explore to uncover whether the world is worth saving.

details.title: Rodent Company
details.short_description: Battle enemy pests using randomly generated toy guns, powerful perks and unique abilities! Join with friends in up to 4-player couch co-op and gather the best arsenal to win!

details.title: Sin Hunter
details.short_description: An innovative roguelike deckbuilder with a fresh card combat system and character-driven relationship stories. Become a Sin Hunter, slay the Original Sins, meet four demon girls, uncover the secrets of Hell City, and become their salvation—you are this world’s “Hope.”

details.title: Car For Sale Together
details.short_description: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.

details.title: Overbit
details.short_description: A 4th-Wall-Breaking Pixel Art Horror/Comedy RPG with Rhythm based Bullet Battles happening inside a Retro Operating System

name: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven

details.title: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven
details.short_description: A man the zombies will not attack fights to protect his allies and base as they journey toward Heaven. Prepare defenses, deploy allies, upgrade equipment, and set traps to survive the horde in this RTS and tower defense hybrid.

details.title: Prison of Doubles
details.short_description: 1-4 player horror. Following the Chernobyl disaster, mutated parasites possess humans, turning them into monsters. As a prison intake guard, you process incoming transfers: both regular criminals and those only pretending to be human. Let a double slip through, and a nightly bloodbath awaits.

details.title: Pilot 6174: Orbital Survival
details.short_description: Navigate star systems using real orbital mechanics. Pilot a cockpit with controls inspired by the Apollo command module. Manage heat, energy, and trajectory.

details.title: Beat Weaver
details.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

details.title: No Mercy, No Sanctuary
details.short_description: Survive a gritty 2D apocalypse featuring realistic physics and visceral dismemberment. Fortify your sanctuary by day and defend it by night. Scrutinize every survivor seeking refuge: inspect them for symptoms, for one hidden infection will doom your entire colony.

details.title: Rent A Car Together
details.short_description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

details.title: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak
details.short_description: ASCENDERS: BEYOND THE PEAK is a turn-based exploration roguelite where survival is vertical. Lead a team of alpinists to recover ancient artifacts from cursed peaks, prepare your expedition, evolve your climbers, master rope mechanics, and face H.P. Lovecraft-inspired horrors within the mountain.

details.title: Dung Slinger
details.short_description: An action-packed physics platformer about being chained to a giant dung ball! Master a complex movement system to move, swing and launch yourself forward. Defeat enemies, overcome obstacles and regain your freedom in a game that blends traditional platforming with a tight physics system!

details.title: The Pines
details.short_description: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

details.title: What's in the box?
details.short_description: OPEN CONTAINERS! Seriously, just buy a container and… OPEN IT! What’s inside? - A MYSTERY! Find a rare item, fix it, and sell it for as much as possible in this first-person incremental game!

details.title: Hardware Simulator
details.short_description: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

details.title: One Iced Latte: Milk Song
details.short_description: Idol baristas, Samurai baristas, VTubers baristas, Robot baristas! The Coffee War has taken over Tokyo! You are Ken Katsuki, a young master and the new manager of Milk Milk Coffee. Help sweet Moka win the Barista Cup! ☆

details.title: Bad Magpie
details.short_description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

details.title: Where is my sword
details.short_description: A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!? Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item! Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

details.title: Screams of the Abyss
details.short_description: Descend into the abyss, following the trail of a vanished expedition. Piece together their story through the recordings they left behind and uncover why none of them ever returned to the surface.

details.title: Every Wednesday
details.short_description: A laundromat. Every Wednesday. And stories that stay. Join Hideki in a small laundromat in the heart of a restless metropolis, where smartphones are not allowed and strangers slowly become part of each other’s lives.

details.title: Bloom Control
details.short_description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

details.title: Carbon Compliance
details.short_description: A simulation game about experiencing the very mundane job of a government official, rummaging through paperwork. Make sure all the paperwork is free of any errors. Deny applications that are not up to the specified requirements. Bored of working, play mini-games to relieve stress.

details.title: Knight George
details.short_description: Knight George is a top-down retro-style action-adventure game. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

details.title: Pemkie Island
details.short_description: Pemkie Island is a monster taming RPG adventure, in a roguelite format. Travel across the 5 different regions while discovering and taming unique creatures called Pemkies. Master their traits, choose the right skills and build the best team possible to restore balance!

name: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator

details.title: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
details.short_description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

details.title: Godless Dawn
details.short_description: Godless Dawn is a ruthless action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Descend into cursed dungeons, uncover the stories behind fallen souls, and reveal the truth hidden behind the silence of the gods.

details.title: Perihelion
details.short_description: Master orbital combat and bend gravity to your advantage in this space combat roguelite. Launch from your carrier, tackle tactical missions, build crew relationships, and upgrade your ship between runs as you slowly unravel the mystery of a lost sister ship.

details.title: Iron Bramble
details.short_description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

details.title: Manum
details.short_description: A fast third-person 4v4 battlemage arena where you build your mage mid-match. Loot spells, combine them freely, and fight for capture points.

details.title: Quarantine
details.short_description: A co-op multiplayer survival game where players run a quarantine checkpoint together during an outbreak. Inspect survivors, manage shared resources, argue over decisions, and survive the consequences... or sabotage each other when panic sets in.

details.title: Midnight Train: New Moon
details.short_description: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

details.title: Stack Order
details.short_description: Stack Order is an enigmatic deckbuilding adventure. Engage in tense one-on-one card duels, use strategy to stack up synergies, and uncover the source of the corruption spreading over this mysterious, handcrafted world.

details.title: Resident Evil Veronica
details.short_description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

details.title: Nordic Sprint
details.short_description: A classic-style cross-country skiing game where technique, stamina and drafting decide the race. Climb the World Cup with 20 abilities, race sprint, biathlon and relay in changing weather and wind – solo or in online multiplayer with up to 12 players.

details.title: Clockwork Revolution
details.short_description: CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE. Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.

details.title: BODY COUNT
details.short_description: Drive to catch bodies, crash to rewind time. Road rage at your past selves in this physics-driven, arcade-style game!

details.title: Pegote
details.short_description: Reshape your cards in this Spanish deck roguelike deckbuilder. Bet your cards on a duel where highest one wins, slap stickers on them to rig the values on the table. Live with your choices or burn the ones you cannot change.

name: Don't Kill Them All - Orc Slay Prevention Sim

details.title: Don't Kill Them All - Orc Slay Prevention Sim
details.short_description: Orcs don’t die: THEY RAGE! Embody their Warchief and lead them out of misery in this brutish strategy game with base-building, where one Orc outburst can turn victory into disaster. Forge bonds between units, shape their personalities, and unleash their true potential both in and out of battle.

details.title: THE LIFT: Supernatural Handyman Simulator
details.short_description: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

details.title: Islands
details.short_description: Island Island Island is a low-poly cartoon-style sandbox survival crafting game. Set in an infinitely dynamically generated world of floating islands, all terrain unfolds in real time as you move—the map has no boundaries.

name: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth

details.title: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth
details.short_description: Join us on an Epic Journey into the warped minds of life long gamers who are creating a nostalgic game, setting the player deep into a fantasy realm with a rich story line and many interactive features.

details.title: Jump Frog
details.short_description: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

details.title: TreeTale
details.short_description: TreeTale is a HACK&SLASH ARPG that combines limitless customization with strategic combat. Players can freely build their characters using an extensive Passive Tree, while the Skill Customization System allows them to refine their combat style to perfection.

details.title: Spells and Sploobies
details.short_description: A tactical hex-grid card game for 2–4 players where wizards clash in strategic PvP duels. Build your deck, summon units, build structures, cast abilities, and issue commands to fight for control of the board.

details.title: Crystals
details.short_description: Crystals is a RPG game where you travel to another Dimension and have to fight multiple enemies using a turn-based combat system and avoid attacks like a platformer.

details.title: 轮回江湖
details.short_description: 2D挂机沙盒武侠网游无货币纯材料交易
Space flight arcade focused on maneuvering.

details.title: Robust Island
details.short_description: A relationship-driven farming sim with time pressure and consequences. Grow crops, raise animals, manage stamina, and build relationships while racing against daily deadlines that shape your success—or force you off the island.

details.title: Atmospheric Labyrinth
details.short_description: Search for unusual events inside a labyrinth of usual rooms. Walk through it, and see daily life differently.

details.title: Irredeemable
details.short_description: Irredeemable is an Open World First Person Shooter where you can explore the war and the criminal world directly on the hood.

details.title: DAUGHTER OF PAIN
details.short_description: "DAUGHTER OF PAIN" is a top-down action game with Roguelike elements. You will explore in dreams and create after waking up... provided that you can defeat the powerful enemies who are the incarnations of pain. Don't be afraid of nightmares - sleep, wake up, create, and repeat this cycle.

details.title: Mazino
details.short_description: A neon-soaked casino twist on classic maze-chase action. Navigate glowing mazes as "Chip," dodge cunning Dealers, ride hot streaks, hit jackpots, and let the music-reactive visuals pull you into one more run. The house always wins... unless you're on a Blazing Streak.

name: Miners and Moyu-spheres in a field of citadels

details.title: Miners and Moyu-spheres in a field of citadels
details.short_description: A colorful RTS with rainbow skills.

details.title: Battle Tanks Online
details.short_description: Retro tank battles with live opponents. Destroy, break through, and outsmart other players in fast-paced, dynamic matches. Destructible environments, arcade-style gameplay, and tactical elements await you.

details.title: Finnish middleschool simulator
details.short_description: In this simulation, you can live the life of dreams. The game is completely open world, and besides attending school, you can also customize your moped, drink alcohol, and enjoy the sauna. If you’re not in the mood for school, you can tell the teacher to fuck off and come to school drunk.

details.title: GODBOX
details.short_description: GODBOX is a coding god-sim where you program life, grow your power by unlocking divine domains, and compete against rival deities. Help your devoted Folk survive while you harness their faith to fuel your divine ascension.

details.title: Trust Me Bro, I Trade
details.short_description: A minimalist incremental clicker about trading stocks and coins in rapid-fire rounds. Watch prices move, trade bulk orders, square off for profit or loss, and unlock upgrades & sectors to further maximize earnings.

details.title: Adept
details.short_description: Conquer the world with fire and sword in a world where chaos reigns.

details.title: Furniture Market
details.short_description: Manage every step of your furniture business. Unload containers with cranes, drive forklifts to organize stock, and design your store for customers. Handle logistics alone or with friends in co-op. A realistic simulation focused on deep mechanics, from port shipments to in-store sales.

name: VIOLENCE DOLL バイオレンスドール

details.title: VIOLENCE DOLL バイオレンスドール
details.short_description: Become V.D, a cybernetic investigator pursuing a global conspiracy in this sci-fi action RPG. Hack enemies at close range to freeze them, then unleash devastating combos. Explore 2.5D stages and engage in real-time 3D battles.

details.title: 思安α.1.0
details.short_description: 游戏类型：日常休闲轻解谜

details.title: Arraywrap
details.short_description: A strange world filled with mystery. Bend space to go through impossible passages and explore the Sky Archipelago. Discover its secrets and rules. What does it all mean?

details.title: Brutal Magic
details.short_description: Master devastating elemental magic in this fast-paced third-person fighting game. Chain explosive spells, outplay your opponent, and unleash spectacular magical combat in a visually stunning fantasy world. 1v1 duels where one hit ends the round.

details.title: Gunlands
details.short_description: Gunlands is an FPS action roguelike about crafting weapons and fighting an evil cult ready to overthrow the world with an army of ascended, mind-controlled soldiers. Find gun parts, assemble them into weapons of mass destruction, and let the chaos rain down upon your enemies.

name: くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！

details.title: くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！
details.short_description: 「くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！」は、3D空間で主人公のねこを操作し、会話でストーリーが進行するRPGです。VR・PC（Windows）の両方でプレイ可能です。プレイヤーであるあなたは、不思議な本に閉じ込められてしまった主人公の「ゆかいなくろもふねこちゃん」になり、問題を解決しながら本から脱出しましょう。

details.title: Delta x Dungeon Breaker
details.short_description: Guide "Kaiza", your main character, through a treacherous high fantasy world grappling with the looming threat of Dungeon Breaks that grows each day. Gather adventurers, train, fight, and die while traversing a deep narrative puzzle on your quest to stop the dungeon breaks!

details.title: Soap Soup Tycoon
details.short_description: Inherit Grandma's restaurant in Kesselbach and make it your own: a schnitzel house, a trattoria, a wok kitchen or wild fusion. In a town where every guest really lives somewhere. Only the big pot in the cellar, Grandma couldn't get out.

details.title: 悠久教室 - Perpetual Classroom -
details.short_description: A horror adventure where you confront supernatural phenomena and unravel mysteries in a school transformed into another world, all to save your childhood friend. Exploration, combat, and psychological terror await you.

details.title: Ghost Network : Dark Hacker
details.short_description: Hack your way up Neon City's underworld. Take contracts from 8 fixers, crack networks from the terminal or run them in a 3D dive, script your own hacks, steal the data and jack out before the trace finds you. A full single-player career.

details.title: Diehexegy
details.short_description: Diehexegy is a hex grid turn-based 4x game with a unique twist: your armies are composed of dice. It has multiple victory conditions and straightforward gameplay.

details.title: Hateful Days
details.short_description: George Prinkerton, expecting nothing terrible about the new day, finds himself caught in a time loop. Shocking events unfold one after another, and what seemed to be a completely ordinary young man becomes trapped in a terrifying whirlwind of events.

details.title: Looping Art Museum
details.short_description: "Looping Art Museum" is a single-player adventure game where you wander through an infinitely-looping art museum, finding changes in the paintings to progress. Interact with a talking "Mr.Cat" and uncover the mysteries of the strange art museum.

details.title: Parkdens
details.short_description: Parkdens is a minimalistic and relaxing nature park building game where you can place tiles and choose variety of objects ranging from statues, sitting areas, shelters to bushes, playgrounds, trees etc. to populate the placed tiles.

details.title: A Story About Forever: Transience
details.short_description: A Story About Forever is a space exploration action RPG game with heavy emphasis on story and character interaction, (inspired by Star Control II). Features Asteroids-style dogfights, an upgradable ship, a deep conversation system, and hundreds of characters with novels' worth of dialog to discover.

details.title: Wrathbreaker
details.short_description: Wrathbreaker is single-player 3rd person combat game where you protect your kingdom from an invading evil empire while growing your personal keep and commanding your troops in battle. Manage resources to grow your fortress, train new troops, create and upgrade your arsenal to defend the realm.

details.title: Dawn Herald: Purple Fox
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite built around teleportation, symmetry, and runic combos, where movement, positioning, and mastery of space decide every fight.

details.title: VIVID
details.short_description: Be a plant in this cozy, narrative-driven plant survival simulation about nature, responsibility, and interconnected systems. You will grow procedurally over time, explore evolving environments, and shape a fragile ecosystem through meaningful choices.

details.title: Retired
details.short_description: RETRO HYPER TIRE RACING! Cruise down hills through 5 different developer created worlds competing for the best track time, or race through a nearly infinite supply of User created levels through the steam workshop!

details.title: 龙之塔
details.short_description: Dragon Tower is a light ROGUE game set in a different world, where players take on the role of a brave adventurer exploring inside the Dragon Tower. They will assemble their own team to create unique strategies and defeat the monsters within the Dragon Tower.

details.title: Australia: Federation 1901
details.short_description: Lead Australia from Federation in 1901 and shape the nation's future. Manage the economy, politics, immigration, infrastructure, defence, education, healthcare, and welfare in a deep historical nation-building simulation where every decision changes history.

details.title: Phase Nexus
details.short_description: Blitz enemies in slow motion as an energy-based speedster and stop time then fire off with precision as a warp speed teleporter in this space-time action! Phase Nexus is a cartoony character action game that stars a quarter alien and a cyborg vigilante fighting against reality-breaking anomalies.

details.title: Immania
details.short_description: Immania is a large-scale real-time strategy game. Command armies of Immanians to capture territory, build interconnected Energy networks, and overwhelm opponents using specialized units, upgrades and powerups.

details.title: 4000 Later
details.short_description: After doing something foolish, you slip into Headspace, whereupon you meet Phil. Will you escape, or will you remain a doofus?

details.title: SolBound
details.short_description: A 4X turn-based strategy game where energy is everything. Build a power network, grow your forces, and fight your rivals for the best ground on a planet where day and night are always on the move.

details.title: KONBOYS
details.short_description: Co-op for up to 4 players. Drive through a dark and mysterious island filled with mutations created by Mycel Corp, navigate using your vehicle’s analog controls, search for the lost complex, and recover the forgotten cargo to sell it and upgrade your gear.

details.title: LENG
details.short_description: A bass-drenched FPS set in a vertical megastructure built on pirate radio and UKF rave culture.

details.title: Build or be sniped
details.short_description: A chaotic physics-based party game built to test friendships. Every match switches things up: build a staircase to steal a sniper’s rifle, shoot rivals off giant jenga blocks over open water, climb a wall covered in knives, throw chairs off a ledge, draw shapes to cast spells and much more...

details.title: Terror of the Titans
details.short_description: Terror of the titans is a 3D arena brawler pitting kaiju against one another. Featuring 10 playable monsters, 10 maps, a movie inspired story mode, and many game modes. Smash, crush, and rampage across the globe!

details.title: Hypocrisy
details.short_description: Hunt a tyrant, liberate oppressed worlds, face the monster within — in a sci-fantasy action roguelike RPG.

details.title: Lumsprout Isle
details.short_description: Lumsprout Isle is a 2D top-down pixel farming game. The world is veiled in a pale grey mist and the sea routes are sealed. Take up your hoe, fishing rod, and weapons, sail through the mining lands, the snowy isle, and the lava isle, and bring the sleeping world back to life.

details.title: Arbiters Dream
details.short_description: Face the God of Chaos in a cosmic tower-defense board game for the balance of the universe. Each run craft a unique deck from tower and unit cards and upgrade them with modular ability runes.

details.title: Bloody Moon - First Fear
details.short_description: First-person horror with no HUD. Nostradamus and Catherine de’ Medici shared a secret that history buried on purpose. Underground, on nights the Moon turns blood red, something still hunts. Every piece of this story really existed. That’s the terrifying part.

details.title: Weekend Racer
details.short_description: Race your way up from weekend wannabe to hired pro driver. Every pixel of the track is simulated live: rain washes it clean, rubber and dirt build up, and the dry line forms as the cars warm it up. Full weather and day/night cycle. It looks cute but it won’t be easy.

details.title: Ram and Hedgehog
details.short_description: Set off on a crazy adventure with the Ram and the Hedgehog, filled with unexpected dangers and fun challenges. They prank each other and annoy everyone around them. But one day, a great goal unites them — food. What could possibly go wrong?

details.title: Cerulean Climb
details.short_description: Play as Lark in a story-driven 2.5D RPG about climbing an endless tower to become God. Explore its wildly different floors, solve puzzle-box dungeons, and break enemy shields in turn-based battles. The higher Lark climbs, the easier it gets to justify what he does to keep going.

details.title: SURANGAMA
details.short_description: Unravel the truth and secrets which bind Tse Li Li to her forgotten past. Battle through hordes of relentless malformed souls and solve intricate puzzles in this Survival Horror X Character Action mashup set in a neon soaked Diyu, the Chinese-Buddhist vision of Hell, inspired by Kowloon Walled City.

details.title: XiSiTeLing with Infinite Winding
details.short_description: Xisiteling and the Infinite Winding A pixel-art deck-building RPG Roguelike. Black fire traps worlds in cycles. Play amnesiac Xisiteling, sword in hand, in the Infinite Corridor. Fight, learn skills, meet others, unlock cards. Choices forge your power. Recover memories; face the truth

details.title: Amaterasu in Hell
details.short_description: You are Amaterasu, the Japanese sun goddess, and circumstances force you to explore the realms of shadow to retrieve the former pets you once mistreated and cast into the Buddhist underworld. Between descents into the underworld, players can unwind in a cavern hub and converse with their animals.

details.title: Path to Transcendence（追境）
details.short_description: Path to Transcendence : a Chinese story driven auditory puzzle game. The story takes place in the Northern Song Dynasty, spanning 30 years from Qinling Mountains to Bianjing. The narrative mainly revolves around light puzzles. Make an appointment to follow and wait for good news.

details.title: Knights of Jikan
details.short_description: Six heroes must travel back in time to defeat a powerful enemy and save the kingdom of Jikan!

details.title: こもれびの丘
details.short_description: I accidentally overslept on the train and ended up in some kind of mysterious towns. This is a relaxing, slow-life game where you wander around the streets freely, meet the locals, and feel the changing seasons together with the main character, Rifa, who unexpectedly became the town's representative

details.title: Fallen Dungeons
details.short_description: Fallen Dungeons is a grid-based dungeon crawler which melds modern aesthetics and mechanics with old school game design.

details.title: Chi Chi's Magic Wash
details.short_description: Help Chi Chi clean grime and master her magical cleaning prowess. Make her parents proud in this cozy witchy cleaning sim. Clean with a spell-powered wand, explore charming locations, find potions, and bring sparkle back to every corner of the enchanted world.

details.title: Pain-Hatching
details.short_description: Game about a rooster, friendship, family, a cult, WOMAN, and chthonic horrors.

details.title: Kiss Magic Curse:the accursed child
details.short_description: One sneeze turns you—a young noble heir—into a stunning woman?! Now, a loyal knight, an elegant fiancée, a sharp-tongued tutor, and a mysterious wizard are turning your life upside down! Uncover secrets, find love, and shape your destiny in this gender-bending rom-com VN with BL & BG routes!

details.title: This Little World
details.short_description: Britain has fallen silent. In a vast 1:1 recreation of the entire island, built from real-world data, begin on foot and bring harmony back to the land: restoring every road, valley, field, town, and tree. Unlock vehicles, reconnect regions, and explore all 200,000 km² of England, Wales and Scotland.

details.title: The Energy Case
